verses.t: Yeshu ka janm is tarah hua: unki maata Mariyam ka vivaah Yosef se tay ho chuka tha lekin isse pahle ki unmein sahvaas hota, yah maalum hua ki Mariyam garbhavti hain—yah garbh Holy Spirit dvaara tha.
Unke pati Yosef ek righteous aadmi the. Ve nahin chaahte the ki Mariyam ko kisi tarah se lajjit hona pare. Isliye unhonne kisi par reveal kie bina Mariyam ko tyaag dene ka nirnay kiya.

Lekin jab unhonne yah nishchay kar liya, Lord ke ek dut ne svapn mein reveal ho unse kaha, “Yosef, David ke vanshaj! Mariyam ko apni patni ke taur par svikaarne mein daro mat; kyonki, jo unke garbh mein hain, vah Holy Spirit se hain.
Vah ek son ko janm deingi. Tum unka naam Yeshu rakhna kyonki vah apne logon ko unke galtiyon se bachaav deinge.”
Yah sab isliye ghatit hua ki prophet ke maadhyam se kaha gaya Lord ka yah vachan pura ho jaae:
“Ek kunvaari kanya garbhdhaaran karegi, son ko janm degi aur use immaanuel naam se pukaara jaayega.” Immaanuel ka arth hai God hamaare saath.
Jaagne par Yosef ne vaisa hi kiya jaisa Lord ke dut ne unhein command di thi—unhonne Mariyam ko patni ke taur par accept kiya,
Lekin son-janm tak unka kaumaary surakshit rakha aur unhonne son ka naam Yeshu rakha.
Jab raaja Herodes ke shaasankaal mein Yahudiya pradesh ke bethlehem shehar mein Yeshu ka janm hua, tab purvvarti deshon se jyotish Yerushalem shehar aae aur puchhtaachh karne lage,
“Kahaan hain vah—Yahudiyon ke raaja, jinhonne janm liya hai? Purvvarti deshon mein hamne unka taara dekha hai aur ham unki worship karne ke lie yahaan aae hain.”
Yah sun raaja Herodes vyaakul ho utha aur uske saath sabhi Yerushalem nivaasi bhi.
Raaja Herodes ne leader priests aur shaastriyon ko ikattha kar unse puchhtaachh ki ki vah kaun sa jagah hai jahaan Yeshu ke janm lene ka sanket hai?
Unhonne javaab diya, “Yahudiya pradesh ke bethlehem shehar mein, kyonki prophet ka lekh hai:

“ ‘Aur tum, Yahudiya pradesh ke bethlehem shehar, Yahudiya pradesh ke naaykon ke beech kisi bhi riti se chhote nahin ho kyonki tummein se hi ek raaja ka aagman hoga, jo meri people Israel ka charvaaha hoga.’”
Isliye Herodes ne jyotishiyon ko alag le jaakar unse us taare ke uday hone ka thik-thik samay maalum kiya
Aur unhein bethlehem shehar bhejte hue kaha, “Aap log jaakar saavdhaanipurvak us baalak ki khoj kijie aur jab vah aapko mil jaae to mujhe iski suchna dijie ki main bhi uski vandna karne ja sakun.”

Raaja ki command sun unhonne apni yaatra dobaara shuruaat ki. Unhein vahi taara dikhaai diya, jo unhonne purvvarti deshon mein dekha tha. Ve uske darshan mein aage barhte chale gae jab tak vah taara us baalak ke ghar par jaakar thahar na gaya.
Use dekhkar ve bare khushi se bhar gae.

Ghar mein pravesh karne par unhonne us baalak ko uski maata Mariyam ke saath dekha aur jhukkar us baalak ki worship ki aur phir unhonne apne kimti uphaar sona, lobaan aur gandhras use bheint charhaai.
Unhein svapn mein God dvaara yah chetaavni di gai ki ve raaja Herodes ke paas lautkar na jaaein. Isliye ve ek dusre raasta se apne desh laut gae.

Unke vida hone ke baad Lord ka ek dut ne Yosef ko ek svapn mein reveal hokar command di, “Utho, baalak aur uski maata ko lekar misr desh ko bhaag jaao aur us samay tak vahin thahre rahna jab tak main tumhein command na dun kyonki Herodes murder ki mansha se baalak ko khoj raha hai.”
Isliye Yosef uthe aur abhi, jabki raat hi thi, unhonne baalak aur uski maata ko lekar misr desh ko prasthaan kiya.
Ve vahaan Herodes ki maut tak thahre rahe ki Lord ka yah vachan pura ho, jo unhonne ek prophet ke maadhyam se kaha tha: “Misr desh se mainne apne son ko bulaaya.”

Yah maalum hone par ki jyotish use bewakoof bana gae, Herodes bahut hi krodhit hua. Jyotishiyon se mili suchna ke aadhaar par usne bethlehem shehar aur uske nazdiki kshetr mein do varsh aur usse kam aayu ke sabhi shishuon ke vinaash ki command de di.
Isse prophet yeremiyaah dvaara purvghoshit is vachan ki purti hui:
“Ramaah shehar mein ek word suna gaya, rona aur ghor vilaap! Raahel apne baalkon ke lie ro rahi hai. Sabr use accept nahin kyonki ab ve hain hi nahin.”
Jab raaja Herodes ki maut hui, Lord ke ek dut ne svapn mein reveal hokar Yosef ko command di,
“Utho! Baalak aur uski maata ko lekar Israel desh laut jaao kyonki jo baalak ke jaan lene par utaaru the, unki maut ho chuki hai.”
Isliye Yosef uthe aur baalak aur uski maata ko lekar Israel desh mein laut aae.

Yah maalum hone par ki Herodes ke jagah par ab uska son aarkhelaaos Yahudiya pradesh ka raaja hai, dar ke kaaran vah vahaan nahin gae. Tab God ki or se svapn mein chetaavni receive hone par vah Galil pradesh ki or chal die
Aur naazreth naamak shehar mein jaakar bas gae ki prophets dvaara kaha gaya-yah vachan pura ho: vah naazri kahlaaega.

Yah vahi hain jinke baare mein prophet yashaayaah ne apne abhilekh mein is tarah sanket diya hai: “Vah aavaaj, jo banjar zameen mein pukaar-pukaarkar kah rahi hai, ‘Lord ka raasta sidha karo, unka raasta saral banaao.’ ”
Baptisma denevaale Yohan ka paridhaan unt ke rom se nirmit kapde aur uske upar chamre ka kamarbandh tha, aur unka khaana tha tiddiyaan aur janglimdhu.
Yerushalem shehar, saare Yahudiya pradesh aur yardan nadi ke nazdiki kshetr se bari sankhya mein log unke paas aane lage.
Galtiyon ko maanne ke baad Yohan unhein yardan nadi mein baptisma diya karte the.
Sachche man phiraane ka pramaan do
Aur aisa mat socho ki aap kah sakte hain, ‘Ham to Abraham ki children hain!’ Kyonki main tumhein bataata hun ki God mein in patthron tak se Abraham ki children paida karne ka power hai.

“Main to tumhein pashchaataap ke lie paani se baptisma de raha hun lekin vah, jo mere baad a rahe hain, mujhse adhik shaktishaali hain. Main to is yogy bhi nahin ki unki jutiyaan uthaaun. Vah tumhein Holy Spirit aur aag mein baptisma deinge.
Yeshu Galil pradesh se yardan nadi par Yohan ke paas aae ki unke dvaara baptisma lein
Lekin Yohan ne iska inkaar karte hue kaha, “Zaruri to yah hai ki main aapse baptisma lun. Yahaan to aap mujhse baptisma lene aae hain!”
Yeshu ne iske uttar mein kaha, “Is samay to yahi hone do. Ham donon ke lie God dvaara nirdhaarit righteousness isi riti se puri karna sahi hai.” Is par Yohan sahmat ho gae.
Baptisma ke baad jaise hi Yeshu paani mein se baahar aae, unke lie heaven khol diya gaya aur Yohan ne God ke aatma ko kabutar ke jaisa utarte hue aur Yeshu par thaharte dekha.
Usi samay heaven se yah word suna gaya, “Yah mera son hai—mera param dear—jisse main puri tarah prasann hun.”
Iske baad Holy Spirit ke nirdesh mein Yeshu ko banjar zameen le jaaya gaya ki vah aarop lagaanevaala dvaara parkhe jaaein.
Unhonne chaalis din aur chaalis raat upvaas kiya. Uske baad jab unhein bhukh lagi,
Parakhne vaale ne unke paas aakar kaha, “Yadi tum God-son ho to in patthron ko command do ki ye roti ban jaaein.”
Yeshu ne use javaab diya, “Insaan ka life sirph khaana par nahin, balki God ke chehra se nikle hue har ek word par bhi nirbhar hai.”
Tab aarop lagaanevaala ne Yeshu ko holy shehar mein le jaakar temple ke shirsh par khara kar diya

Aur unse kaha, “Yadi tum God-son ho to yahaan se niche kud jaao, kyonki likha hai, “Vah apne angels ko tumhaare sambandh mein command deinge aur ve tumhein haathon-haath utha leinge ki tumhaare pair ko patthar se chot na lage.”
Uske uttar mein Yeshu ne usse kaha, “Yah bhi to likha hai tum Lord apne God ko na parkho.”
Tab aarop lagaanevaala Yeshu ko bahut unche parvat par le gaya aur vishv ke saare raajy aur unka saara aishvary dikhaate hue unse kaha,
“Main ye sab tumhein de dunga yadi tum meri dandvat-vandna karo.”
Is par Yeshu ne use javaab diya, “Hat, aarop lagaanevaala! Dur ho! Kyonki likha hai, tum sirph Lord apne God ki hi worship aur service kiya karo.”
Tab aarop lagaanevaala unhein chhorkar chala gaya aur angel aae aur unki service karne lage.
Yah maalum hone par ki baptisma denevaale Yohan ko bandi bana liya gaya hai, Yeshu Galil pradesh mein chale gae,
Aur naazreth shehar ko chhor kafranhum shehar mein bas gae, jo jhil tat par zebulun aur naphtaali naamak kshetr mein tha.
Aisa isliye hua ki prophet yashaayaah ki yah bhavishyvaani puri ho:
Yardan nadi ke paar samudrtat par base zebulun aur naphtaali pradesh arthaat Galil pradesh mein, jahaan gair-israaeli base hue hain,
Andhera mein ji rahe logon ne ek bari roshni ko dekha; gahan andhera ke nivaasiyon par roshni chamki.
Ek din Galil jhil ke kinaare chalte hue Yeshu ne do bhaaiyon ko dekha: Shimon, jo Petros kahlaae aur unke bhaai aandreyaas ko. Ye samudr mein jaal daal rahe the kyonki ve machhuaare the.
Ve usi kshan apne jaal chhorkar Yeshu ka anusran karne lage.

Jab ve vahaan se aage barhe to Yeshu ne do dusre bhaaiyon ko dekha—zebediyos ke son Yaakob aur unke bhaai Yohan ko. Ve donon apne pita ke saath naav mein apne jaal thik kar rahe the. Yeshu ne unhein bulaaya.
Usi kshan ve naav aur apne pita ko chhor Yeshu ke pichhe ho lie.

Saare siriya pradesh mein unke baare mein samaachaar phailta chala gaya aur log unke paas un sabko laane lage, jo rogi the aur unhein bhi, jo vividh rogon, piraaon, dard denevaali aatma, murchchha rogon aur pakshaaghaat se pirit the. Yeshu in sabhi ko svasth karte ja rahe the.
Galil pradesh, dekaapolis, Yerushalem, Yahudiya pradesh aur yardan nadi ke paar se bari bhir unke pichhe-pichhe chali ja rahi thi.
Ikattha ho rahi bhir ko dekh Yeshu parvat par chale gae aur jab vah baith gae to unke disciple unke paas aae.
Yeshu ne unhein teaching dena shuruaat kiya.
“Blessed hain ve, jo din aatma ke hain, kyonki heaven ka kingdom unhin ka hai.
Blessed hain ve, jo shok karte hain. Kyonki unhein shaanti di jaaegi.
Blessed hain ve, jo namr hain kyonki prithvi unhin ki hogi.
Blessed hain ve, jo dharm ke bhukhe aur pyaase hain, kyonki unhein tript kiya jaaega.
Blessed hain ve, jo kind hain, kyonki un par grace ki jaaegi.
Blessed hain ve, jinke dil shuddh hain, kyonki ve God ko dekheinge.
Blessed hain ve, jo shaanti karaane vaale hain, kyonki ve God ki children kahlaaeinge.
Blessed hain ve, jo dharm ke kaaran sataae gae hain, kyonki heaven ka kingdom unhin ka hai.

“Tum prithvi ke namak ho, lekin yadi namak namkin na rahe to uske khaarepan ko dobaara kaise lautaaya ja sakega? Tab to vah kisi bhi upyog ka nahin sivaay iske ki use baahar pheink diya jaae aur log use raundte hue nikal jaaein.
“Tum duniya ke lie roshni ho. Pahaari par sthit shehar ko chhipaaya nahin ja sakta.
Koi bhi jalte hue dip ko kisi bartan se dhaank kar nahin rakhta; use uske nirdhaarit jagah par rakha jaata hai ki vah us ghar mein upasthit logon ko prakaash de.
Logon ke saamne apna prakaash is riti se prakaashit hone do ki ve tumhaare bhale kaamon ko dekh sakein aur tumhaare pita ki, jo heaven mein hain, glory karein.
“Apne man se yah soch nikaal do ki mere aane ka purpose law aur bhavishyadvaktaaon ke lekhon ko vyarth saabit karna hai—unhein pura karna hi mera purpose hai.
Main tum par ek sach reveal kar raha hun: jab tak aakaash aur prithvi astitv mein hain, Scripture ka ek bhi bindu ya maatra gum na hogi, jab tak sab kuchh barbaad na ho jaae.

Isliye jo koi inmein se chhoti si chhoti command ko torta aur anyon ko yahi karne ki teaching deta hai, heaven ka kingdom mein sabse chhota ghoshit kiya jaaega. Iske viprit, jo koi in orders ka follow karta aur inki teaching deta hai, heaven ka kingdom mein vishisht ghoshit kiya jaaega.

Main tumhein is sach se bhi parichit kara dun: yadi God ke prati tumhaari righteousness shaastriyon aur Farisiyon ki righteousness se barhkar na ho to tum kisi bhi riti se heaven ka kingdom mein pravesh na kar sakoge.
“Yah to tum sun hi chuke ho ki purvjon ko yah command di gai thi, ‘Murder mat karo aur jo koi murder karta hai, vah nyaayaalay ke prati uttardaayi hoga’;

Lekin mera tumse kahna hai ki har ek, jo apne bhaai-bahan se gussa karta hai, vah nyaayaalay ke saamne doshi hoga aur jo koi apne bhaai se kahe, ‘Are nikamme!’ Vah sarvochch nyaayaalay ke prati apraadh ka doshi hoga aur vah, jo kahe, ‘Are bewakoof!’ Vah to narak ki aag ke yogy doshi hoga.
“Isliye, yadi tum vedi par apni bheint charhaane ja rahe ho aur vahaan tumhein yah yaad aae ki tumhaare bhaai ke man mein tumhaare prati virodh hai,
Apni bheint vedi ke paas hi chhor do aur jaakar sabse pahle apne bhaai se mel-milaap karo aur tab lautkar apni bheint charhaao.

“Nyaayaalay jaate hue raasta mein hi apne dushman se mitrta ka sambandh phir se bana lo ki tumhaara dushman tumhein nyaayaadhish ke haath mein na saumpe aur nyaayaadhish adhikaari ke aur adhikaari tumhein bandigrih mein daal dein.
Main tumhein is sach se parichit karaana chaahta hun ki jab tak tum ek-ek paisa lauta na do bandigrih se chhut na paaoge.
“Yah to tum sun hi chuke ho ki yah kaha gaya tha: ‘Vyabhichaar mat karo.’
Lekin mera tumse kahna hai ki har ek, jo kisi aurat ko kaamuk nazar se sirf dekh leta hai, vah apne man mein uske saath vyabhichaar kar chuka.
“Yah kaha gaya tha: ‘Koi bhi, jo apni patni se talaak chaahe, vah use alag hone ka pramaan-patr de.’

Lekin mera tumse kahna hai ki har ek, jo vaivaahik vyabhichaar ke alaava kisi dusre kaaran se apni patni se talaak leta hai, vah apni patni ko vyabhichaar ki or dhakelta hai aur jo koi us tyaagi hui se vivaah karta hai, vyabhichaar karta hai.
“Tumhein maalum hoga ki purvjon se kaha gaya tha: ‘Jhuthi shapath mat lo lekin Lord se ki gai shapath ko pura karo.’
Lekin mera tumse kahna hai ki shapath hi na lo; na to heaven ki, kyonki vah God ka sinhaasan hai,
Na prithvi ki, kyonki vah unke charnon ki chauki hai, na Yerushalem ki, kyonki vah raajaadhiraaj ka shehar hai
Aur na hi apne sir ki, kyonki tum ek bhi baal na to kaala karne mein samarth ho aur na hi safed karne mein;
Lekin tumhaari baato mein ‘Haan’ Ka matlab haan aur ‘Na’ Ka na ho—jo kuchh inke atirikt hai, vah us evil dvaara apostle hai.
“Tumhein yah to maalum hai ki yah kaha gaya tha: ‘Aankh ke lie aankh aur daant ke lie daant.’
Lekin mera tumse kahna hai ki bure person ka saamna hi na karo. Iske viprit, jo koi tumhaare daayein gaal par thappar maare, dusra gaal bhi uski or kar do.
Yadi koi tumhein nyaayaalay mein ghasitkar tumhaara kurta lena chaahe to use apni chaadar bhi de do.
Jo koi tumhein ek kilomitar chalne ke lie majbur kare uske saath do kilomitar chale jaao.
Use, jo tumse kuchh maange, de do aur jo tumse udhaar lena chaahe, usse apna chehra na chhipaao.
“Tumhein yah to maalum hai ki yah kaha gaya tha: ‘Apne parosi se love karo aur apne dushman se nafrat.’
Lekin mera tumse kahna hai ki apne dushmanon se love karo aur apne sataanevaalon ke lie prayer;
Ki tum apne svargiy pita ki children ho jaao, kyonki ve bure aur bhale donon par hi suryoday karte hain. Isi tarah ve righteous aur adharmi, donon par hi varsha hone dete hain.
Yadi tum love sirf unhin se karte ho, jo tumse love karte hain to tum kis pratiphal ke adhikaari ho? Kya chungi lenevaale bhi yahi nahin karte?
Yadi tum sirf apne bandhuon ka hi namaskaar karte ho to tum anyon se atirikt aisa kaun sa saraahniy kaam kar rahe ho? Kya gair-Yahudi bhi aisa hi nahin karte?
Isliye zaruri hai ki tum siddh bano, jaise tumhaare svargiy pita siddh hain.
“Dhyaan rahe ki tum logon ki prashansa paane ke purpose se dharm ke kaam na karo anytha tumhein tumhaare svargiy pita se koi bhi pratiphal receive na hoga.

“Jab tum daan do tab iska dhindhora na pito, jaisa paakhandi Yahudi sabhaagrihon aur sarkon par kiya karte hain ki ve insaanon dvaara sammaanit kie jaaein. Sach to yah hai ki ve apna pura-pura pratiphal receive kar chuke;
Lekin tum jab zaruratmandon ko daan do to tumhaare baayein haath ko yah maalum na ho sake ki tumhaara daayaan haath kya kar raha hai
Ki tumhaari daan prakriya puri tarah gupt rahe. Tab tumhaare pita, jo antaryaami hain, tumhein pratiphal deinge.

“Prayer karte hue tumhaari mudra dikhaava karnevaale logon ke jaisa na ho kyonki unki ruchi Yahudi sabhaagrihon mein aur nukkron par khare hokar prayer karne mein hoti hai ki un par logon ki nazar parti rahe. Main tum par yah sach prakaashit kar raha hun ki ve apna pura-pura pratiphal receive kar chuke.
Iske viprit jab tum prayer karo, tum apni kothri mein chale jaao, dvaar band kar lo aur apne pita se, jo adrishy hain, prayer karo aur tumhaare pita, jo antaryaami hain, tumhein pratiphal deinge.
“Apni prayer mein arthhin words ko dohraate na jaao, jaisa gair-Yahudi karte hain kyonki unka soch hai ki words ke adhik hone ke kaaran hi unki prayer suni jaaegi.
Isliye unke jaise na bano kyonki tumhaare svargiy pita ko request karne se pahle hi tumhaari zarurat ka ahsaas rahta hai.
“Tum prayer is tarah kiya karo: “Hamaare svargik pita, aapka naam holy maana jaae.
Aapka raajy har jagah ho. Aapki chaahat puri ho, jis tarah heaven mein usi tarah prithvi par bhi.
Aaj hamein hamaara dainik aahaar provide kijie.
Aap hamaare apraadhon ki maafi kijie jaise hamne unhein maafi kiya hai, jinhonne hamaare khilaaf apraadh kie the.
Hamein pariksha se bachaakar us evil se hamaari raksha kijie kyonki raajy, power aur prataap hamesha-hamesha aap hi ka hai, aamen.
Yadi tum dusron ko unke apraadhon ke lie maafi karte ho to tumhaare svargiy pita bhi tumhein maafi kareinge.
Lekin yadi tum dusron ke apraadh maafi nahin karte ho to tumhaare svargiy pita bhi tumhaare apraadh maafi nahin kareinge.

“Jab kabhi tum upvaas rakho tab paakhandiyon ke jaisa apna munh murjhaaya hua na bana lo. Ve apna rup aisa isliye bana lete hain ki logon ki nazar un par zarur pare. Sach to yah hai ki ve apna pura-pura pratiphal receive kar chuke.
Lekin jab tum upvaas karo to apne baal sanvaaro aur apna munh dho lo
Ki tumhaare upvaas ke baare mein sivaay tumhaare svargiy pita ke—jo adrishy hain—kisi ko bhi maalum na ho. Tab tumhaare pita, jo antaryaami hain, tumhein pratiphal deinge.
“Prithvi par apne lie wealth ikattha na karo, jahaan kit-patange aur jang use barbaadi karte aur chor seindh lagaakar churaate hain
Kyonki jahaan tumhaara wealth hai, vahin tumhaara man bhi hoga.
“Body ka dipak aankh hai. Isliye yadi tumhaari aankh nirogi hai, tumhaara saara body ujiyaala hoga.
Yadi tumhaari aankh rogi hai, tumhaara saara body andhkaarmay ho jaaega. Vah ujiyaala, jo tummein hai, yadi vah andhera hai to kitna gahan hoga vah andhera!

“Koi bhi person do svaamiyon ki service nahin kar sakta kyonki vah ek ko tuchchh maankar dusre ke prati samarpit rahega ya ek ka sammaan karte hue dusre ko tuchchh jaanega. Tum God aur wealth donon ki service kar hi nahin sakte.

“Yahi kaaran hai ki main tumse kahta hun ki apne life ke baare mein chinta na karo ki tum kya khaaoge aur kya pioge; aur na hi body ke baare mein ki kya pahnoge. Kya life aahaar se aur body kapdon se adhik kimti nahin?

Pakshiyon ki or dhyaan do: ve na to bij bote hain, aur na hi khalihaan mein upaj ikattha karte hain. Phir bhi tumhaare svargiy pita unka bharan-poshan karte hain. Kya tum unse kahin jyaada mulyvaan nahin?
Aur tummein aisa kaun hai, jo chinta ke dvaara apni aayu mein ek kshan ki bhi vriddhi kar sakta hai?
“Aur kapde tumhaari chinta ka vishay kyon? Maidaan ke phulon ka dhyaan to karo ki ve kaise khilte hain. Ve na to parishram karte hain aur na hi kapde nirmaan.
Phir bhi main tumse kahta hun ki shalomon ki veshbhusha ka aishvary kisi bhi nazar se inke tuly nahin tha.

Yadi God ghaas ka shrringaar is sima tak karte hain, jiska life thore samay ka hai aur jo kal aag mein jhonk diya jaaega, to kya vah tumko kahin adhik sushobhit na kareinge? Kaisa kamjor hai tumhaara faith!
Islie is baare mein chinta na karo, ‘Ham kya khaaeinge ya kya pieinge’ Ya ‘Hamaare kapdon ka prabandh kaise hoga?’
Gair-Yahudi hi in vastuon ke lie koshish karte rahte hain. Tumhaare svargiy pita ko yah maalum hai ki tumhein in sab ki zarurat hai.
Sabse pahle God ke kingdom ki aur unki righteousness ki khoj karo, aur ye sabhi vastuein tumhein di jaaeingi.
Isliye kal ki chinta na karo—kal apni chinta khud karega kyonki har ek din apne saath apna hi paryaapt duhkh lie hue aata hai.
“Kisi par bhi dosh na lagaao, to log tum par bhi dosh nahin lagaaeinge
Kyonki jaise tum kisi par dosh lagaate ho, usi tarah tum par bhi dosh lagaaya jaaega aur maap ke lie tum jis bartan ka prayog karte ho vahi tumhaare lie istemaal kiya jaaega.
“Tum bhala apne bhaai ki aankh ke kan ki or ungli kyon uthaate ho jabki tum khud apni aankh mein pare latthe ki or dhyaan nahin dete?
Ya tum bhala yah kaise kah sakte ho ‘Zara thahro, main tumhaari aankh se vah kan nikaal deta hun,’ Jabki tumhaari apni aankh mein to lattha para hua hai?
Are paakhandi! Pahle to khud apni aankh mein se us latthe ko to nikaal! Tabhi tu spasht rup se dekh sakega aur apne bhaai ki aankh mein se us kan ko nikaal sakega.
“Request karo, to tumhein diya jaaega; khojo, to tum paaoge; dvaar khatakhtaao, to vah tumhaare lie khol diya jaaega
Kyonki har ek, jo request karta hai, uski request puri ki jaati hai, jo khojta hai, vah receive karta hai aur vah, jo dvaar khatakhtaata hai, uske lie dvaar khol diya jaata hai.
“Tummein aisa kaun hai ki jab uska son usse roti ki maang karta hai to use patthar deta hai
Ya machhli ki maang karne par saamp?

Jab tum evil hone par bhi apni children ko uttam vastuein provide karna jaante ho to tumhaare svargiy pita unhein, jo unse request karte hain, kahin adhik barhkar vah provide na kareinge, jo uttam hai?
Isliye har ek paristhiti mein logon se tumhaara vyavhaar thik vaisa hi ho jaise vyavhaar ki ummid tum unse apne lie karte ho kyonki law aur bhavishyadvaktaaon ki teaching bhi yahi hai.
“Jhuthe bhavishyadvaktaaon se saavdhaan raho, jo bheron ke vesh mein tumhaare bich a jaate hain, lekin vaastav mein ve bhukhe bheriye hote hain.
Unke svabhaav se tum unhein pahchaan jaaoge. Na to kantili jhaariyon mein se angur aur na hi gokhru se anjir ikatthe kie jaate hain.
Vastuth har ek uttam per uttam phal hi phalta hai aur bura per bura phal.
Yah sambhav hi nahin ki uttam per bura phal de aur bura per uttam phal.
Isliye unke svabhaav se tum unhein pahchaan loge.
“Isliye har ek ki tulna, jo meri in teachings ko sunkar unka follow karta hai, us wise person se ki ja sakti hai, jisne apne bhavan ka nirmaan chattaan par kiya.
Aandhi uthi, varsha hui, baarh aai aur us bhavan par thapere pare, phir bhi vah bhavan sthir khara raha kyonki uski ninv chattaan par thi.
Iske viprit har ek jo, meri in teachings ko sunta to hai lekin unka follow nahin karta, vah us nirbuddhi ke jaisa hoga jisne apne bhavan ka nirmaan ret par kiya.
Aandhi uthi, varsha hui, baarh aai, us bhavan par thapere pare aur vah dharaashaayi ho gaya—bhayaavah tha uska vinaash!”
Jab Yeshu ne yah shikshaaein din, bhir aashcharyachkit rah gai
Kyonki Yeshu ki teaching-shaili adhikaarpurn thi, na ki shaastriyon ke jaisa.
Jab Yeshu parvat se utarkar aae tab bari bhir unke pichhe-pichhe chalne lagi.
Ek korh ke rogi ne unke saamne jhukkar unse request karke kaha, “Lord, yadi aap chaahein to mujhe shuddh kar sakte hain.”
Yeshu ne haath barhaakar use sparsh karte hue kaha, “Main chaahta hun. Shuddh ho jaao.” Vah usi kshan korh rog se shuddh ho gaya.

Yeshu ne use command di, “Yah dhyaan rahe ki tum iske baare mein kisi ko na bataao. Ab jaakar priest ke saamne khud ko parikshan ke lie prastut karo, aur Moshe dvaara nirdhaarit bali bheint karo ki tumhaara svaasthy-laabh unke saamne gavaahi ho jaae.”
Jab Yeshu ne kafranhum shehar mein pravesh kiya, tab ek shataadhipti ne aakar unse namrtaapurvak nivedan kiya,
“Lord, ghar par mera servant lakva rog se pirit hai aur vah ghor dard mein hai.”
Yeshu ne use aashvaasan diya, “Main aakar use changa karunga.”
Lekin shataadhipti ne kaha, “Nahin Lord, nahin, main is yogy nahin ki aap mere ghar aaein. Aap keval munh se kah dijie aur mera servant svasth ho jaaega.

Main khud bare adhikaariyon ke adhin niyukt hun aur sainik mere authority mein hain. Main kisi ko order deta hun, ‘Jaao!’ To vah jaata hai, aur kisi ko order deta hun, ‘Idhar aao!’ To vah aata hai. Apne servant se kahta hun, ‘Yah karo!’ To vah vahi karta hai.”
Yah sunkar Yeshu aashcharyachkit rah gae. Unhonne pichhe a rahi bhir se kaha, “Yah ek sach hai ki mainne Israel raashtr mein bhi kisi mein aisa faith nahin dekha.
Main tumhein suchit karna chaahta hun ki heaven ka kingdom mein Abraham, yitshaak aur Yaakob ke saath bhoj mein shaamil hone ke lie purv aur pashchim dishaaon se anekaanek aakar sangti kareinge,
Tab Yeshu ne shataadhipti se kaha, “Jaao, tumhaare lie vaisa hi hoga jaisa tumhaara faith hai.” Usi kshan vah servant changa ho gaya.
Jab Yeshu Petros ke ghar par aae, unhonne unki saas ko bukhaar se pirit paaya.
Unhonne unke haath ka sparsh kiya aur vah bukhaar se mukt ho gai aur uthkar un sab ki service karne mein jut gai.
Jab sandhya hui tab log dard denevaali aatma se pirit logon ko unke paas laane lage aur Yeshu apne vachan sirf se unhein dard denevaali aatma mukt karte gae, saath hi rogiyon ko svasth.
Yah prophet yashaayaah dvaara ki gai is bhavishyvaani ki purti thi: “Unhonne khud hamaari durbaltaaon ko apne upar le liya aur hamaare rogon ko utha liya.”
Apne aas-paas bhir ko dekh Yeshu ne disciples ko jhil ki dusri or jaane ki command di.
Usi samay ek shaastri ne aakar Yeshu se request ki, “Guruvar, aap jahaan kahin jaaeinge, main aapke saath rahunga.”
Yeshu ne uske uttar mein kaha, “Lomriyon ke paas unki guphaaein aur aakaash ke pakshiyon ke paas unke basere hote hain, lekin insaan ke son ke paas to sir rakhne tak ka jagah nahin hai!”
Ek dusre disciple ne unse request ki, “Lord mujhe pahle apne pita ki antyeshti ki anumti de dijie.”
Jab unhonne naav mein pravesh kiya unke disciple bhi unke saath ho lie.
Achaanak jhil mein aisa prachand aandhi uthi ki lahron ne naav ko dhaank liya, lekin Yeshu is samay so rahe the.
Is par disciples ne Yeshu ke paas jaakar unhein jagaate hue kaha, “Lord, hamaari raksha kijie, ham barbaadi hue ja rahe hain!”
Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Kyon dar rahe ho, alpvishvaasiyo!” Vah uthe aur unhonne aandhi aur jhil ko daanta, aur usi kshan hi puri shaanti chha gai.
Disciple hairaan rah gae, aur soch karne lage, “Ye kis tarah ke person hain ki aandhi aur jhil tak inki command ka follow karte hain!”

Jhil paar kar ve gadaara naamak pradesh mein aae. Vahaan kabron ki guphaaon se nikalkar dard denevaali aatma se pirit do person unke saamne a gae. Ve donon itne adhik hinsak the ki koi bhi us raaste se nikal nahin paata tha.
Yeshu ko dekh ve donon chilla-chillaakar kahne lage, “God-son, aapka hamse kya lena dena? Kya aap samay se pahle hi hamein duhkh dene a pahunche hain?”
Vahaan kuchh dur suaron ka ek jhund char raha tha.
Dard denevaali aatma Yeshu se request karne lage, “Yadi aap hamein baahar nikaal hi rahe hain, to hamein in suaron ke jhund mein bhej dijie.”
Yeshu ne unhein command di, “Jaao!” Ve nikalkar suaron mein pravesh kar gae aur pura jhund dhalaan par sarpat bhaagta hua jhil mein ja gira aur dub gaya.
Rakhvaale bhaage aur shehar mein jaakar ghatna ka saara haal kah sunaaya; saath hi yah bhi ki un dard denevaali aatma se pirit logon ke saath kya-kya hua.
Sabhi naagrik shehar se nikalkar Yeshu ke paas aane lage. Jab unhonne Yeshu ko dekha to unse request karne lage ki vah us kshetr ki sima se baahar chale jaaein.
Isliye Yeshu naav mein savaar hokar jhil paar karke apne hi shehar mein a gae.
Kuchh log ek lakva pirit ko bichhaune par unke paas laae. Unka faith dekh Yeshu ne rogi se kaha, “Tumhaare lie yah khushi ka vishay hai: tumhaare galti maafi ho gae hain.”
Kuchh shaastri aapas mein kahne lage, “Yah to God ki ninda kar raha hai!”
Unke vichaaron ka ahsaas hone par Yeshu unhein sambodhit kar bole, “Kyon apne manon mein bura soch kar rahe ho?
Kya kahna saral hai, ‘Tumhaare galti maafi ho gae’ Ya ‘Utho, chalne lago?’

Lekin iska purpose yah hai ki tumhein yah maalum ho jaae ki insaan ke son ko prithvi par galti maafi ka authority saumpa gaya hai.” Tab rogi se Yeshu ne kaha, “Utho, apna bichhauna uthaao aur apne ghar jaao.”
Vah utha aur ghar chala gaya.
Yah dekh bhir hairaan rah gai aur God ka gungaan karne lagi, jinhonne insaanon ko is tarah ka authority diya hai.

Vahaan se jaane ke baad Yeshu ne chungi lenevaale ke aasan par baithe hue ek person ko dekha, jiska naam mattiyaah tha. Yeshu ne use command di, “Mere pichhe ho le.” Mattiyaah uthkar Yeshu ke saath ho lie.
Jab Yeshu khaana ke lie baithe the, kai chungi lenevaale aur apraadhi person bhi unke saath shaamil the.
Yah dekh Farisiyon ne aapatti uthaate hue Yeshu ke disciples se kaha, “Tumhaare guru chungi lenevaale aur apraadhi logon ke saath khaana kyon karte hain?”
Yah sun Yeshu ne spasht kiya, “Chikitsak ki zarurat svasth person ko nahin lekin rogi person ko hoti hai.
Ab jaao aur is kahaavat ka arth samjho: ‘Main balidaan se nahin, par daya se prasann hota hun,’ Kyonki main dharmiyon ko nahin lekin galti karnevaalon ko bulaane ke lie is prithvi par aaya hun.”
Baptisma denevaale Yohan ke disciple Yeshu ke paas aae aur unse savaal kiya, “Kya kaaran hai ki Farisi aur ham to upvaas karte hain lekin aapke disciple nahin?”
Yeshu ne unhein samjhaaya: “Kya yah sambhav hai ki dulhe ke hote hue baaraati vilaap karein? Haan, aisa samay aaega jab dulha unse alag kar diya jaaega—tab ve upvaas kareinge.
“Puraane kapde mein koi bhi naye kapre ka jor nahin lagaata, nahin to kora kapde ka jor sikur kar kapde se alag ho jaata hai aur kapde aur bhi adhik phat jaata hai.

Vaise hi log nae daakhras ko puraani mashkon mein nahin rakhte; anytha ve phat jaati hain aur daakhras to bahkar barbaadi ho hi jaata hai, saath hi mashke bhi. Naya daakhras nai mashkon mein hi rakha jaata hai. Parinaamasvrup donon hi surakshit rahte hain.”

Jab Yeshu un logon se in vishyon par baatchit kar rahe the, Yahudi synagogue ka ek adhikaari unke paas aaya aur unke saamne jhukkar request karne laga, “Kuchh der pahle hi meri putri ki maut hui hai. Aap kripya aakar us par haath rakh dijie aur vah jivit ho jaaegi.”
Yeshu aur unke disciple uske saath chale gae.
Raasta mein baarah varsh se lahusraav-pirit ek aurat ne pichhe se aakar Yeshu ke kapde ke chhor ko chhua,
Kyonki usne apne man mein yah kaha tha: “Yadi main unke kapde ko bhi chhu lun, to main rogmukt ho jaaungi.”
Yeshu ne pichhe murkar use dekha aur usse kaha, “Tumhaare lie yah khushi ka vishay hai: tumhaare faith ne tumhein svasth kar diya.” Usi kshan vah aurat svasth ho gai.
Jab Yeshu Yahudi synagogue ke adhikaari ke ghar par pahunche to unhonne bhir ka kolaahal aur baansuri vaadak shok-sangit bajaate hue bhi suna.
Isliye unhonne command di, “Yahaan se chale jaao kyonki baalika ki maut nahin hui hai—vah so rahi hai.” Is par ve Yeshu ka thattha karne lage,
Lekin jab bhir ko baahar nikaal diya gaya, Yeshu ne kaksh mein pravesh kar baalika ka haath pakra aur vah uth baithi.
Yah samaachaar saare kshetr mein phail gaya.
Jab Yeshu vahaan se vida hue, do andhe person yah pukaarte hue unke pichhe chalne lage, “David-son, ham par grace kijie!”
Jab Yeshu ne ghar mein pravesh kiya ve andhe bhi unke paas pahunch gae. Yeshu ne unse savaal kiya, “Kya tumhein faith hai ki mujhmein yah karne ka power hai?” Unhonne javaab diya, “Ji haan, Lord.”
Tab Yeshu ne yah kahte hue unke netron ka sparsh kiya, “Tumhaare faith ke hisaab se tumhaari chaahat puri ho,”
Aur unhein nazar receive ho gai. Yeshu ne unhein kari chetaavni di, “Yah dhyaan rakhna ki iske baare mein kisi ko maalum na hone paae!”
Lekin unhonne jaakar sabhi kshetr mein Yeshu ke baare mein yah samaachaar prasaarit kar diya.
Jab ve sab vahaan se baahar nikal rahe the, unke saamne ek gunga person, jo dard denevaali aatma se pirit tha, laaya gaya.
Dard denevaali aatma ke nikal jaane ke baad vah baatein karne laga. Yah dekh bhir chakit rah gai aur kahne lagi, “Isse pahle Israel mein aisa kabhi nahin dekha gaya.”
Jabki Farisi kah rahe the, “Yah dard denevaali aatma ka nikaalna dard denevaali aatma ke leader ki madad se karta hai.”
Bhir ko dekh Yeshu ka dil mercy se duhkhit ho utha kyonki ve bin charvaahe ki bheron ke jaisa vyaakul aur niraash the.
Yeshu ne apne baarah disciples ko bulaakar unhein authority diya ki ve dard denevaali aatma ko nikaala karein aur har ek tarah ke rog aur bimaari se svasth karein.
In baarah apostles ke naam is tarah hain: Shimon jo Petros kahlaae, unke bhaai aandreyaas, zebediyos ke son Yaakob, unke bhaai Yohan,
Filippos, baartholomeyos, thomos, chungi lenevaale mattiyaah, halfeyos ke son Yaakob, thaddeiyos,
Kanaani Shimon aur kaariyotvaasi Yahudah, jisne unke saath dhokha kiya.
“Disciple apne guru se shreshth nahin aur na slave apne maalik se.

Disciple ko yahi kaafi hai ki vah apne guru ke tuly ho jaae aur slave apne maalik ke. Yadi unhonne parivaar ke leader ko hi belazbul ghoshit kar diya to us parivaar ke sadasyon ko kya kuchh nahin kaha jaaega!
“Isliye unse bhaybhit na hona kyonki aisa kuchh bhi chhupa nahin, jise khola na jaaega ya aisa koi rahasy nahin, jise reveal na kiya jaaega.
Kya do gauraiyein bahut sasti ek paise mein nahin bikti? Phir bhi aisa nahin ki yadi unmein se ek bhi zameen par gir jaae aur tumhaare pita ko uske baare mein maalum na ho.
Tumhaare sir ka to ek-ek baal gina hua hai.
Isliye bhaybhit na ho. Tumhaara daam kai gauraiya se kahin adhik hai.
Bandigrih mein jab Yohan ne Yeshu ke kaamon ke baare mein suna unhonne apne disciples ko Yeshu se yah puchhne bheja,
“Kya aap vahi hai, jiski promise aur pratiksha ki gai hain, ya ham kisi dusre ka intjaar karein?”
Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Jo kuchh tum dekh aur sun rahe ho uski suchna Yohan ko de do:
Jab Yohan ke disciple vahaan se ja hi rahe the, Lord Yeshu ne bhir se Yohan ke baare mein kahna shuruaat kiya, “Tumhaari ummid banjar zameen mein kya dekhne ki thi? Hava mein hilte hue sarkande ko?
Yadi yah nahin to phir kya dekhne gae the? Kimti kapde dhaaran kie hue kisi person ko? Jo aise kapde dhaaran karte hain unka nivaas to raajmahlon mein hota hai.
Tum kyon gae the? Kisi prophet se bheint karne? Haan! Main tumhein bata raha hun ki yah vah hain, jo prophet se bhi barhkar hain
Yah vah hain jinke baare mein likha gaya hai: “ ‘Main apna dut tumhaare aage bhej raha hun, jo tumhaare aage-aage jaakar tumhaare lie raasta taiyaar karega.’
Sach to yah hai ki aaj tak jitne bhi insaan hue hain unmein se ek bhi baptisma denevaale Yohan se barhkar nahin. Phir bhi heaven ka kingdom mein chhote se chhota bhi Yohan se barhkar hai.
Baptisma denevaale Yohan ke samay se lekar ab tak heaven ka kingdom prabaltaapurvak phail raha hai aur aakaankshi-utsaahi person is par authority kar rahe hain.
Bhavishyadvaktaaon aur law ki bhavishyvaani Yohan tak hi thi.
Yadi tum is sach mein faith kar sako to suno: Yohan hi vah Eliyah hain jinka dobaara aagman hona tha.
Jiske sunne ke kaan hon, vah sun le.
“Is pirhi ki tulna main kisse karun? Yah baajaaron mein baithe hue un baalkon ke jaisa hai, jo pukaarte hue anyon se kah rahe hain:
“ ‘Jab hamne tumhaare lie baansuri bajaai, tum na naache; hamne shok git bhi gaae, phir bhi tum na roe.’
Yohan roti nahin khaate, aur daakhras nahin pite the. Isliye logon ne ghoshna ki, ‘Usmein dard denevaali aatma hai.’

Insaan ka son khaate-pite aaya, aur unhonne ghoshit kar diya, ‘Are, vah to petu aur piyakkar hai; vah to chungi lenevaalon aur apraadhi logon ka mitr hai!’ Samajh apne kaamon se sahi saabit hoti hai.”
“Tum sabhi, jo thake hue aur bhaari bojh se dabe ho, mere paas aao, tumhein vishraam main dunga.
Mera jua apne upar le lo aur mujhse sikho kyonki main din aur dil se namr hun aur tumhein man mein vishraam receive hoga
Kyonki sahaj hai mera jua aur halka hai mera bojh.”
Shabbat par Yeshu aur unke disciple ann ke kheton mein se hokar ja rahe the. Unke disciples ko bhukh lag gai aur ve baalein torkar khaane lage.
Yah dekh Farisiyon ne aapatti uthaai, “Dekh lo, tumhaare disciple vah kar rahe hain jo Shabbat sambandhit law ke hisaab se galat hai.”
Is par Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Kya aap logon ne us ghatna ke baare mein nahin parha jismein bhukh lagne par David aur unke saathiyon ne kya kiya tha?
Kaise unhonne God ke bhavan mein pravesh kiya aur David aur unke saathiyon ne bheint ki vah roti khaai, jise priests ke alaava kisi ka bhi khaana law ke hisaab se na tha?
Ya kya aap logon ne law mein yah nahin parha ki temple mein sevaarat priest Shabbat ki law ka ullanghan karne par bhi nirdosh hi rahte hain?
Lekin main tumhein bata raha hun ki yahaan vah hai, jo temple se barhkar hai.
Vastuth tumne yadi is baat ka arth samjha hota: ‘Main bali ki nahin lekin daya ki kaamna karta hun,’ To tumne in nirdoshon par aarop na lagaaya hota.
Kyonki insaan ka son Shabbat ka maalik hai.”
Vahaan se chalkar Yeshu Yahudi synagogue mein gae.

Vahaan ek person tha, jiska haath laqva maara hua tha. Unhonne Yeshu se savaal kiya, “Kya Shabbat par kisi ko svasth karna law ke hisaab se hai?” Unhonne yah savaal isliye kiya ki ve Yeshu par aarop laga sakein.
Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Tummein kaun aisa person hai jiske paas ek bher hai aur yadi vah bher Shabbat par gaddhe mein gir jaae to vah use haath barhaakar baahar na nikaale?
Ek bher ki tulna mein insaan kitna adhik kimti hai! Isliye Shabbat par kiya gaya bhala kaam law ke hisaab se hota hai.”
Tab Yeshu ne us person ko command di, “Apna haath aage barhaao!” Usne haath aage barhaaya—vah haath dusre haath ke jaisa svasth ho gaya tha.
Isliye Farisi baahar chale gae aur Yeshu ki murder ka sharyantr rachne lage.
Yeshu ko iska ahsaas tha isliye vah vahaan se chale gae. Kai the, jo unke saath unke pichhe-pichhe chal rahe the. Yeshu ne unmein se sabhi rogiyon ko svasth kar diya
Aur unhein chetaavni di ki is baare mein ve kisi se varnan na karein ki vah kaun hain.
Yah prophet yashaayaah dvaara ki gai is bhavishyvaani ki purti thi:
Yahi hai mera chuna hua servant, mera dear paatr, jismein mere jaan ko pura santosh hai. Main use apne aatma se bhara karunga aur vah gair-Yahudiyon mein justice ki ghoshna karega.
Vah na to vivaad karega, na unche word mein kuchh kahega aur na hi galiyon mein koi uska word sun sakega.
Kuchle hue narkat ko vah tor na pheinkega, aur na hi vah timtimaati baati ko bujha dega, jab tak vah justice ko vijay tak na pahuncha de.
Uski pratishtha mein gair-Yahudiyon ke lie ummid hogi.
Tab Yeshu ke saamne ek aisa person laaya gaya, jo dard denevaali aatma se pirit tha, vah andha aur gunga tha. Yeshu ne use svasth kar diya. Parinaamasvrup vah person baatein karne aur dekhne laga.
Sabhi bhir chakit rah gai. Mauzud log aapas mein soch kar rahe the, “Kahin yahi David ka vah vanshaj to nahin?”
Lekin yah sunkar Farisiyon ne iske baare mein apna mat diya, “Yah person keval dard denevaali aatmaaon ke leader belazbul ki madad se dard denevaali aatmaaon ko nikaala karta hai.”
Unke vichaaron ke baare mein maalum hone par Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Koi bhi aisa raajy, jismein phut pari ho, mit jaata hai. Koi bhi shehar ya parivaar phut ki situation mein sthir nahin rah paata.
Yadi aarop lagaanevaala hi aarop lagaanevaala ko baahar nikaala kare to vah apna hi virodhi ho jaaega, tab bhala uska shaasan sthir kaise rah sakega?
Yadi main dard denevaali aatmaaon ko belazbul ke sahyog se baahar nikaala karta hun to phir tumhaare log unko kaise baahar karti hai? Parinaamasvrup ve hi tum par aarop lagaaeinge.
Lekin yadi main dard denevaali aatmaaon ko God ke aatma ke dvaara baahar kar raha hun to yah saabit ho gaya hai ki tumhaare bich God ka kingdom a chuka hai.
“Kya, yah sambhav hai ki koi kisi balvaan person ke ghar mein pravesh kar uski property lut le? Haan, yadi balvaan person ko pahle baandh diya jaae, tab uski property ko lut lena sambhav hai.
“Yadi per achchha hai to phal bhi achchha hi hoga aur yadi per achchha nahin hai to uska phal bhi achchha nahin hoga. Per apne phal se pahchaana jaata hai.
Bhala person khud mein bhare hue uttam bhandaar mein se uttam hi nikaalta hai aur bura person khud mein bhare hue bure bhandaar mein se bura.
Kuchh shaastriyon aur Farisiyon ne Yeshu se request ki, “Guruvar, ham aapse koi adbhut chihn dekhna chaahte hain.”
Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Yah evil aur God ke prati nishthaahin pirhi adbhut chihn ki laalsa karti hai, phir bhi ise prophet yonaah ke chihn ke atirikt koi bhi chihn nahin diya jaaega.
Jab Yeshu bhir se baatein kar rahe the, unki maata aur unke bhaai unse bheint karne ki pratiksha mein baahar thahre hue the.
Kisi ne unhein suchit kiya, “Aapki maata aur bhaai baahar aapse bheint karne ke lie pratiksha kar rahe hain.”
Jis person ne Yeshu ko yah suchna di thi, usse Yeshu ne puchha, “Vaastav mein kaun hai meri maata aur kaun hai mera bhaai?”
Tab apne disciples ki or haath se sanket karte hue Yeshu ne kaha, “Ye hain mere bhaai, meri bahan aur meri maata.
Jo mere svargiy pita ki chaahat puri karta hai, vahi hai mera bhaai, meri bahan aur meri maata.”
Yah ghatna us din ki hai jab Yeshu ghar se baahar jhil ke kinaare par baithe hue the.
Ek bari bhir unke chaaron or ikattha ho gayi. Isliye vah ek naav mein ja baithe aur bhir jhil ke tat par rah gayi.
Unhonne bhir se drishtaanton mein kai vishyon par charcha ki. Yeshu ne kaha: “Ek kisaan bij bone ke lie nikla.
Bij bone mein kuchh bij to raasta ke kinaare gire, jinhein pakshiyon ne aakar chug liya.
Kuchh dusre bij pathrili zameen par bhi ja gire, jahaan paryaapt mitti nahin thi. Paryaapt mitti na hone ke kaaran ve jaldi hi ankurit bhi ho gae.
Lekin jab suryoday hua, ve jhulas gae aur isliye ki unhonne jarein hi nahin pakri thi, ve murjha gae.
Kuchh dusre bij kantili jhaariyon mein ja gire aur jhaariyon ne barhkar unhein daba diya.
Kuchh bij achchhi zameen par gire aur phal laae. Yah upaj sau guni, saath guni, tis guni thi.
Jiske sunne ke kaan hon, vah sun le.”
Yeshu ke disciples ne unke paas aakar unse savaal kiya, “Guruvar, aap logon ko drishtaanton mein hi teaching kyon dete hain?”
Blessed hain tumhaari aankhein kyonki ve dekhti hain aur tumhaare kaan kyonki ve sunte hain.

Main tum par ek sach reveal kar raha hun: kai prophet aur righteous person vah dekhne ki kaamna karte rahe, jo tum dekh rahe ho lekin ve dekh na sake aur ve vah sunne ki kaamna karte rahe, jo tum sun rahe ho lekin sun na sake.
“Ab tum kisaan ka drishtaant suno:

Jab koi person raajy ke baare mein sunta hai lekin use samjha nahin karta, aarop lagaanevaala aata hai aur vah, jo uske dil mein ropa gaya hai, jhapatkar le jaata hai. Yah vah bij hai jo raasta ke kinaare gir gaya tha.
Pathrili zameen vah person hai, jo sandesh ko sunta hai aur turant hi use khushi se apna leta hai
Lekin isliye ki uski jar hai hi nahin, vah thore din ke lie hi usmein tik paata hai. Jab sandesh ke kaaran yaatnaaein aur sataahat shuruaat hote hain, uska patan ho jaata hai.

Vah zameen, jahaan bij kantili jhaariyon ke bich gira, vah person hai jo sandesh ko sunta to hai lekin duniya ki chintaaein aur sampannta ka chhalaava sandesh ko daba dete hain aur vah bina phal ke rah jaata hai.
Vah uttam zameen, jis par bij ropa gaya, vah person hai, jo sandesh ko sunta hai, use samajhta hai aur vaastav mein phal laata hai—boye gaye bij ke tis guna, saath guna aur sau guna.”
Yeshu ne unke saamne ek dusre drishtaant prastut kiya: “Heaven ka kingdom ki tulna us person se ki ja sakti hai, jisne apne khet mein uttam bij ka ropan kiya.
Jab uske servant so rahe the, uska dushman aaya aur gehun ke bij ke beech jangli bij rop kar chala gaya.
Jab gehun ke ankur phute aur baalein aain tab jangli bij ke paudhe bhi dikhaai die.
“Is par servants ne aakar apne maalik se puchha, ‘Maalik, aapne to apne khet mein uttam bij rope the! To phir ye jangli paudhe kahaan se a gae?’
“Maalik ne javaab diya, ‘Yah kaam dushman ka hai.’ “Tab servants ne usse puchha, ‘Kya aap chaahte hain ki ham inhein ukhaar pheinkein?’
“Us person ne javaab diya, ‘Nahin, aisa na ho ki jangli paudhe ukhaarte hue tum gehun bhi ukhaar daalo.
Yeshu ne unke saamne ek dusre drishtaant prastut kiya: “Heaven ka kingdom ek raai ke bij ke jaisa hai, jise ek person ne apne khet mein rop diya.

Yah dusre sabhi bijon ki tulna mein chhota hota hai lekin jab yah pura viksit hua tab khet ke sabhi paudhon se adhik bara ho gaya aur phir vah barhkar ek per mein badal gaya ki aakaash ke pakshi aakar uski daaliyon mein basera karne lage.”

Yeshu ne unke saamne ek aur drishtaant prastut kiya: “Heaven ka kingdom khamir ke jaisa hai, jise ek aurat ne lekar tin maap aate mein mila diya aur hote-hote saara aata khamir ban gaya, yadypi aata bari maatra mein tha.”
Yeshu ne ye puri shikshaaein bhir ko drishtaanton mein din. Koi bhi teaching aisi na thi, jo drishtaant mein na di gai
Ki prophet dvaara ki gai yah bhavishyvaani puri ho jaae: main drishtaanton mein vaartaalaap karunga, main vah sab kahunga, jo srishti ke shuru se gupt hai.
Tab righteous apne pita ke raajy mein sury ke jaisa chamkeinge. Jiske sunne ke kaan hon, vah sun le.”
“Heaven ka kingdom us vyaapaari ke jaisa hai, jo achchhe motiyon ki khoj mein tha.
“Kya tumhein ab yah sab samajh aaya?” Unhonne javaab diya. “Ji haan, Lord.”

Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Yahi kaaran hai ki law ka har ek shikshak, jo heaven ka kingdom ke baare mein prashikshit kiya ja chuka hai, parivaar ke leader ke jaisa hai, jo apne bhandaar se nai aur puraani har ek vastu ko nikaal laata hai.”
Drishtaanton mein apni teaching de chukne par Yeshu us jagah se chale gae.

Tab Yeshu apne grihangar mein aae aur vahaan vah Yahudi synagogue mein logon ko teaching dene lage. Is par ve chakit hokar aapas mein kahne lage, “Is person ko yah knowledge aur in adbhut kaamon ka power kaise receive ho gaya?
Kya yah us barhai ka son nahin? Aur kya iski maata ka naam Mariyam nahin aur kya Yaakob, Yosef, Shimon aur Yahudah iske bhaai nahin?
Aur kya iski bahnein hamaare bich nahin? Tab ise ye sab kaise receive ho gaya?”
Ve Yeshu ke prati krodh se bhar gae. Is par Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Apne grihangar aur parivaar ke alaava prophet kahin bhi apmaanit nahin hota.”
Logon ke unbelief ke kaaran Yeshu ne us shehar mein adhik adbhut kaam nahin kie.
Usi samay Herodes ne, jo desh ke ek chauthaai bhaag ka raaja tha, Yeshu ke baare mein suna.
Unki murder ka kaaran thi Herodes ke bhaai filippos ki patni herodias. Herodes ne baptisma denevaale Yohan ko bandi banaakar kaaraagaar mein daal diya tha
Kyonki baptisma denevaale Yohan use yah chetaavni dete rahte the, “Tumhaara herodias ko apne paas rakhna uchit nahin hai.”
Herodes Yohan ko samaapt hi kar dena chaahta tha lekin use logon ka dar tha kyonki log unhein prophet maante the.
Herodes ke janmdivas samaaroh ke avsar par herodias ki putri ke nrity-pradarshan se Herodes itna prasann hua ki
Usne us kishori se shapath khaakar vachan diya ki vah jo chaahe maang sakti hai.
Apni maata ke sanket par usne kaha, “Mujhe ek thaal mein, yahin, baptisma denevaale Yohan ka sir chaahie.”
Yadypi is par Herodes duhkhit zarur hua lekin apni shapath aur upasthit atithiyon ke kaaran usne iski purti ki command de di.
Usne kisi ko kaaraagaar mein bhejkar Yohan ka sir katva diya,
Use ek thaal mein laakar us kishori ko de diya gaya aur usne use le jaakar apni maata ko de diya.
Yohan ke disciple aae, unke shav ko le gae, unka antim sanskaar kar diya aur Yeshu ko iske baare mein suchit kiya.
Is samaachaar ko sun Yeshu naav par savaar hokar vahaan se ekaant mein chale gae. Jab logon ko yah maalum hua, ve shehron se nikalkar paidal hi unke pichhe chal die.
Tat par pahunchne par Yeshu ne is bari bhir ko dekha aur unka dil mercy se bhar gaya. Unhonne unmein, jo rogi the unko svasth kiya.
Sandhyaakaal unke disciple unke paas aakar kahne lage, “Yah nirjan jagah hai aur din dhal raha hai isliye bhir ko vida kar dijie ki gaanvon mein jaakar log apne lie khaana-law kar sakein.”
Lekin Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Unhein vida karne ki koi zarurat nahin hai—tum unke lie khaana ki law karo!”
Unhonne Yeshu ko bataaya ki yahaan unke paas sirf paanch rotiyaan aur do machhliyaan hain.
Yeshu ne unhein command di, “Unhein yahaan mere paas le aao.”

Logon ko ghaas par baithne ki command dete hue Yeshu ne paanchon rotiyaan aur do machhliyaan apne haathon mein lekar heaven ki or aankhein uthaakar khaana ke lie thanks dene ke baad rotiyaan tor-tor kar disciples ko dena shuruaat kiya aur disciples ne bhir ko.
Sabhi ne bharpet khaaya. Shesh rah gae tukre ikattha karne par baarah tokre bhar gae.
Vahaan jitnon ne khaana kiya tha unmein auraton aur baalkon ko chhorkar aadmiyon ki sankhya hi koi paanch hazaar thi.
Iske baad Yeshu ne disciples ko turant hi naav mein savaar hone ke lie is purpose se vivash kiya ki disciple unke purv hi dusri or pahunch jaaein, jabki vah khud bhir ko vida karne lage.
Bhir ko vida karne ke baad vah akele parvat par chale gae ki vahaan jaakar vah ekaant mein prayer karein. Yah raat ka samay tha aur vah vahaan akele the.
Viprit disha mein hava aur lahron ke thapere khaakar naav tat se bahut dur nikal chuki thi.
Raat ke antim prahar mein Yeshu paani satah par chalte hue unki or aae.
Unhein paani satah par chalte dekh disciple ghabraakar kahne lage, “Dard denevaali aatma hai yah!” Aur ve bhaybhit ho chillaane lage.
Is par Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Daro mat. Saahas rakho! Main hun!”
Petros ne unse kaha, “Lord! Yadi aap hi hain to mujhe command dijie ki main paani par chalte hue aapke paas a jaaun.”
“Aao!” Yeshu ne command di. Petros naav se utarkar paani par chalte hue Yeshu ki or barhne lage
Lekin jab unka dhyaan hava ki gati ki or gaya to vah bhaybhit ho gae aur paani mein dubne lage. Vah chillaae, “Lord! Mujhe bachaaie!”
Yeshu ne turant haath barhaakar unhein thaam liya aur kaha, “Are, alp believer! Tumne sandeh kyon kiya?”
Tab ve donon naav mein charh gae aur vaayu tham gai.
Jhil paar kar ve gannesrat pradesh mein a gae.
Vahaan ke nivaasiyon ne unhein pahchaan liya aur aas-paas ke jagahon mein sandesh bhej diya. Log bimaar logon ko unke paas laane lage.
Ve Yeshu se request karne lage, ki vah unhein sirf apne kapde ka chhor hi chhu lene dein. Anekon ne unka kapde chhua aur svasth ho gae.
Tab Yerushalem se kuchh Farisi aur shaastri Yeshu ke paas aakar kahne lage,
“Aapke disciple purvjon ki parampraaon ka ullanghan kyon karte hain? Ve khaana ke pahle haath nahin dhoya karte.”
Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Apni parampraaon ki purti mein aap khud God ke orders ko kyon torte hain?
God ki command hai, ‘Apne maata-pita ka sammaan karo’ Aur vah, jo maata ya pita ke prati bure word bole, use maut dand diya jaae.
Lekin tum kahte ho, ‘Jo koi apne maata-pita se kahta hai, “Aapko mujhse jo kuchh receive hona tha, vah sab ab God ko bheint kiya ja chuka hai,”
Use maata-pita ka sammaan karna zaruri nahin.’ Aisa karne ke dvaara apni hi parampraaon ko pura karne ki phiraak mein tum God ki command ko torte ho.
Are paakhandiyon! Prophet yashaayaah ki yah bhavishyvaani tumhaare baare mein thik hi hai:
“Ye log sirf apne honthon se mera sammaan karte hain, lekin unke dil mujhse bahut dur hain.
Vyarth mein ve meri vandna karte hain. Unki teaching sirph insaanon dvaara banaae hue niyam hain.”
Tab Yeshu ne bhir ko apne paas bulaakar unse kaha, “Suno aur samjho:
Vah, jo insaan ke chehra mein pravesh karta hai, insaan ko ashuddh nahin karta, lekin use ashuddh vah karta hai, jo uske chehra se nikalta hai.”
Tab Yeshu ke disciples ne unke paas a unse savaal kiya, “Kya aap jaante hain ki aapke is vachan se Farisi apmaanit ho rahe hain?”
Yeshu ne unse uttar mein kaha, “Aisa har ek paudha, jise mere pita ne nahin ropa hai, ukhaar diya jaaega.
Unse dur hi raho. Ve to andhe maargdarshak hain. Yadi andha hi andhe ka maargdarshan karega, to donon hi gaddhe mein gireinge!”
Petros ne Yeshu se request ki, “Lord hamein iska arth samjhaaie.”
Yeshu ne kaha, “Kya tum ab tak samajh nahin paae?
Kya tumhein yah samajh nahin aaya ki jo kuchh chehra mein pravesh karta hai, vah pet mein jaakar body se baahar nikal jaata hai?
Lekin jo kuchh chehra se nikalta hai, uska srot hota hai insaan ka dil. Vahi sab hai jo insaan ko ashuddh karta hai,
Kyonki dil se hi bure soch, murder, vyabhichaar, veshyaagaami, choriyaan, jhuthi gavaahi aur ninda upja karti hain.
Ye hi insaan ko ashuddh karti hain, lekin haath dhoe bina khaana karne se koi person ashuddh nahin hota.”
Tab Yeshu vahaan se nikalkar sor aur sidon pradesh mein ekaantvaas karne lage.
Vahaan ek kanaanvaasi aurat aai aur pukaar-pukaarkar kahne lagi, “Lord! Mujh par daya kijie. David ki children! Meri putri mein ek krur dard denevaali aatma samaaya hua hai aur vah bahut pirit hai.”
Lekin Yeshu ne uski or lesh sirf bhi dhyaan nahin diya. Disciple aakar unse request karne lage, “Lord! Use vida kar dijie. Vah chillaati hui hamaare pichhe lagi hai.”
Yeshu ne javaab diya, “Mujhe sirf Israel vansh ke khoi hui bheron ke paas hi bheja gaya hai.”
Lekin us aurat ne Yeshu ke paas a jhukte hue unse request ki, “Lord! Meri madad kijie!”
Yeshu ne use javaab diya, “Baalkon ko parosa khaana unse lekar kutton ko dena sahi nahin!”
Us aurat ne javaab diya, “Sach hai, Lord, lekin yah bhi to sach hai ki maalik ki mez se gir jaate tukron se kutte apna pet bhar lete hain.”
Yeshu kah uthe, “Saraahniy hai tumhaara faith! Vaisa hi ho, jaisa tum chaahti ho.” Usi kshan uski putri svasth ho gai.
Vahaan se Yeshu Galil jhil ke tat se hote hue parvat par chale gae aur vahaan baith gae.
Ek bari bhir unke paas a gayi. Jinmein langre, apang, andhe, gunge aur dusre rogi the. Logon ne inhein Yeshu ke charnon mein lita diya aur Yeshu ne unhein svasth kar diya.
Gungon ko bolte, apangon ko svasth hote, langron ko chalte aur andhon ko dekhte dekh bhir chakit ho Israel ke God ka gungaan karne lagi.

Yeshu ne apne disciples ko apne paas bulaakar kaha, “Mujhe in logon se sahaanubhuti hai kyonki ye mere saath tin din se hain aur inke paas ab khaane ko kuchh nahin hai. Main inhein bhukha hi vida karna nahin chaahta—kahin ye raasta mein hi murchchhit na ho jaaein.”
Disciples ne kaha, “Is nirjan jagah mein is bari bhir ki tripti ke lie khaana ka prabandh kaise hoga?”
Yeshu ne unse savaal kiya, “Kitni rotiyaan hain tumhaare paas?” “Saat, aur kuchh chhoti machhliyaan,” Unhonne javaab diya.
Yeshu ne bhir ko zameen par baith jaane ka nirdesh diya
Aur khud unhonne saaton rotiyaan aur machhliyaan lekar unke lie God ke prati aabhaar reveal karne ke baad unhein tora aur disciples ko dete gae aur disciple bhir ko.
Sabhi ne khaaya aur tript hue aur disciples ne tori gai rotiyon ke shesh tukron ko ikattha kar saat bare tokre bhar lie.
Vahaan jitnon ne khaana kiya tha unmein auraton aur baalkon ke atirikt aadmiyon hi ki sankhya koi chaar hazaar thi.
Bhir ko vida kar Yeshu naav mein savaar hokar magaadaan kshetr mein aae.
Tab Farisi aur saduki Yeshu ke paas aae aur unko parakhne ke lie unhein heaven se koi adbhut chihn dikhaane ko kaha.
Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Saayankaal hone par tum kahte ho ki mausam anukul rahega kyonki aakaash mein laalima hai.
Vyabhichaari aur God ke prati nishthaahin pirhi chihn khojti hai lekin ise yonaah ke chihn ke atirikt aur koi chihn nahin diya jaaega.” Aur Yeshu unhein vahin chhorkar chale gae.
Jhil ki dusri or pahunchne par disciples ne paaya ki ve apne saath khaana rakhna bhul gae the.
Usi samay Yeshu ne unhein chetaavni dete hue kaha, “Farisiyon aur sadukiyon ke khamir se saavdhaan rahna.”
Is par disciple aapas mein soch-vimarsh karne lage, “Kya Lord ne yah isliye kaha hai ki ham khaana saath laana bhul gae?”
Yeshu unki situation se avgat the, isliye unhonne disciples se kaha, “Are alpvishvaasiyo! Kyon is vivaad mein uljhe hue ho ki tumhaare paas khaana nahin hai?
Kya tumhein ab bhi samajh nahin aaya? Kya tumhein paanch hazaar ke lie paanch rotiyaan yaad nahin? Tumne vahaan shesh rotiyon se bhare kitne tokre uthaae the?
Ya chaar hazaar ke lie ve saat rotiyaan, tumne vahaan shesh rotiyon se bhare kitne tokre uthaae the?
Bhala kaise yah tumhaari samajh se pare hai ki yahaan mainne khaana ka varnan nahin kiya hai? Lekin yah ki mainne tumhein Farisiyon aur sadukiyon ke khamir se saavdhaan kiya hai.”
Tab unhein yah vishay samajh mein aaya ki Yeshu roti ke khamir ka nahin lekin Farisiyon aur sadukiyon ki galat teaching ka varnan kar rahe the.
Jab Yeshu kayasriya filippi kshetr mein pahunche, unhonne apne disciples ke saamne yah savaal rakha: “Logon ke mat mein insaan ke son kaun hai?”
Disciples ne javaab diya, “Kuchh ke mataanusaar baptisma denevaala Yohan, kuchh dusre ke hisaab se Eliyah aur kuchh ke hisaab se yeremiyaah ya bhavishyadvaktaaon mein se koi ek.”
Tab Yeshu ne unse savaal kiya, “Lekin tumhaare mat mein main kaun hun?”
Is par Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Yonaah ke son Shimon, blessed ho tum! Tum par is sach ka prakaashan koi insaan ka kaam nahin lekin mere pita ka hai, jo heaven mein hain.
Yah sun Petros Yeshu ko alag le gae aur unhein jhirki dete hue kahne lage, “God aisa na karein, Lord! Aapke saath aisa kabhi na hoga.”
Lekin Yeshu Petros se unmukh ho bole, “Dur ho ja meri nazar se, aarop lagaanevaala! Tu mere lie baadha hai! Tera man God sambandhit vishyon mein nahin lekin insaan sambandhi vishyon mein hai.”
Is ghatna ke chhah din baad Yeshu Petros, Yaakob aur unke bhaai Yohan ko anyon se alag ek unche parvat par le gae.
Vahaan unhin ke saamne Yeshu ka rupaantran ho gaya. Unka chehra sury ke jaisa bahut chamkila ho utha aur unke kapde prakaash ke jaisa ujjval ho uthe.
Usi samay unhein Moshe aur Eliyah Yeshu se baatein karte hue dikhaai die.
Yah dekh Petros Yeshu se bol uthe, “Lord! Hamaara yahaan hona kaise khushi ka vishay hai! Yadi aap kahein to main yahaan tin mandap banaaun—ek aapke lie, ek Moshe ke lie aur ek Eliyah ke lie.”

Petros abhi yah kah hi rahe the ki ek ujla baadal un par chha gaya aur usmein se ek word sunaai diya, “Yah mera son hai—mera dear, jismein main puri tarah se santusht hun; iski command ka follow karo.”
Yah sun dar ke kaaran disciple zameen par chehra ke bal gir pare.
Yeshu unke paas gae, unhein sparsh kiya aur unse kaha, “Utho! Daro mat!”
Jab ve uthe, tab vahaan unhein Yeshu ke alaava koi dikhaai na diya.
Disciples ne Yeshu se savaal kiya, “Shaastri aisa kyon kahte hain ki pahle Eliyah ka aana zarur hai?”
Yeshu ne javaab diya, “Eliyah aaeinge aur sab kuchh sudhaareinge
Lekin sach to yah hai ki Eliyah pahle hi a chuke hai, aur unhonne unhein na pahchaana. Unhonne Eliyah ke saath manmaana vyavhaar kiya. Thik isi tarah ve insaan ke son ko bhi yaatna deinge.”
Is par disciple samajh gae ki Yeshu baptisma denevaale Yohan ka varnan kar rahe hain.
Jab ve bhir ke paas aae, ek person Yeshu ke saamne ghutne tekkar unse request karne laga,
“Lord! Mere son par grace kijie. Use daure parte hain aur vah bahut kasht mein hai. Vah kabhi aag mein ja girta hai, to kabhi paani mein.
Main use aapke disciples ke paas laaya tha lekin ve use svasth na kar sake.”
Yeshu kah uthe, “Are o avishvaasi aur bigri hui pirhi!” Lord Yeshu ne kaha, “Main kab tak tumhaare saath rahunga, kab tak sabr rakhunga? Yahaan laao apne son ko!”
Yeshu ne us dard denevaali aatma ko phatkaara aur vah us baalak mein se nikal gaya aur baalak usi kshan svasth ho gaya.
Jab Yeshu akele the tab disciple unke paas aae aur unse puchhne lage, “Lord! Ham us dard denevaali aatma ko kyon nahin nikaal sake?”

“Apne faith ki kami ke kaaran,” Yeshu ne javaab diya, “Ek sach main tum par reveal kar raha hun: yadi tummein raai ke ek bij ke tuly bhi faith hai aur tum is parvat ko command do, ‘Yahaan se hat ja!’ To yah parvat yahaan se hat jaaega—asambhav kuchh bhi na hoga.
Jab ve Galil pradesh mein ikattha ho rahe the, Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Ab insaan ka son insaanon ke haathon mein pakarva diya jaaega.
Jab ve kafranhum shehar pahunche, tab unhonne, jo temple ke lie nirdhaarit kar ikattha karte the, Petros ke paas aakar puchha, “Kya tumhaare guru nirdhaarit kar nahin dete?”

“Haan, vah dete hain,” Petros ne unhein javaab diya. Ghar mein pravesh karte hue Yeshu ne hi Petros se savaal kiya, “Shimon, mujhe yah bataao, raaja kisse kar aur shulk lete hain—apni children se ya people se?”
“People se,” Petros ne javaab diya. “Arthaat children kar mukt hai.” Yeshu ne Petros se kaha;

“Phir bhi, aisa na ho ki ve hamse kruddh ho jaaein, jhil mein jaao, aur apna kaanta pheink, jo pahle machhli pakar mein aae uska chehra kholna. Vahaan tumhein ek sikka receive hoga. Vahi sikka unhein apni aur meri or se kar-svarup de dena.”
Tab disciples ne Yeshu ke paas aakar unse puchha, “Heaven ka kingdom mein sabse bara kaun hai?”
Yeshu ne ek baalak ko paas bulaakar use unke saamne khara karte hue kaha,
Main tumhein ek sach bataana chaahta hun: “Jab tak tum badalkar baalak ke jaisa na ho jaao, tumhaara pravesh heaven ka kingdom mein kisi tarah na hoga.
Jo koi khud ko is baalak ke jaisa vinamr kar lega, vahi heaven ka kingdom mein sabse bara hai;
Aur jo koi aise baalak ko mere naam mein grahan karta hai, mujhe grahan karta hai.

“Iske viprit jo koi in baalkon ke lie, jo mujhmein faith karte hain, thokar ka kaaran banta hai, uske lie sahi yahi hoga ki uske gale mein chakki ka paat latkaakar use samudr ki gahraai mein dubo diya jaae.
Thokar ke kaarkon ke lie dhikkaar hai duniya par! Thokron ka hona to nishchit hai lekin dhikkaar hai us person par jiske kaaran thokar lagti hai!

“Dhyaan rakho ki tum in chhoton mein se kisi ko tuchchh nazar se na dekho. Main tumhein bataata hun ki heaven mein inke angel inke lie mere pita ke saamne request karne ke purpose se hamesha upasthit rahte hain. [
“Kya soch hai tumhaara? Yadi kisi person ke paas sau bherein hon aur unmein se ek bhatak jaae to kya vah ninyaanve ko vahin pahaariyon par chhor usko khojne na niklega, jo bhatak gai hai?
Tab sach to yah hai ki yadi vah use khoj leta hai, to vah un ninyaanve ki bajaay, jo bhatki nahin thi, us ek ke lie kahin adhik ullsit hota hai, jo bhatak gai thi.
Isliye tumhaare svargiy pita nahin chaahte ki in chhoton mein se ek bhi chhote ka barbaadi ho.

“Yadi koi sahvishvaasi tumhaare khilaaf koi apraadh kare to jaakar us par uska dosh reveal kar do, lekin yah sirf tum donon ke beech hi ho. Yadi vah tumhaari sun le to tumne use punh receive kar liya.
Lekin yadi vah tumhaari na maane tab apne saath ek ya do ko uske paas le jaao ki ek baat ki pushti ke lie do ya tin gavaahon ki zarurat hoti hai.
“Main tumhein dobaara yaad dila raha hun: yadi tummein se do person prithvi par kisi vishay par ek mat hokar request karein, vah mere pita ke dvaara, jo heaven mein hain, pura kiya jaaega.
Yah isliye ki jahaan do ya tin person mere naam mein ikattha hote hain, vahaan main unke saath hun.”
Tab Petros ne Yeshu ke paas aakar unse savaal kiya, “Lord! Kitni baar mera bhaai mere khilaaf apraadh kare aur main use maafi karun—saat baar?”
Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Main to tumse yah to nahin kahunga saat baar tak lekin sattar ke saat guna tak.
“Isliye heaven ka kingdom ki tulna us raaja se ki ja sakti hai, jisne apne slaves se hisaab-kitaab lena chaaha.
Jab usne shuruaat kiya tab uske saamne vah slave prastut kiya gaya, jo uske laakhon taalanton ka karzdaar tha, lekin
Yah maalum hone par ki uske paas karz chukaane ka koi saadhan nahin hai, maalik ne command di ki use uski patni, baalkon aur saare property sahit bech diya jaae ki karz chukaaya ja sake.
“Is par vah slave apne maalik ke saamne zameen par dandvat ho usse request karne laga, ‘Kripya thora sabr rakhein, main sab kuchh chuka dunga.’
Uske maalik ne daya se bharkar use mukt karke uska saara karz maafi kar diya.
“Us mukt hue slave ne baahar jaate hi us slave ko ja pakra jisne usse sau dinaar karz lie the. Usne use pakarkar uska gala ghontte hue kaha, ‘Mujhse jo karz liya hai, use lauta de!’
“Vah slave is slave ke paanvon par gir para aur request karne laga, ‘Thora sabr rakho. Main sab lauta dunga.’
“Lekin us slave ne uski request par zara bhi dhyaan na diya aur use le jaakar kaaraagaar mein daal diya ki jab tak vah karz na lautaae, vahin rahe.
Isliye jab dusre slaves ne yah sab dekha, ve bahut udaas ho gae aur aakar maalik ko iski suchna di.
“Tab maalik ne us slave ko bulvaakar usse kaha, ‘Are evil! Mainne to tera saara hi karz maafi kar diya kyonki tune mujhse iske lie request ki thi.
Kya yah sahi na tha ki tu bhi apne saathi par grace karta jis tarah mainne tujh par grace ki?’
Apna kathan samaapt karne ke baad Yeshu Galil pradesh se nikalkar Yahudiya pradesh ke us kshetr mein a gae, jo yardan nadi ke paar hai.
Vahaan ek bari bhir unke pichhe ho li aur Yeshu ne rogiyon ko svasth kiya.
Kuchh Farisi Yeshu ko parakhne ke purpose se unke paas aae aur unse savaal kiya, “Kya patni se talaak ke lie pati dvaara prastut koi bhi kaaran vaidh kaha ja sakta hai?”
Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Kya tumne parha nahin ki vah, jinhonne unki srishti ki, unhonne shuruaat hi se unhein nar aur naari banaaya
Aur kaha, ‘Is kaaran aadmi apne maata-pita ko chhorkar apni patni se mila rahega aur ve donon ek deh honge.’
Parinaamasvrup ab ve do nahin lekin ek body hain. Isliye jinhein khud God ne jora hai, unhein koi insaan alag na kare.”
Yah sun unhonne Yeshu se puchha, “To phir Moshe ki law mein yah prabandh kyon hai ki talaak patr dekar patni ko chhor diya jaae?”
Yeshu ne un par yah sach spasht kiya, “Tumhaare dil ki kathorta ke kaaran hi Moshe ne tumhaare lie tumhaari patni se talaak ki anumti di thi. Shuruaat hi se yah prabandh nahin tha.
Tumse mera kahna hai ki jo koi vyabhichaar ke atirikt kisi dusre kaaran se apni patni se talaak kar leta hai aur dusre aurat se vivaah karta hai, vah vyabhichaar karta hai.”
Disciples ne Yeshu se kaha, “Yadi pati-patni ka sambandh aisa hai tab to uttam yahi hoga ki vivaah kiya hi na jaae.”
Yeshu ne iske uttar mein kaha, “Yah situation sab aadmiyon ke lie accept nahin ho sakti—atirikt unke, jinhein God ne aisa banaaya hai,

Kuchh napunsak hain, jo maata ke garbh se hi aise janme hain; kuchh hain, jinhein insaanon ne aisa bana diya hai aur kuchh ne heaven ka kingdom ke lie khud ko aisa bana liya hai. Jo ise samajh sakta hai, samajh le.”
Kuchh log baalkon ko Yeshu ke paas laae ki Yeshu un par haath rakhkar unke lie prayer karein, magar disciples ne un logon ko daanta.
Yah sun Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Baalkon ko yahaan aane do, unhein mere paas aane se mat roko kyonki heaven ka kingdom aison ka hi hai.”
Yah kahte hue Yeshu ne baalkon par haath rakha, iske baad Yeshu vahaan se aage chale gae.
“Tum mujhse kyon puchhte ho ki achchha kya hai? Uttam to sirf ek hi hain. Lekin yadi tum life mein pravesh ki kaamna karte hi ho to orders ka follow karo.”
“Kaun se?” Usne Yeshu se savaal kiya. Unhonne use javaab diya, “Murder mat karo; vyabhichaar mat karo; chori mat karo; jhuthi gavaahi mat do;
Apne maata-pita ka sammaan karo aur tum apne parosi se vaise hi love karo jaise tum khud se karte ho.”
Us yuvak ne Yeshu ko javaab diya, “Main to inka follow karta raha hun; phir ab bhi kya kami hai mujhmein?”
Yah sunkar vah yuvak duhkhi ho laut gaya kyonki vah bahut wealth ka maalik tha.
Apne disciples se unmukh ho Yeshu ne kaha, “Main tum par ek sach reveal kar raha hun; kisi dhani person ka heaven ka kingdom mein pravesh kathin hai.
Vaastav mein God ke kingdom mein ek dhani ke pravesh karne se ek unt ka sui ke chhed mein se paar ho jaana sahaj hai.”
Yeshu ne unki or ektak dekhte hue unhein javaab diya, “Insaan ke lie to yah asambhav hai lekin God ke lie sab kuchh sambhav hai.”
Is par Petros Yeshu se bole, “Dekhie, ham to sab kuchh tyaag kar aapke pichhe ho lie hain. Hamaara puraskaar kya hoga?”
Lekin kai, jo pahle hain, ve antim honge aur jo antim hain, ve pahle.
“Heaven ka kingdom daakh ki baari ke us maalik ke jaisa hai, jo sabere apne udyaan ke lie mazdur laane nikla.
Jab vah mazduron se ek dinaar roz ki mazduri par sahmat ho gaya, usne unhein daakh ki baari mein kaam karne bhej diya.
“Subah nau baje jab vah dobaara shehar chauk se ja raha tha, usne vahaan kuchh mazduron ko bekaar khare paaya.
Usne unse kaha, ‘Tum bhi jaakar mere daakh ki baari mein kaam karo. Jo kuchh sahi hoga, main tumhein dunga.’
Tab ve chale gae. “Vah dobaara baarah baje aur tin baje shehar chauk mein gaya aur aisa hi kiya.
Lagbhag shaam paanch baje vah dobaara vahaan gaya aur kuchh anyon ko vahaan khare paaya. Usne unse savaal kiya, ‘Tum saare din yahaan bekaar kyon khare rahe?’
“Unhonne use javaab diya, ‘Isliye ki kisi ne hamein kaam nahin diya.’ “Usne unse kaha, ‘Tum bhi mere daakh ki baari mein chale jaao.’
“Saanjh hone par daakh ki baari ke maalik ne prabandhak ko command di, ‘Ant mein aae mazduron se shuruaat karte hue sabse pahle kaam par lagaae gae mazduron ko unki mazduri de do.’
“Un mazduron ko, jo gyaarahvein ghante kaam par lagaae gae the, ek-ek dinaar mila.
Is tarah sabse pahle aae mazduron ne socha ki unhein adhik mazduri receive hogi lekin unhein bhi ek-ek dinaar hi mila.
Jab unhonne ise receive kiya tab ve bhusvaami ke khilaaph barabraane lage,
‘Ant mein aae in mazduron ne sirf ek hi ghanta kaam kiya hai aur aapne unhein hamaare baraabar la diya, jabki hamne din ki tej dhup mein kathor parishram kiya.’
“Baari ke maalik ne unhein javaab diya, ‘Mitr main tumhaare saath koi anyaay nahin kar raha. Kya ham ek dinaar mazduri par sahmat na hue the?
Jo kuchh tumhaara hai use accept kar lo aur jaao. Meri chaahat yahi hai ki ant mein kaam par aae mazdur ko utna hi dun jitna tumhein.
Kya yah justice sangat nahin ki main apni property ke saath vah karun jo main chaahta hun? Kya mera udaar hona tumhaari aankhon mein khatak raha hai?’
“Isliye ve, jo antim hain pahle honge aur jo pahle hain, ve antim.”
Jab Yeshu Yerushalem shehar jaane par the, unhonne sirf apne baarah disciples ko apne saath liya. Raasta mein Yeshu ne unse kaha,

“Yah samajh lo ki ham Yerushalem shehar ja rahe hain, jahaan insaan ke son ko pakarvaaya jaaega, leader priests aur shaastriyon ke haathon mein saump diya jaaega aur ve use maut dand ke yogy ghoshit kareinge.
Zebediyos ki patni apne sons ke saath Yeshu ke paas aain aur Yeshu ke saamne jhukkar unse ek request karni chaahi.
Yeshu ne unse puchha, “Aap kya chaahti hain?” Unhonne Yeshu ko javaab diya, “Yah command de dijie ki aapke raajy mein mere ye donon son, ek aapke daayein aur dusra aapke baayein baithe.”
Yeshu ne donon bhaaiyon se unmukh ho kaha, “Tum samajh nahin rahe ki tum kya maang rahe ho! Kya tummein us pyaale ko pine ki kshamta hai, jise main pine par hun?” “Haan, Lord,” Unhonne javaab diya.

Is par Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Sachmuch mera pyaala to tum piyoge, lekin kisi ko apne daayein ya baayein baithaana mera authority nahin hai. Yah unke lie hai, jinke lie yah mere pita dvaara taiyaar kiya gaya hai.”
Yah sun shesh das disciple in donon bhaaiyon par naaraaz ho gae;
Lekin Yeshu ne un sabhi ko apne paas bulaakar unse kaha, “Ve, jo is duniya mein shaasak hain, apne logon par prabhuta karte hain aur unke bare adhikaari un par apna authority dikhaaya karte hain.
Tummein aisa nahin hai, tummein jo mahaan banne ki chaahat rakhta hai, vah tumhaara servant bane,
Aur tummein jo koi shreshth hona chaahta hai, vah tumhaara slave ho.
Jab ve yerikho shehar se baahar nikal hi rahe the, ek bari bhir unke saath ho li.

Vahaan raasta ke kinaare do andhe person baithe hue the. Jab unhein yah ahsaas hua ki Yeshu vahaan se ja rahe hain, ve pukaar-pukaarkar request karne lage, “Lord! David ki children! Ham par grace kijie!”
Bhir ne unhein jhirakte hue shaant rahne ki command di, lekin ve aur bhi adhik unche word mein pukaarne lage, “Lord! David ki children! Ham par grace kijie!”
Yeshu ruk gae, unhein paas bulaaya aur unse savaal kiya, “Kya chaahte ho tum? Main tumhaare lie kya karun?”
Unhonne javaab diya, “Lord! Ham chaahte hain ki ham dekhne lagein.”
Taras khaakar Yeshu ne unki aankhein chhui. Turant hi ve dekhne lage aur ve Yeshu ke pichhe ho lie.
Jab ve Yerushalem shehar ke paas pahunche aur zaitun parvat par baithafge naamak jagah par aae, Yeshu ne do chelon ko is command ke saath aage bheja,
“Saamne gaanv mein jaao. Vahaan pahunchte hi tumhein ek gadhi bandhi hui dikhaai degi. Uske saath uska bachcha bhi hoga. Unhein kholkar mere paas le aao.
Yadi koi tumse is baare mein savaal kare to tum use yah uttar dena, ‘Lord ko inki zarurat hai.’ Vah person tumhein command de dega.”
Yah ghatna prophet dvaara ki gai is bhavishyvaani ki purti thi:
Ziyon ki beti ko yah suchna do: tumhaare paas tumhaara raaja a raha hai; vah namr hai aur vah gadhe par baitha hua hai, haan, gadhe ke bachche par, bojh dhonevaale ke bachche par.
Disciples ne Yeshu ki command ka puri tarah follow kiya
Aur ve gadhi aur uske bachche ko le aae, un par apne baahri kapre bichha die aur Yeshu un kapro par baith gae.
Bhir mein se adhikaansh ne raasta par apne baahri kapre bichha die. Kuchh anyon ne peron ki tahniyaan kaatkar raasta par bichha din.

Yeshu ke aage-aage jaati hui aur pichhe-pichhe aati hui bhir ye naare laga rahi thi “David ke son ki hoshaanna!” “Blessed hai, vah jo Lord ke naam mein a rahe hain.” “Sabse unche jagah mein hoshaanna!”
Jab Yeshu ne Yerushalem shehar mein pravesh kiya, pure shehar mein halchal mach gai. Unke aashchary ka vishay tha: “Kaun hai yah?”
Bhir unhein uttar de rahi thi, “Yahi to hain vah bhavishyadvakta—Galil ke naazreth ke Yeshu.”

Yeshu ne temple mein pravesh kiya aur un sabhi ko temple se baahar nikaal diya, jo vahaan lenden kar rahe the. Saath hi Yeshu ne saahukaaron ki chaukiyaan ulat din aur kabutar bechne vaalon ke aasnon ko palat diya.
Yeshu ne unhein phatkaarte hue kaha, “Scripture ka lekh hai: mera temple prayer ka ghar kahlaaega lekin tum ise daakuon ki khoh bana rahe ho.”
Temple mein hi, Yeshu ke paas andhe aur langre aae aur Yeshu ne unhein svasth kiya.
Jab leader priests aur shaastriyon ne dekha ki Yeshu ne adbhut kaam kie hain aur bachche temple mein, “David ki children ki hoshaanna” Ke naare laga rahe hain, to ve bahut gussa hue.

Aur Yeshu se bole, “Tum sun rahe ho na, ye bachche kya naare laga rahe hain?” Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Haan, kya aapne Scripture mein kabhi nahin parha, baalkon aur dudh pite shishuon ke chehra se aapne apne lie apaar praise ka prabandh kiya hai?”
Yeshu unhein chhorkar shehar ke baahar chale gae aur aaraam ke lie baithniyaah naamak gaanv mein thahar gae.
Bhor ko jab vah shehar mein lautkar a rahe the, unhein bhukh lagi.

Raasta ke kinaare ek anjir ka per dekhkar vah uske paas gae lekin unhein usmein pattiyon ke alaava kuchh nahin mila. Is par Yeshu ne us per ko shaap diya, “Ab se tujhmein kabhi koi phal nahin lagega.” Turant hi vah per murjha gaya.
Yah dekh disciple hairaan rah gae. Unhonne savaal kiya, “Anjir ka yah per turant hi kaise murjha gaya?”

Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Tum is sach ko samajh lo: yadi tumhein faith ho—sandeh tanik bhi na ho—to tum na keval vah karoge, jo is anjir ke per ke saath kiya gaya lekin tum yadi is parvat ko bhi command doge, ‘Ukhar ja aur samudr mein ja gir!’ To yah bhi ho jaaega.
Prayer mein faith se tum jo bhi request karoge, tum use receive karoge.”

Yeshu ne temple mein pravesh kiya aur jab vah vahaan teaching de hi rahe the, leader priest aur purnie unke paas aae aur unse puchha, “Kis authority se tum ye sab kar rahe ho? Kaun hai vah, jisne tumhein iska authority diya hai?”
Yeshu ne iske uttar mein kaha, “Main bhi aapse ek savaal karunga. Yadi aap mujhe uska uttar deinge to main bhi aapke is savaal ka uttar dunga ki main kis authority se yah sab karta hun:

Yohan ka baptisma kiski or se tha—heaven ki or se ya insaanon ki or se?” Is par ve aapas mein soch-vimarsh karne lage, “Yadi ham kahte hain, ‘Heaven ki or se,’ To vah hamse kahega, ‘Tab aapne Yohan mein faith kyon nahin kiya?’
Lekin yadi ham kahte hain, ‘Insaanon ki or se,’ Tab hamein bhir se dar hai; kyonki sabhi Yohan ko prophet maante hain.”
Unhonne aakar Yeshu se kaha, “Aapke savaal ka uttar hamein maalum nahin.” Yeshu ne bhi unhein javaab diya, “Main bhi aapko nahin bataaunga ki main kis authority se ye sab karta hun.
“Is baare mein kya soch hai aapka? Ek person ke do son the. Usne bare son se kaha, ‘He son, aaj jaakar daakh ki baari ka kaam dekh lena.’
“Usne javaab diya, ‘Nahin jaaunga.’ Lekin kuchh samay ke baad use pachhtaava hua aur vah daakh ki baari chala gaya.
“Pita dusre son ke paas gaya aur usse bhi yahi kaha. Usne javaab diya, ‘Ji haan, zarur.’ Lekin vah gaya nahin.

“Yah bataaie ki kis son ne apne pita ki chaahat puri ki?” Unhonne javaab diya: “Bare son ne.” Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Sach yah hai ki samaaj se nikaale log aur veshyaaein aap logon se pahle God ke kingdom mein pravesh kar jaaeinge.

Baptisma denevaale Yohan aapko dharm ka raasta dikhaate hue aae, lekin aap logon ne unka faith hi na kiya. Lekin samaaj ke bahishkriton aur veshyaaon ne unka faith kiya. Yah sab dekhne par bhi aapne unmein faith ke lie pashchaataap na kiya.

“Ek aur drishtaant sunie: ek grihasvaami tha, jisne ek daakh ki baari lagaayi, chaardivaari khari ki, raskund banaaya aur machaan bhi. Iske baad vah daakh ki baari kisaanon ko patte par dekar yaatra par chala gaya.
Jab upaj taiyaar hone ka samay aaya, tab usne kisaanon ke paas apne slave bheje ki ve unse upaj ka pahle se tay kiya hua bhaag ikattha karein.
“Kisaanon ne uske slaves ko pakra, unmein se ek ki pitaai ki, ek ki murder aur ek ka pathraav.
Ab grihasvaami ne pahle se adhik sankhya mein slave bheje. In slaves ke saath bhi kisaanon ne vahi sab kiya.
Is par yah sochkar ki ve mere son ka to sammaan kareinge, us grihasvaami ne apne son ko kisaanon ke paas bheja.
“Lekin jab kisaanon ne son ko dekha to aapas mein soch kiya, ‘Suno! Yah to vaaris hai, chalo, iski murder kar dein aur puri property harap lein.’
Isliye unhonne son ko pakra, use baari ke baahar le gae aur uski murder kar di.
“Isliye yah bataaie, jab daakh ki baari ka maalik vahaan aaega, in kisaanon ka kya karega?”

Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Kya aapne Scripture mein kabhi nahin parha: “ ‘Jis patthar ko raajmistriyon ne anupyogi ghoshit kar diya tha, vahi kone ka mukhy patthar ban gaya. Yah Lord ki or se hua aur yah hamaari nazar mein anutha hai’?
Leader priest aur Farisi yah drishtaant sunkar yah samajh gae ki Lord Yeshu ne un par hi yah drishtaant kaha hai.
Isliye unhonne Yeshu ko pakarne ki koshish to ki, lekin unhein bhir ka dar tha, kyonki log Yeshu ko prophet maante the.
Yeshu phir se unhein drishtaanton mein teaching dene lage. Unhonne kaha,
“Heaven ka kingdom ki tulna ek raaja se ki ja sakti hai, jisne apne son ke vivaah ke uplakshy mein ek bhoj ka aayojan kiya.
Raaja ne apne servants ko aamantrit atithiyon ko bula laane ke lie bheja lekin unhonne aana na chaaha.

“Raaja ne dusre servants ko yah kahkar bheja, ‘Aamantrit atithiyon se kaho, “Mainne apne bhoj ki saari taiyaari kar li hai. Mote-taaje pashuon ko kaate hain, achchhe vyanjan banaae ja chuke hain. Sab kuchh taiyaar hai, bhoj mein padhaarie.” ’
“Lekin aamantriton ne is par bhi koi dhyaan nahin diya lekin ve sab apne kaamon mein lage rahe—ek apne khet mein, dusra apne vyaapaar mein;
Shesh ne un servants ko pakarkar unke saath galat vyavhaar kiya aur phir unki murder kar daali.
Isliye ab tum leader chaukon par chale jaao aur vahaan tumhein jitne bhi person milein, unhein vivaah-bhoj mein aamantrit karo.’
Un servants ne jaakar raaste par jitne person mile, unhein ikattha kar liya—yogy-ayogy sabhi ko, jisse vivaahotsav ka bhojankaksh aamantriton se bhar gaya.
Tab Farisiyon ne jaakar Yeshu ko unhin ke words mein phansaane ki yojna ki.

Unhonne Yeshu ke paas Herodes samarthkon ko is savaal ke saath bheja: “Guruvar, hamein yah to maalum hai ki aap sachche hain, aur God ke kingdom ki teaching puri sach mein hi dete hain. Aap mein kahin koi bhed-bhaav nahin hai, aur aap kisi insaan ke prabhaav mein nahin aate.
Isliye hamein bataaie ki aapke soch se kaysar ko kar bhugtaan karna uchit hai ya nahin?”
Yeshu ko unki kutilta ka ahsaas ho gaya. Yeshu ne kaha, “Are paakhandiyon! Mujhe parakhne ka koshish kar rahe ho!
Kar ke lie nirdhaarit mudra mujhe dikhaao.” Unhonne Yeshu ko dinaar ki ek mudra dikhaai.
Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Is par yah aakriti aur mudran kiska hai?”
“Kaysar ka,” Unhonne javaab diya. Is par Yeshu ne unse kaha, “To phir jo kaysar ka hai, kaysar ko do aur jo God ka hai, God ko.”
Is par ve chakit hokar Yeshu ko chhorkar vahaan se chale gae.
Jab Farisiyon ko yah maalum hua ki Yeshu ne sadukiyon ka munh band kar diya hai, ve khud ekjut ho gae.
Unmein se ek vyavasthaapak ne Yeshu ko parakhne ki mansha se unke saamne yah savaal rakha:
“Guruvar, law ke hisaab se sabse bari command kaun si hai?”
Yeshu ne use javaab diya, “Tum Lord, apne God se, apne saare dil, apne saare jaan aur apni saari samajh se love karo.
Yahi pramukh aur sabse bari command hai.
Aisi hi dusri sabse bari command hai: ‘Apne parosi se vaise hi love karo jaise tum khud se karte ho.’
Inhin do orders par saari law aur bhavishyvaaniyaan aadhaarit hain.”
Vahaan ikattha Farisiyon ke saamne Yeshu ne yah savaal rakha,
“Yeshu ke baare mein kya mat hai aapka—kiski children hai vah?” “David ki,” Unhonne javaab diya.
Tab Yeshu ne unse aage puchha, “Tab phir Holy Spirit se bharkar David use ‘Lord’ Kahkar sambodhit kyon karte hain? David ne kaha hai
“ ‘Lord ne mere Lord se kaha, “Meri daayin or baithe raho, jab tak main tumhaare dushmanon ko tumhaare adhin na kar dun.” ’
Yadi David Yeshu ko Lord kahkar sambodhit karte hain to vah unki children kaise hue?”
