Iske uttar mein na to Farisi kuchh kah sake aur na hi iske baad kisi ko bhi unse koi savaal karne ka saahas hua.
Iske baad Yeshu ne bhir aur disciples ko sambodhit karte hue kaha,
“Farisiyon aur shaastriyon ne khud ko Moshe ke pad par aasin kar rakha hai.
Isliye unki sabhi teachings ke anurup svabhaav to rakho lekin unke dvaara kie ja rahe kaamon ko bilkul na maanna kyonki ve khud hi vah nahin karte, jo vah kahte hain.
Ve logon ke kandhon par bhaari bojh laad to dete hain lekin use hataane ke lie khud ek ungli tak nahin lagaana chaahte.
“Ve sabhi kaam logon ka dhyaan aakarshit karne ke purpose se hi karte hain. Ve un pattiyon ko chaura karte hain, aur ve upri kapde ki jhaalar ko bhi barhaate jaate hain.
Daavton mein mukhy jagah, Yahudi sabhaagrihon mein mukhy aasan,
Shehar chauk mein logon ke dvaara sammaanpurn abhinandan aur rabbi kahlaana hi inhein dear hai.
“Lekin tum khud ke lie rabbi kahlaana accept na karna kyonki tumhaara shikshak sirf ek hain aur tum sab aapas mein bhaai ho.
Prithvi par tum kisi ko apna pita na kahna. Kyonki tumhaara pita sirf ek hain, jo heaven mein hain
Aur na tum khud ke lie maalik sambodhan accept karna kyonki tumhaara maalik sirf ek hain—Yeshu.
Zarur hai ki tummein jo bara banna chaahe vah tumhaara servant ho.
Jo koi khud ko bara karta hai, use chhota bana diya jaaega aur vah, jo khud ko chhota banaata hai, bara kiya jaaega.”

“Dhikkaar hai tum par paakhandi, farisiyo, shaastriyo! Jansaadhaaran ke lie to tum heaven ka kingdom ke dvaar band kar dete ho. Tum na to khud ismein pravesh karte ho aur na hi kisi dusre ko pravesh karne dete ho. [

“Dhikkaar hai tum par andhe aguon! Tum jo yah teaching dete ho, ‘Yadi koi temple ki shapath leta hai to uska koi mahatv nahin lekin yadi koi temple ke sone ki shapath leta hai to uske lie promise puri karna zaruri ho jaata hai.’
Are murkho aur andhon! Adhik mahatvpurn kya hai—sona ya vah temple jisse vah sona holy hota hai?
Isi tarah tum kahte ho, ‘Yadi koi vedi ki shapath leta hai to uska koi mahatv nahin lekin yadi koi vedi par charhaai bheint ki shapath leta hai to uske lie apni promise puri karna zaruri hai.’
Are andhon! Adhik mahatvpurn kya hai, vedi par charhaai bheint ya vedi jisse bheint holy hoti hai?
Isliye jo koi vedi ki shapath leta hai, vah vedi aur vedi par samarpit bheint donon hi ki shapath leta hai.
Jo koi temple ki shapath leta hai, vah temple aur unki, jo ismein rahte hain, donon hi ki shapath leta hai.
Isi tarah jo koi heaven ki shapath leta hai, vah God ke sinhaasan ki aur unki jo us par baitha hain, donon hi ki shapath leta hai.

“Dhikkaar hai tum par paakhandi, farisiyo, shaastriyo! Tum pudina, saumf aur zira ka dasvaan ansh to zarur dete ho lekin law ki kahin adhik gambhir baaton ka arthaat justice, grace aur faith ki upeksha karte ho. Yahi ve baatein hain jinka pura karna zaruri tha—dusron ki andekhi kie bina.
Andhe aguon! Tum makkhi to chhaan kar nikaal pheinkte ho lekin unt nigal jaate ho!
“Dhikkaar hai tum par paakhandi, farisiyo, shaastriyo! Pyaale aur bartan ko baahar se to tum achchhi tarah se saaf karte ho lekin andar laalach aur asanyam se bhara hai.
Andhe farisiyo! Pahle pyaale aur bartan ko bhitar se saaf karo ki ve baahar se bhi saaf ho jaaein.

“Dhikkaar hai tum par paakhandi, farisiyo, shaastriyo! Tum kabron ke jaisa ho, jo baahar se to sajaayi sanvaari jaati hain lekin bhitar mare hue person ki haddiyaan aur sab tarah ki gandgi bhari hoti hai.
Tum bhi baahar se to insaanon ko righteous dikhaai dete ho lekin tumhaare andar kapat aur adharm bhara hua hai.
“Dhikkaar hai tum par paakhandi, farisiyo, shaastriyo! Tum bhavishyadvaktaaon ki kabrein sanvaarte ho aur righteous logon ke smaarak ko sajaate ho aur kahte ho
‘Yadi ham apne purvjon ke samay mein hote, ham in bhavishyadvaktaaon ki murder ke saajhi na hote.’

“Yerushalem! O Yerushalem! Tu bhavishyadvaktaaon ki murder karta aur unka pathraav karta hai, jinhein tere lie bheja jaata hai. Kitni baar mainne yah koshish kiya ki teri children ko ikattha kar ekjut karun, jaise murgi apne chuzon ko apne pankhon ke niche ikattha karti hai lekin tune na chaaha.
Main tujhe bataae deta hun ki iske baad tu mujhe tab tak nahin dekhega jab tak tu yah naara na lagaae. ‘Blessed hai vah, jo Lord ke naam mein a raha hai!’ ”
Unmein se paanch to bewakoof thi aur paanch samajhdaar.
Bewakoof yuvtiyon ne apne saath apne dip to lie lekin tel nahin;
Lekin samajhdaar yuvtiyon ne apne dipon ke saath tel ke bartan bhi rakh lie.
Var ke pahunchne mein der hone ke kaaran unhein nind aane lagi aur ve so gai.
“Sabhi yuvtiyaan uthin aur apne-apne dip taiyaar karne lagin.
Bewakoof yuvtiyon ne samajhdaar yuvtiyon se request ki, ‘Apne tel mein se kuchh hamein bhi de do—hamaare dip bujhe ja rahe hain.’
“Lekin samajhdaar yuvtiyon ne unhein javaab diya, ‘Hamaare aur tumhaare donon ke lie to tel pura nahin hoga. Bhala to yah hoga ki tum jaakar vyaapaariyon se apne lie tel mol le lo.’
“Heaven ka kingdom us person ke jaisa bhi hai, jo ek yaatra ke lie taiyaar tha, jisne har ek servant ko uski yogyta ke anurup property saump di.
Ek ko paanch taalant, ek ko do aur ek ko ek. Iske baad vah apni yaatra par chala gaya.
Jis servant ko paanch taalant die gae the, usne turant us wealth ka vyaapaar mein lenden kiya, jisse usne paanch taalant aur kamaae.
Isi tarah us servant ne bhi, jise do taalant die gae the, do aur kamaae.
Lekin jise ek taalant diya gaya tha, usne jaakar zameen mein gaddha khoda aur apne maalik ki di hui vah property vahaan chhipa di.
“Bare dinon ke baad unke maalik ne lautkar unse hisaab liya.
Jise paanch taalant die gae the, usne apne saath paanch taalant aur laakar maalik se kaha, ‘Mahoday, aapne mujhe paanch taalant die the. Yah dekhie, mainne inse paanch aur kamaae hain.’

“Uske maalik ne usse kaha, ‘Shaabaash, mere yogy aur vishvasniy servant! Tum thore wealth mein vishvasniy paae gae isliye main tumhein kai zimmedaariyaan saumpunga. Apne maalik ke khushi mein sahbhaagi ho jaao.’
“Vah servant bhi aaya, jise do taalant die gae the. Usne maalik se kaha, ‘Mahoday, aapne mujhe do taalant die the. Yah dekhie, mainne do aur kamaae hain!’

“Uske maalik ne usse kaha, ‘Shaabaash, mere yogy aur vishvasniy servant! Tum thore wealth mein vishvasniy paae gae isliye main tumhein kai zimmedaariyaan saumpunga. Apne maalik ke khushi mein sahbhaagi ho jaao.’
Is rahasy ke khulne ke baad Yeshu ne disciples ko dekhkar kaha,
“Yah to tumhein maalum hi hai ki do din baad Fasah utsav hai. Is samay insaan ke son ko krus par charhaae jaane ke lie saump diya jaaega.”
Dusri or leader priest aur varishth naagrik kaayaafas naamak high priest ke ghar ke aangan mein ikattha hue.
Unhonne milkar Yeshu ko chhalpurvak pakarkar unki murder kar dene ka soch kiya.
Ve yah soch bhi kar rahe the: “Yah Fasah utsav ke avsar par na kiya jaae—kahin isse logon mein balva na bharak uthe.”
Jab Yeshu baithniyaah gaanv mein Shimon ke ghar par the—vahi Shimon, jise pahle korh rog hua tha,
Ek aurat unke paas sangmarmar ke bartan mein kimti itr lekar aai. Use usne khaana ke lie baithe Yeshu ke sir par undel diya.
Yah dekh disciple gussa ho kahne lage, “Yah phizulkharchi kis lie?
Yah itr to unche daam par bik sakta tha aur receive dhanraashi garibon mein baanti ja sakti thi.”
Is vishay ko jaankar Yeshu ne unhein jhirakte hue kaha, “Kyon sata rahe ho is aurat ko? Isne mere hit mein ek saraahniy kaam kiya hai.
Nirdhan tumhaare saath hamesha raheinge lekin main tumhaare saath hamesha nahin rahunga.
Tab kaariyotvaasi Yahudah, jo baarah disciples mein se ek tha, leader priests ke paas gaya
Aur unse soch-vimarsh karne laga, “Yadi main Yeshu ko pakarva dun to aap mujhe kya deinge?” Unhonne use gin kar chaandi ke tis sikke de die.
Us samay se vah Yeshu ko pakarvaane ke lie sahi avsar ki taak mein rahne laga.
Akhmiri roti ke utsav ke pahle din disciples ne Yeshu ke paas aakar puchha, “Ham aapke lie Fasah bhoj ki taiyaari kahaan karein? Aap kya chaahte hain?”

Yeshu ne unhein nirdesh diya, “Shehar mein ek person vishesh ke paas jaana aur usse kahna, ‘Guruvar ne kaha hai, mera samay paas hai. Mujhe apne disciples ke saath aapke ghar mein Fasah utsav manaana hai.’ ”
Disciples ne vaisa hi kiya, jaisa Yeshu ne nirdesh diya tha aur unhonne Fasah bhoj taiyaar kiya.
Sandhya samay Yeshu apne baarah disciples ke saath baithe hue the.
Jab ve khaana kar rahe the Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Main tum par ek sach reveal kar raha hun: tumhin mein ek hai, jo mere saath dhokha karega.”
Bahut udaas man se har ek disciple Yeshu se puchhne laga, “Lord, vah main to nahin hun?”
Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Jisne mere saath katore mein apna kaur duboya tha, vahi hai, jo mere saath dhokha karega.

Insaan ke son ko to jaisa ki uske baare mein Scripture mein likha hai, jaana hi hai; lekin dhikkaar hai us person par, jo insaan ke son ke saath dhokha karega. Us person ke lie achchha to yahi hota ki uska janm hi na hota.”
Yahudah ne, jo Yeshu ke saath dhokha kar raha tha, unse savaal kiya, “Rabbi, vah main to nahin hun na?” Yeshu ne use javaab diya, “Yah tumne khud hi kah diya hai.”
Jab ve khaana ke lie baithe, Yeshu ne roti li, uske lie blessing request ki, use tori aur disciples ko dete hue kaha, “Yah lo, khaao; yah mera body hai.”
Tab Yeshu ne pyaala liya, uske lie thanks diya aur disciples ko dete hue kaha, “Tum sab ismein se piyo.
Main yah bataana chaahta hun ki main daakh ka ras us din tak nahin piunga jab tak main apne pita ke raajy mein tumhaare saath daakhras dobaara nahin piun.”
Ek bhakti git gaane ke baad ve zaitun parvat par chale gae.

Yeshu ne disciples se kaha, “Aaj raat tum sabhi mera saath chhorkar chale jaaoge, jaisa ki is sambandh mein Scripture ka lekh hai: “ ‘Main charvaahe ka sanhaar karunga aur, jhund ki sabhi bherein titar-bitar ho jaaeingi.’
Lekin Petros ne Yeshu se kaha, “Sabhi disciple aapka saath chhorkar jaaein to jaaein lekin main aapka saath kabhi na chhorunga.”
Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Sach to yah hai ki aaj hi raat mein, iske pahle ki murg baang de, tum mujhe tin baar nakaar chuke honge.”
Petros ne dobaara unse kaha, “Mujhe aapke saath yadi maut ko bhi gale lagaana pare to bhi main aapko nahin nakaarunga.” Dusre sabhi disciples ne yahi dohraaya.
Tab Yeshu unke saath getsemni naamak jagah par pahunche. Unhonne apne disciples se kaha, “Tum yahin baitho jab tak main vahaan jaakar prayer karta hun.”
Phir vah Petros aur zebediyos ke donon sons ko apne saath le aage chale gae. Vahaan Yeshu bahut udaas aur vyaakul hone lage.
Unhonne disciples se kaha, “Mere jaan itne adhik udaas hain, maano meri maut ho rahi ho. Mere saath tum bhi jaagte raho.”

Tab Yeshu unse thori hi dur ja chehra ke bal girkar prayer karne lage. Unhonne God se nivedan kiya, “Mere pita, yadi sambhav ho to yah pyaala mujhse tal jaae; phir bhi meri nahin lekin aapki chaahat ke anurup ho.”
Jab vah apne disciples ke paas laute to unhein soya hua dekh unhonne Petros se kaha, “Achchha, tum mere saath ek ghanta bhi sajag na rah sake!
Sajag raho, prayer karte raho, aisa na ho ki tum pariksha mein par jaao. Haan, nihsandeh aatma to taiyaar hai lekin body durbal.”
Tab Yeshu ne dusri baar jaakar prayer ki, “Mere pita, yadi yah pyaala mere pie bina mujhse tal nahin sakta to aap hi ki chaahat puri ho.”
Vah dobaara lautkar aae to dekha ki disciple soe hue hain—kyonki unki palkein bojhil thi.
Ek baar phir vah unhein chhor aage chale gae aur tisri baar prayer ki aur unhonne prayer mein vahi sab dohraaya.

Tab vah disciples ke paas laute aur unse kaha, “Kya tum abhi bhi so rahe aur aaraam kar rahe ho? Bahut ho gaya! Dekho! A gaya hai vah kshan! Insaan ka son galti karnevaalon ke haathon pakarvaaya ja raha hai.
Utho! Yahaan se chalein. Dekho, jo mujhe pakarvaane par hai, vah a gaya!”

Yeshu apna kathan samaapt bhi na kar paae the ki Yahudah, jo baarah disciples mein se ek tha, vahaan a pahuncha. Uske saath ek bari bhir thi, jo talvaarein aur laathiyaan lie hue thi. Ye sab leader priests aur purniyon ki or se bheje gae the.
Yeshu ke vishvaasghaati ne unhein yah sanket diya tha: “Main jise chumun, vahi hoga vah. Use hi pakar lena.”
Vahaan pahunchte hi Yahudah sidhe Yeshu ke paas gaya aur unse kaha, “Pranaam, rabbi!” Aur unhein chum liya.
Yeshu ne Yahudah se kaha, “Mere mitr, jis kaam ke lie aae ho, use pura kar lo.” Unhonne aakar Yeshu ko pakar liya.
Yeshu ke disciples mein se ek ne talvaar khinchi aur high priest ke slave par chala di jisse uska kaan kat gaya.
Yeshu ne us disciple se kaha, “Apni talvaar ko myaan mein rakho! Jo talvaar uthaate hain, ve talvaar se hi barbaadi kie jaaeinge.
Phir bhala Scripture ke lekh kaise pure honge, jinmein likha hai ki yah sab isi tarah hona zarur hai?”

Tab Yeshu ne bhir ko sambodhit karte hue kaha, “Kya tumhein mujhe pakarne ke lie talvaarein aur laathiyaan lekar aane ki zarurat thi, jaise kisi daaku ko pakarne ke lie hoti hai? Main to pratidin temple mein baithkar teaching diya karta tha! Tab tumne mujhe nahin pakra!
Yah sab isliye hua hai ki bhavishyadvaktaaon ke lekh pure hon.” Is samay sabhi disciple unhein chhorkar bhaag chuke the.
Jinhonne Yeshu ko pakra tha ve unhein high priest kaayaafas ke yahaan le gae, jahaan shaastri aur purniye ikattha the.
Petros kuchh duri par Yeshu ke pichhe-pichhe chalte hue high priest ke aangan mein a pahunche aur vahaan vah prahriyon ke saath baith gae ki dekhein aage kya-kya hota hai.
Yeshu ko maut dand dene ki chaahat lie hue leader priest aur puri mahaasbha Yeshu ke khilaaf jhuthe gavaah khojne ka yatn kar rahi thi,
Lekin ismein ve viphal hi rahe. Yadypi kai jhuthe gavaah saamne aae, lekin maut dand ke lie zaruri do sahmat gavaah unhein phir bhi na mile. Aakhir do gavaah saamne aae
Jinhonne kaha, “Yah person kahta tha, ‘Main God ke temple ko barbaadi karke use tin din mein dobaara khara karne mein samarth hun.’ ”
Tab high priest khare hue aur Yeshu se puchha, “Kya tumhein apne bachaav mein kuchh nahin kahna hai? Ye sab tumhaare khilaaf kya-kya gavaahi de rahe hain!”
Yah sunna tha ki high priest ne apne kapde phaar daale aur kaha, “God-ninda ki hai isne! Kya ab bhi gavaahon ki zarurat hai? Aap sabhi ne khud yah God-ninda suni hai.
Ab kya soch hai aapka?” Sabhi parishad ne javaab diya, “Yah maut dand ke yogy hai.”
Tab unhonne Yeshu ke chehra par thuka, un par ghunson se prahaar kiya, kuchh ne unhein thappar bhi maare aur phir unse savaal kiya,
“Yeshu! Bhavishyvaani kijie, ki aapko kisne maara hai?”
Petros aangan mein baithe hue the. Ek daasi vahaan se nikli aur Petros se puchhne lagi, “Tum bhi to us galilvaasi Yeshu ke saath the na?”
Lekin Petros ne sabke saamne yah kahte hue is sach ko nakaar diya: “Kya kah rahi ho? Main samjha nahin!”
Jab Petros dvaar se baahar nikle, ek dusri daasi ne Petros ko dekh vahaan upasthit logon se kaha, “Yah person naazreth ke Yeshu ke saath tha.”
Ek baar phir Petros ne shapath khaakar nakaarte hue kaha, “Main us person ko nahin jaanta.”
Kuchh samay baad ek person ne Petros ke paas aakar kaha, “Ismein koi sandeh nahin ki tum bhi unmein se ek ho. Tumhaari bhaasha-shaili se yah spasht ho raha hai.”
Petros apshabd kahte hue shapath khaakar kahne lage, “Main us person ko nahin jaanta!” Unka yah kahna tha ki murg ne baang di.
Petros ko Yeshu ki vah kahi hui baat yaad aai, “Iske purv ki murg baang de tum mujhe tin baar nakaar chuke hoge.” Petros baahar gae aur phut-phutkar rone lage.
Praatahkaal sabhi leader priests aur purniyon ne aapas mein Yeshu ko maut dand dene ki sahamti ki.
Yeshu ko beriyon se baandhkar ve unhein raajypaal Pilatos ke yahaan le gae.

Isi samay, jab Yeshu par saza sunaai gai, Yahudah, jisne Yeshu ke saath dhokha kiya tha, duhkh aur pashchaataap se bhar utha. Usne leader priests aur purniyon ke paas jaakar chaandi ke ve tis sikke yah kahte hue lauta die,
“Ek nirdosh ke saath dhokha karke mainne galti kiya hai.” “Hamein isse kya?” Ve bole, “Yah tumhaari samasya hai!”
Ve sikke temple mein pheink Yahudah chala gaya aur jaakar phaansi laga li.
Un sikkon ko ikattha karte hue leader priests ne soch kiya, “Is raashi ko temple ke kosh mein daalna uchit nahin hai kyonki yah lahu ka daam hai.”
Tab unhonne is baare mein soch-vimarsh kar us raashi se pardeshiyon ke antim sanskaar ke lie kumhaar ka ek khet mol liya.
Yahi kaaran hai ki aaj tak us khet ko “Lahu ka khet” Naam se jaana jaata hai.
Isse prophet yeremiyaah dvaara ki gai yah bhavishyvaani puri ho gai: “Unhonne chaandi ke tis sikke lie—yah uska daam hai, jiska daam Israel vansh ke dvaara nirdhaarit kiya gaya tha
Aur unhonne ve sikke kumhaar ke khet ke lie de die, jaisa nirdesh Lord ne mujhe diya tha.”
Yeshu raajypaal ke saamne laae gae aur raajypaal ne unse savaal karne shuruaat kie, “Kya tum Yahudiyon ke raaja ho?” Yeshu ne use javaab diya, “Yah aap khud hi kah rahe hain.”
Jab Yeshu par leader priests aur purniyon dvaara aarop par aarop lagaae ja rahe the, Yeshu maun bane rahe.
Is par Pilatos ne Yeshu se kaha, “Kya tum sun nahin rahe ye log tum par kitne aarop laga rahe hain?”
Yeshu ne Pilatos ko kisi bhi aarop ka koi uttar na diya. Raajypaal ke lie yah bahut aashcharyajnak tha.
Utsav par parampra ke hisaab se raajypaal ki or se us bandi ko, jise log chaahte the, chhor diya jaata tha.
Us samay bandigrih mein baar-abbaas naamak ek kukhyaat apraadhi bandi tha.
Isliye jab log ikattha hue Pilatos ne unse savaal kiya, “Main tumhaare lie kise chhor dun, baar-abbaas ko ya Yeshu ko, jo Yeshu kahlaata hai? Kya chaahte ho tum?”
Pilatos ko yah maalum ho chuka tha ki sirf jalan ke kaaran hi unhonne Yeshu ko unke haathon mein saumpa tha.
Jab Pilatos nyaayaasan par baitha tha, uski patni ne use yah sandesh bheja, “Us righteous person ko kuchh na karna kyonki pichhli raat mujhe svapn mein uske kaaran ghor dard hui hai.”
Is par leader priests aur purniyon ne bhir ko uksaaya ki ve baar-abbaas ki mukti ki aur Yeshu ke maut dand ki maang karein.
Raajypaal ne unse puchha, “Kya chaahte ho, donon mein se main kise chhor dun?” Bhir ka uttar tha: “Baar-abbaas ko.”
Is par Pilatos ne unse puchha, “Tab main Yeshu ka, jo Yeshu kahlaata hai, kya karun?” Un sabhi ne ek saath kaha, “Use krus par charhaaya jaae!”
Pilatos ne puchha, “Kyon? Kya apraadh hai uska?” Lekin ve aur adhik chillaane lage, “Krus par charhaaya jaae use!”

Jab Pilatos ne dekha ki vah kuchh bhi nahin kar pa raha lekin hullar ki sambhaavna hai to usne bhir ke saamne apne haath dhote hue yah ghoshna kar di, “Main is person ke lahu ka doshi nahin hun. Tum hi iske lie uttardaayi ho.”
Tab Pilatos ne unke lie baar-abbaas ko mukt kar diya lekin Yeshu ko kore lagvaakar krusit karne ke lie bhir ke haathon mein saump diya.
Tab Pilatos ke sainik Yeshu ko praaitoriyam arthaat kile ke bhitar, mahal ke aangan mein le gae aur vahaan unhonne saari romi sainik tukri ikattha kar li.
Jo kapde Yeshu pahne hue the, utaarkar unhonne unhein ek chamkila laal kapde pahna diya.

Unhonne ek kantili lata ko gundhkar uska mukut bana unke sir par rakh diya aur unke daayein haath mein ek narkul ki ek chhari thama di. Tab ve unke saamne ghutne tekkar yah kahte hue unka mazaak karne lage, “Yahudiyon ke raaja ki jay!”
Unhonne Yeshu par thuka bhi aur phir unke haath se us narkul chhari ko lekar usi se unke sir par prahaar karne lage.
Is tarah jab ve Yeshu ka uphaas kar chuke, unhonne vah laal kapde utaarkar unhin ke kapde unhein pahna die aur unhein us sthal par le jaane lage jahaan unhein krus par charhaaya jaana tha.
Jab ve baahar nikle, unhein Shimon naamak ek person, jo kurenaavaasi tha, dikhaai diya. Unhonne use Yeshu ka krus uthaakar chalne ke lie majbur kiya.
Jab ve sab golgotha naamak sthal par pahunche, jiska arth hai (khopri ka jagah).
Unhonne Yeshu ko pine ke lie daakhras aur karve ras ka mishran diya lekin unhonne sirf chakhkar use pina asvikaar kar diya.
Yeshu ko krusit karne ke baad unhonne unke kapdon ko aapas mein baant lene ke lie paasa pheinka
Aur vahin baithkar unki chauksi karne lage.
Unhonne unke sir ke upar doshpatr laga diya tha, jis par likha tha: “Yah Yeshu hai—Yahudiyon ka raaja.”
Usi samay do apraadhiyon ko bhi unke saath krus par charhaaya gaya tha, ek ko unki daayin or, dusre ko unki baayin or.
Aate jaate yaatri uphaas-mudra mein sir hila-hila kar mazaak ura rahe the,
“Are o temple ko barbaadi kar, tin din mein usko dubaara banaanevaale! Bacha le apne aapko—yadi tu God ka son hai to utar a krus se!”
Unke saath krus par charhaaye gae raajadrohi bhi isi tarah unki ullaahna kar rahe the.
Madhyaahn se lekar tin baje tak us saare pradesh par andhera chhaaya raha.
Tin baje ke lagbhag Yeshu ne unchi aavaaj mein pukaarkar kaha, “Eli, eli, lama sabakhthaani?” Jiska arth hai, “Mere God! Mere God! Aapne mujhe kyon chhor diya?”
Udhar khare hue logon mein se kuchh ne kaha, “Are! Suno-suno! Eliyah ko pukaar raha hai!”
Unmein se ek ne turant daurkar ek spanj sirke mein bhigoya aur ek narkul ki ek chhari par rakhkar Yeshu ke honthon tak barha diya.
Lekin auron ne kaha, “Thahro, thahro, dekhein Eliyah use bachaane aate bhi hain ya nahin.”
Yeshu ne ek baar phir unchi aavaaj mein pukaara aur apne jaan tyaag die.
Usi kshan temple ka parda upar se niche tak do bhaagon mein vibhaajit kar diya gaya, prithvi kaamp uthi, chattaanein phat gain
Kai striyaan dur khari hui yah sab dekh rahi thi. Ve Galil pradesh se Yeshu ki service karti hui unke pichhe-pichhe a gai thi.
Unmein thi magdaalaavaasi Mariyam, Yaakob aur Yosef ki maata Mariyam aur zebediyos ki patni.
God ke son Yeshu ke good news ka shuru:
Prophet yashaayaah ke abhilekh ke hisaab se, “Tumhaare purv main apna ek dut bhej raha hun, jo tumhaara raasta taiyaar karega”;
“Banjar zameen mein pukaarnevaale ki aavaaj hai, ‘Lord ka raasta sidha karo, unka raasta saral banaao.’ ”
Yahudiya pradesh ke kshetron se saari bhir aur Yerushalem shehar ke sabhi log unse bheint karne jaane lage. Ye sab galti accept karte hue yardan nadi mein Yohan se baptisma le rahe the.
Yohan ka paridhaan, unt ke rom se nirmit kapde aur uske upar chamre ka kamarbandh tha aur unka khaana tha tiddiyaan aur janglimdhu.
Main baptisma paani mein deta hun; vah tumhein Holy Spirit mein baptisma deinge.”
Usi samay Yeshu Galil pradesh ke naazreth shehar se aae aur unhein Yohan dvaara yardan nadi mein baptisma diya gaya.
Jab Yeshu paani se baahar a rahe the, usi kshan unhonne aakaash ko khulte aur aatma ko, jo kabutar ke jaisa tha, apne upar utarte hue dekha
Aur heaven se nikla ek word bhi sunaai diya: “Tum mere son ho—mere dear—tumse main atiprsann hun.”
Usi samay Holy Spirit ne unhein banjar zameen mein bhej diya.
Banjar zameen mein vah chaalis din aarop lagaanevaala ke dvaara parkhe jaate rahe. Vah vahaan jangli pashuon ke saath rahe aur angels ne unki service ki.
Galil jhil ke paas se jaate hue Yeshu ne Shimon aur unke bhaai aandreyaas ko dekha, jo jhil mein jaal daal rahe the. Ve machhuaare the.
Ve usi kshan apne jaal chhorkar Yeshu ka anusran karne lage.
Aage jaane par unhonne zebediyos ke son Yaakob aur unke bhaai Yohan ko dekha. Ve bhi naav mein the aur apne jaal sudhaar rahe the.
Unhein dekhte hi Yeshu ne unko bulaaya. Ve apne pita zebediyos ko mazduron ke saath naav mein hi chhorkar unke saath chal die.
Ve sab kafranhum shehar aae. Shabbat par Yeshu sthaaniy Yahudi synagogue mein jaakar teaching dene lage.
Log unki teaching se aashcharyachkit rah gae kyonki vah shaastriyon ke jaisa nahin lekin is tarah teaching de rahe the ki unhein iska authority hai.
Usi samay synagogue mein ek person, jo dard denevaali aatma se pirit tha, chilla utha,
“Naazrethvaasi Yeshu! Kya chaahte hain aap? Kya aap hamein barbaadi karne aae hain? Main jaanta hun ki aap kaun hain; God ke holy jan!”
“Chup!” Use phatkaarte hue Yeshu ne kaha, “Baahar nikal ja ismein se!”
Us person ko marorte hue vah dard denevaali aatma unche word mein chillaata hua usmein se baahar nikal gaya.

Sabhi hairaan rah gae. Ve aapas mein soch karne lage, “Yah sab kya ho raha hai? Yah adhikaarpurvak teaching dete hain aur dard denevaali aatma tak ko command dete hai aur ve unka follow bhi karti hain!”
Teji se unki khyaati Galil pradesh ke aas-paas sab jagah phail gai.
Yahudi synagogue se nikalkar ve sidhe Yaakob aur Yohan ke saath Shimon aur aandreyaas ke ghar par gae.
Vahaan Shimon ki saas bukhaar mein pari hui thi. Unhonne bina der kie Yeshu ko iske baare mein bataaya.
Yeshu unke paas aae, unka haath pakar unhein uthaaya aur unka bukhaar jaata raha aur vah unki service tahal mein jut gain.
Sandhya samay suryaast ke baad log asvasth aur jinmein dushtaatmaaain thi un logon ko Yeshu ke paas laane lage.
Saara shehar hi dvaar par ikattha ho gaya
Yeshu ne vibhinn rogon se pirit anekon ko svasth kiya aur kai dard denevaali aatmaaon ko bhi nikaala. Vah dard denevaali aatmaaon ko bolne nahin dete the kyonki ve unhein pahchaanti thi.
Bhor hone par, jab andhera hi tha, Yeshu uthe aur ek sunsaan jagah ko gae. Vahaan vah prayer karne lage.
Shimon aur unke dusre saathi unhein khoj rahe the.
Unhein paakar ve kahne lage, “Sabhi aapko khoj rahe hain.”
Ek korh rogi unke paas aaya. Usne Yeshu ke saamne ghutne tek unse request ki, “Aap chaahein to mujhe shuddh kar sakte hain.”
Taras khaakar Yeshu ne haath barhaakar use sparsh kiya aur kaha, “Main chaahta hun. Tum shuddh ho jaao!”
Usi samay uska korh rog jaata raha aur vah shuddh ho gaya.
Yeshu ne use usi samay is chetaavni ke saath vida kiya,

“Suno! Is baare mein kisi se kuchh na kahna. Haan, jaakar khud ko priest ke saamne prastut karo aur apni shuddhi ke pramaan ke lie Moshe dvaara nirdhaarit vidhi ke hisaab se shuddhi sambandhi bheint charhaao.”
Kuchh din baad Yeshu ke kafranhum shehar lautne par vahaan yah samaachaar phail gaya ki vah laut aae hain.
Vahaan itni vishaal bhir ikatthi ho gai ki kahin koi jagah shesh na raha—yahaan tak ki dvaar ke saamne bhi nahin aur Yeshu Scripture ki teaching de rahe the.
Kuchh log ek lakve ke rogi ko unke paas laae, jise chaar logon ne uthaaya hua tha.
Bhir ke kaaran ve Yeshu ke paas pahunchne mein asmarth the, isliye unhonne jahaan Yeshu the, vahaan ki kachchi chhat ko hataakar vahaan se us rogi ko bichhaune sahit niche utaar diya.
Unke is faith ko dekh Yeshu ne lakve ke rogi se kaha, “Son, tumhaare galti maafi ho chuke hain.”
Vahaan mauzud kuchh shaastri apne man mein yah soch karne lage,
“Yah person aisa kyon kah raha hai? Yah to God ki ninda kar raha hai! God ke atirikt kaun galtiyon ko maafi kar sakta hai?”

Yeshu ko apni aatma mein usi kshan yah maalum ho gaya ki ve is tarah soch-soch kar rahe hain. Yeshu ne unhein hi sambodhit karte hue savaal kiya, “Aap apne man mein is tarah soch-soch kyon kar rahe hain?
Lakve ke rogi se kya kahna saral hai, ‘Tumhaare galti maafi hue’ Ya yah, ‘Utho! Apna bichhauna uthaakar chale jaao’?
Lekin iska purpose yah hai ki tumhein yah maalum ho jaae ki insaan ke son ko prithvi par galti maafi ka authority saumpa gaya hai.” Tab rogi se Yeshu ne kaha,
“Utho, apna bichhauna uthaao aur apne ghar jaao.”
Vah utha aur tatkaal apna bichhauna sametkar un sabke dekhte-dekhte vahaan se chala gaya. Is par ve sabhi chakit rah gae aur God ki vandna karte hue kahne lage, “Aisa hamne kabhi nahin dekha.”
Tab Yeshu dobaara saagar tat par chale gae. Ek vishaal bhir unke paas a gayi aur vah unhein teaching dene lage.
Raasta mein Yeshu ne halfeyos ke son Levi ko kar-chauki par baitha dekha. Unhonne unhein command di, “Mere pichhe aao.” Vah uthe aur unke saath ho lie.
Jab Yeshu Levi ke ghar par khaana ke lie baithe the, kai chungi lenevaale aur apraadhi person Yeshu aur unke disciples ke saath khaana kar rahe the. Ek bari sankhya mein log unke pichhe ho lie the.

Yeshu ko apraadhi logon ke saath khaana karte dekh law ke shikshkon ne, jo vaastav mein Farisi the, unke disciples se savaal kiya, “Yah chungi lenevaale aur apraadhi logon ke saath kyon khaata-pita hai?”
Yah sun Yeshu ne unhein hi sambodhit kar kaha, “Vaidy ki zarurat rogi ko hoti hai, svasth person ko nahin. Main dharmiyon ka nahin lekin galti karnevaalon ka bachaav karne aaya hun.”
Yohan ke disciple aur Farisi upvaas kar rahe the. Kuchh ne aakar Yeshu se savaal kiya, “Aisa kyon hai ki Yohan aur Farisiyon ke disciple to upvaas karte hain lekin aapke disciple nahin?”
Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Kya kabhi var ke rahte hue uske saathi upvaas karte hain? Jab tak var unke saath hai, ve upvaas kar hi nahin sakte.
Lekin vah samay aaega, jab var unke beech se hata liya jaaega, ve us samay upvaas kareinge.
“Kisi puraane kapde par naye kapde ka jor nahin lagaaya jaata kyonki aisa karne par naye kapde ka jor sikur kar us puraane kapde ki pahle se adhik durdsha kar deta hai.

Koi bhi naye daakhras ko puraani mashkon mein nahin rakhta anytha khamir hokar daakhras mashkon ko phaar deti hai. Isse daakhras bhi barbaadi ho jaata hai aur mashkein bhi—naya daakhras nae matke mein hi daala jaata hai.”
Ek Shabbat par Yeshu ann ke kheton mein se hokar ja rahe the. Chalte hue unke disciple baalein torne lage.
Is par Farisiyon ne Yeshu se kaha, “Dekho! Ve log vah kaam kyon kar rahe hain, jo Shabbat par law ke hisaab se nahin hai?”
Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Kya aapne kabhi parha nahin? Kya kiya tha David ne jab vah aur unke saathi bhukhe aur khaana ki kami mein the?

High priest abiyaathar ke samay mein unhonne God ke bhavan mein pravesh kiya aur samarpit holy roti khaai jise khaana priest ke atirikt dusre kisi ke lie law ke hisaab se nahin tha. Yahi roti unhonne apne saathiyon ko bhi di.”
Tab unhonne aage kaha, “Shabbat ki sthaapna insaan ke lie ki gai hai na ki insaan ki Shabbat ke lie.
Isliye, insaan ka son Shabbat ka bhi maalik hai.”
Yeshu ek Yahudi synagogue mein the, jahaan ek person tha, jiska haath laqva maara hua tha.
Kuchh person is avsar ki taak mein the ki Shabbat par Yeshu us person ko svasth karein aur ve un par dosh laga sakein.
Yeshu ne us person ko, jiska haath sukh gaya tha, command di, “Utho! Sabke saamne khare ho jaao!”
Tab anyon ko sambodhit karte hue Yeshu ne puchha, “Shabbat par kya karna law ke hisaab se hai—bhala ya bura? Life ki raksha ya vinaash?” Ve sab maun bane rahe.

Tab un sab par gusse se bhari nazar daalte hue, unke man ki kathorta par vyathit hokar Yeshu ne us person se kaha, “Apna haath aage barhaao.” Usne apna haath aage barhaaya—uska haath punahsvasth ho gaya tha.
Isliye Farisi baahar chale gae aur raaja Herodes ke samarthkon ke saath Yeshu ki murder ka sharyantr rachne lage.
Yeshu apne disciples ke saath jhil ke paas chale gae. Ek vishaal bhir, jo Galil aur Yahudiya pradesh se aakar ikatthi hui thi, unke pichhe-pichhe chal rahi thi.
Yeshu ke bare-bare kaamon ka varnan sunkar Yerushalem shehar, idumiya pradesh, yardan nadi ke paar ke kshetr aur sor aur sidon se bhi anekon kai is bhir mein sammilit ho gae the.
Is vishaal bhir ke dabaav se bachne ke purpose se Yeshu ne disciples ko ek naav taiyaar rakhne ki command di.
Yeshu ne anekon ko svaasthydaan diya tha isliye ve sabhi, jo rogi the, sirf unhein chhu lene ke purpose se un par gire parte the.
Jab kabhi dard denevaali aatma unke saamne aati thi, ve unke saamne girkar chilla-chillaakar kahti thi, “Aap God ke son hain!”
Lekin Yeshu ne unhein chetaavni di ki ve yah kisi se na kahein.
Iske baad Yeshu parvat par chale gae. Vahaan unhonne unhein apne paas bulaaya, jinhein unhonne sahi samjha aur ve unke paas aae.
Aur unhein dard denevaali aatma nikaalne ka authority ho.
Yeshu dvaara chune hue baarah ke naam is tarah hain: Shimon (jinhein unhonne Petros naam diya),
Zebediyos ke son Yaakob aur unke bhaai Yohan, (jinko unhonne upnaam diya tha, boenerges, jiska arth hota hai “Garjan ke son”),
Aandreyaas, filippos, baartholomeyos, mattiyaah, thomos, halfeyos ke son Yaakob, thaddeiyos, Shimon kanaani
Aur kaariyotvaasi Yahudah, jisne Yeshu ke saath dhokha kiya.
Jab Yeshu kisi ke ghar mein the to dobaara ek bari bhir vahaan ikatthi ho gayi—yahaan tak ki unke lie khaana karna bhi asambhav ho gaya.
Jab Yeshu ke parivaar janon ko iska samaachaar mila to ve Yeshu ko apne sanrakshan mein apne saath le jaane ke lie vahaan a gae—unka soch tha ki Yeshu apna maansik santulan kho chuke hain.
Yerushalem shehar se vahaan aae hue shaastriyon ka mat tha ki Yeshu mein belazbul samaaya hua hai aur vah dard denevaali aatmaaon ke naayak ki madad se dard denevaali aatma nikaala karte hain.
Is par Yeshu ne unhein apne paas bulaakar unse drishtaanton mein kahna shuruaat kiya, “Bhala aarop lagaanevaala hi aarop lagaanevaala ko kaise nikaal sakta hai?
Yadi kisi raajy mein phut par chuki hai to uska astitv bana nahin rah sakta.
Vaise hi yadi kisi parivaar mein phut par jaae to vah sthaayi nahin rah sakta.
Yadi aarop lagaanevaala apne hi khilaaf uth khara hua hai aur vah bant chuka hai to uska astitv bana rahna asambhav hai—vah to barbaadi ho chuka hai!

Koi bhi kisi balvaan person ke yahaan zabardasti pravesh kar uski property us samay tak lut nahin sakta jab tak vah us balvaan person ko baandh na le. Tabhi uske lie us balvaan person ki property lutna sambhav hoga.
Main tum par ek atut sach reveal kar raha hun: insaan dvaara kie gae sabhi galti aur ninda maafi yogy hain.
Yeshu ne yah sab isliye kaha tha ki shaastriyon ne un par dosh lagaaya tha ki Yeshu mein dard denevaali aatma samaaya hua hai.
Tabhi Yeshu ki maata aur unke bhaai vahaan a gae. Ve baahar hi khare rahe. Unhonne sandesh bhejkar unhein baahar bulvaaya.
Bhir unhein ghere hue baithi thi. Unhonne Yeshu ko bataaya, “Vah dekhie! Aapki maata aur aapke bhaai aur bahin baahar aapki talaash kar khare hain.”
“Kaun hain meri maata aur kaun hain mere bhaai?” Yeshu ne puchha.
Tab apni nazar apne aas-paas baithe bhir par daalte hue unhonne kaha, “Ye hain meri maata aur mere bhaai!
Jo koi God ki will ko puri karta hai, vahi hai mera bhaai, meri bahan aur meri maata.”

Ek baar phir Yeshu ne jhil tat par teaching dena shuruaat kiya. Aisi bari bhir unke aas-paas ikatthi ho gayi ki unhein jhil tat par lagi ek naav mein jaakar baithna para aur bhir jhil tat par khari rahi.
Vah kai vishyon ko drishtaanton ke maadhyam se spasht karne lage. Teaching dete hue unhonne kaha,
“Suno! Ek kisaan bij bone ke lie nikla.
Bij bone mein kuchh bij to raasta ke kinaare gire, jinhein pakshiyon ne aakar chug liya.
Kuchh dusre bij pathrili zameen par bhi ja gire, jahaan paryaapt mitti nahin thi. Paryaapt mitti na hone ke kaaran ve jaldi hi ankurit bhi ho gae
Lekin jab suryoday hua, ve jhulas gae aur isliye ki unhonne jarein hi nahin pakri thi, ve murjha gae.
Kuchh dusre bij kantili jhaariyon mein gire aur kantili jhaariyon ne unhein daba diya aur unse koi phal utpann na hua.
Kuchh dusre bij achchhi zameen par ja gire, ankurit ho bare hue aur unmein tis guna, saath guna aur sau guna phasal hui.”
Yeshu ne aage kaha, “Jis kisi ke sunne ke kaan hon, vah sun le.”
Jaise hi disciples aur dusre saathiyon ne Yeshu ko akela paaya, unhonne Yeshu se drishtaanton ke baare mein puchha.
Tab Yeshu ne unse savaal kiya, “Kya yah drishtaant tumhaari samajh mein nahin aaya? Tab tum dusre sab drishtaanton ka arth kaise samjhoge?
Bij bonevaala vachan bota hai.
Raasta ke kinaare ki zameen ve log hain, jinmein good news boya to jaata hai lekin jaise hi ve use sunte hain aarop lagaanevaala aakar us boye hue good news ko utha le jaata hai.
Isi tarah pathrili zameen ve log hain, jinmein good news boya jaata hai aur ve ise turant khushi se apna lete hain.
Dusre log us zameen ke jaisa hain, jahaan good news kaanton ke bich boya jaata hai. Ve good news ko sunte hain,
Duniya ki chintaaein, wealth-property ka chhalaava aur dusre vastuon ki laalsaaon ka pravesh us good news ko daba deta hai, jisse uska phaldaai hona asambhav ho jaata hai.
Dusre log us bij ke jaisa hain, jo uttam zameen mein boya jaata hai jo sandesh ko sunta hain, use grahan karte hain aur phal laata hai—boya gaya bij ke tis guna, saath guna aur sau guna.”
Yeshu ne aage kaha, “Dipak ko isliye nahin jalaaya jaata ki use tokri ya chaarpaai ke niche rakh diya jaae. Kya use divat par nahin rakha jaata?
Aisa kuchh bhi nahin, jo chhupa hai aur khola na jaaega aur na kuchh gupt hai, jo prakaash mein na laaya jaaega.
Jis kisi ke sunne ke kaan hon, vah sun le.”
Iske baad Yeshu ne kaha, “Iska vishesh dhyaan rakho ki tum kya sunte ho. Tumhaara naapna usi naap se kiya jaaega jiska istemaal khud tum karte ho—tumhein zarur isse bhi adhik diya jaaega.
Jiske paas hai use aur bhi adhik diya jaaega; jiske paas nahin hai, usse vah bhi le liya jaaega, jo uske paas hai.”
Yeshu ne aage kaha, “God ka kingdom us person ke jaisa hai, jisne zameen par bij daal diya
Aur raat mein jaakar so gaya. Praath uthkar usne dekha ki bij ankurit hokar bara ho raha hai. Kaisi hoti hai yah prakriya, yah vah khud nahin jaanta.
Zameen khud upaj utpann karti hai. Sabse pahle ankur ugta hai, phir baalein, uske baad baalon mein daana.
Daana parne par vah use bina deri kie hasiya se kaat leta hai kyonki upaj taiyaar hai.”
Tab Yeshu ne aage kaha, “God ke kingdom ki tulna kisse ki ja sakti hai? Kis drishtaant ke dvaara ise spasht kiya ja sakta hai?
Yah raai ke bij ke jaisa hai. Jab yah zameen mein boya jaata hai, yah boye gae dusre sabhi bijon ki tulna mein chhota hota hai
Phir bhi boye jaane par yah bara hona shuru kar deta hai aur khet ke sabhi paudhon se adhik bara ho jaata hai—itna ki aakaash ke pakshi uski chhaaya mein basera kar sakte hain.”
Sunnevaalon ki samajh ke hisaab se Yeshu isi tarah ke drishtaanton ke dvaara apna good news prastut karte the;
Bina drishtaant ke vah unse kuchh bhi nahin kahte the, aur vah apne disciples ke lie inka arth tabhi bataaya karte the, jab disciple unke saath akele hote the.
Usi din shaam ke samay mein Yeshu ne disciples se kaha, “Chalo, us paar chalein.”
Bhir ko vahin chhor, unhonne Yeshu ko, vah jaise the vaise hi, apne saath naav mein le turant chal die. Kuchh dusre naavein bhi unke saath ho lin.
Usi samay hava bahut teji se chalne lagi. Tej lahron ke thaperon ke kaaran naav mein paani bharne laga.
Yeshu naav ke pichhle bhaag mein takiya lagaae hue so rahe the. Unhein jagaate hue disciple bole, “Guruvar! Aapko hamaari chinta hi nahin ki ham barbaadi hue ja rahe hain!”
Yeshu jaag gae. Unhonne bavandar ko daanta aur lahron ko command di, “Shaant ho jaao! Sthir ho jaao!” Bavandar shaant ho gaya aur puri shaanti chha gai.
Yeshu disciples ko dekhkar bole, “Kyon itne bhaybhit ho tum? Kya kaaran hai ki tummein ab tak faith nahin?”
Disciple bahut bhaybhit the. Ve aapas mein kahne lage, “Kaun hai yah ki bavandar aur jhil tak inka aajnaapaalan karte hain!”
Tab ve jhil ke dusre tat par giraasen kshetr mein aae.
Yeshu ke naav se niche utarte hi ek insaan jismein dard denevaali aatma thi kabr se nikalkar unke paas aaya.
Vah kabron ke beech hi raha karta tha. Ab koi bhi use saanklon aur beriyon se bhi baandh paane mein samarth na tha.

Bahudha use beriyon aur saanklon mein baandhe jaane ke koshish kie gae lekin vah saanklon ko tor deta aur beriyon ke tukre-tukre kar daalta tha. Ab kisi mein itni kshamta na thi ki use vash mein kar sake.
Raat-din kabron ke beech aur pahaariyon mein vah chillaata rahta tha aur khud ko patthar maar-maar kar ghaayal kar leta tha.
Dur se hi jab usne Yeshu ko dekha, vah daurkar unke paas aaya, apna sir jhukaaya
Aur usmein se unchi aavaaj mein ye word sunaai die, “Param leader God ke son Yeshu! Mera aapka koi lenden nahin. Aapko God ki shapath, mujhe koi kasht na dein,”
Kyonki Yeshu use command de chuke the, “O dard denevaali aatma, is insaan mein se nikal a!”
Tab Yeshu ne usse savaal kiya, “Kya naam hai tera?” Dard denevaali aatma ne javaab diya, “Sena—kyonki ham bahut hain.”
Dard denevaali aatma Yeshu se request karne laga ki vah use us pradesh se baahar na bhejein.
Vahin pahaari par suaron ka ek vishaal jhund char raha tha.
Dard denevaali aatma-samuh ne Yeshu se request ki, “Hamein in suaron mein bhej dijie ki ham unmein ja basein.”

Yeshu ne unhein yah command de di. Ve dard denevaali aatma baahar nikalkar un suaron mein pravesh kar gae. Lagbhag do hazaar suaron ka vah jhund pahaar ki tivr dhalaan par tej gati se daurta hua jhil mein ja duba.
Bhaybhit rakhvaale bhaag gae aur shehar aur paas ke kshetron mein jaakar is ghatna ke baare mein bataane lage. Nagarvaasi, jo kuchh hua tha, use dekhne vahaan aane lage.

Jab ve Yeshu ke paas pahunche, unhonne dekha ki vah dard denevaali aatma se pirit person kapde dhaaran kie hue sachet situation mein vahaan baitha tha. Yah vahi person tha jismein dard denevaali aatmaaon ki sena paithi thi. Yah dekh ve dar gae.
Saare ghatnaakram ko dekhnevaale logon ne unke saamne iska bayaan kiya ki dard denevaali aatma se pirit person aur suaron ke saath kya-kya hua hai.
Is par ve Yeshu se request karne lage ki vah unke kshetr se baahar chale jaaein.
Jab Yeshu naav par savaar ho rahe the, dard denevaali aatmaaon se vimukt hua person Yeshu se request karne laga ki use unke saath le liya jaae.
Yeshu dobaara jhil ke dusre tat par chale gae. Ek bari bhir unke paas ikatthi ho gayi. Yeshu jhil tat par hi rahe.
Sthaaniy Yahudi synagogue ka ek adhikaari, jiska naam jaairus tha, vahaan aaya. Yah dekh ki vah kaun hain, vah unke charnon par gir para.
Bari hi request ke saath usne Yeshu se kaha, “Meri beti marne par hai. Kripya chalie aur us par haath rakh dijie ki vah svasth ho jaae aur jivit rahe.”
Yeshu uske saath chale gae. Bari bhir bhi unke pichhe-pichhe chal rahi thi aur log un par gire parte the.
Ek aurat baarah varsh se lahusraav-pirit thi.
Kai chikitskon ke haathon se usne kai piraaein sahi thi. Ismein vah apna sab kuchh vyay kar chuki thi, phir bhi isse use laabh ke badle haani hi uthaani pari thi.
Yeshu ke baare mein sunkar usne bhir mein pichhe se aakar Yeshu ke kapde ke chhor ko chhua.
Uska yah faith tha: “Yadi main unke kapde ko bhi chhu lun, to main svasth ho jaaungi.”
Usi kshan uska raktasraav tham gaya. Khud use apne body mein yah maalum ho gaya ki vah apni dard se thik ho chuki hai.
Usi kshan Yeshu ko bhi yah aabhaas hua ki unmein se power nikli hai. Bhir mein hi unhonne murkar savaal kiya, “Kaun hai vah, jisne mere kapde ko chhua hai?”
Disciples ne unse kaha, “Aap to dekh hi rahe hain ki kis tarah bhir aap par giri par rahi hai, aur aap savaal kar rahe hain, ‘Kaun hai vah, jisne mere kapde ko chhua hai!’ ”
Lord ki nazar use khojne lagi, jisne yah kiya tha.
Vah aurat yah jaante hue ki uske saath kya hua hai, dar se kaampti hui unke charnon par a giri aur un par saari sach reveal kar di.
Yeshu ne us aurat se kaha, “Putri, tumhaare faith ne tumhein svasth kiya hai. Shaanti mein vida ho jaao aur svasth raho.”
Jab Yeshu yah kah hi rahe the, yaairos ke ghar se aae kuchh logon ne yah suchna di, “Aapki putri ki maut ho chuki hai. Ab guruvar ko kasht dene ka kya laabh?”
Yeshu ne yah sun us Yahudi synagogue adhikaari se kaha, “Bhaybhit na ho—keval faith karo.”
Unhonne Petros, Yaakob aur Yaakob ke bhaai Yohan ke atirikt dusre kisi ko bhi apne saath aane ki anumti na di,
Aur ye sab Yahudi synagogue adhikaari ke ghar par pahunche. Yeshu ne dekha ki vahaan shor macha hua hai aur log unchi aavaaj mein ro-pit rahe hain.
Ghar mein pravesh kar Yeshu ne unhein sambodhit karte hue kaha, “Yah shor aur rona-pitna kyon! Bachchi ki maut nahin hui hai—vah keval so rahi hai.”
Yah sun ve Yeshu ka thattha karne lage. Lekin Yeshu ne un sabhi ko vahaan se baahar nikaal bachchi ke maata-pita aur apne saathiyon ko saath le us kaksh mein pravesh kiya, jahaan vah baalika thi.
Vahaan unhonne baalika ka haath pakarkar usse kaha, “Taalitha koum” (arthaat beti, utho!)
Usi kshan vah uth khari hui aur chalne phirne lagi. Is par ve sabhi chakit rah gae. Baalika baarah varsh ki thi.
Yeshu ne unhein spasht order die ki is ghatna ke baare mein koi bhi jaanne na paae aur phir unse kaha ki us baalika ko khaane ke lie kuchh diya jaae.
Yeshu vahaan se apne grihangar aae. Unke disciple unke saath the.

Shabbat par ve Yahudi synagogue mein teaching dene lage. Unko sun unmein se kai chakit ho kahne lage. “Kahaan se receive hua ise yah sab? Kahaan se receive hua hai ise yah samajh kaushal aur haathon se yah adbhut kaam karne ki kshamta?
Kya yah vahi barhai nahin? Kya yah Mariyam ka son aur Yaakob, yoses, Yahudah aur Shimon ka bhaai nahin? Kya usi ki bahnein hamaare beech nahin hain?” Is par unhonne Yeshu ko asvikaar kar diya.
Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Prophet har jagah sammaanit hota hai sivaay apne khud ke shehar mein, apne sambandhiyon aur parivaar ke beech.”
Kuchh rogiyon par haath rakh unhein svasth karne ke atirikt Yeshu vahaan koi dusre adbhut kaam na kar sake.
Yeshu ko unke unbelief par bahut hi aashchary hua.
Unhonne un baarhon ko bulaaya aur unhein dard denevaali aatmaaon par authority dete hue unhein do-do karke bhej diya.
Yeshu ne unhein order die, “Is yaatra mein chhari ke atirikt apne saath kuchh na le jaana—na khaana, na jholi aur na paisa.
Haan, chappal to pahan sakte ho lekin atirikt baahri kapde nahin.”
Aage unhonne kaha, “Jis ghar mein bhi tum thahro us shehar se vida hone tak vahin rahna.
Unhonne kai dard denevaali aatmaaein nikaali aur kai rogiyon ko tel malkar unhein svasth kiya.
Kuchh kah rahe the, “Vah Eliyah hain.” Kuchh yah bhi kahte sune gae, “Vah ek prophet hain—atit mein hue bhavishyadvaktaaon ke jaisa.”
Khud Herodes ne Yohan ko bandi banaakar kaaraagaar mein daal diya tha kyonki usne apne bhaai filippos ki patni herodias se vivaah kar liya tha.
Yohan Herodes ko yaad dilaate rahte the, “Tumhaare lie apne bhaai ki patni ko rakh lena law ke hisaab se nahin hai.” Isliye
Herodiyaas ke man mein Yohan ke lie shatrubhaav panap raha tha. Vah unka vadh karvaana chaahti thi lekin usse kuchh nahin ho pa raha tha.

Herodes Yohan se darta tha kyonki vah jaanta tha ki Yohan ek righteous aur holy person hain. Herodes ne Yohan ko surakshit rakha tha. Yohan ke pravchan sunkar vah ghabraata to tha phir bhi use unke pravchan sunna bahut dear tha.

Aakhirkaar herodias ko vah mauka receive ho hi gaya: apne janmdivas ke uplakshy mein Herodes ne apne sabhi uchch adhikaariyon, senaaptiyon aur Galil pradesh ke pratishthit logon ko bhoj par aamantrit kiya.
Is avsar par herodias ki putri ne vahaan apne nrity ke dvaara Herodes aur atithiyon ko moh liya. Raaja ne putri se kaha. “Mujhse chaahe jo maang lo, main dunga.”
Raaja ne shapath khaate hue kaha, “Tum jo kuchh maangogi, main tumhein dunga—chaahe vah mera aadha raajy hi kyon na ho.”
Apni maan ke paas jaakar usne puchha, “Kya maangun?” “Baptisma denevaale Yohan ka sir,” Usne kaha.
Putri ne turant jaakar raaja se kaha, “Main chaahti hun ki aap mujhe isi samay ek thaal mein baptisma denevaale Yohan ka sir laakar dein.”
Haalaanki raaja ko isse gahra duhkh to hua lekin aamantrit atithiyon ke saamne li gai apni shapath ke kaaran vah asvikaar na kar saka.
Tatkaal raaja ne ek jallaad ko bulvaaya aur Yohan ka sir le aane ki command di. Vah gaya, kaaraagaar mein Yohan ka vadh kiya
Aur unka sir ek bartan mein rakhkar putri ko saump diya aur usne jaakar apni maata ko saump diya.
Jab Yohan ke disciples ko iska samaachaar receive hua, ve aae aur Yohan ke shav ko le jaakar ek kabr mein rakh diya.
Apostle lautkar Yeshu ke paas aae aur unhein apne dvaara kie gae kaamon aur di gai teaching ka vivran diya.
Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Aao, kuchh samay ke lie kahin ekaant mein chalein aur vishraam karein,” Kyonki kai log a ja rahe the aur unhein khaana tak ka avsar receive na ho saka tha.
Ve chupchaap naav par savaar ho ek sunsaan jagah par chale gae.
Logon ne unhein vahaan jaate hue dekh liya. Anekon ne yah bhi pahchaan liya ki ve kaun the. Aas-paas ke shehron se kai log daurte hue unse pahle hi us jagah par ja pahunche.

Jab Yeshu tat par pahunche, unhonne vahaan ek bari bhir ko ikattha dekha. Use dekh vah duhkhi ho uthe kyonki unhein bhir bina charvaahe ki bheron ke jaisa lagi. Vahaan Yeshu unhein kai vishyon par teaching dene lage.
Din dhal raha tha. Disciples ne Yeshu ke paas aakar unse kaha, “Yah sunsaan jagah hai aur din dhala ja raha hai.
Ab aap inhein vida kar dijie ki ye paas ke gaanvon mein jaakar apne lie khaana-law kar sakein.”

Lekin Yeshu ne unhin se kaha, “Tum hi do inhein khaana!” Disciples ne iske uttar mein kaha, “Itnon ke khaana mein kam se kam do sau dinaar lageinge. Kya aap chaahte hain ki ham jaakar inke lie itne ka khaana le aaein?”
Yeshu ne unse puchha, “Kitni rotiyaan hain yahaan? Jaao, pata lagaao!” Unhonne pata lagaakar javaab diya, “Paanch—aur inke alaava do machhliyaan bhi.”
Yeshu ne sabhi logon ko jhunron mein hari ghaas par baith jaane ki command di.
Ve sabhi sau-sau aur pachaas-pachaas ke jhundon mein baith gae.

Yeshu ne ve paanch rotiyaan aur do machhliyaan lekar heaven ki or aankhein uthaakar unke lie thanks reveal kiya. Tab vah rotiyaan torte aur disciples ko dete gae ki ve unhein bhir mein baantte jaaein. Iske saath unhonne ve do machhliyaan bhi unmein baant din.
Sabhi ne bharpet khaaya.
Disciples ne shesh rah gae rotiyon aur machhliyon ke tukre ikattha kie to baarah tokre bhar gae.
Jinhonne khaana kiya tha, unmein aadmi hi paanch hazaar the.
Turant hi Yeshu ne disciples ko jabran naav par baitha unhein apne se pahle dusre kinaare par sthit shehar baithsaida pahunchne ke lie vida kiya—vah khud bhir ko vida kar rahe the.
Unhein vida karne ke baad vah prayer ke lie parvat par chale gae.
Raat ho chuki thi. Naav jhil ke beech mein thi. Yeshu kinaare par akele the.

Yeshu dekh rahe the ki hava ulti disha mein chalne ke kaaran disciples ko naav khene mein kathin koshish karna par raha tha. Raat ke chauthe prahar Yeshu jhil ki satah par chalte hue unke paas ja pahunche aur aisa ahsaas hua ki vah unse aage nikalna chaah rahe the.
Unhein paani satah par chalta dekh disciple samjhe ki koi dard denevaali aatma hai aur ve chilla uthe
Kyonki unhein dekh ve bhaybhit ho gae the. Is par Yeshu ne kaha, “Main hun! Mat daro! Saahas mat chhoro!”
Yah kahte hue vah unki naav mein charh gae aur vaayu tham gai. Disciple isse bahut chakit rah gae.
Rotiyon ki ghatna ab tak unki samajh se pare thi. Unke dil nirbuddhi jaise ho gae the.
Jhil paar kar ve gannesrat pradesh mein pahunch gae. Unhonne naav vahin laga di.
Yeshu ke naav se utarte hi logon ne unhein pahchaan liya.
Jahaan kahin bhi Yeshu hote the, log daur-daur kar bichhaunon par rogiyon ko vahaan le aate the.

Yeshu jis kisi shehar, gaanv ya baahri kshetr mein pravesh karte the, log rogiyon ko saarvajnik sthalon mein lita kar unse request karte the ki unhein unke kapde ke chhor ka sparsh sirf hi kar lene dein. Jo koi unke kapde ka sparsh kar leta tha, svasth ho jaata tha.
Yerushalem shehar se Farisiyon aur kuchh shaastriyon ne aakar Yeshu ko gher liya.
Unhonne dekha ki Yeshu ke kuchh disciple saanskaarik rup se ashuddh haathon se (bina dhoe hue haathon se) khaana kar rahe hain.
Farisi aur sabhi Yahudi haathon ko bhali-bhaanti dhoe bina khaana nahin karte. Aisa karte hue ve purvjon se chali a rahi prathaaon ka follow karte the.

Baajaar se lautne par ve khud ko paaramprik riti se shuddh kie bina khaana nahin karte the. Ve chali a rahi dusre kai prathaaon ka follow karte chale aae the jaise, katoron, gharon aur pakaane ke taambe ke bartnon ka dhona.
Farisiyon aur shaastriyon ne Yeshu se savaal kiya, “Tumhaare disciple purvjon se chali a rahi prathaaon ka follow kyon nahin karte? Ve ashuddh haathon se khaana karte hain.”

Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Tum paakhandiyon ke lie prophet yashaayaah ki yah bhavishyvaani thik hi hai: “ ‘Ye log sirf apne honthon se mera sammaan karte hain, lekin unke dil mujhse bahut dur hain.
Mere prati unki upaasna vyarth hai. Unki shikshaaein sirf insaan ke mastishk ki upaj hain.’
Aap log insaanon ki parampraaon ka to follow karte jaate hain lekin God ki command ko taalte jaate hain.”
Yeshu ne unse yah bhi kaha, “Aap log kitni suvidhaapurvak parampraaon ka follow karne ke lie God ki command ko taal dete hain!
Moshe ki command hai, ‘Apne maata-pita ka sammaan karo aur vah, jo maata ya pita ke prati bure word bole, use maut dand diya jaae.’
Lekin aapka kahna hai, ‘Yadi koi person apne pita ya maata se is tarah kahe, meri property mein se jo kuchh aapki madad ke lie uplabdh ho sakta tha, vah korbaan hai arthaat God ko samarpit,’
Iske dvaara aap use apne pita aur apni maata ke lie kuchh bhi karne nahin dete.
Apni is pratha ke dvaara, jo purvjon se chali aai hai, aap God ke vachan ko taal dete hain. Aap aise hi kai kaam kiya karte hain.”
Iske baad Yeshu ne bhir ko dobaara apne paas bulaakar use sambodhit karte hue kaha, “Tum sab meri suno aur samjho:
Aisi koi vastu nahin, jo insaan mein baahar se pravesh kar use ashuddh kar sake. Insaan ko ashuddh to vah karta hai, jo uske bhitar se baahar nikal aata hai. [
Jab bhir se vida le vah ghar mein a gae, unke disciples ne unse is drishtaant ke baare mein savaal kiya.
Iske uttar mein Yeshu ne kaha, “Kya tummein bhi samajh ka itna abhaav hai? Kya tumhein samajh nahin aaya ki jo kuchh insaan mein baahar se pravesh karta hai, use ashuddh nahin kar sakta
Kyonki vah uske dil mein nahin, lekin uske pet mein jaata hai aur baahar nikal jaata hai!” Is tarah Yeshu ne sabhi tarah ke khaana ko svachchh ghoshit kar diya.
“Jo insaan mein se baahar aata hai, vahi insaan ko ashuddh karta hai.
Insaan ke bhitar se—insaan ke dil hi se—bure soch baahar aate hain, jo use chori, murder, vyabhichaar,
Lobh, duraachaarita, chhal-kapat, kaamukta, jalan, ninda, ahankaar aur murkhta ki or laga dete hain.
Ye sabhi avgun insaan ke andar se baahar aate aur use ashuddh karte hain.”
Yeshu vahaan se nikalkar sor pradesh mein chale gae, jahaan vah ek ghar mein thahre hue the aur nahin chaahte the ki bhir ko unke baare mein kuchh maalum ho lekin unka vahaan aana chhip na saka.
Unke baare mein sunkar ek aurat unse bheint karne vahaan aai jiski putri dard denevaali aatma se pirit thi. Vahaan pravesh karte hi vah Yeshu ke charnon par ja giri.
Vah aurat yunaani thi—surofoyniki jaati ki. Vah Yeshu se request karti rahi ki vah uski putri mein se dard denevaali aatma ko nikaal dein.
Yeshu ne usse kaha, “Pahle baalkon ko to tript ho jaane do! Baalkon ko parosa khaana unse lekar kutton ko dena sahi nahin!”
Lekin iske uttar mein us aurat ne kaha, “Sach hai Lord, lekin kutte bhi to baalkon ki mez par se gire tukron se apna pet bhar lete hain.”
Yeshu ne usse kaha, “Tumhaare is uttar ka parinaam yah hai ki dard denevaali aatma tumhaari putri ko chhorkar ja chuki hai. Ghar laut jaao.”
Ghar pahunchkar usne apni putri ko bichhaune par leta hua paaya. Dard denevaali aatma use chhorkar ja chuki thi.
Tab vah sor ke kshetr se nikalkar sidon kshetr se hote hue Galil jhil ke paas aae, jo dekaapolis anchal mein tha.
Log unke paas ek aise person ko laae jo bahira tha aur bari kathinaai se bol paata tha. Logon ne Yeshu se us person par haath rakhne ki request ki.
Yeshu us person ko bhir se dur ekaant mein le gae. Vahaan unhonne uske kaanon mein apni ungliyaan daalin. Iske baad apni laar uski jibh par lagaai.
Tab ek gahri aah bharte hue heaven ki or nazar uthaakar unhonne us person ko sambodhit kar kaha, “Effaatha!” (arthaat khul ja!)
Us person ke kaan khul gae, uski jibh ki rukaavat bhi jaati rahi aur vah saamaany rup se baatein karne laga.
Log aashchary se bharkar kaha karte the, “Vah jo kuchh karte hain, bhala hi karte hain—yahaan tak ki vah bahire ko sunne ki aur gunge ko bolne ki power provide karte hain.”
Inhin dinon ki ghatna hai ki ek baar phir vahaan ek bari bhir ikatthi ho gayi. Unke paas khaane ko kuchh na tha. Yeshu ne apne disciples ko bulaakar unse kaha,
“Inke lie mere dil mein mercy umar rahi hai, kyonki ye sab tin din se lagaataar mere saath hain. Inke paas ab kuchh bhi khaana saamagri nahin hai.
Yadi main inhein bhukha hi ghar bhej dun, ve raasta mein hi murchchhit ho jaaeinge. Inmein se kuchh to bahut dur se aae hain.”
Disciples ne kaha, “Is dur jagah mein sab ki tripti ke lie khaana ka prabandh kaun kar paayega?”
Yeshu ne unse puchha, “Kitni rotiyaan hain tumhaare paas?” “Saat,” Unhonne javaab diya.

Yeshu ne bhir ko zameen par baith jaane ki command di; phir saaton rotiyaan lin, unke lie thanks reveal kar unhein tora aur unhein baantne ke lie disciples ko dete gae. Disciple unhein bhir mein baantte gae.
Unke paas kuchh chhoti machhliyaan bhi thi. Un par thanks karte hue Yeshu ne unhein bhi baantne ki command di.
Log khaakar tript hue. Disciples ne tori gai rotiyon ke shesh tukron ko ikattha kar saat bare tokre bhar lie.
Is bhir mein lagbhag chaar hazaar log the. Tab Yeshu ne unhein vida kiya.
Iske baad Yeshu bina der kie apne disciples ke saath naav par savaar hokar daalamnutha kshetr mein a gae.
Farisiyon ne aakar unse vivaad shuruaat kar diya. Unhonne yah parakhne ke lie ki Yeshu God-son hain, heaven ka koi chamatkaar chihn ki maang ki.
Yeshu ne apne andar mein gahri dard mein karaahte hue unhein javaab diya, “Yah pirhi chamatkaar chihn kyon chaahti hai? Sach to yah hai ki is pirhi ko koi bhi chamatkaar chihn nahin diya jaaega.”
Unhein chhorkar Yeshu naav par savaar hokar dusri or chale gae.
Disciple apne saath khaana rakhna bhul gae the—unke paas naav mein sirf ek roti thi.
Yeshu ne disciples ko chetaavni dete hue kaha, “Farisiyon ke khamir se aur Herodes ke khamir se saavdhaan rahna.”
Is par ve aapas mein soch-vimarsh karne lage, “Vah yah isliye kah rahe hain ki hamne apne saath rotiyaan nahin rakhin.”
Unki situation samajhte hue Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Roti ke na hone ke baare mein vaad-vivaad kyon kie ja rahe ho? Kya ab bhi tumhein kuchh samajh nahin a raha? Kya tumhaara dil kathor ho gaya hai?
Aankhein hote hue bhi tumhein kuchh dikhaai nahin de raha aur kaanon ke hote hue bhi tum kuchh sun nahin pa rahe? Tumhein kuchh bhi yaad nahin raha!
Jab mainne paanch hazaar logon ke lie paanch rotiyaan parosin tumne tukron se bhare kitne tokre ikattha kie the?” “Baarah,” Unhonne javaab diya.
“Jab mainne chaar hazaar ke lie saat rotiyaan parosin tab tumne tukron se bhare kitne tokre ikattha kie the?” “Saat,” Unhonne javaab diya.
Tab Yeshu ne unse puchha, “Kya ab bhi tumhaari samajh mein nahin aaya?”
Ve baithsaida shehar aae. Vahaan log ek andhe person ko unke paas laae aur unse request ki ki vah uska sparsh karein.
Yeshu us andhe ka haath pakar use gaanv ke baahar le gae. Vahaan unhonne us person ki aankhon par thuka aur us par haath rakhte hue usse puchha, “Kya tumhein kuchh dikhaai de raha hai?”
Usne upar nazar karte hue kaha, “Mujhe log dikh rahe hain lekin ve aise dikh rahe hain jaise chalte phirte per.”
Yeshu ne dobaara us par apne haath rakhe aur uski or ektak dekha aur use nazar receive ho gai—use sab kuchh saaf-saaf dikhaai dene laga.
Yeshu ne use uske ghar bhejte hue kaha, “Ab is gaanv mein kabhi na aana.”

Yeshu apne disciples ke saath kayasriya praant ke filippoy shehar ke paas ke gaanvon ki yaatra kar rahe the. Raasta mein unhonne apne disciples se yah savaal kiya, “Main kaun hun is baare mein logon ka kya mat hai?”
Unhonne javaab diya, “Kuchh ke lie baptisma denevaale Yohan, kuchh ke lie Eliyah aur kuchh ke lie aap bhavishyadvaktaaon mein se ek hain.”
Yeshu ne disciples ko saavdhaan kiya ki ve kisi se bhi unki charcha na karein.
Yah sab unhonne bahut spasht rup se kaha. Unke is kathan par Petros unhein alag le jaakar daantne lage.

Lekin Yeshu pichhe mure aur apne disciples ko dekhkar unhonne Petros ko daanta, “Dur ho ja meri nazar se, aarop lagaanevaala! Tera man God sambandhi vishyon mein nahin lekin insaan sambandhi vishyon mein laga hua hai.”

Tab Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Main tum par ek atal sach reveal kar raha hun: yahaan upasthit logon mein kuchh aise hain, jo maut tab tak na chakheinge, jab tak ve God ke kingdom ko power ke saath aaya hua na dekh lein.”
Chhah din baad Yeshu keval Petros, Yaakob aur Yohan ko ek unche parvat par le gae ki unhein vahaan ekaant mil sake. Vahaan unhin ke saamne Yeshu ka rupaantran hua.
Unke kapde ujjval aur itne adhik safed ho gae ki prithvi par koi bhi kisi bhi riti se itni ujjval saphedi nahin la sakta.
Unhein vahaan Moshe ke saath Eliyah dikhaai die. Ve Yeshu ke saath baatein kar rahe the.
Yah dekh Petros bol uthe, “Rabbi! Hamaara yahaan hona kitna sukhad hai! Ham yahaan tin mandap banaaein—ek aapke lie, ek Moshe ke lie aur ek Eliyah ke lie.”
Petros ko yah maalum hi na tha ki vah kya kahe ja rahe hain—itne atydhik bhaybhit ho gae the disciple!
Tabhi ek baadal ne vahaan achaanak reveal hokar unhein dhak liya aur usmein se nikla ek word sunaai diya, “Yah mera son hai—mera param dear—jo vah kahta hai, us par dhyaan do!”
Tabhi unhonne dekha ki Yeshu ke atirikt vahaan koi bhi na tha.
Disciples ne Yeshu se savaal kiya, “Kya kaaran hai ki shaastri kahte hain ki pahle Eliyah ka aana zarur hai?”

Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Sach hai. Eliyah hi pahle aaega aur sab kuchh vyavasthit karega. Ab yah bataao: Scripture mein insaan ke son ke baare mein yah varnan kyon hai ki use kai yaatnaaein di jaaeingi aur use tuchchh samjha jaaega?
Suno! Vaastav mein Eliyah a chuke hai aur unhonne unke saath manmaana vyavhaar kiya—thik jaisa ki varnan kiya gaya tha.”
Jab ye tin lautkar shesh disciples ke paas aae to dekha ki ek bari bhir un disciples ke chaaron or jama ho gai hai aur shaastri vaad-vivaad kie ja rahe the.
Yeshu ko dekhte hi bhir ko aashchary hua aur vah namaskaar karne unki or daur pari.
Yeshu ne disciples se puchha, “Kis vishay par unse vaad-vivaad kar rahe the tum?”
Bhir mein se ek person ne unse kaha, “Guruvar, main apne son ko aapke paas laaya tha. Usmein samaai hui aatma ne use gunga bana diya hai.

Jab yah dard denevaali aatma us par prabal hoti hai, use zameen par patak deti hai. Uske munh se phen nikalne lagta hai, vah daant pisne lagta hai aur uska body ainth jaata hai. Mainne aapke disciples se ise nikaalne ki request ki thi lekin ve asphal rahe.”
Yeshu ne bhir se kaha, “Are o avishvaasi aur bigri hui pirhi!” Lord Yeshu ne kaha, “Main kab tak tumhaare saath rahunga, kab tak sabr rakhunga? Yahaan laao baalak ko!”
Log baalak ko unke paas le aae. Yeshu par nazar parte hi dard denevaali aatma ne baalak mein ainthan utpann kar di. Vah zameen par girkar lotne laga aur uske munh se phen aane laga.
Yeshu ne baalak ke pita se puchha, “Yah sab kab se ho raha hai?” “Bachpan se,” Usne javaab diya.
“Is dard denevaali aatma ne use hamesha paani aur aag donon hi mein pheinkkar barbaadi karne ki koshish ki hai. Yadi aapke lie kuchh sambhav hai, ham par daya kar hamaari madad kijie!”
“Yadi aapke lie!” Yeshu ne kaha, “Sab kuchh sambhav hai uske lie, jo faith karta hai.”
Unche word mein baalak ke pita ne kaha, “Main faith karta hun. Mere unbelief ko dur karne mein meri madad kijie.”

Jab Yeshu ne dekha ki aur adhik log bari shighrtaapurvak vahaan ikattha hote ja rahe hain, unhonne dard denevaali aatma ko daantte hue kaha, “O gunge aur bahire dard denevaali aatma, mera order hai ki ismein se baahar nikal ja aur ismein phir kabhi pravesh na karna.”

Us baalak ko aur bhi adhik bhayaavah ainthan mein daalkar chillaate hue vah dard denevaali aatma usmein se nikal gaya. Vah baalak aisa ho gaya maano uske jaan hi nikal gae hon. Kuchh to yahaan tak kahne lage, “Iski maut ho gai hai.”
Lekin Yeshu ne baalak ka haath pakar use uthaaya aur vah khara ho gaya.
Jab Yeshu ne us ghar mein pravesh kiya ekaant paakar disciples ne unse puchha, “Ham us dard denevaali aatma ko kyon nahin nikaal sake?”
Yeshu ne javaab diya, “Sivaay prayer ke is varg nikaala hi nahin ja sakta.”
Vahaan se nikalkar unhonne Galil pradesh ka raasta liya. Yeshu nahin chaahte the ki kisi ko bhi is yaatra ke baare mein maalum ho.
Kafranhum shehar pahunchkar jab unhonne ghar mein pravesh kiya Yeshu ne disciples se puchha, “Raasta mein tum kis vishay par soch-vimarsh kar rahe the?”
Disciple maun bane rahe kyonki raasta mein unke soch-vimarsh ka vishay tha unmein bara kaun hai.
Yeshu ne baithte hue baarhon ko apne paas bulaakar unse kaha, “Yadi kisi ki chaahat bara banne ki hai, vah chhota ho jaae aur sabka servant bane.”
Unhonne ek baalak ko unke beech khara kiya aur phir use god mein lekar disciples ko sambodhit karte hue kaha,
“Jo koi aise baalak ko mere naam mein accept karta hai, mujhe accept karta hai aur jo koi mujhe accept karta hai, vah mujhe nahin lekin mere bhejnevaale ko accept karta hai.”
Yohan ne Yeshu ko suchna di, “Guruvar, hamne ek person ko aapke naam mein dard denevaali aatma nikaalte hue dekha hai. Hamne use rokne ka koshish kiya kyonki vah hammein se nahin hai.”
“Mat roko use!” Yeshu ne unhein command di, “Koi bhi, jo mere naam mein adbhut kaam karta hai, dusre hi kshan meri ninda nahin kar sakta
Kyonki vah person, jo hamaare khilaaf nahin hai, hamaare paksh mein hi hai.
Yadi koi tumhein ek katora paani isliye pilaata hai ki tum Yeshu ke disciple ho to main tum par ek atal sach reveal kar raha hun; vah apna pratiphal na khoega.
“Aur yadi koi in maasum baalkon ke, jinhonne mujh par faith rakha hai, patan ka kaaran bane, uske lie sahi yahi hoga ki uske gale mein chakki ka paat baandh use samudr mein pheink diya jaae.
Har ek person aag dvaara namkin kiya jaaega.
“Namak ek zaruri vastu hai, lekin yadi namak apna khaaraapan kho baithe to kis vastu se uska khaaraapan vaapas kar sakoge? Tum khud mein namak aur aapas mein mel-milaap banaae rakho.”

Yeshu vahaan se nikalkar Yahudiya ke us kshetr mein chale gae, jo yardan nadi ke paar tha. Bhir phir se unke chaaron or ikatthi ho gai. Apni riti ke hisaab se Yeshu ne ek baar phir unhein teaching dena shuruaat kiya.
Unhein parakhne ke purpose se kuchh Farisi unke paas a gae. Unhonne Yeshu se savaal kiya, “Kya aadmi ke lie patni se talaak lena law ke hisaab se hai?”
Yeshu ne hi unse savaal kiya, “Tumhaare lie Moshe ka order kya hai?”
Farisiyon ne unhein javaab diya, “Moshe ne talaak patr likhkar patni ka tyaag karne ki anumti di hai.”
Yeshu ne unhein samjhaaya, “Tumhaare kathor dil ke kaaran Moshe ne tumhaare lie yah command rakhi.
Lekin vaastav mein srishti ke shuruaat hi se God ne unhein nar aur naari banaaya.
Is kaaran aadmi apne maata-pita ko chhorkar apni patni se mila rahega aur ve donon ek deh honge.
Ve donon ek body ho jaaeinge; parinaamasvrup ab ve donon do nahin lekin ek body hain.
Isliye jinhein khud God ne jora hai, unhein koi insaan alag na kare.”
Jab ve apne ghar laut aae, disciples ne Yeshu se iske baare mein jaanna chaaha.
Yeshu ne unhein samjhaaya, “Yadi koi apni patni se talaak lekar dusre aurat se vivaah karta hai, vah us dusre aurat ke saath vyabhichaar karta hai.
Yadi khud aurat apne pati se talaak lekar dusre aadmi se vivaah kar leti hai, vah bhi vyabhichaar karti hai.”
Yeshu ko chhu lene ke purpose se log baalkon ko unke paas la rahe the. Is par disciple unhein daantne lage.
Yah dekh Yeshu ne aprsann hote hue unse kaha, “Baalkon ko yahaan aane do, unhein mere paas aane se mat roko kyonki God ka kingdom aison ka hi hai.
Main tum par ek atal sach reveal kar raha hun; jo God ke kingdom ko ek nanhe baalak ke bhaav mein grahan nahin karta, usmein kabhi pravesh na kar paaega.”
Tab Yeshu ne baalkon ko apni god mein liya aur un par haath rakh unhein aashirvaad diya.
Yeshu ne usse kaha, “Uttam mujhe kyon kah rahe ho? God ke alaava uttam koi bhi nahin hai.
Command to tumhein maalum hi hain: murder na karo, vyabhichaar na karo, chori na karo, jhuthi gavaahi na do, chhal na karo, maata-pita ka sammaan karo.”
Usne javaab diya, “Guruvar, main baalyaavastha se inka follow karta aaya hun.”
Ye word sunte hi uska munh latak gaya. Vah shokit dil se laut gaya kyonki vah bari property ka maalik tha.
Yeshu ne apne aas-paas ikattha disciples se kaha, “God ke kingdom mein dhanvaanon ka pravesh kitna kathin hoga!”
Yeshu ke in vichaaron se disciple chakit rah gae. Ek baar phir Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Ajnaaniyo! Kitna kathin hoga! God ke kingdom mein pravesh!
God ke kingdom mein kisi dhanvaan ke pravesh ki apeksha unt ka sui ke chhed mein se paar ho jaana saral hai.”
Unki or dekhte hue Yeshu ne kaha, “Insaanon ke lie to yah asambhav hai lekin God ke lie nahin—God ke lie sabhi kuchh sambhav hai.”
Petros Yeshu se bole, “Ham to apna sab kuchh tyaag kar aapke pichhe ho lie hain.”
Lekin kai, jo pahle hain antim honge aur jo antim hain ve pahle.”

Yerushalem shehar ki or jaate hue Yeshu un sabke aage-aage chal rahe the. Disciple chakit the aur pichhe chalnevaale dusre log dare hue the. Baarhon ko alag le jaakar Yeshu ne unhein bataana shuruaat kiya ki khud unke saath kya-kya hona zaruri hai.

“Ham Yerushalem shehar ko ja rahe hain, vahaan insaan ke son ko leader priests aur shaastriyon ke haathon mein saump diya jaaega. Ve us par maut saza prasaarit kareinge aur use gair-Yahudiyon ko saump deinge.
Zebediyos ke donon son, Yaakob aur Yohan, Yeshu ke paas aakar request kar kahne lage, “Guruvar, hamaari chaahat hai ki ham aapse jo bhi request karein, aap use hamaare lie puri kar dein.”
Yeshu ne unse puchha, “Kya chaahte ho?”
“Hamaari chaahat hai ki aapki glory ke samay mein ham aapki daayin aur baayin or mein baithein,” Unhonne request ki.
Tab Yeshu ne javaab diya, “Tumhein to yah maalum hi nahin ki tum kya maang rahe ho. Kya tummein vah pyaala pi sakte ho jise main pine par hun, ya tum us baptisma le sakte ho, jo main lenevaala hun?”
Unhonne javaab diya, “Zarur.” Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Vah pyaala, jo main piunga, tum bhi pioge aur tumhein vahi baptisma diya jaaega, jo mujhe diya jaaega.
Lekin kisi ko apne daayein ya baayein paksh mein baithaana mera authority nahin hai. Ye jagah unhin ke lie surakshit hain, jinhein inke lie taiyaar kiya gaya hai.”
Yah sun shesh das disciple Yaakob aur Yohan par naaraaz ho gae.
Un sabko apne paas bulaakar Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Ve, jo is duniya mein shaasak hain, apne logon par prabhuta karte hain aur unke bare adhikaari un par apna authority dikhaaya karte hain,
Lekin tumhaare baare mein aisa nahin hai. Tummein jo bara banne ka ichchhuk hai, usko tumhaara servant ho jaana zaruri hai.
Tummein jo koi shreshth hona chaahta hai, vah sabka slave ho.

Iske baad Yeshu yerikho shehar aae. Jab vah apne disciples aur ek vishaal bhir ke saath yerikho shehar se nikalkar ja rahe the, unhein raasta ke kinaare baitha hua ek andha person, timaau ka son baartimaau, bhikh maangta hua mila.
Jab use yah maalum hua ki vah yaatri naazrethvaasi Yeshu hain, vah pukaarne laga, “David-son, Yeshu! Mujh par grace kijie!”
Unmein se kai use pukaarne se rokne ki bharpur koshish karne lage, lekin vah aur bhi adhik pukaarta gaya, “David ki children, Yeshu! Mujh par grace kijie!”
Yeshu ne ruk kar command di, “Use yahaan laao!” Tab unhonne us andhe person ke paas jaakar usse kaha, “Utho, khushi manaao! Lord tumhein bula rahe hain.”
Andha person baahri kapde pheink, uchhalkar khara ho gaya aur Yeshu ke paas a gaya.
Yeshu ne usse puchha, “Kya chaahte ho mujhse?” “Apni aankhon ki roshni dubaara paana chaahta hun, rabbi!” Andhe ne javaab diya.
Yeshu ne use command di, “Jaao, yah tumhaara faith hai, jiske dvaara tum svasth ho gae ho.” Usi kshan us person ki aankhon ki roshni laut aai aur vah unke pichhe chalne laga.
Jab ve Yerushalem ke paas zaitun parvat ke paas baithniyaah aur baithafge gaanv ke paas pahunche, Yeshu ne apne do disciples ko yah command dekar bheja,
“Is gaanv mein jaao. Vahaan pravesh karne par tumhein ek gadhi ka bachcha bandha hua dikhaai dega, jis par ab tak koi nahin baitha hai. Use kholkar mere paas le aao.
Yadi koi tumse yah puchhe, ‘Yah kya kar rahe ho?’ To tum yah uttar dena, ‘Lord ko iski zarurat hai, vah shighr hi ise lauta deinge.’ ”
Ve chale gae. Unhonne gali mein dvaar ke paas gadhi ka ek bachche ko bandhe dekha. Unhonne use khol liya.
Vahaan khare hue kuchh logon ne yah dekh unse puchha, “Kyon khol rahe ho ise?”
Unhonne unhein vahi javaab diya jaisa Yeshu ne unhein order diya tha aur un logon ne unhein jaane diya.
Ve gadhi ke us bachche ko Yeshu ke paas le aae. Unhonne apne kapde us par bichha die aur Yeshu us par baith gae.
Anekon ne raasta par apne kapde bichha die aur kuchh ne nae patton se ladi hui daaliyaan, jo ve maidaan se kaatkar laae the.
Ve sab log, jo Yeshu ke aage-aage aur pichhe-pichhe chal rahe the, naare laga rahe the, “Hoshaanna!” “Blessed hain vah jo Lord ke naam mein a rahe hain.”
“Blessed hai hamaare kulpita David ka aagaami raajy.” “Sabse unche heaven mein hoshaanna!”

Yerushalem shehar mein pravesh karne par Yeshu temple mein aae aur vahaan ka saavdhaanipurvak nirikshan karne ke baad unhonne baarhon ke saath baithniyaah shehar ki or chalna shuru kiya kyonki shaam ho gayi thi.
Dusre din jab ve baithniyaah se chale to Yeshu ko bhukh lagi.

Dur hi se unhein anjir ka ek hara-bhara per dikhaai diya. Vah us per ke paas aae ki kadaachit unhein usmein kuchh mil jaae lekin vahaan unhein pattiyon ke atirikt kuchh bhi na mila kyonki usmein phal lagne ka samay abhi nahin aaya tha.
Us per se Yeshu ne kaha, “Ab tujhse kabhi bhi koi phal na khaae!” Disciple yah sun rahe the.

Ve Yerushalem pahunche aur Yeshu ne temple mein jaakar un sabhi ko temple se baahar nikaal diya, jo vahaan lenden kar rahe the. Saath hi Yeshu ne saahukaaron ki chaukiyaan ulat din aur kabutar bechne vaalon ke aasnon ko palat diya.
Yeshu ne kisi ko bhi temple mein bechne ka saamaan lekar aane jaane ki anumti na di.
Vahaan teaching dete hue Yeshu ne kaha, “Kya Scripture mein tumne yah nahin parha: ‘Saare raashtron ke lie mera bhavan prayer ka bhavan hoga’? Aur yahaan tumne ise daakuon ki ‘Gufa bana rakha hai.’”
Is ghatna ke baare mein maalum hone par leader priest aur shaastri Yeshu ki murder ki yukti khojne lage. Unhein bhir ka dar tha kyonki Yeshu ki teaching se bhir prabhaavit thi.
Sandhya hone par Yeshu aur unke disciple shehar ke baahar chale jaate the.
Praatahkaal, jab ve vahaan se a rahe the, unhonne us anjir ke per ko jar se sukha hua paaya.
Petros ne yaad karte hue kaha, “Rabbi dekhie! Jis per ko aapne shaap diya tha, vah sukh gaya hai.”
Iske uttar mein Yeshu ne kaha, “God mein faith rakho,

Main tum par ek atal saty reveal kar raha hun: yadi tumhein faith ho—sandeh tanik bhar bhi na ho—to tum na keval vah karoge, jo is anjir ke per ke saath kiya gaya lekin tum yadi is parvat ko bhi command doge, ‘Ukhar ja aur samudr mein ja gir!’ To yah bhi ho jaaega.
Isliye tumse mujhe yah kahna hai: prayer mein faith se tum jo bhi request karoge, unke lie yah faith kar lo ki ve tumhein receive ho gai hain, to ve tumhein provide ki jaaeingi.
Isi tarah, jab tum prayer karo aur tumhaare dil mein kisi ke khilaaf kuchh ho, use maafi kar do, jisse tumhaare svargiy pita bhi tumhaare galti maafi kar dein. [
Iske baad ve dobaara Yerushalem shehar aae. Jab Yeshu temple parisar mein tahal rahe the, leader priest, shaastri aur pravar (netaagan) unke paas aae
Aur unse savaal karne lage, “Kis authority se tum yah sab kar rahe ho? Kaun hai vah, jisne tumhein yah sab karne ka authority diya hai?”
Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Aap logon se main bhi ek savaal karunga. Jab aap mujhe uska uttar deinge tab main bhi aapke is savaal ka uttar dunga ki main kis authority se yah sab kar raha hun.
Yah bataaie ki Yohan ka baptisma God ki or se tha ya insaanon ki or se?”
Ve aapas mein soch-vimarsh karne lage, “Yadi ham yah kahte hain ki vah God ki or se tha to yah kahega, ‘Tab aap logon ne us par faith kyon nahin kiya?’
Unhonne Yeshu ko javaab diya, “Ham nahin jaante.” Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Thik hai, main bhi tumhein yah nahin bataata ki main ye sab kis authority se kar raha hun.”

Yeshu ne unhein drishtaanton ke maadhyam se teaching dena shuruaat kiya: “Ek person ne bagiche mein angur ki bel lagaai, uske chaaron or baar lagaai, usmein raskund khoda, raksha karne ka machaan banaaya aur use kisaanon ko patte par dekar yaatra par chala gaya.
Upaj ke avsar par usne apne ek slave ko un kisaanon ke paas bheja ki vah unse upaj ka kuchh bhaag le aae.
Kisaanon ne us slave ko pakra, uski pitaai ki aur use khaali haath lauta diya.
Us person ne phir ek dusre slave ko bheja. Kisaanon ne uske sir par prahaar kar use ghaayal kar diya aur uske saath sharmnaak vyavhaar kiya.
Us person ne phir ek aur slave ko unke paas bheja, jiski to unhonne murder hi kar di. Usne dusre bahut slaves ko bheje, unhonne kuchh ko maara-pita aur baakiyon ki murder kar di.
“Ab uske paas bhejne ke lie ek hi person shesh tha—uska dear son. Antath usne use hi unke paas bhej diya. Uska soch tha, ‘Ve mere son ka to sammaan kareinge.’
“Un kisaanon ne aapas mein soch kiya, ‘Suno, yah vaaris hai. Yadi iski murder kar dein to yah property hi hamaari ho jaaegi!’
Unhonne uski murder kar di aur use baari ke baahar nikaalkar pheink diya.
“Ab bagiche ke maalik ke saamne kaun sa vikalp shesh rah gaya hai? Vah aakar un kisaanon ka barbaadi karega aur udyaan ka patta dusre kisaanon ko de dega.
Kya tumne Scripture ka yah lekh nahin parha: “ ‘Jis patthar ko raajmistriyon ne nikamma ghoshit kar diya tha, vahi kone ka mukhy patthar ban gaya;
Yah Lord ki or se hua, aur yah hamaari nazar mein adbhut hai’?”

Phalasvrup leader priest aur shaastri Lord Yeshu ko pakarne ki yojna mein jut gae, kyonki ve yah samajh gae the ki Lord Yeshu ne un par hi yah drishtaant kaha hai. Lekin unhein bhir ka dar tha. Islie is avsar par ve Yeshu ko chhor vahaan se chale gae.
Yahudiyon ne Yeshu ke paas kuchh Farisiyon aur Herodes samarthkon ko bheja ki Yeshu ko unki hi kisi baat mein phansaaya ja sake.

Unhonne aakar Yeshu se yah savaal kiya, “Guruvar, yah to hamein maalum hai ki aap ek sachche person hain. Aapko kisi ke samarthan ki zarurat nahin hai kyonki aap mein pakshpaat hai hi nahin. Aap puri sach mein God sambandhi teaching dete hain. Hamein yah bataaie: kaysar ko kar dena law ke hisaab se hai ya nahin?
Ham kar dein ya nahin?” Unka paakhand bhaamp kar Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Kyon mujhe phansaane ki yukti kar rahe ho? Dinaar ki mudra laakar mujhe dikhaao.”
Ve Yeshu ke paas ek mudra le aae. Yeshu ne vah mudra unhein dikhaate hue unse savaal kiya, “Yah chhaap aur naam kiska hai?” “Kaysar ka,” Unhonne javaab diya.
Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Jo kaysar ka hai, vah kaysar ko do aur jo God ka, vah God ko.” Yah sun ve dang rah gae.
Usi samay ek shaastri vahaan se ja raha tha. Usne unka vaartaalaap sun liya. Yah dekh ki Yeshu ne unhein satik javaab diya hai, usne Yeshu se puchha, “Sabse bari command kaun si hai?”
Yeshu ne javaab diya, “Sabse bari command hai: ‘Suno, israaeliyo! Lord hamaare God advitiy Lord hain.
Tum Lord tumhaare God se apne saare dil, saare jaan, saare samajh aur saari power se love karo.’
Dusri command hai, ‘Tum apne parosi se apne hi jaisa love karo.’ Inse barhkar koi aur command hai hi nahin.”
Us shaastri ne Yeshu se kaha, “Ati sundar, guruvar! Aapka kahna hamesha hi saty hai. Vahi ekmaatr hain—unke atirikt aur koi nahin hai
Aur unse hi saare dil, saari samajh aur saari power se love karna, aur apne parosi se apne jaisa love karna sabhi homabliyon aur balidaanon se barhkar hai.”
Jab Yeshu ne yah dekha ki usne buddhimaani se javaab diya hai, unhonne usse kaha, “Tum God ke kingdom se dur nahin ho.” Iske baad kisi mein bhi unse aur savaal karne ka saahas na raha.
Temple ke aangan, mein teaching dete hue Yeshu ne unke saamne yah savaal rakha, “Shaastri yah kyon kahte hain ki Yeshu David ke vanshaj hain?
David ne, Holy Spirit, mein aatmlin ho kaha tha: “ ‘Lord God ne mere Lord se kaha: “Meri daayin or baithe raho jab tak main tumhaare dushmanon ko tumhaare adhin na kar dun.” ’
Khud David unhein Lord kahkar sambodhit kar rahe hain isliye kis bhaav mein Lord David ke son hue?” Bhir unke is vaad-vivaad ka khushi le rahi thi.
Aage teaching dete hue Yeshu ne kaha, “Un shaastriyon se saavdhaan rahna, jo lambe dhile lahraate kapde pahne hue ghuma karte hain, saarvajnik sthalon par sammaanpurn namaskaar ki ummid karte hai.
Ve Yahudi sabhaagrihon mein mukhy aasan aur daavton mein mukhy jagah pasand karte hai.
Ve vidhvaaon ke ghar harap jaate hain aur sirf dikhaave ke purpose se lambi-lambi praarthnaaein karte hain. Kathor hoga inka dand!”
Yeshu temple ke kosh ke saamne baithe hue the. Vah dekh rahe the ki log temple kosh mein kis tarah daan de rahe hain. Kai dhani log bari-bari raashi daal rahe the.
Ek nirdhan vidhva bhi vahaan aai, aur usne taambe ki do chhote sikke daale hain.
Yeshu ne apne disciples ka dhyaan aakarshit karte hue kaha, “Sach yah hai ki is nirdhan vidhva ne kosh mein un sabhi se barhkar diya hai.
Kyonki shesh sabhi ne to apne wealth ki barhti mein se diya hai, lekin is vidhva ne apni nirdhanta mein se apni saari property hi de di—yah uski saari jivika thi.”
Jab Yeshu temple se baahar nikal rahe the, unke ek disciple ne unka dhyaan temple parisar ki or khinchte hue kaha, “Dekhie, guruvar, kitne vishaal hain ye patthar aur kitne bare hain ye bhavan!”
Yeshu zaitun parvat par temple ki or chehra kie hue baithe the. Ekaant paakar Petros, Yaakob, Yohan aur aandreyaas ne Yeshu se yah savaal kiya,

Jab tum bandi banaae jaao aur tum par mukaddma chalaaya jaae to yah chinta na karna ki tumhein vahaan kya kahna hai. Tum vahi kahoge, jo kuchh tumhein vahaan usi samay bataaya jaaega kyonki vahaan tum nahin lekin Holy Spirit apna paksh prastut kar rahe honge.
Vah, jo ghar ki chhat par ho, ghar mein se saamaan lene niche na aae.
