Prayer karte raho, aisa na ho ki tumhein jaare mein bhaagna pare
Saavdhaan rahna, mainne samay se purv hi tumhein iski chetaavni de di hai.
Fasah aur khamir rahit roti ke utsav ke lie sirf do din rah gae the. Leader priest aur shaastri is khoj mein the ki Yeshu ko pakarkar gupt rup se unki murder kar dein,
Kyonki unka soch tha: “Utsav ke samay mein nahin, anytha balva ho jaaega.”

Yeshu baithniyaah shehar aae. Vahaan vah purv korh rogi Shimon naamak person ke ghar par khaana ke lie baithe the. Ek aurat vahaan sangmarmar ke bartan mein shuddh jataamaansi ka bahut kimti itr le aai. Usne us bartan ko tor vah itr Yeshu ke sir par undel diya.
Upasthit atithiyon mein se kuchh kruddh hokar aapas mein barabraane lage, “Kyon kar diya isne is itr ka phizul kharch?
Ise tin sau dinaar se bhi adhik daam par bechkar vah raashi nirdhnon mein baanti ja sakti thi.” Ve us aurat ko iske lie daantne lage.
Lekin Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Chhor do use! Kyon sata rahe ho use? Usne mere lie ek saraahniy kaam kiya hai.
Jahaan tak nirdhnon ka savaal hai, ve to tumhaare saath hamesha hi raheinge. Tum unki madad to kabhi bhi kar sakte ho, lekin main tumhaare saath hamesha nahin rahunga.
Tab kaariyotvaasi Yahudah ne, jo baarah disciples mein se ek tha, Yeshu ko pakarvaane ke purpose se leader priests se bheint ki.
Isse ve bahut prasann ho gae aur use dhanraashi dene ka vachan diya. Isliye Yahudah ek avsar ke lie dekhta raha ki vah kisi bhi tarah sahi avsar par Yeshu ko pakarva de.
Akhmiri roti ke utsav ke pahle din, jo Fasah bali arpan ki bela hoti thi, disciples ne Yeshu se puchha, “Ham aapke lie Fasah kahaan taiyaar karein—aapki chaahat kya hai?”
Is par Yeshu ne apne do disciples ko is nirdesh ke saath bheja, “Shehar mein jaao. Tumhein paani ka matka le jaata hua ek person milega. Uske pichhe-pichhe jaana.
Vah jis ghar mein pravesh karega, uske ghar ke maalik se kahna, ‘Guru ne puchha hai, “Mera atithi kaksh kahaan hai, jahaan main apne disciples ke saath Fasah khaaun?” ’
Vah khud tumhein ek vishaal, taiyaar aur susajjit upri kaksh dikha dega. Hamaare lie vahin taiyaari karna.”
Disciple chale gae. Jab ve shehar pahunche, unhonne thik vaisa hi paaya jaisa Lord ne unse kaha tha aur vahaan unhonne Fasah taiyaar kiya.
Sandhya hone par Yeshu apne baarhon disciples ke saath vahaan aae.
Jab vah khaana par baithe hue the Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Main tum par ek atal saty reveal kar raha hun: tummein se ek, jo mere saath khaana kar raha hai, mere saath dhokha karega.”
Bahut duhkhi ho ve unse ek-ek kar yah puchhne lage, “Nihsandeh vah main to nahin hun?”
Yeshu ne javaab diya, “Hai to vah baarhon mein se ek—vahi, jo mere saath katore mein roti dubo raha hai.

Insaan ke son ko to, jaisa ki uske baare mein Scripture mein likha hai, jaana hi hai; lekin dhikkaar hai us person par, jo insaan ke son ke saath dhokha karega. Us person ke lie achchha to yahi hota ki uska janm hi na hota.”
Khaana ke lie baithe hue Yeshu ne roti lekar uske lie aabhaar thanks karte hue use tora aur unmein baantte hue kaha, “Lo, yah mera body hai.”
Iske baad Yeshu ne pyaala uthaaya, uske lie thanks diya, disciples ko diya aur sabne usmein se piya.
Main tum par ek atal sach reveal kar raha hun: jab tak God ke kingdom mein naya ras na piun, daakh ka ras tab tak main nahin piunga.”
Ek bhakti git gaane ke baad ve zaitun parvat par chale gae.

Unse Yeshu ne kaha, “Tum sabhi mera saath chhorkar chale jaaoge. Jaisa ki is sambandh mein Scripture ka lekh hai: “Main charvaahe ka sanhaar karunga aur jhund ki sabhi bherein titar-bitar ho jaaeingi.
Petros ne kaha, “Sabhi aapka saath chhorkar jaaein to jaaein, lekin main aapko kabhi na chhorunga.”
Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Main tum par ek atal saty reveal kar raha hun; aaj raat mein hi, isse pahle ki murga do baar baang de, tum mujhe tin baar nakaar chuke honge.”
Lekin Petros dridhtaapurvak kahte rahe, “Yadi mujhe aapke saath maut ko apnaana bhi pare to bhi main aapko nahin nakaarunga.” Dusre sabhi disciples ne bhi yahi dohraaya.
Ve getsemni naamak jagah par aae. Yeshu ne apne disciples se kaha, “Jab tak main prayer kar raha hun, tum yahin thahro.”
Unhonne apne saath Petros, Yaakob aur Yohan ko le liya. Vah bahut adhir aur vyaakul ho rahe the.
Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Mere jaan itne vyaakul hain maano meri maut ho rahi ho. Tum yahin thahro aur jaagte raho.”
Vah unse thori hi dur gae aur zameen par girkar yah prayer karne lage ki yadi sambhav ho to yah kshan tal jaae.
Prayer mein unhonne kaha, “Abba! Pita! Aapke lie to sabhi kuchh sambhav hai. Mere saamne rakhe is pyaale ko hata dijie. Phir bhi meri nahin, aapki chaahat ke anurup ho.”
Jab Yeshu vahaan lautkar aae to disciples ko sota hua paaya. Unhonne Petros se kaha, “Shimon! Soe hue ho! Ek ghanta bhi jaage na rah sake!
Sajag raho, prayer karte raho, aisa na ho ki tum pariksha mein par jaao. Haan, nihsandeh aatma to taiyaar hai lekin body durbal.”
Tab unhonne dobaara jaakar vahi prayer ki.
Vah dobaara lautkar aae to dekha ki disciple soe hue hain—kyonki unki palkein bojhil thi. Unhein yah bhi nahin sujh raha tha ki Lord ko kya uttar dein.

Jab Yeshu tisri baar unke paas aae to unhonne unse kaha, “Abhi bhi so rahe ho? Sote raho aur vishraam karo! Bahut ho gaya! Vah kshan a gaya hai. Dekh lo kaise insaan ka son galti karnevaalon ke haathon mein saumpa ja raha hai!
Utho! Yahaan se chalein. Dekho, jo mujhe pakarvaane par hai, vah a gaya!”

Jab Yeshu yah kah hi rahe the, usi kshan Yahudah, jo baarah disciples mein se ek tha, a pahuncha. Uske saath talvaar aur laathiyaan lie hue ek bhir bhi thi. Ye sab leader priests, shaastriyon aur purniyon dvaara bheje gae the.
Pakarvaanevaale ne unhein yah sanket diya tha: “Main jise chumun, vahi hoga vah. Use pakarkar sipaahiyon ki suraksha mein le jaana.”
Vahaan pahunchte hi Yahudah sidhe Yeshu ke paas gaya aur unse kaha, “Rabbi” Aur unhein chum liya.
Is par unhonne Yeshu ko pakarkar baandh liya.
Unmein se, jo Yeshu ke saath the, ek ne talvaar khinchi aur high priest ke slave par prahaar kar diya jisse uska ek kaan kat gaya.
Yeshu ne bhir ko sambodhit karte hue kaha, “Mujhe pakarne ke lie tum talvaar aur laathiyaan lekar aae ho maano main koi daaku hun!
Temple mein teaching dete hue main pratidin tumhaare saath hi hota tha, tab to tumne mujhe nahin pakra lekin ab jo kuchh ghatit ho raha hai vah isliye ki Scripture ka lekh pura ho.”
Sabhi disciple Yeshu ko chhor bhaag chuke the.
Ek yuvak tha, jo Yeshu ke pichhe-pichhe a raha tha. Usne apne body par sirf ek chaadar lapeti hui thi. Jab unhonne use pakarna chaaha,
Vah apni us chaadar ko chhor nanga hi bhaag nikla.
Ve Yeshu ko high priest ke saamne le gae, vahaan sabhi leader priest, varishth naagrik aur shaastri ikattha the.
Petros dur hi dur, unke pichhe-pichhe a rahe the aur vah high priest ke aangan mein bhi a gae. Vah adhikaariyon ke saath baith gae aur unke saath aag taapne lage.
Yeshu ko maut dand dene ki chaahat lie hue leader priest aur puri mahaasbha Yeshu ke khilaaf gavaah khojne ka yatn kar rahi thi lekin ismein ve viphal hi rahe.
Nihsandeh unke khilaaf kai jhuthe gavaah uth khare hue the, lekin unki gavaahi mel na khaayi.
Tab kuchh ne Yeshu ke khilaaf yah jhuthi gavaahi di:
“Hamne ise kahte suna hai: ‘Main insaan ke dvaara banaae gae is temple ko dhaah dunga aur tin din mein ek dusra bana dunga, jo haath se bana na hoga.’ ”
Is aarop mein bhi unke gavaah mein samaanta na thi.
Tab high priest unke saamne khare hue aur Yeshu se puchha, “Kya tumhein apne bachaav mein kuchh nahin kahna hai? Ye sab tumhaare khilaaf kya-kya gavaahi de rahe hain!”
Lekin Yeshu ne koi uttar na diya. Vah maun hi bane rahe. Tab high priest ne un par vyangy karte hue puchha, “Kya tum hi Yeshu ho—param leader ke son?”
Is par high priest ne apne kapde phaarte hue kaha, “Ab kya zarurat rah gai kisi dusre gavaah ki?
Tum sabhi ne God-ninda sun li hai. Kya soch hai tumhaara?” Sabne ek mat se unhein maut dand ka bhaagi ghoshit kiya.
Kuchh ne un par thukna shuruaat kar diya. Unki aankhon par patti baandhkar kuchh unhein ghunse maarte hue kahne lage, “Kar bhavishyvaani!” Aur prahriyon ne unke chehra par thappar bhi maare.
Jab Petros niche aangan mein the. High priest ki ek sevika vahaan aai.
Use Petros vahaan aag taapte hue dikhe isliye vah unki or ektak dekhte hue boli, “Tum bhi to Yeshu naazri ke saath the!”
Petros ne yah kahte hue nakaar diya, “Kya kah rahi ho! Main is baare mein kuchh nahin jaanta. Meri samajh mein kuchh nahin a raha hai,” Aur vah dvaar ki or chale gae.
Ek baar phir jab us daasi ne unhein dekha to aas-paas upasthit logon se dobaara kahne lagi, “Yah bhi unhin mein se ek hai!”
Petros ne dobaara nakaar diya. Kuchh samay baad unke paas khare log hi Petros se kahne lage, “Ismein to koi sandeh hi nahin hai ki tum unmein se ek ho kyonki tum bhi galilvaasi ho.”
Lekin Petros dhikkaar kar shapath khaate hue kahne lage, “Tum jis person ke baare mein kah rahe ho, use to main jaanta hi nahin!”

Usi kshan murge ne dusri baar baang di. Petros ko Yeshu ki vah pahle se kahi hue baat yaad aai, “Iske pahle ki murg do baar baang de, tum tin baar mujhe nakaar chuke honge.” Petros phut-phutkar rone lage.
Bhor hote hi leader priests, netaagan aur shaastriyon ne saari mahaasbha ka satr bulaakar soch kiya aur Yeshu ko, jo abhi bhi bandhe hue the, le jaakar Pilatos ko saump diya.
Pilatos ne Yeshu se puchha, “Kya Yahudiyon ke raaja tum ho?” Yeshu ne iske uttar mein kaha, “Aapne sach kaha hai.”
Leader priest Yeshu par kai aarop lagaate rahe.
Is par Pilatos ne Yeshu se puchha, “Koi uttar nahin doge? Dekho, ye log tum par aarop par aarop lagaate chale ja rahe hain!”
Lekin Yeshu ne koi uttar na diya. Yah Pilatos ke lie aashchary ka vishay tha.
Utsav ke avsar par vah kisi ek bandi ko, logon ki request ke hisaab se, chhor diya karta tha.
Kaaraagaar mein baar-abbaas naamak ek bandi tha. Vah dusre vidrohiyon ke saath vidroh mein murder ke aarop mein bandi banaaya gaya tha.
Bhir ne Pilatos ke paas jaakar unki prathaapurti ki request ki.
Is par Pilatos ne unse puchha, “Achchha, to tum yah chaah rahe ho ki main tumhaare lie Yahudiyon ke raaja ko chhor dun?”
Ab tak Pilatos ko yah maalum ho chuka tha ki leader priests ne Yeshu ko jalanvash pakarvaaya tha.
Lekin leader priests ne bhir ko uksaaya ki ve Yeshu ke jagah par baar-abbaas ko chhor dene ki request karein.
Is par Pilatos ne unse puchha, “To phir main iska kya karun, jise tum Yahudiyon ka raaja kahte ho?”
Ve phir chillaae, “Use krus par charhaao!”
“Kyon,” Pilatos ne unse puchha, “Kya apraadh kiya hai isne?” Is par ve ugr ho balpurvak chillaate hue bole, “Use krus par charhaao!”
Bhir ko santusht karne ke purpose se Pilatos ne unke lie baar-abbaas ko vimukt kar diya aur Yeshu ko kore lagvaakar krus-mrityudand ke lie unke haathon mein saump diya.
Yeshu ko sainik praaitoriyam arthaat kile ke bhitar, mahal ke aangan mein le gae aur vahaan unhonne saari romi sainik tukri ikattha kar li.
Unhonne Yeshu ko vahaan le jaakar baingni rang ka kapde pahna diya aur kaanton ko gundhkar mukut ka rup dekar use unke upar rakh diya
Aur unhein pranaam karke kahne lage, “Yahudiyon ke raaja, aapki jay!”
Ve Yeshu ke sir par sarkandon se maarte ja rahe the. Iske atirikt ve un par thuk rahe the aur uphaas mein unke saamne ghutne tekkar jhuk rahe the.
Jab ve uphaas kar chuke, unhonne vah baingni kapde utaar liya aur unke kapde unhein dobaara pahna die aur unhein krus par charhaane ke lie le jaane lage.
Raasta mein unhein kurenaayos nagarvaasi Shimon naamak person mila, jo aleksaandros aur rufos ka pita tha, jise unhonne Yeshu ka krus uthaakar le chalne ke lie vivash kiya.
Ve Yeshu ko lekar golgotha naamak sthal par aae, jiska arth hai “Khopri ka jagah.”
Unhonne Yeshu ko gandhras mila hua daakhras dena chaaha lekin Yeshu ne use accept na kiya.
Tab unhonne Yeshu ko krus par charha diya. Unhonne Yeshu ke kapde baantne ke lie paasa pheinka ki kapde kise milein.
Yah din ka tisra ghanta tha jab unhonne Yeshu ko krus par charhaaya tha.
Unke doshpatr par likha tha: Yahudiyon ka raaja.
Yeshu ke saath do raajadrohiyon ko bhi krus par charhaaya gaya tha—ek unki daayin or, dusra baayin or. [
Aate jaate yaatri uphaas-mudra mein sir hila-hila kar mazaak ura rahe the, “Are o temple ko barbaadi kar, tin din mein usko dubaara banaanevaale!
Bacha le apne aapko—utar a krus se!”
Isi tarah leader priest bhi shaastriyon ke saath milkar aapas mein unka uphaas kar rahe the, “Anyon ko to bachaata raha, khud ko nahin bacha sakta!
Madhyaahn saare kshetr par andhera chha gaya, jo tin baje tak chhaaya raha.
Navein ghante Yeshu ne unche word mein pukaarte hue kaha, “Eloi, eloi, lama sabakhthaani?” Jiska arth hai, “Mere God, mere God, aapne mujhe kyon chhor diya hai?”
Paas khare logon mein se kuchh ne yah sunkar kaha, “Are! Suno-suno! Eliyah ko pukaar raha hai!”

Yah sun ek person ne daurkar ek spanj ko daakh ke sirke mein dubaakar use sarkande par rakh yah kahte hue Yeshu ko pine ke lie diya, “Ab use chhor do; chalo dekhein, kya Eliyah ise krus se niche utaarne aate hain ya nahin.”
Unche word mein pukaarne ke saath Yeshu ne apne jaan tyaag die.
Temple ka parda upar se niche tak phatkar do bhaagon mein bat gaya.
Kuchh mahilaaein dur khari hui yah sab dekh rahi thi. Inmein magdaalaavaasi Mariyam, kanishth Yaakob aur yoses ki maata Mariyam aur shaalome thi.
Yeshu ke Galil pravaas ke samay ye hi unke pichhe chalte hue unki service karti rahi thi. Dusre kai striyaan bhi thi, jo Yeshu ke saath Yerushalem aai hui thi.
Kai logon ne un ghatnaaon ko likhkar ikattha karne ka kaary kiya hai, jo hamaare bich mein ghati.
Ye sabut hamein unse receive hue hain, jo shuruaat hi se inke pratyakshdarshi aur God ke vachan ke servant rahe.
Mainne khud har ek ghatnaaon ki shuruaat se saavdhaanipurvak jaanch ki hai. Isliye param sammaany thiyofilos mahoday, mujhe bhi yah uchit laga ki aapke lie main yah sab kram ke hisaab se likhun
Ki jo shikshaaein aapko di gai hain, aap unki vishvasniyta ko jaan lein.
Yahudiya pradesh ke raaja Herodes ke shaasankaal mein abiyaah dal ke ek priest the, jinka naam zakaryaah tha. Unki patni ka naam elizaabeth tha, jo haaron ki vanshaj thi.
Ve donon hi God ki nazar mein righteous aur Lord ke sabhi orders aur niymon ke follow mein doshhin the.
Unki koi children na thi kyonki elizaabeth baanjh thi aur ve donon hi ab burhe ho chuke the.
Apne dal ki baari ke hisaab se jab zakaryaah ek din God ke saamne apni priest service bheint kar rahe the,
Unhein priests ki riti ke hisaab se parchi dvaara chunaav kar Lord ke temple mein pravesh karne aur dhup jalaane ka kaam saumpa gaya tha.
Dhup jalaane ke samay baahar sabhi logon ka vishaal samuh prayer kar raha tha.
Tabhi zakaryaah ke saamne Lord ka ek dut reveal hua, jo dhup vedi ki daayin or khara tha.
Angel ko dekh zakaryaah chaunk pare aur bhaybhit ho gae
Lekin us angel ne unse kaha, “Mat daro, zakaryaah! Tumhaari prayer sun li gai hai. Tumhaari patni elizaabeth ek son janegi. Tum uska naam Yohan rakhna.
Tum aanandit aur prasann honge aur kai uske janm ke kaaran khushi manaaeinge.
Yah baalak Lord ki nazar mein mahaan hoga. Vah daakhras aur madira ka sevan kabhi na karega aur maata ke garbh se hi Holy Spirit se bhara hua hoga.
Vah Israel ke vanshjon mein se anekon ko Lord—unke God—ki or lauta le aaega.

Vah Eliyah ki aatma aur power mein Lord ke aage chalnevaala bankar pitaaon ke dil santaanon ki or aur anaajnaakaariyon ko righteous ke knowledge ki or pherega ki ek raashtr ko Lord ke lie taiyaar karein.”
Zakaryaah ne angel se savaal kiya, “Main kaise faith karun—kyonki main thahra ek burha person aur meri patni ki aayu bhi dhal chuki hai?”
Angel ne unhein javaab diya, “Main gabriel hun. Main nit God ki upasthiti mein rahta hun. Mujhe tumhein yah bataane aur is shubh samaachaar ki ghoshna karne ke lie hi bheja gaya hai.

Aur suno! Jab tak meri ye baatein puri na ho jaae, tab tak ke lie tum gunge ho jaaoge, bolne mein asmarth, kyonki tumne mere vachnon par faith nahin kiya, jiska niyat samay par pura hona nishchit hai.”
Baahar zakaryaah ka intjaar kar rahe log asmanjas mein par gae ki unhein temple mein itni der kyon ho rahi hai.

Jab zakaryaah baahar aae, vah unse baatein karne mein asmarth rahe. Isliye ve samajh gae ki zakaryaah ko temple mein koi darshan receive hua hai. Vah unse sanketon dvaara baatchit karte rahe aur maun bane rahe.
Apne priest sevaakaal ki samaapti par zakaryaah ghar laut gae.
Unki patni elizaabeth ne garbhdhaaran kiya aur yah kahte hue paanch maah tak akele mein rahin,
“Lord ne mujh par yah kripaadrishti ki hai aur samuh mein meri lajjit situation se mujhe ubaar liya hai.”
Chhathe maah mein angel gabriel ko God dvaara Galil pradesh ke naazreth naamak shehar mein
Ek kunvaari kanya ke paas bheja gaya, jiska vivaah Yosef naamak ek aadmi se hona nishchit hua tha. Yosef, raaja David ke vanshaj the. Kanya ka naam tha Mariyam.
Mariyam ko sambodhit karte hue angel ne kaha, “Lord ki kripaapaatri, namaskaar! Lord aapke saath hain.”
Is kathan ko sun vah bahut hi ghabra gain ki is tarah ke namaskaar ka kya arth ho sakta hai.
Angel ne unse kaha, “Mat darie, Mariyam! Kyonki aap God ki grace ki paatr hain.
Sunie! Aap garbhdhaaran kar ek son ko janm deingi. Aap unka naam Yeshu rakhein.
Vah mahaan honge. Param leader ke son kahlaaeinge aur Lord God unhein unke purvaj David ka sinhaasan saumpeinge,
Vah Yaakob ke vansh par hamesha ke lie raajy kareinge aur unke raajy ka ant kabhi na hoga.”
Mariyam ne angel se savaal kiya, “Yah kaise sambhav hoga kyonki main to kunvaari hun?”
Angel ne javaab diya, “Holy Spirit aap par utreinge aur param leader ka power aap par chhaaya karega. Isliye jo janm leinge, vah holy aur God-son kahlaaeinge.
Aur yah bhi sunie aapki parijan elizaabeth ne apni vriddhaavastha mein ek son garbhdhaaran kiya hai. Vah, jo baanjh kahlaati thi, unhein chhah maah ka garbh hai.
God ke lie asambhav kuchh bhi nahin.”
Mariyam ne kaha, “Dekhie, main Lord ki daasi hun. Mere lie vahi sab ho, jaisa aapne kaha hai.” Tab vah angel unke paas se chala gaya.
Mariyam turant Yahudiya pradesh ke parvtiy kshetr ke ek shehar ko chali gain.
Vahaan unhonne zakaryaah ke ghar par jaakar elizaabeth ko namaskaar kiya.
Jaise hi elizaabeth ne Mariyam ka namaskaar suna, unke garbh mein shishu uchhal para aur elizaabeth Holy Spirit se bhar gain.
Vah ullsit word mein bol uthi, “Tum sabhi naariyon mein blessed ho aur blessed hai tumhaare garbh ka phal!
Mujh par yah kaisi kripaadrishti hui hai, jo mere Lord ki maata mujhse bheint karne aai hain!
Dekho to, jaise hi tumhaara namaskaar mere kaanon mein para, harshollaas se mere garbh mein shishu uchhal para.
Blessed hai vah, jisne Lord dvaara kahi hui baaton ke pura hone ka faith kiya hai!”
Is par Mariyam ke vachan ye the: “Mera jaan Lord ki prashansa karta hai
Kyonki unhonne apni daasi ki dinta ki or nazar ki hai. Ab se sabhi pirhiyaan mujhe blessed kaheingi,
Kyonki saamarthyi ne mere lie bare-bare kaam kie hain. Holy hai unka naam.
Unki daya unke shraddhaaluon par pirhi se pirhi tak bani rahti hai.
Apne bhujbal se unhonne prataapi kaam kie hain aur abhimaaniyon ko bikhra diya hai.
God ne raajaaon ko unke sinhaasnon se niche utaar diya aur vinamron ko uthaaya hai.
Unhonne bhukhon ko uttam padaarthon se tript kiya aur sampannon ko khaali lauta diya.
Unhonne apne servant Israel ki madad apni us mercy ke smaran mein ki,
Jiski promise usne hamaare baap-daadon se kari thi aur jo Abraham aur unke vanshjon par hamesha-hamesha rahegi.”
Lagbhag tin maah elizaabeth ke saath rahkar Mariyam apne ghar laut gain.
Elizaabeth ka prasavkaal pura hua aur unhonne ek son ko janm diya.
Jab parosiyon aur parijnon ne yah suna ki elizaabeth par yah grace hua hai, to ve bhi unke is khushi mein sammilit ho gae.
Lekin shishu ki maata ne javaab diya; “Nahin! Iska naam Yohan hoga!”
Is par unhonne elizaabeth se kaha, “Aapke parijnon mein to is naam ka koi bhi person nahin hai!”
Tab unhonne shishu ke pita se sanket mein savaal kiya ki vah shishu ka naam kya rakhna chaahte hain?
Zakaryaah ne ek lekhan patt manga kar us par likh diya, “Iska naam Yohan hai.” Yah dekh sabhi chakit rah gae.
Usi kshan unki aavaaj laut aai. Unki jibh ke bandhan khul gae aur vah God ki praise karne lage.
Sabhi parosiyon mein God ke prati shraddha bhaav a gaya aur Yahudiya pradesh ke sabhi parvtiy kshetr mein iski charcha hone lagi.
Nihsandeh Lord ka haath us baalak par tha. Jinhonne yah suna, unhonne ise yaad rakha aur yah soch karte rahe: “Kya hoga yah baalak!”
Holy Spirit se bharkar unke pita zakaryaah is tarah bhavishyvaaniyon ka varnaanubhaashan karna shuru kiya:
“Blessed hain Lord, Israel ke God, kyonki unhonne apni people ki sudhi li aur uska bachaav kiya.
Unhonne hamaare lie apne servant David ke vansh mein ek uddhaarkarta paida kiya hai,
(jaisa unhonne praachin kaal ke apne holy bhavishyadvaktaaon ke maadhyam se reveal kiya)
Dushmanon aur un sabse, jo hamse nafrat karte hain, bachaae rakha
Ki vah hamaare purvjon par apni kripaadrishti pradarshit karein aur apni holy vaacha ko pura karein;
Vahi vaacha, jo unhonne hamaare purvaj Abraham se sthaapit ki thi:
Vah hamein hamaare dushmanon ke haath se chhuraaeinge,
Ki ham pavitrta aur righteousness mein nirbhay ho life bhar unki service kar sakein.
“Aur baalak tum, mere son, param leader God ke prophet kahlaaoge; kyonki tum unka raasta taiyaar karne ke lie Lord ke aage-aage chaloge,
Tum God ki people ko uske galtiyon ki maafi ke dvaara bachaav ka knowledge provide karoge.
Hamaare God ki atydhik grace ke kaaran, heaven se ham par prakaash ka uday hoga,
Un par, jo andhera aur maut ki chhaaya mein hain; ki iske dvaara hamaara maargdarshan shaanti ke raasta par ho.”
Baalak Yohan ka vikaas hota gaya aur vah spiritual rup se bhi balvant hote gae. Israel ke saamne saarvajnik rup se reveal hone ke pahle vah banjar zameen mein nivaas karte rahe.
Yah us samay ki ghatna hai jab samraat kaysar augustos ki or se yah raaj command ghoshit ki gai ki sabhi rom shaasit raashtron mein janganna ki jaae.
Yah siriya raajy par raajypaal kviriniyus ke shaasankaal mein pahli janganna thi.
Sabhi naagrik apne naam likhvaane ke lie apne-apne janmasthaan ko jaane lage.
Yosef, David ke vanshaj the, isliye vah Galil pradesh ke naazreth shehar se Yahudiya pradesh ke bethlehem arthaat David ke shehar gae
Ki vah bhi apni mangetar Mariyam ke saath, jo garbhavti thi, naam likhvaaein.
Vahin Mariyam ka prasavkaal pura hua
Aur unhonne apne pahlauthe son ko janm diya. Unhonne use kapron mein lapet kar charni mein lita diya kyonki yaatri nivaas mein unke thaharne ke lie koi jagah uplabdh na tha.
Usi kshetr mein kuchh charvaahe raat ke samay maidaanon mein apni bheron ki chauksi kar rahe the.
Sahsa Lord ka ek dut unke saamne reveal hua aur Lord ka tej unke chaaron or phail gaya aur charvaahe bahut dar gae.
Is par angel ne unhein sabr dete hue kaha, “Daro mat! Kyonki main bahut khushi ka ek shubh sandesh laaya hun, jo sabhi ke lie hai:
Unki pahchaan ke chihn ye hain: tum kapron mein lipta aur charni mein leta hua ek shishu paaoge.”
Sahsa us angel ke saath angels ka ek vishaal samuh reveal hua, jo God ki praise is gaan ke dvaara kar raha tha:
“Sabse unche heaven mein God ki praise; aur prithvi par unmein, jin par unki kripaadrishti hai, shaanti sthaapit ho.”
Jab angel heaven laut gae tab charvaahon ne aapas mein soch kiya, “Aao ham bethlehem jaakar vah sab dekhein, jiska Lord ne ham par prakaashan kiya hai.”
Isliye ve turant chal pare aur bethlehem shehar pahunchkar Mariyam, Yosef aur us shishu ko dekha, jo charni mein leta hua tha.
Sabhi sunnevaalon ke lie charvaahon ka samaachaar aashchary ka vishay tha.
Mariyam in baaton ko apne dil mein sanjokar unke baare mein soch-soch karti rahin.
Charvaahe God ki praise aur gungaan karte hue laut gae kyonki jo kuchh unhonne suna tha aur dekha tha, vah thik vaisa hi tha, jaisa un par prakaashit kiya gaya tha.
Jab Moshe ki law ke anurup Mariyam aur Yosef ke shuddh hone ke din pure hue, ve shishu ko Yerushalem laae ki use Lord ko bheint kiya jaae.
Jaisa ki law ka order hai: har ek pahlautha son Lord ko bheint kiya jaae
Aur Lord ke law ki command ke hisaab se ek jora panduki ya kabutar ke do bachchon ki bali charhaai jaae.
Yerushalem mein Shimon naamak ek person the. Vah righteous aur shraddhaalu the. Vah Israel ki shaanti ki pratiksha kar rahe the. Un par Holy Spirit ka aachchhaadan tha.
Holy Spirit ke dvaara un par yah spasht kar diya gaya tha ki Lord ke Yeshu ko dekhe bina unki maut nahin hogi.
Holy Spirit ke sikhaane par Shimon temple ke aangan mein aae. Usi samay Mariyam aur Yosef ne law dvaara nirdhaarit vidhiyon ko pura karne ke purpose se shishu Yeshu ko lekar vahaan pravesh kiya.
Shishu Yeshu ko dekhkar Shimon ne unhein god mein lekar God ki praise karte hue kaha.
“Param leader Lord, ab apni promise ke hisaab se apne servant ko shaanti mein vida kijie,
Kyonki mainne apni aankhon se aapke bachaav ko dekh liya hai,
Jise aapne sabhi ke lie taiyaar kiya hai.
Yah aapki people Israel ka gaurav, aur sab raashtron ki knowledge ki roshni hai.”
Mariyam aur Yosef apne son ke baare mein in baaton ko sun chakit rah gae.
Yah talvaar tumhaare hi jaan ko aar-paar bedh degi—ki anekon ke dilon ke soch reveal ho jaaein.”
Hanna naamak ek bhavishyvaktin thi, jo aasher vansh ke fanuel naamak person ki putri thi. Vah bahut vriddh thi aur vivaah ke baad pati ke saath sirf saat varsh rahkar vidhva ho gai thi.
Is samay unki aayu chauraasi varsh thi. Unhonne temple kabhi nahin chhora aur vah din-raat upvaas aur prayer karte hue God ki upaasna mein tallin rahti thi.
Usi samay vah vahaan aai aur God ke prati thanks vyakt karne lagin. Unhonne un sabhi ko is shishu ke baare mein suchit kiya, jo Yerushalem ke chhutkaare ki pratiksha mein the.
Jab Yosef aur Mariyam Lord ke law mein nirdhaarit vidhiyaan puri kar chuke, ve Galil pradesh mein apne shehar naazreth laut gae.
Baalak Yeshu bare hote hue balvant hote gae aur unki samajh ka vikaas hota gaya. God unse prasann the aur vah unki kripaadrishti ke paatr the.
Lord Yeshu ke maata-pita prati varsh Fasah utsav ke uplakshy mein Yerushalem jaaya karte the.
Jab Lord Yeshu ki avastha baarah varsh ki hui, tab pratha ke hisaab se vah bhi apne maata-pita ke saath utsav ke lie Yerushalem gae.
Utsav ki samaapti par jab unke maata-pita ghar laut rahe the, baalak Yeshu Yerushalem mein hi thahar gae. Unke maata-pita isse anjaan the.
Yah sochkar ki baalak yaatri-samuh mein hi kahin hoga, ve us din ki yaatra mein aage barhte gae. Jab unhonne parijnon-mitron mein Lord Yeshu ko khojna shuruaat kiya,
Lord Yeshu unhein unke beech nahin mile isliye ve unhein khojne Yerushalem laut gae.
Tin din baad unhonne Lord Yeshu ko temple parisar mein shikshkon ke saath baitha hua paaya. Vahaan baithe hue vah unki sun rahe the aur unse savaal bhi kar rahe the.
Jis kisi ne bhi unko suna, vah unki samajh aur unke uttron se chakit the.
Unke maata-pita unhein vahaan dekh chakit rah gae. Unki maata ne unse savaal kiya, “Son! Tumne hamaare saath aisa kyon kiya? Tumhaare pita aur main tumhein kitni bechaini se khoj rahe the!”
“Kyon khoj rahe the aap mujhe?” Lord Yeshu ne unse puchha, “Kya aapko yah maalum na tha ki mera mere pita ke ghar mein hi hona uchit hai?”
Mariyam aur Yosef ko Lord Yeshu ki is baat ka arth samajh nahin aaya.
Lord Yeshu apne maata-pita ke saath naazreth laut gae aur unke aajnaakaari rahe. Unki maata ne ye sab vishay dil mein sanjoe rakhe.
Lord Yeshu samajh dildaul aur God aur insaanon ki kripaadrishti mein barhte chale gae.

Samraat kaysar tiberiyos ke shaasankaal ke pandrahvein varsh mein jab pontiyos Pilatos Yahudiya pradesh ka raajypaal, aur Herodes Galil pradesh ka, uska bhaai filippos ituriya aur trakhonitis pradesh ka, aur lisniyas ebilin ka shaasak the,
Aur jab hanna aur kaayaafas high priest pad par the; zakaryaah ke son Yohan ko, jab vah banjar zameen mein the, God ki or se ek sandesh receive hua.

Jaisa baptisma denevaale Yohan ke baare mein prophet yashaayaah ke words ke pustak mein likha hai: “Ek aavaaj, jo banjar zameen mein pukaarnevaale ki kah rahi hai, ‘Lord ke lie raasta ko taiyaar karo; unka raasta saral banaao.
Har ek ghaati bhar di jaaegi, har ek parvat aur pahaari samtal ki jaaegi. Terhe raaste sidhe ho jaaeinge, aur asamtal path samtal.
Har ek insaan ke saamne God ka bachaav spasht ho jaaega.’ ”

Sachche man phiraane ka pramaan do aur apne aapko aisa kahna shuru mat karo: ‘Ham to Abraham ki children hain!’ Kyonki main tumhein bataata hun ki God mein in patthron tak se Abraham ki children paida karne ka power hai.
Is par bhir ne unse savaal kiya, “Tab ham kya karein?”
Yohan ne unhein javaab diya, “Jis person ke paas do kurte hain, vah ek use de de, jiske paas ek bhi nahin hai. Jiske paas khaana hai, vah bhi yahi kare.”
Chungi lenevaale bhi baptisma ke lie unke paas aae aur unhonne Yohan se savaal kiya, “Guruvar! Hamaare lie uchit kya hai?”
“Nirdhaarit raashi se adhik mat lo.” Yohan ne javaab diya.

Kuchh sipaahiyon ne unse savaal kiya, “Hamein bataaie—ham kya karein?” Yohan ne javaab diya, “Na to dara-dhamka kar logon se paisa aintho aur na hi un par jhutha aarop lagaao lekin apne vetan mein hi santusht raho.”
Bari jijnaasa ke bhaav mein bhir yah jaanne ka koshish kar rahi thi aur apne-apne dil mein yahi soch kar rahe the ki kahin Yohan hi to Yeshu nahin hain.

Bhir ko sambodhit karte hue Yohan ne spasht kiya, “Mera baptisma to sirf paani-baptisma hai lekin ek mujhse adhik saamarthyshaali a rahe hain. Main to unki jutiyon ke bandh kholne yogy bhi nahin. Vahi hain, jo tumhein Holy Spirit aur aag mein baptisma deinge.
Jab Yohan ne raajypaal Herodes ko uske bhaai ki patni herodias ke baare mein aur khud usi ke dvaara kie gae dusre kukarmon ke kaaran phatkaar lagaai,
Tab Herodes ne ek aur kukarm kiya: usne Yohan hi ko bandi banaakar kaaraagaar mein daal diya.
Jab log Yohan se baptisma le rahe the, unhonne Lord Yeshu ko bhi baptisma diya. Is avsar par, jab Lord Yeshu prayer kar rahe the, heaven khol diya gaya
Aur Holy Spirit Lord Yeshu par shaaririk taur par kabutar ke jaisa utre aur heaven se nikla ek word suna gaya: “Tum mere son ho—mere dear. Main tummein puri tarah santusht hun.”
Lord Yeshu ne jab apni sevkaai shuruaat ki tab unki avastha lagbhag tis varsh ki thi. Jaisa samjha jaata hai ki vah Yosef ke son hain, Yosef heli ke,
Holy Spirit se bharkar Lord Yeshu yardan nadi se laute aur aatma unhein banjar zameen mein le gaya,
Jahaan chaalis din tak aarop lagaanevaala unhein pariksha mein daalne ka koshish karta raha. Is avdhi mein vah puri tarah bina khaana ke rahe, iske baad unhein bhukh lagi.
Aarop lagaanevaala ne unse kaha, “Yadi tum God ke son ho to is patthar ko command do ki yah roti ban jaae.”
Lord Yeshu ne use javaab diya, “Likha hai: ‘Insaan ka life sirph khaana par hi nirbhar nahin rahta hai.’”
Iske baad aarop lagaanevaala ne unhein unche pahaar par le jaakar kshan sirf mein saare vishv ke sabhi raajyon ki jhalak dikhaai
Aur unse kaha, “In sabka saara authority aur vaibhav main tumhein dunga kyonki ye sab mujhe saumpe gae hain isliye ye sab main apni chaahat se kisi ko bhi de sakta hun.
Yadi tum sirf meri worship karo to ye sab tumhaara ho jaaega.”
Lord Yeshu ne iske uttar mein kaha, “Likha hai: tum sirph Lord apne God ki hi worship aur service kiya karo.”
Iske baad aarop lagaanevaala ne unhein Yerushalem le jaakar temple ki choti par khara kar diya aur unse kaha, “Yadi tum God ke son ho to yahaan se kud jaao,
Kyonki likha hai: “ ‘Vah apne angels ko tumhaari suraksha ke sambandh mein command deinge aur;
Ve tumhein haathon-haath utha leinge; ki tumhaare paanv ko patthar se chot na lage.’ ”
Iske uttar mein Lord Yeshu ne usse kaha, “Yah bhi to likha hai: tum Lord apne God ko na parakhna.”
Jab aarop lagaanevaala Lord Yeshu ko pariksha mein daalne ke sabhi koshish kar chuka, vah unhein kisi satik avsar tak ke lie chhorkar chala gaya.
Lord Yeshu aatma ke power mein Galil pradesh laut gae. Nazdiki sabhi shehron mein unke baare mein samaachaar phail gaya.
Lord Yeshu Yahudi sabhaagrihon mein teaching dete the aur sabhi unki saraahna karte the.
Lord Yeshu naazreth shehar aae, jahaan unka follow poshan hua tha. Shabbat par apni riti ke hisaab se vah Yahudi synagogue mein jaakar Scripture parhne ke lie khare ho gae.
Unhein prophet yashaayaah ka abhilekh diya gaya. Unhonne usmein vah jagah nikaali, jahaan likha hai:
Tab unhonne pustak band karke servant ke haathon mein de di aur khud baith gae. Synagogue mein har ek person unhein ektak dekh raha tha.
Lord Yeshu ne aage kaha, “Aaj aapke sunte-sunte yah lekh pura hua.”
Sabhi Lord Yeshu ki saraahna kar rahe the aur unke chehra se nikalne vaale sundar vichaaron ne sabko chakit kar rakha tha. Ve aapas mein puchh rahe the, “Yah Yosef ka hi son hai na?”

Lord Yeshu ne unhein sambodhit karte hue kaha, “Main jaanta hun ki aap mujhse yah kahna chaaheinge, ‘Are chikitsak! Pahle khud ko to svasth kar! Apne grihangar mein bhi vah sab kar dikha, jo hamne tujhe kafranhum mein karte suna hai.’ ”
Lord Yeshu ne aage kaha, “Vaastav mein koi bhi prophet apne grihangar mein sammaan nahin paata.
Sach to yah hai ki Eliyah ke samay mein jab saarhe tin saal aasmaan band hokar varsha na hui, Israel raashtr mein kai vidhvaaein thi, aur sabhi raashtr mein bhayankar akaal para;
Eliyah ko unmein se kisi ke paas nahin bheja gaya, atirikt uske, jo sidon pradesh ke zaraphta shehar mein thi.
Vaise hi prophet elisha ke samay mein Israel raashtr mein kai korh rogi the lekin siriyaavaasi naamaan ke atirikt koi bhi shuddh nahin kiya gaya.”
Yah sunte hi Yahudi synagogue mein ikattha sabhi person bahut krodhit ho gae.
Unhonne Lord Yeshu ko dhakke maarte hue shehar ke baahar nikaal diya aur unhein khinchte hue us parvat shikhar par le gae, jis par vah shehar basa hua tha ki unhein chattaan par se niche dhakel dein
Lekin Lord Yeshu bachte hue bhir ke bich se nikal gae.
Vahaan se vah Galil pradesh ke kafranhum naamak shehar mein aae aur Shabbat par logon ko teaching dene lage.
Lord Yeshu ki teaching unke lie aashchary ka vishay thi kyonki unka sandesh adhikaarpurn hota tha.
Synagogue mein ek dard denevaali aatma se pirit person tha. Vah unche word mein bol utha,
“Naazrethvaasi Yeshu! Kya chaahte hain aap? Kya aap hamein barbaadi karne aae hain? Main jaanta hun ki aap kaun hain; God ke holy jan!”
“Chup!” Lord Yeshu ne kare word mein kaha, “Usmein se baahar nikal a!” Dard denevaali aatma ne us person ko un sabke saamne zameen par patak diya aur us person ki haani kie bina usmein se nikal gaya.

Yah dekh ve sabhi chakit rah gae aur aapas mein kahne lage, “Kya hai yah word! Yah bare authority aur power ke saath dard denevaali aatmaaon ko command deta hai aur ve insaanon mein se baahar a jaate hain!”
Unke baare mein yah varnan aas-paas ke sabhi kshetron mein phail gaya.
Yahudi synagogue se nikalkar Lord Yeshu Shimon ke nivaas par gae. Vahaan Shimon ki saas jvar-pirit thi. Disciples ne Lord Yeshu se unhein svasth karne ki request ki
Lord Yeshu ne unke paas jaakar jvar ko phatkaara aur jvar unhein chhor chala gaya. Vah turant bichhaune se uthkar unki service tahal mein jut gain.
Suryaast ke samay log vibhinn rogon se piriton ko unke paas le aae. Lord Yeshu ne har ek par haath rakh unhein rog se mukti provide ki.

Iske atirikt anekon mein se dard denevaali aatma yah chillaate hue baahar nikal gae, “Aap to God ke son hain!” Lekin Lord Yeshu unhein daant kar bolne se rok dete the kyonki dard denevaali aatma unke Yeshu hone ke saty se parichit the.
Pau phatte hi Lord Yeshu ek sunsaan sthal par chale gae. Log unhein khojte hue vahaan pahunch gae. Ve koshish kar rahe the ki Lord Yeshu unhein chhorkar na jaaein.
Ek din Lord Yeshu gannesrat jhil ke tat par khare the. Vahaan ek bari bhir unse God ka vachan sunne ke lie un par gir par rahi thi.
Lord Yeshu ne tat par naavein dekhin. Machhuvaare unhein chhorkar chale gae the kyonki ve apne jaal dho rahe the.

Lord Yeshu ek naav par baith gae, jo Shimon ki thi. Unhonne Shimon se naav ko tat se kuchh dur jhil mein le jaane ke lie kaha aur tab unhonne naav mein baithkar ikattha bhir ko teaching deni shuruaat kar di.
Jab vah apna vishay samaapt kar chuke, Shimon ko sambodhit karte hue unhonne kaha, “Naav ko gahre paani mein le chalo aur tab jaal daalo.”
Shimon Lord se bole, “Maalik! Ham raat bhar kathin parishram kar chuke hain lekin haath kuchh na laga, phir bhi, isliye ki yah aap kah rahe hain, main jaal daal deta hun.”
Yah kahte hue unhonne jaal daal die. Jaal mein itni bari sankhya mein machhliyaan a gai ki jaal phatne lage
Isliye unhonne dusri naav ke sah machhuaaron ko madad ke lie bulaaya. Unhonne aakar madad ki aur donon naavon mein itni machhliyaan bhar gain ki bojh ke kaaran naavein dubne lagin.
Sach ka ahsaas hote hi Shimon Lord Yeshu ke charnon par gir kahne lage, “Aap mujhse dur hi rahie Lord, main ek galti karnevaala insaan hun.”
Yah isliye ki Shimon aur unke saathi machhuvaare itni machhliyon ke pakre jaane se achambhit the.

Shimon ke dusre saathi, zebediyos ke donon son, Yaakob aur Yohan bhi yah dekh bhauchakke rah gae the. Tab Lord Yeshu ne Shimon se kaha, “Daro mat! Ab se tum machhliyon ko nahin, insaanon ko mere paas laaoge.”
Isliye unhonne naavein tat par lagaai aur sab kuchh tyaag kar Lord Yeshu ke pichhe chalne lage.
Kisi shehar mein ek person tha, jiske saare body mein korh rog phail chuka tha. Lord Yeshu ko dekh usne zameen par girkar unse request ki, “Lord! Yadi aap chaahein to mujhe shuddh kar sakte hain.”
Lord Yeshu ne haath barhaakar uska sparsh kiya aur kaha, “Main chaahta hun, shuddh ho jaao!” Tatkaal hi use korh rog se changaai receive ho gai.

Lord Yeshu ne use command di, “Iske baare mein kisi se kuchh na kahna lekin jaakar priest ko apne shuddh hone ka pramaan do aur Moshe dvaara nirdhaarit shuddhi-bali bheint karo ki tumhaara korh se chhutkaara unke saamne gavaahi ho jaae.”
Phir bhi Lord Yeshu ke baare mein samaachaar aur bhi adhik phailta gaya. Parinaamasvrup log bhaari sankhya mein unke pravchan sunne aur bimaariyon se changa hone ki abhilaasha se unke paas aane lage.
Lord Yeshu aksar bhir ko chhor, gupt rup se, ekaant mein jaakar prayer kiya karte the.

Ek din, jab Lord Yeshu teaching de rahe the, Farisi aur shaastri, jo Galil aur Yahudiya pradeshon aur Yerushalem shehar se vahaan aae the, baithe hue the. Rogiyon ko svasth karne ka God ka power Lord Yeshu mein sakriy tha.
Kuchh person ek lakve ke rogi ko bichhaune par lita kar vahaan laae. Ye log rogi ko Lord Yeshu ke saamne laane ka koshish kar rahe the.
Jab ve bhir ke kaaran use bhitar le jaane mein asphal rahe to ve chhat par charh gae aur chhat mein se uske bichhaune sahit rogi ko Lord Yeshu ke thik saamne utaar diya.
Unka yah faith dekh Lord Yeshu ne kaha, “Mitr! Tumhaare galti maafi kie ja chuke hain.”
Farisi aur shaastri apne man mein soch karne lage, “Kaun hai yah person, jo God-ninda kar raha hai? Bhala God ke atirikt dusre kaun galti maafi kar sakta hai?”
Yah jaante hue ki unke man mein kya soch uth rahe the, Lord Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Aap apne man mein is tarah tark-vitark kyon kar rahe hain?
Kya kahna saral hai, ‘Tumhaare galti maafi kar die gae’ Ya ‘Utho aur chalo’?

Lekin iska purpose yah hai ki tumhein yah maalum ho jaae ki insaan ke son ko prithvi par galti maafi ka authority saumpa gaya hai.” Tab rogi se Yeshu ne kaha, “Utho, apna bichhauna uthaao aur apne ghar jaao.”
Usi kshan vah rogi un sabke saamne uth khara hua, apna bichhauna uthaaya, jis par vah leta hua tha aur God ka thanks karte hue ghar chala gaya.
Sabhi hairaan rah gae. Sabhi God ka thanks karne lage. Shraddha se bharkar ve kah rahe the, “Hamne aaj anokhe kaam hote dekhe hain.”
Jab vah vahaan se ja rahe the, unki nazar ek chungi lenevaale par pari, jinka naam Levi tha. Vah apni chauki par baithe kaam kar rahe the. Lord Yeshu ne unhein command di, “Aao! Mere pichhe ho lo!”
Levi uthe aur sabhi kuchh vahin chhorkar Lord Yeshu ke pichhe ho lie.
Lord Yeshu ke sammaan mein Levi ne apne ghar par ek bare bhoj ka aayojan kiya. Bari sankhya mein chungi lenevaalon ke atirikt vahaan kai dusre person bhi ikattha the.
Yah dekh us samprdaay ke Farisi aur shaastri Lord Yeshu ke disciples se kahne lage, “Tum log chungi lenevaalon aur apraadhiyon ke saath kyon khaate-pite ho?”
Lord Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Chikitsak ki zarurat svasth person ko nahin, rogi ko hoti hai;
Main prithvi par dharmiyon ko nahin lekin galti karnevaalon ko bulaane aaya hun ki ve pashchaataap karein.”

Farisiyon aur shaastriyon ne unhein yaad dilaate hue kaha, “Yohan ke disciple aksar upvaas aur prayer karte hain. Farisiyon ke disciple bhi yahi karte hain lekin aapke disciple to khaate-pite rahte hain.”
Lord Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Kya dulhe upasthiti mein atithiyon se upvaas ki ummid ki ja sakti hai?
Lekin vah samay aaega, jab dulha unke beech se hata liya jaaega—ve us samay upvaas kareinge.”

Lord Yeshu ne unke saamne yah drishtaant prastut kiya, “Puraane kapde par naye kapde ka jor nahin lagaaya jaata. Yadi koi aisa karta hai tab kora kapde to barbaadi hota hi hai saath hi vah jor puraane kapde par ashobhniy bhi lagta hai.
Vaise hi naya daakhras puraani mashkon mein rakha nahin jaata. Yadi koi aisa kare to naya daakhras mashkon ko phaarkar bah jaaega aur mashke bhi barbaadi ho jaaegi.
Naya daakhras nai mashkon mein hi rakha jaata hai.
Puraane daakhras ka paan karne ke baad koi bhi nae daakhras ki chaahat nahin karta kyonki ve kahte hain, ‘Puraana daakhras hi uttam hai.’ ”
Ek Shabbat par Lord Yeshu ann ke khet se hokar ja rahe the. Unke disciples ne baalein torkar, masal-masal kar khaana shuruaat kar diya.
Yah dekh kuchh Farisiyon ne kaha, “Aap Shabbat par yah kaam kyon kar rahe hain, jo niyam khilaaf?”
Lord Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Kya aapne yah kabhi nahin parha ki bhukh lagne par David aur unke saathiyon ne kya kiya tha?
David ne God ke bhavan mein pravesh kar vah samarpit roti khaai, jiska khaana priests ke atirikt kisi dusre ke lie niyam khilaaf tha? Yahi roti unhonne apne saathiyon ko bhi di.”
Lord Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Insaan ka son Shabbat ka Lord hai.”
Ek dusre Shabbat par Lord Yeshu Yahudi synagogue mein teaching dene lage. Vahaan ek person tha, jiska daayaan haath laqva maara hua tha.
Farisi aur shaastri is avsar ki taak mein the ki Shabbat par Lord Yeshu is person ko svasth karein aur vah un par dosh laga sakein.

Lord Yeshu ko unke manon mein uth rahe vichaaron ka pura pata tha. Unhonne us person ko, jiska haath sukha hua tha, command di, “Utho! Yahaan sabke beech khare ho jaao.” Vah uthkar vahaan khara ho gaya.
Tab Lord Yeshu ne Farisiyon aur shaastriyon ko sambodhit kar savaal kiya, “Yah bataaie, Shabbat par kya karna uchit hai; bhalaai ya buraai? Life raksha ya vinaash?”
Un sab par ek nazar daalte hue Lord Yeshu ne us person ko command di, “Apna haath barhaao!” Usne aisa hi kiya—uska haath svasth ho gaya tha.
Yah dekh Farisi aur shaastri krodh se jalne lage. Ve aapas mein soch-vimarsh karne lage ki Lord Yeshu ke saath ab kya kiya jaae.
Ek din Lord Yeshu parvat par prayer karne chale gae aur saari raat vah God se prayer karte rahe.
Praatahkaal unhonne apne chelon ko apne paas bulaaya aur unmein se baarah ko chunkar unhein apostle pad provide kiya.
Shimon, (jinhein vah Petros naam se pukaarte the) unke bhaai aandreyaas, Yaakob, Yohan, filippos, baartholomeyos
Mattiyaah, thomos, halfeyos ke son Yaakob, raashtrvaadi Shimon,
Yaakob ke son Yahudah, aur kaariyotvaasi Yahudah, jisne unke saath dhokha kiya.

Lord Yeshu unke saath parvat se utre aur aakar ek samtal sthal par khare ho gae. Yerushalem aur samudr ke kinaare ke shehar sor aur sidon se aae logon aur sunnevaalon ka ek bara samuh vahaan ikattha tha,

Jo unke pravchan sunne aur apne rogon se changaai ke purpose se vahaan aaya tha. Is samuh mein dard denevaali aatma se pirit bhi shaamil the, jinhein Lord Yeshu dard denevaali aatma mukt karte ja rahe the.
Sabhi log unhein chhune ka koshish kar rahe the kyonki unse nikli hui power un sabhi ko svasth kar rahi thi.
Apne disciples ki or nazar karte hue Lord Yeshu ne unse kaha: “Blessed ho tum sabhi jo nirdhan ho, kyonki God ka kingdom tumhaara hai.
Blessed ho tum jo bhukhe ho, kyonki tum tript kie jaaoge. Blessed ho tum jo is samay ro rahe ho, kyonki tum aanandit hoge.
“Dhikkaar hai tum par! Tum jo dhani ho, tum apne saare sukh bhog chuke.
Dhikkaar hai tum par! Tum jo ab tript ho, kyonki tumhaare lie bhukha rahna nirdhaarit hai. Dhikkaar hai tum par! Tum jo is samay hans rahe ho, kyonki tum shok aur vilaap karoge.
Dhikkaar hai tum par! Jab sab insaan tumhaari prashansa karte hain kyonki unke purvaj jhuthe bhavishyadvaktaaon ke saath yahi kiya karte the.”
“Lekin tum, jo is samay mere pravchan sun rahe ho, apne dushmanon se love karo aur unke saath bhalaai, jo tumse nafrat karte hain.
Jo tumhein shaap dete hain unko blessing do, aur jo tumhaare saath durvyavhaar karein unke lie prayer karo.
Yadi koi tumhaare ek gaal par prahaar kare uski or dusra bhi pher do. Yadi koi tumhaari chaadar lena chaahe to use apna kurta bhi dene mein sankoch na karo.
Jab bhi koi tumse kuchh maange to use zarur do aur yadi koi tumhaari koi vastu le le to use vaapas na maango
Anyon ke saath tumhaara vyavhaar vaisa hi ho jaise vyavhaar ki ummid tum unse karte ho.
“Yadi tum unhin se love karte ho, jo tumse love karte hain to ismein tumhaari kya prashansa? Kyonki durjan bhi to yahi karte hain.
Vaise hi yadi tum unhin ke saath bhalaai karte ho, jinhonne tumhaare saath bhalaai ki hai, to ismein tumhaari kya prashansa? Kyonki durjan bhi to yahi karte hain.

Aur yadi tum unhin ko karz dete ho, jinse raashi vaapas receive karne ki ummid hoti hai to tumne kaun sa prashansniy kaam kar dikhaaya? Aisa to God se dur rahnevaale log bhi karte hain—is ummid mein ki unki saari raashi unhein lauta di jaaegi.

Sahi to yah hai ki tum apne dushmanon se love karo, unka upkaar karo aur kuchh bhi vaapas receive karne ki ummid kie bina unhein karz de do. Tab tumhaara inaam asaadhaaran hoga aur tum param leader ki children thahraae jaaoge kyonki vah unke prati bhi kind hain, jo upkaar nahin maante aur bure hain.
Kind bano, thik vaise hi, jaise tumhaare pita kind hain.
“Kisi ka justice mat karo to tumhaara bhi justice nahin kiya jaaega. Kisi par dosh mat lagaao to tum par bhi dosh nahin lagaaya jaaega. Maafi karo to tumhein bhi maafi kiya jaaega.

Udaartaapurvak do, to tumhein bhi diya jaaega—pura naap daba-daba kar aur hila-hila kar baahar nikalta hua tumhaari jholi mein undel (yaani bahut udaartaapurvak) deinge. Dene ke tumhaare naap ke hisaab se hi tum receive karoge.”
Lord Yeshu ne unhein is drishtaant ke dvaara bhi teaching di. “Kya koi andha dusre andhe ka maargdarshan kar sakta hai? Kya ve donon hi gaddhe mein na gireinge?
Vidyaarthi apne shikshak se barhkar nahin hai lekin har ek, jisne teaching puri kar li hai, vah apne shikshak ke jaisa hoga.
“Tum bhala apne bhaai ki aankh ke kan ki or ungli kyon uthaate ho jabki tum khud apni aankh mein pare latthe ki or dhyaan nahin dete?

Ya tum bhala yah kaise kah sakte ho ‘Zara thahro, main tumhaari aankh se vah kan nikaal deta hun,’ Jabki tumhaari apni aankh mein to lattha para hua dekh nahin sakte ho? Are paakhandi! Pahle to khud apni aankh mein se us latthe ko to nikaal! Tabhi tu spasht rup se dekh sakega aur apne bhaai ki aankh mein se us kan ko nikaal sakega.”
“Koi bhi achchha per bura phal nahin laata aur na bura per achchha phal.
Har ek per uske apne phalon ke dvaara pahchaana jaata hai. Kantile vrikshon mein se log anjir ya kantili jhaariyon mein se angur ikattha nahin kiya karte.

Bhala person dil mein bhare hue uttam bhandaar mein se uttam hi nikaalta hai aur bura person apne dil mein bhare hue bure bhandaar mein se bura; kyonki uska chehra uske dil mein bhari hui vastuon mein se hi nikaalta hai.”
“Tum log mujhe, Lord, Lord kahkar kyon pukaarte ho jabki meri commands ka follow hi nahin karte?
Main tumhein bataaunga ki vah person kis tarah ka hai, jo mere paas aata hai, mere sandesh ko sunta aur uska follow karta hai:

Vah us ghar banaanevaale ke jaisa hai, jisne gahri khudaai karke chattaan par ninv daali. Muslaadhaar baarish ke tej bahaav ne us ghar par thokrein maari lekin use hila na paaya kyonki vah ghar majbut tha.

Vah person, jo mere sandesh ko sunta hai lekin uska follow nahin karta, us person ke jaisa hai, jisne zameen par bina ninv ke ghar banaaya aur jis kshan us par tej bahaav ne thokrein maari, vah dhah gaya aur uska sarvnaash ho gaya.”
Logon ko upar likhi teaching dene ke baad Lord Yeshu kafranhum shehar laut gae.
Vahaan ek shataadhipti ka ek bahut dear servant rog se bistar par tha. Rog ke kaaran vah lagbhag marne par tha.
Lord Yeshu ke baare mein maalum hone par senaapti ne kuchh varishth Yahudiyon ko Lord Yeshu ke paas is request ke saath bheja, ki vah aakar uske servant ko changa karein.
Unhonne Lord Yeshu ke paas aakar unse request kar kaha, “Yah senaapti nishchay hi aapki is daya ka paatr hai
Kyonki use hamaari janta se love hai aur usne hamaare lie synagogue bhi banaaya hai.”

Isliye Lord Yeshu unke saath chale gae. Lord Yeshu uske ghar ke paas pahunche hi the ki shataadhipti ne apne mitron ke dvaara unhein sandesh bheja, “Lord! Aap kasht na kijie. Main is yogy nahin hun ki aap mere ghar padhaarein.
Apni isi ayogyta ko dhyaan mein rakhte hue main khud aapse bheint karne nahin aaya. Aap sirf vachan kah dijie aur mera servant svasth ho jaaega.

Main khud bare adhikaariyon ke adhin niyukt hun aur sainik mere authority mein hain. Main kisi ko order deta hun, ‘Jaao!’ To vah jaata hai aur kisi ko order deta hun, ‘Idhar aao!’ To vah aata hai. Apne servant se kahta hun, ‘Yah karo!’ To vah vahi karta hai.”
Yah sunkar Lord Yeshu bahut chakit hue aur murkar pichhe a rahi bhir ko sambodhit kar bole, “Main yah bataana sahi samajhta hun ki mujhe israaeliyon tak mein aisa drirh faith dekhne ko nahin mila.”
Ve, jo senaapti dvaara Lord Yeshu ke paas bheje gae the, jab ghar laute to yah paaya ki vah servant svasth ho chuka tha.
Iske kuchh hi samay baad Lord Yeshu naain naamak ek shehar ko gae. Ek bari bhir aur unke disciple unke saath the.
Jab vah shehar dvaar par pahunche, ek mrit person antim sanskaar ke lie baahar laaya ja raha tha—apni maata ka eklauta son aur vah khud vidhva thi; aur uske saath shehar ki ek bari bhir thi.
Use dekh Lord Yeshu mercy se bhar uthe. Unhonne usse kaha, “Roo mat!”
Tab unhonne jaakar us arthi ko sparsh kiya. Yah dekh ve, jinhonne use uthaaya hua tha, ruk gae. Tab Lord Yeshu ne kaha, “Yuvak! Main tumse kahta hun, uth jaao!”
Mritak uth baitha aur vaartaalaap karne laga. Lord Yeshu ne maata ko uska jivit son saump diya.
Ve sabhi shraddha mein God ka thanks karne lage. Ve kah rahe the, “Hamaare beech ek tejasvi prophet ka aagman hua hai. God ne apni people ki sudhi li hai.”
Lord Yeshu ke baare mein yah samaachaar Yahudiya pradesh aur paas ke kshetron mein phail gaya.
Yohan ke disciples ne unhein is baare mein suchna di.
Yohan ne apne do disciples ko Lord ke paas is savaal ke saath bheja, “Kya aap vahi hain jinke aagman ki pratiksha ki ja rahi hai, ya ham kisi dusre ki pratiksha karein?”

Jab ve donon Lord Yeshu ke paas pahunche unhonne kaha, “Baptisma denevaale Yohan ne hamein aapke paas yah puchhne bheja hai, ‘Kya aap vahi hain, jinke aagman ki pratiksha ki ja rahi hai, ya ham kisi dusre ki pratiksha karein?’ ”
Thik usi samay Lord Yeshu anekon ko svasth kar rahe the, jo rogi, pirit aur dard denevaali aatma ke sataae hue the. Vah kai andhon ko bhi nazar provide kar rahe the.
Yohan ka sandesh laanevaalon ke vida hone ke baad Lord Yeshu ne bhir se Yohan ke baare mein kahna shuruaat kiya, “Tumhaari ummid banjar zameen mein kya dekhne ki thi? Hava mein hilte hue sarkande ko?
Yadi yah nahin to phir kya dekhne gae the? Kimti kapde dhaaran kie hue kisi person ko? Jo aise kapde dhaaran karte hain unka nivaas to raajmahlon mein hota hai.
Tum kyon gae the? Kisi prophet se bheint karne? Haan! Main tumhein bata raha hun ki yah vah hain, jo prophet se bhi barhkar hain
Yah vahi hain, jinke baare mein likha gaya hai: “ ‘Main apna dut tumhaare aage bhej raha hun, jo tumhaare aage-aage chalkar tumhaare lie raasta taiyaar karega.’
Sach to yah hai ki aaj tak jitne bhi insaan hue hain unmein se ek bhi (baptisma denevaale) Yohan se barhkar nahin. Phir bhi, God ke kingdom mein chhote se chhota bhi Yohan se barhkar hai.”
Jab sabhi logon ne, yahaan tak ki chungi lenevaalon ne, Lord Yeshu ke vachan, sune to unhonne Yohan ka baptisma lene ke dvaara yah accept kiya ki God ki yojna sahi hai.
Lekin Farisiyon aur shaastriyon ne baptisma na lekar unke lie tay God ke purpose ko asvikaar kar diya.
Lord Yeshu ne aage kaha, “Is pirhi ke logon ki tulna main kisse karun? Kiske jaisa hain ye?

Ye baajaar mein baithe hue un baalkon ke jaisa hain, jo ek dusre se pukaar-pukaarkar kah rahe hain: “ ‘Hamne tumhaare lie baansuri bajaai, lekin tum nahin naache, hamne tumhaare lie shok git bhi gaaya, phir bhi tum na roe.’
Baptisma denevaale Yohan roti nahin khaate the aur daakhras ka sevan bhi nahin karte the isliye tumne ghoshit kar diya, ‘Usmein dard denevaali aatma ka vaas hai.’

Insaan ke son ka khaan-paan saamaany hai aur tum ghoshna karte hain, ‘Are, vah to petu aur piyakkar hai; vah to chungi lenevaalon aur apraadhi logon ka mitr hai!’ Samajh apni children dvaara saabit hui hai
Phir bhi knowledge ki sach uski sabhi santaanon dvaara reveal ki gai hai.”
Ek Farisi ne Lord Yeshu ko bhoj par aamantrit kiya. Lord Yeshu aamantran accept kar vahaan gae aur khaana ke lie baith gae.
Shehar ki ek galti karnevaali aurat, yah maalum hone par ki Lord Yeshu vahaan aamantrit hain, sangmarmar ke bartan mein itr lekar aai

Aur unke charnon ke paas roti hui khari ho gai. Uske aansuon se unke paanv bhigne lage. Tab usne Lord ke paavon ko apne baalon se ponchha, unke paavon ko chuma aur us itr ko unke paavon par undel diya.

Jab us Farisi ne, jisne Lord Yeshu ko aamantrit kiya tha, yah dekha to man mein soch karne laga, “Yadi yah person vaastav mein prophet hota to zarur jaan jaata ki jo aurat use chhu rahi hai, vah kaun hai—ek galti karnevaala aurat!”
Lord Yeshu ne us Farisi ko kaha, “Shimon, mujhe tumse kuchh kahna hai.” “Kahie, guruvar,” Usne kaha.
Lord Yeshu ne kaha, “Ek saahukaar ke do karzdaar the—ek paanch sau dinaar ka aur dusra pachaas ka.
Donon hi karz chukaane mein asmarth the isliye us saahukaar ne donon hi ke karz maafi kar die. Yah bataao, donon mein se kaun us saahukaar se adhik love karega?”
Shimon ne javaab diya, “Mere soch se vah, jiski bari raashi maafi ki gai.” “Tumne sahi javaab diya,” Lord Yeshu ne kaha.

Tab us aurat se unmukh hokar Lord Yeshu ne Shimon se kaha, “Is aurat ki or dekho. Main tumhaare ghar aaya, tumne to mujhe paanv dhone ke lie bhi paani na diya lekin isne apne aansuon se mere paanv bhigo die aur apne keshon se unhein ponchh diya.
Tumne chumban se mera svaagat nahin kiya lekin yah aurat mere paanvon ko chumti rahi.
Tumne mere sir par tel nahin mala lekin isne mere paanvon par itr undel diya hai.

Main tumhein bataana chaahta hun ki yah mujhse itna adhik love isliye karti hai ki iske bahut galti maafi kar die gae hain; lekin vah, jiske thore hi galti maafi kie gae hain, love bhi thora hi karta hai.”
Tab Lord Yeshu ne us aurat se kaha, “Tumhaare galti maafi kar die gae hain.”
Aamantrit atithi aapas mein soch-vimarsh karne lage, “Kaun hai yah, jo galti bhi maafi karta hai?”
Lord Yeshu ne us aurat se kaha, “Tumhaara faith hi tumhaare bachaav ka kaaran hai. Shaanti mein vida ho jaao.”

Inke atirikt kuchh ve striyaan bhi unke saath yaatra kar rahi thi, jinhein rogon aur dard denevaali aatmaaon se chhutkaara dilaaya gaya tha: magdaalaavaasi Mariyam, jismein se saat dard denevaali aatma nikaale gae the,
Herodes ke bhandaari kuza ki patni yohaanna, suzanna aur dusre striyaan. Ye ve striyaan thi, jo apni property se inki madad kar rahi thi.
Jab shehar-shehar se bari bhir ikattha ho rahi thi aur log Lord Yeshu ke paas a rahe the, Lord Yeshu ne unhein is drishtaant ke dvaara teaching di.
“Ek kisaan bij bone ke lie nikla. Bij bone mein kuchh bij to raasta ke kinaare gire, pairon ke niche kuchle gae aur aakaash ke pakshiyon ne unhein chug liya.
Kuchh pathrili zameen par ja pare, ve ankurit to hue lekin nami na hone ke kaaran murjha gae.
Kuchh bij kantili jhaariyon mein ja pare aur jhaariyon ne unke saath bare hote hue unhein daba diya.

Kuchh bij achchhi zameen par gire, bare hue aur phal laae—jitna boya gaya tha usse sau guna.” Jab Lord Yeshu yah drishtaant suna chuke to unhonne unche word mein kaha, “Jiske sunne ke kaan hon vah sun le.”
Unke disciples ne unse savaal kiya, “Is drishtaant ka arth kya hai?”

Lord Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Tumhein to God ke kingdom ka bhed jaanne ki kshamta provide ki gai hai lekin anyon ke lie mujhe drishtaanton ka prayog karna parta hain jisse ki, “ ‘Ve dekhte hue bhi na dekhein; aur sunte hue bhi na samjhein.’
“Is drishtaant ka arth yah hai: bij God ka vachan hai.

Vah zameen jahaan bij kantili jhaariyon ke beech gira, ve log hain, jo sunte to hain lekin jab ve jivanpath par aage barhte hain, life ki chintaaein, wealth aur vilaasita unka daman kar deti hain aur ve majbut ho hi nahin paate.
Iske viprit uttam zameen ve log hain, jo bhale aur nishkpat dil se vachan sunte hain aur use dridhtaapurvak thaame rahte hain aur nirantar phal laate hain.
“Koi bhi dipak ko jalaakar na to use bartan se dhaankta hai aur na hi use palang ke niche rakhta hai lekin use divat par rakhta hai ki kamre mein pravesh karne par log dekh sakein.
Aisa kuchh bhi chhipa hua nahin hai jise reveal na kiya jaaega aur aisa koi rahasy nahin jise ujaagar kar saamne na laaya jaaega.
Isliye iska vishesh dhyaan rakho ki tum kaise sunte ho. Jis kisi ke paas hai, use aur bhi diya jaaega aur jis kisi ke paas nahin hai, uske paas se vah bhi le liya jaaega, jo uske soch se uska hai.”
Tab Lord Yeshu ki maata aur unke bhaai unse bheint karne vahaan aae lekin logon ki bhir ke kaaran ve unke paas pahunchne mein asmarth rahe.
Kisi ne Lord Yeshu ko suchna di, “Aapki maata aur bhaai baahar khare hain—ve aapse bheint karna chaah rahe hain.”
Lord Yeshu ne kaha, “Meri maata aur bhaai ve hain, jo God ka vachan sunte aur uska follow karte hain.”
Ek din Lord Yeshu ne disciples se kaha, “Aao, ham jhil ki dusri or chalein.” Isliye ve sab naav mein baithkar chal die.
Jab ve naav khe rahe the Lord Yeshu so gae. Usi samay jhil par prachand bavandar utha, yahaan tak ki naav mein paani bharne laga aur unka life khatre mein par gaya.

Disciples ne jaakar Lord Yeshu ko jagaate hue kaha, “Maalik! Maalik! Ham barbaadi hue ja rahe hain!” Lord Yeshu uthe. Aur bavandar aur tej lahron ko daanta; bavandar tham gaya aur tej lahrein shaant ho gain.

“Kahaan hai tumhaara faith?” Lord Yeshu ne apne disciples se savaal kiya. Dar aur achambhe mein ve ek dusre se puchhne lage, “Kaun hain yah, jo bavandar aur lahron tak ko order dete hain aur ve bhi unke orders ka follow karti hain!”
Iske baad ve giraasen pradesh mein aae, jo Galil jhil ke dusri or hai.

Jab Lord Yeshu tat par utre, unki bheint ek aise person se ho gai, jismein kai dard denevaali aatma samaaye hue the. Dard denevaali aatma se pirit person unke paas a gaya. Yah person lambe samay se kapre na pahanta tha. Vah makaan mein nahin lekin kabron ki guphaaon mein rahta tha.

Lord Yeshu par nazar parte hi vah chillaata hua unke charnon mein ja gira aur bahut unche word mein chillaaya, “Yeshu! Param leader God ke son! Mera aur aapka ek dusre se kya lena dena? Aapse meri request hai ki aap mujhe kasht na dein,”

Kyonki Lord Yeshu dard denevaali aatma ko us person mein se nikal jaane ki command de chuke the. Samay samay par dard denevaali aatma us person par prabal ho jaaya karta tha aur log use saanklon aur beriyon mein baandhkar pahre mein rakhte the, phir bhi vah dard denevaali aatma beriyaan tor use sunsaan jagah mein le jaata tha.
Lord Yeshu ne usse savaal kiya, “Kya naam hai tumhaara?” “Vishaal sena,” Usne javaab diya kyonki kai dard denevaali aatma usmein samaae hue the.
Dard denevaali aatma-gan Lord Yeshu se nirantar request kar rahe the ki vah unhein paataal mein na bhejein.

Vahin pahaari ke dhaal par suaron ka ek vishaal samuh char raha tha. Dard denevaali aatmaaon ne Lord Yeshu se request ki ki vah unhein suaron mein jaane ki anumti de dein. Lord Yeshu ne unhein anumti de di.
Jab dard denevaali aatma us person mein se baahar aae, unhonne turant jaakar suaron mein pravesh kiya aur suar dhaal se jhapatkar daurte hue jhil mein ja dube.
In suaron ke charvaahe yah dekh daurkar gae aur shehar aur us pradesh mein sab jagah is ghatna ke baare mein bataane lage.

Log vahaan yah dekhne aane lage ki kya hua hai. Tab ve Lord Yeshu ke paas aae. Vahaan unhonne dekha ki vah person, jo pahle dard denevaali aatma se pirit tha, kapde dhaaran kie hue, puri tarah svasth aur sachet Lord Yeshu ke charnon mein baitha hua hai. Yah dekh ve hairaan rah gae.
Jinhonne yah sab dekha, unhonne jaakar anyon ko suchit kiya ki yah dard denevaali aatma se pirit person kis tarah dard denevaali aatma se mukt hua hai.

Tab giraasen pradesh aur paas ke kshetron ke sabhi nivaasiyon ne Lord Yeshu ko vahaan se dur chale jaane ko kaha kyonki ve bahut bhaybhit ho gae the. Isliye Lord Yeshu naav dvaara vahaan se chale gae.
Jab Lord Yeshu jhil ki dusri or pahunche, vahaan intjaar karti bhir ne unka svaagat kiya.
Jaairus naamak ek person, jo Yahudi synagogue ka leader tha, unse bheint karne aaya. Usne Lord Yeshu ke charnon par girkar unse request ki ki vah uske saath uske ghar jaaein
Kyonki uski ekmaatr beti, jo lagbhag baarah varsh ki thi, marne par thi. Jab Lord Yeshu vahaan ja rahe the, raasta mein vah bhir mein dabe ja rahe the.
Vahaan baarah varsh se lahusraav-pirit ek aurat thi. Usne apni saari jivika vaidyon par kharch kar di thi, par vah kisi bhi ilaaj se svasth na ho paai thi.
Is aurat ne pichhe se aakar Yeshu ke kapde ke chhor ko chhua, aur usi kshan uska lahu bahna band ho gaya.
“Kisne mujhe chhua hai?” Lord Yeshu ne puchha. Jab sabhi isse inkaar kar rahe the, Petros ne unse kaha, “Maalik! Yah barhti hui bhir aap par giri ja rahi hai.”
Lekin Lord Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Kisi ne to mujhe chhua hai kyonki mujhe yah pata chala hai ki mujhmein se power nikli hai.”

Jab us aurat ne yah samajh liya ki uska chhupa rahna asambhav hai, dar se kaampti hui saamne aai aur Lord Yeshu ke charnon mein gir pari. Usne sabhi upasthit bhir ke saamne yah accept kiya ki usne Lord Yeshu ko kyon chhua tha aur kaise vah tatkaal rog se changi ho gai.
Is par Lord Yeshu ne usse kaha, “Beti! Tumhaare faith ne tumhein svasth kiya hai. God ki shaanti mein laut jaao.”
Jab Lord Yeshu yah kah hi rahe the, Yahudi synagogue leader jaairus ke ghar se kisi person ne aakar suchna di, “Aapki putri ki maut ho chuki hai, ab guruvar ko kasht na dijie.”
Yah sun Lord Yeshu ne jaairus ko sambodhit kar kaha, “Daro mat! Keval faith karo aur vah svasth ho jaaegi.”
Jab ve jaairus ke ghar par pahunche, Lord Yeshu ne Petros, Yohan aur Yaakob aur kanya ke maata-pita ke atirikt dusre kisi ko apne saath bhitar aane ki anumti nahin di.
Us samay sabhi us baalika ke lie ro-rokar shok reveal kar rahe the. “Band karo yah rona-chillaana!” Lord Yeshu ne command di, “Uski maut nahin hui hai—vah sirph so rahi hai.”
Is par ve Lord Yeshu par hansne lage kyonki ve jaante the ki baalika ki maut ho chuki hai.
Lord Yeshu ne baalika ka haath pakarkar kaha, “Beti, utho!”
Uske jaan usmein laut aae aur vah turant khari ho gai. Lord Yeshu ne unse kaha ki baalika ko khaane ke lie kuchh diya jaae.
Uske maata-pita chakit rah gae lekin Lord Yeshu ne unhein nirdesh diya ki jo kuchh hua hai, uski charcha kisi se na karein.
Lord Yeshu ne baarhon disciples ko bulaakar unhein dard denevaali aatmaaon ko nikaalne aur rog dur karne ka power aur authority provide kiya
Kuchh dusre kah rahe the ki Eliyah reveal hue hain aur kuchh anyon ne daava kiya ki praachin kaal ke bhavishyadvaktaaon mein se koi dobaara jivit ho gaya hai
Lekin Herodes ne virodh kiya, “Yohan ka sir to khud mainne urvaaya tha, tab yah kaun hai, jiske baare mein main ye sab sun raha hun?” Isliye Herodes Lord Yeshu se milne ka koshish karne laga.
Apni yaatra se lautkar apostles ne Lord Yeshu ke saamne apne-apne kaamon ka bakhaan kiya. Tab Lord Yeshu unhein lekar chupchaap baithsaida naamak shehar chale gae.

Lekin logon ko iske baare mein maalum ho gaya aur ve vahaan pahunch gae. Lord Yeshu ne saharsh unka svaagat kiya aur unhein God ke kingdom ke baare mein teaching di aur un rogiyon ko changa kiya, jinhein iski zarurat thi.

Jab din dhalne par aaya tab baarhon apostles ne Lord Yeshu ke paas aakar unhein sujhaav diya, “Bhir ko vida kar dijie ki ve paas ke gaanvon mein jaakar apne thaharne aur khaana ki law kar sakein kyonki yah sunsaan jagah hai.”

Is par Lord Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Tumhin karo inke khaana ki law!” Unhonne iske uttar mein kaha, “Hamaare paas to keval paanch rotiyaan aur do machhliyaan hi hain; haan, yadi ham jaakar in sabke lie khaana mol le aaein to yah sambhav hai.”
Is bhir mein aadmi hi lagbhag paanch hazaar the. Lord Yeshu ne disciples ko order diya, “Inhein lagbhag pachaas-pachaas ke jhund mein baitha do.”
Disciples ne un sabko khaana ke lie baitha diya.

Paanchon rotiyaan aur donon machhliyaan apne haath mein lekar Lord Yeshu ne heaven ki or nazar karte hue unke lie God ko thanks kiya aur unhein tor-tor kar disciples ko dete gae ki ve logon mein inko baantte jaaein.
Sabhi ne bharpet khaaya. Shesh rah gae tukre ikattha karne par baarah tokre bhar gae.
Ek samay, jab Lord Yeshu ekaant mein prayer kar rahe the aur unke disciple bhi unke saath the, Lord Yeshu ne disciples se savaal kiya, “Log kya kahte hain ve mere baare mein; ki main kaun hun?”
Unhonne javaab diya, “Kuchh kahte hain baptisma denevaala Yohan; kuchh Eliyah; aur kuchh dusre kahte hain puraane bhavishyadvaktaaon mein se ek, jo dobaara jivit ho gaya hai.”
“Main kaun hun is baare mein tumhaari dhaarna kya hai?” Lord Yeshu ne savaal kiya. Petros ne javaab diya, “God ke Yeshu.”
Lord Yeshu ne unhein kari chetaavni dete hue kaha ki ve yah kisi se na kahein.
“Sach to yah hai ki yahaan kuchh hain, jo maut tab tak na chakheinge jab tak ve God ka kingdom dekh na lein.”
Apni is baat ke lagbhag aath din baad Lord Yeshu Petros, Yohan aur Yaakob ko saath lekar ek unche parvat shikhar par prayer karne gae.
Jab Lord Yeshu prayer kar rahe the, unke mukhmandal ka rup badal gaya aur unke kapde safed aur ujle ho gae.
Do person—Moshe aur Eliyah—unke saath baatein karte dikhaai die.
Ve bhi svargiy tej mein the. Unki baaton ka vishay tha Lord Yeshu ka jaana, jo Yerushalem shehar mein shighr hi hone par tha.
Petros aur uske saathi bahut nind mein the lekin jab ve puri tarah jaag gae, unhonne Lord Yeshu ko unke svargiy tej mein un do logon ke saath dekha.

Jab ve aadmi Lord Yeshu ke paas se jaane lage Petros Lord Yeshu se bole, “Lord! Hamaare lie yahaan hona kitna achchha hai! Ham yahaan tin mandap banaaein: ek aapke lie, ek Moshe ke lie aur ek Eliyah ke lie.” Khud unhein apni in kahi hui baaton ka matlab nahin pata tha.
Jab Petros yah kah hi rahe the, ek baadal ne un sabko dhaamp liya. Baadal se ghir jaane par ve bhaybhit ho gae.
Baadal mein se ek aavaaj sunaai di: “Yah mera son hai—mera chuna hua. Iske order ka follow karo.”
Aavaaj samaapt hone par unhonne dekha ki Lord Yeshu akele hain. Jo kuchh unhonne dekha tha, unhonne us samay uska varnan kisi se bhi na kiya. Ve is baare mein maun bane rahe.
Agle din jab ve parvat se niche aae, ek bari bhir vahaan ikattha thi.
Bhir mein se ek person ne unche word mein pukaarkar kaha, “Guruvar! Aapse meri request hai ki aap mere son ko svasth kar dein kyonki vah meri iklauti children hai.

Ek dard denevaali aatma aksar us par prabal ho jaata hai aur vah sahsa chikhne lagta hai. Dard denevaali aatma use zameen par patak deta hai aur mere son ko ainthan shuruaat ho jaati hai aur uske chehra se phen nikalne lagta hai. Yah dard denevaali aatma kadaachit hi use chhorkar jaata hai—vah use barbaadi karne par utaaru hai.
Mainne aapke disciples se request ki thi ki ve use mere son mein se nikaal dein lekin ve asphal rahe.”
“Are o avishvaasi aur bigri hui pirhi!” Lord Yeshu ne kaha, “Main kab tak tumhaare saath rahunga, kab tak sabr rakhunga? Yahaan laao apne son ko!”

Jab vah baalak paas a hi raha tha, dard denevaali aatma ne use zameen par patak diya, jisse uske body mein ainthan shuruaat ho gai lekin Lord Yeshu ne dard denevaali aatma ko daanta, baalak ko svasth kiya aur use uske pita ko saump diya.
God ka prataap dekh sabhi chakit rah gae.
“Jo kuchh main kah raha hun bahut dhyaanpurvak suno aur yaad rakho: insaan ka son insaanon ke haathon pakarvaaya jaane par hai.”

Lekin disciple is baat ka matlab samajh na paae. Is baat ka matlab unse chhupaakar rakha gaya tha. Yahi kaaran tha ki ve iska matlab samajh na paae aur unhein iske baare mein Lord Yeshu se puchhne ka saahas bhi na hua.
Disciples mein is vishay ko lekar vivaad chhir gaya ki unmein shreshth kaun hai.
Yah jaante hue ki disciple apne man mein kya soch rahe hain Lord Yeshu ne ek chhote baalak ko apne paas khara karke kaha,

“Jo koi mere naam mein is chhote baalak ko grahan karta hai, mujhe grahan karta hai, aur jo koi mujhe grahan karta hai, unhein grahan karta hai jinhonne mujhe bheja hai. Vah, jo tumhaare beech chhota hai, vahi hai jo shreshth hai.”
Yohan ne unhein suchna di, “Lord, hamne ek person ko aapke naam mein dard denevaali aatma nikaalte hue dekha hai. Hamne use aisa karne se rokne ka prayatn kiya kyonki vah hammein se nahin hai.”
“Mat roko use!” Lord Yeshu ne kaha, “Kyonki jo tumhaara virodhi nahin, vah tumhaare paksh mein hai.”
Jab Lord Yeshu ke heaven mein utha lie jaane ka nirdhaarit samay paas aaya, soch drirh karke Lord Yeshu ne apne paanv Yerushalem shehar ki or barha die.
Unhonne apne aage sandeshvaahak bhej die. Ve shamriya pradesh ke ek gaanv mein pahunche ki Lord Yeshu ke aagman ki taiyaari karein
Lekin vahaan ke nivaasiyon ne unhein accept nahin kiya kyonki Lord Yeshu Yerushalem shehar ki or ja rahe the.

Jab unke do disciples—Yaakob aur Yohan ne yah dekha to unhonne Lord Yeshu se savaal kiya, “Lord, yadi aap command dein to ham prayer karein ki aakaash se inhein barbaadi karne ke lie aag ki baarish ho jaae.”
Pichhe murkar Lord Yeshu ne unhein daanta, “Tum nahin samajh rahe ki tum yah kis matlab se kah rahe ho. Insaan ka son insaanon ke vinaash ke lie nahin lekin unke bachaav ke lie aaya hai!”
Aur ve dusre shehar ki or barh gae.
Raasta mein ek person ne apni chaahat vyakt karte hue unse kaha, “Aap jahaan kahin jaaeinge, main aapke saath rahunga.”
Yeshu ne uske uttar mein kaha, “Lomriyon ke paas unki guphaaein aur aakaash ke pakshiyon ke paas unke basere hote hain lekin insaan ke son ke paas to sir rakhne tak ka jagah nahin hai!”
Ek dusre person ne Lord Yeshu se kaha, “Lord, main aapke saath chalunga lekin pahle main apne parijnon se vida le lun.”
Lord Yeshu ne iske uttar mein kaha, “Aisa koi bhi person, jo hal chalaane ko tatpar ho, lekin uski nazar pichhe ki or lagi hui ho, God ke kingdom ke yogy nahin.”
Ve bahattar bahut utsaah se bharkar laute aur kahne lage, “Lord! Aapke naam mein to dard denevaali aatma bhi hamaare saamne samarpan kar dete hain!”
Is par Lord Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Main aarop lagaanevaala ko bijli ke jaisa heaven se girte dekh raha tha.
Mainne tumhein saampon aur bichchhuon ko raundne aur dushman ke sabhi power ka barbaadi karne ka authority diya hai isliye kisi bhi riti se tumhaari haani na hogi.
Tab Lord Yeshu ne apne disciples ki or unmukh ho unse vyaktigat rup se kaha, “Blessed hain ve aankh, jo vah dekh rahi hain, jo tum dekh rahe ho
Kyonki sach maano, kai prophet aur raaja vah dekhne ki kaamna karte rahe, jo tum dekh rahe ho lekin ve dekh na sake aur ve vah sunne ki kaamna karte rahe, jo tum sun rahe ho lekin sun na sake.”
Lord Yeshu ne usse savaal kiya, “Law mein kya likha hai, iske baare mein tumhaara vishleshan kya hai?”
Us person ne javaab diya, “ ‘Lord, apne God se apne saare dil, apne saare jaan, apni saari power aur apni saari samajh se love karo aur apne parosi se apne jaisa love.’”
Lord Yeshu ne usse kaha, “Tumhaara uttar bilkul sahi hai. Yahi karne se tum jivit rahoge.”
Khud ko sangat pramaanit karne ke purpose se usne Lord Yeshu se savaal kiya, “To yah bataaie kaun hai mera parosi?”
Lord Yeshu ne javaab diya. “Yerushalem shehar se ek person yerikho shehar ja raha tha ki daakuon ne use gher liya, uske kapde chhin lie, uski pitaai ki aur use adhamri haalat mein chhorkar bhaag gae.
Sanyog se ek priest usi raasta se ja raha tha. Jab usne us person ko dekha, vah raasta ke dusri or se aage barh gaya.
Isi tarah ek Levi bhi usi jagah par aaya, uski nazar us par pari to vah bhi dusri or se hota hua chala gaya.
Ek shamriyaavaasi bhi usi raasta se yaatra karte hue us jagah par a pahuncha. Jab uski nazar us ghaayal person par pari, vah daya se bhar gaya.
Vah uske paas gaya aur uske ghaavon par tel aur daakhras lagaakar patti baandhi. Tab vah ghaayal person ko apne vaahak pashu par baithaakar ek yaatri nivaas mein le gaya aur uski service tahal ki.
Agle din usne do dinaar yaatri nivaas ke maalik ko dete hue kaha, ‘Is person ki service tahal kijie. Iske atirikt jo bhi laagat hoga vah main lautne par chuka dunga.’
“Yah bataao tumhaare soch se in tinon logon mein se kaun un daakuon dvaara ghaayal person ka parosi hai?”
Vakil ne javaab diya, “Vahi, jisne uske prati karunaabhaav ka parichay diya.” Lord Yeshu ne usse kaha, “Jaao, tumhaara svabhaav bhi aisa hi ho.”
Lord Yeshu aur unke disciple yaatra karte hue ek gaanv mein pahunche, jahaan maartha naamak ek aurat ne unhein apne ghar mein aamantrit kiya.
Uski ek bahan thi, jiska naam Mariyam tha. Vah Lord ke charnon mein baithkar unke pravchan sunne lagi

Lekin maartha vibhinn taiyaariyon mein uljhi rahi. Vah Lord Yeshu ke paas aai aur unse savaal kiya, “Lord, kya aapko iska lesh sirf bhi dhyaan nahin ki meri bahan ne atithi-satkaar ka saara bojh mujh akeli par hi chhor diya hai? Aap usse kahein ki vah meri madad kare.”
“Maartha, maartha,” Lord ne kaha, “Tum kai vishyon ki chinta karti aur ghabra jaati ho
Lekin zarurat to kuchh hi ki hai—vaastav mein ek hi ki. Mariyam ne usi uttam bhaag ko chuna hai, jo usse kabhi alag na kiya jaaega.”

Ek din Lord Yeshu ek jagah par prayer kar rahe the. Jab unhonne prayer samaapt ki unke disciples mein se ek ne unse request ki, “Lord, hamko prayer karna sikha dijie—thik jaise Yohan ne apne disciples ko sikhaaya hai.”
Lord Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Jab bhi tum prayer karo, is tarah kiya karo: “ ‘Hamaare svargiy pita! Aapka naam sabhi jagah sammaanit ho. Aapka raajy har jagah sthaapit ho.
Hamaara roz ka khaana hamein har din diya kijie.
Hamaare galtiyon ko maafi kijie. Ham bhi unke galti maafi karte hain, jo hamaare khilaaf galti karte hain. Hamein pariksha mein phansne se bachaaie.’ ”
Lord Yeshu ne unse aage kaha, “Tummein se kisi ka ek mitr aadhi raat mein aakar yah request kare, ‘Mitr! Mujhe tin rotiyaan de do;
Kyonki mera ek mitr yaatra karte hue ghar aaya hai aur uske khaana ke lie mere paas kuchh nahin hai.’
Tab vah andar hi se uttar de, ‘Mujhe mat sataao! Dvaar band ho chuka hai aur mere baalak mere saath so rahe hain. Ab main uthkar tumhein kuchh nahin de sakta.’
Main jo kah raha hun use samjho: haalaanki vah person mitr hone par bhi bhale hi use dena na chaahe, phir bhi us mitr ke bahut request karne par uski zarurat ke hisaab se use zarur dega.
“Yahi kaaran hai ki mainne tumse kaha hai: request karo, to tumhein diya jaaega; khojo, to tum paaoge; dvaar khatakhtaao, to vah tumhaare lie khol diya jaaega
Kyonki har ek, jo request karta hai, uski request puri ki jaati hai, jo khojta hai, vah receive karta hai aur vah, jo dvaar khatakhtaata hai, uske lie dvaar khol diya jaata hai.
“Tummein kaun pita aisa hai, jo apne son ke machhli maangne par use saamp de
Ya ande ki request par bichchhu?

Jab tum evil hone par bhi apni children ko uttam vastuein provide karna jaante ho to tumhaare svargiy pita unhein, jo unse request karte hain, kahin adhik barhkar Holy Spirit provide na kareinge, jo uttam hai?”
Lord Yeshu ek person mein se, jo gunga tha, ek dard denevaali aatma ko nikaal rahe the. Dard denevaali aatma ke nikalte hi vah, jo gunga tha, bolne laga. Yah dekh bhir achambhit rah gai.
Lekin unmein se kuchh ne kaha, “Vah to dard denevaali aatmaaon ke leader belazbul ki madad se dard denevaali aatma nikaalta hai.”
Kuchh dusre ne Lord Yeshu ko parakhne ke purpose se unse adbhut chihn ki maang ki.
Unke man ki baatein jaankar Lord Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Koi bhi raajy, jismein phut par chuki hai, barbaadi ho jaata hai aur jis parivaar mein phut par chuki ho, uska barbaadi ho jaata hai.

Yadi aarop lagaanevaala apne hi khilaaf kaam karne lage to uska raajy sthir kaise rah sakta hai? Main ye sab isliye kah raha hun ki tum yah daava kar rahe ho ki main dard denevaali aatmaaon ko belazbul ki madad se nikaala karta hun.
Yadi main dard denevaali aatmaaon ko belazbul ke sahyog se baahar nikaala karta hun to phir tumhaare anuyaayi unko kaise baahar karti hai? Parinaamasvrup ve hi tum par aarop lagaaeinge.
Lekin yadi main dard denevaali aatmaaon ko God ke power ke dvaara nikaalta hun, tab God ka kingdom tumhaare beech a chuka hai.
“Jab koi balvaan person shastron se puri tarah se susajjit hokar apne ghar ki chauksi karta hai, to uski property surakshit rahti hai

Lekin jab usse adhik balvaan koi person us par aakrman kar use apne vash mein kar leta hai aur ve sabhi shastr, jin par vah bharosa karta tha, chhin leta hai, to vah uski property ko lutkar baant deta hai.
“Vah, jo mere paksh mein nahin hai mere khilaaf hai aur vah, jo mere saath ikattha nahin karta, vah bikherta hai.

“Jab dard denevaali aatma kisi person mein se baahar a jaati hai, vah nivaas jagah ki khoj mein sukhe jagahon mein phirti hai, lekin use nivaas jagah receive nahin ho paata. Tab vah sochti hai ki main jis nivaas jagah ko chhorkar aayi thi, vahin laut jaaun.
Vah vahaan lautkar use khaali, saaf aur suthra paati hai.
Tab vah jaakar apne se adhik buri saat aatma aur le aati hai aur ve sab us person mein pravesh kar usmein apna ghar bana leti hain. Tab us person ki situation pahle se kharaab ho jaati hai.”
Jab Lord Yeshu yah teaching de rahe the, bhir mein se ek naari pukaar uthi, “Blessed hai vah maata, jisne aapko janm diya aur aapka follow poshan kiya.”
Lekin Lord Yeshu ne kaha, “Lekin blessed ve hain, jo God ke vachan ko sunkar uska follow karte hain.”

Jab aur adhik log ikattha hone lage, Lord Yeshu ne kaha, “Yah pirhi bahut buri pirhi hai. Yah chamatkaar chihnon ki maang karti hai lekin prophet yonaah ke chihn ke atirikt ise aur koi chihn nahin diya jaaega.
Jis tarah God ki or se prophet yonaah ninve nagarvaasiyon ke lie ek chihn the, usi tarah insaan ka son is pirhi ke lie ek chihn hai.
“Dip jalaakar koi bhi use na to aise jagah par rakhta hai, jahaan vah chhup jaae aur na hi kisi bartan ke niche; lekin vah use uske niyat jagah par rakhta hai, ki jo pravesh karte hain, dekh sakein.
Tumhaare body ka dipak tumhaari aankh hain. Yadi tumhaari aankh nirogi hain, tumhaara saara body ujiyaala hoga lekin yadi tumhaari aankhein rogi hain, to tumhaara body bhi andhiyaara hoga.
Dhyaan rahe ki tumhaare bhitar chhipa hua ujaala andhera na ho.
Isliye yadi tumhaara saara body ujiyaala hai, usmein zara sa bhi andhera nahin hai, tab vah sab jagah ujaala dega—jaise ek dip apne ujaale se tumhein ujiyaala deta hai.”
Jab Lord Yeshu apna pravchan samaapt kar chuke, ek Farisi ne unhein khaana ke lie aamantrit kiya. Lord Yeshu uske saath gae aur khaana ke lie baith gae.
Us Farisi ko yah dekh aashchary hua ki khaana ke purv Lord Yeshu ne haath nahin dhoe.
Lord Yeshu ne is par usse kaha, “Tum Farisi pyaale aur thaali ko baahar se to saaf karte ho lekin tumhaare dil lobh aur dushtta se bhare hue hain.
Nirbuddhiyon! Jisne baahri bhaag banaaya hai, kya usi ne andruni bhaag nahin banaaya?
Tummein jo andar basa hua hai, use daan mein de do, tab tum aur tumhaare sanskaar shuddh ho paaeinge.

“Dhikkaar hai tum par, farisiyo! Tum God ko apne pudina, braamhi aur dusre har ek saag-paat ka dasvaan ansh to dete ho lekin insaanon ke prati justice aur God ke prati love ki upeksha karte ho. Ye hi ve chizein hain, jinko pura karna zaruri hai—anyon ki upeksha kie bina.
“Dhikkaar hai tum par, farisiyo! Tumhein sabhaagrihon mein leader aasan aur shehar chauk mein logon dvaara sammaan bhara namaskaar pasand hai.
“Dhikkaar hai tum par! Kyonki tum un chhipi hui kabron ke jaisa ho jin par log anjaane hi chalte phirte hain.”
Ek vakil ne Lord Yeshu se kaha, “Guruvar! Aisa kahkar aap hamaara bhi apmaan kar rahe hain.”
