Lord Yeshu ne iske uttar mein kaha, “Dhikkaar hai tum par bhi, vakilon! Kyonki tum logon par niymon ka aisa bojh laad dete ho, jisko uthaana kathin hota hai, jabki tum khud unki madad ke lie apni ungli se chhute tak nahin.
“Dhikkaar hai tum par! Kyonki tum bhavishyadvaktaaon ke lie smaarak banaate ho, jabki tumhaare apne purvjon ne hi un bhavishyadvaktaaon ki murder ki thi.
Isliye God ki samajh ka bhi yah kahna hai: ‘Main unke paas prophet aur apostle bhejunga. Ve unmein se kuchh ki murder kar deinge aur kuchh ko utpirit kareinge
Haabil se lekar zakaryaah tak, jinki murder vedi aur temple ke beech ki gai thi. Haan, mera faith karo: iska hisaab isi pirhi se liya jaaega.’
“Dhikkaar hai tum par, vakilon! Tumne knowledge ki kunji to le li hain, lekin tumne hi ismein pravesh nahin kiya, aur jo ismein pravesh kar rahe the, unka bhi raasta band kar diya hai.”
Lord Yeshu ke vahaan se nikalne par shaastri aur Farisi, jo unke kattar virodhi ho gae the, unse kai vishyon par kathin savaal karne lage.
Ve is ghaat mein the ki ve Lord Yeshu ko unke hi kisi kathan dvaara phansa lein.

Isi samay vahaan hazaaron logon ka itna vishaal samuh ikattha ho gaya ki ve ek dusre par gir rahe the. Lord Yeshu ne sabse pahle apne disciples ko sambodhit karte hue kaha, “Farisiyon ke khamir arthaat dhong se saavdhaan raho.
Aisa kuchh bhi dhaka nahin, jise khola na jaaega ya aisa koi rahasy nahin, jise reveal na kiya jaaega.
“Mere mitron, meri suno: unse bhaybhit na ho, jo body ka to barbaadi kar sakte hain lekin iske baad isse adhik aur kuchh nahin
Kya do assaarion mein paanch gauraiyaan nahin bechi jaatin? Phir bhi God unmein se ek ko bhi nahin bhulte.
Tumhaare sir ka to ek-ek baal gina hua hai. Isliye bhaybhit na ho. Tumhaara daam kai gauraiya se kahin adhik hai.
“Jab tum unke dvaara sabhaagrihon, shaaskon aur adhikaariyon ke saamne prastut kie jaao to is baare mein koi chinta na karna ki apne bachaav mein tumhein kya uttar dena hai ya kya kahna hai
Kyonki Holy Spirit hi tum par reveal kareinge ki us samay tumhaara kya kahna sahi hoga.”
Upasthit bhir mein se kisi ne Lord Yeshu se kaha, “Guruvar, mere bhaai se kahie ki vah mere saath pita ki property ka bantvaara kar le.”
Lord Yeshu ne iske uttar mein kaha, “He maanav! Kisne mujhe tumhaare lie nyaaykarta ya madhyasth thahraaya hai?”
Tab Lord Yeshu ne bhir ko dekhte hue unhein chetaavni di, “Khud ko har ek tarah ke laalach se bachaae rakho. Insaan ka life uski property ki bahutaayat hone par bhala nahin hai.”
Tab Lord Yeshu ne unke saamne yah drishtaant prastut kiya: “Kisi person ki zameen se achchhi phasal utpann hui.
Usne man mein soch kiya, ‘Ab main kya karun? Phasal rakhne ke lie to mere paas jagah hi nahin hai.’
“Phir usne soch kiya, ‘Main aisa karta hun: main in bakhaaron ko torkar bare bhandaar nirmit karunga. Tab meri saari upaj aur vastuon ka rakh rakhaav ho sakega.
Tab main khud se kahunga, “Kai varshon ke lie ab tere lie uttam vastuein ikattha hain. Vishraam kar! Kha, pi aur khushi kar!” ’
“Lekin God ne usse kaha, ‘Are bewakoof! Aaj hi raat tere jaan tujhse le lie jaaeinge; tab ye sab, jo tune apne lie ikattha kar rakha hai, kiska hoga?’
“Yahi hai us person ki situation, jo sirf apne lie is tarah ikattha karta hai lekin jo God ki nazar mein dhanvaan nahin hai.”

Iske baad apne disciples se unmukh ho Lord Yeshu ne kaha, “Yahi kaaran hai ki mainne tumse kaha hai, apne life ke baare mein yah chinta na karo ki ham kya khaaeinge ya apne body ke baare mein ki ham kya pahneinge.
Life khaana se aur body kapdon se barhkar hai.

Kauvon par soch karo: ve na to bote hain aur na kaatte hain. Unke na to khalihaan hote hain aur na bhandaar; phir bhi God unhein khaana provide karte hain. Tumhaara daam pakshiyon se kahin adhik barhkar hai!
Tummein se kaun hai, jo chinta ke dvaara apni aayu mein ek pal bhi barha paaya hai?
Jab tum yah chhota sa kaam hi nahin kar sakte to bhala dusre vishyon ke lie chintit kyon rahte ho?
“Jangli phulon ko dekho! Ve na to kataai karte hain aur na bunaai; lekin main kahta hun ki raaja shalomon tak apne saare aishvary mein inmein se ek ke tuly bhi saje na the.

Yadi God ghaas ka shrringaar is sima tak karte hain, jiska life thore samay ka hai aur jo kal aag mein jhonk diya jaaega, kya vah tumhein aur kitna adhik sushobhit na kareinge? Kaisa kamjor hai tumhaara faith!
Is udher-bun mein lage na raho ki tum kya khaaoge ya kya piyoge aur na hi iski koi chinta karo.
Vishv ke sabhi raashtr isi kaary mein lage hain. Tumhaare pita ko pahle hi yah maalum hai ki tumhein in vastuon ki zarurat hai.
Inki jagah God ke kingdom ki khoj karo aur ye sabhi vastuein tumhaari ho jaaeingi.
“Tum, jo sankhya mein kam ho, bhaybhit na hona kyonki tumhaare pita tumhein raajy dekar santusht hue hain.
Kyonki jahaan tumhaara wealth hai, vahin tumhaara man bhi hoga.”
“Hamesha taiyaar raho aur apne dip jalaae rakho,
Blessed hain ve slave, jinhein maalik raat ke dusre ya tisre prahar mein bhi aakar jaagte paae.
Petros ne unse savaal kiya, “Lord, aapka yah drishtaant sirf hamaare lie hi hai ya bhir ke lie bhi?”
Lord ne javaab diya, “Vah faithful aur wise bhandaari kaun hoga jise maalik sabhi servants ka leader thahraae ki vah dusre servants ko nirdhaarit samay par bhojy saamagri de de.
“Main prithvi par aag barsaane ke lakshy se aaya hun aur kaisa uttam hota yadi yah isi samay ho jaata!
Lekin mere lie baptisma ki prakriya nirdhaarit hai aur jab tak yah prakriya puri nahin ho jaati, kaisi duhkhdaayi hai iski dard!
Bhir ko sambodhit karte hue Lord Yeshu ne kaha, “Jab tum pashchim disha mein baadal uthte dekhte ho to tum turant kahte ho, ‘Baarish hogi’ Aur baarish hoti hai.
Jab pavan dakshin disha se bahta hai tum kahte ho, ‘Ab garmi paregi,’ Aur aisa hi hua karta hai.
Paakhandiyon! Tum dharti aur aakaash ki or dekhkar to bhed kar lete ho lekin is yug ka bhed kyon nahin kar sakte?
“Tum khud apne lie sahi galat ka phaisla kyon nahin kar lete?

Jab tum apne dushman ke saath nyaayaadhish ke saamne prastut hone ja rahe ho, pura koshish karo ki raasta mein hi tum donon mein mel ho jaae anytha vah to tumhein ghasitkar nyaayaadhish ke saamne prastut kar dega, nyaayaadhish tumhein adhikaari ke haath saump dega aur adhikaari tumhein jel mein daal dega.
Main tumse kahta hun ki jab tak tum ek-ek paisa lauta na do bandigrih se chhut na paaoge.”
Usi samay vahaan upasthit kuchh logon ne Lord Yeshu ko un galilvaasiyon ki yaad dilaayi, jinka lahu Pilatos ne unhin ke balidaanon mein mila diya tha.
Lord Yeshu ne unse puchha, “Kya tumhaare soch se ye galili dusre galilvaasiyon ki tulna mein adhik galti karnevaala the ki unki yah situation hui?
Ya ve athaarah person, jin par siloam ka minaar gira, jisse unki maut ho gai, Yerushalem vaasiyon ki apeksha adhik doshi the?
Tab Lord Yeshu ne unhein is drishtaant ke dvaara samjhaana shuruaat kiya, “Ek person ne apne bagiche mein ek anjir ka per lagaaya. Vah phal ki ummid mein uske paas aaya.

Usne maali se kaha, ‘Dekho, main tin varsh se is per mein phal ki ummid lie a raha hun aur mujhe ab tak koi phal receive nahin hua. Kaat daalo ise! Bhala kyon iske kaaran zameen vyarth hi ghiri rahe?’
“Lekin maali ne maalik se kaha, ‘Maalik, ise is varsh aur rahne dijie. Main iske aas-paas ki zameen khodkar ismein khaad daal deta hun.
Yadi agle varsh yah phal laae to achchha hai, nahin to ise katva dijiega.’ ”
Shabbat par Lord Yeshu Yahudi synagogue mein teaching de rahe the.
Vahaan ek aisi aurat thi, jise ek dard denevaali aatma ne athaarah varsh se apang kiya hua tha. Jiske kaaran uska body jhukkar dohra ho gaya tha aur uske lie sidha khara hona asambhav ho gaya tha.
Jab Lord Yeshu ki nazar us par pari, unhonne use apne paas bulaaya aur usse kaha, “He naari, tum apne is rog se mukt ho gai ho,”
Yah kahte hue Lord Yeshu ne us par apne haath rakhe aur usi kshan vah sidhi khari ho gai aur God ka thanks karne lagi.

Lekin Yahudi synagogue leader is par bahut rusht ho gaya kyonki Lord Yeshu ne use Shabbat par svasth kiya tha. Synagogue leader ne vahaan ikattha logon se kaha, “Kaam karne ke lie chhah din nirdhaarit kie gae hain isliye in chhah dinon mein aakar apna svaasthy receive karo, na ki Shabbat par.”
Lekin Lord ne iske uttar mein kaha, “Paakhandiyon! Kya Shabbat par tummein se har ek apne bail ya gadhe ko pashushaala se kholkar paani pilaane nahin le jaata?
Aur kya is aurat ko, jo Abraham hi ki children hai, jise aarop lagaanevaala ne athaarah varsh se baandh rakha tha, Shabbat par is bandhan se mukt kiya jaana uchit na tha?”
Lord Yeshu ke ye word sun unke sabhi virodhi lajjit ho gae. Saari bhir Lord Yeshu dvaara kie ja rahe in mahaan kaamon ko dekh aanandit thi.
Isliye Lord Yeshu ne unse kahna shuruaat kiya, “God ka kingdom kaisa hoga? Main iski tulna kisse karun?

God ka kingdom raai ke bij ke jaisa hai, jise kisi person ne apni vaatika mein boya, aur usne viksit hote hue per ka rup le liya—yahaan tak ki aakaash ke pakshi bhi aakar uski shaakhaaon par basera karne lage.”
Lord Yeshu ne dobaara kaha, “God ke kingdom ki tulna main kisse karun?
God ka kingdom khamir ke jaisa hai, jise ek aurat ne tin maap aate mein milaaya aur saara aata hi khamir yukt ho gaya.”
Shehar-shehar aur gaanv-gaanv hote hue aur raasta mein teaching dete hue Lord Yeshu Yerushalem shehar ki or barh rahe the.
Chaaron dishaaon se log aakar God ke kingdom ke utsav mein shaamil honge
Aur sach yah hai ki jo antim hain ve pahle honge aur jo pahle ve antim.”
Usi samay kuchh Farisiyon ne unke paas aakar unse kaha, “Yahaan se chale jaao kyonki Herodes tumhaari murder kar dena chaahta hai.”
Lord Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Jaakar us lomri se kaho, ‘Main aaj aur kal dard denevaali aatmaaon ko nikaalunga aur logon ko changa karunga aur tisre din main apne lakshy par pahunch jaaunga.’
Phir bhi yah zaruri hai ki main aaj, kal aur parson yaatra karun kyonki yah ho hi nahin sakta ki kisi prophet ki murder Yerushalem shehar ke baahar ho.

“Yerushalem! O Yerushalem! Tu bhavishyadvaktaaon ki murder karta aur unka pathraav karta hai, jinhein tere lie bheja jaata hai. Kitni baar mainne yah koshish kiya ki teri children ko ikattha kar ekjut karun, jaise murgi apne chuzon ko apne pankhon ke niche ikattha karti hai lekin tune na chaaha.
Ek avsar par jab Lord Yeshu Shabbat par Farisiyon ke naaykon mein se ek ke ghar khaana karne gae, ve sabhi unhein utsuktaapurvak dekh rahe the.
Vahaan jalodar rog se pirit ek person tha.
Lord Yeshu ne Farisiyon aur vakilon se savaal kiya, “Shabbat par kisi ko svasth karna law ke hisaab se hai ya nahin?”
Lekin ve maun rahe. Isliye Lord Yeshu ne us rogi par haath rakh use svasth kar diya aur use vida kiya.
Tab Lord Yeshu ne unse savaal kiya, “Yah bataao, yadi tummein se kisi ka son ya bail Shabbat par kuein mein gir jaae to kya tum use turant hi baahar na nikaaloge?”
Unke paas is savaal ka koi uttar na tha.
Jab Lord Yeshu ne yah dekha ki aamantrit person apne lie kis tarah leader aasan chun lete hain, Lord Yeshu ne unhein yah soch diya:
“Jab bhi koi tumhein vivaah ke utsav mein aamantrit kare, tum apne lie aadaryogy aasan na chunna. Yah sambhav hai ki usne tumse adhik kisi aadaryogy person ko bhi aamantrit kiya ho.
Tab vah person, jisne tumhein aur use donon hi ko aamantrit kiya hai, aakar tumse kahe ‘Tum yah aasan inhein de do,’ Tab lajjit ho tumhein vah aasan chhorkar sabse pichhe ke aasan par baithna pare.

Lekin jab tumhein kahin aamantrit kiya jaae, jaakar sabse saadhaaran aasan par baith jaao jisse ki jab jisne tumhein aamantrit kiya hai tumhaare paas aae to yah kahe, ‘Mere mitr, utho aur us unche aasan par baitho.’ Is par dusre sabhi aamantrit atithiyon ke saamne tum aadaryogy saabit hoge.
Har ek, jo khud ko bara banaata hai, chhota bana diya jaaega aur jo khud ko chhota bana deta hai, bara kiya jaaega.”

Tab phir Lord Yeshu ne apne nyota denevaale se kaha, “Jab tum din ya raat ke khaana par kisi ko aamantrit karo to apne mitron, bhaai-bandhuon, parijnon ya dhanvaan parosiyon ko aamantrit mat karo; aisa na ho ki ve bhi tumhein aamantrit karein aur tumhein badla mil jaae.
Lekin jab tum bhoj ka aayojan karo to nirdhnon, apangon, langron aur andhon ko aamantrit karo.
Yah sun vahaan aamantrit logon mein se ek ne Lord Yeshu se kaha, “Blessed hai vah, jo God ke kingdom ke bhoj mein sammilit hoga.”
Yah sun Lord Yeshu ne kaha, “Kisi person ne ek bara bhoj ka aayojan kiya aur anekon ko aamantrit kiya.
Bhoj taiyaar hone par usne apne servants ko is suchna ke saath aamantriton ke paas bheja, ‘A jaaie, sab kuchh taiyaar hai.’
“Lekin ve sabhi bahaane banaane lage. Ek ne kaha, ‘Mainne zameen mol li hai aur zaruri hai ki main jaakar uska nirikshan karun. Kripya mujhe maafi karein.’
“Dusre ne kaha, ‘Mainne abhi-abhi paanch jore bail mol lie hain aur main unhein parakhne ke lie bas nikal hi raha hun. Kripya mujhe maafi karein.’
“Ek aur dusre ne kaha, ‘Abhi, isi samay mera vivaah hua hai isliye mera aana sambhav nahin.’

“Servant ne lautkar apne maalik ko yah suchna de di. Bahut gusse mein ghar ke maalik ne servant ko command di, ‘Turant shehar ki galiyon-chauraahon mein jaao aur nirdhnon, apangon, langron aur andhon ko le aao.’
“Servant ne lautkar suchna di, ‘Maalik, aapke aadeshaanusaar kaam pura ho chuka hai lekin ab bhi kuchh jagah bharne baaki hai.’
Ek bari bhir Lord Yeshu ke saath saath chal rahi thi. Lord Yeshu ne murkar unse kaha,
“Tummein aisa kaun hai, jo bhavan nirmaan karna chaahe aur pahle baithkar kharch ka anumaan na kare ki uske paas nirmaan kaam pura karne ke lie paryaapt raashi hai bhi ya nahin?
Anytha yadi vah ninv daal le aur kaam pura na kar paae to dekhnevaalon ke thatthon ka kaaran ban jaaega:
‘Dekho, dekho! Isne kaam shuruaat to kar diya lekin ab samaapt nahin kar pa raha!’
“Ya aisa kaun raaja hoga, jo dusre par aakrman karne ke pahle yah soch na karega ki vah apne das hazaar sainikon ke saath apne khilaaf bis hazaar ki sena se takkar lene mein samarth hai bhi ya nahin?
Yadi nahin, to jab dushman ki sena dur hi hai, vah apne duton ko bhejkar uske saamne shaanti ka prastaav rakhega.
“Namak uttam hai lekin yadi namak hi svaadhin ho jaae to kis vastu se uska svaad lautaaya ja sakega?
Sabhi chungi lenevaale aur galti karnevaala log Lord Yeshu ke pravchan sunne unke paas aae
Lekin Farisi aur shaastri barabraane lage, “Yah person galti karnevaalon se mitrta rakhte hue unke saath sangti karta hai.”
Isliye Lord Yeshu ne unke saamne yah drishtaant prastut kiya:
“Tummein se aisa kaun hoga, jiske paas sau bherein hon aur unmein se ek kho jaae to vah ninyaanve ko banjar zameen mein chhorkar us khoi hui ko tab tak khojta na rahega, jab tak vah mil na jaae?
Aur jab vah use mil jaati hai, use aanandpurvak kandhon par laad leta hai.
Ghar lautne par vah apne mitron aur parosiyon ko ikattha kar kahta hai, ‘Mere khushi mein sammilit ho jaao kyonki mujhe meri khoi hui bher mil gai hai!’

Yah baat yaad rakho: pashchaataap karte hue ek galti karnevaala ke lie un ninyaanve dharmiyon ki tulna mein heaven mein kahin adhik khushi manaaya jaata hai, jinhein man phiraane ki zarurat nahin hai.”

“Ya kaun aisi aurat hogi, jiske paas chaandi ke das sikke hon aur unmein se ek kho jaae to vah ghar mein roshni kar ghar ko buhaarte hue us sikke ko tab tak khojti na rahegi jab tak vah mil nahin jaata?
Sikka milne par vah apni parosinon aur saheliyon se kahti hai, ‘Mere khushi mein shaamil ho jaao kyonki mera khoya hua sikka mil gaya hai.’
Main tumse kahta hun ki heaven mein isi tarah God ke duton ke saamne us galti karnevaala ke lie khushi manaaya jaata hai, jisne man phiraaya hai.”
Lord Yeshu ne aage kaha, “Kisi person ke do son the.
Chhote son ne pita se request ki, ‘Pitaaji, property mein se mera bhaag mujhe de dijie.’ Isliye pita ne donon sons mein apni property baant di.
“Shighr hi chhote son ne apne bhaag mein aai saari property li aur ek dur desh ki or chala gaya. Vahaan usne apna saara wealth manmaani lifestyle mein ura diya.
Aur ab, jab uska sab kuchh samaapt ho gaya tha, saare desh mein bhishan akaal para lekin uske paas ab kuchh bhi baaki na rah gaya tha.
Isliye vah usi desh ke ek naagrik ke yahaan chala gaya jisne use apne kheton mein suar charaane bhej diya.
Vah suaron ke chaare se hi apna pet bharne ke lie taras jaata tha. Koi bhi use khaane ke lie kuchh nahin deta tha.
“Apni paristhiti ke baare mein hosh mein aane par vah soch karne laga: ‘Mere pita ke kitne hi servants ko adhik maatra mein khaana uplabdh hai aur yahaan main bhukha mar raha hun!
Main lautkar apne pita ke paas jaaunga aur unse kahunga: pitaaji! Mainne ve jo heaven mein hain, unke khilaaf aur aapke khilaaf galti kiya hai.
Iske baad main is yogy nahin rah gaya ki aapka son kahlaaun. Ab aap mujhe apne yahaan mazdur hi rakh lijie.’
Isliye vah uthkar apne pita ke paas laut gaya. “Vah dur hi tha ki pita ne use dekh liya aur vah daya se bhar gaya. Vah daurkar apne son ke paas gaya aur use gale lagaakar chumta raha.
“Son ne pita se kaha, ‘Pitaaji! Mainne heaven ke khilaaf aur aapke prati galti kiya hai, main ab is yogy nahin raha ki main aapka son kahlaaun.’
“Lekin pita ne apne servants ko command di, ‘Bina der kie sabse achchhe kapde laakar ise pahnaao aur iski ungli mein anguthi aur paanvon mein jutiyaan bhi pahnaao;
Jaakar ek sabse achchhe bachhre se khaana taiyaar karo. Chalo, ham sab khushi manaaein
Kyonki mera yah son mar gaya tha, ab jivit ho gaya hai; yah kho gaya tha lekin ab mil gaya hai.’ Isliye ve sabhi khushi se bhar gae.
“Us samay bara beta apne kheton mein kaam kar raha tha. Jab vah lautkar ghar a raha tha, paas aane par use sangit aur naachne ki aavaaj sunaai di.
Usne ek servant ko bulaakar usse puchha, ‘Yah sab kya ho raha hai?’
‘Aapka bhaai laut aaya hai,’ Us servant ne javaab diya, ‘Aur aapke pita ne sabse achchha bachhra lekar bhoj taiyaar karvaaya hai kyonki unka son unhein sakushal aur surakshit mil gaya hai.’
“Gusse mein bare bhaai ne ghar ke bhitar tak jaana na chaaha. Isliye uske pita ne hi baahar aakar usse request ki.

Usne apne pita ko javaab diya, ‘Dekhie, in sabhi varshon mein main slave jaise aapki service karta raha hun aur kabhi bhi aapki command nahin taali phir bhi aapne kabhi mujhe ek memna tak na diya ki main apne mitron ke saath milkar khushi mana sakun.
Lekin jab aapka yah son, jisne aapki property veshyaaon par ura di, ghar laut aaya, to aapne uske lie sabse achchhe bachhre ka khaana banvaaya hai!’
“ ‘Mere son!’ Pita ne kaha, ‘Tum to hamesha se hi mere saath ho. Vah sab, jo mera hai, tumhaara hi hai.
Hamaare lie khushi manaana aur harshit hona sahi hi hai kyonki tumhaara yah bhaai, jo mar gaya tha, ab jivit ho gaya hai; vah, jo kho gaya tha, ab mil gaya hai.’ ”
Lord Yeshu ne apne disciples ko yah vrittaant bhi sunaaya: “Kisi dhani person ka ek bhandaari tha, jiske baare mein use yah suchna di gai ki vah uski property ka durupyog kar raha hai.
Isliye maalik ne use bulaakar usse puchhtaachh ki: ‘Tumhaare baare mein main yah kya sun raha hun? Apne prabandhan ka hisaab de do kyonki ab tum bhandaari ke pad par nahin rah sakte.’

“Bhandaari man mein soch karne laga, ‘Ab main kya karun? Maalik mujh se bhandaari ka pad chhin raha hai. Mera body itna balvaan nahin ki main zameen khodne ka kaam karun aur lajja ke kaaran main bhikh bhi na maang sakunga.
Ab mere saamne kya raasta bacha rah gaya hai, main samajh gaya ki mere lie kya karna sahi hai ki mujhe pad se hata die jaane ke baad bhi logon ki mitrta mere saath bani rahe.’
“Usne apne maalik ke har ek karzdaar ko bulvaaya. Pahle karzdaar se usne savaal kiya, ‘Tum par mere maalik ka kitna karz hai?’
“ ‘3,000 litar tel,’ Usne javaab diya. “Bhandaari ne usse kaha, ‘Lo, yah hai tumhaara bahi khaata. Turant baithkar ismein 1,500 likh do.’
“Tab usne dusre ko bulaaya usse puchha, ‘Tum par kitna karz hai?’ “ ‘30 tan gehun.’ “Bhandaari ne kaha, ‘Apna bahi khaata lekar usmein 24 likh do.’
“Maalik ne is thag bhandaari ki is chaturaai bhari yojna ki saraahna ki: saansaarik log roshni ki children ki tulna mein apne jaise logon ke saath apne aachaar-vyavhaar mein kitne adhik chatur hain!
“Vah, jo thore mein faithful hai, vah us jyaada mein bhi faithful hota hai; vah, jo thore mein bhrasht hai, jyaada mein bhi bhrasht hoga.
Isliye yadi tum saansaarik property ke prati faithful na paae gae to tumhein sachcha wealth kaun saumpega?
Yadi tum kisi dusre ki property ke prati faithful pramaanit na hue to kaun tumhein vah saumpega, jo tumhaara hi hai?

“Kisi bhi slave ke lie do svaamiyon ki service nahin kar sakta kyonki vah ek ko tuchchh maankar dusre ke prati samarpit rahega ya ek ka sammaan karte hue dusre ko tuchchh jaanega. Tum God aur wealth donon ki service kar hi nahin sakte.”
Ve Farisi, jinhein wealth se lagaav tha, ye sab sunkar Lord Yeshu ka uphaas karne lage.

Unhein sambodhit karte hue Lord Yeshu ne kaha, “Tum khud ko anyon ke saamne nitimaan prastut karte ho lekin God tumhaare dil ko jaante hain. Vah, jo insaanon ke saamne mahaan hai, God ki nazar mein ghrinit hai.
Heaven aur prithvi ka khatm ho jaana saral hai bajaay iske ki law ka ek bhi bindu vyarth pramaanit ho.
“Vah, jo apni patni se talaak lekar dusre aurat se vivaah karta hai, vyabhichaar karta hai; aur vah aadmi, jo us tyaagi hui aurat se vivaah karta hai, vyabhichaar karta hai.”
Iske baad apne disciples se Lord Yeshu ne kaha, “Yah asambhav hai ki thokrein na lagein lekin dhikkaar hai us person par, jo thokar ka kaaran hai.
Iske bajaay ki vah nirblon ke lie thokar ka kaaran bane, uttam yah hota ki uske gale mein chakki ka paat baandhkar use gahre samudr mein pheink diya jaata.
Isliye tum khud ke prati saavdhaan raho. “Yadi tumhaara bhaai ya bahan apraadh kare to use daanto aur yadi vah man phiraae to use maafi kar do.
Yadi vah ek din mein tumhaare khilaaf saat baar bhi apraadh kare aur saaton baar tumse aakar kahe, ‘Mujhe iska pachhtaava hai,’ To use maafi kar do.”
Apostles ne unse request ki, “Lord, hamaare faith ko barha dijie.”

Lord Yeshu ne javaab diya, “Yadi tumhaara faith raai ke bij ke baraabar bhi ho, to tum is shahtut ke per ko yah command dete, ‘Ukhar ja aur jaakar samudr mein lag ja!’ To yah tumhaari command ka follow karta.
“Kya tummein se koi aisa hai, jiske khet mein kaam karne ya bheron ki rakhvaali ke lie ek slave ho aur jab vah slave khet se laute to vah slave se kahe, ‘Aao, mere saath khaana karo’?

Kya vah apne slave ko yah command na dega, ‘Mere lie khaana taiyaar karo aur mujhe khaana parosne ke lie taiyaar ho jaao. Main khaana ke lie baith raha hun. Tum mere khaana samaapt karne ke baad khaana kar lena?’
Kya vah apne slave ka aabhaar isliye maanega ki usne use die gae orders ka follow kiya hai? Nahin!
Yerushalem shehar ki or barhte hue Lord Yeshu shamriya aur Galil pradesh ke bich se hote hue ja rahe the.
Jab vah gaanv mein pravesh kar hi rahe the, unki bheint das korh rogiyon se hui, jo dur hi khare rahe.
Unhonne dur hi se pukaarte hue Lord Yeshu se kaha, “Maalik! Lord Yeshu! Ham par grace kijie!”
Unhein dekh Lord Yeshu ne unhein command di, “Jaakar priests dvaara khud ka nirikshan karvaao.” Jab ve ja hi rahe the, ve shuddh ho gae.
Unmein se ek, yah ahsaas hote hi ki vah shuddh ho gaya hai, Lord Yeshu ke paas laut aaya aur unche word mein God ki vandna karne laga.
Lord Yeshu ke charnon par girkar usne unke prati thanks reveal kiya—vah shamriyaavaasi tha.
Lord Yeshu ne usse savaal kiya, “Kya sabhi das shuddh nahin hue? Kahaan hain ve dusre nau?
Kya is pardeshi ke atirikt kisi dusre ne God ke prati thanks reveal karna sahi na samjha?”
Tab Lord Yeshu ne usse kaha, “Utho aur jaao. Tumhaare faith ne tumhein har tarah se svasth kiya hai.”
Ek avsar par, jab Farisiyon ne unse yah jaanna chaaha ki God ke kingdom ka aagman kab hoga, to Lord Yeshu ne javaab diya, “God ke kingdom ka aagman dikhnevaale sanketon ke saath nahin hoga
Aur na hi iske baare mein koi yah kah sakta hai, ‘Dekho, dekho! Yah hai God ka kingdom!’ Kyonki God ka kingdom tumhaare hi bich mein hai.”
Lekin uske purv uska kai yaatnaaein sahna aur is pirhi dvaara tiraskaar kiya jaana zarur hai.
Jo apne praanon ko bachaana chaahta hai, unhein kho deta hai aur vah, jo apne life se moh nahin rakhta, use bacha paata hai.
Tab Lord Yeshu ne disciples ko yah samjhaane ke purpose se ki niraash hue bina nirantar prayer karte rahna hi sahi hai, yah drishtaant prastut kiya.
“Kisi shehar mein ek nyaayaadhish tha. Vah na to God se darta tha aur na kisi ko kuchh samajhta tha.
Usi shehar mein ek vidhva bhi thi, jo baar-baar us nyaayaadhish ke paas ‘Aakar request karti thi ki use justice dilaaya jaae.’
“Kuchh samay tak to vah nyaayaadhish use taalta raha lekin phir usne man mein soch kiya, ‘Yadypi main na to God se darta hun aur na logon se prabhaavit hota hun
Phir bhi yah vidhva a-aakar meri naak mein dam kie ja rahi hai. Isliye uttam yahi hoga ki main iska justice kar hi dun ki yah baar-baar aakar meri naak mein dam to na kare.’ ”
Lord ne aage kaha, “Us adharmi nyaayaadhish ke words par dhyaan do ki usne kya kaha.
Tab kya God apne un chune huon ka justice na kareinge, jo din-raat unke naam ki dohaai diya karte hain? Kya vah unke sambandh mein der kareinge?
Tab Lord Yeshu ne unke lie, jo khud ko to righteous maante the lekin anyon ko tuchchh nazar se dekhte the, yah drishtaant prastut kiya.
“Prayer karne do person temple mein gae, ek Farisi tha aur dusra chungi lenevaala.
Farisi ki prayer is tarah thi: ‘God! Main aapka aabhaari hun ki main dusre insaanon jaisa nahin hun—chhali, anyaayi, vyabhichaari aur na is chungi lenevaale ke jaisa.
Main saptaah mein do baar upvaas karta hun aur apni saari aay ka dasvaan ansh diya karta hun.’
“Lekin chungi lenevaala dur hi khara raha. Usne nazar tak uthaane ka saahas na kiya, apne sine par shok mein prahaar karte hue usne kaha, ‘Lord God! Grace kijie mujh galti karnevaala par!’

“Faith karo vaastav mein yahi chungi lenevaala (God se) right thehraaya jaakar ghar lauta—na ki vah Farisi. Kyonki har ek, jo khud ko bara banaata hai, chhota bana diya jaaega aur jo person khud namr ho jaata hai, vah uncha uthaaya jaata hai.”
Log apne baalkon ko Lord Yeshu ke paas la rahe the ki Lord Yeshu unhein sparsh sirf kar dein. Disciple yah dekh unhein daantne lage.
Lord Yeshu ne baalkon ko apne paas bulaate hue kaha, “Nanhe baalkon ko mere paas aane do. Mat roko unhein! Kyonki God ka kingdom aison hi ka hai.
Main tum par ek atal sach reveal kar raha hun; jo God ke kingdom ko ek nanhe baalak ke bhaav mein grahan nahin karta, vah usmein kabhi pravesh na kar paaega.”
“Uttam mujhe kyon kah rahe ho?” Lord Yeshu ne kaha, “God ke alaava uttam koi bhi nahin hai.
Command to tumhein maalum hi hain: vyabhichaar na karna, murder na karna, chori na karna, jhuthi gavaahi na dena, apne maata-pita ka sammaan karna.”
“In sabka follow to main bachpan se karta a raha hun,” Usne javaab diya.
Yah sun vah leader bahut duhkhi ho gaya kyonki vah bahut dhani tha.
Use dekhkar Lord Yeshu ne kaha, “Dhanvaanon ka God ke kingdom mein pravesh kaisa kathin hai!
Ek dhani ke God ke kingdom mein pravesh karne ki tulna mein sui ke chhed mein se unt ka paar ho jaana saral hai.”
Lord Yeshu ne javaab diya, “Jo insaan ke lie asambhav hai, vah God ke lie sambhav hai.”
Petros ne Lord Yeshu se kaha, “Ham to apna gharbaar chhorkar aapke pichhe chal rahe hain.”
Lord Yeshu ne iske uttar mein kaha, “Sach to yah hai ki aisa koi bhi nahin, jisne God ke kingdom ke lie apni ghar-grihasthi, patni, bhaai, bahan, maata-pita ya children ka tyaag kiya ho

Tab Lord Yeshu ne baarhon disciples ko alag le jaakar un par reveal kiya, “Ham Yerushalem shehar ja rahe hain. Bhavishyadvaktaaon dvaara insaan ke son ke baare mein jo bhi likha gaya hai, vah pura hone par hai,
Use anyjaatiyon ko saump diya jaaega. Uska uphaas kiya jaaega, use apmaanit kiya jaaega, us par thuka jaaega.
Disciples ko kuchh bhi samajh mein na aaya. Unse iska arth chhipaakar rakha gaya tha. Is baare mein Lord Yeshu ki kahi baatein disciples ki samajh se pare thi.
Jab Lord Yeshu yerikho shehar ke paas pahunche, unhein ek andha mila, jo raasta ke kinaare baitha hua bhiksha maang raha tha.
Bhir ka shor sunkar usne jaanna chaaha ki kya ho raha hai.
Unhonne use bataaya, “Naazreth ke Yeshu yahaan se hokar ja nikal rahein hain.”
Vah andha pukaar utha, “Yeshu! David ki children! Mujh par daya kijie!”
Unhonne, jo aage-aage chal rahe the, use daanta aur use shaant rahne ki command di. Is par vah aur bhi unche word mein pukaarne laga, “David ke son! Mujh par grace kijie!”
Lord Yeshu ruk gae aur unhein command di ki vah person unke paas laaya jaae. Jab vah unke paas laaya gaya, Lord Yeshu ne usse savaal kiya,
“Kya chaahte ho? Main tumhaare lie kya karun?” “Lord main dekhna chaahta hun!” Usne javaab diya.
Lord Yeshu ne kaha, “Roshni receive karo. Tumhaare faith ne tumhein svasth kiya hai.”
Tatkaal hi vah dekhne laga. God ki vandna karte hue vah Lord Yeshu ke pichhe chalne laga. Yah dekh saari bhir bhi God ka thanks karne lagi.
Lord Yeshu ne yerikho shehar mein pravesh kiya.
Vahaan zakkhaaiyos naamak ek person tha, jo leader chungi lenevaala aur dhani person tha.
Vah yah dekhne ka prayatn kar raha tha ki Lord Yeshu kaun hain. Bhir mein vah Lord Yeshu ko dekh nahin pa raha tha kyonki vah naata tha.
Isliye Lord Yeshu ko dekhne ke lie vah daurkar aage barha aur gular ke ek per par charh gaya kyonki Lord Yeshu usi raasta se jaane ko the.
Jab Lord Yeshu vahaan pahunche, unhonne upar dekhte hue usse kaha, “Zakkhaaiyos, turant niche a jaao. Zaruri hai ki aaj main tumhaare ghar mein thahrun.”
Vah turant niche utra aur khushi se unhein apne ghar le gaya.
Yah dekh sabhi barabraane lage, “Vah to ek aise person ke ghar gaya hai, jo apraadhi hai.”

Lekin zakkhaaiyos ne khare hokar Lord se kaha, “Prabhuvar! Main apni aadhi property nirdhnon mein daan kar dunga aur yadi mainne kisi se galat dhang se kuchh bhi liya hai to main use chauguni raashi lauta dunga.”
Lord Yeshu ne usse kaha, “Aaj is parivaar mein bachaav ka aagman hua hai—yah person bhi Abraham ki children hai.
Insaan ka son khoe huon ko khojne aur unhein bachaav dene aaya hai.”

Jab ve in baaton ko sun rahe the, Lord Yeshu ne ek drishtaant prastut kiya kyonki ab ve Yerushalem shehar ke paas pahunch rahe the aur logon ki ummid thi ki God ka kingdom turant hi reveal hone par hai.
Lord Yeshu ne kahna shuruaat kiya: “Ek kulin person raajpad receive karne ke lie dur desh ki yaatra par nikla.
Yaatra ke pahle usne apne das slaves ko bulaakar unhein das sone ke sikke dete hue kaha, ‘Mere lautne tak is raashi se vyaapaar karna.’
“Log usse nafrat karte the isliye unhonne uske pichhe ek servants ki tukri ko is sandesh ke saath bheja, ‘Ham nahin chaahte ki yah person ham par shaasan kare.’
“Is par bhi use raaja bana diya gaya. Lautne par usne un slaves ko bulvaaya ki vah yah maalum kare ki unhonne us raashi se vyaapaar kar kitna laabh kamaaya hai.
“Pahle slave ne aakar bataaya, ‘Maalik, aapke dvaara die gae sone ke sikkon se mainne das sikke aur kamaae hain.’
“ ‘Shaabaash, mere yogy slave!’ Maalik ne javaab diya, ‘Isliye ki tum bahut chhoti zimmedaari mein bhi faithful paae gae, tum das shehron ki zimmedaari sambhaalo.’
“Dusre slave ne aakar bataaya, ‘Maalik, aapke dvaara die gae sone ke sikkon se mainne paanch aur kamaae hain.’
“Maalik ne javaab diya, ‘Tum paanch shehron ki zimmedaari sambhaalo.’
“Tab ek dusre slave aaya aur maalik se kahne laga, ‘Maalik, yah hai aapka diya hua sone ka sikka, jise mainne bari hi saavdhaani se kapre mein lapet, sambhaal kar rakha hai.
Mujhe aapse dar tha kyonki aap kathor person hain. Aapne jiska nivesh bhi nahin kiya, vah aap le lete hain, jo aapne boya hi nahin, use kaatte hain.’
Iske baad Lord Yeshu unke aage-aage chalte hue Yerushalem shehar ki or barh gae.
Jab Lord Yeshu zaitun naamak parvat par base gaanv baithafge aur baithniyaah pahunche, unhonne apne do disciples ko is command ke saath aage bhej diya,
“Saamne us gaanv mein jaao. Vahaan pravesh karte hi tumhein gadhe ka ek bachcha bandha hua milega, jiski ab tak kisi ne savaari nahin ki hai; use kholkar yahaan le aao.
Yadi koi tumse yah savaal kare, ‘Kyon khol rahe ho ise?’ To use uttar dena, ‘Lord ko iski zarurat hai.’ ”
Jinhein iske lie bheja gaya tha, unhonne thik vaisa hi paaya, jaisa unhein suchit kiya gaya tha.
Jab ve gadhi ke us bachche ko khol hi rahe the, uske svaamiyon ne unse puchha, “Kyon khol rahe ho ise?”
Unhonne javaab diya, “Lord ko iski zarurat hai.”
Ve use Lord ke paas le aae aur us par apne kapde daalkar Lord Yeshu ko us par baitha diya.
Jab Lord ja rahe the, logon ne apne baahri kapde raasta par bichha die.

Jab ve us jagah par pahunche, jahaan zaitun parvat ka dhaal shuruaat hota hai, saari bhir un sabhi adbhut kaamon ko yaad karte hue, jo unhonne dekhe the, unche word mein aanandpurvak God ki praise karne lagi:
“Praise ke yogy hai vah raaja, jo Lord ke naam mein a raha hai!” “Heaven mein shaanti aur sarvochch mein glory ho!”
Bhir mein se kuchh Farisiyon ne, aapatti uthaate hue Lord Yeshu se kaha, “Guru, apne disciples ko daantie!”
“Main aapko yah bataana chaahta hun,” Lord Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Yadi ye shaant ho gae to praise in patthron se nikalne lagegi.”
Jab vah Yerushalem shehar ke paas aae to shehar ko dekh vah yah kahte hue ro pare,
“Yadi tum, haan tum, aaj itna hi samajh lete ki shaanti ka matlab kya hai! Lekin yah tumse chhipaakar rakha gaya hai.
Temple mein pravesh karne par Lord Yeshu ne sabhi bechne vaalon ko yah kahte hue vahaan se baahar karna shuruaat kar diya,
“Likha hai: mera ghar prayer ka ghar hoga, lekin tumne to ise daakuon ki gufa bana rakhi hai!”
Lord Yeshu har roz temple mein teaching diya karte the. Leader priest, shaastri aur jansaadhaaran mein se leader naagrik unki murder ki yojna kar rahe the,
Lekin unki koi bhi yojna saphal nahin ho rahi thi kyonki log Lord Yeshu ke pravachnon se bahut prabhaavit the.
Unhonne unse puchha, “Yah bataao, tum kis authority se ye sab kar rahe ho? Kaun hai vah, jisne tumhein yah authority diya hai?”
Lord Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Ek savaal main bhi aapse puchhta hun: mujhe bataaie,
Yohan ka baptisma God ki or se tha ya insaanon ki or se?”
Is par ve aapas mein soch-vimarsh karne lage, “Yadi ham kahte hain, ‘God ki or se,’ To vah kahega, ‘Tab tumne Yohan ka faith kyon nahin kiya?’
Lekin yadi ham kahein, ‘Insaanon se,’ Tab to janta hamaara pathraav kar hamein maar daalegi kyonki unka to yah pakka faith hai ki Yohan ek prophet the.”
Isliye unhonne Lord Yeshu ko javaab diya, “Ham nahin jaante ki vah baptisma kahaan se tha.”
Lord Yeshu ne iske uttar mein kaha, “To main bhi tumhein nahin bataata ki kis authority se main ye kaam kar raha hun.”
Lord Yeshu ne bhir ko yah drishtaant sunaaya: “Ek person ne ek daakh ki baari lagaai aur use kisaanon ko patte par dekar lambi yaatra par chala gaya.
Phasal taiyaar hone par usne apne ek slave ko unke paas bheja ki ve phasal ka ek bhaag use de dein lekin un kisaanon ne uski pitaai kar use khaali haath hi lauta diya.
Tab usne dusre slave ko unke paas bheja. Kisaanon ne us slave ki bhi pitaai ki, uske saath sharmnaak vyavhaar kiya aur use bhi khaali haath lauta diya.
Usne tisre slave ko unke paas bheja. Unhonne use bhi ghaayal kar baahar pheink diya.
“Tab daakh ki baari ke maalik ne soch kiya: ‘Ab mera kya karna sahi hoga? Main apne dear son ko unke paas bhejunga. Zarur ve uska sammaan kareinge.’
“Lekin uske son ko dekh kisaanon ne aapas mein soch-vimarsh kiya, ‘Suno, yah to vaaris hai! Chalo, iski murder kar dein jisse yah property hi hamaari ho jaae.’
Unhonne use baari ke baahar nikaalkar uski murder kar di. “Yah bataao, udyaan ka maalik ab unke saath kya karega?
Yahi ki vah aaega aur in kisaanon ka vadh kar baari dusre kisaanon ko saump dega.” Yah sun logon ne kaha, “Aisa kabhi na ho!”
Tab unki or dekhkar Lord Yeshu ne unse savaal kiya, “To is lekh ka matlab kya hai: “ ‘Raajmistriyon dvaara nikammi thahraai shila hi aadhaar ki shila ban gai’?”
“Har ek, jo is patthar par girega, tukre-tukre ho jaaega lekin jis kisi par yah patthar girega use kuchalkar churn bana dega.”

Phalasvrup leader priest aur shaastri tatkshan Lord Yeshu ko pakarne ki yojna mein jut gae, kyonki ve yah samajh gae the ki Lord Yeshu ne un par hi yah drishtaant kaha hai. Lekin unhein bhir ka dar tha.

Ve Lord Yeshu ki gatividhiyon par nazar rakhe hue the. Unhonne Lord Yeshu ke paas apne guptchar bheje ki ve dharm ka dhong kar Lord Yeshu ko unki hi kisi baat mein phansaakar unhein raajypaal ko saump dein.

Guptachron ne Lord Yeshu se savaal kiya, “Guruvar, yah to ham jaante hain ki aapki baatein aur shikshaaein sahi hain aur aap kisi ke prati pakshpaati bhi nahin hain. Aap puri sach mein God ke baare mein teaching diya karte hain.
Isliye yah bataaie ki kaysar ko kar dena justice sangat hai ya nahin?”
Lord Yeshu ne unki chaturaai jaante hue unse kaha.
“Mujhe ek dinaar dikhaao. Is par aakriti aur mudran kiska hai?” Unhonne javaab diya, “Kaysar ka.”
Lord Yeshu ne unse kaha, “To jo kaysar ka hai. Vah kaysar ko aur jo God ka hai, vah God ko do.”
Bhir ki upasthiti mein ve Lord Yeshu ko unki baaton ke kaaran pakarne mein asphal rahe. Lord Yeshu ke is uttar se ve chakit the aur aage kuchh bhi na kah paae.
Lord Yeshu ne unse savaal kiya, “Log yah kyon kahte hain ki Yeshu David ki children hain,
Kyonki khud David stotr sanhita mein kahte hain: “ ‘God ne mere Lord se kaha, “Mere daayein paksh mein baithe raho,
Main tumhaare dushmanon ko tumhaare adhin karunga.” ’
Jab David unhein Lord kahkar sambodhit karte hain tab vah David ke son kaise hue?”
Saari bhir ko sunte hue Lord Yeshu ne disciples ko sambodhit karte hue kaha,

“Un shaastriyon se saavdhaan rahna, jo lambe dhile lahraate kapde pahne hue ghuma karte hain, saarvajnik sthalon par sammaanpurn namaskaar ki ummid karte hai. Ve Yahudi sabhaagrihon mein mukhy aasan aur daavton mein mukhy jagah ki priti rakhte hai.
Ve vidhvaaon ke ghar harap jaate hain aur sirf dikhaave ke purpose se lambi-lambi praarthnaaein karte hain. Kathor hoga inka dand!”
Lord Yeshu ne dekha ki dhani person daankosh mein apna apna daan daal rahe hain.
Unhonne yah bhi dekha ki ek nirdhan vidhva ne do chhote sikke daale hain.
Is par Lord Yeshu ne kaha, “Sach yah hai ki is nirdhan vidhva ne un sabhi se barhkar diya hai.
In sabne to apne wealth ki barhti mein se diya hai lekin is vidhva ne apni kangaali mein se apni saari jivika hi de di hai.”
Jab kuchh disciple temple ke baare mein charcha kar rahe the ki yah bhavan kitne sundar patthron aur mannat ki bheinton se sajaaya hai;

“In sabke pahle ve tumhein pakar leinge aur tumhein yaatnaaein deinge. Mere naam ke kaaran ve tumhein sabhaagrihon mein le jaaeinge, bandigrih mein daal deinge aur tumhein raajaaon aur raajypaalon ke haathon mein saump deinge.
Tumhein gavaahi dene ka suavsar receive ho jaaega.
Isliye yah sunishchit karo ki tum pahle hi apne bachaav ki taiyaari nahin karoge,
Kyonki tumhein apne bachaav mein kahne ke soch aur samajh main dunga, jiska tumhaare virodhi na to saamna kar sakeinge aur na hi khandan.
Phir bhi tumhaare ek baal tak ki haani na hogi.
Din ke samay Lord Yeshu temple mein teaching diya karte aur sandhyaakaal mein vah zaitun parvat par jaakar prayer karte hue raat bitaaya karte the.
Log bhor mein unka pravchan sunne temple a jaaya karte the.
Akhmiri roti ka utsav, jo Fasah parv kahlaata hai, paas a raha tha.
Leader priest aur shaastri is khoj mein the ki Lord Yeshu ko kis tarah maar daala jaae, lekin unhein logon ka dar tha.
Aarop lagaanevaala ne kaariyotvaasi Yahudah mein, jo baarah disciples mein se ek tha, pravesh kiya.
Usne leader priests aur adhikaariyon se milkar nishchit kiya ki vah kis tarah Lord Yeshu ko pakarva sakta hai.
Is par prasann ho ve use iska daam dene par sahmat ho gae.
Yahudah Lord Yeshu ko unke haath pakarva dene ke aise suavsar ki pratiksha karne laga, jab aas-paas bhir na ho.
Tab akhmiri roti ka utsav a gaya, jab Fasah ka memna bali kiya jaata tha.
Lord Yeshu ne Petros aur Yohan ko is command ke saath bheja, “Jaao aur hamaare lie Fasah ki taiyaari karo.”
Unhonne unse savaal kiya, “Lord, ham kis jagah par iski taiyaari karein, aap kya chaahte hain?”
Lord Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Shehar mein pravesh karte hi tumhein ek person paani ka ghara le jaata hua milega. Uska pichha karte hue tum us ghar mein chale jaana,
Jis ghar mein vah pravesh karega. Us ghar ke maalik se kahna, ‘Guru ne puchha hai, “Vah atithi kaksh kahaan hai jahaan main apne disciples ke saath Fasah khaaunga?” ’
Vah tumko ek vishaal, susajjit upri kaksh dikhaaega; tum vahin saari taiyaari karna.”
Yah sun ve donon vahaan se chale gae aur sab kuchh thik vaisa hi paaya jaisa Lord Yeshu ne kaha tha. Unhonne vahaan Fasah taiyaar kiya.
Niyat samay par Lord Yeshu apne apostles ke saath bhoj par baithe.
Unhonne apostles se kaha, “Meri bari laalsa thi ki main apne duhkh-bhog ke pahle yah Fasah tumhaare saath khaaun.
Kyonki sach yah hai ki main ise dobaara tab tak nahin khaaunga jab tak yah God ke kingdom mein pura na ho.”
Tab unhonne pyaala uthaaya, God ke prati thanks diya aur kaha, “Ise lo, aapas mein baant lo
Kyonki yah nirdhaarit hai ki jab tak God ke kingdom ka aagman na ho jaae, daakh ka ras tab tak main nahin piunga.”
Vah, jo mujhe pakarvaaega hamaare saath is bhoj mein shaamil hai.
Insaan ka son, jaisa uske lie tay kiya gaya hai, aage barh raha hai, lekin dhikkaar hai us person par jo use pakarva raha hai!”
Yah sun ve aapas mein soch-vimarsh karne lage ki vah kaun ho sakta hai, jo yah karne par hai.
Unke bich yah vivaad bhi uth khara hua ki unmein se sabse bara kaun hai.
Yah jaan Lord Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Gair-Yahudiyon ke raaja un par shaasan karte hain aur ve, jinhein un par authority hai, unke hitaishi kahlaate hain.
Lekin tum vah nahin ho—tummein jo bara hai, vah sabse chhote ke jaisa ho jaae aur raaja servant jaisa.
Bara kaun hai—kya vah, jo khaana par baitha hai ya vah, jo khara hua service kar raha hai? Tumhaare beech main servant ke jaisa hun.
Tumhin ho, jo mere visham samyon mein mera saath dete rahe ho.
Isliye jaisa mere pita ne mujhe ek raajy provide kiya hai,
Vaisa hi main bhi tumhein yah authority deta hun ki tum mere raajy mein meri mez par baithkar mere saath sangti karo, aur sinhaasnon par baithkar Israel ke baarah vanshon ka justice.
“Shimon, Shimon, suno! Aarop lagaanevaala ne tum sabko gehun ke jaisa alag karne ki command receive kar li hai.
Lekin Shimon, tumhaare lie mainne prayer ki hai ki tumhaare faith ka patan na ho. Jab tum pahle jaisi situation par laut aao to apne bhaaiyon ko bhi faith mein majbut karna.”
Petros ne Lord Yeshu se kaha, “Lord, main to aapke saath donon hi ko svikaarne ke lie tatpar hun—bandigrih aur maut!”
Lord Yeshu ne iske uttar mein kaha, “Suno, Petros, aaj raat, murg tab tak baang na dega, jab tak tum tin baar is sach ko ki tum mujhe jaante ho, nakaar na chuke hoge.”
Tab Lord Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Lekin ab jis kisi ke paas batua hai, vah use saath le le. Isi tarah jhola bhi aur jiske paas talvaar nahin hai, vah apna kapde bechkar talvaar mol le.
Main tumhein bataana chaahta hun ki yah jo lekh likha hai, ‘Uski ginti apraadhiyon mein hui’ Uska mujhmein pura hona zaruri hai; kyonki mujhse sambandhit sabhi lekhon ka pura hona zarur hai.”
Disciples ne kaha, “Lord, dekhie, ye do talvaarein hain.” Lord Yeshu ne javaab diya, “Paryaapt hain.”
Tab Lord Yeshu us ghar ke baahar nikalkar zaitun parvat par chale gae, jahaan vah praayh jaaya karte the. Unke disciple bhi unke saath the.
Us jagah par pahunchkar Lord Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Prayer karo ki tum pariksha mein na phanso.”
Tab Lord Yeshu disciples se kuchh hi duri par gae aur unhonne ghutne tekkar yah prayer ki:
“Pitaaji, yadi sambhav ho to yaatna ka yah pyaala mujhse dur kar dijie phir bhi meri nahin, aapki chaahat puri ho.”
Usi samay heaven se ek angel ne aakar unmein bal ka sanchaar kiya.
Jaan nikalne ke jaisa dard mein vah aur bhi adhik kaatar bhaav mein prayer karne lage. Unka pasina lahu ke jaisa zameen par tapak raha tha.
Jab vah prayer se uthe aur disciples ke paas aae to unhein sota hua paaya. Udaasi ke maare disciple so chuke the.
Lord Yeshu ne disciples se kaha, “So kyon rahe ho? Utho! Prayer karo ki tum kisi pariksha mein na phanso.”
Lord Yeshu jab yah kah hi rahe the, tabhi ek bhir vahaan a pahunchi. Unmein Yahudah, jo baarah disciples mein se ek tha, sabse aage tha. Vah Lord Yeshu ko chumne ke lie aage barha
Lekin Lord Yeshu ne usse kaha, “Yahudah! Kya insaan ke son ko tum is chumban ke dvaara pakarva rahe ho?”
Yah pata chalne par ki kya hone par hai disciples ne Lord Yeshu se puchha, “Lord, kya ham talvaar chalaaein?”
Unmein se ek ne to high priest ke slave par vaar kar us slave ka daahina kaan hi ura diya.
“Bas! Bahut hua” Lord Yeshu is par bole, aur unhonne us slave ke kaan ka sparsh kar use pahle jaisa kar diya.
Tab Lord Yeshu ne leader priests, temple ke pahruon aur vahaan upasthit purniyon ko sambodhit karte hue kaha, “Talvaarein aur laathiyaan lekar kya aap kisi raajadrohi ko pakarne aae hain?
Aapne mujhe tab to nahin pakra jab main temple aangan mein pratidin aapke saath hua karta tha! Yah isliye ki yah kshan aapka hai—andhera ke haakim ka.”
Ve Lord Yeshu ko pakarkar high priest ke ghar par le gae. Petros dur hi dur se unke pichhe-pichhe chalte rahe.
Jab log aangan mein aag jalaae hue baithe the, Petros bhi unke saath baith gae.
Ek sevika ne Petros ko aag ki roshni mein dekha aur unko ektak dekhte hue kaha, “Yah person bhi uske saath tha!”
Petros ne nakaarte hue kaha, “Nahin! He aurat, main use nahin jaanta!”
Kuchh samay baad kisi dusre ne unhein dekhkar kaha, “Tum bhi to unmein se ek ho!” “Nahin bhaai, nahin!” Petros ne javaab diya.
Lagbhag ek ghante baad ek dusre person ne bal dete hue kaha, “Nihsandeh yah person bhi uske saath tha kyonki yah bhi galilvaasi hai.”
Petros ne javaab diya, “Mahoday, meri samajh mein nahin a raha ki aap kya kah rahe hain!” Jab vah yah kah hi rahe the ki ek murg ne baang di.
Usi samay Lord ne murkar Petros ki or nazar ki aur Petros ko Lord ki pahle kahi hui baat yaad a gai: “Iske pahle ki murg baang de, tum aaj tin baar mujhe nakaar chuke hoge.”
Petros baahar chale gae aur phut-phutkar rone lage.
Jinhonne Lord Yeshu ko pakra tha, ve unko thatthon mein uraate hue un par vaar karte ja rahe the.
Unhonne Lord Yeshu ki aankhon par patti baandhi aur unse puchhne lage, “Bhavishyvaani kar, kisne vaar kiya hai tujh par?”
Iske atirikt ve unki ninda karte hue unke lie kai apmaanajnak word bhi kahe ja rahe the.
Pau phatne par purniye logon ne leader priests aur shaastriyon ki ek sabha bulaai aur Lord Yeshu ko mahaasbha mein le gae.
Yadi main aapse koi savaal karun to aap uska uttar hi na deinge;
Lekin ab iske baad insaan ka son sarvshaktimaan God ki daayin or baithaaya jaaega.”
Unhonne savaal kiya, “To kya tum God ke son ho?” Lord Yeshu ne javaab diya, “Ji haan, main hun.”
Yah sun ve kahne lage, “Ab hamein gavaahon ki kya zarurat hai? Khud hamne yah iske chehra se sun liya hai.”
Is par saari sabha uth khari hui aur ve Lord Yeshu ko raajypaal Pilatos ke paas le gae.
Isliye Pilatos ne Lord Yeshu se savaal kiya, “Kya tum Yahudiyon ke raaja ho?” “Sach vahi hai, jo aapne kaha hai.” Lord Yeshu ne javaab diya.
Is par Pilatos ne leader priests aur bhir ko sambodhit karte hue ghoshna ki, “Mujhe is person mein aisa koi dosh nahin mila ki is par mukaddma chalaaya jaae.”
Lekin ve dridhtaapurvak kahte rahe, “Yah saare Yahudiya pradesh mein logon ko apni teachings dvaara bharka raha hai. Yah sab isne Galil pradesh mein shuruaat kiya aur ab yahaan bhi a pahuncha hai.”
Yah sunte hi Pilatos ne savaal kiya, “Kya yah person galilvaasi hai?”
Yah maalum hone par ki Lord Yeshu Herodes ke authority kshetr ke hain, usne unhein Herodes ke paas bhej diya, jo is samay Yerushalem shehar mein hi tha.

Lord Yeshu ko dekhkar Herodes bahut prasann hua kyonki bahut dinon se use Lord Yeshu ko dekhne ki chaahat thi. Usne Lord Yeshu ke baare mein bahut kuchh sun rakha tha. Use ummid thi ki vah Lord Yeshu dvaara kiya gaya koi chamatkaar dekh sakega.
Usne Lord Yeshu se kai savaal kie lekin Lord Yeshu ne koi bhi uttar na diya.
Leader priest aur shaastri vahin khare hue the aur pure zor shor se Lord Yeshu par dosh laga rahe the.
Herodes aur uske sainikon ne apmaan karke Lord Yeshu ka mazaak uraaya aur un par bharkila kapde daalkar vaapas Pilatos ke paas bhej diya.
Usi din se Herodes aur Pilatos mein mitrta ho gai—iske pahle ve ek dusre ke dushman the.
Pilatos ne leader priests, naaykon aur logon ko paas bulaaya

Aur unse kaha, “Tum is person ko yah kahte hue mere paas laae ho ki yah logon ko vidroh ke lie uksa raha hai. Tumhaari hi upasthiti mein mainne usse puchhtaachh ki aur mujhe usmein tumhaare dvaara lagaae aarop ke lie koi bhi aadhaar nahin mila—na hi Herodes ko usmein koi dosh mila hai.
Usne use hamaare paas hi bhej diya hai. Tum dekh hi rahe ho ki usne maut dand ke yogy koi apraadh nahin kiya hai.
Isliye main use kore lagvaakar chhor deta hun.” [
Bhir ek word mein chilla uthi, “Use maut dand dijie aur hamaare lie baar-abbaas ko mukt kar dijie!”
(baar-abbaas ko shehar mein vidroh bharkaane aur murder ke aarop mein bandi banaaya gaya tha.)
Lord Yeshu ko mukt karne ki chaahat se Pilatos ne unse ek baar phir request ki,
Lekin ve chillaate rahe, “Krus par charhaao! Krus par charhaao!”
Pilatos ne tisri baar unse savaal kiya, “Kyon? Kya hai uska apraadh? Mujhe to usmein maut dand dene yogy koi dosh nahin mila. Main use kore lagvaakar chhor deta hun.”
Lekin ve hath karte hue unche word mein chillaate rahe, “Krus par charhaao use!” Tab haarkar use unke aage jhukna hi para.
Pilatos ne anumti de di ki unki maang puri ki jaae

Aur usne us person ko mukt kar diya, jise vidroh aur murder ke apraadhon mein bandi banaaya gaya tha, jise chhor dene ki unhonne maang ki thi aur usne Lord Yeshu ko bhir ki chaahat hisaab se unhein hi saump diya.

Jab sainik Lord Yeshu ko lekar ja rahe the, unhonne saayrinvaasi Shimon ko pakra, jo apne gaanv se a raha tha. Unhonne Lord Yeshu ke lie nirdhaarit krus us par laad diya ki vah use lekar Lord Yeshu ke pichhe-pichhe jaae.
Murkar Lord Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Yerushalem ki putriyo! Mere lie rona chhorkar khud apne lie aur apni children ke lie roo.
“ ‘Tab ve parvton se kaheinge, “Ham par a giro!” Aur pahaariyon se kaheinge, “Hamein dhaamp lo!” ’
Kyonki jab ve ek hare per ke saath is tarah ka vyavhaar kar rahe hain tab kya hogi sukhe per ki dasha?”
Raajadroh ke apraadhi do person bhi Lord Yeshu ke saath maut dand ke lie le jaae ja rahe the.
Jab ve kapaal naamak sthal par pahunche unhonne Lord Yeshu aur un donon raajadrohiyon ko bhi krusit kar diya—ek ko Lord Yeshu ki daayin or dusre ko unki baayin or.
Lord Yeshu ne prayer ki, “Pita, inko maafi kar dijie kyonki inhein yah pata hi nahin ki ye kya kar rahe hain.” Unhonne paasa pheinkkar Lord Yeshu ke kapde aapas mein baant lie.

Bhir khari hui yah sab dekh rahi thi. Yahudi raaja yah kahte hue Lord Yeshu ka thattha kar rahe the, “Isne dusre logon ki raksha ki hai. Yadi yah God ka Yeshu, unka chuna hua hai, to ab apni raksha khud kar le.”
Sainik bhi unka thattha kiye. Ve Lord Yeshu ke paas aakar unhein ghatiya daakhras prastut karke kahe,
“Yadi Yahudiyon ke raaja ho to khud ko bacha lo.”
Krus par unke sir ke upar suchna patr ke taur par yah likha tha: yahi vah Yahudiyon ka raaja hai.
Vahaan latkaae gae raajadrohiyon mein se ek ne Lord Yeshu par apshabdon ki bauchhaar karte hue kaha: “Are! Kya tum Yeshu nahin ho? Khud apne aapko bachaao aur hamko bhi!”
Lekin dusre raajadrohi ne dapatte hue usse kaha, “Kya tujhe God ka thora bhi dar nahin hai? Tujhe bhi to vahi dand diya ja raha hai!
Hamaare lie to yah dand sahi hi hai kyonki hamein vahi mil raha hai, jo hamaare bure kaamon ke lie sahi hai lekin inhonne to kuchh bhi galat nahin kiya.”
Tab Lord Yeshu ki or dekhkar usne unse request ki, “Aadarniy Yeshu! Apne raajy mein mujh par daya kijiega.”
Yah din ka madhyaahn tha. Saare kshetr par andhera chha gaya aur yah tin baje tak chhaaya raha.
Sury andhiyaara ho gaya, temple ka parda phatkar do bhaagon mein baant diya gaya.
Lord Yeshu ne unche word mein pukaarte hue kaha, “Pita! Main apni aatma aapke haathon mein saumpta hun.” Yah kahte hue unhonne jaan tyaag die.
Vah shataadhipti, jo yah sab dekh raha tha, yah kahte hue God ki vandna karne laga, “Sachmuch yah person nirdosh tha.”
Lord Yeshu ke parichit aur Galil pradesh se Lord Yeshu ke saath aai striyaan kuchh dur khari hui ye sab dekh rahi thi.
Tab Lord Yeshu unhein baithniyaah naamak gaanv tak le gae aur apne haath uthaakar unhein blessing di.
Jab vah unhein blessing de hi rahe the vah unse vida ho gae aur heaven mein utha liye gaye.
Tab unhonne Yeshu ki worship ki aur bahut hi khushi mein Yerushalem laut gae.
Ve temple mein niymit rup se God ki praise karte rahte the.
Aadi mein vachan tha, vachan God ke saath tha aur vachan God tha.
Yahi vachan aadi mein God ke saath tha.
Saari srishti unke dvaara utpann hui. Saari srishti mein kuchh bhi unke bina utpann nahin hua.
Life unhin mein tha aur vah life maanav jaati ki roshni tha.
Vah roshni andhera mein chamakti rahi. Andhera us par prabal na ho saka.
God ne Yohan naamak ek person ko bheja
Ki vah roshni ko dekhein aur uske gavaah banein ki log unke maadhyam se roshni mein faith karein.
Vah khud roshni nahin the lekin roshni ki gavaahi dene aae the.
Vah sachchi roshni, jo har ek person ko prakaashit karti hai, duniya mein aane par thi.
Vah duniya mein the aur duniya unhin ke dvaara banaaya gaya phir bhi duniya ne unhein na jaana.
Vah apni srishti mein aae lekin unke apnon ne hi unhein grahan nahin kiya.
Lekin jitnon ne unhein grahan kiya arthaat unke naam mein faith kiya, un sabko unhonne God ki children hone ka authority diya;
Jo na to lahu se, na shaaririk chaahat se aur na maanviy chaahat se, lekin God se paida hue hain.
Vachan ne body dhaaran kar hamaare beech tambu ke jaisa vaas kiya aur hamne unki glory ko apna liya—aisi glory ko, jo pita ke eklaute son ki hoti hai—grace aur sach se paripurn.
Unhein dekhkar Yohan ne ghoshna ki, “Yah vahi hain jinke baare mein mainne kaha tha, ‘Vah, jo mere baad a rahe hain, vaastav mein mujhse shreshth hain kyonki vah mujhse pahle the.’ ”
Unki paripurnta ke kaaran ham sabne grace par grace receive kiya.
Law Moshe ke dvaara di gayi thi, lekin grace aur sach Yeshu dvaara aae.
God ko kabhi kisi ne nahin dekha, keval God-son ke alaava; jo pita se hain; unhin ne hamein God se avgat karaaya.
Jab Yahudi aguon ne Yerushalem se priests aur leviyon ko Yohan se yah puchhne bheja, “Tum kaun ho?”
Tab unhonne Yohan se dobaara puchha, “To kya tum Eliyah ho?” Yohan ne javaab diya, “Nahin.” Tab unhonne puchha, “Kya tum vah prophet ho?” Yohan ne javaab diya, “Nahin.”
Is par unhonne puchha, “To hamein bataao ki tum kaun ho, tum apne baare mein kya kahte ho ki ham apne bhejne vaalon ko uttar de sakein?”
Is par Yohan ne prophet yashaayaah ke lekh ke hisaab se javaab diya, “Main uski aavaaj hun jo banjar zameen mein pukaar-pukaarkar kah rahi hai, ‘Lord ke lie raasta sidha karo.’ ”
Ye log Farisiyon ki or se bheje gae the.
Iske baad unhonne Yohan se savaal kiya, “Jab tum na to Yeshu ho, na prophet Eliyah aur na vah bhavishyadvakta, to tum baptisma kyon dete ho?”
Yohan ne unhein javaab diya, “Main to paani mein baptisma deta hun lekin tumhaare beech ek aise hain, jinhein tum nahin jaante.
Yah vahi hain, jo mere baad a rahe hain, main jinki juti ka bandh kholne ke yogy bhi nahin hun.”
Ye sab baithniyaah gaanv mein hua, jo yardan nadi ke paar tha jismein Yohan baptisma diya karte the.
Yah vahi hain, jinke baare mein mainne kaha tha, ‘Mere baad vah a rahe hain, jo mujhse shreshth hain kyonki vah mujhse pahle se maujud hain.’
Main bhi unhein nahin jaanta tha, main paani mein baptisma deta hua isliye aaya ki vah Israel par reveal ho jaaein.”
Iske atirikt Yohan ne yah gavaahi bhi di, “Mainne heaven se aatma ko kabutar ke jaisa utarte aur Yeshu par thaharte hue dekha.

Main unhein nahin jaanta tha lekin God, jinhonne mujhe paani mein baptisma dene ke lie bheja, unhin ne mujhe bataaya, ‘Jis par tum aatma ko utarte aur thaharte hue dekhoge, vahi Holy Spirit mein baptisma deinge.’
Khud mainne yah dekha aur main iska gavaah hun ki yahi God ka son hain.”
Agle din jab Yohan apne do disciples ke saath khare hue the,
Yah sunkar donon disciple Yeshu ki or barhne lage.
Yeshu ne unhein apne pichhe aate dekh unse puchha, “Tum kya chaahte ho?” Unhonne kaha, “Guruvar, aap kahaan rahte hain?”
Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Aao aur dekh lo.” Isliye unhonne jaakar Yeshu ka ghar dekha aur us din unhin ke saath rahe. Yah din ka lagbhag dasvaan ghanta tha.
Yohan ki gavaahi sunkar Yeshu ke pichhe a rahe do disciples mein ek Shimon Petros ke bhaai aandreyaas the.
Tab aandreyaas unhein Yeshu ke paas laae. Yeshu ne Shimon ki or dekhkar kaha, “Tum Yohan ke son Shimon ho, tum kaifas arthaat Petros kahlaaoge.”
Agle din Galil jaate hue Yeshu ki bheint filippos se hui. Unhonne unse kaha, “Mere pichhe ho le.”
Aandreyaas aur Shimon ke jaisa filippos bhi baithsaida shehar ke nivaasi the.
Filippos ne naathaanaael ko khoj kar unse kaha, “Jinka varnan law mein Moshe aur bhavishyadvaktaaon ne kiya hai, vah hamein mil gae hain—naazreth nivaasi Yosef ke son Yeshu.”
Yah sun naathaanaael ne turant unse puchha, “Kya naazreth se kuchh bhi uttam nikal sakta hai?” “Aakar khud dekh lo,” Filippos ne javaab diya.
Yeshu ne naathaanaael ko apni or aate dekh unke baare mein kaha, “Dekho! Ek sachcha israaeli hai, jismein koi kapat nahin hai.”
Naathaanaael ne Yeshu se puchha, “Aap mujhe kaise jaante hain?” Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Isse purv ki filippos ne tumhein bulaaya, mainne tumhein anjir ke per ke niche dekha tha.”
Tab Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Kya tum faith isliye karte ho ki mainne tumse yah kaha ki mainne tumhein anjir ke per ke niche dekha? Tum isse bhi adhik bare-bare kaam dekhoge.”
Tisre din Galil pradesh ke kaana shehar mein ek vivaahotsav tha. Yeshu ki maata vahaan upasthit thi.
Yeshu aur unke disciple bhi vahaan aamantrit the.
Jab vahaan daakhras kam parne laga to Yeshu ki maata ne unse kaha, “Unka daakhras samaapt ho gaya hai.”
Is par Yeshu ne unse kaha, “He aurat, isse aapka aur mera kya sambandh? Mera samay abhi nahin aaya hai.”
Unki maata ne servants se kaha, “Jo kuchh vah tumse kahein, vahi karo.”
Vahaan Yahudi parampra ke hisaab se shuddh karne ke lie paani ke chhah patthar ke bartan rakhe hue the. Har ek mein lagbhag sau sava sau litar paani samaata tha.
Yeshu ne servants se kaha, “Bartnon ko paani se bhar do.” Unhonne unhein munh tak bhar diya.
Iske baad Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Ab ismein se thora nikaalkar samaaroh ke sanchaalak ke paas le jaao.” Unhonne vaisa hi kiya.

Jab samaaroh ke leader ne us paani ko chakha—jo vaastav mein daakhras mein badal gaya tha aur use maalum nahin tha ki vah kahaan se aaya tha, lekin jinhonne use nikaala tha, ve jaante the—tab samaaroh ke leader ne dulhe ko bulvaaya
Aur usse kaha, “Har ek person pahle uttam daakhras parosta hai aur jab log pikar tript ho jaate hain, tab sasta, lekin tumne to uttam daakhras ab tak rakh chhora hai!”
Yah Yeshu ke adbhut chihnon ke karne ki shuruaat thi, jo Galil pradesh ke kaana shehar mein hua, jiske dvaara unhonne apna prataap reveal kiya aur unke disciples ne unmein faith kiya.
Iske baad Yeshu, unki maata, unke bhaai aur unke disciple kuchh dinon ke lie kafranhum shehar chale gae.
Jab Yahudiyon ka Fasah utsav paas aaya to Yeshu apne disciples ke saath Yerushalem gae.
Unhonne temple mein bail, bher aur kabutar bechne vaalon aur saahukaaron ko vyaapaar karte hue paaya.
Isliye unhonne rassiyon ka ek kora banaaya aur un sabko bailon aur bheron sahit temple se baahar nikaal diya aur saahukaaron ke sikke bikher die, unki chaukiyon ko ulat diya
Aur kabutar bechne vaalon se kaha, “Inhein yahaan se le jaao. Mere pita ke bhavan ko vyaapaarik keindr mat banaao.”
Yah sun disciples ko Scripture ka yah lekh yaad aaya: “Aapke bhavan ki dhun mein jalte jalte main bhasm hua.”
Tab Yahudi aguon ne Yeshu se kaha, “In kaamon par apna authority pramaanit karne ke lie tum hamein kya chihn dikha sakte ho?”
Fasah utsav ke samay jab Yeshu Yerushalem mein the, to unke dvaara kie gae adbhut chinhon ko dekhkar kai logon ne unmein faith kiya,
Lekin Yeshu unke prati aashvast nahin the kyonki vah insaan ke svabhaav se parichit the.
Unhein insaan ke baare mein insaan ki gavaahi ki zarurat nahin thi. Vah jaante the ki insaan kya hai.
Nikodemos naamak ek Farisi, jo Yahudiyon ke leaders mein se ek the,

Raat ke samay Yeshu ke paas aae aur unse kaha, “Rabbi, ham jaante hain ki aap God ki or se bheje gae guru hain kyonki ye adbhut kaam, jo aap karte hain, koi bhi nahin kar sakta yadi God uske saath na hon.”
Nikodemos ne unse puchha, “Vriddh insaan ka dobaara janm lena kaise sambhav hai, kya vah naya janm lene ke lie punh apni maata ke garbh mein pravesh kare?”
Kyonki maanav body mein janm sirf shaaririk janm hai, jabki aatma se janm naya janm hai.
Jis tarah vaayu jis or chaahti hai, us or bahti hai. Aap uski dhvani to sunte hain lekin yah nahin bata sakte ki vah kis or se aati aur kis or jaati hai. Aatma se paida person bhi aisa hi hai.”
Nikodemos ne puchha, “Yah sab kaise sambhav hai?”
Yeshu ne javaab diya, “Israel ke shikshak,” Hokar bhi aap in baaton ko nahin samajhte!
Main aap par yah atal sach reveal kar raha hun: ham vahi kahte hain, jo ham jaante hain aur ham usi ki gavaahi dete hain, jise hamne dekha hai, lekin aap hamaari gavaahi grahan nahin karte.
Jab main aapse saansaarik vishyon ki baatein karta hun, aap mera faith nahin karte to yadi main svargiy vishyon ki baatein karun to faith kaise kareinge?
Insaan ke son ke alaava aur koi heaven nahin gaya kyonki vahi pahle heaven se utra hai.
Jis tarah Moshe ne banjar zameen mein saamp ko uncha uthaaya, usi tarah zaruri hai ki insaan ka son bhi uncha uthaaya jaae.
Kyonki God ne apne son ko duniya par dosh lagaane ke lie nahin lekin duniya ke bachaav ke lie bheja.
Antim nirnay ka aadhaar yah hai: roshni ke duniya mein a jaane par bhi insaanon ne roshni ki tulna mein andhera ko dear jaana kyonki unke kaam bure the.
Kukarmon mein lin person roshni se nafrat karta aur roshni mein aane se katraata hai ki kahin uske kaam reveal na ho jaaein;
Lekin sachcha person roshni ke paas aata hai, jisse yah reveal ho jaae ki uske kaam God ki or se kie gae kaam hain.
Iske baad Yeshu aur unke disciple Yahudiya pradesh mein aae, jahaan ve unke saath rahkar baptisma dete rahe.
Yohan bhi yardan nadi mein shaalim shehar ke paas enon naamak jagah mein baptisma dete the kyonki vahaan paani bahut maatra mein tha.
Is samay tak Yohan bandigrih mein nahin daale gae the.
Ek Yahudi ne Yohan ke disciples se paani dvaara shuddhikran ki vidhi ke baare mein spashtikran chaaha.

Disciples ne Yohan ke paas jaakar unse kaha, “Rabbi, dekhie, yardan paar vah person, jo aapke saath the aur aap jinki gavaahi dete rahe hain, sab log unhin ke paas ja rahe hain aur vah unhein baptisma bhi de rahe hain.”
Is par Yohan ne kaha, “Koi bhi tab tak kuchh receive nahin kar sakta, jab tak use heaven se na diya jaae.
Tum khud mere gavaah ho ki mainne kaha tha, ‘Main Yeshu nahin lekin unke lie pahle bheja gaya dut hun’
Var vahi hai jiske saath vadhu hai lekin var ke saath uska mitr uska word sun khushi se bahut praphullit hota hai. Yahi hai mera khushi, jo ab pura hua hai.
Yah nishchit hai ki vah barhte jaaein aur main ghatta jaaun.”
Jinka aagman heaven se hua hai vahi sabse bara hain, jo prithvi se hai, vah prithvi ka hai aur prithvi hi se sambandhit vishyon ki baatein karta hai. Vah, jo God se aae hain, vah sabse upar hain.
Jo unhonne dekha aur suna hai vah usi ki gavaahi dete hain, phir bhi koi unki gavaahi grahan nahin karta.
Jinhonne unki gavaahi grahan ki hai, unhonne yah saabit kiya hai ki God sachcha hai.
Vah, jinhein God ne bheja hai God ke vachnon ka prachaar karte hain, kyonki God unhein bina kisi maap ke aatma dete hain.
Pita ko son se love hai aur unhonne sab kuchh uske haath mein saump diya hai.
Jab Yeshu ko yah maalum hua ki Farisiyon ke beech unke baare mein charcha ho rahi hai ki vah Yohan se adhik disciple banaate aur baptisma dete hain;
Yadypi khud Yeshu nahin lekin unke disciple baptisma dete the,
Tab vah Yahudiya pradesh chhorkar punh Galil pradesh ko laute.
Unhein shamriya pradesh mein se hokar jaana para.
Vah shamriya pradesh ke sukhaar naamak shehar pahunche. Yah shehar us zameen ke paas hai, jo Yaakob ne apne son Yosef ko di thi.
Yaakob ka kuna bhi vahin tha. Yaatra se thake Yeshu kuein ke paas baith gae. Yah lagbhag din ka baarah baje ka samay tha.
Usi samay shamriyaavaasi ek aurat us kuein se paani bharne aai. Yeshu ne usse kaha, “Mujhe pine ke lie paani do.”
Us samay Yeshu ke disciple shehar mein khaana lene gae hue the.

Is par aashchary karte hue us shamriyaavaasi aurat ne Yeshu se puchha, “Aap Yahudi hokar mujh shamriyaavaasi se paani kaise maang rahe hain?” (Yahudi shamriyaavaasiyon se kisi tarah ka sambandh nahin rakhte the.)

Yeshu ne javaab diya, “Yadi tum God ke vardaan ko jaantin aur yah pahchaantin ki vah kaun hai, jo tumse kah raha hai, ‘Mujhe pine ke lie paani do,’ To tum usse maangtin aur vah tumhein life ka paani deta.”
Aurat ne kaha, “Lekin shriman, aapke paas to paani nikaalne ke lie koi bartan bhi nahin hai aur kuna bahut gahra hai; life ka paani aapke paas kahaan se aaya!
Aap hamaare kulpita Yaakob se barhkar to hain nahin, jinhonne hamein yah kuna diya, jismein se khud unhonne, unki children ne aur unke pashuon ne bhi piya.”
Yeshu ne kaha, “Kuein ka paani pikar har ek person phir pyaasa hoga.
Yah sunkar aurat ne unse kaha, “Shriman, aap mujhe bhi vah paani dijie ki mujhe na pyaas lage aur na hi mujhe yahaan tak paani bharne aate rahna pare.”
Yeshu ne usse kaha, “Jaao, apne pati ko yahaan lekar aao.”
Aurat ne javaab diya, “Mere pati nahin hai.” Yeshu ne usse kaha, “Tumne sach kaha ki tumhaara pati nahin hai.
Sach yah hai ki paanch pati pahle hi tumhaare saath rah chuke hain aur ab bhi jo tumhaare saath rah raha hai, tumhaara pati nahin hai.”
Yah sun aurat ne unse kaha, “Shriman, aisa lagta hai ki aap prophet hain.
Hamaare purvaj is parvat par worship karte the lekin aap Yahudi log kahte hain ki Yerushalem hi vah jagah hai, jahaan worship karna sahi hai.”
Yeshu ne usse kaha, “Mera faith karo ki vah samay a raha hai jab tum na to is parvat par pita ki worship karoge aur na Yerushalem mein.
Tum log to uski worship karte ho jise tum jaante nahin. Ham unki worship karte hain jinhein ham jaante hain, kyonki bachaav Yahudiyon mein se hi hai.
Vah samay a raha hai balki a hi gaya hai jab sachche bhakt pita ki worship apni antraatma aur sach mein kareinge kyonki pita apne lie aise hi bhakton ki khoj mein hain.
God aatma hain isliye zaruri hai ki unke bhakt apni aatma aur sach mein unki worship karein.”
Yeshu ne usse kaha, “Jo tumse baatein kar raha hai, vahi to main hi hun.”

Tabhi unke disciple a gae aur Yeshu ko ek aurat se baatein karte dekh dang rah gae, phir bhi kisi ne unse yah puchhne ka saahas nahin kiya ki vah ek aurat se baatein kyon kar rahe the ya usse kya jaanna chaahte the.
Apna ghara vahin chhor vah aurat shehar mein jaakar logon ko bataane lagi,
“Aao, ek person ko dekho, jinhonne mere life ki saari baatein suna di hain. Kahin yahi to Yeshu nahin?”
Tab nagarvaasi Yeshu ko dekhne vahaan aane lage.
Isi bich disciples ne Yeshu se request ki, “Rabbi, kuchh kha lijie.”
Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Mere paas khaane ke lie aisa khaana hai, jiske baare mein tum kuchh nahin jaante.”
Is par disciple aapas mein puchhtaachh karne lage, “Kahin koi guru ke lie khaana to nahin laaya?”
Yahaan yah kahaavat thik baithti hai: ‘Ek boe dusra kaate.’
Tab shamriyaavaasiyon ki request par Yeshu do din tak unke beech rahe
Do din baad Yeshu ne Galil pradesh ki or prasthaan kiya.
Yadypi Yeshu khud spasht kar chuke the ki prophet ko apne hi desh mein sammaan nahin milta,
Galil pradesh pahunchne par galilvaasiyon ne unka svaagat kiya kyonki ve Fasah utsav ke samay Yerushalem mein Yeshu dvaara kie gae kaam dekh chuke the.
Yeshu dobaara Galil pradesh ke kaana shehar mein aae, jahaan unhonne paani ko daakhras mein badla tha. Kafranhum shehar mein ek raajkarmchaari tha, jiska son asvasth tha.
Yah sunkar ki Yeshu Yahudiya pradesh se Galil mein aae hue hain, usne aakar Yeshu se request ki ki vah chalkar uske son ko svasth kar dein, jo maut-shayya par hai.
Is par Yeshu ne use jhirki dete hue kaha, “Tum log to chihn aur chamatkaar dekhe bina faith hi nahin karte!”
Raajkarmchaari ne unse dobaara request ki, “Shriman, isse purv ki mere baalak ki maut ho, kripya mere saath chalein.”
Yeshu ne usse kaha, “Jaao, tumhaara son jivit rahega.” Us person ne Yeshu ke vachan par faith kiya aur ghar laut gaya.
Jab vah raasta mein hi tha, uske slave use mil gae aur unhonne use suchna di, “Maalik, aapka son svasth ho gaya hai.”
“Vah kis samay se svasth hone laga tha?” Usne unse puchha. Unhonne kaha, “Kal lagbhag dophar ek baje uska jvar utar gaya.”
Pita samajh gaya ki yah thik usi samay hua jab Yeshu ne kaha tha, “Tumhaara son jivit rahega.” Is par usne aur uske saare parivaar ne Yeshu mein faith kiya.
Yah dusra adbhut chihn tha, jo Yeshu ne Yahudiya pradesh se lautkar Galil pradesh mein kiya.
In baaton ke pashchaat Yeshu Yahudiyon ke ek parv mein Yerushalem gae.
Yerushalem mein bher-phaatak ke paas ek jalaashay hai, jo ibri bhaasha mein baithzaada kahlaata hai aur jiske paanch osaare hain,
Uske kinaare andhe, apang aur lakve ke kai rogi pare rahte the,
Inmein ek person aisa tha, jo artis varsh se rogi tha.
Yeshu ne use vahaan pare hue dekh aur yah maalum hone par ki vah vahaan bahut samay se para hua hai, uske paas jaakar puchha, “Kya tum svasth hona chaahte ho?”
Rogi ne javaab diya, “Shriman, aisa koi nahin, jo paani ke hilne par mujhe jalaashay mein utaare—mere koshish ke purv hi koi dusre person usmein utar jaata hai.”
Yeshu ne usse kaha, “Utho, apna bichhauna uthaao aur chalne phirne lago.”
Turant vah person svasth ho gaya aur apna bichhauna uthaakar chala gaya. Vah Shabbat tha.
Ath Yahudi aguon ne svasth hue person se kaha, “Aaj Shabbat hai. Ath tumhaara bichhauna uthaana uchit nahin hai.”
Usne kaha, “Jinhonne mujhe svasth kiya hai, unhin ne mujhe command di, ‘Apna bichhauna uthaao aur chalne phirne lago.’ ”
Unhonne usse puchha, “Kaun hai vah, jisne tumse kaha hai ki apna bichhauna uthaao aur chalne phirne lago?”
Svasth hua person nahin jaanta tha ki usko svasth karnevaala kaun tha kyonki us samay Yeshu bhir mein gum ho gae the.
Kuchh samay baad Yeshu ne us person ko temple mein dekh usse kaha, “Dekho, tum svasth ho gae ho, ab galti na karna. Aisa na ho ki tumhaara haal isse jyaada bura ho jaae.”
Tab us person ne aakar Yahudi aguon ko suchit kiya ki jinhonne use svasth kiya hai, vah Yeshu hain.
Shabbat par Yeshu dvaara yah kaam kie jaane ke kaaran Yahudi aguein unko sataane lage.
Yeshu ne spasht kiya, “Mere pita ab tak kaary kar rahe hain isliye main bhi kaam kar raha hun.”

Parinaamasvrup Yahudi aguein Yeshu ki murder ke lie aur bhi adhik than gae kyonki unke hisaab se Yeshu Shabbat ki vidhi ko tor hi nahin rahe the balki God ko apna pita kahkar khud ko God ke tuly bhi darsha rahe the.

Yeshu ne kaha: “Main tum par ek atal sach reveal kar raha hun; son khud kuchh nahin kar sakta. Vah vahi kar sakta hai, jo vah pita ko karte hue dekhta hai kyonki jo kuchh pita karte hain, son bhi vahi karta hai.
Pita son se love karte hain aur vah son ko apni har ek yojna se parichit rakhte hain. Vah inse bhi bare-bare kaam dikhaaeinge, jinhein dekh tum chakit ho jaaoge.
Jis tarah pita apne aap mein life rakhta hai, usi tarah son mein basa hua life pita ke dvaara diya gaya life hai.

Main khud apni or se kuchh nahin kar sakta. Main unse jaise nirdesh receive karta hun, vaisa hi nirnay deta hun. Mera nirnay sachcha hota hai kyonki main apni chaahat nahin lekin apne bhejnevaale ki chaahat puri karne ke lie samarpit hun.
“Yadi main khud apne hi baare mein gavaahi dun to meri gavaahi maany nahin hogi.
Ek aur hain, jo mere gavaah hain aur main jaanta hun ki mere baare mein unki gavaahi atal hai.
“Tumne Yohan ke paas apne log bheje aur Yohan ne bhi sach ki hi gavaahi di.
Yohan vah jalta hua aur chamakta hua dipak the, jinke ujaale mein tumhein kuchh samay tak khushi manaana sukhad laga.
“Meri gavaahi Yohan ki gavaahi se adhik bari hai kyonki pita dvaara mujhe saumpe gae kaam ko pura karna hi is sach ka sabut hai ki pita ne mujhe bheja hai.
Iske atirikt pita arthaat khud mere bhejnevaale ne bhi mere baare mein gavaahi di hai. Tumne na to kabhi unki aavaaj suni hai, na unka rup dekha hai
Aur na hi unka vachan tumhaare dil mein sthir rah saka hai kyonki jise unhonne bheja hai, tum usmein faith nahin karte.
Tum shaastron ka manan is faith mein karte ho ki unmein anant kaal ka life basa hai. Ye sabhi Scripture mere hi baare mein gavaahi dete hain.
Yah sab hone par bhi life paane ke lie tum mere paas aana nahin chaahte.
“Insaan ki prashansa mujhe accept nahin
Kyonki main tumhein jaanta hun aur mujhe yah bhi maalum hai ki God ka love tumhaare man mein hai hi nahin.
Tum mujhe grahan nahin karte jabki main apne pita ke naam mein aaya hun lekin yadi koi apne hi naam mein aae to tum use grahan kar loge.
Tum mujhmein faith kaise kar sakte ho yadi tum ek dusre se prashansa ki ummid karte ho aur us prashansa ke lie koi koshish nahin karte, jo ekmaatr God se receive hoti hai?
“Yah soch apne man se nikaal do ki pita ke saamne main tum par aarop lagaaunga; tum par doshaaropan to Moshe kareinge—Moshe, jin par tumne ummid laga rakhi hai.
Yadi tum vaastav mein Moshe mein faith karte to mujhmein bhi karte kyonki unhonne mere hi baare mein likha hai.
Jab tum unke lekhon ka hi faith nahin karte to meri baaton ka faith kaise karoge?”
In baaton ke baad Yeshu Galil arthaat tiberiyos jhil ke us paar chale gae.
Unke dvaara rogiyon ko svaasthydaan ke adbhut chihnon se prabhaavit ek bari bhir unke saath ho li.
Yeshu parvat par jaakar vahaan apne disciples ke saath baith gae.
Yahudiyon ka Fasah utsav paas tha.
Jab Yeshu ne bari bhir ko apni or aate dekha to filippos se puchha, “In sabko khilaane ke lie ham khaana kahaan se mol leinge?”
Yeshu ne yah savaal unhein parakhne ke lie kiya tha kyonki vah jaante the ki vah kya karne par the.
Filippos ne javaab diya, “Do sau dinaar ki rotiyaan bhi unke lie paryaapt nahin hongi ki har ek ko thori-thori mil paae.”
Yeshu ke disciple Shimon Petros ke bhaai aandreyaas ne unhein suchit kiya,
“Yahaan ek larka hai, jiske paas jau ki paanch rotiyaan aur do machhliyaan hain lekin unse itne logon ka kya hoga?”
Yeshu ne kaha, “Logon ko baitha do” Aur ve sab, jinmein aadmiyon ki hi sankhya paanch hazaar thi, ghani ghaas par baith gae.
Tab Yeshu ne rotiyaan lekar thanks diya aur unki zarurat ke hisaab se baant din aur usi tarah machhliyaan bhi.
Jab ve sab tript ho gae to Yeshu ne apne disciples ko command di, “Shesh tukron ko ikattha kar lo ki kuchh bhi barbaadi na ho,”
Unhonne jau ki un paanch rotiyon ke shesh tukre ikattha kie, jinse baarah tokre bhar gae.
Logon ne is adbhut chihn ko dekhkar kaha, “Nihsandeh yah vahi prophet hain, duniya jinki pratiksha kar raha hai.”
Jab Yeshu ko yah maalum hua ki log unhein zabardasti raaja banaane ke purpose se le jaana chaahte hain to vah phir se parvat par akele chale gae.
Jab sandhya hui to Yeshu ke disciple jhil ke tat par utar gae.
Andhera ho chuka tha aur Yeshu ab tak unke paas nahin pahunche the. Unhonne naav par savaar hokar Galil jhil ke dusri or kafranhum shehar ke lie prasthaan kiya.
Usi samay tej hava ke kaaran jhil mein lahrein barhne lagin.
Naav ko lagbhag paanch kilomitar khene ke baad disciples ne Yeshu ko paani satah par chalte aur naav ki or aate dekha. Yah dekhkar ve bhaybhit ho gae.
Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Bhaybhit mat ho, main hun.”
Yah sun disciple Yeshu ko naav mein charhaane ko taiyaar ho gae. Iske baad naav us kinaare par pahunch gai jahaan unhein jaana tha.
Agle din jhil ke us paar rah gai bhir ko maalum hua ki vahaan keval ek chhoti naav thi aur Yeshu disciples ke saath usmein nahin gae the—keval disciple hi usmein dusre paar gae the.
Tab tiberiyos shehar se dusre naavein us jagah par aain, jahaan Lord ne bari bhir ko khaana karaaya tha.
Jab bhir ne dekha ki na to Yeshu vahaan hain aur na hi unke disciple, to ve Yeshu ko khojte hue naavon dvaara kafranhum shehar pahunch gae.
Jhil ke is paar Yeshu ko paakar unhonne unse puchha, “Rabbi, aap yahaan kab pahunche?”
Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Main tum par yah atal sach reveal kar raha hun: tum mujhe isliye nahin khoj rahe ki tumne adbhut chihn dekhe hain lekin isliye ki tum rotiyaan khaakar tript hue ho.
Is par unhonne Yeshu se puchha, “Hamse God ki will kya hai?”
Is par unhonne Yeshu se dobaara puchha, “Aap aisa kaun sa adbhut chihn dikha sakte hain ki ham aap mein faith karein? Kya hai vah kaam?
Hamaare purvjon ne banjar zameen mein manna khaaya; Scripture ke hisaab se: khaana ke lie God ne unhein heaven se roti di.”
Is par Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Main tum par yah atal sach reveal kar raha hun: heaven se vah roti tumhein Moshe ne nahin di; mere pita hi hain, jo tumhein heaven se vaastvik roti dete hain.
Kyonki God ki roti vah hai, jo heaven se aati hai, aur duniya ko life provide karti hai.”
Yah sunkar unhonne request ki, “Lord, ab se hamein yahi roti dein.”
Main tumse pahle bhi kah chuka hun ki tum mujhe dekhkar bhi mujhmein faith nahin karte.
Main heaven se apni chaahat puri karne nahin, apne bhejnevaale ki chaahat puri karne ke lie aaya hun.
Yeshu ka yah daava sunkar: “Heaven se utri roti main hi hun,” Yahudi ague kurkuraane lage
Aur aapas mein mantrna karne lage, “Kya yah Yosef ka son Yeshu nahin, jiske maata-pita ko ham jaante hain? To ab yah kaise kah raha hai ki yah heaven se aaya hai?”
Yah jaankar Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Kurkuraao mat,
Bhavishyadvaktaaon ke abhilekh mein yah likha hua hai: ve sab God dvaara sikhaae hue honge, ath har ek, jisne pita God ko suna aur unse sikha hai, mere paas aata hai.
Kisi ne pita God ko nahin dekha sivaay uske, jo pita God se hai, keval usi ne unhein dekha hai.
Main hi hun life ki roti.
Banjar zameen mein tumhaare purvjon ne manna khaaya phir bhi unki maut ho gai.
Yah sunkar Yahudi ague aapas mein vivaad karne lage, “Yah person kaise hamein apna body khaane ke lie de sakta hai?”
Mera body hi vaastvik khaana aur mera lahu hi vaastvik pey hai.
Jo mera body khaata aur mera lahu pita hai, vahi hai, jo mujhmein bana rahta hai aur main usmein.
Jaise jivant pita God ne mujhe bheja hai aur main pita ke kaaran jivit hun, vaise hi vah bhi, jo mujhe grahan karta hai, mere kaaran jivit rahega.
Yeshu ne ye baatein kafranhum shehar ke Yahudi synagogue mein teaching dete hue bataain.
Yah baatein sunkar unke kai disciples ne kaha, “Bahut kathor hai yah teaching. Kaun ise accept kar sakta hai?”
Apne chelon ki barabraahat ka ahsaas hone par Yeshu ne kaha, “Kya yah tumhaare lie thokar ka kaaran hai?
Tum tab kya karoge jab tum insaan ke son ko upar heaven mein jaate dekhoge, jahaan vah pahle tha?
Aatma hi hain, jo body ko life deti hai. Keval body ka kuchh mahatv nahin. Jo vachan mainne tumse kahe hain, ve aatma hain aur life bhi.
Iske parinaamasvrup Yeshu ke kai chele pichhe hat gae aur unke pichhe chalna chhor diya.
Yah dekh Yeshu ne apne baarah disciples se abhimukh ho unse puchha, “Kahin tum bhi to laut jaana nahin chaahte?”
Hamne faith kiya aur jaan liya hai ki aap hi God ke holy jan hain.”
(unka ishaara kaariyotvaasi Shimon ke son Yahudah ki or tha kyonki un baarah disciples mein se vahi Yeshu ke saath dhokha karne par tha.)
In baaton ke baad Yeshu Galil pradesh ke dusre kshetron mein yaatra karne lage. Vah Yahudiya pradesh mein jaana nahin chaahte the kyonki Yahudi ague unki murder ki taak mein the.
Yahudiyon ka ek parv—jhopriyon ka utsav—paas tha.
Yeshu ke bhaaiyon ne unse kaha, “Yahudiya chale jaao jisse tumhaare chele tumhaare in kaamon ko dekh sakein;
Khyaati chaahnevaala person apne kaam gupt mein nahin karta. Jab tum ye kaam karte hi ho to khud ko duniya par reveal kar do.”
Is par Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Tumhaara sahi samay to kabhi bhi a sakta hai lekin mera sahi samay abhi nahin aaya.
Duniya tumse nafrat nahin kar sakta—vah mujhse nafrat karta hai kyonki main yah reveal karta hun ki uske kaam bure hain.
Tum parv mein jaao. Main abhi nahin jaaunga kyonki mera samay abhi tak pura nahin hua hai.”
Yah kahkar Yeshu Galil pradesh mein hi thahre rahe.
Apne bhaaiyon ke jhopriyon ke utsav mein chale jaane ke baad ve bhi gupt rup se vahaan gae.
Utsav mein kuchh Yahudi ague Yeshu ko khojte hue puchhtaachh kar rahe the, “Kahaan hai vah?”
Yadypi Yeshu ke baare mein logon mein bara vivaad ho raha tha—kuchh kah rahe the, “Vah bhala person hai.” Aur kuchh ka kahna tha, “Nahin, vah bharmaanevaala hai—sabke saath chhal karta hai.”
Taubhi koi bhi person Yahudiyon ke dar ke kaaran Yeshu ke baare mein khulkar baat nahin karta tha.
