Jab utsav ke beech Yeshu temple mein jaakar teaching dene lage,
Yahudi ague chakit hokar kahne lage, “Yah person bina parhe wise kaise ban gaya?”
Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Yah teaching meri nahin lekin unki hai, jinhonne mujhe bheja hai.
Yadi koi person unki chaahat puri karne ke lie pran kare to use yah maalum ho jaaega ki yah teaching God ki or se hai ya meri or se.
Vah, jo apne hi soch prastut karta hai, apna hi aadar chaahta hai, lekin vah, jo apne bhejnevaale ka aadar chaahta hai, vah bilkul sachcha hai aur usmein koi chhal nahin.
Kya Moshe ne tumhein law nahin di? Phir bhi tummein se koi uska follow nahin karta. Meri murder ki taak mein kyon ho tum?”
Bhir ne javaab diya, “Kaun tumhaari murder karna chaahta hai? Tum dard denevaali aatma se pirit ho.”
Yeshu ne kaha, “Mainne Shabbat par ek chamatkaar kiya aur tum sab krodhit ho gae.
Tumhaara justice baahri rup par nahin lekin sach par aadhaarit ho.”
Yerushalem nivaasiyon mein se kuchh ne yah savaal kiya, “Kya yah vahi nahin, ve jiski murder ki taak mein hain?
Lekin dekho, vah bhir se khulkar, bina dar ke baatein karta hai aur adhikaari kuchh bhi nahin kahte! Kahin aisa to nahin ki adhikaariyon ko maalum ho gaya hai ki yahi vaastav mein Yeshu hain?
Is person ki prishthbhumi hamein maalum hai, lekin jab Yeshu reveal honge to kisi ko yah maalum nahin hoga ki vah kahaan ke hain.”

Temple mein teaching dete hue Yeshu ne unche word mein kaha, “Tum mujhe jaante ho aur yah bhi jaante ho ki main kahaan se aaya hun. Sach yah hai ki main khud nahin aaya. Jinhonne mujhe bheja hai, vah sachcha hai lekin tum unhein nahin jaante,
Main unhein jaanta hun kyonki unhin mein se main hun aur mujhe unhin ne bheja hai.”
Yah sunkar unhonne Yeshu ko bandi banaana chaaha lekin kisi ne un par haath na daala kyonki unka samay ab tak nahin aaya tha.
Farisiyon ne bhir ko is baare mein aapas mein soch-vimarsh karte hue sun liya. Isliye Yeshu ko bandi banaane ke lie leader priests va Farisiyon ne temple ke pahredaaron ko bheja.
Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Thore samay ke lie main tumhaare saath hun, uske baad main apne bhejnevaale ke paas laut jaaunga.
Tum mujhe khojoge lekin paaoge nahin kyonki jahaan main hounga, tum vahaan nahin a sakte.”

Is par Yahudi ague soch-vimarsh karne lage, “Yah person kahaan jaane par hai ki ham use khoj nahin paaeinge? Kya yah yunaaniyon ke beech pravaasi Yahudiyon mein basna chaahta hai ki yunaaniyon ko bhi teaching de?
Yah kya kah raha hai ki tum mujhe khojoge aur nahin paaoge kyonki jahaan main hounga tum vahaan nahin a sakte?”
Utsav ke antim din, jab utsav charam sima par hota hai, Yeshu ne khare hokar unche word mein kaha, “Yadi koi pyaasa hai to mere paas aae aur pie.
Yah unhonne Holy Spirit ke baare mein kaha tha, jinhein un par faith karnevaale receive karne par the. Holy Spirit ab tak utre nahin the kyonki Yeshu ab tak glory ko na pahunche the.
Yah sab sunkar bhir mein se kuchh ne kaha, “Sachmuch yah person hi vah prophet hai.”
Kuchh dusre ne kaha, “Yah Yeshu hain.” Lekin kuchh ne kaha, “Yeshu ka aana Galil se to nahin hoga na?
Kya Scripture ke hisaab se Yeshu ka aana David ke vansh aur unke shehar bethlehem se na hoga?”
Is tarah Yeshu ke kaaran bhir mein matbhed ho gaya.
Kuchh unhein bandi banaana chaahte the phir bhi kisi ne bhi un par haath na daala.
Santriyon ke lautne par leader priests aur Farisiyon ne unse puchha, “Tum use lekar kyon nahin aae?”
Santriyon ne javaab diya, “Aisa bataanevaala hamne aaj tak nahin suna.”
Tab Farisiyon ne kataaksh kiya, “Kahin tum bhi to uske bahkaave mein nahin a gae?
Kya leaders ya Farisiyon mein se kisi ne bhi usmein faith kiya hai?
Tab nikodemos ne, jo leaders mein se ek the aur Yeshu se pahle mil chuke the, unse kaha,
“Kya hamaari law kisi person ki sune bina aur uski gatividhi jaane bina use apraadhi ghoshit karti hai?”
Is par unhonne nikodemos se puchha, “Kahin tum bhi to galili nahin ho? Shaastron ka manan karo aur dekho ki kisi bhi prophet ka aana Galil pradesh se nahin hota.”
[ve sabhi apne-apne ghar laut gaein].
Aur Yeshu jaitun parvat par chale gaye.
Bhor ko vah dobaara temple mein aae aur logon ke beech baithkar unko teaching dene lage.
Usi samay Farisiyon va shaastriyon ne vyabhichaar ke kaary mein pakri gai ek aurat ko laakar beech mein khara kar diya
Aur Yeshu se savaal kiya, “Guru, yah aurat vyabhichaar karte hue pakri gai hai.
Moshe ne law mein hamein aisi auraton ko pathraav dvaara maar daalne ki command di hai; lekin aap kya kahte hain?”
Unhonne Yeshu ko parakhne ke lie yah savaal kiya tha ki un par aarop lagaane ke lie unhein koi aadhaar mil jaae. Lekin Yeshu jhukkar zameen par ungli se likhne lage.
Jab ve Yeshu se baar-baar savaal karte rahe, Yeshu ne sidhe khare hokar unse kaha, “Tummein se jis kisi ne kabhi koi galti na kiya ho, vahi use sabse pahla patthar maare.”
Aur vah dobaara jhukkar zameen par likhne lage.
Yah sunkar varishth se shuruaat kar ek-ek karke sab vahaan se chale gae—keval vah aurat aur Yeshu hi vahaan rah gae.
Yeshu ne sidhe khare hote hue aurat ki or dekhkar usse puchha, “He aurat! Ve sab kahaan hain? Kya tumhein kisi ne bhi dandit nahin kiya?”
Usne javaab diya, “Kisi ne bhi nahin, Lord.” Yeshu ne usse kaha, “Main bhi tumhein dandit nahin karta. Jaao, ab phir galti na karna.”

Temple mein apni teaching ko dobaara shuru karte hue Yeshu ne logon se kaha, “Duniya ki roshni main hi hun. Jo koi mere pichhe chalta hai, vah andhera mein kabhi na chalega kyonki life ki roshni usi mein basegi.”
Tab Farisiyon ne unse kaha, “Tum apne hi baare mein gavaahi de rahe ho isliye tumhaari gavaahi accept nahin ki ja sakti hai.”

Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Yadi main khud apne baare mein gavaahi de bhi raha hun, to bhi meri gavaahi accept ki ja sakti hai kyonki mujhe maalum hai ki main kahaan se aaya hun aur kahaan ja raha hun; lekin tum log nahin jaante ki main kahaan se aaya aur kahaan ja raha hun.
Tum log maanviy soch se dusre logon ka justice karte ho; main kisi ka justice nahin karta.
Yadi main kisi ka justice karun bhi to vah sahi hi hoga, kyonki ismein main akela nahin—ismein main aur mere bhejne vaala pita bhi shaamil hain.
Tumhaari law mein hi yah likha hai ki do logon ki gavaahi sach ke taur par accept ki ja sakti hai.
Ek gavaah to main hi hun, jo khud apne baare mein gavaahi de raha hun aur mere baare mein dusre gavaah—mere bhejnevaale—pita God hain.”
Tab unhonne Yeshu se puchha, “Kahaan hai tumhaara yah pita?” Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Na to tum mujhe jaante ho aur na hi mere pita ko; yadi tum mujhe jaante to mere pita ko bhi jaan lete.”
Yeshu ne ye vachan temple parisar mein teaching dete samay kahe, phir bhi kisi ne un par haath nahin daala kyonki unka samay abhi nahin aaya tha.
Tab Yahudi ague aapas mein soch karne lage, “Kahin vah aatmhatya to nahin karega kyonki vah kah raha hai, ‘Jahaan main ja raha hun, vahaan tum nahin a sakte’?”
Tab unhonne unse puchha, “Kaun ho tum?” Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Tumse main ab tak kya kahta a raha hun?
Tumhaare baare mein mujhe bahut kuchh kahna aur nirnay karna hai. Main duniya se vahi kahta hun, jo mainne apne bhejnevaale se suna hai. Mere bhejnevaale faithful hain.”
Ve ab tak yah samajh nahin paae the ki Yeshu unse pita God ke baare mein kah rahe the.
Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Jab tum insaan ke son ko uncha uthaaoge tab tum jaan loge ki main vahi hun aur yah bhi ki main khud kuchh nahin kahta, main vahi kahta hun, jo pita ne mujhe sikhaaya hai.
Mere bhejnevaale mere saath hain, unhonne mujhe akela nahin chhora kyonki main hamesha vahi karta hun, jismein unki khushi hai.”
Ye sab sunkar anekon ne Yeshu mein faith kiya.
Tab Yeshu ne un Yahudiyon se, jinhonne unhein maanyta de di thi, kaha, “Yadi tum meri teachings ka follow karte rahoge to vaastav mein mere disciple hoge.
Tum saty ko jaanoge aur saty tumhein svatantr karega.”
Unhonne Yeshu ko javaab diya, “Ham Abraham ke vanshaj hain aur ham kabhi bhi kisi ke slave nahin hue. Tum yah kaise kahte ho ‘Tum svatantr ho jaaoge’?”
Slave hamesha ghar mein nahin rahta; son hamesha rahta hai.
Isliye yadi son tumhein svatantr kare to tum vaastav mein svatantr ho jaaoge.
Main jaanta hun ki tum Abraham ke vanshaj ho, phir bhi tum meri murder karne ki taak mein ho; yah isliye ki tumne mere sandesh ko hraday mein grahan nahin kiya.
Main vahi kahta hun, jo mainne saakshaat apne pita ko karte hue dekha hai, lekin tum vah karte ho, jo tumne apne pita se suna hai.”
Unhonne Yeshu se kaha, “Hamaare pita Abraham hain.” Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Yadi tum Abraham ki children ho to Abraham ke jaisa vyavhaar bhi karo.
Tum meri murder karna chaahte ho—main, jisne God se receive sach tum par reveal kiya hai. Abraham ka vyavhaar aisa nahin tha.
Tumhaara vyavhaar tumhaare hi pita ke jaisa hai.” Is par unhonne virodh kiya, “Ham avaidh children nahin hain, hamaara ek hi pita hai—God.”
Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Yadi God tumhaare pita hote to tum mujhse love karte kyonki main God se hun. Main apni chaahat se nahin aaya; God ne mujhe bheja hai.
Meri baatein tum isliye nahin samajhte ki tummein mera sandesh sunne ki kshamta nahin hai.
Main sach kahta hun isliye tum mera faith nahin karte.
Is par Yahudi ague bole, “To kya hamaara yah mat sahi nahin ki tum shamriyaavaasi ho aur tummein dard denevaali aatma samaaya hua hai?”
Yeshu ne javaab diya, “Mujhmein dard denevaali aatma nahin hai. Main apne pita ka sammaan karta hun aur tum mera apmaan karte ho.
Main apni glory ke lie koshish nahin karta hun; ek hain, jo iske lie koshish karte hain aur nirnay bhi vahi karte hain.
Main tum par yah atal sach reveal kar raha hun: yadi koi meri teaching ka follow karega, uski maut kabhi na hogi.”

Is par Yahudiyon ne Yeshu se kaha, “Ab hamein nishchay ho gaya ki tummein dard denevaali aatma hai. Abraham aur bhavishyadvaktaaon ki maut ho chuki aur tum kahte ho ki jo koi tumhaari teaching ka follow karega, uski maut kabhi na hogi.
Kya tum hamaare pita Abraham se bhi bare ho? Unki maut hui aur bhavishyadvaktaaon ki bhi. Tum apne aapko samajhte kya ho?”
Yeshu ne javaab diya, “Yadi main khud ko gaurvaanvit karta hun to meri glory vyarth hai. Jinhonne mujhe gaurvaanvit kiya hai vah mere pita hain, jinhein tum apna God maante ho.

Tum unhein nahin jaante, main unhein jaanta hun. Yadi main yah kahta ki main unhein nahin jaanta to main bhi tumhaare jaisa jhutha saabit ho jaaunga. Main unhein jaanta hun, isliye unke orders ka follow karta hun.
Tumhaare pita Abraham mera din dekhne ki ummid mein magan hue the. Unhonne ise dekha aur aanandit hue.”
Tab Yahudiyon ne kataaksh kiya, “Tumhaari aayu to abhi pachaas varsh ki bhi nahin hai aur tumne Abraham ko dekha hai?”
Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Main tum par yah atal sach reveal kar raha hun: Abraham ke janm ke purv se hi main hun.”
Yah sunte hi unhonne Yeshu ka pathraav karne ke lie patthar utha lie lekin Yeshu unki nazar se bachte hue temple se nikal gae.
Vahaan se jaate hue raasta mein Yeshu ko janm se andha ek person mila,
Jise dekh unke disciples ne unse puchha, “Rabbi, kiske galti ke kaaran yah person andha janma—iske ya iske maata-pita ke?”
Yeshu ne javaab diya, “Na iske aur na hi iske maata-pita ke galti, ke kaaran lekin isliye ki ismein God ka kaam reveal ho.
Jab tak main duniya mein hun, main hi hun duniya ki roshni.”
Yah kahne ke baad unhonne zameen par thuka, thuk se mitti ka lep banaaya aur usse andhe person ki aankhon par lep kiya
Aur usse kaha, “Jaao, siloam ke kund mein dho lo.” Siloam ka arth hai bheja hua. Isliye usne jaakar dhoya aur dekhta hua lauta.
Tab uske parosi aur ve, jinhonne use iske purv bhiksha maangte hue dekha tha, aapas mein kahne lage, “Kya yah vahi nahin, jo baitha hua bhikh maanga karta tha?”
Kuchh ne pushti ki ki yah vahi hai. Kuchh ne kaha. “Nahin, yah sirf uske jaisa dikhta hai.” Jabki vah kahta raha, “Main vahi hun.”
Isliye unhonne usse puchha, “Tumhein nazar receive kaise hui?”
Usne javaab diya, “Yeshu naamak ek person ne mitti ka lep banaaya aur usse meri aankhon par lep kar mujhe command di, ‘Jaao, siloam ke kund mein dho lo.’ Mainne jaakar dhoya aur main dekhne laga.”
Unhonne usse puchha, “Ab kahaan hai vah person?” Usne javaab diya, “Main nahin jaanta.”
Tab ve us person ko jo pahle andha tha, Farisiyon ke paas le gae.
Jis din Yeshu ne use aankh ki roshni dene ki prakriya mein mitti ka lep banaaya tha, vah Shabbat tha.
Farisiyon ne us person se puchhtaachh ki ki usne nazar receive kaise ki? Usne unhein javaab diya, “Unhonne meri aankhon par mitti ka lep lagaaya, mainne unhein dhoya aur ab main dekh sakta hun.”

Is par kuchh Farisi kahne lage, “Vah person God ki or se nahin hai, kyonki vah Shabbat ke vidhaan ka follow nahin karta.” Lekin dusre kahne lage, “Koi galti karnevaala person aise adbhut chihn kaise dikha sakta hai?” Is vishay ko lekar unmein matbhed ho gaya.
Ath unhonne jo pahle andha tha us person se dobaara puchha, “Jis person ne tumhein aankhon ki roshni di hai, uske baare mein tumhaara kya mat hai?” Usne javaab diya, “Vah prophet hain.”
Yahudi aguein yah faith hi nahin kar pa rahe the ki vah, jo pahle andha tha, ab dekh sakta hai. Isliye unhonne uske maata-pita ko bulvaaya
Aur unse puchha, “Kya yah tumhaara son hai, jiske baare mein tum kahte ho ki vah janm se andha tha? Ab yah kaise dekhne laga?”
Uske maata-pita ne javaab diya, “Haan, yah to ham jaante hain ki yah hamaara son hai aur yah bhi ki yah andha hi janma tha;
Lekin ham yah nahin jaante ki yah kaise dekhne laga ya kisne use aankhon ki roshni di hai. Vah baalak nahin hai, aap usi se puchh lijie. Vah apne baare mein khud hi bataaega.”
Isliye uske maata-pita ne kaha tha, “Vah baalak nahin hai, aap usi se puchh lijie.”
Isliye Farisiyon ne jo pahle andha tha usko dobaara bulaaya aur kaha, “God ki glory karo. Ham yah jaante hain ki vah person galti karnevaala hai.”
Usne javaab diya, “Vah galti karnevaala hai ya nahin, yah to main nahin jaanta; haan, itna main zarur jaanta hun ki main andha tha aur ab dekhta hun.”
Is par unhonne usse dobaara savaal kiya, “Us person ne aisa kya kiya ki tumhein aankhon ki roshni mil gai?”
Usne javaab diya, “Main pahle hi bata chuka hun lekin aap logon ne suna nahin. Aap log baar-baar kyon sunna chaahte hain? Kya aap log bhi unke chele banna chaahte hain?”
Is par unhonne uski ullaahna karte hue usse kaha, “Tu hi hai uska chela! Ham to Moshe ke chele hain.
Ham jaante hain ki God ne Moshe se baatein ki thi. Jahaan tak is person ka savaal hai, ham nahin jaante ki vah kahaan se aaya hai.”
Usne unse kaha, “Tab to yah bare aashchary ka vishay hai! Aapko yah bhi maalum nahin ki vah kahaan se hain jabki unhonne mujhe aankhon ki roshni di hai!
Ham sabhi jaante hain ki God galti karnevaalon ki nahin sunte—vah uski sunte hain, jo God ke bhakt hai aur unki chaahat puri karte hai.
Aadikaal se kabhi aisa sunne mein nahin aaya ki kisi ne janm ke andhe ko aankhon ki roshni di ho.
Yadi vah God ki or se na hote to vah kuchh bhi nahin kar sakte the.”
Yah sun unhonne us person se kaha, “Tu! Tu to puri tarah se galti mein janma hai aur hamein sikhaata hai!” Yah kahte hue unhonne use Yahudi synagogue se baahar nikaal diya.
Yeshu ne usse kaha, “Use tumne dekha hai aur jo tumse baatein kar raha hai, vah vahi hai.”
Tab Yeshu ne kaha, “Main is duniya mein justice ke lie hi aaya hun ki jo nahin dekhte, ve dekhein aur jo dekhte hain, ve andhe ho jaaein.”
Vahaan khare kuchh Farisiyon ne in words ko sunkar kaha, “To kya ham bhi andhe hain?”
“Main tum Farisiyon par yah atal sach reveal kar raha hun. Vah, jo bhershaala mein dvaar se pravesh nahin karta lekin baara phaand kar ghusta hai, chor aur lutera hai,
Lekin jo dvaar se pravesh karta hai, vah bheron ka charvaaha hai.
Uske lie dvaarpaal dvaar khol deta hai, bherein uski aavaaj sunti hain. Vah apni bheron ko naam lekar bulaata aur unhein baahar le jaata hai.
Apni sab bheron ko baahar nikaal lene ke baad vah unke aage-aage chalta hai aur bherein uske pichhe-pichhe kyonki ve uski aavaaj pahchaanti hain.
Ve kisi anjaan ke pichhe kabhi nahin chaleingi lekin usse bhaageingi kyonki ve us anjaan ki aavaaj nahin pahchaantin.”
Yeshu ke is drishtaant ka matlab sunnevaale Farisi nahin samjhe ki vah unse kahna kya chaah rahe the.
Isliye Yeshu ne dobaara kaha, “Main tum par yah atal sach reveal kar raha hun: bheron ka dvaar main hi hun.
Ve sabhi, jo mujhse pahle aae, chor aur lutere the. Bheron ne unki nahin suni.
Chor kisi dusre purpose se nahin, sirf churaane, murder karne aur barbaadi karne aata hai; main isliye aaya ki ve life paaein aur bahutaayat ka life paaein.
“Main hi hun achchha charvaaha. Achchha charvaaha apni bheron ke lie apne jaan de deta hai.
Mazdur, jo na to charvaaha hai aur na bheron ka maalik, bheriye ko aate dekh bheron ko chhorkar bhaag jaata hai. Bheriya unhein pakarta hai aur ve titar-bitar ho jaati hain.
Isliye ki vah mazdur hai, use bheron ki koi chinta nahin hai.
“Main hi hun achchha charvaaha. Main apnon ko jaanta hun aur mere apne mujhe;
Thik jis tarah pita God mujhe jaante hain, aur main unhein. Bheron ke lie main apne jaan bheint kar deta hun.
Meri aur bhi bherein hain, jo ab tak is bhershaala mein nahin hain. Mujhe unhein bhi laana hai. Ve meri aavaaj suneingi; tab ek hi jhund aur ek hi charvaaha hoga.
Pita mujhse love isliye karte hain ki main apne jaan bheint kar deta hun—ki unhein dobaara receive karun.

Koi bhi mujhse mere jaan chhin nahin raha—main apne jaan apni chaahat se bheint kar raha hun. Mujhe apne jaan bheint karne aur use dobaara receive karne ka authority hai, jo mujhe apne pita ki or se receive hua hai.”
Yeshu ke is vaktavy ke kaaran Yahudiyon mein dobaara matbhed utpann ho gaya.
Unmein se kuchh ne kaha, “Yah dard denevaali aatma se pirit hai ya nipat sirphira. Kyon sunte ho tum uski?”
Kuchh dusre logon ne kaha, “Ye vachan dard denevaali aatma se pirit person ke nahin ho sakte; kya koi dard denevaali aatma andhon ko aankhon ki roshni de sakta hai?”
Shit ritu thi aur Yerushalem mein samarpan parv manaaya ja raha tha.
Yeshu temple parisar mein shalomon ke dvaara banaae hue mandap mein tahal rahe the.
Yeshu ne javaab diya, “Mainne to aapko bata diya hai, lekin aap hi faith nahin karte. Sabhi kaam, jo main apne pita ke naam mein karta hun, ve hi mere gavaah hain.
Meri bherein meri aavaaj sunti hain. Main unhein jaanta hun aur ve mere pichhe-pichhe chalti hain.
Main aur pita ek tatv hain.”
Tab Yahudiyon ne dobaara unka pathraav karne ke lie patthar utha lie.
Yeshu ne unse savaal kiya, “Mainne apne pita ki or se tumhaare saamne kai bhale kaam kie. Unmein se kis kaam ke lie tum mera pathraav karna chaahte ho?”
Yahudiyon ne javaab diya, “Bhale kaam ke kaaran nahin, lekin God-ninda ke kaaran: tum insaan hote hue khud ko God ghoshit karte ho!”
Yeshu ne unse puchha, “Kya tumhaare law mein yah nahin likha: mainne kaha ki tum ishvar ho?
Jinhein God ka sandesh diya gaya tha, unhein ishvar kahkar sambodhit kiya gaya—aur Scripture ka lekh tal nahin sakta,

To jise pita ne vishesh purpose pura karne ke lie alag kar duniya mein bhej diya hai, uske baare mein aap yah ghoshna kar rahe hain: ‘Tum God ki ninda kar rahe ho!’ Kya sirf isliye ki mainne yah daava kiya hai, ‘Main God ka son hun’?
Mat karo mujhmein faith yadi main apne pita ke kaam nahin kar raha.
Lekin yadi main ye kaam kar hi raha hun, to bhale hi tum mujhmein faith na karo, in kaamon mein to faith karo ki tum jaan jaao aur samajh lo ki pita God mujhmein hain aur main pita God mein.”
Is par unhonne dobaara Yeshu ko bandi banaane ka koshish kiya, lekin vah unke haath se bachkar nikal gae.
Iske baad Yeshu yardan nadi ke paar dobaara us jagah ko chale gae, jahaan pahle Yohan baptisma dete the aur vah vahin thahre rahe.
Vahaan kai log unke paas aane lage. Ve kah rahe the, “Yadypi Yohan ne koi adbhut chihn nahin dikhaaya, phir bhi jo kuchh unhonne inke baare mein kaha tha, vah sab sach hai.”
Laazros naamak person bimaar tha, jo Mariyam aur uski bahan maartha ke gaanv baithniyaah ka nivaasi tha.
Yah vahi Mariyam thi, jisne kimti aur shuddh sugandh dravy se Yeshu ke charnon ko malkar unhein apne keshon se ponchha tha, usi ka bhaai laazros asvasth tha.
Isliye bahnon ne Yeshu ko sandesh bheja, “Lord, aapka dear, laazros bimaar hai.”
Yah sunkar Yeshu ne kaha, “Yah bimaari maut ki nahin, lekin God ki glory ka saadhan banegi, jisse God ka son gaurvaanvit ho.”
Maartha, uski bahan Mariyam aur laazros Yeshu ke priyjan the.
Uski bimaari ke baare mein maalum hone par bhi Yeshu vahin do din aur thahre rahe, jahaan vah the.
Iske baad unhonne apne disciples se kaha, “Chalo, ham dobaara Yahudiya chalein.”
Disciples ne unse savaal kiya, “Rabbi, abhi to Yahudi ague pathraav dvaara aapki murder karna chaah rahe the, phir bhi aap vahaan jaana chaahte hain?”
Yeshu ne javaab diya, “Kya din mein prakaash ke baarah ghante nahin hote? Yadi koi din mein chale to vah thokar nahin khaata kyonki vah duniya ki roshni ko dekhta hai.
Lekin yadi koi raat mein chale to thokar khaata hai kyonki usmein roshni nahin.”
Iske baad Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Hamaara mitr laazros so gaya hai. Main ja raha hun ki use nind se jagaaun.”
Tab disciples ne unse kaha, “Lord, yadi vah sirf so gaya hai to svasth ho jaaega.”
Yeshu ne to uski maut ke baare mein kaha tha lekin disciple samjhe ki vah nind ke baare mein kah rahe the.
Is par Yeshu ne unse spasht words mein kaha, “Laazros ki maut ho chuki hai.
Yah tumhaare hi hit mein hai ki main vahaan nahin tha—ki tum faith karo. Aao, ab ham uske paas chalein.”
Tab thomos ne, jinka upnaam didumos tha, apne saathi disciples se kaha, “Aao, inke saath ham bhi marne chalein.”
Vahaan pahunchkar Yeshu ko maalum hua ki laazros ko kandra-qabr mein rakhe hue chaar din ho chuke hai.
Baithniyaah shehar Yerushalem ke paas, lagbhag tin kilomitar ki duri par tha.
Kai Yahudi aguein maartha aur Mariyam ke paas unke bhaai ki maut par shaanti dene a gae the.
Jaise hi maartha ko Yeshu ke shehar ke paas hone ki suchna mili, vah unse milne chali gai lekin Mariyam ghar mein hi rahi.
Maartha ne Yeshu se kaha, “Lord, yadi aap yahaan hote to mere bhaai ki maut na hoti.
Phir bhi main jaanti hun ki ab bhi aap God se jo kuchh maangeinge, vah aapko deinge.”
Yah kahkar vah laut gai aur apni bahan Mariyam ko alag le jaakar use suchit kiya, “Guruvar a gae hain aur tumhein bula rahe hain.”
Yah sunkar Mariyam tatkaal Yeshu se milne nikal pari.
Yeshu ne ab tak shehar mein pravesh nahin kiya tha. Vah vahin the, jahaan maartha ne unse bheint ki thi.
Jab vahaan shaanti dene aae Yahudiyon ne Mariyam ko ekaaek uthkar baahar jaate hue dekha to ve bhi uske pichhe-pichhe yah samajhkar chale gae ki vah kabr par rone ke lie ja rahi hai.
Yeshu ke paas pahunch Mariyam unke charnon mein gir pari aur kahne lagi, “Lord, yadi aap yahaan hote to mere bhaai ki maut na hoti.”
Yeshu ne use aur uske saath aae Yahudiyon ko rote hue dekha to unka dil vyaakul ho utha. Unhonne udaas word mein puchha,
“Tumne use kahaan rakha hai?” Unhonne unse kaha, “Aaie, Lord, dekh lijie.”
Yeshu roya!
Yah dekh shesh Yahudi kahne lage, “Dekho inhein (Yeshu ko) vah kitna dear tha!”
Lekin unmein se kuchh ne kaha, “Kya yah, jinhonne andhe ko aankhon ki roshni di, is person ko maut se bacha na sakte the?”
Dobaara bahut udaas hokar Yeshu kabr par aae, jo vastuth ek kandra thi, jiske pravesh dvaar par ek patthar rakha hua tha.
Yeshu ne vah patthar hataane ko kaha. Mritak ki bahan maartha ne aapatti reveal karte hue unse kaha, “Lord, use mare hue chaar din ho chuke hain. Ab to usmein se durgandh a rahi hogi.”
Yeshu ne usse kaha, “Kya mainne tumse nahin kaha tha ki yadi tum faith karogi to God ki glory ko dekhogi?”
Isliye unhonne patthar hata diya. Yeshu ne apni aankhein upar uthaai aur kaha, “Pita, main aapka thanks karta hun ki aapne meri sun li.
Main jaanta hun ki aap hamesha meri sunte hain lekin yahaan upasthit bhir ke kaaran mainne aisa kaha hai ki ve sab faith karein ki aapne hi mujhe bheja hai.”
Tab unhonne unche word mein pukaara, “Laazros, baahar a jaao!”
Vah, jo chaar din se mara hua tha, baahar a gaya. Uska saara body pattiyon mein aur uska chehra kapre mein lipta hua tha. Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Ise khol do aur jaane do.”
Yah dekh Mariyam ke paas aae Yahudiyon mein se anekon ne Yeshu mein faith kiya.
Lekin kuchh ne Farisiyon ko ja bataaya ki Yeshu ne kya-kya kiya tha.
Tab leader priests aur Farisiyon ne mahaasbha bulaai aur kaha: “Ham is person ke baare mein kya kar rahe hain? Yah adbhut chihnon par chihn dikha raha hai!
Tab sabha mein upasthit us varsh ke high priest kaayaafas ne kaha, “Aap na to kuchh jaante hain
Aur na hi yah samajhte hain ki saari janta ke vinaash ki bajaay sirf ek person raashtr ke hit mein praanon ka tyaag karna aapke lie bhala hai!”
Yah usne apni or se nahin kaha tha lekin us varsh ke high priest hone ke kaaran usne yah bhavishyvaani ki thi, ki raashtr ke hit mein Yeshu praanon ka tyaag kareinge,
Aur na keval ek janta ke hit mein lekin God ki titar-bitar hui children ko ikattha karne ke lie bhi.
Us din se ve sab ekjut hokar unki murder ki yojna banaane lage.
Isliye Yeshu ne Yahudiyon ke beech saarvajnik rup se ghumna band kar diya. Vahaan se vah banjar zameen ke paas apne disciples ke saath efraayim naamak shehar mein jaakar rahne lage.
Yahudiyon ka Fasah parv paas tha. Aas-paas se kai log Yerushalem gae ki Fasah mein sammilit hone ke lie khud ko saanskaarik rup se shuddh karein.
Ve Yeshu ki khoj mein the aur temple parisar mein khare hue ek dusre se puchh rahe the, “Tumhaara kya soch hai, vah parv mein aaega ya nahin?”
Leader priests aur Farisiyon ne Yeshu ko bandi banaane ke purpose se command de rakhi thi ki jis kisi ko unki jaankaari ho, vah unhein turant suchit kare.
Vahaan unke lie bhoj ka aayojan kiya gaya tha. Maartha khaana paros rahi thi aur Yeshu ke saath bhoj mein sammilit logon mein laazros bhi tha.
Vahaan Mariyam ne jataamaansi ke lagbhag tin sau mililitar kimti aur shuddh sugandh dravy Yeshu ke charnon par mala aur unhein apne keshon se ponchha. Saara ghar isse sugandhit ho gaya.
Is par unka ek disciple—kaariyotvaasi Yahudah, jo unke saath dhokha karne par tha, kahne laga,
“Yah sugandh dravy garibon ke liye tin sau dinaar mein kyon nahin becha gaya?”
Yah usne isliye nahin kaha tha ki vah garibon ki chinta karta tha, lekin isliye ki vah chor tha; dhanraashi rakhne ki zimmedaari uski thi, jismein se vah wealth chori karta tha.
Garib tumhaare saath hamesha raheinge lekin main tumhaare saath hamesha nahin rahunga.”
Parinaamasvrup, leader priest laazros ki bhi murder ki yojna karne lage,
Kyonki laazros ke kaaran kai Yahudi unhein chhor Yeshu mein faith karne lage the.
Agle din parv mein aae vishaal bhir ne suna ki Yeshu Yerushalem a rahe hain.

Ve sab khajur ke vrikshon ki daaliyaan lekar Yeshu se milne nikal pare aur unche word mein jay jaykaar karne lage. “Hoshaanna!” “Blessed hain vah, jo Lord ke naam mein a rahe hain!” “Blessed hain Israel ke raaja!”
Vahaan Yeshu gadhe ke ek bachche par baith gae—vaise hi jaisa ki Scripture ka lekh hai:
“Ziyon ki putri, bhaybhit na ho! Dekho, tumhaara raaja gadhe par baitha hua a raha hai.”

Unke disciple us samay to yah nahin samjhe lekin jab Yeshu ki glory hui to unhein yaad aaya ki Scripture mein yah sab unhin ke baare mein likha gaya tha aur bhir ne sab kuchh vachan ke hisaab se hi kiya tha.
Ve sab, jinhonne Yeshu ke dvaara laazros ko kabr se baahar bulaae jaate aur mare huon mein se dobaara jivit kie jaate dekha tha, unki gavaahi de rahe the.
Bhir ka unhein dekhne ke lie aane ka ek kaaran yah bhi tha ki ve Yeshu ke is adbhut chihn ke baare mein sun chuke the.
Yah sab jaankar Farisi aapas mein kahne lage, “Tumse kuchh bhi nahin ho pa raha hai. Dekho, saara duniya uske pichhe ho liya hai!”
Parv ki worship mein sammilit hone aae logon mein kuchh yunaani bhi the.
Unhonne Galil pradesh ke baithsaidaavaasi filippos se request ki, “Shrimaan! Ham Yeshu se bheint karna chaahte hain.”
Filippos ne aandreyaas ko yah suchna di aur un donon ne jaakar Yeshu ko.
Yah sunkar Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Insaan ke son ke gaurvaanvit hone ka samay a gaya hai.
Main tum par yah atal sach reveal kar raha hun: jab tak bij zameen mein parkar mar na jaae, akela hi rahta hai lekin yadi vah mar jaae to bahut phalta hai.
Yadi koi meri service karta hai, vah mere pichhe chale. Mera servant vahin hoga jahaan main hun. Jo meri service karta hai, uska pita God aadar kareinge.
“Is samay meri aatma vyaakul hai. Main kya kahun? ‘Pita, mujhe is situation se bacha lijie’? Lekin isi kaaran se to main yahaan tak aaya hun.
Pita, apne naam ka gaurav kijie.” Is par heaven se nikalkar yah aavaaj sunaai di, “Mainne tumhein gaurvaanvit kiya hai, aur dobaara gaurvaanvit karunga.”
Bhir ne jab yah suna to kuchh ne kaha, “Dekho, baadal garja!” Dusre kuchh ne kaha, “Kisi angel ne unse kuchh kaha hai.”
Is par Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Yah aavaaj mere nahin, tumhaare lie hai.
Is duniya ke justice ka samay a gaya hai aur ab is duniya ke haakim ko nikaal diya jaaega.
Jab main prithvi se unche par uthaaya jaaunga to sab logon ko apni or khinch lunga.”
Iske dvaara Yeshu ne yah sanket diya ki unki maut kis tarah ki hogi.
Bhir ne unse savaal kiya, “Hamne law mein se suna hai ki Yeshu ka astitv hamesha rahega. Aap yah kaise kahte hain ki insaan ke son ka unche par uthaaya jaana zaruri hai? Kaun hai yah insaan ka son?”

Tab Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Roshni tumhaare beech kuchh hi samay tak hai. Jab tak roshni hai, chalte raho, aisa na ho ki andhera tumhein a ghere kyonki jo andhera mein chalta hai, vah nahin jaanta ki kis or ja raha hai.
Jisse prophet yashaayaah ka yah vachan pura ho: “Lord, kisne hamaari baaton par faith kiya aur Lord ka haath kis par reveal hua hai?”
Yashaayaah ne yah varnan isliye kiya ki unhonne Lord ka prataap dekha aur uska varnan kiya.
Kyonki unhein God se receive aadar ki tulna mein insaanon se receive aadar adhik dear tha.
Kyonki jo koi mujhe dekhta hai, vah mere bhejnevaale ko dekhta hai.
“Main us person par dosh nahin lagaata, jo mere sandesh sunkar unka follow nahin karta kyonki main duniya par dosh lagaane nahin lekin duniya ke bachaav ke lie aaya hun.
Mainne apni or se kuchh nahin kaha, lekin mere pita ne, jo mere bhejnevaale hain, command di hai ki main kya kahun aur kaise kahun.

Fasah utsav ke purv hi Yeshu yah jaante the ki unka duniya ko chhorkar pita God ke paas laut jaane ka samay paas a gaya hai. Yeshu unse hamesha love karte rahe, jo duniya mein unke apne the lekin ab unhonne unse ant tak vaisa hi love rakha.
Shimon ke son kaariyotvaasi Yahudah ke man mein aarop lagaanevaala yah soch daal chuka tha ki vah Yeshu ke saath dhokha kare.
Bhoj ke samay Yeshu ne bhali-bhaanti yah jaante hue ki pita ne sab kuchh unke haath mein kar diya hai aur yah bhi, ki vah God ki or se aae hain aur God ke paas laut rahe hain,
Khaana ki mez se uthkar apne baahri kapre utaare, kamar mein angochha baandh liya
Aur ek bartan mein paani undelkar disciples ke paanv dhone aur kamar mein bandhe angochhe se ponchhne lage.
Jab vah Shimon Petros ke paas aae to Petros ne unse kaha, “Lord, aap mere paanv dhoeinge?”
Yeshu ne javaab diya, “Jo main kar raha hun, tum use is samay nahin, kuchh samay baad samjhoge.”
Petros ne kaha, “Nahin, Lord, aap mere paanv kabhi bhi na dhoeinge.” “Yadi main tumhaare paanv na dhoun to tumhaara mere saath koi sambandh nahin rah jaaega,” Yeshu ne kaha.
Is par Shimon Petros ne Yeshu se kaha, “Lord, tab to mere paanv hi nahin, haath aur sir bhi dho dijie.”
Yeshu ne kaha, “Jo snaan kar chuka hai, vah puri tarah saaf ho chuka hai, use zarurat hai sirf paanv dhone ki; tum log saaf ho lekin sabke sab saaf nahin.”
Yeshu yah jaante the ki kaun unke saath dhokha kar raha hai, isliye unhonne yah kaha: “Lekin sabke sab saaf nahin.”
Jab Yeshu disciples ke paanv dhokar, apne baahri kapre dobaara pahankar khaana ke lie baith gae, to unhonne disciples se kaha, “Tum samajh rahe ho ki mainne tumhaare saath yah kya kiya hai?
Tum log mujhe ‘Guru’ Aur ‘Lord,’ Kahte ho, sahi hi hai—kyonki main vah hun.
Isliye yadi mainne, ‘Lord’ Aur ‘Guru’ Hokar bhi tumhaare paanv dhoe hain, to sahi hai ki tum bhi ek dusre ke paanv dhoo.
Mainne tumhaare saamne ek aadarsh prastut kiya hai—tum bhi vaisa hi karo, jaisa mainne tumhaare saath kiya hai.
Main tum par yah atal sach reveal kar raha hun: slave apne maalik se barhkar nahin hota aur na hi koi bheja hua dut apne bhejnevaale se.
Ye sab to tum jaante hi ho. Sukhad hoga tumhaara life yadi tum inka follow bhi karo.

“Main tum sabke baare mein nahin kah raha hun—main jaanta hun ki mainne kinhein chuna hai. Main yah isliye kah raha hun ki Scripture ka yah lekh pura ho: jo meri roti khaata hai, usi ne mujh par laat uthaai hai.
Main tum par yah atal sach reveal kar raha hun: jo mere kisi bhi bheje hue ko grahan karta hai, vah mujhe grahan karta hai aur jo mujhe grahan karta hai, mere bhejnevaale ko grahan karta hai.”
Yah kahte-kahte Yeshu aatma mein vyaakul ho uthe. Unhonne kaha, “Main tum par yah atal sach reveal kar raha hun: tummein se ek mere saath dhokha karega.”
Disciple sandeh mein ek dusre ko dekhne lage ki guru yah kiske baare mein kah rahe hain.
Ek disciple, jo Yeshu ka vishesh priyjan tha, unke bahut paas baitha tha;
Shimon Petros ne usse sanket se puchha, “Lord aisa kiske baare mein kah rahe hain?”
Us disciple ne Yeshu se puchha, “Kaun hai vah, Lord?”
Yeshu ne javaab diya, “Jise main yah roti dubokar dunga, vah.” Tab unhonne roti Shimon ke son kaariyotvaasi Yahudah ko de di.
Tukra lete hi usmein aarop lagaanevaala sama gaya. Yeshu ne usse kaha. “Tumhein jo kuchh karna hai, shighr karo.”
Khaana par baithe kisi bhi disciple ko yah maalum na ho paaya ki unhonne yah usse kis matlab se kaha tha.
Kuchh ne yah samjha ki Yeshu usse kah rahe hain ki jo kuchh hamein parv ke lie chaahie, shighr mol lo ya garibon ko kuchh de do kyonki Yahudah ke paas wealth ki thaili rahti thi.
Isliye Yahudah tatkaal baahar chala gaya. Vah raat ka samay tha.
Jab Yahudah baahar chala gaya to Yeshu ne kaha, “Ab insaan ka son gaurvaanvit hua hai aur usmein God gaurvaanvit hue hain.
Yadi usmein God mahimit hue hain to God bhi use khud mahimit kareinge aur shighr hi mahimit kareinge.
“Main bas ab thori hi der tumhaare saath hun, tum mujhe dhunrhoge aur jaisa mainne Yahudi aguon se kaha hai, vaisa main tumse bhi kahta hun, ‘Jahaan main ja raha hun vahaan tum nahin a sakte.’
“Main tumhein ek nai command de raha hun: ek dusre se love karo—jaise mainne tumse love kiya hai, vaise hi tum bhi ek dusre se love karo.
Yadi tum ek dusre se love karoge to yah sab jaan leinge ki tum mere chele ho.”

Shimon Petros ne puchha, “Lord, aap kahaan ja rahe hain?” Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Jahaan main ja raha hun, vahaan mere pichhe chalte hue tum abhi nahin a sakte—tum vahaan kuchh samay baad aaoge.”
Petros ne unse dobaara puchha, “Lord, main aapke pichhe abhi kyon nahin chal sakta? Main to aapke lie apne jaan bhi de dunga.”
Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Tum mere lie apne jaan dene ka daava karte ho? Main tumse kahta hun, murg us samay tak baang nahin dega jab tak tum tin baar mujhe nakaar na doge.
Vah raasta tum jaante ho, jo mere thikaane tak pahunchaata hai.”
Thomos ne unse savaal kiya, “Lord, ham aapka thikaana hi nahin jaante to uska raasta kaise jaan sakte hain?”
Yadi tum vaastav mein mujhe jaante to mere pita ko bhi jaante. Ab se tumne unhein jaan liya hai aur unhein dekh bhi liya hai.”
Filippos ne Yeshu se request ki, “Lord, aap hamein pita ke darshan sirf kara dein, yahi hamaare lie kaafi hoga.”

“Filippos!” Yeshu ne kaha, “Itne lambe samay se main tumhaare saath hun, kya phir bhi tum mujhe nahin jaante? Jisne mujhe dekha hai, usne pita ko bhi dekh liya. Phir tum yah kaise kah rahe ho, ‘Hamein pita ke darshan kara dijie’?
Mera faith karo ki main pita mein hun aur pita mujhmein, nahin to kaamon ki gavaahi ke kaaran faith karo.
Mere naam mein tum jo kuchh maangoge, main use pura karunga jisse son mein pita ki glory ho.
Mere naam mein tum mujhse koi bhi request karo, main use pura karunga.
“Yadi tumhein mujhse love hai to tum mere orders ka follow karoge.
Main pita se request karunga aur vah tumhein ek aur sahaayak deinge ki vah hamesha tumhaare saath rahein:

Sach ka aatma, jinhein duniya grahan nahin kar sakta kyonki duniya na to unhein dekhta hai aur na hi unhein jaanta hai. Tum unhein jaante ho kyonki vah tumhaare saath rahte hain, aur vah tummein raheinge.
Kuchh hi samay shesh hai, jab duniya mujhe nahin dekhega lekin tum mujhe dekhoge. Main jivit hun isliye tum bhi jivit rahoge.
Us din tumhein yah maalum ho jaaega ki main apne pita mein hun, tum mujhmein ho aur main tummein.

Vah, jo mere orders ko accept karta aur unka follow karta hai, vahi hai, jo mujhse love karta hai. Vah, jo mujhse love karta hai, mere pita ka priyjan hoga. Main usse love karunga aur khud ko us par reveal karunga.”
Yahudah ne, (jo kaariyotvaasi nahin tha), unse savaal kiya, “Lord, aisa kya ho gaya ki aap khud ko to ham par reveal kareinge lekin duniya par nahin?”
Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Yadi koi person mujhse love karta hai to vah meri teaching ka follow karega; vah mere pita ka priyjan banega aur ham uske paas aakar uske saath nivaas kareinge.
Vah, jo mujhse love nahin karta, mere vachan ka follow nahin karta. Ye vachan, jo tum sun rahe ho, mere nahin, mere pita ke hain, jo mere bhejnevaale hain.
“Tumhaare saath rahte hue mainne ye sach tum par reveal kar die hain
Lekin sahaayak arthaat Holy Spirit, jinhein pita mere naam mein bhejeinge, tumhein in sab vishyon ki teaching deinge aur jo kuchh mainne tumse kaha hai, uski yaad dilaaeinge.
Tumhaare lie main shaanti chhore jaata hun; main tumhein apni shaanti de raha hun; vaisi nahin, jaisi duniya deta hai. Apne man ko vyaakul aur bhaybhit na hone do.
Yah ghatit hone se pahle hi mainne tumhein isse avgat kara diya hai ki jab yah ghatit ho to tum faith karo.
Ab main tumse adhik kuchh nahin kahunga kyonki duniya ka raaja a raha hai. Mujh par uska koi authority nahin hai.
Duniya yah samajh le ki main apne pita se love karta hun. Yahi kaaran hai ki main unke saare orders ka follow karta hun. “Utho, yahaan se chalein.
“Main hi hun sachchi daakhalta aur mere pita kisaan hain.
Us vachan ke dvaara, jo mainne tumse kaha hai, tum shuddh ho chuke ho.
Mujhmein sthir bane raho to main tummein sthir bana rahunga. Shaakha yadi lata se juri na rahe to phal nahin de sakti, vaise hi tum bhi mujhmein sthir rahe bina phal nahin de sakte.
Yadi tum mujhmein sthir bane raho aur mere vachan tummein sthir bane rahein to tumhaare maangne par tumhaari chaahat puri ki jaaegi.
Tumhaare phalon ki bahutaayat mein mere pita ki glory aur tumhaara mere disciple hone ka sabut hai.
“Jis tarah pita ne mujhse love kiya hai usi tarah mainne bhi tumse love kiya hai; mere love mein sthir bane raho.
Yah sab mainne tumse isliye kaha hai ki tummein mera khushi bana rahe aur tumhaara khushi pura ho jaae.
Yah meri command hai ki tum ek dusre se usi tarah love karo, jis tarah mainne tumse love kiya hai.
Isse shreshth love aur koi nahin ki koi apne mitron ke lie apne jaan de de.
Mainne tumhein slave nahin, mitr maana hai kyonki slave maalik ke kaaryon se anjaan rahta hai. Mainne tumhein un sabhi baaton ko bata diya hai, jo mujhe pita se mili hui hain.
Meri command yah hai: ek dusre se love karo.
Ki law ka yah lekh pura ho: unhonne akaaran hi mujhse nafrat ki.
“Jab sahaayak—sach ka aatma, jo pita se hain—aaeinge, jinhein main tumhaare lie pita ke paas se bhejunga, vah mere baare mein gavaahi deinge.
Ve synagogue se tumko nikaal deinge, itna hi nahin, vah samay bhi a raha hai jab tumhaara hatyaara apne kukarm ko God ki service samjhega.
Ye kukarm ve isliye kareinge ki unhonne na to pita ko jaana hai aur na mujhe.

Ye sach mainne tum par isliye reveal ki hai ki jab yah sab hone lage to tumhein yaad aae ki inke baare mein mainne tumhein pahle se hi saavdhaan kar diya tha. Mainne ye sab tumhein shuruaat mein isliye nahin bataaya ki us samay main tumhaare saath tha.
Ab main apne bhejnevaale ke paas ja raha hun, aur tummein se koi nahin puchh raha ki, ‘Aap kahaan ja rahe hain?’
Ye sab sunkar tumhaara dil shok se bhar gaya hai.
Phir bhi sach yah hai ki mera jaana tumhaare lie laabhdaayak hai kyonki yadi main na jaaun to vah svargiy sahaayak tumhaare paas nahin aaeinge. Yadi main jaaun to main unhein tumhaare paas bhejunga.
Vah aakar duniya ke saamne galti, righteousness aur justice ke baare mein doshon ko prakaash mein laaeinge:
Righteousness ke baare mein; kyonki main pita ke paas ja raha hun aur iske baad tum mujhe na dekhoge;
Justice ke baare mein; kyonki duniya ka haakim doshi thahraaya ja chuka hai.
“Mujhe tumse bahut kuchh kahna hai, lekin abhi tum use grahan karne ke saksham nahin ho.

Jab sahaayak—sach ka aatma—aaeinge, vah saari sach mein tumhaara maargdarshan kareinge. Vah apni or se kuchh nahin kaheinge, lekin vahi kaheinge, jo vah sunte hain. Vah tumhaare lie aanevaali ghatnaaon ko ujaagar kareinge.
Vahi mujhe gaurvaanvit kareinge kyonki vah mujhse receive baaton ko tumhaare saamne reveal kareinge.
Vah sab kuchh, jo pita ka hai, mera hai; isliye mainne yah kaha ki vah mujhse mili hui baaton ko tum par reveal kareinge.”
“Kuchh hi samay mein tum mujhe nahin dekhoge aur kuchh samay baad tum mujhe dobaara dekhoge.”

Is par unke kuchh disciple aapas mein soch-vimarsh karne lage, “Unka isse kya matlab hai ki vah hamse kah rahe hain, ‘Kuchh hi samay mein tum mujhe nahin dekhoge aur kuchh samay baad tum mujhe dobaara dekhoge’ Aur yah bhi, ‘Main pita ke paas ja raha hun’?”
Ve ek dusre se puchhte rahe, “Samajh nahin aata ki vah kya kah rahe hain. Kya hai yah kuchh samay baad jiske baare mein vah baar-baar kah rahe hain?”

Yah jaante hue ki ve unse kuchh puchhna chaahte hain, Yeshu ne unse savaal kiya, “Kya tum is vishay par soch kar rahe ho ki mainne tumse kaha ki kuchh hi samay mein tum mujhe nahin dekhoge aur kuchh samay baad mujhe dobaara dekhoge?
Main tum par yah atal sach reveal kar raha hun: tum rooge aur vilaap karoge jabki duniya khushi mana raha hoga. Tum shokaakul hoge lekin tumhaara shok khushi mein badal jaaega.
Prasav ke pahle aurat shokit hoti hai kyonki uska prasav paas a gaya hai lekin shishu ke janm ke baad duniya mein uske aane ke khushi mein vah apni dard bhul jaati hai.
Isi tarah abhi tum bhi shokit ho lekin main tumse dobaara milunga, jisse tumhaara dil aanandit hoga koi tumse tumhaara khushi chhin na lega.
Us din tum mujhse koi savaal na karoge. Main tum par yah atal sach reveal kar raha hun: yadi tum pita se kuchh bhi maangoge, vah tumhein mere naam mein de deinge.
Ab tak tumne mere naam mein pita se kuchh bhi nahin maanga; maango aur tumhein zarur receive hoga ki tumhaara khushi pura ho jaae.
“Is samay mainne ye sab baatein tumhein kahaavton mein bataayi hai lekin samay a raha hai, jab main pita ke baare mein kahaavton mein nahin lekin saaf words mein bataaunga.
Us din tum khud mere naam mein pita se maangoge. Main yah nahin kah raha ki mujhe hi tumhaari or se pita se request karni paregi.
Pita khud tumse love karte hain kyonki tumne mujhse love kiya aur yah faith kiya hai ki main God se aaya hua hun.
Haan, main—pita ka bheja hua—duniya mein aaya hun aur ab duniya ko chhor raha hun ki pita ke paas laut jaaun.”
Tab disciple kah uthe, “Haan, ab aap kahaavton mein nahin, saaf words mein samjha rahe hain.
Ab ham samajh gae hain ki aap sab kuchh jaante hain aur ab kisi ko aapse koi savaal karne ki zarurat nahin. Isliye ham faith karte hain ki aap God ki or se aae hain.”
Yeshu ne unse kaha, “Tumhein ab faith ho raha hai!”
Dekho, samay a raha hai lekin a chuka hai, jab tum titar-bitar ho apne aap mein vyast ho jaaoge aur mujhe akela chhor doge; lekin main akela nahin hun, mere pita mere saath hain.
“Mainne tumse ye sab isliye kaha hai ki tumhein mujhmein shaanti receive ho. Duniya mein tumhaare lie klesh hi klesh hai lekin aanandit ho ki mainne duniya par vijay receive ki hai.”
In baaton ke reveal karne ke baad Yeshu ne heaven ki or nazar uthaakar prayer ki. “Pita, vah samay a gaya hai. Apne son ko gaurvaanvit kijie ki son aapko gaurvaanvit kare.
Jo kaam aapne mujhe saumpa tha, use pura kar mainne prithvi par aapko gaurvaanvit kiya hai.
Isliye pita, aap mujhe apne saath usi glory se gaurvaanvit kijie, jo glory meri aapke saath duniya ki srishti se pahle thi.
“Mainne aapko un sab par pragat kiya, duniya mein se jinko chunkar aapne mujhe saumpa tha. Ve aapke the lekin aapne unhein mujhe saumpa tha aur unhonne aapke vachan ka follow kiya.
Ab ve jaan gae hain ki jo kuchh aapne mujhe diya hai, vah sab aap hi ki or se hai
Kyonki aapse receive aajnaaein mainne unhein de di hai. Unhonne unko grahan kiya aur vaastav mein yah jaan liya hai ki main aapse aaya hun; unhonne faith kiya ki aap hi mere bhejnevaale hain.
Aapse meri request duniya ke lie nahin lekin unke lie hai, jo aapke hain aur jinhein aapne mujhe saumpa hai.
Vah sab, jo mera hai, aapka hai, jo aapka hai, vah mera hai aur main unmein gaurvaanvit hua hun

Ab main duniya mein nahin rahunga; main aapke paas a raha hun, lekin ve sab duniya mein hain. Holy pita! Unhein apne us naam mein, jo aapne mujhe diya hai, surakshit rakhie ki ve ek hon jaise ham ek hain.

Jab main unke saath tha, mainne unhein aapke us naam mein, jo aapne mujhe diya tha, surakshit rakha. Mainne unki raksha ki; unmein se kisi ka barbaadi nahin hua, sivaay vinaash ke son ke; vah bhi isliye ki Scripture ka vachan pura ho.
“Ab main aapke paas a raha hun. Ye sab main duniya mein rahte hue hi kah raha hun ki ve mere khushi se paripurn ho jaaein.
Main aapse yah request nahin karta ki aap unhein duniya mein se utha lein lekin yah ki aap unhein us evil se bachaae rakhein.
Unhein sach mein apne lie alag kijie—aapka vachan saty hai.
Unke lie main khud ko samarpit karta hun ki ve bhi sach mein samarpit ho jaaein.
Pita! Ve sab ek hon; jaise aap mujhmein aur main aap mein, vaise hi ve hammein ek hon jisse duniya faith kare ki aap hi mere bhejnevaale hain.
Vah glory, jo aapne mujhe provide ki hai, mainne unhein de di hai ki ve bhi ek hon, jis tarah ham ek hain,
Aap mujhmein aur main unmein ki ve puri tarah se ek ho jaaein jisse duniya par yah saaf ho jaae ki aapne hi mujhe bheja aur aapne unse vaisa hi love kiya hai jaisa mujhse.

“Pita, meri chaahat yah hai ki ve bhi, jinhein aapne mujhe saumpa hai, mere saath vahin rahein, jahaan main hun ki ve meri us glory ko dekh sakein, jo aapne mujhe di hai kyonki duniya ki srishti ke pahle se hi aapne mujhse love kiya hai.
“He nitimaan pita, duniya ne to aapko nahin jaana lekin main aapko jaanta hun, aur unko yah maalum ho gaya hai ki aapne hi mujhe bheja hai.
Mainne aapko un par reveal kiya hai, aur reveal karta rahunga ki jis love se aapne mujhse love kiya hai, vahi love unmein bas jaae aur main unmein.”
In baaton ke kahne ke baad Yeshu apne disciples ke saath kidron ghaati paar kar ek bagiche mein gae.
Yahudah, jo unke saath dhokha kar raha tha, us jagah ko jaanta tha kyonki Yeshu vahaan aksar apne disciples se bheint kiya karte the.
Tab Yahudah romi sainikon ka dal, leader priests aur Farisiyon ke servants ke saath vahaan a pahuncha. Unke paas laaltenein, mashaalein aur shastr the.
Yeshu ne yah jaante hue ki unke saath kya-kya hone par hai, aage barhkar unse puchha, “Tum kise khoj rahe ho?”
“Naazrethvaasi Yeshu ko,” Unhonne javaab diya. Yeshu ne kaha, “Vah main hi hun.” Vishvaasghaati Yahudah bhi unke saath tha.
Jaise hi Yeshu ne kaha “Vah main hi hun,” Ve pichhe hate aur gir pare.
Yeshu ne dobaara puchha, “Tum kise khoj rahe ho?” Ve bole, “Naazrethvaasi Yeshu ko.”
Yeshu ne kaha, “Main tumse kah chuka hun ki vah main hi hun. Isliye yadi tum mujhe hi khoj rahe ho to inhein jaane do.”
Yah isliye ki khud unke dvaara kaha gaya-yah vachan pura ho “Aapke dvaara saumpe huon mein se mainne kisi ek ko bhi na khoya.”
Shimon Petros ne, jinke paas talvaar thi, use myaan se khinchkar high priest ke ek servant par vaar kar diya jisse uska daahina kaan kat gaya. (us servant ka naam maalkhos tha.)
Yah dekh Yeshu ne Petros ko command di, “Talvaar myaan mein rakho! Kya main vah pyaala na piun jo pita ne mujhe diya hai?”
Tab sainikon ke dal, senaapti aur Yahudiyon ke adhikaariyon ne Yeshu ko bandi bana liya.
Pahle ve unhein hanna ke paas le gae, jo us varsh ke high priest kaayaafas ka sasur tha.
Kaayaafas ne hi Yahudi aguon ko soch diya tha ki raashtr ke hit mein ek person ka jaan tyaag karna sahi hai.
Shimon Petros aur ek dusre disciple Yeshu ke pichhe-pichhe gae. Yah disciple high priest ki jaan pahchaan ka tha. Isliye vah bhi Yeshu ke saath high priest ke ghar ke parisar mein chala gaya
Lekin Petros dvaar par baahar hi khare rahe. Tab vah disciple, jo high priest ki jaan pahchaan ka tha, baahar aaya aur dvaar par niyukt daasi se kahkar Petros ko bhitar le gaya.
Dvaar par nidharmi us daasi ne Petros se puchha, “Kahin tum bhi to is person ke disciples mein se nahin ho?” “Nahin, nahin,” Unhonne javaab diya.
Thand ke kaaran servants aur sainikon ne aag jala rakhi thi aur khare hue aag taap rahe the. Petros bhi unke saath khare hue aag taap rahe the.
High priest ne Yeshu se unke disciples aur unke dvaara di ja rahi teaching ke baare mein puchhtaachh ki.

Yeshu ne unhein javaab diya, “Mainne duniya se khulkar baatein ki hain. Mainne hamesha sabhaagrihon aur temple mein teaching di hai, jahaan sabhi Yahudi ikattha hote hain. Gupt mein mainne kabhi bhi kuchh nahin kaha.
Aap mujhse savaal kyon kar rahe hain? Savaal unse kijie jinhonne mere pravchan sune hain. Ve jaante hain ki mainne kya-kya kaha hai.”
Yah sunte hi vahaan khare ek adhikaari ne Yeshu par vaar karte hue kaha, “Kya high priest ko uttar dene ka yahi dhang hai tumhaara?”
Yeshu ne kaha, “Yadi mera kahna galat hai to saabit karo magar yadi mainne jo kaha hai vah sahi hai to phir tum mujhe kyon maar rahe ho?”
Isliye Yeshu ko, jo abhi bhi bandhe hue hi the, hanna ne high priest kaayaafas ke paas bhej diya.
Isi bich logon ne Shimon Petros se, jo vahaan khare hue aag taap rahe the, puchha, “Kahin tum bhi to iske disciples mein se nahin ho?” Petros ne nakaarte hue kaha, “Main nahin hun.”
Tab high priest ke servants mein se ek ne, jo us person ka sambandhi tha, jiska kaan Petros ne kaat daala tha, unse puchha, “Kya tum vahi nahin, jise mainne uske saath upvan mein dekha tha?”
Petros ne phir asvikaar kiya aur tatkaal murg ne baang di.
Pau phatte hi Yahudi aguein Yeshu ko kaayaafas ke paas se raajamhal le gae; lekin unhonne khud bhavan mein pravesh nahin kiya ki kahin ve Fasah bhoj ke purv saanskaarik rup se ashuddh na ho jaaein.
Isliye Pilatos ne baahar aakar unse savaal kiya, “Kya aarop hai tumhaara is person par?”
Unhonne javaab diya, “Yadi yah person apraadhi na hota to ham ise aapke paas kyon laate?”
Pilatos ne unse kaha, “To ise le jaao aur apne hi niyam ke hisaab se khud iska justice karo.” Is par Yahudiyon ne kaha, “Kisi ke jaan lena hamaare authority mein nahin hai.”
Aisa isliye hua ki Yeshu ke ve vachan pure hon, jinke dvaara unhonne sanket diya tha ki unki maut kis tarah ki hogi.
Isliye bhavan mein lautkar Pilatos ne Yeshu ko bulvaaya aur savaal kiya, “Kya tum Yahudiyon ke raaja ho?”
Is par Yeshu ne usse savaal kiya, “Yah aapka apna soch hai ya dusre logon ne mere baare mein aapko aisa bataaya hai?”
Pilatos ne javaab diya, “Kya main Yahudi hun? Tumhaare apne hi logon aur leader priests ne tumhein mere haath saumpa hai. Bataao, aisa kya kiya hai tumne?”

Yeshu ne javaab diya, “Mera raajy is duniya ka nahin hai. Yadi is duniya ka hota to mere servant mujhe Yahudi aguon ke haath saumpe jaane ke khilaaf larte; lekin sach to yah hai ki mera raajy yahaan ka hai hi nahin.”

Is par Pilatos ne unse kaha, “To tum raaja ho?” Yeshu ne javaab diya, “Aap thik kahte hain ki main raaja hun. Mera janm hi isliye hua hai. Duniya mein mere aane ka purpose yahi hai ki main sach ki gavaahi dun. Har ek person, jo sachcha hai, meri sunta hai.”
“Kya hai sach?” Pilatos ne savaal kiya. Tab Pilatos ne dobaara baahar jaakar Yahudiyon ko suchit kiya, “Mujhe usmein koi dosh nahin mila
Lekin tumhaari ek parampra hai ki Fasah ke avsar par main tumhaare lie kisi ek kaidi ko riha karun. Isliye kya tum chaahte ho ki main tumhaare lie Yahudiyon ka raaja riha kar dun?”
Is par ve chillaakar bole, “Ise nahin! Baar-abbaas ko!” Jabki baar-abbaas vidrohi tha.
Isliye Pilatos ne Yeshu ko bhitar le jaakar unhein kore lagvaae.
Sainikon ne kaanton ka ek mukut gunthkar unke sir par rakha aur unke upar ek baingni kapde daal diya
Aur ve ek-ek kar unke saamne aakar unke chehra par prahaar karte hue kahne lage, “Yahudiyon ke raaja ki jay!”
Pilatos ne dobaara aakar bhir se kaha, “Dekho, main use tumhaare lie baahar la raha hun ki tum jaan lo ki mujhe usmein koi dosh nahin mila.”
Tab kaanton ka mukut va baingni kapde dhaaran kie hue Yeshu ko baahar laaya gaya aur Pilatos ne logon se kaha, “Dekho, ise!”

Jab leader priests aur servants ne Yeshu ko dekha to chillaakar kahne lage, “Krusdand! Krusdand!” Pilatos ne unse kaha, “Ise le jaao aur tum hi do ise maut dand kyonki mujhe to ismein koi dosh nahin mila.”
Yahudi aguon ne javaab diya, “Hamaara ek niyam hai. Us niyam ke hisaab se is person ko maut dand hi milna chaahie kyonki yah khud ko God ka son bataata hai.”
Jab Pilatos ne yah suna to vah aur adhik bhaybhit ho gaya.
Tab usne dobaara raajamhal mein jaakar Yeshu se puchha, “Tum kahaan ke ho?” Lekin Yeshu ne use koi uttar nahin diya.
Isliye Pilatos ne unse kaha, “Tum bolte kyon nahin? Kya tum nahin jaante ki mujhe yah authority hai ki main tumhein mukt kar dun aur yah bhi ki tumhein maut dand dun?”
Yeshu ne javaab diya, “Aapka mujh par koi authority na hota yadi vah aapko upar se na diya gaya hota. Bahut nich hai uska galti, jisne mujhe aapke haath saumpa hai.”

Parinaamasvrup Pilatos ne unhein mukt karne ke yatn kie lekin Yahudi aguon ne chilla-chillaakar kaha, “Yadi aapne is person ko mukt kiya to aap kaysar ke mitr nahin hain. Har ek, jo khud ko raaja darshaata hai, vah kaysar ka virodhi hai.”
Ye sab sunkar Pilatos Yeshu ko baahar laaya aur justice aasan par baith gaya, jo us jagah par tha, (jise ibri bhaasha mein gabbtha arthaat chabutra kaha jaata hai).
Yah Fasah ki taiyaari ke din ka chhatha ghanta tha. Pilatos ne Yahudi aguon se kaha. “Yah lo, tumhaara raaja.”

Is par ve chillaane lage, “Ise yahaan se le jaao! Le jaao ise yahaan se aur maut dand do!” Pilatos ne unse puchha, “Kya main tumhaare raaja ko maut dand dun?” Leader priests ne kaha, “Kaysar ke atirikt hamaara koi raaja nahin hai.”
Tab Pilatos ne krus-mrityudand ke lie Yeshu ko unke haath saump diya.
Yeshu apna krus khud uthaae hue, us jagah gaye jo ibri bhaasha mein golgotha kahlaata hai, jiska arth hai khopri ka jagah.
Vahaan unhonne Yeshu ko dusre do logon ke saath unke beech krus par charhaaya.
Pilatos ne ek patal par likhkar krus par lagva diya. Naazreth ka Yeshu, Yahudiyon ka raaja.
Yah kai Yahudiyon ne parha kyonki Yeshu ko krus par charhaae jaane ka jagah shehar ke paas hi tha. Yah ibri, laatini aur yunaani bhaashaaon mein likha tha.
Is par Yahudiyon ke leader priests ne Pilatos se kaha, “Yahudiyon ka raaja mat likhie lekin vah likhie, jo usne kaha tha: ‘Main Yahudiyon ka raaja hun.’ ”
Pilatos ne javaab diya, “Ab mainne jo likh diya, vah likh diya.”
Sainikon ne Yeshu ko krusit karne ke baad unke baahri kapre lekar chaar bhaag kie aur aapas mein baant lie. Unke andar ka kapde jor rahit upar se niche tak buna hua tha.

Isliye sainikon ne soch kiya, “Ise phaarein nahin lekin is par paasa pheinkkar nirnay kar lein ki yah kisko milega.” Sainikon ne jo kiya usse Scripture ka is lekh pura ho gaya: “Unhonne mera baahri kapra aapas mein baant liya, aur mere andar ke kapde ke lie paasa pheinka.”
Yeshu ke krus ke paas unki maata, unki maata ki bahan, klopas ki patni Mariyam aur magdaalaavaasi Mariyam khari hui thi.
Jab Yeshu ne apni maata aur us disciple ko, jo unka priyjan tha, vahaan khare dekha to apni maata se bole, “He aurat! Yah aapka son hai.”
Aur us disciple se bole, “Yah tumhaari maata hai.” Us din se vah disciple Mariyam ka rakhvaala ban gaya.
Iske baad Yeshu ne yah jaante hue ki ab sab kuchh pura ho chuka hai, Scripture ka lekh pura karne ke lie kaha, “Main pyaasa hun.”
Vahaan daakhras ke sirke se bhara ek bartan rakha tha. Logon ne usmein spanj bhigo jufa paudhe ki tahni par rakhkar unke chehra tak pahunchaaya.
Use chakhkar Yeshu ne kaha, “Ab sab pura ho gaya” Aur sir jhukaakar jaan tyaag die.

Vah Fasah ki taiyaari ka din tha. Isliye Yahudi aguon ne Pilatos se nivedan kiya ki un logon ki taangein torkar unhein krus se utaar liya jaae jisse ve Shabbat par krus par na rahein kyonki vah ek vishesh mahatv ka Shabbat tha.
Isliye sainikon ne Yeshu ke sang krus par charhaae gae ek person ki taangein pahle torin aur tab dusre ki.
Jab ve Yeshu ke paas aae to unhein maalum hua ki unke jaan pahle hi nikal chuke the. Isliye unhonne unki taangein nahin torin
Lekin ek sainik ne unki pasli ko bhaale se bedha aur vahaan se turant lahu va paani bah nikla.
Vah, jisne yah dekha, usne gavaahi di hai aur uski gavaahi sachchi hai—vah jaanta hai ki vah sach hi kah raha hai, ki tum bhi faith kar sako.
Yah isliye hua ki Scripture ka yah lekh pura ho: uski ek bhi haddi tori na jaaegi.
Scripture ka ek dusre lekh bhi is tarah hai: ve uski or dekheinge, jise unhonne bedha hai.
Thiyofilos mahoday, mere pahle abhilekh ka vishay tha Yeshu ki shikshaaein aur unke dvaara shuru kie gae ve kaam,
Jo unhonne apne chune hue apostles ko Holy Spirit ke nirdesh mein die gae orders ke baad heaven mein accept kar lie jaane tak kie.
Ek din Yeshu ne unhein ikattha kar command di, “Yerushalem us samay tak na chhorna, jab tak mere pita (God) dvaara ki gai promise, jiska varnan main kar chuka hun, puri na ho jaae.
Yohan to paani mein baptisma dete the lekin shighr hi tumko Holy Spirit mein baptisma diya jaaega.”
“Holy Spirit ke tum par utarne par tumhein power receive hoga aur tum Yerushalem, saare Yahudiya, shamriya aur prithvi ke dur-dur tak ke kshetron mein mere gavaah hoge.”
Tab ve us pahaari se, jise zaitun parvat bhi kaha jaata hai, Yerushalem laut gae. Yah jagah Yerushalem se lagbhag ek kilomitar duri par hai.

Shehar mein pahunchkar ve upar ke kamre mein ikattha ho gae, jahaan ve rah rahe the. Vahaan Petros, Yohan, Yaakob, aandreyaas, filippos, thomos, baartholomeyos, mattiyaah, halfeyos ke son Yaakob, Shimon zelotes aur Yaakob ke son Yahudah upasthit the.
Ye sabhi vahaan niymit rup se sach ke saath ek man hokar, Yeshu ki maata Mariyam, unke bhaaiyon aur dusre auraton ke saath prayer ke lie ikattha hone lage.
Tab ek din, jab lagbhag ek sau bis believer ikattha the, Petros unke bich khare hokar kahne lage,
“Dear bhaai bahino, Yeshu ko pakarvaane ke lie agua Yahudah, ke baare mein David ke maadhyam se Holy Spirit ke dvaara kaha gaya Scripture ka vachan pura hona zaruri tha.
Vah hammein se ek aur service ke kaary mein sahbhaagi tha.”
Adharm ki kamaai se usne zameen mol li. Vahaan vah sir ke bal aisa gira ki uska pet phat gaya aur uski saari aantein baahar bikhar gain.
Saare Yerushalem mein yah samaachaar phail gaya. Yahi kaaran hai ki vah zameen ab unhin ki bhaasha mein hakladma arthaat lahu-zameen ke naam se badnaam ho gai hai.
“Bhajan mein varnan hai: “ ‘Uski zameen ujaar ho jaae; aur usmein koi basne na paae,’ Aur yah bhi, “ ‘Koi dusre uska pad le le.’
Isliye yah zaruri hai ki ek aise person ko chuna jaae, jo Lord Yeshu ke kaaryon ke saare samay ka gavaah hai.
Isliye do naam sujhaae gae: Yosef jise baarsabbaas ke naam se jaana jaata hai, jiska upnaam tha yustas aur dusra person mattiyaas.
Tab unhonne yah prayer ki, “He manon ko jaanchnevaale Lord, ham par yah saaf kijie ki in donon mein se aapne kise chuna hai
Ki vah is service ke kaary aur apostles ki vah khaali jagah le, jisse mukt hokar Yahudah apne thahraae hue jagah par chala gaya.”
Tab unhonne chit daalein aur mat mattiyaas ke paksh mein pare, isliye vah gyaarah apostles mein sammilit kar liya gaya.
Yahudiyon ke pentekost parv ke din, jab disciple ek jagah par ikattha the,
Sahsa aakaash se tej aandhi jaisi aavaaj us kamre mein phail gai, jahaan ve sab baithe the.
Tab unke saamne aisi jvaala reveal hui jiska aakaar jibh ke jaisa tha, jo alag hokar unmein se pratyek person par jaakar thaharti gai.
Ve sabhi Holy Spirit se bharkar Holy Spirit dvaara di gai dusre bhaashaaon mein baatein karne lage.
Us samay aakaash ke niche ke har ek desh se aae shraddhaalu Yahudi Yerushalem mein hi thahre hue the.
Is kolaahal ko sunkar vahaan bhir ikattha ho gain. Ve sabhi aashcharyachkit ho gae kyonki ve sabhi har ek ko apni nij bhaasha mein baatein karte hue sun rahe the.
Achambhit ho ve ek dusre se puchh rahe the, “Kya ye sabhi galilvaasi nahin hain?
Tab yah kya ho raha hai, jo hammein se har ek videshi inhein hamaari apni-apni maatribhaasha mein baatein karte hue sun raha hai!
Paarthi, maadi, ilaami aur mesopotaamiyaavaasi, Yahudiya aur kappaadokiya, pontos aur aasiya,
Frijiya, pamfuliya, misr, aur libiyaavaasi, jo krete ke aas-paas hai; romi ke rahnevaale Yahudi aur dikshit Yahudi,
Kreti aur arbi, sabhi apni-apni maatribhaasha mein inke chehra se God ke paraakram ke baare mein sun rahe hain!”
Chakit aur ghabraakar ve ek dusre se puchh rahe the, “Yah kya ho raha hai?”
Lekin kuchh dusre thattha kar kah rahe the, “Inhonne kuchh adhik madhu hi pi rakhi hai.”

Tab gyaarah ke saath Petros ne khare hokar unche word mein kahna shuruaat kiya: “Yahudiyaavaasiyon aur Yerushalem vaasiyon, aapke lie is vishay ko samajhna bahut zaruri hai; isliye meri baaton ko dhyaanpurvak sunie:
Jaisa aap samajh rahe hain, ye person nashe mein nahin hain kyonki yah din ka tisra hi ghanta hai!
Vastut, yah yoel prophet dvaara ki gai is bhavishyvaani ki purti hai:
“Israaeli priyjan, dhyaan se sunie! Naazrethvaasi Yeshu ko, jinhein aap jaante hain, jinhein God ne aapke beech power ke kaamon, chamatkaaron aur chihnon ke dvaara reveal kiya,
God ki nirdhaarit yojna aur purv knowledge mein aapke haathon mein adharmiyon ki madad se saump diya gaya ki unhein krus-mrityudand diya jaae;
David ne unke baare mein kaha tha: “Main hamesha Lord ko nihaarta raha kyonki vah meri daayin or hain, ki main larakhra na jaaun.
Isliye mera dil aanandit aur meri jibh magan hui; iske alaava mera body bhi ummid mein bana rahega,
Aapne mujh par life ka raasta reveal kar diya. Aap mujhe apni upasthiti mein khushi se bhar deinge.
“Priyjan, purvaj David ke baare mein yah bilkul sach hai ki unki maut hui aur unke shav ko kabr mein bhi rakha gaya. Vah kabr aaj bhi vahin hai.
Isliye unke prophet hone ke kaaran aur isliye bhi ki unhein yah maalum tha ki God ne shapath li thi ki unhin ka ek vanshaj sinhaasan par baithaaya jaaega,
God ki daayin or sarvochch pad par baithkar, pita se receive Holy Spirit lekar unhonne ham par undel diya, jo aap khud dekh aur sun rahe hain.
Yadypi David us samay heaven nahin pahunche the taubhi unhonne khud kaha tha, “ ‘Lord ne mere Lord se kaha: “Meri daayin or baithe raho
Main tumhaare dushmanon ko tumhaare adhin karunga.”’
“Isliye saara Israel nishchit rup se yah jaan le ki inhin Yeshu ko, jinhein tum logon ne krusit kiya God ne Lord aur Yeshu pad se sammaanit kiya.”
Apostles dvaara kie ja rahe adbhut kaam aur adbhut chihn sabhi ke lie aashchary ka vishay ban gae the.
Ek din navein ghante par, jo prayer ka nirdhaarit samay tha, Petros aur Yohan temple ja rahe the.

Usi samay janm se apang ek person ko bhi vahaan le jaaya ja raha tha, jise pratidin temple ke oriyan arthaat sundar naamak dvaar par chhor diya jaata tha ki vah vahaan pravesh karte logon se bhiksha request kar sake.
Petros aur Yohan ko pravesh karte dekh usne unse bhikh maangi.
Petros aur Yohan ne uski or sidhe, ektak dekhte hue kaha, “Hamaari or dekho.”
Unse kuchh paane ki ummid mein vah unhein taakne laga.
Petros ne usse kaha, “Chaandi aur sona to mere paas hai nahin lekin main tumhein vah deta hun, jo mere paas hai: naazreth ke Yeshu ke naam mein svasth ho jaao aur chalne lago.”
Yah kahte hue unhonne uska daayaan haath pakarkar use uthaaya. Usi kshan uske paanvon aur takhnon mein bal-sanchaar hua,
Vah uchhalkar khara ho gaya aur chalne laga. Usne unke saath chalte, uchhalte-kudte, God ka gungaan karte hue temple mein pravesh kiya.
Vahaan sabhi ne use chalte phirte aur God ka gungaan karte hue dekha.
Yah jaankar ki yah vahi bhikshuk hai, jo temple ke sundar naamak dvaar par baitha karta tha, ve usmein yah parivartan dekh achambhit aur chakit rah gae.
Vah Petros aur Yohan ka saath chhor hi nahin raha tha. Vahaan upasthit chakit bhir daurti hui unke paas aakar shalomon ke osaare mein ikatthi hone lagi.

Yah dekh Petros, unhein sambodhit kar kahne lage: “Israaeli bandhuon, aap is person ya ham par itne chakit kyon hain? Hamein aise kyon dekh rahe hain maano hamne hi ise apne power aur bhakti ke dvaara chalne yogy banaaya hai?

Abraham, yitshaak aur Yaakob ke God, hamaare purvjon ke God ne apne servant Yeshu ko gaurvaanvit kiya, jinhein aap logon ne asvikaar karte hue Pilatos ke haathon mein saump diya—jabki Pilatos ne unhein chhor dene ka nishchay kar liya tha.
Aap logon ne ek holy aur righteous person ko asvikaar kar ek hatyaare ko chhura dene ki request ki.

Yeshu ke naam mein faith ke kaaran is person mein, jise aap jaante hain, jise aap is samay dekh rahe hain, bal-sanchaar hua hai. Yah person Yeshu ke naam mein sashakt kiya gaya aur Yeshu mein faith ke dvaara pure rup se svasth hua hai, jaisa ki aap khud dekh sakte hain.
“Priyjan, main yah jaanta hun ki aapne Yeshu ke khilaaf yah sab ajnaanta ke kaaran kiya hai, thik jaisa aapke shaaskon ne bhi kiya tha.
Lekin God ne sabhi bhavishyadvaktaaon ke dvaara yah pahle se hi ghoshna kar di thi ki unke Yeshu ke lie yah yaatna nirdhaarit hai. Yah usi ki purti hai.
Isliye pashchaataap kijie, God ki or man phiraaie ki aapke galti mita die jaaein, jiske phalasvrup Lord ki or se aapke lie vishraam aur shaanti ka samay a jaae
Aur vah Yeshu ko, jo aapke lie pahle se thahraae gae Yeshu hain, bhej dein,

Jinka heaven ke dvaara accept kiya jaana nishchit hai, jab tak God dvaara har ek vastu ki punahsthaapna ka samay na a jaae, jiski promise God ne praachin kaal mein apne bhavishyadvaktaaon ke maadhyam se ki thi.
Moshe ne yah ghoshna ki thi: ‘Lord, tumhaare God, tumhaare bich mein, tumhaare hi logon mein se tumhaare lie mere jaisa ek prophet ko uthaaeinge. Tum usi ke orders ka follow karoge.
“Shamuel prophet se lekar unke baadvaale sabhi bhavishyadvaktaaon dvaara bhi inhin dinon ke baare mein ghoshna ki gai hai.
Tum sab un bhavishyadvaktaaon aur us vaacha ki children ho, jiski sthaapna God ne hamaare purvjon ke saath Abraham se yah kahte hue ki thi.
God ne apne servant ko mare huon mein se uthaakar sabse pahle tumhaare paas bhej diya ki vah tummein se pratyek ko tumhaari buraaiyon se pherkar blessing provide karein.”
Jab ve bhir ko sambodhit kar hi rahe the, ki achaanak priest gan, temple rakhvaalon ka leader aur saduki unke paas a pahunche.
Unhonne unhein bandi banaakar agle din tak ke lie kaaraagaar mein daal diya kyonki din dhal chuka tha.
Unke sandesh ko sunkar anekon ne faith kiya, jinki sankhya lagbhag paanch hazaar tak pahunch gai.
Agle din Yahudiyon ke raaja, purniye aur shaastri Yerushalem mein ikattha the.
Vahaan high priest hanna, kaayaafas, Yohan, aleksaandros aur mahaayaajkiy vansh ke sabhi sadasy ikattha the.
Unhonne apostles ko sabke bich khara kar savaal karna shuruaat kar diya: “Tumne kis authority se ya kis naam mein yah kiya hai?”
Tab Holy Spirit se bharkar Petros ne javaab diya: “Sammaanniy raajaagan aur samaaj ke purniyon!
Yadi aaj hamaara parikshan isliye kiya ja raha hai ki ek apang ka kalyaan hua hai aur isliye ki yah person kis prakriya dvaara svasth hua hai,
Yeshu hi vah chattaan hain “ ‘Jinhein aap bhavan nirmaataaon ne thukra kar asvikrit kar diya, jo kone ka leader patthar ban gae.’
Petros aur Yohan ka yah saahas dekh aur yah jaankar ki ve donon anparh aur saadhaaran person hain, ve chakit rah gae. Unhein dhire dhire yah yaad aaya ki ye ve hain, jo Yeshu ke saathi rahe hain.
Lekin svasth hue person ki upasthiti ke kaaran ve kuchh na kah sake;
Unhonne unhein sabhaagaar se baahar jaane ki command di. Tab ve aapas mein soch-vimarsh karne lage,
“Ham inke saath kya karein? Yah to spasht hai ki inke dvaara ek asaadhaaran chamatkaar zarur hua hai aur yah Yerushalem nivaasiyon ko bhi maalum ho chuka hai. Is sach ko ham nakaar nahin sakte.
Lekin logon mein is samaachaar ka aur adhik prasaar na ho, ham inhein yah chetaavni dein ki ab ve kisi se bhi is naam ka varnan karte hue baatchit na karein.”
Tab unhonne unhein bhitar bulaakar command di ki ve na to Yeshu naam ka varnan karein aur na hi uske baare mein koi teaching dein.
Lekin Petros aur Yohan ne unhein javaab diya, “Aap khud nirnay kijie ki God ki nazar mein uchit kya hai: aapki command ka follow ya God ki command ka.
Hamse to yah ho hi nahin sakta ki jo kuchh hamne dekha aur suna hai uska varnan na karein.”

Is par Yahudi leaders ne unhein dobaara dhamki dekar chhor diya. Unhein yah sujh hi nahin raha tha ki unhein kis aadhaar par dand diya jaae kyonki sabhi log is ghatna ke lie God ki praise kar rahe the.
Us person ki umr, jo adbhut rup se svasth hua tha, chaalis varsh se adhik thi.
Mukt hone par apostles ne apne saathiyon ko ja bataaya ki leader priests aur purniyon ne unse kya-kya kaha tha.
Yah vivran sunkar un sabne ek man ho unche word mein God se prayer ki: “Param leader Lord, aap hi hain jinhonne heaven, prithvi, samudr aur inmein nivaas kar rahe praaniyon ki srishti ki hai.
Aapne hi Holy Spirit se apne servant, hamaare purvaj David ke dvaara kaha: “ ‘Raashtr krodhit kyon hote hain jaatiyaan vyarth yojnaaein kyon karti hain?
Prithvi ke raajaagan morcha baandhte aur shaasaklog Lord ke khilaaf aur unke abhishikt ke khilaaf ekjut ho uth khare hote hain.’
Yah ek sach hai ki is shehar mein Herodes aur pontiyos Pilatos donon hi israaeliyon aur gair-Yahudiyon ke saath milkar aapke dvaara abhishikt, aapke holy servant Yeshu ke khilaaf ekjut ho gae
Ki jo kuchh aapke power aur purpose ke hisaab se pahle se nirdhaarit tha, vahi ho.
Lord, unki dhamkiyon ki or dhyaan dijie aur apne slaves ko yah power dijie ki ve aapke vachan ka prachaar bina dar ke kar sakein
Jab aap apne saamarthyi sparsh ke dvaara changa karte aur apne holy servant Yeshu ke dvaara adbhut chihnon ka pradarshan karte jaate hain.”
Unki yah prayer samaapt hote hi vah bhavan, jismein ve ikattha the, tharathra gaya aur ve sabhi Holy Spirit se bhar gae aur bina dar ke God ke sandesh ka prachaar karne lage.
Disciples ke is samudaay mein sabhi ek man aur ek jaan the. Koi bhi apne wealth par apna authority nahin jataata tha. Un sabhi ka wealth ek mein mila hua tha.
Unmein koi bhi nirdhan nahin tha kyonki unmein jo kheton va makaanon ke maalik the, apni property bechkar usse receive dhanraashi laate
Aur apostles ke charnon mein rakh dete the, jise zarurat ke hisaab se nirdhnon mein baant diya jaata tha.
Yosef naamak ek saiprasvaasi Levi the, jinhein apostles dvaara baaranbaas naam diya gaya tha, jiska arth hai protsaahan ka son,
Unhonne apni zameen ko bech diya aur usse receive wealth laakar apostles ke charnon mein rakh diya.
Apostles dvaara logon ke beech kai adbhut chihn dikhaae ja rahe the aur Yeshu ke sabhi believer ek man hokar shalomon ke osaare mein ikattha hua karte the.
Phir bhi, adhikaadhik sankhya mein aurat-aadmi Lord mein faith karte chale ja rahe the.
Faith ke parinaamasvrup log rogiyon ko unke bichhaunon sahit laakar sarkon par litaane lage ki kam se kam us raasta se jaate hue Petros ki chhaaya hi unmein se kisi par par jaae.
Bari sankhya mein log Yerushalem ke aas-paas ke shehron se apne rogi aur dard denevaali aatmaaon ke sataaye parijnon ko lekar aane lage aur ve sabhi change hote jaate the.
Parinaamasvrup high priest aur uske saath saduki samprdaay ke baaki sadasy jalan se bhar gae.
Unhonne apostles ko bandi banaakar kaaraagaar mein band kar diya.

Is par ve praatahkaal temple mein jaakar teaching dene lage. High priest aur unke mandal ke vahaan ikattha hone par unhonne samiti ka adhiveshan aamantrit kiya. Ismein Israel ki mahaasbha ko bhi shaamil kiya gaya aur command di gai ki kaaraavaas mein bandi apostle unke saamne prastut kie jaaein
Lekin un adhikaariyon ne apostles ko vahaan nahin paaya. Unhonne lautkar unhein yah samaachaar diya,
“Vahaan jaakar hamne dekha ki kaaraagaar ke dvaar par taala vaisa hi laga hua hai aur vahaan prahri bhi khare hue the, lekin dvaar kholne par hamein kaksh mein koi bhi nahin mila.”
Is samaachaar ne temple ke leader rakshak aur leader priests ko ghabra diya. Ve soch karne lage ki is paristhiti ka parinaam kya hoga.
Jab ve isi udher-bun mein the, kisi ne aakar unhein bataaya ki jinhein kaaraagaar mein band kiya gaya tha, ve to temple mein logon ko teaching de rahe hain.

Yah sun temple ka leader rakshak apne adhikaariyon ke saath vahaan jaakar apostles ko mahaasbha ke saamne le aaya. Janta dvaara pathraav kie jaane ke dar se adhikaariyon ne unke saath koi bal prayog nahin kiya.
Unke vahaan upasthit kie jaane par high priest ne unse puchhtaachh shuru ki,

“Hamne tumhein kari command di thi ki is naam mein ab koi teaching mat dena, par dekho, tumne to Yerushalem ko apni teaching se bhar diya hai, aur tum is person ki murder ka dosh ham par marhne ke lie nishchay kar chuke ho.”
Petros aur apostles ne iska javaab diya, “Ham to insaanon ki bajaay God ke hi aajnaakaari raheinge.
Ham in ghatnaaon ke gavaah hain—aur Holy Spirit bhi, jinhein God ne apni command maannevaalon ko diya hai.”
Yah sun ve tilmila uthe aur unki murder ki kaamna karne lage.
Lekin gamaaliel naamak Farisi ne, jo law ke shikshak aur jansaadhaaran mein sammaanit the, mahaasbha mein khare hokar command di ki apostles ko sabhaakaksh se kuchh der ke lie baahar bhej diya jaae.
Tab gamaaliel ne sabha ko sambodhit karte hue kaha, “Israaeli bandhuon, bhali-bhaanti soch kar lijie ki aap inke saath kya karna chaahte hain.
Kuchh hi samay purv thaddeyos ne kuchh hone ka daava kiya tha aur chaar sau person uske saath ho lie. Uski murder kar di gai aur uske anuyaayi titar-bitar hokar barbaadi ho gae.
Iske baad galilvaasi Yahudah ne janganna ke avsar par sir uthaaya aur logon ko bharma diya. Vah bhi maara gaya aur uske anuyaayi bhi titar-bitar ho gae.
Isliye inke baare mein meri salaah yah hai ki aap inhein chhor dein aur inse dur hi rahein kyonki yadi inke kaary ki upaj aur yojna insaan ki or se hai to yah apne aap hi viphal ho jaaegi;
Magar yadi yah sab God ki or se hai to aap unhein barbaadi nahin kar paaeinge—aisa na ho ki is silsile mein aap khud ko God ka hi virodh karta hua paaein.”

Mahaasbha ne gamaaliel ka soch accept kar liya. Unhonne apostles ko kaksh mein bulvaakar kore lagvaae, aur unhein yah command di ki ve ab se Yeshu ke naam mein kuchh na kahein aur phir unhein mukt kar diya.
Apostle mahaasbha se khushi manaate hue chale gae ki unhein Yeshu ke kaaran apmaan-yogy to samjha gaya.

Us samay, jab is mat ke disciples ki sankhya mein bahut vriddhi ho rahi thi, yunaani bhaashi Yahudi ibri bhaashi Yahudiyon ke khilaaf yah shikaayat laae ki dainik khaana baantne mein unki vidhvaaon ki upeksha ki ja rahi thi.
Is par baarhon apostles ne sabhi disciples ki sabha aayojit kar unse kaha: “Hamaare lie yah thik nahin hai ki ham God ke vachan ki upeksha kar dusron ki service mein samay lagaaein.
Isliye bhaai bahino, apne mein se saat aise logon ko chun lo, jinke baare mein yah sabko maalum ho ki ve Holy Spirit aur samajh se bharpur hain. Ham yah zimmedaari unhin ko saump deinge
Lekin khud ham prayer, vachan ke prachaar aur teaching dene ke prati samarpit raheinge.”

Saari sabha ne is prastaav ko saharsh accept kar liya. Unhonne stefaanos, jo faith aur Holy Spirit se bharkar the, filippos, prokoros, nikaanor, timon, parminaas aur Yahudi mat mein haal hi mein shaamil hue antiyokhvaasi nikolos ko chun liya.
Inhein ve apostles ke saamne laae. Unhonne chune hue logon ke lie prayer ki aur un par haath rakhkar unhein service ke lie authority diya.
God ka vachan phailta chala gaya, Yerushalem mein disciples ki sankhya mein apaar vriddhi hoti gai aur kai priests ne bhi is vishvaasmat ko accept kar liya.
Grace aur power se bharkar stefaanos logon ke bich mein asaadhaaran adbhut chihn dikha rahe the.
Isi samay libartin synagogue se sambaddh kuchh sadasy, jo mul rup se kurena, aleksaandriya, kilikiya aur aasiya pradeshon ke nivaasi the, aakar stefaanos se vaad-vivaad karne lage.
Ve stefaanos ki buddhimatta aur Holy Spirit se apostle baaton ka saamna karne mein viphal rahe.
Isliye unhonne gupt rup se kuchh logon ko yah kahne ke lie phuslaaya, “Hamne ise Moshe aur God ke khilaaf nindniy words ka prayog karte hue suna hai.”
Unhonne stefaanos ke khilaaf janta, purniyon, aur shaastriyon ko uksaaya aur unhonne aakar stefaanos ko bandi banaaya aur unhein mahaasbha ke saamne le gae.
Vahaan unhonne jhuthe gavaah prastut kie jinhonne stefaanos par yah aarop lagaaya, “Yah person nirantar is holy jagah aur law ke khilaaf bolta rahta hai.
Hamne ise yah kahte bhi suna hai ki naazrethvaasi Yeshu is jagah ko barbaadi kar dega aur un sabhi prathaaon ko badal dega, jo hamein Moshe dvaara saumpi gai hain.”
Mahaasbha ke sab sadasy stefaanos ko ektak dekh rahe the. Unhein unka mukhmandal angel ke jaisa dikhaai diya.
High priest ne unse savaal kiya, “Kya yah aarop sach hai?”

Stefaanos ne use javaab diya, “Aadarniy guruvar aur bandhuon,” Kripya sunie: mahaamhim God ne hamaare purvaj Abraham ko unke haaraan pradesh mein aakar basne ke purv, jab vah mesopotaamiya mein the, divy darshan dete hue command di:
Apne pita ke ghar aur apne rishtedaaron ko chhorkar us desh ko chala ja, jo main tujhe dikhaaunga.

“Isliye vah kasdiyon ke desh ko chhorkar haaraan shehar mein bas gae. Iske baad unke pita ki maut ke baad, God unhein is zameen par le aae jis par aap nivaas kar rahe hain. God ne unhein is bhubhaag ka koi uttraadhikaar nahin diya;

Yahaan tak ki pair rakhne ka bhi jagah nahin. Lekin God ne unke us samay nihsantaan hone par bhi unse yah promise ki ki unke baad vah unke vanshjon ko yah zameen unki property ke taur par provide kareinge.
Tab God ne Abraham se kaha, ‘Yah sach hai tumhaare vansh ke log paraae desh mein pardeshi hokar raheinge, jahaan unhein slave bana liya jaaega, aur unhein chaar sau varsh tak duhkh deinge.
Phir jis desh ke ve slave honge, us desh ke logon ko main dand dunga, phir tumhaare vansh ke log vahaan se bahut wealth lekar nikleinge.’
“Jalan ke kaaran gotrpitaaon ne Yosef ko misr desh mein bech diya lekin God ki kripaadrishti Yosef par bani rahi.

Isliye God ne Yosef ko sabhi yaatnaaon se mukt kar unhein samajh provide ki aur misr desh ke raaja faroh ki kripaadrishti provide ki aur faroh ne unhein misr desh aur pure raajamhal par adhikaari bana diya.
“Tab saare misr aur kanaan desh mein akaal para jisse har jagah haahaakaar mach gaya aur hamaare purvjon ke saamne khaana ka abhaav ho gaya.
Lekin jab Yaakob ko yah maalum hua ki misr desh mein ann uplabdh hai, unhonne hamaare purvjon ko ann lene vahaan bheja, jinki yah pahli misr ki yaatra thi.
Jab ve ann lene vahaan dusri baar gae, Yosef ne khud ko apne bhaaiyon par reveal kar diya, jisse faroh Yosef ke parivaar se parichit ho gaya.
Tab Yosef ne apne pita aur saare parivaar ko, jinki sankhya pachhattar thi, misr desh mein bula liya.
Tab Yaakob misr desh mein bas gae aur vahin unki aur hamaare purvjon ki maut hui.
Unke avshesh shekem shehar laae gae aur unhein Abraham dvaara mol li gai kandra-qabr mein rakha gaya, jise Abraham ne shekem shehar ke nivaasi haamor ke sons ko daam dekar kharida tha.
“Jab God dvaara Abraham se ki gai promise ko puri karne ka samay aaya tab misr desh mein hamaare purvjon ki sankhya mein kai guna vriddhi ho chuki thi.
Us samay misr mein ek naya raaja bana, jo Yosef ko nahin jaanta tha.
Usne hamaare purvjon ke saath chaalaaki se bura vyavhaar kiya aur navjaat shishuon ko barbaadi karne ke lie vivash kiya ki ek bhi shishu bacha na rahe.
“Isi kaal mein Moshe ka janm hua. Vah God ki nazar mein chaahne yogy the. Tin maah tak unka follow poshan unke pita ke hi parivaar mein hua.
Jab unko chhupaae rakhna asambhav ho gaya, tab faroh ki putri unhein le gai. Usne unka follow poshan apne son jaise kiya.
Misr desh ki saari vidya mein Moshe ko prashikshit kiya gaya. Vah baatchit aur kartavy-follow karne mein prabhaavshaali the.
“Jab Moshe lagbhag chaalis varsh ke hue, unke man mein apne israaeli bandhuon se bheint karne ka soch aaya.
Vahaan unhonne ek israaeli ke saath anyaay se bhara vyavhaar hote dekh uski raksha ki aur sataae jaanevaale ke badle mein misrvaasi ki murder kar di.
Unka soch yah tha ki unke is kaam ke dvaara israaeli yah samajh jaaeinge ki God khud unhin ke dvaara israaeliyon ko mukt kara rahe hain lekin aisa hua nahin.
