Dusre din jab unhonne aapas mein larte hue do israaeliyon ke beech yah kahte hue mel-milaap ka koshish kiya, ‘Tum bhaai-bhaai ho, kyon ek dusre ko aahat karna chaah rahe ho?’
“Us anyaay karnevaale israaeli ne Moshe ko dhakka dete hue kaha, ‘Kisne tumhein ham par raaja aur justice karnevaala thahraaya hai?
Kahin tumhaara matlab kal us misri jaise meri bhi murder ka to nahin hai? Bolo!’
Yah sun Moshe vahaan se bhaag khare hue aur midiyaan desh mein pardeshi hokar rahne lage. Vahaan unke do son paida hue.
“Chaalis varsh vyatit hone par sinaay parvat ke banjar zameen mein ek jalti hui kantili jhaari aag ki lau mein unhein ek angel dikhaai diya.
Is drishy ne unhein aashcharyachkit kar diya. Jab vah ise nazdiki se dekhne ke purpose se jhaari ke paas gae to God ne unse kaha:
‘Main tumhaare purvjon ke pita arthaat Abraham, yitshaak aur Yaakob ka God hun.’ Moshe dar se kaampne lage aur upar aankh uthaane ka saahas na kar sake.
“Lord ne Moshe se kaha, apni pairon se jute utaar do, kyonki yah jagah, jis par tum khare ho, holy hai.

Misr desh mein meri people par ho raha atyaachaar mainne achchhi tarah se dekha hai. ‘Mainne unka karaahna bhi suna hai. Main unhein mukt karaane niche utar aaya hun. Suno, main tumhein misr desh bhejunga.’

“Yah vahi Moshe hain, jinhein israaeliyon ne yah kahte hue asvikaar kar diya tha, ‘Kisne tumhein ham par raaja aur justice karnevaala thahraaya hai?’ God ne unhin ko us angel dvaara, jo jhaari mein unhein dikhaai diya tha, raaja aur chhuraane vaala thahraakar bhej diya.
Yah vahi Moshe the, jinhonne unka naayak hokar unhein baahar nikaala aur misr desh, laal saagar aur chaalis varsh banjar zameen mein adbhut chihn dikhaate hue unka maargdarshan kiya.
“Yahi the vah Moshe, jinhonne Israel ki children ke saamne yah ghoshna pahle se hi ki thi, ‘Tumhaare hi deshvaasiyon mein se God mere hi jaisa ek prophet ko uthaaeinge.’

Yah vahi hain, jo banjar zameen mein israaeli samudaay mein us angel ke saath maujud the, jisne unse sinaay parvat par baatein ki aur jo hamaare purvjon ke saath the aur Moshe ne tumhein saump dene ke lie jinse jivit vachan receive kie.
“Hamaare purvaj unke aajnaapaalan ke ichchhuk nahin the. Ve man hi man misr desh ki kaamna karne lage.
Ve haaron se kahte rahe, ‘Hamaare aage-aage jaane ke lie devtaaon ko sthaapit karo. Is Moshe ki, jo hamein misr saamraajy se baahar lekar aaya hai, kaun jaane kya hua!’
Tab unhonne bachhre ki ek murti banaai, use bali charhaai aur apne haathon ke kaamon par utsav manaane lage.

Isse God ne unse munh morkar unhein aakaash ke nakshatron ki upaasna karne ke lie chhor diya, jaisa bhavishyadvaktaaon ke abhilekh mein likha hai: “ ‘He Israel ke vanshjon, nirjan pradesh mein chaalis saal tak kya tumne mujhe balidaan aur bheint charhaaya?
Tumne devta molek ki vedi ki sthaapna ki, apne devta refaan ke taare ko uncha kiya aur unhin ki murtiyon ko worship ke lie sthaapit kiya. Isliye main tumhein baabel se dur nikaal le jaaunga.’
“Banjar zameen mein gavaahi ka tambu hamaare purvjon ke paas tha. Iska nirmaan thik-thik God dvaara Moshe ko die gae nirdesh ke hisaab se kiya gaya tha, jiska aakaar khud Moshe dekh chuke the.

Hamaare purvaj is gavaahi ke tambu ko yahoshu ke netritv mein apne saath us zameen par le aae, jise unhonne apne authority mein le liya tha aur jahaan se God ne hamaare purvjon ke saamne se raashtron ko nikaal diya tha. Aisa David ke samay tak raha.
David par God ki kripaadrishti thi. David ne unse Yaakob ke God ke lie ek nivaas jagah banaane ki command chaahi.
Lekin is bhavan ka nirmaan shalomon dvaara kiya gaya.
“Sach to yah hai ki, param leader God insaan ke haath se bane bhavan mein vaas nahin karte. Prophet ki ghoshna hai:
“ ‘Heaven mera sinhaasan aur prithvi mere pairon ki chauki hai. Kis tarah ka ghar banaaoge tum mere lie? God ka kahna hai, ya kahaan hoga mera vishraam jagah?
Kya ye sabhi mere hi haathon ki rachna nahin?’

Kya kabhi bhi koi aisa prophet hua hai, jise aapke purvjon ne sataaya na ho? Yahaan tak ki unhonne to un bhavishyadvaktaaon ki murder bhi kar di jinhonne us righteous jan ke aagman ki pahle se hi ghoshna ki thi. Yahaan usi ki murder karke aap log vishvaasghaati aur hatyaare ban gae hain.
Yah sun saare sunnevaale tilmila uthe aur stefaanos par daant pisne lage.
Lekin Holy Spirit se bharkar stefaanos ne jab apni nazar heaven ki or uthaai, unhonne God ki glory ko aur Yeshu ko God ke daahini or khare hue dekha.
Stefaanos ne sunnevaalon ko sambodhit karte hue kaha, “Vah dekhie! Mujhe heaven khula hua aur insaan ka son God ke daahini or khare hue dikhaai de rahe hain.”
Yah sunte hi sunnevaalon ne chikhte hue apne kaanon par haath rakh lie. Phir ve gusse mein stefaanos par ek saath tut pare.

Unhonne stefaanos ko pakra aur ghasitte hue shehar ke baahar le gae aur vahaan unhonne pathraav karke unki murder kar di. Is samay unhonne apne baahri kapre shaaul naamak yuvak ke paas rakh chhore the.
Jab ve stefaanos ka pathraav kar rahe the, stefaanos ne Lord se is tarah prayer ki, “Lord Yeshu, meri aatma ko accept kijie.”
Tab unhonne ghutne tekkar unche word mein yah kaha, “Lord, inhein is galti ka doshi na thahraana.” Yah kahte hue stefaanos lambi nind mein so gae.
Stefaanos ki murder mein puri tarah shaaul sahmat tha.
Kuchh shraddhaalu logon ne stefaanos ke shav ki antyeshti ki aur unke lie gahra shok manaaya.
Shaaul church ko sata raha tha; vah gharon mein ghus, aurat-aadmiyon ko ghasitkar kaaraagaar mein daal raha tha.
Filippos ke adbhut chihnon ko dekh bhir ek man hokar unke pravchan sunne lagi.
Kai dard denevaali aatmaaon ke sataae huon mein se dard denevaali aatma unche word mein chillaate hue baahar a rahe the. Kai apang aur lakve ke pirit bhi svasth ho rahe the.
Shehar mein khushi ki lahar daur gai thi.
Usi shehar mein Shimon naamak ek person tha, jisne shamriya raashtr ko jaadu-tone ke dvaara chakit kar rakha tha. Vah apni mahaanta ka daava karta tha.
Chhote-bare sabhi ne yah kahkar uska loha maan rakha tha: “Yahi hai vah, jise God ki mahaashakti kaha jaata hai.”
Uske in chamatkaaron se sabhi bahut prabhaavit the kyonki usne unhein bahut dinon se apni jaadui vidya se chakit kiya hua tha.
Khud Shimon ne bhi faith kiya, baptisma liya aur filippos ka disciple ban gaya. Vah adbhut chihn aur power se bhare mahaan kaamon ko dekhkar hairaan tha.
Jab Yerushalem shehar mein apostles ko yah maalum hua ki shamriya shehar ne God ke vachan ko accept kar liya hai, unhonne Petros aur Yohan ko vahaan bhej diya.
Vahaan pahunchkar unhonne unke lie prayer ki ki ve Holy Spirit receive karein
Kyonki vahaan ab tak kisi par bhi Holy Spirit nahin utra tha. Unhonne Lord Yeshu ke naam mein baptisma sirf hi liya tha.
Tab apostles ne un par haath rakhe aur unhonne Holy Spirit receive kiya.
Jab Shimon ne yah dekha ki apostles ke sirf haath rakhne se Holy Spirit praapti sambhav hai, usne apostles ko yah kahte hue wealth dena chaaha,
“Mujhe bhi yah authority provide kar dijie ki main jis kisi par haath rakhun use Holy Spirit receive ho jaae.”
Lekin Petros ne usse kaha, “Sarvnaash ho tera aur tere wealth ka! Kyonki tune God ka vardaan wealth se receive karna chaaha.
Is service mein tera na koi bhaag hai na koi hissedaari, kyonki tera dil God ke saamne sachcha nahin hai.
Isliye sahi yah hoga ki tu apni durvritti se pashchaataap kare aur prayer kare ki yadi sambhav ho to Lord tere dil ki is buraai ko maafi karein,
Kyonki mujhe yah spasht dikhaai de raha hai ki tu karvaahat se bhara hua aur puri tarah galti mein jakra hua hai.”
Yah sun tonhe Shimon ne unse request ki “Aap hi Lord se mere lie prayer kijie ki aapne jo kuchh kaha hai, usmein se kuchh bhi mujh par asar na karne paae.”
Lord ke ek dut ne filippos se kaha, “Utho, dakshin disha ki or us raasta par jaao, jo Yerushalem se ajjaah shehar ko jaata hai.” Yah banjar zameen ka raasta hai.
Filippos is command ke hisaab se chal pare. Raasta mein unki bheint ek khoje se hui, jo ithiyopiya ki raani kandaake ki raajyasbha mein mantri tha. Vah worship ke lie Yerushalem aaya hua tha.
Vah svadesh lautte samay apne rath mein baithe hue prophet yashaayaah ka lekh parh raha tha.
Holy Spirit ne filippos ko command di, “Aage barho aur rath ke saath saath chalte jaao.”
Filippos daurkar rath ke paas pahunche. Unhonne us person ko prophet yashaayaah ke granth se parhte hue suna to usse savaal kiya, “Aap jo parh rahe hain, kya use samajh rahe hain?”
“Bhala main ise kaise samajh sakta hun jab tak koi mujhe ye sab na samjhaae?” Mantri ne javaab diya. Isliye usne filippos se rath mein baithne ki request ki.

Khoje jo bhaag parh raha tha, vah yah tha: “Vadh ke lie le jaae ja rahe memne ke jaisa usko le jaaya gaya, aur jaise un katarnevaale ke saamne memna shaant rahta hai, vaise hi usne bhi apna chehra na khola.
Apne apmaan mein vah justice se vanchit rah gae. Kaun unke vanshjon ka varnan karega? Kyonki prithvi par se unka life samaapt kar diya gaya.”
Khoje ne filippos se request ki, “Kripya mujhe bataaein, prophet yah kiska varnan kar rahe hain—apna, ya kisi aur ka?”
Jab ve raasta mein hi the, ek jalaashay ko dekh khoje ne filippos se puchha, “Yah dekhie, paani! Mere baptisma lene mein kya koi baadha hai?” [
Tab filippos ne rath rokne ki command di aur khud filippos va khoje donon paani mein utar gae aur filippos ne use baptisma diya.
Jab ve donon paani se baahar aae, sahsa filippos Lord ke aatma ke dvaara vahaan se utha lie gae. Vah khoje ko dobaara dikhaai na die. Khushi se bharkar khoja svadesh laut gaya,
Is samay shaaul par Lord ke disciples ko dhamkaane aur unki murder karne ki dhun chhaai hui thi. Vah high priest ke paas gaya
Aur unse damishk shehar ke Yahudi sabhaagrihon ke lie is purpose ke authority patron ki request ki ki yadi use is mat ke disciple—aurat ya aadmi—milein to unhein bandi banaakar Yerushalem le aae.
Jab vah damishk shehar ke paas pahuncha, ekaaek uske chaaron or heaven se ek bijli kaundh gai,
Vah zameen par gir para aur usne khud ko sambodhit karta hua ek word suna: “Shaaul! Shaaul! Tum mujhe kyon sata rahe ho?”
Iske uttar mein usne kaha, “Lord! Aap kaun hain?” Lord ne javaab diya, “Main Yeshu hun, jise tum sata rahe ho
Lekin ab utho, shehar mein jaao aur tumhein kya karna hai, tumhein bata diya jaaega.”
Shaaul ke sahyaatri avaak khare the. Unhein word to zarur sunaai de raha tha lekin koi dikhaai nahin de raha tha.
Tab shaaul zameen par se utha. Yadypi uski aankhein to khuli thi, vah kuchh bhi dekh nahin pa raha tha. Isliye uska haath pakarkar ve use damishk shehar mein le gae.
Tin din tak vah andha raha. Usne na kuchh khaaya aur na kuchh piya.
Damishk mein hananyaah naamak person Yeshu ke ek disciple the. Unse Lord ne darshan mein kaha. “Hananyaah!” “Kya command hai, Lord?” Unhonne javaab diya.
Lord ne unse kaha, “Sidha naamak gali par jaakar Yahudah ke ghar mein taarasyosvaasi shaaul ke baare mein puchho, jo prayer kar raha hai.
Usne darshan mein dekha hai ki hananyaah naamak ek person aakar us par haath rakhe ki vah dobaara dekhne lagein.”
Hananyaah ne sandeh vyakt kiya, “Lekin Lord! Mainne is person ke baare mein anekon se sun rakha hai ki usne Yerushalem mein aapke holy logon ka kitna bura kiya hai
Aur yahaan bhi vah leader priests se yah authority patr lekar aaya hai ki un sabhi ko bandi banaakar le jaae, jo aapke disciple hain.”

Hananyaah ne us ghar mein jaakar shaaul par apne haath rakhe aur kaha, “Bhaai shaaul, Lord Yeshu ne, jinhonne tumhein yahaan aate hue raasta mein darshan diya, mujhe tumhaare paas bheja hai ki tumhein dobaara aankhon ki roshni mil jaae aur tum Holy Spirit se bhar jaao.”
Turant hi uski aankhon par se papri jaisi giri aur vah dobaara dekhne laga, vah utha aur use baptisma diya gaya.
Khaana ke baad uske body mein bal laut aaya.

Unke sunnevaale chakit ho yah soch karte the, “Kya yah vahi nahin jisne Yerushalem mein unka bura kiya, jo Yeshu ke believer the aur vah yahaan bhi isi purpose se aaya tha ki unhein bandi banaakar leader priests ke saamne prastut kare?”
Lekin shaaul saamarthyi hote chale gae aur damishk ke Yahudiyon ke saamne yah pramaanit karte hue ki Yeshu hi Yeshu hain, unhein niruttar karte rahe.
Kuchh samay bitne ke baad Yahudiyon ne unki murder ki yojna ki
Lekin shaaul ko unki is yojna ke baare mein maalum ho gaya. Shaaul ki murder ke purpose se unhonne shehar dvaar par raat-din chauksi kari kar di
Lekin raat mein unke disciples ne unhein tokre mein baithaakar shehar ki shahrapnaah se niche utaar diya.

Yerushalem pahunchkar shaaul ne Yeshu ke disciples mein shaamil hone ka koshish kiya lekin ve sab unse bhaybhit the kyonki ve faith nahin kar pa rahe the ki shaaul bhi ab vaastav mein Yeshu ke disciple ho gae hain

Lekin baaranbaas unhein apostles ke paas le gae aur unhein spasht bataaya ki raasta mein kis tarah shaaul ko Lord ka darshan receive hua aur Lord ne unse baatchit ki aur kaise unhonne damishk shehar mein Yeshu ke naam ka prachaar nidarta se kiya hai.
Isliye shaaul Yerushalem mein apostles ke saath svatantrta purvak aate jaate rahne lage aur Yeshu ke naam ka prachaar nidarta se karne lage.
Vah yunaani bhaasha ke Yahudiyon se baatchit aur vaad-vivaad karte the jabki ve bhi unki murder ki koshish kar rahe the.
Jab dusre disciples ko iske baare mein maalum hua, ve unhein kayasriya shehar le gae jahaan se unhonne unhein taarasyos shehar bhej diya.
Petros in sabhi kshetron mein yaatra karte hue ludda naamak jagah ke santon ke bich pahunche.
Vahaan unki bheint ainiyaas naam ke person se hui, jo aath varsh se lakve se pirit tha.
Petros ne usse kaha, “Ainiyaas, Yeshu ke naam mein change ho jaao, utho aur apna bichhauna sambhaalo.” Vah turant uth khara hua.
Use changa hua dekhkar sabhi ludda shehar aur shaaron nagarvaasiyon ne Lord mein faith kiya.
Yoppa shehar mein tabitha naamak ek shishya thi. Tabitha naam ka yunaani anuvaad hai dorkas. Vah bahut hi bhali, kind aur paropkaari aurat thi aur udaartaapurvak daan diya karti thi.
Kisi rog se uski maut ho gai. Snaan ke baad use upri kamre mein lita diya gaya tha.

Ludda shehar yoppa shehar ke paas hai. Disciples ne Petros ke baare mein sun rakha tha, isliye logon ne do logon ko is request ke saath Petros ke paas bheja, “Kripya bina der kie yahaan aane ka kasht karein.”

Petros uthkar unke saath chal die. Unhein us upri kaksh mein le jaaya gaya. Vahaan sabhi vidhvaaein unhein gherkar rone lagi. Unhonne Petros ko ve sab kapde dikhaae, jo dorkas ne apne jivankaal mein banaae the.

Magar Petros ne un sabhi ko kaksh se baahar bhej diya. Tab unhonne ghutne tekkar prayer ki aur phir shav ki or munh karke command di, “Tabitha! Utho!” Us aurat ne apni aankhein khol din aur Petros ko dekh vah uth baithi.
Petros ne haath barhaakar use uthaaya aur disciples aur vidhvaaon ko vahaan bulaakar jivit dorkas unke saamne prastut kar di.
Saare yoppa mein yah ghatna sabko maalum ho gai. Anekon ne Lord mein faith kiya.
Petros vahaan kai din Shimon naamak person ke yahaan thahre rahe, jo vyavsaay se chamre ka kaam karta tha.
Kayasriya shehar mein korneliyos naamak ek person the, jo itaaliyan naamak sainy dal ke shataadhipti the.
Vah God par faith rakhnevaale person the. Vah aur unka parivaar, sabhi shraddhaalu the. Vah Yahudiyon ko udaar man se daan dete aur God se nirantar prayer karte the.
Din ke lagbhag navein ghante mein unhonne ek darshan mein spasht dekha ki God ke ek angel ne unke paas aakar unse kaha, “Korneliyos!”
Bhaybhit korneliyos ne angel ki or ektak dekhte hue savaal kiya, “Kya command hai, Lord?” Angel ne spasht kiya, “God dvaara tumhaari praarthnaaein aur tumhaare daan yaad kie gae hain.
Isliye apne servant yoppa shehar bhejkar Shimon naamak person ko bulva lo. Vah Petros bhi kahlaate hain.
Is samay vah Shimon naamak charmshodhak ke yahaan atithi hain, jiska ghar samudr ke kinaare par hai.”
Angel ke jaate hi korneliyos ne apne do servants aur unki nirantar service ke lie thahraae hue ek bhakt sainik ko bulvaaya
Aur unhein saari situation ke baare mein bataate hue yoppa shehar bhej diya.
Ye log dusre din chhathe ghante ke lagbhag yoppa shehar ke paas pahunche. Usi samay Petros ghar ki khuli chhat par prayer karne gae the.
Vahaan unhein bhukh lagi aur kuchh khaane ki chaahat bahut barh gai. Jab khaana taiyaar kiya hi ja raha tha, Petros dhyaanmagn ho gae.
Unhonne heaven ko khula dekha jahaan se ek vishaal chaadar jaisi vastu chaaron konon se niche utaari ja rahi thi.
Ismein prithvi ke sabhi tarah ke chaupaae, reingte hue jantu aur pakshi the.
Tab unhein ek word sunaai diya, “Utho, Petros! Maaro aur khaao!”
Petros ne javaab diya, “Katai nahin Lord! Kyonki mainne kabhi bhi koi apvitr aur ashuddh vastu nahin khaai hai.”
Unhein dusri baar word sunaai diya, “Jin vastuon ko khud God ne shuddh kar diya hai unhein ashuddh mat samjho.”
Tin baar dohraane ke baad turant hi vah vastu heaven mein utha li gai.
Petros abhi isi duvidha mein the ki is darshan ka arth kya ho sakta hai, korneliyos dvaara bheje gae person puchhtaachh karte hue Shimon ke dvaar par a pahunche.
Unhonne pukaarkar puchha, “Kya Shimon, jinka naam Petros bhi hai, yahin thahre hue hain?”
Petros abhi bhi usi darshan par soch kar rahe the ki Holy Spirit ne unse kaha, “Suno! Tin person tumhein khojte hue yahaan aae hain.
Nissankoch unke saath chale jaao kyonki khud mainne unhein tumhaare paas bheja hai.”
Petros niche gae aur unse kaha, “Tum jise khoj rahe ho, vah main hun. Kya kaaran hai tumhaare yahaan aane ka?”

Unhonne javaab diya, “Hamein shataadhipti korneliyos ne aapke paas bheja hai. Vah sach par chalnevaale, shraddhaalu aur sabhi Yahudi samaaj mein sammaanit hain. Unhein ek holy angel ki or se yah nirdesh mila hai ki vah aapko aamantrit kar sahaprivaar aapse vachan sunein.”
Petros ne unhein apne atithi hone ka aamantran diya.
Dusre din ve kayasriya shehar pahunche. Korneliyos unhin ki pratiksha kar rahe the. Unhonne apne sambandhiyon aur ghanishth mitron ko aamantrit kiya hua tha.
Jaise hi Petros ne unke nivaas mein pravesh kiya, korneliyos ne unke charnon mein girkar unki praise ki,
Lekin Petros ne unhein uthaate hue kaha, “Uthie! Main bhi sirf insaan hun.”
Unse baatchit karte hue Petros ne bhitar pravesh kiya, jahaan unhonne bari sankhya mein logon ko ikattha paaya.

Unhein sambodhit karte hue Petros ne kaha, “Aap sab yah to samajhte hi hain ki ek Yahudi ke lie kisi gair-Yahudi ke saath sambandh rakhna ya uske ghar milne jaana Yahudi niymon ke khilaaf hai lekin khud God ne mujh par yah reveal kiya hai ki main kisi bhi insaan ko apvitr ya ashuddh na maanun.
Yahi kaaran hai ki jab aapne mujhe aamantrit kiya main yahaan bina kisi aapatti ke chala aaya. Isliye ab main jaanna chaahta hun ki aapne mujhe yahaan aamantrit kyon kiya hai?”
Korneliyos ne unhein javaab diya, “Chaar din purv navein ghante main apne ghar mein prayer kar raha tha ki mainne dekha ki mere saamne ujle kapron mein ek person khara hua hai.
Usne mujhe sambodhit karke kaha, ‘Korneliyos, tumhaari prayer sun li gai hai aur tumhaare dvaara die gae daan God ne yaad kie hain.
Isliye ab kisi ko yoppa shehar bhejkar samudr ke kinaare par Shimon chamrevaale ke yahaan atithi hokar thahre Shimon ko, jinhein Petros naam se jaana jaata hai, bulva lo.’

Mainne turant aapko bulvaane ke lie apne servant bheje aur aapne yahaan aane ki grace ki hai. Ham sab yahaan isliye upasthit hain ki aapse vah sab sunein jise sunaane ki command aapko Lord ki or se receive hui hai.”
Petros ne unse kaha: “Ab main yah achchhi tarah se samajh gaya hun ki God kisi ke bhi pakshdhar nahin hain.
Har ek janta mein us person ko God angikaar karta hai, jo God mein shraddha rakhta aur vahi karta hai jo sahi hai.
Aap sabko maalum hi hai ki Galil pradesh mein Yohan dvaara baptisma ki ghoshna se shuru hokar saare Yahudiya pradesh mein kya-kya hua hai,

Kaise God ne Holy Spirit aur power se naazrethvaasi Yeshu ka abhishek kiya, kaise vah bhalaai karte rahe aur unhein svasth karte rahe, jo aarop lagaanevaala dvaara sataae hue the kyonki God unke saath the.
“Chaahe Yahudiya pradesh mein ya Yerushalem mein jo kuchh vah karte rahe ham uske pratyaksh saakshi hain. Unhin ko unhonne kaath par latkaakar maar daala.
Unke baare mein sabhi bhavishyadvaktaaon ki yah gavaahi hai ki unhin ke naam ke dvaara har ek person, jo unmein faith karta hai, galti maafi receive karta hai.”
Jab Petros yah kah hi rahe the, is pravchan ke har ek sunnevaale par Holy Spirit utar gae.
Kyonki ve unhein dusre bhaashaaon mein bhaashan karte aur God ka thanks karte sun rahe the. Is par Petros ne savaal kiya,
“Kaun inke paani-baptisma par aapatti utha sakta hai kyonki inhonne thik hamaare hi jaisa Holy Spirit receive kiya hai?”
Tab Petros ne unhein command di ki ve Yeshu ke naam mein baptisma lein. Petros se unhonne kuchh din aur apne saath rahne ki request ki.
Saare Yahudiya pradesh mein apostles aur disciples tak yah samaachaar pahunch gaya ki gair-Yahudiyon ne bhi God ke vachan-sandesh ko grahan kar liya hai.
Isliye Petros ne unhein kramaanusaar samjhaana shuru kiya,

“Jab main yoppa shehar mein prayer kar raha tha, avchetan avastha mein mainne darshan mein ek chaadar jaisi vastu ko chaaron konon se latke hue heaven se niche utarte dekha. Vah vastu mere ekdam paas a gai.
Use dhyaan se dekhne par mainne paaya ki usmein prithvi par ke sabhi chaupaaye, jangli pashu, reingte jantu aur aakaash ke pakshi the.
Usi samay mujhe yah word sunaai diya, ‘Utho, Petros, maaro aur khaao.’
“Mainne javaab diya, ‘Bilkul nahin Lord! Kyonki mainne kabhi bhi koi apvitr ya ashuddh vastu munh mein nahin daali.’
“Heaven se dobaara yah word sunaai diya, ‘Jise God ne shuddh ghoshit kar diya hai tum use ashuddh mat samjho.’
Tin baar dohraane ke baad vah sab heaven mein utha liya gaya.
“Thik usi samay tin person us ghar ke saamne a khare hue, jahaan main thahra hua tha. Ve kayasriya shehar se mere lie bheje gae the.
Holy Spirit ne mujhe command di ki main bina kisi aapatti ke unke saath chala jaaun. Mere saath ye chhah disciple bhi vahaan gae the, aur ham us person ke ghar mein gae.
Usne hamein bataaya ki kis tarah usne apne ghar mein us angel ko dekha, jisne use command di thi ki yoppa shehar se Shimon arthaat Petros ko aamantrit kiya jaae,
“Jab mainne pravchan shuru kiya un par bhi Holy Spirit utre—thik usi tarah, jis tarah vah shuruaat mein ham par utre the.
Tab mujhe Lord ke ye word yaad aae, ‘Nihsandeh Yohan paani mein baptisma deta raha lekin tumhein Holy Spirit mein baptisma diya jaaega.’

Yah sunne ke baad iske uttar mein ve kuchh bhi na kah paae lekin in words mein God ka thanks karne lage, “Iska matlab to yah hua ki life paane ke lie God ne gair-Yahudiyon ko bhi pashchaataap ki or ubhaara hai.”

Ve disciple, jo stefaanos ke sataahat ke phalasvrup shuruaat mein titar-bitar ho gae the, foynike, saipras aur antiyokh shehron mein ja pahunche the. Ye Yahudiyon ke atirikt dusre kisi ko bhi sandesh nahin sunaate the
Un par Lord ki kripaadrishti thi. Bari sankhya mein logon ne faith kar Lord ko grahan kiya.
Yah samaachaar Yerushalem ki church mein bhi pahuncha. Isliye unhonne baaranbaas ko antiyokh shehar bheja.
Vahaan pahunchkar jab baaranbaas ne God ke grace ke pramaan dekhe to vah bahut aanandit hue aur unhonne unhein puri lagan ke saath Lord mein sthir bane rahne ke lie protsaahit kiya.
Baaranbaas ek bhale, Holy Spirit se bhare hue aur faith mein paripurn person the, aur bahut bari sankhya mein log Lord ke paas laae gae.
Isliye baaranbaas ko taarasyos shehar jaakar shaaul ko khojna sahi laga.

Shaaul ke mil jaane par vah unhein lekar antiyokh shehar a gae. Vahaan church mein ek varsh tak rahkar donon ne kai logon ko teaching di. Antiyokh shehar mein hi sabse pahle Yeshu ke disciple masihi kahlaae.
Inhin dinon mein kuchh prophet Yerushalem se antiyokh aae.
Unhin mein se haagaabus naamak ek prophet ne Holy Spirit ki prerna se yah sanket diya ki saari prithvi par akaal parne par hai—yah kaysar klodiyos ke shaasankaal ki ghatna hai.
Isliye disciples ne Yahudiya pradesh ke Yeshu ke believer bhaai bahinon ke lie apni power ke hisaab se madad dene ka nishchay kiya.
Apne is nishchay ke hisaab se unhonne daanraashi baaranbaas aur shaaul ke dvaara purniyon ko bhej di.
Usi samay raaja Herodes ne church ke kuchh logon ko sataane ke purpose se bandi bana liya
Aur talvaar se Yohan ke bhaai Yaakob ki murder karva di.
Jab usne yah dekha ki uske aisa karne se Yahudi prasann hote hain, usne Petros ko bhi bandi banaane ka nishchay kiya. Yah akhmiri roti ke parv ka avsar tha.
Petros ko bandi banaakar usne un par chaar-chaar sainikon ke chaar dalon ka pahra laga diya ki Fasah parv samaapt ho jaane par vah un par mukaddma chalaae.
Petros ko kaaraagaar mein rakha gaya lekin church unke lie ek man se prayer kar rahi thi.
Un par mukaddma chalaae jaane se ek raat pahle Petros do sainikon ke beech beriyon se bandhe soe hue the. Aur dvaar ke saamne bhi chaukidaar pahra de rahe the.
Lord ka ek dut ekaaek vahaan reveal hua aur vah kamra roshni se bhar gaya. Angel ne Petros ko thapathpa kar jagaaya aur kaha, “Jaldi uthie!” Tatkaal hi Petros ki hathakriyaan gir parin.
Angel ne Petros se kaha, “Kapde aur jutiyaan pahan lijie” Petros ne aisa hi kiya. Tab angel ne unhein command di, “Ab upri kapra orh kar mere pichhe-pichhe a jaaie.”
Petros uske pichhe kaaraagaar se baahar a gae lekin vah yah samajh nahin pa rahe the ki jo kuchh angel dvaara kiya ja raha tha, vah sach thi ya sirf sapna.

Jab ve pahle aur dusre pahre ko paar karke us lohe ke darvaaze par pahunche, jo shehar mein khulta hai, vah dvaar apne aap khul gaya aur ve baahar nikal gae. Jab ve gali paar kar chuke to achaanak angel unhein chhorkar chala gaya.
Tab Petros ki sudh-budh lauti aur vah kah uthe, “Ab mujhe sach ka ahsaas ho raha hai ki Lord ne hi apne angel ko bhejkar mujhe Herodes se aur Yahudi logon ki saari ummidon se chhura liya hai.”
Yah jaankar vah Yohan arthaat maarkaas ki maata Mariyam ke ghar pahunche, jahaan kai disciple ikattha hokar prayer kar rahe the.
Unke khatakhtaane par roda naamak daasi dvaar par aai.
Petros ka word pahchaankar, khushi mein dvaar khole bina hi usne andar jaakar bataaya ki Petros baahar dvaar par khare hain.
Ve usse kahne lage, “Teri to mati maari gai hai!” Lekin jab vah apni baat par atal rahi to ve kahne lage, “Vah Petros ka angel hoga.”
Udhar Petros dvaar khatakhtaate rahe. Aakhirkaar jab unhonne dvaar khola, ve Petros ko dekhkar hakka-bakka rah gae.

Petros ne haath se shaant rahne ka sanket dete hue unhein bataaya ki Lord ne kis tarah unhein kaaraagaar se baahar nikaala. Petros ne unse kaha ki ve Yaakob aur dusre bhaai bahinon ko is baare mein bata dein. Tab vah khud dusri jagah chale gae.
Agle din subah sainikon mein bari khalabli mach gai ki Petros ka kya hua?
Herodes ne unki bahut khoj karvaai aur unhein kahin bhi na paakar usne pahredaaron ki jaanch ki aur un sabke lie maut dand ka order de diya.

Herodes sor aur sidonvaasiyon se bahut naaraaz tha. Ye log raaja ke ghar ki dekhbhaal karnevaale blaastos ki sahaanubhuti receive kar ek mat hokar mel-milaap ka prastaav lekar raaja ke paas aae the kyonki anaaj ki purti ke lie ve raaja ke kshetr par hi nirbhar the.
Herodes ne niyat din apne raajsi kapde dhaaran kar sinhaasan par viraajmaan ho people ko sambodhit karna shuruaat kiya.
Bhir chillaati rahi, “Yah maanav ka nahin, devta ka word hai.”
Usi kshan Lord ke ek dut ne Herodes par vaar kiya kyonki usne God ko glory nahin di thi. Uske body mein kire par gae aur uski maut ho gai.
Lord ka vachan barhta aur phailta chala gaya.
Baaranbaas aur shaaul Yerushalem mein apni service samaapt kar vahaan se laut gae. Unhonne Yohan ko, jo maarkaas naam se bhi prasiddh hain, apne saath le liya tha.

Antiyokh shehar ki church mein kai prophet aur shikshak the: baaranbaas, Shimon, jinka upnaam niger bhi tha, kureni lukiyos, manaayen, (jiska follow poshan raajy ke chauthaai bhaag ke raaja Herodes ke saath hua tha) aur shaaul.
Jab ye log Lord ki worship aur upvaas kar rahe the, Holy Spirit ne unse kaha, “Baaranbaas aur shaaul ko us service ke lie samarpit karo, jiske lie mainne unko bulaaya hai.”
Isliye jab ve upvaas aur prayer kar chuke, unhonne baaranbaas aur shaaul par haath rakhe aur unhein is service ke lie bhej diya.
Holy Spirit dvaara bheje gae ve selyukiya shehar gae aur vahaan se jalmaarg se saipras gae.
Jab ve saare dvip ko ghumkar paafos shehar pahunche, jahaan unki bheint baar-Yeshu naamak ek Yahudi person se hui, jo jaadugar aur jhutha prophet tha.
Vah raajypaal sergiyos Paulos ka sahyogi tha. Sergiyos Paulos wise person tha. Usne baaranbaas aur shaaul ko bulvaakar unse God ke vachan ko sunne ki abhilaasha vyakt ki
Lekin jaadugar elimos—jiske naam ka hi arth hai jaadugar—unka virodh karta raha. Uska koshish tha raajypaal ko God ke vachan mein faith karne se rokna,
Lekin shaaul ne, jinhein Paulos naam se bhi jaana jaata hai, Holy Spirit se bharkar use ektak dekhte hue kaha,
“He, saare chhal aur kapat se ot-prot aarop lagaanevaala ke kaput! Saare dharm ke bairi! Kya tu Lord ki sach ko bhrasht karne ke prayaason ko nahin chhorega?

Dekh le, tujh par Lord ka prahaar hua hai. Tu andha ho jaaega aur kuchh samay ke lie sury ki roshni na dekh sakega.” Usi kshan us par dhundhlaapan aur andhera chha gaya. Vah yahaan vahaan tatolne laga ki koi haath pakarkar uski madad kare.
Is ghatna ko dekh raajypaal ne Lord mein faith kiya, kyonki Lord ki teachings ne use chakit kar diya tha.
Paulos aur unke saathiyon ne paafos shehar se samudri yaatra shuru ki aur ve pamfuliya pradesh ke perge shehar mein ja pahunche. Yohan unhein vahin chhorkar Yerushalem laut gae.
Tab ve perge se hote hue pisidiya pradesh ke antiyokh shehar pahunche aur Shabbat par Yahudi synagogue mein jaakar baith gae.

Jab law aur bhavishyadvaktaaon ke granthon ka parhna samaapt ho chuka, synagogue ke adhikaariyon ne unse kaha, “Priyjan, yadi aap mein se kisi ke paas logon ke protsaahan ke lie koi vachan hai to grace kar vah use yahaan prastut kare.”
Is par Paulos ne haath se sanket karte hue khare hokar kaha. “Israaeli vaasiyon aur God ke shraddhaaluo, suno!
Israel ke God ne hamaare purvjon ko chuna aur misr desh mein unke ghar ki avdhi mein unhein ek phalvant raashtr banaaya aur Lord hi apne baahubal se unhein us desh se baahar nikaal laae;
Iske baad banjar zameen mein vah lagbhag chaalis varsh tak unke prati sahanshil bane rahe
Aur unhonne kanaan desh ki saat qaumon ko barbaadi kar unki zameen apne logon ko miraas mein de di.
Is saari prakriya mein lagbhag chaar sau pachaas varsh lage. “Iske baad God unke lie prophet shamuel ke aane tak nyaayaadhish thahraate rahe.
Phir Israel ne apne lie raaja ki request ki. Isliye God ne unhein binyaamin ke vansh se kish ka son shaaul de diya, jo chaalis varsh tak unka raaja raha.

God ne shaaul ko pad se hataakar uske jagah par David ko raaja banaaya jinke baare mein unhonne khud kaha tha ki yishai ka son David mere man ke hisaab se person hai. Vahi meri saari chaahat puri karega.

Apni tay ki hui service ka kaary pura karte hue Yohan ghoshna karte rahe, ‘Kya hai mere baare mein aapka faith? Main vah nahin hun. Yah samajh lijie: mere baad ek a rahe hain. Main jinki juti ka bandh kholne yogy tak nahin hun.’
“Abraham ki children, mere priyjan aur aapke bich, jo God ke shraddhaalu hain, sunein ki yahi bachaav ka sandesh hamaare lie bheja gaya hai.

Yerushalem vaasiyon aur unke shaaskon ne na to Yeshu ko pahchaana aur na hi bhavishyadvaktaaon ki aavaaj ko, jinka parhna har ek Shabbat par kiya jaata hai aur jinki purti unhonne Yeshu ko dand dekar ki,
Haalaanki unhein maar daalne ka unke saamne koi bhi aadhaar nahin tha—unhonne Pilatos se unke maut dand ki maang ki.
Jab Paulos aur baaranbaas Yahudi synagogue se baahar nikal rahe the, logon ne unse request ki ki ve aanevaale Shabbat par bhi isi vishay par aage pravchan dein.
Jab sabha samaapt hui kai Yahudi aur Yahudi mat mein se aae hue nae believer Paulos aur baaranbaas ke saath ho lie. Paulos aur baaranbaas ne unse God ke grace mein sthir rahne ki request ki.
Agle Shabbat par lagbhag saara shehar God ka vachan sunne ke lie umar para.
Us bari bhir ko dekh Yahudi jalan se bhar gae aur Paulos dvaara pesh kie gae vichaaron ka virodh karte hue unki ghor ninda karne lage.
Kyonki hamaare lie God ki command hai: “ ‘Mainne tumko gair-Yahudiyon ke lie ek roshni ke taur par chuna hai, ki tumhaare dvaara saari prithvi par bachaav laaya jaae.’ ”
Saare kshetr mein Lord ka vachan-sandesh phailta chala gaya.

Lekin Yahudi aguon ne shehar ki bhali, shraddhaalu auraton aur unche pad par baithe logon ko bharka diya aur Paulos aur baaranbaas ke khilaaf upadrav karva kar unhein apne kshetr ki sima se nikaal diya.
Lord ke disciple khushi aur Holy Spirit se bharte chale gae.
Ikoniyon shehar mein Paulos aur baaranbaas Yahudi sabhaagrihon mein gae. Vahaan unka pravchan itna prabhaavshaali raha ki bari sankhya mein Yahudiyon aur yunaaniyon ne faith kiya.
Lekin jin Yahudiyon ne faith nahin kiya tha, unhonne gair-Yahudiyon ko bharka diya aur unke manon mein inke khilaaf zahar bhar diya.
Vahaan unhonne Lord par aashrit ho, nidarta se sandesh dete hue kaafi samay bitaaya. Lord unke dvaara kie ja rahe adbhut chihnon ke maadhyam se apne grace ke sandesh ko saabit kar rahe the.
Vahaan ke naagrikon mein phut par gai thi. Kuchh Yahudiyon ke paksh mein the to kuchh apostles ke.
Yah maalum hone par ki shaaskon ke sahyog se Yahudiyon aur gair-Yahudiyon dvaara unhein apmaanit kar unka pathraav karne ki yojna banaai ja rahi hai,
Ve lukaaoniya, lustra aur darbe shehron aur unke upnagron ki or chale gae
Lustra shehar mein ek person tha, jo janm se apang tha aur kabhi chal phir hi na saka tha.
Vah Paulos ka pravchan sun raha tha. Paulos usko dhyaan se dekh raha tha aur yah paakar ki usmein svasth hone ka faith hai.
Paulos ne unche word mein use command di, “Apne pairon par sidhe khare ho jaao!” Usi kshan vah person uchhalkar khara ho gaya aur chalne laga.
Jab Paulos dvaara kie gae is kaam ko logon ne dekha ve lukaaoniyaai bhaasha mein chillaane lage, “Devta hamaare beech maanav taur par utar aae hain.”
Unhonne baaranbaas ko zyus naam se sambodhit kiya aur Paulos ko hermes naam se kyonki vah leader prachaarak the.
Shehar ke baahar zyus ka temple tha. Zyus ka priest bail aur pushphaar lie hue shehar faatak par a gaya kyonki vah bhir ke saath bali charhaana chaah raha tha.
Yah maalum hone par apostle Paulos va baaranbaas apne kapre phaarkar, yah chillaate hue bhir ki or lapke,
Haalaanki unhonne pichhle yugon mein jantaaon ko unki apni maanytaaon ke hisaab se vyavhaar karne diya.

To bhi unhonne khud apne baare mein gavaah spasht rakha—vah bhalaai karte hue aakaash se varsha aur rituon ke hisaab se hamein upaj provide karte rahe. Vah paryaapt khaana aur khushi provide karte hue hamaare manon ko tript karte rahe hain.”
Unke itni safaai dene ke baad bhi bhir ko unke lie bali bheint charhaane se bari kathinaai se roka ja saka.
Tab kuchh Yahudi antiyokh aur ikoniyon shehron se vahaan a pahunche. Bhir ko apne paksh mein karke unhonne Paulos ka pathraav kiya aur unhein mara hua samajh ghasitkar shehar ke baahar chhor aae.
Lekin jab disciple unke aas-paas ikattha hue, vah uth khare hue aur shehar mein laut gae. Agle din vah baaranbaas ke saath vahaan se darbe shehar ko chale gae.
Ve disciples ko drirh karte aur protsaahit karte hue yah teaching dete rahe ki unka God ke kingdom mein pravesh hetu is faith mein sthir rahna aur kai vipattiyon ko sahna zaruri hai.
Paulos aur baaranbaas har ek church mein upvaas aur prayer ke saath praachinon ko chuna karte aur unhein unhin Lord ke haathon mein saump dete the jis Lord mein unhonne faith kiya tha.
Pisidiya kshetr mein se jaate hue ve pamfuliya shehar mein aae.
Vahaan se perge shehar mein vachan sunaakar ve attaaliya shehar gae.
Vahaan se jalmaarg ve antiyokh shehar pahunche, jahaan se unhein God ke grace mein saumpkar us kaam ke lie bheja gaya tha, jise ve ab pura kar laut aae the.

Vahaan pahunchkar unhonne saari church ko ikattha kiya aur sabke saamne un sabhi kaamon ka varnan kiya, jo God dvaara unke maadhyam se pure kie gae the aur yah bhi ki kis tarah God ne gair-Yahudiyon ke lie faith ka dvaar khol diya hai.
Vahaan ve disciples ke bich lambe samay tak rahe.

Is baare mein Paulos aur baaranbaas ka unke saath gahra matbhed ho gaya aur unmein ugr vivaad chhir gaya. Tab ek mat hokar yah nishchay kiya gaya ki Paulos aur baaranbaas ko kuchh dusre disciples ke saath is vishay par soch-vimarsh ke purpose se apostles aur purniyon ke paas Yerushalem bhej diya jaae.

Church ne unhein vida kiya. Tab ve foynike aur shamriya pradeshon se hote hue aage barhe aur vahaan bhi gair-Yahudiyon dvaara Yeshu ko accept kie jaane ka vistrit varnan karte gae jisse sabhi disciples mein apaar harsh ki lahar daur gai.
Unke Yerushalem pahunchne par church, apostles aur purniyon ne unka svaagat kiya. Paulos aur baaranbaas ne unhein un sabhi kaamon ka vivran diya, jo God ne unke maadhyam se kie the.
Apostle aur praachin is vishay par soch-vimarsh ke purpose se ikattha hue.
Manon ko jaanchnevaale God ne thik hamaare jaise unhein bhi Holy Spirit provide karke iski gavaahi di.
Unhonne unke dil faith dvaara shuddh karke hamaare aur unke bich koi bhed na rahne diya.
Isliye ab tum log in disciples ki gardan par vah jua rakhkar God ko kyon parakh rahe ho, jise na to ham aur na hamaare purvaj hi utha paae?
Hamaara faith to yah hai ki Lord Yeshu ke grace ke dvaara hamaara bachaav thik vaise hi hua hai jaise unka.”
Baaranbaas aur Paulos ke bhaashan ko sabha ke sabhi sadasy chupchaap sun rahe the ki God ne kis tarah unke maadhyam se gair-Yahudiyon ke bich adbhut chihn dikhaae hain.
Unke bhaashan ke khatm hone par Yaakob ne sabha ko sambodhit kiya, “Priyjan, mera soch yah hai:
Shimon ne is baat ki or hamaara dhyaan aakarshit kiya hai ki shuruaat mein God ne kis tarah gair-Yahudiyon mein se apne lie people ka nirmaan karne mein ruchi reveal ki hai.
Bhavishyadvaktaaon ke abhilekh bhi iska samarthan karte hain, jaisa ki likha hai:
“ ‘In ghatnaaon ke baad main laut aaunga aur David ke dhvast mandap ko dobaara banaaunga. Aur khandahron ko dobaara banaakar phir khara karunga,
Jisse shesh maanav jaati God ko pa sake, aur ve sabhi gair-Yahudi bhi, jin par mere naam ki chhaap lagi hai.’ Yah unhin Lord ki aavaaj hai,
Jo puraatan kaal se in baaton ko reveal karte aae hain.
“Isliye mera phaisla yah hai, ki ham un gair-Yahudiyon ke lie koi kathinaai utpann na karein, jo God ki or phir rahe hain.

Lekin achchha yah hoga ki ham unhein yah command likh bhejein ki ve murtiyon ki ashuddhta se khud ko bachaae rakhein, veshyaagaami aur gala ghont kar maare gae pashuon ke maans se dur rahein aur lahu ka sevan na karein.

Isliye saari church ke saath apostles aur purniyon ko yah sahi laga ki apne hi bich se kuchh logon ko chunkar Paulos aur baaranbaas ke saath antiyokh shehar bhej diya jaae. Unhonne iske lie Yahudah, jise baarsabbaas naam se bhi jaana jaata hai aur silaas ko chun liya. Ye unke bich leader maane jaate the.
Unke haath se bheja patr yah tha: apostles, purniyon aur bhaaiyon ki or se: antiyokh, siriya aur kilikiya pradesh ke gair-Yahudi vishvaasiyo, aap sabhi ko namaskaar!
Hamein yah maalum hua hai ki hamaare hi beech se kuchh baahri logon ne apni baaton ke dvaara tumhaare manon ko vichlit kar diya hai.
Ath hamne ek mat se hamaare dear mitr baaranbaas aur Paulos ke saath kuchh logon ko tumhaare paas bhejna sahi samjha.
Ye ve hain, jinhonne hamaare Lord Yeshu ke lie apne praanon ka jokhim uthaaya hai.
Isliye ham Yahudah aur silaas ko tumhaare paas bhej rahe hain ki tum khud unhin ke chehra se is vishay ko sun sako
Kyonki Holy Spirit aur khud hamein yah sahi laga ki in zaruri baaton ke alaava tum par aur koi bojh na laada jaae:
Murtiyon ko charhaae gae khaana, lahu, gala ghont kar maare gae jivon ke maans ke sevan se aur veshyaagaami se pare raho. Yahi tumhaare lie uttam hai. Sabko shubhechchha!
Vahaan se nikalkar ve antiyokh shehar pahunche aur unhonne vahaan church ko ikattha kar vah patr unhein saump diya.
Patr ke parhe jaane par uske utsaah barhaanevaale sandesh se ve bahut aanandit hue.
Yahudah aur silaas ne, jo khud prophet the, tatvpurn baaton ke dvaara disciples ko protsaahit aur sthir kiya.
Unke kuchh samay vahaan thaharne ke baad unhonne unhein dobaara shaantipurvak unhin ke paas bhej diya, jinhonne unhein yahaan bheja tha. [
Baaranbaas ki chaahat thi ki vah Yohan ko, jinka upnaam maarkaas bhi tha, apne saath le chalein
Lekin Paulos balpurvak kahte rahe ki unhein saath na liya jaae kyonki vah pamfuliya shehar mein unka saath aur kaam adhura chhor chale gae the.
Is vishay ko lekar unmein aisa kathor vivaad hua ki ve ek dusre se alag ho gae. Baaranbaas maarkaas ko lekar saipras chale gae.
Disciples dvaara Lord ke grace mein saumpe jaakar Paulos ne silaas ko saath le yaatra shuruaat ki.
Ve siriya aur kilikiya pradeshon se hote hue kalisiyaaon ko sthir karte aage barhte gae.
Vah darbe aur lustra shehar bhi gae. Vahaan timothiyos naamak ek disciple the jinki maata Yahudi masihi shishya; lekin pita yunaani the.
Timothiyos ikoniyon aur lustra shehron ke disciples mein sammaanit the.
Ve shehar-shehar yaatra karte hue disciples ko ve sabhi command saumpte jaate the, jo Yerushalem mein apostles aur purniyon dvaara thahraai gayi thi.
Isliye church pratidin faith mein sthir hoti gai aur unki sankhya mein pratidin barhotri hoti gai.
Ve frijiya aur galaatiya kshetron mein se hote hue aage barh gae. Holy Spirit ki command thi ki ve aasiya kshetr mein God ke vachan ka prachaar na karein
Musiya shehar pahunchne par unhonne bithuniya shehar jaane ka soch kiya lekin Yeshu ke aatma ne unhein iski command nahin di.
Isliye musiya shehar se nikalkar ve troos shehar pahunche.
Raat mein Paulos ne ek darshan dekha: ek makedoniyaavaasi unse duhkhi word mein request kar raha tha, “Makedoniya kshetr mein aakar hamaari madad kijie!”
Troos shehar se ham sidhe jalmaarg dvaara saamothresiya taapu pahunche aur dusre din niyaapolis shehar
Aur vahaan se filippoy shehar, jo makedoniya pradesh ka ek leader shehar aur romi basti hai. Ham yahaan kuchh din thahar gae.
Shabbat par ham shehar dvaar se nikalkar prayer ke lie nirdhaarit jagah ki khoj mein nadi tat par chale gae. Ham vahaan ikatthi hui auraton se vaartaalaap karte hue baith gae.

Vahaan thuaateira shehar nivaasi ludiya naamak ek aurat thi, jo God ki aaraadhak thi. Vah baingni rang ke kapdon ki vyaapaari thi. Usne hamaara vaartaalaap suna aur Lord ne Paulos dvaara di ja rahi teaching ke prati uska dil khol diya.

Jab usne aur uske rishtedaaron ne baptisma le liya tab usne hamko apne yahaan aamantrit karte hue kaha, “Yadi aap yah maante hain ki main Lord ke prati faithful hun, to aakar mere ghar mein rahie.” Usne hamein request accept karne par vivash kar diya.

Ek din prayer sthal ki or jaate hue raasta mein hamaari bheint ek yuva daasi se hui, jismein ek aisi dard denevaali aatma thi, jiski madad se vah bhavishy reveal kar deti thi. Vah apne svaamiyon ki bahut aay ka saadhan ban gai thi.

Kai dinon tak vah yahi karti rahi. Ant mein jhunjhla kar Paulos pichhe mure aur uske andar samaai dard denevaali aatma se bole, “Yeshu ke naam mein main tujhe command deta hun, nikal ja usmein se!” Turant hi vah dard denevaali aatma use chhorkar chali gai.
Jab uske svaamiyon ko yah maalum hua ki unki aay ki ummid jaati rahi, ve Paulos aur silaas ko pakarkar shehar chauk mein leader nyaayaadhishon ke saamne le gae
Aur unse kahne lage, “In Yahudiyon ne shehar mein utpaat macha rakha hai.
Ye log aisi prathaaon ka prachaar kar rahe hain jinhein accept karna ya follow karna ham romi naagrikon ke niymaanusaar nahin hai.”
Is par saari bhir unke khilaaf ho gai aur leader haakimon ne unke kapde phaar daale aur unhein beint lagaane ki command di.
Un par kai kathor prahaaron ke baad unhein kaaraagaar mein daal diya gaya aur kaaraagaar-shaasak ko unhein kathor suraksha mein rakhne ka nirdesh diya.
Is order par kaaraagaar-shaasak ne unhein bhitri kaksh mein daalkar unke pairon ko lakri ki beriyon mein jakar diya.
Lagbhag aadhi raat ke samay Paulos aur silaas prayer kar rahe the aur God ki praise mein bhajan ga rahe the. Unke saathi kaidi unki sun rahe the.
Achaanak aisa bara bhukamp aaya ki kaaraagaar ki ninv hil gai, turant sabhi dvaar khul gae aur sabhi bandiyon ki beriyaan tut gain.
Nind se jaagne par kaaraagaar-shaasak ne sabhi dvaar khule paae. Yah sochkar ki saare kaidi bhaag chuke hain, vah talvaar se apne praanon ka ant karne ja hi raha tha;
Tab Paulos ne unche word mein usse kaha, “Khud ko koi haani na pahunchaaie, ham sab yahin hain!”
Kaaraagaar-shaasak roshni ka intjaam karne ke lie command dete hue bhitar daur gaya aur dar se kaampte hue Paulos aur silaas ke charnon mein gir para.
Tab unhonne kaaraagaar-shaasak aur uske saare parivaar ko Lord ke vachan ki teaching di.
Iske baad vah unhein apne ghar le aaya aur unhein khaana karaaya. God mein saprivaar faith karke ve sabhi bahut aanandit the.
Agle din leader haakimon ne apne adhikaariyon dvaara yah command bheji, “Un logon ko chhor do.”
Kaaraagaar-shaasak ne is command ki suchna Paulos ko dete hue kaha, “Leader nyaayaadhishon ne aapko chhor dene ki command di hai. Isliye aap shaantipurvak yahaan se vida ho sakte hain.”

Paulos ne unhein javaab diya, “Unhonne hamein bina kisi mukaddme ke sabke saamne pitvaaya, jabki ham romi naagrik hain, phir hamein kaaraagaar mein bhi daal diya aur ab ve hamein chupchaap baahar bhejna chaah rahe hain! Bilkul nahin! Khud unhin ko yahaan aane dijie, ve hi hamein yahaan se baahar chhor deinge.”
Un adhikaariyon ne yah sab leader nyaayaadhishon ko ja bataaya. Yah maalum hone par ki Paulos aur silaas romi naagrik hain ve bahut hi dar gae.
Tab ve khud aakar Paulos aur silaas ko manaane lage aur unhein kaaraagaar se baahar laakar unse shehar se chale jaane ki request karte rahe.
Tab Paulos aur silaas kaaraagaar se nikalkar ludiya ke ghar gae. Vahaan bhaai bahinon se bheint kar unhein protsaahit karte hue ve vahaan se vida ho gae.
Tab ve yaatra karte hue amfipolis aur apolloniya shehron se hote hue thesslonikeyus shehar pahunche, jahaan Yahudiyon ka ek aaraadhnaalay tha.
Roz ki tarah Paulos Yahudi aaraadhnaalay mein gae aur tin shabbaathon par Scripture ke aadhaar par unse vaad-vivaad karte rahe

Kuchh Yahudi is baat se aashvast hokar Paulos aur silaas ke saath sahmat ho gae. Inke alaava God ke prati shraddhaalu yunaani aur bari sankhya mein kai kulin mahilaaein bhi is vishvaasmat mein shaamil ho gain.

Kuchh Yahudi yah sab dekh jalan se bhar gae aur unhonne apne saath asaamaajik tatvon ko le shehar chauk mein ikattha ho hullar machaana shuru kar diya. Ve yaason ke makaan ke saamne ikattha hokar Paulos aur silaas ko bhir ke saamne laane ka koshish karne lage.

Unhein vahaan na paakar ve yaason aur kuchh dusre disciples ko ghasitkar shehar ke adhikaariyon ke saamne le jaakar chilla-chillaakar kahne lage, “Ye ve log hain, jinhonne duniya ko ast-vyast kar diya hai aur ab ye yahaan bhi a pahunche hain.
Yaason ne unhein apne ghar mein sharan di hai. Ye sabhi kaysar ke orders ke khilaaf kaam karte hain. Inka maanna hai ki raaja ek dusre person hai—Yeshu.”
Yah sunna tha ki bhir aur shehar-shaasak bharak uthe.
Unhonne yaason aur dusre disciples ki zamaanat milne par hi unhein riha kiya.
Raat hote hi disciples ne Paulos aur silaas ko bina der kie beroya shehar ki or bhej diya. Vahaan pahunchte hi ve Yahudiyon ke aaraadhnaalay mein gae.

Beroyaavaasi Yahudi thesslonikeyus ke logon ki tulna mein adhik mahaan charitr ke the. Unhonne Lord ke vachan ko bari laalsa se accept kar liya. Baaton ki sach ki pushti ke purpose se ve har din Scripture ka gambhirta se adhyyan kiya karte the.
Parinaamasvrup unmein se anekon ne faith kiya. Jinmein kai jaane maane yunaani aurat-aadmi bhi the.
Turant hi Yeshu ke believers ne Paulos ko samudr ke kinaare par bhej diya lekin silaas aur timothiyos vahin rahe.
Paulos ke sahaaykon ne unhein athenon shehar tak pahuncha diya lekin Paulos ke is command ke saath ve beroya laut gae ki silaas aur timothiyos ko jald hi unke paas bhej diya jaae.
Jab Paulos athenon shehar mein silaas aur timothiyos ki pratiksha kar rahe the, vah yah dekhkar ki saara shehar murtiyon se bhara hua hai, aatma mein bahut duhkhi ho uthe.
Isliye vah Yahudi synagogue mein har roz Yahudiyon, bhakt yunaaniyon aur shehar chauk mein upasthit logon se vaad-vivaad karne lage.
Isliye ve Paulos ko eriyopaagus naamak aaraadhnaalay mein le gae. Vahaan unhonne Paulos se savaal kiya, “Aapke dvaara di ja rahi yah nai teaching kya hai, kya aap hamein samjhaaeinge?
Kyonki aapke dvaara bataayi gai baatein hamaare lie anokhi hain. Ham jaanna chaahte hain ki inka matlab kya hai.”
Sabhi athenonvaasiyon aur vahaan aae pardeshiyon ki riti thi ki ve apna saara samay kisi dusre kaam mein nahin lekin nae-nae vishyon ko sunne ya kahne mein hi lagaaya karte the.
Eriyopaagus aaraadhnaalay mein Paulos ne unke beech ja khare hokar unhein sambodhit karte hue kaha: “Athenonvaasiyon! Aapke baare mein mera maanna hai ki aap har or se bahut hi dhaarmik hain.
“Vah God jinhonne vishv aur usmein ki sab vastuon ki srishti ki, jo heaven aur prithvi ke maalik hain, na to vah insaan ke banaae mandiron mein vaas karte hain
Aur na hi unhein zarurat hai kisi insaan ki service ki—vah kisi par nirbhar nahin hain kyonki vahi sabke life, saans aur sabhi zaruri vastuon ke denevaale hain.
Vahi hain, jinhonne ek hi mul aadmi se saare duniya par basa dene ke lakshy se har ek jaati ko banaaya aur unke thahraae hue samay aur nivaas simaaon ka nirdhaaran bhi kiya
Ki ve God ki khoj karein aur kahin unhein khojte-khojte receive bhi kar lein—yadypi vah hammein se kisi se bhi dur nahin hain.
Kyonki unhin mein hamaara life, hamaara chalna phirna aur hamaara astitv bana hai—thik vaisa hi jaisa ki aap hi ke apne kuchh kaviyon ne bhi kaha hai: ‘Ham bhi unke vanshaj hain.’
“Isliye God ke vanshaj hone ke kaaran hamaari yah dhaarna anuchit hai ki ishvratv sone-chaandi, patthar, kalaakaar ki kalaakriti aur insaan ke soch ke jaisa hai.
Ab tak to God is ajnaanta ki andekhi karte rahe hain lekin ab God har jagah pratyek person ko pashchaataap ka bulaava de rahe hain
Us samay Paulos unke beech se chale gae
Lekin kuchh ne unka anuchran karte hue Lord mein faith kiya. Unmein eriyopaagus ka sadasy diyonusiyos, daamaaris naamak ek mahila aur kuchh dusre person the.
Iske baad Paulos athenon shehar se korinthos shehar chale gae.

Vahaan unki bheint akulos naamak ek Yahudi se hui. Vah janmath pontos shehar ka nivaasi tha. Kuchh hi samay purv vah apni patni priska ke saath itaaliya se palaayan kar aaya tha kyonki samraat klodiyos ne rom se saare Yahudiyon ke nikal jaane ki command di thi. Paulos unse bheint karne gae.
Paulos aur akulos ka vyavsaay ek hi tha isliye Paulos unhin ke saath rahkar kaam karne lage—ve donon hi tambu banaanevaale the.
Jab makedoniya se silaas aur timothiyos vahaan aae to Paulos sirf vachan ki teaching dene ke prati samarpit ho gae aur Yahudiyon ke saamne yah saabit karne lage ki Yeshu hi vah Yeshu hain.

Unki or se pratirodh aur ninda ki situation mein Paulos apne kapde jhatak kar kah diya karte the, “Apne vinaash ke lie tum khud doshi ho—main nirdosh hun. Ab main gair-Yahudiyon ke beech ja raha hun.”
Paulos Yahudi aaraadhnaalay se nikalkar titos yustas naamak person ke ghar chale gae. Vah God bhakt person tha. Uska ghar Yahudi aaraadhnaalay ke paas hi tha.
Lord ne Paulos se raat mein darshan mein kaha, “Ab bhaybhit na hona. Vachan ka prachaar karte jaao. Maun na raho.
Main tumhaare saath hun. Koi tum par aakrman karke tumhein haani nahin pahuncha sakta kyonki is shehar mein mere kai bhakt hain.”
Isliye Paulos vahaan ek varsh chhah maah tak rahe aur God ke vachan ki teaching dete rahe.
Jab gailiyo aakhaaya pradesh ka raajypaal tha, Yahudi ek mat hokar Paulos ke khilaaf khare ho gae aur unhein nyaayaalay le gae.
Unhonne un par aarop lagaaya, “Yah person logon ko God ki worship is tarah se karne ke lie phusla raha hai, jo law ke orders ke viprit hai.”

Jab Paulos apni-apni raksha mein kuchh bolne par hi the, gailiyo ne Yahudiyon se kaha, “O Yahudiyon! Yadi tum mere saamne kisi tarah ke apraadh ya kisi ghor dushtta ka aarop lekar aate to main uske lie apne authority ka istemaal karta
Lekin yadi yah vivaadit words, naamon ya tumhaare hi apne vidhaan se sambandhit hai to iska nirnay tum khud karo. Main iska nirnay nahin karna chaahta.”
Phir usne unhein nyaayaalay ke baahar khader diya.
Yahudiyon ne Yahudi aaraadhnaalay ke leader sosthenes ko pakarkar nyaayaalay ke saamne hi pitna shuruaat kar diya. Gailiyo par iska koi prabhaav nahin para.

Vahaan kai din rahne ke baad Paulos bhaai bahinon se vida lekar jalmaarg se siriya pradesh chale gae. Unke saath priska aur akulos bhi the. Kenakhreya shehar mein Paulos ne apna mundan karva liya kyonki unhonne ek sankalp liya tha.
Ve ifesos shehar mein aae. Paulos unhein vahin chhorkar Yahudi synagogue mein jaakar Yahudiyon se vaad-vivaad karne lage.
Ve Paulos se kuchh din aur thaharne ki request karte rahe lekin Paulos raazi nahin hue.
Paulos ne unse yah kahte hue command chaahi “Yadi God chaaheinge to main dobaara lautkar tumhaare paas aaunga” Aur vah ifesos shehar chhorkar jalmaarg se aage chale gae.
Kayasriya shehar pahunchkar Yerushalem jaakar unhonne church se bheint ki aur phir antiyokh shehar chale gae.

Antiyokh shehar mein kuchh din bita kar vah vahaan se vida hue aur shehar-shehar yaatra karte hue sabhi galaatiya pradesh aur frijiya kshetr mein se hote hue disciples ko protsaahit karte hue aage barh gae.
Apollos naamak ek Yahudi person the, jinka janm aleksaandriya shehar mein hua tha. Vah ifesos shehar aae. Vah prabhaavshaali vakta aur Scripture ke bare wise the

Lekin unhein Lord ke raasta ki sirf zubaani teaching di gai thi. Vah bahut utsaahi svabhaav ke the aur Yeshu ke baare mein unki teaching satik thi lekin unka knowledge sirf Yohan ke baptisma tak hi simit tha.

Apollos nidarta se Yahudi aaraadhnaalay mein pravchan dene lage lekin jab priska aur akulos ne unka pravchan suna to ve unhein alag le gae aur vahaan unhonne apollos ko God ke teaching-siddhaant ki sach ko aur adhik saaf riti se samjhaaya.

Jab apollos ne aakhaaya pradesh ke aage jaane ki chaahat vyakt ki to bhaai bahinon ne unhein protsaahit kiya aur aakhaaya pradesh ke disciples ko patr likhkar request ki ki ve unhein accept karein. Isliye jab apollos vahaan pahunche, unhonne un disciples ka bahut protsaahan kiya, jinhonne grace dvaara faith kiya tha
Kyonki vah saarvajnik rup se Yahudiyon ka khandan karte aur Scripture ke aadhaar par pramaanit karte the ki Yeshu hi vah Yeshu hain.
Jab apollos korinthos shehar mein the tab Paulos durvartiy pradeshon se hote hue ifesos shehar aae aur unki bheint kuchh disciples se hui.
Paulos ne unse savaal kiya, “Kya faith karte samay tumne Holy Spirit receive kiya tha?” Unhonne javaab diya, “Nahin. Hamne to yah suna tak nahin ki Holy Spirit bhi kuchh hota hai.”
Tab Paulos ne savaal kiya, “To tumne baptisma kaun sa liya tha?” Unhonne javaab diya, “Yohan ka.”
Jab Paulos ne unke upar haath rakha, un par Holy Spirit utra aur ve dusre bhaashaaon mein baatchit aur bhavishyvaani karne lage.
Ye lagbhag baarah person the.
Tab Paulos aaraadhnaalay mein gae aur vahaan vah tin maah tak har Shabbat ko nidarta se bolte rahe aur God ke kingdom ke baare mein logon ki shankaaon ko dur karte rahe.

Lekin, jo kathor the, unhonne vachan ko nahin maana aur saarvajnik rup se is mat ke baare mein bure vichaaron ka prachaar kiya. Isliye Paulos apne disciples ko saath le vahaan se chale gae. Vah tiraannus ke vidyaalay mein gae, jahaan vah har roz bhir se God sambandhi vishyon par baat kiya karte the.
Yah sab do varsh tak hota raha. Iske parinaamasvrup saare aasiya pradesh mein Yahudiyon aur yunaaniyon donon hi ne Lord ka sandesh suna.
God ne Paulos ke dvaara asaadhaaran chamatkaar dikhaae,
Yahaan tak ki unke body se sparsh hue rumaal aur angochhe jab rogiyon tak le jaae gae, ve svasth ho gae aur dard denevaali aatma unhein chhor chale gae.

Shehar-shehar ghumte hue kuchh Yahudi ojhaaon ne bhi dard denevaali aatma se piriton ko Lord Yeshu ke naam mein yah kahte hue dard denevaali aatmaaon se mukt karne ka koshish kiya, “Main Yeshu naam mein, jinka prachaar apostle Paulos karte hain, tumhein baahar aane ki command deta hun.”
Skiva naamak Yahudi leader priest ke saat son the, jo yahi kar rahe the.
Ek din ek dard denevaali aatma ne unse kaha, “Yeshu ko to main jaanta hun aur Paulos ke baare mein bhi mujhe maalum hai, lekin tum kaun ho?”
Aur us dard denevaali aatma se pirit person ne lapak kar un sabhi ko apne vash mein kar liya aur unki aisi pitaai ki ki ve us ghar se nange aur ghaayal hokar bhaage.
Is ghatna ke baare mein ifesos shehar ke sabhi Yahudiyon aur yunaaniyon ko maalum ho gaya aur un par aatank chha gaya lekin Lord Yeshu ka naam barhta chala gaya.
Kuchh nae disciples ne saarvajnik rup se accept kiya ki ve khud bhi inhin kaamon mein lage hue the.
Kai jaadugron ne apni pothiyaan laakar sabke saamne jala di. Unka aaka gaya kul daam pachaas hazaar chaandi ke sikke tha.
Lord ke paraakram se vachan barhta gaya aur majbut hota chala gaya.
Iske baad Paulos ne apne man mein makedoniya aur aakhaaya pradesh se hote hue Yerushalem jaane ka nishchay kiya. Vah man mein soch kar rahe the, “In sabke baad mera rom jaana bhi sahi hoga.”
Apne do sahaaykon—timothiyos aur iraastus ko makedoniya pradesh preshit kar vah khud kuchh samay ke lie aasiya pradesh mein ruk gae.
Usi samay vahaan is mat ko lekar bari khalabli mach gai.
Demetriyos naamak ek chaandi ka kaarigar tha, jo aartimis devi ke temple ke murtiyaan garha karta tha, jisse kaarigron ka ek bara udyog chal raha tha.
Usne inhein aur isi tarah ke kaam karnevaale sab kaarigron ko ikattha kar unse kaha, “Bhaaiyo, yah to aap samajhte hi hain ki hamaari barhotri ka aadhaar yahi kaam hai.

Aapne dekha aur suna hoga ki na keval ifesos shehar mein lekin sabhi aasiya pradesh mein is Paulos ne bari sankhya mein logon ko yah kahkar bharma diya hai ki haath ke garhe devta vaastvik devta nahin hote.

Ab jokhim na keval yah hai ki hamaare kaam ka sammaan jaata rahega lekin yah bhi ki mahaan devi aartimis ka temple bhi vyarth saabit ho jaaega aur vah, jiski puja saara aasiya pradesh hi nahin lekin saara vishv karta hai, apne bhavy pad se gira di jaaegi.”
Yah sunte hi ve sab krodh se bhar gae aur chilla uthe, “Ifesosvaasiyon ki devi aartimis mahaan hai!”
Saara shehar ghabraaya hua tha. Ekjut ho ve makedoniya pradesh se aae Paulos ke saathi gaayos aur aaristaarkhos ko ghasitte hue rangshaala ki or bhaage.
Paulos is bhir ke saamne jaana hi chaahte the lekin disciples ne unhein aisa nahin karne diya.
Na keval unhonne lekin shehar-prashaaskon ne bhi, jo Paulos ke mitr the, baar-baar sandesh bhejkar unse rangshaala ki or na jaane ki request ki.
Bhir mein se koi kuchh chilla raha tha to koi aur kuchh. Saari bhir puri tarah ghabraai hui thi. Bahuton ko to yahi maalum na tha ki ve vahaan ikattha kis lie hue hain.

Kuchh ne yah arth nikaala ki yah sab aleksaandros ke kaaran ho raha hai kyonki Yahudiyon ne use hi aage kar rakha tha. Vah apne haath ke sanket se apne bachaav mein bhir se kuchh kahne ka koshish bhi kar raha tha
Lekin jaise hi unhein yah maalum hua ki aleksaandros Yahudi hai, saari bhir lagbhag do ghante tak ek word mein chillaati rahi “Ifesosvaasiyon ki devi aartimis mahaan hai.”

Bhir ke shaant ho jaane par shehar ke haakimon ne unhein sambodhit karte hue kaha, “Ifesosvaasiyo! Bhala yah kaun nahin jaanta ki ifesos shehar mahaan aartimis aur us murti ka rakshak hai, jo aakaash se utri hai.
Ab, jabki yah bina vivaad ke sach hai, thik yah hoga ki aap shaant rahein aur bina soche samjhe kuchh bhi na karein.
Aap in logon ko yahaan le aae hain, jo na to mandiron ke lutere hain aur na hi hamaari devi ki ninda karnevaale.
Isliye yadi demetriyos aur uske saathi kaarigron ko inke baare mein koi aapatti hai to nyaayaalay khula hai aur nyaayaadhish bhi uplabdh hain. Ve unke saamne apne aarop pesh karein.
Yadi aapki iske alaava koi dusri maang hai to use niyat sabha mein hi pura kiya jaaega.

Aaj ki is ghatna ke kaaran ham par upadrav ka aarop lagne ka khatra hai kyonki iske lie koi bhi thos kaaran dikhaai nahin parta. Is sambandh mein ham is titar-bitar bhir ke ikattha hone ka thos kaaran dene mein asmarth honge.”
Yah kahkar shehar haakimon ne bhir ko vida kar diya.
Shehar mein kolaahal shaant hone par Paulos ne disciples ko bulvaaya, unko protsaahit kiya aur unse vida lekar makedoniya pradesh ki or ravaana hua.
Vah un sabhi kshetron mein se hote hue, vahaan disciples ka utsaah barhaate hue yunaan desh ja pahunche.

Vah vahaan tin mahine tak kaary karte rahe lekin jab vah siriya pradesh ki yaatra shuruaat karne par the, unhein yah suchna receive hui ki Yahudi unke khilaaf sharyantr rach rahe hain, to unhonne makedoniya pradesh se hote hue laut jaane ka nishchay kiya.
Is yaatra mein beroyaavaasi paayrus ke son sopetar, thesslonikeyus shehar ke aaristaarkhos, sekundus, darbe se gaayos, timothiyos aur aasiya pradesh se tukhikas va trofimas hamaare saathi yaatri the.
Ye saathi yaatri hamse aage chale gae aur troos shehar pahunchkar hamaara intjaar karte rahe
Lekin hamne akhmiri roti ke utsav ke baad hi filippoy shehar se jalmaarg dvaara yaatra shuru ki. Paanch din mein ham troos shehar pahunche aur apne saathiyon se mile. Vahaan ham saat din rahe.
Saptaah ke pahle din ham roti torne ke lie ikattha hue. Paulos ne vahaan pravchan dena shuruaat kar diya, jo beech raatri tak chalta gaya kyonki unki yojna agle din yaatra shuruaat karne ki thi.
Us upri kaksh mein, jahaan sab ikattha hue the, kai dipak paani rahe the.
Yutikus naamak ek yuvak khirki par baitha hua jhapkiyaan le raha tha. Paulos pravchan karte chale gae aur yutikus ko gahri nind a gai. Vah tisre tal se zameen par ja gira aur uski maut ho gai.
Paulos niche gae, uske paas jaakar usse lipat gae aur kaha, “Ghabraao mat, yah jivit hai.”
Tab vah dobaara upar gae aur roti torne ki riti puri ki. Vah unse itni lambi baatchit karte rahe ki subah ho gai. Iske baad ve vahaan se chale gae.
Us yuvak ko vahaan se jivit le jaate hue un sabke harsh ki koi sima na thi.

Ham jalyaan par savaar ho assos shehar ki or aage barhe, jahaan se hamein Paulos ko saath lekar aage barhna tha. Paulos vahaan thal raasta se pahunche the kyonki yah unhin ki pahle se thahraai yojna thi.
Assos shehar mein unse bheint hone par hamne unhein jalyaan mein apne saath liya aur mitilin shehar ja pahunche.
Dusre din vahaan se yaatra karte hue ham kios shehar ke paas se hote hue saamos shehar pahunche aur uske agle din miletos shehar.

Paulos ne ifesos shehar mein na utarkar aage barhte jaane ka nishchay kiya kyonki vah chaahte the ki aasiya pradesh mein thaharne ke bajaay yadi sambhav ho to shighr hi pentekost utsav ke avsar par Yerushalem pahunch jaaein.
Miletos shehar se Paulos ne ifesos shehar ko samaachaar bhejkar church ke praachinon ko bulvaaya.
Unke vahaan pahunchne par Paulos ne unhein sambodhit karte hue kaha: “Aasiya pradesh mein mere pravesh ke pahle din se aapko yah maalum hai ki main kis tarah hamesha aapke saath raha,
Aur kis tarah saari vinamrta mein aansu bahaate hue un yaatnaaon ke bich bhi, jo Yahudiyon ke sharyantr ke kaaran mujh par aai, main Lord ki service karta raha.
Ghar-ghar jaakar aur saarvajnik rup se vah teaching dene mein, jo tumhaare lie laabhdaayak hai, main kabhi pichhe nahin raha.
Main Yahudiyon aur yunaaniyon se puri sach mein pashchaataap ke dvaara God ki or man phiraane aur hamaare Lord Yeshu mein faith ki request karta raha hun.
“Ab, Holy Spirit ki prerna mein main Yerushalem ja raha hun. Vahaan mere saath kya hoga, isse main anjaan hun;
Bajaay iske ki har ek shehar mein Holy Spirit mujhe saavdhaan karte rahte hain ki mere lie beriyaan aur yaatnaaein taiyaar hain.
Isliye aaj main tum sab par yah spasht kar raha hun ki main kisi ke bhi vinaash ka doshi nahin hun.
Mainne kisi par bhi God ke saare purpose ko bataane mein aanaakaani nahin ki.
Main jaanta hun ki mere jaane ke baad tumhaare bich phaarnevaale bheriye a jaaeinge, jo is samuh ko nahin chhoreinge.
Itna hi nahin, tumhaare bich se aise logon ka uthna hoga, jo galat teaching dene lageinge aur tumhaare hi jhund mein se apne chele banaane lageinge.
Isliye yah yaad rakhte hue saavdhaan raho ki tin varsh tak mainne din-raat aansu bahaate hue tumhein chetaavni dene mein koi dhil nahin di.

“Ab main tumhein Lord aur unke grace ke vachan ki dekhbhaal mein saump raha hun, jismein tumhaare vikaas karne aur tumhein un sabke saath miraas provide karne ki kshamta hai, jo Lord ke lie alag kie gae hain.
Mainne kisi ke svarn, rajat ya kapde ka laalach nahin kiya.
Tum sab khud jaante ho ki apni zarurton ki purti ke lie aur unke lie bhi, jo mere saath rahe, mainne apne in haathon se mehnat ki hai.

Har ek paristhiti mein mainne tumhaare saamne yahi aadarsh prastut kiya hai ki yah zaruri hai ki ham durblon ki madad isi riti se kathin parishram ke dvaara karein. Khud Lord Yeshu dvaara kahe gae ye word yaad rakho, ‘Lene ke bajaay dena blessed hai.’ ”
Jab Paulos yah kah chuke, unhonne ghutne tekkar un sabke saath prayer ki.
Tab disciple rone lage aur Paulos se gale lagkar unhein baar-baar chumne lage.
Unki dard ka sabse bara kaaran yah tha ki Paulos ne kah diya tha ki ab ve unhein kabhi na dekh sakeinge. Iske baad ve sab Paulos ke saath jalyaan tak gae.
Jab hamne unse vida lekar jalmaarg se yaatra shuruaat ki aur hamne sidhe kos dvip ka raasta liya, phir agle din rodos dvip ka aur vahaan se pataara dvip ka.
Vahaan foynike shehar jaane ke lie ek jalyaan taiyaar tha. Ham us par savaar ho gae aur hamne yaatra shuruaat ki.
Hamein baayin or saipras dvip dikhaai diya. Ham use chhorkar siriya pradesh ki or barhte gae aur sor shehar ja pahunche kyonki vahaan jalyaan se saamaan utaara jaana tha.
Vahaan hamne disciples ka pata lagaaya aur unke saath saat din rahe. Holy Spirit ke maadhyam se ve baar-baar Paulos se Yerushalem na jaane ki request karte rahe.
Jab vahaan se hamaare jaane ka samay aaya, ve parivaar ke saath hamein vida karne shehar sima tak aae. Samudrtat par hamne ghutne tekkar prayer ki aur ek dusre se vida li.
Ham jalyaan mein savaar ho gae aur ve sab apne-apne ghar laut gae.
Sor shehar se shuru ki gai yaatra puri kar ham ptulemaais shehar pahunche. Sthaaniy bhaai bahinon se bheint kar ham ek din vahin ruk gae.
Agle din yaatra karte hue ham kayasriya aae aur prachaarak filippos ke ghar gae, jo un saat diknon mein se ek the. Ham unhin ke ghar mein thahre.
Unki chaar kunvaari putriyaan thi, jo bhavishyvaani kiya karti thi.
Jab hamein, vahaan rahte hue kuchh din ho gae, vahaan haagaabus naamak ek prophet aae, jo Yahudiya pradesh ke the.

Vah jab hamse bheint karne aae, unhonne Paulos ka patuka lekar usse apne haath-pair baandhte hue kaha, “Holy Spirit ka kahna hai, ‘Yerushalem ke Yahudi ague us person ko isi riti se baandheinge jiska yah patuka hai aur use anyjaatiyon ke haathon mein saump deinge.’ ”
Yah sunkar sthaaniy disciples aur hamne bhi Paulos se Yerushalem na jaane ki request ki.
Paulos ne javaab diya, “Is tarah ro-rokar mera dil kyon tor rahe ho? Main Yerushalem mein na keval bandi banaae jaane lekin Lord Yeshu ke naam ke lie maar daale jaane ke lie bhi taiyaar hun.”
Isliye jab unhein manaana asambhav ho gaya, ham shaant ho gae. Ham keval yahi kah paae, “Lord hi ki chaahat puri ho!”
Kuchh din baad hamne taiyaari ki aur Yerushalem ke lie chal die.
Kayasriya shehar ke kuchh disciple bhi hamaare saath ho lie. Thaharne ke lie hamein saiprasvaasi mneson ke ghar le jaaya gaya. Vah sabse pahle ke disciples mein se ek tha.
Yerushalem pahunchne par bhaai bahinon ne bare aanandpurvak hamaara svaagat kiya.
Agle din Paulos hamaare saath Yaakob ke nivaas par gae, jahaan sabhi praachin ikattha the.
Namaskaar ke baad Paulos ne ek-ek karke vah sab bataana shuru kiya, jo God ne unki service ke maadhyam se anyjaatiyon ke bich kiya tha.
Yah sab sun, ve God ka thanks karne lage. Unhonne Paulos se kaha, “Dekhie, priyjan, Yahudiyon mein hazaaron hain jinhonne faith kiya hai. Ve sabhi law ke majbut samarthak bhi hain.
Ab bataaie, ham kya karein? Unhein zarur yah to maalum ho hi jaaega ki aap yahaan aae hue hain.
Isliye hamaara sujhaav maanie: yahaan aise chaar person hain, jinhonne shapath li hai,

Aap unke saath jaaie, shuddh hone ki vidhi puri kijie aur unke mundan ka kharch uthaaiye. Tab sabko yah maalum ho jaaega ki jo kuchh bhi aapke baare mein kaha gaya hai, usmein koi sach nahin hai aur aap khud law ka follow karte hain.

Jahaan tak gair-Yahudi disciples ka savaal hai, hamne unhein apna phaisla likhkar bhej diya hai ki ve murtiyon ko charhaai khaana saamagri, lahu, gala ghont kar maare gae pashuon ke maans ke sevan se aur veshyaagaami se pare rahein.”

Agle din Paulos ne in logon ke saath jaakar khud ko shuddh kiya. Tab vah temple gae ki vah vahaan us taarikh ki suchna dein, jab unki shuddh karne ki riti ki avdhi samaapt hogi aur unmein se har ek ke lie bheint charhaai jaaegi.

Jab saat din praayh samaapt hone par hi the, aasiya pradesh se vahaan aae kuchh Yahudiyon ne Paulos ko temple mein dekh liya. Unhonne saari maujud bhir mein kolaahal macha diya aur Paulos ko yah kahte hue bandi bana liya,

“Dear israaeliyon! Hamaari madad karo! Yahi hai vah, jo har jagah hamaare raashtr, law ke niymon aur is temple ke khilaaf teaching deta phir raha hai. Iske alaava yah yunaaniyon ko bhi temple ke andar le aaya hai. Ab yah holy jagah apvitr ho gaya hai.”
(vaastav mein iske pahle unhonne ifesosvaasi trofimas ko Paulos ke saath shehar mein dekh liya tha isliye ve samjhe ki Paulos use apne saath temple mein le gae the.)
Saare shehar mein khalabli mach gai. Log ek saath Paulos ki or lapke, unhein pakra aur unhein ghasitkar temple ke baahar kar diya aur turant dvaar band kar die gae.
Jab ve Paulos ki murder ki yojna kar hi rahe the, romi senaapti ko suchna di gai ki saare shehar mein kolaahal macha hua hai.
Senaapti turant apne saath kuchh sainik aur adhikaariyon ko lekar daurta hua ghatna sthal par ja pahuncha. Senaapti aur sainikon ko dekhte hi, unhonne Paulos ko pitna band kar diya.
Senaapti ne aage barhkar Paulos ko pakarkar unhein do-do beriyon se baandhne ki command di aur logon se savaal kiya ki yah kaun hai aur kya kiya hai isne?
Lekin bhir mein koi kuchh chilla raha tha to koi kuchh. Jab senaapti kolaahal ke kaaran sach na jaan paaya, usne Paulos ko sena garh mein le jaane ka order diya.
Jab ve sirhiyon tak pahunche, gusse mein balva karne ko utaaru bhir ke kaaran suraksha ki nazar se sainik Paulos ko uthaakar andar le gae.
Bhir unke pichhe-pichhe yah chillaati hui chal rahi thi, “Maar daalo use!”
Jab ve sainik garh par pahunchne par hi the, Paulos ne senaapti se kaha, “Kya main aapse kuchh kah sakta hun?” Senaapti ne aashchary se puchha, “Tum yunaani bhaasha jaante ho?
Iska arth yah hai ki tum vah misri nahin ho jisne kuchh samay pahle vidroh kar diya tha aur jo chaar hazaar aatankiyon ko banjar zameen mein le gaya tha.”
Paulos ne use javaab diya, “Main kilikiya pradesh ke taarasyos shehar ka ek Yahudi naagrik hun. Main aapki command paakar is bhir se kuchh kahna chaahta hun.”
Senaapti se command milne par Paulos ne sirhiyon par khare hokar bhir se shaant rahne ko kaha. Jab ve sab shaant ho gae, unhonne bhir ko ibri bhaasha mein sambodhit kiya:
“Priyjan! Ab kripya mera uttar sun lein.”
Jab unhonne Paulos ko ibri bhaasha mein sambodhit karte hue suna to ve aur adhik shaant ho gae. Paulos ne unse kahna shuru kiya.

“Main Yahudi hun, mera janm kilikiya pradesh, ke taarasyos shehar mein aur follow poshan isi shehar Yerushalem mein hua hai. Meri teaching niymaanukul purvjon ki law ke anurup aachaary gamaaliel mahoday ki dekhrekh mein hui, aaj God ke prati jaisa aap sabka utsaah hai, vaisa hi mera bhi tha.
Main to is mat ke disciples ko jaan lene tak sata raha tha, aurat-aadmi donon ko hi main bandi bana kaaraagaar mein daal deta tha,

High priest aur purniyon ki samiti ke sadasy is sach ke gavaah hain, jinse damishk shehar ke Yahudiyon ke sambandh mein authority patr receive kar main damishk shehar ja raha tha ki vahaan se is mat ke disciples ko bandi banaakar Yerushalem le aaun ki ve dandit kie jaaein.
“Jab main lagbhag dophar ke samay damishk shehar ke paas pahuncha, aakaash se achaanak bahut tej prakaash mere chaaron or chamka
Aur main zameen par gir para. Tabhi mujhe sambodhit karta ek word sunaai diya, ‘Shaaul! Shaaul! Tum mujhe kyon sata rahe ho?’
“Mainne savaal kiya, ‘Aap kaun hain, Lord?’ “ ‘Main naazreth shehar ka Yeshu hun, jise tum sata rahe ho,’ Us word ne javaab diya.
Mere saathiyon ko prakaash to zarur dikhaai de raha tha lekin mujhse baatchit karta hua word unhein saaf sunaai nahin de raha tha.
“Mainne puchha, ‘Main kya karun, Lord?’ Lord ne mujhe javaab diya. “ ‘Utho, damishk shehar mein jaao, vahin tumhein bataaya jaaega ki tumhaare dvaara kya-kya kiya jaana tay kiya gaya hai.’
Tej prakaash ke kaaran main dekhne ki kshamta kho baitha tha. Isliye mere saathi mera haath pakarkar mujhe damishk shehar le gae.
“Hananyaah naamak person, jo law ke hisaab se God bhakt aur sabhi sthaaniy Yahudiyon dvaara sammaanit the,
Mere paas aakar mujhse bole, ‘Bhaai shaaul! Apni nazar receive karo!’ Usi kshan nazar receive kar mainne unki or dekha.
“Unhonne mujhse kaha, ‘Hamaare purvjon ke God ne aapko apni chaahat jaanne aur unhein dekhne ke lie, jo righteous hain aur unhin ke chehra se nikle hue word sunne ke lie chuna gaya hai.
To ab der kyon? Uthie, baptisma lijie—Lord ke naam ki dohaai dete hue galti maafi receive kijie.’
“Yerushalem lautne par jab main temple mein prayer kar raha tha, main dhyaanmagn ki situation mein pahunch gaya.
Mainne Lord ko khud se yah kahte suna, ‘Bina der kie Yerushalem chhor do kyonki mere baare mein tumhaare dvaara di gai gavaahi inhein accept nahin hogi.’
“Mainne javaab diya, ‘Lord, ve khud yah jaante hain ki ek-ek Yahudi aaraadhnaalay se main aapke disciples ko chun-chunkar bandi banaata aur yaatnaaein deta tha.
Jab aapke gavaah stefaanos ka lahu bahaaya ja raha tha to main na keval iske samarthan mein vahaan khara tha, lekin uske hatyaaron ke baahri kapron ki rakhvaali bhi kar raha tha.’
“Lekin mere lie Lord ki command thi, ‘Jaao; main tumhein gair-Yahudiyon ke bich dur-dur ke jagahon mein bhej raha hun.’ ”
Yahaan tak to ve Paulos ki baat dhyaan se sunte rahe lekin ab unhonne chillaana shuru kar diya, “Is person ke bojh se dharti ko mukt karo. Ise jivit rahne ka koi authority nahin hai.”
Jab ve chillaane, kapde uchhaalne aur hava mein dhul uraane lage
To senaapti ne Paulos ko sena garh ke andar le jaane ki command di ki unhein kore lagaakar unse puchhtaachh ki jaae aur unke khilaaf bhir ke is tarah chillaane ka kaaran maalum ho sake.

Jab ve Paulos ko kore lagaane ki taiyaari mein unke haath-pair phailaakar baandh hi rahe the, Paulos ne apne paas khare shataadhipti se savaal kiya, “Kya aapke saamne ek romi naagrik ka dosh saabit hue bina use kore lagaana thik hai?”
Yah sunna hi tha ki shataadhipti ne turant senaapti ke paas jaakar usse kaha, “Aap yah kya karne par hain? Yah person to romi naagrik hai!”
Senaapti ne Paulos ke paas aakar unse savaal kiya, “Tum romi naagrik ho?” “Ji haan.” Paulos ne javaab diya.
Senaapti ne unse kaha, “Ek bari raashi chukaane par receive hui hai mujhe yah naagrikta.” “Lekin main to janm se romi naagrik hun!” Paulos ne javaab diya.
Ve log, jo unse puchhtaachh karne aae the turant vahaan se khisak lie. Jab senaapti ko yah maalum hua ki usne Paulos ko, jo ek romi naagrik hain, beriyaan laga di hain, to vah ghabra gaya.

Agle din sach maalum karne ki chaahat mein ki Paulos par Yahudiyon dvaara aarop kyon lagaae gae, senaapti ne unhein riha kar diya, leader priests aur mahaasbha ko ikattha hone ki command di aur Paulos ko laakar unke saamne pesh kiya.
Mahaasbha ki or dhyaan se dekhte hue Paulos ne kahna shuru kiya, “Priyjan, God ke saamne mera life aaj tak puri tarah sachche vivek sa raha hai.”
Is par high priest hananyaah ne Paulos ke paas khare huon ko Paulos ke chehra par vaar karne ki command di.

Khud Paulos hi bol uthe, “Are o saphedi puti divaar, tum par hi God ka vaar hone par hai! Tum to yahaan law ki vidhiyon ke hisaab se justice karne baithe ho, phir bhi mujh par vaar karne ki command dekar khud law bhang kar rahe ho?”
Ve, jo Paulos ke paas khare the kahne lage, “Tum to God ke high priest ka tiraskaar karne ka dussaahas kar baithe ho!”
Paulos ne javaab diya, “Bhaaiyo, mujhe yah maalum hi na tha ki yah high priest hain Scripture ka lekh hai: apne leaders ko shaap na dena.”
Jaise hi unhonne yah kaha, Farisiyon aur sadukiyon ke bich vivaad chhir gaya aur saari sabha mein phut par gai,

Vahaan bara kolaahal shuru ho gaya. Farisiyon ki or se kuchh shaastriyon ne khare hokar jhagarte hue kaha, “Hamaari nazar mein yah person nirdosh hai. Sambhav hai kisi aatma ya khud angel hi ne usse baatein ki hon.”
Jab vahaan kolaahal barhne laga, senaapti is aashanka se ghabra gaya ki log Paulos ke chithre na ura dein. Isliye usne sena ko command di ki Paulos ko jabran vahaan se sena garh mein le jaaya jaae.
Praatahkaal kuchh Yahudiyon ne ek sharyantr racha aur shapath khaai ki Paulos ko samaapt karne tak ve ann-paani grahan nahin kareinge.
Is yojna mein chaalis se adhik person shaamil ho gae.
Unhonne leader priests aur purniyon se kaha, “Hamne thaan liya hai ki Paulos ko samaapt kie bina ham ann-paani chakheinge tak nahin.

Isliye aap aur mahaasbha milkar senaapti ko suchna bhejein aur Paulos ko yahaan aise bulva lein, maano aap uska vivaad baariki se jaanch karke suljhaana chaahte hain. Yahaan hamne uske pahunchne ke pahle hi use maar daalne ki taiyaari kar rakhi hai.”
Paulos ke bhaanje ne is maar daalne ke baare mein sun liya. Usne sena ghar mein jaakar Paulos ko iski suchna de di.
Paulos ne ek shataadhipti ko bulaakar kaha, “Kripya is yuvak ko senaapti ke paas le jaaie. Iske paas unke lie ek suchna hai.”
Isliye shataadhipti ne use senaapti ke paas le jaakar kaha, “Kaidi Paulos ne mujhe bulaakar request ki hai ki is yuvak ko aapke paas le aaun kyonki iske paas aapke lie ek suchna hai.”
Isliye senaapti ne us yuvak ka haath pakarkar alag le jaakar usse puchhtaachh karni shuru kar di, “Kya suchna hai tumhaare paas?”
Usne javaab diya, “Paulos ko mahaasbha mein bulaana Yahudiyon ki sirph ek yojna hi hai, maano ve unke baare mein baariki se jaanch karna chaahte hain.

Kripya unki is request ki or dhyaan na dein kyonki chaalis se adhik person Paulos ke lie ghaat lagaae baithe hain. Unhonne thaan liya hai ki jab tak ve Paulos ko khatm nahin kar dete, ve na to kuchh khaaeinge aur na hi kuchh pieinge. Ab ve aapki haan ke intjaar mein baithe hain.”
Senaapti ne yuvak ko is nirdesh ke saath vida kar diya, “Kisi ko bhi yah maalum na hone paae ki tumne mujhe yah suchna di hai.”

Tab senaapti ne do shataadhiptiyon ko bulaakar command di, “Raat ke tisre ghante tak do sau sainikon ko lekar kayasriya shehar ko prasthaan karo. Unke saath sattar ghurasvaar aur do sau bhaalaadhaari sainik bhi hon.
Paulos ke lie ghore ki savaari ka prabandh karo ki vah raajypaal feliks ke paas surakshit pahuncha die jaaein.”
Senaapti ne unke haath yah patr bhej diya:
Parmashreshth raajypaal feliks ki service mein, klodiyos lisiyas ka saadar, namaskaar.

Jab is person ko Yahudiyon ne dabocha aur iski murder karne par hi the, main ghatna sthal par apni sainik tukri ke saath ja pahuncha aur ise unke panjon se mukt karaaya kyonki mujhe yah maalum hua ki yah ek romi naagrik hai.
Tab is par lagaae aaropon ki pushti ke purpose se mainne ise unki mahaasbha ke saamne prastut kiya.
Vahaan mujhe yah maalum hua ki is par lagaae gae aarop sirf unki hi law ki vidhiyon se sambandhit hain, na ki aise, jinke lie hamaare niymon ke hisaab se maut dand ya kaaraavaas diya jaae.

Phir mujhe yah suchna receive hui ki is person ke khilaaf murder ka sharyantr racha ja raha hai. Mainne ise bina der kie aapke paas bhejne ka nishchay kiya. Mainne aaropiyon ko bhi ye nirdesh de die hain ki ve iske khilaaf sabhi aarop aapke hi saamne prastut karein.
Isliye command ke hisaab se sainikon ne raaton-raat Paulos ko antipaatris shehar ke paas pahuncha diya.
Dusre din ghurasvaaron ko Paulos ke saath bhejkar ve khud sainik garh laut aae.
Kayasriya shehar pahunchkar unhonne raajypaal ko vah patr saumpa aur Paulos ko unke saamne prastut kiya.
Patr parhkar raajypaal ne Paulos se savaal kiya ki vah kis pradesh ke hain. Yah maalum hone par ki vah kilikiya pradesh ke hain
Raajypaal ne kaha, “Tumhaare aaropiyon ke yahaan pahunchne par hi main tumhaari sunvaai karunga” Aur usne Paulos ko Herodes ke raajamhal parisar mein rakhne ki command di.
