Paanch din baad high priest hananyaah purniyon aur tartulus naamak ek vakil ke saath kayasriya shehar a pahunche aur unhonne raajypaal ke saamne Paulos ke khilaaf apne aarop prastut kie.

Jab Paulos ko vahaan laaya gaya, raajypaal ke saamne tartulus ne Paulos par aarop lagaane shuruaat kar die: “Aapki durdrishti ke kaaran aapke shaasan mein lambe samay se shaanti bani rahi hai aur aapke shaasit pradesh mein is raashtr ke lie aapke dvaara lagaataar sudhaar kie ja rahe hain.
Parmashreshth raajypaal feliks, ham inka har jagah aur har tarah se thanks karte hue haardik svaagat karte hain.
Main aapka aur adhik samay kharaab nahin karunga. Main aapse yah chhota sa uttar sunne ki request karna chaahta hun.

“Yah person hamaare lie vaastav mein kashtdaayak kira saabit ho raha hai. Yah ek aisa person hai, jo vishv ke saare Yahudiyon ke bich matbhed paida kar raha hai. Yah ek kukhyaat naazri panth ka mukhiya bhi hai.
Isne temple ki pavitrta bhang karne ki bhi koshish ki hai isliye hamne ise bandi bana liya. [ham to apni hi law ki vidhiyon ke hisaab se iska justice karna chaah rahe the.
Aur hamein aapke saamne apne aarop prastut hone ki command di.] ki aap khud situation ki jaanch kar in sabhi aaropon se sambandhit sachchaaiyon ko jaan sakein.”
Tab dusre Yahudiyon ne bhi aarop lagaana shuruaat kar diya aur is baat ki pushti ki ki ye sabhi aarop sahi hain.

Raajypaal feliks ki or se sanket receive hone par Paulos ne iske uttar mein kahna shuruaat kiya. “Is baat ke prakaash mein ki aap is raashtr ke nyaayaadhish rahe hain, main khushi se apna bachaav prastut kar raha hun.
Aap is sach ki pushti kar sakte hain ki main lagbhag baarah din pahle sirph worship ke purpose se Yerushalem gaya
Aur inhonne na to mujhe temple mein, na Yahudi aaraadhnaalay mein aur na shehar mein kisi se vaad-vivaad karte ya shehar ki shaanti bhang karte paaya hai aur
Na hi ve mujh par lagaae ja rahe in aaropon ko saabit kar sakte hain.

Haan yah main aapke saamne zarur accept karta hun ki is mat ke hisaab se, jise inhonne panth naam diya hai, main vaastav mein hamaare purvjon ke hi God ki service-upaasna karta hun. Sab kuchh, jo law aur bhavishyadvaktaaon ke lekhon ke hisaab se hai, main usmein puri tarah faith karta hun.
Islie main bhi God aur insaanon donon hi ke saamne hamesha ek nishklank vivek banaae rakhne ki bharpur koshish karta hun.
“Kai varshon ke bit jaane ke baad main apne samaaj ke garibon ke lie madad raashi lekar aur bali charhaane ke purpose se Yerushalem aaya tha.
Usi samay inhonne temple mein mujhe shuddh hone ki riti puri karte hue dekha. Vahaan na koi bhir thi aur na hi kisi tarah ka shor.

Haan, us samay vahaan aasiya pradesh ke kuchh Yahudi zarur the, jinka yahaan aapke saamne upasthit hona sahi tha. Yadi unhein mere virodh mein kuchh kahna hi tha to sahi yahi tha ki ve ise aapki upasthiti mein kahte.
Anytha ye person, jo yahaan khare hain, khud bataaein ki mahaasbha ke saamne unhonne mujhe kis baare mein doshi paaya hai,
Lekin raajypaal feliks ne, jo is panth se bhali-bhaanti parichit tha, sunvaai ko sthagit karte hue ghoshna ki, “Senaapti lisiyas ke aane par hi main is baare mein nirnay dunga.”
Usne shataadhipti ko command di ki Paulos ko kaaraavaas mein to rakha jaae lekin unhein itni svatantrta zarur di jaae ki unke khaas mitr aakar unki service kar sakein.
Kuchh dinon ke baad feliks apni patni drusilla ke saath vahaan aaya, jo Yahudi thi. Usne Paulos ko bulvaane ki command di aur unse unke Yeshu mein faith vishay par baatein suni.
Feliks Paulos se dhanraashi praapti ki ummid lagaae hue tha. Isi ummid mein vah Paulos ko baatchit ke lie baar-baar apne paas bulvaata tha.
Yahi kram do varshon tak chalta raha. Tab feliks ke jagah par porkiyos festus is pad par chuna gaya aur Yahudiyon ko prasann karne ke purpose se feliks ne Paulos ko bandi hi bana rahne diya.
Kaarybhaar sambhaalne ke tin din baad festus kayasriya shehar se Yerushalem gaya.
Vahaan uske saamne leader priests aur Yahudi aguon ne Paulos ke khilaaf mukaddma prastut kiya. Unhonne festus se request ki
Ki vah vishesh kripaadrishti kar Paulos ko Yerushalem bhej dein. Vaastav mein unki yojna raasta mein ghaat lagaakar Paulos ki murder karne ki thi.
Festus ne iske uttar mein kaha, “Paulos to kayasriya mein bandi hai aur main khud shighr vahaan ja raha hun.
Isliye aap mein se kuchh leader person mere saath vahaan chalein. Yadi Paulos ko vaastav mein doshi paaya gaya to us par mukaddma chalaaya jaaega.”
Aath-das din thaharne ke baad festus kayasriya laut gaya aur agle din Paulos ko nyaayaalay mein laane ki command di.
Paulos ke vahaan aane par Yerushalem se aae Yahudiyon ne unhein gher liya aur un par kai gambhir aaropon ki bauchhaar shuru kar di, jinhein ve khud saabit na kar paae.
Apne bachaav mein Paulos ne kaha, “Mainne na to Yahudiyon ki law ke khilaaf kisi bhi tarah ka apraadh kiya hai aur na hi temple ya kaysar ke khilaaf.”
Phir bhi Yahudiyon ko prasann karne ke purpose se festus ne Paulos se savaal kiya, “Kya tum chaahte ho ki tumhaare in aaropon ki sunvaai mere saamne Yerushalem mein ho?”

Is par Paulos ne javaab diya, “Main kaysar ke nyaayaalay mein khara hun. Thik yahi hai ki meri sunvaai yahin ho. Mainne Yahudiyon ke khilaaf koi apraadh nahin kiya hai; yah to aapko bhi bhali-bhaanti maalum hai.

Yadi main apraadhi hi hun aur yadi mainne maut dand ke yogy koi apraadh kiya hi hai, to mujhe maut dand accept hai. Lekin yadi in Yahudiyon dvaara mujh par lagaae aarop sach nahin hain to kisi ko yah authority nahin ki vah mujhe inke haathon mein saumpe. Yahaan main apni sunvaai ki yaachika kaysar ke nyaayaalay mein bhej raha hun.”
Apni mahaasbha se soch-vimarsh ke baad festus ne ghoshna ki, “Thik hai. Tumne kaysar se sunvaai ki request ki hai to tumhein kaysar ke paas hi bheja jaaega.”
Kuchh samay baad raaja agrippa aur bernike festus se bheint karne kayasriya shehar aae.
Ve vahaan bahut samay tak thahre. Festus ne raaja ko Paulos ke baare mein is tarah bataaya: “Feliks ek bandi ko yahaan chhor gaya hai.
Jab main Yerushalem gaya hua tha; vahaan leader priests aur Yahudi praachinon ne us par aarop lagaae the. Unhonne use maut dand die jaane ki maang ki.

“Mainne unke saamne romi shaasan ki niti spasht karte hue unse kaha ki is niti ke antargat doshi aur dosh lagaanevaalon ke aamne-saamne savaal javaab kie bina aur doshi ko apni safaai pesh karne ka avsar die bina dand ke lie saump dena sahi nahin hai.
Isliye unke yahaan ikattha hote hi mainne bina der kie dusre hi din is person ko nyaayaalay mein prastut kie jaane ki command di.
Jab aaropi khare hue, unhonne us par savaal javaab shuru kar die lekin mere anumaan ke viprit, ye aarop un apraadhon ke nahin the jinki mujhe ummid thi
Main samajh nahin pa raha tha ki is tarah ke vishay ka pata kaise kiya jaae. Isliye mainne yah jaanna chaaha, kya vah Yerushalem mein mukaddma chalaae jaane ke lie raazi hai.
Lekin Paulos ki is request par ki samraat ke nirnay tak use kaaraavaas mein rakha jaae, mainne use kaysar ke paas bheje jaane tak bandi banaae rakhne ki command di hai.”
Raaja agrippa ne festus se kaha, “Main khud uska bachaav sunna chaahunga.” Festus ne use aashvaasan dete hue kaha, “Thik hai, kal hi sun lijie.”

Agle din jab raaja agrippa aur bernike ne aupchaarik dhumdhaam ke saath sabhaagaar mein pravesh kiya, unke saath senaapti aur ganmaany naagrik bhi the. Festus ki command par Paulos ko vahaan laaya gaya.

Festus ne kahna shuru kiya, “Mahaaraaj agrippa aur upasthit sajjno! Is person ko dekhie, jiske baare mein saare Yahudi samaaj ne Yerushalem aur yahaan kayasriya mein mere nyaayaalay mein yaachika prastut ki hai. Ye log chilla-chillaakar yah kah rahe hain ki ab use ek kshan bhi jivit rahne ka authority nahin hai.

Lekin apni jaanch mein mainne ismein aisa kuchh bhi nahin paaya jiske lie use maut dand diya jaae aur ab, jab usne khud samraat ke nyaayaalay mein yaachika prastut ki hai, mainne use rom bhej dene ka nishchay kiya hai.

Phir bhi, uske baare mein mere paas kuchh bhi tay nahin hai jise likhkar mahaaraajaadhiraaj ki service mein prastut kiya jaae. Yahi kaaran hai ki mainne use aap sabke saamne prastut kiya hai—vishesh rup se mahaaraaj agrippa aapke saamne, jisse ki saari jaanch puri hone par mujhe likhne ke lie kuchh sabut mil jaaein, jo samraat ki service mein prastut kie ja sakein.
Kyonki mere lie yah galat hai ki kisi bhi doshi ko uske aaropon ke varnan ke bina aage bheja jaae.”

Isliye raaja agrippa ne Paulos ko sambodhit karte hue kaha, “Tumhein apna paksh prastut karne ki command hai.” Isliye Paulos ne ek bolnevaale ki mudra mein haath uthaate hue apne bachaav mein kahna shuru kiya.
“Mahaaraaj agrippa, aaj main khud ko blessed maan raha hun, jo main yahaan Yahudiyon dvaara lagaae gae aaropon ke khilaaf uttar denevaale ke taur par aapke saamne khara hua hun.
Vishesh rup se isliye bhi ki aap Yahudi prathaaon aur samasyaaon ko bhali-bhaanti jaante hain. Isliye main aapse request karta hun ki aap mera paksh sabr se sunein.
“Mere desh aur Yerushalem mein sabhi Yahudi meri yuvaavastha se lekar ab tak ki lifestyle se achchhi tarah se parichit hain.
Isliye ki lambe samay se ve mujhse parichit hain, ve chaahein to, is sach ki gavaahi bhi de sakte hain ki mainne Farisi samprdaay ke anurup, jo kattartam mat hai, life jiya hai.
Aaj main God dvaara hamaare purvjon ko di gai promise ki ummid ke kaaran yahaan doshi ke taur par khara hun.

Yah vahi promise hai, jiske pure hone ki ummid hamaare baarah gotr din-raat sach mein God ki service-upaasna karte hue kar rahe hain. Mahaaraaj, aaj mujh par Yahudiyon dvaara mukaddma isi ummid ke kaaran chalaaya ja raha hai.
“Meri apni maanyta bhi yahi thi ki naazrethvaasi Yeshu ke naam ke virodh mein mujhe bahut kuchh karna zaruri hai.
Yerushalem mein mainne thik yahi kiya bhi. Leader priests se authority patr lekar main kai disciples ko kaaraagaar mein daal deta tha, jab unki murder ki jaati thi to usmein meri bhi sammti hoti thi.

Aksar sabhi Yahudi aaraadhnaalyon mein jaakar main unhein dandit karte hue Yeshu ki ninda ke lie baadhy karne ka koshish bhi karta tha aur krodh mein paagal hokar main unka pichha karte hue sima paar ke shehron mein bhi unhein sataaya karta tha.
“Isi purpose se ek baar main leader priests se authority patr receive kar damishk shehar ja raha tha.
Mahaaraaj! Dophar ke samay mainne aur mere sahyaatriyon ne aakaash se sury se bhi kahin adhik tej roshni dekhi.
Jab ham sab zameen par gir pare, mujhe ibri bhaasha mein sambodhit karta hua ek word sunaai diya, ‘Shaaul! Shaaul! Tum mujhe kyon sata rahe ho? Paine par laat maarna tumhaare lie hi haanikaarak hai.’
“Mainne savaal kiya, ‘Aap kaun hain, Lord?’ “Lord ne javaab diya ‘Main Yeshu hun tum jise sata rahe ho,

Lekin utho, khare ho jaao kyonki tumhein darshan dene ka mera purpose yah hai ki na keval, jo kuchh tumne dekha hai lekin vah sab, jo main tumhein apne baare mein dikhaaunga, uske lie tumhein servant aur gavaah thahraaun.

Ki unki aankhein kholun aur unhein andhera se nikaalkar roshni mein aur aarop lagaanevaala ke authority se God ke kingdom mein le aaun ki ve galti maafi receive kar sakein aur unke saamne a jaaein, jo mujhmein faith ke dvaara God ke lie alag kie gae hain.’
“Isliye mahaaraaj agrippa, mainne svargiy darshan ki baat nahin taali.

Mainne sabse pahle damishk shehar mein, iske baad Yerushalem aur saare Yahudiya pradesh aur gair-Yahudiyon mein bhi yah prachaar kiya ki ve pashchaataap karke God ki or laut aaein aur apne svabhaav ke dvaara apne pashchaataap ko pramaanit karein.
Yahi vah kaaran hai ki kuchh Yahudiyon ne temple mein mujhe pakarkar meri murder karni chaahi.

Ab tak mujhe God ki madad receive hoti rahi, jiske parinaamasvrup main aap aur chhote-bare sabhi ke saamne usi sach ke pura hone ki ghoshna kar raha hun jiska varnan Moshe aur bhavishyadvaktaaon ne kiya tha
Jab Paulos apne bachaav mein yah kah hi rahe the, festus ne unche word mein kaha, “Paulos! Tumhaari to mati bhrasht ho gai hai. Tumhaari bahut teaching tumhein paagal bana rahi hai.”
Lekin Paulos ne javaab diya, “Bahut sammaany festus mahoday, meri mati bhrasht nahin hui hai! Mera kathan sach aur knowledge ke hai.

Mahaaraaj to in vishyon se parichit hain. Main bare aatmvishvaas ke saath unse yah sab kah raha hun. Mujhe pura nishchay hai ki in vishyon mein se kuchh bhi unke lie naya nahin hai kyonki inmein se kuchh bhi gupt mein nahin kiya gaya.
Mahaaraaj agrippa, kya aap bhavishyadvaktaaon ka faith karte hain? Main jaanta hun ki aap faith karte hain.”

Paulos ne javaab diya, “Shighr hi ya vilamb se, God se meri to yahi request hai ki na keval aap, lekin ye sabhi sunnevaale, jo aaj meri baatein sun rahe hain, mere hi jaisa ho jaaein—sivaay in beriyon ke.”
Tab raaja, raajypaal, bernike aur ve sabhi, jo unke saath vahaan baithe hue the, khare ho gae aur
Nyaayaalay se baahar nikalkar aapas mein soch-vimarsh karne lage: “Is person ne maut dand ya kaaraavaas ke yogy koi apraadh nahin kiya hai!”
Raaja agrippa ne raajypaal festus se kaha, “Yadi is person ne kaysar se dohaai ka prastaav na kiya hota to ise chhor diya gaya hota!”
Jab yah tay ho gaya ki hamein jalmaarg se itaaliya jaana hai to unhonne Paulos aur kuchh dusre bandiyon ko raajkiy sainy dal ke yuliyus naamak shataadhipti ko saump diya.

Ham sab aadraamutteyum shehar ke ek jalyaan par savaar hue, jo aasiya pradesh ke samudr ke kinaare ke shehron se hote hue jaane ke lie taiyaar tha. Jalmaarg dvaara hamaari yaatra shuru hui. Aaristaarkhos bhi hamaara saathi yaatri tha, jo makedoniya pradesh ke thesslonikeyus shehar ka vaasi tha.
Agle din ham sidon shehar pahunch gae. Bhale dil se yuliyus ne Paulos ko shehar mein jaakar apne priyajnon se milne aur unse zaruri vastuein le aane ki command de di.
Vahaan se hamne yaatra dobaara shuru ki aur ulti hava bahne ke kaaran hamein saipras dvip ki ot se aage barhna para.
Jab ham samudr mein yaatra karte hue kilikiya aur pamfuliya shehron ke tat se hote hue lukiya ke mura shehar pahunche.
Vahaan shataadhipti ko yah maalum hua ki aleksaandriya ka ek jalyaan itaaliya desh jaane ke lie taiyaar khara hai. Isliye usne hamein usi par savaar karva diya.

Hamein dhimi gati se yaatra karte kai din ho gae the. Hamaara knidos shehar pahunchna kathin ho gaya kyonki ulti hava chal rahi thi. Isliye ham saalmone ke saamne vaala krete dvip ke paas se hote hue aage barh gae.
Bari kathinaai mein uske paas se hote hue ham ek jagah par pahunche jiska naam tha kaalos limenas arthaat manoram bandargaah. Laasiya shehar isi ke paas sthit hai.

Bahut adhik samay kharaab ho chuka tha. Hamaari paani-yaatra khatre se bhar gai thi, kyonki sardi ke mausam mein tay kiya hua praayashchit bali divas bit chuka tha. Isliye Paulos ne unhein chetaavni dete hue kaha,
“Mujhe saaf dikhaai de raha hai ki hamaari yah yaatra haanikaarak hai. Iske kaaran jalyaan va saamaan ki hi nahin lekin khud hamaare jivnon ki ghor haani hone par hai.”
Lekin shataadhipti ne Paulos ki chetaavni ki ansuni kar jalyaan chaalak aur jalyaan maalik ka sujhaav accept kar liya.

Thand ke dinon mein yah bandargaah is yogy nahin rah jaata tha ki ismein thahra jaae. Isliye bahumat tha ki aage barha jaae. Unhonne is ummid mein yaatra shuru kar di ki kisi tarah thand shuru hone ke pahle foynike shehar to pahunch hi jaaeinge. Yah krete dvip ka bandargaah tha, jiska dvaar dakshin-pashchim aur uttar-pashchim disha mein hai.
Jab saamaany dakshin vaayu bahne lagi, unhein aisa laga ki unhein apne lakshy ki praapti ho gai hai. Isliye unhonne langar utha liya aur krete dvip ke kinaare samudr se hote hue aage barhe.
Ve abhi adhik dur na ja paae the ki yuraakilo naamak bhayankar chakrvaati hava bahne lagi aur
Jalyaan iski chapet mein a gaya. Vah is tej hava ke thaperon ka saamna karne mein asmarth tha. Isliye hamne yaan ko isi hava ke bahaav mein chhor diya aur hava ke saath bahne lage.
Kauda naamak ek chhote dvip ki or hava ke bahaav mein bahte hue ham bari kathinaai se jivanrakshak naav ko jalyaan se baandh paae.

Unhonne jalyaan ko peinde se lekar upar tak rasson dvaara achchhi riti se kas diya aur is aashanka se ki kahin unka jalyaan sirtis ke uthle samudr ki ret mein phans na jaae, unhonne langar ko thora niche utaarkar jalyaan ko hava ke bahaav ke saath saath bahne ke lie chhor diya.
Agle din tej lahron aur bhayankar aandhi ke thaperon ke kaaran unhonne yaan mein lada hua saamaan pheinkna shuru kar diya.
Tisre din ve apne hi haathon se jalyaan ke bhaari upkarnon ko pheinkne lage.
Kai din tak na to sury hi dikhaai diya aur na hi taare. Hava ka bahaav tej bana hua tha isliye hamaare jivit bache rahne ki saari ummid dhire dhire khatm hoti chali gai.

Ek lambe samay tak bhukhe rahne ke baad Paulos ne unke beech khare hokar yah kaha, “Mitro, uttam to yah hota ki aap log mera soch accept karte aur krete dvip se aage hi na barhte jisse is haani se bacha ja sakta.
Ab aapse meri request hai ki aap saahas na chhorein kyonki jalyaan ke alaava kisi ke bhi life ki haani nahin hogi;
Kyonki vah, jo mere God hain aur main jinka servant hun, unka ek angel raat mein mere paas a khara hua
Aur usne mujhe sabr diya, ‘Mat dar, Paulos, tumhein kaysar ke saamne upasthit hona hi hai. God ne apni mercy mein tumhein aur tumhaare saath yaatra karnevaalon ko jivandaan diya hai.’
Isliye saathiyo, saahas na chhoro kyonki main God mein faith karta hun. Thik vaisa hi hoga jaisa mujhe bataaya gaya hai.
Ham zarur hi kisi dvip ke thal par pahunch jaaeinge.”
Chaudahvein din-raat ke samay, jab ham aadriya saagar mein lahron ke thaperon ke bich aage barh rahe the, aadhi raat ko naavikon ko yah ahsaas hua ki ve thal ke paas pahunch rahe hain.
Jab unhonne gahraai naapi to paaya ki gahraai saintis mitar thi. Kuchh aur aage barhne par gahraai sattaais mitar nikli.
Is aashanka se ki kahin ve chattaanon se takra na jaaein unhonne jalyaan ki pichhli or se chaar langar daal die aur utsukta se subah hone ki kaamna karne lage.
Jalyaan se pichha chhuraakar bhaagne ke kaary mein naavikon ne jivanrakshak naav ko paani mein is tarah utaara maano ve saamne ki or ke langar niche kar rahe hon.
Paulos ne shataadhipti aur sainikon ko chetaavni dete hue kaha, “Yadi ye log jalyaan par na rahe to aap bhi jivit na rah sakeinge.”
Isliye sainikon ne un rassiyon ko kaat diya jisse vah naav latki hui thi.
Paulos ne un sabse kuchh kha lene ki request ki, “Chaudah din se aap anishchitta ki situation ka saamna karte a rahe hain aur aap logon ne kuchh khaaya bhi nahin hai.
Isliye aapse meri request yah hai ki aap kuchh to zarur kha lein. Jisse ki aapka bachaav ho. Aapke sir ka ek baal bhi barbaadi na hoga.”
Yah kahte hue unhonne roti li aur sabhi ke saamne uske lie God ke prati thanks reveal kiya, use tora aur khaane lage.
Ve sabhi utsaahit ho gae aur sabhi ne khaana kiya.
Jalyaan mein ham sab kul do sau chhihattar person the.
Bharpet khaana kar unhonne jalyaan mein lada hua gehun samudr mein pheinkna shuru kar diya ki jalyaan ka bojh kam ho jaae.
Din nikalne par ve us jagah ko pahchaan to na sake lekin tabhi unhein khaari-jaisa samudr ka kinaara dikhaai diya. Unhonne nishchay kar liya ki yadi sambhav ho to jalyaan ko vahin laga dein.
Unhonne langar samudr mein kaat giraae, paal ke rasse dhile kar die aur samudr ke kinaare ki or barhne ke lakshy se saamne ke paal khol die,
Lekin jalyaan ret mein phans gaya. Uska agla bhaag to sthir ho gaya lekin pichhla bhaag lahron ke thaperon se tutta chala gaya.
Sainikon ne sabhi kaidiyon ko maar daalne ki yojna ki ki unmein se koi bhi tair kar bhaag na jaae

Lekin shataadhipti Paulos ko surakshit le jaana chaahta tha; isliye usne sainikon ka iraada pura na hone diya aur yah command di ki ve, jo tair sakte hain, kud kar tairte hue jalyaan se pahle zameen par pahunch jaaein
Aur baaki yaatri jalyaan ke tute anshon aur patron ke sahaare kisi tarah zameen par pahunch jaaein. Is tarah sabhi yaatri zameen par surakshit pahunch gae.
Jab sabhi yaatri vahaan surakshit a gae. Tab hamein maalum hua ki is dvip ka naam mailite tha.
Vahaan ke nivaasiyon ne hamaare prati anokhi daya dikhaai. Lagaataar varsha ke kaaran taapmaan mein giraavat a gai thi. Thand ke kaaran unhonne aag jalaakar hamaara svaagat kiya.
Jab Paulos ne lakriyon ka ek gattha aag par rakha hi tha ki taap ke kaaran ek vishaila saamp usmein se nikalkar unki baanh par lipat gaya.

Vahaan ke nivaasiyon ne is jantu ko unki baanh se latka dekha to aapas mein kahne lage, “Sachmuch yah person hatyaara hai. Samudri baarh se to yah bach nikla hai lekin justice-devi nahin chaahti ki yah jivit rahe.”
Lekin Paulos ne us jantu ko aag mein jhatak diya aur unka koi bura nahin hua.

Ve sabhi yah intjaar karte rahe ki unki baanh suj jaaegi ya vah kisi bhi kshan markar gir pareinge. Ve der tak isi ki pratiksha karte rahe lekin unke saath kuchh bhi asaamaany nahin hua. Isliye logon ka nazriya hi badal gaya aur ve kahne lage ki Paulos ek devta hain.
Us jagah ke paas hi ek bhumikhand tha, jo us dvip ke leader shaasak publiyus ki property thi. Usne hamein apne ghar mein aamantrit kiya aur tin din tak hamaari vishesh aavabhgat ki.
Uska pita bimaar tha. Vah jvar aur aanv se pirit para tha. Paulos use dekhne gae. Uske lie prayer karne aur us par haath rakhne ke dvaara unhonne us person ko svasth kar diya.
Parinaamasvrup us dvip ke dusre rogi bhi Paulos ke paas aane lage aur svasth hote chale gae.
Unhonne kai tarah se hamaara sammaan kiya. Jab hamne vahaan se paani-yaatra shuru ki, unhonne ve saari vastuein, jo hamaare lie zaruri thi, jalyaan par rakh din.

Tin mahine baad hamne aleksaandriya ja rahe jalyaan par yaatra shuru ki. Yah jalyaan thand ke kaaran is dvip mein thahra hua tha. Is yaan ke agle bhaag par ek jori devtaaon ki ek aakriti—dioskurois garhi hui thi.
Saayraakyuz shehar pahunchne par ham vahaan tin din rahe.
Vahaan se aage barhkar ham regiyam shehar pahunche. Ek din baad jab hamein dakshin vaayu mili ham phir aage barhe aur dusre din puteoli shehar ja pahunche.
Vahaan kuchh bhaai bahin the, jinhonne hamein apne ghar mein thaharne ke lie aamantrit kiya. Ham vahaan saat din thahre. Aakhirkaar ham rom shehar pahunch gae.

Hamaare baare mein samaachaar milne par bhaai bahin hamse bheint karne appiyus ke chauk aur trion taabernon naamak jagah tak aae. Unhein dekh Paulos ne bahut aanandit ho God ke prati thanks reveal kiya.
Rom pahunchne par Paulos ko akele rahne ki command mil gai lekin un par pahre ke lie ek sainik ko thahra diya gaya tha.

Tin din baad unhonne Yahudi aguon ki ek sabha bulaai. Unke ikattha hone par Paulos ne unhein sambodhit karte hue kaha, “Mere dear bhaaiyo, yadypi mainne svajaatiy Yahudiyon aur hamaare purvjon ki prathaaon ke khilaaf kuchh bhi nahin kiya hai phir bhi mujhe Yerushalem mein bandi banaakar romi sarkaar ke haathon mein saump diya gaya hai.
Meri jaanch karne ke baad ve mujhe riha karne ke lie taiyaar the kyonki unhonne mujhe jaan-dand ka doshi nahin paaya.
Lekin jab Yahudiyon ne iska virodh kiya to mujhe majbur hokar kaysar ke saamne dohaai deni pari—isliye nahin ki mujhe apne raashtr ke khilaaf koi aarop lagaana tha.
Mainne aap logon se milne ki command isliye li hai ki main aapse soch-vimarsh kar sakun, kyonki yah beri mainne Israel ki ummid ki bhalaai mein dhaaran ki hai.”
Unhonne Paulos ko javaab diya, “Hamein Yahudiya pradesh se aapke sambandh mein na to koi patr receive hua hai aur na hi kisi ne yahaan aakar aapke baare mein koi pratikul suchna di hai.
Hamein is mat ke baare mein aapse hi aapke soch sunne ki chaahat thi. Hamein maalum hai ki har jagah is mat ka virodh ho raha hai.”

Tab iske lie ek din tay kiya gaya aur nirdhaarit samay par bari sankhya mein log unke ghar par aae. Subah se lekar shaam tak Paulos sach se God ke kingdom ke baare mein teaching dete rahe aur Yeshu ke baare mein Moshe ki law aur bhavishyadvaktaaon ke lekhon se spasht karke unhein dilaasa dilaate rahe.
Unki baaton ko sunkar unmein se kuchh to maan gae, lekin kuchh anyon ne iska faith nahin kiya.
Jab ve ek dusre se sahmat na ho sake to ve Paulos ki is antim baat ko sunkar jaane lage: “Prophet yashaayaah ne Holy Spirit ke dvaara aap logon ke purvjon par ek thik sach hi prakaashit ki thi:
“ ‘In logon se jaakar kaho, “Tum log sunte to rahoge, lekin samjhoge nahin. Tum log dekhte bhi rahoge, lekin pahchaan na sakoge.”

Kyonki in logon ka dil jar ho chuka hai. Apne kaanon se ve kadaachit hi kuchh sun paate hain aur aankhein to unhonne mund hi rakhi hain, ki kahin ve aankhon se dekh na lein aur kaanon se sun na lein aur apne dil se samajhkar laut aaein aur main, God, unhein svasth aur purn bana dun.’
“Isliye yah sahi hai ki aapko yah maalum ho jaae ki God ka yah bachaav ab gair-Yahudiyon ke lie bhi maujud hai. Ve bhi ise accept kareinge.” [
Paulos vahaan apne bhaare ke makaan mein pure do saal rahe. Vah bheint karne aae logon ko pure dil se accept karte the.
Yah patr Paulos ki or se hai, jo Yeshu ka slave hai, jiska aagman ek apostle ke taur par hua aur jo God ke us ishvriy good news ke lie alag kiya gaya hai,
Jiski promise God ne pahle hi apne bhavishyadvaktaaon ke dvaara holy abhilekhon mein ki thi,
Jo unke son ke sambandh mein thi, jo shaaririk nazar se David ke vanshaj the,
Jinmein se tum bhi Yeshu ke hone ke lie bulaae gae ho.
Yah patr rom shehar mein un sabhi ke naam hai, jo God ke dear hain, jinka bulaava holy hone ke lie kiya gaya hai. God hamaare pita aur Lord Yeshu ki or se tummein grace aur shaanti bani rahe.
Tumse bheint karne ke lie meri bahut chaahat isliye hai ki tumhein spiritual rup se majbut karne ke purpose se koi spiritual vardaan provide karun
Ki tum aur main aapas mein ek dusre ke faith dvaara protsaahit ho jaaein.
Main yunaaniyon aur barabron, buddhimaanon aur nirbuddhiyon donon hi ka karzdaar hun.
Kyonki God ke baare mein jo kuchh bhi jaana ja sakta hai, vah knowledge insaanon par reveal hai—ise khud God ne un par reveal kiya hai.
God ka knowledge hone par bhi unhonne na to God ko God ke yogy sammaan diya aur na hi unka aabhaar maana. Iske viprit unki soch power vyarth ho gai aur unke jar dilon par andhera chha gaya.
Unka daava tha ki ve wise hain lekin ve bilkul bewakoof saabit hue,
Kyonki unhonne avinaashi God ke prataap ko badalkar naashmaan insaan, pakshiyon, pashuon aur reingte jantuon mein kar diya.
Ye ve hain, jinhonne God ke sach ka badlaav jhuth se kiya. Ye ve hain, jinhonne srishti ki vandna archna ki, na ki srishtikarta ki, jo hamesha-hamesha vandniy hain. Aamen.
Unmein sab tarah ki buraaiyaan sama gain: dushtta, lobh, dushkriti, jalan, murder, jhagra, chhal, durbhaav, kaanaaphusi,
Dusron ki ninda, God se nafrat, asabhy, ghamand, ding maarna, sharyantr rachna, maata-pita ki command taalna,
Nirbuddhi, vishvaasghaati, kathorta aur nirdayta.

Uprokt ke prakaash mein tummein se pratyek aaropi ke paas apne bachaav ke lie koi bhi tark baaki nahin rah jaata kyonki jis vishay ko lekar tum us dusre ko doshi ghoshit kar rahe ho, us baare mein tum khud par saza prasaarit kar rahe ho kyonki jis vishay ke lie tum use doshi ghoshit kar rahe ho, tum khud vahi karte ho.
Ya is sach ko pahchaane bina ki God ki grace hi tumhein pashchaataap karna sikhaati hai, tumne God ke grace, sabr aur sahanshilta rupi wealth ko tuchchh samjha hai?
Magar pratyek achchhe kaam karnevaale ke lie glory, aadar aur shaanti tay hain—sabse pahle Yahudi ke lie aur phir yunaani ke lie bhi.
Pakshpaat God mein hai hi nahin.
God ki nazar mein righteous ve nahin, jo law ke sunnevaale hain lekin righteous ve hain, jo law ka follow karnevaale hain.
Law se puri tarah anjaan gair-Yahudi apni mul pravritti ke prabhaav se law ka follow karte paae jaate hain. Isliye law na hone par bhi ve khud apne lie law hain.
Iske dvaara ve yah pradarshit karte hain ki unke dilon par law likhi hai. Iski gavaah hai unki antraatma, jo un par dosh lagaane ya unke bachaav ke dvaara situation ka anumaan lagaati hai.
Lekin tum—yadi tum Yahudi ho aur law ka follow karte ho; God se apne sambandh ka tumhein garv hai;
Tumhein God ki will maalum hai, tum achchhi-achchhi vastuon ke samarthak ho kyonki tumhein inke baare mein law se sikhaaya gaya hai;
Tumhein yah nishchay hai ki tum drishtihinon ke lie sahi maargdarshak ho; jo andhera mein hain unke lie roshni ho;
Mandbuddhiyon ke guru aur baalkon ke shikshak ho kyonki tumne law mein us knowledge aur us sach ke namune ko pahchaan liya hai;
Isliye tum, jo anyon ko teaching dete ho, khud ko teaching kyon nahin dete? Tum, jo yah updesh dete ho, “Chori mat karo,” Kya tum khud hi chori nahin karte!
Tum, jo yah sikhaate ho, “Vyabhichaar anuchit hai,” Kya tum khud hi vyabhichaar mein lin nahin ho! Tum, jo murtiyon se nafrat ka dikhaava karte ho, khud hi unke temple nahin lutte!
Tum, jo law par garv karte ho, kya tum khud hi law bhang kar God ki hi pratishtha bhang nahin karte!
Jaisa ki Scripture ka hi lekh hai: tum gair-Yahudiyon ke bich God ki ninda ke kaaran ho.
Har ek nazrie se bahut kuchh! Sabse pahle to yah ki Yahudiyon ko hi God ke ishvriy vachan saumpe gae.
Isse kya antar parta hai ki kuchh ne faith nahin kiya. Kya unka unbelief God ki faithfulness ko samaapt kar deta hai? Nahin! Bilkul nahin!

Duniya ka pratyek person jhutha saabit ho sakta hai lekin God hi hain, jo apne vachan ka follow karte raheinge, jaisa ki Scripture ka lekh hai: “Aap apni baaton mein righteous saabit hon aur justice hone par jay paaein.”
Scripture ka lekh bhi yahi hai: “Koi bhi righteous nahin—ek bhi nahin;
Koi bhi nahin, jismein sochne ki power hai; koi bhi nahin, jo God ko khojta hai!
Sabhi God se dur ho gae, ve sab nikamme ho gae. Koi bhi bhalaai karnevaala nahin, ek bhi nahin.”
“Unke gale khuli kabr aur unki jibh chhal-kapat ka saadhan hain.” “Unke honthon se ghaatak saampon ka vish chhalakta hai.”
“Unke munh shaap aur karvaahat se bhare hue hain.”
“Unke paanv lahu bahaane ke lie phurtile hain;
Vinaash aur klesh unke raasta mein bichhe hain,
Shaanti ke raasta se ve hamesha anjaan hain.”
“Uski nazar mein God ke prati koi dar hai hi nahin.”
Ab hamein yah to maalum ho gaya ki law ke nirdesh unhin se kahte hain, jo law ke adhin hain ki har ek munh band ho jaae aur pura vishv God ke saamne hisaab denevaala ho jaae
Tab hamaare ghamand ka kya hua? Uska bahishkaar kar diya gaya hai. Kis siddhaant ke dvaara? Kaamon ke siddhaant ke dvaara? Nahin! Yah hua hai faith ki law dvaara.
Kya God sirph Yahudiyon hi ke God hain? Kya vah gair-Yahudiyon ke God nahin? Nihsandeh, vah unke bhi God hain;
To kya hamaara faith law ko vyarth thahraata hai? Nahin! Bilkul nahin! Iske viprit apne faith ke dvaara ham law ko sthir karte hain.
Ham apne gotrpita Abraham ke baare mein kya kahein—kya tha is baare mein unka anubhav?
Mazdur ki mazduri uska uphaar nahin, authority hai.
Jaise David ne us person ki dhanyta ka varnan kiya hai, jise God ne law ka follow na karne par bhi right thehraaya:
Yadi law ka follow karne se unhein miraas receive hoti hai to faith khokhla aur promise beasar saabit ho gai hai.

Parinaamasvrup faith hi us promise ka aadhaar hai, ki God ke grace mein Abraham ke sabhi vanshjon ko yah promise nishchit rup se receive ho sake—na keval unhein, jo law ke adhin hain lekin unhein bhi, jinka faith vaisa hi hai, jaisa Abraham ka, jo ham sabhi ke gotrpita hain.

Jaisa ki Scripture ka lekh hai: “Mainne tumhein kai raashtron ka pita thahraaya hai.” Hamaare gotrpita Abraham ne unhin God mein faith kiya, jo mare huon ko life dete hain aur astitv mein aane ki command unhein dete hain, jo hain hi nahin.
Bilkul niraasha ki situation mein bhi Abraham ne unse ki gai is promise ke thik anurup us ummid mein faith kiya: vah anekon raashtron ke pita honge, aise hi honge tumhaare vanshaj.
Abraham jaante the ki unka body mari hue dasha mein tha kyonki unki aayu lagbhag sau varsh thi aur saaraah ka garbh to mrit tha hi. Phir bhi vah faith mein kamjor nahin hue.
Unhonne God ki promise ke sambandh mein apne faith mein vichlit na hokar, khud ko usmein majbut karte hue God ki glory ki
Aur puri tarah nishchint rahe ki vah, jinhonne yah promise ki hai, use pura karne mein bhi saamarthyi hain.
Unke lie righteousness maani gai, ye word sirf unhin ke baare mein nahin hain,
Jinke maadhyam se faith ke dvaara hamaari pahunch us grace mein hai, jismein ham ab sthir hain. Ab ham God ki glory ki ummid mein aanandit hain.
Aur ummid lajjit kabhi nahin hone deti kyonki hamein di hui Holy Spirit dvaara God ka love hamaare dilon mein undel diya gaya hai.
Apraadh, vardaan ke jaisa nahin. Ek insaan ke apraadh ke kaaran anekon ki maut hui, jabki God ke grace aur ek insaan, Yeshu ke grace mein diya hua vardaan anekon kai mein sthaapit ho gaya.

Kyonki jab ek insaan ke apraadh ke kaaran ek hi insaan ke maadhyam se maut ka shaasan ho gaya, tab isse kahin adhik phaila hua hai bara grace aur righteousness ka vah vardaan, jo unke life mein us ek insaan, Yeshu ke dvaara shaasan karega.
Dear bhaai bahino, tum jo law se parichit ho, kya tumhein yah maalum nahin ki kisi bhi person par law ki prabhuta usi samay tak rahti hai jab tak vah jivit hai?
Kaanuni taur par vivaahit aurat apne pati se usi samay tak bandhi rahti hai jab tak uska pati jivit hai, lekin pati ki maut hone par vah kaanuni rup se apne pati se mukt ho jaati hai.

Yadi apne pati ke jivit rahte hue vah kisi dusre aadmi se sambandh banaati hai to vah vyabhichaarini kahlaati hai lekin apne pati ki maut ke baad vah kaanuni rup se svatantr ho jaati hai aur dusre aadmi se vivaah karne par vyabhichaarini nahin kahlaati.

Lekin ab ham uske prati mare sarikhe hokar, jisne hamein baandh rakha tha, law se svatantr kar die gae hain ki ham law dvaara sthaapit puraani riti par nahin lekin Holy Spirit dvaara ek nai riti mein service karne lag jaaein.
Aur meri maut ho gai, aur vah command jisse mujhe jivit hona tha, meri maut ka kaaran bani
Isliye law holy hai aur command holy, righteous aur bhali hai.
Yah isliye ki yah meri samajh se hamesha se pare hai ki main kya karta hun—main vah nahin karta, jo main karna chaahta hun lekin main vahi karta hun, jisse mujhe nafrat hai.
Isliye yadi main vahi sab karta hun, jo mujhe apriy hai, to main law se sahmat hun aur accept karta hun ki yah sahi hai.
Vah hit, jiski mujhmein abhilaasha hai, mujhse karte nahin banta lekin ho vah jaata hai, jise main karna nahin chaahta.
Yahaan mujhe is sach ka ahsaas hota hai ki jab bhi main bhalaai ke lie utaaru hota hun, vahaan mujhse buraai ho jaati hai.
Mera bhitri manushyatv to God ki law mein prasann hai
Ve sabhi, jo God ke aatma dvaara chalaae jaate hain, God ki children hain.
Tumhein daasatv ki vah aatma nahin di gai, jo tumhein dobaara dar ki or le jaaye, lekin tumhein lepaalakpan ki aatma provide ki gai hai. Isi ki prerna se ham pukaarte hain, “Abba! Pita!”
Khud Holy Spirit hamaari aatma ke saath is sach ki pushti karte hain ki ham God ki children hain
Aur jab ham children hi hain to ham vaaris bhi hain—God ke vaaris aur Yeshu ke sahvaaris—yadi ham vaastav mein unke saath yaatnaaein sahte hain ki ham unke saath gaurvaanvit bhi hon.

Isi tarah Holy Spirit bhi hamaari durbalta ki situation mein hamaari madad ke lie hamse jur jaate hain kyonki ham nahin jaante ki prayer kis tarah karna sahi hai lekin Holy Spirit khud hamaare lie madhyasth hokar aisi aahon ke saath jo bayaan se baahar hai prayer karte rahte hain
Aur manon ko jaanchnevaale God yah jaante hain ki Holy Spirit ka purpose kya hai kyonki Holy Spirit God ki will ke hisaab se holy logon ke lie prayer karte hain.
Hamein yah ahsaas hai ki jo log God se love karte hain aur God ki will ke hisaab se bulaaye gaye hain, unke liye sab baatein milkar bhalaai hi ko utpann karti hain.
To is baare mein kya kaha ja sakta hai? Yadi God hamaare paksh mein hain to kaun ho sakta hai hamaara virodhi?
Kaun hamein Yeshu ke love se alag karega? Klesh, sankat, sataahat, akaal, kangaali, jokhim ya talvaar se maut?
Thik jaisa Scripture mein likha bhi hai: “Aapke nimitt ham din bhar maut ka saamna karte rahte hain; hamaari situation vadh ke lie nirdhaarit bheron ke jaisa hai.”
Magar in sab vishyon mein ham unke maadhyam se, jinhonne hamse love kiya hai, vijyi se bhi barhkar hain.
Na unchaai, na gahraai aur na koi aur srishti hamaare Lord Yeshu mein God ke jo love hai, usse hamein alag kar sakti hai.
Yeshu mein main yah sach reveal kar raha hun—yah jhuth nahin—Holy Spirit mein meri antraatma is sach ki pushti kar rahi hai
Ki mera dil bahut khedit aur bahut dard mein hai.
Main yah kaamna kar sakta tha ki achchha hota ki khud main shaapit hota—apne bhaaiyon ke lie, jo shaaririk rup se mere sajaatiy hain—Yeshu se alag ho jaata.
Ye sabhi israaeli hain. Lepaalakpan ke kaaran uttraadhikaar, glory, vaachaaein, law, temple ki service-worship nirdesh aur pratijnaaein inhin ki hain.
Purkhe bhi inhin ke hain aur shaaririk paksh ke hisaab se Yeshu bhi inhin ke vanshaj hain, jo sarvochch hain, jo yugaanuyug praise ke yogy God hain, aamen.
Kya God ki promise viphal ho gayi? Nahin! Vaastvik israaeli ve sabhi nahin, jo Israel ke vanshaj hain
Aur na hi sirf Abraham ka vanshaj hona unhein God ki children bana deta hai. Iske viprit, likha hai: tumhaare vanshaj yitshaak ke maadhyam se naamit honge.
Arthaat shaaririk rup se janme hue God ki children nahin lekin promise ke antargat janme hue hi vaastvik children samjhe jaate hain
Kyonki promise is tarah ki gai: “Agle varsh main isi samay dobaara aaunga aur saaraah ka ek son hoga.”
Hamein bhi, jo unke dvaara bulaae gae hain, sirf Yahudiyon hi mein se nahin, lekin gair-Yahudiyon mein se bhi.
Jaisa ki vah prophet hoshe ke abhilekh mein bhi kahte hain: “Main unhein ‘Apni people’ Ghoshit karunga, jo meri people nahin the; aur unhein ‘Dear’ Sambodhit karunga, jo priyjan the hi nahin,”
Aur, “Jis jagah par unse yah kaha gaya tha, ‘Tum meri people nahin ho,’ Usi jagah par ve ‘Jivit God ki children’ Ghoshit kie jaaeinge.”
Tab parinaam kya nikla? Ve gair-Yahudi, jo righteousness ko khoj bhi nahin rahe the, unhonne righteousness receive kar li—vah bhi vah righteousness, jo faith ke dvaara hai.
Lekin righteousness ki law ki khoj kar raha Israel us law ke bhed tak pahunchne mein asphal hi raha.
Dear bhaai bahino, unka bachaav hi meri haardik abhilaasha aur God se meri prayer ka vishay hai.
Unke baare mein main yah gavaahi deta hun ki unmein God ke prati utsaah to hai lekin unka yah utsaah vaastvik knowledge ke hisaab se nahin hai.
God ki righteousness ke baare mein ajnaanta aur apni hi righteousness ki sthaapna karne ke utsaah mein unhonne khud ko God ki righteousness ke adhin nahin kiya.
Us har ek person ke lie, jo Yeshu mein faith karta hai, Yeshu hi righteousness ki law ki samaapti hain.
Moshe ke hisaab se law par aadhaarit righteousness hai, jo inka anusran karega, vah inke kaaran jivit rahega.
Lekin faith par aadhaarit righteousness ka bhed hai: apne man mein yah soch na karo: heaven par kaun charhega, Yeshu ko utaar laane ke lie?
Yahudi aur yunaani mein koi bhed nahin rah gaya kyonki ek hi Lord sabke Lord hain, jo un sabke lie, jo unki dohaai dete hain, apaar sampda hain.
Isliye spasht hai ki faith ki utpatti hoti hai sunne ke maadhyam se aur sunna Yeshu ke vachan ke maadhyam se.
Lekin ab savaal yah hai: kya unhonne suna nahin? Nihsandeh unhonne suna hai: unka word saari prithvi mein aur, unka sandesh prithvi ke chhor tak pahunch chuka hai.

Mera savaal hai, kya israaeli ise samajh sake? Pahle Moshe ne kaha: main ek aisi janta ke dvaara tummein jalanbhaav utpann karunga, jo raashtr hai hi nahin. Main tumhein ek aise raashtr ke dvaara krodhit karunga, jismein samajh hai hi nahin.
Iske baad prophet yashaayaah nidartaapurvak kahte hain: mujhe to unhonne pa liya, jo mujhe khoj bhi nahin rahe the aur main un par reveal ho gaya, jinhonne iski kaamna bhi nahin ki thi.
Israel ke baare mein God ka kathan hai: “Main command na maannevaali aur hathili people ke saamne pure din haath pasaare raha.”
To mera savaal yah hai: kya God ne apni people ka tyaag kar diya hai? Nahin! Bilkul nahin! Kyonki khud main ek israaeli hun—Abraham ki children aur binyaamin ka vanshaj.

God ne apni purvaavgat people ka tyaag nahin kar diya ya kya tum yah nahin jaante ki Scripture mein Eliyah se sambandhit bhaag mein kya kaha gaya hai—Israel ke khilaaf hokar vah God se kaise request karte hain:
“Lord, unhonne aapke bhavishyadvaktaaon ki murder kar di hai, unhonne aapki vediyaan dhvast kar din. Sirf main shesh raha hun aur ab ve mere praanon ke pyaase hain?”
Is par God ka uttar kya tha? “Mainne apne lie aise saat hazaar person chun rakhe hain, jo baal devta ke saamne natmastak nahin hue hain.”
Ab, yadi iski utpatti grace ke dvaara hi hui hai to iska aadhaar kaam nahin hain nahin to grace, grace nahin rah jaaega.

To mera savaal yah hai: kya unhein aisi thokar lagi ki ve kabhi na uth paaein? Nahin! Bilkul nahin! Yahudiyon ke girne ke dvaara hi gair-Yahudiyon ko bachaav receive hua hai ki Yahudiyon mein jalanbhaav utpann ho jaae.
Yadi unki giraavat hi duniya ke lie spiritual wealth aur unki asphalta hi gair-Yahudiyon ke lie spiritual wealth saabit hui hai to kitna jyaada hoga un sabhi ki bharpuri ka prabhaav!
Ab main tumse baatein karta hun, jo gair-Yahudi ho. Ab, jabki main gair-Yahudiyon ke lie apostle hun, mujhe apni sevkaai ka garv hai
Kyonki yadi unki asvikriti duniya se God ke mel-milaap ka kaaran ban gai hai, to unki svikriti mare huon mein se ji uthne ke alaava kya ho sakti hai?
Yadi bheint ka pahla peda holy thahra to gundha hua saara aata hi holy hai. Yadi jar holy hai to shaakhaaein bhi holy hi huin na?
Lekin yadi kuchh shaakhaaein tori gai aur tum, jo ek jangli zaitun ho, unmein rope gae ho aur unke saath zaitun per ki jar ke ang hone ke kaaran paushtik saar ke sahbhaagi ban gae ho
To un shaakhaaon ka ghamand na bharna. Yadi tum ghamand bharte hi ho to is sach par soch karo: yah tum nahin, jo jar ke poshak ho lekin jar hi hai, jo tumhaara poshak hai.
Tab tumhaara dusra tark hoga: “Shaakhaaein tori gai ki mujhe ropa ja sake.”
Thik hai. Lekin unhein to unke unbelief ke kaaran alag kiya gaya lekin tum sthir ho apne faith ke kaaran. Iske baare mein ghamand na bharte hue shraddha bhaav ko jagah do.
Tab ve bhi, yadi ve apne unbelief ke hath mein bane na rahein, rope jaaeinge kyonki God unhein ropne mein samarth hain.

Jab tumhein us per se, jo praakritik rup se jangli zaitun hai, kaatkar svabhaav ke khilaaf phal denevaale jaitun ke per mein jora gaya hai, tab ve shaakhaaein, jo praakritik hain, apne hi mul per mein kitni saraltaapurvak jor li jaaeingi!
God dvaara diya gaya vardaan aur unka bulaava atal hain.
Thik jis tarah tumne, jo kisi samay God ki command na maannevaale the, ab un Yahudiyon ki anaajnaakaarita ke kaaran kripaadrishti receive ki hai.
Ve abhi bhi anaajnaakaari hain ki tum par dikhaai gai kripaadrishti ke kaaran un par bhi kripaadrishti ho jaae.
Is samay God ne sabhi ko command ke ullanghan ki sima mein rakh diya hai ki vah sabhi par kripaadrishti kar sakein.
Oh! Kaisa apaar hai God ki samajh aur knowledge ka bhandaar! Kaise athaah hain unke nirnay! Aur kaisa rahasyamyi hai unke kaam karne ka tarika!
Bhala kaun jaan saka hai God ke man ko? Ya kaun hua hai unka salaahkaar?
Kya kisi ne God ko kabhi kuchh diya hai ki God use vah lautaaein?
Vahi hain sab kuchh ke srot, vahi hain sab kuchh ke kaarak, vahi hain sab kuchh ki niyti—unhin ki glory hamesha-hamesha hoti rahe, aamen.

Dear bhaai bahino, God ki bari daya ke prakaash mein tum sabse meri request hai ki tum apne body ko God ke lie God ko bhaanevaala life aur holy bali ke taur par bheint karo. Yahi tumhaari spiritual worship ki vidhi hai.
Is duniya ke svarup mein na dhalo, lekin man ke nae ho jaane ke dvaara tummein jar se parivartan ho jaae ki tum God ki will ko, jo uttam, grahan karne yogy aur trutihin hai, satyaapit kar sako.

Mujhe die gae bare grace ke dvaara main tummein se har ek ko sambodhit karte hue kahta hun ki koi bhi khud ko adhik na samjhe, lekin khud ke baare mein tumhaara aanklan God dvaara die gae faith ke parimaan ke hisaab se ho.
Yah isliye ki jis tarah hamaare body mein kai ang hote hain aur sab ang ek hi kaam nahin karte;
Usi tarah ham, jo kai hain, Yeshu mein ek body aur vyaktigat rup se sabhi ek dusre ke ang hain.
Isliye ki hamein die gae grace ke hisaab se hammein Holy Spirit dvaara di gai bhinn-bhinn kshamtaaein hain. Jise bhavishyvaani ki kshamta receive hai, vah uska upyog apne faith ke hisaab se kare;
Yadi sevkaai ki, to sevkaai mein; sikhaane ki, to sikhaane mein;
Updeshak ki, to updesh dene mein; madad ki, to bina dikhaave ke udaartaapurvak dene mein; jise aguvaai ki, vah mehnat ke saath aguvaai kare aur jise karunaabhaav ki, vah iska prayog saharsh kare.
Love nishkpat ho; buraai se nafrat karo; aadarsh ke prati aasakt raho;
Aapsi love mein samarpit raho; anyon ko uncha sammaan do;
Tumhaara utsaah kabhi kam na ho; spiritual utsaah bana rahe; Lord ki service karte raho;
Ummid mein khushi, kleshon mein sabr aur prayer mein niymitta banaae rakho;
Holy santon ki madad ke lie tatpar raho, aatithy satkaar karte raho.
Apne sataanevaalon ke lie tumhaare chehra se blessing hi nikle—blessing—na ki shaap;
Jo aanandit hain, unke saath khushi manaao aur jo shokit hain, unke saath shok;
Tummein aapas mein mel bhaav ho; tumhaari soch mein ahankaar na ho lekin unse milne-julne ke lie tatpar raho, jo samaaj ki nazar mein chhote hain; khud ko jnaanvaan na samjho.
Kisi ke prati bhi dushtta ka badla dushtta na ho; tumhaara svabhaav sab ki nazar mein suhaavna ho;
Yadi sambhav ho to yathaashakti sabhi ke saath mel banaae rakho.
Yadi tumhaara dushman bhukha hai, use khaana karaao, yadi vah pyaasa hai, use paani do; aisa karke tum uske sir par angaaron ka dher laga doge.
Buraai se na haarkar buraai ko bhalaai ke dvaara hara do.
Jise jo kuchh diya jaana nirdhaarit hai, use vah do: jise kar dena hai, use kar do; jise shulk, use shulk; jinse darna hai, unse daro aur jo sammaan ke adhikaari hain, unka sammaan karo.
Aapsi love ke alaava kisi ke karzdaar na ho. Vah jo apne parosi se love karta hai, usne law ka follow kar liya

Kyonki: vyabhichaar mat karo, murder mat karo, chori mat karo, lobh mat karo, aur iske atirikt yadi koi bhi dusre command ho to uska saar yahi hai: apne parosi ke lie tumhaara love vaisa hi ho jaisa tumhaara khud ke lie hai.
Love parosi ka bura nahin karta. Isliye love law ki purti hai.
Zaruri hai ki tum samay ko pahchaano. Tumhaara nind se jaag jaane ka samay a chuka hai. Us samay ki tulna mein, jab hamne is faith ko apnaaya tha, hamaare bachaav ki purti paas hai.
Raat samaapt hone par hai. Din ka shuru ho raha hai. Isliye ham andhera ke kaamon ko tyaag kar roshni ke shastr dhaaran kar lein.
Hamaara svabhaav samay ke hisaab se—din ke anukul ho, na ki lila-krira, piyakkarpan, vyabhichaar, bhrasht aachran, jhagra aur jalan se bhara,
Faith mein kamjor person ko uski maanytaaon ke baare mein kisi bhi shanka ke bina hi accept karo.
Ek person is faith se sab kuchh khaata hai ki sabhi kuchh bhojy hai lekin jiska faith nirbal hai, vah sirf saag-paat hi khaata hai.

Vah, jo sab kuchh khaata hai, use tuchchh nazar se na dekhe, jo sab kuchh nahin khaata; isi tarah vah, jo sab kuchh nahin khaata, us par dosh na lagaae, jo sab kuchh khaata hai kyonki God ne use accept kar hi liya hai.
Kaun ho tum, jo kisi aur ke servant par ungli utha rahe ho? Servant sthir rahe ya gire, yah uske maalik ki zimmedaari hai. Vah sthir hi hoga kyonki Lord use sthir karne mein samarth hain.
Koi kisi ek vishesh din ko mahatv deta hai jabki kisi dusre ke lie sabhi din ek jaisa hote hain. Har ek apni-apni dhaarna mein hi puri tarah nishchit rahe.

Jo person kisi vishesh din ko mahatv deta hai, vah use Lord ke lie mahatv deta hai aur vah, jo sab kuchh khaata hai, Lord ke lie khaata hai kyonki vah iske lie God ke prati thanks reveal karta hai aur jo nahin khaata, vah Lord ka dhyaan rakhte hue nahin khaata aur vah bhi God hi ke prati thanks reveal karta hai.
Hammein se kisi ka bhi life uska apna nahin hai aur na hi kisi ki maut khud uske lie hoti hai
Kyonki yadi ham jivit hain to Lord ke lie aur yadi hamaari maut hoti hai, to vah bhi Lord ke lie hi. Isliye ham jivit rahein ya hamaari maut ho, ham Lord hi ke hain.
Lekin tum saathi par aarop kyon lagaate ho? Ya tum use tuchchh kyon samajhte ho? Ham sabhi ko God ke justice aasan ke saamne upasthit hona hai.
Scripture ka lekh hai: “Yah Lord ka kahna hai, ‘Shapath mere life ki, har ek ghutna mere saamne jhuk jaaega, har ek jibh God ko accept karegi.’ ”
Hammein se pratyek God ko khud apna hisaab dega.
Isliye ab se ham ek dusre par aarop na lagaaein lekin yah nishchay karein ki ham apne bhaai ke raasta mein na to baadha utpann kareinge aur na hi thokar ka koi kaaran.

Mujhe yah maalum hai aur Lord Yeshu mein main puri tarah se nishchit hun ki apne aap mein kuchh bhi ashuddh nahin hai. Yadi kisi person ne kisi vastu ko ashuddh maan hi liya hai, vah uske lie hi ashuddh hai.
Yadi aapke khaana ke kaaran saathi udaas hota hai to tumhaara svabhaav love ke hisaab se nahin raha. Apne khaana ke kaaran to uska vinaash na karo, jiske lie Yeshu ne apne jaan die!
Isliye jo tumhaari nazar mein tumhaare lie sahi aur uchit hai, uske baare mein anyon ko ninda karne ka avsar na mile
Kyonki God ka kingdom sirf khaan-paan ke baare mein nahin lekin Holy Spirit mein righteousness, shaanti aur khushi mein hai.
Jo koi Yeshu ki service is bhaav mein karta hai, vah God ko grahan yogy aur insaanon dvaara bhaata hai.
Ham apne sabhi koshish paarasprik aur ek dusre ki unnti ki disha mein hi lakshit karein.

Khaana ko mahatv dete hue God ke kaam ko na bigaaro. Vaastav mein sabhi bhojy padaarth svachchh hain lekin ye us person ke lie bure ho jaate hain, jo inhein khaakar dusre ke lie thokar ka kaaran banta hai.
Sahi yah hai ki na to maans ka sevan kiya jaae aur na hi daakhras ka ya aisa kuchh bhi kiya jaae, jisse saathi ko thokar lage.
In vishyon par apne faith ko khud apne aur God ke beech simit rakho. Blessed hai vah person, jiski antraatma uske dvaara svikrit kie gae vishyon mein use nahin dhikkaarti.
Zaruri hai ki ham, jo faith mein majbut hain, kamzoron ki kamzori ke prati sabr ka bhaav rakhein na ki sirph apni prasannta ka.
Hammein se pratyek apne parosi ki bhalaai aur unnti ke lie uski prasannta ka dhyaan rakhe.
Kyonki Yeshu ne apne aapko prasann nahin kiya jaisa ki Scripture ka lekh hai: unki ninda, jo aapke nindak hain, mujh par a pari hai.
Pahle samay ke sabhi abhilekh hamein teaching dene ke purpose se likhe gae ki nirantar koshish aur Scripture ke protsaahan dvaara hammein ummid ka anubhav ho.
God, jo sabr aur protsaahan ke daata hai, tummein Yeshu ke anurup aapas mein ekta ka bhaav utpann karein
Ki tum ek man aur ek word mein God, hamaare Lord Yeshu ke pita ka thanks aur glory karo.
Isliye ek dusre ko accept karo—thik jis tarah Yeshu ne God ki glory ke lie hamein accept kiya hai.
Aur gair-Yahudi God ki kripaadrishti ke lie unki glory karein, jaisa ki Scripture ka lekh hai: isliye main gair-Yahudiyon ke bich aapka thanks karunga; main aapke naam ka gungaan karunga.
Phir likha hai: gair-Yahudiyon! God ki people ke saath milkar khushi karo.
Aur yah bhi: sabhi gair-Yahudiyon! Tum Lord ka thanks karo; sabhi janta unka thanks karein.
Dear bhaai bahino, tumhaare baare mein khud main bhi nishchit hun ki tum bhi sarvgunsampann, sabhi knowledge se bharkar aur ek dusre ko kartavy ki yaad dilaane mein puri tarah saksham ho.
Phir bhi mainne kuchh vishyon par tumhein saahas karke likha hai ki tumhein inka dobaara smaran dila sakun. Yah isliye ki mujhe God ke dvaara grace provide kiya gaya
Ki main God ke ishvriy good news ke priest ke taur par gair-Yahudiyon ke lie Yeshu ka servant banun ki gair-Yahudi Holy Spirit ke dvaara alag kie jaakar God ke lie grahan yogy bheint ban jaaein.
Ab mere paas Yeshu mein God sambandhit vishyon par garv karne ka kaaran hai.
Main sirf un vishyon ka varnan karna chaahunga, jo Yeshu ne mujhe maadhyam banaakar mere prachaar ke dvaara pure kie, jiska parinaam hua gair-Yahudiyon ki aajnaakaarita.
Jaisa Scripture ka lekh hai: ve, jinhonne unka samaachaar receive nahin kiya, unhein dekheinge aur ve, jinhonne kuchh bhi nahin suna, samajh leinge.
Yahi vah kaaran hai ki tumse bheint karne ke lie mere aane mein baadha parti rahi.
Ab in deshon mein mere saamne koi jagah baaki nahin raha aur kai varshon se meri yah chaahat bhi rahi hai ki tumse bheint karun.

Mere lie yah sambhav ho sakega jab main spen yaatra ko jaaunga. Mujhe ummid hai ki jaate hue tumse bheint ho aur thore samay ke lie tumhaari sangti ka khushi lun aur tumhaari madad bhi receive kar sakun
Lekin is samay to main Yerushalem ke holy logon ki madad ke lie Yerushalem ki or ja raha hun.
Makedoniya aur aakhaaya pradesh ki kalisiyaaein Yerushalem ke nirdhan holy logon ki madad ke lie khushi se saamne aai.

Sach maano, unhonne yah khushi se kiya hai. Ve Yerushalem vaasiyon ke karzdaar hain kyonki jab gair-Yahudiyon ne unse spiritual wealth receive kiya hai to yah uchit hi hai ki ab ve bhautik vastuon dvaara bhi unki madad karein.
Isliye apne kartavy ko pura kar jab main nishchit ho jaaunga ki unhein yah raashi receive ho gai hai, main spen ki or jaaunga aur raasta mein tumse bheint karunga.
Yah to mujhe maalum hai ki jab main tumse bheint karunga, mere saath Yeshu ki blessing puri tarah hongi.
Ab, dear bhaai bahino, hamaare Lord Yeshu aur Holy Spirit ke love ke dvaara tumse meri request hai ki mere saath milkar God se mere lie praarthnaaon mein jut jaao
Ki main Yahudiya pradesh ke avishvaasi logon ki yojnaaon se bach sakun aur Yerushalem ke holy logon ke prati meri service unhein accept ho
Ki main God ki will ke dvaara tumse aanandpurvak bheint kar sakun aur tumhaari sangti mere lie ek sukhad vishraam ho jaae.
Shaanti ke God tum sabke saath rahein. Aamen.
Main, hamaari bahan foibe ko, jo kenakhreya shehar ki church ki vishvast sevika hai.
Jaisa holy logon ke lie sahi hai, Lord mein use accept kar use jis kisi taur par bhi madad ki zarurat ho, provide karo. Khud usne anekon ki madad ki hai aur meri bhi.
Yeshu mein mere sahsevkon priska aur akulos ko mera namaskaar.
Unhonne mere hit mein apne jaan jokhim mein daale the. Na keval main lekin gair-Yahudiyon ki sabhi kalisiyaaein unki rini hain.
Us church ko namaskaar, jo unke ghar mein ikattha hoti hai. Mere dear mitr ipaaenetos ko namaskaar. Aasiya pradesh mein usi ne sabse pahle Yeshu ko accept kiya tha.
Mariyam ko namaskaar. Usne tumhaare lie bahut parishram kiya hai.
Aandronikos aur yuniyas ko namaskaar. Ye mere sambandhi aur sahbandi hain. Apostles mein inka jagah varnniy hai. Ye bhi mujhse pahle Yeshu mein a chuke the.
Lord mein mere dear aampliyaatos ko namaskaar.
Yeshu mein hamaare sahkarmi arbaanas ko namaskaar aur mere dear staakhus ko bhi.
Yeshu mein pramaanit aur svikrit apelles ko namaskaar. Aaristobulas ke parijnon ko namaskaar.
Mere sambandhi herodiyon ko namaskaar. Naarkisas ke parijnon mein se unhein, jo Lord ke anugaami hain, namaskaar.
Lord ke karmi triphena aur trufosa ko namaskaar. Mere dear parsis ko namaskaar. Usne Lord mein athak parishram kiya hai.
Lord ke chune hue person rufos ko namaskaar aur uski maata ko bhi, jo meri bhi maata hain.
Aasunkritos, flegon, hermes, paatrobas, hermes aur unke sahyogi bhaai bahinon ko namaskaar.
Filologos aur yuliya, nereyus, uski bahan aur olumpas aur unke saath sabhi holy logon ko namaskaar.
Tumhaara paarasprik namaskaar holy chumban ke saath ho. Yeshu ki sabhi kalisiyaaon ki or se tumhein namaskaar.
Ye log hamaare Lord Yeshu ke nahin lekin apni hi laalsaaon ke slave hain. Apni chikni-chupri aur chaturaai se ki gai baatchit ke dvaara ve bhole-bhaale logon ko bhatka dete hain.
Sabhi tumhaari aajnaakaarita ke baare mein sun chuke hain. Yah mere lie khushi ka vishay hai. Phir bhi meri yah chaahat hai ki tum bhalaai ke prati wise aur buraai ke prati bhole bane raho.
Shaanti ke God shighr hi aarop lagaanevaala ko tumhaare paanvon ke niche kuchal deinge. Hamaare Lord Yeshu ka grace tum par bana rahe.
Mere sahkarmi timothiyos ka namaskaar. Vaise hi mere parijan lukiyos, yaason aur sosipaatros ka bhi.
Is patr ke likhnevaale, tertiyos ka tumhein Lord mein namaskaar.
Gaayos ka, jiske yahaan main atithi hun aur jiske ghar par church worship karti hai, tumhein namaskaar. Shehar koshaadhyaksh iraastus aur sangi believer kvaartos ka bhi tumhein namaskaar. [
Ab us God ko, jo tumko mere good news aur Yeshu ke prachaar dvaara aur sashakt kar sakta, us bhed ke prakaashan ke hisaab se, jo sanaatan se chhipaakar rakha gaya tha;
Yeshu ke dvaara un ekmaatr wise God ki glory hamesha-hamesha hoti rahe! Aamen.
God ki will ke hisaab se Yeshu ke lie bulaae gae apostle Paulos aur hamaare bhaai sosthenes ki or se.

Korinthos shehar mein sthaapit God ki church ko ve, jo Yeshu mein holy kie gae hain aur jinka un sabke jaisa, jo har jagah hamaare aur unke Lord Yeshu ki praise karte hain, holy logon ke taur par bulaaye gaye hain:
Tum sabko hamaare pita God aur Lord Yeshu ki or se grace aur shaanti.
Yeshu mein tumhein die gae God ke grace ke lie main tumhaare lie God ke prati nirantar thanks karta hun.
Kyonki tum Yeshu mein sab tarah se sampann kie gae ho, saare knowledge aur uski har baat mein;
Thik jis tarah tummein Yeshu ke sandesh ki pushti bhi hui hai.
Vahi Yeshu tumhein ant tak drirh banaae rakheinge ki tum hamaare Lord Yeshu ke din nirdosh paae jaao.
God faithful hain, jinke dvaara tumhaara bulaava unke son, Yeshu hamaare Lord ki sangti mein kiya gaya hai.
Dear bhaai bahino, apne Lord Yeshu ke naam mein meri tumse request hai, ki tummein aapsi mel ho, phut kahin bhi na ho, tum man aur mat mein ek ho.
Kyonki tumhaare baare mein, dear bhaai bahino, kloe parivaar ke kuchh sadasyon dvaara mujhe yah sanket diya gaya hai ki tumhaare beech jhagra chal raha hai.
Mere kahne ka matlab yah hai ki tummein har ek ka mat alag hai: koi kahta hai, “Main Paulos ka disciple hun,” Koi, “Main apollos ka,” To koi, “Main kaifas ka,” Ya “Main Yeshu ka disciple hun.”
Kya Yeshu ka bantvaara kar diya gaya hai? Kya tumhaare lie Paulos ko krusit kiya gaya tha? Ya tumhaara baptisma Paulos ke naam mein kiya gaya tha?
Main God ka aabhaari hun ki krispos aur gaayos ke atirikt tummein se kisi ko bhi mainne baptisma nahin diya,
(haan, mainne stefaanos ke parivaar ko bhi baptisma diya hai lekin iske alaava mainne kisi dusre ko baptisma diya ho, iska mujhe dhyaan nahin.)
Jaisa ki Scripture ka lekh hai: “Main jnaaniyon ka knowledge barbaadi kar dunga; aur samajhdaaron ki samajh ko shuny.”
Kahaan hai wise? Kahaan hai shaastri? Aur kahaan hai is yug ka vivaadi? Kya God ke saamne duniya ka saara knowledge murkhta nahin hai?
Yahudi chamatkaar chihnon ki maang karte hain aur yunaani knowledge ke khoji hain,
Lekin bulaae huon, Yahudi ya yunaani donon hi ke lie yahi Yeshu God ka power aur God ka knowledge hain.
Kyonki God ki murkhta insaanon ki samajh se kahin adhik wise, aur God ki durbalta insaanon ke bal se kahin adhik balvaan hai.
Dear bhaai bahino, yaad karo ki jab tumhein bulaaya gaya, us samay anekon mein na to body ke hisaab se knowledge tha, na hi bal aur na hi kulinta.
Jnaanvaanon ko lajjit karne ke lie God ne unko chuna, jo duniya ki nazar mein bewakoof hai aur shaktishaaliyon ko lajjit karne ke lie usko, jo duniya ki nazar mein durbal hai.
God ne unko chuna, jo duniya ki nazar mein nicha hai, tuchchh hai aur jo hai hi nahin ki use vyarth kar dein, jo mahatvpurn samjhi jaati hai,
Ki koi bhi insaan God ke saamne ghamand na kare.
Scripture ka lekh hai: “Jo garv karta hai, vah God mein garv kare.”
Kyonki tumhaare bich main is nishchay ke saath aaya tha ki main Yeshu aur unki krus ki maut ke alaava kisi bhi dusre vishay ko na jaanun.
Jab main tumhaare bich tha, main nirbal tha—bhaybhit aur tharathraata hua.
Ki tumhaare faith ka aadhaar God ka power ho, na ki insaan ka knowledge.
Phir bhi main unhein, jo majbut hain, knowledge bhara sandesh deta hun lekin yah knowledge na is yug ka hai aur na is yug ke shaaskon ka, jinka barbaadi hona tay hai.
Ham God ke knowledge ka—us rahasymay bhed ka—jo gupt rakha gaya hai, reveal karte hain, jise God ne yugon se pahle hamaari glory ke lie tay kiya tha.
Is knowledge ko is yug ke kisi bhi raaja ne na pahchaana. Yadi ve ise pahchaan lete, ve jyotirmay Lord ko krusit na karte.

Lekin, thik jaisa Scripture ka lekh hai: “Jo kabhi aankhon se dikhaai nahin diya, jo kabhi kaanon se suna nahin gaya, aur jo insaan ke dil mein nahin utra” Vah sab God ne unke lie jo unse love karte hain, taiyaar kiya hai.
Yah sab God ne ham par aatma ke maadhyam se reveal kiya. Aatma sab ki, yahaan tak ki God ki gurh baaton ki bhi khoj karte hain.
Insaanon mein insaan ki antraatma ke atirikt dusre koi bhi unke man ki baaton ko nahin jaanta.
Hamein duniya ki aatma nahin lekin vah aatma receive hui hai, jo God ki or se hain ki ham vah sab jaan sakein, jo God ne hamein udaartaapurvak provide kiya hai.
Ham unke lie, jo spiritual hain, spiritual baaton ka varnan insaan ke knowledge ke words ke dvaara nahin lekin spiritual words mein karte hain.
Bina aatma ka person God ke aatma ke vishay ki baaton ko accept nahin karta kyonki inhein vah murkhta maanta hai, ye sab uski samajh se pare hain kyonki inki vivechna Holy Spirit dvaara ki jaati hai.
Lekin vah, jo spiritual hai, pratyek baat ki jaanch karta hai lekin khud uski jaanch koi nahin karta,
Kyonki, “Kaun hai vah, jisne Lord ke man ko jaan liya hai ki vah unhein nirdesh de sake?” Lekin ham ve hain, jinmein Yeshu ka man maujud hai.
Dear bhaai bahno, main tumse us star par baat karne mein asmarth raha jis star par spiritual logon se ki jaati hai. Tumse meri baat aisi thi maano saansaarik logon se—Yeshu mein shishuon se.
Tumhein mainne aahaar ke lie dudh diya na ki thos aahaar kyonki tummein ise grahan karne ki kshamta hi na thi. Sach to yah hai ki tummein yah kshamta ab bhi nahin hai.
Kyonki tum ab bhi saansaarik hi ho. Jab tumhaare bich jalan aur jhagra hai to kya tum saansaarik na hue? Kya tumhaara svabhaav keval maanviy nahin?
Kyonki jab tummein se koi kahta hai, “Main Paulos ka hun,” Ya, “Main apollos ka hun,” To is svabhaav mein kya tum bilkul insaan hi na hue?
To phir, kya hai, apollos aur kya hai Paulos? Keval servant, jinke dvaara tumne faith kiya—har ek ne Lord dvaara saumpi gai zimmedaari ko nibhaaya.
Mainne ropa, apollos ne sincha lekin barhat God dvaara ki gai.
Isliye shrey yogy vah nahin hai, jisne use ropa ya jisne use sincha lekin sirph God, jinhonne usko bara kiya hai.
Vah, jo ropta hai aur vah, jo sinchta hai ek hi purpose ke lie kaam karte hain lekin donon hi ko apni-apni mehnat ke hisaab se pratiphal receive hoga.
Ham God ke sahkarmi hain, tum God ki zameen ho. Tum God ka bhavan ho.

God ke grace ke hisaab se mainne ek kushal mistri ke jaisa ninv daali aur ab koi aur us par bhavan nirmaan kar raha hai lekin har ek person saavdhaan rahe ki vah is ninv par us bhavan ka nirmaan kaise karta hai.
Jo ninv daali ja chuki hai, uske atirikt koi bhi person dusre ninv nahin daal sakta, khud Yeshu hi vah ninv hain.
Yadi koi is ninv par sone, chaandi, kimti ratn, lakri, bhusi ya ghaas se nirmaan kare to,
Vah din sach ko prakaash mein la dega kyonki kaamon ki parakh aag ke dvaara ki jaaegi. Yahi aag har ek ke kaam ko saabit karegi.
Yadi kisi ke dvaara banaaya bhavan is ninv par sthir rahta hai to use iska inaam receive hoga.
Kya tumhein yah ahsaas nahin ki tum God ka temple ho aur tummein God ka aatma vaas karta hai?
Yadi koi God ke temple ko barbaadi kare to vah bhi God dvaara barbaadi kar diya jaaega kyonki God ka temple holy hai aur khud tum vah temple ho.
Dhokhe mein na raho. Yadi tummein se koi yah soch baitha hai ki vah saansaarik baaton ke hisaab se wise hai, to sahi yah hoga ki vah khud ko “Bewakoof” Bana le ki vah wise ban jaae.
Kyonki sach yah hai ki saansaarik knowledge God ki nazar mein murkhta hai. Jaisa ki Scripture ka lekh hai: “Vahi hain, jo buddhimaanon ko unki chaturaai mein phansa dete hain.”
Aur yah bhi, “God jaante hain ki buddhimaanon ke soch vyarth hain.”
Isliye, koi bhi insaan ki uplabdhiyon ka garv na kare! Sab kuchh tumhaara hi hai,
Chaahe Paulos ho ya apollos ya kaifas, chaahe vah duniya ho ya life maut, chaahe vah vartmaan ho ya bhavishy—sab kuchh tumhaara hi hai,
Aur tum Yeshu ke ho, aur Yeshu God ke.
Sahi to yah hoga ki hamein Yeshu ka bhandaari sirf samjha jaae, jinhein God ke bhedon ki zimmedaari saumpi gai hai.
Bhandaari ko faithful hona zaruri hai.
Yah meri nazar mein mahatvhin hai ki meri parakh tumhaare dvaara ki jaae ya kisi nyaayaalay dvaara. Balki main khud apni parakh nahin karta.
Meri antraatma mujhmein koi dosh nahin paati, phir bhi isse main nirdosh saabit nahin ho jaata. Lord hi hain, jo meri parakh karte hain.

Dear bhaai bahno, mainne tumhaare hi hit mein apna aur apollos ka udaahran prastut kiya hai ki iske dvaara tum is baat se sambandhit teaching le sako, “Holy abhilekh ki maryaada ka ullanghan na karna.” Ki tum ek ka paksh le dusre ka tiraskaar na karne lago.

Kaun kahta hai ki tum anyon se shreshth ho? Kya hai tumhaare paas, jo tumhein kisi ke dvaara diya nahin gaya? Jab yah tumhein kisi ke dvaara hi diya gaya hai to tum ghamand aise kyon bharte ho maano yah tumhein kisi ke dvaara nahin diya gaya?

Tum to yah sochkar hi santusht ho gae ki tumhaari saari zarurton ki purti ho chuki—tum sampann ho gae ho, hamaare sahyog ke bina hi tum raaja ban gae ho! Uttam to yahi hota ki tum vaastav mein raaja ban jaate aur ham bhi tumhaare saath shaasan karte!
Ham Yeshu ke lie bewakoof hain, lekin tum Yeshu mein ek hokar wise ho! Ham durbal hain aur tum balvaan! Tum aadar paate ho aur ham tiraskaar!
Is samay bhi ham bhukhe-pyaase aur aparyaapt kapdon mein hain, sataae jaate aur maare-maare phirte hain.
Ham mehnat karte hain aur apne haathon se kaam karte hain. Jab hamaari buraai ki jaati hai, ham aashirvaad dete hain; ham sataae jaate hain lekin sabr se sahte hain;
Jab hamaari ninda ki jaati hai to ham vinamrta se uttar dete hain. Ham to maano is duniya ka mail aur sabke lie kura-karkat ban gae hain.
Yah sab main tumhein lajjit karne ke purpose se nahin likh raha lekin apni dear children ke taur par tumhein saavdhaan kar raha hun.

Isliye mainne timothiyos ko tumhaare paas bheja hai, jo mera dear aur Lord mein faithful son hai. Vahi tumhein Yeshu mein meri lifestyle ki yaad dilaaega—thik jaisi teaching iske baare mein main har jagah, har ek church mein deta hun.
Tummein se kuchh to ahankaar mein phule nahin sama rahe maano main vahaan aaunga hi nahin.
Yadi Lord ne chaaha to, main shighr hi tumhaare paas aaunga, tab na keval in ahankaariyon ki teaching lekin unka power bhi mere saamne spasht ho jaaega.
God ka kingdom sirf words mein nahin lekin power mein nihit hai.
To kya chaahte ho tum? Main tumhaare paas chhari lekar aaun ya namrta ke bhaav mein love ke saath?
Tumhaare bich jhagra uthne ki situation mein kaun apna phaisla holy logon ke saamne na laakar saansaarik nyaayaadhish ke saamne le jaane ka dussaahas karega?

Kya tumhein yah maalum nahin ki duniya ka justice holy logon dvaara kiya jaaega? Yadi duniya ka justice tumhaare dvaara kiya jaaega to kya tum in chhote-chhote jhagron ko suljhaane mein saksham nahin?
Yadi tumhaare bich saansaarik jhagre hain hi to kya tumhaare bich, (church mein), koi bhi aisa wise nahin, jo apne saathi believer ke jhagre ko vivek se suljha sake?
Yah kahkar tumhein lajjit karna hi mera purpose hai. Kya tumhaare beech ek bhi aisa wise person nahin, jo bhaai-bhaai ke beech uthe vivaad ko suljha sake—ek bhi nahin!
Yahaan to ek believer dusre ko nyaaypaalika mein ghasit raha hai aur vah bhi gair-Yahudiyon ke saamne!
Yadi tumhaare bich jhagre chal rahe hain, to tum pahle hi haar chuke ho. Iski bajaay tum hi anyaay kyon nahin sah lete aur iski ummid tum hi dhokha khaate kyon nahin rah jaate?
Iske viprit tum khud hi anyaay aur dhokha kar rahe ho aur vah bhi bhaai bahnon ke saath!

Kadaachit koi yah kahe, “Mere lie sab kuchh law ke hisaab se sahi hai.” Thik hai, lekin main kahta hun ki tumhaare lie sab kuchh laabhdaayak nahin hai. Main bhi kah sakta hun ki mere lie sab kuchh law ke hisaab se sahi hai lekin main nahin chaahunga ki main kisi bhi vastu ka slave banun.

Tab kadaachit koi kahe, “Khaana pet ke lie aur pet khaana ke lie hai.” Thik hai, lekin main kahta hun ki God donon hi ko samaapt kar deinge. Sach yah bhi hai ki body veshyaagaami ke lie nahin lekin Lord ke lie hai aur Lord body ke rakshak hain.
Kya tumhein maalum nahin ki tum sabke body Yeshu ke ang hain? To kya main Yeshu ke angon ko veshya ke ang bana dun? Aisa bilkul na ho!
Kya tumhein yah ahsaas nahin ki vah, jo veshya se jura hota hai, uske saath ek tan ho jaata hai? Kyonki God ne kaha hai, “Ve donon ek tan honge.”
Vah, jo Lord se jura hota hai, unse ek aatma ho jaata hai.
Veshyaagaami se dur bhaago! Insaan dvaara kie gae dusre galti uske body ko prabhaavit nahin karte lekin veshyaavritti karnevaala apne hi body ke khilaaf galti karta hai.
Kya tumhein yah ahsaas nahin ki tumhaara body Holy Spirit ka—jinka tumhaare andar vaas hai aur jo tumhein God se receive hue hain—temple hai? Tum par tumhaara authority nahin
Kyonki tumhein daam dekar mol liya gaya hai; isliye apne body ke dvaara God ki glory karo.
Ab ve vishay jinke sambandh mein tumne mujhse likhkar puchha hai: aadmi ke lie uchit to yahi hai ki vah aurat ka sparsh hi na kare
Lekin vyabhichaar se bachne ke lie har ek aadmi ki apni patni aur har ek aurat ka apna pati ho.
Yah zaruri hai ki pati apni patni ke prati apna kartavy pura kare aur isi tarah patni bhi apne pati ke prati.
Patni ne apne pati ko apne body par authority diya hai, vaise hi pati ne apni patni ko apne body par authority diya hai.

Pati-patni ek dusre ko shaaririk sambandhon se dur na rakhein—sivaay aapsi sahamti se prayer ke purpose se simit avdhi ke lie. Iske turant baad ve dobaara saath ho jaaein ki kahin sanyam tutne ke kaaran aarop lagaanevaala unhein pariksha mein na phansa le.
Yah main suvidha anumti ke taur par kah raha hun—command ke taur par nahin.
Vaise to meri chaahat to yahi hai ki sabhi aadmi aise hote jaisa khud main hun lekin God ne tummein se har ek ko bhinn-bhinn kshamtaaein provide ki hain.
Avivaahiton aur vidhvaaon se mera kahna hai ki ve akele hi rahein—jaisa main hun
Lekin yadi unke lie sanyam rakhna sambhav nahin to ve vivaah kar lein—kaamaatur hokar jalte rahne ki bajaay vivaah kar lena hi uttam hai.
Vivaahiton ke lie mera nirdesh hai—mera nahin lekin Lord ka: patni apne pati se sambandh na tore.
Yadi patni ka sambandh tut hi jaata hai to vah dobaara vivaah na kare ya pati se mel-milaap kar le. Pati apni patni ka tyaag na kare.
Magar baakiyon se mera kahna hai ki yadi kisi saathi believer ki patni believer na ho aur vah uske saath rahne ke lie sahmat ho to pati uska tyaag na kare.
Yadi kisi aurat ka pati believer na ho aur vah uske saath rahne ke lie raazi ho to patni uska tyaag na kare;

Phir bhi yadi avishvaasi dampti alag hona chaahe to use ho jaane diya jaae. Koi bhi believer bhaai ya believer bahan is bandhan mein bandhe rahne ke lie baadhy nahin. God ne hamein shaanti se bhare life ke lie bulaaya hai.
Patni yah sambhaavna kabhi bhula na de: patni apne pati ke bachaav ka saadhan ho sakti hai, vaise hi pati apni patni ke bachaav ka.
God ne jise jaisi situation mein rakha hai aur jis taur par use bulaaya hai, vah usi mein bana rahe. Sabhi kalisiyaaon ke lie mera yahi nirdesh hai.
Har ek usi avastha mein bana rahe, jismein usko bulaaya gaya tha.
Kya tumhein us samay bulaaya gaya tha, jab tum slave the? Yah tumhaare lie chinta ka vishay na ho lekin yadi daasatv se svatantr hone ka suavsar aae to is suavsar ka laabh zarur uthaao.
Vah, jisko us samay bulaaya gaya, jab vah slave tha, ab Lord mein svatantr kiya hua person hai; isi tarah, jisko us samay bulaaya gaya, jab vah svatantr tha, ab vah Yeshu ka slave hai.
Tum daam dekar mol lie gae ho isliye insaan ke slave na ban jaao.
Dear bhaai bahno, tummein se har ek usi avastha mein, jismein use bulaaya gaya tha, God ke saath jura rahe.
Kunvaariyon ke sambandh mein mere paas Lord ki or se koi command nahin hai lekin main, jo Lord ki grace ke kaaran vishvasniy hun, apni or se yah kahna chaahta hun:
Vartmaan sankat ke kaaran mere soch se aadmi ke lie uttam yahi hoga ki vah jis situation mein hai, usi mein bana rahe.
Yadi tum vivaahit ho to patni ka tyaag na karo. Yadi avivaahit ho to patni khojne ka koshish na karo.

Yadi tum vivaah karte hi ho to bhi galti nahin karte. Yadi koi kunvaari kanya vivaah karti hai to yah galti nahin hai. Phir bhi inke saath saamaany vaivaahik life sambandhi jhanjhat lage raheinge aur main vaastav mein tumhein inhin se bachaane ka koshish kar raha hun.
Dear bhaai bahno, mera matlab yah hai ki thora hi samay shesh rah gaya hai isliye ab se ve, jo vivaahit hain aise rahein, maano avivaahit hon.
Jo shokit hain unka shok reveal na ho; jo aanandit hain unka khushi chhupa rahe aur jo mol le rahe hain, ve aise ho jaaein maano unke paas kuchh bhi nahin hai.
Meri chaahat hai ki tum saansaarik life ki abhilaashaaon se mukt raho. Uske lie, jo avivaahit hai, Lord sambandhi vishyon ka dhyaan rakhna sambhav hai ki vah Lord ko santusht kaise kar sakta hai;
Lekin vah, jo vivaahit hai, uska dhyaan duniya sambandhit vishyon mein hi laga rahta hai ki vah apni patni ko prasann kaise kare,

Uski ruchiyaan banti rahti hain. Usi tarah patihin aur kunvaari aurat ki ruchiyaan Lord se sambandhit vishyon mein simit rah sakti hain—aur iske lie vah body aur aatma mein holy rahne mein koshish karti rahti hai, lekin vah aurat, jo vivaahit hai, duniya sambandhi vishyon ka dhyaan rakhti hai ki vah apne pati ko prasann kaise kare.
Main yah sab tumhaari bhalaai ke lie hi kah raha hun—kisi tarah se phansaane ke lie nahin lekin isliye ki tumhaari lifestyle aadarsh ho aur Lord ke prati tumhaara samarpan ekchitt hokar rahe.

Yadi kisi ko yah lage ki vah apni putri ke vivaah mein deri karne ke dvaara uske saath anyaay kar raha hai, kyonki uski aayu dhal rahi hai, vah vahi kare, jo vah sahi samajhta hai, vah use vivaah karne de. Yah koi galti nahin hai.
Lekin vah, jo bina kisi baadha ke drirh sankalp hai, apni chaahat hisaab se nirnay lene ki situation mein hai aur jisne apni putri ka vivaah na karne ka nishchay kar liya hai, uska nirnay sahi hai.
Isliye jo apni putri ka vivaah karta hai, uska nirnay bhi sahi hai aur jo uska vivaah na karaane ka nishchay karta hai, vah aur bhi sahi hai.

Patni tab tak pati se juri rahti hai, jab tak pati jivit hai. Yadi pati ki maut ho jaae to vah apni chaahat ke hisaab se vivaah karne ke lie svatantr hai—lekin zaruri yah hai ki vah aadmi bhi Lord mein believer hi ho.
Mera vyaktigat mat yah hai ki vah aurat usi situation mein bani rahe, jismein vah is samay hai. Vah isi situation mein sukhi rahegi. Mujhe faith hai ki mujhmein bhi God ka aatma vaas karta hai.
Ab murtiyon ko charhaai hui vastuon ke sambandh mein: ham jaante hain ki ham sab wise hain. Vaastav mein to knowledge hamein ghamandi banaata hai jabki love hamein unnat karta hai.
Yadi koi yah samajhta hai ki vah jnaanvaan hai to vaastav mein vah ab tak vaisa knowledge hi nahin paaya, jaisa jaanna uske lie zaruri hai.
Vah, jo God se love karta hai, God ka parichit ho jaata hai.

Jahaan tak murtiyon ko charhaai hui vastuon ko khaane ka savaal hai, ham is baat ko bhali-bhaanti jaante hain ki saare duniya mein kahin bhi murtiyon mein God nahin hai aur ek ke atirikt aur koi God nahin hai.
Yadypi aakaash aur prithvi par kai tathaakthit devta hain, jaise ki kai devta aur kai Lord bhi hain
Lekin hamaare lie to God sirf ek hi hain—vah pita—jinmein ham sab srisht hain, aur ham usi ke lie hain. Lord ek hi hain—Yeshu—inhin ke dvaara sab kuchh hai, inhin ke dvaara ham hain.

Lekin sabhi ko yah baat maalum nahin hain. Kuchh person aise hain, jo ab tak murtiyon se jure hain aur ve us khaana ko murtiyon ko bheint kiya hua khaana maante hue khaate hain. Unka kamjor vivek ashuddh ho gaya hai.
Hamein God ke paas le jaane mein khaana ka koi yogdaan nahin hota—khaana se na to koi haani sambhav hai aur na hi koi laabh.
Lekin saavdhaan rahna ki tumhaari yah svatantrta nirblon ke lie thokar ka kaaran na bane.
Yadi kisi ka vivek kamjor hai aur vah tum jaise wise person ko murti ke temple mein khaana karte dekh le to kya use bhi murti ko charhaai hui vastuein khaane ka saahas na milega?
Ismein tumhaara wise hona uske vinaash ka kaaran ho gaya, jiske lie Yeshu ne jaan diya.
Is tarah believers ke khilaaf galti karne aur unke vivek ko, jo kamjor hain, chot pahunchaane ke dvaara tum Yeshu ke khilaaf galti karte ho.
Isliye yadi khaana kisi ke lie thokar ka kaaran banta hai to main maans ka khaana kabhi na karunga ki main believers ke lie thokar ka kaaran na banun.
Kya main svatantr nahin? Kya main apostle nahin? Kya mainne hamaare Lord Yeshu ko saakshaat nahin dekha? Kya tum Lord mein mere parishram ka phal nahin?
Bhale hi main anyon ke lie apostle nahin lekin tumhaare lie to hun kyonki tum Lord mein meri preritaai ki mohar ho.
Jo mujh par dosh lagaate hain, unse apne paksh mein mera yah kahna hai:
Kya hamein tumhaare khaana mein bhaag lene ka authority nahin?
Kya dusre apostles, Lord ke bhaaiyon aur kaifas ke jaisa hi hamein bhi apne saath apni believer patni ko le jaane ka authority nahin?
Kya baaranbaas aur main hi aise hain, jo khud apni kamaai karne ke lie majbur hain?

Kaun sainik aisa hai, jo sena mein service karte hue apna kharch khud uthaata hai? Kaun hai, jo daakh ki baari ko lagaata to hai aur khud uska phal nahin khaata? Ya kaun aisa pashu paalak hai, jo apne pashuon ke dudh ka upyog na karta ho?
Kya main yah sirph insaan ki riti se kah raha hun? Kya law bhi yahi nahin kahti?
Jaisa ki Moshe ki law mein likha hai: daanvni karte bail ke chehra ko mukhbandhni na baandhna. Kya God ko sirf bailon ka hi dhyaan hai?

Yadi tum par dusron ka authority hai to kya tum par hamaara authority un sabse barhkar nahin? Phir bhi hamne is authority ka upyog nahin kiya. Iske viprit ham sab kuchh sabr ke saath sahte rahe ki Yeshu ke ishvriy good news ke prachaar mein koi baadha na aae.
Kya tumhein maalum nahin ki temple mein kaam karnevaalon ka bharan-poshan temple se hi hota hai aur jo bali vedi par charhaai jaati hai, ve usi bali mein se apna bhaag receive karte hain?

Lekin mainne inmein se kisi bhi authority ka upyog nahin kiya aur na hi main is purpose se likh raha hun ki mere lie kuchh kiya jaae. Iske bajaay ki koi mujhe mere is gaurav se vanchit kare, main mar jaana uchit samajhta hun,
Kya tum nahin jaante ki pratiyogita mein daurte to sabhi hain lekin puraskaar sirf ek ko hi milta hai. Tum aise dauro ki puraskaar tumhein receive ho.
Main lakshyhin person ke jaisa nahin daurta. Main hava mein ghunse nahin maarta.
Dear bhaai bahno, main nahin chaahta ki tum is baat se anjaan raho ki hamaare saare purvaj baadal ki chhaaya mein yaatra karte rahe, aur sabhi ne samudr paar kiya.
Un sabhi ka Moshe mein, baadal mein aur samudr mein baptisma hua.
Sabne ek hi spiritual khaana kiya,
Sabne ek hi spiritual paani piya kyonki ve sab ek hi spiritual chattaan mein se piya karte the, jo unke saath saath chalti thi aur vah chattaan the Yeshu.
Yah sab hone par bhi God unmein se bahuton se santusht na the isliye banjar zameen mein hi unke jaan le lie gae.
Ye sabhi ghatnaaein hamaare lie chetaavni thi ki ham buraai ki laalsa na karein, jaise hamaare purvjon ne ki thi.
Na hi tum murtipujak bano, jaise unmein se kuchh the, jaisa Scripture ka lekh hai: ve khaane-pine baith gae aur khare hokar rangreliyaan manaane lage.
Ham veshyaagaami mein lin na hon, jaise unmein se kuchh ho gae the aur parinaamasvrup, ek hi din mein teis hazaar ki maut ho gai.
Na ham Yeshu ko parkhein, jaise unmein se kuchh ne kiya aur saampon ke dasne se unka barbaadi ho gaya.
Na hi tum kurkuraao, jaisa unmein se kuchh ne kiya aur barbaadi karnevaale dvaara barbaadi kie gae.
Unke saath ghati hui ye ghatnaaein chinh thi, jo hamaare lie chetaavni ke taur par likhi gai kyonki ham us yug mein hain, jo ant ke paas hai.
Isliye vah, jo yah samajhta hai ki vah sthir hai, saavdhaan rahe ki kahin gir na pare.

Koi aisi pariksha tum par nahin aai, jo sabhi ke lie saamaany na ho. God faithful hain. Vah tumhein kisi aisi pariksha mein nahin parne deinge, jo tumhaari kshamta ke pare ho lekin vah pariksha ke saath upaay bhi kareinge ki tum sthir rah sako.
Isliye dear bhaai bahno, murti puja se dur bhaago.
Yah main tumhein wise maante hue kah raha hun: main jo kah raha hun usko parkho.
Ek roti mein hamaari sahbhaagita hamaare kai hone par bhi hamaare ek body hone ka pratik hai.
Israaeliyon ke baare mein socho, jo vedi par charhaai hui bali khaate hain, kya iske dvaara ve ek nahin ho jaate?
Kya hai mere kahne ka matlab? Kya murti ko charhaai hui vastu ka koi mahatv hai ya us murti ka koi mahatv hai?
