Bilkul nahin! Meri maanyta to yah hai ki jo vastuein gair-Yahudi charhaate hain, ve unhein dard denevaali aatmaaon ko charhaate hain—God ko nahin.

Yah ho hi nahin sakta ki tum Lord ke pyaale mein se piyo aur dard denevaali aatmaaon ke pyaale mein se bhi; isi tarah yah bhi nahin ho sakta ki tum Lord ki mez mein sahbhaagi ho aur dard denevaali aatmaaon ki mez mein bhi.
Kya ham Lord mein jalan paida karne ka dussaahas kar rahe hain? Kya ham Lord se adhik shaktishaali hain?
Uchit to sabhi kuchh hai lekin sabhi kuchh laabhdaayak nahin. Uchit to sabhi kuchh hai lekin sabhi kuchh unnti ke lie nahin.
Tummein se pratyek apne bhale ka hi nahin lekin dusre ke bhale ka bhi dhyaan rakhe.
Apni antraatma ki bhalaai ke lie bina koi savaal kie maans vikretaaon ke yahaan se jo kuchh uplabdh ho, vah kha lo,
Kyonki prithvi aur prithvi mein jo kuchh bhi hai sabhi kuchh Lord ka hi hai.
Yadi kisi avishvaasi ke aamantran par uske yahaan khaana ke lie jaana zaruri ho jaae to apni antraatma ki bhalaai ke lie, bina koi bhi savaal kie vah kha lo, jo tumhein parosa jaae.
Lekin yadi koi tumhein yah bataae, “Yah murtiyon ko bheint bali hai,” To use na khaana—uski bhalaai ke lie, jisne tumhein yah bataaya hai aur vivek ki bhalaai ke lie.
Mera matlab tumhaare apne vivek se nahin lekin us dusre person ke vivek se hai—meri svatantrta bhala kyon kisi dusre ke vivek dvaara naapi jaae?
Yadi main thanks dekar khaana mein shaamil hota hun to uske lie mujh par dosh kyon lagaaya jaata hai, jiske lie mainne God ke prati thanks reveal kiya?
Isliye tum chaahe jo kuchh karo, chaahe jo kuchh khaao ya piyo, vah God ki glory ke lie ho.
Tum na Yahudiyon ke lie thokar ka kaaran bano, na yunaaniyon ke lie aur na hi God ki church ke lie;
Main tumhaari taarif karta hun ki tum har ek kshetr mein mujhe yaad rakhte ho aur un teachings ka majbuti se follow karte ho, jaisi mainne tumhein saumpi thi.
Yah command dete hue main tumhaari koi baraai nahin kar raha: worship sabhaaon mein tumhaare ikattha hone se bhalaai nahin lekin buraai hi hoti hai.
Sabse pahle to yah: jab tum church ke taur par ikattha hote ho, to mere sunne mein yah aaya hai ki tummein phut pari rahti hai aur main ek sima tak iska faith bhi karta hun.
Haan, yah sach hai ki tumhaare bich bantvaara hona zaruri bhi hai ki ve, jo God dvaara chune hue hain, prakaash mein a jaaein.
Jis riti se tum khaana ke lie ikattha hote ho, use Lord-bhoj nahin kaha ja sakta.

Us bhoj mein jab khaana ka samay aata hai, tum khaana par tut parte ho aur kisi ki pratiksha kie bina apna apna khaana kar lete ho. Parinaamasvrup koi to bhukha hi rah jaata hai aur koi matvaala ho jaata hai.

Kya khaane-pine ke lie tumhaare apne ghar nahin? Ya tum God ki church ka tiraskaar karne aur nirdhnon ko lajjit karne par tule hue ho? Ab main kya kahun? Kya main iske lie tumhaari saraahna karun? Nahin! Bilkul nahin!
Jo mainne Lord se receive kiya, vah mainne tumhein bhi saump diya: Lord Yeshu ne, jis raat unhein pakarvaaya ja raha tha, roti li,
Yahi kaaran hai ki tummein se kai durbal aur rogi hain aur kai maut mein so gae.
Yadi ham apne vivek ko sahi riti se jaanch lein to hamaari taarna nahin ki jaaegi
Isliye dear bhaai bahno, jab tum khaana ke lie ikattha hote ho to ek dusre ke lie thahre raho.
Ab Holy Spirit dvaara di gai kshamtaaon se sambandhit baaton ke baare mein: main nahin chaahta, dear bhaai bahno, ki tum inse anjaan raho.
Tumhein yaad hoga ki Yeshu mein avishvaasi situation mein tum gungi murtiyon ke pichhe chalne ke lie bhatka die gae the.
Aatma dvaara di gai kshamtaaein alag-alag hain lekin aatma ek hi hain.
Sevkaai bhi alag-alag hain lekin Lord ek hi hain.
Kaam karne ke tarike bhi kai hain lekin God ek hi hain, jo sab insaanon mein unka prabhaav utpann karte hain.
Pratyek ko Holy Spirit ka prakaashan sabke baraabar laabh ke purpose se diya jaata hai.
Aatma dvaara kisi ko knowledge bhari salaah ki kshamta aur kisi ko unhin aatma dvaara knowledge bhari teaching ki kshamta provide ki jaati hai;
Kisi ko unhin aatma dvaara faith ki aur kisi ko unhin aatma dvaara changa karne ki kshamta provide ki jaati hai;
Kisi ko power ke kaam karne ki, kisi ko bhavishyvaani ki. Kisi ko aatmaaon ki pahchaan ki, kisi ko dusre bhaashaaon ki aur kisi ko bhaashaaon ke varnan ki kshamta.
In sabko sirph ek aur ek hi aatma ke dvaara kiya jaata hai aur vah har ek mein ye kshamtaaein vyaktigat rup se baant dete hain.
Jis tarah body ek hai aur uske ang kai, body ke ang kai hone par bhi body ek hi hai; isi tarah Yeshu bhi hain.
Body sirph ek ang nahin lekin kai ang hai.
Yadi pair kahe, “Main haath nahin isliye main body ka ang nahin.” To kya uske aisa kahne se vah body ka ang nahin rah jaata?
Aur yadi kaan kahe, “Main aankh nahin isliye main body ka ang nahin.” To kya uske aisa kahne se vah body ka ang nahin rah jaata?
Yadi saara body aankh hi hota to sunna kaise hota? Yadi saara body kaan hi hota to sunghna kaise hota?
Lekin God ne apni achchhi samajh ke hisaab se har ek ang ko body mein niyukt kiya hai.
Yadi sabhi ang ek hi ang hote to body kahaan hota?
Isliye vaastvikta yah hai ki ang kai lekin body ek hi hai.
Aankh haath se nahin kah sakti, “Mujhe tumhaari koi zarurat nahin,” Ya haath-pair se, “Mujhe tumhaari zarurat nahin.”
Iske viprit body ke ve ang, jo durbal maalum hote hain, bahut zaruri hain.
Body ke jo ang tulna mein kam mahatv ke samjhe jaate hain, unhin ko ham adhik mahatv dete hain aur tuchchh angon ko ham vishesh dhyaan rakhte hue dhaanke rakhte hain,
Jabki shobhniy angon ko iski koi zarurat nahin lekin God ne body mein angon ko is tarah banaaya hai ki tuchchh angon ki mahatta bhi pahchaani jaae
Ki body mein koi phut na ho lekin har ek ang ek dusre ka dhyaan rakhe.
Yadi ek ang ko dard hoti hai, to uske saath sabhi ang pirit hote hain. Yadi ek ang ko sammaanit kiya jaata hai to uske saath sabhi ang uske khushi mein sahbhaagi hote hain.
Tum Yeshu ke body ho aur tummein se har ek is body ka ang hai.

Church mein God ne sabse pahle apostles, dusra bhavishyadvaktaaon aur tisra shikshkon ko niyukt kiya hai. Iske baad unko, jinhein adbhut kaam, changa karne ka, bhalaai karnevaale, prashaasan-prabandh karnevaale aur dusre bhaasha bolne ki kshamta provide ki gai hai.
Isliye kya sabhi apostle hain? Sabhi prophet hain? Sabhi shikshak hain? Sabhi adbhut kaam karte hain?
Kya sabhi ko changaai karne ki kshamta di gai hai? Kya sabhi dusre bhaashaaon mein baat karte hain? Kya sabhi vyaakhya karte hain?
Sahi to yah hoga ki tum unchi kshamtaaon ki chaahat karo.
Yadi main insaanon aur angels ki bhaashaaon mein baatein karun magar yadi main love na rakhun, to main ghanaghnaata ghariyaal ya jhanajhnaati jhaanjh hun.

Yadi mujhe bhavishyvaani karne ki kshamta receive hai, main bhed jaanne vaala aur wise hun aur mera faith aisa majbut ho ki mere vachan sirf se parvat apne jagah se hat jaaein lekin main love na rakhun to main kuchh bhi nahin.
Yadi main apni saari property kangaalon mein baant dun aur apna body bhasm hone ke lie balidaan kar dun lekin yadi main love na rakhun to kya laabh?
Love patient hai, love kind hai. Love jalan nahin karta, apni baraai nahin karta, ghamand nahin karta,
Ashobhniy nahin, svaarthi nahin, jhunjhlaata bhi nahin aur krodhi bhi nahin hai.
Uska khushi duraachaar mein nahin, sach mein hai.
Love hamesha hi suraksha provide karta hai, sandeh nahin karta, hamesha aashaavaan aur hamesha sabr banaae rahta hai.
Love anant kaal ka hai. Jahaan tak bhavishyvaaniyon ka savaal hai, ve thore samay ke lie hain. Bhaashaaein nihshabd ho jaaeingi aur knowledge mit jaaega
Kyonki adhura hai hamaara knowledge aur adhuri hai hamaari bhavishyvaani karne ki kshamta;
Lekin jab ham siddhta tak pahunch jaaeinge, vah sab, jo adhura hai, mit jaaega.

Jab main baalak tha, main baalak ke jaisa baatein karta tha, baalak ke jaisa soch karta tha aur baalak ke jaisa hi vaad-vivaad karta tha lekin sayaana hone par mainne baalkon ka sa vyavhaar chhor diya.

Is samay to hamein aaine mein dhundhla dikhaai deta hai lekin us samay ham aamne-saamne dekheinge. Mera knowledge is samay adhura hai lekin us samay mera knowledge vaisa hi hoga jaisa is samay mere baare mein God ka hai.
Par ab ye tin: faith, ummid aur love ye tinon sthaai hai lekin inmein sabse upar hai love.
Isliye love ka svabhaav rakhte hue spiritual vardaanon ki bari chaahat karte raho—vishesh rup se bhavishyvaani karne ke var ki.

Vah, jo dusre bhaasha mein soch reveal karta hai, insaanon se nahin, God se baatein karta hai. Sach to yah hai ki koi bhi sunnevaala uski bhaasha nahin samajhta—vah Holy Spirit ki aguvaai ke dvaara gurh sach reveal karta hai.
Lekin vah, jo bhavishyvaani karta hai, spiritual unnti, protsaahan aur sabr ke lie insaanon ko sambodhit karta hai;
Vah, jo dusre bhaasha mein sandesh sunaata hai, sirf khud ko unnat karta hai lekin vah, jo bhavishyvaani karta hai, church ko unnat karta hai.

Main chaahta to hun ki tummein se har ek ko dusre bhaashaaon ki kshamta receive ho lekin iski bajaay behtar yah hoga ki tumhein bhavishyvaani ki kshamta receive ho; kyonki vah, jo bhavishyvaani karta hai, us dusre bhaasha bolnevaale se, jo anuvaad kie bina dusre bhaasha mein baatein karta hai, behtar hai kyonki anuvaad kie jaane par hi church ki unnti sambhav ho sakti hai.

Dear bhaai bahno, yadi main tumse dusre bhaashaaon mein baatein karun to main ismein tumhaara kya bhala karunga yadi ismein tumhaare lie koi prakaashan ya knowledge ya bhavishyvaani ya teaching na ho?
Nirjiv vastuein bhi dhvani utpann karti hain, chaahe baansuri ho ya koi taar-vaady. Yadi unse utpann svaron mein bhinnta na ho to yah kaise maalum hoga ki kaun sa vaady bajaaya ja raha hai?
Yadi bigul ka svar aspasht ho to yuddh ke lie taiyaar kaun hoga?
Isi tarah yadi dusre bhaasha mein baatein karte hue tumhaare bole hue word saaf na hon to kaun samjhega ki kya kaha ja raha hai? Yah to hava se baatein karna hua.
Vishv mein na jaane kitni bhaashaaein hain aur unmein se koi bhi vyarth nahin.
Yadi main kisi ki bhaasha na samajh paaun to main uske lie aur vah mere lie videshi hua.
Isi tarah tum bhi, jo spiritual vardaanon ke prati itne utsuk ho, un kshamtaaon ke upyog ke lie aise prayaasrat raho ki unse church ka puri tarah vikaas ho.
Isliye vah, jo dusre bhaasha mein baatein karta hai, prayer kare ki use uska varnan aur anuvaad karne ki kshamta bhi receive ho jaae.
Jab main dusre bhaasha mein prayer karta hun to meri aatma to prayer karti rahti hai lekin mera mastishk nishphal rahta hai,
To sahi kya hai? Yahi na ki main aatma se prayer karun aur samajh se bhi. Main aatma se gaaunga aur samajh se bhi gaaunga.
Yadi tum sirph aatma mein praise karte ho to vahaan upasthit anjaan person tumhaare thanks ke ant mein “Aamen” Kaise kahega, kyonki use to yah maalum hi nahin ki tum kah kya rahe ho?
Nihsandeh tumne to sundar riti se thanks reveal kiya lekin isse us person ka kuchh bhi bhala nahin hua.
Main God ka aabhaari hun ki main tum sabse adhik dusre bhaashaaon mein baatein karta hun.
Phir bhi church sabha mein teaching dene ke purpose se main soch samajhkar sirf paanch word hi kahna sahi samajhta hun iski bajaay ki main dusre bhaasha ke das hazaar word kahun.
Dear bhaai bahno, tumhaari samajh baalkon ke jaisa nahin, sayaanon ke jaisa ho. Tum sirph buraai ke lie baalak bane raho.
Scripture ka lekh hai: main dusre bhaasha bolne vaalon aur anjaan logon ke chehra se apni people se baatein karunga; phir bhi ve meri na suneinge; yah Lord ka vachan hai.

Isliye dusre bhaashaaon mein baatein karna believers ke lie nahin lekin avishvaasiyon ke lie chihn ka rup hai lekin bhavishyvaani karna avishvaasiyon ke lie nahin lekin Yeshu ke believers ke lie chihn svarup hai.

Yadi saari church ikattha ho aur pratyek person dusre bhaasha mein baatein karne lage aur usi samay vahaan aise person pravesh karein, jo ye bhaashaaein nahin samajhte ya avishvaasi hain, to kya ve tumhein paagal na samjheinge?

Lekin yadi sabhi bhavishyvaani karein aur vahaan koi aisa person pravesh kare, jise yah kshamta receive na ho, ya vahaan koi avishvaasi pravesh kare to use apni galti ki avastha ka ahsaas ho jaaega, vah apne vivek ko tatolega
Aur uske dil ke bhed khul jaaeinge. Tab vah yah ghoshna karte hue ki nishchay hi God tumhaare bich maujud hain, dandvat ho God ki vandna karne lagega.

Tab, dear bhaai bahno, nishkarsh kya nikla? Jab tum worship ke lie ikattha hote ho, to tummein se koi to git prastut karta hai, koi updesh deta hai, koi Lord ke dvaara diya gaya prakaashan prastut karta hai, koi dusre bhaasha mein baatein karta aur koi uska anuvaad karta hai. Dear bhaai bahno, tum jo kuchh karo vah church ki unnti ke lie ho.
Jahaan tak dusre bhaasha mein baatein karne ka savaal hai, adhik se adhik do ya tin person hi kramaanusaar yah karein aur koi person uska anuvaad bhi kare.
Yadi vahaan koi anuvaad karnevaala na ho to ve chup rahein aur unki baatein unke aur God ke bich simit rahe.
Bhavishyvaani sirf do ya tin person hi karein aur baaki unke vachan ko parkhein.
Yadi usi samay kisi par ishvriy prakaashan ho, to vah, jo is samay bhavishyvaani kar raha hai, shaant ho jaae,
Tum sab ek-ek karke bhavishyvaani kar sakte ho ki sabhi ko teaching aur protsaahan receive ho sake.
Bhavishyadvaktaaon ka apni aatma par pura niyantran rahta hai.
God garabri ke nahin, shaanti ke God hain—holy logon ki sabhi worship sabhaaon ke lie sahi yahi hai,
Kya God ka vachan tumse nikla hai? Ya sirph tum par hi God ke vachan ka prakaashan hua hai?
Yadi koi khud ko prophet ya spiritual person samajhta hai to vah yah jaan le ki main tumhein jo kuchh likh raha hun, ve sab Lord ki aajnaaein hain.
Yadi koi is sach ko nahin maanta hai, vah khud bhi maana na jaaega.
Isliye, dear bhaai bahno, bhavishyvaani karne ki kshamta ki chaahat karte raho, dusre bhaasha bolne se mana na karo.
Tum jo kuchh karo, vah shaalinta aur vyavasthit taur par kiya jaae.
Ab holy logon ki madad ke lie dhanraashi ke sambandh mein: is baare mein mainne, jo command galaatiya pradesh ki kalisiyaaon ko di thi, unhin commands ka follow tum bhi karo.
Saptaah ke pahle din tummein se har ek apni aay ke hisaab se kuchh dhanraashi alag rakh chhore ki mere vahaan aane par tumhein wealth ikattha na karna pare.
Jab main vahaan aaunga, tumhaare dvaara chune gae logon ko patron ke saath bhej dunga ki ve ikattha raashi ko Yerushalem pahuncha dein.
Yadi mera jaana bhi sahi hua to ve mere saath ja sakeinge.
Mein makedoniya yaatra ke baad tumhaare paas aaunga kyonki main makedoniya yaatra ki yojna bana raha hun.
Sambhvath main aakar tumhaare saath kuchh samay vyatit karun ya puri shit ritu hi ki tum mujhe mere aage ke saphar ki or, main jahaan kahin jaaun, vida kar sako.
Main nahin chaahta ki tumse keval chalte-chalte milun lekin meri ummid hai ki yadi God chaahein to main tumhaare saath kuchh samay vyatit karun.
Main pentekost parv tak ifesos shehar mein hi rahunga
Kyonki mere lie vahaan upyogi service ka dvaar khula hai. Iske atirikt vahaan mere kai virodhi bhi hain.
Jab timothiyos vahaan aae to yah sunishchit karna ki vah tumhaare saath nishchint rahe kyonki mere jaisa vah bhi Lord ke kaam mein jura hai.
Dhyaan rahe ki koi use tuchchh na samjhe. Use sakushal vida karna ki vah mere paas laut aae. Main dusre bhaaiyon ke saath uski pratiksha mein hun.

Ab hamaare bhaai apollos ke sambandh mein: mainne unse baar-baar request ki ki vah dusre bhaaiyon ke saath tumhaare paas aaein lekin vah is samay yaatra ke lie taiyaar nahin lekin sahi avsar receive hote hi vah vahaan aaeinge.
Jaagte raho, faith mein sthir raho, nidar bano, nishchay karo
Aur har ek kaam love bhaav mein hi karo.
Stefaanos, fortunaatos aur akhiyaakos ka yahaan aana mere lie khushi ka vishay hai. Unke kaaran tumhaari or se jo kami thi, vah puri ho gai.
Unke kaaran mere aur tumhaare man mein nai taazgi ka sanchaar hua hai. Aise logon ko maanyta zarur di jaae.
Aasiya pradesh ki kalisiyaaon ka tumhein namaskaar. Akulos aur priska aur us church ki or se, jo unke ghar par worship ke lie ikattha hoti hai, Lord mein tumhein bahut-bahut namaskaar.
Yahaan sabhi bhaai bahnon ki or se tumhein namaskaar. Holy chumban ke saath ek dusre ka namaskaar karo.
Main, Paulos tumhein apne haath se yah namaskaar likh raha hun.
Tum par Lord Yeshu ka grace ho.
Yeshu mein mera love tum par hamesha rahe, aamen.
God ki will ke dvaara Yeshu ke apostle Paulos aur hamaare bhaai timothiyos. Ki or se korinthos shehar mein God ki church aur aakhaaya pradesh ke sabhi holy logon ko:
God hamaare pita aur Lord Yeshu ki or se tumhein grace aur shaanti receive ho.
Praise ke yogy hain God hamaare Lord Yeshu ke pita—karunaamay pita aur sab tarah ke sabr ke srot God,
Jo hamaari saari piraaon mein sabr provide karte hain ki ham piriton ko usi tarah sabr provide kar sakein, jis tarah God hamein sabr provide karte hain.
Thik jis tarah hammein Yeshu ke duhkhon ki bahutaayat hai, usi tarah bahut hai Yeshu ke dvaara hamaara sabr.

Yadi ham yaatnaaein sahte hain to yah tumhaare sabr aur bachaav ke lie hai; yadi hamein sabr receive hua hai to yah tumhaare protsaahan ke lie hai ki tum bhi unhin yaatnaaon ko sabr ke saath sah sako, jo ham sah rahe hain.
Is ahsaas ke prakaash mein tumhaare baare mein hamaari ummid atal hai ki jis tarah tum hamaare kashton mein sahbhaagi ho, usi tarah tum hamaare sabr mein bhi sahbhaagi hoge.

Dear bhaai bahno, ham nahin chaahte ki tum un sab klesh ke baare mein anjaan raho, jo aasiya pradesh mein ham par aae. Ham aise bojh se dab gae the, jo hamaari sahanshakti se pare tha. Yahaan tak ki ham life ki ummid tak kho chuke the.
Hamein aisa lag raha tha, maano ham par saza hi prasaarit ho chuki hai. Yah isliye hua ki ham khud par nahin lekin God mein faith sthir rakhein, jo mare huon ko jivit karte hain.
Hamne God par, jinhonne hamein ghor sankat se bachaaya aur bachaate hi raheinge, ummid rakhi hai, vah hamein bhavishy mein bhi bachaate hi raheinge,

Kyonki tum apni praarthnaaon ke dvaara hamaari madad karte ho ki hamaari or se anekon dvaara us grace ke lie thanks reveal kiya ja sake, jo anekon ki praarthnaaon ke phalasvrup hamein receive hua hai.

Isliye hamaare garv karne ka kaaran yah hai: hamaari antraatma ki pushti ki hamaare shaaririk life mein, vishesh rup se tumhaare sambandh mein hamaara vyavhaar God dvaara di gai pavitrta aur sach sahit raha hai. Yah saansaarik knowledge ka nahin lekin sirf God ke grace ka parinaam tha.
Hamaare patron mein aisa kuchh nahin hota, jo tum parh ya samajh na sako aur meri ummid yah hai ki tum ant mein sab kuchh samajh loge.
Thik jis tarah tum hamein bahut thora hi samajh paae ho ki tum hamaare garv ka vishay ho, Lord Yeshu ke din tum bhi ham par garv karoge.
Is nishchay ke dvaara sabse pahle, main is purpose se tumhaare paas aana chaahta tha ki tumhein dugni grace ka anubhav ho.
Meri yojna thi ki main makedoniya jaate hue tumhaare paas aaun aur vahaan se lautte hue bhi. Iske baad tum mujhe Yahudiya pradesh ki yaatra par bhej dete.
Kya meri yah yojna meri asthir maansikta thi? Ya mere purpose insaan ke knowledge apostle hote hain ki mera bolna ek hi samay mein haan-haan bhi hota hai aur na-na bhi?
Jis tarah nihsandeh God faithful hain, usi tarah hamaari baaton mein bhi “Haan” Ka matlab haan aur “Na” Ka matlab na hi hota hai.
God ka son Yeshu, jinka prachaar silvaanos, timothiyos aur mainne tumhaare beech kiya, vah prachaar kabhi “Haan” Ya kabhi “Na” Nahin lekin God mein hamesha haan hi raha hai.
God ki saari pratijnaaein unmein “Haan” Hi hain. Isliye ham God ki glory ke lie Yeshu ke dvaara “Aamen” Kahte hain.
-22 God hi hain, jo tumhaare saath hamein Yeshu mein majbut karte hain. God ne ham par apni mohar lagaakar bayaane ke taur par apna aatma hamaare dil mein rakhkar hamaara abhishek kiya hai.
God meri is sach ke gavaah hain ki main dobaara korinthos isliye nahin aaya ki main tumhein kasht dena nahin chaahta tha.
Iska matlab yah nahin ki ham tumhaare faith par apna authority jataaein kyonki tum apne faith mein sthir khare ho. Ham to tumhaare hi khushi ke lie tumhaare sahkarmi hain.
Apni or se main yah nishchay kar chuka tha ki main ek baar phir vahaan aakar tumhein duhkh na dun,
Kyonki vahaan aakar yadi main hi tumhein duhkhi karun to mujhe khushi kinse receive hoga, keval unse, jinhein main ne duhkh pahunchaaya?

Mainne tumhein isi purpose se patr likha tha ki jab main vahaan aaun to ve hi log mere duhkh ka kaaran na ho jaaein, jinse mujhe khushi ki ummid hai. Mujhe nishchay hai ki mera khushi tum sabhi ka khushi hai.
Dil ke kasht aur klesh ke kaaran aansu baha-baha kar mainne tumhein yah patr likha hai, isliye nahin ki tumhein duhkhi karun lekin isliye ki tum tumhaare prati mere atyaadhik love ko samajh sako.
Yadi koi duhkh ka kaaran hai to vah sirf mere lie nahin lekin kisi sima tak tum sabhi ke lie duhkh ka kaaran bana hai. Main iske baare mein isse adhik kuchh aur nahin kahna chaahta.
Kaafi hai aise person ke lie bahumat dvaara tay kiya gaya dand.
Iski bajaay bhala yah hoga ki tum use maafi kar sabr do. Kahin aisa na ho ki kasht ki adhikaai use niraasha mein dubo de.
Isliye tumse meri request hai ki tum dobaara uske prati apne love ki pushti karo.
Yah patr mainne yah jaanne ke purpose se bhi likha hai ki tum sab vishyon mein aajnaakaari ho ya nahin.

Jise tum kisi baare mein maafi karte ho, use main bhi maafi karta hun. Jis baare mein mainne maafi kiya hai—yadi vah vaastav mein maafi yogy tha—use mainne Yeshu ko upasthit jaankar tumhaare lie maafi kiya hai
Ki aarop lagaanevaala hamaari situation ka koi bhi laabh na uthaane paae—ham uski chaalon se anjaan nahin hain.
Vahaan apne bhaai titos ko na paakar mera man vyaakul ho utha. Isliye unse vida lekar main makedoniya pradesh chala gaya.
Thanks ho God ka! Jo Yeshu ke jay ke utsav ki shobhaayaatra mein hamaare aage chalte hain aur hamaare dvaara apne knowledge ki sumdhur sugandh har jagah phailaate jaate hain.

Ham unke jaisa nahin, jinke lie God ka vachan kharidne-bechne dvaara laabh kamaane ki vastu hai. Iske viprit ham sach mein God ki or se, God ke saamne Yeshu mein ishvriy good news ko dusron tak pahunchaate hain.
Kya hamne dobaara apni aatmaprshansa karni shuru kar di? Ya kuchh dusre logon ke jaisa hamein bhi tumse ya tumhaare lie siphaarish ke patron ki zarurat hai?
Hamaare patr to tum khud ho—hamaare dilon par likhe hue—jo sabke dvaara pahchaane aur parhe ja sakte ho.
Yah saaf hi hai ki Yeshu ka patr tum ho—hamaari sevkaai ka parinaam—jise syaahi se nahin lekin jivit God ke aatma se patthar ki patiya par nahin lekin insaan ke dil ki patiya par likha gaya hai.
Hamein Yeshu ke dvaara God mein aisa hi faith hai.
Situation yah nahin ki ham yah daava karein ki ham apne aap mein kuchh kar sakne ke yogy hain—God hamaari yogyta ka srot hain,
Jinhonne hamein nai vaacha ka kaam karne yogy servant banaaya. Yah vaacha likhi hui law ki nahin lekin aatma ki hai. Likhi hui law maut ko janm deti hai magar aatma life deti hai.

Yadi patthar ki patiya par khode gae akshron mein ankit maut ki vaacha itni tejomay thi ki Israel ke vanshaj Moshe ke chehra par apni nazar sthir rakh paane mein asmarth the—yadypi yah tej dhire dhire kam hota ja raha tha.
To phir aatma ki vaacha aur kitni adhik tejomay na hogi?
Sach to yah hai ki is vartmaan prataap ke saamne vah pahle ka prataap, prataap rah hi nahin gaya.
Yadi uska tej aisa tha, jo lagaataar kam ho raha tha, to uska tej, jo hamesha sthir hai, aur kitna adhik barhkar na hoga!
Isi ummid ke kaaran hamaari baatein bina dar ki hai.
Ham Moshe ke jaisa bhi nahin, jo apna chehra isliye dhaka rakhte the ki Israel ke log us dhire dhire kam hote hue tej ko na dekh paaein.
Vaastav mein Israel ke logon ke man mand ho gae the. Puraana niyam dene ke avsar par aaj bhi vahi parda para rahta hai kyonki yah parda sirph Yeshu mein hataaya jaata hai.
Haan, aaj bhi jab kabhi Moshe ka granth parha jaata hai, unke dil par parda para rahta hai.
Yah parda us samay hatta hai, jab koi person Lord ki or man phiraata hai.
Yahi Lord vah aatma hain aur jahaan kahin Lord ka aatma maujud hain, vahaan svatantrta hai
Aur ham, jo khule chehra se Lord ki glory nihaarte hain, dhire dhire barhti hui glory ke saath unke svarup mein badalte ja rahe hain. Yah glory Lord se, jo aatma hain, baahar nikalti hai.
Isliye ki yah sevkaai hamein God ki grace se receive hui hai, ham niraash nahin hote.

Hamne lajja ke gupt kaamon ko tyaag diya hai. Na to hamaare svabhaav mein kisi tarah ki chaturaai hai aur na hi ham God ke vachan ko tor maror kar prastut karte hain. Lekin sach ko reveal karke ham God ke saamne khud ko har ek ke vivek ke lie prastut karte hain.
Ham khud ko uncha nahin karte—ham Yeshu ko Lord aur khud ko Yeshu ke lie tumhaare slave ghoshit karte hain.

God, jinhonne kaha, “Andhera mein se roshni chamke,” Vahi God hain, jinhonne hamaara dil chamka diya ki hamein Yeshu ke chehra mein chamakte hue God ke prataap ke knowledge ka prakaash provide karein.
Yah beshkimti khajaana mitti ke paatron mein isliye rakha hua hai ki yah saaf ho jaae ki yah asim power hamaari nahin lekin God ki hai.
Ham chaaron or se kashton se ghire rahte hain, lekin kuchle nahin jaate; ghabraate to hain, lekin niraash nahin hote;
Sataae to jaate hain, lekin tyaage nahin jaate; bahut kuchle jaate hain, lekin barbaad nahin hote.
Ham hardam Yeshu ki maut ko apne body mein lie phirte hain ki Yeshu ka life hamaare body mein reveal ho jaae.
Isliye ham, jo jivit hain, hardam Yeshu ke lie maut ko saumpe jaate hain ki hamaari shaaririk deh mein Yeshu ka life reveal ho jaae.
Is situation mein maut hammein sakriy hai aur life tummein.
Faith ke usi bhaav mein, jaisa ki Scripture ka lekh hai: mainne faith kiya, isliye main chup na raha. Ham bhi yah sab isliye kahte hain ki hamne bhi faith kiya hai.
Yah sab tumhaare hit mein hai ki grace, jo adhik se adhik insaanon mein vyaapt hota ja raha hai, God ki glory ke lie adhik se adhik thanks ka kaaran bane.
Isliye ham udaas nahin hote. Hamaara baahri manushyatv to kamjor hota ja raha hai lekin bhitri manushyatv din-pratidin naya hota ja raha hai.

Kyonki hamne apna dhyaan us par keindrit nahin kiya, jo dikhaai deta hai lekin us par, jo dikhaai nahin deta hai. Jo kuchh dikhaai deta hai, vah kshan-bhar ka hai lekin jo dikhaai nahin deta vah anant kaal ka.
Kyonki ham rup ko dekhkar nahin, faith se jivit hain.
Yah tumhaare saamne apni aatmaprshansa nahin lekin yah tumhaare lie ek aisa suavsar hai ki tum ham par garv karo ki tum unhein iska uttar de sako, jo apne man ki bajaay baahri rup ka garv karte hain.
Yadi ham besudh pratit hote hain, to yah God ke lie hai aur yadi komal, to tumhaare lie.
Isliye hamne insaan ki nazar se kisi ko bhi samajhna chhor diya hai. Haan, ek samay tha, jab hamne Yeshu ka anumaan insaan ki nazar se lagaaya tha—ab nahin. Ab ham unhein jaan gae hain.
Yadi koi Yeshu mein hai, to vah nai srishti hai. Puraana bit gaya. Dekh lo: sab baatein nai ho gai hain!
Yah sab God ki or se hai, jinhonne Yeshu ke dvaara khud se hamaara mel-milaap kiya aur hamein mel-milaap ki sevkaai saumpi hai.
Dusre words mein, God ne duniya ke khud se mel-milaap ki sthaapna ki prakriya mein Yeshu mein insaan ke apraadhon ka hisaab na rakha. Ab unhonne hamein mel-milaap ki sevkaai saump di hai.
Isliye ham Yeshu ke raajdut hain. God hamaare dvaara tumse request kar rahe hain. Yeshu ki or se tumse hamaari request hai: God se mel-milaap kar lo.
God ke sahkarmi hone ke kaaran hamaari tumse request hai ki tum unse receive hue grace ko vyarth na jaane do,
Kyonki God ka kahna hai: “Anukul avsar par mainne tumhaari pukaar suni, bachaav ke din mainne tumhaari madad ki.” Suno! Yahi hai vah anukul avsar; yahi hai vah bachaav ka din!
Hamaara svabhaav kisi ke lie kisi bhi kshetr mein baadha nahin banta ki hamaari sevkaai par dosh na ho.
Isliye ham har ek paristhiti mein khud ko God ke suyogy servant ke jaisa prastut karte hain: sabr se dard sahne mein, daridrta mein, kasht mein,
Sataahat mein, jel mein, upadrav mein, adhik parishram mein, aparyaapt nind mein, upvaas mein,
Shuddhta mein, knowledge mein, sabr mein, sahridayta mein, Holy Spirit mein, nishchhal love mein,
Sach ke sandesh mein, God ke power mein, vaar aur bachaav donon hi pakshon ke lie God ki righteousness ke hathiyaaron se jo daahine aur baaein haathon mein hain,
Aadar-niraadar mein aur ninda aur prashansa mein; hamein bharmaanevaala samjha jaata hai, jabki ham satyvaadi hain;
Ham prasiddh hain; phir bhi aprsiddh maane jaate hain, ham jivit to hain, par mare hue samjhe jaate hain! Hamein dand to diya jaata hai lekin hamaare jaan nahin lie ja sakte.
Ham kasht mein bhi aanandit rahte hain. Haalaanki ham khud to kangaal hain lekin baakiyon ko dhanvaan bana dete hain. Hamaari nirdhanta mein ham dhanvaan hain.
Korinthvaasiyo! Hamne puri sach mein tum par sach reveal kiya hai—hamne tumhaare saamne apna dil kholkar rakh diya hai.
Hamne tum par koi rok-tok nahin lagaai; rok-tok khud tumne hi apne manon par lagaai hai.
Tumhein apne baalak samajhte hue main tumse kah raha hun: tum bhi apne dil hamaare saamne kholkar rakh do.
Aur, “Main tumhaara pita banunga aur tum meri children. Yahi hai sarvshaktimaan Lord ka kahna.”
Hamein apne dilon mein jagah do. Hamne kisi ke saath anyaay nahin kiya, kisi ko aahat nahin kiya, kisi ka anuchit laabh nahin uthaaya.
Yah kahne ke dvaara ham tum par dosh nahin laga rahe hain. Main pahle bhi kah chuka hun ki tum hamaare dil mein base ho aur hamaara-tumhaara life-maran ka saath hai.
Mujhe tum par atut faith hai. Mujhe tum par garv hai, main bahut protsaahit hua hun. Saare kashton mein bhi main khushi se bharpur rahta hun.
Hamaare makedoniya mein rahne ke dauraan hamein shaaririk rup se vishraam nahin lekin chaaron or se kasht hi kasht milta raha—baahar to laraaiyaan aur andar dar ki baatein.
Magar God ne, jo hataashon ko sabr dete hain, titos ko yahaan upasthit kar hamein sabr diya.

Na keval uski upasthiti ke dvaara hi lekin us protsaahan ke dvaara bhi, jo titos ko tumse receive hua. Usne mujhe mere prati tumhaari laalsa, vedna aur utsaah ke baare mein bataaya. Isse mera khushi aur adhik barh gaya.
Yadypi tum mere patr se shokit hue ho, mujhe iska khed nahin—pahle khed zarur hua tha magar ab main dekhta hun ki tum us patr se shokit to hue lekin thore samay ke lie.

Ab main aanandit hun, isliye nahin ki tum shokit hue lekin isliye ki yahi tumhaare pashchaataap ka kaaran ban gaya. Yah sab God ki will ke hisaab se hi hua ki tumhein hamaare kaaran kisi tarah ki haani na ho.

Vah duhkh, jo God ki or se aata hai, vah aisa pashchaataap ka kaaran ban jaata hai jo hamein bachaav ki or le jaata hai, jahaan khed ke lie koi jagah hi nahin rahta; jabki saansaarik duhkh maut utpann karta hai.

Dhyaan do ki God ki or se aae duhkh ne tummein kya-kya parivartan kie hain: aisi utsukta bhari tatparta, apna paksh spasht karne ki aisi bari chaahat, anyaay ke prati aisa krodh, sankat ke prati aisi saavdhaani, mujhse bheint karne ki aisi tej laalsa, service ke prati aisa utsaah aur duraachaari ko dand dene ke lie aisi teji ke dvaara tumne yah saabit kar diya ki sab kuchh thik-thaak karne mein tumne koi bhi kami nahin chhori hai.

Haalaanki yah patr mainne na to tumhein isliye likha ki mujhe uski chinta thi, jo atyaachaar karta hai aur na hi uske lie, jo atyaachaar sahta hai lekin isliye ki God ke saamne khud tumhin yah dekh lo ki tum hamaare prati kitne sachche ho.
Yahi hamaare sabr ka kaaran hai. Apne sabr se kahin adhik ham titos ke khushi mein harshit hain kyonki tum sabne usmein nai taazgi ka sanchaar kiya hai.

Yadi titos ke saamne mainne tum par garv reveal kiya hai to mujhe uske lie lajjit nahin hona para. Jis tarah, jo kuchh mainne tumse kaha vah sach tha, usi tarah titos ke saamne mera garv reveal karna bhi sach saabit hua.
Tumhaare prati main puri tarah aashvast hun. Yah mere lie khushi ka vishay hai.
Ham bhaai bahnon ko makedoniya ki kalisiyaaon ko God dvaara die gae grace ke baare mein bataana chaahte hain.
Bare bhishan sankton mein bhi unka bara khushi, aur bhaari kangaali mein bhi unki bari udaarta chhalak pari hai.
Main is sach ki pushti kar sakta hun ki unhonne na keval utna hi diya, jo unke lie sambhav tha lekin usse kahin adhik! Yah unhonne apni chaahat se diya hai.
Unhonne to hamse request par request karte hue anumti chaahi ki unhein holy logon ki madad ki dhanyta mein shaamil hone ka suavsar provide kiya jaae.
Yah sab hamaari ummid ke viprit tha. Isse bhi barhkar unhonne God ki will ke anurup sabse pahle khud ko Lord ke lie aur phir hamaare lie samarpit kar diya.
Isliye hamne titos se request ki ki jis tarah iske pahle usne tummein yah prakriya shuru ki thi, vaise hi vah is saraahniy kaam ko pura bhi kare.
Thik jis tarah tum faith, vachan, knowledge, utsaah aur hamaare prati love mein barhte jaate ho, usi tarah ab tumhaara koshish yah ho ki tum is saraahniy service mein bhi barhte jaao.
Main tumhein koi command nahin de raha. Main sirph baakiyon ke utsaah se tumhaare love ki tulna kar iski sach ko parakh raha hun.
Hamaare Lord Yeshu ki grace se tum bhali-bhaanti parichit ho: yadypi vah bahut dhani the, tumhaare lie unhonne nirdhanta apna li ki unki nirdhanta ke dvaara tum dhani ho jaao.
Yahaan main apna mat prastut kar raha hun, jismein tumhaara bhala hai: pichhle varsh tumne daan diya bhi aur daan dene ki chaahat mein tum aage the,

Isliye jo kaam tumne shuru kiya tha, use pura bhi karo—is kaam ki samaapti ke lie bhi vaise hi utsaahi bane raho, jaise iski yojna taiyaar karte samay the. Iski samaapti usse karo, jo is samay tumhaare paas hain.
Yadi kisi mein daan dene ki chaahat hai to jo kuchh uske paas hai, usi ke aadhaar par uska daan grahan hoga—uske aadhaar par nahin, jo uske paas nahin hai.
Hamaara matlab yah nahin hai ki dusron ki bhalaai karne ke kaaran khud tum kasht saho. Hamaara purpose sirph justice karna hai.

Is samay to tumhaari barhotri unki zarurat puri karne ke lie kaafi hai. Kabhi yah bhi sambhav hai ki tum khud ko zarurat mein paao aur ve apni barhotri mein se tumhaari madad karein. Tab donon paksh jaisa ho jaaeinge.
Scripture ka udaahran hai: jisne adhik maatra mein ikattha kar liya, usne kuchh bhi jyaada nahin paaya aur jisne kam ikattha kiya, use koi kami na hui.
Titos ke man mein tumhaare prati aisa hi utsaah jagaane ke lie main God ka aabhaari hun.
Usne na keval hamaari request hi saharsh accept ki balki vah utsaah mein apni chaahat se tumhaare paas chala gaya hai.
Itna hi nahin, khud Lord ki glory aur logon par is madad ke lie hamaari tatparta reveal karne ke purpose se kalisiyaaon ne is person ko hamaare saath yaatra karne ke lie chuna hai.
Ham saavdhaan hain ki kisi ko bhi is madad ki raashi ke prabandh karne mein ham par ungli uthaane ka avsar na mile.
Hamaara purpose na keval vah hai, jo Lord ki nazar mein shobhniy aur bhala hai lekin insaanon ki nazar mein bhi.

Inke saath ham ek aur person ko bhej rahe hain. Kai avasron par hamne use parkha hai aur use sachcha hi paaya hai. Ab to tumhaare lie uske bharose ne usmein aur adhik utsaah aur madad ke lie teji ka sanchaar kiya hai.
Titos tumhaare bich mera saathi aur sahkarmi hai. Uske saathi yaatri kalisiyaaon ke bheje hue aur Yeshu ka gaurav hain.
Isliye kalisiyaaon ke saamne khule dil se un par apne love aur tumhaare prati hamaare garv ke kaarnon ka pramaan do.
Vaastav mein yah zaruri hi nahin ki main holy logon mein apni sevkaai ke baare mein tumhein kuchh likhun

Kyonki madad ke lie tumhaari taiyaari se main bhali-bhaanti parichit hun. Makedoniyaavaasiyon ke saamne main iska garv bhi karta raha hun ki aakhaaya pradesh ki church pichhle ek varsh se iske lie taiyaar hai aur unmein se adhikaansh ko tumhaare utsaah se prerna receive hui.

Mainne kuchh saathi believers ko tumhaare paas isliye bheja hai ki tumhaare baare mein mera garv karna khokhla na thahre, lekin ve khud tumhein service ke lie taiyaar paaein—thik jaisa main unse kahta raha hun.

Aisa na ho ki jab koi makedoniyaavaasi mere saath aae aur tumhein daan dene ke lie taiyaar na paae to hamein tumhaare prati aise aashvast hone ke kaaran lajjit hona pare—tumhaari apni lajja to ek alag vishay hoga.

Isliye mainne yah zaruri samjha ki main saathi believers se yah request karun ki ve pahle hi tumhaare paas chale jaaein aur us promise ki gai bheint ka prabandh kar lein, jo tumne udaarta ke bhaav mein di hai, na ki kanjusi ke bhaav mein.
Yaad rahe: vah, jo thora bota hai, thora hi kaatega aur vah, jo bahut bota hai, bahut kaatega.
Isliye jisne apne man mein jitna bhi dene ka nishchay kiya hai, utna hi de—bina chaahat ke ya vivashta mein nahin kyonki God ko dear vah hai, jo khushi se deta hai.
God samarth hain ki vah tumhein bahut adhik grace provide karein ki tumhein sab kuchh paryaapt maatra mein receive hota rahe aur har bhale kaam ke lie tumhaare paas adhikta mein ho,
Jaisa ki Scripture ka lekh hai: unhonne kangaalon ko udaartaapurvak daan diya; unki sach aur righteousness yugaanuyug bani rahti hai.

Vah God, jo kisaan ke lie bij ka aur khaana ke lie aahaar ka intjaam karte hain, vahi bone ke lie tumhaare lie bij ka intjaam aur vikaas kareinge aur tumhaari righteousness ki upaj mein unnti kareinge.
Apni apurv udaarta ke lie tum pratyek paksh mein dhani kie jaaoge. Hamaare maadhyam se tumhaari yah udaarta God ke prati thanks ka vishay ho rahi hai.
Yah sevkaai na keval holy logon ki zarurton ko pura karne ka hi saadhan hai lekin God ke prati umarta hua thanks ka bhaav bhi hai.
Tum par God ke atydhik grace ko dekh ve tumhaare lie bari lagan se prayer kareinge.
God ko unke avarnniy vardaan ke lie aabhaar!
Main Paulos, jo tumhaare bich upasthit hone par to din lekin tumse dur hone par nidar ho jaata hun, khud Yeshu ki udaarta aur komalta mein tumse vyaktigat request kar raha hun.
Meri request yah hai: jab main vahaan aaun to mujhe unke prati, jo yah sochte hain ki hamaari lifestyle saansaarik hai, vah kathorta dikhaani na pare jiski mujhse ummid ki jaati hai.
Haalaanki ham duniya mein rahte hain magar ham yuddh vaise nahin karte jaise yah duniya karta hai.
Hamaare yuddh ke astr-shastr saansaarik nahin hain—ye God ke power mein garhon ko dhaah dete hain.
Iske dvaara ham us har ek virodh ko, us har ek garv karnevaale ko, jo God ke knowledge ke khilaaf sir uthaata hai, gira dete hain aur har ek dhaarna ko Yeshu ka aajnaakaari bandi bana dete hain.
Tumhaari aajnaakaarita aur sach ki bharpuri saabit ho jaane par ham sabhi command na maannevaalon ko dand dene ke lie taiyaar hain.

Tum sirph jo saamne hai, uske baahri rup ko dekhte ho. Yadi kisi ko apne baare mein yah nishchay hai ki vah Yeshu ka hai to vah is par dobaara soch kare ki jaise vah Yeshu ka hai, vaise hi ham bhi Yeshu ke hain.
Yadi main us authority ka kuchh adhik hi garv karta hun, jo Lord ne mujhe tumhaare nirmaan ke lie saumpa hai, na ki tumhaare vinaash ke lie, to usmein mujhe koi lajja nahin.
Main nahin chaahta ki tumhein yah ahsaas ho ki main tumhein daraane ke purpose se yah patr likh raha hun.
Mere baare mein kuchh ka kahna hai, “Uske patr mahatvpurn aur prabhaavshaali to hote hain lekin uska vyaktitv kamjor hai aur baatein karna prabhaavit nahin karta.”
Ye log yaad rakhein ki tumhaare saath na hone ki situation mein ham apne patron ki abhivyakti mein jo kuchh hote hain, vahi ham tumhaare saath hone par apne svabhaav mein bhi hote hain.

Ham unke saath apni ginti ya tulna karne ka saahas nahin karte, jo apni hi prashansa karne mein lin hain. Ve apne hi maapdandon ke hisaab se apne aapko maapte hain aur apni tulna ve khud se hi karte hain. Ekdam bewakoof hain ve!
Ham apni maryaada ke baahar garv nahin kareinge. Ham God dvaara nirdhaarit maryaada mein hi simit raheinge. Tum bhi isi sima mein simit ho.

Anyon dvaara kie parishram ka shrey lekar bhi ham is ummid mein sima paar nahin karte ki jaise jaise tumhaara faith gahra hota jaata hai, tumhaare bich apni hi sima mein hamaara kaaryakshetr aur gatividhiyaan phailti jaaein
Jo garv karta hai, vah God mein garv kare.
Grahan vah nahin kiya jaata, jo apni taarif khud karta hai lekin vah hai, jiski taarif Lord karte hain.
Main chaahta hun ki tum meri chhoti si murkhta ko sah lo—jaise vaastav mein tum is samay sah bhi rahe ho.
Tumhaare lie meri love ki dhun thik vaisi hi hai jaisi God ki. Tum us holy kunvaari jaise ho, jiski mangni mainne ekmaatr var—Yeshu—ko saumpne ke purpose se ki hai.
Main yah nahin maanta ki main tathaakthit bare se bare apostles se tuchchh hun.
Maana ki main bolne mein nipun nahin hun lekin nishchit hi knowledge mein main kam nahin. Vastuth hamne pratyek tarah se pratyek kshetr mein tumhaare lie ise spasht kar diya hai.
Tumhaare bich service karte hue mera bharan-poshan dusre kalisiyaaon dvaara kiya ja raha tha. Yah ek tarah se unhein lutna hi hua.

Tumhaare saath rahte hue aarthik zarurat mein bhi main tummein se kisi par bhi bojh na bana. Makedoniya pradesh se aae saathi believers ne meri sabhi zarurton ki purti ki. Har kshetr mein mera yahi koshish raha hai ki main tum par bojh na banun. Bhavishy mein bhi mera koshish yahi rahega.
Mujhmein Yeshu ka sach maujud hai, isliye pure aakhaaya pradesh ke kshetron mein koi bhi mujhe mere is gaurav se dur na kar sakega.
Kyon? Kya isliye ki mujhe tumse love nahin? God gavaah hain ki main tumse love karta hun.
Main jo kuchh kar raha hun, vahi karta jaaunga ki un logon ki is baare mein garv karne ki saari sambhaavnaaein samaapt ho jaaein ki ve bhi vahi kaam kar rahe hain, jo ham kar rahe hain.
Aise person jhuthe apostle aur chhal se kaam karnevaale hain, jo Yeshu ke apostle hone ka dhong karte hain.
Yah koi aashchary ka vishay nahin ki aarop lagaanevaala bhi jyotirmay angel hone ka nakal karta hai,
Isliye ismein koi bari baat nahin ki uske servant bhi jo righteousness ke servant hone ka naatak karte hain, jinka ant unke kaamon ke hisaab se hi hoga.

Main dobaara yaad dila raha hun: koi mujhe bewakoof na samjhe lekin yadi tumne mujhe aisa maan hi liya hai to mujhe bewakoof ke taur par hi accept kar lo. Isse mujhe bhi garv karne ka avsar mil jaaega.
Bedhrak kaha gaya mera vachan Lord dvaara diya gaya nahin hai—yah sab to ek bewakoof ki garv mein kahi gai baat hai.
Kitne to apni maanviy uplabdhiyon ka garv kar rahe hain, to main bhi garv kyon na karun?
Tum to aise wise ho ki bewakoofon ko khushi se sah lete ho.

Vastuth tum to uski tak sah lete ho, jo tumhein slave bana leta hai, jo tumhaara shoshan karta hai, tumhaara anuchit laabh uthaata hai, khud ko unnat karta hai, yahaan tak ki vah tumhaare chehra par thappar tak maar deta hai!

Mujhe khud lajjit ho kahna par raha hai ki ham in sab ki tulna mein bahut durbal the. Koi kisi bhi vishay ka abhimaan karne ka saahas kare—main yah murkhtaapurvak kah raha hun—main bhi usi tarah abhimaan karne ka saahas kar raha hun.
Kya ve ibri hain? Ibri main bhi hun, kya ve israaeli hain? Israaeli main bhi hun, kya ve Abraham ke vanshaj hain? Abraham ka vanshaj main bhi hun.

Kya ve Yeshu ke servant hain? Main paagal person ki tarah kahta hun, main unse kahin barhkar hun: mainne unse kahin adhik parishram kiya hai, unse kahin adhik bandi banaaya gaya hun, anginat baar pita gaya hun, aksar hi mere jaan sankat mein pare hain.
Yahudiyon ne mujhe paanch baar ek kam chaalis kore lagaae.
Tin baar main beint se pita gaya, ek baar mera pathraav kiya gaya aur tin baar mera jalyaan dhvast hua, ek raat aur ek din mujhe samudr mein vyatit karna para.

Baar-baar mujhe yaatraaein karni parin. Kabhi nadiyon ke, kabhi daakuon ke, kabhi apne deshvaasiyon ke, kabhi gair-Yahudiyon ke, kabhi shehron mein, kabhi banjar zameen mein, kabhi samudr mein jokhim ka aur kabhi jhuthe believers ke jokhim ka saamna karna para hai.
Mainne kai raatein jaag kar, bhukhe-pyaase rahkar, aksar bhukhe rahkar, sardi aur thore kapdon mein rahte hue kathin parishram kiya aur kai kathinaaiyaan jheli hain.
In sab baahri kathinaaiyon ke alaava pratidin mujh par sabhi kalisiyaaon ki bhalaai ki chinta ka dabaav rahta hai.
Kaun kamjor hai, jiski kamzori ka ahsaas mujhe nahin hota? Kiske galti mein parne se main chintit nahin hota?
Yadi mujhe garv karna hi hai to main apni kamzori ka garv karunga.
Lord Yeshu ke God aur pita, jo yugaanuyug blessed hain, gavaah hain ki main jhuth nahin bol raha:
Jab main damishk mein tha to raaja aretos ke raajypaal ne mujhe bandi banaane ke purpose se shehar mein pahra baitha diya tha
Lekin mujhe shahrapnaah ke ek jharokhe se ek tokre mein baithaakar niche utaar diya gaya aur is tarah main uske haathon se bach nikla.
Apni baraai karna mere lie zaruri ho gaya hai—haalaanki ismein koi bhi laabh nahin hai—isliye main Lord ke dvaara die gae darshnon aur divy prakaashnon ke varnan ki or barh raha hun.
Main ek aise person ko, jo Yeshu ka believer hai, jaanta hun. Chaudah varsh pahle yah person tisre heaven tak utha liya gaya—body ke saath ya bina body ke, mujhe maalum nahin—yah God hi jaante hain.
Main jaanta hun kaise yahi person—body ke saath ya bina body ke, mujhe maalum nahin—yah God hi jaante hain;
Isi person ki or se main garv karunga—khud apne baare mein nahin—sivaay apni kamzoriyon ke.

Vaise bhi yadi main apni baraai karne hi lagun to ise meri murkhta nahin maana ja sakega kyonki vah saty varnan hoga. Lekin main yah bhi nahin karunga ki koi bhi mere svabhaav, mere varnan se prabhaavit ho mujhe mere kathan ya karni se adhik shrey dene lage.

Mere adbhut prakaashnon ki shreshthta ke kaaran mujhe apni baraai karne se rokne ke purpose se mere body mein ek kaanta lagaaya gaya hai—mujhe kasht dete rahne ke lie aarop lagaanevaala ka ek apdut—ki main apni baraai na karun.
Iske upaay ke lie mainne tin baar Lord se girgiraakar request ki.

Lord ka uttar tha: “Kamzori mein mera power siddh ho jaata hai isliye tumhaare lie mera grace hi kaafi hai.” Iske prakaash mein main bare harsh ke saath apni kamzoriyon ke baare mein garv karunga ki mere dvaara Lord Yeshu ka power sakriy ho jaae.
Yeshu ke lie main kamzoriyon, apmaanon, kashton, utpirnon aur kathinaaiyon mein puri tarah santusht hun kyonki jab kabhi main durbal hota hun, tabhi main balvant hota hun.

Yah karte hue mainne khud ko bewakoof bana liya hai. Tumne hi mujhe iske lie majbur kiya hai. Hona to yah tha ki tum meri prashansa karte. Yadypi main tuchchh hun phir bhi main un bare-bare apostles ki tulna mein kam nahin hun.
Mainne tumhaare bich rahte hue preritaai pramaan svarup sabr, chamatkaar chihn, adbhut kaam aur power bhare kaam dikhaae.
Bhala tum kis kshetr mein dusre kalisiyaaon ki tulna mein kam rahe, sivaay iske ki main kabhi bhi tumhaare lie bojh nahin bana? Maafi kar do. Mujhse bhul ho gai.

Main tisri baar vahaan aane ke lie taiyaar hun. Main tumhaare lie bojh nahin banunga. Meri ruchi tumhaari property mein nahin, khud tummein hai. Children se yah ummid nahin ki jaati ki ve maata-pita ke lie kamaaein—children ke lie maata-pita kamaate hain.
Tumhaari aatmaaon ke bhale ke lie main nishchit hi apna sab kuchh aur khud ko kharch karne ke lie taiyaar hun. Kya tumhein barhkar love karne ka badla tum mujhe kam love karne ke dvaara doge?
Kuchh bhi ho, main tum par bojh nahin bana. Phir bhi koi na koi mujh par yah dosh zarur laga sakta hai, “Bara dhurt hai vah! Chhal kar gaya hai tumse!”
Kya vaastav mein in logon ko tumhaare paas bhejkar mainne tumhaara galat phaayda uthaaya hai?

Titos ko tumhaare paas bhejne ki request mainne ki thi. Uske saath apne is bhaai ko bhi mainne hi bheja tha. Kya titos ne tumhaara galat phaayda uthaaya? Kya hamaara svabhaav ek hi bhaav se apostle na tha? Kya ham unhin pad-chihnon par na chale?

Yah sambhav hai tum apne man mein yah soch kar rahe ho ki ham yah sab apne bachaav mein kah rahe hain. Dear mitro, ham yah sab God ke saamne Yeshu mein tumhein unnat karne ke purpose se kah rahe hain.

Mujhe yah dar hai ki mere vahaan aane par main tumhein apni ummid ke hisaab se na paaun aur tum bhi mujhe apni ummid ke hisaab se na paao. Mujhe dar hai ki vahaan jhagra, jalan, krodh, udaasi, badnaami, bakvaad, ahankaar aur upadrav paaun!

Mujhe dar hai ki mere vahaan dobaara aane par kahin mere God tumhaare saamne meri pratishtha bhang na kar dein aur mujhe tummein se kai ke atit mein kie gae galtiyon aur unke ashuddhta, gair-kaanuni aur kaamukta bhare svabhaav ke lie pashchaataap na karne ke kaaran shok karna pare.
Tumhaare paas main tisri baar a raha hun. “Har ek baat ki pushti ke lie do ya tin gavaahon ki zarurat hoti hai.”

Vahaan apne dusri baar thaharne ke avsar par mainne tumse kaha tha aur ab vahaan anupasthit hone par bhi vahaan aane se pahle main un sabse yah kah raha hun: jinhonne atit mein galti kiya hai aur baaki logon se bhi, yadi main phir aaunga to kisi par daya na karunga
Kyonki tum yah sabut chaahte ho ki jo mere dvaara baatein karte hain, vah Yeshu hain aur vah tumhaare prati nirbal nahin lekin tumhaare beech saamarthyi hain.

Vaastav mein vah durbalta ki avastha mein hi krusit kie gae, phir bhi vah God ke power mein jivit hain. Nihsandeh ham unmein kamjor hain, phir bhi ham tumhaare lie God ke sakriy power ke kaaran unke saath jivit raheinge.
Mujhe bharosa hai ki tum yah jaan jaaoge ki ham kasauti par khote nahin utre.
Ham God se prayer karte hain ki tumse koi galti na ho. Isliye nahin ki ham bhale dikhaai dein, lekin isliye ki tum vahi karo, jo uchit hai, phir ham bhale hi khote dikhaai dein.
Sach ke virodh mein ham kuchh bhi nahin kar sakte. Ham sach ke pakshdhar hi rah sakte hain.
Ham apne kamjor hone aur tumhaare samarth hone par aanandit hote hain aur yah prayer bhi karte hain ki tum siddh ban jaao.

Is kaaran dur hote hue bhi main tumhein yah sab likh raha hun ki vahaan upasthiti hone par mujhe Lord dvaara die gae authority ka prayog kathor bhaav mein na karna parhe. Is authority ka purpose hai unnat karna, na ki barbaadi karna.
Ant mein, dear bhaai bahno, aanandit raho, apna svabhaav saaf rakho, ek dusre ko protsaahit karte raho, ek mat raho, shaanti banaae rakho aur love aur shaanti ke God tumhaare saath honge.
Holy chumban se ek dusre ko namaskaar karo.
Sabhi holy log jo yahaan hain, unki or se namaskaar.
Lord Yeshu ka grace, aur God ka love, aur Holy Spirit ki sahbhaagita tum sabhi ke saath bani rahe.

Yah patr Paulos ki or se hai, jise na to insaanon ki or se aur na hi kisi insaan ki prakriya dvaara lekin Yeshu aur pita God dvaara, jinhonne Yeshu ko mare huon mein se jivit kiya, apostle chuna gaya,
Aur un bhaai bahnon ki or se, jo is samay mere saath hain, galaatiya pradesh ki kalisiyaaon ke naam mein:
Hamaare pita God aur Lord Yeshu ki or se tumhein grace aur shaanti receive ho.
Unhin ki glory hamesha hoti rahe. Aamen.
Par vah dusra good news jo vaastav mein ishvriy good news hai hi nahin! Saaf taur par kuchh log hain, jo Yeshu ke ishvriy good news ko bigaarkar tumhein ghabra dena chaahte hain.

Kiska kripaapaatr banne ki koshish kar raha hun main—insaanon ka ya God ka? Kya main insaanon ko prasann karne ke lie koshish kar raha hun? Yadi main ab tak insaanon ko hi prasann kar raha hota to Yeshu ka slave na hota.
Yah mujhe na to kisi insaan se aur na hi kisi teaching se, lekin khud Yeshu ke prakaashan ke dvaara receive hua hai.

Yahudi mat ke disciple ke taur par meri lifestyle kaisi thi, iske baare mein tum sun chuke ho. Main kis riti se God ki church par ghor atyaachaar kiya karta tha aur use barbaadi karne ke lie koshish karta rahta tha.
Yahudi mat mein apne purvjon ki parampraaon ke prati bahut utsaahi, main apni aayu ke Yahudiyon se adhik unnat hota ja raha tha.
Lekin God ko, jinhonne maata ke garbh se hi mujhe chun liya aur apne grace ke dvaara mujhe bulaaya, yah sahi laga
Aur na hi main Yerushalem mein unke paas gaya, jo mujhse pahle apostle chune ja chuke the, lekin main araabiya kshetr mein chala gaya aur vahaan se dobaara damishk shehar laut gaya.
Tin varsh baad, main kaifas se bheint karne Yerushalem gaya aur unke saath pandrah din raha.
Lekin Lord ke bhaai Yaakob ke alaava dusre kisi apostle se meri bheint nahin hui.
God ke saamne main tumhein sabr deta hun ki apne is vivran mein main kuchh bhi jhuth nahin kah raha.
Tab main siriya aur kilikiya pradesh ke kshetron mein gaya.
Yahudiya pradesh ki kalisiyaaon se, jo ab Yeshu mein hain, main ab tak vyaktigat rup se aprichit tha.
Unke lie main God ki glory ka vishay ho gaya.
Tab chaudah varsh baad, main baaranbaas ke saath dobaara Yerushalem gaya. Is samay main titos ko bhi apne saath le gaya.
Yah savaal un paakhandiyon ke kaaran utha tha, jo hamaare bich chupke se ghus aae the ki Yeshu mein hamaari svatantrta ka bhed lein aur hamein daasatv mein daal dein.
Ham ek kshan ke lie bhi unke aage na jhuke ki tummein vidymaan ishvriy good news ki sach surakshit rahe.
Iska mere lie koi mahatv nahin ki ve, jo naami the, pahle kya the; God bhed-bhaav karnevaala nahin hain, mere sandesh mein un naami logon ka koi yogdaan nahin tha.
Unhonne hamse sirph yahi request ki ki ham nirdhnon ki andekhi na karein—thik yahi to main bhi chaahta tha!
Jab kaifas antiyokh shehar aae, mainne unke chehra par unka virodh kiya kyonki unki galti saaf-saaf thi.
Baaki Yahudi bhi unke saath is kapat mein shaamil ho gae, yahaan tak ki baaranbaas bhi.

Jab mainne yah dekha ki unka svabhaav ishvriy good news ke bhed ke hisaab se nahin hai, mainne sabke saamne kaifas se kaha, “Yadi khud Yahudi, hokar aapka svabhaav Yahudiyon ke jaisa nahin lekin gair-Yahudiyon ke jaisa hai, to aap gair-Yahudiyon ko Yahudiyon jaise svabhaav ke lie baadhy kaise kar sakte ho?
Yadi main usi ko dobaara banaata hun, jise mainne gira diya tha, to main khud ko hi apraadhi saabit karta hun.
“Kyonki law ke dvaara main law ke lie mar gaya ki main God ke lie jiun.
Nirbuddhi galaatiyo! Kisne tumhein sammohit kar diya? Tumhaare saamne to Yeshu ko saaf-saaf krus par dikhaaya gaya tha.
Main tumse sirph yah jaanna chaahta hun: Holy Spirit tumne law ke niyam-follow dvaara receive kiya ya ishvriy good news ko sunne aur usmein faith karne ke dvaara?
Kya tum itne nirbuddhi ho? Jo Holy Spirit dvaara shuru kiya gaya tha kya vah insaan ke kaaryon se siddh banaaya ja raha hai?
Tumne itne duhkh uthaae to kya ve vaastav mein vyarth the?
God, jo tumhein apna aatma provide karte aur tumhaare bich chamatkaar karte hain, kya yah vah law ka follow karne ke dvaara karte hain ya faith ke saath sunne ke dvaara?
Phir bhi, law faith par aadhaarit nahin hai, “Iske viprit, jo iska anusran karega, vah iske kaaran jivit rahega.”
Yah sab isliye ki Yeshu mein Abraham ki aashishein gair-Yahudiyon tak aaein aur ham faith dvaara promise ki hui Holy Spirit receive karein.
Dear bhaai bahno, main saamaany life se udaahran de raha hun. Ek maanviy vaacha ki pushti ke baad use na to koi alag karta hai aur na hi usmein kuchh jorta hai.
Pratijnaaein Abraham aur unke vanshaj se ki gai thi. Vahaan yah nahin kaha gaya “Vanshjon se,” Maano anekon se lekin ek hi se arthaat “Vanshaj se,” Arthaat Yeshu se.

Mere kahne ka matlab yah hai: God ne Abraham se ek vaacha sthaapit ki aur use pura karne ki promise bhi ki. Chaar sau tis varsh baad di gai law na to God ki vaacha ko mita sakti hai aur na God ki promise ko.
Yadi miraas ka aadhaar law hai to miraas promise par aadhaarit ho hi nahin sakti, lekin God ne Abraham ko yah miraas promise dvaara hi provide ki.
Sirph ek paksh ke lie madhyasth zaruri nahin hota, jabki God sirph ek hain.
To kya law God ki pratijnaaon ke viprit hai? Bilkul nahin! Yadi koi aisi law di gai hoti, jo life provide kar sakti thi, tab nishchyath us law ke follow karne par righteousness receive ho jaati.
Yeshu mein faith ke prakaashan se pahle ham law ke sanrakshan mein rakhe gae, us faith se anjaan, jo reveal hone par tha.
Isliye law hamein Yeshu tak pahunchaane ke lie hamaara sanrakshak hua ki ham faith dvaara righteous thahraae jaaein.
Lekin ab, jab faith a chuka hai, ham sanrakshak ke adhin nahin rahe.
Isliye tum sab Yeshu mein faith dvaara God ki children ho,
Isliye ab na koi Yahudi hai, na koi yunaani; na koi svatantr hai, na koi slave aur na koi aadmi hai, na koi aurat kyonki tum sab Yeshu mein ek ho.
Yadi tum Yeshu ke ho, to tum Abraham ke vanshaj ho, God ki promise ke vaaris.
Mera kahne ka purpose yah hai ki jab tak vaaris baalak hai, slave aur usmein kisi bhi tarah ka antar nahin hota, yadypi vah har ek vastu ka maalik hai.
Vah pita dvaara nirdhaarit samay tak ke lie rakshkon va prabandhkon ke sanrakshan mein rahta hai.
Isi tarah ham bhi, jab baalak the, duniya ki aadi teaching ke adhin daasatv mein the.
Lekin nirdhaarit samay ke pura hone par God ne apne son ko bheja, jo aurat se janme, law ke adhin,
Ki un sabko chhura lein, jo law ke adhin hain, ki ham God ki children hone ka authority receive kar sakein.
Ab isliye ki tum children ho, God ne apne son ke aatma ko, jo abba, pita pukaarta hai, hamaare dilon mein bhej diya hai.
Isliye ab tum slave nahin lekin children ban gae ho aur yadi tum children ho to God ke dvaara vaaris bhi.
Jab tum God ko nahin jaante the, us samay tum unke slave the, jo vaastav mein ishvar hain hi nahin.

Lekin ab, jab tumne God ko jaan liya hai, lekin yah kahein ki God dvaara jaan liye gae ho, to phir tum kamjor aur dayniy aadi teachings ka slave banne ke lie kyon laut rahe ho? Kya tumhein dobaara unhin ka slave banne ki laalsa hai?
Tum to vishesh divas, maah, ritu aur varsh manaate ja rahe ho.
Mujhe tumhaare lie aashanka hai ki kahin tumhaare lie mera parishram vyarth hi to nahin gaya.
Dear bhaai bahno, main tumse request karta hun ki tum mere jaisa ban jaao kyonki main bhi tumhaare jaisa ban gaya hun. Tumne mujhe koi haani nahin pahunchaai.

Lekin meri shaaririk situation ke kaaran, jo tumhaare lie ek parakh thi, tumne na to mujhse nafrat ki aur na hi mujhse chehra mora, lekin mujhe is tarah accept kiya, maano main God ka angel hun, Yeshu hun.
Ab kahaan gaya tumhaara khushi manaana? Main khud gavaah hun ki yadi sambhav hota to us samay tum apni aankhein tak nikaalkar mujhe de dete.
Kya sirph sach bolne ke kaaran main tumhaara dushman ho gaya?
Ve tumhein apne paksh mein karne ko utsuk hain, lekin kisi bhale matlab se nahin; unka matlab to tumhein mujhse alag karna hai ki tum unke disciple ban jaao.
Hamesha hi achchhe purpose ke lie utsaahi hona uttam hota hai aur sirf usi samay nahin, jab main tumhaare beech upasthit hota hun.
He baalko, tummein Yeshu ka svarup puri tarah viksit hone tak main dobaara prasav dard mein rahunga.
Bari abhilaasha thi ki is samay main tumhaare paas hota aur mithi vaani mein tumse baatein karta, kyonki tumhaare baare mein main duvidha mein para hun.
Mujhe yah bataao: tum, jo law ke adhin rahna chaahte ho, kya tum vaastav mein law ka follow nahin karte?
Scripture mein likha hai ki Abraham ke do son the, ek daasi se aur dusra svatantr aurat se.
Daasi ka son body se janma tha aur svatantr aurat ke son ka janm promise ke pura hone ke lie hua tha.
Yah ek drishtaant hai. Ye striyaan do vaachaaein hain. Sinaay parvat ki vaacha haagaar hai, jisse daasatv ki children paida hoti hai.
Haagaar araabiya mein sinaay parvat hai, jo vartmaan Yerushalem ka pratik hai kyonki vah santaanon sahit daasatv mein hai.
Lekin svargiy Yerushalem svatantr hai. Vah hamaari maata hai.

Jaisa ki likha hai: “Baanjh, tum, jo children paida karne mein asmarth ho, aanandit ho. Tum, jo prasav dard se anjaan ho, jay jaykaar karo, kyonki tyaagi hui ki children, suhaagan ki children se adhik hai.”
Dear bhaai bahno, tum yitshaak ke jaisa promise ki children ho.
Lekin jaise us samay body se janma son aatma se janme son ko sataaya karta tha, vaisi hi situation is samay bhi hai.
Isliye, dear bhaai bahno, ham daasi ki nahin, lekin svatantr aurat ki children hain.
Isi svatantrta mein bane rahne ke lie Yeshu ne hamein svatantr kiya hai. Isliye sthir raho aur dobaara daasatv ke jue mein na juto.
Lekin ham Holy Spirit ke dvaara faith se righteousness ki ummid ki baat johte hain.
Daur mein bahut barhiya tha tumhaara vikaas. Kaun ban gaya tumhaare sach par chalne mein rukaavat?
Yah uksaava unki or se nahin hai, jinhonne tumhein bulaaya.
“Thora-sa khamir saare aate ko khamir kar deta hai.”
Lord mein mujhe tum par bharosa hai ki tum kisi dusre soch ko accept na karoge. Jo bhi tumhein bharmaaega va daanva-dol karega, vah dand bhogega, chaahe vah koi bhi kyon na ho.
Uttam to yahi hota ki ve, jo tumhein daanva-dol kar rahe hain, khud ko napunsak bana lete!
Dear bhaai bahno, tumhaara bulaava svatantrta ke lie kiya gaya hai. Apni svatantrta ko apni shaaririk chaahaton ki purti ka suavsar mat banaao lekin prempurvak ek dusre ki service karo.
Kyonki saari law ka saar sirph ek vaaky mein chhipa hua hai: “Jaise tum khud se love karte ho, vaise hi apne parosi se bhi love karo.”
Yadi tum ek dusre ko hinsak pashuon ki bhaanti kaatte-phaarte rahe, to saavdhaan! Kahin tumhin ek dusre ka barbaadi na kar baitho.
Yadi tum Holy Spirit dvaara chalaae chalte ho to tum law ke adhin nahin ho.
Body dvaara utpann kaam spasht hain: veshyaagaami, ashuddhta, bhrashtaachaar,
Murti puja, jaadu-tona, shatruta, jhagra, jalan, krodh, svaarth, matbhed, vidharm;

Daah, matvaalaapan, lila-krira aur inke jaisa dusre, jinke baare mein main tumhein chetaavni de raha hun ki jinka svabhaav is tarah ka hai, ve meri purv chetaavni ke anurup God ke kingdom ke vaaris nahin honge.
Lekin aatma ka phal hai love, khushi, shaanti, sabr, daya, udaarta, vishvastta,
Vinamrta aur aatmsanyam; koi bhi vidhaan inke khilaaf nahin hai.
Jo Yeshu ke hain, unhonne body ko uski vaasnaaon aur abhilaashaaon sahit krus par charha diya hai.
Ab, jabki hamne Holy Spirit dvaara life receive kiya hai, hamaara svabhaav bhi aatma se apostle ho.
Na ham ghamandi banein, na ek dusre ko uksaaein aur na hi aapas mein dvesh rakhein.

Dear bhaai bahno, yadi tumhein yah maalum ho ki kisi person ne koi apraadh kiya hai, to tum, jo spiritual ho, use namrtaapurvak sudhaaro, lekin tum khud saavdhaan raho ki kahin tum bhi pariksha mein na par jaao.
Ek dusre ka bojh uthaaya karo. Iske dvaara tum Yeshu ki law ko pura karoge.
Yadi koi person kuchh na hone par bhi khud ko pahuncha hua samajhta hai to vah khud ko dhokha deta hai.
Har ek person apne kaamon ki jaanch khud kare, tab uske saamne kisi aur par nahin, khud apne par ghamand karne ka kaaran hoga
Kyonki har ek person apna bojh khud hi uthaaega.
Jise vachan ki teaching di ja rahi hai, vah har ek uttam vastu mein apne shikshak ko sammilit kare.
Kisi bhram mein na rahna: God mazaak ke vishay nahin hain kyonki insaan jo kuchh bota hai, vahi kaatta hai.
Ham bhalaai ke kaam karne mein saahas na chhorein kyonki yadi ham dhile na ho jaaein to ham nirdhaarit samay par upaj zarur kaateinge.
Jab tak hamaare saamne suavsar hai, ham sabhi ka bhala karte rahein, visheshkar believer parivaar ke sadasyon ka.
Dhyaan do ki kaise bare aakaar ke akshron mein mainne tumhein apne haathon se yah likha hai!
Aisa kabhi na ho ki main hamaare Lord Yeshu ke krus ke alaava aur kisi bhi vishay par ghamand karun. Inhin Yeshu ke kaaran duniya mere lie krus par charhaaya ja chuka hai aur main duniya ke lie.
Ve sabhi, jo is siddhaant ka follow karte hain, unmein aur God ke Israel mein shaanti va grace vyaapt ho.
Ant mein, ab koi mujhe kisi tarah ki dard na pahunchaae kyonki mere body par Yeshu ke ghaav ke chihn hain.
Dear bhaai bahno, hamaare Lord Yeshu ka grace tum par bana rahe. Aamen.
Paulos ki or se, jo God ki will ke hisaab se Yeshu ka apostle hai, un holy logon ko, jo ifesos shehar mein Yeshu ke believer hain:
Tumhein hamaare pita God aur hamaare Lord Yeshu ki or se grace aur shaanti receive hoti rahe.
Hamaare Lord Yeshu ke God aur pita ki praise ho, jinhonne hamein Yeshu mein svargiy jagahon mein har ek spiritual blessing se blessed kiya hai.
Yah grace unhonne ham par bahutaayat se barsaaya, unhonne saari buddhimaani aur vivek mein,
Apni chaahat ka bhed ham par apne bhale purpose ke hisaab se reveal kiya, jo unhonne khud Yeshu mein sthaapit ki thi,
Yah intjaam unhonne samyon ko pura hone ko dhyaan mein rakhkar Yeshu mein heaven aur prithvi ki sabhi vastuon ko ikattha karne ke lie kiya.
Ki ant mein ham, jinhonne pahle se Yeshu mein ummid rakhi, unki glory ki praise ke saadhan ho jaaein.
Yahi kaaran hai ki main bhi Lord Yeshu mein tumhaare faith aur holy logon ke prati tumhaare love ke baare mein sunkar,
Apni praarthnaaon mein tumhein yaad karte hue God ko thanks dena nahin chhorta.
Meri prayer yah hai ki hamaare Lord Yeshu ke God aur prataapmay pita tumhein knowledge va prakaashan ki aatma provide karein ki tum unhein uttam riti se jaan sako.
Aur main prayer karta hun ki apne man ki aankhon ke prakaashan se tum jaan sako ki unki bulaahat ki ummid aur unke holy logon ki miraas ke vaibhav ka wealth kya hai,
Aur ham believers ke prati unka power kaisa mahaan hai. Yah power unki mahaashakti ki kaam-pranaali ke anurup hai
Sabhi satta, pradhaanta, power, authority aur har ek naam ke upar, chaahe is yug ke ya aanevaale yug ke.
Unhonne sab kuchh unke adhin kar diya aur church ke lie sabhi vastuon ka shiromni thahra diya
Church, jo unka body, unki paripurnta hai, jo sab mein sab kuchh bharkar karte hain.
Lekin daya mein dhani God ne apne apaar love ke kaaran,
Jab ham apne apraadhon mein mare hue the, Yeshu mein hamein jivit kiya—bachaav tumhein grace hi se receive hua hai.
Ki vah aanevaale samyon mein apne grace ka uttam wealth Yeshu mein hamaare lie ki gai grace mein dikha sakein.
Kyonki grace hi se, faith ke dvaara tumhein bachaav receive hua hai. Yah tumhaare kaaran nahin, balki God ka vardaan hai,
Aur yah kaamon ka pratiphal nahin hai ki koi garv kare,
Kyonki ham God dvaara pahle se thahraae hue bhale kaamon ke lie Yeshu mein rache gae God ki rachna hain.
Yaad rakho tum us samay duniya mein Yeshu se alag, Israel ki naagrikta se nikaale gae, promise ki vaachaaon se aprichit, aashaahin aur God se rahit the.
Vah khud hamaara mel hain, kyonki unhonne apne body mein donon samuhon ke bich ki divaar ko dhaah kar donon ko ek kar diya,
Vah unhonne orders ki law jiski aajnaaein vidhiyon ki riti par thi mita di ki iske dvaara vah khud mein un do ke jagah par ek nae insaan ko banaakar mel-milaap ki sthaapna karein,
Aur krus ke dvaara ek body mein ham donon ka God se mel-milaap kara sakein ki shatruta samaapt ki ja sake.
Kyonki unhin mein hokar ek hi aatma mein donon hi ki pahunch pita God tak hai.
Isliye ab tum pardeshi aur musaaphir nahin, lekin God ke holy logon ke saath sahnaagrik aur God ke parivaar ke ho,
Jiski sanrachna apostles aur bhavishyadvaktaaon dvaara rakhi gai ninv par hui, jiski aadhaarshila khud Yeshu hain.
Jinmein saari bhavan ki rachna ek saath milkar Lord ke lie holy temple hone ke lie barhti jaati hai.
Jinmein tum sabhi God ka nivaas jagah hone ke lie Holy Spirit dvaara sanyojit kie jaate hue banaae ja rahe ho.
Nishchit hi tumne God ke grace ke us prabandhan ke baare mein suna hai, jo mujhe tumhaare lie provide kiya gaya,
Arthaat vah bhed, jo mujh par prakaashan ke dvaara reveal kiya gaya, jiska main sankshep mein varnan pahle kar chuka hun.
Ise parhte hue tum Yeshu ke bhed ke baare mein mere vivek ko samajh sakte ho,
Jo maanav jaati par dusre pirhiyon mein is tarah reveal nahin kiya gaya tha, jis tarah ab Lord ke holy apostles aur bhavishyadvaktaaon par Holy Spirit mein reveal kiya gaya hai.
Ab ishvriy good news ke dvaara gair-Yahudi Yeshu mein miraas ke saajhi, ek hi body ke ang aur promise ke sahbhaagi hain.
God ke grace ke vardaan mein unki sakriy power ke hisaab se yah ishvriy good news mujhe saumpa gaya aur main jiska servant chuna gaya.
Ki ab church ke dvaara God ka vibhinn tarah ka knowledge aakaashmandal ke leaders aur adhikaariyon par reveal kiya jaae,
Yah us sanaatan purpose ke hisaab se hua, jo God ne Yeshu hamaare Lord mein pura kiya.
Jinmein apne faith ke dvaara pravesh ke lie hamein saahas aur bharosa receive hua hai.
Isliye tumse meri yah request hai ki tum un utpirnon ke kaaran, jo main tumhaare lie sah raha hun, niraash na ho; kyonki ve tumhaara gaurav hain.
Yahi kaaran hai ki main pita ke saamne ghutne tekta hun,
Jinmein heaven aur prithvi ke har ek gotr ka naam rakha jaata hai,
Ki vah apni apaar glory ke hisaab se apne Holy Spirit ke dvaara tumhaare antraatma ko power-sampann karein,
Ki faith ke dvaara Yeshu tumhaare dil mein vaas karein aur love mein majbut va sthir hokar,
Tum sabhi holy jan Yeshu ke love ki lambaai, chauraai, unchaai va gahraai ko bhali-bhaanti samajh sako,
Aur Yeshu ke us love ko jaan sako, jo knowledge se pare hai ki God ki saari bharpuri tummein sthaapit ho jaae.
Ab unhein jo hammein kaaryshil power ke dvaara hamaari request aur soch aur samajh se apaar kahin adhik barhkar karne mein saksham hain,
Hammein is samay sakriy power ke dvaara, church aur Yeshu mein unki glory pirhi se pirhi, hamesha-hamesha hoti rahe, aamen.
Isliye main, jo Lord ke lie bandi hun, tumse request karta hun ki tumhaari lifestyle tumhaari bulaahat ke anurup ho.
Tummein vishuddh vinamrta, saumyta aur sabr ke saath aapas mein love mein sahne ka bhaav bhar jaae.
Shaanti ke bandhan mein Holy Spirit ki ekta ko yathaashakti sanrakshit banaae rakho. Ek hi body hai, ek hi aatma.
Thik isi tarah vah ummid bhi ek hi hai jismein tumhein bulaaya gaya hai;
Ek hi Lord, ek hi faith, ek hi baptisma;
Aur saari maanav jaati ke pita, jo sabke upar, sabke bich aur sab mein ek hi God hain.
Lekin hammein se har ek ko Yeshu ke vardaan ke parimaan ke hisaab se grace provide kiya gaya hai.
Isi sandarbh mein Scripture ka lekh hai: “Jab vah sabse unche par charh gae, bandiyon ko bandi banaakar le gae aur unhonne insaanon ko vardaan provide kie.”
(is kahaavat ka matlab kya ho sakta hai ki vah “Sabse unche par charh gae,” Sivaay iske ki vah pahle adholok mein niche utar gae?
Vah, jo niche utre, vahi hain, jo aasmaanon se bhi unche jagah mein bare sammaan ke saath charhe ki saare srishti ko paripurn kar dein.)
Unhonne church ko kuchh apostle, kuchh bhavishyadvakta, kuchh ishvriy good news sunaanevaale aur kuchh church ke rakhvaale updeshak provide kie,
Jab tak ham sabhi ko faith aur God-son ke bahut knowledge ki ekta uplabdh na ho jaae—siddh insaan ke jaisa—jo Yeshu ka sampurn dildaul hai.
Lekin sach ko prempurvak vyakt karte hue har ek paksh mein hamaari unnti unmein hoti jaae, jo leader hain, arthaat, Yeshu.
Jinke dvaara saara body joron dvaara gathkar aur ek saath milkar love mein viksit hota jaata hai kyonki har ek ang apna tay kiya gaya kaam thik-thaak karta jaata hai.
Isliye main Lord ke saath pushti karte hue tumse request ke saath kahta hun ki ab tumhaara svabhaav gair-Yahudiyon ke jaisa khokhli man ki riti se apostle na ho.
Unke man ki kathorta se utpann ajnaanta ke kaaran ve God ke life se alag hain aur unki samajh andheri ho gai hai.
Sunn hokar unhonne khud ko lobh se bharkar sab tarah ki kaamukta aur anaitikta ke adhin kar diya hai.
Yeshu ke baare mein aisi teaching tumhein nahin di gai thi
Yadi vaastav mein tumne unke baare mein suna aur unki teaching ko grahan kiya hai, jo Yeshu mein sach ke anurup hai.
Isliye apne puraane svabhaav se apostle svabhaav ko tyaag do, jo chhal ki laalsaaon ke kaaran bhrasht hota ja raha hai;
Ki tumhaare man ka svabhaav naya ho jaae;
Nae svabhaav ko dhaaran kar lo, jiski rachna righteousness aur pavitrta mein God ke svarup mein hui hai.
Isliye jhuth ka tyaag kar, har ek person apne parosi se sach hi kahe kyonki ham ek hi body ke ang hain.
“Yadi tum krodhit hote bhi ho, to bhi galti na karo.” Suryaast tak tumhaare krodh ka ant ho jaae,
Aarop lagaanevaala ko koi avsar na do.
Vah, jo chori karta raha hai, ab chori na kare lekin parishram kare ki vah apne haathon se kie gae upyogi kaamon ke dvaara dusre logon ki bhi madad kar sake, jinhein kisi tarah ki zarurat hai.
Tumhaare chehra se koi bhadde word nahin lekin aisa vachan nikle, jo avsar ke anukul, anyon ke lie grace ka kaaran aur sunnevaalon ke lie bhala ho.
Sab tarah ki karvaahat, rosh, krodh, jhagra, ninda, aakrosh aur bairbhaav ko khud se alag kar do.
Ek dusre ke prati kind aur sahriday bane raho, aur ek dusre ko usi tarah maafi karo, jis tarah God ne Yeshu mein tumhein maafi kiya hai.
God ki love paatr children hone ke naate, tum God ke pichhe chalnevaale bano.
Jaisa ki holy logon ke lie sahi hai, tumhaare bich vyabhichaarita, kisi bhi tarah ki malinta aur kisi bhi tarah ke lobh ka varnan tak na ho.
Aur na hi tumhaare bich nirlajjta aur murkhta bhari baatchit ya ashlil mazaak ho, jo hamesha hi vyarth hai lekin tumhaare bich thanks hi suna jaae.
Iske pahle tum andhera the, magar ab Lord mein roshni ho. Isliye roshni ki children ki tarah svabhaav karo.
(kyonki roshni ka phal sab tarah ki righteousness, sadaachaar aur sach mein hai)
Yah dunrho ki hamaare kin kaamon se Lord santusht hote hain.
Andhera ke nishphal kaamon mein shaamil na ho lekin unhein sankoch prakaash mein laao.
Un kaamon ki to charcha karna bhi lajjaaspad hai, jo anaajnaakaariyon dvaara gupt mein kie jaate hain.
Roshni mein aane par sab kuchh reveal ho jaata hai kyonki roshni hi hai, jo sab kuchh reveal karti hai.
Is par kaha gaya hai: “Soe hue, jaago, mare huon mein se ji utho, Yeshu tum par roshni chamkaaeinge.”
Apne svabhaav ke baare mein vishesh rup se saavdhaan raho. Tumhaara svabhaav bewakoofon sa na ho lekin buddhimaanon sa ho,
Samay ka sadupyog karo, kyonki yah bure dinon ka samay hai.
Isliye nirbuddhi nahin lekin Lord ki chaahat ke knowledge ke lie vivek receive karo.
Daakhras se matvaale na ho kyonki isse bhrashtaachaar paida hoti hai. Lekin, Holy Spirit se bhar jaao,
Tab Lord ke lie aapas mein saare dil se tum bhajan, praise gaan va spiritual git gaate raho,
Har ek vishay ke lie hamesha hamaare Lord Yeshu ke naam mein pita God ke prati thanks dete raho.
Yeshu mein aadar ke kaaran ek dusre ke prati samarpit raho.
Pati, apni patni se, usi tarah love kare jis tarah Yeshu ne church se love kiya aur khud ko uske lie balidaan kar diya
Ki vah use vachan ke snaan ke dvaara galti se shuddh kar apne lie alag kare,
Ki use apne lie aisi tejasvi church banaakar pesh karein jismein na koi kalank, na koi jhurri, na hi inke jaisa koi dosh ho lekin vah holy va nishklank ho.
Isi tarah, pati ke lie uchit hai ki vah apni patni se vaise hi love kare jaise apne body se karta hai. Vah, jo apni patni se love karta hai, khud se love karta. Hai
Kyonki koi bhi apne body se nafrat nahin karta lekin snehpurvak uska poshan karta hai, jis tarah Yeshu church ka karte hain,
“Kyonki ham unke body ke ang hain.
Is kaaran aadmi apne maata-pita ko chhorkar apni patni se mila rahega aur ve donon ek deh honge”
Yah ek gahra bhed hai aur main yah Yeshu aur church ke sandarbh mein upyog kar raha hun.
Phir bhi, tummein se har ek apni patni se apne jaisa love karein aur patni apne pati ka sammaan kare.
He baalko, Lord mein apne maata-pita ka aajnaapaalan karein kyonki uchit yahi hai.
“Apne maata-pita ka sammaan karo”—commands mein se yah aisi pahli command hai jiske saath promise juri hai,
“Tumhaara bhala ho aur tum prithvi par bahut din tak jivit raho.”
Tummein jo pita hain, apni children ko krodh na dilaaein, lekin Lord ki teaching va anushaasan mein unka follow poshan karein.
Isliye, Lord va unke apaar power mein balvant bano.
God ke sabhi astr-shastron se khud ko susajjit kar lo, ki tum aarop lagaanevaala ke chhal-bal ke pratirodh mein khare rah sako.
Hamaara mall-yuddh sirph insaanon se nahin, lekin leaders, adhikaariyon, andhera ki saansaarik shaktiyon aur aakaashmandal mein dushtta ki spiritual senaaon se hai.
Isliye sthir khare rahne ke lie sabhi zarurton ko puri kar God ke sabhi astr-shastron se khud ko susajjit kar lo ki tum us bure din mein saamna kar sako.
Isliye apni kamar sach se kaskar, righteousness ka kavach dhaaran kar sthir khare raho,
Paanvon mein shaanti ke ishvriy good news ke prachaar ki tatparta ke jute dhaaran kar lo.
Inke alaava faith ki dhaal bhi, ki tum evil ke sabhi jalte hue baanon ko bujha sako.
Tab bachaav ka top aur aatma ki talvaar, God ka vachan dhaaran kar lo.
Aur aatma mein har samay request aur prayer ki jaati rahe. Jaagte hue lagaataar bina thake koshish karna tumhaara lakshy ho. Sabhi holy logon ke lie nirantar prayer kiya karo.
Tukhikas, jo Lord mein mera dear bhaai aur ek faithful servant hai, tumhein meri sabhi paristhitiyon aur gatividhiyon se avgat kara dega.
Main use tumhaare paas isi purpose se bhej raha hun, ki tum hamaari situation se avgat ho jaao, aur vah tumhaare dilon ko protsaahit kar sake.
Pita God aur Lord Yeshu ki or se sabhi bhaai bahnon ko shaanti aur faith ke saath saprem namaskaar.
Un sabhi par grace hota rahe, jo hamaare Lord Yeshu se kabhi na khatm honevaala love karte hain.
Yeshu ke slave Paulos aur timothiyos ki or se, Yeshu mein un holy logon aur filippoy nagarvaasi, church adhyaksh aur servants ko.
God hamaare pita aur Lord Yeshu ki or se grace va shaanti receive ho.
Jab-jab main tumhein yaad karta hun, apne God ka aabhaar maanta hun.
Aur aanandpurvak apni har ek prayer mein tum sabke lie hamesha God se madad ki request karta hun,
Kyonki tum shuruaat hi se ab tak ishvriy good news ke prachaar mein mere sahbhaagi rahe ho,
Main nishchaypurvak kah sakta hun ki God ne tummein jo uttam kaam shuruaat kiya hai, vah use Yeshu ke din tak pura kar deinge.

Tumhaare lie meri yah bhaavna sahi hi hai kyonki mere dil mein tumhaara vishesh jagah hai. Yah isliye ki meri beriyon mein aur ishvriy good news ki raksha aur pramaan ki prakriya mein tum sab grace mein mere sahbhaagi rahe ho.
Is baare mein God mere gavaah hain ki Yeshu ki sukumaar mercy mein tumhaare lie main kitna laalaayit hun.
Meri prayer yah hai ki tumhaara love vaastvik knowledge aur vivek mein aur bhi adhik samriddh hota jaae,
Taaki tumhaari madad ho vah sab pahchaan sakne mein, jo sarvashreshth hai, jisse tum Yeshu ke din tak sachche aur nishklank rah sako,
Aur Yeshu ke dvaara prabhaavi righteousness se God ki glory aur praise ke lie phal laao.
Parinaamasvrup kaaraagaar ke pahredaar aur dusre sabhi yah jaan gae hain ki main Yeshu ke lie bandi hun.
Mere bandi hone ke kaaran Lord mein adhikaansh saathi bhaai bahan God ka vachan saahas, tatparta aur nidartaapurvak sunaane ke lie pahle se kahin adhik utsaahi ho gae hain.
Ye ve hain, jo yah love ke lie karte hain kyonki ye jaante hain ki mera chunaav ishvriy good news ki raksha ke lie hua hai.
Kyonki main jaanta hun ki tumhaari praarthnaaon aur Yeshu ke aatma ki madad se main mukt ho jaaunga.

Meri haardik chaahat aur ummid yah hai ki main kisi bhi paristhiti mein lajjit na houn, lekin hamesha ki tarah ab bhi nidarta mein mere body se, chaahe jivit avastha mein ya mrit avastha mein, Yeshu ki glory hoti rahein.
Lekin yadi mujhe body mein jina hi hai to yah mere liye phalpurn saarthak parishram hoga. Main kya chunun main nahin jaanta!
Phir bhi tumhaare lie mera body mein jivit rahna adhik zaruri hai.
Mera drirh faith hai ki main jivit rahunga aur tumhaare vikaas aur faith mein khushi ke kaaran tumhaare bich bana rahunga,
Ki tumse bheint karne mera dobaara aana Yeshu mein mere prati tumhaare gaurav ko aur bhi adhik barha de.
Virodhiyon se kisi bhi tarah bhaybhit na ho—yah unke vinaash ka, lekin tumhaare bachaav ka sabut hai aur vah bhi God ki or se.
Usi jalan ka anubhav karte hue, jise tumne mujhmein dekha aur jiske mujhmein hone ke baare mein tum ab sun rahe ho.
Isliye yadi Yeshu mein zara sa bhi protsaahan, love se utpann sabr, aatma ki sahbhaagita aur mercy aur grace hai,
To ek man, ek sa love, ek hi chitt aur ek lakshy ke lie thaan kar mera khushi pura kar do.
Svaarth aur jhuthi baraai se kuchh bhi na karo, lekin vinamrta ke saath tummein se pratyek apni bajaay dusre ko shreshth samjhe.
Tummein se har ek sirph apni hi bhalaai ka nahin lekin dusron ki bhalaai ka bhi dhyaan rakhe.
Tumhaara svabhaav vaisa hi ho, jaisa Yeshu ka tha:
Jinhonne God ke svarup mein hote hue bhi, God se apni tulna par apna authority banaae rakhna sahi na samjha;
Lekin apne aapko shuny kar, slave ka svarup dhaaran karte hue, aur insaan ki samaanta mein ho gaya.
Aur insaan ke body mein reveal hokar, apne aapko din karke maut— krus ki maut tak, aajnaakaari rahkar khud ko shuny banaaya.
Isliye God ne unhein sabse unche pad par aasin kiya, aur unke naam ko glory di ki vah har ek naam se uncha ho,
Ki har ek ghutna Yeshu naam ki vandna mein jhuk jaae, heaven mein, prithvi mein aur prithvi ke niche,
Kyonki God hi hain, jinhonne apni suichchha ke lie tummein abhilaasha aur kaary karne dono baaton ke liye prabhaav daala hai.
Sab kaam bina kurkuraae aur bina vaad-vivaad ke kiya karo,
Ki tum is buri aur bhrasht pirhi mein, “God ki nishklank children ke taur par khud ko nishkpat aur nishpaap saabit kar sako.” Ki tum is pirhi ke bich jalte hue dipon ke jaisa chamko
Tumne life ka vachan majbuti se thaama hua hai. Tab yah Yeshu ke din mein mere garv ka kaaran hoga, ki na to meri daur-dhup vyarth gai aur na hi mera parishram.
Yadi tumhaare faith ki service aur bali par main argh (lahu) ke jaisa undela bhi ja raha hun, taubhi tum sabke saath yah mera khushi hai.
Meri request hai ki tum bhi isi tarah aanandit raho aur mere khushi mein shaamil ho jaao.
