Lord Yeshu mein mujhe ummid hai ki main shighr hi timothiyos ko tumhaare paas bhejunga ki tumhaara samaachaar jaankar mere utsaah mein bhi barhotri ho.
Meri nazar mein uske jaisa aisa dusra koi person nahin hai jise mere jaise vaastav mein tumhaari chinta ho.
Dusre sabhi Yeshu ki aashaaon ki nahin lekin apni hi bhalaai karne mein lin hain.
Isliye main ummid karta hun ki apni situation spasht hote hi main use tumhaare paas bhej sakunga.
Mujhe Lord mein pura bharosa hai ki main khud bhi jald vahaan aaunga.
Is samay mujhe zaruri yah laga ki main ipaafroditos ko tumhaare paas bhejun, jo mera bhaai, sahkarmi aur sahyoddha hai, jo meri zarurton mein madad ke lie tumhaari or se bheja gaya dut hai.
Vah tum sabse milne ke lie laalaayit hai aur vyaakul bhi. Tumne uski bimaari ke baare mein suna tha.
Bimaari! Vah to marne par tha, lekin us par God ki daya hui, na keval us par lekin mujh par bhi, ki mujhe aur adhik duhkhi na hona pare.
Is kaaran use bhejne ke lie main aur bhi adhik utsuk hun ki use dobaara dekhkar tum aanandit ho jaao aur tumhaare baare mein meri chinta bhi kam ho jaae.
Lord mein aanandpurvak uska svaagat-satkaar karna, uske jaise logon ka aadar kiya karo,
Kyonki Yeshu ke kaam ke lie usne apne jaan jokhim mein daal die the ki tumhaare dvaara mere prati ki gai shesh service vah puri kar sake.
Isliye, dear bhaai bahno, Lord mein aanandit raho. Is vishay par tumhein dobaara likhne se mujhe kasht nahin hota lekin yah tumhaari suraksha ki yojna hai.
Kutton, bure kaam karnevaalon aur angon ke kaat-kut karnevaalon se saavdhaan raho.
Yadypi khud mere paas body par bhi nirbhar rahne ka kaaran ho sakta tha. Yadi kisi ki yah dhaarna hai ki uske lie body par bharosa karne ka kaaran hai to mere paas to kahin adhik hai:
Unmaad mein church ka sataanevaala aur law mein bataai gai righteousness ke maapdandon ke hisaab se, nishklank.
Jo kuchh mere lie laabhdaayak tha, mainne use Yeshu ke lie apni haani maan liya hai.

Isse kahin adhik barhkar Yeshu mere Lord ko jaanne ke uttam mahatv ke saamne mainne sabhi vastuon ko haani maan liya hai—vaastav mein mainne inhein kura maan liya hai ki main Yeshu ko receive kar sakun aur main unmein sthir ho jaaun, jinke lie mainne sabhi vastuein kho din hain.
Ab meri apni righteousness vah nahin jo law ke follow se receive hoti hai lekin vah hai, jo Yeshu mein faith dvaara receive hoti hai—God ki or se faith ki righteousness.

Iska arth yah nahin ki mujhe yah sab uplabdh ho chuka hai ya mainne siddhta receive kar li hai, lekin main koshish ke saath aage barhta chala ja raha hun ki mujhe vah receive ho jaae, jiske lie Yeshu ne mujhe pakar liya hai.
Mere bhaaiyon aur bahnon, mere soch se main ise ab tak pa nahin saka hun lekin haan, main yah zarur kar raha hun: biti baaton ko bhulaate hue, aage ki or barhte hue,
Yeshu mein God ki svargiy bulaave ke inaam ko receive karne ke lie nishaane ki or barhta jaata hun.
Isliye hammein se jitne bhi spiritual kshetr mein siddh kahlaate hain, unka bhi yahi soch ho; lekin yadi kisi baare mein tumhaara maanna alag hai, God use tum par reveal kar deinge.
Phir bhi hamaara svabhaav usi namune ke hisaab se ho, jahaan tak ham pahunch chuke hain.
Bahut hain jinke baare mein mainne pahle bhi spasht kiya hai aur ab aansu bahaate hue reveal kar raha hun ki ve Yeshu ke krus ke dushman hokar jite hain.
Barbaadi hona hi unka ant hai, unka pet hi unka ishvar hai, ve apni nirlajjta par gaurav karte hain, unhonne apna man prithvi ki vastuon mein laga rakha hai.
Yeshu apne usi power ke prayog ke dvaara, jisse unhonne har ek vastu ko apne adhin kiya hai, hamaare kamjor nashvar body ka rup badalkar apne glory ke body ke jaisa kar deinge.
Isliye dear bhaai bahno, tum, jinse bheint karne ke lie main laalaayit hun; tum, jo mera khushi aur mukut ho, Lord mein sthir bane raho!
Main yuodiya se request kar raha hun aur main suntukhe se bhi request kar raha hun ki Lord mein ve aapas mein ek man rahein.
Lord mein hamesha aanandit raho, main dobaara kahunga: aanandit raho.
Kisi bhi tarah ki chinta na karo, lekin har ek paristhiti mein tumhaare nivedan thanks ke saath prayer aur request ke dvaara God ke saamne prastut ki jaaein.
Tab God ki shaanti, jo insaan ki samajh se baahar hai, Yeshu mein tumhaare man aur vichaaron ki raksha karegi.
Ant mein dear bhaai bahno, jo sach hai, jo nirdosh hai, jo righteous hai, jo nirmal hai, jo sundar hai, jo prashansniy hai arthaat jo uttam aur saraahniy gun hain, unhin par tumhaara man laga rahe.
Inhin vishyon ko tumne mujhse sikha; receive kiya aur mujhse suna va mujhmein dekha hai; inhin ka svabhaav kiya karo aur shaanti ke srot God tumhaare saath honge.

Ab main Lord mein atydhik aanandit hun ki ab antath tummein mere prati sadbhaav dobaara jaagrit ho gaya hain. Nihsandeh tumhein meri hitchinta pahle bhi thi lekin use reveal karne ka suavsar tumhein nahin mila.
Yah main abhaav ke kaaran nahin kah raha hun kyonki mainne har ek paristhiti mein santusht rahna sikh liya hai.
Mainne kangaali aur bharpuri donon mein rahna sikh liya hai. Har ek paristhiti aur har ek baare mein mainne tript hone aur bhukha rahne ka bhed aur ghatna va barhna donon sikh liya hai.
Jo mujhe power provide karte hain, unmein main sab kuchh karne mein saksham hun.
Tumne meri visham paristhitiyon mein mera saath dekar saraahniy kaam kiya hai.
Filippoyvaasiyo, ishvriy good news prachaar ke shuruaat mein makedoniya se yaatra shuruaat karte samay tumhaare atirikt kisi bhi church se mujhe aarthik madad receive nahin hui;
Isi tarah thesslonikeyus mein bhi tumne meri zarurat mein kai baar madad ki.
Yah nahin ki main aarthik madad paane ki chaahat rakhta hun, lekin main aise pratiphal ki kaamna karta hun, jisse tumhaara laabh barhta jaae.

Ipaafroditos ke dvaara jo madad tumne bheji hai, usse mainne sab kuchh receive kiya hai aur adhikaai mein receive kar liya hai. Yah mere lie kaafi hai. Vah God ke lie manmohak sugandh, grahan yogy bali va aanandajnak hai.
Hamaare pita God, apne apaar wealth ke anurup Yeshu mein tumhaari har ek zarurat pura kareinge.
God hamaare pita ki glory yugaanuyug bani rahe, aamen.
Yeshu mein sabhi holy logon ko meri shubhkaamnaaein. Mere saathi bhaai bahnon ki or se tumhein shubhkaamnaaein.
Aur sabhi holy logon ki or se abhinandan, visheshkar kaysar ke gharaane ki or se.
Tum par Lord Yeshu ka grace tumhaari aatma ke saath bana rahe. Aamen!
God ki will se Yeshu ke apostle Paulos aur hamaare bhaai timothiyos ki or se,
Kolossoy ke holy logon aur Yeshu mein sachche believer bhaai bahnon ko, hamaare pita God ki or se grace aur shaanti.
Tumhaare lie prayer karte samay ham hamaare Lord Yeshu ke pita God ke saamne hamesha apna aabhaar reveal karte hain,
Kyonki hamne Yeshu mein tumhaare faith aur sabhi holy logon ke prati tumhaare love ke baare mein suna hai.
Inka aadhaar hai vah faith aur love jo upja hai us ummid se jo aapke lie heaven mein rakhi hui hai aur jiske baare mein tum pahle hi sach ka varnan—bachaav ke good news mein sun chuke ho
Thik jise tumne hamaare dear sahkarmi slave epaafraas se sikha, jo tumhaare lie Yeshu ka sachcha servant hai.
Vah hamein Holy Spirit mein tumhaare love ke baare mein suchit bhi karta raha hai.

Isi kaaran jis din se hamne yah suna hai, hamne tumhaare lie prayer karna nahin chhora aur ham yah request karte hain ki tum pure spiritual knowledge aur samajh mein God ki will ke saare knowledge mein bharpur hote jaao,
Ki tumhaara svabhaav Lord ke yogy ho, jo unhein har tarah se prasann karnevaala ho, jo har ek bhale kaary mein phaldaai ho aur God ke saare knowledge mein unnat hote hue tum,
Saari sahanshilta aur sabr ke lie unki glory ki power ke hisaab se saare power se balvaan hote jaao aur
Pita ka khushi se aabhaar maano, jinhonne tumhein roshni ke raajy mein holy logon ki miraas mein shaamil hone ke lie yogy bana diya.
Kyonki vahi hamein andhera ke vash se nikaalkar apne dear son ke raajy mein le aae hain.
Vah to andekhe God ka svarup hain. Vah saari srishti mein pahlauthe hain.

Kyonki unhin mein sab kuchh rachaaya gaya hai—svargiy jagahon mein aur prithvi par, dekhi aur andekhi, sinhaasan aur prabhutaaein, raaja aur adhikaari—sabhi kuchh unhin ke dvaara aur unhin ke lie banaaya gaya.
Vah saari srishti mein pratham hain aur saari srishti unmein sthir rahti hai.
Kyonki pita ki prasannta isi mein thi ki unmein hi saari paripurnta vaas kare aur vah
Haalaanki iske pahle tum bure kaamon ke kaaran God se alag the aur tumhaare man mein bairbhaav tha.

Ab to main tumhaare lie apne kashton mein praphullit hota hun aur main unki deh—church ke lie apne body mein Yeshu ki yaatnaaon mein baaki rah gai kami ko pura karte hue apni zimmedaari puri kar raha hun.
Vah bhed jo yugon aur pirhiyon se chhipa raha hai lekin ab unke holy logon par reveal kiya gaya hai.
Jin par God ne anyjaatiyon ke bich is bhed ke vaibhav ke wealth ko reveal kar dena sahi samjha. Vah bhed hai tummein sthir bana Yeshu, tumhaari honevaali glory ki ummid.
Isi purpose se main unke power ke hisaab se, jo mujhmein prabal rup se kaary kar rahi hai, mehnat karte hue parishram kar raha hun.

Main chaahta hun ki tumko yah maalum ho ki main tumhaare lie aur un sabke lie, jo laaodikeiya mein hain aur un sabke lie, jinhonne mujhe vyaktigat rup se nahin dekha hai, kitna kathin parishram kar raha hun.
Ki unke dil protsaahit hokar love mein jurkar us pure wealth ko receive ho, jo samajh ke pure nishchay mein aur God ke bhed ka vaastvik knowledge ho, jo khud Yeshu hai,
Jinmein samajh aur knowledge ke saare bhandaar chhipe hai.
Haalaanki shaaririk rup se main vahaan anupasthit hun to bhi, tumhaare uttam anushaasan aur Yeshu mein tumhaare faith ki drirhta ko dekhkar prasann hote hue, aatma mein main tumhaare saath hun.
Isliye ki tumne Lord Yeshu ko accept kar liya hai, apna life unmein jiyon,
Unmein gahraai tak jare hue, aur Yeshu mein unnat hote hue apne faith mein drirh ho jaao—thik jaisi teaching tumhein di gai thi—aur tummein thanks bhaav adhik se adhik hota rahe.
Yah dhyaan rahe ki koi bhi tumhein tatvajnaan aur khokhle chhal ke maadhyam se apne vash mein na kar le, jo insaan ki parampra aur duniya ki aadi teaching par aadhaarit hai—na ki Yeshu ke hisaab se.
Parmeshvratv ki saari paripurnta unke body mein vaas karti hai.
Tumne unhin mein, jo pradhaanta aur authority mein sabse upar hain, saari paripurnta receive ki hai.
Unhonne hamaare karz ke pramaan-patr ko, jismein hamaare khilaaf likha gaya adhyaadesh tha, mitaakar krus par kilon se jar kar saamne se hata diya
Aur God ne leaders aur adhikaariyon ko nihattha kar unhein apni vijay yaatra mein khullam-khulla tamaashe ka paatr bana diya.
Isliye tumhaare khaan-paan ya utsav, nae chaand ya Shabbat ko lekar koi tumhaara phaisla na karne paae.
Ye sab honevaali ghatnaaon ki chhaaya sirf hain. Mul vastuein to Yeshu ki hain.
Yah person us sir ko dridhtaapurvak thaame nahin rahta jisse saara body joron aur saans lenevaale angon dvaara poshit aur sambaddh rahta aur God dvaara kie gae vikaas se barhta jaata hai.
Jab tum saansaarik tatvajnaan ke prati Yeshu ke saath mar chuke ho to ab tumhaari lifestyle aisi kyon hai, jo duniya ke in niymon ke adhin hai:
“Ise mat chhuo! Ise mat chakho! Ise vyavhaar mein mat laao!”?
Lagaataar upyog ke kaaran in vastuon ka barbaadi hona inka svabhaav hai kyonki inka aadhaar sirph insaan ki aajnaaein aur shikshaaein hain.

Apni hi suvidha ke hisaab se garhi gai worship vidhi, vinamrta ke dikhaave aur body ko kasht dene ke bhaav se zarur dikhaai de sakti hai, lekin shaaririk vaasnaaon ke daman ke lie ye sab hamesha viphal siddh hote hain.
Apna chitt upar ki vastuon mein lin rakho—un vastuon mein nahin, jo shaaririk hain.
Kyonki tumhaari maut ho chuki hai aur tumhaara life Yeshu ke saath God mein chhipa hua hai.
Isliye apni prithvi ki deh ke angon ko—veshyaagaami, ashuddhta, dushkaamna, laalsa aur lobh ko, jo vaastav mein murti puja hi hai—maar do
Ek samay tumhaara life bhi inhin mein lin tha.
Lekin ab tum sabhi krodh, rosh, bairbhaav, ninda aur gandi bhaasha ka bhi tyaag kar do.
Ek dusre se jhuth mat bolo kyonki tum puraane svabhaav ko uske kaamon sahit utaar chuke
Aur ab tumne nae svabhaav ko dhaaran kar liya hai. Yah svabhaav apne srishtikarta ki chhavi ke hisaab se vaastvik knowledge ke lie naya hota jaata hai.
Isliye God ke chune hue, holy logon aur dear paatron ke jaisa apne dilon mein mercy, bhalaai, vinamrta, dinta aur sabr dhaaran kar lo.
Aapas mein sahanshilta aur maafi karne ka bhaav bana rahe. Yadi kisi ko kisi dusre ke prati shikaayat ho, vah use usi tarah maafi kare jaise Lord ne tumhein maafi kiya hai
Aur in sabse barhkar love bhaav banaae rakho, jo ekta ka samucha sutr hai.
Tumhaare dil mein Yeshu ki shaanti raajy kare—vastuth ek body mein tumhein isi ke lie bulaaya gaya hai. Hamesha dhanyvaadi bane raho.

Tummein Yeshu ke vachan ko apne dil mein puri adhikaai se basne do. Ek dusre ko siddh knowledge mein teaching aur chetaavni do aur God ke prati haardik thanks ke saath praise, bhajan aur spiritual git gaao
Aur vachan aur kaam mein jo kuchh karo, vah sab Lord Yeshu ke naam mein pita God ka aabhaar maante hue karo.
Pati apni patni se love kare—uske prati kathor na ho.
Baalak hamesha apne maata-pita ki aajnaapaalan karein kyonki Lord ke lie yahi prasannta hai.
Pita apni children ko asantusht na kare ki unka saahas tut jaae.
Saavdhaani aur thanks ke bhaav mein lagaataar prayer karte raho;
Jisse ki main use usi tarah spasht kar sakun jaisa ki zaruri hai.
Tumhaari baatchit hamesha hi garimaamay aur saloni ho—is ahsaas ke saath ki tumhein kis person ko kaisa uttar dena hai.
Tukhikas tumhein mere baare mein saari jaankaari dega. Vah hamaara dear bhaai, Lord mein faithful servant aur sahdaas hai.
Main use tumhaare paas isi purpose se bhej raha hun, ki tum hamaari situation se avgat ho jaao, aur vah tumhaare dilon ko protsaahit kar sake.
Aur uske saath mainne onesimos, hamaare dear aur faithful bhaai ko bhi bheja hai, jo tummein se ek hai. Ye hamaari saari paristhiti se tumhein avgat karaaeinge.

Mere saath kaidi aaristaarkhos ki or se namaskaar aur maarkaas ki or se bhi, jo baaranbaas ka sambandhi hai. (jiske baare mein tumhein yah nirdesh diya gaya tha; ki yadi vah aae to uski pahunaai karna.)
Aur Yeshu ka bhi, jiska upnaam yustas hai. Khatniton mein se sirf ye hi God ke kingdom ke kaam mein mere sahkarmi hain, jo mere lie protsaahan ka kaaran bane hain.

Epaafraas ki or se bhi tumhein namaskaar, jo tummein se ek aur Yeshu ka slave hai. Vah tumhaare lie hamesha man ki ekaagrta se praarthnaarat rahta hai ki tum God ki saari chaahat mein siddh aur puri tarah aashvast hokar sthir raho.
Uske man mein, laaodikeiya aur hiraapolis ke believers aur tumhaari bhalaai ki gahri chinta hai. Main iska gavaah hun.
Hamaare dear chikitsak lukos aur demaas ka tumhein namaskaar.
Laaodikeiya shehar ke believer bhaai bahnon aur numfe aur us church ko, jo uske ghar par ikattha hoti hai, namaskaar.
Is patr ke tumhaare beech parhe jaane ke baad yah dhyaan rahe ki yah laaodikeiya shehar ki church ke saamne bhi parha jaae. Tum mere us patr ko parh lena, jo laaodikeiya shehar se aaega.
Aarkhippos se kahna, “Vah dhyaan rakhe ki jo sevkaai use Lord mein saumpi gai hai, vah use pura kare.”
Main, Paulos, apne hi haath se yah shubhkaamna likh raha hun. Main beriyon mein hun, mujhe prayer mein yaad rakhna. Tum par grace nirantar bana rahe.
Pita God aur Lord Yeshu mein thesslonikeyus shehar ki church ko yah patr Paulos, silvaanos aur timothiyos ki or se hai. Tumhein grace aur shaanti milti rahe.
Apni praarthnaaon mein tumhaara varnan karte hue ham hamesha tum sabhi ke lie God ka aabhaar maante hain.
Ham hamesha hi God, hamaare pita ke saamne tumhaare faith ke kaam, love ka parishram aur hamaare Lord Yeshu mein tumhaari drirh ummid ko yaad karte hain.
Jiska parinaam yah hua ki tum makedoniya aur aakhaaya pradesh mein sabhi believers ke lie ek aadarsh ban gae.

Tumhaare dvaara bheja gaya Lord ka sandesh na keval makedoniya aur aakhaaya pradesh mein sunaaya gaya aur barhta gaya lekin God mein tumhaara faith bhi sabko maalum ho gaya hai. Parinaamasvrup koi zarurat nahin rah gai ki is baare mein ab ham kuchh kahein,

Ve hi har jagah is baat ka varnan kar rahe hain ki tumhaare dvaara kiya gaya hamaara svaagat kaisa bhavy tha aur yah bhi ki kis tarah tum murtiyon se dur hokar God ki or jhuk gae ki jivit aur sachche God ki service karne lago
Dear bhaai bahno, tumhein yah ahsaas to hai hi ki tumse bheint karne ke lie hamaara aana vyarth nahin tha.
Hamaara updesh na to bharma denevaali teaching thi, na ashuddh purpose se apostle aur na hi chhalaava.
Yah to tumhein maalum hi hai ki na to hamaari baaton mein chaaplusi thi aur na hi hamne lobh se apostle ho kuchh kiya—God gavaah hain;
Hamne insaanon se sammaan paane ki bhi koshish nahin ki; na tumse aur na kisi aur se, Yeshu ke apostle hone ke kaaran tumse madad paana hamaara authority tha.
Tumhaare prati hamaara vyavhaar vaisa hi komal tha, jaisa ek shishu ka poshan karti maata ka, jo khud bari komaltaapurvak apne baalkon ka poshan karti hai.
Tum iske gavaah ho aur God bhi ki tum sabhi believers ke saath hamaara svabhaav kitna sachcha, righteous aur nirdosh tha.
Tumhein yah bhi maalum hai ki jaise pita apni nij children ke lie karta hai, usi tarah ham tummein se har ek ko
Protsaahit karte hue, saantvna aur prerna dete hue rahe, ki tumhaara svabhaav God ke yogy ho, jinhonne tumhein apne raajy aur glory mein bulaaya hai.

Yahi kaaran hai ki ham bhi God ke prati nirantar thanks reveal karte hain ki jis samay tumne hamse God ke vachan ke sandesh ko accept kiya, tumne ise kisi insaan ke sandesh ke taur par nahin lekin uski sach mein arthaat God hi ke vachan ke taur par grahan kiya, jo tummein, jinhonne faith kiya hai, kaary bhi kar raha hai.
Lekin, dear bhaai bahno, jab ham tumse thore samay ke lie alag hue the (shaaririk rup se, na ki spiritual rup se), tumhein saamne dekhne ki hamaari laalsa aur bhi adhik prabal ho gai thi.
Ham chaahte the ki aakar tumse bheint karein—visheshkar main, Paulos, to ek nahin, kai baar chaah raha tha lekin aarop lagaanevaala ne hamaare koshish nishphal kar die.
Haan, tumhin to hamaara gaurav aur khushi ho.
Isliye jab yah hamaare lie asahniy ho gaya, hamne athenon shehar mein hi ruke rahna sahi samjha.
Ki tummein se koi bhi in kleshon ke dvaara dagamga na jaae. Tumhein to yah achchhi tarah se maalum hai ki ham par in kleshon ka aana zarur hai.
Vastuth jab ham tumhaare yahaan the, ham pahle hi tumhein yah bataate rahe ki ham par kleshon ka aana nishchit hai aur tumhein to maalum hi hai ki hua bhi aisa hi.

Yahi kaaran hai ki jab yah mere lie asahniy ho gaya, mainne bhi is aashanka se ki kahin aarop lagaanevaala ne tumhein pariksha mein phansa na liya ho aur hamaara parishram vyarth na chala jaae, tumhaare faith ki situation maalum karne ka koshish kiya.

Lekin ab, jab timothiyos tumse bheint kar hamaare paas laut aaya hai, usne tumhaare faith aur love ke sambandh mein bahut hi utsaah barhaanevaale samaachaar die hain aur yah bhi ki tum hamein mithi yaadon ke taur par yaad karte hue hamse bheint karne ke lie utne hi laalaayit ho jitne khud ham tumhein dekhne ke lie laalaayit hain.
Dear bhaai bahno, yahi kaaran hai ki ham sankat aur klesh ki situation mein bhi tumhaare faith dvaara protsaahit hue.
Lord mein tumhaare sthir hone ka sandesh hamaare lie navjivan ka sanchaar hai.
God ke saamne tumhaare baare mein us bare khushi ke lie ham bhala God ke prati aur kis tarah ka thanks reveal kar sakte hain?
Jab ham raat-din ekchitt hokar prayer karte rahte hain ki ham tumhein saamne dekh sakein aur tumhaare faith mein jo kami hai, use pura kar sakein.
Khud hamaare God aur pita aur Yeshu hamaare Lord tum tak pahunchne mein hamaara maargdarshan karein
Aur Lord hi tumhein ek dusre ke prati hi nahin lekin sabke prati love mein barhaae aur unnat karein, thik vaise hi jaise ham tumse love karte hain

Antath dear bhaai bahno, tumne hamse apne svabhaav aur God ko prasann karne ke baare mein jis tarah ke nirdesh receive kie the—thik jaisa tumhaara svabhaav hai bhi—Lord Yeshu mein tumse hamaari request aur samjhaana hai ki tum inmein aur bhi adhik unnat hote chale jaao.
Tumhein ve aajnaaein maalum hi hain, jo hamne tumhein Lord Yeshu ki or se die the.
God ki will hai ki tum pavitrta ki situation mein raho—tum veshyaagaami se alag raho;
Ki tummein se har ek ko apne-apne body ko pavitrta aur sammaanpurvak sanymit rakhne ka knowledge ho,
Kaamukta ki abhilaasha mein anyjaatiyon ke jaisa nahin, jo God se anjaan hain;

Is baare mein koi bhi sima ullanghan kar apne saathi believer ka shoshan na kare kyonki in sab vishyon mein khud Lord badla lete hain, jaise hamne pahle hi yah spasht karte hue tumhein gambhir chetaavni bhi di thi.
God ne hamaara bulaava apvitrta ke lie nahin lekin holy hone ke lie kiya hai.
Parinaamasvrup vah, jo in nirdeshon ko nahin maanta hai, kisi insaan ko nahin lekin God hi ko asvikaar karta hai, jo apna Holy Spirit tumhein dete hain.
Bhaaichaare ke baare mein mujhe kuchh bhi likhne ki zarurat nahin kyonki khud God dvaara tumhein teaching di gai hai ki tummein aapas mein love ho.
Vastuth makedoniya pradesh ke believers ke prati tumhaari yahi chaahat hai. Dear bhaai bahno, hamaari tumse yahi request hai ki tum isi mein aur adhik barhte jaao,
Shaant lifestyle tumhaari bari chaahat ban jaae. Sirph apne hi kaary mein magan raho. Apne haathon se parishram karte raho, jaisa hamne tumhein command di hai,
Ki tumhaari lifestyle dusre logon ki nazar mein tumhein sammaanniy bana de aur khud tumhein kisi tarah ka abhaav na ho.
Isliye ham, baakiyon ke jaisa soe hue nahin lekin saavdhaan aur vyavasthit rahein.
Kyonki ve, jo sote hain, raat mein sote hain aur ve, jo matvaale hote hain, raat mein hi matvaale hote hain.
Ab isliye ki ham din ke bane hue hain, ham faith aur love ka kavach aur bachaav ki ummid ka top dhaaran kar vyavasthit ho jaaein.
Isliye tum, jaisa is samay kar hi rahe ho, ek dusre ko aapas mein protsaahit aur unnat karne mein lage raho.
Dear bhaai bahno, tumse hamaari request hai ki tum unki saraahna karo, jo tumhaare bich lagan se parishram kar rahe hain, jo Lord mein tumhaare lie zimmedaar hain aur tumhein teaching dete hain.
Unke parishram ko dhyaan mein rakhte hue unhein prempurvak uncha sammaan do. Aapas mein mel-milaap banaae rakho.
Dear bhaai bahno, ham tumse request karte hain ki jo bigre hue hain, unhein phatkaar lagaao; jo dare hue hain, unhein dhaadhas do, durblon ki madad karo aur sabhi ke saath dhirajvaan bane raho.
Yah dhyaan rakho ki koi bhi buraai ka badla buraai se na lene paae lekin hamesha vahi karne ka koshish karo, jismein paarasprik aur sabhi ka bhala ho.
Hamesha aanandit raho,
Prayer lagaataar ki jaae,
Har ek paristhiti mein thanks reveal kiya jaae; kyonki Yeshu mein tumse God ki yahi ummid hai.
Holy Spirit ko na bujhaao.
Bhavishyvaaniyon ko tuchchh na samjho
Lekin har ek ko saavdhaanipurvak baariki se jaancho aur use, jo achchha hai, thaame raho.
Buraai ka uske har ek taur par bahishkaar karo.
Sachche hain vah, jinhonne tumhein bulaaya hai. Vahi isko pura bhi kareinge.
Dear bhaai bahno, hamaare lie prayer karte rahna.
Holy chumban se ek dusre ko namaskaar karo.
Lord mein hamaari yah command hai ki yah patr sab bhaai bahnon ke saamne parha jaae.
Tum par hamaare Lord Yeshu ki grace bani rahe.
Thesslonikeyus shehar ki church ko, jo pita God aur Lord Yeshu mein hai, Paulos, silvaanos aur timothiyos ki or se:
Tummein pita God aur Lord Yeshu ka grace aur shaanti bani rahe.
Dear bhaai bahno, tumhaare barhte hue faith aur har ek mein aapsi love ke din-pratidin barhte jaane ke lie God ko hamaara lagaataar thanks sahi hi hai.

Isliye, God ki kalisiyaaon mein ham tumhaare dvaara sahe ja rahe utpirnon aur yaatnaaon ki situation mein bhi tumhaare dvaara ki ja rahi lagaataar koshishon aur faith ka varnan bahut garv ke saath karte hain.

Is baat ke prakaash mein ham tumhaare lie hamesha prayer karte hain ki tum hamaare God ke mat mein apni bulaave ke anurup paae jaao aur tum uttam purpose ki har ek abhilaasha aur faith ke har ek kaam ko power se pura karte jaao,
Ki hamaare God aur Lord Yeshu ki grace ke hisaab se tummein hamaare Lord Yeshu ki aur unmein tumhaari glory ho.
Ant mein, dear bhaai bahno, hamaare lie prayer karo ki Lord ka sandesh tej gati se har jagah phailta jaae aur use glory receive ho, thik jaisi tumhaare bich.
Aur yah bhi ki ham terhe manvaale logon aur evil insaanon se surakshit rahein kyonki faith ka vardaan sabhi ne receive nahin kiya hai.
Lekin Lord faithful hain. Vahi tumhein sthir kareinge aur us evil se tumhaari raksha kareinge.
Lord tumhaare dilon ko God ke love aur Yeshu ke sabr ki or aguvaai karein.
Itna hi nahin, hamne kisi ke yahaan daam chukaae bina khaana nahin kiya lekin hamne din-raat parishram kiya aur kaam karte rahe ki ham tummein se kisi ke lie bhi bojh na banein.
Yahaan tak ki jab ham tumhaare bich mein the, ham tumhein yah command diya karte the: “Kisi aalsi ko khaana na diya jaae.”
Sunne mein yah aaya hai ki tummein se kuchh ki lifestyle aalas bhari ho gai hai. Ve koi bhi kaam nahin kar rahe; vastuth ve anyon ke lie baadha ban gae hain.
Aise logon ke lie Lord Yeshu mein hamaari request bhari command hai ki ve gambhirta purvak kaam par lag jaaein aur ve apne hi parishram se kamaaya hua khaana karein.
Lekin, dear bhaai bahno, tum khud vah karne mein pichhe na hatna, jo sahi aur bhala hai.
Itna sab hone par bhi use dushman na maano lekin ek bhaai samajhkar use samjhaao.
Shaanti ke God khud tumhein har ek paristhiti mein nirantar shaanti provide karte rahein. Lord tum sabke saath hon.
Main, Paulos, apne haathon se namaskaar likh raha hun. Mere har ek patr ka pahchaan chihn yahi hai. Yahi mere likhne ka tarika hai.
Hamaare Lord Yeshu ka grace tum sab par bana rahe.
Faith mein mere vaastvik son timothiyos ko: pita God aur hamaare Lord Yeshu ki or se grace, grace aur shaanti.
Mainne makedoniya pradesh jaate samay tumse request ki thi ki, tum ifesos shehar mein hi rah jaao aur kuchh bataae hue logon ko chetaavni do ki ve na to bharmaanevaali teaching dein
Aur na puraani kahaaniyon aur anthin vanshaavliyon mein lin rahein. Inse faith par aadhaarit God ki yojna ke unnat hone ki bajaay matbhed utpann hota hai.
Hamaari command ka purpose hai nirmal dil se utpann love, shuddh antraatma aur nishkpat faith.
Kuchh hain, jo raaste se bhatak kar vyarth ke vaad-vivaad mein phans gae hain.
Ve law ke shikshak banne ki abhilaasha to karte hain lekin ve jo kahte hain aur jin vishyon ka ve drirh vishvaaspurvak daava karte hain, khud hi unhein nahin samajhte.
Hamein yah maalum hai ki law bhali hai—yadi iska prayog uchit riti se kiya jaae.
Vah blessed God ke gaurvaanvit ishvriy good news ke hisaab se hai, jo mujhe saumpi gai hai.
Main hamaare Lord Yeshu ke prati, jinhonne mujhe power provide kiya hai, thanks karta hun ki unhonne mujhe faithful samjha aur apni service mein chuna.
Haalaanki pahle main God ki ninda karnevaala tha, atyaachaari aur adharmi tha lekin mujh par grace ki gai kyonki apni ajnaanta mein unmein unbelief ke kaaran mainne yah sab kiya tha.
Yeshu mein hamaare Lord ka bahut adhik grace faith aur love ke saath mujh par hua.
Sanaatan raaja, avinaashi, andekhe aur ekmaatr God ka aadar aur glory hamesha-hamesha hoti rahe, aamen.
Mere son, timothiyos, main tumhein yah command tumhaare baare mein pahle se ki gai bhavishyvaaniyon ke hisaab se saump raha hun ki unki prerna se tum nirantar sangharsh kar sako,
Aur faith aur achchhe vivek ko thaame rakho, kuchh ne jiski upeksha ki aur apne faith ka sarvnaash kar baithe.
Isliye sabse pahli request yah hai ki sabhi ke lie request, praarthnaaein, dusron ke lie praarthnaaein aur thanks prastut kie jaaein,
Raajaaon aur adhikaariyon ke lie ki hamaara life sammaan aur God ki bhakti mein shaanti aur chain se ho.
God ek hi hain aur God aur insaanon ke madhyasth bhi ek hi hain—dehdhaari Yeshu,
Main chaahta hun ki har jagah sabhaaon mein aadmi, bina krodh aur vivaad ke, God ko samarpit haathon ko upar uthaakar prayer kiya karein.
Isi tarah auraton ka sanvaarna samay ke hisaab se ho—shaalinta bhara aur vivekshil—sirph baal-sajaane aur svarn, motiyon ya kimti kapdon se nahin,
Lekin achchhe kaamon se, jo God bhakt auraton ke lie uchit hai.
Yah baat faithful hai: yadi kisi person mein adhyaksh pad ki chaahat hai, yah ek uttam kaam ki abhilaasha hai.
Isliye zaruri hai ki adhyaksh prashansniy, ek patni ka pati, sanymi, viveki, sammaan yogy, atithi-satkaar karnevaala aur nipun shikshak ho,
Vah pinevaala, jhagraalu, adhir, vivaadi aur paise ka laalchi na ho.
Vah apne parivaar ka uttam prabandhak ho. Children par uska garima se bhara anushaasan ho.
(yadi koi person apne parivaar ka hi prabandh karna nahin jaanta to bhala vah God ki church ki dekhrekh kis tarah kar paaega?)
Vah naya disciple na ho ki vah ahankaarvash aarop lagaanevaala ke jaisa dand ka bhaagi na ho jaae.
Yah bhi zaruri hai ki church ke baahar bhi vah sammaan yogy ho ki vah badnaami aur aarop lagaanevaala ke jaal mein na par jaae.
Isi tarah zaruri hai ki dikan bhi gambhir aur nishkpat hon. Madira paan mein uski ruchi nahin honi chaahie, na nich kamaai ke laalchi.
Ve nirmal man mein faith ka bhed surakshit rakhein.
Parkhe jaane ke baad prashansniy paae jaane par hi unhein dikan pad par chuna jaae.
Isi tarah, unki patni bhi gambhir hon, na ki galat baatein karne mein lin rahnevaali—ve har ek kshetr mein vyavasthit aur faithful hon.
Dikan ek patni ka pati ho aur apni children aur parivaar ke achchhe prabandh karnevaale hon.
Jinhonne dikan ke taur par achchhi service ki hai, unhonne apne lie achchha jagah bana liya hai aur Yeshu mein apne faith ke baare mein unhein drirh nishchay hai.
Tumhaare paas shighr aane ki ummid karte hue bhi main tumhein yah sab likh raha hun,
Ki yadi mere aane mein deri ho hi jaae to bhi tumhein iska ahsaas ho ki God ke parivaar mein, jo jivit God ki church aur sach ka stambh va ninv hai, kis tarah ka svabhaav karna chaahie.
Holy Spirit ka spasht kathan yah hai ki ant ke samay mein kuchh person faith ka tyaag kar deinge aur ve dhurt aatmaaon aur dard denevaali aatmaaon ki teachings par man lagaaeinge.
Yah un jhuthe insaanon ke dikhaave ki teachings ke kaaran hoga, jinke vivek mein maano jalte hue lohe se muhar laga di gai hon.

Ye ve hain, jo vivaah karne se rokte hain, khaana padaarthon ko bhi tyaagne ki maang karte hain, jinhein God ne believers aur sach ko jaanne vaale logon ki bhalaai ke lie isliye banaaya hai ki thanks ke saath miljul kar khaaya jaaein.
God ki banaai hui har ek vastu achchhi hai, koi bhi vastu asvikaar karne yogy nahin—yadi use thanks ke saath accept kiya jaaein,
Kyonki vah God ke vachan aur prayer dvaara shuddh ki jaati hai.

Believer bhaai bahnon ko in baaton ka ahsaas karaane ke dvaara tum khud ko Yeshu ka aadarsh servant saabit karoge, jiska poshan nirantar faith ke vachan aur achchhe updeshon ki baaton ke dvaara hota hai, jiska tum follow karte aae ho.
Saansaarik aur kaalpnik kathaaon se dur raho, iske viprit tum apne aapko God ki bhakti ke lie anushaasit kar lo.
Shaaririk vyaayaam sirph thore laabh ka hai jabki God bhakti ka laabh sab baaton mein hai kyonki vah life ka aashvaasan deti hai—is samay aur aanevaale life, donon ka.
Yah baat sach hai, jo har tarah se maanne yogy hai:
Tumhaare orders aur teachings ke vishay ye hi hon.
Tulna mein kam aayu ke kaaran koi tumhein tuchchh na samjhe lekin baatchit, svabhaav, love, faith aur pavitrta mein Yeshu ke believers ka aadarsh bano.
Mere vahaan pahunchne tak Scripture ke saarvajnik riti se parhne, updesh aur teaching paane mein lin raho.
Andar base hue Holy Spirit dvaara di gai kshamta ki upeksha na karo, jo tumhein bhavishyvaani ke dvaara us samay provide ki gai, jab church ke purniyon ne tum par haath rakhe.
In nirdeshon par vishesh dhyaan do, inmein lin ho jaao ki tumhaari unnti sab par reveal ho jaae.
Apne life aur teaching ka puri power se dhyaan rakho. Ismein lagaataar chaukas raho kyonki tum aisa karne ke dvaara donon ka bachaav nishchit karoge—khud apna aur apne sunnevaalon ka.
Apne se adhik umr ke person ko apmaan ke bhaav se na daanto lekin use pita maankar usse request karo. Apne se kam umr ke person ko bhaai,
Adhik umr ki auraton ko maata aur kam umr ki auraton ko nirmal bhaav se bahan maano.
Asmarth vidhvaaon ka sammaan karo.

Lekin yadi kisi vidhva ke son-pautr hon to ve sabse pahle apne hi parivaar ke prati apne kartavy-follow dvaara God ke bhakt hona sikhein aur apne maata-pita ke upkaaron ka phal dein kyonki God ko yahi bhaata hai.
Vah, jo vaastav mein vidhva hai aur jo akeli rah gai hai, God par hi aashrit rahti hai aur din-raat God se request aur prayer karne mein lavlin rahti hai.
Par vah vidhva, jiski lifestyle nirlajjta bhari hai, jite ji mari hui hai.
Tum unhein upar bataae gae nirdesh bhi do ki ve nirdosh rahein.
Usi vidhva ka panjikran karo jiski aayu saath varsh se adhik ho aur jiska ek hi pati raha ho;

Jo apne bhale kaamon ke lie sunaam ho; jisne apni children ka uttam follow poshan kiya ho; aatithy satkaar kiya ho; holy logon ke charan dhoe hon; din-duhkhiyon ki madad ki ho aur sab tarah ke bhale kaamon mein lin rahi ho.
Tulna mein kam aayu ki vidhvaaon ke naam na likhna kyonki kaam-vaasna prabal hone par ve Yeshu se dur ho dusre vivaah ki kaamna karne lageingi.
Justice-dand hi unki niyti hogi kyonki unhonne panjikran se sambandhit apni purv shapath tor di hai.

Iske alaava ve aalsi rahne lagti hain aur ghar-ghar ghuma karti hain. Ve na keval aalsi rahti hain lekin baakiyon ke kaamon mein hastakshep karti aur dusron ki buraai mein khushi leti hain, aur ve baatein bolti hai, jo unhein nahin bolni chaahiye.
Isliye main chaahta hun ki kam aayu ki vidhvaaein vivaah karein, children paida karein, grihasthi sambhaalein aur virodhiyon ko ninda ka koi avsar na dein.
Kuchh hain, jo pahle hi murkar aarop lagaanevaala ki disciple ban chuki hain.
Yadi kisi believer parivaar mein aashrit vidhvaaein hain to vahi uski madad kare ki uska bojh church par na pare, ki church aison ki madad kar sake, jo vaastav mein asmarth hain.
Scripture ka lekh hai, “Daanvni karte bail ke chehra ko mukhbandhni na baandhna,” Aur “Mazdur apne mazduri ka hakdaar hai.”
Kisi bhi church-praachin ke khilaaf do ya tin gavaahon ke bina koi bhi aarop accept na karo.
Main God, Yeshu aur chune hue angels ke saamne tumhein yah zimmedaari saumpta hun ki bina kisi pakshpaat ke in orders ka follow karo. Pakshpaat ke bhaav mein kuchh bhi na kiya jaae.
Ab se sirph paani hi tumhaara pey na rahe lekin apne udar aur baar-baar ho rahe rogon ke kaaran thori maatra mein daakhras ka sevan bhi karte rahna.
Isi tarah achchhe kaam bhi reveal hain aur jo nahin hain, ve chhipaae nahin ja sakte.
Yadi koi isse alag teaching deta hai aur hamaare Lord Yeshu ke yathaarth sandesh aur God ki bhakti ki teaching se sahmat nahin hota,
Vah abhimaani hai, ajnaani hai aur use bina matlab ke vaad-vivaad va words ke yuddh ka rog hai, jiske parinaamasvrup jalan, jhagre, dusron ki buraai, bure sandeh
Aur bigri hui samajh aur sach se alag logon mein vyarth jhagre utpann ho jaate hai. Ye ve hain, jo God ki bhakti ko kamaai ka saadhan samajhte hain.
Lekin santosh bhari God ki bhakti khud mein ek adbhut wealth hai
Kyonki ham is duniya mein kuchh bhi lekar nahin aae hain, isliye ham yahaan se kuchh le ja bhi na sakeinge.
Ham isi mein santusht raheinge ki hamaare paas khaana aur kapde hain.
Jo dhani banne ke abhilaashi hain, ve pariksha, phandein aur kai murkhta bhare va haanikaarak laalsaaon mein par jaate hain, jo unhein patan aur vinaash ke gart mein le dubaati hain.
Wealth ka laalach har ek tarah ki buraai ki jar hai. Kuchh isi laalach mein faith se bhatak gae aur ismein unhonne khud ko kai duhkhon se chhalni kar liya hai.
Lekin tum, jo God ke servant ho, in sabse dur bhaago aur sach, God bhakti, faith, love, sabr aur vinamrta ka pichha karo.
Jo thik samay par God ke dvaara pura hoga—God, jo blessed va ekmaatr adhipti, raajaaon ke raaja aur prabhuon ke Lord hain,
Sirph vahi amarty hain, jinka vaas apaar roshni mein hai. Jinhein kisi ne na to kabhi dekha hai aur na hi dekh sakta hai. Unki glory aur prabhuta nirantar rahe. Aamen.
Duniya ke dhanvaanon ko order do ki ve ghamand na karein aur apni ummid naashmaan wealth par nahin, lekin God par rakhein, jo hamaare upbhog ki har ek vastu bahutaayat mein dete hain.
Unhein bhale kaam karne, achchhe kaamon ka dhani ho jaane aur daan denevaale va udaar banne ki command do.
Is tarah ve is wealth ka kharch apne aanevaale life ki ninv ke lie kareinge ki ve us life ko, jo vaastvik hai, thaame rah sakein.
Jise accept kar kai apne mul faith se bhatak gae. Tum par grace hota rahe.
Paulos ki or se, jo Yeshu mein us life ki promise ke hisaab se, God ki will ke dvaara Yeshu ka apostle hai,
Dear son timothiyos ko: hamaare pita God aur Yeshu, hamaare Lord ki or se grace, grace aur shaanti mile.
Main raat-din apni praarthnaaon mein tumhein yaad karte hue God ko thanks deta hun, jinki service main shuddh vivek se usi tarah karta hun, jaise mere purvaj karte the.
Tumhaare aansuon ko yaad karte hue, mujhe tumse milne ki laalsa hoti hai ki mera khushi pura ho jaae.
Mujhe tumhaara nishkpat faith yaad aata hai, jo sabse pahle tumhaari naani lois aur tumhaari maata yunike mein maujud tha, aur jo nishchit hi tummein bhi maujud hai.
Yahi kaaran hai ki main tumhein yaad dila raha hun ki God dvaara di gai us kshamta ko punar-jvalit karo, jo tum par mere haath rakhne ke dvaara tummein thi.
Yah isliye ki God ne hamein dar ka nahin lekin power, love aur aatm-anushaasan ka man diya hai.

God ne hi hamein bachaav provide kiya aur holy life ke lie hamein bulaaya hai—hamaare kaamon ke aadhaar par nahin lekin sanaatan kaal se Yeshu mein hamaare lie aarakshit apne hi purpose aur grace ke antargat.

Yahi kaaran hai ki main ye yaatnaaein bhi sah raha hun lekin yah mere lie lajjaaspad nahin hai kyonki main jaanta hun ki mainne kin mein faith kiya hai aur mujhe yah pura nishchay hai ki vah us din tak meri dharohar ki raksha karne mein puri tarah saamarthyi hain.
Holy Spirit ke dvaara, jinka hamaare bhitar vaas hai, us anupam dharohar ki raksha karo.
Tumhein yah maalum hi hai ki aasiya pradesh ke sabhi believer mujhse dur ho gae hain, unmein figelas aur harmogenes bhi hain.
Onesiforas ke parivaar par Lord grace karein. Usne aksar mujhmein nai sphurti ka sanchaar kiya hai. Meri beriyaan uske lie lajja ka vishay nahin thi.
Jab vah rom shehar mein tha, usne yatnpurvak mujhe khoja aur mujhse bheint ki.
Ifesos shehar mein ki gai uski sevaaon se tum bhali-bhaanti parichit ho. Lord karein ki us din use Lord ki grace receive ho!
Isliye, he son, Yeshu mein receive hue grace mein balvaan ho jaao.
Un teachings ko, jo tumne anekon gavaahon ki upasthiti mein mujhse receive ki hain, aise faithful logon ko saump do, jinmein baakiyon ko bhi teaching dene ki kshamta hai.
Koi bhi yoddha ranbhumi mein dainik life ke jhanjhton mein nahin parta ki vah yoddha ke taur par apne bharti karnevaale ko santusht kar sake.
Isi tarah yadi koi akhaare ki pratiyogita mein bhaag leta hai lekin niyam ke hisaab se pradarshan nahin karta, vijay padak receive nahin karta.
Yah sahi hi hai ki parishrmi kisaan upaj se apna hissa sabse pahle receive kare.
Meri teachings par soch karo. Lord tumhein sab vishyon mein samajh provide kareinge.
Usi ishvriy good news ke lie main kasht sah raha hun, yahaan tak ki main apraadhi jaisa beriyon mein jakra gaya hun—lekin God ka vachan kaid nahin kiya ja saka.
Ham chaahe sach par chalna tyaag dein, to bhi vah faithful rahte hain, kyonki vah apne svabhaav ke khilaaf nahin ja sakte.

Unhein in vishyon ki yaad dilaate raho. God ki upasthiti mein unhein chetaavni do ki ve words par vaad-vivaad na kiya karein. Isse kisi ka koi laabh nahin hota lekin isse sunnevaalon ka vinaash hi hota hai.
Saty ke vachan ko thik riti se kaam mein laate hue God ke aise grahan yogy servant banne ka pura koshish karo, jise lajjit na hona pare.
Saansaarik aur vyarth ki baatchit se dur raho, nahin to saansaarikta barhti hi jaaegi.
Aur is tarah ki teaching sare ghaav ki tarah phail jaaegi. Hyumaineos aur filetos isi ke samarthkon mein se hain,
Isliye jo person khud ko is tarah ki gandgi se saaf kar leta hai, use achchha, alag kiya hua, maalik ke lie upyogi aur har ek bhale kaam ke lie taiyaar kiya hua bartan maana jaaega.
Javaani ki abhilaashaaon se dur bhaago aur unki sangti mein righteousness, faith, love aur shaanti ka svabhaav karo, jo nirmal dil se Lord ko pukaarte hain
Murkhta aur ajnaantaapurn vivaadon se dur raho; yah jaante hue ki inse jhagra utpann hota hai.
Lord ke slave ka jhagraalu hona sahi nahin hai. Vah sabke saath kind, nipun shikshak, anyaay ki situation mein patient ho,
Jo virodhiyon ko namrtaapurvak is sambhaavna ki ummid mein samjhaae ki kya jaane God unhein saty ke knowledge ki praapti ke lie pashchaataap ki or bhejein.
Ve sachet ho jaaein aur aarop lagaanevaala ke us phande se chhut jaaein jismein usne unhein apni chaahat puri karne ke lie jakar rakha hai.
Insaan svaarthi, laalchi, dingmaar, ahankaari, God ki ninda karnevaala, maata-pita ki command taalnevaala, dayaarhit, apvitr,
Nirmam, maafi rahit, dusron ki buraai karnevaala, asanymi, kathor, bhale ka bairi,
Vishvaasghaati, dhith, ghamandi aur God bhakt nahin lekin sukh-vilaas ke chaahnevaale honge.
Ve sikhne ka koshish to karti hain lekin sach ke saare knowledge tak pahunch hi nahin paatin.
Jis tarah yaannes aur yaambres ne Moshe ka virodh kiya tha, usi tarah ye bhrasht samajh ke person sach ka virodh karte hain. Banaavti hai inka faith.
Yah sab adhik samay tak nahin chalega kyonki un donon ke jaisa unki murkhta sabke saamne prakaash mein a jaaegi.
Tumne meri teaching, svabhaav, purpose, faith, sataae jaane ke samay, love aur sabr aur sahanshilta ka bhali-bhaanti anusran kiya hai
Aur tumhein maalum hai ki antiyokh, ikoniyon aur lustra shehron mein mujh par kaise-kaise atyaachaar hue, phir bhi un sabhi mein se Lord ne mujhe nikaala hai.
Yah sach hai ki ve sabhi, jo Yeshu mein sach ka life jine ka nishchay karte hain, sataae hi jaaeinge,
Lekin evil aur bahkaanevaale chhal karte aur khud chhale jaate hue lagaataar vinaash ke gaddhe mein girte jaaeinge.
Lekin tum khud un teachings mein, jo tumne receive ki aur jinkein baare mein tum aashvast ho chuke ho, sthir raho, yah yaad rakhte hue ki kinhonne tumhein ye shikshaaein di hain,
Yah bhi ki bachpan se tum holy abhilekhon se parichit ho, jo tumhein vah buddhimta dene mein samarth hain, jisse Yeshu mein faith ke dvaara bachaav receive hota hai.
Sampurn Scripture God ki prerna se racha gaya hai. Yah teaching dene, galat dhaarnaaon ka virodh karne, dosh-sudhaar aur righteousness ki teaching ke lie sahi hai,
Ki God ka jan puri tarah se har ek achchhe kaary ke lie susajjit paaya jaae.
Ek or to ve sach se kaan pher leinge aur dusri or kahaaniyon par dhyaan lagaaeinge
Main argh (pey-yajn) ke jaisa undela ja chuka hun, mere jaane ka samay a chuka hai.
Mera sangharsh saarthak raha hai. Mainne apni daur puri kar li hai. Mainne dridhtaapurvak faith ko thaame rakha hai.
Tum jald se jald mere paas aane ka pura koshish karo
Kyonki demaas ne aadhunik yug ke aakarshan mein mujhe tyaag kar thesslonikeyus shehar jaana sahi samjha hai. Kreskes galaatiya shehar aur titos daalamtiya shehar gae hue hain.
Keval lukos mere saath hain. Aate hue maarkaas ko apne saath le aana kyonki vah sevkaai mein mere lie upyogi hai.
Mainne tukhikas ko ifesos shehar bhej diya hai.
Vah angarkha, jo main troos shehar mein kaarpus ke paas chhor aaya tha, saath lete aana, saath hi ve granth bhi, visheshath charmpatr.
Aleksaandros thathere ne meri bari haani ki hai. Lord use uske kaamon ke hisaab se pratiphal provide karein.
Tum khud bhi usse saavdhaan raho kyonki usne hamaari teaching ka kara virodh kiya tha.
Meri pahli sunvaai ke samay koi mere saath nahin tha—sabne mujhe tyaag diya; iske lie unhein doshi na maana jaae.
Lord mujhe har ek buraai se ubaareinge aur apne svargiy raajy mein surakshit le jaaeinge. Unki glory yugaanuyug ho. Aamen.
Priska va akulos ko aur onesiforas ke parivaar ko mera namaskaar.
Iraastus ab tak korinthos shehar mein hi hai lekin trofimas ki bimaari ke kaaran use miletos shehar mein chhorna para.
Jaare ke pahle hi aane ka pura koshish karna. Tumhein yubulas ka namaskaar, saath hi pudens, linos, klaudia aur sabhi believer bhaai bahnon ko bhi namaskaar.
Lord tumhaari aatma ke saath hon. Tum par grace bana rahe.
Faith ki sahbhaagita mein mere sachche son titos ko God ke slave aur Yeshu ke apostle Paulos ki or se, jinhein God ke chune huon ke faith aur unke saty ke knowledge ke lie,
Mainne tumhein krete dvip mein isliye chhora tha ki tum vahaan bache hue kaam ki puri law karo aur har ek shehar mein mere anudeshaanusaar aise church-purniyon ki niyukti karo,
Jo nirdosh aur ek patni ke pati hon, jinki children believer ho aur jin par kaamukta aur nirankushta ka aarop na ho.
God dvaara chune hue prabandhak ke taur par bhandaari ka nirdosh hona zaruri hai, na ki hathi, krodhi, madira pinevaala, jhagraalu ya laalchi.
Vah atithi-satkaar karnevaala, sab tarah ki uchit baaton ka samarthak, vivekshil, nyaayi, holy aur aisa ho jisne apni indriyon ko apne vash mein kar liya ho.
Vah us vishvasniy sandesh par sthir rahe, jo siddhaant teaching ke anukul hai ki vah khari teaching ka updesh kar iske virodhiyon ka munh band kar sake.
Inka chehra band karna atyaavashyak hai kyonki ye nich kamaai ke laabh ke lie galat teaching dekar ghar ke ghar ujaar rahe hain.
Unhin mein se ek ne, jo unka apna tathaakthit prophet hai, kaha hai, “Kretevaasi hamesha hi jhuthe, evil pashu aur aalsi petu rahe hain.”
Yah ghoshna sach hai. Isliye unhein kari phatkaar lagaana, ki ve faith mein sthir bane rahein
Aur Yahudiyon ki kaalpnik kahaaniyon aur sach se dur ho gae logon ke orders ki or dhyaan na dein.
Ve God ko jaanne ka daava to zarur karte hain lekin unke kaam ise galat saabit karte hain. Ve ghrinit, avajnaakaari aur kisi bhi bhale kaam ke yogy nahin hain.
Lekin tumhaare lie sahi yah hai ki tum aisi teaching do, jo khare updesh ke hisaab se hai.
Buzurg aadmi sanymi, sammaaniy, vivekshil aur faith, love va sabr mein atal hon.
Isi tarah buzurg striyaan bhi sammaaniy hon. Ve na to dusron ki buraai karnevaali hon aur na madira pine vaali hon, lekin ve achchhi baaton ki sikhaanevaali hon
Ki ve yuvtiyon ko apostle karein ki ve apne pati aur apni children se love karein,
Aur ve vivekshil, holy, sughar grihni va sushil hon aur apne-apne pati ke adhin rahein, jisse God ke vachan ki ninda na ho.
Yuvkon ko vivekshil hone ke lie protsaahit karo.
Har ek kshetr mein tum bhale kaamon mein aadarsh maane jaao. Sahi teaching sach aur gambhirta mein di jaae.
Tumhaari baatchit ke baare mein koi buraai na kar sake ki tumhaare virodhi lajjit ho jaaein aur unke saamne hamaare virodh mein kuchh bhi kahne ka vishay na rahe.
Saari maanav jaati ke bachaav ke lie God ka grace reveal hua hai,
Jiski hamaare lie teaching hai ki ham “Galat” Kaamon aur saansaarik abhilaashaaon ka tyaag kar is yug mein sanyam, righteousness aur God bhakti ka life jie,
Adhikaarpurvak in sab vishyon ki teaching dete hue logon ko samjhaao aur protsaahit karo. Ismein koi bhi tumhein tuchchh na jaane.
Kisi ki buraai na karein, jhagraalu nahin, komal svabhaav ke hon aur sabke saath vinamr rahein.
Kabhi ham bhi nirbuddhi, command na maannevaale, galat, bhinn-bhinn tarah ke sukh-vilaas ke slave the; bairbhaav, jalan aur nafrat ke paatr ke taur par ek dusre ke prati nafrat mein ji rahe the.

To unhonne hamein bachaav provide kiya—un kaamon ke aadhaar par nahin jo hamne righteousness mein kie hain lekin apni hi grace ke hisaab se nae janm ke snaan aur Holy Spirit ke navikran ki nishpatti mein

Ye baat faith karne yogy hain. Aur main chaahta hun ki tum in vishyon ko nidarta se sikhaao ki jinhonne God mein faith kiya hai, unke man un kaamon par keindrit ho jaaein, jo sabke lie aadarsh aur laabhdaayak hain.
Jab main aartemaas ya tukhikas ko tumhaare paas bhejun to jald se jald mujhse nikopolis shehar mein bheint karne ka koshish karna. Mainne jaara vahaan bitaane ka nirnay liya hai.
Apollos aur vidhi-visheshajn zenos ki yaatra mein har tarah se madad karna ki unhein kisi tarah ki kami na ho.
Saathi believer achchhe kaamon mein jut jaana sikhein ki roz ki zarurtein puri hon aur ve nishphal na ho jaaein.
Unki or se, jo mere saath hain namaskaar. Aur jo faith ke kaaran hamse love karte hain, unko namaskaar. Tum sab par grace bana rahe.
Yeshu ke lie bandi Paulos aur hamaare bhaai timothiyos ki or se, hamaare dear sahkarmi filemon,
Hamaari bahan aapfiya, hamaare saathi yoddha aarkhippos aur church ko, jo tumhaare ghar mein ikattha hoti hai:
Hamaare pita God aur Lord Yeshu ka grace va shaanti receive ho.
Apni praarthnaaon mein tumhein yaad karte hue main hamesha apne God ka thanks karta hun,
Kyonki main Lord Yeshu aur sabhi holy logon ke prati tumhaare love aur faith ke baare mein suna karta hun.
Meri prayer hai ki tumhaare faith ka sahbhaagi hona har ek vardaan ke spasht ahsaas ke dvaara, jo tummein Yeshu ke lie hai, prabhaavshaali ho.
Dear bhaai bahno, tumhaari love bhaavna se mujhe bahut khushi va protsaahan mila hai kyonki tumhaare kaaran holy logon ke man aanandit hue hain.
Yadypi mujhe Yeshu mein tumhein yah command dene ka authority hai ki tumhaara kya karna sahi hai,
Main, Yeshu ke lie bandi burha Paulos, premvash tumse is samay sirf request kar raha hun.
Meri request mere son onesimos ke sambandh mein hai, jo kaaraavaas mein mera spiritual son ban gaya hai,
Jo isse pahle tumhaare lie kisi kaam ka na tha lekin ab tumhaare aur mere, donon ke lie bare kaam ka ho gaya hai.
Use, jo ab mere dil ka tukra hai, main tumhaare paas vaapas bhej raha hun.
Haalaanki main chaahta tha ki use apne paas hi rakhun ki vah tumhaara jagah lekar ishvriy good news ke lie mujh bandi ki service kare.
Lekin mainne tumhaari salaah ke bina kuchh bhi karna uchit na samjha ki tumhaari udaarta majburivash nahin lekin apni chaahat se ho.
Kyonki vah tumse kuchh samay ke lie isi kaaran alag hua ki tum use hamesha ke lie receive kar lo.

Slave ke taur par nahin lekin slave se unche ek dear bhaai ke taur par, visheshkar mere lie. Vah mujhe to bahut dear hai hi lekin mujhse barhkar tumhein donon hi rupon mein—person ke taur par aur Lord mein bhaai ke taur par.
Isliye yadi tum mujhe apna sahbhaagi samajhte ho to meri request hai ki tum use aise apna lo jaise tumne mujhe apnaaya tha.
Yadi usne kisi bhi tarah se tumhaari koi haani ki hai ya us par tumhaara koi karz hai to use mere naam likh dena.
Main, Paulos, apne haath se yah likh raha hun ki main vah karz chuka dunga—mujhe tumhein yah yaad dilaana zaruri nahin ki tumhaara saara life mera karzdaar hai.
Dear bhaai bahno, meri kaamna hai ki Lord mein mujhe tumse yah madad receive ho aur mera man Yeshu mein aanandit ho jaae.
Tumhaare aajnaakaari hone par bharosa karke, main tumhein yah likh raha hun kyonki main jaanta hun ki tum mere kahe se kahin adhik karoge.
Iske saath hi, mere ghar ka bhi prabandh karo kyonki mujhe ummid hai ki tumhaari praarthnaaon ke uttar mein main God dvaara tumhein dobaara lauta diya jaaunga.
Yeshu mein mera saathi bandi epaafraas.
Aur mere sahkarmi maarkaas, aaristaarkhos, demaas aur lukos tumhein namaskaar karte hain.
Lord Yeshu ka grace tumhaari aatma ke saath rahe.
Purv mein God ne bhavishyadvaktaaon ke maadhyam se hamaare purvjon se kai samay khandon mein vibhinn tarah se baatein ki,
Lekin son ke baare mein: “He God, aapka sinhaasan anashvar hai; aapke raajy ka raajdand vahi hoga, jo sach ka raajdand hai.
Righteousness aapko dear hai aur dushtta ghrinaaspad; yahi kaaran hai ki God, aapke God ne harsh ke tel se aapko abhishikt karke aapke sab saathiyon se unche jagah par basa diya hai.
Aur, “Lord! Aapne shuruaat mein hi prithvi ki ninv rakhi, aur aakaashmandal aapke hi haathon ki kaarigri hai.
Ve to barbaad ho jaaeinge lekin aap astitv mein hi raheinge. Ve sabhi kapde jaisa puraane ho jaaeinge.
Aap unhein kapdon ke hi jaisa parivartit kar deinge. Unka astitv samaapt ho jaaega. Par aap na badalnevaale hain, aapke samay ka koi ant nahin.”
Isliye zaruri hai ki hamne jo suna hai, us par vishesh dhyaan dein. Aisa na ho ki ham usse dur chale jaaein.

Tab bhala ham itne uttam bachaav ki upeksha karke aanevaale dand se kaise bach sakeinge, jiska varnan sabse pahle khud Lord dvaara kiya gaya, iske baad jiski pushti hamaare lie unke dvaara ki gai, jinhonne ise suna?
Unke alaava God ne chihnon, chamatkaaron aur vibhinn adbhut kaamon ke dvaara aur apni ichchhaanusaar di gai Holy Spirit ki kshamtaaon dvaara bhi iski pushti ki hai.
Kisi ne ise is tarah spasht kiya hai: “Insaan hai hi kya, ki aap usko yaad karein ya insaan ki children, jiska aap dhyaan rakhein?

Aapne sabhi vastuein uske adhin kar din.” Saari srishti ko unke adhin karte hue God ne aisa kuchh bhi na chhora, jo unke adhin na kiya gaya ho; lekin sach yah hai ki ab tak ham sabhi vastuon ko unke adhin nahin dekh pa rahe.
Yah sahi hi tha ki God, jinke lie aur jinke dvaara har ek vastu ka astitv hai, kai santaanon ko glory mein pravesh karaane ke dvaara unke uddhaarkarta ko duhkh uthaane ke dvaara siddh banaaein.
Jo holy karte hain aur ve sabhi, jo holy kie ja rahe hain, donon ek hi pita ki children hain. Yahi kaaran hai ki vah unhein bhaai kahte hue lajjit nahin hote.
Vah kahte hain, “Main apne bhaai bahnon ke saamne aapke naam ki ghoshna karunga, sabha ke saamne main aapki vandna gaaunga.”
Aur dobaara, “Main unmein bharosa karunga.” Aur dobaara, “Main aur ve, jinhein children ke taur par God ne mujhe saumpa hai, yahaan hain.”
Isliye ki children lahu aur maans ki hoti hai, Yeshu bhi lahu aur maans ke ho gae ki maut ke dvaara vah use arthaat aarop lagaanevaala ko, jismein maut ka power tha, balhin kar dein
Aur vah un sabhi ko svatantr kar dein, jo maut ke dar ke kaaran life bhar daasatv ke adhin hokar rah gae the.
Khud unhonne apni parakh ke avsar par duhkh uthaaya, isliye vah ab unhein madad provide karne mein saksham hain, jinhein pariksha mein daalkar parkha ja raha hai.
Isliye svargiy bulaahat mein bhaagidaar holy dear bhaai bahno, Yeshu par dhyaan do, jo hamaare lie God ke ishvriy good news ke dut aur high priest hain.
Vah apne chunnevaale ke prati usi tarah faithful bane rahe, jis tarah God ke saare parivaar mein Moshe.
Yeshu Moshe ki tulna mein unchi glory ke yogy paae gae, jis tarah bhavan ki tulna mein bhavan nirmaata.
Har ek bhavan ka nirmaan kisi na kisi ke dvaara hi kiya jaata hai lekin har ek vastu ke banaanevaale God hain.
Jin vishyon ka varnan bhavishy mein hone par tha, “Unki ghoshna karne mein God ke saare parivaar mein Moshe ek servant ke taur par faithful the,”
Lekin Yeshu ek son ke taur par apne parivaar mein faithful hain. Aur vah parivaar ham khud hain, yadi ham drirh faith aur apne ummid ke gaurav ko ant tak dridhtaapurvak thaame rahte hain.
Isliye thik jis tarah Holy Spirit ka kahna hai: “Yadi aaj, tum unki aavaaj suno,
To apne dil kathor na kar lena, jaisa tumne mujhe uksaate hue banjar zameen, mein pariksha ke samay kiya tha,
Vahaan tumhaare purvjon ne chaalis varshon tak, mere mahaan kaamon ko dekhne ke baad bhi chunauti dete hue mujhe parkha tha.
Isliye main us pirhi se krodhit raha; mainne unse kaha, ‘Hamesha hi unka dil mujhse dur ho jaata hai, unhein mere orders ka koi ahsaas nahin hai.’
Isliye mainne apne krodh mein shapath li, ‘Mere vishraam mein unka pravesh kabhi na hoga.’ ”
Dear bhaai bahno, saavdhaan raho ki tumhaare samaaj mein kisi bhi person ka aisa bura aur avishvaasi dil na ho, jo jivit God se dur ho jaata hai.
Yadi ham apne pahle bharose ko ant tak surakshit banaae rakhte hain, ham Yeshu ke sahbhaagi bane rahte hain.
Jaisa ki varnan kiya gaya hai: “Yadi aaj tum unki aavaaj suno to apne dil kathor na kar lena, jaisa tumne us samay mujhe uksaate hue kiya tha.”
Kaun the ve, jinhonne unki aavaaj sunne ke baad unhein uksaaya tha? Kya ve sabhi nahin, jinhein Moshe misr desh se baahar nikaal laae the?
Aur kaun the ve, jinse vah chaalis varsh tak krodhit rahe? Kya ve hi nahin, jinhonne galti kiya aur jinke shav banjar zameen mein pare rahe?
Aur phir kaun the ve, jinke sambandh mein unhonne shapath khaai thi ki ve log unke vishraam mein pravesh nahin paaeinge? Kya ye sab ve hi nahin the, jinhonne command nahin maani thi?
Isliye yah spasht hai ki unbelief ke kaaran ve pravesh nahin pa sake.
Isliye ham is baare mein vishesh saavdhaan rahein ki jab tak unke vishraam mein pravesh ki promise maany hai, aap mein se koi bhi usmein pravesh se chuk na jaae.

Hamne, jinhonne faith kiya, us vishraam mein pravesh paaya, thik jaisa unka kahna tha, “Jaise mainne apne krodh mein shapath khaai, ‘Ve mere vishraam mein pravesh kabhi na paaeinge.’ ” Yadypi unke kaam srishti ke shuruaat se hi pure ho chuke the.
Unhonne saatvein din ke sambandh mein kisi jagah par is tarah varnan kiya tha: “Tab saatvein din God ne apne sabhi kaamon se vishraam kiya.”
Ek baar phir isi bhaag mein, “Ve mere vishraam mein pravesh kabhi na kareinge.”

God ne ek din dobaara tay kiya, “Aaj.” Isi din ke baare mein ek lambe samay ke baad unhonne David ke chehra se yah kaha tha, thik jaisa ki pahle bhi kaha tha: “Yadi aaj tum unki aavaaj suno to apne dil kathor na kar lena.”
Yadi unhein yahoshu dvaara vishraam provide kiya gaya hota to God iske baad ek dusre din ka varnan na karte.
Isliye God ki people ke lie ab bhi ek Shabbat ka vishraam tay hai;
Kyonki vah, jo God ke vishraam mein pravesh karta hai, apne kaamon se bhi vishraam karta hai, jis tarah khud God ne vishraam kiya tha.
Isliye ham us vishraam mein pravesh ka pure saahas se koshish karein, ki kisi ko bhi usi tarah anaajnaakaarita ka dand bhogna na pare.

God ka vachan jivit, sakriy aur kisi bhi dodhaari talvaar se kahin adhik dhaardaar hai, jo hamaare bhitar mein pravesh kar hamaari aatma, jaan, joron aur majja ko bhed deta hai. Yah hamaare dil ke uddheshyon aur vichaaron ko pahchaanne mein saksham hai.
Jinhein hamein hisaab dena hai, unki nazar se koi bhi praani chhipa nahin hai—sabhi vastuein unke saamne saaf aur khuli hui hain.
Isliye ki vah, jo aakaashmandal mein se hokar pahunch gae, jab vah high priest—God-son, Yeshu—hamaari or hain; ham apne faith mein sthir bane rahein.
Isliye ham grace ke sinhaasan ke saamne nidar hokar jaaein, ki hamein zarurat ke avsar par grace aur grace receive ho.
Usmein ajnaanon aur bhule-bhatkon ke saath namr vyavhaar karne ki kshamta hoti hai kyonki vah khud bhi nirbaltaaon ke adhin hai.
Kisi bhi person ko yah sammaan apni koshish se nahin lekin God ki bulaahat dvaara receive hoti hai, jaise haaron ko.
Isi tarah Yeshu ne bhi high priest ke pad par baithne ke lie khud ko uncha nahin kiya lekin unhonne, jinhonne unse yah kaha, “Tum mere son ho; aaj main tumhaara pita hua hun.”
Jaisa unhonne dusri jagah bhi kaha hai, “Tum melkhizedek ki shrinkhla mein, ek anant kaal ke priest ho.”

Apne deh mein rahne ke samay mein unhonne unche word mein rote hue, aansuon ke saath unke saamne praarthnaaein aur request ki, jo unhein maut se bacha sakte the, unki God mein bhakti ke kaaran unki praarthnaaein accept ki gai.
Son hone par bhi, unhonne apne duhkh uthaane se command maanne ki teaching li.
Kyonki vah God dvaara melkhizedek ki shrrinkhla ke high priest chune gae the.
Hamaare paas is baare mein kahne ke lie bahut kuchh hai aur iska varnan karna bhi kathin kaam hai kyonki tum apni sunne ki kshamta kho baithe ho.

Samay ke hisaab se to tumhein ab tak shikshak ban jaana chaahie tha lekin ab zaruri yah ho gaya hai ki koi tumhein dobaara God ke ishvriy vachnon ke shuru ke siddhaanton ki teaching de. Tumhein thos aahaar nahin, dudh ki zarurat ho gai hai!
Vah jo sirf dudh ka sevan karta hai, righteousness ki teaching se aprichit hai, kyonki vah shishu hai.
Thos aahaar sayaanon ke lie hota hai, jinhonne lagaataar abhyaas ke dvaara apni jnaanendriyon ko iske prati nipun bana liya hai ki kya sahi hai aur kya galat.

Isliye ham siddhta ko apna lakshy bana lein, Yeshu sambandhit praarambhik teachings se upar uthkar paripakvta ki or barhein. Ninv dobaara na rakhein, jo vyarth ki prathaaon se man phiraana aur God ke prati faith,
Yadi God hamein command dein to ham aisa hi kareinge.
Vah zameen, jo vrishti ke paani ko sokhkar kisaan ke lie upyogi upaj utpann karti hai, God ki or se blessing paati hai.
Priyo, haalaanki hamne tumhaare saamne is vishay ko is riti se spasht kiya hai; phir bhi ham tumhaare lie isse achchhi vastuon aur bachaav se sambandhit aashishon ke prati aashvast hain.
God anyaayi nahin hain ki unke sammaan ke lie tumhaare dvaara holy logon ke bhale ke lie kie gae—aur ab bhi kie ja rahe—bhale kaamon aur tumhaare dvaara unke lie abhivyakt love ki upeksha karein.
Hamaari yahi chaahat hai ki tummein se har ek mein aisa utsaah pradarshit ho ki ant tak tummein ummid ka pura nishchay spasht dikhaai de.
God ne jab Abraham se promise ki to shapath lene ke lie unke saamne khud se bara aur koi na tha, isliye unhonne apne hi naam se yah shapath li,
“Nishchyath main tumhein blessing dunga aur tumhaare vansh ko barhaata jaaunga”
Isliye Abraham sabr rakhkar pratiksha karte rahe aur unhein vah receive hua, jiski promise ki gai thi.
Insaan to khud se bare person ki shapath leta hai; tab donon pakshon ke lie pushti ke taur par li gai shapath sabhi jhagron ka ant kar deti hai.
Isi tarah God ne is purpose se shapath li ki vah promise ke vaarison ko apne na badalnevaale purpose ke baare mein puri tarah santusht karein.

Islie ki do na badalnevaali vastuon dvaara, jinke baare mein God jhuthe saabit ho hi nahin sakte; hamein, jinhonne unki sharan li hai, us ummid ko surakshit rakhne ka drirhta se saahas receive ho, jo hamaare saamne prastut ki gai hai.
Yahi ummid hamaare jaan ka langar hai, sthir aur drirh. Jo us parde ke bhitar pahunchta bhi hai,
Jahaan Yeshu ne agua hokar hamaare lie melkhizedek ki shrrinkhla ke ek anant kaal ka high priest bankar pravesh kiya.
Param leader God ke priest shaalem shehar ke raaja melkhizedek ne Abraham se us samay bheint ki aur unhein blessing di, jab Abraham raajaaon ko hara karke laut rahe the,

Unhein Abraham ne yuddh mein receive hui saamagri ka dasvaan ansh bheint kiya. Melkhizedek naam ka praathmik arth hai “Righteousness ke raaja”; aur dusra arth hoga “Shaanti ke raaja” Kyonki vah “Shaalem shehar ke raaja” The.

Kisi ko bhi melkhizedek ki vanshaavli ke baare mein kuchh bhi maalum nahin hai jiska na pita na maata na vanshaavli hai, jiske na dinon ka aadi hai aur na life ka ant hai, God ke son ke jaisa vah anant kaal ke priest hain.
Ab soch karo ki kaise mahaan the yah person, jinhein hamaare gotrpita Abraham ne yuddh mein receive hui vastuon ka sabse achchha dasvaan ansh bheint kiya!

Moshe ke dvaara prastut law mein Levi ke vanshjon ke lie, jo priest ke pad par chune gae hain, yah command hai ki ve sab logon se dasvaan ansh ikattha karein arthaat unse, jo unke bhaai hain—Abraham ki children.
Lekin unhonne, jinki vanshaavli kisi ko maalum nahin, Abraham se dasvaan ansh receive kiya aur unko blessing di, jinse pratijnaaein ki gai thi.
Yah ek vivaad rahit sach hai ki chhota bare se aashirvaad receive karta hai.
Is sandarbh mein priest jo mar jaanevaala insaan hai, dasvaan ansh receive karte hain lekin yahaan isko paanevaale melkhizedek ke baare mein yah kaha gaya hai ki vah jivit hain.
Isliye yah kah sakta hai ki Levi ne bhi, jo dasvaan ansh receive karta hai, us samay dasvaan ansh diya, jab Abraham ne melkhizedek ko dasvaan ansh bheint kiya,
Jab melkhizedek ne Abraham se bheint ki, us samay to Levi ka janm bhi nahin hua tha—vah apne purvaj ke body mein hi the.

Ab yadi siddhi (ya purnta) Levi yaajakta ke maadhyam se receive hui—kyonki isi ke aadhaar par logon ne law receive ki thi—tab ek aise priest ki kya zarurat thi, jiska aagman melkhizedek ki shrrinkhla mein ho, na ki haaron ki shrrinkhla mein?
Kyonki jab kabhi priest pad badla jaata hai, law mein badlaav bhi zaruri ho jaata hai.
Yah sab ham unke baare mein kah rahe hain, jo ek dusre gotr ke the. Us gotr ke kisi bhi person ne vedi par priest ke taur par service nahin ki.
Yah to reveal hai ki hamaare Lord Yahudah gotr se the. Moshe ne is gotr se priests ke hone ka kahin koi varnan nahin kiya.
Melkhizedek ke jaisa ek dusre priest ke aagman se yah aur bhi adhik saaf ho jaata hai,
Melkhizedek shaaririk aavashyaktaaon ki purti ki law ke aadhaar par nahin lekin ek avinaashi life ke power ke aadhaar par priest bane the
Kyonki is baare mein Yeshu se sambandhit yah pushti ki gai: “Tum melkhizedek ki shrrinkhla mein, ek anant kaal ke priest ho.”
Ek or pahli command ka bahishkaar uski durbalta aur nishphalta ke kaaran kar diya gaya.
Kyonki law siddhta ki situation laane mein asphal rahin—dusri or ab ek uttam ummid ka uday ho raha hai, jiske dvaara ham God ki upasthiti mein pahunchte hain.
Yah sab shapath lie bina nahin hua. Vaastav mein priests ki niyukti bina kisi shapath ke hoti thi
Lekin Yeshu ki niyukti unki shapath ke dvaara hui, jinhonne unke baare mein kaha: “Lord ne shapath li hai aur vah apna soch parivartit nahin kareinge: ‘Tum anant kaal ke priest ho.’ ”
Iska matlab yah hua ki Yeshu ek uttam vaacha ke jamaanatdaar ban gae hain.
Ek purv mein priests ki sankhya jyaada hoti thi kyonki har ek priest ki maut ke saath uski service samaapt ho jaati thi;
Lekin dusri or Yeshu, isliye ki vah anant kaal ke hain, apne pad par sthaayi hain.

Isliye vah unke bachaav ke lie saamarthyi hain, jo unke maadhyam se God ke paas aate hain kyonki vah apne request karnevaalon ke paksh mein pita ke saamne nivedan prastut karne ke lie hamesha-hamesha jivit hain.

Law, high priests ke taur par insaanon ko chunta hai, jo maanviy durbaltaaon mein simit hote hain lekin shapath ke vachan ne, jo law ke baad prabhaavi hui, ek son ko chuna, jinhein anant kaal ke lie siddh bana diya gaya.
Bari sach yah hai: hamaare high priest vah hain, jo heaven mein mahaamhim ke daayein paksh mein baithe hain,
Jo vaastvik temple mein sevaarat hain, jiska nirmaan kisi maanav ne nahin, khud Lord ne kiya hai.
Yadi Yeshu prithvi par hote, vah priest ho hi nahin sakte the kyonki yahaan law ke hisaab se bheint charhaane ke lie priest hain.

Ye ve priest hain, jo svargiy vastuon ke pratirup aur pratibimb sirf ki worship karte hain, kyonki Moshe ko, jab vah tambu ka nirmaan karne par the, God ke dvaara yah chetaavni di gai thi: yah dhyaan rakhna ki tum tambu ka nirmaan thik-thik vaisa hi karo, jaisa tumhein parvat par dikhaaya gaya tha,
Lekin ab Yeshu ne dusre priests ki tulna mein kahin adhik achchhi sevkaai receive kar li hai: ab vah ek uttam vaacha ke madhyasth bhi hain, jiska order uttam pratijnaaon par hua hai.
Yadi vah pahli vaacha nirdosh hoti to dusri ki zarurat hi na hoti.
Khud God ne us pirhi ko doshi paakar yah kaha: “Yah dekh lena, ve din a rahe hain, yah Lord ki vaani hai, jab main Israel vansh ke saath aur Yahudah gotr ke saath ek nayi vaacha sthaapit karunga.

Vaisi nahin, jaisi mainne unke purvjon se us samay ki thi, jab mainne unka haath pakarkar unhein misr desh se baahar nikaala tha, kyonki ve meri vaacha mein sthir nahin rahe, isliye main unse dur ho gaya, yah Lord ka kahna hai.

Lekin main Israel ke logon ke saath yah vaacha baandhunga yah Lord ka kathan hai un dinon ke baad main apna niyam unke dil mein likhunga aur unke mastishk par ankit kar dunga. Main unka God ho jaaunga, aur ve meri people.

Tab har ek person apne parosi ko teaching nahin deinge, har ek person apne sajaatiy ko punh yah nahin kahega, ‘Lord ko jaan lo,’ Kyonki ve sabhi mujhe jaan jaaeinge, chhote se bare tak, yah Lord ki vaani hai.
Jab God ek “Nai” Vaacha ka varnan kar rahe the, tab unhonne pahle ko anupyogi ghoshit kar diya. Jo kuchh anupyogi aur jirn ho raha hai, vah barbaad hone par hai.
Pahli vaacha mein bhi God ki worship aur saansaarik temple ke baare mein niyam the.
Kyonki ek tambu banaaya gaya tha, jiske baahri kamre mein dipastambh, chauki aur holy roti rakhi jaati thi. Yah tambu holy jagah kahlaata tha.
Dusre parde se aage jo tambu tha, vah param holy jagah kahlaata tha,

Vahaan dhup ke lie sone ki vedi, sone ki patriyon se marhi hui vaacha ka sanduk, jismein manna se bhara sone ka bartan, hamesha komal patte lagte rahnevaali haaron ki laathi aur vaacha ki patiyaan rakhe hue the.
Iske alaava sanduk ke upar tejomay karub karunaasan ko dhaampe hue the. Lekin ab in sabka vistaar se varnan sambhav nahin.
In sabke aise prabandh ke baad God ki worship ke lie priest har samay baahri tambu mein pravesh kiya karte the.
Holy Spirit yah baat spasht kar rahe hain ki jab tak baahri kamra hai, param holy jagah mein pravesh-raasta khula nahin hai.
Ye sudhaar ke samay tak hi asardaar raheingi kyonki inka sambandh sirph khaan-paan aur bhinn-bhinn shuddh karne ki vidhiyon se hai—un vidhiyon se, jo body se sambandhit hain.
Jahaan vaacha hai, vahaan zaruri hai ki vaacha baandhnevaale ki maut ho,
Kyonki vaacha uske baandhnevaale ki maut ke saabit hone par hi jaayaz hoti hai; jab tak vah jivit rahta hai, vaacha prabhaavi ho hi nahin sakti.
Yahi kaaran hai ki pahli vaacha bhi bina lahu ke prabhaavi nahin hui thi.

Jab Moshe apne chehra se law ke hisaab se Israel ko saari command de chuke, unhonne bachhron aur bakron ka lahu lekar paani, laal un aur jufa jhaari ki chhari ke dvaara law ki pustak aur israaeli people donon hi par yah kahte hue chhirak diya.
“Yah us vaacha, jise follow karne ki command God ne tumhein di hai, uska rakt hai.”
Isi tarah unhonne tambu aur service ke lie istemaal kie sabhi paatron par bhi lahu chhirak diya.
Isliye, jab vah duniya mein aae, unhonne kaha: “Bali aur bheint ki aapne chaahat nahin ki, lekin ek body aapne mere lie taiyaar kiya hai;
Tab mainne kaha, ‘Lord God, main a gaya hun ki aapki chaahat puri karun. Scripture mein yah mera hi varnan hai.’ ”
Tab unhonne kaha, “Lijie, main a gaya hun ki aapki chaahat puri karun.” Is tarah vah pahle ko asvikaar kar dvitiy ko niyukt karte hain.
Tab vahaan vah us samay ki pratiksha karne lage ki kab unke dushman unke adhin bana die jaaeinge
Holy Spirit bhi, jab vah yah kah chuke, yah gavaahi dete hain:
“Main unke saath yah vaacha baandhunga yah Lord ka kathan hai un dinon ke baad main apna niyam unke dil mein likhunga aur unke mastishk par ankit kar dunga.”
Aur, God ke parivaar mein hamaare lie ek sabse uttam priest nirdhaarit hain,
Ab ham bina kisi shak ke apni us ummid mein atal rahein, jise hamne accept kiya hai kyonki jinhonne promise ki hai, vah faithful hain.
Ham yah bhi vishesh dhyaan rakhein ki ham aapas mein love aur bhale kaamon mein ek dusre ko kis tarah apostle karein
Un praarambhik dinon ki situation ko yaad karo jab knowledge receive karne ke baad tum kashton ki situation mein sangharsh karte rahe
Kuchh to saarvajnik rup se uphaas paatr banaae jaakar ninda aur kashton ke dvaara aur kuchh isi tarah ke vyavhaar ko sah rahe dusre believers ka saath dene ke kaaran.

Tumne un par sahaanubhuti vyakt ki, jo bandi banaae gae the aur tumne property ke chhin jaane ko bhi isliye saharsh accept kar liya ki tumhein yah maalum tha ki nishchit hi uttam aur sthaayi hai tumhaari sampda.
Isliye apne drirh faith se dur na ho jaao jiska pratiphal bara hai.
Is samay zarurat hai sabr ki ki jab tum God ki will puri kar chuko, tumhein vah receive ho jaae jiski promise ki gai thi.
Aur faith un tatvon ka nishchay hai, hamne jinki ummid ki hai, aur un tatvon ka pramaan hai, jinhein hamne dekha nahin hai.
Isi ke dvaara praachinon ne God ki prashansa receive ki.
Yah faith hi hai, jiske dvaara hamne yah jaana hai ki God ki command sirf se saari srishti astitv mein a gai. Vah sab, jo dikhta hai uski utpatti dekhi hui vastuon se nahin hui.

Yah faith hi tha, jiske dvaara haabil ne God ko kaain ki tulna mein behtar bali bheint ki, jiske kaaran khud God ne prashansa ke saath haabil ko right thehraaya. God ne haabil ki bheint ki prashansa ki. Yadypi unki maut ho chuki hai, unka yahi faith aaj bhi hamaare lie gavaahi hai.

Yah faith hi tha ki hanokh utha lie gae ki vah maut ka anubhav na karein: “Unhein phir dekha na gaya, khud God ne hi unhein apne saath le liya tha.” Unhein uthaae jaane ke pahle unki prashansa ki gai thi ki unhonne God ko prasann kiya tha.

Faith ki kami mein God ko prasann karna asambhav hai kyonki God ke paas aanevaale person ke lie yah zaruri hai ki vah yah faith kare ki God hain aur yah bhi ki vah unhein pratiphal dete hain, jo unki khoj karte hain.

Yah faith hi tha, jiske dvaara Abraham ne God ke bulaane par ghar-parivaar ka tyaag kar ek dusre desh ko chale jaane ke lie unki command ka follow kiya—vah desh, jo God unhein miraas mein dene par the. Vah yah jaane bina hi chal pare ki vah kahaan ja rahe the.

Vah faith ke dvaara hi us promise kie hue desh mein vaise rahe, jaise videsh mein ek ajanbi rahta hai. Videsh mein ek ajanbi ki tarah unhonne yitshaak aur Yaakob ke saath tambuon mein nivaas kiya, jo usi promise ke saath vaaris the.
Unki nazar us sthaayi shehar ki or thi, jiske rachnevaale aur banaanevaale God hain.
Yah faith hi tha ki saaraah ne bhi garbhdhaaran ki kshamta receive ki haalaanki unki avastha is yogy nahin rah gai thi. Unhonne faith kiya ki God, jinhonne iski promise ki thi, faithful hain.
Is kaaran us person ke dvaara, jo mare hue se the, itne vanshaj paida hue, jitne aakaash mein taare aur samudr ke kinaare par ret ke kan hain.

Faith ki situation mein hi in sab ki maut hui, yadypi unhein promise ki hui vastuein receive nahin hui thi, lekin unhonne un tatvon ko dur se pahchaankar is ahsaas ke saath unka svaagat kiya ki ve khud prithvi par pardeshi aur baahri hain.
Is tarah ke bhaavon ko reveal karne ke dvaara ve yah saaf kar dete hain ki ve apne hi desh ki khoj mein hain.
Vastuth yadi ve us desh ko yaad kar rahe the, jisse ve nikal aae the, tab unke saamne vahaan laut jaane ka suavsar bhi hota

Lekin sach yah hai ki unhein ek behtar desh ki chaahat thi, jo svargiy hai. Isliye un logon dvaara God kahlaae jaane mein God ko kisi tarah ki lajja nahin hai kyonki God hi ne unke lie ek shehar ka nirmaan kiya hai.
Yah faith hi tha ki Abraham ne, jab unhein parkha gaya, yitshaak ko bali ke lie bheint kar diya. Jinhonne pratijnaaon ko receive kiya tha, vah apne eklaute son ko bheint kar rahe the,
Yah vahi the, jinse kaha gaya tha, “Tumhaare vanshaj yitshaak ke maadhyam se naamit honge.”
Abraham yah samajh chuke the ki God mein mare huon ko jivit karne ka power hai. Ek tarah se unhonne bhi yitshaak ko mare huon mein se jivit receive kiya.
Yah faith hi tha ki yitshaak ne Yaakob aur esaav ko unke aanevaale life ke lie aashirvaad diya.
Yah faith hi tha ki Yaakob ne apne marte samay Yosef ke donon sons ko apni laathi ka sahaara le aashirvaad diya aur worship ki.
Yah faith hi tha ki Yosef ne apni maut ke samay israaeliyon ke nirgman jaane ka varnan kiya aur apni asthiyon ke baare mein command din.
Yah faith hi tha ki jab Moshe ka janm hua, unke maata-pita ne unhein tin maah tak chhipaae rakha. Unhonne dekha ki shishu sundar hai isliye ve raaj command se bhaybhit na hue.
Yah faith hi tha ki Moshe ne bare hone par faroh ki putri ki children kahlaana asvikaar kar diya.
Unki nazar mein Yeshu ke lie sahi gai ninda misr desh ke bhandaaron se kahin adhik kimti thi kyonki unki aankhein us inaam par sthir thi.
Yah faith hi tha ki Moshe misr desh ko chhorkar chale gae. Unhein faroh ke krodh ka koi dar na tha. Vah aage hi barhte chale gae maano vah unhein dekh rahe the, jo andekhe hain.
Yah faith hi tha ki Moshe ne israaeliyon ko Fasah utsav manaane aur bali-lahu chhirakne ki command di ki vah, jo pahlauthe sons ka barbaadi kar raha tha, unmein se kisi ko sparsh na kare.
Yah faith hi tha ki unhonne laal saagar aise paar kar liya, maano ve sukhi zameen par chal rahe hon lekin jab misrvaasiyon ne vahi karna chaaha to dub mare.
Yah faith hi tha jiske dvaara yerikho shehar ki divaar unke saat din tak parikrma karne par gir pari.
Yah faith hi tha ki nagravdhu raahaab ne guptachron ka svaagat maitri bhaav mein kiya aur command na maannevaalon ke saath barbaadi nahin hui.
Main aur kya kahun? Samay ki kami mujhe command nahin deti ki main gidaun, baaraak, shimshon, yiphtaah, David, shamuel aur bhavishyadvaktaaon ka varnan karun,
Jo faith se raajyon par vijyi hue, jinhonne righteousness mein raajy kiya, jinhein pratijnaaon ka phal receive hua, jinhonne sinhon ke munh baandh die,
Aag ki lapton ko thanda kar diya, talvaar ki dhaar se bach nikle; jinhein nirbal se balvant bana diya gaya; yuddh mein vir saabit hue; jinhonne videshi senaaon ko khader diya.
Kuchh dusre the, jinki parakh uphaas, koron, beriyon mein jakre jaane aur bandigrih mein daale jaane ke dvaara hui.

Unka pathraav kiya gaya, unhein chir daala gaya, laalach diya gaya, talvaar se unka vadh kiya gaya, bheron va bakriyon ki khaal mein marh diya gaya, ve abhaav ki situation mein the, unhein yaatnaaein di gain aur unse durvyavhaar kiya gaya.
Unke lie duniya sahi jagah saabit na hua. Ve banjar zameen mein, parvton par, guphaaon mein aur zameen ke gaddhon mein bhatakte-chhipte rahe.
Ye sabhi gavaahon ne apne faith ke dvaara God ka grace receive kiya, lekin inhonne vah receive nahin kiya jiski inse promise ki gai thi;
Kyonki unke lie God ke dvaara kuchh behtar hi nirdhaarit tha ki hamaare saath jure bina unhein siddhta receive na ho.
Un par soch karo, jinhonne galti karnevaalon dvaara die gae ghor kasht isliye sah lie ki tum niraash hokar saahas na chhor do.
Isliye shithil hote ja rahe haathon aur nirbal ghutnon ko majbut banaao.
Aur “Apna raasta sidha banaao” Jisse apang ang barbaad na hon lekin svasth bane rahein.
Sabhi ke saath shaanti banaae rakho aur us pavitrta ke khoji raho, jiske bina koi bhi Lord ko dekh na paaega.
Saavdhaan raho ki tumhaare bich na to koi vyabhichaari person ho aur na hi esaav ke jaisa God ka virodhi, jisne pahlautha son hone ke apne authority ko sirf ek khaana ke lie bech diya.
Tum us parvat ke paas nahin a pahunche, jise sparsh kiya ja sake aur na hi dahakti jvaala, andhera, kaali ghata aur bavandar;
Turhi ki aavaaj aur word ki aisi dhvani ke paas, jiske word aise the ki jinhonne use suna, request ki ki ab vah unse aur adhik kuchh na kahe,
Us samay to unki aavaaj ne prithvi ko hila diya tha lekin ab unhonne yah kahte hue promise ki hai, “Ek baar phir main na keval prithvi lekin heaven ko bhi hila dunga.”
Ye word “Ek baar phir” Un vastuon ke hataae jaane ki or sanket hain, jo asthir hain arthaat srisht vastuein, ki ve vastuein, jo achal hain, sthaayi rah sakein.
Isliye jab hamne avinaashi raajy receive kiya hai, ham God ke aabhaari hon ki is aabhaar ke dvaara ham God ko sammaan aur shraddha ke saath svikaaryogy worship bheint kar sakein,
Bhaaichaare ka love lagaataar bana rahe.
Aprichiton ka atithi-satkaar karna na bhulo. Aisa karne ke dvaara kuchh ne anjaane hi angels ka atithi-satkaar kiya tha.
Bandiyon ke prati tumhaara vyavhaar aisa ho maano tum khud unke saath bandigrih mein ho. Sataae jaane vaalon ko na bhulna kyonki tum sabhi ek body ke ang ho.
Vivaah ki baat sammaanit rahe aur vivaah ka bichhauna kabhi ashuddh na hone paae kyonki God vyabhichaariyon aur parastrigaamiyon ko dandit kareinge.

Yah dhyaan rahe ki tumhaara charitr wealth ke lobh se mukt ho. Jo kuchh tumhaare paas hai, usi mein santusht raho kyonki khud unhonne kaha hai, “Main na to tumhaara tyaag karunga aur na hi kabhi tumhein chhorunga.”
Isliye ham nishchaypurvak yah kahte hain, “Lord mere sahaayak hain, main darunga nahin. Insaan mera kya kar lega?”
Yeshu ek sa hain—kal, aaj aur yugaanuyug.
Hamaari ek vedi hai, jis par se unhein, jo temple mein service karte hain, khaane ka koi authority nahin hai.
Kyonki yahaan hamaara ghar sthaai shehar mein nahin hai—ham us shehar ki pratiksha kar rahe hain, jo anant kaal ka hai.
Bhalaai karna aur vastuon ka aapas mein milkar baantna samaapt na karo kyonki ye aisi bali hain, jo God ko prasann karti hain.
Hamaare lie nirantar prayer karte raho, kyonki hamein hamaare nirmal vivek ka nishchay hai. Hamaara lagaataar koshish yahi hai ki hamaara life har ek baat mein aadaryogy ho.
Tumse meri vishesh request hai ki prayer karo ki main tumse bheint karne shighr a sakun.

Tumhein har ek bhale kaam mein apni chaahat ki purti ke lie susajjit karein aur hamein Yeshu ke dvaara vah karne ke lie apostle karein, jo unki nazar mein sukhad hai. Unhin ki glory hamesha-hamesha hoti rahe. Aamen.
Dear bhaai bahno, meri request hai ki is updesh-patr ko sabr se sahan karna kyonki yah mainne sankshep mein likha hai.
Yaad rahe ki hamaare bhaai timothiyos ko chhor diya gaya hai. Yadi vah yahaan shighr aaein to, unke saath aakar main tumse bheint kar sakunga.
Apne sabhi aguon aur sabhi holy logon ko mera namaskaar. Itaaliya vaasiyon ka tumhein namaskaar.
Tum sab par grace bana rahe.
