A moment afterwards, a crowd, issuing from all the houses and collecting from all the alleys, rushed in the same direction and reached the Grotto at the same time with the child.
In the valley, the snow had melted within the last two or three days, but still remained on the crests of the neighboring peaks.
The weather was fine and clear, and not a speck was to be seen in the calm blue of the firmament.
The sun seemed to rise with royal pomp from the bosom of the white mountains and threw a splendor over his cradle of snow.
It was the anniversary of the day on which the Angel Gabriel had descended to the purest of virgins, the Virgin of Nazareth, and had saluted her in the name of the Lord.
The Church was celebrating the feast of the Annunciation.
While the crowd was hurrying to the Grotto, and amongst it might be noticed the greater number of those who had been cured — Louis Bourriette, the widow Crouzat, Blaisette Soupenne, Benoite Cazeaux.

Auguste Bordes, and twenty more, the Catholic Church, at the close of her morning office, was intoning those wonderful words, "At that moment shall the eyes of the blind be opened, the ears of the deaf shall recover their hearing, the lame shall leap like the deer, for the waters have burst forth in the desert, and torrents in the wilderness."
Bernadette had not been deceived by the joyful presentiment she had felt.
The voice which had called her was the voice of the faithful Virgin.
As soon as the child had fallen on her knees the Apparition made herself manifest.
As ever before, an ineffable aureole beamed around her, of boundless splendor and infinite sweetness; it was like the eternal glory of absolute peace.
As ever before, her veil and her robe falling in chaste folds were white like the glistening snow.
The two roses which blossomed on her feet had the yellow tinge which pervades the base of heaven at the first light of the virgin da\vn.
Her girdle was blue as the azure firmament.
Bernadette, plunged in ecstacy, had forgotten earth in the presence of her spotless beauty.
"O Lady,' she said to her, "would you have the goodness to inform me who you are and what is your name?
"The queenly Apparition smiled but gave no reply.
But at that very moment, the Universal Church, proceeding with the solemn prayers of her Office, was exclaiming: "O holy and immaculate Virginity, what praises can I give unto Thee?
In truth, I know not, for thou hast borne in thy womb Him whom the Heavens cannot contain."
Bernadette heard not these distant voices, nor could she surmise these profound harmonies.
Notwithstanding the silence on the part of the Vision, she urged her request, and repeated: "O Lady, would you have the kindness to inform me who you are and what is your name?
"The Apparition appeared to become more radiant, as if her joy kept increasing, and yet she did not reply to the child's question.

But the Church, spread over the whole of Christendom, was continuing her prayers and chaunts and had reached those words: "Wish me joy, all ye who love the Lord, for when I was yet a child, the Most High hath loved me, and from my womb was produced the GodMan.
All generations shall proclaim me Blessed, for God hath deigned to regard the lowliness of his hand-maiden; and from my womb was produced the God-Man."
Bernadette redoubled the urgency of her request and pronounced for the third time the words: $ "O Lady, would you have the kindness to inform me who you are and what is your name?"
The Apparition appeared to enter more and more into the glory of beatitude, and as if absorbed in her own felicity, continued to return no answer.

But, by an extraordinary coincidence the universal choir of the Church was at that moment bursting forth into a song of joy and pronouncing the earthly name of the marvelous Apparition, "Hail Mary, full of Grace, the Lord is with Thee, blessed art Thou among women."
Bernadette pronounced once more these suppliant words: "O Lady, I beseech you, have the kindness to inform me who you are and what is your name?
"The hands of the Apparition were clasped with fervor and her countenance was radiant with the splendors of infinite beatitude.
It was Humility crowned with Glory.

At the same time that Bernadette was contemplating the Vision, the Vision was doubtless contemplating, in the bosom of the divine Trinity, God the Father of whom She was the daughter, God the Holy Ghost of whom She was the Spouse, and God the Son of whom She was the Mother.
At the last question of the child She unclasped her hands, slipping over Her right arm the chaplet, whose alabaster beads were strung on a golden thread.
She then opened both of Her arms and bent them towards the ground, as if to show to the earth Her Virgin hands, full of blessings.

Afterwards, raising them towards the eternal region, from which on that very day centuries before the divine Messenger of the Annunciation had de 2i scended, She joined them again fervently, and gazing up to Heaven with an expression of unspeakable gratitude, she pronounced the following words: "I am the Immaculate Conception."
Thus saying, She disappeared, and the child, like the multitude, found herself opposite a solitary rock.
At her side, the miraculous Fountain, falling through its wooden conduit into its rustic basin, soothed the ear with the peaceful murmur of its waters.
It was the day and the hour, when Holy Church was intoning in her Office the magnificent hymn, — "O most glorious of Virgins."
O Gloriosa Virginum, Sublimis inter sidera.
XIV.

THE Mother of Our Lord Jesus had not said — "I am Mary, the Immaculate"; She had said, — "I am the Immaculate Conception," as if to mark the absolute, and, as it were, substantial character of the divine privilege granted to Her alone since Adam and Eve were created by God.
It is as if she had said, not, "I am pure," but, "I am purity itself; "not, "I am a Virgin," but, "I am the incarnate and living Virginity; "not, "I am white," but, "I am whiteness!"
Any thing that is white may cease to be so; but, Whiteness is always white.
It is its essence and not its quality.

Mary is more than conceived without wrong: She i I/ the Immaculate Conception itself; the essential and superior type; the archetype of unsullied humanity, of humanity as it proceeded from the hands of God, without having been tainted by the original stain, by the impure element which the fault of our first Parents mixed with the very source of that vast river of generations, which has flowed for the last six thousand years, and of which, each of us, is a fleeting wave.
What would you do, if you wished to draw water pure from a muddy spring?
You would pass it through a filter, and the water clears itself of its grosser elements.
You then pass it through a second filter, then through a third, and so on.
The time soon comes when the water becomes entirely pure and clear, — a liquid diamond.
In the same manner did God act, when the original Spring was troubled.
He chose a particular family in this world, and watched over it from age to age, from Seth unto Noah, from Shem unto David, from David even unto Joachim and Anne, the parents of the Blessed Virgin.

And, when this human blood was thus filtered, so to speak, in spite of the accidents of some intermediate guilty persons, through nearly fifty generations of patriarchs and just men, there came into the world a creature absolutely pure; a creature without stain; a daughter of Adam entirely immaculate.
She was called Mary, and Her fruitful Virginity produced Jesus.
The Virgin, at that moment, had desired to attest by her presence and her miracles, the last dogma defined by the Church, and proclaimed by St.
Peter, speaking by the voice of Pius IX.

It was the first time in her life that the little shep10 21 herd-girl, to whom the divine Virgin had just appeared, had heard the words: "Immaculate Conception; "and, being entirely ignorant of their meaning, she exerted herself to the utmost on her way back to Lourdes to retain them in her memory.

"I repeated them to myself all along the road, in order not to forget them," she told us, one day; "and, up to the very door of the presbytery to which I was going, I kept saying, Immaculate Conception, Immaculate Conception, at each step I made, as I wished to take to the Cure the exact words of the Vision, in order that the chapel might be built."
FIFTH BOOK.
I.
Phir Yahweh ne abraam se kaha, “Apne pita ke ghar aur apne rishtedaaron ko chhorkar us desh ko chala ja, jo main tumhein dikhaaunga.
“Main tumse ek bari jaati banaaunga, main tumhein blessing dunga; main tumhaara naam bara karunga, aur tum ek blessing honge.
Jo tumhein blessing deinge, main unhein blessing dunga aur jo tumhein shaap dega; main unhein shaap dunga. Tumse hi prithvi ke sab log blessed honge.”
Isliye Yahweh ke order ke hisaab se abraam chal pare; lot bhi unke saath gaye. Jab abraam haaraan se nikle, tab ve 75 varsh ke the.
Abraam apne saath unki patni saaray, unka bhatija lot, unki puri property aur haaraan desh mein receive slave aur daasiyon ko lekar kanaan desh pahunche.
Vahaan se abraam shekem mein moreh ke baanj vriksh tak pahunch gae. Us samay us desh mein kanaani log rahte the.
Yahweh ne abraam ko darshan diya aur kaha, “Tumhaare vansh ko main yah desh dunga.” Tab abraam ne us jagah par Yahweh ke sammaan mein, jo un par reveal hue the, ek vedi banaai.

Phir abraam vahaan se bethel ke purv mein parvat ki or barh gae, vahin unhonne tambu khare kie. Unke pashchim mein bethel aur purv mein ay shehar the. Abraam ne vahaan Yahweh ke sammaan mein vedi banaai aur worship ki.
Vahaan se abraam negev ki or barhe.
Us desh mein akaal para, tab abraam kuchh samay ke liye misr desh mein rahne ke liye chale gae, kyonki unke desh mein bhayankar akaal para tha.
Abraam apni patni, saari property aur lot ko lekar kanaan desh ke negev mein aae.
Abraam ke paas bahut pashu, sone aur chaandi hone ke kaaran ve bahut dhani ho gaye the.
Ve negev se bethel tak pahunch gae, jahaan ve pahle rahte the arthaat bethel aur ay ke bich mein.
Aur jahaan unhonne pahle ek vedi banaai thi vahaan abraam ne Yahweh se prayer ki.
Lot ke paas bhi bahut bher-bakriyaan aur pashu the. Unhonne bhi abraam ke paas apne tambu lagaae.
Par zamin ki kami ke kaaran ve donon ek saath na rah pa rahe the kyonki unke paas bahut adhik property thi.
Aur abraam aur lot ke charvaahon ke bich aapas mein laraai ho jaati thi. Aur us samay us desh mein kanaani aur parijzi log bhi rahte the.
Isliye abraam ne lot se kaha, “Ham donon ke bich aur hamaare charvaahon ke bich jhagra na ho, kyonki ham ek hi parivaar ke hain.
Isliye ham donon alag ho jaate hain. Yadi tum baayin disha mein jaana chaahte ho, to main daayin or chala jaaunga aur yadi tum daayin disha mein jaana chaahte ho, to main baayin or chala jaaunga.”

Lot ne yardan nadi va uske aas-paas ki hariyaali ko dekha; vah chaaron taraph phaili thi aur zoar ki disha mein yardan nadi bhi paani se bhari thi. Vah Yahweh ka bagicha, aur misr desh ke jaisa upjaau thi. (yah Yahweh ke dvaara sodom va amoraah ko barbaadi karne ke pahle ki baat hai.)
Isliye lot ne yardan ghaati ko jo, purv disha ki or hai, chun liya. Is tarah lot aur abraam ek dusre se alag ho gae.
Abraam kanaan desh mein bas gae aur lot yardan ghaati ke shehron mein. Lot ne apne tambu sodom shehar ke nikat khare kie.
Sodom ke aadmi evil the aur Yahweh ki nazar mein ve bahut galti karnevaala the.
Lot se abraam ke alag hone ke baad Yahweh ne abraam se kaha, “Tum jis jagah par khare ho, vahaan se chaaron or dekho.
Kyonki yah saari zameen, jo tumhein dikh rahi hai, main tumhein aur tumhaare vansh ko hamesha ke lie dunga.
Main tumhaare vansh ko zameen ki dhul ke kan ke jaisa asankhy bana dunga, tab yadi koi in kanon ko gin sake, to tumhaare vansh ko bhi gin paayega.
Ab utho, is desh ki lambaai aur chauraai mein chalo phiro, kyonki yah main tumhein dunga.”
Isliye abraam ne hebron mein mamre ke baanj vriksh ke paas apne tambu khare kie aur unhonne vahaan Yahweh ke lie ek vedi banaai.
In baaton ke baad abraam ko ek darshan mein Yahweh ka yah sandesh mila: “Abraam, bhaybhit na ho, main tumhaari dhaal, aur tumhaara sabse bara pratiphal hun.”
Abraam ne javaab diya, “He Lord Yahweh, aap mujhe kya de sakte hain, kyonki meri koi children nahin hai, aur mera vaaris dameshek ka eliezar hoga?”
Abraam ne yah bhi kaha, “Aapki or se to mujhe koi children nahin mili; isliye mere ghar mein ek servant mera vaaris hoga.”
Tab abraam ke paas Yahweh ka yah vachan aaya, “Tumhaara vaaris yah slave nahin, lekin ek son jo tumhaara hi maans aur khun hai, tumhaara vaaris hoga.”
Yahweh abraam ko baahar le gae aur abraam se kahne lage, “Aakaash ki or dekho. Aur taaron ki ginti karo.” Yahweh ne abraam se kaha, “Aise hi tumhaara vansh hoga, jinko koi gin nahin paayega.”
Abraam ne Yahweh par faith kiya; Yahweh ne is baat ko uski righteousness maani.
Yahweh ne abraam ko aashvaasan diya “Main vahi Yahweh hun, jisne tumhein kasdiyon ke ur shehar se baahar nikaala, taaki tumhein yah desh mile aur tum is desh par authority kare.”
Abraam ne kaha, “He Lord Yahweh, main kaise jaanun ki aap mujhe yah desh deinge?”
Par tumhaara ant bahut shaanti se hoga aur tum apni pure burhaape ki aayu mein apne purkhon ke paas daphnaae jaaoge.
Aur usi din Yahweh ne abraam se ek vaacha baandhi aur kaha, “Main tumhaare vansh ko misr ke nadi se lekar pharaat mahaandi tak dunga,
Abraam ki patni saaray nihsantaan thi. Uski haagaar naamak ek daasi thi, jo misri thi;

Saaray ne abraam se kaha, “Main to maan nahin ban sakti kyonki main baanjh hun isliye grace karke aap meri daasi ko svikaarein, sambhvath uske dvaara children ka sukh pa sakun.” Abraam ne saaray ke is baat ko maan liya.
Abraam ko kanaan desh mein rahte hue das saal ho chuke the. Abraam ki patni saaray ne apni daasi haagaar ko abraam ki patni hone ke lie unko saump diya.
Abraam ne haagaar ke saath shaaririk sambandh banaae; is tarah haagaar garbhavti hui tab haagaar saaray ko tuchchh samajhne lagi.

Saaray ne abraam se kaha, “Mere saath ho rahe upadrav ka kaaran aap hain. Mainne apni daasi ko keval vaaris paane ke lie aapko saumpa tha lekin haagaar garbhavti hote hi mujhe tuchchh samajhne lagi. Ab Yahweh hi aapke aur mere bich justice karein.”

Abraam ne saaray se kaha, “Suno, tumhaari daasi par tumhaara hi authority hai. Tum jaisa chaaho uske saath karo.” Tab saaray haagaar ko tang karne lagi. Haagaar pareshaan hokar saaray ke saamne se bhaag gai.
Jab Yahweh ke dut ne use nirjan pradesh mein ek sote ke paas dekha jo shur ke raasta par tha.
Tab angel ne usse puchha, “He saaray ki daasi haagaar, tum kahaan se a rahi ho? Aur kahaan ja rahi ho?” Haagaar ne javaab diya, “Main apni svaamini saaray ke paas se bhaagkar aai hun.”
Aur Yahweh ke dut ne kaha, “Main tumhaare vansh ko bahut badhaaunga, itna ki unki ginti karna mushkil hoga.”
Yahweh ke dut ne yah bhi kaha: “Dekho, tum garbhavti hogi aur ek son ko janm dogi. Uska naam tum ishmaael rakhna, kyonki Yahweh ne tumhaare rona suna hai.
Tab haagaar ne Yahweh ka jinhonne usse baat ki thi, yah naam rakha: “Atta-el-roi,” (arthaat aap mujhe dekhnevaala God hain) usne yah bhi kaha, “Mainne ab usko dekha hai jo mujhe dekhta hai.”
Is ghatna ke kaaran us kuein ka naam baer-lahaai-roi para, jo kaadesh aur bered ke bich mein hai.
Abraam se haagaar ka ek beta hua aur abraam ne haagaar se janme apne is bete ka naam ishmaael rakha.
Abraam chhiyaasi varsh ke the, jab ishmaael paida hua.
Yahweh ne mamre ke baanj vrikshon ke paas Abraham ko darshan diya, tab Abraham din ki kari dhup mein apne tambu ke dvaar par baithe hue the.

Abraham ne aankhein upar uthaakar dekha ki unke saamne tin person khare hain. Jab unhonne in logon ko dekha, tab ve unse milne ke liye tambu ke dvaar se daurkar unke paas gae, aur jhukkar unko pranaam kiya.
Abraham ne unse kaha, “Mere maalik, yadi mujh par aapki kripaadrishti ho, to apne servant ke yahaan ruke bina na jaaein.
Aap is per ke niche baithiye, main paani lekar aata hun, taaki aap apne paanv dho sakein.”

Main aapke lie khaana taiyaar karta hun, taaki aap khaakar taro taaja ho sakein aur phir apni aage ki yaatra mein jaaein—kyonki aap apne servant ke yahaan aae hain. Unhonne Abraham se kaha, “Vaisa hi karo, jaisa ki tumne kaha hai.”
Abraham jaldi tambu mein saaraah ke paas gae aur kaha, “Turant, tin maap maida gundhkar kuchh rotiyaan banaao.”
Abraham daurkar apne gaay-bail ke jhund ke paas gae aur ek komal achchha bachhra chhaant kar apne servant ko diya aur usse kaha, jaldi se khaana taiyaar karo.
Phir Abraham ne dahi, dudh aur bachhra jo taiyaar karvaaya tha, unko khilaaya. Jab ve tinon khaana kar rahe the, Abraham per ki chhaaya mein unke paas khare rahe.
Unhonne Abraham se puchha, “Tumhaari patni saaraah kahaan hai?” Abraham ne kaha, “Vah tambu mein hai.”

Is par unmein se ek ne kaha, “Agle varsh, isi vasant ritu samay mein, main nishchay vaapas aaunga, tab tumhaari patni saaraah putravti hogi.” Abraham ki pith tambu ki or thi, aur tambu ke dvaar par saaraah yah baat sun rahi thi.
Abraham aur saaraah bahut burhe the, aur saaraah bachcha paida karne ki umr ko paar kar chuki thi.
Isliye saaraah man hi man hanste hue sochne lagi, “Main kamjor ho chuki aur mere maalik bahut burhe hai, ab kya yah khushi hamaare life mein aayegi?”
Tab Yahweh ne Abraham se savaal kiya, “Saaraah yah kahkar kyon hans rahi hai ki kya main vaastav mein ek bachche ko janm dungi, jabki main to ek burhi hun?
Kya Yahweh ke lie koi kaam kathin hai? Main agle saal isi nirdhaarit samay tumse milne aaunga, tab saaraah putravti hogi.”
Tab saaraah dar gayi, aur yah kahkar jhuth bolne lagi, “Main nahin hansi thi.” Tab God ke dut ne kaha, “Tum zarur hansi thi.”
Iske baad ve person jaane ke lie uthe aur sodom ki or dekhne lage, Abraham unko vida karne ke lie unke saath saath chal rahe the.
Tab Yahweh ne socha, “Jo kaam main karnevaala hun, kya main Abraham se chhipa rakhun?
Abraham se to nishchay ek bari aur saamarthi jaati hogi aur usse hi prithvi ki saari jaatiyaan blessing paaeingi

Kyonki mainne unhein isliye chuna ki ve apne bachchon aur ghar ke logon ko sahi aur justice ki baat sikhaayein aur ve Yahweh ke raasta mein sthir rahein, taaki Yahweh Abraham se kie gae vaayde ko pura karein.”
Tab Yahweh ne bataaya, “Sodom aur amoraah ki chillaahat barh gai hai, unka galti bahut barh gaya hai
Isliye main vahaan jaakar dekhunga ki unke kaam us chillaahat ke mutaabik bure hain ya nahin. Yadi nahin, to main samajh lunga.”
Phir unmein se do person vahaan se murkar sodom ki or chale gae, jabki Abraham Yahweh ke saamne ruke rahe.
Abraham ne Yahweh se kaha: “Kya aap sachmuch bure logon ke saath dharmiyon ko bhi barbaadi kareinge?
Yadi us shehar mein pachaas righteous hon, to kya aap us shehar ko barbaadi kareinge? Kya un pachaas dharmiyon ke kaaran baaki sab log bach nahin sakte?

Is tarah ka kaam karna aapse dur rahe—evil ke saath righteous ko maar daalna, evil aur righteous ke saath ek jaisa vyavhaar karna. Aisa karna aapse dur rahe! Kya saari prithvi ka nyaayi justice na kare?”
Yahweh ne kaha, “Yadi mujhe sodom shahar mein pachaas righteous person mil jaaein, to main unke kaaran pure shahar ko chhor dunga.”
Abraham ne phir kaha: “Haalaaki main keval mitti aur raakh hun, phir bhi mainne Lord se baat karne ki himmat ki hai,

Yadi vahaan pachaas mein se paanch righteous kam ho jaayein, to kya aap paanch righteous kam hone ke kaaran pure shehar ka barbaadi kareinge?” Yahweh ne javaab diya, “Yadi mujhe vahaan paintaalis bhi mil jaaein, to main us shehar ko barbaadi nahin karunga.”
Ek baar phir Abraham ne Yahweh se kaha, “Yadi vahaan chaalis hi righteous paae jaaein to?” Yahweh ne javaab diya, “Un chaalis ke kaaran bhi main barbaadi na karunga.”

Tab Abraham ne kaha, “Lord, aap mujh par naaraaj na hoein, par mujhe bolne dein. Yadi vahaan tis hi righteous paae jaaein to?” Yahweh ne javaab diya, “Yadi mujhe vahaan tis bhi mil jaaein, to main barbaadi na karunga.”

Abraham ne kaha, “Lord, mainne aapse baat karne ki himmat to kar hi li hai; yah bhi ho sakta hai ki vahaan bis hi paae jaaein to?” Yahweh ne javaab diya, “Main un bis ke kaaran us shehar ko barbaadi na karunga.”

Phir Abraham ne kaha, “He Lord, aap krodhit na hon, aakhiri baar aapse request karta hun. Yadi vahaan das hi paae jaaein to?” Yahweh ne javaab diya, “Main un das ke kaaran us shehar ko barbaadi na karunga.”
Jab Yahweh Abraham se baat kar chuke, to ve vahaan se chale gaye, aur Abraham apne ghar vaapas chala gaya.
Yahweh ne apne kahe vachan ke mutaabik saaraah par grace kiya, aur unhonne saaraah se jo vaayda kiya tha, use pura kiya.
Saaraah garbhavti hui aur usne Abraham ke burhaape mein, God ke niyukt kie gaye samay mein ek bete ko janm diya.
Abraham ne saaraah se janme is son ka naam yitshaak rakha.
Jab uska beta yitshaak aath din ka hua, tab Abraham ne God ki command ke hisaab se uska khatna kiya.
Yitshaak ke janm ke samay Abraham ki aayu ek sau varsh ki thi.
Saaraah ne kaha, “Mujhe God ne hansi se bhar diya aur jo koi yah baat sunega, vah bhi mere saath hansega.”
Aur usne yah bhi kaha, “Abraham se kaun kahta tha ki saaraah bachche ko dudh pila paayegi? Lekin mainne unke burhaape mein unko ek son diya.”
Saaraah ka beta bara hota gaya aur uska dudh chhuraaya gaya, aur jis din yitshaak ka dudh chhuraaya gaya, us din Abraham ne ek bara bhoj diya.
Par saaraah ne dekha ki misri haagaar ka beta, jo Abraham se janma tha, uphaas kar raha hai,
To saaraah ne Abraham se kaha, “Is daasi aur iske son ko yahaan se nikaal do, kyonki is daasi ka son mere son yitshaak ke saath vaaris kabhi nahin ho sakta.”
Is baat ne Abraham ko bahut dukhit kar diya, kyonki yah baat apne son ishmaael ke sambandh mein thi.
Lekin God ne Abraham se kaha, “Us larke aur daasi ke baare mein sochkar pareshaan mat ho jo kuchh saaraah tumse kahe, use sun lo kyonki tumhaare vanshaj yitshaak ke maadhyam se naamit honge.
Daasi ke son se bhi main ek jaati banaaunga, kyonki vah tumhaara hai.”
Tab Abraham ne jaldi uthkar khaana aur paani dekar haagaar aur uske son ko vahaan se chale jaane ko kaha haagaar vahaan se nikal gai aur bearsheba ke sunsaan raaste mein bhatakti rahi.
Aur jab paani khatm ho gaya, usne apne bete ko ek jhaari ki chhaanv mein leta diya.
Vah khud ek tir ki duri mein jaakar baith gai, kyonki vah soch rahi thi, “Main apne bete ka rona aur uski pareshaani nahin dekh paaungi.” Aur vahaan baithte hi vah phut-phutkar rone lagi.
God ne us bete ka rona suna aur heaven se God ke dut ne haagaar se puchha, “He haagaar, kya hua tumhein? Daro mat; kyonki jahaan tera beta para hai, vahaan se God ne uske rone ko sun liya hain.
Ab utho, apne bete ko uthaao, kyonki main usse ek bari jaati banaaunga.”
Yah kahte hue God ne haagaar ko ek kuna dikhaaya. Usne us kuein se paani lekar apne bete ko pilaaya.
Vah beta God ke grace se bara ho gaya aur vah dhanurdhaari bana.
Vah paaraan ke nirjan desh mein rahta tha. Uski maata ne uske lie misr desh se hi shaadi ke lie larki dhunrh li.
Abimelek aur uski sena ke senaapti phikol ne Abraham se kaha, “Aapke sab kaamon mein God ki blessing rahi hai.
Isliye aap hamse vaayda kijiye ki aap mujhe, mere vanshjon se ya meri bhaavi pirhiyon se kabhi dhokha nahin kareinge, lekin aap ham sab par daya karna-jaisa mainne aapse kiya tha.”
Abraham ne kaha, “Main aapse vaayda karta hun.”
Aur Abraham ne abimelek se us kuein ke baare mein kaha, jise abimelek ke servants ne le liya tha.
Abimelek ne javaab diya, “Na to aapne mujhe iske baare mein kabhi bataaya, na aaj tak mainne is baare mein suna hai aur na mujhe yah baat maalum hai.”
Abraham ne abimelek ko bheint mein bherein aur bachhre die aur donon ne vaayda kiya.
Phir Abraham ne saat memnon ko alag kiya,
Abimelek ne Abraham se puchha, “Kya matlab hai in saat memnon ko alag karne ka?”
Abraham ne kaha, “Ki aap ye saat memne lein taaki yah hamaare bich sabut hoga, ki yah kuna mainne khoda hai.”
Isliye Abraham ne us jagah ka naam bearsheba rakha, kyonki yahaan un donon ne yah shapath li thi.
Ath un donon ne bearsheba mein yah vaacha sthaapit ki. Phir abimelek aur uska senaapti phikol philistiya desh chale.
Abraham ne bearsheba mein ek jhaau ka per lagaaya aur vahaan usne Yahweh, sanaatan God ki worship ki.
Aur bahut samay tak Abraham philistiya desh mein raha.
Abraham bahut burhe ho gaye the, aur Yahweh ne unhein sab tarah se blessed kiya tha.
Abraham ne apne puraane servant se, jo ghar ki aur pure property ki dekhbhaal karta tha, kaha, “Tum apna haath meri jaangh ke niche rakho.
Main chaahta hun ki tum heaven aur prithvi ke God Yahweh ki shapath khaao ki tum in kanaaniyon ki putriyon mein se, jinke bich ham rah rahe hain, mere bete ki shaadi nahin karaaoge,
Lekin tum mere desh mein mere rishtedaaron mein se mere bete yitshaak ke lie patni laaoge.”
Us servant ne Abraham se puchha, “Us situation mein main kya karun, jab vah aurat is desh mein aana hi na chaahe; kya main aapke son ko us desh mein le jaaun, jahaan se aap aae hain?”
Is par Abraham ne kaha, “Tum mere son ko vahaan kabhi nahin le jaana.

Yahweh, jo heaven ke God hain, jo mujhe mere pita ke parivaar aur meri janmbhumi se laaye hain aur jinhonne shapath khaakar mujhse yah vaayda kiya, ‘Yah desh main tumhaare vansh ko dunga’—ve hi angel ko tumhaare aage-aage bhejeinge aur tum mere son ke lie vahaan se ek patni lekar aaoge.
Agar kanya tumhaare saath aane ke lie mana kare, tab tum meri is shapath se mukt ho jaaoge. Lekin dhyaan rakhna ki tum mere son ko vaapas vahaan na le jaana.”
Isliye us servant ne apne maalik Abraham ki jaangh ke niche apna haath rakha aur is baare mein shapath khaakar Abraham se vaayda kiya.
Tab us servant ne apne maalik ke unt ke jhund mein se das unton ko liya aur un par apne maalik ki or se vibhinn uphaar laada aur naahor ke grihangar uttar-pashchim mesopotaamiya ki or prasthaan kiya.
Shehar ke baahar pahunchkar usne unton ko kuein ke paas baitha diya; yah shaam ka samay tha. Isi samay striyaan paani bharne baahar aaya karti thin.
Tab servant ne prayer ki, “Yahweh, mere maalik Abraham ke God, mere kaam ko saphal karein aur mere maalik Abraham par daya karein.
Aap dekh rahe hain ki main is paani ke sote ke nikat khara hun, aur is nagarvaasiyon ki kanyaaein paani bharne ke lie nikalkar a rahi hain.

Aap kuchh aisa kijie ki jis kanya se main yah kahun, ‘Apna ghara jhukaakar kripya mujhe paani pila de,’ Aur vah kanya kahe, ‘Aap paani pi lijie, aur phir main aapke unton ko bhi paani pila dungi’—yah vahi kanya ho jise aapne apne servant yitshaak ke lie chuna hai. Iske dvaara mujhe yah faith ho jaaega ki aapne mere maalik par apni mercy dikhaai hai.”
Iske purv ki uski prayer khatm hoti, rebekaah shehar ke baahar apne kandhe par ghara lekar paani bharne aai. Vah milkaah ke son bethuel ki putri thi aur milkaah Abraham ke bhaai naahor ki patni thi.
Rebekaah bahut sundar thi, kunvaari thi; ab tak kisi aadmi se uska sansarg nahin hua tha. Vah niche sote par gai, apna ghara paani se bhara aur phir upar a gai.
Servant daurkar uske nikat aaya aur usse kaha, “Kripya apne ghare se mujhe thora paani pila do.”
Rebekaah ne kaha, “He mere Lord lijie, pijiye” Aur usne turant ghare ko niche karke use paani pilaaya.
Jab vah servant ko paani pila chuki, tab rebekaah ne usse kaha, “Main aapke unton ke lie bhi paani lekar aati hun, jab tak ve pure tript na ho jaaein.”
Usne bina der kie ghare ka paani haude mein undelkar vaapas sote par aur paani bharne gai, aur uske saare unton ke liye paryaapt paani le aai.
Jab yah sab ho raha tha, bina ek word kahe, us servant dhyaan se rebekaah ko dekhkar soch raha tha ki Yahweh ne uski yaatra ko saphal kiya hai ya nahin.
Jab unton ne paani pi liya, tab servant ne aadha shekel sone ki ek nath aur das shekel sone ke do kangan nikaala.
Aur rebekaah ko dekar usse puchha, “Tum kiski beti ho? Kripya mujhe bataao, kya tumhaare pita ke ghar mein is raat thaharne ke lie jagah hai?”
Rebekaah ne javaab diya, “Main naahor aur milkaah ke son bethuel ki beti hun.”
Aur usne yah bhi kaha, “Hamaare yahaan ghaas aur chaara bahut hai, aur raat mein thaharne ke liye jagah bhi hai.”
Tab us servant ne jhukkar aur yah kahkar Yahweh ki worship ki,
“Blessed hain Yahweh, mere maalik Abraham ke God, jinhonne mere maalik ke prati apne love aur mercy ko nahin hataaya. Yahweh mujhe sahi jagah par laaye jo mere maalik ke rishtedaaron ka hi ghar hai.”
Vah kanya daurkar apne ghar gai aur apni maata ke ghar ke logon ko sab baatein bataai.
Rebekaah ke bhaai laabaan daurkar kuein ke paas gae jahaan servant tha.

Jab usne nath aur apni bahan ke haathon mein kangan dekha aur jo baat servant ne kahi thi, use suni, tab vah us servant ke paas gaya, aur dekha ki vah servant sote ke nikat unton ke baaju mein khara hai.
Laabaan ne servant se kaha, “He Yahweh ke blessed jan, mere saath chalie! Aap yahaan baahar kyon khare hain? Mainne ghar ko, aur unton ke thaharne ke liye bhi jagah taiyaar ki hai.”
Vah servant laabaan ke saath ghar aaya aur unton par se saamaan utaara gaya. Unton ke liye painra aur chaara laaya gaya. Servant aur uske saath ke logon ke liye pair dhone hetu paani diya gaya.
Tab servant ko khaana diya gaya, par usne kaha, “Main tab tak khaana na karunga, jab tak ki main apne aane ka prayojan na bata dun.” Laabaan ne kaha, “Thik hai, bata dein.”
Tab usne kaha, “Main Abraham ka servant hun.
Yahweh ne mere maalik ko bahut blessing di hain, jisse ve dhanvaan ho gae hain. Yahweh ne unhein bahut bher-bakri aur pashu, sona aur chaandi, servant aur sevikaaein aur unt aur gadhe diye hain.
Mere maalik ki patni saaraah ko vriddhaavastha mein ek beta paida hua, aur Abraham ne use apna sab kuchh de diya hai.
Aur mere maalik ne mujhe shapath dilaakar kaha, ‘Tum mere son ki patni banne ke lie kanaaniyon ki kisi beti ko, jinke bich main rahta hun, na laana,
Par tum mere pita ke parivaar, mere apne vansh mein jaana, aur mere son ke lie ek patni laana.’
“Tab mainne apne maalik se puchha, ‘Yadi vah yuvti mere saath aana nahin chaahegi, tab kya?’

“Mere maalik ne kaha, ‘Yahweh, jinke saamne main imaandaari se chalta aaya hun, ve apne angel ko tumhaare saath bhejeinge aur tumhaari yaatra ko saphal kareinge, taaki tum mere son ke lie mere apne vansh aur mere pita ke parivaar se ek patni la sako.
Tum mere is shapath se tab hi chhut paaoge, jab tum mere vansh ke logon ke paas jaaoge, aur yadi ve us kanya ko tumhaare saath bhejne ke lie mana karein—tab tum mere shapath se chhut jaaoge.’
“Aaj jab main kuein ke paas pahuncha, to mainne yah prayer ki, ‘Yahweh, mere maalik Abraham ke God, main jis purpose se yahaan aaya hun, vah kaam pura ho jaaye.
Dekhiye, main is kuein ke kinaare khara hun. Yadi koi kanya nikalkar paani bharne ke liye aati hai aur main usse kahta hun, “Grace karke mujhe apne ghare se thora paani pila de,”
Aur yadi vah mujhse kahti hai, “Pijiye, aur main aapke unton ke liye bhi paani lekar aati hun,” To vah vahi kanya ho, jise Yahweh ne mere maalik ke bete ke liye chuna hai.’

“Iske pahle ki main apne man mein yah prayer khatm karta, rebekaah apne kandhe par ghara liye nikalkar aai. Vah niche sote ke paas jaakar paani bharne lagi, aur mainne usse kaha, ‘Kripya mujhe thora paani pila do.’
“Tab usne turant apne kandhe mein se ghare ko jhukaakar kaha, ‘Pi lijiye, aur phir main aapke unton ko bhi paani pila dungi.’ Tab mainne paani piya, aur usne unton ko bhi paani pilaaya.
“Tab mainne usse puchha, ‘Tum kiski beti ho?’ “Usne kaha, ‘Main bethuel ki beti hun, jo naahor aur milkaah ke son hai.’ “Tab mainne uske naak mein nath aur uske haathon mein kangan pahna die,

Aur mainne jhukkar Yahweh ki worship ki. Mainne Yahweh, apne maalik Abraham ke God ki glory ki, jinhonne mujhe sahi raasta mein aguvaai ki, taaki main apne maalik ke bhaai ki natnin ko apne maalik ke bete ke liye patni ke taur par le ja sakun.
Isliye ab, yadi aap mere maalik ke prati daya aur sach dikhaana chaahte hain, to mujhe bataaiye; aur yadi nahin, to vah bhi bataaiye, ki kis raaste par murna hai.”
Yah sab sunkar laabaan aur bethuel ne kaha, “Yah sab Yahweh ki or se hua hai; ham tumse achchha ya bura kuchh nahin kah sakte.
Rebekaah tumhaare saamne hai; ise apne saath le jaao, taaki vah tumhaare maalik ke son ki patni ho jaae, jaisa ki Yahweh ne nirdesh diya hai.”
Unki baaton ko sunkar Abraham ke servant ne zameen par jhukkar Yahweh ko dandvat kiya.
Tab servant ne sone aur chaandi ke gahne aur kapde nikaalkar rebekaah ko die; usne rebekaah ke bhaai aur uski maata ko bhi bahumuly vastuein di.
Phir usne aur uske saath ke logon ne khaaya piya aur vahaan raat bitaai. Agle din subah jab ve sokar uthe to servant ne kaha, “Mujhe apne maalik ke paas vaapas jaane ke lie vida kijiye.”
Par rebekaah ke bhaai aur uski maan ne kaha, “Kanya ko hamaare saath kuchh din arthaat kam se kam das din rahne do; tab use le jaana.”
Par servant ne unse kaha, “Mujhe mat rokie; kyonki Yahweh ne meri is yaatra ko saphal kiya hai. Mujhe apne maalik ke paas laut jaane ke liye vida kijie.”
Tab unhonne kaha, “Ham rebekaah ko bulaakar iske baare mein usse puchhte hain.”
Tab unhonne rebekaah ko bulaakar usse puchha, “Kya tum is person ke saath jaaogi?” Usne kaha, “Haan, main jaaungi.”
Isliye unhonne apni bahan rebekaah ko uski parichaarika aur Abraham ke servant aur uske logon ke saath vida kiya.
Aur unhonne rebekaah ko aashirvaad dete hue kaha, “He hamaari bahan, tumhaara vansh hajaaron hajaar ki sankhya mein barhe; tumhaara vansh apne dushmanon ke shehar par authority karne paaye.”
Tab rebekaah aur uski parichaarikaaein taiyaar huin aur unton par charhkar us person ke saath gain aur vah servant rebekaah ko lekar ravaana ho gaya.
Yitshaak baer-lahaai-roi se aakar ab negev mein nivaas kar rahe the.
Ek shaam jab ve chintan karne maidaan mein gaye the, tab unhonne unton ko aate hue dekha.
Rebekaah ne bhi aankh uthaakar yitshaak ko dekha aur vah apne unt par se niche utri

Aur servant se puchha, “Maidaan mein vah kaun person hai, jo hamse milne a rahe hain?” Servant ne javaab diya, “Ve mere maalik hain.” Yah sunkar rebekaah ne apna ghunghat liya aur apne aapko dhaamp liya.
Tab servant ne yitshaak ko ve sab baatein bataai, jo usne kiya tha.

Tab yitshaak rebekaah ko apni maan saaraah ke tambu mein le aaya, aur usne rebekaah se shaadi ki. Vah uski patni ho gai, aur usne usse love kiya; is tarah yitshaak ko uski maata ki maut ke baad saantvna mili.
Abraham ne apni puri property yitshaak ko saump di thi.
Lekin Abraham ne apni rakhailon ki santaanon ko apne jivankaal mein hi uphaar dekar unhein apne son yitshaak se dur purv ke desh mein bhej diya tha.
Abraham ki umr ek sau pachhattar saal ki thi.
Tab Abraham ne apni puri vriddhaavastha mein aakhiri saans li, ek vriddh person ke taur par unki puri aayu mein maut hui; aur ve apne logon mein ja mile.
Unke son yitshaak aur ishmaael ne unhein mamre ke paas maakhpelaah ke gupha mein mitti di, jo hitti zohaar ke son ephron ke khet mein thi,
Yah vahi khet tha, jise Abraham ne hittiyon se kharida tha. Vahaan unki patni saaraah ke paas Abraham daphnaaya gaya.
Abraham ki maut ke baad, God ne unke son yitshaak ko blessing di, jo us samay baer-lahaai-roi mein rahta tha.
Abraham ke son yitshaak ki vanshaavli is tarah hai: Abraham se yitshaak ka janm hua.
Paddan-araamvaasi araami bethuel ki putri aur araami laabaan ki bahan rebekaah se vivaah karte samay yitshaak ki aayu chaalis varsh thi.
Yitshaak ne apni patni ki or se Yahweh se prayer ki, kyonki vah baanjh thi. Yahweh ne uski prayer sun li aur uski patni rebekaah garbhavti hui.
Bachche uske garbh mein ek dusre ko dhakka dete rahte the. Tab rebekaah ne kaha, “Yah kya ho raha hai mere saath?” Aur vah Yahweh se puchhne gai.
Yahweh ne usse kaha, “Tumhaare garbh mein do jaatiyaan hain, tummein se do janta ke log nikalkar alag honge; ek samuh ke log dusre se adhik balvaan honge, aur bara chhote ki service karega.”
Jab uske prasav ka samay aaya. Uske garbh mein jurvaan bachche the.
Jo pahla beta hua vah laal tha, aur uska pura body baalon se bhara tha; is kaaran uska naam esaav rakha gaya.
Iske baad, uske bhaai ka janm hua, jo apne haath se apne bhaai esaav ki eri pakre hue tha; tab uska naam Yaakob rakha gaya. Jab rebekaah ne bachchon ko janm diya, tab yitshaak ki umr saath varsh thi.
Donon bachche bare hote gaye, aur esaav khule maidaan ka ek kushal shikaari ban gaya, jabki Yaakob ghar mein tambuon ke bich rahkar santusht rahta tha.
Esaav yitshaak ka dear tha kyonki yitshaak ko aakhet ka maans bahut achchha lagta tha, par Yaakob rebekaah ka dear tha.
Ek baar jab Yaakob dhimi aanch mein kuchh paka raha tha, tab esaav baahar maidaan se aaya aur vah bahut bhukha tha.
Usne Yaakob se kaha, “Mujhe bahut bhukh lagi hai; tum jo paka rahe ho, jaldi karke usmein se mujhe kuchh khaane ko do.” (yahi kaaran hai ki use edom bhi kaha gaya.)
Lekin Yaakob ne usse kaha, “Pahle aap apne pahlauthe ka authority mujhe de do.”
Esaav ne kaha, “Dekh, bhukh se mere jaan nikal rahe hain; pahlauthe ke authority se mujhe kya phaayda hai?”
Par Yaakob ne kaha, “To pahle aap mujhse shapath khaaiye.” Tab esaav ne shapath khaakar apne pahlauthe ka authority Yaakob ke haath bech diya.
Tab Yaakob ne esaav ko kuchh roti aur pakaai hui daal di. Esaav ne khaaya piya, aur uthkar chala gaya. Is tarah esaav ne apne pahlauthe ke authority ko tuchchh samjha.

Jab yitshaak vriddh ho gaye the aur unki aankhein itni kamjor ho gain ki vah dekh nahin sakte the, tab unhonne apne bare bete esaav ko bulaaya aur kaha, “He mere son.” Unhonne kaha, “Kya command hai pitaaji?”
Yitshaak ne kaha, “Main to burha ho gaya hun aur nahin jaanta ki kab mar jaaunga.
Isliye ab tum apna hathiyaar—apna tarkash aur dhanush lo aur khule maidaan mein jaao aur mere liye koi van pashu shikaar karke le aao.
Aur meri pasand ke hisaab se svaadisht khaana banaakar mere paas le aana ki main use khaaun aur apne marne se pahle tumhein blessing dun.”
Jab yitshaak apne son esaav se baatein kar rahe the, tab rebekaah unki baaton ko sun rahi thi. Jab esaav khule maidaan mein shikaar laane ke lie chala gaya,
Tab rebekaah ne apne son Yaakob se kaha, “Dekh, mainne tumhaare pita ko tumhaare bhaai esaav se yah kahte hue suna hai,
‘Shikaar karke mere liye svaadisht khaana banaakar la ki main use khaaun aur apne marne se pahle Yahweh ke saamne tumhein blessing dun.’
Isliye, he mere son, ab dhyaan se meri baat sun aur jo main kahti hun use kar:
Jaanavron ke jhund mein jaakar do achchhe chhote bakre le a, taaki main tumhaare pita ke lie unke pasand ke hisaab se svaadisht khaana bana dun.
Tab tum us khaana ko apne pita ke paas le jaana, taaki vah use khaakar apne marne se pahle tumhein apni blessing dein.”
Yaakob ne apni maata rebekaah se kaha, “Par mere bhaai ke body mein pure baal hain, lekin meri tvacha chikni hai.
Yadi mere pita mujhe chhueinge tab kya hoga? Main to dhokha denevaala thahrunga aur blessing ke badle apne upar shaap laaunga.”
Tab uski maan ne kaha, “Mere son, tumhaara shaap mujh par a jaae. Main jaisa kahti hun tu vaisa hi kar; ja aur unko mere liye le a.”
Isliye Yaakob jaakar unko laaya aur apni maan ko de diya, aur usne Yaakob ke pita ki pasand ke hisaab se svaadisht khaana taiyaar kiya.
Tab rebekaah ne apne bare bete esaav ke sabse achchhe kapre ghar se laakar apne chhote bete Yaakob ko pahna die.
Usne bakri ke khaalon se uske chikne bhaag aur gale aur gale ke chikne bhaag ko bhi dhank diya.
Tab usne apni pakaai svaadisht maans ko aur roti lekar Yaakob ko di.
Apne pita ke paas jaakar Yaakob ne kaha, “Pitaaji.” Yitshaak ne javaab diya, “Haan beta, kaun ho tum?”

Yaakob ne apne pita ko javaab diya, “Main aapka bara beta esaav hun. Mainne vah sab kiya hai, jaisa aapne kaha tha. Kripya baithiye aur mere shikaar se pakaaya khaana kijiye aur mujhe apni blessing dijiye.”
Yitshaak ne apne son se puchha, “Mere son, yah tumhein itni jaldi kaise mil gaya?” Yaakob ne kaha, “Yahweh aapke God ne mujhe saphalta di.”
Tab yitshaak ne Yaakob se kaha, “He mere son, mere paas a, taaki main tumhein chhukar jaan sakun ki tu sahi mein mera son esaav hai ya nahin.”
Tab Yaakob apne pita yitshaak ke paas gaya, jisne use chhua aur kaha, “Aavaaj to Yaakob ki hai lekin haath esaav ke haath jaise hain.”
Yitshaak ne use nahin pahchaana, kyonki uske haath mein vaise hi baal the jaise esaav ke the. Islie yitshaak use blessing dene ke lie aage barha.
Yitshaak ne puchha, “Kya tu sahi mein mera son esaav hai?” Yaakob ne javaab diya, “Main hun.”

Tab yitshaak ne kaha, “He mere son, apne shikaar se pakaaye kuchh khaana mere khaane ke liye la, taaki main tumhein apni blessing dun.” Yaakob apne pita ke paas khaana laaya aur usne khaaya; aur vah daakhras bhi laaya aur usne piya.
Tab uske pita yitshaak ne usse kaha, “He mere son, yahaan a aur mujhe chum.”

Isliye Yaakob uske paas gaya aur use chuma. Jab yitshaak ko uske kapron se esaav ki gandh aai, isliye usne use blessing dete hue kaha, “Mere bete ki khushbu Yahweh ki blessing se maidaan mein phail gai hai.
Ab God tumhein aakaash ki os, prithvi ki achchhi upaj aur ann aur naye daakhras se blessed kareinge.

Sabhi raashtr tumhaari service kareinge, jaati-jaati ke log tumhaare saamne jhukeinge, tum apne bhaaiyon ke upar shaasak honge; tumhaari maan ke son tumhaare saamne jhukeinge. Jo tumhein shaap deinge ve khud shaapit honge aur jo tumhein blessing deinge ve blessing paayeinge.”
Jaise hi yitshaak Yaakob ko blessing de chuke tab unka bhaai esaav shikaar karke ghar aaya.
Unhonne jaldi svaadisht khaana taiyaar kiya aur apne pita se kaha “Pitaaji, uthie aur svaadisht khaana khaakar mujhe apni blessing dijie.”
Uske pita yitshaak ne unse puchha, “Kaun ho tum?” Usne kaha, “Main aapka beta hun, aapka bara beta esaav.”
Yah sun yitshaak kaampte hue bole, “To vah kaun tha, jo mere lie khaana laaya tha? Aur mainne use blessed bhi kiya, ab vah blessed hi rahega!”
Apne pita ki ye baat sunkar esaav phut-phutkar rone laga aur apne pita se kaha, “Pitaaji, mujhe blessing dijie, mujhe bhi!”
Yitshaak ne kaha, “Tumhaare bhaai ne dhokha kiya aur blessing le li.”

Esaav ne kaha, “Uske lie Yaakob naam sahi nahin hai? Do baar usne mere saath bura kiya: pahle usne mere bare hone ka authority le liya aur ab meri blessing bhi chhin li!” Tab esaav ne apne pita se puchha, “Kya aapne mere lie ek bhi blessing nahin bachaai?”

Yitshaak ne esaav se kaha, “Main to use tumhaara maalik bana chuka hun. Aur sabhi sambandhiyon ko uska servant banaakar use saump diya aur use ann aur naye daakhras se bhare rahne ki blessing di hain. Ab mere son, tumhaare lie main kya karun?”
Esaav ne apne pita se puchha, “Pitaaji, kya aapke paas mere lie ek bhi blessing nahin? Aur vah rota hua kahne laga ki pitaaji mujhe bhi blessing dijie!”
Tab yitshaak ne kaha, “Tumhaara ghar achchhi upaj vaali zameen par ho aur us par aakaash se os gire.
Tum apni talvaar ki taakat se jivit rahoge. Tum apne bhaai ki service karoge; lekin haan, lekin tum aazaadi ke lie laroge, aur tum apne upar pare uske pratibandh ko tor pheinkoge.”
Esaav apne bhaai Yaakob se nafrat karne laga aur man mein aisa sochne laga, “Pita ki maut shok ke din nazdik hai, unke baad main Yaakob ki murder kar dunga.”

Jab rebekaah ko apne bare bete ki ye baatein bataai gain tab usne servant bhejkar apne chhote son yaakub ko bulvaakar usse kaha, “Tumhaare bhaai esaav ke man mein tumhaare lie bahut nafrat hain. Suno, tumhaara bhaai esaav tumhein maarne ka sharyantr kar raha hai.
Isliye tum yahaan se bhaagkar mere bhaai laabaan ke yahaan chale jaao.
Vahaan jaakar kuchh samay raho, jab tak tumhaare bhaai ka gussa khatm na ho jaae.
Jab tumhaare bhaai ka gussa khatm hoga, aur bhul jaayega ki tumne uske saath kya kiya, tab main tumhein vahaan se bula lungi. Main ek hi din tum donon ko kyon kho dun?”

Ek din rebekaah ne yitshaak se kaha, “Heth ki in putriyon ne mera life duhkhi kar diya hai. Yadi Yaakob bhi heth ki putriyon mein se kisi ko, apni patni bana lega to mere lie jina aur mushkil ho jaaega?” Isliye Yaakob ko uske maama ke ghar bhej do.
Isliye yitshaak ne Yaakob ko blessing di aur kaha: “Kanaani kanyaaon se shaadi mat karna.
Par paddan-araam mein apne naana bethuel ke yahaan chale jaao. Aur vahaan apne maama laabaan ki putriyon mein se kisi se vivaah kar lena.
Sarvshaktimaan God ki daya tum par bani rahe aur sukh aur shaanti se aage barho.
God tumhein ve aashishein dein, jinhein unhonne Abraham ko di thi, tumhein aur tumhaare vansh ko, us desh ka adhikaari banaaye.”
In sab blessed vachan ke saath yitshaak ne Yaakob ko vida kiya. Yaakob apni aur esaav ki maata rebekaah ke bhaai araamvaasi laabaan ke yahaan chale gae, jo paddan-araam ke bethuel ke son the.
Esaav ko maalum ho gaya tha ki yitshaak ne Yaakob ko blessing dekar paddan-araam mein bheja hai taaki vah apne lie patni chune, aur order bhi diya hai ki vah kanaani aurat se vivaah na kare,
Aur Yaakob apne pita aur maata ki baat ko maante hue paddan-araam mein chale gaye.
Tab esaav ko yah samajh mein a gaya, ki uske pita ko kanaan desh ki kanyaaein pasand nahin hain.
Isliye esaav ne apni patniyon ke alaava Abraham ke son ishmaael ki putri maahaalaath se, jo nebaaiyoth ki bahan thi, vivaah kar liya.
Yaakob bearsheba se haaraan ki or gae.
Jab vah ek jagah pahuncha tab raat ko unhein vahaan rukna para, kyonki tab tak suraj dhal chuka tha. Unhonne ek patthar apne sir ke niche rakha aur let gae.
Tab unhonne ek svapn dekha: ek sirhi prithvi par khari hai, uska dusra sira heaven tak pahuncha hua tha. Unhonne dekha ki God ke angel is par charh rahe aur utar rahe hain.

Unhonne dekha ki upar Yahweh khare hain, aur kah rahe hain, “Main hi Yahweh hun, tumhaare pita Abraham aur yitshaak ka God. Jis zameen par tum is samay lete hue ho, main vah zameen tumhein aur tumhaare vansh ko dunga.
Tumhaara vansh zameen ki dhul ke jaisa blessed hokar prithvi ke chaaron dishaaon mein phail jaayega. Prithvi par sabhi log tumhaare aur tumhaare vansh ke dvaara blessed honge.
Main tumhaare saath rahunga aur jahaan kahin tum jaaoge, main tumhaari raksha karunga. Aur tumhein isi desh mein lauta le aaunga. Jab tak main apni baat puri na kar lun tab tak tumhein na chhodunga.”
Achaanak Yaakob ki nind khul gai aur kaha, “Nishchay is jagah par Yahweh ki upasthiti hai aur mujhe yah maalum hi na tha.”
Yaakob bhaybhit hokar kahne lage, “Anokha hai yah jagah! Yah God ke bhavan ke alaava kuchh aur nahin ho sakta; zarur yah heaven ka dvaar hi hoga.”
Yaakob ne us patthar ko, jise usne apne sir ke niche rakha tha, ek stambh ke jaise khara kar us par tel daala,
Yaakob ne us jagah ka naam bethel rakha; jabki us jagah ka naam luz tha.
Phir Yaakob ne pran liya, “Yadi God ki upasthiti mere saath saath bani rahegi, aur mujhe surakshit rakheinge, mujhe khaana aur kapdon ki kami nahin hogi
Aur mujhe mere pita ke ghar tak surakshit pahuncha deinge, to Yahweh hi mere God honge.
Yah patthar, jise mainne stambh banaakar khara kiya hai, God ka bhavan hoga aur aap mujhe jo kuchh deinge, nishchyath main uska dashmaansh aapko hi samarpit karunga.”
Yaakob apni yaatra mein aage barhte gae aur purvi desh mein ja pahunche.
Tab unhein maidaan mein ek kuna aur bher-bakriyon ke tin jhund baithe nazar aaye aur unhonne dekha ki jis kuein se bher-bakriyon ko paani pilaate the us kuein par bara patthar rakha hua tha.
Jab bher-bakriyaan ek saath ikatthi ho jaatin tab kuein se patthar hataakar bher-bakriyon ko paani pilaaya jaata tha, phir patthar kuein par vaapas lurhka diya jaata tha.
Yaakob ne charvaahon se puchha, “Mere bhaaiyo, aap kahaan se aae hain?” Unhonne kaha, “Ham haaraan ke hain.”
Yaakob ne puchha, “Kya aap naahor ke pote laabaan ko jaante hain?” Unhonne kaha, “Haan, ham jaante hain.”
Phir Yaakob ne puchha, “Kya ve thik hain?” Unhonne kaha, “Ve thik hain aur unki beti raahel apni bheron ke saath yahaan a rahi hai.”
Yaakob ne kaha, “Dekho, suraj abhi bhi uncha hai, abhi to shaam nahin hui phir itni jaldi bher-bakriyon ko kyon ikattha kar rahe ho, abhi unhein paani pilaakar charne do.”
Lekin unhonne kaha, “Nahin, sab bher-bakriyaan ek saath aane par hi kuein se patthar hataakar bher-bakriyon ko paani pilaaya jaata hai.”
Jab ve baat kar rahe the, raahel apne pita ki bherein lekar vahaan a gai, kyonki vah pashu charaaya karti thi.
Jab Yaakob ne apni maata ke bhaai laabaan ki putri aur bher-bakri ko dekha, to unhonne jaakar kuein ke chehra se patthar hataaya aur bher-bakriyon ko paani pilaane lage.
Tab Yaakob ne raahel ko chumban diya aur rone lage.
Yaakob ne raahel ko bataaya, ki vah uske pita ke sambandhi hain, aur rebekaah ke son hain. Raahel daurti hui apne pita ko yah bataane gai.

Jab laabaan ne apni bahan ke son Yaakob ke baare mein suna, vah bhi daurkar unse milne aaye. Unhonne Yaakob ko chumban diya aur unhein apne ghar par laae. Yaakob ne laabaan ko apne baare mein bataaya.
Laabaan ne Yaakob se kaha, “Nihsandeh tum meri hi haddi aur maans ho.”
Tab laabaan ne Yaakob se kaha, “Yadypi tum mere sambandhi ho, yah achchha nahin ki mere lie tum bina vetan ke kaam karte raho! Isliye tum vetan lekar hi kaam karna!”
Laabaan ki do putriyaan thin. Bari ka naam liyaah aur chhoti ka naam raahel tha.
Liyaah ki aankhein dhundhli thi par raahel sundar thi.
Yaakob raahel ko chaahne lage, Yaakob ne laabaan se kaha, “Aapki chhoti beti raahel ko paane ke lie main saat varsh aapki service karne ko taiyaar hun.”
Laabaan ne kaha, “Main raahel ko kisi dusre aadmi ko dene se tumko dena behtar hai. Tum yahin hamaare saath raho.”
Isliye Yaakob ne raahel ko paane ke lie saat varsh service ki, lekin use yah samay bahut kam laga kyonki vah raahel se bahut love karta tha.
Phir Yaakob ne laabaan se kaha, “Saat varsh ho gaye; ab aapki beti raahel mujhe dijie taaki usse meri shaadi ho jaaye.”
Laabaan ne apne samaaj ke logon ko bulaakar sabko khaana khilaaya.
Shaam ko usne apni beti liyaah ko Yaakob ko saump di aur Yaakob ne uske saath vivaah kiya.
Laabaan ne apni daasi zilpaah ko bhi liyaah ko uski daasi hone ke lie diya.

Jab Yaakob ko maalum para ki vah to liyaah thi, Yaakob ne laabaan se puchha, “Yah kya kiya aapne mere saath? Main aapki service raahel ke lie kar raha tha? Phir aapne mere saath aisa dhokha kyon kiya?”
Laabaan ne kaha, “Hamaare samaaj mein bari ko chhor pahle chhoti ki shaadi nahin kar sakte.
Vivaah ke utsav ko pure saptaah manaate raho aur main raahel ko bhi tumhein vivaah ke lie dunga; lekin tumhein aur saat varsh tak meri service karni paregi.”
Isliye Yaakob ne aisa hi kiya. Aur samaaroh ka vah saptaah pura kiya, tab laabaan ne Yaakob ko raahel patni svarup saump di.
Laabaan ne apni daasi bilhaah ko bhi raahel ki daasi hone ke lie use saump diya.
Yaakob raahel ke paas gaya aur use raahel liyaah se adhik dear thi. Aur usne laabaan ke lie aur saat saal service ki.
Jab Yahweh ne dekha ki liyaah ko pyaar nahin mil raha, Yahweh ne liyaah ko garbh se blessed kiya aur raahel ko baanjh kar diya.
Liyaah garbhavti hui aur usne ek bete ko janm diya aur uska naam riyuben yah kahkar rakha, “Yahweh ne mere duhkh ko dekha, aur ab mere pati zarur mujhse love kareinge.”
Liyaah ka ek aur son paida hua. Usne kaha, “Kyonki Yahweh ne yah sun liya ki main dear nahin hun aur mujhe yah ek aur son diya.” Usne uska naam Shimon rakha.

Liyaah phir se garbhavti hui aur jab uska ek son paida hua tab usne kaha, “Ab mere pati mujhse jur jaayeinge kyonki mainein unke tin sons ko janm diya hai.” Isliye liyaah ne tisre bete ka naam Levi rakha.
Usne ek aur bete ko janm diya aur kaha, “Ab main Yahweh ki praise karungi,” Isliye usne us bete ka naam Yahudah rakha. Uske baad liyaah ke bachche hone band ho gae.
Raahel ne yah dekha ki Yaakob ke lie uske dvaara koi children nahin hui, to use apni bahan se nafrat ho gai. Vah Yaakob se jhagarne lagi, “Mujhe children dijie, nahin to main mar jaaungi!”
Yah sun Yaakob gusse se chillaae aur kaha, “Kya main God ke jagah mein hun ki tumhaari band kokh kholun?”
God ne liyaah ki sun li. Usne garbhdhaaran kiya aur Yaakob ko paanchvaan son diya.
Is par liyaah ne kaha, “God ne mujhe meri majduri di hai kyonki mainne apni daasi mere pati ko di.” Aur isliye uska naam issaakhaar rakha.
Phir liyaah ne chhathe son ko janm diya.
Liyaah ne kaha, “God ne mujhe ek uttam bheint se sammaanit kiya hai. Ab mere pati meri kadr kareinge, kyonki mainne unko chhah son diye hain.” Aur isliye us son ka naam zebulun rakha.
Phir kuchh samay baad liya ki ek beti hui, uska naam dinaah rakha.
Iske baad God ne raahel par daya ki. God ne use garbhdhaaran karne ke lie saksham kiya.
Use ek beta hua, aur usne kaha, “God ne mera kalank mita diya hai.”
Yah kahte hue use Yosef naam diya ki Yahweh mujhe ek aur son dein.
Jab raahel ne Yosef ko janm diya, tab Yaakob ne laabaan se kaha, “Ab mujhe mere desh jaane dijie.
Mujhe meri patniyaan aur children de dijie, jiske lie mainne itne varsh aapki service ki hai. Jo service main aapke lie karta raha hun, vah aapko maalum hai.”
Lekin laabaan ne kaha, “Yahweh ki or se mujhe yah maalum hua hai, ki mujhe jo blessing mili hai, vah tumhaare hi kaaran mili hai. Isliye tum mujhse naaraaj nahin ho, to mere yahaan hi raho.”
Laabaan ne kaha, “Service ke badle tum kya chaahte ho, main tumhein vahi dunga.”
Lekin Yaakob ne laabaan se kaha, “Mainne aapki service kaise ki hai, yah baat aapse chhipi nahin hai, aur aapke pashu ki dekhrekh bhi mainne kaise ki hain.
Pahle pashu kam the lekin ab bahut jyaada ho gaye hain. Mainne jo bhi kaam kiya, usmein Yahweh ne blessing di hai. Lekin ab main apne gharaane ke baare mein sochna chaahta hun.”
Tab laabaan ne puchha, “Tumhaari majduri kya hogi?” Yaakob ne kaha, “Aap mujhe kuchh na dijie. Lekin, aap chaahein to aapke pashuon ki charvaahi aur dekhbhaal karta rahunga:
Aaj main bher-bakriyon mein se, dhaari vaale sab ek taraph aur bina dhaari vaale ek taraph karke alag karunga aur is tarah donon ko alag rakhkar unki dekhrekh karunga.

Jab aap meri majduri dene aaeinge tab in bher-bakriyon ko jo alag karke rakhi hain aap dekhna aur yadi in bher-bakriyon mein se koi dhaari vaali aur chitkabri na ho vah dikhe to use chori kiya hua maan lena.”
Laabaan ne javaab diya, “Thik hain, tum jaisa chaahte ho vaisa karo.”

Par us din laabaan ne dhaari vaale aur dhabbe yukt bakron aur sabhi chittiyukt aur dhabbe yukt bakriyon ko alag kar diya aur har ek, jis par shvet rang paaya gaya aur bheron mein se sabhi kaali bher alag kar in sabhi ko apne sons ko saump diya.
Tab unhonne apne va Yaakob ke bich tin din ki yaatra ki duri bana li. Ab Yaakob laabaan ki bach gai bher-bakriyon ki charvaahi karne lage.
Kuchh samay baad Yaakob ne chinaar, baadaam aur armon vriksh ki tahniyaan lekar unki chhaal chhil kar un par saphed dhaariyaan banaai isse un tahniyon ke andar ka saphed bhaag dikhne laga.
Phir Yaakob ne in chhariyon ko haudon mein saja diya, taaki ve sidhe bher-bakriyon ke saamne hon jahaan ve bherein paani piya karti thin.
Ve chhariyon ke saamne samaagam kiya aur bakriyaan gaabhin huin, aur jab bachche hote the to ve dhaariyukt, chittiyukt ya dhabbe yukt hote the.
Yaakob unko alag karte jaate the. Saath hi ve bheron ka chehra laabaan ki dhaariyukt aur puri kaali bheron ki or kar dete the. Is tarah vah apne pashu aur laabaan ke pashu ko alag rakhte the.
Jab taakatdaar bhere samaagam karte the, Yaakob unhin ke samaksh naandon mein ve chhariyaan rakh dete the, ki unka samaagam unhin chhariyon ke samaksh ho,

Lekin jab unke samaksh durbal bherein hoti thin, tab vah un chhariyon ko unke samaksh nahin rakhte the. Parinaamasvrup, sab durbal bherein laabaan ke paksh mein aur sashakt bherein Yaakob ke paksh mein a jaati thi.
Isliye Yaakob bahut dhani ho gaye, unke paas bahut bher-bakriyaan slave-daasiyaan, unt aur gadhe bhi the.

Yaakob ke kaanon mein yah samaachaar para ki laabaan ke son barabra rahe the, “Yaakob ne to vah sab harap liya hai, jo hamaare pita ka tha aur ab vah hamaare pita hi ki property ke aadhaar par samriddh bana baitha hai.”
Yahaan Yaakob ne paaya ki laabaan ki abhivritti unke prati ab pahle jaisi nahin rah gai thi.
Is situation ke prakaash mein Yahweh ne Yaakob ko order diya, “Apne pita aur apne sambandhiyon ke desh ko laut jaao. Main ismein tumhaare paksh mein hun.”
Isliye Yaakob ne raahel aur liyaah ko vahin bula liya, jahaan ve bher-bakriyon ke saath the.
Unhonne unse kaha, “Main tumhaare pita ki abhivritti spasht dekh raha hun; ab yah mere prati pahle jaisi sauhaardpurn nahin rah gai; lekin mere pita ke God mere saath rahe hain.
Tum donon ko hi yah uttam riti se jnaat hai ki mainne yathaashakti tumhaare pita ki service ki hai.
Itna hone par bhi tumhaare pita ne mere saath chhal kiya aur das avasron par mere paarishrmik mein parivartan kie hain; phir bhi God ne unhein meri koi haani na karne di.

Yadi unhonne kaha, ‘Chittiyukt pashu tumhaare paarishrmik honge,’ To sabhi bher chittiyukt memne hi paida karne lage; yadi unhonne kaha, ‘Achchha, dhaariyukt pashu tumhaara paarishrmik honge,’ To bher dhaariyukt memne utpann karne lage.
Yah to God ka hi krity tha, jo unhonne tumhaare pita ke ye pashu mujhe de die hain.
“Tab pashuon ke samaagam ke avsar par mainne ek svapn dekha ki ve bakre, jo sambhog kar rahe the, ve dhaariyukt, chittiyukt aur dhabbe yukt the.
God ke dut ne svapn mein mujhse kaha, ‘Yaakob,’ Mainne kaha, ‘Kya command hai, Lord?’

Aur usne kaha, ‘Yaakob, dekho-dekho, jitne bhi bakre is samay sambhog kar rahe hain, ve dhaariyukt hain, chittiyukt hain aur dhabbe yukt hain; kyonki mainne vah sab dekh liya hai, jo laabaan tumhaare saath karta raha hai.
Main bethel ka God hun, jahaan tumne us shilaakhand ka abhyanjan kiya tha, jahaan tumne mere samaksh sankalp liya tha; ab utho. Chhor do is jagah ko aur apne janmasthaan ko laut jaao.’ ”
Raahel aur liyaah ne unse kaha, “Kya ab bhi hamaare pita ki property mein hamaara koi ansh ya uttraadhikaar shesh rah gaya hai?
Kya ab ham unke aanklan mein videshi nahin ho gai hain? Unhonne hamein bech diya hai, aur hamaare ansh ki dhanraashi bhi harap li hai.
Nihsandeh ab to, jo property God ne hamaare pita se chhin li hai, hamaari aur hamaari children ki ho chuki hai. To aap vahi kijie, jiska nirdesh aapko God de chuke hain.”
Tab Yaakob ne apne baalkon aur patniyon ko unton par baitha diya,

Yaakob ne apne sab pashuon ko, apni sab property ko, jo unke vahaan rahte hue sanklit hoti gai thi aur vah pashu wealth, jo paddan-araam mein unke pravaaskaal mein sanklit hota chala gaya tha, in sabko lekar apne pita yitshaak ke aavaas kanaan ki or prasthaan kiya.
Jab laabaan un katarne ke lie baahar gaya hua tha, raahel ne apne pita ke grihdevta—pratimaaon ki chori kar li.
Tab Yaakob ne bhi araami laabaan ke saath pravanchna ki; Yaakob ne laabaan ko suchit hi nahin kiya ki ve palaayan kar rahe the.
Isliye Yaakob apni sab property ko lekar palaayan kar gae. Unhonne pharaat nadi paar ki aur parvtiy pradesh gilaaad ki disha mein aage barh gae.
Tisre din jab laabaan ko yah suchna di gai ki Yaakob palaayan kar chuke hain,
Tab laabaan ne apne sambandhiyon ko saath lekar Yaakob ka pichha kiya. Saat din pichha karne ke baad ve gilaaad ke parvtiy pradesh mein unke nikat pahunch gae.
God ne araami laabaan par raatri mein svapn mein reveal hokar use chetaavni di, “Saavdhaan rahna ki tum Yaakob se kuchh dear-apriy na kah baitho.”
Laabaan Yaakob tak ja pahuncha. Yaakob ke shivir parvtiy kshetr mein the aur laabaan ne bhi apne shivir apne sambandhiyon sadrish gilaaad ke parvtiy kshetr mein khare kie hue the.
Laabaan ne Yaakob se kaha, “Yah kya kar rahe ho tum? Yah to mere saath chhal hai! Tum to meri putriyon ko aise lie ja rahe ho, jaise yuddhbandiyon ko talvaar ke aatank mein le jaaya jaata hai.
Kya aavashyakta thi aise chhipkar bhaagne ki, mujhse chhal karne ki? Yadi tumne mujhe iski suchna di hoti, to main tumhein daph aur kinnor ki sangat par giton ke saath saharsh vida karta!
Tumne to mujhe suavsar hi na diya ki main apne son-putriyon ko chumban ke saath vida kar sakta. Tumhaara yah krity murkhtaapurn hai.
Mujhe yah authority hai ki tumhein iske lie prataarit karun; lekin tumhaare pita ke God ne kal raatri mujh par reveal hokar mujhe order diya hai ki main tumse kuchh bhi dear-apriy na kahun.
Thik hai, tumhein apne pita ke nikat rahne ki chaahat hai, maan liya; lekin kya aavashyakta thi tumhein mere grih-devtaaon ki chori karne ki?”
Tab Yaakob ne laabaan ko javaab diya, “Mere is tarah aane ka kaaran thi meri yah aashanka, ki aap mujhse apni putriyaan balaat chhin lete.

Lekin aapko jis kisi ke paas se ve grihdevta receive honge, use jivit na chhora jaaega. Aapke hi sambandhiyon ki upasthiti mein aap hamaari property mein se jo kuchh aapka hai, le lijie.” Yaakob ko is tathy ka koi sanjnaan na tha ki raahel ne un grih-devtaaon ki murtiyon ko churaai hain.

Isliye laabaan Yaakob ke shivir ke bhitar gaya, uske baad liyaah ke shivir mein, aur uske baad parichaarikaaon ke shivir mein. Lekin vah devta use vahaan receive na hua. Tab vah liyaah ke shivir se nikalkar raahel ke shivir mein gaya.

Raahel ne hi ve grihdevta chhipaae hue the, jinhein usne unt ki kaathi mein rakha hua tha. Vah khud un par baith gai thi. Laabaan ne sab shivir mein khoj kar li thi, lekin use kuchh receive na hua tha.

Usne apne pita se aagrah kiya, “Pitaaji, aap kruddh na hon. Main aapke samaksh khari hone ke asmarth hun; kyonki is samay main rajasvla hun.” Tab laabaan ke khojne par bhi use ve grih-devtaaon ki murtiyaan nahin milin.
Tab Yaakob ka krodh uddipt ho utha. Vah laabaan se tark-vitark karne lage, “Kya apraadh hai mera?” Kya galti kiya hai mainne, jo aap is tarah mera pichha karte hue a rahe hain?

Aapne meri sab vastuon mein un devtaaon ki khoj kar li hai, lekin aapko koi bhi apni vastu receive hui hai? Aapke aur mere sambandhiyon ke samaksh yah spasht ho jaae, ki ve ham donon ke beech apna nirnay de sakein.
“In bis varshon tak main aapke saath raha hun. Aapki bheron aur bakriyon mein kabhi garbhpaat nahin hua. Apne khaana ke lie mainne kabhi aapke pashuvrind mein se merhe nahin uthaae.

Jab kabhi kisi vany pashu ne hamaare pashu ko phaara, mainne use kabhi aapke vrind mein sammilit nahin kiya; ise mainne apni hi haani mein sammilit kiya tha. Chaahe koi pashu din mein chori hua ya raatri mein, aapne mujhse bhugtaan ki maang ki.
Meri situation to aisi rahi ki din mein mujh par ushma ka prahaar hota raha aur raatri mein thand ka. Mere netron se nidra dur hi dur rahi.

In bis varshon mein main aapke parivaar mein raha hun; chaudah varsh aapki putriyon ke lie aur chhah varsh aapke bher-bakriyon ke lie. In varshon mein aapne das baar mera paarishrmik parivartit kiya hai.

Yadi mere pita ke God, Abraham aur yitshaak ke God ka dar mere saath na hota, to aapne to mujhe rikt hast hi vida kar diya hota. God ne mere kasht aur mere haathon ke parishram ko dekha hai, aur uska pratiphal unhonne mujhe kal raat mein provide kar diya hai.”

Yah sab sunkar laabaan ne Yaakob ko javaab diya, “Ye striyaan meri putriyaan hain, ye baalak mere baalak hain, ye bher-bakriyaan bhi meri hi hain, aur jo kuchh tumhein dikhaai de raha hai, vah mera hi hai; lekin ab main apni putriyon aur in baalkon ka kya karun, jo inki santti hain?
Isliye aao, ham paraspar yah vaacha sthaapit kar lein, tum aur main, aur yahi hamaare beech saakshy ho jaae.”
Isliye Yaakob ne ek shilaakhand ko stambh svarup khara kiya.
Yaakob ne apne sambandhiyon se kaha, “Patthar ekatr karo.” Isliye unhonne patthar ekatr kar ek dher bana diya aur us dher ke nikat baith unhonne khaana kiya.
Laabaan ne to ise naam diya yegar-sahdutha lekin Yaakob ne ise galaed kahkar pukaara.
Laabaan ne kaha, “Patthron ka yah dher aaj mere aur tumhaare beech ek saakshy hai.” Isliye ise galaed aur mizpaah naam diya gaya,
Kyonki unka kathan tha, “Jab ham ek dusre ki nazar se dur hon, Yahweh hi tumhaare aur mere beech chauksi banaae rakhein.
Yadi tum meri putriyon ke saath durvyavhaar karo ya meri putriyon ke atirikt patniyaan le aao, yadypi koi insaan yah dekh na sakega, lekin smaran rahe, tumhaare aur mere beech God saakshy hain.”
Laabaan ne Yaakob se kaha, “Is dher ko aur is stambh ko dekho, jo mainne tumhaare aur mere beech mein sthaapit kiya hai.

Yah stambh aur patthron ka dher saakshy hai, ki main iske nikat se hokar tumhaari haani karne ke lakshy se aage nahin barhunga, vaise hi tum bhi is dher aur is stambh ke nikat se hokar meri haani ke purpose se aage nahin barhoge.
Iske lie Abraham ke God, naahor ke God aur unke pita ke God hamaara justice karein.” Isliye Yaakob ne apne pita yitshaak ke prati dar-bhaav mein shapath li.
Phir Yaakob ne us parvat par hi bali arpit ki aur apne sambandhiyon ko bhoj ke lie aamantrit kiya. Unhonne khaana kiya aur parvat par hi raatri vyatit ki.
Bare tarke laabaan utha, apne son-putriyon ka chumban liya aur unhein aashirvaad diya. Phir laabaan svadesh laut gaya.
Jab Yaakob apne desh ki or nikle tab raaste mein unki bheint God ke dut se hui.
Unhein dekhkar Yaakob ne kaha, “Yah God ka shivir hai!” Unhonne us jagah ko maahaanaaim naam diya.
Yaakob ne apne bhaai esaav ke paas edom ke seir desh mein dut bheje,
Aur unse kaha ki mera maalik esaav se yah kahna ki aapke servant Yaakob kahta hai, “Main laabaan ke yahaan paraaye hokar ab tak vahin raha.
Ab mere paas bail, gadhe aur aurat-aadmi va daasiyaan hain. Mere adhipti esaav ke paas dut bhejne ka kaaran yah tha ki aapki kripaadrishti mujh par bani rahe.”
Jab ve dut lautkar Yaakob ke paas aae aur unhein bataaya, “Ham aapke bhaai se mile. Ve aapse milne yahaan a rahe hain aur unke saath chaar sau logon ka jhund bhi hai.”
Yah sun Yaakob bahut dar gaye aur vyaakul ho gae. Unhonne apne saath chal rahe logon ko do bhaagon mein baant diya aur bher-bakriyon, gaay-bailon aur unton ke do samuh bana die.
Yah sochkar ki, agar esaav aakar ek jhund par aakrman karega, to dusra jhund bachkar bhaag jaayega.
Yaakob ne kaha, “He Yahweh, mere pita Abraham aur yitshaak ke God, aapne hi mujhe apne desh jaane ko kaha aur kaha ki main tumhein blessed karunga.
Aapne mujhe jitna love kiya, barhaaya aur blessed kiya, main uske yogy nahin hun, kyonki jaate samay mere paas ek chhari hi thi jisko lekar mainne yardan nadi paar ki thi aur
Ab main in do samuhon ke saath laut raha hun. Lord, meri binti hai ki aap mujhe mere bhaai esaav se bachaaein. Mujhe dar hai ki vah aakar mujh par, va in maataaon aur baalkon par aakrman karega.
Aapne kaha tha ki nishchay main tumhein barhaaunga aur tumhaare vansh ki sankhya saagar tat ke baalu jaisa kar dunga.”
Yaakob ne raat vahin bitaai. Aur unhonne apni property mein se apne bhaai esaav ko uphaar dene ke lie alag kiya:
Do sau bakriyaan aur bis bakre, do sau bherein aur bis merhe,
Tis dudhaar untniyaan aur unke shaavak, chaalis gaayein aur das saanr, bis gadhiyaan aur das gadhe.
Yaakob ne pashuon ke alag-alag jhund banaakar apne servants ko saump die, aur unhonne apne servants se kaha, “Mere aage-aage chalte jaao aur har ek jhund ke bich thori jagah chhorna.”
Jo sabse aage tha unse kaha: “Jab tum mere bhaai esaav se miloge aur vah tumse puchhega, ‘Kaun hai tumhaara maalik aur kahaan ja rahe ho? Aur ye sab pashu, jo aage ja rahe hain, kiske hain?’
Tab tum unse kahna, ‘Ye sabhi aapke bhaai Yaakob ke hain, jo uphaar mein unke adhipti esaav ko die ja rahe hain. Aur Yaakob hamaare pichhe a rahe hain.’ ”
Yaakob ne yahi baat dusre aur tisre aur un sabhi ko kahi, jo unke pichhe-pichhe a rahe the.

“Tum yah kahna, ‘Aapke servant Yaakob pichhe a rahe hain.’ ” Kyonki Yaakob ne socha, “Itne uphaar dekar main esaav ko khush kar dunga. Iske baad main unke saath jaaunga. Tab zarur, vah mujhe accept kar leinge.”
Aur isi tarah sab uphaar aage barhte gaye, aur Yaakob tambu mein rahe.
Us raat Yaakob uthe aur apni donon patniyon, donon daasiyon aur baalkon ko lekar yabbok ke ghaat ke paar chale gae.
Yaakob ne sabko nadi ki dusri taraph bhej diya.
Aur Yaakob vahin ruk gaye. Ek person vahaan aakar subah tak unse mall-yuddh karta raha.
Jab us person ne yah dekha ki vah Yaakob ko hara nahin saka tab usne Yaakob ki jaangh ki nas ko chhua aur mall-yuddh karte-karte hi unki nas charh gai.
Yah hone par us person ne Yaakob se kaha, “Ab mujhe jaane do.” Lekin Yaakob ne us person se kaha, “Nahin, main aapko tab tak jaane na dunga, jab tak aap mujhe blessing na deinge.”
Tab usne Yaakob se puchha, “Tumhaara naam kya hai?” Usne kaha, “Yaakob.”
Tab us person ne unse kaha, “Ab se tumhaara naam Yaakob nahin balki Israel hoga, kyonki God se aur insaanon se sangharsh karte hue tum jit gae ho.”
Tab Yaakob ne us person se kaha, “Kripya aap mujhe apna naam bataaie.” Us person ne javaab diya, “Kya karoge mera naam jaankar?” Aur tab us person ne vahin Yaakob ko blessing di.
Jahaan yah sab kuchh hua Yaakob ne us jagah ka naam paniel rakha, yah kahkar ki “Mainne God ko aamne-saamne dekha, phir bhi mera life bach gaya!”
Jab Yaakob paniel se nikle tab suraj uske upar ug aaya tha. Vah apni jaangh ke kaaran langra rahe the.
Is ghatna ka smaran karte hue Israel vansh aaj tak jaangh ki putthe ki maanspeshi ko nahin khaate kyonki us person ne Yaakob ke jaangh ki isi maanspeshi par chhua tha.
Yaakob ne dekha ki dur esaav apne chaar sau saathiyon ke saath a rahe the; Yaakob ne apne baalkon ko liyaah, raahel aur donon daasiyon ko do bhaagon mein kar diye.
Unhonne donon daasiyon aur unke baalkon ko sabse aage kar diya, unke pichhe liyaah aur uski children aur raahel aur Yosef sabse pichhe the.
Yaakob sabse aage the aur esaav ko dekhte hi saat baar zameen par girkar dandvat kiya aur esaav ke paas pahunche.
Esaav daurte hue aae aur Yaakob ko gale lagaaya aur chumban kiya. Aur dono rone lage.
Esaav ne auraton aur baalkon ko dekha. Usne puchha, “Tumhaare saath ye sab kaun hain?” Yaakob ne kaha ye baalak, “Jo God ne apni grace se aapke slave ko diye hain.”
Aur daasiyaan apne-apne baalkon ke saath paas aai aur jhukkar pranaam kiya.
Vaise hi liyaah apne baalkon ke saath paas aai, usne bhi jhukkar pranaam kiya aur phir raahel ke saath Yosef bhi aaya aur pranaam kiya.
Esaav ne Yaakob se puchha, “Ye gaay, bail mujhe kyon diya, samajh mein nahin aaya.” Yaakob bole, “Mere adhipti, main iske dvaara aapki daya paana chaahta hun.”
Esaav ne kaha, “He mere bhaai mere paas sab kuchh hai. Aur jo kuchh tumhaara hai, use apne hi paas rahne do.”

Yaakob ne kaha, “Nahin! Yadi aapka grace mujh par hai, to meri or se in uphaaron ko accept kar lijie; kyonki aapko dekhkar laga ki mainne God ke darshan pa liye, aur aapne mujhe dil se svikaara bhi hai.

Grace kar aap mere dvaara prastut is bheint ko accept kar lijie, jo main aapke lie laaya hun, kyonki mere prati God bahut kind rahe hain aur mere paas bahut hai.” Jab Yaakob ne zabardasti ki, esaav ne vah bheint accept kar li.
Phir esaav ne kaha, “Chalo, yahaan se apne ghar chalein. Main tumhaare aage-aage chalunga.”
Is par Yaakob ne esaav se kaha, “Mere maalik, aap jaante hain ki baalak kamjor hain bher-bakri aur gaayein jo dudh denevaali hain, unka dhyaan rakhna bahut zaruri hai.
Isliye mere maalik, aap aage chaliye aur main aapke pichhe-pichhe dhire se, bher-bakri aur gaayon ka dhyaan rakhte hue unki raftaar mein chalunga.”
Tab esaav ne Yaakob se kaha, “Main apne saathiyon ko aapke paas chhor deta hun.” Tab Yaakob ne kaha, “Kya iski zarurat hai? Mujh par mere maalik ki daya bani rahe, yahi kaafi hai.”
Isliye esaav usi din seir chale gaye.
Yaakob sukkoth ki disha mein aage barhe. Vahin unhonne apne lie ek ghar banaaya aur pashuon ke rahne ke lie prabandh kiya. Isliye is jagah ka naam sukkoth par gaya.
Paddan-araam se yaatra karte hue Yaakob kanaan desh ke shekem shehar pahunche aur unhonne shehar ke paas tambu khare kie.
Jis jagah par unhonne tambu khare kie, us zamin ko unhonne shekem ke pita, haamor ke sons se ek sau chaandi ki mudraaein dekar kharida tha.
Phir Yaakob ne vahaan ek vedi banaai, jise unhonne el-elohe-Israel naam rakha.
Yaakob kanaan desh mein rahte the. Vahin to unke pita pardeshi hokar rahe the.

Yah hai Yaakob ke parivaar ka itihaas. Yaakob ke vansh mein Yosef jab satrah varsh ke the vah apne bhaaiyon ke saath bher-bakriyon ko charaate the, unke pita ki patniyon bilhaah aur zilpaah ke son bhi unke saath hi the. Yosef apne pita ko apne bhaaiyon ki galat aadton ke baare mein bataaya karte the.
Israel apne sabhi bachchon se jyaada Yosef ko pyaar karte the; kyonki vah unke burhaape ki children thi. Yaakob ne Yosef ke lie rang biranga kapde banvaaya tha.
Yosef ke bhaaiyon ne dekha ki unke pita unse jyaada Yosef ko pyaar karte hain; isliye ve Yosef se nafrat karne lage.
Yosef ne ek svapn dekha tha, jise usne apne bhaaiyon ko bataaya. Yosef ke bhaai Yosef se jyaada nafrat karne lage.
Yosef ne apne bhaaiyon se kaha, “Kripya mera svapn sunie.
Ham sab khet mein pula baandh rahe the. Mainne dekha ki mera pula uthkar sidha khara ho gaya. Aur aapke pule mere pule ke aas-paas ekatr ho gaye aur mere pule ko pranaam karne lage.”
Yah sun unke bhaai kah uthe, “To kya tum ham par authority karne ka soch kar rahe ho? Kya tum sach mein ham par authority kar loge?” Iske baad ve Yosef se aur jyaada nafrat karne lage.
Phir Yosef ne dusra sapna dekha. Yosef ne kaha, “Mainne dusra sapna dekha hai; mainne suraj, chaand aur gyaarah nakshatron ko mujhe pranaam karte dekha.”

Yah svapn Yosef ne apne pita aur bhaaiyon ko bataaya, jise sun unke pita ne use daantte hue kaha, “Yah kaisa svapn dekhte ho tum! Kya yah vaastav mein sambhav hai ki main, tumhaari maata aur tumhaare bhaai tumhaare paas aaeinge aur tumhein pranaam kareinge?”
Yosef ke bhaai usse lagaataar irshya karte rahe. Lekin Yosef ke pita ne in sabhi baaton ko apne man mein rakha.
Yosef ke bhaai apne pita ki bher-bakriyon ko charaane ke lie shekem gae the.
Israel ne Yosef se kaha, “Tumhaare bhaai shekem mein bher-bakri chara rahe hain na? Main tumhein unke paas bhejna chaahta hun.” Yosef ne kaha, “Main chala jaata hun.”
Yaakob ne Yosef se kaha, “Tum jaao aur apne bhaaiyon ka haal pata karke aao aur mujhe bataao.” Yosef ko Yaakob ne hebron ghaati se ravaana kiya. Aur Yosef shekem pahunche,
Jab Yosef ek maidaan mein idhar-udhar dekh rahe the, tab ek person unhein mila, jisne usse puchha, “Kya dhunrh rahe ho tum?”
Yosef ne kaha, “Main apne bhaaiyon ko dhunrh raha hun. Kya aap grace kar mujhe bataaeinge ve apni bher-bakriyaan kahaan chara rahe hain?”
Us person ne kaha, “Ve to yahaan se ja chuke hain, kyonki mainne unhein yah kahte suna tha, ‘Chalo, ab dothaan jaayein.’ ” Isliye Yosef apne bhaaiyon ko dhunrhte dothaan pahunche.
Jab bhaaiyon ne dur se Yosef ko aate dekha, uske nazdik aane ke pahle hi unhonne usko maar daalne ka soch kiya.
Unhonne kaha, “Yah lo, a gaya svapn dekhnevaala!
Chalo, uski murder kar yahaan kisi gaddhe mein pheink dein, aur ham kah deinge, ki use kisi jangli jaanvar ne kha liya; phir ham dekhte hain uske svapn ka kya hota hai.”
Lekin riyuben Yosef ko bachaana chaahta tha. Isliye riyuben ne kaha “Ham Yosef ko jaan se nahin maareinge;
Balki ham use banjar zameen ke kisi gaddhe mein daal dete hain,” Riyuben ne aisa isliye kaha ki vah Yosef ko bachaakar pita ko saump dena chaahta tha.
Jaise hi Yosef apne bhaaiyon ke paas aaye, unhonne Yosef ka rang biranga kapde, jo vah pahne hue the utaar diya,
Aur Yosef ko ek sukhe gaddhe mein daal diya, gaddha khaali tha; usmein paani nahin tha.

Yah karke ve khaana karne baithe. Tabhi unhonne dekha ki gilaaad ki or se ishmaaeliyon ka ek samuh a raha tha. Unke unton par sugandh gond, balsaan aur gandhras lade hue the. Yah sab ve misr le ja rahe the.
Yahudah ne apne bhaaiyon se kaha, “Apne bhaai ki murder kar use chhupaane se hamein kuchh nahin milega.
Ham ise in ishmaaeliyon ko bech dein. Ham iski murder na karein; antath vah hamaara bhaai hi hai, hamaara apna khun.” Bhaaiyon ko yah baat thik lagi.
Usi samay kuchh midiyaani vyaapaari vahaan se nikle, tab unhonne unki madad se Yosef ko gaddhe se upar khinch nikaala aur use ishmaaeliyon ko bis chaandi ke sikkon mein bech diya.
Jab riyuben us gaddhe par lauta, tab usne dekha ki Yosef vahaan nahin hain. Yah dekh usne apne kapde phaar lie.
Usne apne bhaaiyon ke paas jaakar puchha, “Vah to vahaan nahin hain! Mujhe samajh nahin a raha, ab main kya karun?”
Bhaaiyon ne ek bakri ko maara aur uske khun mein Yosef ke sundar angarkhe ko dubo diya
Aur us kapde ko apne pita ke paas le jaakar kaha, “Hamein yah kapde mila; kya yah aapke son ka kapde to nahin?”
Yaakob ne kapde dekhkar kaha, “Yah mere son ka hi kapde hai. Kisi jangli pashu ne use kha liya hai.”
Tab Yaakob ne apne kapde phaare, taat pahan lie aur kai dinon tak apne bete ke lie rote rahe.

Sabne Yaakob ko dilaasa dene ki koshish ki, par Yaakob ka duhkh kam na hua, aur ve Yosef ke lie rote hi rahe. Yaakob ne kaha, “Main marne ke din tak (shiyol tak) apne son Yosef ke shok mein duba rahunga.”
Vahaan, midiyaaniyon ne misr pahunchkar Yosef ko potiphar ko bech diya, jo faroh ka ek adhikaari, angrakshkon ka leader tha.
Jab Yosef ko misr le gaye, tab faroh ke angrakshkon ke leader misri potiphar ne use un ishmaaeliyon se mol le liya jo use vahaan laae the.
Yosef par Yahweh ki grace thi, isliye vah saphal person ban gaye. Vah misri maalik ke ghar mein rahte the.
Yosef ke maalik ne yah samajh liya tha ki Yosef par Yahweh ki grace hai, vah jo bhi kaam karte hain, Yahweh us kaam ko saphal kar dete the.
Is kaaran Yosef unke kripaapaatr ban unki service mein lag gaye. Potiphar ne unhein ab apne pure ghar ka aur property ka adhikaari bana diya tha.
Aur jab se Yosef ko property ka adhikaari banaaya Yahweh ne Yosef ke kaaran us misri ghar ko bahut blessing di. Yahweh ki blessing potiphar ke ghar mein aur uske kheton mein thi.
Isliye potiphar ne apni puri property Yosef ko saump di. Potiphar apne khaana ke alaava kisi bhi chiz par dhyaan nahin deta tha. Yosef sundar va rupvaan yuvak the,
Aur kuchh samay baad potiphar ki patni Yosef ke prati galat soch rakhne lagi aur usse kaha, “Mujhse samaagam karo!”

Lekin Yosef ne mana kiya aur apni svaamini se kaha, “Yah samajhne ki koshish kijie ki is ghar mein mere maalik kisi bhi vishay ki chinta nahin karte, unhonne to apni puri property hi mere paas chhor di hai.

Is ghar mein koi bhi mujhse bara nahin hai. Mere maalik ne mujhe aapke alaava kisi bhi vastu se alag nahin rakha hai, kyonki aap unki patni hain. Isliye yah kaise sambhav hai ki main aisi dushtta kar God ke khilaaf galti karun?”
Vah din-pratidin Yosef se samaagam ke lie aagrah karti rahi, Yosef na to samaagam ke lie tatpar hue aur na hi uske paas rahne ke lie taiyaar hue.
Ek din jab ghar mein koi bhi servant nahin tha aur Yosef ghar mein apne kaam karne gaye.
Potiphar ki patni ne Yosef ke kapde pakar lie aur unse aagrah karne lagi, “Mujhse sambhog karo!” Yosef apna kapde usi ke haath mein chhorkar bhaagkar baahar a gaye.
Jab us aurat ne dekha ki Yosef apna kapde uske haathon mein chhorkar baahar bhaag gae,
Usne sab servants ko bulaaya aur kaha, “Yah dekho, mere pati ne is ibri ko hamaari dekhbhaal ke lie rakha hai lekin vah mujhe dushit karne mere paas aaya tab main chilla pari.
Jaise hi usne meri chillaahat suni, vah apna kapde mere saath chhorkar baahar bhaag gaya.”
Yosef ka vah kapde apne pati ke lautne tak apne paas rakha.
Pati ke aane par usne bataaya: “Aap jis ibri slave ko yahaan laae hain, vah mera apmaan karne yahaan aaya tha.
Jaise hi main chillaai, vah apna kapde chhorkar baahar bhaag gaya.”
Jab Yosef ke maalik ne apni patni ki yah baat suni, ‘Aapke servant ne mujhse aisa vyavhaar kiya’ Tab use bahut gussa aaya.
Yosef ke maalik ne use kaaraagaar mein daal diya, yah vahi jagah tha jahaan raaja ke apraadhi rakhe jaate the. Yosef isi kaaraagaar mein the,
Lekin Yosef par Yahweh ki grace thi aur isliye kaaraagaar ke adhikaari Yosef ka pura dhyaan rakhte the.
Kaaraagaar ke adhikaari ne Yosef ko kaaraagaar ki puri javaabdaari saump di; kaaraagaar mein jo kuchh hota tha Yosef ke kahne se hi hota tha.
Kaaraagaar ke adhikaari jaante the ki Yosef par Yahweh ki grace hai aur Yosef jo kuchh karte the, Yahweh us kaam ko saphal karte the.
Kuchh samay baad raaja faroh ke katora-vaahak aur unke khaana banaanevaale ne apne maalik faroh ke khilaaf kuchh galti ki.
Aur leader khaansaame aur leader pilaane vaale donon par raaja gussa hue,
Isliye raaja ne un donon ko kaaraavaas mein daal diya, jahaan Yosef bhi bandi the.
Angrakshkon ke leader ne Yosef ke haath un donon ko saump diya. Yosef unka dhyaan rakhte the. Aur ve donon kuchh samay tak kaaraavaas mein rahe,
Tab ek raat donon ne alag-alag sapna dekha, aur har ek sapne ka apna alag-alag arth tha.
Jab subah Yosef vahaan aae aur un donon ko dekha ki ve udaas the.
Yosef ne jo uske saath uske maalik ke ghar mein kaaraavaas mein the, unse puchha: “Aap dono aise udaas kyon hain?”

Unhonne kaha, “Ham donon hi ne svapn dekha hai, lekin koi bhi nahin hai, jo uska matlab bata sake.” Yah sunkar Yosef ne kaha, “Kya aap nahin jaante ki svapn ki vyaakhya God ki or se hoti hai? Kripya aap mujhe apna svapn bataaein.”
