Tab leader pilaane vaale ne Yosef se kaha, “Apne svapn mein mainne dekha ki mere paas ek daakhalta hai,
Jismein tin shaakhaaein hain. Jaise hi in par kaliyaan khili, unmein phul khilein aur angur lagkar pak gae.
Aur main faroh ka pyaala mere haath mein tha, aur mainne angur lekar pyaale mein ras nichora. Phir mainne pyaala faroh ke haathon mein diya.”
Svapn sunkar Yosef ne kaha, “Ve tin shaakhaaein tin din hain.
Aur tin din mein faroh aapko vaapas bula leinge aur aapka kaam dubaara aapko saump deinge aur aap phir se pilaane ka kaam shuru kareinge.
Yosef ne unse kaha jab aap faroh raaja ke paas jaayeinge tab mujhe mat bhulna, lekin raaja ko mere baare mein bataana aur mujhe kaaraavaas se baahar nikalvaana.
Mujhe apne ghar ibriyon ke desh se zabardasti se laaya gaya tha aur yahaan par bhi mainne aisa koi apraadh nahin kiya hai jiske liye mujhe is kaal-kothri mein daala gaya.”

Phir leader khaana banaanevaale ne dekha ki dusre naukar ke svapn ki vyaakhya unke paksh mein thi, tab usne Yosef se kaha, “Mainne bhi ek svapn dekha hai: mainne dekha ki mere sir par safed roti ki tin tokriyaan rakhi hain.
Sabse upar ki tokri mein faroh ke lie taiyaar kie gae sabhi tarah ke vyanjan the, tokri sir par rakhi hui thi; pakshi usmein se khaate ja rahe the.”
Svapn sunkar Yosef ne arth bataaya: “Ve tin tokriyaan tin din hain.
In tin dinon mein faroh tumhaara sir kaat deinge aur body ko per par latka deinge aur pakshi aakar tumhaare body ko nocheinge.”
Yahi hua. Tisre din faroh ka janmdin tha usne apne sabhi servants ko bhoj diya us din leader pilaane vaale aur leader pakaane vaale donon ko kaaraavaas se baahar laaya gaya.
Leader pilaane vaale ko phir se uski javaabdaari de di gai; vah faroh ke haath mein phir se pyaala dene lage.
Lekin leader pakaane vaale ko phaansi par latka diya; sab kuchh vaisa hi hua jaisa Yosef ne bataaya tha.
Yah sab dekhkar bhi leader pilaane vaale ne Yosef ko yaad na kiya; par bhul gaya.
Pure do saal baad faroh ne ek svapn dekha: ve nil nadi ke kinaare khare hain.
Nadi mein se saat sundar aur moti gaayein nikli aur ghaas charne lagin.
Phir aur saat gaayein nil nadi mein se niklin, jo kurup aur patli thin. Ye nadi ke kinaare un moti gaayon ke paas aakar khari ho gain.
Aur kurup aur durbal gaayon ne un sundar aur moti gaayon ko kha liya. Isse faroh ki nind khul gai.
Jab unhein phir nind aai, tab unhonne ek aur svapn dekha: ek hi tane mein se saat baalein ugin, jo achchhi aur moti moti thin.
Phir saat aur baalein ugin jo patli aur murjhaai hui thin,
Tab patli baalon ne moti baalon ko nigal liya. Isse faroh ki nind khul gai aur vah samajh gaye ki yah svapn tha.

Subah hone par raaja man mein bechain hue, isliye inka arth jaanne ke lie misr desh ke sab jyotishiyon aur panditon ko bulvaaya aur faroh ne unhein apne donon svapn bataaye lekin koi bhi unka arth nahin bata paaya.
Tab leader pilaane vaale ne faroh se kaha, “Aaj mujhe apni galti yaad a rahi hai.
Ek baar faroh apne naukron se kruddh hue aur mujhe aur leader khaansaame ko angrakshkon ke naayak ke ghar ke bandigrih mein daala.
Hamne us kaaraavaas mein svapn dekha, aur donon hi svapn ka apna alag arth tha.
Ek ibri yuvak vahaan tha, vah angrakshkon ke naayak ka servant tha. Jab hamne use apna svapn bataaya usne hamaare har ek ke svapn ki vyaakhya ki.
Jaisa usne bataaya tha vaisa hi hua: faroh ne mujhe to apna pad saump diya, aur khaansaamein ko jaan-dand de diya.”
Yah sunkar faroh ne kaha ki Yosef ko mere paas laao. Unhonne jaldi Yosef ko kaaraagaar se baahar nikaala. Aur uske baal kataakar uske kapre badalkar faroh ke paas lekar aaye.
Faroh ne Yosef se kaha, “Mainne ek svapn dekha hai, uska arth koi nahin bata pa rahe hain, lekin mainne tumhaare baare mein suna hai ki tum svapn ka arth bata sakte ho.”
Yosef ne yah sunkar faroh se kaha, “Arth main nahin, balki khud God hi deinge.”
Tab faroh ne kaha, “Mainne svapn mein dekha ki main nil nadi ke kinaare khara hun.
Vahaan mainne saat moti aur sundar gaayon ko nil nadi se nikalte dekha. Aur ve ghaas char rahi thin.
Tabhi mainne dekha ki saat aur gaayein niklin—jo dubli, patli aur kurup thin. Aisi kurup gaayein mainne misr desh mein kabhi nahin dekhin.
Durbal aur kurup gaayon ne un saat moti aur sundar gaayon ko kha liya.
Itna hone par bhi yah samajh nahin paaye ki inhonne un saat moti gaayon ko kaise kha liya; lekin ve ab bhi vaisi hi kurup bani hui thin. Aur meri nind khul gai.
“Mainne ek aur svapn dekha: ek hi tane mein se saat moti aur achchhi baalein ugin.
Tabhi mainne dekha ki kamjor aur murjhaai, aur purvi vaayu se jhulsi baalein ugin.
Aur kamjor baalon ne un moti baalon ko nigal liya. Mainne apne jyotishiyon se ye svapn bataaye, lekin arth koi nahin bata paaya.”
Tab Yosef ne faroh se kaha, “Aapke donon svapn ek hi hain. Inmein God ne faroh ko bataaya hain ki God kya karne ja rahe hain.
Saat sundar aur moti gaayein saat varsh hain, saat achchhi baalein bhi saat varsh hain; donon hi svapn ek hi hain.
Kamjor aur kurup gaayein, saat varsh hain, aur murjhaai hui baalein jo dekhi ve bhi saat varsh; ve akaal ke honge.
“Jaisa mainne faroh ko bataaya, thik vaisa hi hoga; God ne aapko yah dikha diya hai ki jaldi hi kya honevaala hai.
Misr desh mein saat varsh bahut hi achchhi phasal hogi,
Aur uske baad saat varsh ka akaal hoga. Tab misr desh ke log saari upaj ko bhul jaayeinge, aur akaal se desh ka barbaadi hoga.
Akaal itna bhayaanak hoga ki achchhi phasal aur upaj kisi ko yaad tak nahin rahegi.
Faroh aapne ek hi baat ke vishay do baar svapn dekhe; yah is baat ko dikhaata hai ki God nishchay hi aisa hone deinge aur God jaldi hi ise pura kareinge.
“Isliye faroh jaldi kisi samajhdaar aur wise person ko misr desh ka adhikaari banaaein.
Aur faroh saare misr desh mein sarvekshkon ko niyukt kare aur saat varsh jo achchhi phasal aur upaj ka hai, us samay zameen ki upaj ka panchmaansh ikattha karein.
Tab achchhi phasal ke saat varshon mein saari khaana vastu ekatrit ki jaaye aur anaaj ko faroh ke authority mein bhandaar shehron mein surakshit rakhte jaayein.
Aur yah khaana saat varsh ke akaal se bachne ke lie pure misr desh ko dene ke lie ikattha kare taaki log khaana ke abhaav mein nahin marein.”
Faroh aur sab karmchaariyon ko laga ki yah javaabdaari Yosef ko hi di jaaye.
Faroh ne apne servants se puchha, “Kya hamein aisa koi person mil sakta hai jismein God ka aatma ho?”
Phir faroh ne Yosef se kaha, “Isliye ki God ne hi tum par yah sab reveal kiya hai, tum yah javaabdaari lo kyonki tum jaisa samajhdaar aur wise koi nahin.
Aur tum mere mahal ke adhikaari honge aur meri people tumhaare hi order ka follow karegi. Main sinhaasan par baithne ke kaaran raaja hokar tumse bara rahunga.”
Aur faroh ne Yosef se kaha, “Mainne tumhein saare misr desh par authority de diya hai.”
Yah kahte hue faroh ne apni raajmudra vaali anguthi utaarkar Yosef ko pahna di, aur malmal ke kapde aur gale mein sone ki maala bhi pahna di.

Phir faroh ne Yosef ko apne dusre rath mein charhaakar sammaan diya. Rathon ke aage-aage chal rahe adhikaari bol rahe the, “Ghutne teko!” Is tarah faroh ne Yosef ko sampurn misr ka authority saump diya.
Aur faroh ne Yosef se kaha, “Faroh to main hun, lekin ab se saare misr desh mein bina tumhaari command ke koi bhi na to haath utha sakega aur na hi paanv.”
Faroh ne Yosef ka naya naam zaaphenaath-paaniyaah rakha aur unka vivaah on ke priest potiphera ki putri asenaath se kar diya. Is tarah ab Yosef sab misr desh ke prashaasak ho gae.
Jab Yosef ko misr ke raaja faroh ke paas laaya gaya, tab ve tis varsh ke the. Faroh se authority paakar Yosef sab misr desh ka nirikshan karne ke lie nikle.
Pahle saat varshon mein bahut upaj hui.

Aur Yosef ne in saat varshon mein bahut khaana vastuein jama ki, jo misr desh mein utpann ho rahi thin. Vah sab ann Yosef shehron mein jama karte gae. Jis shehar ke paas khet tha uski upaj vahin jama karte gae.
Is tarah Yosef ne saagar tat ke baalu jaisa anaaj jama kar liya ki usko ginna hi chhor diya, kyonki upaj asankhy ho chuki thi.
Isse pahle ki akaal ke varsh shuru hon, on ke priest potiphera ki putri asenaath se Yosef ke do son paida hue.
Pahle bete ka naam Yosef ne manashsheh rakha kyonki unhonne soch kiya, “God ne sabhi kashton aur mere pita ke parivaar ko bhulaane mein meri madad ki hai.”
Unhonne dusre son ka naam ephraaim rakha, kyonki unka kahna tha, “Duhkh milne ki jagah is desh mein God ne mujhe phalvant kiya.”
Jab misr desh mein phasal ke ve saat varsh khatm hue,
Tab akaal ke saat varshon ki shuruaat hui, jaisa Yosef ne kaha tha. Sabhi deshon mein akaal tha, lekin misr desh mein ann ki koi kami na thi.
Jab misr desh mein khaana ki kami hone lagi tab log faroh se khaana maangne lage. Faroh ne misr ki people se kaha, “Tum Yosef ke paas jaao. Vah jo kuchh kahe, vahi karna.”
Jab pure desh mein akaal para, tab Yosef ne apne bhandaar kholkar misrvaasiyon ko ann bechna shuru kiya, kyonki akaal bhayaanak tha.
Prithvi ke alag-alag desh se log Yosef se ann kharidne aane lage, kyonki saari prithvi par akaal bhayankar ho chuka tha.
Jab Yaakob ko yah pata chala ki misr desh mein ann mil raha hai, to unhonne apne beton se kaha, “Kyon ek dusre ka chehra taak rahe ho?
Misr desh mein ann mil raha hai. Jaao aur vahaan se ann kharid kar laao, ki ham jivit rah sakein.”
Tab Yosef ke das bhaai ann kharidne misr desh aaye.
Lekin Yaakob ne Yosef ke bhaai binyaamin ko nahin bheja kyonki unhein yah dar tha ki kahin us par koi kasht na a pare.
Isliye Israel ke son ann kharidne misr pahunche, kyonki kanaan desh mein bhi akaal tha.
Yosef misr desh ke prashaasak the. Vahi pure raashtr ko ann bechte the. Yosef ke bhaai vahaan pahunche aur unko pranaam kiya aur unka muh zamin ki or tha.

Yosef apne bhaaiyon ko dekhte hi pahchaan gae; lekin anjaan bankar vah apne bhaaiyon se kathorta se baat kar rahe the. Yosef ne unse puchha, “Tum log kahaan se aae ho?” Unhonne kaha, “Kanaan desh se, ann kharidne ke lie aae hain.”
Yosef ne to apne bhaaiyon ko pahchaan liya tha, lekin bhaaiyon ne unhein nahin pahchaana tha.
Tab Yosef ko apne svapn yaad aaye, jo unhonne unke baare mein dekhe the. Unhonne apne bhaaiyon se kaha, “Tum log bhedie ho aur tum yahaan hamaare desh ki durdsha dekhne aae ho.”
Unhonne kaha, “Nahin, adhipti mahoday, aapke ye servant ann kharidne yahaan aae hain.
Ham sabhi ek hi pita ki children hain. Ham, sidhe aur sachche log hain, koi jaasus nahin.”
Yosef ne phir bhi unse kaha, “Main nahin maan sakta. Tum log zarur hamaare desh ki durdsha dekhne aae ho!”

Lekin ve baar-baar kahte rahe, “Aapke ye servant baarah bhaai hain, jo ek hi pita ki children hain, ham kanaan ke rahnevaale hain. Hamaara chhota bhaai hamaare pita ke saath hi hai. Hamaara ek bhaai ab jivit nahin hai.”
Yosef ne unse kaha, “Kuchh bhi ho, main jaanta hun ki tum log jaasus hi ho!
Ab tumhein jaanchne ka ek hi tarika hain: faroh ke life ki shapath, tumhaare chhote bhaai ko yahaan aana hoga.
Tummein se koi jaakar apne bhaai ko yahaan lekar aao; faroh ki shapath, tab tak tum sabhi bandi bankar yahin rahoge, aur tumne kitna sach kaha hai vah pata chal jaayega.”
Tab Yosef ne unhein tin din ke lie bandigrih mein daal diya.
Tisre din Yosef ne unse kaha, “Yadi jivit rahna chaahte ho, to tumhein yah karna hoga; kyonki mujhmein God ka dar hai:
Yadi tum sachche ho, to tummein se ek bhaai kaaraagaar mein rahe aur baaki tum log vaapas ghar jaao aur apne parivaar ko akaal se bachaane ke lie ann le jaao.
Aur apne chhote bhaai ko yahaan lekar aana, taaki vah tumhaare words ko saabit kar sake aur tumhaari maut na ho!” Unhonne is baat ko maana.

Tab ve aapas mein baat karne lage, “Ham apne bhaai ke prati doshi hain, kyonki jab vah hamse lagaataar daya maangi, aur uske praanon ki vedna dikh rahi thi, lekin hamne hi apna man kathor bana liya tha. Yahi kaaran ki aaj ham par yah kasht a para hai.”
Riyuben ne kaha, “Kya main nahin kah raha tha, larke ke khilaaf koi apraadh mat karo? Tumne meri baat na suni. Ab samay a gaya hai; uski murder ka badla paane ka.”
Unhein maalum nahin para ki Yosef unki baat ko samajh rahe the.
Yosef unke saamne se alag jaakar rone lage; phir vaapas aakar unhonne unhin ke saamne Shimon ko pakra aur baandh diya.

Phir Yosef ne order diya ki unke boron ko ann se bhar diya jaae aur jo daam diya hai, vah bhi usi ke bore mein rakh diya jaae. Aur Yosef ne kaha ki unki yaatra ke lie zaruri saamaan bhi unhein de diya jaae.
Tab bhaaiyon ne apne-apne gadhon par ann ke bore rakhe aur vahaan se chal pare.
Jab raaste mein gadhe ko chaara dene ke purpose se unmein se ek ne bora khola, to use vahi rupya dikha jise usne unhein diya tha.

Yah usne apne bhaaiyon ko bataaya, “Mainne jo rupya diya tha vah mere bore mein mila hai.” Ve sabhi aashchary karne lage. Aur kaampne lage aur ek dusre ki or dekhte hue kahne lage, “God ne hamaare saath yah kya kar diya hai?”
Jab ve kanaan desh mein apne pita Yaakob ke paas pahunche, tab unhonne apne pita ko puri ghatna bataai.
Aur kaha, “Us desh ka adhipti hamse kathor hokar baat kar raha tha. Usne hamein apne desh ka jaasus samjha.
Hamne unhein samjhaaya, ‘Ham sachche log hain; jaasus nahin.
Aur bataaya ki ham baarah bhaai hain, ek hi pita ki children. Ek bhaai ab jivit nahin raha, aur hamaara chhota bhaai pita ke saath kanaan desh mein hi hai.’
“Us desh ke adhipti ne hamse kaha, ‘Tumhaari sach tab reveal hogi jab tum apne bhaaiyon mein se ek ko mere paas chhorkar jaaoge; aur ab akaal mein apne parivaaron ke lie ann lekar jaao.
Jab tum apne chhote bhaai ko mere paas laaoge, tab maalum parega ki tum jaasus nahin ho, phir main tumhaare bhaai ko chhor dunga aur tum is desh mein vyaapaar kar sakoge.’ ”
Jab ve apne-apne bore khaali kar rahe the, un sabhi ne dekha ki sabke boron mein unke rupye ki thailiyaan rakhi hui hai! Jab unhonne aur unke pita ne rupye ki thaili dekhi, tab ve dar gae.
Unke pita Yaakob ne unse kaha, “Tum logon ne to mujhse meri children hi chhin li hai. Yosef nahin raha aur ab tum log binyaamin ko le ja rahe ho. Yah sab mere khilaaf hi ho raha hai!”

Riyuben ne apne pita ko yah aashvaasan diya, “Agar main binyaamin ko yahaan vaapas na laaun, to aap mere donon sons ki murder kar dena. Aap binyaamin ko mere haathon mein saump dijie, main use vaapas laaunga.”

Lekin Yaakob kahte rahe, “Mera son tumhaare saath na jaaega; kyonki uske bhaai ki maut ho hi chuki hai, isliye vah akela hi rah gaya hai. Yadi is yaatra mein uske saath kuchh anarth hua to tum is burhaape mein mujhe ghor vedna ke saath kabr mein niche utaaroge.”
Desh mein ab bhi akaal bahut bhayankar tha.
Jab unke dvaara misr desh se laaya hua ann khatm hone laga, tab unke pita ne kaha, “Jaao, thora aur anaaj kharid kar laao.”
Lekin Yahudah ne unse kaha, “Bari gambhirta purvak us prashaasak ne hamein chetaavni di thi, ‘Yadi tum apne saath apne bhaai ko na laao to mujhe apna chehra na dikhaana.’
Ann mol lene ham tab hi vahaan jaayeinge, jab aap hamaare saath hamaare bhaai ko bhi bhejeinge.
Yadi aap use hamaare saath nahin bhejeinge, to ham bhi nahin jaaeinge. Kyonki us adhipti ne kaha tha, ‘Mere saamne hi na aana, yadi tumhaara bhaai tumhaare saath na hoga.’ ”
Israel ne kaha, “Kyon tum logon ne use yah bataakar mera anarth kar diya ki tumhaara ek bhaai aur bhi hai?”

Lekin unhonne apne pita ko yah bataaya, “Vah person hi hamse hamaare baare mein aur hamaare sambandhiyon ke baare mein puchh raha tha, ‘Kya tumhaara pita ab bhi jivit hai? Kya tumhaara koi dusre bhaai bhi hai?’ Ham keval uske prashnon ka uttar de rahe the. Hamein kya maalum tha ki vah hamse aisa kaheinge ‘Apne us bhaai ko yahaan le aao?’ ”

Yahudah ne apne pita Israel se kaha, “Is larke ko mere saath bhej dijie, tab ham yahaan se jaaeinge, taaki akaal mein hamaari maut na ho jaae aur aap, aur hamaare bachche nahin marein aur sab jivit rah sakein.
Main is larke ki javaabdaari apne upar leta hun; agar use aapke paas lauta na laaun, to main hamesha-hamesha aapka doshi bana rahunga.
Yadi ham deri na karte to ham vahaan do baar jaakar a gae hote.”

Yah sun unke pita Israel ne unse kaha, “Agar yahi baat hai, to thik hai, yahi karo. Lekin aap log apne-apne boron mein us person ke lie uphaar svarup balsaan, madhu, gond, gandhras, pista aur baadaam le jaao.
Do guna rupya bhi le jaao aur jo rupya tumhaare bore mein vahaan se aaya tha vah bhi vaapas kar dena, shaayad bhul ho gai hogi.
Apne bhaai ko apne saath le jaao, deri na karo.
Prayer hai ki sarvshaktimaan God us person ke dil mein daya daale taaki vah tumhaare us bhaai binyaamin ko chhor de. Agar bichharna hi hai, to aisa hi hone do.”
Tab unhonne uphaar, do guna rupya aur apne saath binyaamin ko liya aur misr ke lie ravaana hue, aur Yosef ke paas pahunche.

Jab Yosef ne apne bhaaiyon ke saath binyaamin ko dekha, tab unhonne apne ghar ke servant se kaha, “In logon ko mere ghar le jaao, ek pashu ka vadh kar khaana taiyaar karo. Ye sabhi dophar ka khaana mere saath kareinge.”
Servant se jaisa kaha gaya usne vaisa hi kiya aur in bhaaiyon ko Yosef ke ghar par le gae.

Yosef ke ghar aakar sab dar gae. Sabne socha, “Jo rupya ham sabke bore mein tha, ve ham logon ko apraadhi siddh karne lie unka upyog kareinge. Tab ve ham logon ke gadhon ko le leinge aur ham logon ko slave banaaeinge.”
Isliye ghar ke paas aakar unhonne Yosef ke grih servant se kaha,
“Mahoday, faith kijie, jab ham pichhle baar bhi sirf anaaj kharidne hi aaye the
Tab hamne dharmshaala pahunchkar apne-apne bore khole, to hamne dekha ki jo rupya hamne yahaan anaaj ke lie diya tha vah vaapas hamaare bore mein rakha gaya; tab ham vah rupya apne saath laae hain.
Dubaara kharidne ke lie bhi rupya laae hain. Hamein kuchh bhi nahin pata ki kisne rupya hamaare boron mein rakha tha.”

Us servant ne unse kaha, “Shaant ho jaaie, dariye nahin, aapke God, tumhaare pita ke God ne aapke boron mein rupya rakha hoga. Mujhe to rupya mil chuka hai.” Yah kahte hue vah Shimon ko unke paas baahar laae.
Jab servant unhein Yosef ke ghar ke bhitar le gaye, usne unhein paanv dhone ke lie paani diya, sabne apne paanv dhoe, servant ne unke gadhon ko chaara bhi diya.
Dophar mein Yosef ke ghar pahunchne se pahle Yosef ko dene ke lie jo bheint ve laae the unhein taiyaar kiya kyonki Yosef in sabke saath khaana khaane aanevaale the.
Yosef ke ghar pahunchte hi jo bheint ve unke lie laae the unhein unko diya aur pranaam kiya.
Yosef ne sabka haal puchha aur kaha, “Kya tumhaare burhe pita jinke baare mein tumne mujhe bataaya tha vah jivit hain?”
Unhonne kaha, “Hamaare pita thik hain, abhi tak jivit hain.” Aur aadar ke saath sir jhukaakar pranaam kiya.
Tab Yosef ne binyaamin ko dekha, Yosef ne puchha, “Kya yahi tumhaara chhota bhaai hai, jiske baare mein tumne mujhse bataaya tha?” Yosef ne kaha, “Mere son, tum par God ki grace bani rahe.”
Yah kahkar Yosef ekdam uthkar chale gae, kyonki apne bhaai ko dekhkar pyaar se unki aankhein bhar aain aur ekaant mein jaakar rone lage.
Ve apna munh dhokar vaapas baahar aaye aur apne aapko sambhaala aur kaha, “Khaana paroso.”
Yosef khaana khaane alag baith gae aur bhaaiyon ko dusri or alag bithaaya, kyonki misri aur ibri ek saath khaana nahin kar sakte.
Yosef ke bhaaiyon ko unke saamne hi apni-apni aayu ke kram se pankti mein baitha gaya; sabke pahle sabse bara, phir uska chhota, phir uska chhota. Sabhi bhaai ek dusre ko aashchary se dekhte rahe.
Yosef ne apne lie parose gae khaana mein se sabko diya, lekin binyaamin ko paanch guna jyaada diya gaya. Sabne Yosef ke saath bharpet khaaya aur piya.
Yosef ne apne ghar ke bhandaari ko order diya: “Inke boron ko jitna ve le ja sakte hain utne ann se bhar do aur har ek ka diya gaya wealth usi ke bore mein daal dena.
Tab sabse chhote bhaai ke bore mein mera chaandi ka katora aur ann ke lie liya gaya wealth bhi rakh dena.” Bhandaari ne Yosef ke order ke anurup hi kiya.
Bhor hote hi unhein unke apne-apne gadhon ke saath vida kar diya gaya.
Ve shehar ke baahar nikle hi the ki Yosef ne apne ghar ke bhandaari ko order diya, “Utho, unka pichha karo. Jab tum un tak pahunch jaao, to unse kahna, ‘Bhalaai ka badla tum bure se kyon de rahe ho?
Kya yah vahi paatr nahin hai, jisse hamaare maalik pite hain, jisse vah bhaavi jaante hain? Aap logon ne yah uchit nahin kiya hai.’ ”
Vah bhandaari un tak ja pahuncha aur unse vahi sab kah diya.
Unhonne use javaab diya, “Mere maalik, aap yah kya kah rahe hain? Aapke servant aisa kuchh bhi nahin kar sakte!
Aap dekh lijie ki vah raashi, jo hamaare saath chali gai thi, kanaan desh se hamne aapko lauta di hai. To ham aapke maalik ke aavaas se chaandi ya svarn kyon churaate?
Jis kisi ke paas vah paatr paaya jaae, use jaan-dand de diya jaae, aur ham sabhi aapke adhipti ke slave ban jaaeinge.”
Bhandaari ne unse kaha, “Thik hai, jaisa tum logon ne kaha hai, vaisa hi hoga, jiske paas se vah paatr paaya jaaega, vah mera slave ho jaaega, shesh nirdosh honge.”
Shighr hi unhonne apne-apne bore niche utaare. Har ek ne apna bora khol diya.
Usne khojna shuruaat kiya, sabse bare se sabse chhote ke kram mein, aur katora binyaamin ke bore mein paaya gaya.
Yah dekh har ek ne apne-apne kapde phaar daale, gadhon par saamagri laadi aur shehar ko laut gae.
Jab Yahudah aur uske bhaai Yosef ke aavaas par pahunche, Yosef vahin the. Ve unke samaksh nat hue.
Yosef ne unse kaha, “Yah kya kiya hai aap logon ne? Kya aapko yah bodh nahin ki main apne is pad par hone ke kaaran vaastav mein bhavishy jnaat kar sakta hun?”

Iska uttar Yahudah ne diya, “Ham apne maalik se kya kahein? Hamaare paas to kahne ke lie word hi nahin hain. Ham khud ko nirdosh pramaanit hi nahin kar sakte. God hi ne aapke servants ki galti jnaat kar li hai. Dekhie, ham apne adhipti ke slave hone ke lie taiyaar hain; ham sabhi aur vah jiske bore mein vah katora paaya gaya hai.”
Yosef ne javaab diya, “Main aisa kabhi nahin kar sakta. Mera slave vahi person banaaya jaaega, jiske bore mein vah katora paaya gaya hai. Shesh aap sabhi apne pita ke paas shaantipurvak laut jaaein.”

Yah sun Yahudah Yosef ke nikat gae aur unse aagrah kiya, “Mere adhipti mahoday, kya aap apne servant ko apne kaanon mein kuchh kahne ki anumti provide kareinge? Kripya aap mujh apne servant par kruddh na hon, kyonki aap to pad mein faroh ke jaisa hain.
Mere adhipti, aapne apne servants se puchha tha, ‘Kya tumhaare pita ya bhaai hain?’

Hamne apne adhipti ko javaab diya tha, ‘Hamaare vayovriddh pita hain aur unki vriddhaavastha mein ek baalak bhi hai. Haan, uske bhaai ki maut ho chuki hai. Ab vah apni maata ka ekmaatr son rah gaya hai. Vah apne pita ka bahut dear son hai.’
“Tab mahoday ne apne in servants ko order diya tha, ‘Us son ko yahaan le aao, ki main use dekh sakun.’
Lekin hamne apne adhipti se nivedan kiya tha, ‘Yah kishor apne pita se dur nahin rah sakta, kyonki yadi use pita se dur kiya jaaega, to uske pita ki maut ho jaaegi.’
Lekin aapne to apne in servants se kaha tha, ‘Yadi tumhaara vah kanishth bhaai tumhaare saath yahaan nahin aaega, to tum mera chehra na dekhoge.’
Tab hua yah ki jab ham lautkar apne pita ke yahaan pahunche, hamne unhein apne adhipti, aap ka order suna diya.
“Hamaare pita ka order tha, ‘Punh misr jaakar hamaare upbhog ke lie kuchh ann le aao.’
Hamne prativaad kiya, ‘Ham vahaan bina hamaare kanishth bhaai ke nahin ja sakte; kyonki ham adhipti ki upasthiti mein bina apne kanishth bhaai ke pravesh kar hi nahin sakeinge.’
“Aapke servant hamaare pita ne hamein smaran dilaaya, ‘Tumhein smaran hi hai ki meri patni se mujhe do son paida hue the,
Ek to main kho chuka hun. Nishchay hi vah koi hinsak pashu dvaara phaar daala gaya hai, tab se mainne use nahin dekha hai.
Ab yadi tum is kanishth ko bhi mujhse dur le jaana chaah rahe ho aur yadi uska bhi kuchh anisht ho jaata hai, to is vriddhaavastha mein tum mujh par vishaadpurn maut le aaoge.’
“Isliye ab aapke servant mere pita ke paas lautunga aur yadi yah kishor hamaare saath na hoga to; vastusthiti yah hai ki hamaare pita ka jaan is kishor ke praanon se sanyukt hai,

Jab vah yah paaeinge, ki ham is kishor ko saath lekar nahin laute hain, to unke jaan hi nikal jaaeinge. Ham, aapke servant, hamaare pita ko unki vriddhaavastha mein ghor shok ke saath adholok bhej deinge.

Main aapka servant, apne pita ke samaksh is kishor ke lie pratibhuti hokar aaya hun. Mainne pita ko aashvaasan diya tha, ‘Yadi main use lautaakar aapke samaksh laane mein asmarth paaya jaaun, to main apne pita ke samaksh hamesha-hamesha ke lie doshi bana rahunga.’
“Tab he maalik, ab grace kar is kishor ke jagah par mujhe apna slave bana lijie.
Kyonki main ab apne pita ke samaksh kaise ja sakta hun, yadi yah kishor hamaare saath na hoga? Mujhe dar hai ki isse mere pita par anisht hi a parega!”

Yahaan tak aakar Yosef ka niyantran tut gaya. Vah vahaan upasthit sabhi logon ke samaksh chilla uthe, “Sab yahaan se baahar chale jaaein.” Sab vahaan se baahar chale gae. Tab Yosef ne khud ko apne bhaaiyon par apne vaastvik taur par reveal kiya.
Yosef ka krandan itna prabal tha ki baahar misri adhikaariyon ne ise sun liya aur iske baare mein faroh ke parivaar ne bhi sun liya.
Tab Yosef ne apne bhaaiyon se kaha, “Main Yosef hun! Kya mera pitaaji ab bhi jivit hain?” Lekin unke bhaai avaak rah gae the, unke lie Yosef ke samaksh kuchh bhi kahna asambhav ho gaya tha.

Tab Yosef ne apne bhaaiyon se anurodh kiya, “Mere nikat aaie” Ve unke nikat gae tab Yosef ne unse kaha, main aapka bhaai Yosef hun, jise aap logon ne misr desh se aanevaale vyaapaariyon ke haathon mein bech diya tha!
Ab aap na to khud ke lie shokit hon aur na hi kruddh, ki aapne mujhe yahaan ke lie vikrit kar diya tha; kyonki God hi mujhe aapke purv yahaan le aae hain, ki life bachaae jaaein.
Kyonki do varsh se sampurn desh mein akaal vyaapt hai aur yah paanch varsh aur bhi vyaapt rahega. Tab in varshon mein na to hal chalaae ja sakeinge aur na hi kisi tarah ki katni sambhav ho sakegi.
God ne mujhe aap logon ke purv hi yahaan bhej diya tha, ki vah aap logon ke lie prithvi par ek sheshaansh bacha rakhein, aapko ek bara bachaav dvaara jivit rakha ja sake.

“Isliye, vaastav mein, mujhe yahaan aap logon ke dvaara nahin, lekin God dvaara bheja gaya tha. God ne hi mujhe faroh ke pita ka jagah diya hai, mujhe faroh ki sab grihasthi ka prabhaari aur pure misr desh par prashaasak niyukt kar diya hai.

Ab aap log avilamb mere pita ke paas jaakar unse kahein, ‘Aapke son Yosef ka yah aagrah hai: God ne mujhe samagr misr desh ka prashaasak niyukt kiya hai. Aap yahaan mere paas a jaaein. Ab vilamb na karein.
Aap log aakar goshen pradesh mein bas jaaein aur mere nikat hi aap, aapki children, aapki children ki children, aapke pashuvrind, aapki bher-bakri aur aapki sampurn property bhi.
Vahaan main aapke lie khaana ki law karta rahunga, kyonki akaal abhi paanch varsh aur rahega, jiske kaaran aap vahaan aapki sampurn grihasthi ke saath purnath saadhan vihin ho jaaeinge.’
“Ab aap log khud dekh lijie aur yahaan khud mera bhaai binyaamin bhi yah dekh raha hai ki yah khud main aapse kah raha hun.

Ab aap log jaaie aur jaakar misr mein mere is vaibhav ka ullekh vahaan mere pita se kijie aur us sabka bhi, jo khud aapne yahaan dekha hai. Zaruri hai ki ab aap ati shighr jaaein aur mere pita ko yahaan le aaein.”
Tab Yosef apne bhaai binyaamin ko gale lagaakar rote rahe aur binyaamin bhi unse gale lagkar rote rahe.
Phir Yosef ne apne sabhi bhaaiyon ka chumban liya aur unke saath rote rahe; iske baad hi unke bhaaiyon ne Yosef ke saath baat karna shuru kiya.
Faroh ke parivaar mein bhi yah samaachaar suna gaya ki Yosef ke bhaai aae hue hain, jise sunkar faroh aur uske slaves mein ullaas ki lahar daur gai.
Tab faroh ne Yosef ke samaksh prastaav rakha, “Apne bhaaiyon se yah kaho, ‘Apne-apne gadhon par saamaan rakhein aur kanaan desh chale jaaein,
Vahaan se apne pita aur sab grihasthi lekar yahaan mere paas a jaaein, main unhein misr desh ka sarvottam hi provide karunga aur unka khaana is desh ki prachurta mein se hi hoga.’
“Aur ab, Yosef tumhaare lie order yah hai; ‘Aisa karo: yahaan misr desh se auraton aur baalkon ke lie vaahan le jaao aur apne pita ko yahaan le aao.
Apne saamaan ki chinta na karna, kyonki misr desh mein jo kuchh sarvottam hai, vah sab tumhaara hi hai.’ ”
Israel ke sons ne thik yahi kiya. Faroh ke order ke anurup Yosef ne unhein vaahan provide kar die aur yaatra ke lie zaruri saamagri bhi di.
Yosef ne har ek ko ek-ek jori kapde bhi diya, lekin binyaamin ko tin sau chaandi mudraaein aur paanch jori kapde diye.

Apne pita ke lie Yosef ne ye sabhi vastuein bhejin: das gadhe, jin par misr ki sarvottam vastuein rakh di gai thin, das gadhiyaan, jin par bhojy saamagri aur ann rakh diya gaya tha, ki yaatra ke samay unke pita ka bharan-poshan hota rahe.
Is tarah Yosef ne apne bhaaiyon ko kanaan desh ke lie bhej diya. Jab ve vida ho hi rahe the, tab Yosef ne unse aagrah kiya, “Yaatra beech aapas mein jhagarna nahin.”
Isliye ve misr desh se apne pita ke paas kanaan mein pahunch gae,
Unhonne apne pita ko suchit kiya, “Yosef jivit hai! Aur saty to yah hai ki vah sab misr desh ka prashaasak hai.” Yah sun Yaakob avaak rah gae—unhein apne sons ki baaton par faith hi na hua.

Tab unhonne apne pita ko Yosef ki kahi hui vah saari baatein bataai jo unhonne unse kahi thin. Jab unhonne Yosef dvaara bhejein vaahan dekhe, jo unko le jaane ke lie bheje gae the, tab unke pita Yaakob ke ji mein ji aaya.
Tab Israel ne kaha, “Main aashvast hun! Mera son Yosef jivit hai, apni maut ke purv vahaan jaakar main use dekhunga.”
Israel apni puri property lekar vahaan se ravaana hue. Jab ve bearsheba pahunche, unhonne apne pita yitshaak ke God ko bali charhaai.
Us raat God ne Israel ko darshan mein kaha “He, Yaakob! Yaakob!” Usne kaha, “Kahiye, kya command hai?”
Unhonne kaha, “Main God, tumhaare pita ka God hun; misr jaane se mat daro, tum vahaan jaao aur main vahaan tumse ek bari jaati banaaunga.
Misr tak main tumhaare saath saath chalunga aur nishchyath main hi tumhein vahaan se lauta bhi laaunga. Tumhaari maut ke samay Yosef tumhaare paas hoga.”
Tab Israel ke sons ne apne pita Yaakob, apne-apne baalkon aur apni-apni patniyon ko us gaari mein baitha diya, jise faroh ne bheji thi.
Inhonne apne saath apne pashu aur puri property le li thi, jo kanaan desh mein unhonne arjit thi. Yaakob aur unke sabhi log misr desh pahunch gaye.
Yaakob apne son aur unke pautr, unki putriyaan aur unki pautriyaan—sabhi ko apne saath misr lekar aaye.
Yaakob ne Yahudah ko pahle Yosef ke paas goshen ke lie maargdarshan paane ke lie bheja. Jab Yahudah goshen pradesh mein pahunch gaya,
Tab Yosef ne apna rath taiyaar karvaaya ki vah apne pita Israel se bheint karne goshen pahunch jaaein. Jaise hi unke pita unke paas aaye, vah unke gale lagkar bahut der tak rote rahe.
Phir Israel ne Yosef se kaha, “Ab main shaantipurvak apne jaan tyaag sakta hun, kyonki mainne tumhein dekh liya hai, ki tum jivit ho.”
Yosef ne apne bhaaiyon aur apne pita ke sabhi logon se kaha, “Main jaakar faroh ko bataata hun, ‘Kanaan desh se mere bhaai aur mere pita ka parivaar yahaan pahunch chuka hai.
Ve sabhi charvaahe hain; aur pashu paalte hain. Ve apne saath pashu, bher-bakri aur apni puri property lekar aae hain.’
Yosef ne apne pita aur bhaaiyon se kaha ki agar faroh aap logon se puchhe, ‘Aap log kya karte hain?’
To kahna ki ham charvaahe hain, aur ‘Hamaare purvaj yahi kaam karte the.’ Isse aapke lie goshen mein rahna aasaan ho jaaega. Kyonki misr ke log charvaahon se nafrat karte hain.”
Yosef ne jaakar faroh ko bataaya, “Mere pita aur mere bhaai apne sab bher-bakri, pashu aur apni puri property lekar kanaan desh se a chuke hain aur ve goshen desh mein hain.”
Yosef ne apne paanch bhaaiyon ko faroh ke saamne prastut kiya.
Faroh ne unke bhaaiyon se puchha, “Aap log kya kaam karte hain?” Unhonne faroh se kaha, “Ham hamaare purvjon ki hi tarah pashu paalte hain.

Ab is desh mein kuchh samay ke liye rahne aae hain, kyonki kanaan mein bhayankar akaal hone ke kaaran aapke slaves ke pashuon ke lie chaara nahin hai. Tab grace kar hamein goshen mein rahne ki anumti de dijie.”
Faroh ne Yosef se kaha, “Tumhaare pita aur tumhaare bhaai tumhaare paas aae hain,

Pura misr desh tumhaare lie khula hai; apne pita aur apne bhaaiyon ko goshen ke sabse achchhe bhaag mein rahne ki suvidha de do. Aur bhaaiyon mein se koi samajhdaar ho to use mere pashuon ki dekhbhaal ki puri javaabdaari de do.”
Phir Yosef pita Yaakob ko bhi faroh se milaane laae. Yaakob ne faroh ko blessing di.
Faroh ne Yaakob se puchha, “Aapki umr kya hai?”
Yaakob ne faroh ko bataaya “Meri tirth yaatra ke varsh ek sau tis rahe hain. Meri aayu bahut chhoti aur kashtabhri rahi hai aur vah mere purvjon si lambi nahin rahi hai!”
Yaakob faroh ko blessing dekar vahaan se chale gaye.
Yosef ne apne pita aur bhaaiyon ko faroh ki command hisaab se misr mein sabse achchhi jagah raameses mein zamin di.
Yosef ne apne pita, apne bhaaiyon aur pita ke pure parivaar ko unke bachchon ki ginti ke hisaab se khaana uplabdh karaaya.
Pure desh mein akaal ke kaaran khaana ki kami thi. Misr desh aur kanaan desh akaal ke kaaran bhukha para tha.
Misr desh aur kanaan desh ka saara wealth Yosef ne faroh ke raajamhal mein anaaj ke badle ikattha kar liya tha.

Jab logon ke paas anaaj kharidne ke lie rupya nahin tha tab vah Yosef ke paas aakar binti karne lage, “Hamein khaane ko khaana dijie. Ham aapki aankhon ke saamne kyon marein? Hamaara rupya sab khatm ho gaya hai.”
Yosef ne kaha, “Yadi tumaara rupya khatm ho gaya hain to tum apne pashu hamein dete jaao aur ham tumhein uske badle anaaj deinge.”

Isliye ve apne pashu Yosef ko dene lage; aur Yosef unhein unke ghore, pashuon, bher-bakri aur gadhon ke badle mein anaaj dene lage. Yosef ne us varsh unke sab pashuon ke badle mein unki khaana ki law ki.

Jab vah varsh khatm hua tab agle varsh vah Yosef ke paas aae aur unse kaha, “Maalik yah sach aapse chhupi nahin rah sakti ki hamaara saara rupya kharch ho gaya hain aur pashu bhi aapke ho gaye hai; ab hamaara body aur hamaari zamin hi bach gai hai.

Kya ham aur hamaari zamin aapki aankhon ke saamne barbaadi ho jaayeingi? Ab khaana ke badle aap hamaari zamin ko hi kharid lijie, aur ham apni zamin ke saath faroh ke slave ban jaaeinge. Hamein sirph bij de dijiye ki ham nahin marein lekin jivit rahein ki hamaari zameen nirjan na ho.”
Is tarah Yosef ne misr desh ki puri zamin faroh ke liye kharid li. Sabhi misrvaasiyon ne apni zameen bech di kyonki akaal bhayankar tha aur zamin faroh ki ho gai.
Yosef ne misr ke ek chhor se dusre chhor tak logon ko, slave bana diya.
Sirph priests ki zameen ko nahin kharida, kyonki unko faroh ki or se nirdhaarit khaana milta tha aur vah unke jine ke liye paryaapt tha, isliye unhonne apni zamin nahin bechi.
Yosef ne logon se kaha, “Mainne faroh ke lie aapko aur aapki zameen ko aaj kharid liya hai, ab aapke liye yah bij diya hai ki aap apni zamin par is bij ko bona aur kheti karna.

Aur jab upaj aayegi usmein se faroh ko paanchvaan bhaag dena hoga aur shesh chaar bhaag aapke honge; zamin mein bone ke bij ke liye aur aap, aapke parivaar aur aapke bachchon ke khaana ke liye honge.”
Tab logon ne kaha, “Aapne hamaara life bacha liya; yadi hamaare maalik ki daya ham par bani rahe aur ham faroh ke slave bane raheinge.”
Yosef ne jo niyam banaaya tha ki upaj ka paanchvaan bhaag faroh ko dena zaruri hai vah aaj bhi sthaapit hai. Sirph priests ki zameen faroh ki nahin hui.
Israel misr desh ke goshen naamak jagah par rah rahe the, vahaan ve phalte phulte wealth-property arjit karte gaye aur sankhya mein kai guna barhte gaye.
Misr mein Yaakob ko satrah saal ho chuke the, aur ve ek sau saintaalis varsh tak rahe.

Jab Israel marne par the, unhonne apne son Yosef ko paas bulaaya aur kaha, “Yadi tum mujhse love karte ho to meri jaangh ke niche apna haath rakhkar shapath lo, ki tum mujhse mercy aur faith ka bartaav karoge aur mujhe misr mein nahin dafnaaoge,
Jab main chir-nidra mein apne purvjon se ja milun, tab mujhe misr desh se le jaana aur purvjon ke saath unhin ke paas mujhe dafnaana.” Yosef ne kaha, “Main aisa hi karunga jaisa aapne kaha hai.”
Yaakob ne kaha, “Mujhse vaayda karo!” Yosef ne unse vaayda kiya aur Israel khaat ke sirhaane ki or jhuk gae.
Kuchh din baad Yosef ko bataaya gaya, “Aapke pita ki tabiyat thik nahin hai.” Yah sun Yosef apne dono sons; manashsheh aur ephraaim ko lekar apne pita se milne nikal pare.
Kisi ne Yaakob ko bata diya, “Yosef aapse milne a rahe hain.” Tab Israel apni saari power sametkar khaat se uthkar baith gaye.
Aur Yosef se baat karne lage aur kaha, “Kanaan desh ke luz mein sarvshaktimaan God ne mujhe darshan dekar blessing di.
Aur kaha, ‘Main tumhein phalvant karunga aur tujhe raajy-raajy ke samuh ka mukhiya banaaunga aur yah desh tumhein aur baad mein tumhaare vansh ko sadaakaal ke liye dunga.’
“Tumhaare ye dono son, jinka janm misr mein mere aane se pahle hua hai, ve meri children hain; ephraaim aur manashsheh mere kahlaaeinge, jaise riyuben aur Shimon mere hain.
Lekin tumhaari children, jo in donon ke baad janmegi, vah tumhaari kahlaaegi. Ve apne bhaaiyon ke pradeshon ke bhitar miraas receive kareinge.
Jab main paddan se a raha tha aur efraatha pahunchne hi vaale the ki raahel ki maut ka duhkh mujh par aan para. Mainne unhein efraatha ke raaste arthaat bethlehem mein daphnaaya.”
Yosef ke sons ko dekhkar Israel ne puchha, “Kaun hain ye?”
Yosef ne apne pita se kaha, “Ye mere son hain, jo mujhe is desh mein God ne diye.” Tab Yaakob ne kaha, “Mere paas unhein laao, ki main unhein blessing dun.”
Israel ki aankhein umr ke kaaran kamjor ho gayin thin ki ve dekh nahin sakte the. Yosef apne sons ko apne pita ke paas le gae. Yaakob ne unhein chuma aur unhein gale lagaaya.
Yosef ko dekhte hue Israel ne kaha, “Mainne yah na socha tha ki tumhein phir se dekh paaunga, lekin God ne mujhe tumhaari children tak dekhne ka saubhaagy diya.”
Yosef ne apne sons ko apne pita ki god se utaara aur jhukkar munh ke bal pranaam kiya.
Phir Yosef donon ko Israel ke najdik le gaye; daaein haath se vah ephraaim aur baaein haath se manashsheh ko pakre hue the. Ephraaim Israel ke baain or tha aur manashsheh Israel ke daain or.
Lekin Israel ne apna daayaan haath chhote bete ephraaim ke sir par aur apna baayaan haath manashsheh ke sir par rakha. Yaakob ne jaanbujhkar aisa kiya.
Yosef ko blessing dete hue Israel ne kaha, “God, jiske sammukh mere purvaj Abraham aur yitshaak chalte the, vahi God, life bhar aaj tak mera charvaaha bankar rahe hain,

Vah angel, jisne har pal meri raksha ki hai, vahi donon bachchon ko blessed karein. Aur ye donon mere, mere pita Abraham aur mere pita yitshaak, ke naam ko uncha karein. Aur prithvi mein barhte jaaye.”

Jab Yosef ne dekha ki unke pita ne apna daayaan haath ephraaim ke sir rakha hai to unhein achchha nahin laga ve apne pita ka daayaan haath pakarkar ephraaim ke sir par se hataakar manashsheh ke sir par rakhne lage.
Yosef ne apne pita se kaha, “Vah nahin, pitaaji, bara beta yah hai; aap apna daayaan haath is par rakh dijie.”
Lekin unke pita ne kaha, “Mujhe pata hai mere son; yah bhi mahaan ban jaaega, aur barhega to bhi uska chhota bhaai usse mahaan ho jaaega aur usse kai jaatiyaan nikleingi.”

Us din Israel ne unhein blessing di aur kaha, “Israel ke log tumhaara naam lekar aise kaheinge: ‘God tumhein ephraaim aur manashsheh ke jaisa bana dein.’ ” Yah kahte hue Yaakob ne ephraaim ko manashsheh se adhik shreshth jagah de diya.
Phir Israel ne Yosef se kaha, “Suno, ab meri maut ka samay a gaya hai, lekin God tumhaare saath saath raheinge aur tumhein apne purvjon ke desh mein vaapas le jaaeinge.
Main tumhein tumhaare bhaaiyon se barhkar hissa jyaada de raha hun—vah bhaag, jo mainne amoriyon se apni talvaar aur dhanush ke dvaara paaya tha.”
Tab Yaakob ne apne beton ko bulaakar unse kaha: “Tum sab ek saath aao, taaki tumhein bata sakun ki tumhaare saath ab kya-kya hoga.
“Yaakob ke putro, suno aur apne pita Israel ki baaton par dhyaan do.
“Riyuben, tum to mere bare bete, mere bal aur mere paurush ka phal ho, pratishtha aur power ka uttam bhaag tum hi ho.
Jo ashaant paani ke jaisa ugr hain, isliye tum mahaan na banoge, kyonki tumne apne pita ke bichhaune ko ashuddh kiya.
“Shimon aur Levi bhaai-bhaai hain; unki talvaarein hinsa ka saadhan hain.
Aisa kabhi na ho ki mujhe unki sabha mein jaana pare, main unki sabhaaon se na judun, kyonki gusse mein unhonne insaanon ko maar daala aur sanak mein unhonne bailon ki nasein kaat di.
Shaapit hai unka krodh jo bhishan hain aur unka aisa gussa, jo nirdyi aur krur hai! Main unhein Yaakob mein baant dunga. Aur unhein Israel mein titar-bitar kar dunga.
“Yahudah, tumhaare bhaai tumhaari prashansa kareinge; tumhaara haath tumhaare dushmanon ki gardan par parega; tumhaare pita ki dusre children tumhaare sammaan mein jhuk jaaeinge.
Yahudah to javaan sinh ke jaisa hai; he mere son, tum apne shikaar par khare sher ke jaisa ho jo aaraam karne ke lie letta hai, kismein use chherne ka saahas hai?
Yahudah se raajdand kabhi bhi alag na hoga aur na hi uske vansh se shaasan ka raajdand, dur hoga, jab tak vah na a jaaye aur raajy-raajy ke log uske adhin raheinge.
Apne gadhe ko daakhalta se baandh deta hai, aur gadhe ke bachche ko uttam daakhalta par baandhega; usne apna kapde daakhamdhu mein dhoya hai, aur baahri kapde daakhras mein dhoya hai.
Uski aankhein daakhamdhu se chamkili aur, uske daant dudh se bhi adhik saphed honge.
“Zebulun saagar ke kinaare rahega aur iska samudri tat jahaajon ke lie surakshit hoga, aur uski sima sidon desh tak phail jaayegi.
“Issaakhaar ek balvant gadha hai, vah pashuon ke baare ke bich rahta hai.
Jab usne dekha ki aaraam karne ki jagah thik hai, ki zameen sukhdaai hai, tab usne apne kandhe ko bojh uthaane ke lie jhuka diya aur vah begaar ka slave ban jaayega.
“Daan apne logon ka justice Israel ke ek gotr jaisa karega.
Daan raasta ka ek saamp hoga, path par ek sarp! Vah ghore ki eri ko dasta hai, aur savaar achaanak gir jaata hai.
“He Yahweh, main aapke bachaav ki baat johta hun.
“Gaad par chhaapaamaar chhaapa maareinge, lekin vah bhi unki eri par maarega.
“Aasher ka ann bahut uttam hoga aur vah raajsi khaana uplabdh karaaega.
“Naphtaali chhori hui hirni ke jaisa hai jo sundar bachchon ko janm deti hai.
“Yosef to phal se bhari ek shaakha hai jo sote ke paas lagi hui phalvant lata ki ek shaakha hai jo baare ke sahaare charhi hain.
Dhanush chalaanevaale ne dhanush chalaaya aur tir chhora aur lagkar dard hua.
Lekin uska dhanush drirh raha, uski baanhein majbut rahin, yah Yaakob ke sarvshaktimaan God ki or se tha, jo Israel ke charvaahe aur chattaan hain.

Tumhaare pita ke God ki or se, jo tumhaare sahaayak hain aur us sarvshaktimaan se jo svargiy aashishon se tumhein blessed kareinge, ve aashishein, jo niche gahraaiyon se aati hain, stanon aur garbh ki aashishein dega.

Tumhaare pita ki aashishein to mere purvjon ke pahaaron se barhkar hain ye anant parvton se sambandhit aashishon se barhkar hain. Ye hi aashishein Yosef par reveal hokar uske sir ka mukut banein, jo sab bhaaiyon se pratishthit hua hai.
“Binyaamin ek krur bheriya hai; savere vah aher ka sevan karta hai, shaam ko vah lut saamagri baanta karta hai.”
Ye sabhi Israel ke baarah gotr hain unke pita ne unke baare mein tab kaha jab vah unhein blessing de rahe the, aur unmein se ek-ek ko inhin vachnon se blessing di.
Tab Israel ne kaha, “Mujhe mere purvjon ki usi gufa mein daphnaana, jo ephron hitti ke khet mein hai,
Kanaan desh mein us kabrasthaan mein, jo maakhpelaah ke khet mein, mamre ke paas hai, jise Abraham ne hitti ephron se kharida tha.
Vahaan unhonne Abraham aur unki patni saaraah ko daphnaaya tha, vahin unhonne yitshaak aur unki patni rebekaah ko daphnaaya aur vahin mainne liyaah ko bhi daphnaaya hai;
Vah khet gupha sahit hittiyon se kharida hai.”
Jab Yaakob apne sons ko ye order de chuke, tab unhonne apne pair apne bichhaune par kar lie aur aakhiri saans li, ve apne purvjon se ja mile.
Yosef apne pita se lipat kar bahut roye.
Yosef ne apne servants se, jo vaidy the unse kaha ki ve pita ke shav mein sugandh dravy bhar dein. Vaidyon ne Israel ke shav ka sanlepan kiya.
Is kaam mein chaalis din lag jaate the. Misrvaasiyon ne Yaakob ke lie sattar din tak shok manaaya.
Jab shok ke din pure hue tab Yosef ne jaakar faroh ke parivaar se kaha, “Yadi aapka grace mujh par hai to faroh se kahiye,

‘Mere pita ne marne se pahle mujhse yah shapath karvaai: unhonne kaha, main marne par hun mujhe kanaan desh mein us kabr mein daphnaana, jo mainne apne liye khodi hai, isliye mujhe apne pita ke shav ko kanaan desh le jaane ki command dein taaki main vahaan jaakar apne pita ko daphnaakar laut aaun.’ ”
Faroh ne kaha, “Jaakar apne pita ko jaisi unhonne tumse shapath karvaai thi, vaise daphnaakar aao.”
Isliye Yosef apne pita ke shav ko lekar ravaana hue aur faroh ke sab servant unke saath gaye. Unke saath unke parivaar ke aur misr desh ke saare leader the.
Yosef ka pura parivaar, unke bhaai aur unke pita ka parivaar bhi tha. Ve goshen mein bachchon aur apne bher-bakri aur pashuon ko chhorkar gaye.
Unke saath ghore aur rath aur logon ki bari bhir thi.
Jab ve ataad ke khalihaan tak jo yardan ke paar hai, pahunche; tab ve bare duhkhi hue aur rone lage; unhonne vahaan apne pita ke lie saat din ka shok rakha.
Jab kanaan ke logon ne ataad ke khalihaan mein yah vilaap dekha to kaha, “Misrvaasiyon ke lie yah vaastav mein gahra shok hai.” Isliye yardan paar us jagah ka naam abel-misraim rakha gaya.
Is tarah Yaakob ke sons ne unke lie thik vaisa hi kiya, jaisa Yaakob ne kaha tha:
Yaakob ke sons ne unhein kanaan desh mein mamre ke paas maakhpelaah ke khet ki gupha mein daphna diya, jo Abraham ne kabrasthaan ke lie hitti ephron se kharidi thi.
Apne pita ko daphnaane ke baad Yosef misr desh laut gae. Unke saath unke bhaai bhi laut gae aur ve sab bhi, jo unke saath yahaan aae the.
Jab Yosef ke bhaaiyon ne socha, “Hamaare pita ka nidhan ho chuka hai, ab yadi Yosef hamse naphrat karke pichhli baaton ka badla lega to ham kya kareinge?”
Isliye unhonne Yosef se kaha: “Pita ne hamse kaha tha ki

‘Yosef se kahna ki grace kar apne bhaaiyon ke atyaachaar aur galtiyon ko maaph kar do jo unhonne tumse kie the,’ Isliye ab, grace kar apne pita ke God ke naam se hamaari galtiyon ko maaph kar do.” Yosef unki yah baat sunkar rone lage.
Tab unke bhaai bhi rone lage aur Yosef ke saamne jhukkar kahne lage, “Ham sabhi aapke slave hain.”
Lekin Yosef ne unse kaha, “Aap log mat daro. Kya main koi God hun?
Main jaanta hun ki aap logon ne bhale hi meri haani ki yojna banaai ho, lekin God ne use achchhe ke liye kiya ki bahuton ka life bacha liya gaya!
Isliye bhaybhit na ho; main khud tumhein aur tumhaare bachchon ko khaana dunga.” Is tarah Yosef ne apne bhaaiyon ko saantvna di aur unse komalta se baatein ki.
Yosef misr mein apne pita ke pure parivaar ke saath rahe. Yosef ki umr ek sau das varsh hui.
Yosef ne ephraaim ki tisri pirhi bhi dekhi aur manashsheh ke pote, jo maakhir ke son the, unhein bhi janm ke baad Yosef ke ghutnon par rakha gaya.

Yosef ne apne bhaaiyon ko kaha, “Main ab marne par hun, lekin God zarur aap sab ki raksha kareinge aur vahi tumhein is desh se us desh mein le jaaeinge, jiski shapath unhonne Abraham, yitshaak aur Yaakob se ki thi.”
Tab Yosef ne Israel ke sons se shapath li, “God aap sabhi ki madad ke liye aaeinge aur tab aap log meri haddiyon ko yahaan se lekar jaana.”
Yosef ki maut ek sau das varsh mein hui. Unke shav ko sugandh dravy se bhara gaya aur unhein misr desh mein hi ek sanduk mein rakh diya gaya.
Yaakob ke saath misr mein apne-apne gharaane ke saath aakar rahnevaale israaeliyon ke naam nimn likhit hain:
Riyuben, Shimon, Levi aur Yahudah;
Issaakhaar, zebulun aur binyaamin;
Daan aur naphtaali; gaad aur aasher.
Yaakob ke vansh mein sattar jan the, Yosef pahle hi misr mein the.
Vahaan Yosef aur unke sabhi bhaai aur puri pirhi ke logon ki maut ho gai thi.
Israaeli bahut phalvant the aur ve barhte chale gae, aur bahut saamarthyi hokar pure desh mein bhar gae.
Phir misr mein ek naya raaja bana, jo Yosef ko nahin jaanta tha.
Usne apni people se yah kaha, “Israel ke log sankhya mein aur bal mein hamse adhik hain.
Isliye ham samajhdaari se rahein, ye log to barhte jaaeinge! Aisa na ho ki yuddh ki situation mein hamaare dushmanon ke saath milkar, hamse hi yuddh karne lagein aur desh chhorkar chale jaaein.”
Is soch se unhonne israaeliyon ko kari mehnat karaane ke purpose se thekedaar niyukt kar die. Tab faroh ke lie pithom aur raameses naamak bhandaargrih shehron ko banaae.
Jitna israaeliyon ko kasht diya gaya, utne hi ve barhte aur desh mein phailte gae, isliye israaeli misrvaasiyon ke lie dar ka kaaran ban gaye.
Misri israaeliyon se kathor mehnat karaate rahe.
Is tarah misriyon ne israaeliyon ke life ko duhkhpurn kar diya. Unhein gaare aur int ke lie kari mehnat karni parti thi. Sabhi kaamon mein unhein duhkhi kar sataaya jaata tha.
Yah dekh misr desh ke raaja ne ibri dhaayon ko bulvaaya. Inmein ek ka naam shiphraah aur dusri ka puaah tha.
Raaja ne unse kaha, “Ibri auraton ka prasav karaate samay jaise hi tumhein yah pata chali ki larka hai, tum uski murder kar dena; lekin yadi vah putri ho, to use jivit rahne dena.”
Lekin dhaayein God ka dar maanne vaalin thin. Is kaaran unhonne raaja ki baat nahin maani; ve sons ko jivit chhorti chali gain.
Isliye raaja ne dhaayon ko bulvaaya aur unse puchha, “Tum aisa kyon kar rahi ho? Kyon larkon ko jivit chhor rahi ho?”
Unhonne faroh ko javaab diya, “Ibri striyaan misri auraton ke jaisa nahin hoti; ve hrisht-pusht hoti hain, isliye hamaare pahunchne se pahle hi prasav kar chuki hoti hain.”
Is kaaran God ki daya un dhaayon par bani rahi, israaeli barhte aur shaktishaali hote gae.
Dhaayon ke man mein God ka dar tha, is kaaran God ne unko apne parivaar diye.
Phir faroh ne sab logon se kaha, “Har navjaat son ko, jo tumhaare aas-paas janm leta hai, unhein nil nadi mein pheink diya karna, lekin putri ko jivit rahne dena.”
Levi gotr ke ek person ne Levi gotr ki ek kanya se vivaah kiya.
Us kanya ne garbhdhaaran kiya aur ek bachche ko janm diya, aur vah bahut sundar tha, usne use tin mahine tak chhipaae rakha.

Lekin jab bachche ko chhipaae rakhna uske lie mushkil ho gaya tab usne ek tokri banaai aur us par taarkol aur pich ka lep kiya. Usne bachche ko tokri mein rakh us tokri ko nil nadi ke kinaare lambi ghaason ke bich mein rakh diya.
Us bachche ki bahan bachche ke saath kya hoga yah dekhne ke lie dur khari hui thi.
Faroh ki putri nil nadi mein snaan karne aai aur uski daasiyaan nadi ke kinaare chal rahi thin. Faroh ki putri ki najar us tokri par pari. Usne apni daasiyon ko vah tokri laane ko kaha.
Us tokri ko kholne par uski najar us bachche par pari, jo us samay ro raha tha. Bachche par usko daya aai aur vah samajh gai ki yah kisi ibri ka hi bachcha hai.
Us bachche ki bahan ne faroh ki putri se puchha, “Kya main jaakar iske lie ibri dhaayon mein se kisi ko le aaun jo ise dudh pila sake?”
Faroh ki putri ne usse kaha, “Jaao!” Tab vah larki jaakar bachche ki maan ko hi bula laai.
Faroh ki putri ne usse kaha, “Is bachche ko le jaao aur iska follow poshan karo. Iske lie main tumhein majduri dungi.” Tab vah aurat us bachche ko le gai aur uska follow poshan kiya.

Jab bachcha bara ho gaya tab vah bachche ko faroh ki putri ke paas le gai aur faroh ki putri ne use apna son maan liya. Usne uska naam Moshe rakha. Uska matlab tha, “Mainne use paani mein se paaya hai.”
Jab Moshe javaan hue, tab vah apne logon se milne unke paas gae to dekha ki ve kari mehnat kar rahe the. Usi samay unhonne dekha ki ek misri kisi ibri ko maar raha tha.
Isliye Moshe ne us misri ko maar diya aur use ret mein chhipa diya.
Agle din Moshe ne dekha ki do ibri aapas mein lar rahe hain. Isliye Moshe ne unse puchha, “Kyon aapas mein lar rahe ho?”

Us person ne Moshe ko javaab diya, “Kisne tumhein ham par raaja aur justice karnevaala thahraaya hai? Kahin tumhaara matlab kal us misri jaise meri bhi murder ka to nahin hai?” Yah sunkar Moshe dar gae aur unhonne socha, “Ab yah bhed khul chuka hai.”
Jab faroh ko yah maalum hua, tab usne Moshe ki murder karne ko socha, lekin Moshe faroh ke saamne se bhaagkar midiyaan desh mein rahne lage, vahaan ek kuna tha.
Midiyaan ke priest ki saat putriyaan thin. Ve us kuein mein paani bharne aain aur unhonne apne pita ki bher-bakriyon ke lie naandon mein paani bhara.
Tabhi kuchh charvaahe aae aur un kanyaaon ko vahaan se bhaga diya; tab Moshe vahaan aae aur un kanyaaon ka bachaav kiya aur unki bher-bakriyon ko paani pilaaya.
Jab ve ghar lautin, to unke pita riyuel ne unse puchha, “Aaj itni jaldi kaise ghar laut aai ho?”
Unhonne javaab diya, “Ek misri ne un charvaahon se hamaari raksha ki. Yahi nahin, usne kuein se paani nikaalkar hamein aur hamaari bher-bakriyon ko bhi pilaaya.”
Riyuel ne apni putriyon se puchha, “Vah person kahaan hai? Tum use vahin kyon chhor aai? Use khaana ke lie bula laao!”
Moshe unke saath rahne ke lie taiyaar ho gae. Riyuel ne apni putri zipporaah ka vivaah Moshe ke saath kar diya.
Unhonne ek son ko janm diya. Moshe ne uska naam gershom rakha, uska matlab tha, “Main pardesh mein ek ajanbi hun.”

Us lambe samaykaal ke baad misr desh ke raaja ki maut ho gai. Israaeli apne daasatv mein karaah rahe the aur duhaai de rahe the. Ve madad ki guhaar kar rahe the aur unke daasatv ki yah guhaar God tak pahunchi.
God ne unki karaahat suni, aur Abraham, yitshaak aur Yaakob ke saath ki gai apni vaacha ko yaad kiya.
God ne Israel ki or nazar ki aur unki situation par dhyaan diya.
Moshe apne sasur, midiyaan ke priest yethro ki bher-bakriyaan charaate hue nirjan kshetr ke pashchim mein God ke parvat horeb par pahunch gae.
Vahaan un jhaariyon ke bich mein se aag ki lau mein Yahweh ke dut ne unko darshan diya, unhonne dekha ki jhaari paani rahi thi, par bhasm nahin hoti.
Isliye Moshe ne socha, “Main jaakar jalti hui jhaari ko dekhun ki jhaari jalkar bhasm kyon nahin hoti.”
Jab Yahweh ne yah dekha ki Moshe yah dekhne aage barh rahe hain, God ne us jhaari se unhein bulaaya, “Moshe, Moshe!” Unhonne javaab diya, “Kahie Lord.”
Yahweh ne kaha, “Paas na aao, apni pairon se jute utaar do, kyonki yah jagah, jis par tum khare ho, holy hai.”
Yahweh ne yah kaha, “Main hi tumhaare purvjon ke pita arthaat Abraham ka, yitshaak aur Yaakob ka God hun.” Yah sun Moshe ne apna munh chhipa liya, kyonki vah God ki or dekhne se darta tha.
Yahweh God ne Moshe se kaha, “Misr desh mein mere logon ki haalat mainne dekhi hai; unke kashtkar mehnat karaane vaalon ke kaaran unka rona mainne suna hai aur unke kasht ko jaanta hun,

Isliye ab main unhein misriyon ke authority se chhuraane utar aaya hun, taaki unhein us desh se nikaalkar ek uttam desh mein le jaaun, jahaan dudh aur madhu bahta hai, jo kanaaniyon, hittiyon, amoriyon, parijziyon, hivviyon aur yabusiyon ka desh hai.
Ab sun lo: israaeliyon ki prayer mujh tak pahunchi hai; iske alaava misriyon dvaara un par kie ja rahe atyaachaar bhi mainne dekh lie hain.
Isliye ab main tumhein faroh ke paas bhejunga ki tum meri people israaeliyon ko misr desh se nikaal laae.”
Lekin Moshe ne God se kaha, “Main kaun hun jo faroh ke paas jaaun aur israaeliyon ko misr desh se nikaalun?”

Lekin God ne Moshe se kaha, “Main tumhaare saath saath rahunga, aur is baat ka sabut khud main hun, jab tum meri people ko misr desh se nikaal chuke honge, tab tum isi parvat par God ki worship karoge.”

Yah sun Moshe ne God ko javaab diya, “Yadi main israaeliyon ke paas jaakar unse kahun, ‘Tumhaare hi purvjon ke God ne mujhe tumhaare paas bheja hai.’ Aur ve mujhse puchhein, ‘Kya hai us God ka naam?’ To main unhein kya naam bataaun?”
God ne Moshe ko javaab diya, “Main vahi hun, jo main hun.” God ne aage yah kaha, “Tumhein israaeliyon se yah kahna hoga: jiska naam ‘Main hun hai, unhin ne mujhe bheja hai.’ ”

Phir God ne Moshe se kaha, “Tum israaeliyon se yah kahna ‘Yahweh, tumhaare purvjon ke God, Abraham, yitshaak aur Yaakob ke God hi ne mujhe tumhaare paas bheja hai.’ “Yahi mera sthir naam hai, sab pirhi se pirhi tak smaran rakhne ka mera naam yahi hai.

“Ab tum jaao aur israaeliyon se kaho: ‘Yahweh God jo tumhaare purvjon ke God Abraham, yitshaak aur Yaakob ke God jo mujh par reveal hue aur mujhse kaha ki mainne tum par najar rakhi hai, aur misr desh mein tumhaare saath jo kuchh kiya gaya hai usko mainne dekha hai.

Isliye mainne yah vaayda kiya ki main tumhein misr desh mein ho rahe kasht se baahar nikaalunga aur kanaaniyon, hittiyon, amoriyon, parijzir, hivviyon aur yabusiyon ke desh mein le aaunga, jahaan dudh aur madhu ki dhaara bahti hai.’

“Israel ke leader tumhaari baaton ko suneinge. Tab tum Israel ke leaders ke saath misr desh ke raaja ke saamne jaana aur usse kahna ki Yahweh, jo ibriyon ke God hain, ham par reveal hue hain. Ab hamein tin din ki yaatra ki duri tak nirjan pradesh mein jaane de, taaki ham Yahweh ko, jo hamaare God hain, bali arpit kar sakein;
Lekin mujhe maalum hai ki misr desh ka raaja tumhein tab tak jaane nahin dega, jab tak use ek shaktishaali haath majbur na kare.
Isliye main ab apna haath barhaakar misr desh mein alag-alag tariqon ke chamatkaari kaary karke un par vaar karunga, tab hi ve tumhein jaane deinge.
“Main apni is people ko misriyon se anugrhit karvaaunga; jab tum vahaan se nikloge, tum khaali haath na nikloge.
Har ek ibri aurat apne paas rah rahe misri parosi aurat se sone, chaandi ke jevar aur kapde maangkar apne son-putriyon ko pahna de. Is tarah tum misriyon ko lut lena.”
Yah sun Moshe ne puchha, “Kya hoga jab ve meri baat ka na faith karein aur na maanein, aur kahein, ‘Yah asambhav hai ki Yahweh tum par reveal hue hon?’ ”
Yahweh ne unhein javaab diya, “Tumhaare haath mein kya hai?” Moshe ne javaab diya, “Ek laathi.”
Yahweh ne kaha, “Use zameen par daal do!” Tab Moshe ne use zameen par daal di. Vah laathi saamp ban gai, Moshe darkar dur chale gae.
Yahweh ne Moshe se kaha, “Apna haath barhaakar uski punchh pakar lo!” Tab Moshe ne apna haath barhaakar use pakar liya aur vah unke haath mein aate hi laathi ban gai!
Yahweh ne kaha, “Yah dekhkar ve faith kareinge ki tumhaare purvjon ke God, Abraham, yitshaak aur Yaakob ke God hi, tum par reveal hue hain.”

Phir Yahweh ne Moshe se dubaara kaha “Ab apna haath kapde ke bhitar apni chhaati par rakho.” Moshe ne apna haath apni chhaati par rakhkar baahar nikaala, turant unka haath kushth ke kaaran him jaisa shvet ho gaya.

Tab Yahweh ne unse kaha, “Apna haath vaapas apni chhaati par rakho!” Moshe ne apna haath vaapas apni chhaati par rakha; aur jab unhonne apna haath chhaati se baahar nikaala, vah vaapas pahle jaisa sahi ho gaya.
“Yadi ve tumhaari baat ka faith na karein ya us pahle vaale chinh ko na maanein, ho sakta hai ki ve dusre chinh par faith kar lein.

Lekin yadi ve in donon chinhon par bhi faith na karein aur tumhaari baat ko bhi na maane, tab tum nil nadi se kuchh paani lekar sukhi zameen par daal dena; nil nadi se liya gaya vah paani sukhi zameen par daalte hi khun ban jaaega.”

Tab Moshe ne Yahweh se kaha, “Yahweh God, mujhe maaph karein, main achchhi tarah se bol nahin sakta hun, pahle bhi nahin bol sakta tha, aur na jab se aapne apne slave se baat ki thi, meri zubaan tutli aur dhimi hai!”
Yahweh ne unse puchha, “Kisne insaan ka munh banaaya hai? Kaun use gunga ya bahira banaata hai? Kaun hai jo usko bolne ki power ya dekhne ke lie roshni deta hai? Kya main, khud Yahweh nahin?
Ab jaao. Main, haan, main tumhein bolne ki madad karunga, aur bataaunga, ki tumhein kya bolna hai.”
Lekin Moshe ne mana kiya aur kaha, “Lord, apne slave ko maaph kar de, kripya aap kisi dusre ko bhej dijie.”
Yahweh Moshe se naaraaj hue. Unhonne Moshe se kaha, “Tumhaara bhaai, ahron, jo Levi hai, vah tumse milne yahin a raha hai. Tumhein dekhkar vah khush ho jaaega.
Tum use yah sab bataana aur uske munh mein baatein daalna iske alaava main—haan main, tum donon ki bolne mein madad karunga, main tum donon ko sahi raasta par chalna sikhaaunga.
Vah tumhaari or se logon se baat karega va tum ahron ke God jaisa honge.
Is laathi ko tum apne haath mein hi rakhna, isi se tum adbhut kaam kar paaoge.”

Moshe vahaan se aakar apne sasur yethro se milne gae aur unse kaha, “Kripya mujhe jaane dijie taaki main misr desh mein apne bhaai-bandhuon se milkar pata karun ki unmein se koi ab bhi zinda hai ya nahin.” Yethro ne unse kaha, “Tum shaanti se jaao.”
Midiyaan desh mein hi Moshe ko Yahweh ki or se yah order mil chuka tha, “Misr desh ko laut jaao, kyonki un sabhi ki maut ho chuki hai, jo tumhaari murder karna chaahte the.”
Phir Moshe apni patni aur sons ko gadhe par baithaakar misr desh ko laut gae. God ke kahe hisaab se Moshe God ki laathi apne haath mein li hui thi.

Yahweh ne Moshe se kaha, “Misr desh pahunchkar tum ve sabhi chinh faroh ko dikhaana jo mainne tumhaare vash mein kie hain, lekin main faroh ke man ko kathor kar dunga, aur vah israaeliyon ko jaane na dega.
Tab tum faroh se kahna, ‘Yahweh ka sandesh yah hai: Israel mera son—mera pahlautha hai.
Yah mera order hai ki mere son ko jaane do, ki vah meri worship kar sake; lekin tum unhein jaane nahin de rahe ho. Is kaaran main tumhaare bare bete ko maar dunga.’ ”
Yahweh ne ahron se kaha, “Nirjan pradesh mein jaakar Moshe se milo.” Aur ahron God ke parvat par gaye aur Moshe se mile. Ahron ne Moshe ka chumban kiya.
Moshe ne ahron ko vah sab baatein bataain jinhein kahne ke liye Yahweh ne use bheja tha. Moshe ne vah adbhut chinh bhi bataae, jinhein Yahweh ne Moshe ko karne ki command di thi.
Moshe aur ahron ne israaeliyon ke sab leaders ko bulaaya.
Ahron ne unko vah sab baat bataai, jo Yahweh ne Moshe se kahi thi. Phir unhonne sab logon ke saamne vah chinh bhi dikhaaye.

Chinh dekhkar logon ne unka faith kiya aur jab unhein yah pata chala ki Yahweh ne israaeliyon ki or kaan lagaaya hai aur unke dukhon ki or dhyaan diya hai, tab unhonne jhukkar pranaam kiya aur God ki worship ki.
Prashaaskon ke shaasankaal mein saare desh mein ek akaal para. Yahudiya ke bethlehem shehar ka ek person apni patni aur sons ke saath moaab desh mein pravaas karne ke lie chala gaya.
Is person ka naam elimelekh, uski patni ka naam naavomi, aur uske sons ke naam mahlon aur kilyon the. Ye Yahudah ke bethlehem ke iphrath parivaar se the.
Kuchh samay baad elimelekh ki maut ho gai. Ab naavomi apne sons ke saath akeli rah gai.
Unke sons ne moaab desh ki hi yuvtiyon se vivaah kar liya. Ek ka naam tha orpaah aur dusri ka ruth. Moaab desh mein unke lagbhag das varsh rahne ke baad,
Mahlon aur kilyon ki maut ho gai. Ab naavomi apne donon sons aur pati ke bina akeli rah gai.
Yah pata parne par ki Yahweh ne apni people ko khaana dekar unki sudhi li hai, naavomi ne apni donon bahuon ke saath moaab desh se Yahudiya ko laut jaane ka soch kiya.
Tab jahaan vah rah rahi thi vah jagah chhorkar apni bahuon ke saath Yahudiya ke raasta par chal parin.
Raasta mein naavomi ne apni bahuon se kaha, “Tum donon apne-apne maayke laut jaao. Yahweh tum par vaise hi dayaalu hon, jaisi tum mritkon aur mujh par dayaalu rahi ho.
Yahweh ki kripaadrishti mein tumhein apne-apne honevaale pati ke ghar mein sukh-shaanti receive ho.” Tab naavomi ne unko chuma aur ve phaphak-phaphak kar roti rahin.
Unhonne naavomi ko javaab diya, “Nahin, ham aapke saath, aapke hi logon mein ja raheingi.”
Lekin naavomi ne unse kaha, “Laut jaao meri putriyo, tum bhala kyon mere saath jaaogi? Kya ab bhi mere garbh mein son hain, jo tumhaare pati ban sakein?

Laut jaao meri putriyo, apne ghar laut jaao, kyonki meri aayu vah nahin rahi, ki main dobaara vivaah kar sakun. Yadi main yah bhi kahun ki mujhe ummid hai, yadi main aaj raat vivaah kar garbhdhaaran bhi kar lun,
To kya tum unke yuva hone ka intjaar karogi? To kya tum tab tak vivaah na karogi? Nahin, meri putriyo, mere dil ka duhkh bahut hi gahra hai, kyonki khud Yahweh mere khilaaf ho gae hain!”
Tab ve dobaara phaphak-phaphak kar rone lagin; phir orpaah ne apni saas ko chuma, aur unse vida ho gai, lekin ruth ne apni saas ko na chhora.
Naavomi ne ruth se kaha, “Suno, tumhaari jethaani to apne logon aur apne devtaaon ke paas laut gai hai. Tum bhi apni jethaani ke jaisa laut jaao.”

Lekin ruth ne use javaab diya, “Aap mujhe na to laut jaane ke lie majbur karein aur na aapko chhorne ke lie, kyonki aap jahaan bhi jaaeingi, main aapke hi saath jaaungi aur jahaan aap raheingi, main vahin rahungi. Aapke log mere log honge aur aapke God mere God;

Jis jagah par aap aakhiri saans lein, main bhi vahin aakhiri saans lun, aur vahin mujhe bhi mitti di jaae. Ab yadi maut ke alaava mera aapse alag hone ka koi aur kaaran ho, to Yahweh mujhe kathor se kathor dand dein.”
Jab naavomi ne yah dekha ki ruth unke saath jaane ke lie drirh nishchyi hai, tab unhonne ruth ko majbur karne ki aur koshish na ki.

Tab ve aage chalte-chalte baithleham pahunch gai. Jab unhonne bethlehem shehar mein pravesh kiya, unhein dekh shehar mein uttejna ki lahar daur gai. Achambhe mein striyaan puchhne lagin, “Kahin yah naavomi to nahin?”
“Mat kaho mujhe naavomi! Maara kaho mujhe, maara! Usne javaab diya, kyonki sarvshaktimaan ne mere life ko karvaahat se bhar diya hai.

Main yahaan se to bhari puri gai thi, lekin Yahweh mujhe yahaan khaali haath lauta laaein hain. Tab mujhe naavomi kyon pukaara jaae? Jab Yahweh ne hi mujhe yah dand diya hai, aur sarvshaktimaan dvaara hi mujh par yah musibat daali gai hai.”
Is tarah naavomi moaab desh se apni bahu ruth ke saath, jo moaab ki rahnevaali thi, laut aai. Bethlehem shehar mein yah jau ki kataai ka samay tha.
Naavomi ke pati ke boaz naam ke ek rishtedaar tha. Vah elimelekh ke parivaar se ek naami aur dhani person tha.

Moaabi ruth ne naavomi se puchha, “Kya aap mujhe anumti deingi ki main kheton mein kisi aise person ke pichhe jaakar, jo mujhe iski anumti de de ki giri hui silla ikatthi karun?” Naavomi ne javaab diya, “Jaao, meri beti.”
So ruth ne khet mein jaakar phasal kaatnevaalon ke pichhe-pichhe baalein ikatthi karna shuru kar diya. Sanyog se yah khet elimelekh ke rishtedaar boaz ka tha.

Kuchh hi samay baad, jab boaz bethlehem shehar se vahaan khet mein aae, unhonne phasal kaatnevaalon ko namaskaar karte hue unse kaha, “Yahweh aapke saath rahein!” Unhonne iske uttar mein kaha, “Yahweh ki kripaadrishti aap par bani rahe.”
Boaz ne phasal kaatnevaalon ke prabhaari se puchha, “Yah yuvti kaun hai?”
Phasal kaatnevaalon ke prabhaari ne javaab diya, “Yahi hai vah moaabi yuvti, jo moaab desh se naavomi ke saath aai hai.

Usne mujhse anumti maangi thi, ‘Mujhe kaatnevaalon ke pichhe-pichhe, puliyon ke bich se giri hui silla ikatthi karne dein.’ Yah subah se aai hui hai aur thore se aaraam ke alaava tab se ab tak kaam hi kar rahi hai.”
Tab boaz ne ruth se kaha, “Beti, dhyaan se suno. Kisi dusre khet mein baalein binne na jaana, aur na hi is khet se baahar jaana. Behtar hoga ki tum meri in daasiyon ke paas hi bani rahe.

Yah dhyaan rahe ki ve kis khet mein katni kar rahi hain, ki tum unke pichhe-pichhe silla bin karte jaana. Mainne apne slaves ko order diya hai ki ve tumhein kisi bhi tarah ka takliph na dein. Jab tumhein pyaas lagi to, jaakar slaves dvaara bhare gae matkon se paani pi lena.”
Ruth ne zameen tak jhukkar dandvat karte hue kaha, “Kya kaaran hai, jo mujh videshi aurat par aapki aisi kripaadrishti hui, aur aapne meri itni chinta ki hai?”

Boaz ne javaab diya, “Apne pati ki maut se lekar ab tak tumne apni saas ke lie jo kuchh kiya hai, aur jis tarah tum apne maata-pita ka ghar aur apni maatribhumi ko chhorkar puri tarah se anjaane logon ke bich a gai ho, iska pura varnan mujhe sunaaya gaya hai.
Tumne jo kuchh kiya hai, Yahweh tumhein uska pratiphal dein, aur Israel ka God Yahweh hi jiske pankhon ke niche tumne sharan li hai, tumhein iska vipul puraskaar dein!”
Ruth ne unse kaha, “Mahoday, haalaanki main aapki in daasiyon ke baraabar bhi nahin hun, aapne mujh par kripaadrishti ki, mujhse komal words mein baatein ki hain, aapne mujhe protsaahit kiya hai.”

Khaana ke samay boaz ne ruth se kaha, “Yahaan a jaao, mere saath khaana karo, aur apne kaur ko sirke mein duboti jaao.” So vah phasal kaatnevaalon ke saath baith gai aur boaz ne use bhuna hua anaaj bhi de diya, jise usne na keval bharpet khaaya balki uske paas kuchh ann bacha bhi rah gaya.
Jab vah giri hui baalein ikatthi karne ke lie dobaara uthi, boaz ne slaves ko command di, “Yadi vah puliyon ke bich se bhi ikattha karne lage, na use rokna aur na use daantna.
Aur haan, aisa karna, kuchh baalein puliyon mein se khinchkar bhi daal dena, ki vah unhein bhi binkar ikattha kar le.”
So vah shaam tak zameen par giri hui baalein ikatthi karti rahi. Jab usne daane alag kie, unki maatra lagbhag 13 kilo nikli.
Vah ise lekar shehar mein gai, aur apni saas ke saamne yah ann aur us khaana ko bhi rakh diya, jo uske tript hone ke baad bacha rah gaya tha.

Uski saas ne usse puchha, “Tumne baalein kahaan se binin? Tum kis jagah par kaam karti rahi? Blessed hai vah person, jisne tumhaara dhyaan rakha!” Tab ruth ne apni saas ko bataaya ki usne kiske saath kaam kiya tha, “Jis person ke yahaan mainne aaj kaam kiya hai, unka naam boaz hai.”

Tab naavomi ne ruth se kaha, “Yahweh ki kripaadrishti un par bani rahe, jo na to jiviton ko apni grace se dur rakhte hain, aur na mare huon ko.” Naavomi ne yah bhi kaha, “Vah person hamaara nazdiki rishtedaar hai; hamaara ek chhuraane vaala bhi.”
Moaabi ruth ne aage kaha, “Iske alaava unhonne mujhse yah bhi kaha hai, ‘Iska dhyaan rakhna, ki tum katni khatm hone tak mere slaves ke paas hi raho.’ ”
Tab naavomi ne apni bahu ruth se kaha, “Meri beti, yah tumhaare bhale ke lie hi hai ki tum in daasiyon ke saath ho, nahin to kisi dusre ke khet mein tumhein pareshaan kiya ja sakta tha.”
To jau aur gehun ki katni khatm hone tak ruth boaz ki daasiyon ke saath saath hi bani rahi. Vah apni saas ke saath hi rahti thi.
Ek din ruth ki saas naavomi ne ruth se kaha, “Meri beti, kya yah meri javaabdaari nahin ki main tumhaara ghar basaane ka prabandh karun, ki ab ismein tumhaara bhala ho.
Suno, boaz hamaare rishtedaar hain, jinki daasiyon ke saath tum kaam kar rahi thi. Dekho, aaj shaam vah khalihaan mein jau phatkeinge.

So achchhi tarah se snaan karke taiyaar ho ja, sabse achchhe kapre pahankar khalihaan mein jaana, lekin dhyaan rahe, jab tak boaz khaana khatm na kar lein, tum unhein apni upasthiti ka ahsaas na hone dena.

Lekin tum us jagah ko achchhi tarah se dekh lena, jahaan vah sone ke lie gae hain. Iske baad tum vahaan jaana, aur unke pairon ki chaadar uthaakar tum khud bhi vahin let jaana. Iske baad tumhaara kya karna sahi hai, vahi tumhein bataaeinge.”
“Jo jo aapne kaha hai, main thik vaisa hi karungi,” Ruth ne iske uttar mein kaha.
So ruth khalihaan mein gai aur vahaan usne thik vahi kiya, jaisa uski saas ne use kaha tha.
Boaz bahut hi khush the, jab unhonne khaana-pina khatm kiya, vah anaaj ke dher ke paas sone ke lie chale gae. Tab ruth dabe paanv vahaan aai, aur boaz ke pairon ki chaadar uthaakar vahaan let gai.
Bich raat mein jab boaz ne karvat li to vah chaunk pare, ki ek aurat unke pairon ke nikat leti hui thi!
Unhonne puchha, “Kaun ho tum?” “Main ruth hun, aapki daasi.” Ruth ne javaab diya. “Aap hamaare chhuraanevaale hain, so apni daasi ko apne pankhon ki sharan provide karein.”

“Beti,” Boaz ne iske uttar mein kaha, “Yahweh ki kripaadrishti tum par bani rahe. Samarpan aur nishtha ki tumhaari yah priti tumhaari pahle ki priti se barhkar hai. Tumne yahaan ke kisi bhi dhani ya saadhaaran yuvak se vivaah ka soch nahin kiya.
Ab, meri beti, kisi bhi vishay ki chinta na karo. Tumhaari chaahat ke hisaab se main sabhi kuchh karunga, kyonki shehar mein sabhi ko yah maalum hai ki tum achchhe charitr ki aurat ho.
Yah sahi hai ki main tumhaara chhuraane vaala hun, lekin is riti mein ek aur person hai, jiska authority mujhse pahle hai.

Abhi tum yahin thahro, subah yadi vah person apna daayitv pura karta hai to bahut achchha, nahin to jivit Yahweh ki shapath, main tumse promise karta hun, ki main tumhein chhuraaunga. Subah hone tak yahin soti raho.”

So ruth subah hone tak boaz ke paitaane soti rahin, lekin iske pahle ki ujaala ho aur koi unhein pahchaan sake, vah uth gai. Boaz ne usse kaha, “Kisi ko yah pata na chale ki tum khalihaan mein aai thi.”

Tab boaz ne usse aage kaha, “Apni orhni aage phailaao.” So usne apni orhni vahaan bichha di, boaz ne chhah maap jau uski orhni mein daal die aur use uske kandhe par rakh diya, aur vah shehar mein chali gayi.
Jab ruth apni saas ke paas pahunchi, naavomi ne usse puchha, “Meri putri, bataao kaisa raha?” Tab ruth ne apni saas ko vah sab bata diya, jo boaz ne uske lie kiya tha.
Ruth ne aage kaha, “Unhonne mujhe ye chhah maap jau bhi yah kahte hue die hain, ‘Apni saas ke paas khaali haath na jaana.’ ”
Is par naavomi ne ruth se kaha, “Meri putri, ab sabr dharkar dekhti jaao ki aage kya-kya hota hai. Kyonki vah person aaj is vishay ko suljhaae bina shaant na baithega.”

Usi samay boaz shehar dvaar par jaakar baith gae, aur jab vahaan vah chhuraane vaala aaya, jiska varnan boaz ruth se kar chuke the, boaz ne unse kaha, “Mitr yahaan aaie aur mere paas baithie.” So vah aakar boaz ke paas baith gaya.
Iske baad boaz ne shehar ke purniyon mein se das ko bhi vahaan bulva liya aur unse request ki, “Kripya yahaan baithie,” So ve sab baith gae.
Tab boaz ne us chhuraanevaale se kaha, “Naavomi, jo moaab desh se laut aai hain, elimelekh, hamaare rishtedaar ki zameen, ka ek bhaag bech rahi hain.”

So main yah sahi samajhta hun ki main aapko iski suchna in words mein de dun, “Is zamin ko in gavaahon ki upasthiti mein aur hamaare naagrikon ke purniyon ki upasthiti mein kharid lo. Yadi tum isko chhuraana chaaho, isko chhura lo. Lekin yadi tum chhuraana na chaaho, mujhse kah do, ki mujhe tumhaari chaahat maalum ho jaae, kyonki tumhaare alaava iska aur koi dusra chhuraane vaala nahin hai. Tumhaare baad main chhura sakta hun.” Us chhuraanevaale ne kaha, “Main isko chhura lunga.”

Is par boaz ne kaha, “Jis din tum naavomi se us zamin ko kharidoge, tumhein moaabi ruth ko, jo us mritak rishtedaar ki vidhva hai, bhi mol lena parega ki mritak ka naam is property ke saath bana rah sake.”

Is par us chhuraanevaale ne kaha, “Is situation mein main isko chhuraane mein asmarth hun, kyonki aisa karne par apne hi vansh ka nuksaan kar baithunga. Chhuraane ka yah authority ab tum le lo. Kyonki main yah chhuraane mein asmarth hun.”

(Israel mein puraane samay se yah pratha chali a rahi thi, ki chhuraane ki prakriya mein lenden ko pakka karne ke pramaan ke taur par chhuraane vaala apna juta utaarkar dusre person ko saump diya karta tha. Israel desh mein lenden pakka karne ki yahi vidhi thi.)
So jab us chhuraanevaale ne boaz se kaha, “Tum khud hi isko kharid lo,” Usne apna juta utaarkar boaz ko de diya.
Tab boaz ne purniyon aur sabhi upasthit logon ko yah kaha, “Aaj aap sabhi is baat ke gavaah hain, ki mainne naavomi se vah sab kharid liya hai, jo elimelekh ka aur kilyon aur mahlon ka tha.

Saath hi mainne mahlon ki vidhva moaabi ruth ko apni patni hone ke lie accept kar liya hai, ki mritak ki property ke uttraadhikaar ke lie children paida ho, aur uske janmasthaan aur unke rishtedaaron mein se mritak ka naam mitne na paae. Aap sabhi aaj iske gavaah hain!”

Is par shehar dvaar ki saari bhir aur shehar ke purniyon ne javaab diya, “Ham iske gavaah hain. Jo aurat tumhaare parivaar mein pravesh kar rahi hai, Yahweh use raahel aur liyaah ke jaisa banaaein, jo donon hi Israel ke saare gotron ka mul hain. Tum efraatha mein sampann hote jaao aur bethlehem mein tumhaara yash phail jaae.
Yahweh dvaara tumhein jo children is aurat se mile, vah perez ke jaisa hon, jo Yahudah ke taamaar dvaara receive hue the.”
Boaz ne ruth se vivaah kar liya aur jab vah uske paas gaya, Yahweh ne ruth ko garbhdhaaran ki kshamta di, aur use ek son paida hua.
Striyaan aakar naavomi se kahne lagi, “Blessed hain Yahweh, jinhonne aaj aapko chhuraanevaale ke bina nahin chhora. Israel desh mein is chhuraanevaale ka bara naam ho jaae!

Vah aap mein life bhar dega aur aapke burhaape mein vahi aapka sahaara hoga, kyonki aapki bahu ne use janm diya hai, uska love aap par bahut hi apaar hai, jo aapke lie saat sons se kahin adhik barhkar hai.”
Tab naavomi ne bachche ko apni god mein utha liya aur dhaay ke jaisa uski dekhbhaal karne lagi.

Parosi auraton ne bachche ko ek naam diya. Unka kahna tha, “Naavomi ko ek beta hua hai!” Unke dvaara bachche ko diya gaya naam tha, obed. Yahi yishai ka pita hua, jo raaja David ke pita the. Arthaat raaja David ke daada.
Yah haakaaliyaah ke son nehemiyaah ke vachan hain. Yah ghatna bisvein varsh ke kislev mahine ki hai, jab main raajdhaani shushan mein tha,
Yahudiya se kuchh log mere ek rishtedaar hanaani ke saath aae; mainne unse Yerushalem ke baare mein aur un Yahudiyon ke baare mein jaankaari paai, jo bandhuaai se bach nikle the aur jo ab jivit the.

Unhonne mujhe bataaya, “Vah bache hue Yahudi, jo bandhuaai se jivit bach nikal aaye hain aur jo is samay us pradesh mein rah rahe hain, ve bare dard mein aur nindniy avastha mein hain. Yerushalem ki shahrapnaah tut chuki hai aur uske pravesh phaatak jala die ja chuke hain.”
Yah sunkar main baithkar rone laga aur main bahut din rota raha; kuchh din tak main heaven ke God ke saamne upvaas aur prayer karta raha.

Mainne kaha: “Yahweh, heaven ke God yah meri prayer hai, aap jo mahaan aur aadarniy God hain, aap, jo unke prati apni vaacha aur apni mercy rakhte hain, jo aapke prati apne love mein atal aur aajnaapaalan karte hain,

Aapke servant ki prayer ki or aapke kaan lage rahein aur aapki aankhein khuli rahein, ki aap apne servant ki prayer sunein, main aapke charnon mein aapke servant Israel vanshjon ki or se din-raat yah prayer kar raha hun. Israaeliyon ne aur hamne jo galti aapke khilaaf kie hain, unhein main accept kar raha hun. Mainne aur mere pita ke parivaar ne galti kie hain.

Hamaara aachran aapke saamne bahut hi dushtta se bhara raha hai. Hamne aapke orders ka follow nahin kiya hai, na hi hamne aapke niymon aur vidhiyon ka follow hi kiya hai, jinka order aapne apne servant Moshe ko diya tha.
“Aap apne us order ko yaad kijie, jo aapne apne servant Moshe ko is tarah diya tha: ‘Yadi tum avishvaasi ho jaaoge to main tumhein deshon ke bich bikhra dunga.

Magar yadi tum meri or phirkar mere orders ka follow karke unka anusran karoge, to tummein se bikhre hue logon ko yadi dur aakaash ke niche tak kar diya gaya hai, main vahaan se bhi us jagah par le aaunga, jis jagah ko mainne apni pratishtha ki sthaapna ke lie sahi samjha hai.’
“Ve aapke hi servant hain, aapki hi people, jinhein aapne apne asaadhaaran power aur balvant haath se chhura liya tha.

Lord, aapse meri prayer hai, apne servant ki request par kaan lagaaein aur un servants ki praarthnaaon par, jo aapka dar maante hain. Aaj apne servant ko saphalta dekar uske prati is person par daya kijie.” Main is samay raaja ke lie pilaane vaale ke pad par tha.

Raaja artahshasta ke shaasankaal ke bisvein varsh mein nisaan maah mein jab raaja ke saamne daakhamdhu rakhi hui thi, mainne unhein daakhamdhu paros di. Iske pahle unke saamne main duhkhi hokar kabhi nahin gaya tha.
Yah dekh raaja ne mujhse savaal kiya, “Jab tum bimaar nahin ho, to tumhaara chehra itna utra kyon hai? Yah man ki udaasi ke alaava aur kuchh nahin.” Yah sunkar main bahut hi dar gaya.

Mainne raaja ko javaab diya, “Mahaaraaj aap hamesha jivit rahein. Mera chehra kyon na utre, jab vah shehar, jo mere purkhon ki kabron ka jagah hai, ujaar para hua hai aur us shehar ke phaatak paani chuke hain.”
Tab raaja ne mujhse puchha, “To tum kya chaahte ho?” Tab mainne heaven ke God se prayer ki.

Mainne raaja ko javaab diya, “Agar mahaaraaj ko yah sahi lage aur agar aap apne servant se khush hain, to mujhe Yahudiya jaane ki anumti dein. Vahaan, jis shehar mein mere purkhon ki kabrein hain, main us shehar ko dobaara banva sakun.”

Tab raaja ne mujhse puchha, “Iske lie tumhein kitna samay lagega aur tumhaara lautna kab hoga?” Is samay raani bhi raaja ke paas baithi thi. Mainne raaja ke saamne ek samay tay karke bata diya, so raaja ne khushi ke saath mujhe vahaan jaane ki anumti de di.

Mainne raaja se request ki, “Yadi yah mahaaraaj ko sahi lage, mujhe us nadi ke us or ke raajypaalon ke lie mahaaraaj dvaara likhe sandesh de die jaaein, ki ve mujhe apne raajyon mein se hokar Yahudiya tak pahunchne ki command dete jaaein.

Ek sandesh mahaaraaj ke banjar zameen ke pahredaar aasaph ke lie bhi zaruri hoga, ki vah temple ke kile ke phaatkon ki kariyon ke lie, shahrapnaah aur us ghar ke lie jismein main rahunga, lakri ka intjaam kar de.” Raaja ne sabhi sandesh mujhe de die, kyonki mujh par God ki kripaadrishti bani hui thi.
Jab us nadi ke paar ke pradeshon ke raajypaalon se meri bheint hui, mainne unhein raaja dvaara likhe gae sandesh saump die. Raaja ne mere saath adhikaari, sainik aur ghurasvaar bhi bheje the.
Jab horoni sanballat aur ammoni adhikaari tobiyaah ko is baare mein pata chala, to un donon ko bahut bura laga, ki koi israaeliyon ka bhala chaahnevaala yahaan a pahuncha hai.
