Yerushalem pahunchkar main vahaan tin din raha.

Main raat mein uth gaya, mere saath kuchh log bhi the. Mainne yah kisi ko bhi reveal nahin kiya, ki Yerushalem ke baare mein God ne mere man mein kya karne ka soch daala hai. Mere saath us pashu ke alaava koi bhi dusra pashu na tha, jis par main savaar tha.

Isliye raat mein main ghaati ke phaatak se nikalkar ajgar kuein aur kura phaatak ki disha mein aage barha. Main Yerushalem ki shahrapnaah ka baariki se jaanch karta ja raha tha. Shahrapnaah tuti hui thi aur phaatak jale hue the.
Tab main jharne ke phaatak aur raaja ke taalaab par ja pahuncha, yahaan mere pashu ke lie aage barhna naamumkin tha.
Isliye main raat mein hi naale se hota hua shahrapnaah ka baariki se muaayna karta gaya. Tab mainne dobaara ghaati phaatak mein se pravesh kiya aur laut gaya.

Adhikaariyon ko yah pata hi na chal saka, ki main kahaan gaya tha ya yah ki mainne kya kaam kiya tha. Mainne ab tak Yahudiyon, priests, prashaaskon, adhikaariyon aur baakiyon par, jinhein kaam mein jut jaana tha, kuchh bhi nahin bataaya tha.

Tab mainne unse kaha, “Hamaari durdsha aapke saamne saaf hi hai; Yerushalem ujaar para hai aur uske phaatak gire pare hain. Aaie, ham Yerushalem ki shahrapnaah ko dobaara banaaein, ki ham dobaara hansi ka vishay na rah jaaein.”

Mainne unko yah saaf bataaya ki kis tarah mujh par mere God ki kripaadrishti hui aur yah bhi ki raaja ne mere lie aashvaasan ke word kahe the. Yah sun unhonne kaha, “Chalie, ham banaane ka kaam shuru karein.” Is tarah ve is achchhe kaam mein lag gae.

Lekin jab horoni sanballat, ammoni adhikaari tobiyaah aur arbi geshem ne yah sab suna, ve hamaara mazaak uraane lage, nafrat se bharkar ve hamse kahne lage, “Kya kar rahe ho yah? Kya tum raaja ke khilaaf vidroh karoge?”

Tab mainne unhein javaab diya, “Heaven ke God hi hamein ismein saphalta deinge; isliye ham unke servant banaane ka kaam shuru kareinge. Ismein aapka koi lena dena nahin hai na hi yahaan aapka koi authority hai aur na Yerushalem mein aapka koi smaarak hi hai.”
Jab sanballat ko yah maalum hua ki ham shahrapnaah ko dobaara se bana rahe hain, vah gusse se bhar gaya aur ham Yahudiyon ka mazaak uraane laga.

Usne apne saath mein kaam karnevaalon aur shamriya ke senaadhyakshon ke saamne kaha, “Yah nirbal Yahudi kar kya rahe hain? Kya ye log apne lie isko dobaara bana leinge? Tab kya ve bali charha sakeinge? Kya ve yah kaam ek hi din mein pura kar sakeinge? Kya ve patthar ke tukron ke dher se bhavan banaane ke laayak patthar nikaal sakeinge, jabki ye aag mein paani chuke hain?”
Ammoni tobiyaah jo uske paas hi khara tha, kahne laga, “Are, ve log jo bana rahe hain, vah aisa hai, ki agar ek lomri hi us par kud pare to unki banaai hui patthar ki shahrapnaah dhah jaaegi!”
Hamaare God, sun lijie ki hamaara kaisa apmaan ho raha hai! Unke dvaara ki ja rahi is ninda ko unhin par lauta dijie aur unhein bandhuaai ke desh mein lut ka saamaan bana dijie.
Unke galti ko maafi na kijie. Aapke saamne se unka galti mitaaya na jaae kyonki unhonne shahrapnaah banaane vaalon ka manobal khatm kar diya hai.
Is tarah hamne shahrapnaah ko banaaya aur saari shahrapnaah uski aadhi unchaai tak puri ho gai, kyonki log is kaam ke prati drirh the.

Is mauke par jab sanballat, tobiyaah, arbiyon, ammoniyon, aur ashdodiyon ne yah suna, ki Yerushalem ki shahrapnaah ka marammat ka kaam teji par hai aur sabhi naake ab band kie jaane lage hain, ve bahut hi gussa ho gae.
Un sabhi ne milkar Yerushalem par hamla karne ka sharyantr racha, ki iske dvaara vahaan garabri daali ja sake.
Isliye hamne apne God se prayer ki aur unki yojnaaon ka dhyaan rakhte hue vahaan din aur raat ke lie pahredaar thahra die.
So Yahudiya mein log is tarah kahne lage: “Bojh uthaane vaalon ka bal ghat gaya hai, phir bhi malba bahut hai; ham khud hi shahrapnaah banaane ke laayak nahin rahe hain.”
Hamaare dushmanon ne aapas mein soch-vimarsh kiya, “Ham aisa karein: hamaare unke bich mein pahunchne tak unhein yah pata hi na chalne paae, tab ham unko maar ke is kaam ko khatm kar deinge.”
Unke aas-paas ke Yahudiyon ne das baar aakar hamein is sharyantr ki suchna di, “Ve log har ek disha se aakar ham par hamla kareinge.”

Isliye mainne shahrapnaah ke pichhe un jaghon par pahredaar thahra die, jahaan-jahaan unchaai kam thi jo jagah ab tak khuli pari thi. Mainne parivaaron ko unki talvaaron, bhaalon aur dhanushon ke saath baitha diya.

Jab mujhe unke man mein a rahe dar ka ahsaas hua, mainne raison, adhikaariyon aur baaki logon ko yah kaha, “Koi zarurat nahin unse darne ki! Aap yaad rakhie: sirph Lord ko, jo mahaan aur prataapi hai. Apne bhaaiyon, apne sons, apni putriyon, apni patniyon aur apne gharon ki bhalaai ko dhyaan mein rakhkar yuddh ke lie taiyaar ho jaaie.”
Hamaare dushmanon ko yah maalum ho gaya ki hamein unke sharyantr ka pata chal chuka hai aur God ne unki yojna viphal kar di hai. Ham sabhi shahrapnaah ke apne-apne kaam mein dobaara lag gae.

Us din ke baad mere aadhe servant shahrapnaah ke kaam karte the aur aadhe kavach pahankar barchhi, dhanush aur dhaal lie hue rahte the. Yahudah ke saare gharaane ko haakimon ka samarthan mila hua tha.
Ve sabhi, jo shahrapnaah ko banaane mein lage the aur jo saamaan uthaane mein lage the, ek haath se kaam karte the aur dusre mein hathiyaar thaame rahte the.
Kaam karte hue bhi har ek mistri apni jaangh par talvaar latkaae hue rahta tha aur jis person ki javaabdaari thi narsinga phunkna, vah lagaataar mere paas hi khara rahta tha.
Raison, adhikaariyon aur dusre logon ko mainne kaha, “Yah kaam bara aur phaila hua hai aur ham sabhi is shahrapnaah par ek dusre se alag ho chuke hain.
Isliye jab kabhi tumhein narsinge ki aavaaj sunaai de, tum usi disha mein aakar hamaare paas ikattha ho jaana. Hamaare God hamaare lie yuddh kareinge.”
Is tarah ham is kaam mein lag gae-aadhe log subah se lekar taaron ke dikhne tak barchhi lie hue khare rahte the.
Us samay mainne logon se yah bhi kaha, “Har ek person raat ke samay apne-apne servant ke saath Yerushalem mein hi rahe, ki raat mein to ve pahredaar ho jaaein aur din ke samay kaam karne lagein.”

Na to mere lie, na mere sambandhiyon ke lie, na mere servants ke lie aur na un pahredaaron ke lie, jo mere saath saath bane rahte the, apne kapre badalne ka mauka mil paata tha; jab ham jalaashyon ke paas jaate the, tab bhi hathiyaaron ko aapne saath rakhte the.
Isi samay logon aur unki patniyon ne unke Yahudi saathiyon ke saath jhagarna shuru kar diya.
Iska kaaran tha ve log, jo yah kah rahe the “Ham, hamaare son aur hamaari putriyaan ginti mein bahut hain; isliye hamein anaaj diya jaae ki ham use khaakar zinda rah sakein.”
Kuchh aur bhi the, jo kah rahe the “Hamne apne khet, hamaare angur ke bagiche aur apne ghar girvi rakhe hue hain ki is akaal ki situation mein hamein anaaj to mil sake.”
Inke alaava bhi kuchh aur the, jo yah kah rahe the “Hamne apne kheton aur angur ke bagichon par raaja dvaara thahraaya gaya kar bharne ke lie karz liya hua hai.

Ham bhi apne bhaai-bandhuon ke jaisa haddi-maans ke hi hain, hamaari children unki children ke jaisa hi hai; phir bhi dekh lijie hamein apne son-putriyon ko slave hone ke lie saumpne ke lie majbur hona par raha hai. Hamaari kuchh putriyaan to pahle hi zabardasti bandhak bana li gai hain. Ab ham nisshaay rah gae hain, kyonki hamaare khet aur angur ke bagiche ab dusron ke authority mein chale gae hain.”
Unki shikaaytein aur baatein sun main bahut hi krodhit ho gaya.

Mainne apne man mein socha, phir unche padaadhikaariyon aur shaaskon se bhi salaah li aur phir mainne unse kaha, “Aap mein se har ek apne hi bhaai-bandhu se zabardasti byaaj vasuli kar raha hai!” Isliye mainne unke khilaaf ek bari sabha ki.

Unse mainne kaha, “Hamne apni power bhar un Yahudi bhaai-bandhuon ko daam dekar un deshon se chhuraaya hai, jahaan unhein bech diya gaya tha. Ab kya aap log inhein dobaara unhin ko bechte jaaeinge, ki hamein unhein ek baar phir unse kharidna pare?” Ve chup rahe aur apne bachaav mein kahne ke lie unke paas kuchh bhi na tha.

Mainne unhein dobaara chetaavni di, “Aap jo kuchh kar rahe hain, vah galat hai. Hamaare dushman desh hamaari ninda karein, is baat ka dhyaan rakhte hue kya yah sahi nahin ki aap apne God ka dar maankar chalein?
Khud mainne, mere bhaaiyon ne aur mere servants ne unhein udhaar ke taur par sikke aur anaaj dena shuru kar diya hai. Grace kar ham unse yah zabardasti bhugtaan karaana band kar dein.

Grace kar aaj hi unhein unke khet, angur ke bagiche, unke jaitun ke bagiche aur unke ghar unhein lauta dein. Iske alaava unka wealth, anaaj, nai daakhamdhu aur tel ka sauvaan bhaag bhi, jo aap unse zabardasti le rahe hai.”

Unhonne iske uttar mein kaha, “Ham unhein yah sab lauta deinge, unse kuchh bhi zabardasti nahin leinge. Vahi kareinge, jo aap ke dvaara sujhaaya gaya hai.” Tab mainne priests ko bulva liya aur unse yah shapath le li ki ve is promise ke hisaab se hi kareinge.

Tab mainne apne baahri kapre ke saamne ka chhor jhatakte hue kaha, “God aise har ek insaan ko uske ghar se aur uski property se thik usi tarah jhatak de, jo is shapath ko puri na karega, yahaan tak ki use is tarah hila diya jaae ki vah puri tarah khaali hi ho jaae.” Yah sun saari sabha kah uthi, “Aamen!” Aur unke munh se Yahweh ki praise nikli. Logon ne apni shapath ke hisaab se hi kiya.

Raaja artahshasta ke raajy-kaal ke bisvein saal se battisvein saal tak; baarah saal, jis din se mujhe Yahudiya ka raajypaal banaaya gaya tha, na to mainne aur na mere rishtedaaron ne raajypaal ke lie tay kiya gaya khaana khaaya.

Mujhse pahle ke raajypaalon ne to people par bhaari bojh laad diya tha. Ve unse unka khaana aur anguron ka ras chhin liya karte the, saath hi chaandi ke chaalis shakel bhi; yahaan tak ki unke saathi servant tak people ka shoshan kiya karte the. God ka dar maanne ke kaaran main aisa na kar saka.
Mainne khud ko shahrapnaah banaane ke kaam mein laga diya. Hamne koi bhi zamin nahin kharidi. Mere sabhi servant is kaam ke lie vahaan ikatthe ho jaate the.
Mere khaana ki mez par hamaare paas ke deshon se aae logon ke alaava ek sau pachaas Yahudi aur adhikaari hua karte the.

Mere har roz ke khaana ke lie ek bail, chhah sabse achchhi bherein aur kuchh pakshi taiyaar kie jaate the. Das din mein ek baar tarah-tarah ki daakhamdhu bari maatra mein parosi jaati thi. Itna sab hone par bhi mainne raajypaal ke lie thahraaya gaya khaana nahin mangvaaya; kyonki vaise bhi people bojh ke niche dabi ja rahi thi.
Mere God, mere dvaara is people ke hit mein kie gae sabhi kaamon ke lie mujhe yaad rakhiyega.

Jab hamaare dushmanon sanballat, tobiyaah, arbi geshem aur baaki dushmanon ko iska samaachaar mila ki mainne shahrapnaah ko dobaara bana liya hai, ki shahrapnaah mein ab kahin bhi koi daraar nahin rah gai hai, yadypi is samay tak phaatkon mein palle baithaae nahin gae the,
Tab sanballat aur geshem ne mujhe yah sandesh bheja “Aap aaie ki ham ono ke maidaan mein chepirim naamak jagah par bheint karein.” Magar iske dvaara unka iraada mera bura karne ka hi tha.

Tab mainne apne dut unhein is sandesh ke saath bheje: “Mera yah kaam bahut bara hai, isliye mera yahaan aana sambhav nahin hai. Yah kaise sahi ho sakta hai ki main ise chhorkar aapse bheint karne vahaan aaun?”
Unhonne chaar baar yahi sandesh bheja aur mainne bhi unhein vahi javaab diya.
Tab sanballat ne apne servant dvaara ek sandesh mere lie bheja yah vahi sandesh paanchvi baar bheja gaya tha. Uske haath mein diya yah khula patr tha.

Patr mein likha tha: “Desh-desh ke logon mein yah kaha jaane laga hai aur uski khabar hamein gashmu se receive hui hai, ki aap aur Yahudi vidroh ki yojna bana rahe hain. Shahrapnaah banaana isi yojna ka bhaag hai. In suchnaaon ke hisaab se aap unko raaja banne ki yojna bana rahe hain.

Iske lie to aapne Yerushalem mein bhavishyadvakta bhi thahra die hain, jinki javaabdaari hogi yah ghoshna karna: ‘Yahudiyon mein ab ek raaja hai!’ Ab yahi khabar raaja ko bhi di hi jaaegi. Isliye ab aap a jaaie ham aapas mein salaah karein.”
Iske uttar mein mainne use apna dut is sandesh ke saath bheja “Aapke kahne ke hisaab se yahaan kuchh bhi nahin kiya ja raha hain yah sab to khud aapke hi dimaag ki upaj hai.”
Un sabhi ka lakshy hamein daraana hi tha. Unka sochna tha, “Isse ve dar jaaeinge aur yah kaam pura na ho sakega.” Magar God, meri baazuon mein taakat dijie.

Main mehetaabel ke pote delaaiyaah ke son shemaayaah ke ghar par gaya, jo ghar se baahar jaane mein asmarth tha, usne prastaav rakha, “Ham God ke bhavan mein temple ke andar hi ikattha hon aur temple ke darvaaje band kar lein, kyonki ve aapki murder ke purpose se yahaan a rahe hain aur ve raat mein hi aapki murder karna chaah rahe hain.”
Lekin mainne inkaar kiya, “Kya mere jaise person ke lie is tarah bhaagna achchha hoga? Aur kya mujh jaise person ke lie temple mein jaakar apna life bachaana sahi hoga? Main nahin jaaunga vahaan!”
Tab mujhe yah ahsaas ho gaya, ki nishchit hi yah God dvaara bheji gai salaah nahin thi! Usne to yah bhavishyvaani ke taur par isliye kaha tha, ki use tobiyaah aur sanballat ne paisa diya tha.

Shemaayaah ko paise dekar mujhe daraane ke lie kaam par rakha gaya tha, ki main darkar vahi karun, jisse main God ke khilaaf galti kar baithun, aur iski vajah se unhein mujh par dosh lagaane ka mauka mil jaae aur main unke lie ninda ka paatr ban jaaun.
Mere God, aap tobiyaah aur sanballat ke is kaam ko bhula dijie. Unke alaava us aurat, bhavishyadvakta noaadiya ko bhi aur un sabhi prophets ko bhi, jo mujhe daraane ki koshish kar rahe the.
Is tarah elul mahine ki pachchisvin taarikh par 52 dinon mein shahrapnaah ki marammat ka kaam pura ho gaya.

Sabhi dushmanon ko yah samaachaar mil gaya, hamaare sabhi paas vaale deshon ne yah dekh liya. Ve bahut dar gae. Kyonki unke saamne yah saaf ho gaya tha ki yah kaam hamaare God ki madad hi se pura ho saka tha.
Iske alaava unhin dinon mein Yahudiya ke bare adhikaariyon aur tobiyaah ke bich chitthi bahut aati-jaati thi.

Kyonki Yahudiya ke kai person tobiyaah ka paksh lene ki shapath lie hue the, kyonki vah aaraah ke son shekniyaah ka daamaad tha aur uske son yehohaanan ka vivaah berekhiyaah ke son meshullaam ki putri se hua tha.
Iske alaava, ve mere hi saamne uske bhale kaamon ki suchna bhi de diya karte the. Tab tobiyaah ne mujhe daraane ke lie patr bhejna shuru kar diya.
Jab shahrapnaah banaane ka kaam pura ho gaya, mainne pallon ko thik jagah par baitha diya aur dvaarpaalon, gaaykon aur leviyon ko chuna,
Mainne apne bhaai hanaani aur garh ke haakim hanniyaah ko Yerushalem ka adhikaari thahra diya, kyonki hanniyaah faithful person tha aur vah God ka bahut dar maanne vaala person tha.

Unke lie mera order tha, “Jab tak suraj mein garmi rahe Yerushalem ke phaatak na khole jaaein aur jab tak pahredaar dvaar par khare hi honge, dvaar band hi rakhe jaaein aur unmein chitakni lagi rahe. Jo dvaarpaal thahraae jaaein, ve Yerushalem ke rahnevaale hi hon; har ek ko apne-apne nirdisht jagahon par aur shesh apne gharon ke saamne ke dvaar par khara kiye jaae.”
Shehar phaila hua aur bara tha, lekin nivaasiyon ki ginti thori hi thi aur abhi ghar nahin bane the.
Ab priest, Levi, dvaarpaal, gaayak, kuchh saamaany prajaajan, temple ke servant, jo sabhi Israel vanshaj hi the, apne-apne shehron mein rahne lage.

Ek bari bhir ke taur par pura Israel us chauk mein ikattha ho gaya, jo paani phaatak ke saamne hai. Unhonne law ke wise priest ezra se request ki thi, ki vah Yahweh dvaara Israel ke lie di hui Moshe ki law ki pustak apne saath laaein.
Tab priest ezra saatvein mahine ke pahle din un sabhi aurat-aadmiyon ki sabha ke saamne vah law ki pustak lekar aae, jo sunkar samajh sakte the.
Ezra subah se lekar dophar tak paani phaatak ke saamne ikattha bhir ke saamne un aurat-aadmiyon ke lie parhkar sunaate rahe, jo sunkar samajh sakte the, ye sabhi law ki pustak par dhyaan lagaae the.
Ezra ne puri bhir ke dekhte is pustak ko khola, kyonki vah us unchi chauki par khare hue the. Jaise hi unhonne pustak kholi, puri bhir khari ho gai.

Tab ezra ne Yahweh, mahaan God ki praise ki aur bhir ne kaha: “Aamen, aamen!” Un sabhi logon ne apne haath uthaae hue the, tab bare hi aadar ke saath bhir ne zameen ki or jhukkar Yahweh ki praise ki unke munh zamin par hi lage rahe.
Ve is pustak se parhte jaate-God ki law mein se aur ve uska anuvaad bhi karte jaate the ki sabhi log parhe gae bhaag ko samajhte bhi jaaein.

Tab nehemiyaah ne, jo raajypaal the, priest ezra ne, jo law ke wise the aur leviyon ne, jo sabhi logon ke shikshak the, ghoshna ki: “Yahweh tumhaare God ke saamne yah din holy hai; na to shokit hoo, aur na hi roo,” Kyonki law ke vachan sunkar sabhi log rone lage the.

Nehemiyaah ne unhein order diya “Jaaie, achchha-achchha khaana kijie, mitha-mitha ras pijie aur kuchh bhaag use bhi de dijie, jiske paas yah sab taiyaar kiya hua nahin hai; kyonki yah din hamaare Yahweh ke saamne holy hai. Duhkhi na rahie; kyonki Yahweh ke die hue khushi mein hi aapka bal hai.”
Is tarah leviyon ne sabhi ko yah kahkar saath shaant kiya, “Aap shaant ho jaaie. Aap duhkhi na hon; kyonki yah holy din hai.”
Tab sabhi log khaane-pine ke lie chale gae aur unhonne utsav ke lie kuchh bhaag dusron ko bhi die; kyonki yah ek khaas utsav tha. Yah isliye ki unhonne holy law-vidhaan ka matlab samajh liya tha.
Iske baad dusre din saari people ke pitron ke leader priest aur Levi law ke wise ezra ke saamne ikattha hue, ki yah maalum kar sakein ki law ke vachnon ka matlab kya hai.
Unke soch karne ka vishay tha Moshe ke dvaara Yahweh ki command hisaab se saatvein mahine mein jhopriyon ke utsav ke mauke par Israel vanshjon ka rahan-sahan kaisa ho.

Isliye unhonne ghoshna karke Yerushalem mein aur raajy ke sabhi shehron mein yah ghoshna karva di, “Pahaaron par jaakar zaitun, jangli jaitun, mehandi, khajur aur dusre pattiyon ke peron ki daaliyaan laai jaaein ki inka istemaal law mein likhi hui vidhi ke hisaab se jhopriyaan banaane ke lie kiya ja sake.”

Tab log baahar gae, aur daaliyaan lekar aae aur apne-apne lie jhopriyaan bana lin; har ek ne apni chhat par aur apne aangan mein aur God ke bhavan ke aangan mein, us chauk mein jo paani phaatak ke saamne hai aur ephraaim phaatak ke saamne ke chauk par.

Bandhuaai se laute huon ki puri bhir ne jhopriyaan banaain aur unmein rahe bhi. Balki Israel vanshjon ne nun ke son yahoshu ke shaasankaal se ab tak yah nahin kiya tha. Yah bahut bara khushi ka utsav ho gaya.
Ezra har roz, pahle din se aakhiri din tak God ki law ki pustak mein se sunaaya karte the. Order ke hisaab se aathvein din vishesh mahaasbha bulaai gai.

Iske baad bache hue log, priest, Levi, dvaarpaal, gaayak, temple ke servant aur ve sabhi, jinhonne khud ko God ki law ke lie desh-desh ke logon se alag kar rakha tha, unki patniyaan, unke son-putriyaan; aur ve sabhi, jinmein knowledge aur samajh thi,

Apne sambandhiyon aur unke raison ke saath mil gae. Inhonne apne aap par ek shaap le liya aur unhonne Yahweh ki law ke follow karne ki shapath li, vah law, jo God ke servant Moshe dvaara di gayi thi; sabhi ne pran kiya, ki ve God, hamaare Lord Yahweh ki sabhi commands, niymon aur vidhiyon ka follow karne mein chauksi kareinge.
Unhonne yah shapath bhi li, ki ve apni putriyon ka vivaah is desh ke nivaasiyon se na hone deinge aur na apne sons ke lie unki putriyon ko laaeinge.

Us situation mein, jab us desh ke nivaasi kisi Shabbat par ya kisi alag kie hue Lord ke Shabbat par bechne ke lie apna kuchh saamaan ya anaaj lekar aaein, ham Shabbat par ya aise alag kie hue din par ham unse isko nahin kharideinge. Ham har saatvein saal na to kheti kareinge aur na udhaar mein die hue paise ko vaapas lene ki koshish kareinge.
Hamne khud apne upar yah javaabdaari bhi le li ki ham har saal ek tihaai shekel ka daan diya kareinge, ki yah God ke bhavan mein service ke lie istemaal kiya jaae;

Holy roti ke lie, nity annabli ke lie, nity homabli ke lie, shabbaathon ke lie, nae chaand ke lie, thahraae gae avasron ke lie, alag ki gai vastuon ke lie, aur galtiyon ki bali ke lie, ki unke dvaara Israel ke lie praayashchit kiya ja sake aur hamaare God ke bhavan ke saare kaamon mein yah yogdaan de sakein.

Iske alaava hamne priests, leviyon aur logon ke bich lakri ki bheint ke lie chitthi daali, ki ve ise har saal apne-apne pitron ke hisaab se is sabhi avasron par hamaare God ke bhavan mein le aaein ki Yahweh hamaare God ki vedi par aag jalaai ja sake, jaisa ki law ka order hai.
Ki ve is zameen ki pahli upaj ko, har ek per ke pahle phal ko har saal Yahweh ke bhavan mein le aaya karein.

Ki ve hamaari children ke, apne pashuon ke, apni bher-bakriyon ke pahlauthon ko, likhi gai vidhi ke hisaab se hamaare God ke bhavan mein service kar rahe priests ke saamne hamaare God ke bhavan mein le aaein.

Ham khud bhi apne gundhe hue aate ka pahla bhaag, apne daan, har ek per ka phal, nai daakhamdhu ka aur tel ka pahla bhaag hamaare God ke bhavan ke kamron mein nity priests ke saamne le aaeinge aur apni zameen ki upaj ka dasvaan bhaag leviyon ke saamne, kyonki Levi hi sabhi shehron mein dasvein ansh ke adhikaari hain.

Ahron ke vansh ka koi priest us avsar par Levi ke saath rahega, jab Levi dasvaan bhaag ikattha karte hain. Tab Levi hamaare God ke bhavan mein aae dasvein bhaag ka dasvaan bhaag lekar jaaega, yaani bhandaar ghar ke kamron mein.

Israel vanshaj aur Levi vanshaj anaaj ke daan, nai daakhamdhu aur tel un kamron mein le aaeinge. Vahaan holy jagah mein istemaal ke lie thahraae gae bartan rakhe honge aur vahaan service kar rahe priest, dvaarpaal aur gaayak thahraae hue rahte hain. Is tarah ham hamaare God ke bhavan ko akela na chhoreinge.

Yerushalem ki shahrapnaah ki pratishtha ke lie unhonne sabhi jagahon se leviyon ko dhunrh nikaala ki unhein Yerushalem laaya ja sake, ki ve is pratishtha ke utsav ko khushi mein jhaanjhon, saarangi aur vina bajaakar aur thanks ke giton ko gaakar mana sakein.
Tab gaaykon ke son Yerushalem ke paas ke kshetron se aur netofaathiyon ke gaanvon se ikattha ho gae.
Beth-gilgaal aur apne kheton se, geba aur azmaaveth se bhi, kyonki in gaaykon ne apne lie Yerushalem ke paas ke kshetron mein gaanv bana lie the.
Priests aur leviyon ne apne aapko shuddh kiya; unhonne logon, phaatkon aur shahrapnaah ko bhi shuddh kiya.

Mainne Yahudiya ke haakimon ko apne paas shahrapnaah ke upar aamantrit kiya aur do bare gaaykon ke jhunr ko thanks dene ki javaabdaari saump di. Pahle gaaykon ke jhunr ka kaam tha ki vah shahrapnaah par charhkar daayin or kura phaatak ki disha mein aage barhein.
Hoshaaiyaah aur Yahudiya ke leaders mein se aadhe leader unka anusran kar rahe the.
Azriyaah, ezra, meshullaam,
Yudaah, binyaamin, shemaayaah, yeremiyaah
Aur turhiyon ke saath priests ke kuchh son bhi unke saath the aur zakaryaah, jo yonaatan ka son tha, jo shemaayaah ka, jo mattniyaah ka, jo mikaaiyaah ka, jo zakkur ka, jo aasaph ka son tha;
Uske saath uske sambandhi shemaayaah, azaarel, milaalai, gilaalaai, maaai, nethaanel, yudaah aur hanaani the. Yah apne saath God ke jan David ke baaje lie hue the. Shaastri ezra unke aage-aage the.
Jharna phaatak shahrapnaah pahunchkar ve David-shehar ki sirhiyon se upar charh gae. Ve sidhe David ke ghar ke upar ki divaar ki sirhiyon se purv ki or paani phaatak tak pahunch gae.

Dusra gaaykon ka jhunr baayin or barh gaya. Main unka anusran kar raha tha. Aadha jhunr shahrapnaah ke us bhaag par tha, jo bhatthiyon ke khambhe ke upar banaai gai thi. Ham log bhatthiyon ke minaaron ke upar bani shahrapnaah se chauri shahrapnaah ki or barhe

Phir ephraaim phaatak ki or, puraane phaatak ki or, machhli phaatak ki or, hanaanel khambhe ki or aur shatak khambhe ki or jaate hue machhli phaatak tak. Ve sabhi pahredaar phaatak par jaakar thahar gae.
Iske baad donon hi gaaykon ke jhunr God ke bhavan mein jaakar khare hue. Main bhi vahaan ja khara hua. Mere saath vahaan adhikaari varg mein se aadhe adhikaari shaamil the.
Vahin shofaar lie hue priest the eliyaakim, maaaseiyaah, miniyaamin, mikaaiyaah, elioenaai, zakaryaah aur hanniyaah.
Inke alaava vahaan maaaseiyaah, shemaayaah, eliezar, ujji, yehohaanan, maalkhiyaah, elaam aur ezar naam priest bhi the. Yizraahiyaah ke nirdeshan mein gaaykon ne apna gaana prastut kiya.

Us mauke par logon ne bari-bari baliyaan charhaain. Vahaan bahut hi khushi manaaya ja raha tha, kyonki yah God ki or se diya gaya khushi tha-yahaan tak ki striyaan aur bachche tak khushi mana rahe the; phalasvrup Yerushalem ka yah khushi dur-dur tak sunaai de raha tha.

Usi avsar par bhandaaron ke adhikaari bhi chune gae, ki ve sabhi daan, pahle phalon, dasvein ansh ko shehron ke kheton ke hisaab se, law ke dvaara un bhaagon ko priests aur leviyon ke lie ikattha karein; kyonki yah Yahudiya ke logon ke lie khushi ka vishay tha ki ye priest aur Levi service karte the.
In sabhi ne David aur unke son shalomon dvaara die gae order ke hisaab se gaaykon aur dvaarpaalon ke saath milkar apne God ki worship aur shuddh karne ki service ki.
Kyonki pahle ke samay mein, yaani David aur aasaph ke samay mein gaaykon ke lie ek leader hua karta tha, jab ve God ke lie praise ke git aur thanks ke git prastut kiya karte the.

Is tarah zerubbaabel aur nehemiyaah ke shaasankaal mein gaaykon aur dvaarpaalon ke lie thahraae gae har din ka bhaag sabhi israaeli charhaaya karte the aur leviyon ka bhaag holy karke diya karte the aur tab Levi ahron ke vanshjon ke lie thahraaya gaya bhaag alag rakh diya karte the.
Raaja ahashverosh ke shaasankaal mein, jiska saamraajy hind desh se kush tak 127 raajyon tak vistirn tha,
Jab vah raajdhaani shushan mein apne raaj sinhaasan par viraajmaan tha,

Apne shaasankaal ke tisre varsh mein usne apne sab adhikaariyon aur karmchaariyon ke lie ek vishisht utsav ka aayojan kiya. Phaaras aur mediya ke senaapti, saare saansad aur raajypaal is bhoj mein uske saath shaamil hue.
Yah bhoj 180 din chalta raha, jismein raaja ne apna raajsi vaibhav, samriddhi aur property ka pradarshan kiya.
Jab is kaal ka ant hua, raaja ne raajdhaani shushan mein upasthit sab people ke lie; chaahe vah saamaany ho ya vishisht, raajamhal ke udyaan ke aangan mein saat dinon ka ek vishesh bhoj aayojit kiya.

Is sthal ko saphed aur baingni kapdon ka utkrisht san ke parde bainjni doriyon dvaara chaandi ki chharon se latkaakar sajaaya gaya tha. Ye chharein sangmarmar ke stambhon par lagi thi. Vahaan sona aur chaandi ke aasan sajaae gae the is sthal ko sangmarmar ke khambhon, amuly ratnon aur amuly patthron se garha gaya tha.
Daakhamdhu sone ke vibhinn tarah ke bartnon mein parosi ja rahi thi. Raajkiy daakhamdhu raaja ke bare bhandaar mein se bahutaayat se parosi ja rahi thi.

Pey parosne ke baare mein command thi ki kisi ko iske pine ke lie majbur na kiya jaae kyonki raaja ne raaj karmchaariyon ko yah command di thi ki ve vahi karein jaisa har ek bulaae gae log chaahte hai.
Raani vashti ne bhi raajamhal ki auraton ke liye ahashverosh ke raajamhal mein bhoj diya tha.
Saatvein din jab raaja daakhamdhu se mast tha usne mahumaan biztha harbona bigtha abagtha zethar aur karkas naamak saat khojon ko

Order diya ki raani vashti ko raaja ke saamne uske raajsi mukut ke saath prastut kiya jaae, shaaskon aur sab upasthit atithiyon ke saamne uske saundary ka pradarshan kare, raani vashti ati sundar thi.
Lekin raani vashti ne khojon dvaara die gae raaja ke is order ko asvikaar kar diya. Is par raaja krodhit ho utha, krodh uske andar bharakne laga.
Tab raaja apne samay ke hisaab se apne un jnaaniyon se bola jo nyaayshaastr aur niyam ke visheshajn the

In unche padon par the: karashna, shetaar, admaata, tarshish, meres, marsena, aur mamukaan. Ye saat phaaras aur mediya ke aise leader the jo saamraajy mein zaruri the, unke lie raaja ki upasthiti mein pravesh aasaan tha.
Raaja ne inse puchha, “Niyam ke hisaab se ab raani vashti ke saath kya kiya jaana sahi hoga, kyonki usne khojon dvaara di gai raaja ahashverosh ki command nahin maani hai?”

Mamukaan ne raaja aur adhikaariyon ke saamne saaph kiya, “Raani vashti ka yah kaam raaja ke khilaaf apraadh hai, matlab yah sab adhikaariyon, raaja ahashverosh ke raajyon ke sab logon ke khilaaf ek bara apraadh hai.

Kyonki raani ke is kaam ki suchna sab auraton ko mil jaaegi, jiska parinaam yah hoga, ve sabhi apne-apne patiyon ke prati nafrat ke saath vyavhaar kareingi, kyonki tab ve yah soch karne lageingi, ‘Raaja ahashverosh ka order tha ki raani vashti unke saamne laayi jaae, lekin vah unke saamne nahin aai.’
Phaaras aur mediya ki auraton ne aaj raani ke jis vyavhaar ke baare mein sun liya hai, raaja ke haakimo se vaisa hi vyavhaar kareingi. Isse unmein bahut nafrat aur krodh utpann ho jaaega.

“Yadi raaja ko yah upyukt lage, vah ek raajaajna prasaarit kar dein jise phaaras aur mediya ke niymon mein likh diya jaae ki kabhi is niyam ko badla na ja sake, ki ab kabhi bhi raani vashti raaja ahashverosh ki upasthiti mein pravesh na kare, tab raani vashti ka raajkiy pad kisi dusre ko jo vashti se adhik yogy hain use provide kar dein

Jab raaja ke dvaara prasaarit command unke sampurn saamraajy mein sunaai jaaegi tab sab striyaan apne patiyon ka aadar karne lageingi, vishesh ya saamaany, sabhi apne-apne patiyon ka sammaan karne lageingi.”
Raaja aur shaaskon ke lie yah paraamarsh svikaary tha, tab raaja ne mamukaan ke prastaav ke anurup hi kaary pura kiya.

Tab usne raaja ke sab raajyon mein patr preshit kie, har ek raajy mein usi ki akshar ke anurup aur har ek jaati ko usi ki bhaasha mein ki apne-apne parivaar mein har ek aadmi ghar ka mukhiya ho aur vah apne jaati ki bhaasha bola kare.
Jab yah sab pura ho chuka, raaja ahashverosh ka krodh thanda ho gaya, usne vashti ke us aachran ka smaran kiya aur yah bhi, ki vashti ke khilaaf kaisi raajaajna prabhaavi ki ja chuki thi.
Raaja ke adhikaariyon ne raaja ke saamne prastaav rakha, “Raaja ke lie rupvaan, yuva kunvaariyon ki khoj ki jaaein.

Saamraajy ke har ek raajy mein raaja mukhiyaaon ko niyukt karein, ki ve raajdhaani shushan mein har ek rupvaan, yuva, kunvaariyon ko ekatr karein. Unhein raaja ke khoja hegaai ke sanrakshan nivaas mein rakha jaae, jo sab auraton ke lie prabandhak tha. In sabhi kunvaariyon ko sundar banaane vaali vastuein di jaaein.
Tab vah yuvti, jo raaja ko uttam lage, vah vashti ke jagah par raani ho jaae.” Raaja ko yah prastaav achchha laga aur usne yahi kiya.
Shushan garhangar mein ek Yahudi nivaas karta tha, jiska naam tha, moradkay, vah binyaamin ka vansh ka tha vah yaair ka son tha, jo shimei ka, jo kish ka son tha.
Vah Yahudiya ke raaja yakoniyaah ke saath Yerushalem se dusre bandiyon ke saath bandhuaai mein gaya hua tha, jinhein baabel ke raaja nabukadnejzar ne bandi banaakar le gaya tha.

Moradkay hadaassaah ka follow poshan kar raha tha. Hadaassaah ester naam se bhi jaani jaati thi. Vah moradkay ke chaacha ki putri thi uske maata-pita jivit nahin the. Yah yuvti sundar aur rupavti thi. Jab uske maata-pita ki maut hui, mordikay ne use apni hi putri sadrish apna liya tha.

Uske baad ka ghatnaakram is tarah hai: jab raaja ki raajaajna sarvatr suna di gayi, kai yuvtiyaan garhangar shushan hegaai ke sanrakshan ekatr kar di gai thi. Ester ko bhi raajamhal mein hegaai ke sanrakshan mein diya gaya, jo yuvtiyon ka prabhaari tha.

Hegaai ko ester dear lagi aur use hegaai ki grace receive ho gayi. Hegaai ne turant ester ki saundary prasaadhan aur khaana vastu ka prabandh kar diya. Iske alaava usne ester ke lie raajamhal ki saat sarvottam parichaarikaaein rakhi. Ester aur in daasiyon ko nivaas jagah ke sarvottam kshetr mein rakh diya.
Ester ne moradkay ke sandesh ke hisaab se apni jaati aur prishthbhumi ki baatein gupt rakhi thi.
Pratidin moradkay raani mahal ke aangan ke saamne aaya jaaya karta tha ki use ester ki gatividhiyon ki jaankaari rahein.

Jab moradkay ke chaacha abihaail ki putri ester ki baari aai, jiska moradkay ne apni hi putri sadrish follow poshan kiya tha, vah raaja ki upasthiti mein prastut hui. Usne raaja ke khoja hegaai dvaara, jo auraton ka prabhaari tha, diye paraamarsh ke atirikt apne lie kuchh bhi yaachna nahin ki. Jis kisi ne ester ko dekha, har ek ko vah sundar lagi.
Tab dasvein maah mein, arthaat tebith maah mein raaja ahashverosh ke shaasan ke saatvein varsh mein ester ko raaja ahashverosh ke raajamhal mein laaya gaya.

Ester sabhi dusre yuvtiyon ki apeksha mein raaja ko dear lagi, use dusre sabhi kunvaariyon ki apeksha raaja ki adhik grace aur grace receive ho gaya, itna, ki raaja ne uske sir par raajkiy mukut rakhkar use vashti ke jagah par raani ghoshit kar diya.

Is avsar par raaja ne ek bhavy bhoj aayojit kiya, jise naam diya gaya ester ka bhoj, ismein uske sabhi shaasak aur adhikaari aamantrit the. Iske atirikt sab saamraajy mein avkaash ghoshit kiya aur raaja ke kosh mein se uphaar bhi vitrit kie gae.
Jab kunvaari navyuvtiyaan phir se ekatrit ho gai, moradkay us samay raajamhal parisar ke phaatak par hi baitha hua tha.

Ab tak ester ne apni jaati aur kul ke baare mein prishthbhumi reveal nahin ki thi, jaisa moradkay ne use order diya tha, kyonki ester vahi karti thi, jo moradkaay use order deta tha. Thik jaisa vah us samay karti thi, jab vah uske sanrakshan mein thi.

Unhin dinon mein jab moradkay raajamhal parisar ke dvaar par baitha karta tha, raaja ke dvaarpaalon mein se do, bigthaan aur teresh kisi kaaran raaja ahashverosh par naaraaj ho gae aur uski murder ki yukti karne lage.
Is sharyantr ke baare mein moradkay ko maalum ho gaya. Iski suchna usne raani ester ko de di aur moradkay ki or se ester ne raaja ko suchit kiya.
Jab is sharyantr ki khojbin ki gai aur is baat ka pata chala, un donon ko maut dand par latka diya gaya. Iska ullekh raaja ke saamne hi itihaas granth mein likh liya.
In ghatnaaon ke baad raaja ahashverosh ne agaagi hammedaatha ke son haamaan ko varnan kiya. Raaja ne use un sabhi ke upar authority provide kar use sammaanit kiya, jo raaja ke saath shaasak the.

Raajamhal parisar ke dvaar par sabhi adhikaari-servant jhukkar haamaan ko dandvat kiya karte the kyonki raaja ke hi or se uske sambandh yah order prasaarit kiya ja chuka tha. Lekin moradkay na to jhukta tha aur na usko dandvat karta tha.
Ek avsar par pravesh dvaar par niyukt raaja ke adhikaariyon ne moradkay se savaal kiya, “Tum raaja ki command ka follow kyon nahin karte?”

Jab ve moradkay ko pratidin iska smaran dilaate rahe aur phir bhi usne unki chetaavni ki or dhyaan nahin diya, tab unhonne is vishay ka ullekh haamaan se kiya, ki ve yah maalum kar sakein ki moradkay ka soch svikaary hoga ya nahin, kyonki moradkay un par yah reveal kar chuka tha ki vah ek Yahudi hai.
Jab haamaan ne yah dekha ki moradkay na to uske saamne jhukta hai aur na hi uska aadar karta hai, tab haamaan kruddh ho gaya!

Kyonki unhonne use yah bhi suchit kiya tha, ki moradkaay kis samudaay se tha. Is kaaran haamaan yah yukti karne laga ki kis riti se sab Yahudiyon ko barbaad kiya ja sakta hai, jo moradkay ke sajaatiy the, jo ahashverosh ke saamraajy mein phail gaye the.

Raaja ahashverosh ke shaasan ke baarahvein varsh ke pahle mahine nisaan mein haamaan ke saamne din-din aur mahine-mahine karke baarahvein mahine ke lie arthaat adaar ke lie pur arthaat chitthi daali gai.

Haamaan ne raaja ahashverosh se nivedan kiya, “Aapke saare saamraajy mein kuchh vishesh jaati samuh ke log bikhre hue rah rahe hain. Inka apna niyam hai, jo sabhi anyon se alag hain. Ye ve hain, jo raaja ke niyam ko mahatv nahin dete. Inhein bane rahne dena raaja ke laabh mein na hoga.

Yadi yah raaja ko uttam lage, yah raajaajna prasaarit ki jaae, ki inhein barbaad kar diya jaae. Main khud koshaadhikaariyon ke haath mein das hajaar chaandi ke sikke saumpunga, ki jo jo raajaajna ka follow karega, unhein di jaayein.”
Is par raaja ne apni ungli se raajkiy anguthi nikaali aur Yahudiyon ke dushman agaagvaasi hammedaatha ke son haamaan ko saump di.
Raaja ne haamaan ko aashvaasan diya, “Tumhein dhanraashi bhi di ja rahi hai aur sahaayak bhi. Ab tumhein jo kuchh zaruri lage vahi karo.”

Tab pratham mahine ki terahvin tithi par raaja ke lekhkon ko aamantrit kiya gaya aur haamaan dvaara di gayi raajaajna saare saamraajy ke har ek raajy ke haakimo aur raajypaalon ke naam aur people par niyukt adhikaariyon ke lie usi raajy ki bhaasha aur akshar mein likhva di gai. Yah raajaajna ahashverosh ke naam mein likh di gai thi. Aur is par raaja ki raajmudra ki mohar laga di gai thi.

Ye chitthi saare saamraajy ke har ek raajy ko chitthi sandeshvaahkon dvaara di gai thi. Inmein sandesh yah tha: Yahudiyon ka sanhaar ho, unhein barbaad kar do, un sabhi ka astitv hi samaapt kar do, chaahe yuva hon, vriddh hon, striyaan hon, ya baalak hon, yah ek hi din mein pura ho, baarahvein mahine adaar ki terahvin tithi par. Isi din unki property bhi lut li jaae.
Is lekh ki ek prati har ek raajy mein logon ke saamne is ghoshna ke saath saumpi jaae ki sab log us vishesh din ke lie taiyaar rahein.

Raaja ke order par sandeshvaahak turant chale gae. Raajaajna ko garhangar shushan mein jaahir kar diya gaya. Raaja aur haamaan saath baithe hue daakhamdhu mein mast the jabki shushan shehar mein ghabraahat phail chuki thi.
Yah sab, jo kuchh kiya gaya tha, maalum hua tab moradkay ne apne kapde phaar die, taat orhe, deh par bhasm lagaakar shok karta raha, aur unchi aavaaj se chillaate hue shehar chauk se
Raajamhal pravesh dvaar par ja pahuncha. Taat orh ke raajamhal ke dvaar se pravesh karna mana tha.

Saare saamraajy mein jahaan-jahaan raajaajna aur order pahunch chuka tha, Yahudiyon mein gahan vedna-vilaap phail chuka tha. Yahudi upvaas kar rahe the; ro rahe the, haan, chillaate bhi. Anekon ne bhasm ke saath taat orh lie the.

Ester ki parichaarikaaon aur khojon ne use iski suchna di. Jisse vah bahut sankat mein thi. Usne moradkay ke lie kapde bhej die, ki vah apne taat kapde chhor de, lekin moradkaay ne ye kapde asvikaar kar die.

Tab ester ne raaja ke khojon mein se haathaakh naam khoja ko bulvaaya, jise khud raaja ne hi ester ki service ke lie niyukt kiya tha; ester ne haathaakh ko moradkay se yah maalum karne ke lie preshit kiya, ki yah sab kya ho raha hai aur iske pichhe kya kaaran hai?
Tab haathaakh raajamhal pravesh dvaar ke saamne shehar chauk par gaya.
Moradkay ne use apne saath hue sab ghatna ka vivran de diya aur yah bhi ki haamaan ne Yahudiyon ko barbaad karne par raajkosh mein thik-thik kitna wealth dene ki promise ki hai.

Moradkay ne to use us raajaajna jo shushan shehar mein unke barbaadi ke lie nikaali ja chuki thi, uski ek nakal bhi is purpose se saump di, ki haathaakh yah ester ko dikha de aur use is vishay ki suchna receive ho sake; aur ester raaja se uski grace ki yaachna kare aur raaja ke saamne apne logon ka paksh samarthan kar sake.
Haathaakh ne vahaan se lautkar moradkay dvaara reveal ki gai sab baat ester ko bata di.
Is par ester ne haathaakh ko moradkay tak yah sandesh pahunchaane ka order diya,

“Raaja ke saare karmchaari aur raaja ke saare saamraajy ki people is baat ko jaanti hain, ki koi aurat ya aadmi yadi bulaahat ke bina raaja ke bhitri aangan mein pravesh kar jaata hai, unke liye ek hi niyam banaakar rakha hai, use maut dand diya jaae. Uske jivit rah sakne ka sirf ek hi law shesh rahta hai yadi raaja uski or apna svarn raajdand barhaae, ki vah jivit rah sake. Maalum hai ki gat tis dinon se raaja dvaara mujhe bulaaya nahin gaya hai.”
Jab ester ki ye baatein moradkay ko sunaai gai,
Moradkay ne aagrah kiya ki ester ko yah uttar bhej diya jaae: “Is soch mein na rah jaana ki tumhaare raajamhal mein rahne ke kaaran tum sab Yahudiyon par aae sankat se bach jaaogi.

Yadi tum is avsar par chup rahin, Yahudiyon ke lie nishchay kisi dusre jagah se raahat aur bachaav to a hi jaaega, lekin tum aur tumhaara kul mit jaaega. Kaun is marm ko samajh sakta hai ki tumhein yah raajpad is paristhiti ke lie provide kiya gaya hai?”
Tab ester ne unhein moradkay ke lie is uttar ke saath bheja,

“Jaaie aur shushan shehar ke sabhi Yahudiyon ko ekatr kijie aur mere lie upvaas kijie; tin din aur tin raat ko koi bhi kuchh na khaae aur na hi kuchh pie. Apni parichaarikaaon ke saath khud main bhi isi tarah upvaas karungi. Tab main isi situation mein raaja ke paas bhitar jaaungi, jo niyam ke khilaaf hai. Tab yadi mera barbaadi hota hai, to ho jaae.”
Moradkay ne jaakar thik yahi kiya, jaisa ester ne use command di thi.

Tab ghatnaakram is tarah hai: upvaas ke tritiy din ester apne raajkiy raajsi poshaak dhaaran kar raaja ke raajamhal ke aangan mein raaja ke kakshon ke saamne ja khari hui. Raaja is samay sinhaasan kaksh mein, jo raajamhal ke pravesh ke sammukh hai, sinhaasan par baitha tha.

Jab raaja ne raani ester ko aangan mein khari hui dekha, tab raaja ke dil mein ester ke prati grace hui aur dil khushi se bhar gaya. Raaja ne apne haath mein pakre hue svarn raajdand le, ester ki or mein barha diya. Tab samay ke anurup ester ne aage barhkar raajdand ke nok ko sparsh kiya.
Raaja ne usse puchha, “Raani ester, kya hua? Kya chaahti ho tum? Yadi tumne mujhse aadhe saamraajy ki bhi yaachna ki, to vah bhi tumhein de diya jaaega.”
Ester ne javaab diya, “Yadi mahaaraaj mujhse prasann hain, to mahaaraaj aur haamaan aaj mere dvaara aayojit bhoj mein shaamil hone ka kasht karein.”
Raaja ne order diya, “Turant haamaan ko bulaaya jaae, ki ham ester ki chaahat ko puri karein.” Tab raaja aur haamaan ester dvaara taiyaar kie gae bhoj mein sammilit hone aae.

Jab bhoj ke avsar par daakhamdhu pine baithe the, raaja ne ester se savaal kiya, “Kya hai tumhaari yaachna, ki isko puri ki ja sake. Kya hai tumhaara aagrah? Yadi vah mere aadhe saamraajy tak hai, purn kiya jaaega.”
Ester ne javaab diya, “Meri yaachna aur binti yah hai

Yadi mainne raaja ki grace receive kar li hai, aur yadi mera aagrah purn karne mein raaja ne accept kiya hai aur vah meri request purn karne ke liye bhi tatpar hain, to kya raaja aur haamaan mere dvaara taiyaar kie gae bhoj par kal bhi a sakeinge, tab main vahi karungi, jo raaja order deinge.”

Us din haamaan bahut aanandit dil ke saath lauta; lekin jaise hi haamaan ki nazar moradkay par pari, jo us samay raajamhal ke dvaar par hi tha, jisne uske saamne khara hokar abhinandan karna uchit na samjha aur na hi use sammaan dena uchit samjha, haamaan moradkay ke prati krodh se bhar utha.
Phir bhi haamaan ne khud par niyantran banaae rakha aur apne ghar ko laut gaya. Usne apne mitron aur patni zeresh ko apne paas mein bula liya.

Unke saamne haamaan ne apne vaibhav aur samriddhi ka, apne sons ki sankhya ka aur har ek ghatna ka ullekh kiya, jinmein raaja ne uski prashansa ka varnan kiya aur raaja dvaara, dusre sabhi shaaskon aur raaja ke adhikaariyon ki apeksha use uncha pad dene ki apeksha varnan kiya gaya.
Haamaan ne yah bhi kaha, “Yah bhi maalum hai ki raani ester ne raaja ke saath kisi dusre ko aamantrit na kar sirf mujhe hi aamantrit karna uchit samjha.
Phir bhi, itna sab hone par bhi mujhe koi chain nahin milta, jab kabhi main Yahudi moradkay ko raajamhal parisar dvaar par baitha hua dekhta hun.”

Yah sun unki patni zeresh aur uske sab mitron ne yah sujhaav diya “Aap bis mitar uncha ek phaansi ka khambha banva dijie aur subah jaakar raaja se anurodh kar moradkay ko latka dijie. Aur aap jaaie aur raaja ke saath bhoj ka khushi uthaaie.” Haamaan ko yah paraamarsh sahi laga tab usne us stambh ka nirmaan karva daala.
Us raat raaja ko nind nahin aai, tab usne order diya, ki itihaas ki pustak laayi jaae, ki use raaja ke saamne vaachan kiya jaae.
Vahaan pustak mein yah baat saamne aayi, ki raaja ke do dvaarpaal khoja, bigthaan aur teresh ka raaja ahashverosh ki murder ka sharyantr moradkay dvaara suchit kiya gaya tha.
Raaja ne puchha, “Moradkay ko iske lie kaun sa sammaan ya puraskaar diya gaya?” Raaja ke parichaaraakon ne javaab diya. “Kuchh bhi nahin kiya gaya hai, uske lie.”

Raaja ne puchha, “Kaun hai is samay aangan mein?” Hua yah tha, ki haamaan ne isi samay raajamhal parisar ke baahar ke aangan mein pravesh kiya tha, ki vah raaja se moradkay ko us stambh par latkaane ki charcha kar sake, jo usne moradkay ke lie banvaaya tha.
Raaja ke adhikaariyon ne use suchit kiya, “Mahaaraaj, haamaan aangan mein thahre hue hain.” Raaja ne order diya, “Use yahaan aane do.”

Haamaan bhitar a gaya. Raaja ne usse savaal kiya, “Yah bataao, yadi raaja kisi person ko sammaan provide karna chaahe, to iske lie kya-kya upyukt hoga?” Haamaan ke man mein soch aaya: “Mere atirikt raaja bhala kise sammaanit karna chaaheinge?”
Haamaan ne raaja ko javaab diya, “Raaja jis person ko sammaan karna chaahein,
Uske lie vahi raajsi poshaak laaya jaae, jo khud raaja pahna karte hain, use vahi ghora diya jaae, jiska prayog khud raaja karte hain, aur uske sir par raajsi mukut bhi rakha jaae;

Yah raajsi poshaak aur ghora raaja ke sarvochch shaasak ko saumpa jaae ki vah yah raajsi kapde us person ko pahna de, jise raaja aadar karna chaahte hain. Tab us person ko ghore par savaar kiya jaae aur use is tarah se shehar chauk mein lekar ghumaaya jaae. Yah karte hue uske aage-aage yah ghoshna ki jaae: ‘Raaja jis person ko aadar karna chaahte hain, uske saath yahi kiya jaaega.’ ”

Raaja ne haamaan ko order diya, “Turant ve raajsi kapde aur ghora lo, jaisa sujhaav abhi tumne rakha hai aur Yahudi moradkay ke saath vah sab karo, jo is samay raajamhal ke parisar ke dvaar par baitha hua hai. Tumne jaisa jaisa sujhaav rakha hai, usmein koi kami na aane paae.”

Tab haamaan ne raajsi poshaak, kapde liya aur ghora liya. Usne moradkay ko vah raajsi poshaak, kapde pahnaaya aur use ghore par savaar karke shehar chauk mein ghumaaya. Vah uske aage-aage yah ghoshna kiye ja rahe the: “Us person ke saath aisa hi kiya jaaega, jiska raaja aadar karna chaahte hain.”
Moradkay to raajamhal parisar dvaar par laut gaya; lekin haamaan turant apne ghar ko vilaap karta apne sir ko dhaamp kar laut gaya.

Usne apni patni zeresh aur apne mitron ko uske saath jo hua sab kuchh kah sunaaya. Yah sun uski patni zeresh aur uske wise doston ne use chetaavni di, “Yadi moradkay, jiske saamne tumhaare patan ki shuruaat ho chuki hai, Yahudi mul ka hai, jab tak tum use paraajit na kar paaoge-tumhaara patan sunishchit hai.”
Jab unke beech yah vaartaalaap chal raha tha, vahaan raaja ke khoja a pahunche aur haamaan ko tatkaal apne saath us bhoj ke lie le gae, jise ester ne taiyaar kiya tha.
Raaja aur haamaan raani ester ke yahaan daakhamdhu pi rahe the.

Yah bhoj ka dvitiy din tha. Raaja ne bhoj ke avsar par daakhamdhu pite hue savaal kiya, “Raani ester, tumhaara anurodh kya hai? Vah purn kiya jaaega. Kya hai tumhaari request? Yadi is raajy ke aadha tak bhi ho, vah purn kiya jaaega.”
Raani ester ne javaab diya, “Mahaaraaj, yadi mujh par aapki grace hai, yadi mahaaraaj mujhse prasann hain, meri request par mujhe aur mere sahjaatiyon ko mere anurodh par jaan daan mile,

Kyonki mujhe aur mere sahjaatiyon ko bech diya gaya hai, ki ham barbaad kar die jaaein, ki hamaara vadh kar diya jaae. Yadi hamein sirf slave-daasiyon sadrish hi bech diya jaata to main maun rah jaati kyonki tab mujhe mahaaraaj ko kasht dene ki zid nahin karni parti.”
Raaja ahashverosh ne raani ester se puchha, “Kaun hai vah aur kahaan hai vah, jisne yah zid ki hai?”
Ester ne javaab diya, “Vah dushman, vah virodhi hai yah evil haamaan!” Yah sunte hi raaja aur raani ke saamne haamaan bahut bhaybhit ho gaya.

Bahut krodh mein raaja apni daakhamdhu vahin chhor raajamhal udyaan mein chala gaya; lekin haamaan vahin thahar gaya ki raani ester se apne life ki yaachna kar sake, kyonki use ab yah maalum ho chuka tha, raaja ne use maut dand dene ka nishchay kar liya hai.

Kuchh samay baad jab raaja raajamhal udyaan se lautkar daakhamdhu kaksh mein lauta, haamaan is samay ester ke saamne jhuka hua tha. Vah drishy dekh raaja kah utha, “Kya yah mere hi upasthiti mein raani se balaatkaar karna chaahta hai?” Raaja ke is vachan ko sunkar, karmchaariyon ne haamaan ke munh ko dhaamp diya.

Raaja ke saamne upasthit khojon mein ek harbona naamak khoja ne suchna di, “Mahaaraaj, vastusthiti yah hai ki haamaan ne hi moradkay ki murder ke lie apne ghar ke nikat bis mitar uncha phaansi ka khambha banva rakha hai, jabki moradkay ne raaja ke laabh ki suchna di thi!” Raaja ne tatkshan order diya, “Ise usi par latka diya jaae.”
Tab unhonne haamaan ko usi phaansi ke khambhe par latka diya, jise usne moradkay ko maut dand ke lie banvaaya tha. Tab raaja ka kop thanda ho gaya.

Usi din raaja ahashverosh ne Yahudiyon ke dushman haamaan ki sampurn property raani ester ke naam kar di. Moradkay ko raaja ke saamne laaya gaya, kyonki ester ne moradkay se apne sambandh spasht kar die the.
Raaja ne haamaan se li gayi raajkiy anguthi apni ungli se utaarkar moradkay ko saump di. Ester ne moradkay ko haamaan ki property ka adhikaari niyukt diya.

Iske baad ester phir raaja se boli. Aur raaja ke charnon par ja giri aur rote hue usne raaja se nivedan kiya, ki vah agaagi aur haamaan ki evil yojna ko khatm kar dein, us sharyantr ko, jo usne Yahudiyon ke khilaaf racha tha.
Raaja ne apna svarn raajdand ester ki or barhaaya. Yah dekh ester uthkar raaja ke saamne khari ho gai.

Usne raaja se aagrah kiya, “Yadi yah raaja ki nazar mein santoshaprad hai, yadi mujh par aapki kripaadrishti hui hai, yah vishay raaja ki nazar mein thik hai aur main mahaaraaj ki nazar mein uttam hun, to agaagi hammedaatha ke son haamaan dvaara rache patron ko, jismein usne un sabhi Yahudiyon ko jo raaja ke saare saamraajy mein base hue hain, barbaad karne ke lie likha tha, radd karne ke lie chitthiyaan likhi jaaein
Kyonki apne sajaatiyon par a pare sankat ko dekhte hue main kaise sah sakti hun, main apne parivaar ke vinaash ko dekhte hue kaise sahan kar sakti hun?”

Tab raaja ne raani ester aur Yahudi moradkay se kaha, “Mainne haamaan ki property ester ke naam kar di hai, haamaan ko unhonne maut dand par latka diya hai, kyonki usne Yahudiyon ke khilaaf haath uthaaya tha.

Moradkay, ab tum raaja ki or se jaisa bhi bhala samjho, Yahudiyon ko sambodhit raajaajna likho aur us par raaja ki raajmudra mudrit laga do; kyonki vah raajaajna, jis par raaja ki raajmudra ki mohar lagi hui hoti hai, badli nahin ja sakti.”

Yah tritiy maah arthaat sivaan ki teisvin tithi thi. Raaja ke sachivon ko bulvaaya gaya. Unhonne sab 127 raajyon mein, jo hind se kush tak phaile the, unmein nivaas kar rahe Yahudiyon, vahaan niyukt raajypaalon, upraajypaalon, haakimon ko sambodhit moradkay ke order ki chitthiyaan un raajyon ki akshron aur bhaashaaon mein likh di gai.

Moradkay ne yah command raaja ahashverosh ki or se likhkar us par anguthi ki muhar laga di aur ye chitthi ghore par savaar sandeshvaahkon ke dvaara bhej di gai. Ye sabhi ghore uchch koti ke raajkiy suraksha ke ghore the.

In chitthiyon ke dvaara raaja ne un Yahudiyon ko, jo saamraajy ke har ek shehar mein rahte the, yah anumti provide kar di thi, ki ve ekatr hokar apne praanon ki raksha ke upakram mein kisi bhi samudaay va raajy ki sashastr sena ko, jo un par, unki auraton aur baalkon par aakrman karein, unko ghaat aur barbaad karein, aur unki property ko lut lein aur unka astitv hi mita dein.
Yah raaja ahashverosh ke akhil saamraajy ke sab raajyon mein ek hi din-baarahvein mahina adaar ki terahvin tithi par kiya jaae.

Is patr ki ek prati raaja ke order ke saath har praant ko bheji jaani thi. Yah ek niyam ban gaya. Har praant mein ise niyam ke taur par le liya. Raajy mein rahnevaali pratyek jaati ke logon ke bich iska prachaar kiya gaya. Unhonne aisa isliye kiya jisse us vishesh din ke liye Yahudi taiyaar ho jaayein jab Yahudiyon ko apne dushmanon se badla lene ki anumti de di jaaegi.
Raaja ki command ke kaaran sandeshvaahak raajkiy ghoron par turant, drut gati se nikal gae. Raajdhaani shushan shehar mein raajaajna bhej di gai thi.

Moradkay nile aur saphed raajkiy kapde dhaaran hue, ek golaakaar svarn mukut dhaaran kie hue, aur utkrisht malmal ka baingni raajsi poshaak dhaaran hue raaja ke upasthiti se nikalkar baahar shehar mein a gaya. Sampurn raajdhaani shushan shehar ke log ullaas se bharkar jayghosh kar rahe the,
Kyonki is samay sab Yahudi is sammaan ke kaaran vimukti aur ullaas mein magan ho chuke the.

Yahin nahin, har ek raajy ke har ek shehar mein jaise jaise raaja ki raajaajna aur uska order chitthiyaan pahunch gayi, Yahudiyon mein harsh aur ullaas phailta chala gaya, ek utsav aur mahotsav jaise. Is avsar par jansaadhaaran par Yahudiyon ka aatank aisa gahan ho gaya ki raajyon mein anekon ne Yahudi mat angikaar kar liya.
Raaja ahashverosh ne sab saamraajy par, haan, durast saagar tat, taapu ke kshetron tak kar laga diya.

Raaja ke sabhi ullekhniy aur vaibhavshaali uplabdhiyon ka vivran aur moradkay ki mahaanta ka purn varnan, jis udaatt pad par raaja ne use niyukt kiya tha, unka ullekh mediya aur phaaras ke raajaaon ke itihaas ke granth mein likha hai.

Sirf raaja ahashverosh hi pad mein Yahudi moradkay se uchchtar tha. Vah Yahudiyon mein ati aadarmaan tha aur vah apne qaumon mein dear tha. Vah hamesha people ke laabh ka hi koshish karta, aur sab raashtr ki bhalaai ke paksh mein hi yaachna karta tha.
Uz desh mein ayyob naamak ek person the. Ve sidhe, khare, God ke shraddha yukt aur buraai se dur the.
Unke saat son aur tin putriyaan thin,
Unke paas saat hajaar bherein, tin hajaar unt, paanch sau jore bail, paanch sau gadhiyaan aur kai-kai slave-daasiyaan thin. Purvi deshon mein koi bhi unke tuly dhanvaan na tha.
Unke son apne-apne janmdin par apne gharon mein daavat ka aayojan karte the, jismein ve apni tinon bahnon ko bhi aamantrit kiya karte the, ki ve bhi bhoj mein sammilit hon.

Jab utsvon ka samay samaapt ho jaata tha, tab ayyob apni in santaanon ko apne yahaan bulaakar unhein holy kiya karte the. Vah bare bhor ko uthkar unki sankhya ke anurup homabli arpit karte the. Unki soch thi, “Sambhav hai mere sons se koi galti hua ho aur unhonne apne dil mein hi God ke prati anisht kiya ho aur God ko chhor diya ho.” Ayyob yah sab niyampurvak kiya karte the.
Yah vah din tha, jab God ke son ne khud ko Yahweh ke saamne prastut kiya aur aarop lagaanevaala bhi unke saath aaya hua tha.
Yahweh ne aarop lagaanevaala se puchha, “Tum kahaan se a rahe ho?” Aarop lagaanevaala ne Yahweh ko javaab diya, “Prithvi par idhar-udhar ghumte-phirte hue aur dolte-daalte aaya hun.”

Yahweh ne aarop lagaanevaala se savaal kiya, “Kya tumne ayyob, mere servant par dhyaan diya hai? Ki saari prithvi par koi bhi uske tuly nahin hai. Vah sidha, khara, God ke prati shraddha yukt aur buraai se dur hai.”
Aarop lagaanevaala ne Yahweh se puchha, “Kya ayyob God ke prati shraddha bina laabh ke maanta hai?
Aapne uske ghar ke aur uski property ke chaaron or apni suraksha ka baara baandh rakha hai? Aapne uske shram ko samriddh kiya hai. Uski property is desh mein phailti ja rahi hai.
Aap haath barhaakar uski sab property ko chhuein, vah nishchay aapke saamne aapki ninda karne lagega.”

Yahweh ne aarop lagaanevaala se kaha, “Achchha suno, uski sab property par main tumhein authority de raha hun, sirf dhyaan do, tum usko sparsh mat karna.” Aarop lagaanevaala Yahweh ki upasthiti se chala gaya.
Jis din ayyob ke son-putriyaan jyeshth bhaai ke ghar par utsav mein vyast the,
Ek dut ne ayyob ko suchit kiya, “Bail hal chala rahe the aur nikat hi gadhe char rahe the,
Ki shibaaiyon ne aakrman kiya aur inhein lutkar le gae. Unhonne to hamaare slave-daasiyon ka talvaar se sanhaar kar diya hai, sirf main bachte hue aapko suchit karne aaya hun!”

Abhi uska kahna purn bhi na hua tha, ki ek dusre dut ne aakar suchna di, “Aakaash se God ki jvaala reveal hui aur hamaari bherein aur slave-daasiyaan bhasm ho gae, main bachte hue aapko suchit karne aaya hun!”

Uska kahna abhi purn bhi na hua tha, ki ek dusre dut bhi vahaan a pahuncha aur kahne laga, “Kasdiyon ne tin dal banaakar unton par chhaapa maara aur unhein le gae. Slave-daasiyon ka unhonne talvaar se sanhaar kar diya hai, sirf main bachte hue aapko suchit karne aaya hun!”
Vah abhi kah hi raha tha, ki ek dusre dut bhi vahaan a pahuncha aur unhein suchit karne laga, “Aapke jyeshth son ke ghar par aapke son-putriyaan utsav mein kha-pi rahe the,

Ki ek bari aandhi chali, jiska shuruaat registaan kshetr se hua tha, isne us ghar par chaaron or se aisa prahaar kiya ki dab kar sab yuvaaon ki maut ho gai. Sirf main bachkar aapko suchna dene aaya hun!”
Ayyob yah sun uthe, aur apne kapde phaar daale, apne sir ka mundan kiya aur zameen par dandvat kiya.
Unke vachan the: “Maata ke garbh se main nanga aaya tha, aur main nanga hi chala jaaunga. Yahweh ne diya tha, Yahweh ne le liya; blessed hai Yahweh ka naam.”
Sab ghatnaakram mein ayyob ne na to koi galti kiya aur na hi unhonne God ki kisi bhi tarah ki ninda ki.
Phir ek din jab angel Yahweh ki upasthiti mein ekatr hue, aarop lagaanevaala bhi unke beech mein aaya tha, ki vah khud ko God ke saamne prastut kare.

Yahweh ne aarop lagaanevaala se savaal kiya, “Tum kahaan se a rahe ho?” Aarop lagaanevaala ne Yahweh ko javaab diya, “Prithvi par idhar-udhar ghumte-phirte aur iski chaaron dishaaon mein dolte-daalte aaya hun.”

Yahweh ne aarop lagaanevaala se savaal kiya, “Kya tumne ayyob, mere servant par dhyaan diya hai? Kyonki prithvi par koi bhi uske tuly nahin hai. Vah sidha, imaandaar, God ke prati shraddha yukt aur buraai se dur rahnevaala person hai. Ab bhi vah apni kharaai par atal hai, jabki tumhin ho jisne use barbaad karne ke lie mujhe akaaran hi uksaaya tha.”
Aarop lagaanevaala ne Yahweh ko javaab diya, “Khaal ka vinimay khaal se! Apne praanon ki raksha mein insaan apna sarvasv dene ke lie taiyaar ho jaata hai.
Ab aap uski haddi aur maans ko sparsh kijie; tab vah aapke saamne aapki ninda karne lagega.”
Yah sunkar Yahweh ne aarop lagaanevaala ko javaab diya, “Suno, ab vah tumhaare authority mein hai; bas itna dhyaan rahe ki uska life surakshit rahe.”
Aarop lagaanevaala Yahweh ki upasthiti se chala gaya aur jaakar ayyob par aisa prahaar kiya ki unki deh par, talvon se lekar sir tak, dukhdaai phore nikal aae.
Vah raakh mein ja baithe aur ek thikre ke tukre se khud ko khujlaane lage.
Yah sab dekh unki patni ne unse kaha, “Kya tum ab bhi apni kharaai ko hi thaame rahoge? God ki ninda karo aur mar jaao!”

Lekin ayyob ne use javaab diya, “Tum to bewakoof auraton ke jaisa bak-bak karne lagi ho. Kya hamaare lie yah bhala hoga ki God se sukh accept karte jaaein aur duhkh kuchh bhi nahin?” In sabhi sthitiyon mein ayyob ne apne chehra dvaara koi galti nahin kiya.

Jab ayyob ke tin mitron ko ayyob ki dukhad situation ka samaachaar receive hua, tab tinon hi apne-apne jagahon se ayyob ke ghar a gae, temaani se eliphaaz, shuhi se bildad aur naaamath se zophar. In tinon ne yojna banaai ki sahaanubhuti aur saantvna dene ke lie ve ayyob se bheint kareinge.
Jab ve dur hi the aur unhonne ayyob ki or dekha, to ve unhein pahchaan hi na sake. Ve uchch svar mein rone lage. Har ek ne apne-apne kapdon ko phaarkar apne-apne upar dhul daal li.
Tab ve jaakar ayyob ke nikat zameen par saat din aur saat raatri chup baithe rahe, kyonki unke saamne yah purnath spasht tha ki ayyob ki dard bahut bhayaanak thi.
Uske baad ayyob ne apna munh khola aur apne janmdivas ko dhikkaara.
Unka vachan tha:
“Jis din mera janm hona nirdhaarit tha, vahi din mit jaae aur vah raatri, jab yah ghoshna ki gayi ki ek baalak ka garbhdhaaran hua hai!
Andhkaarmay ho vah din; svargik God uska dhyaan hi na rakhein; kisi bhi roshni ka prakaash us par na pare.
Andhera aur maut ke baadal bane rahein; us par ek baadal a jaae; din ka andhera usko daraane ka kaaran ho jaae.
Us raatri ko bhi andhera apne vash mein kar le; varsh ke dinon mein, yah din aanandmay na samjha jaae; maahon mein us din ki ganna na ki jaae.
Oh, vah raatri baanjh ho jaae; koi bhi khushi dhvani use sunaai na de.
Ve, jo dinon ko dhikkaarte rahte hain aur livyaathaan ko uksaane ke lie tatpar rahte hain, ve ise bhi dhikkaarein.
Iske sandhya ke taare kaale ho jaaein; iska ujiyaala barbaad ho jaae, iske lie prabhaat hi mit jaae;
Kyonki yahi vah din tha, jisne meri maata ke prasav ko roka nahin, aur na hi isne vipatti ko meri nazar se chhipaaya.
“Janm hote hi meri maut kyon na ho gai, kyon nahin garbh se nikalte hi mera jaan chala gaya?
Kyon un ghutnon ne mujhe thaam liya aur mere dugdhpaan ke lie ve stan tatpar kyon the?
Yadi aisa na hota to aaj main shaanti se para hua hota; main nidra mein vishraanti kar raha hota,
Mere saath hote duniya ke raaja aur mantri, jinhonne apne hi lie sunsaan jagah ko punarnirmaan kiya tha.
Ya ve shaasak, jo svarn dhaaran kie hue the, jinhonne chaandi se apne kosh bhar lie the.
Ya us mrit bhrun ke jaisa, us shishu-jaisa, jisne prakaash ka anubhav hi nahin kiya, meri bhi situation vaisi hoti.
Us jagah par to evil log bhi duhkh dena chhor dete hain aur thake maande vishraanti ke lie kabr mein ja pahunchte hain,
Vahaan ekatr bandi bhi ek saath sukh se rahte hain; vahaan unke pahredaaron ki aavaaj ve nahin sunte.
Vahaan saamaany bhi hain aur vishisht bhi, vahaan slave apne maalik se svatantr ho chuka hai.
“Jo dard mein para hua hai, use prakaash ka kya laabh, aur usko life kyon dena hai, jiski aatma karvaahat se bhar chuki ho,
Vah jiski manokaamna maut ki hai, lekin maut usse dur-dur rahti hai, vah maut ko is yatn se khoj raha hai, maano vah ek khajaana hai.
Bhala kise, kisi kabr ko dekh khushi hota hai?
Us person ko prakaash provide karne ka kya laabh, jiske saamne koi raasta nahin hai, jise God dvaara simit kar diya gaya hai?
Khaana ko dekhne se hi meri karaahat ka shuruaat hota hai; aur paani jaisa bahta hai mera vilaap.
Jo kuchh mere saamne dar ka vishay the; unhin ne mujhe gher rakha hai, jo mere saamne bhayaavah tha, vahi mujh par a para hai.
Main sukh situation mein nahin hun, main nishchint nahin hun; mujhmein vishraanti nahin hai, lekin khalabli samaai hai.”
Tab temaanvaasi eliphaaz ne javaab diya:
“Ayyob, yadi main tumse kuchh kahne ka dhaadhas karun, kya tum chirh jaaoge? Lekin kuchh na kahna bhi asambhav ho raha hai.
Yah saty hai ki tumne anekon ko chetaaya hai, tumne anekon ko protsaahit kiya hai.
Tumhaare words se anekon ke larakhraate pair sthir hue hain; tumse hi nirbal ghutnon mein bal-sanchaar hua hai.
Ab tum khud usi situation ka saamna kar rahe ho aur tum adhir ho rahe ho; usne tumhein sparsh kiya hai aur tum niraasha mein dube hue ho!
Kya tumhaare bal ka aadhaar God ke prati tumhaari shraddha nahin hai? Kya tumhaari ummid ka aadhaar tumhaara aachran khara hona nahin?
“Ab yah saty yaad na hone dena ki kya kabhi koi apne nirdosh hone ke kaaran barbaad hua? Ya kahaan sajjan ko barbaad kiya gaya hai?
Apne anubhav ke aadhaar par main kahunga, jo galti mein hal chalaate hain aur jo sankat bote hain, ve usi ki upaj ekatr karte hain.
God ke shvaas sirf se ve barbaad ho jaate hain; unke kop ke visphot se ve barbaad ho jaate hain,
Sinh ki dahaar, hinsak sinh ki garaj, balishth sinhon ke daant tut jaate hain.
Khaana ke abhaav mein sinh barbaad ho rahe hain, sinhni ke bachche idhar-udhar ja chuke hain.
“Ek sandesh chhipte-chhipaate mujhe diya gaya, mere kaanon ne vah shaant dhvani sun li.
Raatri mein sapnon mein vichaaron ke beech ke drishyon se, jab insaan ghor nidra mein pare hue hote hain,
Main dar se bhaybhit ho gaya, mujh par kampkampi chha gai, vastuth meri sab haddiyaan hil rahi thin.
Usi avsar par mere chehre ke saamne se ek aatma nikalkar chali gai, mere rom khare ho gae.
Main stabdh khara rah gaya. Uske rup ko samajhna mere lie sambhav na tha. Ek rup ko mere netr zarur dekh rahe the. Vaataavran mein purnath sannaata tha, tab mainne ek svar suna
‘Kya maanav jaati God ki nazar mein righteous ho sakti hai? Kya rachyita ki parakh mein maanav holy ho sakta hai?
God ne apne servants par bharosa nahin rakha hai, apne angels par ve dosh aaropit karte hain.
Tab un par jo mitti ke gharon mein nivaas karte, jinki ninv hi dhul mein rakhi hui hai, jinhein patange-jaisa kuchalna kitna adhik sambhav hai!
Praatahkaal se lekar sandhyaakaal tak unhein tukre-tukre kar diya jaata hai; unhein hamesha-hamesha ke lie vinasht kar diya jaata hai, kisi ka dhyaan un par nahin jaata.
Kya yah saty nahin ki unke tambuon ki rassiyaan unke bhitar hi khol di jaati hain? Aur buddhihinon ki maut ho jaati hai?’ ”
“Isi samay pukaarkar dekh. Hai koi jo ise sunega? Tum kis sajjan person se madad ki ummid karoge?
Krodh hi bewakoof person ke vinaash ka kaaran ho jaata hai, aur jalan bhole ke lie ghaatak hoti hai.
Mainne bewakoof ko jar pakde dekha hai, lekin tatkaal hi mainne uske ghar ko shaap de diya.
Uski children surakshit nahin hai, shehar chauk mein ve kasht ke lakshy bane hue hain, koi bhi vahaan nahin, jo unko chhurvaaega,
Uski kati hui upaj bhukhe log kha jaate hain, kantile kshetr ki upaj bhi ve nahin chhorte. Lobhi uski property harapne ke lie pyaase hain.
Kasht ka utpann dhul se nahin hota aur na vipatti zameen se upajti hai.
Jis tarah chingaariyaan upar disha mein hi barhti hain usi tarah insaan ka janm hota hi hai yaatnaaon ke lie.
“Haan, main to God ki khoj karunga; main apna paksh God ke saamne prastut karunga.
Vahi vilakshan aur agamy kaary karte hain, asankhy hain aapke chamatkaar.
Vahi prithvi par vrishti barsaate aur kheton ko paani pahunchaate hain.
Tab vah vinamron ko unche jagah par baithaate hain, jo vilaap kar rahe hain, unhein suraksha provide karte hain.
Vah chaalaak ke sharyantr ko viphal kar dete hain, parinaamasvrup unke kaary saphal ho hi nahin paate.
Vah buddhimaanon ko unhin ki yukti mein uljha dete hain aur dhurt ka paraamarsh tatkaal viphal ho jaata hai.
Din mein hi ve andhera mein ja parte hain aur madhyaahn par unhein raatri ke jaisa tatolna parta hai.
Lekin pratiraksha ke lie God ka vachan hai unke chehra ki talvaar; vah balvaanon ki power se din ki raksha karte hain.
Tab nisshaay ke lie ummid hai, anivaary hai ki bure log chup rahein.
“Dhyaan do, kaisa prasann hai vah person jisko God taarna dete hain; tab sarvshaktimaan ke dvaara ki ja rahi taarna se nafrat na karna.
Chot pahunchaana aur marham patti karna, donon hi unke dvaara hote hain; vahi ghaav lagaate aur svaasthy bhi vahi provide karte hain.
Vah chhah kashton se tumhaara nikaas kareinge, saat mein bhi anisht tumhaara sparsh nahin kar sakega.
Akaal ki situation mein God tumhein maut se bachaaeinge, vaise hi yuddh mein talvaar ke prahaar se.
Tum chaabuk jaisa jibh se surakshit rahoge, aur tumhein hinsa bhaybhit na kar sakegi.
Hinsa aur akaal tumhaare lie uphaas ke vishay honge, tumhein hinsak pashuon ka dar na hoga.
Tum khet ke patthron ke saath rahoge aur van-pashuon se tumhaari maitri ho jaaegi.
Tumhein yah to maalum ho jaaega ki tumhaara dera surakshit hai; tum apne ghar mein jaaoge aur tumhein kisi bhi haani ka dar na hoga.
Tumhein yah bhi bodh ho jaaega ki tumhaare vanshjon ki sankhya bari hogi, tumhaari santti zameen ki ghaas jaisa hogi.
Maut ki bela mein bhi tumhaare shaury ka hraas na hua hoga, jis tarah paripakv ann ekatr kiya jaata hai.
“Is par dhyaan do: hamne ise parakh liya hai yah aisa hi hai. Ise suno aur khud ise pahchaan lo.”
Yah sun ayyob ne yah kaha:
“Kaisa hota yadi meri dard maapi ja sakti, ise taraaju mein rakha jaata!
Tab to iska maap saagar tat ki baalu se adhik hota. Isliye mere word murkhta bhare lagte hain.
Kyonki sarvshaktimaan ke baan mujhe bedhe hue hain, unka vish riskar meri aatma mein pahunch raha hai. God ka aatank aakrman ke lie mere khilaaf khara hai!
Kya jangli gadha ghaas ke saamne aakar reinkta hai? Kya bachhra apna chaara dekh rambhaata hai?
Kya kisi svaadarhit vastu ka sevan namak ke bina sambhav hai? Kya ande ki saphedi mein koi bhi svaad hota hai?
Main unka sparsh hi nahin chaahta; mere lie ye ghrinit khaana-jaisa hain.
“Kaisa hota yadi mera anurodh purn ho jaata aur God meri laalsa ko purn kar dete,
Tab aisa ho jaata ki God mujhe kuchalne ke lie tatpar ho jaate, ki vah haath barhaakar mera barbaadi kar dete!
Lekin tab bhi mujhe to santosh hai, main asahy dard mein bhi aanandit hota hun, kyonki mainne holy vachnon ke orders ka virodh nahin kiya hai.
“Kya hai meri power, jo main ummid karun? Kya hai meri niyti, jo main sabr rakhun?
Kya mera bal vah hai, jo chattaanon ka hota hai? Ya kya meri deh ki rachna kaansy se hui hai?
Kya meri madad ka mul mere antar mein nihit nahin, kya meri vimukti mujhse dur ho chuki?
“Jo apne duhkhi mitr par mercy nahin dikhaata, vah sarvshaktimaan God ke prati shraddha chhor deta hai.
Mere bhaai to jaldhaaraaon jaisa vishvaasghaati hi pramaanit hue, ve jaldhaaraaein, jo vilin ho jaati hain,
Jinmein him pighal kar paani banta hai aur unka paani chhip jaata hai.
Ve jalhin shaant aur suni ho jaati hain, ve grishmaritu mein apne jagah se vilin ho jaati hain.
Ve apne raaste se bhatak jaate hain; uske baad ve marubhumi mein vilin ho jaati hain.
Tema ke yaatri dal unhein khojte rahe, shiba ke yaatriyon ne un par ummid rakhi thi.
Un par bharosa kar unhein pachhtaava hua; ve vahaan pahunche aur niraash ho gae.
Ab situation yah hai, ki tum inhin jaldhaaraaon ke jaisa ho chuke ho; tum aatank ko dekhkar dar jaate ho.
Kya mainne kabhi yah aagrah kiya hai, ‘Kuchh to de do mujhe, ya, apni property mein se kuchh dekar mujhe mukt kara lo,
Ya, dushman ke bandhan se mujhe mukt kara lo, is upadrav karnevaale person ke authority se mujhe chhura lo?’
“Mujhe teaching dijie, main chup rahunga; meri trutiyaan mujh par reveal kar dijie.
Sach mein kahe gae udgaar kitne sukhdaayak hote hain! Lekin aapke vivaad se kya reveal hota hai?
Kya tumhaara abhipraay mere kahne ki ninda karna hai, niraash person ke udgaar to nirarthak hi hote hain?
Tum to pitrihinon ke lie chitthi daaloge aur apne mitr ko hi bech doge.
“Ab grace karo aur meri or dekho. Phir dekhna ki kya main tumhaare chehra par jhuth bol sakunga?
Ab koi anyaay na hone paae; chhor do yah sab, main ab bhi satynishth hun.
Kya meri jibh anyaaypurn hai? Kya mujhmein buraai aur achchhaai ka bodh na raha?
“Kya aihik life mein insaan shram karne ke lie bandha nahin hai? Kya uska jivankaal mazdur jaisa nahin hai?
Us slave ke jaisa, jo haamphte hue chhaaya khojta hai, us mazdur ke jaisa, jo utkanthaapurvak apni mazduri milne ki pratiksha karta hai.
Isi tarah mere lie nirarthakta ke maah aur dard ki raatein nirdhaarit ki gai hain.
Main is soch ke saath bichhaune par jaata hun, ‘Main kab uthunga?’ Lekin raatri samaapt nahin hoti. Main praatahkaal tak karavtein badalta rah jaata hun.
Meri khaal par kiton aur dhul ki parat jam chuki hai, meri khaal kathor ho chuki hai, usmein se sraav bahta rahta hai.
“Mere dinon ki gati to bunkar ki dharki ki gati se bhi adhik hai, jab ve samaapt hote hain, ummid shesh nahin rah jaati.
Yah smarniy hai ki mera life sirf shvaas hai; kalyaan ab mere saamne aaega nahin.
Vah, jo mujhe aaj dekh raha hai, iske baad nahin dekhega; tumhaare dekhte-dekhte main astitvhin ho jaaunga.
Jab koi baadal chhup jaata hai, uska astitv mit jaata hai, usi tarah vah adholok mein pravesh kar jaata hai, punh yahaan nahin lautta.
Vah apne ghar mein nahin lautta; na hi us jagah par uska astitv rah jaata hai.
“Tab main apne chehra ko niyantrit na chhorunga; main apne dil ki vedna undel dunga, apni aatma ki karvaahat se bharke kurkuraata rahunga.
God, kya main saagar hun, ya saagar ka vikraal paani jantu, ki aapne mujh par pahra baitha rakha hai?
Yadi main yah soch karun ki bichhaune par to mujhe sukh santosh receive ho jaaega, mere aasan par mujhe in piraaon se mukti receive ho jaaegi,
Tab aap mujhe svapnon ke dvaara bhaybhit karne lagte hain aur darshan dikha-dikhaakar aatankit kar dete hain;
Ki meri aatma ko ghutan ho jaae, ki meri piraaein mere jaan le lein.
Main apne life se nafrat karta hun; main hamesha jivit rahna nahin chaahta hun. Chhor do mujhe akela; mera life bas ek shvaas tuly hai.
“Lord, insaan hai hi kya, jise aap aisa mahatv dete hain, jiska aap dhyaan rakhte hain,
Har subah aap uska parikshan karte, aur har pal use parakhte rahte hain?
Kya aap apni nazar mujh par se kabhi na hataaeinge? Kya aap mujhe itna bhi akela na chhoreinge, ki main apni laar ko gale se niche utaar sakun?

Lord, aap jo insaanon par apni nazar lagaae rakhte hain, kya kiya hai mainne aapke khilaaf? Kya mujhse koi galti ho gaya hai? Aapne kyon mujhe lakshy bana rakha hai? Kya, ab to main apne hi lie ek bojh ban chuka hun?
Tab aap meri galtiyon ko maafi kyon nahin kar rahe, kyon aap mere galti ko maaph nahin kar rahe? Kyonki ab to tujhe dhul mein mil jaana hai; aap mujhe khojeinge, lekin mujhe nahin paaeinge.”
Tab shuhi bildad ne kahna shuruaat kiya:
“Aur kitna dohraaoge is vishay ko? Ab to tumhaare word tej hava jaisi ho chuke hain.
Kya God dvaara anyaay sambhav hai? Kya sarvshaktimaan justice ko pathabhrasht karega?
Yadi tumhaare sons ne God ke khilaaf galti kiya hai, tab to God ne unhein unke apraadhon ke adhin kar diya hai.
Yadi tum God ko aagrahpurvak arthna karein, sarvshaktimaan se grace ki yaachna karein,
Yadi tum paaparhit aur imaandaar ho, yah nishchit hai ki God tumhaare paksh mein sakriy ho jaaeinge aur tumhaari yuktta ki situation ko punahsthaapit kar deinge.
Yadypi tumhaara shuruaat namr jaan parega, phir bhi tumhaara bhavishy bahut mahaan hoga.
“Grace karo aur purv pirhiyon se maalum karo, un vishyon par soch karo,
Kyonki ham to kal ki pirhi hain aur hamein iska koi knowledge nahin hai, kyonki prithvi par hamaara life chhaaya-jaisa hota hai.
Kya ve tumhein teaching dete hue reveal na kareinge, aur apne man ke soch vyakt na kareinge?
Kya daldal mein kabhi sarkanda ug sakta hai? Kya paani bin jhaariyaan jivit rah sakti hain?
Vah hara hi hota hai aur ise kaata nahin jaata, phir bhi yah dusre paudhon ki apeksha pahle hi sukh jaata hai.
Unki chaalachlan bhi aisi hoti hai, jo God ko bhul jaate hain; shraddhaahin insaanon ki ummid barbaad ho jaati hai.
Uska aatmvishvaas durbal hota hai aur uska faith makri ke jaal jaisa pal bhar ka hota hai.
Usne apne ghar ke aashray par bharosa kiya, lekin vah sthir na rah saka hai; usne har sambhav koshish to kie, lekin ismein tikne ki kshamta hi na thi.
Vah sury prakaash mein samriddh ho jaata hai, uski jarein udyaan mein phailti jaati hain.
Uski jarein patthron ko chaaron or se jakar leti hain, vah patthron se nirmit bhavan ko pakre rakhta hai.
Yadi use uske jagah se ukhaar diya jaae, tab usse yah kaha jaaega: ‘Tumhein mainne kabhi dekha nahin!’
Ayyob, dhyaan do! Yahi hai God ki nitiyon ka khushi; isi dhul se dusre upjeinge.
“Maalum hai ki God satynishth person ko upekshit nahin chhor dete, aur na vah dushkarmiyon ka samarthan karte hain.
Ab bhi vah tumhaare life ko haasy se purn kar deinge, tum uchch svar mein harshollaas karoge.
Jinhein tumse nafrat hai, lajja unka paridhaan hogi aur durvritton ka ghar astitv mein na rahega.”
Tab ayyob ne aur kaha:
“Vastuth mujhe yah maalum hai ki saty yahi hai. Lekin insaan bhala God ki aankhon mein nirdosh kaise ho sakta hai?
Yadi koi person God se vaad-vivaad karna chaahe, to vah God ko ek hajaar mein se ek savaal ka bhi uttar nahin de sakega.
Vah to man se wise aur bal ke shur hain. Kaun unki haani kie bina unki upeksha kar saka hai?
Sirf God hi hain, jo vichlit kar dete hain, kise yah maalum hai ki apne krodh mein vah kis riti se unhein palat dete hain.
Kaun hai jo prithvi ko iske jagah se hata deta hai, ki iske aadhaar-stambh tharathra jaate hain.
Uske order par sury nishprabh ho jaata hai, kaun taaron par apni mohar laga deta hai?
Kaun akele hi aakaashmandal ko phaila deta hai, kaun saagar ki lahron ko raundta chala jaata hai;
Kisne sapt rishi, mrigshirsh, kritika aur dakshin nakshatron ki sthaapna ki hai?
Kaun vilakshan kaary karta hai? Ve kaary, jo agamy, aashcharyajnak aur asankhy bhi hain.
Yadi ve mere nikat se hokar niklein, vah drishy na honge; yadi vah mere nikat se hokar niklein, mujhe unka bodh bhi na hoga.
Yadi vah kuchh chhinna chaahein, kaun unhein rok sakta hai? Kismein unse yah savaal karne ka saahas hai, ‘Yah kya kar rahe hain aap?’
God apne kop ko shaant nahin kareinge; unke niche raahaab ke sahaayak dubke baithe hain.
“Main unhein kis tarah uttar de sakta hun? Main kaise unke lie doshi va nirdosh ko pahchaanun?
Kyonki yadi mujhe righteous person pahchaana bhi jaae, to uttar dena mere lie asambhav hoga; mujhe apne justice ki grace ke lie yaachna karni hogi.
Yadi ve meri pukaar sun lete hain, mere lie yah faith karna kathin hoga, ki ve meri pukaar ko sun rahe the.
Kyonki ve to mujhe tuphaan dvaara ghaayal karte hain, aur akaaran hi mere ghaavon ki sankhya mein vriddhi karte hain.
Ve mujhe shvaas bhi na lene deinge, vah mujhe karvaahat se paripurn kar dete hain.
Yadi yah authority ka vishay hai, to God balshaali hain! Yadi yah justice ka vishay hai, to kaun unke saamne thahar sakta hai?
Yadypi main imaandaar hun, mere hi word mujhe doshaaropit kareinge; yadypi main doshhin hun, mera munh mujhe doshi ghoshit kareinge.
“Main doshhin hun, yah khud mujhe dikhaai nahin deta; mujhe to khud se nafrat ho rahi hai.
Sabhi jaisa hain; tab mera soch yah hai, ‘Ve to nirdosh aur durvritt donon hi ko barbaad kar dete hain.’
Yadi ekaaek aai vipatti mahaamaari le aati hai, to God nirdoshon ki niraasha ka uphaas karte hain.
Sab ko evil ke haathon mein saup diya gaya hai, ve apne nyaayaadhishon ke chehre ko aavritt kar dete hain. Agar ve nahin hain, to ve kaun hain?
“Mere in dinon ki gati to dhaavak se bhi tivr hai; ve ure chale ja rahe hain, inhonne bura samay hi dekha hai.
Ye aise nikle ja rahe hain, ki maano ye sarkandon ki naukaaein hon, maano garur apne shikaar par jhapatta hai.
Yadypi main kahun: main apni shikaayat prastut nahin karunga, ‘Main apne chehre ke vishaad ko hataakar ullaas karunga.’
Mere sab kashton ne mujhe bhaybhit kar rakha hai, mujhe yah maalum hai ki aap mujhe nirdosh ghoshit nahin kareinge.
Meri ganna durvritton mein ho chuki hai, to phir main ab vyarth parishram kyon karun?
Yadi main khud ko barph ke nirmal paani se saaph kar lun, apne haathon ko saabun se saaf kar lun,
Yah sab hone par bhi aap mujhe kabr mein daal deinge. Mere kapde mujhse nafrat karne lageinge.
“God koi mere jaisa insaan to nahin hain, ki main unhein vaad-vivaad mein sammilit kar lun, ki main unke saath nyaayaalay mein pravesh karun.
Ham donon ke beech koi bhi madhyasth nahin, ki vah ham donon ke sir par haath rakhe.
God hi mujh par se apna niyantran hata lein, unka aatank mujhe bhaybhit na karne paae.
Isi ke baad main unse bina dar ke vaartaalaap kar sakunga, lekin khud main apne antar mein vaisa nahin hun.
“Apne life se mujhe nafrat hai; main khulkar apni shikaayat prastut karunga. Mere words ka mul hai meri aatma ki karvaahat.
God se mera aagrah hai: mujh par doshaaropan na kijie, mujh par yah reveal kar dijie, ki mere saath amarta ka mul kya hai.
Kya aapke lie yah upyukt hai ki aap atyaachaar karein, ki aap apni hi kriti ko tyaag dein, aur durvritton ki yojna ko samarthan dein?
Kya aapke netr insaanon ke netr-jaisa hain? Kya aapka dekhna insaanon-jaisa hota hai?
Kya aapka jivankaal insaanon-jaisa hai, ya aapke life ke varsh insaanon-jaisa hain,
Ki aap mujhmein dosh khoj rahe hain, ki aap mere galti ki chhaanbin kar rahe hain?
Aapke knowledge ke hisaab se saty yahi hai main doshi nahin hun, phir bhi aapki or se mere lie koi bhi mukti nahin hai.
“Meri sampurn sanrachna aapki hi kriti hai, kya aap mujhe barbaad kar deinge?
Smaran kijie, meri rachna aapne mitti se ki hai. Kya aap phir mujhe mitti mein shaamil kar deinge?
Aapne kya mujhe dudh ke jaisa nahin undela aur dahi-jaisa nahin jama diya tha?
Kya aapne mujhe maans aur khaal ka aavran nahin pahnaaya aur mujhe haddiyon aur maanspeshiyon se buna tha?
Aapne mujhe life aur mercy-love ka anudaan diya aur aapki grace mein meri aatma surakshit rahi hai.
“Phir bhi ye saty aapne apne dil mein gopniy rakh lie, mujhe yah maalum hai ki yah aap mein surakshit hai:
Yadi main koi galti kar baithun to aapka dhyaan meri or jaaega. Tab aap mujhe nirdosh na chhoreinge.
Dhikkaar hai mujh par—yadi main doshi hun! Aur yadypi main beksur hun, mujhmein sir uncha karne ka saahas nahin hai. Main to lajja se bhara hua hun, kyonki mujhe meri dayniy durdsha ka bodh hai.
Yadi main apna sir uncha kar lun, to aap mera pichha aise kareinge, jaise sinh apne aahaar ka pichha karta hai; ek baar phir aap mujh par apni power ka pradarshan kareinge.
Aap mere khilaaf nae-nae saakshi lekar aate hain aur mere khilaaf apne kop ki vriddhi karte hain; mujh par to kashton par kasht chale a rahe hain.
“Tab aapne mujhe garbh se baahar kyon aane diya? Uttam to yahi hota ki vahin meri maut ho jaati ki mujh par kisi ki nazar na parti.
Mujhe to aisa ho jaana tha, maano main hua hi nahin; ya sidhe garbh se kabr mein!
Kya God mujhe mere in thore se dinon mein shaanti se rahne na deinge? Aap apna yah jagah chhor dijie, ki main kuchh der ke lie aanandit rah sakun.
Iske purv ki main vahaan ke lie ur jaaun, jahaan se koi lautkar nahin aata, us andhera aur maut ke jagah ko,
Us ghor andhera ke jagah ko, jahaan kuchh garabri nahin hai, us jagah mein andhera bhi prakaash jaisa hai.”
Iske baad naaamathvaasi zophar ne kahna shuruaat kiya:
