“Kya mere itne saare words ka uttar nahin milega? Kya koi vaachaal person dosh mukt maana jaaega?
Kya tumhaari ahankaar ki baatein logon ko chup kar paaegi? Kya tum uphaas karke bhi kasht se mukt rahoge?
Kyonki tumne to kaha hai, ‘Meri teaching nirmal hai aur aapke aanklan mein main nirdosh hun,’
Lekin yah sambhav hai ki God sanvaad karne lagein aur vah tumhaare khilaaf apna nirnay dein.
Vah tum par knowledge ka rahasy pragat kar dein, kyonki saty knowledge ke do paksh hain. Tab yah samajh lo, ki God tumhaare apraadh ke kuchh ansh ko bhul jaate hain.
“Kya, God ke rahasy ki gahraai ko naapna tumhaare lie sambhav hai? Kya tum sarvshaktimaan ki simaaon ki jaanch kar sakte ho?
Kya karoge tum? Ve to aakaash-jaisa unnat hain. Kya maalum kar sakoge tum? Ve to paataal se bhi adhik athaah hain.
Iska vistaar prithvi se bhi lamba hai aur mahaasaagar se bhi adhik vyaapak.
“Yadi vah aaein aur tumhein bandi bana dein, aur tumhaare lie adaalat aayojit kar dein, to kaun unhein rok sakta hai?
Vah to paakhandi ko pahchaan lete hain, unhein to yah bhi aavashyakta nahin; ki vah galti karnevaala ke lie soch karein.
Jaise jangli gadhe ka bachcha insaan nahin ban sakta, vaise hi kisi bewakoof ko wise nahin banaaya ja sakta.
“Yadi tum apne dil ko shuddh disha ki or barhaao, aur apna haath God ki or barhaao,
Yadi tumhaare haath jis galti mein phanse hai, tum iska parityaag kar do aur apne gharon mein buraai ka pravesh na hone do,
To tum nihsankoch apna sir uncha kar sakoge aur tum nirbhay ho sthir khare rah sakoge.
Kyonki tumhein apne kashton ka smaran rahega, jaise vah paani jo bah chuka hai vaisi hi hogi tumhaari smriti.
Tab tumhaara life dophar ke suraj se bhi adhik prakaashmaan ho jaaega, andhera bhi prabhaat-jaisa hoga.
Tab tum faith karoge, kyonki tab tumhaare saamne hogi ek ummid; tum aas-paas nirikshan karoge aur phir purn suraksha mein vishraam karoge.
Koi bhi tumhaari nidra mein baadha na daalega, kai tumhaare samarthan ki apeksha kareinge.
Lekin durvritton ki nazar shuny ho jaaegi, unke lie nikaas na ho sakega; unke lie ekmaatr ummid hai maut.”
Tab ayyob ne javaab diya:
“Nihsandeh tumhin ho ve log, tumhaare saath hi knowledge ka astitv mit jaaega!
Lekin tumhaare jaisa samajh mujhmein bhi hai; tumse kam nahin hai mera star. Kise bodh nahin hai is saty ka?
“Apne mitron ke lie to main hansi mazaak ka vishay hokar rah gaya hun, mainne God ko pukaara aur unhonne iska pratyuttar bhi diya; aur ab yahaan khara aur nirdosh person uphaas ka paatr ho gaya hai!
Sukhi dhanvaan person ko duhkhi person ghrinit lag raha hai. Jo pahle hi larakhra raha hai, usi par prahaar kiya ja raha hai.
Unhin ke gharon ko surakshit chhora ja raha hai, jo hinsak-vinaashak hain, ve hi suraksha mein nivaas kar rahe hain, jo God ko uksaate rahe hain, jo sochte hain ki ishvar apni mutthi mein hai!
“Lekin ab jaakar pashuon se paraamarsh lo, ab ve tumhein teaching dene lagein, aakaash mein urte pakshi tumhein suchna dene lagein;
Anytha prithvi se hi vaartaalaap karo, vahi tumhein teaching de, mahaasaagar ki machhliyaan tumhaare lie shikshak ho jaaein.
Kaun hai tumhaare beech jo is saty se anjaan hai, ki yah sab Yahweh ki kriti hai?
Kiska authority hai har ek jivdhaari life par aur sab maanav jaati ke shvaas par?
Kya kaan words ki parakh nahin karta, jis tarah jibh khaana ke svaad ko parakhti hai?
Kya, vriddhon mein samajh paayi nahin jaati hai? Kya lambi aayu samajh nahin le aati?
“Vivek aur bal God ke saath hain; nirnay aur samajh bhi unhin mein shaamil hain.
Jo kuchh unke dvaara gira diya jaata hai, use phir se banaaya nahin ja sakta; jab vah kisi ko bandi bana lete hain, asambhav hai uska chhutkaara.
Suno! Kya kahin sukha para hai? Yah isliye ki God ne hi paani rok kar rakha hai; jab vah ise preshit kar dete hain, prithvi jalmagn ho jaati hai.
Vahi hain bal aur knowledge ke srot; dhokha denevaala aur dhokha khaanevaala donon hi unke adhin hain.
Vah mantriyon ko vivastr kar chhorte hain aur nyaayaadhishon ko bewakoof bana dete hain.
Vah raajaaon dvaara daali gai beriyon ko tor pheinkte hain aur unki kamar ko bandhan se susajjit kar dete hain.
Vah priests ko nagn paanv chalne ke lie majbur kar dete hain aur unhein, jo sthir the, paraajit kar dete hain.
Vah faith salaahkaaron ko avaak bana dete hain aur baron ki samajhne ki power samaapt kar dete hain
Vah aadarniy person ko nafrat ke paatr bana chhorte hain. Aur shurviron ko nikamma kar dete hain.
Vah ghor andhera mein bare rahasy reveal kar dete hain, aur ghor andhera ko prakaash mein le aate hain.
Vahi raashtron ko unnat karte aur phir unhein barbaad bhi kar dete hain. Vah raashtron ko samriddh karte aur phir use nivaas rahit bhi kar dete hain.
Vah vishv ke shaaskon ki samajh shuny kar dete hain aur unhein registaan pradesh mein dishaahin bhatakne ke lie chhor dete hain.
Ve ghor andhera mein tatolte rah jaate hain aur vah unhein is situation mein daal dete hain, maano koi matvaala larakhra raha ho.
“Suno, mere netr yah sab dekh chuke hain, mere kaanon ne, yah sab sun liya hai aur mainne ise samajh liya hai.
Jo kuchh tumhein maalum hai, vah sab mujhe maalum hai; main tumse kisi bhi riti se kam nahin hun,
Haan, main iska ullekh sarvshaktimaan se zarur karunga, meri abhilaasha hai ki is baare mein God se vaad-vivaad karun.
Tum to jhuthi baat ka chitran kar rahe ho; tum sabhi ayogy vaidy ho!
Uttam to yah hota ki tum chup rahte! Isi mein siddh ho jaati tumhaari buddhimaani.
Grace kar mere vivaad par dhyaan do; aur mere honthon ki bahas ki baaton par dhyaan karo.
Kya tum vah baat karoge, jo God ki nazar mein anyaaypurn hai? Ya vah kahoge, jo unki nazar mein chhalpurn hai?
Kya tum God ke lie pakshpaat karoge? Kya tum God se vaad-vivaad karoge?
Kya jab tumhaari parakh ki jaaegi, to yah tumhaare hit mein hoga? Ya tum insaanon ke jaisa God se chhal karne ka yatn karne lagoge?
Yadi tum gupt mein pakshpaat karoge, tumhein unki or se phatkaar hi receive hogi.
Kya God ka maahaatmy tumhein bhaybhit na kar dega? Kya unka aatank tumhein bhaybhit na kar dega?
Tumhaari uktiyaan raakh ke nitivchan ke jaisa hain; tumhaari pratiraksha mitti jaisa rah gai hai.
“Mere saamne chup raho, ki main apne soch prastut kar sakun; tab chaahe kaisi bhi samasya a pare.
Bhala main khud ko jokhim mein kyon daalun aur apne jaan hatheli par lekar ghumun?
Chaahe God mera ghaat bhi karein, phir bhi unmein meri ummid bani rahegi; God ke saamne main apna paksh prastut karunga.
Yahi meri chhutkaare ka kaaran hoga, kyonki koi bura person unki upasthiti mein pravesh karna na chaahega!
Bari saavdhaanipurvak mera vaktavy sun lo; aur meri ghoshna ko man mein basa lo.
Ab sun lo, prastuti ke lie mera paksh taiyaar hai, mujhe nishchay hai mujhe justice receive hokar rahega.
Kaun karega mujhse vaad-vivaad? Yadi koi mujhe doshi pramaanit kar de, main chup hokar jaan tyaag dunga.
“God, meri do yaachnaaein purn kar dijie, tab main aapse chhipne ka koshish nahin karunga.
Mujh par se apna kathor haath dur kar lijie, aur apne aatank mujhse dur kar lijie.
Tab mujhe bula lijie ki main prashnon ke uttar de sakun, ya mujhe bolne dijie, aur in par apni pratikriya vyakt kijie.
Kitne hain mere galti aur apraadh? Reveal kar dijie, mera apraadh aur mera galti.
Aap mujhse apna chehra kyon chhipa rahe hain? Aapne mujhe apna dushman kyon maan liya hai?
Kya aap ek vaayu pravaah mein urti hui patti ko yaatna deinge? Kya aap sukhi bhusi ka pichha kareinge?
Aapne mere khilaaf karve aaropon ki suchi banaai hai aur aapne meri yuvaavastha ke galtiyon ko mujh par laad diya hai.
Aapne mere paanvon mein beriyaan daal di hai; aap mere raaston par nazar rakhte hain. Iske lie aapne mere paanvon ke talvon ko chinhit kar diya hai.
“Tab insaan kisi sari-gali vastu ke jaisa barbaad hota jaata hai, us kapde ke jaisa, jise kire kha chuke hon.
“Aurat se janme insaan ka life, alpkaalik aur duhkh bhara hota hai.
Us pushp jaisa, jo khilta hai aur murjha jaata hai; vah to chhaaya-jaisa drut gati se vilin ho jaata aur astitvhin rah jaata hai.
Kya is tarah ka praani is yogy hai ki aap us par nazar banaae rakhein aur uska justice karne ke lie use apni upasthiti mein aane dein?
Ashuddh mein se kisi shuddh vastu ki srishti kaun kar sakta hai? Koi bhi is yogy nahin hai!
Isliye ki insaan ka life simit hai; uske life ke maah aapne niyat kar rakhe hain. Saath aapne uski simaaein nirdhaarit kar di hain, ki vah inke paar na ja sake.
Jab tak vah vaitnik mazdur jaisa apna samay purn karta hai us par se apni nazar hata lijie, ki use vishraam receive ho sake.
“Vriksh ke lie to sadaiv ummid bani rahti hai: jab use kaata jaata hai, uske tane se ankur nikal aate hain. Uski daaliyaan viksit ho jaati hain.
Yadypi zameen ke bhitar iski mul jirn hoti jaati hai aur zameen mein iska thunth barbaad ho jaata hai,
Paani ki gandh receive hote hi yah khilne lagta hai aur paudhe ke jaisa yah apni shaakhaaein phailaane lagta hai.
Lekin insaan hai ki, maut hone par vah para rah jaata hai; uska shvaas samaapt hua, ki vah astitvhin rah jaata hai.
Jaise saagar ka paani sukhte rahta hai aur nadi dhup se sukh jaati hai,
Usi tarah insaan, maut mein para hua leta rah jaata hai; aakaash ke astitvhin hone tak uski situation yahi rahegi, use is gahri nind se jagaaya jaana asambhav hai.
“Uttam to yahi hota ki aap mujhe adholok mein chhipa dete, aap mujhe apne kop ke thanda hone tak chhipaae rahte! Aap ek avdhi nishchit karke iske purn ho jaane par mera smaran karte!
Kya insaan ke lie yah sambhav hai ki uski maut ke baad vah jivit ho jaae? Apne life ke sab shrampurn varshon mein main yahi pratiksha karta rah jaaunga. Kab hoga vah navoday?
Aap aahvaan karo, to main uttar dunga; aap apne us banaae gaye praani ki laalsa kareinge.
Tab aap mere pairon ka lekh rakheinge lekin mere galtiyon ka nahin.
Mere apraadh ko ek thaili mein moharband kar diya jaaega; aap mere galtiyon ko dhaamp deinge.
“Jaise parvat barbaad hote-hote vah chur-chur ho jaata hai, chattaan apne jagah se hat jaati hai.
Paani mein bhi patthron ko kaatne ki kshamta hoti hai, tivr paani pravaah prithvi ki dhul saath le jaate hain, aap bhi insaan ki ummid ke saath yahi karte hain.
Ek hi baar aap use aisa haraate hain, ki vah mit jaata hai; aap uska svarup parivartit kar dete hain aur use nikaal dete hain.
Yadi uski children sammaanit hoti hai, use to iska knowledge nahin hota; ya jab ve apmaanit kie jaate hain, ve isse anjaan hi rahte hain.
Jab tak vah deh mein hota hai, dard ka anubhav karta hai, isi situation mein use vedna ka anubhav hota hai.”
Iske baad temaani eliphaaz ke udgaar ye the:
“Kya kisi wise ke udgaar khokhle soch ho sakte hain aur kya vah purvi pavan se apna pet bhar sakta hai?
Kya vah nirarthak satyon ke aadhaar par soch kar sakta hai? Vah un words ka prayog kar sakta hai? Jinka koi laabh nahin banta?
Tumne to God ke sammaan ko hi tyaag diya hai, aur tumne God ki shraddha mein vighn daale.
Tumhaara galti hi tumhaare words ki prerna hai, aur tumne dhurton ke words ka prayog kiye hain.
Ye to tumhaara munh hi hai, jo tujhe doshi thahra raha hai, main nahin; tumhaare hi word tum par aarop laga rahe hain.
“Kya sab maanav jaati mein tum sarvaprtham janme ho? Ya kya parvton ke astitv mein aane ke purv tumhaara follow poshan hua tha?
Kya tumhein God ki gupt abhilaasha sunaai de rahi hai? Kya tum knowledge ko khud tak simit rakhe hue ho?
Tumhein aisa kya maalum hai, jo hamein maalum nahin hai? Tumne vah kya samajh liya hai, jo ham samajh na paae hain?
Hamaare beech saphed baal ke vriddh vidymaan hain, ye tumhaare pita se adhik aayu ke bhi hain.
Kya God se mili saantvna tumhaari nazar mein paryaapt hai, ve word bhi jo tumse saumytaapurvak se kahe gae hain?
Kyon tumhaara dil udaasin ho gaya hai? Kyon tumhaare netr krodh mein chamak rahe hain?
Ki tumhaara dil God ke khilaaf ho gaya hai, aur tum ab aise word vyarth rup se uchchaar rahe ho?
“Insaan hai hi kya, jo use shuddh rakha jaae ya vah, jo aurat se paida hua, nirdosh ho?
Dhyaan do, yadi God apne holy logon par bhi faith nahin karte, aur heaven unki nazar mein shuddh nahin hai.
Tab insaan kitna nikrisht hoga, jo ghrinit aur bhrasht hai, jo galti ko paani jaisa piya karta hai!
“Yah main tumhein samjhaaunga meri suno jo kuchh mainne dekha hai; main usi ki ghoshna karunga,
Jo kuchh buddhimaanon ne bataaya hai, jise unhonne apne purvjon se bhi gupt nahin rakha hai.
(jinhein sirf yah desh provide kiya gaya tha aur unke beech koi bhi videshi na tha):
Durvritt apne sab jivankaal mein dard se tarapta rahta hai. Aur balaatkaari ke lie sab varsh simit rakh die gae hain.
Uske kaanon mein aatank sambandhi dhvaniyaan gunjti rahti hain; jabki shaantikaal mein vinaash us par tut parta hai.
Use yah faith nahin hai ki uska andhera se nikaas sambhav hai; ki uski niyti talvaar sanhaar hai.
Vah khaana ki khoj mein idhar-udhar bhatakta rahta hai, yah maalum karte hue, ‘Kahin kuchh khaane yogy vastu hai?’ Use yah maalum hai ki andhera ka divas paas hai.
Vedna aur chinta ne use bhaybhit kar rakha hai; ek aakraamak raaja jaisa unhonne use vash mein kar rakha hai,
Kyonki usne God ki or haath barhaane ka dhaadhas kiya hai aur vah sarvshaktimaan ke saamne ahankaar ka koshish karta hai.
Vah God ki or sidhe daur para hai, usne majbut dhaal le rakhi hai.
“Kyonki usne apna chehra apni vasa mein chhipa liya hai aur apni jaangh charbi se bharpur kar li hai.
Vah to ujaar shehron mein nivaas karta raha hai, aise gharon mein jahaan koi bhi rahna nahin chaahta tha, jinki niyti hi hai khandhar ho jaane ke lie.
Na to vah dhani ho jaaega, na hi uski property dirgh kaal tak uske authority mein rahegi, uski upaj barhegi nahin.
Use andhera se mukti receive na hogi; jvaala uske ankuron ko jhulsa degi, aur God ke shvaas se vah dur ur jaaega.
Uttam ho ki vah vyarth baaton par aashrit na rahe, vah khud ko chhal mein na rakhe, kyonki uska pratiphal dhokha hi hoga.
Samay ke purv hi use iska pratiphal receive ho jaaega, uski shaakhaaein hari nahin rah jaaeingi.
Uska vinaash vaisa hi hoga, jaisa kachche draakshon ki lata kuchal di jaati hai, jaise jaitun vriksh se pushpon ka jharna hota hai.
Kyonki durvritton ki sabha khaali hoti hai, bhrasht logon ke tambu ko agni chat kar jaati hai.
Unke vichaaron mein vipatti garbhdhaaran karti hai aur ve galti ko janm dete hain; unka antahkran chhal ki yojna garhta rahta hai.”
Ayyob ne javaab diya:
“Main aise kai soch sun chuka hun; tum tinon hi nikamme dilaasa denevaale ho!
Kya in khokhle udgaaron ka koi ant nahin hai? Ya kis dard ne tumse ye uttar dilvaae hain?
Tumhaari shaili mein main bhi vaartaalaap kar sakta hun, yadi main aaj tumhaari situation mein hota; main to tumhaare sammaan mein kaavy rachna kar deta aur apna sir bhi hilaata rahta.
Main apne words ke dvaara tummein saahas barha sakta hun; aur mere vichaaron ki saantvna tumhaari vedna kam karti hai.
“Yadi main kuchh kah bhi dun, tab bhi meri vedna kam na hogi; yadi main chup rahun, isse bhi mujhe koi laabh na hoga.
Lekin God ne mujhe thaka diya hai; aapne mere mitr-mandal ko hi ujaar diya hai.
Aapne mujhe sankuchit kar diya hai, yah mera saakshi ho gaya hai; mera dublaapan mere khilaaf pramaanit ho raha hai, mera chehra mera virodh kar raha hai.
God ke kop ne mujhe phaar rakha hai jaise kisi pashu ko phaara jaata hai, vah mujh par daant piste rahe; mere dushman mujh par kop karte rahte hain.
Majaak karte hue ve mere saamne apna chehra kholte hain; nafrat ke aaveg mein unhonne mere kapolon par prahaar bhi kiya hai. Ve sab mere virodh mein ekjut ho gae hain.
God ne mujhe adharmiyon ke vash mein kar diya hai aur vah mujhe ek se dusre ke haath mein saumpte hain.

Main to nishchint ho chuka tha, lekin God ne mujhe chur-chur kar diya; unhonne mujhe gardan se pakarkar is riti se jhanjhora, ki main chur-chur ho bikhar gaya; unhonne to mujhe nishaana bhi bana diya hai.
Unke baanon se main chaaron or se ghir chuka hun. Buri tarah se unhonne mere gurde kaatkar ghaayal kar die hain. Unhonne mera pitt zameen par bikhra diya.
Vah baar-baar mujh par aakrman karte rahte hain; vah ek yoddha jaisa mujh par jhapatte hain.
“Mainne to apni deh par taat rakhi hai aur apna sir dhul mein thuns diya hai.
Rote-rote mera chehra laal ho chuka hai, meri palkon par vishaad chha gai hai.
Jabki na to mere haathon ne koi hinsa ki hai aur na meri prayer mein koi svaarth shaamil tha.
“Prithvi, mere rakt par aavran na daalna; aur meri dohaai ko vishraanti na lene dena.
Dhyaan do, ab bhi mera saakshi heaven mein hai; mera gavaah sarvochch hai.
Mere mitr hi mere virodhi ho gae hain. Mera aansu bahaana to God ke saamne hai.
Upyukt hota ki insaan God se usi star par aagrah kar sakta, jis tarah koi person apne parosi se.
“Kyonki jab kuchh varsh bit jaayeinge, tab main vahaan pahunch jaaunga, jahaan se koi lautkar nahin aata.
Mera manobal tut chuka hai, mere life ki roshni ka ant a chuka hai, kabr ko meri pratiksha hai.
Ismein koi sandeh nahin, thattha karnevaale mere saath ho chuke hain; meri nazar unke bharkaane vaale kaaryon par tiki hui hai.
“God, mujhe vah zamaanat de dijie, jo aapki maang hai. Kaun hai vah, jo mera jaamin ho sakega?
Aapne to unki samajh ko baadhit kar rakha hai; islie aap to unhein jayvant hone nahin deinge.
Jo lut mein apne ansh ke lie apne mitron ki chugli karta hai, uski children ki nazar jaati rahegi.
“God ne to mujhe ek nindniy bana diya hai, main to ab vah ho chuka hun, jis par log thukte hain.
Shok se meri nazar kshin ho chuki hai; mere sab ang ab chhaaya-jaisa ho chuke hain.
Yah sab dekh sajjan chup rah jaaeinge; aur nirdosh milkar durvritton ke khilaaf ho jaaeinge.
Phir bhi khara apni nitiyon par atal bana rahega, aur ve, jo satynishth hain, balvant hote chale jaaeinge.
“Lekin aao, tum sabhi aao, ek baar phir cheshta kar lo! Tumhaare beech mujhe wise receive nahin hoga.
Mere dinon ka to ant ho chuka hai, meri yojnaaein chur-chur ho chuki hain. Yahi situation hai mere dil ki abhilaashaaon ki.
Ve to raatri ko bhi din mein badal dete hain, ve kahte hain, ‘Prakaash nikat hai,’ Jabki ve andhera mein hote hain.
Yadi main ghar ke lie adholok ki khoj karun, main andhera mein apna bichhauna laga lun.
Yadi main us kabr ko pukaarkar kahun, ‘Mere janak to tum ho aur kiron se ki tum meri maata ya meri bahin ho,’
To meri ummid kahaan hai? Kise meri ummid ka dhyaan hai?
Kya yah bhi mere saath adholok mein sama jaaegi? Kya ham sabhi saath saath dhul mein mil jaaeinge?”
Iske baad shuhi bildad ne apni pratikriya vyakt ki:
“Kab tak tum isi tarah words mein uljhe rahoge? Kuchh saarthak vishay prastut karo, ki kuchh parinaam reveal ho sake.
Hamein pashu kyon samjha ja raha hai? Kya ham tumhaari nazar mein bewakoof hain?
Tum, jo krodh mein khud ko phaare ja rahe ho, kya, tumhaare hit mein to prithvi ab ujar ho jaani chaahie? Ya, kya chattaan ko apni jagah se alag kiya jaaye?
“Saty to yah hai ki durvritt ka dip vastuth bujh chuka hai; uske dvaara prajvlit agnishikha mein to prakaash hi nahin hai.
Uska tambu andhera mein hai; uske upar ka dipak bujh gaya hai.
Uski drut chaal ko rok diya gaya hai; aur uski apni yukti use le dubi,
Kyonki vah to apne jaal mein ja phansa hai; usne apne hi phande mein pair daal diya hai.
Uski eri par vah phanda ja para aur sampurn upakran usi par a gira hai,
Zameen ke niche uske lie vah gaanth chhipaai gai thi; uske raaste mein ek phanda rakha gaya tha.
Ab to aatank ne use chaaron or se gher rakha hai aur uske pichhe parkar use sata rahe hain.
Uske bal ka thattha hua ja raha hai; vipatti uske nikat thahri hui hai.
Uski khaal par ghor vyaadhi lagi hui hai; uske angon ko maut ke pahlauthe ne khaana bana liya hai.
Uske hi tambu ki suraksha mein se use jhapat liya gaya hai ab ve use aatank ke raaja ke saamne pradarshit ho rahe hain.
Ab uske tambu mein videshi ja base hain; uske ghar par gandhak chhirak diya gaya hai.
Zameen ke bhitar uski jarein ab shushk ho chuki hain aur upar unki shaakhaaein kaati ja chuki hain.
Dharti ke log usko yaad nahin kareinge; bas ab koi bhi usko yaad nahin karega.
Use to prakaash mein se andhera mein dhakel diya gaya hai aur insaanon ke samaaj se use khader diya gaya hai.
Insaanon ke beech uska koi vanshaj nahin rah gaya hai, jahaan-jahaan vah pravaas karta hai, vahaan uska koi uttarjivi nahin.
Pashchimi kshetron mein uski situation par log chakit honge aur purvi kshetron mein dar ne logon ko jakar liya hai.
Nishchyath durvritton ka nivaas aisa hi hota hai; unka nivaas, jinhein God ka koi knowledge nahin hai.”
Tab ayyob ne javaab diya:
“Tum kab tak mujhe yaatna dete rahoge aur apne in words se kuchalte rahoge?
In dason avasron par tum mera apmaan karte rahe ho; mere saath anyaay karte hue tumhein lajja tak na aai.
Haan, yadi vaastav mein mujhse koi truti hui hai, to yah truti mere lie chinta ka vishay hai.
Yadi tum vaastav mein khud ko mujhse uchchtar pradarshit karoge aur mujh par meri situation ko nindniy pramaanit kar doge,
Tab main yah samajh lunga, ki meri yah situation God ki or se hai aur unhin ne mujhe is jaal mein daala hai.
“Main to chilla raha hun, ‘Anyaay!’ Lekin mujhe koi uttar nahin mil raha; main madad ke lie pukaar raha hun, lekin justice kahin se mil nahin raha hai.
God ne hi jab mere raasta rok diya hai, main aage kaise barhun? Unhonne to mere raasta andhera kar die hain.
Mera sammaan mujhse chhin liya gaya hai, aur jo mukut mere sir par tha, vah bhi utaar liya gaya hai.
Vah mujhe chaaron or se torne mein shaamil hain, ki main barbaad ho jaaun; unhonne meri ummid ko ukhaar diya hai, jaise kisi vriksh se kiya jaata hai.
Apna kop bhi unhonne mujh par undel diya hai; kyonki unhonne to mujhe apna dushman maan liya hai.
Unki sena ekatr ho rahi hai; unhonne mere khilaaf dhalaan taiyaar ki hai aur mere tambu ke aas-paas gheraabandi kar li hai.
“Unhonne to mere bhaaiyon ko mujhse dur kar diya hai; mere parichit mujhse purnath anjaan ho gae hain.
Mere sambandhiyon ne to mera tyaag kar diya hai; mere param mitron ne mujhe yaad karna chhor diya hai.
Ve, jo meri grihasthi ke ang hain aur jo meri parichaarikaaein hain; ve sab mujhe pardeshi samajhne lagi hain.
Main apne servant ko apne nikat bulaata hun, lekin vah uttar nahin deta.
Meri patni ke lie ab mera shvaas ghrinaaspad ho gaya hai; apne bhaaiyon ke lie main ghinauna ho gaya hun.
Yahaan tak ki chhote-chhote baalak mujhe tuchchh samajhne lage hain; jaise hi main uthta hun, ve meri ninda karte hain.
Mere sabhi sahyogi mere vidveshi ho gae hain; mujhe jin-jin se love tha, ve ab mere khilaaf ho chuke hain.
Ab to main sirf chamri aur haddiyon ka rah gaya hun; main jo hun, maut se baal-baal bach nikla hun.
“Mere mitron, mujh par grace karo, kyonki mujh par to God ka prahaar hua hai.
Lekin God ke jaisa tum mujhe kyon sata rahe ho? Kya meri deh ko yaatna dekar tumhein santosh nahin hua hai?
“Kaisa hota yadi mere in vichaaron ko likha jaata, inhein pustak ka rup diya ja sakta,
Sise ke patal par lauh lekhni se unhein chattaan par sthaayi rup se khod diya jaata!
Lekin mujhe yah maalum hai ki mera chhuraane vaala jivit hain, aur antath vah prithvi par khara raheinge.
Meri deh ke barbaad ho jaane ke baad bhi, main apni deh mein hi God ka darshan karunga;
Jinhein main apni hi aankhon se dekhunga, unhein dusre kisi ke nahin, balki mere hi netr dekheinge. Mera man andar hi andar utaavla hua ja raha hai!
“Ab yadi tum yah soch karne lago, ‘Ham use kaise sata sakeinge?’ Ya, ‘Us par ham kaun sa aarop laga sakeinge?’
Tab upyukt yah hoga ki tum apne upar talvaar ke prahaar ka dhyaan rakho; kyonki krodh ka dand talvaar se hota hai, tab tumhein yah bodh hona anivaary hai, ki ek justice ka samay hai.”
Tab naaamathvaasi zophar ne kahna shuruaat kiya:
“Mere vichaaron ne mujhe pratyuttar ke lie apostle kiya kyonki mera antarman uttejit ho gaya tha.
Mainne us jhirki ki or dhyaan diya, jo mera apmaan kar rahi thi iska bhaav samajhkar hi mainne pratyuttar ka nishchay kiya hai.
“Kya shuru se tumhein iski vaastvikta maalum thi, us avsar se jab prithvi par insaan ki srishti hui thi,
Alpkaalik hi hota hai, durvritt ka ullaas aur kshanik hota hai galti karnevaala ka khushi.
Bhale hi uska naam aakaash tuly uncha ho aur uska sir meghon tak ja pahuncha ho,
Vah kure jaisa purnath mit jaata hai; jinhonne use dekha tha, ve puchhte rah jaaeinge, ‘Kahaan hai vah?’
Vah to svapn jaisa tut jaata hai, tab use khojne par bhi paaya nahin ja sakta, raatri ke darshan jaisa uski smriti mit jaati hai.
Jin netron ne use dekha tha, unke lie ab vah adrishy hai; na hi vah jagah, jiske saamne vah bana rahta tha.
Uske sons ki grace dinon par bani rahti hai aur vah apne haathon se apni property lautaata hai.
Uski haddiyaan uske yauvan se bhari hain lekin yah shaury usi ke saath dhul mein ja milta hai.
“Yadypi uske chehra ko anisht ka svaad lag chuka hai aur vah ise apni jibh ke niche chhipaae rakhta hai,
Yadypi vah iski aakaanksha karta rahta hai, vah apne chehra mein ise chhipaae rakhta hai,
Phir bhi uska khaana uske pet mein uthal-puthal karta hai; vah vahaan naag ke vish mein parinat ho jaata hai.
Usne to wealth-property nigal rakhi hai, lekin use ugalna hi hoga; God hi unhein uske pet se baahar nikaal deinge.
Vah to naagon ke vish ko chus leta hai; sarp ki jibh uska sanhaar kar deti hai.
Vah nadiyon ki or nazar nahin kar paaega, un nadiyon ki or, jinmein dudh aur dahi bah rahe hain.
Vah apni uplabdhiyon ko lautaane laga hai, iska upbhog karna uske lie sambhav nahin hai; vyaapaar mein mile laabh ka vah khushi na le sakega.
Kyonki usne kangaalon par atyaachaar kie hain aur unka tyaag kar diya hai; usne vah ghar harap liya hai, jiska nirmaan usne nahin kiya hai.
“Isliye ki uska man vichlit tha; vah apni abhilaashit vastuon ko apne authority mein na rakh saka.
Khaane ke liye kuchh bhi shesh na rah gaya; tab ab uski samriddhi alpkaalin hi rah gai hai.
Jab vah paripurnta ki situation mein hoga tab bhi vah santusht na rah sakega; har ek person, jo is samay yaatna ki situation mein hoga, uske khilaaf uth khara hoga.
Jab vah pet bharke kha chuka hoga, God apne prachand kop ko us par undel deinge, tabhi yah kop ki vrishti us par baras paregi.
Sambhav hai ki vah lauh shastr ke prahaar se bach nikle lekin kaansybaan to use bedh hi dega.
Yah baan uski deh mein se khincha jaaega, aur yah uski pith ki or se baahar aaega, uski chamakdaar nok uske pitt se sani hui hai. Vah aatank se bhaybhit hai.
Ghor andhera uski property ki pratiksha mein hai. Agni hi use chat kar jaaegi. Yah agni uske tambu ke bache huon ko bhasm kar jaaegi.
Heaven hi uske galti ko ujaagar karega; prithvi bhi uske khilaaf khari hogi.
Uske vansh ka vistaar samaapt ho jaaega, God ke kop-divas par uski property barbaadi ho jaaegi.
Yahi hoga God dvaara niyat durvritt ka bhaag, haan, vah uttraadhikaar, jo use Yahweh dvaara diya gaya hai.”
Tab ayyob ne javaab diya:
“Ab dhyaan se meri baat sun lo aur isse tumhein saantvna receive ho.
Mere udgaar purn hone tak sabr rakhna, baad mein tum mera uphaas kar sakte ho.
“Meri situation yah hai ki meri shikaayat kisi insaan se nahin hai, tab kya meri adhirta asangat hai?
Meri situation par dhyaan do aur is par chakit bhi ho jaao; aashcharyachkit hokar apne chehra par haath rakh lo.
Uski smriti mujhe dara deti hai; aur meri deh aatank mein sama jaati hai.
Kyon durvritt dirghaayu receive karte jaate hain? Ve unnti karte jaate aur sashakt ho jaate hain.
Itna hi nahin unke to vansh bhi, unke jivankaal mein samriddh hote jaate hain.
Unke gharon par aatank nahin hota; un par God ka dand bhi nahin hota.
Uska saanr bina kisi baadha ke gaabhin karta hai; uski gaay bachche ko janm deti hai, aur kabhi uska garbhpaat nahin hota.
Unke baalak sankhya mein jhund jaisa hote hain; aur khelte rahte hain.
Ve khanjri aur kinnor ki sangat par gaayan karte hain; baansuri ka svar unhein aanandit kar deta hai.
Unke life ke din to samriddhi mein hi purn hote hain, tab ve ekaaek adholok mein pravesh kar jaate hain.
Ve to God ko order de baithte hain, ‘Dur ho jaaie mujhse!’ Koi ruchi nahin hai hamein aapki nitiyon mein.
Kaun hai yah sarvshaktimaan, ki ham unki service karein? Kya milega, hamein yadi ham unse aagrah kareinge?
Tumhin dekh lo, unki samriddhi unke haath mein nahin hai, durvritton ki paraamarsh mujhe svikaary nahin hai.
“Kya kabhi aisa hua hai ki evil logon ka dipak bujha ho? Ya un par vipatti ka parvat tut para ho, kya kabhi God ne apne kop mein un par barbaadi prabhaavi kiya hai?
Kya durvritt vaayu pravaah mein bhusi-jaisa hain, us bhusi-jaisa jo tuphaan mein vilin ho jaata hai?
Tum daava karte ho, ‘God kisi bhi person ke galti ko uski children ke lie jama kar rakhte hain.’ To upyukt hain ki vah iska dand prabhaavi kar dein, ki use situation bodh ho jaae.
Uttam hoga ki vah khud apne barbaadi ko dekh le; vah khud sarvshaktimaan ke kop ka paan kar le.
Kyonki jab uski aayu ke varsh samaapt kar die gae hain to vah apni grihasthi ki chinta kaise kar sakta hai?
“Kya yah sambhav hai ki koi God ko knowledge de, vah, jo parlok ke praaniyon ka justice karte hain?
Purnath sashakt person ka bhi dehaavsaan ho jaata hai, uska, jo nishchint aur santusht tha.
Jiski deh par charbi thi aur haddiyon mein majja bhi tha.
Jabki dusre person ki maut karvaahat mein hoti hai, jisne life mein kuchh bhi sukh receive nahin kiya.
Donon dhul mein ja milte hain, aur kire unhein dhaank lete hain.
“Yah samajh lo, main tumhaare vichaaron se avgat hun, un yojnaaon se bhi, jinke dvaara tum mujhe chhalte rahte ho.
Tumhaare man mein savaal uth raha hai, ‘Kahaan hai us kulin person ka ghar, kahaan hai vah tambu, jahaan durvritt nivaas karte hain?’
Kya tumne kabhi anubhvi yaatriyon se savaal kiya hai? Kya unke saakshy se tum parichit ho?
Kyonki durvritt to pralay ke lie hain, ve kop-divas par bandi bana lie jaaeinge.
Kaun use uske krityon ka smaran dilaaega? Kaun use uske krityon ka pratiphal dega?
Jab uski maut par use daphan kiya jaaega, log uski kabr par pahredaar rakheinge.
Ghaati ki mitti use mithi lagti hai; sabhi uska anugman kareinge, jabki asankhy to ve hain, jo uski yaatra mein honge.
“Tumhaare nirarthak vachan mujhe saantvna kaise deinge? Kyonki tumhaare pratyuttar jhuthi baaton se bhare hain!”
Tab temaanvaasi eliphaaz ne pratyuttar mein kaha:
“Kya koi balvaan aadmi God ke lie upyogi ho sakta hai? Ya kya koi wise khud ka kalyaan kar sakta hai?
Kya tumhaari kharaai sarvshaktimaan ke lie khushi hai? Ya kya tumhaara trutihin chaalachlan laabhkaari hota hai?
“Kya tumhaare dvaara diya gaya sammaan tumhein unke saamne svikaary bana deta hai, ki vah tumhaare khilaaf justice karne lagte hain?
Kya tumhaari buraai bahut nahin kahi ja sakti? Kya tumhaare galti ka ant nahin?
Kyon tumne akaaran apne bhaaiyon ka bandhak rakh liya hai, aur insaanon ko vivastr kar chhora hai?
Thake maande se tumne pey paani ke lie tak na puchha, bhukhe se tumne khaana chhipa rakha hai.
Lekin prithvi par balvaanon ka authority hai, iske nivaasi sammaany person hain.
Tumne vidhvaaon ko niraash lauta diya hai pitrihinon ka bal kuchal diya gaya hai.
Yahi kaaran hai ki tumhaare chaaron or phande phaile hain, aatank ne tumhein bhaybhit kar rakha hai,
Sambhvath yah andhera hai ki tum drishtihin ho jaao, ek bari paani raashi mein tum jalmagn ho chuke ho.
“Kya God heaven mein viraajmaan nahin hain? Dur ke taaron par nazar daalo. Kitni unchaai par hain ve!
Tum puchh rahe ho, ‘Kya-kya maalum hai God ko?’ Kya ghor andhera mein bhi unhein situation bodh ho sakta hai?
Megh unke lie chhipne ka saadhan ho jaate hain, tab vah dekh sakte hain; vah to nabhomandal mein chalte phirte hain.
Kya tum us praachin raasta par chalte rahoge, jo durvritton ka raasta hua karta tha?
Jinhein samay se purv hi utha liya gaya, jinki to ninv hi nadi apne pravaah mein baha le gai?
Ve God se aagrah karte, ‘Hamse dur chale jaaie!’ Aur yah bhi ‘Sarvshaktimaan unka kya bigaar lega?’
Phir bhi God ne unke gharon ko uttam vastuon se bhar rakha hai, lekin un durvritton ki yukti meri samajh se pare hai.
Yah dekh dhaarmik ullsit ho rahe hain aur ve; jo nirdosh hain, unka uphaas kar rahe hain.
Unka naara hai, ‘Yah saty hai ki hamaare dushman mita die gae hain, unki samriddhi ko agni bhasm kar chuki hai.’
“Ab bhi samarpan karke God se mel kar lo; tab to tumhaare kalyaan ki sambhaavna hai.
Kripya unse teaching grahan kar lo. Unke words ko man mein rakh lo.
Yadi tum sarvshaktimaan ki or murkar paas ho jaao, tum pahle ki tarah ho jaaoge: yadi tum apne ghar mein se buraai ko dur kar doge,
Yadi tum apne svarn ko zameen mein daba doge, us svarn ko, jo ophir se laaya gaya hai, use nadiyon ke patthron ke beech chhipa doge,
Tab sarvshaktimaan khud tumhaare lie svarn ho jaaeinge haan, utkrisht chaandi.
Tum God ki or nazar karoge, tab sarvshaktimaan tumhaare parmaanand ho jaaeinge.
Jab tum unse prayer karoge, vah tumhaari sun leinge, iske atirikt tum apni manntein bhi purn karoge.
Tum kisi vishay ki kaamna karoge aur vah tumhaare lie saphal ho jaaega, iske atirikt tumhaara raasta bhi prakaashit ho jaaega.
Us situation mein jab tum purnath hataash ho jaaoge, tumhaari baatein tumhaara ‘Aatmvishvaas reveal kareingi!’ God vinit person ko raksha provide karte hain.
Nirdosh ko God suraksha provide karte hain, vah nirdosh tumhaare hi shuddh kaamon ke kaaran chhuraaya jaaega.”
Tab ayyob ne kaha:
“Aaj bhi apraadh ke bhaav mein main shikaayat kar raha hun; main karaah raha hun, phir bhi God mujh par kathor bane hue hain.
Uttam hoga ki mujhe yah maalum hota ki main kahaan jaakar unse bheint kar sakun, ki main unke nivaas pahunch sakun!
Tab main unke saamne apni shikaayat prastut kar deta, apne saare soch unke saamne undel deta.
Tab mujhe unke uttar samajh a jaate, mujhe yah maalum ho jaata ki vah mujhse kya kaheinge.
Kya vah apni us mahaashakti ke saath mera saamna kareinge? Nahin! Nishchyath vah mere nivedan par dhyaan deinge.
Sajjan unse vahaan vivaad kareinge aur main unke justice ke dvaara mukti receive karunga.
“Ab yah dekh lo: main aage barhta hun, lekin vah vahaan nahin hain; main viprit disha mein aage barhta hun, lekin vah vahaan bhi dikhaai nahin dete.
Jab vah mere baayein paksh mein sakriy hote hain; vah mujhe dikhaai nahin dete.
Lekin unhein yah zarur maalum rahta hai ki main kis raasta par aage barh raha hun; main to unke dvaara parkhe jaane par kundan jaisa shuddh pramaanit ho jaaunga.
Mere paanv unke path se vichlit nahin hue; mainne kabhi koi dusre raasta nahin chuna hai.
Unke chehra se nikle orders ka main sadaiv follow karta raha hun; unke orders ko main apne khaana se adhik amuly maanta raha hun.
“Vah to aprtim hai, unka, kaun ho sakta hai virodhi? Vah vahi karte hain, jo unhein sarvopyukt lagta hai.
Jo kuchh mere lie pahle se thahra hai, vah use pura karte hain, aisi hi kai yojnaaein unke paas jama hain.
Isliye unki upasthiti mere lie bhayaaspad hai; is baare mein main jitna soch karta hun, utna hi bhaybhit hota jaata hun.
God ne mere dil ko kshin bana diya hai; mera ghabraana sarvshaktimaan janit hai,
Lekin andhera mujhe chup nahin rakh sakega, na hi vah ghor andhera, jisne mere chehra ko dhak kar rakha hai.
“Sarvshaktimaan God ne justice-divas ko thahraaya kyon nahin hai? Aur ve, jo unhein jaante hain, is din ki pratiksha karte rah jaate hain?
Kuchh log to zameen ki simaaon ko parivartit karte rahte hain; ve bherein pakarkar harap lete hain.
Ve pitrihin ke gadhon ko hakaal kar le jaate hain. Ve vidhva ke bail ko bandhak bana lete hain.
Ve daridr ko raasta se hata dete hain; desh ke dinon ko majbur hokar ek saath chhip jaana parta hai.
Dhyaan do, din vany gadhon-jaisa khaana khojte hue bhatakte rahte hain, marubhumi mein apne baalkon ke khaana ke lie.
Apne khet mein ve chaara ekatr karte hain aur durvritton ke daakh ki baari se silla uthaate hain.
Shitkaal mein unke lie koi aavran nahin rahte. Unhein to vivastr hi raatri vyatit karni parti hai.
Ve parvtiy vrishti se bhige hue hain, suraksha ke lie unhonne chattaan ka aashray liya hua hai.
Dusre ve hain, jo dudhmunhe, pitrihin baalkon ko chhin lete hain; ye hi hain ve, jo din logon se bandhak vastu kar rakh lete hain.
Unhin ke kaaran din ko vivastr rah jaana parta hai; ve hi bhukhon se ann ki puliyaan chhine lete hain.
Dinon ki divaaron ke bhitar hi ve tel nikaalte hain; ve draakshras-kund mein angur to raundte hain, lekin khud pyaase hi rahte hain.
Naagrik karaah rahe hain, aur ghaaylon ki aatma pukaar rahi hai. Phir bhi God bewakoofon ki yaachna ki or dhyaan nahin dete.
“Kuchh dusre aise hain, jo roshni ke khilaaf apraadhi hain, unhein iski nitiyon mein koi ruchi nahin hai, tab ve roshni ke raaston par aana nahin chaahte.
Hatyaara bare bhor uth jaata hai, vah jaakar dinon aur daridron ki murder karta hai, raatri mein vah chori karta hai.
Vyabhichaari ki nazar raat aane ki pratiksha karti rahti hai, vah soch karta hai, ‘Tab mujhe koi dekh na sakega.’ Vah apne chehre ko andhere mein chhipa leta hai.
Raatri hone par ve seindh lagaate hain, aur din mein ve ghar mein chhipe rahte hain; prakaash mein unhein koi ruchi nahin rahti.
Unke saamne praatahkaal bhi vaisa hi hota hai, jaisa ghor andhera, kyonki unki maitri to ghor andhera ke aatank se hai.
“Vastuth ve paani ke upar ke phen jaisa hain; unka bhukhand shaapit hai. Tab koi us disha mein daakh ki baari ki or nahin jaata.
Sukha aur garmi him-paani ko nigal lete hain, yahi situation hogi adholok mein galti karnevaalon ki.
Garbh unhein bhul jaata hai, kire use aise aahaar bana lete hain; ki uski smriti bhi mit jaati hai, galti karnevaala vaisa hi barbaad ho jaaega, jaise vriksh.
Vah baanjh aurat tak se chhal karta hai aur vidhva ka kalyaan uske dhyaan mein nahin aata.
Lekin God apni power se balvaan ko hata dete hain; yadypi ve pratishthit ho chuke hote hain, unke life ka koi aashvaasan nahin hota.
God unhein suraksha provide karte hain, unka poshan karte hain, vah unke raaston ki chauksi bhi karte hain.

Alpkaal ke lie ve utkarsh bhi karte jaate hain, tab ve barbaad ho jaate hain; iske atirikt ve gir jaate hain aur ve anyon ke jaisa purvjon mein ja milte hain; ann ki baalon ke jaisa kat jaana hi unka ant hota hai.
“Ab, yadi saty yahi hai, to kaun mujhe jhutha pramaanit kar sakta hai aur meri baat ko arthhin ghoshit kar sakta hai?”
Tab bildad ne, jo shuhi tha, apna mat dena shuruaat kiya:
“Prabhutv aur atishay sammaan ke adhikaari God hi hain; vahi sarvochch heaven mein law ki sthaapna karte hain.
Kya God ki sena gany hai? Kaun hai, jo unke prakaash se achhuta rah saka hai?
Tab kya insaan God ke saamne yukt pramaanit ho sakta hai? Ya naari se janme kisi ko bhi shuddh kaha ja sakta hai?
Yadi God ke saamne chandrma prakaashmaan nahin hai aur taaron mein koi shuddhta nahin hai,
Tab insaan kya hai, jo sirf ek kira hai, maanav praani, jo sirf ek keinchua hi hai!”
Tab ayyob ne javaab diya:
“Kya madad ki hai tumne ek durbal ki! Vaah! Kaise tumne bina power ka upyog kie hi ek haath ki raksha kar daali hai!
Kaise tumne ek jnaanhin person ko aisa paraamarsh de daala hai! Kaise samriddhi se tumne thik antardrishti provide ki hai!
Kisne tumhein is baat ke lie apostle kiya hai? Kiski aatma tumhaare dvaara baatein ki hai?
“Mritkon ki aatmaaein tharathra uthi hain, ve jo paani-jantuon se bhi niche ke tal mein basi hui hain.
God ke saamne maut khuli aur barbaadi-sthal dhaka nahin hai.
God ne uttar disha ko rikt antriksh mein vistirn kiya hai; prithvi ko unhonne shuny mein latka diya hai.
Vah paani ko apne meghon mein lapet lete hain aur unke niche megh nahin baras paate hain.
Vah purn chandrma ka chehra chhipa dete hain aur vah apne megh iske upar phaila dete hain.
Unhonne paani ke upar kshitij ka chinh lagaaya hai. Prakaash aur andhera ki sima par.
Heaven ke stambh kaamp uthte hain aur unhein God ki daant par aashchary hota hai.
Apne power se unhonne saagar ko manthan kiya; apni samajh bujh se unhonne raahaab ko sanhaar kar diya.
Unka shvaas heaven ko ujjval bana deta hai; unki bhuja ne drut sarp ko bedh daala hai.
Yah samajh lo, ki ye sab to unke mahaakaary ki jhalak sirf hai; unke baare mein ham kitna kam sun paate hain! Tab kismein kshamta hai ki unke paraakram ki thaah le sake?”
Tab apne vachan mein ayyob ne kaha:
“Jivit God ki shapath, jinhonne mujhe mere adhikaaron se vanchit kar diya hai, sarvshaktimaan ne mere jaan ko karvaahat se bhar diya hai,
Kyonki jab tak mujhmein life shesh hai, jab tak mere nathunon mein God ka life-shvaas hai,
Nishchyath mere chehra se kuchh bhi asangat mukhrit na hoga, aur na hi meri jibh koi chhal uchchaaran karegi.
God aisa kabhi na hone dein, ki tumhein sachcha ghoshit kar dun; mrityuparyant main righteousness ka tyaag na karunga.
Apni righteousness ko main kisi bhi riti se chhut na jaane dunga; life bhar mera antarman mujhe nahin dhikkaarega.
“Mera dushman evil-jaisa ho, mera virodhi anyaayi-jaisa ho.
Jab durjan ki ummid samaapt ho jaati hai, jab God uske jaan le lete hain, to phir kaun si ummid baaki rah jaati hai?
Jab us par sankat a parega, kya God uski pukaar suneinge?
Tab bhi kya sarvshaktimaan uske khushi ka kaaran bane raheinge? Kya tab bhi vah har situation mein God ko hi pukaarta rahega?
“Main tumhein God ke power ki teaching dena chaahunga; sarvshaktimaan kya-kya kar sakte hain, main yah chhipa nahin rakhunga.
Vastuth yah sab tumse gupt nahin hai; tab kya kaaran hai ki tum yah vyarth baatein kar rahe ho?
“God ki or se yahi hai durvritton ki niyti, sarvshaktimaan ki or se vah miraas, jo atyaachaari receive karte hain.
Yadypi uske kai son hain, lekin unke lie talvaar-ghaat hi nirdhaarit hai; uske vansh kabhi paryaapt khaana receive na kar sakeinge.
Uske uttarjivi mahaamaari se kabr mein jaaeinge, uski vidhvaaein ro bhi na paaeingi.
Yadypi vah chaandi aise sanchit kar raha hota hai, maano yah dhul ho aur kapde aise ekatr karta hai, maano vah mitti ka dher ho.
Vah yah sab karta rahega, lekin dhaarmik person hi inhein dhaaran kareinge aur chaandi nirdoshon mein vitrit kar di jaaegi.
Uska ghar makri ke jaale-jaisa nirmit hai, ya us aashray jaisa, jo chaukidaar apne lie bana leta hai.
Bichhaune par jaate hue, to vah ek dhanvaan person tha; lekin ab iske baad use jaagne par kuchh bhi nahin rah jaata hai.
Aatank use baarh jaisa bhaybhit kar leta hai; raatri mein aandhi use chupchaap le jaati hai.
Purvi vaayu use dur le urti hai, vah vilin ho jaata hai; kyonki aandhi use le uri hai.
Kyonki yah use bina kisi grace ke pheink dega; vah isse bachne ka koshish zarur karega.
Log uski situation ko dekh aanandit ho taali bajaaeinge aur use uske jagah se khader deinge.”
Ismein koi sandeh nahin, ki vahaan chaandi ki khaan hai aur ek aisa jagah, jahaan ve svarn ko shuddh karte hain.
Dhul mein se lauh ko alag kiya jaata hai, aur chattaan mein se taamba dhaatu pighlaaya jaata hai.
Insaan iski khoj mein andhera bhare sthal mein dur-dur tak jaata hai; chaahe vah andhera mein chhipi koi chattaan hai ya koi ghor andhera bhare sthal.
Insaan ke ghar se dur vah gahri khaan khodte hain, registaan jagah mein se durgam sthalon mein ja pahunchte hain; aur gahraai mein latke rahte hain.
Prithvi-prithvi hi hai, jo hamein khaana provide karti hai, lekin niche bhugarbh agnimay hai.
Prithvi mein chattaanein nilamni ka srot hain, prithvi ki dhul mein hi svarn milta hai.
Yah raasta hinsak pakshiyon ko maalum nahin hai, aur na is par baaj ki nazar hi kabhi pari hai.
Is raasta par nishchint, hrisht-pusht pashu kabhi nahin chale hain, aur na hinsak sinh is raasta se kabhi gaya hai.
Insaan chakmak ke patthar ko sparsh karta hai, parvton ko to vah aadhaar se hi palta deta hai.
Vah chattaanon mein se raasta nikaal lete hain aur unki nazar vahin parti hai, jahaan kuchh amuly hota hai;
Paani pravaah rok kar vah baandh khare kar dete hain aur vah jo adrishy tha, use prakaashit kar dete hain.
Savaal yahi uthta hai ki kahaan mil sakti hai samajh? Kahaan hai vah jagah jahaan samajh ki jar hai?
Insaan iska muly nahin jaanta vastuth jiviton ke lok mein yah paai hi nahin jaati.
Saagar ki gahraai ki ghoshna hai, “Mujhmein nahin hai yah”; mahaasaagar spasht karta hai, “Mainne ise nahin chhipaaya.”
Svarn se isko mol nahin liya ja sakta, vaise hi chaandi maap kar iska muly nirdhaaran sambhav nahin hai.
Ophir ka svarn bhi ise kharid nahin sakta, na hi gomed ya nilamni iske lie paryaapt honge.
Svarn aur sphatik iske star par nahin pahunch sakte, aur vaise hi kundan ke aabhushan se iska vinimay sambhav nahin hai.
Munga aur sphatik maniyon ka yahaan ullekh karna vyarth hai; knowledge ki uplabdhi motiyon se kahin adhik upar hai.
Kush desh ka pukhraaj iske baraabar nahin ho sakta; kundan se iska mulyaankan sambhav nahin hai.
Tab, kahaan hai vivek ka udgam? Kahaan hai samajh ka nivaas?
Tab yah spasht hai ki yah insaanon ki nazar se chhipi hai, haan, pakshiyon ki nazar se bhi ise nahin dekh paate hai.
Barbaadi aur maut spasht kahte hain “Apne kaanon se to hamne bas, iska ullekh suna hai.”
Sirf God ko is tak pahunchne ka raasta maalum hai, unhein hi maalum hai iska jagah.
Kyonki ve prithvi ke chhor tak nazar karte hain aur aakaash ke niche ki har ek vastu unki nazar mein hoti hai.
Jab unhonne vaayu ko bojh provide kiya aur paani ko aaytan se maapa,
Jab unhonne vrishti ki sima tay kar di aur garjan aur bijli ki disha nirdhaarit kar di,
Tabhi unhonne ise dekha aur iski ghoshna ki unhonne ise sansthaapit kiya aur ise khoj bhi nikaala.
Tab unhonne insaan par yah prakaashit kiya, “Ise samajh lo Lord ke prati dar, yahi hai samajh, aur buraaiyon se duri banaae rakhna hi samajhdaari hai.”
Tab apne vachan mein ayyob ne kaha:
“Upyukt to yah hota ki main us situation mein ja pahunchta jahaan main kuchh maah purv tha, un dinon mein, jab mujh par God ki grace hua karti thi,
Jab God ke dipak ka prakaash mere sir par chamak raha tha. Jab andhera mein main unhin ke prakaash mein aage barh raha tha!
Ve meri yuvaavastha ke din the, us samay mere ghar par God ki grace thi,
Us samay sarvshaktimaan mere saath the, mere children bhi us samay mere nikat the.
Us samay to situation aisi thi, maano mere pair makkhan se dhoe jaate the, aur chattaanein mere lie tel ki dhaaraaein bahaaya karti thin.
“Tab main shehar ke dvaar mein chala jaaya karta tha, jahaan mere lie ek aasan hua karta tha,
Yuva sammaan mein mere saamne aane mein hichakte the, aur praurh mere lie sammaan ke saath uthkar khare ho jaate the;
Yahaan tak ki shaasak apna vaartaalaap rok dete the aur chehra par haath rakh lete the;
Pratishthit person shaant svar mein vaartaalaap karne lagte the, unki to jibh hi taalu se lag jaati thi.
Mujhe aise word sunne ko milte the ‘Blessed hain vah,’ Jab meri nazar un par parti thi, yah ve mere baare mein kah rahe hote the.
Yah isliye, ki main un dinon ki madad ke lie tatpar rahta tha, jo madad ki dohaai lagaate the. Aur un pitrihinon ki, jinka sahaayak koi nahin hai.
Jo marne par tha, us person ki samriddhi mujhe di gai hai; jiske kaaran us vidhva ke dil se harshgaan phut pare the.
Mainne yuktta dhaaran kar li, isne mujhe dhak liya; mera justice ka kaam baahy kapde aur pagri ke jaisa tha.
Main drishtihinon ke lie nazar ho gaya aur apangon ke lie pair.
Daridron ke lie main pita ho gaya; mainne aprichiton ke justice ke lie jaanch partaal ki thi.
Mainne evil logon ke jabre tore aur unhein ja chhuraaya, jo barbaad hone par hi the.
“Tab mainne yah soch kiya, ‘Meri maut mere ghar mein hi hogi aur main apne life ke dinon ko baalu ke jaisa tyaag dunga.
Meri jarein paani tak pahunchi hui hain saari raatri meri shaakhaaon par os chhaai rahti hai.
Sabhi ki or se mujhe prashansa receive hoti rahi hai, meri power, mera dhanush, mere haath mein hamesha bana rahega.
“Ve log mere paraamarsh ko suna karte the, meri pratiksha karte rahte the, is riti se ve mere paraamarsh ko shaanti se accept bhi karte the.
Mere vaktavy ke baad ve pratikriya ka saahas nahin karte the; meri baatein ve grahan kar lete the.
Ve mere lie vaise hi pratiksha karte the, jaise vrishti ki, unke chehra vaise hi khule rah jaate the, maano yah vasant ritu ki vrishti hai.
Ve mushkil se faith karte the, jab main un par muskuraata tha; mere chehre ka prakaash unke lie kimti tha.
Unka leader hone ke kaaran main unhein upyukt hal sujhaata tha; sena ki tukriyon ke lie main ranniti prastut karta tha; main hi unhein jo duhkhi the saantvna provide karta tha.
“Lekin ab to ve hi mera uphaas kar rahe hain, jo mujhse kam umr ke hain, ye ve hi hain, jinke pitaaon ko mainne is yogy bhi na samjha tha ki ve meri bhedon ke rakshak kutton ke saath baithein.
Vastuth unki kshamta aur kaushal mere kisi kaam ka na tha, power unmein rah na gai thi.
Akaal aur garibi ne unhein kurup bana diya hai, raatri mein ve registaan ke kure mein jaakar sukhi zameen chaatte hain.
Ve jhaariyon ke beech se loniya saag ekatr karte hain, jhaau vriksh ke mul unka khaana hai.
Ve samaaj se bahishkrit kar die gae hain, aur log un par dutkaar rahe the, jaise ki ve chor the.
Parinaam yah hua ki ve ab bhayaavah ghaatiyon mein, zameen ke bilon mein aur chattaanon mein nivaas karne lage hain.
Jhaariyon ke beech se ve pukaarte rahte hain; ve to kantili jhaariyon ke niche ekatr ho gae hain.
Ve bewakoof aur aprichit the, jinhein kore maar-maar kar desh se khader diya gaya tha.
“Ab main aison ke vyangy ka paatr ban chuka hun; main unke saamne ninda ka paryaay ban chuka hun.
Unhein mujhse aisi nafrat ho chuki hai, ki ve mujhse dur-dur rahte hain; ve mere chehra par thukne ka koi avsar nahin chhorte.
Ye duhkh ke tir mujh par God dvaara hi chhore gae hain, ve mere saamne purnath nirankush ho chuke hain.
Meri daayin or aise logon ki santti viksit ho rahi hai. Jo mere pairon ke lie jaal bichhaate hai, ve mere khilaaf gheraabandi dhalaan ka nirmaan karte hain.
Ve mere nikalne ke raaste bigaarte; ve mere barbaadi ka laabh paana chaahte hain. Unhein koi bhi nahin rokta.
Ve aate hain to aisa maalum hota hai maano ve divaar ke suraakh se nikalkar a rahe hain; ve tuphaan mein se lurhakte hue aate maalum hote hain.
Saare dar to mujh par hi a pare hain; mera sab sammaan, sampurn aatmvishvaas maano vaayu mein ura ja raha hai. Meri suraksha megh ke jaisa kho chuki hai.
“Ab mere jaan mere andar mein hi dube ja rahe hain; dard ke dinon ne mujhe bhaybhit kar rakha hai.
Raatri mein meri haddiyon mein chubhan shuruaat ho jaati hai; meri chubhti vedna hardam bani rahti hai.
Bare hi balpurvak mere kapde ko pakra gaya hai aur use mere gale ke aas-paas kas diya gaya hai.
God ne mujhe kichar mein daal diya hai, main sirf dhul aur bhasm hokar rah gaya hun.
“Main aapko pukaarta rahta hun, lekin aap meri or dhyaan nahin dete.
Aap mere prati krur ho gae hain; aap apni bhuja ke bal se mujh par vaar karte hain.
Jab aap mujhe uthaate hain, to isliye ki main vaayu pravaah mein ur jaaun; tuphaan mein to main vilin ho jaata hun;
Ab to mujhe maalum ho chuka hai, ki aap mujhe meri maut ki or le ja rahe hain, us or, jahaan ant mein sab jivit praani ekatr hote jaate hain.
“Kya vah jo, kure ke dher mein ja para hai, madad ke lie haath nahin barhaata ya kya barbaadi ki situation mein koi madad ke lie nahin pukaarta.
Kya sankat mein pare person ke lie mainne aansu nahin bahaaya? Kya daridr person ke lie mujhe vedna na hui thi?
Jab mainne kalyaan ki pratyaasha ki, mujhe anisht receive hua; mainne prakaash ki pratiksha ki, to andhera chha gaya.
Mujhe vishraanti nahi hai, kyonki meri antriyaan ubal rahi hain; mere saamne is samay vipatti ke din a gae hain.
Main to ab saantvna rahit, vilaap kar raha hun; main sabha mein khara hua madad ki yaachna kar raha hun.
Main to ab gidron ka bhaai aur shuturmurgon ka mitr bankar rah gaya hun.
Meri khaal kaali ho chuki hai; jvar mein meri haddiyaan garm ho rahi hain.
Mera vaady ab karun svar utpann kar raha hai, meri baansuri ka svar bhi aisa maalum hota hai, maano koi ro raha hai.
“Apne netron se mainne ek promise ki hai ki main kisi kumaari kanya ki or kaamuktaapurn nazar se nahin dekhunga.
Heaven se God dvaara kya-kya provide kiya jaata hai ya heaven se sarvshaktimaan se kaun si miraas receive hoti hai?
Kya anyaayi ke lie vidhvans aur evil logon ke lie sarvnaash nahin?
Kya God ke saamne meri lifestyle aur mere pairon ki sankhya spasht nahin hoti?
“Yadi mainne jhuth ka aachran kiya hai, yadi mere pair chhal ki disha mein drut gati se barhte,
Tab khud God sachche taraaju par mujhe maap lein aur God hi meri nirdoshita ko maalum kar lein.
Yadi unke path se mere paanv kabhi bhatke hon, ya mere dil ne meri khud ki nazar ka anugman kiya ho, ya kahin bhi mere haath kalankit hue hon.
To mere dvaara ropit upaj dusre ka aahaar ho jaae aur meri upaj ukhaar daali jaae.
“Yadi mera dil kisi paraai aurat dvaara lubhaaya gaya ho, ya main apne parosi ke dvaar par ghaat lagaae baitha hun,
To meri patni dusre ke lie kathor shram ke lie laga di jaae, aur dusre aadmi uske saath soyein,
Kyonki kaamukta ghriny hai, aur ek dandniy galti.
Yah vah aag hogi, jo vinaash ke lie prajvlit hoti hai, aur jo meri sab samriddhi ko barbaadi kar degi.
“Yadi mainne apne slave-daasiyon ke aagrah ko bekaar samjha hai aur unmein mere prati asantosh ka bhaav utpann hua ho,
Tab us samay main kya kar sakunga, jab God sakriy ho jaaeinge? Jab vah mujhse puchhtaachh kareinge, main unhein kya uttar dunga?
Kya unhin God ne, jinhonne garbh mein meri rachna ki hai? Unki bhi rachna nahin ki hai aur kya ham sab ki rachna ek hi svarup mein nahin ki gai?
“Yadi mainne dinon ko unki abhilaasha se kabhi vanchit rakha ho, ya main kisi vidhva ke niraash hone ka kaaran hua hun,
Ya mainne chhip-chhip kar khaana kiya ho, aur kisi pitrihin ko khaana se vanchit rakha ho.
Mainne to pita tuly unka follow poshan kiya hai, baalykaal se hi mainne uska maargdarshan kiya hai.
Yadi mainne aparyaapt kapdon ke kaaran kisi ka barbaadi hone diya hai, ya koi daridr vastrhin rah gaya ho.
Aison ko to main uni kapde provide karta raha hun, jo meri bhedon ke un se banaae gae the.
Yadi mainne kisi pitrihin par prahaar kiya ho, kyonki shehar chauk mein kuchh log mere paksh mein ho gae the,
Tab meri baanh kandhe se ukhar kar gir jaae aur meri baanh kandhe se tut jaae.
Kyonki God ki or se aai vipatti mere lie bhayaavah hai. Unke prataap ke kaaran mera kuchh bhi kar paana asambhav hai.
“Yadi mera bharosa meri dhanaadhyta par ho aur sone ko mainne, ‘Apni suraksha ghoshit kiya ho,’
Yadi mainne apni mahaan property ka ahankaar kiya ho, aur isliye ki mainne apne shram se yah uplabdh kiya hai.
Yadi mainne chamakte suraj ko nihaara hota, ya us chandrma ko, jo apne vaibhav mein apni yaatra purn karta hai,
Aur yah dekh mera dil mere antar mein in par mohit ho gaya hota, aur mere haath ne in par ek chumban kar diya hota,
Yah bhi galti hi hua hota, jiska dandit kiya jaana anivaary ho jaata, kyonki yah to God ko unke authority se vanchit karna ho jaata.
“Kya main kabhi apne dushman ke durbhaagy mein aanandit hua hun ya us situation par aanandmagn hua hun, jab us par musibat tut pari?
Nahin! Mainne kabhi bhi shaap dete hue apne dushman ki maut ki yaachna karne ka galti apne chehra ko nahin karne diya.
Kya mere ghar ke logon ki saakshy yah nahin hai, ‘Uske ghar ke khaana se mujhe santosh nahin hua?’
Mainne kisi bhi videshi pravaasi ko apne ghar ke atirikt anyatr thaharne nahin diya, kyonki mere ghar ke dvaar pravaasiyon ke lie sadaiv khule rahte hain.
Kya, mainne dusre logon ke jaisa apne andar mein apne galti ko chhupa rakha hai; apne adharm ko dhaamp rakha hai?
Kya, mujhe janmat ka dar raha hai? Kya, parijnon ki nafrat mujhe dara rahi hai? Kya, main isliye chup rahkar apne ghar se baahar na jaata tha?

(“Uttam hoti vah situation, jismein koi to mera paksh sunne ke lie tatpar hota! Dekh lo ye hain mere hastaakshar sarvshaktimaan hi iska uttar dein; mere dushman ne mujh par yah likhit shikaayat ki hai.
Iska dhaaran mujhe kaandhon par karna hoga, yah aarop mere apne sir par mukut ke jaisa dhaaran karna hoga.
Main to God ke saamne apne dvaara uthaae gae sab pair spasht kar dunga; main ek raajneta ki abhivritti unki upasthiti mein pravesh karunga.)
“Yadi mera khet mere khilaaf apna svar uncha karta hai aur kund milkar rone lagte hain,
Yadi mainne bina muly chukaae upaj ka upbhog kiya ho ya mere kaaran uske svaamiyon ne apne jaan ganvaae hon,
To gehun ke jagah par kaante barhne lagein aur jau ke jagah par jangli ghaas ug jaae.” Yahaan ayyob ka vachan samaapt ho gaya.
Tab in tinon ne hi ayyob ko pratyuttar dena chhor diya, kyonki ayyob khud ki righteousness ke baare mein atal mat ke the.
Lekin raam ke parivaar ke buzvaasi baarkael ke son elihu ka krodh bharak utha-uska yah krodh ayyob par hi tha, kyonki ayyob khud ko God ke saamne nek pramaanit karne mein atal the.
Iske viprit ayyob apne tinon mitron par naaraaj the, kyonki ve unke prashnon ke uttar dene mein viphal rahe the.
Ab tak elihu ne kuchh nahin kaha tha, kyonki vah un sabhi se kam umr ka tha.
Tab, jab elihu ne dhyaan diya ki dusre tin prashnon ke uttar dene mein asmarth the, tab uska krodh bharak utha.
Tab buzvaasi baarkael ke son elihu ne kahna shuruaat kiya: “Main thahra kam umr ka aur aap sabhi bare; isliye main jhijhakta raha aur mainne apne soch vyakt nahin kie.
Mera mat yahi tha, ‘Soch vahi vyakt karein, jo varshon mein mujhse aage hain, knowledge ki teaching ve hi dein, jo bare hain.’
Vastuth sarvshaktimaan ki shvaas aur God ka aatma hi hai, jo insaan mein knowledge pragat karta hai.
Sambhaavna to yah hai ki bare mein vidvatta hi na ho, aur bare mein justice ki koi samajh na ho.
“Tab mainne bhi apni chaahat reveal ki ‘Meri bhi sun lijie; main apne soch vyakt karunga.’
Sunie, ab tak main aap logon ke vaktavy sunta hua thahra raha hun, aap logon ke soch bhi mainne sun lie hain, jo aap log ghor soch karte hue prastut kar rahe the.
Main aapke vaktavy bare hi dhyaanpurvak sunta raha hun. Nihsandeh aisa koi bhi na tha jisne mahoday ayyob ke words ka virodh kiya ho; aap mein se ek ne bhi unka uttar nahin diya.
Ab yah mat bolna, ‘Hamein knowledge ki uplabdhi ho gai hai; insaan nahin, khud God hi unke tarkon ka khandan kareinge.’
Kyonki ayyob ne apna vaktavy mere virodh mein lakshit nahin kiya tha, main to unhein aap logon ke jaisa soch se uttar bhi na de sakunga.
“Ve niraash ho chuke hain, ab ve uttar hi nahin de rahe; ab to unke paas word na rah gae hain.
Kya unke chup rahne ke kaaran mujhe pratiksha karna hoga, kyonki ab ve vahaan chupchaap khare hue hain, uttar dene ke lie unke saamne kuchh na raha hai.
Tab main bhi apne soch prastut karunga; main bhi vah sab reveal karunga, jo mujhe maalum hai.
Soch mere man mein samaae hue hain, meri aatma mujhe apostle kar rahi hai.
Mera dil to daakhamdhu jaisa hai, jise band kar rakha gaya hai, aisa jaise naye daakhras ki botal phatne hi vaali hai.
Jo kuchh mujhe kahna hai, use kahne dijie, taaki mere dil ko shaanti mil jaae; mujhe uttar dene dijie.
Main ab kisi ka paksh na lunga aur na kisi ki chaaplusi hi karunga;
Kyonki chaaplusi mere svabhaav mein nahin hai, tab yadi main yah karne lagun, mere rachyita mujhe yahaan se utha lein.
“Phir bhi, mahoday ayyob, grace kar mere vaktavy; mere sabhi vichaaron par dhyaan dijie.
Ab main apne word aapke saamne reveal raha hun; ab meri jibh aur mera chehra taiyaar ho rahe hain.
Mere ye word mere dil ki imaandaari se nikal rahe hain; mere honth purn sach mein knowledge reveal kareinge.
Main God ke aatma ki kriti hun; meri praanvaayu sarvshaktimaan God ke uchchhvaas se hai.
Yadi aapke lie sambhav ho to mere words ka khandan kijie; mera saamna karne ke lie aap taiyaar ho jaaie.
Smaran rakhie aapke jaisa main bhi God ki srishti hun; main bhi mitti ki hi rachna hun.
Sunie, mujhse aapko kisi tarah ka dar na ho, main aapko kisi bhi riti se kathor nahin karunga.
“Nihsandeh jo kuchh aapne kaha hain, vah sab mainne suna hai, aapke sabhi word main sun chuka hun—
‘Main nishklank hun, atyaachaar rahit hun; main nirdosh hun aur mujhmein koi dosh nahin hai.
Dhyaan dijie, phir bhi God mere khilaaf dosh khoj rahe hain; unhonne to mujhe apna dushman samjhe hain.
Unhonne mere paanv kaath mein jakar die; mere sab raaston par vah nigraani banaae hue hain.’
“Sunie, main aapko suchit kar raha hun: aap is baare mein nitimaan nahin hain, kyonki God insaanon se bare hain.
Aap God ke khilaaf yah shikaayat kyon kar rahe hain ki vah apne kaaryon ka lekha nahin diya karte?
God sanvaad zarur karte hain—kabhi ek riti se, kabhi dusre riti se— insaan iske or dhyaan dene se chuk jaata hai.
Kabhi to svapn ke maadhyam se, kabhi raatri mein prakaashit darshan ke maadhyam se, jab insaan ghor nidra mein para rahta hai, jab vah bichhaune par nind mein dubta hai.
Tab God uske kaan ko jaagrit kar dete hain. Use chetaavniyon se bhaybhit kar dete hain,
Ki aisa karke vah insaan ko uske aachran se dur kar dein aur insaan ko ahankaar se bacha lein;
God gaddhe se insaan ki aatma ki raksha kar lete hain, ki uska life adholok mein na chala jaae.
“Insaan jab apne bichhaune par hota hai, tab bhi use dard dvaara sataaya jaata hai, iske atirikt uski haddiyon mein gahan vedna ke dvaara bhi.
Parinaamasvrup uska man tak khaana se nafrat karne lagta hai bhale hi vah uska sarvaadhik uttam khaana raha ho.
Uske body ka maans dekhte hi sukh jaata hai, ve haddiyaan, jo adrishy thi, maans sukh kar ab spasht dikhaai de rahi hain.
Tab uske jaan us kabr ke nikat pahunch jaate hain, aur uska life maut ke duton ke nikat pahunch jaata hai.
Yadi sahasron mein se koi ek angel aisa hai, jo uska madhyasth hai, ki use yah smaran dilaae, ki uske lie sarvopyukt kya hai,
Tab vah bari hi shaalinta ke bhaav mein usse yah kahe. ‘Uska us kabr mein jaana nirast kar diya jaae, mujhe iske lie chhurauti receive ho chuki hai;
Ab uske maans ko navyuvak ke maans se bhi pusht kar diya jaae, use uske yuvaavastha ke kaal mein pahuncha diya jaae.’

Tab uske lie yah sambhav ho jaaega, ki vah God se prayer kare aur God use accept bhi kar leinge, ki vah harshollaas mein God ke chehre ko nihaar sake aur God us person ki yuktta ki punahsthaapna kar sakein.
Vah ga gaakar dusre insaanon ke saamne yah bata dega. ‘Mainne righteous ko vikrit karne ka galti kiya hai, mere lie aisa karna upyukt na tha.
God ne mere jaan ko us kabr mein ja parne se bacha liya hai, ab mere jaan ujiyaale ko dekh sakeinge.’
“Yah dekh lena, God insaanon ke saath yah sab bahudha karte hain,
Ki vah us kabr se insaan ke jaan lauta laaein, ki insaan life roshni ke dvaara prakaashit kiya ja sake.
“Ayyob, mere in words ko dhyaan se sun lo; tum chup rahoge, to main apna sanvaad shuruaat karunga.
Yadi tumhein kuchh bhi kahna ho to kah do, kah daalo; kyonki main chaahta hun, ki main tumhein nirdosh pramaanit kar dun.
Yadi yah sambhav nahin, to mera soch dhyaan se sun lo; yadi tum chup raho, to main tumhein samajh ki teaching de sakunga.”
Elihu ne phir kaha:
“Buddhimaanon, mera vaktavy suno; aap to sab samajhte hi hain, tab meri sun lijie.
Jaise jibh khaana ke svaad ko parakhti hai, kaan bhi vaktavy ki vivechna karta hai.
Uttam yahi hoga, ki ham yahaan apne lie; vahi accept kar lein, jo bhala hai.
“Ayyob ne yah daava kiya hai ‘Main to nirdosh hun, lekin God ne mere saath anyaay kiya hai;
Kya apne authority ke baare mein, main jhutha daava karunga? Mera ghaav asaadhy hai, jabki meri or se koi avajna nahin hui hai.’
Kya aisa koi person hai, jo ayyob ke jaisa ho, jo ninda ka paani jaisa paan kar jaate hain,
Jo galti karnevaala logon ki sangti karte hain; jo durvritton ke saath kaaryon mein jut jaate hain?
Kyonki unhonne yah kaha hai, ‘Koi laabh nahin hota yadi koi person God se aanandit hota.’
“Tab ab aap dhyaan se meri sun lijie, aap to wise hain. God ke lie to yah sambhav hi nahin ki vah kisi bhi tarah ki buraai kare, sarvshaktimaan se koi bhul hona sambhav nahin.
Kyonki vah to kisi ko bhi uske kaaryon ke anurup pratiphal dete hain; aur uske aachran ke hisaab se phal bhi.
Nishchay, God buraai nahin kareinge aur sarvshaktimaan justice ko vikrit nahin hone deinge.
Prithvi par unhein adhikaari kisne banaaya hai? Kisne sampurn vishv ka daayitv unhein saumpa hai?
Yadi vah yah nishchay kar lete hain, ki vah koi kaary nishpann kareinge, yadi vah apni aatma aur apna shvaas le lein,
To sab maanav jaati tatkshan barbaad ho jaaegi aur insaan dhul mein laut jaaega.
“Lekin yadi vaastav mein aap mein samajh hai, yah sun lijie; mere word ki dhvani par dhyaan dijie.
Kya yah upyukt hai ki vah shaasan kare, jise justice se nafrat hai? Kya aap us shur par, jo purn righteous hai dand prasaarit kareinge?
Jismein raaja tak par yah aakshep lagaane ka saahas hai ‘Nikamme,’ Aur leaders par, ‘Tum evil ho,’
Jo pramukhon se prabhaavit hokar unka paksh nahin karta, jo na dinon ko tuchchh samajh dhanaadhyon ko sammaan deta hai, kyonki unmein yah bodh prabal rahta hai donon hi ek God ki kriti hain?
Sabhi ki maut kshan sirf mein ho jaati hai, beech raatri ke samay ek pal ke saath unke jaan ur jaate hain, haan, shurvir tak, bina kisi maanav haath ke prahaar ke chale jaate hain.
“Kyonki insaan ki har ek gatividhi par God ki nazar rahti hai; uski sab chaal God ko maalum rahte hain.
Na to koi aisa andhera hai, aur na hi aisi koi chhaaya, jahaan duraachaari chhipne ke lie aashray le sakein.
God ke lie yah zaruri nahin, ki vah kisi insaan ke lie gae nirnay par soch karein, ki insaan ko justice ke lie God ke saamne upasthit hona pare.
Bina kuchh puchhe God, shurviron ko chur-chur kar dete hain, tab dusre person ko uske jagah par niyukt kar dete hain.
Tab God ko unke krityon ka pura hisaab rahta hai, raatri ke rahte hi vah unhein mita dete hain, ve kuchal die jaate hain.
Un par God ka prahaar vaisa hi hota hai, maano koi duraachaari saarvajnik riti se dandit kiya ja raha ho,
Kyonki ve God se dur ho gaye the, unhonne God ke raasta ka koi dhyaan nahin diya tha,
Ki kangaalon ki pukaar God tak ja pahunchi, ki pirit ki pukaar God ne suni.
Jab God chup rahte hain, tab un par ungli kaun utha sakega? Aur agar vah chehra chhipaane ka nirnay le lein, to kaun unki jhalak dekh sakega; chaahe koi raashtr ho ya person?
Lekin durjan shaasak na ban sakein, aur na hi ve people ke lie mohjaal pramaanit hon.
“Kya koi God ke saamne yah daava kare, ‘Main to gunahgaar hun, lekin iske baad mujhse koi apraadh na hoga.
Ab aap mujhe us vishay ki teaching dijie; jo mere lie ab tak adrishy hai. Chaahe mujhse koi galti ho gaya hai, main ab ise kabhi na karunga.’

Mahoday ayyob, kya God aapki sharton par nuksaan kareinge, kyonki aapne to God ki kaaryaprnaali par virodh reveal kiya hai, chunaav to aapko hi karna hoga mujhe nahin tab; apne knowledge ki ghoshna kar dijie.
“Ve, jo wise hain, aur ve, jo wise hain, meri suneinge aur mujhse kaheinge,
‘Ayyob ki baat bina knowledge ki hoti hai; unke kathnon mein koi vidvatta nahin hai.’
Mahoday ayyob ko bari hi sukshmta-purvak parkha jaae, kyonki unke uttron mein dushtta paai jaati hai!
Vah apne galti par vidroh ka yog dete hain; vah hamaare hi beech rahte hue uphaas mein taali bajaate aur God ki ninda par ninda karte jaate hain.”
Elihu ne aur kaha:
“Kya aap yah justice samajhte hain? Aap kahte hain, ‘Mera dharm God ke dharm se upar hai?’
Kyonki aap to yahi kaheinge, ‘Aap par mere galti ka kya prabhaav parta hai, aur galti na karne ke dvaara mainne kya receive kiya hai?’
“Iska uttar aapko main dunga, aapko aur aapke mitron ko.
Aakaash ki or nazar uthaao; meghon ka avlokan karo, ve tumse upar hain.
Jab aap galti kar baithte hain, isse haani God ki kaisi hoti hai? Yadi aapke atyaachaaron ki sankhya adhik ho jaati, kya God par iska koi prabhaav hota hai?
Yadi aap righteous hain, aap God ke lie kaun sa upkaar kar deinge, ya aapke is krity se aap unke lie kaun sa laabh haasil kar deinge?
Aapki dushchritrta aap jaise person par hi shobha deti hai, aur aapki righteousness maanavta ke lie yog deti hai.
“Atyaachaaron mein vriddhi hone par insaan karaahne lagte hain; ve bure kaam ke lie kisi shur ki khoj karte hain.
Lekin kisi ka dhyaan is or nahin jaata ‘Kahaan hain God, mera rachyita, jo raat mein git dete hain,
Rachyita God hi hain, jinki teaching hamein pashu pakshiyon se adhik vidvatta deti hai, aur hamein aakaash ke pakshiyon se adhik wise bana deti hai.’
Vahaan ve madad ki pukaar dete hain, lekin God unki or dhyaan nahin dete, kyonki ve durjan apne ahankaar mein dube hue rahte hain.
Yah nirvivaad saty hai ki God nirarthak pukaar ko nahin sunte; sarvshaktimaan is or dhyaan dena bhi upyukt nahin samajhte.
Mahoday ayyob, aap kah rahe the, aap God ko nahin dekh sakte, anivaary hai ki aap God ke samay ki pratiksha karein. Aapka paksh unke saamne rakha ja chuka hai.
Iske atirikt, God krodh kar tumhein dand nahin deta, aur na hi vah abhimaan ki or dhyaan dete hain,
Mahoday ayyob, isliye vyarth hai aapka is tarah baatein karna; aap bina kisi knowledge ke apne udgaar par udgaar kie ja rahe hain.”
Elihu ne aage kaha:
“Aap kuchh der aur pratiksha kijie, ki main aapke saamne yah reveal kar sakun, ki God ki or se aur bhi bahut kuchh kaha ja sakta hai.
Apna knowledge main dur se lekar aaunga; main yah pramaanit karunga ki mere rachyita righteous hain.
Kyonki main aapko yah aashvaasan de raha hun, ki meri aakhyaan jhuth nahin hai; jo person is samay aapke saamne khara hai, uska knowledge trutihin hai.
“Smaran rakhie God sarvshaktimaan to hain, lekin vah kisi se nafrat nahin karte; unki power shaaririk bhi hai aur maansik bhi.
Vah evil logon ko jivit nahin chhorte lekin vah piriton ko justice se vanchit nahin rakhte.
Dharmiyon par se unki najar kabhi nahin hatti, vah unhein raajaaon ke saath baitha dete hain, aur yah unnti sthaayi ho jaati hai, ve sammaanit hokar vahaan unche pad ko receive kie jaate hain.
Lekin yadi koi beriyon mein jakar diya gaya ho, use dard ki rassiyon se baandh diya gaya ho,
God un par yah reveal kar dete hain, ki is dard ka kaaran kya hai? Unka hi ahankaar, unka yahi galti.
Tab God unhein upyukt teaching ke follow ke lie majbur kar dete hain, aur unhein order dete hain, ki ve galti se dur ho jaaein.
Yadi ve aajnaapaalan kar God ki service mein lag jaate hain, unka sampurn life samriddhi se purn ho jaata hai aur unka life sukhi bana rahta hai.
Lekin yadi ve unke nirdeshon ki upeksha karte hain, talvaar se barbaadi unki niyti ho jaati hai aur bina knowledge ke ve mar jaate hain.
“Lekin ve, jo durvritt hain, jo man mein krodh ko poshit karte hain; jab God unhein beriyon mein jakar dete hain, ve madad ki pukaar nahin dete.
Unki maut unke yauvan mein hi ho jaati hai, devtaaon ko samarpit luchchon ke beech mein.
Lekin God piriton ko unki dard se mukt karte hain; yahi dard unke lie nae anubhav ka kaaran ho jaati hai.
“Tab vastuth God ne aapko vipatti ke chehra se nikaala hai, ki aapko mukti ke vishaal, surakshit jagah par sthaapit kar dein, aur aapko sarvotkrisht svaadisht khaana paros dein.
Lekin ab aapko vahi dand diya ja raha hai, jo durvritton ke lie hi upyukt hai; ab aap saty aur justice ke antargat parkhe jaaeinge.
Ab upyukt yah hoga ki aap saavdhaan rahein, ki koi aapko wealth-property ke dvaara lubha na le; aisa na ho ki koi ghus dekar raaste se bhatka de.
Aapka kya mat hai, kya aapki wealth-property aapki dard se mukti ka saadhan ban sakegi, ya kya aapki sampurn power aapko suraksha provide kar sakegi?
Us raatri ki kaamna na kijie, jab log apne-apne gharon se baahar barbaad hone lageinge.
Saavdhaan rahie, buraai ki or na murie, aisa jaan parta hai, ki aapne dard ke badle buraai ko chun liya hai.
“Dekho, power mein God sarvochch hain. Kaun hai unke tuly utkrisht shikshak?
Kisne unhein is pad par niyukt kiya hai, kaun unse kabhi yah kah saka hai ‘Ismein to aapne kami kar di hai’?
Yah smaran rahe ki God ke kaaryon ka gungaan karte rahein, jinke baare mein log praise karte rahe hain.
Sabhi inke saakshy hain; dur-dur se unhonne yah sab dekha hai.
Dhyaan dijie God mahaan hain, unhein puri tarah samajh paana hamaare lie asambhav hai! Unki aayu ke varshon ki sankhya maalum karna asambhav hai.
“Kyonki vah paani ki bundon ko astitv mein laate hain, ye bundein baadlon se vrishti bankar tapakti hain;
Megh yahi vrishti undelte jaate hain, bahutaayat se yah insaanon par barasti hain.
Kya kisi mein yah kshamta hai, ki meghon ko phailaane ki baat ko samajh sake, God ke mandap ki bijliyaan ko samajh le?
Dekhie, God hi ujiyaale ko apne aas-paas bikhra lete hain aur mahaasaagar ki thaah ko dhaamp dete hain.
Kyonki ye hi hain God ke ve saadhan, jinke dvaara vah jantaaon ka justice karte hain. Aur khaana bhi bahulta mein provide karte hain.
Vah bijli apne haathon mein le lete hain, aur use order dete hain, ki vah lakshy par ja pare.
Bijli ka naad unki upasthiti ki ghoshna hai; pashuon ko to iska purvaabhaas ho jaata hai.
“Main is soch se bhi kaamp uthta hun. Vastuth mera dil uchhal parta hai.
God ke udghosh ke naad aur unke chehra se nikli garagraahat sunie.
Ise vah sampurn aakaash mein prasaarit kar dete hain aur bijli ko dharti ki chhoron tak.
Tatpashchaat garjnaavat svar udbhut hota hai; God ka prataapmay svar, jab unka yah svar prakshepit hota hai, vah kuchh bhi rakh nahin chhorte.
Vilakshan hi hota hai God ka yah garajna; unke mahaakaary hamaari samajh se pare hote hain.
God him ko order dete hain, ‘Ab prithvi par baras paro,’ Aur muslaadhaar vrishti ko, ‘Prachand rakhna dhaara ko.’
God har ek person ke haath rok dete hain ki sabhi insaan har ek kaary ke lie shrey God ko de.
Tab vany pashu apni guphaaon mein aashray le lete hain aur vahin chhipe rahte hain.
Prachand vrishti dakshin disha se barhti chali aati hain aur shit lahar uttar disha se.
Him ki rachna God ke phunk se hoti hai aur vyaapak ho jaata hai paani ka barph banna.
God hi ghane megh ko nami se bhar dete hain; ve nami ke zarie apni bijli ko bikher dete hain.
Ve sabhi God hi ke nirdesh par apni disha parivartit karte hain ki ve sab insaanon dvaara basaai prithvi par vahi karein, jiska order unhein God se receive hota hai.
God apni srishti, is prithvi ke hit mein iske sudhaar ke nimitt, ya apne nirjar love se apostle ho ise nishpann karte hain.
“Ayyob, kripya yah sunie; God ke vilakshan kaaryon par soch kijie.
Kya aapko maalum hai, ki God ne inhein sthaapit kaise kiya hai, aur vah kaise megh mein us bijli ko chamkaate hain?
Kya aapko maalum hai ki baadal adhar mein kaise rahte hain? Yah sab unke dvaara nishpaadit adbhut kaary hain, jo apne knowledge mein paripurn hain.
Jab dharti dakshin vaayu pravaah ke kaaran nistabdh ho jaati hai aapke kapdon mein ushnta hua karti hai?
Mahoday ayyob, kya aap God ke saath milkar, dhali hui dhaatu ke darpan-jaisa aakaash ko vistirn kar sakte hain?
“Aap hi hamein bataaie, ki hamein God se kya nivedan karna hoga; hamaare andhera ke kaaran unke saamne apna paksh pesh karna hamaare lie sambhav nahin!
Kya God ko yah suchna de di jaaegi, ki main unse baat karun? Ki koi person apne hi praanon ki haani ki yojna kare?
Is samay yah saty hai, ki insaan ke lie yah sambhav nahin, ki vah prabhaavi sury prakaash ki or nazar kar sake. Kyonki vaayu pravaah ne aakaash se megh hata diya hai.
Uttar disha se svarnim aabha ka uday ho raha hai; God ke chaaron or bara tej prakaash hai.
Vah sarvshaktimaan, jinki upasthiti mein pravesh durgam hai, vah power mein unnat hain; yah ho hi nahin sakta ki vah justice aur atishay righteousness ka hanan karein.
Isliye aadarsh yahi hai, ki insaan unke prati shraddha bhaav rakhein. God dvaara ve sabhi aadarniy hain, jinhonne khud ko wise samajh rakha hai.”
Tab khud Yahweh ne tuphaan mein se ayyob ko javaab diya:
“Kaun hai vah, jo ajnaanta ke vichaaron dvaara meri yukti ko bigaar raha hai?
Aisa karo ab tum aadmi ke bhaav kamar baandh lo; tab main tumse savaal karna shuruaat karunga, tumhein in prashnon ka uttar dena hoga.
“Kahaan the tum, jab mainne prithvi ki ninv daali thi? Yadi tummein kuchh bhi samajh hai, mujhe iska uttar do.
Yadi tumhein maalum ho! To mujhe bataao, kisne prithvi ki naap thahraai hai? Ya, kisne iski maap rekhaaein nishchit ki?
Kis padaarth par iska aadhaar sthaapit hai? Kisne iska aadhaar rakha?
Jab nishaant taara sahgaan mein ek saath ga rahe the aur sabhi angel ullaasnaad kar rahe the, tab kahaan the tum?
“Ya kisne mahaasaagar ko dvaaron dvaara simit kiya, jab garbh se iska udbhav ho raha tha;
Jab mainne iske lie megh paridhaan nirmit kiya aur ghor andhera ko iski mekhla bana diya,
Aur mainne is par simaaein chinhit kar din aur aise dvaar bana die, jinmein chitakniyaan lagaai gain;
Aur mainne yah order de diya ‘Tum yahin tak a sakte ho, iske aage nahin aur yahaan aakar tumhaari ve sashakt vaali tarangein ruk jaaeingi’?
“Kya tumne apne life mein prabhaat ko yah order diya hai, ki vah upyukt kshan par hi arunoday kiya kare,
Ki yah prithvi ke har ek chhor tak reveal kare, ki duraachaari apne-apne chhipne ke jagah se hila die jaaein?
Gili mitti par mohar lagaane jaisa parivartan jismein paridhaan ke sukshm bhed spasht ho jaate hain.
Sury prakaash ki ugrta durvritton ko duraachaar se roke rahti hai, maano hinsa ke lie uthi hui unki bhuja tor di gai ho.
“Achchha, yah bataao, kya tumne jaakar mahaasaagar ke sroton ka nirikshan kiya hai ya saagar tal par chalna phirna kiya hai?
Kya tumne ghor andhera mein jaakar maut ke dvaaron ko dekha hai?
Kya tumhein zara sa bhi anumaan hai, ki prithvi ka vistaar kitna hai, mujhe bataao, kya-kya maalum hai tumhein?
“Kahaan hai prakaash ke ghar ka raasta? Vaise hi, kahaan hai andhera ka aashray,
Ki tum unhein yah to suchit kar sako, ki kahaan hai unki sima aur tum iske ghar ka raasta pahchaan sako?
Tumhein vaastav mein yah maalum hai, kyonki tab tumhaara janm ho chuka hoga! Tab to tumhaari aayu ke varsh bhi kai hi honge!
“Kya tumne kabhi him ke bhandaar mein pravesh kiya hai, ya kya tumne kabhi him ke bhandaargrih dekhe hain,
Un olon ko jinhein mainne dard ke samay ke lie rakha hua hai yuddh aur sangharsh ke dinon ke lie?
Kya tumhein maalum hai ki prakaash ka vibhaajan kahaan hai, ya yah ki prithvi par purvaai kaise bikhar jaati hai?
Kya tumhein maalum hai ki bari barsaat ke lie dhaara ki nahar kisne kaati hai, ya bijli ki disha kisne nirdhaarit ki hai,
Ki registaan pradesh mein paani barsaayein, us banjar zameen jahaan koi nahin rahta,
Ki ujre aur banjar zameen ki pyaas mit jaae, aur vahaan ghaas ke bijon ka ankuran ho jaae?
Hai koi vrishti ka janak? Ya kaun hai os ki bundon ka utpaadak?
Kis garbh se him ka prasav hai? Aur aakaash ka paala kahaan se janma hai?
Paani patthar ke jaisa kathor ho jaata hai aur isse mahaasaagar ki satah ek kaaraagaar ka rup dhaaran kar leti hai.
“Ayyob, kya tum kritika nakshatr ke samuh ko paraspar gunth sakte ho, ya mrigshirsh ke bandhnon ko khol sakte ho?
Kya tum kisi taaraamandal ko uske nirdhaarit samay par reveal kar sakte ho aur kya tum sapt rishi ko disha-nirdesh de sakte ho?
Kya tum aakaashmandal ke adhyaadeshon ko jaante ho, ya kya tum prithvi par bhi vahi adhyaadesh prabhaavi kar sakte ho?
“Kya yah sambhav hai ki tum apna svar meghon tak prakshepit kar do, ki unmein parisimit paani tumhaare lie vipul vrishti ban jaae?
Kya tum bijli ko aisa order de sakte ho, ki ve upasthit ho tumse nivedan karein, ‘Kya command hai, aap order dein’?
Kisne baaj pakshi mein aisa knowledge sthaapit kiya hai, ya kisne murge ko purv knowledge ki kshamta provide ki hai?
Kaun hai vah, jismein aisa knowledge hai, ki vah meghon ki ganna kar leta hai? Ya kaun hai vah, jo aakaash ke paani ke matkon ko jhuka sakta hai,
Jab dhul mitti ka dhela bankar kathor ho jaati hai, aur ye dhele bhi ek dusre se mil jaate hain?
“Ayyob, kya tum sinhni ke lie shikaar karte ho, sheron ki bhukh ko mitaate ho
Jo apni kandra mein dubki baithi hai, ya jo jhaariyon mein ghaat lagaae baithi hai?
Kauvon ko paushtik aahaar kaun parosta hai, jab iske bachche God ko pukaarte hain, aur apna khaana khojte hue bhatakte rahte hain?
“Kya tumhein jaankaari hai, ki parvtiy bakriyaan kis samay bachchon ko janm deti hain? Kya tumne kabhi hirni ko apne bachche ko janm dete hue dekha hai?
Kya tumhein yah maalum hai, ki unki garbhaavastha kitne maah ki hoti hai? Ya kis samay vah unka prasav karti hai?
Prasav karte hue ve jhuk jaati hain; tab prasav dard se mukt ho jaati hain.
Unki santti hoti jaati hain, khule maidaanon mein hi unka vikaas ho jaata hai; viksit hone par ve apni maata ki or nahin lautte.
“Kisne vany gadhon ko aisi svatantrta provide ki hai? Kisne us drut gadhe ko bandhan mukt kar diya hai?
Mainne ghar ke lie use registaan provide kiya hai aur uske nivaas ke taur par namkin satah.
Use to shehron ke shor se nafrat hai; aprichit hai vah niyanta ki haank se.
Apni charaai jo parvatmaala mein hai, vah ghuma karta hai aur har ek hari vanaspti ki khoj mein rahta hai.
“Kya koi vany saanr tumhaari service karne ke lie taiyaar hoga? Ya kya vah tumhaari charni ke nikat raatri mein thahrega?
Kya tum usko rassiyon se baandhkar hal mein jot sakte ho? Ya kya vah tumhaare kheton mein tumhaare pichhe-pichhe paata khinchega?
Kya tum us par sirf isliye bharosa karoge, ki vah bahut shaktishaali hai? Aur sab shram usi ke bharose par chhor doge?
Kya tumhein us par aisa bharosa ho jaaega, ki vah tumhaari kaati gai upaj ko ghar tak pahuncha dega aur phasal khalihaan tak surakshit pahunch jaaegi?
“Kya shuturmurg khushi se apne pankh phulaati hai, uski tulna saaras ke paron se ki ja sakte hai?
Shuturmurg to apne ande zameen par rakh unhein chhor deti hai, sirf zameen ki ushnta hi rah jaati hai.
