Use to is saty ka bhi dhyaan nahin rah jaata ki un par kisi ka pair bhi par sakta hai ya koi vany pashu unhein raund bhi sakta hai.
Bachchon ke prati uska vyavhaar krur rahta hai maano unse uska koi sambandh nahin hai; use is vishay ki koi chinta nahin rahti, ki isse uska shram nirarthak rah jaaega.
God ne hi use is sima tak bewakoof kar diya hai use zara bhi saamaany bodh provide nahin kiya gaya hai.
Yah sab hone par bhi, yadi vah apni lambi kaaya ka prayog karne lagti hai, tab vah ghora aur ghurasvaar ka uphaas bana chhorti hai.
“Ayyob, ab yah bataao, kya tumne ghore ko uska saahas provide kiya hai? Kya uske gardan par kesar tumhaari rachna hai?
Kya uska tidde-jaisa uchhal jaana tumhaare dvaara sambhav hua hai, uska prabhaavshaali hinhinaana dur-dur tak aatank prasaarit kar deta hai?
Vah apne khur se ghaati ki zameen ko uchhaalta hai aur sashastr dushman ka saamna karne nikal parta hai.
Aatank ko dekh vah hans parta hai use kisi ka dar nahin hota; talvaar ko dekh vah pichhe nahin hatta.
Uski pith par rakha tarkash kharakhraata hai, vahin chamakti hui barchhi aur bhaala bhi hai.
Bari hi ris aur krodh se vah lambi duriyaan paar kar jaata hai; tab vah narsinge sunkar bhi nahin rukta.
Har ek narsing naad par vah pratyuttar deta hai, ‘Vaah!’ Use to dur hi se yuddh ki gandh a jaati hai, vah sena naaykon ka garjan aur order pahchaan leta hai.
“Ayyob, kya tumhaare paraamarsh par baaj aakaash mein uncha uthta hai aur apne pankhon ko dakshin disha ki or phailaata hai?
Kya tumhaare order par garur upar urta hai aur apna ghonsla uchch jagah par nirmaan karta hai?
Chattaan par vah apna aashray sthaapit karta hai; choti par, jo agamy hai, vah basera karta hai.
Usi bindu se vah apne aahaar ko khoj leta hai; aisi hai uski sukshmdrishti ki vah ise dur se dekh leta hai.
Jahaan kahin shav hote hain, vah vahin pahunch jaata hai aur uske bachche raktpaan karte hain.”
Tab Yahweh ne ayyob se puchha:
“Kya ab sarvshaktimaan ka virodhi apni paraajay accept karne ke lie tatpar hai ab vah uttar de? Jo God par doshaaropan karta hai!”
Tab ayyob ne Yahweh ko yah javaab diya:
“Dekhie, main nagany bekaar person, main kaun hota hun, jo aapko uttar dun? Main apne chehra par apna haath rakh leta hun.
Ek baar main dhrishtta kar chuka hun ab nahin, sambhvath do baar, lekin ab main kuchh na kahunga.”
Tab khud Yahweh ne tuphaan mein se ayyob ko javaab diya:
“Ek yoddha ke jaisa katibaddh ho jaao; ab savaal puchhne ki baari meri hai aur suchna dene ki tumhaari.
“Kya tum vaastav mein mere nirnay ko badal doge? Kya tum khud ko nirdosh pramaanit karne ke lie mujhe doshi pramaanit karoge?
Kya, tumhaari bhuja God ki bhuja jaisa hai? Kya, tu God jaisi garjna kar sakega?
To phir naam aur sammaan dhaaran kar lo, khud ko vaibhav aur aishvary mein lapet lo.
Apne barhte krodh ko nirbaadh bah jaane do, jis kisi ahankaari se tumhaara saamna ho, use jhukaate jaao.
Har ek ahankaari ko vinit bana do, har ek khare hue duraachaari ko paanvon se kuchal do.
Tab un sabhi ko zameen mein mila do; kisi gupt jagah mein unhein baandh do.
Tab main sarvaprtham tumhaari kshamta ko accept karunga, ki tumhaara daayaan haath tumhaari raksha ke lie paryaapt hai.
“Ab is saty par soch karo jaise mainne tumhein srija hai, vaise hi us vishaal jantu bahemoth ko bhi jo bail jaisa ghaas charta hai.
Uske shaaririk bal par soch karo, uski maanspeshiyon ki kshamta par soch karo!
Uski punchh devdaar vriksh ke jaisa kathor hoti hai; uski jaangh ka snaayu-tantr kaisa buna gaya hain.
Uski haddiyaan kaansy ki naliyaan jaisa hai, uske ang lohe ke chhar ke jaisa majbut hain.
Vah God ki ek utkrisht rachna hai, lekin uska rachyita use talvaar se niyantrit kar leta hai.
Parvat uske lie aahaar lekar aate hain, idhar-udhar vany pashu phirte rahte hain.
Vah kamal ke paudhe ke niche let jaata hai, jo kichar aur sarkandon ke beech mein hai.
Paudhe use chhaaya provide karte hain; aur nadiyon ke majnun vriksh uske aas-paas use ghere rahte hain.
Yadi nadi mein baarh a jaae, to uski koi haani nahin hoti; vah nishchint bana rahta hai, yadypi yardan ka paani uske chehra tak uncha uth jaata hai.
Jab vah saavdhaan sajag rahta hai tab kismein saahas hai ki use baandh le, kya koi uski naak mein chhed kar sakta hai?
“Kya tum livyaathaan ko machhli pakarne ki ankuri se khinch sakoge? Ya kya tum uski jibh ko kisi dor se baandh sako?
Kya uski naak mein rassi baandhna tumhaare lie sambhav hai, ya kya tum ankuri ke lie uske jabre mein chhed kar sakte ho?
Kya vah tumse grace ki yaachna karega? Kya vah tumse shaalintaapurvak vinay karega?
Kya vah tumse vaacha sthaapit karega? Kya tum use life bhar apna slave banaane ka koshish karoge?
Kya tum uske saath usi riti se khel sakoge jaise kisi pakshi se? Ya use apni yuvtiyon ke lie baandhkar rakh sakoge?
Kya vyaapaari uske lie vinimay karna chaaheinge? Kya vyaapaari apne lie paraspar uska vibhaajan kar sakeinge?
Kya tum uski khaal ko barchhi se bedh sakte ho ya uske sir ko bhaale se barbaad kar sakte ho?
Bas, ek hi baar us par apna haath rakhkar dekho, dusri baar tumhein yah karne ka saahas na hoga. Uske saath ka sangharsh tumhaare lie avismarniy rahega.
Vyarth hai tumhaari yah apeksha, ki tum use apne authority mein kar loge; tum to uske saamne aate hi gir jaaoge.
Koi bhi use uksaane ka dhaadhas nahin kar sakta. Tab kaun karega uska saamna?
Us par aakrman karne ke baad kaun surakshit rah sakta hai? Aakaash ke niche ki har ek vastu meri hi hai.
“Uske angon ka varnan na karne ke baare mein main chup rahunga, na hi uski bari power aur uske sundar deh ka.
Kaun uske baahy aavran ko utaar sakta hai? Kaun iske lie saahas karega ki usmein baagdor daal sake?
Kaun uske chehra ke dvaar kholne mein samarth hoga, jo uske bhayaavah daanton se ghira hai?
Uski pith par dhaalein panktibaddh rup se bichhi hui hain aur ye bahut dridhtaapurvak vahaan lagi hui hain;
Ve is riti se ek dusre se sati hui hain, ki inmein se vaayu tak nahin nikal sakti.
Ve sabhi ek dusre se juri hui hain unhonne ek dusre ko aisa jakar rakha hai; ki inhein tora nahin ja sakta.
Uski chhink to aag ki laptein prakshepit kar deti hai; aur uske netr ushaakiran jaisa dikhte hain.
Uske chehra se jvalant mashaalein reveal rahti; aur inke saath chingaariyaan bhi jharti rahti hain.
Uske naak se dhuaan uthta rahta hai, maano kisi ubalte paatr se, jo jalte hue sarkandon ke upar rakha hua hai.
Uski shvaas koylon ko prajvlit kar deti, uske chehra se agnishikha nikalti rahti hai.
Uske gardan mein power ka nivaas hai, to uske aage-aage niraasha barhti jaati hai.
Uski maanspeshiyaan uski deh par achal aur drirh,
Aur uska dil to patthar jaisa kathor hai! Haan! Chakki ke nichle paat ke patthar jaisa!
Jab-jab vah uthkar khara hota hai, shurvir bhaybhit ho jaate hain. Uske prahaar ke dar se ve pichhe hat jaate hain.
Us par jis kisi talvaar se prahaar kiya jaata hai, vah prabhaavhin rah jaati hai, vaise hi us par barchhi, bhaale aur baan bhi.
Uske saamne lauh bhusa jaisa hota hai, aur kaansa sar rahe lakri ke jaisa.
Baan ka dar use bhaga nahin sakta. Gophan prakshepit patthar to uske saamne kaati upaj ke thunth prahaar jaisa hota hai.
Laathi ka prahaar bhi thunth ke prahaar jaisa hota hai, vah to barchhi ki dhvani sun hansne lagta hai.
Uske pet par jo jhuriya hain, ve mitti ke tute thikre jaisa hain. Kichar par chalte hue vah aisa lagta hai, maano vah anaaj kutne ka patta jaisa chinh chhor raha hai.
Uske prabhaav se mahaasaagar paani, aisa dikhta hai maano haanri mein uphaan a gaya ho. Tab saagar aisa ho jaata, maano vah marham ka paatr ho.
Vah apne pichhe ek chamkili lakir chhorta jaata hai yah drishy aisa ho jaata hai, maano yah kisi vriddh ka sir hai.
Prithvi par uske jaisa kuchh bhi nahin hai; ekmaatr nirbhik rachna!
Uske aanklan mein sarvochch rachnaaein bhi nagany hain; vah sab ahankaariyon ka raaja hai.”
Tab ayyob ne Yahweh ko yah javaab diya:
“Mere Lord, mujhe maalum hai ki aap sabhi kuchh kar sakte hain; aur aapki kisi bhi yojna viphal nahin hoti.

Aapne puchha tha, ‘Kaun hai vah ajnaani, jo mere knowledge par aavran daal deta hai?’ Yahi kaaran hai ki main accept kar raha hun, ki mujhe in vishyon ka koi knowledge na tha, main nahin samajh saka, ki kya-kya ho raha tha, aur jo kuchh ho raha tha, vah vismaykaari tha.
“Aapne kaha tha, ‘Ab tum chup raho; ki ab main sanvaad kar sakun, tab savaal main karunga, ki tum inka uttar do.’
Iske purv aapka knowledge mere lie sirf samaachaar hi tha, lekin ab aapko meri aankhein dekh chuki hain.
Isliye ab main khud ko ghrinaaspad samajh raha hun, main iske lie dhul aur bhasm mein praayashchit karta hun.”

Ayyob se apna aakhyaan samaapt karke Yahweh ne temaani eliphaaz se puchha, “Main tumse aur tumhaare donon mitron se aprsann hun, kyonki tumne mere baare mein vah sab abhivyakt nahin kiya, jo sahi hai, jaisa mere servant ayyob ne reveal kiya tha.

Tab ab tum saat bachhre aur saat merhe lo aur mere servant ayyob ke paas jaakar apne lie homabli arpit karo aur mera servant ayyob tumhaare lie prayer karega, kyonki main uski yaachna accept kar lunga, ki tumhaari murkhta ke anurup vyavhaar na karun, kyonki tumne mere baare mein vah sab abhivyakt nahin kiya, jo upyukt tha jaisa ayyob ne kiya tha.”
Tab temaani eliphaaz ne, shuhi bildad ne aur naaamthi zophar ne Yahweh ke order ke hisaab se anupaalan kiya aur Yahweh ne ayyob ki yaachna accept kar li.
Jab ayyob apne mitron ke lie prayer kar chuke, tab Yahweh ne ayyob ki property ko purvaavastha mein kar diya aur jo kuchh ayyob ka tha, use do guna kar diya.

Kaalaantar unke sab bhaai bahnon aur purv parichiton ne unke ghar par aakar bhoj mein unke saath sangti ki. Unhonne un par Yahweh dvaara sab vipattiyon ke sambandh mein sahaanubhuti aur saantvna di. Unmein se har ek ne ayyob ko dhanraashi aur sone ke sikke bheint mein diye.

Yahweh ne ayyob ke in uttar varshon ko unke purv varshon ki apeksha kahin adhik blessed kiya. Unki property mein ab chaudah hajaar bherein, chhah hajaar unt, ek hajaar jore bail aur ek hajaar gadhiyaan ho gain.
Unke saat son aur tin putriyaan huin.
Pahli putri ka naam unhonne yamimaah, dusri ka keziaah, tisri ka keren-happukh rakha.
Sab desh mein ayyob ki putriyon jaisa saundary anyatr nahin thi. Unke pita ne unhein unke bhaaiyon ke saath hi miraas di.
Iske baad ayyob ek sau chaalis varsh aur jivit rahe. Unhonne chaar pirhiyon tak apne son aur pautr dekhe.
Vriddh ayyob apni purn paripakv aayu mein chale gaye.
Kaisa blessed hai vah aadmi jo evil logon ki sammti ka aachran nahin karta, na galti karnevaalon ke raasta par khara rahta aur na hi uphaas karnevaalon ki baithak mein baithta hai,
Iske viprit uska ullaas Yahweh ki law ka follow karne mein hai, usi ka manan vah din-raat karta rahta hai.
Vah bahti jaldhaaraaon ke tat par lagaae gae us vriksh ke jaisa hai, jo upyukt ritu mein phal deta hai jiski pattiyaan kabhi murjhaati nahin. Aisa aadmi jo kuchh karta hai usmein saphal hota hai.
Lekin evil aise nahin hote! Ve us bhuse ke jaisa hote hain, jise pavan ura le jaati hai.
Tab evil justice mein tik nahin paaeinge, aur na hi galti karnevaala dharmiyon ke mandli mein.
Nishchyath Yahweh dharmiyon ke aachran ko sukh samriddhi se sampann karte hain, lekin evil logon ko unka aachran hi barbaad kar daalega.
Kyon macha rahe hain raashtr yah khalabli? Kyon desh-desh jute hain viphal sharyantr ki rachna mein?
Yahweh aur unke abhishikt ke virodh mein duniya ke raajaaon ne eka kiya hai ekjut hokar shaasak sammti kar rahe hain:
“Chalo, tor pheinkein unke dvaara daali gai ye beriyaan, utaar daalein unke dvaara baandhi gai ye rassiyaan.”
Vah, jo svargik sinhaasan par viraajmaan hain, un par hanste hain, Lord unka uphaas karte hain.
Tab vah unhein apne prakop se daraakar apne rosh mein unhein sambodhit karte hain,
“Apne holy parvat ziyon par khud mainne apne raaja ko basa diya hai.”
Main Yahweh ki raajaajna ki ghoshna karunga: unhonne mujhse kaha hai, “Tum mere son ho; aaj main tumhaara janak ho gaya hun.
Mujhse maango, to main tumhein raashtr de dunga aur sampurn prithvi ko tumhaari nij property bana dunga.
Tum unhein lohe ke chhar se tukre-tukre kar daaloge; mitti ke paatron jaisa chur-chur kar doge.”
Tab raajaao, wise bano; prithvi ke nyaayiyon, sachet ho jaao.
Shraddha bhaav mein Yahweh ki worship karo; tharathraate hue khushi manaao.

Purn sach mein son ko sammaan do, aisa na ho ki vah krodhit ho jaae aur tum raasta mein hi barbaad ho jaao, kyonki uska krodh shighr bharakta hai. Blessed hote hain ve sabhi, jo unka aashray lete hain.
Yahweh! Kitne saare hain mere dushman! Kitne hain jo mere virodh mein uth khare hue hain!
Ve mere baare mein kahne lage hain, “God use bachaav provide nahin kareinge.”
Lekin, Yahweh, aap sadaiv hi jokhim mein meri dhaal hain, aap hi hain meri glory, aap mera mastak uncha karte hain.
Yahweh! Mainne uchch svar mein aapko pukaara hai, aur aapne apne holy parvat se mujhe javaab diya.
Main letta aur nishchint so jaata hun; main punh sakushal jaag uthta hun, kyonki Yahweh meri raksha kar rahe the.
Mujhe un asankhy dushmanon ka koi dar nahin jinhonne mujhe chaaron or se gher liya hai.
Uthie Yahweh! Mere God, aakar mujhe bachaaie! Nihsandeh aap mere sab dushmanon ke jabre par prahaar karein; aap un evil logon ke daant tor daalein.
Bachaav to Yahweh mein hi hai, aapki people par aapki kripaadrishti bani rahe!
He mere dharmmay God, jab main pukaarun, mujhe uttar dein! Aapne mere sankat ke samay meri madad ki; ab apne grace mein meri prayer ka uttar dein.
Manushyo! Kab tak tum mera apmaan karte rahoge? Kab tak tum chhal se love aur uski khoj karte rahoge, jo nirarthak hai, jo sirf jhuthi hi hai?
Yah smaran rakho ki Yahweh ne apne bhakt ko apne nimitt alag kar rakha hai; jab main pukaarun Yahweh meri suneinge.
Shraddha mein galti ka parityaag kar do; shaant ho jaao, bichhaune par lete hue aatm-parikshan karo.
Law dvaara nirdhaarit bali arpan karo aur Yahweh par bharosa karo.
Kai hain, jo kahte hain, “Kaun hai, jo hamein yah darshaaega ki kya hai upyukt aur kya hai bhala?” Yahweh, ham par apne chehra ka prakaash chamkaaein.
Jinhein ann aur daakhamdhu ki bari upaj receive hui hai, unse bhi adhik khushi se aapne mere dil bhar diya hai.
Main shaantipurvak letunga aur so jaaunga, kyonki Yahweh, sirf aap hi mujhe, surakshaapurn vishraam provide karte hain.
Yahweh, mere vachnon par dhyaan dein, mere words ki aahon par soch karein.
Mere God, mere raaja, madad ke lie meri pukaar par dhyaan dein, kyonki Yahweh, meri yah prayer aapse hai.
Yahweh, aap praatahkaal meri vaani suneinge; suryoday ke samay main aapko bali arpit karunga aur aapke pratyuttar ki pratiksha karunga.
Nihsandeh aap vah God nahin, jo dushtta ka samarthan karein; vastuth buraai aapke saath nahin rah sakti.
Ghamandi aapki upasthiti mein thahar nahin sakte, evil aapke lie ghrinaaspad hain;
Jhuth bolne vaalon ka aap vinaash karte hain. Hatyaaron aur dhurton se, Yahweh, ko nafrat hai.
Lekin aapke, apaar love ke baahuly ke parinaamasvrup main, aapke aavaas mein pravesh kar sakunga; purn shraddha mein jhukkar main aapke holy temple mein worship karunga.
Yahweh, mere dushmanon ke kaaran apne dharmmay raasta par meri aguvaai karein; mere aage-aage apne sidhe raasta ko dikha.
Mere dushmanon ka ek bhi word sachcha nahin hai; unke dil buraai se bhare hain. Unka gala khuli hui kabr jaisa hai; unki jibh chikni-chupri baatein karti hai.

Lord God! Aap un par dand-command prasaarit karein, ki apni hi yuktiyon ke jaal mein phanskar unka barbaadi ho jaae, unke apraadhon ki adhikta ke kaaran aap unhein apni upasthiti se dur karein, kyonki unhonne aapke khilaaf balva kiya hai.
Aanandit hon aapke sabhi sharnaagat; sadaiv ho unka khushi. Aap unhein surakshit rakhein, jo aapse love rakhte hain, ve sadaiv ullsit rahein.
Yahweh, dharmiyon par aapki kripaadrishti bani rahti hai; aap apne grace mein unhein dhaal ke jaisa suraksha provide karte hain.
Yahweh, apne krodh mein mujhe na daantein, jhunjhlaahat mein meri taarna na karein.
Grace karein, Yahweh, main shithil ho chuka hun; mujhmein power ka sanchaar karein, meri haddiyon ko bhi dard ne jakar liya hai.
Mere jaan ghor dard mein hain. Yahweh, aap kab tak thahre raheinge?
Yahweh, aakar mujhe bacha lijie; apne mercy-love ke nimitt mujhe bacha lijie.
Kyonki mrit avastha mein aapka smaran karna sambhav nahin. Adholok mein kaun aapka praise kar sakta hai?
Karaahte-karaahte main thak chuka hun, prati raatri mere aansuon se mera bichhauna bhig jaata hai, mere aansu mera takiya bhigote rahte hain.
Shok se meri aankhein nistej ho gai hain; mere dushmanon ke kaaran meri aankhein kshin ho chuki hain.
Dushto, dur raho mujhse, Yahweh ne mere rone ka word sun liya hai.
Yahweh ne mera girgiraana suna hai; Yahweh meri prayer accept kar leinge.
Mere sab dushman lajjit kie jaaeinge, ve purnath niraash ho jaaeinge; ve pith dikhaaeinge aur tatkaal hi lajjit kie jaaeinge!
Yahweh, mere God! Main aapke hi aashray mein aaya hun; un sabse mujhe bacha lijie, jo mera pichha kar rahe hain, un sabse meri raksha kijie,
Anytha ve mere jaan ko sinh ki naai phaarkar tukre-tukre kar daaleinge, jabki mujhe chhuraane ke lie vahaan koi bhi na hoga.
Yahweh, mere God, yadi mainne vah kiya hai, jaisa ve kah rahe hain, yadi main kisi anuchit kaary ka doshi hun,
Yadi mainne uski buraai ki hai, jiske saath mere shaantipurn sambandh the, ya mainne apne dushman ko akaaran hi mukt kar diya hai,
To dushman mera pichha kare aur mujhe pakar le; vah mujhe pairon se kuchalkar maar daale aur meri glory ko dhul mein mila de.
Yahweh, kop mein uthie; mere dushmanon ke khilaaf bahut jhunjhlaahat ke saath uthiye. Apne nirdhaarit justice-dand ke anurup mere paksh mein madad kijie.
Aapke chaaron or vishv ke sab raashtr ekatr hon aur aap punh unke beech apne nirdhaarit uchchaasan par viraajmaan ho jaaie,
Yahweh hi raashtron ke nyaayaadhyaksh hain. Yahweh, meri sach, aur imaandaari ke kaaran mera justice karein,
Evil ke dushkarm samaapt ho jaaein aap imaandaari ko sthir karein, aap hi yukt God hain. Aap hi hain, jo man ke vichaaron aur marm ki vivechna karte hain.
God meri suraksha ki dhaal hain, vahi sidhe manvaalon ko bachaate hain.
God yukt nyaayaadhyaksh hain, aise God, jo sadaiv hi buraai se krodh karte hain.
Yadi insaan pashchaattaap na kare, God apni talvaar ki dhaar tikshn karte hain; vah apna dhanush saadh baan dori par charha lete hain.
God ne apne ghaatak shastr taiyaar kar lie hain; unhonne apne baanon ko agnibaan bana liya hai.
Evil jan vinaash ki yojnaaon ko apne garbh mein dhaaran kie hue hain, ve jhuth ka janm dete hain.
Usne zameen khodi aur gaddha banaaya aur vah apne hi khode hue gaddhe mein ja gira.
Uski vinaashak yuktiyaan lautkar usi ke sir par a pareingi; uski hinsa usi ki khopri par a utregi.
Main Yahweh ko unke dharm ke hisaab se thanks dunga; main sarvochch Yahweh ke naam ka praise karunga.
Yahweh, hamaare Lord, sab prithvi par kitna tejmay hai aapka naam! Heaven par aapne apne vaibhav ko pradarshit kiya hai.
Aapne apne dushmanon ke kaaran baalkon aur shishuon ke chehra se apna bal basa liya, ki aapke virodhiyon aur dushman ka ant ho jaae.
Jab main aapki ungliyon, dvaara racha aakaash, chandrma aur nakshatron ko, jinhein aapne yathaasthaan par sthaapit kiya, dekhta hun,
Tab main soch karta hun: insaan hai hi kya, ki aap uski or dhyaan dein? Kya visheshta hai maanav mein ki aap uske baare mein soch bhi karein?
Aapne use apni srishti ka prashaasak banaaya; aapne sabhi kuchh uske authority mein de diya:
Bher-bakri, gaay-bail, aur vany pashu,
Aakaash ke pakshi, aur samudr ki machhliyaan, aur samudri dhaaraaon mein chalte phirte sabhi jalchar bhi.
Yahweh, hamaare Lord, sab prithvi par kitna tejmay hai aapka naam!
Yahweh, main sampurn dil se aapka aabhaar maanunga; main aapke har ek aashchary karmon ka varnan karunga.
Main aap mein ullsit hokar khushi manaata hun; sarvochch Lord, main aapka bhajan gaata hun.
Jab mere dushman pith dikhaakar bhaage; ve aapki upasthiti ke kaaran barbaadi hokar larakhra kar gir pare.
Aapne justice kiya aur mere paksh mein nirnay diya, aapne apne sinhaasan par baith sach mein justice kiya.
Aapne jantaaon ko daanta aur evil logon ko barbaad kar diya; aapne hamesha ke lie unka naam mita diya.
Koi bhi dushman shesh na raha, unke shehar ab sthaayi vidhvans sirf rah gae hain; dushman ka naam bhi shesh na raha.
Lekin Yahweh sadaiv sinhaasan par viraajmaan hain; unhonne apna sinhaasan justice ke lie sthaapit kiya hai.
Vah duniya ka justice aur raashtron ka nirnay righteousness se karte hain.
Yahweh hi duhkhit ko sharan dete hain, sankat ke samay vahi uncha garh hain.
Jinhonne aapki glory ko pahchaan liya hai, ve aap par bharosa kareinge, Yahweh, jinhonne aapse prayer ki, aapne unhein niraash na hone diya.
Yahweh ka gungaan karo, jo ziyon mein sinhaasan par viraajmaan hain; raashtron mein unke aashchary kaaryon ki udghoshna karo.
Vah, jo piriton ke badla lenevaale hain, unhein smaran rakhte hain; dinon ki vaani ko vah ansuni nahin karte.
He Yahweh, mujh par kripaadrishti kijie! Meri dard par nazar kijie. Aap hi hain, jo mujhe maut-dvaar ke nikat se jhapatkar utha sakte hain,
Ki main ziyon ki putri ke dvaaron ke bhitar aapke har ek gun ka varnan karun, ki main aapke dvaara kie bachaav mein ullsit houn.
Dusre janta usi gaddhe mein ja gire, jise khud unhin ne khoda tha; unke pair usi jaal mein ja phanse, jise unhonne bichhaaya tha.
Yahweh ne khud ko reveal kiya, unhonne justice sampann kiya; evil apne hi phande mein ulajh kar rah gae.
Evil adholok mein laut jaaeinge, yahi niyti hai un sabhi raashtron ki bhi, jinhonne God ki upeksha ki hai.
Din daridr hamesha bhula nahin die jaaeinge; piriton ki ummid hamesha ke lie chur nahin hogi.
Yahweh, aap uth jaaein, ki koi insaan prabal na ho jaae; jantaaon ka justice aapke saamne ho.
Yahweh, aap unhein bhaybhit kar dein; jantaaon ko yah bodh ho jaae ki ve sirf insaan hain.
Yahweh, aap dur kyon khare hain? Sankat ke samay aap khud ko kyon chhipa lete hain?
Durjan apne ahankaar mein ashaay nirdhan ko khaderte hain, durjan apni hi rachi gai yuktiyon mein phanskar rah jaaein.
Durjan ki manokaamna purn hoti jaati hai, tab vah iska ghamand karta hai; laalchi aadmi Yahweh ki ninda karta aur unse alag ho jaata hai.
Evil apne ahankaar mein God ki kaamna hi nahin karta; vah apne man mein sirf yahi soch karta rahta hai: God hai hi nahin.
Evil ke koshish sadaiv saphal hote jaate hain; uske saamne aapke orders ka koi mahatv hai hi nahin; uske sab virodhi uske saamne tuchchh hain.
Vah khud ko aashvaasan deta rahta hai: “Main vichlit na hounga, meri kisi bhi pirhi mein koi bhi vipda nahin a sakti.”
Uska chehra shaap, chhal aur atyaachaar se bhara rahta hai; uski jibh utpaat aur dushtta chhipaae rahti hai.
Vah gaanvon ke nikat ghaat lagaae baitha rahta hai; vah chhipkar nirdosh ki murder karta hai. Uski aankhein chupchaap ashaay ki taak mein rahti hain;
Vah pratiksha mein ghaat lagaae hue baitha rahta hai, jaise jhaari mein sinh. Ghaat mein baithe hue uska lakshy hota hai nirdhan-duhkhi, vah use apne jaal mein phansa ghasitkar le jaata hai.
Vah duhkhi dab kar jhuk jaata; aur uski power ke saamne paraajit ho jaata hai.
Us evil ki yah maanyta hai, “God sab bhul chuke hain; unhonne apna chehra chhipa liya hai, vah yah sab kabhi nahin dekheinge.”
Yahweh, uthie, apna haath uthaaiye, God! In evil logon ko dand dijie, duhkhiton ko bhula na dijie.
Evil God ka tiraskaar karte hue apne man mein kyon kahta rahta hai, “God iska lekha leinge hi nahin”?

Lekin nihsandeh aapne sab kuchh dekha hai, aapne yaatna aur utpiran par dhyaan diya hai; aap situation ko apne niyantran mein le lein. Duhkhi aur laachaar khud ko aapke haathon mein saump rahe hain; kyonki aap hi sahaayak hain anaathon ke.
Kutil aur evil ka bhujbal tor dijie; uski dushtta ka lekha us samay tak lete rahie jab tak kuchh bhi dushtta shesh na rah jaae.
Hamesha-hamesha ke lie Yahweh mahaaraajaadhiraaj hain; unke raajy mein se dusre janta mit gae hain.
Yahweh, aapne vinit ki abhilaasha par nazar ki hai; aap unke dil ko aashvaasan provide kareinge,
Anaath aur duhkhit ki raksha ke lie, aapka dhyaan unki vaani par laga rahega ki mitti se bana maanav ab se punh aatank prasaarit na kare.
Mainne Yahweh mein aashray liya hai, phir tum mujhse yah kyon kah rahe ho: “Panchhi ke jaisa apne parvat ko ur ja.
Saavdhaan! Evil ne apna dhanush saadh liya hai; aur usne dhanush par baan bhi charha liya hai, ki andhera mein sidhe logon ki murder kar de.
Yadi aadhaar hi barbaad ho jaae, to righteous ke paas kaun sa vikalp shesh rah jaata hai?”
Yahweh apne holy temple mein hain; unka sinhaasan heaven mein basa hai. Unki nazar sarvatr insaanon ko dekhti hai; unki sukshmdrishti har ek ko parakhti rahti hai.
Yahweh ki nazar righteous aur evil donon ko parakhti hai, Yahweh ke aatma hinsa dear aadmiyon se nafrat karte hain.
Evil logon par vah phandon ki vrishti kareinge, unke pyaale mein unka ansh hoga agni; gandhak aur prachand hava.
Yahweh yukt hain, righteous hi unhein dear hain; righteous jan unka munh dekhne paaeinge.
Yahweh, hamaari raksha kijie, koi bhakt ab shesh na raha; insaanon ke beech se faithful aadmi nahin rahe.
Insaan insaan se jhuthi baatein kar raha hai; ve chaaplusi karte hue ek dusre ka chhal karte hain.
Achchha hoga yadi Yahweh chaaplusi honthon aur ghamandi jibh ko kaat daalein.
Ve ding maarte hue kahte hain, “Power hamaari jibh mein magan hai; onth hamaare vash mein hain. Kaun ho sakta hai hamaara maalik?”

Lekin ab Yahweh ka kahna hai, “Duhkhiton ke prati ki gai hinsa ke kaaran, nirdhnon ki karun vaani ke kaaran main unke paksh mein uth khara hounga. Main unhein vahi suraksha provide karunga, ve jiski kaamna kar rahe hain.”
Yahweh ka vachan shuddh hai, us chaandi-jaisa hain, jise bhatti mein saat baar tapa kar shuddh kiya gaya hai.
Yahweh, unhein apni suraksha mein banaae rakheinge unhein is pirhi se hamesha suraksha provide kareinge,
Jab insaanon dvaara nichta ka aadar kiya jaata hai, tab evil chaaron aur akar kar chalte phirte hain.
Kab tak, Yahweh? Kab tak aap mujhe bhula rakheinge, kya hamesha ke lie? Kab tak aap mujhse apna chehra chhipaae raheinge?
Kab tak main apne man ko samjhaata rahun? Kab tak din-raat mera dil vedna sahta rahega? Kab tak mere dushman mujh par prabal hote raheinge?
Yahweh, mere God, meri or dhyaan de mujhe uttar dijie. Meri aankhon ko jyotirmay kijie, aisa na ho ki main maut ki nind mein sama jaaun,
Tab to nihsandeh mere dushman yah ghoshna kareinge, “Hamne use barbaadi kar diya,” Aisa na ho ki mera larakhraana mere virodhiyon ke lie khushi ka vishay ban jaae.
Jahaan tak mera sambandh hai, Yahweh, mujhe aapke mercy-love par bharosa hai; tab mera dil aapke dvaara kie bachaav mein magan hoga.
Main Yahweh ka bhajan gaaunga, kyonki unhonne mujh par anekaanek upkaar kie hain.
Bewakoof man hi man mein kahte hain, “God hai hi nahin.” Ve sabhi bhrasht hain aur unke kaam ghinaune hain; aisa koi bhi nahin, jo bhalaai karta ho.
Heaven se Yahweh insaanon par nazar daalte hain is ummid mein ki koi to hoga, jo wise hai, jo God ki khoj karta ho.
Sabhi insaan bhatak gae hain, sabhi naitik rup se bhrasht ho chuke hain; koi bhi satkarm paropkaar nahin karta, haan, ek bhi nahin.
Meri people ke ye bhakshak, ye evil aadmi, kya aise nirbuddhi hain? Jo use aise kha jaate hain, jaise roti ko; kya unhein Yahweh ki upaasna ka koi dhyaan nahin?
Vahaan ve bahut ghabra gaye hain, kyonki God righteous pirhi ke paksh mein hote hain.
Tum duhkhit ko lajjit karne ki yukti kar rahe ho, lekin unka aashray Yahweh hain.
Kaisa uttam hota yadi Israel ka bachaav ziyon se pragat hota! Yaakob ke lie vah harshollaas ka avsar hoga, jab Yahweh apni people ko daasatv se lauta laaeinge, tab Israel aanandit ho jaaega!
Yahweh, kaun aapke tambu mein rah sakega? Kaun aapke holy parvat par nivaas kar sakega?
Vahi, jiska aachran nishklank hai, jo righteousness ka aachran karta hai, jo dil se sach bolta hai;
Jiski jibh se ninda ke word nahin nikalte, jo na to apne parosi ki buraai karta hai, aur na apne kisi mitr ki,
Jiske lie Yahweh ki nazar mein nikamma aadmi ghrinit hai, lekin Yahweh ka dar maannevaale aadmi sammaany; jo har muly par apni promise purn karta hai, chaahe uski haani hi kyon na ho;
Jo rin dekar byaaj nahin leta; aur nirdosh ke khilaaf jhuthi gavaahi dene ke purpose se ghus nahin leta. Is tarah ke aachran ka aadmi sadaiv sthir rahega vah kabhi na dagamgaaega.
God, mujhe suraksha provide kijie, kyonki mainne aap mein aashray liya hai.
Yahweh se mainne kaha, “Aap hi Lord hain; vastuth aapko chhor mera hit sambhav hi nahin.”
Prithvi par aapke log holy glorious hain, “Ve hi mere sukh aur khushi ka srot hain.”
Ve, jo dusre devtaaon ke pichhe bhaagte hain, unke kleshon mein vriddhi hoti jaaegi. Main un devtaaon ke lie na to rakt ki pey bali undelunga aur na main unka naam apne honthon par laaunga.
Yahweh, aap mera hissa hain, aap hi mera bhaag hain; aap hi mujhe suraksha provide karte hain.
Maap ki dor ne mere lie ramniy jagah nirdhaarit kie hain; nihsandeh mera bhaag aakarshak hai.
Main Yahweh ko stuty kahunga, jinhonne mera maargdarshan kiya hai; raatri mein bhi mera antahkran mujhe teaching deta hai.
Mainne sadaiv hi Yahweh ki upasthiti ka bodh apne saamne banaae rakha hai. Jab vah nit mere daayein paksh mein rahte hain, to bhala main kaise larakhra sakta hun.
Isliye mera dil aanandit aur meri jibh magan hui; mera body bhi suraksha mein vishraam karega,
Kyonki aap mere jaan ko adholok mein sarne nahin chhor deinge, aur na apne manchaahe dear paatr ko maut ke kshay mein.
Aap mujh par hamesha life ka raasta prakaashit kareinge; aapki upasthiti mein param khushi hai, aapke daahine haath mein hamesha sukh bana rahta hai.
Yahweh, mera justice sangat, anurodh sunie; meri pukaar par dhyaan dijie. Meri prayer ko sun lijie, jo kapti honthon se nikle word nahin hain.
Aapke dvaara mera justice kiya jaae; aapki nazar mein vahi aae jo dharmmay hai.
Aap mere dil ko parakh chuke hain, raatri mein aapne mera dhyaan rakha hai, aapne mujhe parakhkar nirdosh paaya hai; mainne yah nishchay kiya hai ki mere chehra se koi apraadh na hoga.
Insaanon ke aachran ke sandarbh mein, thik aapke hi order ke anurup main hinsak insaanon ke raaston se dur hi dur raha hun.
Mere paanv aapke raaston par drirh rahein; aur mere paanv larakhraae nahin.
Mainne aapko hi pukaara hai, kyonki God, aap mujhe uttar deinge; meri or kaan lagaakar meri binti ko sunie.
Apne dushmanon ke paas se aapke daayein paksh mein aae hue sharnaagton ke rakshak, un par apne mercy-love ka aashchary pradarshan kijie.
Apne aankhon ki putli ke jaisa meri suraksha kijie; apne pankhon ki aar mein mujhe chhipa lijie
Un evil logon se, jo mujh par prahaar karte rahte hain, un praanghaatak dushmanon se, jinhonne mujhe gher liya hai.
Unke dil kathor ho chuke hain, unke word ghamandi hain.
Ve mera pichha karte rahe hain aur ab unhonne mujhe gher liya hai. Unki aankhein mujhe khoj rahi hain, ki ve mujhe dharti par patak dein.
Vah us sinh ke jaisa hai jo phaar khaane ko tatpar hai, us javaan sinh ke jaisa jo ghaat lagaae chhipa baitha hai.
Uthie, Yahweh, uska saamna kijie, use barbaadi kijie; apni talvaar ke dvaara durjan se mere jaan bacha lijie,

Yahweh, apne haathon dvaara, un insaanon se, un saansaarik insaanon se jinka bhaag sirf isi life mein magan hai. Unka pet aap apni nidhi se paripurn kar dete hain; children paakar ve prasann hain, aur ve apni samriddhi apni children ke lie chhor jaate hain.
Apni righteousness ke kaaran main aapke chehra ka darshan karunga; jab main praath aankhein kholun, to aapke svarup ka darshan mujhe khushi se tript kar dega.
Yahweh, mere power, main aapse love karta hun.
Yahweh meri chattaan, mera garh aur mere chhuraanevaale hain; mere God, mere lie chattaan hain, jinmein main aasra leta hun, vah meri dhaal aur mere bachaav ka sing, vah mera garh.
Main dohaai Yahweh ki deta hun, sirph vahi praise ke yogy hain, aur main dushmanon se chhutkaara pa leta hun.
Maut ki lahron mein ghir chuka tha; mujh par vidhvans ki tej dhaara ka vaar ho raha tha.
Adholok ke tantuon ne mujhe uljha liya tha; main maut ke jaal ke aamne-saamne a gaya tha.
Apni vedna mein mainne Yahweh ki dohaai di; mainne apne hi God ko pukaara. Apne temple mein unhonne meri aavaaj sun li, unke kaanon mein mera rona ja para.
Prithvi jhulkar kaampne lagi, pahaaron ki ninv tharathra uthi; aur kaampne lagi. Kyonki Lord kruddh the.
Unke nathunon se dhuaan uth raha tha; unke chehra ki aag chat karti ja rahi thi, usne koylon ko dahka rakha tha.
Unhonne aakaashmandal ko jhukaaya aur utar aae; unke pairon ke niche ghana andhera tha.
Vah karub par charhkar ur gae; vah hava ke pankhon par charhkar ur gaye!
Unhonne andhera orh liya, vah unka chhaata ban gaya, ghane-kaale varsha ke megh mein ghire hue.
Unki upasthiti ke tej se megh olon aur bijliyaan ke saath aage barh rahe the.
Heaven se Yahweh ne garjan ki aur param leader ne apne word sunaae.
Unhonne baan chhore aur unhein bikhra diya, bijliyon ne unke pair ukhaar die.
Yahweh ki prataarna se, nathunon se unke saans ke jhonke se saagar ke jalmaarg dikhaai dene lage; duniya ki nivein khul gain.
Unhonne heaven se haath barhaakar mujhe thaam liya; prabal paani pravaah se unhonne mujhe baahar nikaal liya.
Unhonne mujhe mere prabal dushman se mukt kiya, unse, jinhein mujhse nafrat thi, ve mujhse kahin adhik shaktimaan the.
Sankat ke din unhonne mujh par aakrman kar diya tha, lekin meri madad Yahweh mein magan thi.
Vah mujhe khule jagah par le aae; mujhse apni prasannta ke kaaran unhonne mujhe chhuraaya hai.
Meri bhalaai ke hisaab se hi Yahweh ne mujhe pratiphal diya hai; mere haathon ki svachchhta ke hisaab se unhonne mujhe inaam diya hai.
Main Yahweh ki nitiyon ka follow karta raha hun; mainne God ke khilaaf koi duraachaar nahin kiya hai.
Unki saari niyam sanhita mere saamne bani rahi; unke niymon se main kabhi bhi vichlit nahin hua.
Main unke saamne nirdosh bana raha, dosh bhaav mujhse dur hi dur raha.
Isliye Yahweh ne mujhe meri bhalaai ke hisaab se hi pratiphal diya hai, unki nazron mein mere haathon ki shuddhta ke hisaab se.
Sachche logon ke prati aap khud faithful saabit hote hain, nirdosh person par aap khud ko nirdosh hi reveal karte hain.
Vah, jo nirmal hai, us par apni nirmalta reveal karte hain, kutil person par aap apni chaturta pragat karte hain.
Aap vinamr ko suraksha provide karte hain, lekin aap nicha unko kar dete hain, jinki aankhein ahankaar se charhi hoti hain.
Yahweh, aap mere dipak ko jalaate rahiye, mere God, aap mere andhera ko jyotirmay kar dete hain.
Jab aap meri or hain, to main sena se takkar le sakta hun; mere God ke kaaran main divaar tak phaand sakta hun.
Yah vah God hain, jinki nitiyaan khari hain: taaya hua hai Yahweh ka vachan; apne sabhi sharnaagton ke lie vah dhaal ban jaate hain.
Kyonki Yahweh ke alaava koi God hai? Aur hamaare God ke alaava koi chattaan hai?
Vahi God mere majbut aasra hain; vah nirdosh person ko apne raasta par chalaate hain.
Unhin ne mere paanvon ko hiran ke paanvon ke jaisa bana diya hai; unche jagahon par vah mujhe suraksha dete hain.
Vah mere haathon ko yuddh ke lie prashikshit karte hain; ab meri baanhein kaanse ke dhanush ko bhi istemaal kar leti hain.
Aapne mujhe bachaav ki dhaal provide ki hai, aapka daayaan haath mujhe thaame hue hai; aapki saumyta ne mujhe glory provide ki hai.
Mere paanvon ke lie aapne chaura raasta diya hai, ismein mere pagon ke lie koi phislan nahin hai.
Mainne apne dushmanon ka pichha kar unhein barbaadi kar diya hai; jab tak ve puri tarah barbaadi na ho gae main lautkar nahin aaya.
Mainne unhein aisa kuchal diya ki ve punh sir na utha sakein; ve to mere pairon mein a gire.
Aapne mujhe yuddh ke lie zaruri power se bhar diya; aapne unhein, jo mere khilaaf uth khare hue the, mere saamne jhuka diya.
Aapne mere dushmanon ko pith dikhaakar bhaagne par vivash kar diya, ve mere virodhi the. Mainne unhein barbaad kar diya.
Unhonne madad ke lie pukaara, magar unki raksha ke lie koi bhi na aaya. Unhonne Yahweh ki bhi dohaai di, magar unhonne bhi unhein uttar na diya.
Mainne unhein aisa kuchla ki ve pavan mein urti dhul se ho gae; mainne unhein raasta ke kichar ke jaisa apne pairon se raund daala.

Aapne mujhe mere sajaatiyon ke dvaara uthaae kalah se chhutkaara diya hai; aapne mujhe saare raashtron par sabse upar banaae rakha; ab ve log meri service kar rahe hain, jinse main puri tarah aprichit hun.
Videshi meri upasthiti mein slave ki tarah vyavhaar karte aae; jaise hi unhein mere baare mein maalum hua, ve mere prati aajnaakaari ho gae.
Videshiyon ka manobal jaata raha; ve kaampte hue apne garhon se baahar a gae.
Jivit hain Yahweh! Blessed hain meri chattaan! Mere chhutkaare ki chattaan, mere God pratishthit hon!
God, jinhonne mujhe pratiphal diya mera badla liya, aur jantaaon ko mere adhin kar diya.
Jo mujhe mere dushmanon se mukt karte hain, aap hi ne mujhe mere dushmanon ke upar uncha kiya hai; aap hi ne hinsak aadmiyon se meri raksha ki hai.
Isliye, Yahweh, main raashtron ke saamne aapki praise karunga; aapke naam ka gungaan karunga.
“Apne raaja ke lie vahi hain chhutkaare ka khambha; apne abhishikt par David aur unke vanshjon par, vah hamesha apaar love reveal karte rahte hain.”
Heaven God ki glory ko pragat karta hai; antriksh unki hastkriti ka praghoshan karta hai.
Har ek din aagaami din se is baare mein vaartaalaap karta hai; har ek raatri aagaami raatri ko knowledge ki power pragat karti hai.
Is prakriya mein na to koi boli hai, na hi koi word; yahaan tak ki ismein koi aavaaz bhi nahin hai.
Inka svar sampurn prithvi par gunjta rahta hai, inka sandesh prithvi ke chhor tak ja pahunchta hai. God ne heaven mein sury ke lie ek mandap taiyaar kiya hai.
Aur sury ek var ke jaisa hai, jo apne mandap se baahar a raha hai, ek bare shurvir ke jaisa, jiske lie daur ek aanandaprdaayi krity hai.
Vah aakaash ke ek sire se uday hota hai, aur dusre sire tak chakkar maarta hai; uske taap se kuchh bhi chhupa nahin rahta.
Sampurn hai Yahweh ki law, jo aatma ki sanjivni hai. Faithful hain Yahweh ke adhiniyam, jo saadhaaran logon ko wise banaate hain.
Dharmmay hain Yahweh ke niti sutr, jo dil ka ullaas hain. Shuddh hain Yahweh ke order, jo aankhon mein roshni le aate hain.
Nirmal hai Yahweh ki shraddha, jo amar hai. Saty hain Yahweh ke niyam, jo purnath dharmmay hain.
Ve svarn se bhi adhik mulyvaan hain, haan, uttam kundan se bhi adhik, ve madhu se adhik madhur hain, haan, madhuchhatte se tapakte madhu se bhi adhik madhur.
Inhin ke dvaara aapke servant ko chetaavni milti hain; inke follow karne se bara pratiphal receive hota hai.
Apni bhul-chuk ka knowledge kise hota hai? Ajnaanta mein kie gae mere galtiyon ko maafi kar dijie.
Apne servant ko dhithaai ke galti karne se roke rahie; ve mujhe adhin karne na paaein. Tab main nirapraadh bana rahunga, main bare apraadhon ka doshi na rahunga.
Yahweh, meri chattaan aur mere uddhaarak, mere chehra ka vachan aur mere dil ka chintan aapko svikaary ho.
Sankat ke samay Yahweh aapki prayer ka uttar dein; Yaakob ke God mein aapki suraksha ho.
Vah apne holy aavaas mein se aapke lie madad provide karein, ziyon se aapki madad ka prabandh ho.
God aapki sab baliyon ka smaran rakhein, aapki agnibli unhein svikaary ho.
Vah aapke dil ka manorath purn karein, aapki sab yojnaaein saphal hon!
Aapke bachaav hone par ham harshollaas mein jay jaykaar kareinge, aur apne God ke naam mein dhvaja unchi kareinge. Hamaari kaamna hai ki Yahweh aapki saari praarthnaaein sunkar unhein purn karein.

Ab mujhe yah aashvaasan receive ho gaya hai: ki Yahweh apne abhishikt ko suraksha provide karte hain. Vah apne holy heaven se apni bhuja ke suraksha denevaale power ke dvaara unhein pratyuttar dete hain.
Kuchh ko rathon ka, to kuchh ko apne ghoron par bharosa hain, lekin hamein bharosa hai Yahweh, hamaare God ke naam par.
Ve larakhraate hain aur unka patan ho jaata hai, lekin hamaara jay hota hai aur ham sthir rahte hain.
Yahweh, mahaaraaja ko vijay provide karein! Ham jab bhi pukaarein, hamein pratyuttar dein!
Yahweh, aapki power par raaja harshit hai. Aapke dvaara provide kiye gaye bachaav se raaja ka harshaatirek dekhte hi banta hai!
Aapne uske dil ka manorath purn kiya hai, aapne uske anurodh ko purn karne mein asvikaar nahin kiya.
Aapne utkrisht aashishon ke saath uska svaagat kiya hai, aapne uske sir ko kundan ke mukut se sushobhit kiya hai.
Raaja ne aapse life ki prayer ki, aapne use jivandaan kiya— haan, sadaiv ka life.
Aapke dvaara die gaye vijay se raaja ki glory unchi hui hai; aapne use aishvary aur tej se vibhushit kiya hai.
Nihsandeh aapne use hamesha ke liye aashishein provide ki hain, apni upasthiti ke khushi se aapne use ullsit kiya hai.
Yah isliye ki mahaaraaj ka bharosa Yahweh par hai; sarvochch God ki mercy, love ke kaaran raaja atal rahega.
Aap sab dushmanon ko dhunrh nikaaleinge; aapka baahubal un sabhi ko kaid kar laaega, jo aapse nafrat karte hain.
Aapke reveal hone par, ve sabhi jalte bhatti mein paani jaaeinge. Apne kop mein Yahweh unhein nigal jaaega, unki agni unhein bhasm kar degi.
Aap unki santti ko prithvi se mita deinge, unke vanshaj insaanon ke beech nahin rah jaaeinge.
Yadypi aapke khilaaf unki yojna buraai karne ki hai aur ve yukti bhi racheinge, ve saphal na ho paaeinge.
Kyonki jab aap dhanush se un par nishaana lagaaeinge, aapke kaaran ve pith dikhaakar bhaag khare honge.
Apni power mein, Yahweh, aap unche hote jaaein; ham aapke power ka gungaan kareinge.
Mere God, mere God, kyon aapne mera parityaag kar diya? Mujhe mukt karne mein itna vilamb kyon ho raha hai? Kyon mere karaahne ka svar aap sun nahin pa rahe?
Mere God, main din mein pukaarta hun par aap uttar nahin dete, raatri mein bhi mujhe shaanti receive nahin ho paati.
Jabki holy hain aap; jo Israel ke praise par viraajmaan hain.
Hamaare purvjon ne aap par bharosa kiya; unhonne aap par bharosa kiya aur aapne unka bachaav kiya.
Unhonne aapko pukaara aur aapne unka bachaav kiya; aap mein unke faith ne unhein lajjit hone na diya.
Ab main insaan nahin, kira sirf rah gaya hun, insaanon ke lie lajjit, jansaadhaaran ke lie apmaanit.
Ve sabhi, jo mujhe dekhte hain, mera uphaas karte hain; ve mera apmaan karte hue sir hilaate hue kahte hain,
“Usne Yahweh mein bharosa kiya hai, Yahweh hi use mukt karaaein. Vahi use bachaaein, kyonki vah Yahweh mein hi magan rahta hai.”
Aap hi hain, jinhonne mujhe garbh se surakshit nikaala; jab main apni maata ki god mein hi tha, aapne mujhmein apne prati faith jagaaya.
Janm ke samay se hi mujhe aapki suraksha mein chhor diya gaya; aap us kshan se mere God hain, jis kshan se main maata ke garbh mein aaya.
Lord, mujhse dur na rahein, kyonki sankat nikat dikhaai de raha hai aur mera sahaayak koi nahin.
Kai saanr mujhe ghere hue hain; baashaan ke sashakt saanron ne mujhe gher rakha hai.
Unhonne apne munh aise phaar rakhe hain jaise garajnevaale hinsak sinh apne shikaar ko dekh chehra phaarte hain.
Mujhe paani ke jaisa undel diya gaya hai, meri haddiyaan joron se ukhar gai hain. Mera dil mom jaisa ho chuka hai; vah bhi mere bhitar hi bhitar pighal chuka hai.
Mera munh thikre jaisa shushk ho chuka hai, meri jibh taalu se chipak gai hai; aapne mujhe maut ki mitti mein chhor diya hai.
Kutte mujhe gherkar khare hue hain, evil logon ka samuh mere chaaron or khara hua hai; unhonne mere haath aur paanv chhed die hain.
Ab main apni ek-ek haddi gin sakta hun; log mujhe taakte hue mujh par kudrishti daalte hain.
Unhonne mera baahri kapra aapas mein baant liya, aur mere andar ke kapde ke lie paasa pheinka.
Lekin, Yahweh, aap mujhse dur na rahein. Aap meri power ke srot hain; meri madad ke lie der mat lagaaie.
Talvaar ke prahaar se aur kutton ke aakrman se, mere life ki raksha karein.
Sinhon ke munh se aur vany saanron ke sigon se, meri raksha karein.
Tab main svajnon mein aapki glory ka prachaar karunga; sabha mein main aapka praise karunga.
Yahweh ke shraddhaaluo, unka praise karo! Yaakob ke vanshjo, unka sammaan karo! Sab Israel vanshjo, unki vandna karo!

Kyonki Yahweh ne duhkhiton ki shochniy, karun situation ko na to tuchchh jaana aur na hi usse nafrat ki. Vah piriton ki yaatnaaein dekhkar unse dur na hue, lekin unhonne unki madad ke lie unki vaani suni.
Mahaasbha mein aapke gungaan ke lie mere prernaasrot aap hi hain; aapke shraddhaaluon ke saamne main apne pran purn karunga.
Namr aadmi khaana kar tript ho jaaega; jo Yahweh ke khoji hain, ve unka praise kareinge. Hamesha sajiv rahe tumhaara dil!
Prithvi ki chhor tak sabhi insaan Yahweh ko smaran kar unki or unmukh honge, raashtron ke sab parivaar unke saamne natmastak honge.
Kyonki raajy Yahweh hi ka hai, sab raashtron ke adhipti vahi hain.
Kha-pikar prithvi ke sab hrisht-pusht unke saamne natmastak ho unki vandna kareinge; sabhi nashvar insaan unke saamne ghutne tek deinge, jo apne hi jaan jivit rakh nahin sakte.
Yah sampurn pirhi unki service karegi; bhaavi pirhi ko Lord ke baare mein bataaya jaaega.
Ve God ki righteousness aur unke dvaara kie gae mahaakaary ki ghoshna us pirhi ke saamne kareinge, jo abhi ajanmi hi hai.
Yahweh mere charvaaha hain, mujhe koi ghati na hogi.
Vah mujhe hari-hari charaaiyon mein vishraanti provide karte hain, vah mujhe shaant sphurti denevaali jaldhaaraaon ke nikat le jaate hain.
Vah mere jaan mein navjivan ka sanchaar karte hain. Vah apni hi glory ke nimitt mujhe dharm ke raasta par lie chalte hain.

Yadypi main bhayaanak andhkaarmay ghaati mein se hokar aage barhta hun, taubhi main kisi buraai se bhaybhit nahin hota, kyonki aap mere saath hote hain, aapki laathi aur aapki chhari, mere aashvaasan hain.
Aap mere dushmanon ke saamne mere lie utkrisht khaana paroste hain. Aap tel se mere sir ko mala karte hain; mera pyaala umar raha hai.
Nishchyath kushal mangal aur mercy-love aajivan mere saath saath bane raheinge, aur main hamesha-hamesha Yahweh ke aavaas mein, nivaas karta rahunga.
Prithvi aur prithvi mein jo kuchh bhi hai, sabhi kuchh Yahweh ka hi hai. Duniya aur ve sabhi, jo ismein nivaas karte hain, unhin ke hain;
Kyonki unhin ne mahaasaagar par iski ninv rakhi aur jalaprvaahon par ise sthir kiya.
Kaun charh sakega Yahweh ke parvat par? Kaun khara rah sakega unke holy jagah mein?
Vahi, jiske haath nirmal aur dil shuddh hai, jo murtiyon par bharosa nahi rakhta, jo jhuthi shapath nahin karta.
Us par Yahweh ki blessing sthaayi rahegi. God, uska chhuraane vaala, use right thehraaya kareinge.
Yahi hai vah pirhi, jo Yahweh ki kripaadrishti khojne vaali, jo aapke darshan ki abhilaashi hai, he Yaakob ke God!
Pravesh dvaaro, unche karo apne mastak; praachin kivaaro, unche ho jaao, ki mahaatejasvi mahaaraaj pravesh kar sakein.
Yah mahaatejasvi raaja hain kaun? Yahweh, teji aur samarth, Yahweh, yuddh mein paraakrmi.
Pravesh dvaaron, uncha karo apne mastak; praachin kivaaron, unche ho jaao, ki mahaatejasvi mahaaraaj pravesh kar sakein.
Yah mahaatejasvi raaja kaun hai? Sarvshaktimaan Yahweh! Vahi hain mahaatejasvi mahaaraaja.
Yahweh, mainne aap par apni aatma samarpit ki hai.
Mere God, mainne aap par bharosa kiya hai; mujhe lajjit hone na dijie, aur na mere dushman mera pichha karne paaein.
Koi bhi, jisne aap par apni ummid rakhi hai lajjit kadaapi nahin kiya ja sakta, lajjit ve kie jaaeinge, jo vishvaasghaat karte hain.
Yahweh, mujhe apne raasta dikha, mujhe apne raaston ki teaching dijie.
Apne saty ki or meri aguvaai kijie aur mujhe teaching dijie, kyonki aap mere chhuraanevaale God hain, din bhar main aapki hi pratiksha karta rahta hun.
Yahweh, apni asim daya aur apne mercy-love ka smaran kijie, jo anant kaal se hote aae hain.
Yuvaavastha mein kie gae mere apraadhon ka aur mere hathile aachran ka lekha na rakhie; lekin, Yahweh, apni mercy mein mera smaran rakhie, kyonki Yahweh, aap bhale hain!
Yahweh bhale aur saty hain, tab vah galti karnevaalon ko apni nitiyon ki teaching dete hain.
Vinit ko vah dharmmay raasta par le chalte hain, aur use apne raasta ki teaching dete hain.
Jo Yahweh ki vaacha aur law ka follow karte hain, unke sabhi raasta unke lie prempurn aur faithful hain.
Yahweh, apni glory ke nimitt, mera apraadh maafi karein, yadypi mera apraadh ghor hai.
Tab kaun hai vah insaan, jo Yahweh se darta hai? Yahweh us par vah raasta reveal kareinge, jis par uska chalna bhala hai.
Tab samriddh hoga uska life, aur uski santti us desh par shaasan karegi.
Apne shraddhaaluon par hi Yahweh apne rahasy prakaashit karte hain; unhin par vah apni vaacha pragat karte hain.
Meri aankhein ektak Yahweh ko dekh rahin hain, kyonki vahi mere pairon ko phande se mukt kareinge.
He Yahweh, meri or murkar mujh par kripaadrishti kijie, kyonki main akela aur pirit hun.
Mere dil ka santaap barh gaya hai, mujhe meri yaatnaaon se bacha lijie.
Meri dard aur yaatna par nazar kijie, aur mere sab galti maafi kar dijie.
Dekhie, mere dushmanon ki sankhya kitni bari hai, yah bhi dekhie ki mere prati kitni ugr hai unki nafrat!
Mere life ki raksha kijie aur mujhe bacha lijie; mujhe lajjit na hona pare, kyonki main aapke aashray mein aaya hun.
Kharaai aur sach mujhe surakshit rakhein, kyonki mainne aap par hi bharosa kiya hai.
He God, Israel ko bacha lijie, sab sankton se Israel ko mukt kijie!
Yahweh, mujhe nirdosh pramaanit kijie, kyonki main sidha hun; Yahweh par se mera bharosa kabhi nahin dagamgaaya.
Yahweh, mujhe parakh lijie, mera parikshan kar lijie, mere dil aur mere man ko parakh lijie;
Aapke mercy-love ka bodh mujhmein sadaiv bana rahta hai, aapki satyta mere raasta ka aashvaasan hai.
Main na to nikammi chaal chalne vaalon ki sangat karta hun, aur na main kaptiyon se sahmat hota hun.
Kukarmiyon ki sab sabhaaein mere lie ghrinit hain aur main evil logon ki sangat mein nahin baithta.
Main apne haath dhokar nirdoshta pramaanit karunga aur Yahweh, main aapki vedi ki parikrma karunga,
Ki main uchch svar mein aapke prati aabhaar vyakt kar sakun aur aapke aashchary kaaryon ko bata sakun.
Yahweh, mujhe aapke aavaas, holy temple se love hai, yahi vah jagah hai, jahaan aapki glory ka nivaas hai.
Galti karnevaalon ki niyti mein mujhe sammilit na kijie, hinsak aadmiyon ke saath mujhe dand na dijie.
Unke haathon mein evil yukti hai, jinke daayein haath ghus se bhare hue hain.
Lekin main apne aachran mein sadaiv khara rahunga; mujh par grace kar mujhe mukt kar dijie.
Mere pair chauras zameen par sthir hain; shraddhaaluon ki mahaasbha mein main Yahweh ki vandna karunga.
Yahweh meri roshni aur bachaav hain; mujhe kiska dar ho sakta hai? Yahweh mere life ka drirh garh hain, to mujhe kiska dar?
Jab durjan mujhe nigalne ke lie mujh par aakrman karte hain, jab mere virodhi aur mere dushman mere khilaaf uth khare hote hain, ve thokar khaakar gir jaate hain.
Yadi ek sena bhi mujhe gher le, tab bhi mera dil bhaybhit na hoga; yadi mere khilaaf yuddh bhi chhir jaae, tab bhi main purnath nishchint bana rahunga.
Yahweh se mainne ek hi prayer ki hai, yahi meri aakaanksha hai: main aajivan Yahweh ke aavaas mein nivaas kar sakun, ki Yahweh ke saundary ko dekhta rahun aur unke temple mein manan karta rahun.
Kyonki vahi hain jo sankat kaal mein mujhe aashray deinge; vahi mujhe apne gupt-mandap ke aashray mein chhipa leinge aur ek uchch chattaan mein mujhe suraksha provide kareinge.

Tab jin dushmanon ne mujhe ghera hua hai, unke saamne mera mastak uncha ho jaaega. Tab uchch harshollaas ke saath main Yahweh ke gupt-mandap mein bali arpit karunga; main gaaunga, haan, main Yahweh ki vandna karunga.
Yahweh, meri vaani sunie; mujh par grace kar mujhe uttar dijie.
Aapne kaha, “Mere khoji bano!” Mera dil aapse yah kahta hai, Yahweh, main aapka hi khoji banunga.
Mujhse apna mukhmandal na chhipaaie, krodh mein apne servant ko dur na kijie; aap hi mere sahaayak rahe hain. Mere God, mere uddhaarak mujhe asvikaar na kijie aur na mera parityaag kijie.
Mere maata-pita bhale hi mera parityaag kar dein, lekin Yahweh mujhe accept kar leinge.
Yahweh, mujhe apne aachran ki teaching dein; mere dushmanon ke beech surakshit raasta par meri aguvaai karein.
Mujhe mere dushmanon ki ichchhaapurti ka saadhan hone ke lie na chhor dein, mere khilaaf jhuthe saakshy uth khare hue hain, ve sabhi hinsa par utaaru hain.
Mujhe yah purn nishchay hai: ki main isi life mein, Yahweh ki kripaadrishti ka anubhav karunga.
Yahweh mein apni ummid sthir rakho; drirh rahkar saahsi bano, haan, Yahweh par bharosa rakho.

Yahweh, main aapko pukaar raha hun; aap meri suraksha ki chattaan hain, meri ansuni na kijie. Kahin aisa na ho ki aapke pratyuttar na dene par main unke jaisa ho jaaun, jo mritak lok mein utar rahe hain.
Jab main param holy jagah ki or apne haath uthaaun, jab main madad ke lie aapko pukaarun, to meri pukaar sun lijie.

Evil logon ke lie nirdhaarit dand mein mujhe sammilit na kijie, ve adharm karte rahte hain, parosiyon ke saath unka vaartaalaap bahut mel-milaap ka hota hai lekin unke dil mein unke lie buraai ki yuktiyaan hi upajti rahti hain.
Unhein unke aachran ke anukul hi pratiphal dijie, unhonne jo kuchh kiya hai buraai ki hai; unhein unke sabhi kaaryon ke anurup dand dijie, unhein vahi dand dijie, jiske ve adhikaari hain.
Kyonki Yahweh ke mahaakaary ka, Yahweh ki kritiyon ke lie hi, unki nazar mein koi mahatv nahin! Yahweh unhein barbaad kar deinge, is riti se ki ve kabhi uth na paaeinge.
Yahweh ka praise ho, unhonne madad ke lie meri pukaar sun li hai.
Yahweh mera bal aur meri dhaal hain; un par hi mera bharosa hai, unhonne meri madad ki hai. Mera dil harshollaas mein uchhal raha hai, main apne git ke dvaara unke lie aabhaar vyakt karunga.
Yahweh apni people ka bal hain, apne abhishikt ke lie bachaav ka drirh garh hain.
Aap apni miraas ko bachaav provide kijie aur use blessing dijie; unke charvaaha hokar unhein hamesha-hamesha sambhaalte rahie.
Angel, Yahweh ki glory karo, unke tej aur power ki glory karo.
Yahweh ko unke naam ke anurup glory provide karo; unki pavitrta ki bhavyta mein Yahweh ki worship karo.
Mahaasaagar ki satah par Yahweh ka svar pratidhvnit hota hai; glorious God ka svar garjan jaisa hai, Yahweh prabal lahron ke upar garjan karte hain.
Shaktishaali hai Yahweh ka svar; bhavy hai Yahweh ka svar.
Yahweh ka svar devdaar vriksh ko ukhaar pheinkta hai; Yahweh labaanon ke devdaar vrikshon ko tukre-tukre kar daalte hain.
Yahweh labaanon ko bachhre jaise uchhalne, aur harmon ko vany saanr jaise, uchhalne ke lie apostle karte hain.
Yahweh ke svar ka prahaar, bijliyon ke jaisa hota hai.
Yahweh ka svar van ko hila deta hai; Yahweh kaadesh ke banjar zameen ko hila dete hain.
Yahweh ke svar se hirniyon ka garbhpaat ho jaata hai; unke svar se banjar zameen mein patjhar ho jaata hai. Tab unke temple mein sabhi pukaar uthte hain, “Yahweh ki glory hi glory!”
Dher paani raashi par Yahweh ka sinhaasan basa hai; hamesha mahaaraaja hokar vah sinhaasan par viraajmaan hain.
Yahweh apni people ko bal provide karte hain; Yahweh apni people ko shaanti ki blessing provide karte hain.
Yahweh, main aapki glory aur prashansa karunga, kyonki aapne mujhe gahraai mein se bacha liya hai ab mere dushmanon ko mujh par hansne ka santosh receive na ho sakega.
Yahweh, mere God, mainne madad ke lie aapko pukaara, aapne mujhe punahsvasth kar diya.
Yahweh, aapne mujhe adholok se upar khinch liya; aapne mujhe jivandaan diya, unmein se bacha liya, jo adholok-kabr mein hain.
Yahweh ke bhakto, unke praise gaan gaao; unki glory mein jay jaykaar karo.
Kyonki kshan sirf ka hota hai unka kop, lekin aajivan sthaayi rahti hai unki kripaadrishti; yah sambhav hai rona raat bhar rahe, lekin sabera ullaas se bhara hota hai.
Apni samriddhi ki situation mein main kah utha, “Ab mujh par vishamta ki situation kabhi na aaegi.”
Yahweh, aapne hi mujh par kripaadrishti kar, mujhe parvat jaisa sthir kar diya; lekin jab aapne mujhse apna chehra chhipa liya, tab main niraash ho gaya.
Yahweh, mainne aapko pukaara; mere Lord, mainne aapse grace ki prayer ki:
“Kya laabh hoga meri maut se, mere adholok mein jaane se? Kya mitti aapki praise karegi? Kya vah aapki sach ki saakshy degi?
Yahweh, meri request sunie, mujh par grace kijie; Yahweh, meri madad kijie.”
Aapne mere vilaap ko ullaas-nrity mein badal diya; aapne mere shok-kapde taat utaarkar mujhe harsh ka aavran de diya,
Ki mera dil hamesha aapka gungaan karta rahe aur kabhi chup na rahe. Yahweh, mere God, main hamesha-hamesha aapke prati aabhaar vyakt karta rahunga.
Yahweh, mainne aap mein hi sharan li hai; mujhe kabhi lajjit na hone dijie; apni righteousness ke kaaran he God, mera bachaav kijie.
Meri pukaar sunkar, turant mujhe chhura lijie; meri aashray-chattaan hokar mere bachaav ka, drirh garh bankar meri raksha kijie.
Isliye ki aap meri chattaan aur mera garh hain, apni hi glory ke nimitt mere raasta mein aguvaai aur sanchaalan kijie.
Mujhe us jaal se bacha lijie jo mere lie bichhaaya gaya hai, kyonki aap hi mera aashray-sthal hain.
Apni aatma main aapke haathon mein saump raha hun; Yahweh, saty ke God, aapne hi mujhe mukt kiya hai.
Mujhe nafrat hai vyarth pratimaaon ke upaaskon se; lekin meri, aastha hai Yahweh mein.
Main harshit hokar aapke mercy-love mein ullsit hounga, aapne meri dard par dhyaan diya aur mere jaan ki vedna ko pahchaana hai.
Aapne mujhe dushman ke haathon mein nahin saumpa aur aapne mere pairon ko ek vishaal jagah par sthaapit kiya hai.
Yahweh, mujh par grace kijie, main is samay sankat mein hun; shok se meri aankhein dhundhli par chuki hain, mere jaan aur meri deh bhi shithil ho chuki hai.
Vedna mein mera life samaapt hua ja raha hai; aahein bharte-bharte meri aayu barbaad ho rahi hai; apraadhon ne meri power ko khatm kar diya hai, meri haddiyaan tak jirn ho chuki hain.
Virodhiyon ke kaaran, main apne parosiyon ke saamne ghrinaaspad ban gaya hun, main apne parichiton ke saamne bhayaaspad ban gaya hun, sarak par mujhe dekh ve chhipne lagte hain.
Unhonne mujhe aise bhula diya hai maano main ek mrit aadmi hun; main vaisa hi vyarth ho gaya hun jaise ek tuta paatr.
Anekon ka phusphus karna main sun raha hun; “Aatank ne mujhe chaaron or se gher liya hai!” Ve mere khilaaf sammti rach rahe hain, ve mere jaan lene ke lie taiyaar ho gae hain.
Lekin Yahweh, mainne aap par bharosa rakha hai; yah meri saakshi hai, “Aap hi mere God hain.”
Mera life aapke hi haathon mein hai; mujhe mere dushmanon se chhura lijie, un sabse meri raksha kijie, jo mera pichha kar rahe hain.
Apne mukhmandal ka prakaash apne servant par chamkaaie; apne mercy-love ke kaaran mera bachaav kijie.
Yahweh, mujhe lajjit na hona pare, main baar-baar aapko pukaarta raha hun; lajjit hon evil aur adholok ho unki niyti, jahaan jaakar ve chupchaap ho jaaein.
Unke jhuth bhaashi onth muk ho jaaein, kyonki ve nafrat aur ghamand se apostle ho, dharmiyon ke khilaaf ahankaar karte rahte hain.
Kaisi mahaan hai aapki bhalaai, jo aapne apne shraddhaaluon ke nimitt aarakshit rakhi hai, jo aapne apne sharnaagton ke lie saarvajnik rup se pradarshit ki hai.
Apni upasthiti ke aashray-sthal mein aap unhein insaanon ke sharyantron se suraksha provide karte hain; apne aavaas mein aap unhein dushmanon ke jhagraalu jibh se suraksha provide karte hain.
Stuty hain, Yahweh! Jab dushmanon ne mujhe gher liya tha, unhonne mujh par apna mercy-love pradarshit kiya.
Ghabraahat mein main kah utha tha, “Main aapki nazar se dur ho chuka hun!” Lekin jab mainne madad ke lie aapko aavaaj di tab aapne meri pukaar sun li.
Yahweh ke sabhi bhakto, unse love karo! Sachche logon ko Yahweh suraksha provide karte hain, lekin ahankaari ko pura-pura dand.
Tum sabhi, jinhonne Yahweh par bharosa rakha hai, drirh rahte hue saahsi bano.
Blessed hain ve, jinke apraadh maafi kar die gae, jinke galtiyon ko dhaamp diya gaya hai.
Blessed hai vah person, jiske galtiyon ka hisaab Yahweh kabhi na leinge. Aur jiske dil mein koi kapat nahin hai.
Jab tak mainne apna galti chhipaae rakha, din bhar karaahte rahne ke kaaran, meri haddiyaan kshin hoti chali gain,
Kyonki din-raat aapka haath mujh par bhaari tha; mera bal maano grishmkaal ki taap se sukh gaya.

Tab mainne apna galti angikaar kiya, mainne apna apraadh nahin chhipaaya. Mainne nishchay kiya, “Main Yahweh ke saamne apne apraadh accept karunga.” Jab mainne aapke saamne apna galti accept kiya tab aapne mere apraadh ka dosh maafi kiya.
Isliye aapke sabhi shraddhaalu, jab tak sambhav hai aapse prayer karte rahein. Tab, jab sankat ka prabal paani pravaah aaega, vah unko sparsh na kar sakega.
Aap mere aashray-sthal hain; aap hi mujhe sankat se bachaaeinge aur mujhe bachaav ke vijay ghosh se gher leinge.
Yahweh ne kaha, main tumhein sadbuddhi provide karunga aur upyukt raasta ke lie tumhaari aguvaai karunga; main tumhein sammti dunga aur tumhaari raksha karta rahunga.
Tumhaari manovritti na to ghore jaisa ho, na khachchar jaisa, jinmein samajh hi nahin hoti. Unhein to raas aur lagaam dvaara niyantrit karna parta hai, anytha ve tumhaare nikat nahin aate.
Evil apne upar kai sankat le aate hain, lekin Yahweh ka mercy-love unke sachche logon ko ghere hue uski suraksha karta rahta hai.
Yahweh mein ullsit hoo aur khushi manaao, dharmiyo gaao; tum sabhi, jo sidhe manvaale ho, harshollaas mein jay jaykaar karo!
Dharmiyon, Yahweh ke lie harshollaas mein gaao; unka praise karna sidhe logon ke lie shobhniy hota hai.
Kinnor ki sangat par Yahweh ka thanks karo; das tantuon ke nebel par unke lie sangit gaao.
Unke praise mein ek naya git gaao; kushaltaapurvak vaadan karte hue tanmay hokar gaao.
Kyonki Yahweh ka vachan saty aur khara hai; apne har ek kaary mein vah faithful hain.
Unhein dharm aur justice dear hain; sab prithvi mein Yahweh ka mercy-love vyaapt hai.
Heaven Yahweh ke order se hi astitv mein aaya, aur sab nakshatr unke hi chehra ke uchchhvaas ke dvaara banaae gae.
Ve mahaasaagar ke paani ko ek dher paani raashi ke taur par ekatr kar dete hain; aur gahire saagron ko bhandaargrih mein rakhte hain.
Sab prithvi Yahweh ko dare; prithvi ke sab vaasi unke dar mein nistabdh khare ho jaaein.
Kyonki unhin ke order sirf se yah prithvi astitv mein aai; unhin ke order se yah sthir bhi ho gai.
Yahweh raashtron ki yuktiyaan vyarth kar dete hain; vah logon ki yojnaaon ko viphal kar dete hain.
Iske viprit Yahweh ki yojnaaein hamesha-hamesha sthaayi bani rahti hain, unke dil ke soch pirhi se pirhi tak bani rahte hain.
Blessed hai vah raashtr, jiske God Yahweh hain, vah people, jise unhonne apna nij bhaag chun liya.
Yahweh heaven se prithvi par nazar karte hain, vah sab insaanon ko nihaarte hain;
Vah apne aavaas se prithvi ke sab nivaasiyon ka nirikshan karte rahte hain.
Unhin ne sab insaanon ke dil ki rachna ki, vahi unke saare kaaryon ko parakhte rahte hain.
Kisi bhi raaja ka bachaav uski sena ki power se nahin hota; kisi bhi shur yoddha ka shaury usko nahin bachaata.
Vijay ke lie ashv par bharosa karna nirarthak hai; vah kitna bhi shaktishaali ho, bachaav ka kaaran nahin ho sakta.
Suno, Yahweh ki nazar un sab par sthir rahti hai, jo unke shraddhaalu hote hain, jinka bharosa unke mercy-love mein bana rahta hai,
Ki vahi unhein maut se bachaav dekar akaal mein jivit rakhein.
Ham dhairypurvak Yahweh par bharosa rakhe hue hain; vahi hamaare sahaayak aur dhaal hain.
Unmein hi hamaara dil aanandit rahta hai, unki holy glory mein hi hamein bharosa hai.
Yahweh, aapka mercy-love ham par bana rahe, hamne aap par hi bharosa rakha hai.
Har ek situation mein main Yahweh ko yogy kahta rahunga; mere honthon par unki praise-prashansa ke udgaar sadaiv hi bane raheinge.
Meri aatma Yahweh mein garv karti hai; pirit yah sunein aur ullsit hon.
Mere saath Yahweh ka gungaan karo; ham sab milkar Yahweh ki glory ko uncha karein.
Mainne Yahweh se prayer ki aur unhonne pratyuttar diya; unhonne mujhe sab tarah ke dar se mukt kiya.
Jinhonne unse apeksha ki, ve ullsit hi hue; ismein unhein kabhi lajjit na hona para.
Is duhkhi aadmi ne madad ke lie pukaara aur Yahweh ne pratyuttar diya; unhonne use uske sab sankton se chhura liya hai.
Yahweh ka dut unke shraddhaaluon ke chaaron or unki chauksi karta rahta hai aur unko bachaata hai.
Khud chakhkar dekh lo ki kitne bhale hain Yahweh; kaisa blessed hai ve, jo unka aashray lete hain.
Sabhi bhakto, Yahweh ke prati shraddha rakho. Jo un par shraddha rakhte hain, unhein koi bhi ghati nahin hoti.
Yuva sinh durbal ho sakte hain aur ve bhukhe bhi rah jaate hain, lekin jo Yahweh ke khoji hain, unhein kisi upyukt vastu ki ghati nahin hogi.
Mere baalko, nikat aakar dhyaan se suno; main tumhein Yahweh ke prati shraddha sikhaaunga.
Tummein se jis kisi ko life ke muly ka bodh hai aur jise sukhad dirghaayu ki aakaanksha hai,
Vah apni jibh ko bura bolne se aur apne honthon ko jhuth se mukt rakhe;
Buraai mein ruchi lena chhorkar paropkaar kare; mel-milaap ka yatn kare aur isi ke lie pichha kare.
Kyonki Yahweh ki nazar dharmiyon par aur unke kaan unki request par lage rahte hain,
Lekin Yahweh buraai karnevaalon se dur rahte hain; ki unka naam hi prithvi se mita daalein.
Righteous ki pukaar ko Yahweh zarur sunte hain; vah unhein unke sankat se chhuraate hain.
Yahweh tute dil ke nikat hote hain, vah unhein chhura lete hain, jo aatma mein pise hue hai.
Yah sambhav hai ki righteous par kai-kai vipattiyaan a parein, lekin Yahweh use un sabhi se bacha lete hain;
Vah uski har ek haddi ko surakshit rakhte hain, unmein se ek bhi nahin tutti.
Dushtta hi evil ki maut ka kaaran hoti hai; righteous ke dushman dandit kie jaaeinge.
Yahweh apne servants ko chhura lete hain; jo koi unmein aashray leta hai, vah doshi ghoshit nahin kiya jaaega.
Yahweh, aap unse justice-vinyaay karein, jo mujhse justice-vinyaay kar rahe hain; aap unse yuddh karein, jo mujhse yuddh kar rahe hain.
Dhaal aur kavach ke saath; meri madad ke lie a jaaie.
Unke khilaaf, jo mera pichha kar rahe hain, barchhi aur bhaala uthaaiye. Mere jaan ko yah aashvaasan dijie, “Main hun tumhaara bachaav.”
Ve, jo mere praanon ke pyaase hain, ve lajjit aur apmaanit hon; jo mere vinaash ki yojna bana rahe hain, paraajit ho bhaag khare hon.
Jab Yahweh ka dut unka pichha kare, ve us bhuse jaisa ho jaaein, jise pavan ura le jaata hai;
Unka raasta aisa ho jaae, jis par andhera aur phislan hai. Aur us par Yahweh ka dut unka pichha karta jaae.
Unhonne akaaran hi mere lie jaal bichhaaya aur akaaran hi unhonne mere lie gaddha khoda hai,
Unka vinaash un par achaanak hi a pare, ve usi jaal mein ja phanse, jo unhonne bichhaaya tha, ve khud us gaddhe mein girkar barbaad ho jaaein.
Tab Yahweh mein mera jaan ullsit hoga aur unke dvaara kiya gaya bachaav mere harshollaas ka vishay hoga.
Meri haddiyaan tak kah utheingi, “Kaun hai Yahweh ke tuly? Aap hi hain jo duhkhi ko balvaan se, aur daridr aur din ko luteron se chhuraate hain.”
Krur saakshy mere khilaaf uth khare hue hain; ve mujhse un vishyon ki puchhtaachh kar rahe hain, jinka mujhe koi knowledge hi nahin hai.
Ve mere upkaar ka pratiphal apkaar mein de rahe hain, main shokit hokar rah gaya hun.
Jab ve duhkhi the, mainne sahaanubhuti mein shok-kapde dhaaran kie, yahaan tak ki mainne din hokar upvaas bhi kiya. Jab meri praarthnaaein bina koi uttar ke mere paas laut aain,
Main is bhaav mein vilaap karta chala gaya maano main apne mitr ya bhaai ke lie vilaap kar raha hun. Main shok mein aise jhuk gaya maano main apni maata ke lie shok kar raha hun.

Lekin yahaan jab main thokar khaakar gir para hun, ve ekatr ho khushi mana rahe hain; iske purv ki main kuchh samajh paata, ve mujh par aakrman karne ke lie ekjut ho gae hain. Ve lagaataar meri ninda kar rahe hain.
Jab ve naastik jaise mera uphaas kar rahe the, usmein krurta ka samaavesh tha; ve mujh par daant bhi pis rahe the.
Yahweh, aap kab tak yah sab chupchaap hi dekhte raheinge? Unke vinaashkaari kaary se mera bachaav kijie, sinhon jaisa in evil logon se meri raksha kijie.
Mahaasbha ke saamne main aapka aabhaar vyakt karunga; janasmuh mein main aapka praise karunga.

Jo akaaran hi mere dushman ban gae hain, ab unhein mera uphaas karne ka santosh receive na ho; ab akaaran hi mere virodhi ban gae aadmiyon ko aankhon hi aankhon mein meri ninda mein nirlajjtaapurn sanket karne ka avsar receive na ho.
Unke vaartaalaap shaanti prerak nahin hote, ve shaanti dear naagrikon ke lie jhuthe aarop sochne mein lage rahte hain.
Chehra phaarkar ve mere khilaaf yah kahte hain, “Aaha! Aaha! Hamne apni hi aankhon se sab dekh liya hai.”
Yahweh, saty aapki nazar mein hai; ab aap shaant na rahie. Yahweh, ab mujhse dur na rahie.
Meri raksha ke lie uthie! Mere God aur mere maalik, mere paksh mein justice prastut kijie.
Yahweh, mere God, apni sach mein mujhe nirdosh pramaanit kijie; meri situation se unhein koi khushi receive na ho.
Ve man hi man yah na kah sakein, “Dekha, yahi to ham chaahte the!” Ya ve yah na kah sakein, “Ham use nigal gae.”
Ve sabhi, jo meri dukhad situation par aanandit ho rahe hain, lajjit aur niraash ho jaaein; ve sabhi, jinhonne mujhe nich pramaanit karna chaaha tha khud ninda aur lajja mein dab jaaein.

Ve sabhi, jo mujhe dosh mukt hua dekhne ki kaamna karte rahe, khushi mein ullsit ho jay jaykaar karein; unka sthaayi naara yah ho jaae, “Unchi ho Yahweh ki glory, vah apne servant ke kalyaan mein ullsit hote hain.”
Meri jibh hamesha aapki righteousness ki ghoshna, aur aapki vandna karti rahegi.
Evil ke dil mein uska dosh bhaav use kahte rahta hai: uski nazar mein God ke prati koi dar hai hi nahin.
Apni hi nazron mein vah khud ki chaaplusi karta hai. Aise mein use na to apna galti dikhaai deta hai, na hi use galti se nafrat hoti hai.
Uska bolna chhalpurn aur buraai ka hai; samajh ne uska saath chhor diya hai aur upkaar bhaav ab usmein raha hi nahin.
Yahaan tak ki bichhaune par lete hue vah buri yukti rachta rahta hai; usne khud ko adharm ke lie samarpit kar diya hai. Vah buraai ko asvikaar nahin kar paata.
Yahweh, aapka mercy-love heaven tak, aur aapki faithfulness aakaashmandal tak vyaapt hai.
Aapki righteousness vishaal parvat jaisa, aur aapki sach athaah mahaasaagar tuly hai. Yahweh, aap hi insaan aur pashu, donon ke parirakshak hain.
Kaisa aprtim hai aapka mercy-love! Aapke pankhon ki chhaaya mein saadhaaran aur vishisht, sabhi insaan aashray lete hain.
Ve aapke aavaas ke utkrisht khaana se tript hote hain; aap sukh ki nadi se unki pyaas bujhaate hain.
Aap hi life ke srot hain; aapke prakaash ke dvaara hi hamein roshni ka bhaas hota hai.
Jinmein aapke prati shraddha hai, un par aap apna mercy-love aur jinmein aapke prati sach hai, un par apni righteousness banaae rakhein.
Mujhe ahankaari ka pair kuchal na paae, aur na evil ka haath mujhe baahar dhakel sake.
Kukarmiyon ka ant ho chuka hai, ve zamin-dost ho chuke hain, ve aise pheink die gae hain, ki ab ve uth nahin pa rahe!
Evil logon ke kaaran mat kurho, kukarmiyon se daah mat karo;
Kyonki ve to ghaas ke jaisa shighr murjha jaaeinge, ve hare paudhe ke jaisa shighr barbaad ho jaaeinge.
Yahweh mein bharosa rakhte hue vahi karo, jo upyukt hai; ki tum surakshit hokar svadesh mein khushhaal nivaas kar sako.
Tumhaara khushi Yahweh mein magan ho, vahi tumhaare manorath purn kareinge.
Yahweh ko apne life ki yojnaaein saump do; un par bharosa karo aur ve tumhaare lie ye sab kareinge:
Ve tumhaari righteousness ko sabere ke sury ke jaisa aur tumhaari sach ko madhyaahn ke sury jaisa chamkaaeinge.
Yahweh ke saamne chupchaap rahkar dhairypurvak un par bharosa karo; jab evil aadmiyon ki yuktiyaan saphal hone lagein ya jab ve apni buraai ki yojnaaon mein saphal hone lagein to mat kurho!
Krodh se dur raho, kop ka parityaag kar do; kurho mat! Isse buraai hi hoti hai.
Kukarmi to kaat daale jaaeinge, lekin Yahweh ke shraddhaaluon ke lie bhaag aarakshit hai.
Kuchh hi samay shesh hai jab evil ka astitv na rahega; tum use khojne par bhi na paaoge.
Lekin namr log prithvi ke adhikaari honge, ve bari samriddhi mein aanandit raheinge.
Evil dharmiyon ke khilaaf buri yukti rachte rahte hain, unhein dekh daant piste rahte hain;
Lekin Lord evil par hanste hain, kyonki vah jaante hain ki uske din samaapt ho rahe hain.
Evil talvaar khinchte hain aur dhanush par dori charhaate hain ki duhkhi aur din daridr ko mita dein, unka vadh kar dein, jo sidhe hain.
Lekin unki talvaar unhin ke dil ko chhedegi aur unke dhanush tut jaaeinge.
Evil ki vipul property ki apeksha righteous ki simit raashi hi kahin uttam hai;
Kyonki evil ki bhujaaon ka tora jaana nishchit hai, lekin Yahweh dharmiyon ka bal hain.
Yahweh nirdosh aadmiyon ki aayu par nazar rakhte hain, unka nij bhaag hamesha sthaayi rahega.
Sankat kaal mein bhi unhein lajja ka saamna nahin karna parega; akaal mein bhi unke paas bharpur rahega.
Evil logon ka vinaash sunishchit hai: Yahweh ke dushmanon ki situation ghaas ke vaibhav ke jaisa hai, ve dhuein ke jaisa vilin ho jaaeinge.
Evil rin lekar use lautaata nahin, lekin righteous udaartaapurvak deta rahta hai;
Yahweh dvaara blessed aadmi prithvi ke bhaagi honge, Yahweh dvaara shaapit aadmi barbaad kar die jaaeinge.
Jis aadmi ke kadam Yahweh dvaara niyojit kie jaate hain, uske aachran se Yahweh prasann hote hain;
Tab yadi vah larakhra bhi jaae, vah girega nahin, kyonki Yahweh uska haath thaame hue hain.
Mainne yuvaavastha dekhi aur ab main praurh hun, lekin aaj tak mainne na to righteous ko shokit hote dekha hai aur na uski children ko bhikh maangte.
Righteous sadaiv udaar hi hote hain aur udaartaapurvak dete rahte hain; blessed rahti hai unki children.
Buraai se pare rahkar paropkaar karo; tab tumhaara life sadaiv surakshit bana rahega.
Kyonki Yahweh ko sach dear hai aur ve apne bhakton ka parityaag kabhi nahin karte. Vah chirkaal ke lie surakshit ho jaate hain; lekin evil ki santti mita di jaaegi.
Righteous prithvi ke bhaagi honge aur usmein hamesha nivaas kareinge.
Righteous apne chehra se knowledge ki baatein kahta hai, aur uski jibh justice sangat vachan hi uchchaarti hai.
Uske dil mein uske God ki law basi hai; uske kadam phisalte nahin.
Evil, jo righteous ke praanon ka pyaasa hai, uski ghaat lagaae baitha rahta hai;
Lekin Yahweh righteous ko evil ke authority mein jaane nahin deinge aur na hi nyaayaalay mein use doshi pramaanit hone deinge.

Yahweh ki madad ki pratiksha karo aur unhin ke sanmaarg par chalte raho. Vahi tumko aisa uncha kareinge, ki tumhein us zameen ka adhikaari kar dein; evil logon ki murder tum khud apni aankhon se dekhoge.
Mainne ek evil aur krur aadmi ko dekha hai jo upjaau zameen ke hare vriksh ke jaisa uncha tha,
Lekin shighr hi uska astitv samaapt ho gaya; khojne par bhi main use na pa saka.
Nirdosh ki or dekho, khare ko dekhte raho; ujjval hota hai shaant aadmi ka bhavishy.
Lekin sab apraadhi barbaadi hi honge; evil logon ki santti hi mita di jaaegi.
Yahweh dharmiyon ke bachaav ka ugam jagah hain; vahi vipatti ke avsar par unke aashray hote hain.
Yahweh unki madad karte hue unko bachaate hain; isliye ki righteous Yahweh ka aashray lete hain, Yahweh evil se unki raksha karte hue unko bachaate hain.
Yahweh, apne krodh mein mujhe na daantie aur na apne kop mein mujhe dand dijie.
Kyonki aapke baan mujhe lag chuke hain, aur aapke haath ke bojh ne mujhe daba rakha hai.
Aapke prakop ne meri deh ko svasth nahin chhora; mere hi galti ke parinaamasvrup meri haddiyon mein ab bal nahin raha.
Main apne apraadhon mein dub chuka hun; ek atishay bojh ke jaisa ve meri uthaane ki kshamta se pare hain.
Mere ghaav sar chuke hain, ve bahut ghrinaaspad hain yah sabhi meri galat murkhta ka hi parinaam hai.
Main jhuk gaya hun, durbalta ke shokbhaav se bahut nicha ho gaya hun; saare din main vilaap hi karta rahta hun.
Meri kamar mein jalti-chubhti-si dard ho rahi hai; meri deh bahut rugn ho gai hai.
Main durbal hun aur tut chuka hun; main dil ki dard mein karaah raha hun.
Lord, aapko yah jnaat hai ki meri aakaanksha kya hai; meri aahein aapse chhupi nahin hain.
Mere dil ki dharakne tivr ho gai hain, mujhmein bal shesh na raha; yahaan tak ki meri aankhon ki roshni bhi jaati rahi.
Mere mitr aur mere saathi mere ghaavon ke kaaran mere nikat nahin aana chaahte; mere sambandhi mujhse dur hi dur rahte hain.
Mere praanon ke pyaase logon ne mere lie jaal bichhaaya hai, jinhein meri durgti ki kaamna hai; mere vinaash ki yojna bana rahe hain, ve saare din chhal ki buri yukti rachte rahte hain.
Main badhir insaan jaisa ho chuka hun, jise kuchh sunaai nahin deta, main muk aadmi-jaisa ho chuka hun, jo baatein nahin kar sakta;
Haan, main us aadmi-sa ho chuka hun, jiski sunne ki power jaati rahi, jiska chehra bolne ke yogy nahin rah gaya.
Yahweh, mainne aap par hi bharosa kiya hai; ki Lord mere God uttar aapse hi receive hoga.
Mainne aapse anurodh kiya tha, “Yadi mere pair phislein, to unhein mujh par hansne aur prabal hone ka sukh na dena.”
Ab mujhe mera ant nikat aata dikh raha hai, meri dard satat mere saamne bani rahti hai.
Main apna apraadh accept kar raha hun; mere galti ne mujhe bahut vyaakul kar rakha hai.
Mere dushman prabal, sashakt aur kai hain; jo akaaran hi mujhse nafrat karte hain.
Ve mere upkaaron ka pratiphal apkaar mein dete hain; jab main upkaar karna chaahta hun, ve mera virodh karte hain.
Yahweh, mera parityaag na kijie; mere God, mujhse dur na rahie.
Turant meri madad kijie, mere Lord, mere uddhaarkarta.
Mainne nishchay kiya, “Main galti karne se apne aachran aur jibh se apne bolne ki chauksi karunga; yadi main evil logon ki upasthiti mein hun, main apne vachnon par niyantran rakhunga.”
Tab mainne maun dhaaran kar liya, yahaan tak ki mainne bhali baaton par bhi niyantran laga diya, tab meri vyaakulta barhti chali gai;
Bhitar hi bhitar mera dil jalta gaya aur is vishay par adhik soch karne par mere bhitar agni bharakne lagi; tab mainne apna maun tor diya aur jibh se bol utha:
“Yahweh, mujh par mere life ka ant reveal kar dijie. Mujhe bataaie ki kitne din shesh hain mere life ke; mujh par spasht kijie ki kitna hai mera kshanbhangur life.
Aapne meri aayu kshanik sirf hi nirdhaarit ki hai; aapki tulna mein meri aayu ke varsh nagany hain. Vaise bhi insaan ka life-shvaas sirf hi hota hai, vah shaktishaali person ka bhi.
“Ek chhaaya ke jaisa, jo chalti-phirti rahti hai; uski saari bhaag daur nirarthak hi hoti hai. Vah wealth sanchit karta jaata hai, lekin use yah jnaat hi nahin hota, ki uska upbhog kaun karega.
“To Lord, ab main kis baat ki pratiksha karun? Meri ekmaatr ummid aap hi hain.
Mujhe mere sab apraadhon se bachaav provide kijie; mujhe bewakoofon ki nafrat ka paatr hone se bachaaie.
Main muk ban gaya; mainne kuchh bhi na kahna upyukt samjha, kyonki aap uthe the.
Ab mujh par prahaar karna rok dijie; aapke prahaar se main tut chuka hun.
Insaanon dvaara kie gae apraadh ke lie aap unhein taarna ke saath dand dete hain, aap unki amuly property aise barbaad kar dete hain, maano use kira kha gaya. Nishchyath insaan sirf ek shvaas hai.
“Yahweh, meri prayer sunie, meri madad ki pukaar par dhyaan dijie; mere aansuon ki ansuni na kijie. Main alpkaal ke lie aapka pardeshi hun, thik jis tarah mere sab purvaj pravaasi the.
Iske purv ki main chala jaaun, apni kopdrishti mujh par se hata lijie, ki kuchh samay ke lie hi mujhe khushi ka sukh receive ho sake.”
Main dhairypurvak Yahweh ki pratiksha karta raha; unhonne meri or jhukkar mera rona suna.
Unhonne mujhe satyaanaash ke gaddhe mein se bacha liya, daldal aur kich ke gaddhe se nikaala; unhonne mujhe ek chattaan par le ja khara kar diya ab mere paanv sthir jagah par hai.
Unhonne mujhe hamaare God ke praise mein, ek nae git ko sikhaaya. Kai yah dekheinge, shraddha se bhaybhit ho jaaeinge aur Yahweh mein faith kareinge.
Blessed hai vah aadmi, jo Yahweh par bharosa rakhta hai, jo abhimaaniyon se koi ummid nahin rakhta, ya unse, jo jhuthe devtaaon ki sharan mein hain.

Yahweh, mere God, aapke dvaara kie gae chamatkaar chinh kai-kai hain, aur hamaare lie aapke dvaara yojit yojnaaein. Aapke tuly koi bhi nahin hai; yadi main unka varnan karna shuruaat bhi karun, to unke asankhy hone ke kaaran unki ginti karna asambhav hoga.
Aapko bali aur bheint ki koi abhilaasha nahin, lekin aapne mere kaan khol die. Aapne agnibli aur galtiyon ki bali ki bhi chaahat nahin ki.
Tab mainne yah kaha, “Dekhie main a raha hun; pustika mein yah mere hi baare mein likha hai.
Mere God, mujhe dear hai aapki hi ichchhaapurti; aapki law mere dil mein basi hai.”
Vishaal sabha mein mainne aapke dharmmay shubh sandesh ka prachaar kiya hai; dekh lijie, Yahweh, aap jaante hain ki main is baare mein chup na rahunga.

Mainne apne God ki righteousness ko apne dil mein hi simit nahin rakha; main aapki faithfulness aur aapke dvaara provide kie gae bachaav ki charcha karta rahta hun. Vishaal sabha ke saamne main aapke saty aur aapke mercy-love ko chhupaata nahin.
Yahweh, aap apni grace se mujhe dur na kariye; aapka mercy-love aur aapki satyta nirantar mujhe surakshit rakheinge.

Main asankhy buraaiyon se ghir chuka hun; mere apraadhon ne barhkar mujhe daba diya hai; parinaamasvrup ab main dekh bhi nahin pa raha. Ye apraadh sankhya mein mere sir ke baalon se bhi adhik hain, mera saahas ab tuta ja raha hai.
Yahweh, grace kar mujhe bachaav provide kijie; Yahweh, turant meri madad kijie.
