Ve, jo mere praanon ke pyaase hain, lajjit aur niraash kie jaaein; ve jinka khushi meri dard mein hai, pith dikhaakar bhaagein aur apmaanit kie jaaein.
Ve sabhi, jo meri situation ko dekh, “Aaha! Aaha!” Kar rahe hain, apni hi lajjaaspad situation ko dekh vismit ho jaaein.
Lekin ve sabhi, jo aapki khoj karte hain harshollaas mein magan hon; ve sabhi, jinhein aapke bachaav ki aakaanksha hai, yahi kahein, “Ati mahaan hain Yahweh!”
Lord, main garib aur zaruratmand hun; is kaaran mujh par kripaadrishti kijie. Aap hi mere sahaayak aur chhuraanevaale hain; mere God, ab vilamb na kijie.
Blessed hai vah insaan, jo daridr aur durbal ki sudhi leta hai; Yahweh vipatti ki situation se uska bachaav karte hain.
Yahweh use suraksha provide kar uske life ki raksha kareinge. Vah apne desh mein blessed hoga. Yahweh use uske dushmanon ki ichchhaapurti ke lie nahin chhor deinge.
Rogshayya par Yahweh use sambhaalte raheinge, aur use punahsvasth kareinge.
Mainne pukaara, “Yahweh, mujh par grace kijie; yadypi mainne aapke khilaaf galti kiya hai, phir bhi mujhe rogmukt kijie.”
Buraai bhaav mein mere dushman mere baare mein kaamna karte hain, “Kab marega vah aur kab uska naam mitega?”

Jab kabhi unmein se koi mujhse bheint karne aata hai, vah khokhla dikhaava sirf karta hai, jabki man hi man vah mere baare mein adharm ki baatein sanchay karta hai; baahar jaakar vah inke aadhaar par meri ninda karta hai.
Mere sab dushman milkar mere khilaaf mein kaanaaphusi karte rahte hain; ve mere sambandh mein buraai ki yojna sochte rahte hain.
Ve kahte hain, “Use ek ghrinit rog ka sankrman ho gaya hai; ab vah is rogshayya se kabhi uth na sakega.”
Yahaan tak ki jo mera param mitr tha, jis par main bharosa karta tha, jiske saath main khaana karta tha, usi ne mujh par laat uthaai hai.
Lekin Yahweh, aap mujh par grace karein; mujhmein punh bal-sanchaar karein ki main unse pratishodh le sakun.
Isliye ki mera dushman mujhe barbaadi na kar saka, main samajh gaya hun ki aap mujhse aprsann nahin hain.
Meri sach ke kaaran mujhe sthir rakhte hue, hamesha-hamesha ke lie apni upasthiti mein mujhe basa lijie.
Hamesha se hamesha tak Israel ke God, Yahweh ka praise hota rahe. Aamen aur aamen.
Jaise hirni ko bahte jharnon ki utkat laalsa hoti hai, vaise hi God, mere jaan ko aapki laalsa rahti hai.
Mera jaan God ke lie, haan, jivant God ke lie pyaasa hai. Main kab jaakar God se bheint kar sakunga?
Din aur raat, mere aansu hi mera aahaar ban gae hain. Saare din log mujhse ek hi savaal kar rahe hain, “Kahaan hai tumhaara God?”

Jab main apne jaan aapke sammukh undel raha hun, mujhe un saari ghatnaaon ka smaran a raha hai; kyonki main hi God ke bhavan ki or agrgaami, vishaal janasmuh ki shobhaayaatra ka adhinaayak hua karta tha. Us samay utsav ke vaataavran mein jay jaykaar aur thanks ki dhvani gunj rahi hoti thi.
Mere jaan, tum aise khinn kyon ho? Kyon mere dil mein tum aise vyaakul ho gae ho? God par bharosa rakho, kyonki yah sab hone par main punh unki upasthiti ke aashvaasan ke lie unka praise karunga.
Mere God! Mere andar khinn hai mera jaan; tab main yardan pradesh se aur harmon, mitsaar parvat se aapka smaran karunga.
Aapke jharne ki garjna ke upar se saagar saagar ka aahvaan karta hai; saagar ki lahrein aur tat par takraati lahrein mujh par hoti hui nikal gain.
Din ke samay Yahweh apna mercy-love pragat karte hain, raatri mein unka git jo mere life ke lie God ko sambodhit ek prayer hai, use main gaaya karunga.
God, meri chattaan se main savaal karunga, “Aap mujhe kyon bhul gae? Mere dushmanon dvaara di ja rahi yaatnaaon ke kaaran, kyon mujhe shokit hona par raha hai?”
Jab saare din mere dushman yah kahte hue mujh par taana maarte hain, “Kahaan hai tumhaara God?” Tab meri haddiyaan maut vedna sah rahin hain.
Mere jaan, tum aise khinn kyon ho? Kyon mere dil mein tum aise vyaakul ho gae ho? God par bharosa rakho, kyonki yah sab hote hue bhi main Yahweh ka praise karunga.
God, mujhe nirdosh pramaanit kijie, shraddhaahin pirhi ke khilaaf mere paksh mein nirnay dijie. Mujhe jhuth bolne vaalon se aur evil logon se mukt kijie.
Kyonki aap vah God hain, jinmein mera bal hai. Aap mujhe bhul kyon gae? Mere dushmanon dvaara di ja rahi yaatnaaon ke kaaran, mujhe shokit kyon hona par raha hai?
Apni roshni aur apna saty bhej dijie, unhein hi meri aguvaai karne dijie; ki main aapke holy parvat tak pahunch sakun, jo aapka aavaas hai.
Tab main God ki vedi ke nikat ja sakunga, vahi God, jo mere parmaanand hain. Tab God, mere God, main kinnor ki sangat par aapki vandna karunga.
Mere jaan, tum aise khinn kyon ho? Kyon mere dil mein tum aise vyaakul ho gae ho? God par bharosa rakho, kyonki yah sab hote hue bhi main Yahweh ka praise karunga.
He God, hamne apne kaanon se suna hai, purvjon ne uska ullekh kiya hai, ki praachin kaal mein, hamaare purvjon ke samay mein aapne jo kuchh kiya hai:
Apne bhujbal se aapne jantaaon ko nikaal diya aur unke jagah par hamaare purvjon ko basa diya; aapne un logon ko kuchal diya aur hamaare purvjon ko samriddh bana diya.

Yah authority unhonne apni talvaar ke bal par nahin kiya, aur na hi yah unke bhujbal ka parinaam tha; yah parinaam tha aapke daayein haath, uski power aur aapke chehra ke prakaash ka, kyonki ve aapki priti ke paatr the.
Mere God, aap mere raaja hain, Yaakob ki vijay ka order dijie.
Aapke dvaara hi ham apne dushmanon par prabal ho sakeinge; aap hi ke glorious naam se ham apne dushmanon ko kuchal daaleinge.
Mujhe apne dhanush par bharosa nahin hai, meri talvaar bhi meri vijay ka saadhan nahin hai;
Hamein apne dushmanon par vijay aapne hi provide ki hai, aapne hi hamaare dushmanon ko lajjit kiya hai.
Ham nirantar God mein garv karte rahe, ham hamesha-hamesha aapki glory ka thanks karte raheinge.
Lekin ab aapne hamein lajjit hone ke lie shokit chhor diya hai; aap hamaari sena ke saath bhi nahin chal rahe.
Aapke dur hone ke kaaran, hamein dushmanon ko pith dikhaani pari. Yahaan tak ki hamaare virodhi hamein lutkar chale gae.
Aapne hamein vadh ke lie nirdhaarit bheron jaisa chhor diya hai. Aapne hamein kai raashtron mein bikher diya hai.
Aapne apni people ko mitti ke mol bech diya, aur upar se aapne ismein laabh milne ki bhi baat nahin ki.
Apne parosiyon ke lie ab ham nindniy ho gae hain, sabke saamne ghrinit aur uphaas paatr.
Raashtron mein ham upma hokar rah gae hain; hamaare naam par ve sir hilaane lagte hain.
Saare din mera apmaan mere saamne jhulta rahta hai, aur meri lajja ne mujhe bhaybhit kar rakha hai.
Us dushman ki vaani, jo meri ninda aur mujhe kalankit karta hai, uski upasthiti ke kaaran jo dushman aur badla lenevaale hai.
Hamne na to aapko bhula diya tha, aur na hamne aapki vaacha hi bhang ki; phir bhi hamein yah sab sahna para.
Hamaare dil aapse bahke nahin; hamaare kadam aapke raasta se bhatke nahin.
Phir bhi aapne hamein ujaar kar gidron ka basera bana diya; aur hamein gahan andhera mein chhipa diya.
Yadi ham apne God ko bhul hi jaate ya hamne dusre devtaaon ki or haath barhaaya hota,
Kya God ko iska pata na chal gaya hota, unhein to dil ke sabhi rahasyon ka knowledge hota hai?
Phir bhi aapke nimitt ham din bhar maut ka saamna karte rahte hain; hamaari situation vadh ke lie nirdhaarit bheron ke jaisa hai.
Jaagie, Lord! So kyon rahe hain? Uth jaaie! Hamein hamesha ke lie shokit na chhorie.
Aapne hamse apna chehra kyon chhipa liya hai hamaari durdsha aur utpiran ko andekha na kijie?
Hamaare jaan dhul mein mil hi chuke hain; hamaara pet zameen se ja laga hai.
Uthkar hamaari madad kijie; apne mercy-love ke nimitt hamein mukt kijie.
Raaja ke sammaan mein kavita paath karte hue mere dil mein madhur bhaav umar raha hain; meri jibh kushal lekhak ki lekhni ban gai hai.
Aap hi aadmiyon mein sarvashreshth hain, aapke honthon mein grace bhara hota hai, kyonki khud God dvaara aapko sadaiv ke lie blessed kiya gaya hai.
Paramvir yoddha, talvaar se susajjit ho jaaie; aishvary aur tej dhaaran kar lijie.
Saty, vinamrta aur righteousness ki raksha karte hue, aapke samriddh yash mein, aishvary ke saath apne ashv par savaar ho jaaie! Aapka daayaan haath adbhut kaary kar dikhaae!
Aapke tikshn baan raaja ke dushmanon ke dil bedh dein; raashtr aapse barbaadi ho aapke charnon mein gir parein.
God, aapka sinhaasan amar hai; aapke raajy ka raajdand vahi hoga, jo sach ka raajdand hai.
Righteousness aapko dear hai aur dushtta ghrinaaspad; yahi kaaran hai ki God, aapke God ne harsh ke tel se aapko abhishikt karke aapke sab saathiyon se unche jagah par basa diya hai.
Aapke sabhi kapde gandhras, agru aur tejpaat se sugandhit kie gae hain; haathi-daant se jarit raajamhal se madhur tantu vaadyon ka sangit aapko magan karta rahta hai.
Aapke raajy mein aadarniy auraton ke pad par raajkumaariyaan hain; aapke daayein paksh mein ophir raajy ke kundan se saji raaj-vadhu viraajmaan hain.
Raajkanya, sunie, dhyaan dijie aur soch kijie: ab aapka raajy aur aapke pita ka parivaar praachin kaal ka vishay ho gaya.
Tab mahaaraaj aapke saundary ki kaamna kareinge; kyonki vah aapke maalik hain, ab aap unke saamne natmastak hon.
Sor desh ki raajkanya uphaar lekar aaeingi, dhani aadmi aapki kripaadrishti ki kaamna kareinge.
Antahpur mein raajkanya ne bhavy shringaar kiya hai; uske kapde par sone ke dhaagon se karhaai ki gai hai.
Karhaai kie gae kapde dhaaran kie hue unhein raaja ke nikat le jaaya ja raha hai; unke pichhe kunvaari vadhu saheliyon ki panktiyaan chal rahi hain, yah samuh ab aapke nikat pahunch raha hai.
Ye sabhi khushi aur ullaas ke bhaav mein yahaan a pahunche hain, ab unhonne raajamhal mein pravesh kiya hai.
Aapke son purvjon ke jagah par honge; aap unhein sab desh ke shaasak bana deinge.
Sabhi pirhiyon ke lie main aapki glory sajiv rakhunga; tab sab raashtr hamesha-hamesha aapka thanks kareinge.
God hamaare aashray-sthal aur power hain, sankat ki situation mein sadaiv uplabdh sahaayak.
Tab ham bhaybhit na honge, chaahe prithvi visthaapit ho jaae, chaahe parvat mahaasaagar ke garbh mein ja parein,
Haan, tab bhi jab samudr garajna karte hue phen uthaane lagein aur parvat is uttejna ke kaaran tharra jaaein.
God ke shehar mein ek nadi hai, jiski jaldhaara mein is shehar ka ullaas hai, yah shehar vah holy jagah hai, jahaan sarvochch God nivaas karte hain.
God is shehar mein nivaas karte hain, is shehar ki kshati na hogi; har ek arunoday mein uske lie God ki madad milti rahegi.
Raashtron mein khalabli machi hui hai, raajy ke log dagamgaane lage; God ke ek aahvaan par, prithvi pighal jaati hai.
Sarvshaktimaan Yahweh hamaare paksh mein hain; Yaakob ke God mein hamaari suraksha hai.
Yahaan aakar Yahweh ke kaaryon par soch karo, prithvi par unhonne kaisa vidhvans kiya hai.
Unhin ke order se prithvi ke chhor tak yuddh tham jaate hain. Vahi dhanush ko bhang aur bhaale ko tukre-tukre kar dete hain; vah rathon ko agni mein bhasm kar dete hain.
God kahte hain, “Sab koshish chhorkar yah samajh lo ki God main hun; sab raashtron mein meri glory hogi, sab prithvi par meri glory hogi.”
Sarvshaktimaan Yahweh hamaare paksh mein hain; Yaakob ke God mein hamaari suraksha hai.
Sab raashtro, taaliyaan bajaao; harshollaas mein God ka jay jaykaar karo.
Yahweh, sarvochch God dar-yogy hain, vahi sab prithvi ke upar paraakrmi raaja hain.
Unhin ne jantaaon ko hamaare adhin kar diya hai, log hamaare pairon ke niche ho gae hain.
Unhin ne hamaare lie nij bhaag ko nirdhaarit kiya hai, yahi Yaakob ka gaurav hai, jo unka dear hai.
Jay jaykaar ki dhvani ke beech se God upar uthaae gae, turhi naad ke beech Yahweh upar uthaae gae.
Praise gaan mein God ki vandna karo, vandna karo; praise gaan mein hamaare raajaadhiraaj ki vandna karo, vandna karo.
God sampurn prithvi ke raajaadhiraaj hain; unke sammaan mein ek praise git prastut karo.
Sampurn raashtron par God ka shaasan hai; God apne mahaan sinhaasan par viraajmaan hain.
Abraham ke God ki people ke taur par jantaaon ke adhyaksh ekatr hue hain, kyonki prithvi ki dhaalon par God ka authority hai; God bahut unche hain.
Mahaan hain Yahweh, hamaare God ke shehar mein, unke holy parvat mein, sarvochch vandna aur prashansa ke yogy.
Manohar hain iske shikhar, jismein sab prithvi aanandmagn hai, ziyon parvat uttar ke uchch parvat zephon ke jaisa hai, jo raajaadhiraaj ka shehar hai.
Iske raajmahlon mein God nivaas karte hain; unhonne khud ko iska garh pramaanit kar diya hai.
Jab raajaaon ne apni senaaein sanyukt ki, jab unhonne is par aakrman kiya,
Tab ve ise dekh chakit rah gae; ve bhaybhit ho bhaag khare hue.
Dar ke kaaran unhein vahaan aisi kampkampi hone lagi, jaisi prasav dard mein prasuta ko hoti hai.
Aapne unka aisa vidhvans kiya, jaise tarshish ke jalyaanon ka purvi hava ke kaaran hua tha.
Jaisa hamne suna tha, aur jaisa hamne dekha hai sarvshaktimaan Yahweh ke shehar mein, hamaare God ke shehar mein: God use hamesha glory provide kareinge.
God, aapke temple mein, hamne aapke mercy-love par chintan kiya hai.
Jaisi aapki glory hai, vaisi hi aapki praise-prashansa bhi prithvi ke chhor tak pahunch rahi hai; aapka daayaan haath righteousness se bhara hai.
Ziyon parvat ullsit hai, Yahudah pradesh ke shehar aapke nishpaksh justice ke kaaran harshit ho rahe hain.
Ziyon ki parikrma karte hue, uske stambhon ki ganna karo.
Uski shahrapnaah par nazar lagaao, uske mahlon ka bhraman karo, ki tatpashchaat tum agli pirhi ko inke baare mein bata sako.
Yahi hain vah God, jo yugaanuyug ke lie hamaare God hain; vahi ant tak hamaari aguvaai karte raheinge.
Vibhinn deshon ke nivaasiyo, yah suno; dharti ke vaasiyo, yah suno,
Suno are uchch aur nimn, suno are din jano aur amiro,
Main buddhimaani ki baatein karne par hun; aur mere dil ka chintan samajh se paripurn hoga.
Main nitivchan par dhyaan dunga; main kinnor ki sangat par paheli spasht karunga:
Kya aavashyakta hai vipatti ke samay mujhe bhaybhit hone ki, jab evil dhokhebaaj mujhe a gherte hain;
Haan, ve jinka bharosa unki property par hai, aur jinhein apni sampannta ka garv hai?
Koi bhi insaan kisi dusre insaan ke praanon ka bachaav nahin kar sakta, aur na hi vah God ko kisi ke praanon ke lie chhurauti de sakta hai.
Kyonki uske praanon ka muly bahut uncha hai, ki koi muly paryaapt nahin hai,
Ki insaan hamesha jivit rahe, vah kabhi kabr ka anubhav na kare.
Sabhi ke saamne yah spasht hai, ki sabhi buddhimaano ki bhi maut hoti hai; vaise hi bewakoofon aur ajnaaniyon ki bhi, ye sabhi apni property dusron ke lie chhor jaate hain.
Unki aatma mein unka soch hai, ki unke aavaas amar hain, aur unke nivaas sabhi pirhiyon ke lie ho gae hain, ve to apne deshon ko bhi apne naam se pukaarne lage hain.
Apne aishvary ke baavjud insaan amratv receive nahin kar sakta; vah to phir bhi nashvar pashu jaisa hi hai.
Yah niyti unki hai, jo buddhihin hain aur unki, jo unke vichaaron se sahmat hote hain.

Bheron ke jaisa adholok hi unki niyti hai; maut hi unka charvaaha hoga. Praatahkaal sidhe log un par shaasan kareinge aur unki deh adholok ki graas ho jaaeingi, parinaamasvrup unka koi aadhaar shesh na rah jaaega.
Mere jaan God dvaara adholok ki power se mukt kie jaaeinge; nishchyath vah mujhe accept kar leinge.
Kisi aadmi ki viksit hoti ja rahi samriddhi ko dekh dar na jaana, jab uski lifestyle vaibhavshaali hone lage;
Kyonki maut hone par vah inmein se kuchh bhi apne saath nahin le jaaega, uska vaibhav uske saath kabr mein nahin utrega.
Yadypi jab vah jivit tha, usne prashansa hi receive ki, kyonki insaan samriddh hone par unki prashansa karte hi hain,
Vah aadmi antath apne purvjon mein hi ja milega, jinke lie life prakaash dekhna niyat nahin hai.
Ek dhanvaan insaan ko subuddhi kho gaya hai, to usmein aur us naashmaan pashu mein koi antar nahin rah gaya!
Vah, jo sarvshaktimaan hain, Yahweh, God, suryoday se suryaast tak prithvi ko sambodhit karte hain.
Ziyon ke param saundary mein, God tej dikha rahe hain.
Hamaare God a rahe hain, vah nishkriy nahin rah sakte; unke aage-aage bhasmkaari agni chalti hai, aur unke chaaron or hai prachand aandhi.
Unhonne aakaash aur prithvi ko aahvaan kiya, ki ve apni people ki justice-prakriya shuruaat karein.
Unhonne order diya, “Mere paas mere bhakton ko ekatr karo, jinhonne bali arpan ke dvaara mujhse vaacha sthaapit ki hai.”
Aakaash unki righteousness ki pushti karta hai, kyonki God hi nyaayaadhyaksh hain.
“Meri people, meri suno, main kuchh kah raha hun; Israel, main tumhaare khilaaf saakshy de raha hun, God main hun, tumhaara God.
Tumhaari baliyon ke kaaran main tumhein daant nahin raha aur na main tumhaari agnibliyon ki aalochna kar raha hun, jo nit mujhe arpit ki ja rahi hain.
Mujhe na to tumhaare pashushaale se bail ki aavashyakta hai aur na hi tumhaare jhund se kisi bakre ki,
Kyonki har ek vany pashu mera hai, vaise hi hajaaron pahaariyon par char rahe pashu bhi mere hi hain.
Parvton mein base sab pakshiyon ko main jaanta hun, maidaan mein chalte phirte sab praani bhi mere hi hain.
Tab yadi main bhukha hota to tumse nahin kahta, kyonki sab duniya aur ismein magan sabhi vastuein meri hi hain.
Kya bailon ka maans mera aahaar hai aur bakron ka rakt mera pey?
“God ko thanks ka bali arpit karo, sarvochch God ke lie apni promise purn karo,
Tab sankat kaal mein mujhe pukaaro; to main tumhaara bachaav karunga aur tum mujhe sammaan doge.”
Lekin evil se, God kahte hain: “Jab tum meri teachings se nafrat karte, aur mere nirdeshon ko hey maante ho?
To kya authority hai tumhein meri law ka vaachan karne, ya meri vaacha ko bolne ka?
Chor ko dekhte hi tum uske saath ho lete ho; vaise hi tum vyabhichaariyon ke saath vyabhichaar mein sammilit ho jaate ho.
Tumne apne chehra ko buraai ke lie samarpit kar diya hai, tumhaari jibh chhal-kapat ke lie tatpar rahti hai.
Tum nirantar apne hi bhaai ki ninda karte rahte ho, apne hi sage bhaai ke khilaaf chugli lagaate rahte ho.
Tum yah sab karte rahe, lekin main chup raha, aur tum yah samajhte rahe ki main tumse sahmat hun. Lekin main ab tumhi par shaasan karunga aur tumhaare hi sammukh tum par aarop lagaaunga.
“Tum, jo God ko bhulnevaale ho gae ho, soch karo, aisa na ho ki main tumhein tukre-tukre kar barbaad kar dun aur koi tumhaari raksha na kar sake:
Jo koi mujhe thanks ki bali arpit karta hai, mera sammaan karta hai, main use, jo sanmaarg ka aachran karta hai, God ke bachaav ka anubhav karvaaunga.”
God, apne mercy-love mein, apni bari mercy mein; mujh par daya kijie, mere apraadhon ko mita dijie.
Mere sab adharm ko dho dijie aur mujhe mere galti se shuddh kar dijie.
Mainne apne apraadh pahchaan lie hain, aur mera galti mere nazar par chhaaya rahta hai.

Vastuth mainne aapke, sirf aapke khilaaf hi galti kiya hai, mainne thik vahi kiya hai, jo aapki nazar mein bura hai; tab jab aap apne justice ke anurup dand dete hain, yah har nazar se justice sangat aur upyukt hai.
Ismein bhi sandeh nahin ki main janm ke samay se hi galti karnevaala hun, haan, usi kshan se, jab meri maata ne mujhe garbh mein dhaaran kiya tha.
Yah bhi baatein hain ki aapki yah abhilaasha hai, ki hamaari aatma mein saty ho; tab aap mere antahkran mein bhalaai provide kareinge.
Jufa paudhe ki tahni se mujhe svachchh karein, to main shuddh ho jaaunga; mujhe dho dijie, tab main him se bhi adhik shvet ho jaaunga.
Mujhmein harshollaas aur khushi ka sanchaar kijie; ki meri haddiyaan jinhein aapne kuchal di hain, magan ho uthein.
Mere galtiyon ko apni nazar se dur kar dijie aur mere sab apraadh mita dijie.
God, mujhmein ek shuddh dil ko utpann kijie, aur mere andar mein sudrirh aatma ki punahsthaapna kijie.
Mujhe apne saannidhy se dur na kijie aur mujhse aapke pavitraatma ko na chhinie.
Apne bachaav ka ullaas mujhmein punh sanchaarit kijie, aur ek tatpar aatma provide kar mujhmein navjivan ka sanchaar kijie.
Tab main apraadhiyon ko aapki nitiyon ki teaching de sakunga, ki galti karnevaala aapki or punh phir sakein.
God, mere chhuraanevaale God, mujhe raktpaat ke dosh se mukt kar dijie, ki meri jibh aapki righteousness ka praise gaan kar sake.
Lord, mere honthon ko khol dijie, ki mere chehra se aapki praise-prashansa ho sake.
Aapki prasannta baliyon mein nahin hai, anytha main bali arpit karta, agnibli mein bhi aap prasann nahin hain.
Tuti aatma hi God ko svikaary yogy bali hai; tute aur pachhtaaye dil se, he God, aap nafrat nahin karte hain.
Aapki kripaadrishti se ziyon ki samriddhi ho, Yerushalem ki shahrapnaah ka punarnirmaan ho.
Tab righteous ki agnibli aur sarvaang pashubli arpan se aap prasann honge; aur aapki vedi par bail arpit kie jaaeinge.
He balvaan ghamandi, apni buraai ka ahankaar kyon karta hai? Tu din bhar kyon ghamand karta hai, tu jo God ki najar mein ek apmaan hai?
Tej ustre jaisi tumhaari jibh vinaash ki buri yukti rachti rahti hai, aur tum chhal ke kaary mein lipt rahte ho.
Tumhein bhalaai se jyaada adharm, aur saty se adhik jhuthaachaar pasand hai.
He chhali jibh, tujhe to har ek bura word dear hai!
Yah sunishchit hai ki God ne tere lie sthaayi vinaash nirdhaarit kiya hai: vah tujhe ukhaarkar tere nivaas se dur kar deinge; God tujhe jiv-lok se ukhaar deinge.
Yah dekh righteous bhaybhit ho jaaeinge; ve use dekh yah kahte hue uphaas kareinge,
“Us aadmi ko dekho, jisne God ko apna aashray banaana upyukt na samjha lekin usne apni wealth-property par bharosa kiya aur anyon par dushkarm karte hue sashakt hota gaya!”
Lekin main God ke nivaas ke hare-bhare jaitun vriksh ke jaisa hun; main God ke mercy-love par hamesha-hamesha bharosa rakhta hun.

God, main aapke dvaara kie gae kaaryon ke lie hamesha-hamesha aapka thanks karta rahunga. Aapke naam meri ummid rahegi, kyonki vah uttam hai, aapke bhakton ke upasthiti mein main aapki vandna karta rahunga.
Bewakoof man hi man mein kahte hain, “God hai hi nahin.” Ve sabhi bhrasht hain aur unki lifestyle ghinauni hai; aisa koi bhi nahin, jo bhalaai karta ho.
Heaven se God insaanon par nazar daalte hain is ummid mein ki koi to hoga, jo wise hai, jo God ki khoj karta ho.
Sabhi insaan bhatak gae hain, sabhi naitik rup se bhrasht ho chuke hain; koi bhi satkarm paropkaar nahin karta, haan, ek bhi nahin.
Meri people ke ye bhakshak, ye evil aadmi, kya aise nirbuddhi hain? Jo use aise kha jaate hain, jaise roti ko; kya unhein God ki upaasna ka koi dhyaan nahin?

Jahaan dar ka koi kaaran hi na tha, vahaan ve bahut bhaybhit ho gae. God ne unki haddiyon ko bikhra diya, jo tere khilaaf chhaavni daale hue the; tumne unhein lajjit kar daala, kyonki ve God dvaara lajjit kiye gaye the.
Kaisa uttam hota yadi Israel ka bachaav ziyon se pragat hota! Yaakob ke lie vah harshollaas ka avsar hoga, jab God apni people ko daasatv se lauta laaeinge, tab Israel aanandit ho jaaega!
God, apne naam ke dvaara mera bachaav kijie; apni power ke dvaara mujhe nirdosh pramaanit kijie.
God, meri prayer sunie; mere chehra ke vachnon par dhyaan dijie.
Aise aprichit aadmiyon ne mujh par aakrman kar diya hai; kukarmi aadmi ab mere jaan ke pyaase ho gae hain, jinke dil mein aapke prati koi shraddha nahin hai.
Koi sandeh nahin ki God meri madad ke lie tatpar hain; Lord hi hain, jo mujhmein bal dete hain.
Aisa ho ki buraai mere nindkon par hi ja pare; God apni faithfulness ke kaaran unka vinaash kar dijie.
Main aapko svechchha bali arpit karunga; Yahweh, main aapki mahaan glory ki saraahna karunga, kyonki yah shobhniy hai.
Aapne sab sankton se mera chhutkaara kiya hai, mainne khud apni aankhon se, apne dushmanon ki paraajay dekhi hai.
God, meri prayer par dhyaan dijie, meri girgiraahat ko na thukraaie;
Meri girgiraahat sunkar, mujhe uttar dijie. Mere vichaaron ne mujhe vyaakul kar diya hai.
Dushmanon ki lalkaar ne mujhe niraash kar chhora hai; unhin ke dvaara mujh par kasht undele gae hain aur ve krodh mein mujhe kharikhoti suna rahe hain.
Bhitar hi bhitar mera dil vedna mein bhar raha hai; mujhmein maut ka dar sama gaya hai.
Dar aur kampkampi ne mujhe bhaybhit kar liya hai; main aatank se ghir chuka hun.
Tab main soch karne laga, “Kaisa hota yadi kabutar jaisa mere pankh hote! Aur main urkar dur shaanti mein vishraam kar paata.
Haan, main urkar dur chala jaata, aur nirjan pradesh mein nivaas bana leta.
Main bavandar aur aandhi se dur, apne aashray-sthal ko lautne ki shighrta karta.”
Lord, evil logon ke beech phut daal dijie, unki bhaasha mein garabri kar dijie, yah spasht hi hai ki shehar mein hinsa aur kalah phut pare hain.
Din-raat ve shahrapnaah par chhip-chhip kar ghumte rahte hain; shehar mein vaimnasy aur adharm ka saamraajy hai.
Vahaan vinaashkaari shaktiyaan prabal ho rahi hain; galiyon mein dhamkiyaan aur chhal samaapt hi nahin hote.
Yadi dushman meri ninda karta to yah, mere lie sahniy hai; yadi mera virodhi mere khilaaf uth khara ho to, main usse chhip sakta hun.
Lekin yahaan to tum, mere saathi, mere param mitr, mere dushman ho gae hain, jo mere saath saath rahe hain,
Tumhaare hi saath mainne sangti ke mel-milaap avasron ka khushi liya tha, dusre aaraadhkon ke saath ham bhi saath saath God ke bhavan ko jaate the.
Ab uttam vahi hoga ki achaanak hi mere dushmanon par maut a pare; ve jivit hi adholok mein utar jaaein, kyonki buraai unke ghar mein a basi hai, unki aatma mein bhi.
Yahaan main to God ko hi pukaarunga, Yahweh hi mera bachaav kareinge.
Praath, dophar aur sandhya main dard mein karaahta rahunga, aur vah meri pukaar suneinge.
Unhonne mujhe us yuddh se bina kisi haani ke surakshit nikaal liya, jo mere khilaaf kiya ja raha tha jabki mere kai virodhi the.
Hamesha ke sinhaasan par viraajmaan God, meri request sunkar unhein taarna kareinge. Ve aise hain, jinka dil parivartit nahin hota; unmein God ka koi dar nahin.
Mera saathi hi apne mitron par prahaar kar raha hai; usne apni vaacha bhang kar di hai.
Makkhan jaisi chikni hain uski baatein, phir bhi yuddh uske dil mein hai; uske words mein tel se adhik komalta thi, phir bhi ve nangi talvaar the.
Apne daayitvon ka bojh Yahweh ko saump do, tumhaare bal ka srot vahi hain; yah ho hi nahin sakta ki vah kisi righteous aadmi ko patan ke lie shokit chhor dein.
Lekin God, aapne evil logon ke lie vinaash ke gaddhe ko nirdhaarit kiya hai; rakt pipaasu aur kapti insaan apni aadhi aayu tak bhi pahunch na paaeinge. Lekin mera bharosa aap par atal bana rahega.
God, mujh par grace kijie, kyonki dushman mujhe kuchal rahe hain; din bhar unka aakrman mujh par prabal hota ja raha hai.
Mere nindak saare din mera pichha karte hain; kai hain, jo mujh par apne ahankaar se prahaar kar rahe hain.
Bhaybhit hone ki situation mein, main aap par hi bharosa karunga.
God, aapki promise praise prashansniy hai, God, main aap par hi bharosa rakhunga aur purnath nirbhay ho jaaunga. Nashvar insaan mera kya bigaar lega?
Din bhar mere vachan ko ulta kar prasaarit kiya jaata hai; meri haani ki yuktiyaan sochna unki dincharya ho gai hai.
Ve buri yukti rachte hain, ve ghaat lagaae baithe rahte hain, ve mere har kadam par nazar banaae rakhte hain, ki kab mere jaan le sakein.
Unki dushtta ko dekhkar unhein bachkar na jaane dein; God, apne krodh ke dvaara in logon ko mita dijie.
Aapne mere bhatakne ka lekha rakha hai; aapne mere aansu apni kuppi mein jama kar rakhein hain. Aapne inka lekha bhi apni pustak mein rakha hai?
Tab jaise hi main aapko pukaarunga, mere dushman pith dikhaakar bhaag khare honge. Tab yah pramaanit ho jaaega ki God mere paksh mein hain.
Vahi God, jinki promise praise prashansniy hai, vahi Yahweh, jinki promise praise prashansniy hai.
Main God par hi bharosa rakhunga, tab mujhe kisi ka dar na hoga. Insaan mera kya bigaar sakta hai?
God, mujhe aapke prati ki gai manntein purn karni hain; main aapko apni aabhaar-bali arpan karunga.
Kyonki aapne maut se mere praanon ki raksha ki hai, mere paanvon ko aapne phisalne se bachaaya hai ki main, God, aapke saath saath life roshni mein chal sakun.
Mujh par grace kijie, he mere God, grace kijie, kyonki mainne aapko hi apna aashray-sthal banaaya hai. Main aapke pankhon ke niche aashray lie rahunga, jab tak vinaash mujh par se tal na jaae.
Main sarvochch God ko pukaarta hun, vahi God, jo mujhe nirdosh thahraate hain.
Vah heaven se madad bhejkar mera bachaav kareinge; jo mujhe kuchalte hain unse unhein nafrat hai. God apna mercy-love aur apna saty preshit kareinge.
Main sinhon se ghir gaya hun; main hinsak pashuon jaisa insaanon ke beech para hua hun. Unke daant bhaalon aur baanon jaisa, aur jibhein talvaar jaisa tikshn hain.
God, aap sarvochch heaven mein base hain; aapka tej sab prithvi ko bhaybhit karein.
Unhonne mere raasta mein jaal bichhaaya hai; mera jaan duba ja raha tha. Unhonne mere raasta mein gaddha bhi khod rakha tha, lekin ve khud usi mein ja gire hain.
Mera dil nishchint hai, God, mera dil nishchint hai; main praise karte hue gaaunga aur sangit bajaaunga.
Meri aatma, jaago! Nebel aur kinnor jaago! Main ushahkaal ko jaagrit karunga.
Lord, main logon ke beech aapka aabhaar vyakt karunga; raashtron ke maghy main aapka praise karunga.
Kyonki aapka mercy-love aakaash se bhi mahaan hai; aapki sach antriksh tak ja pahunchti hai.
God, aap sarvochch heaven mein base hain; aapka tej sab prithvi ko bhaybhit karein.
Nyaayaadhisho, kya vaastav mein tumhaara nirnay justice sangat hota hai? Kya, tumhaara nirnay vaastav mein nishpaksh hi hota hai?
Nahin, man hi man tum anyaaypurn yukti karte rahte ho, prithvi par tum hinsa paroste ho.
Evil log janm se hi phisalte hain, garbh se hi; God se jhuth bolte hue bhatak jaate hai.
Unka vish vishaile sarp ka vish hai, us bahre sarp ke jaisa, jisne apne kaan band kar rakhe hain.
Ki ab use sampere ki dhun sunaai na de, chaahe vah kitna hi madhur sangit prastut kare.
God, unke chehra ke bhitar hi unke daant tor dijie; Yahweh, in sinhon ke daadhon ko hi ukhaar dijie!
Ve paani ke jaise bahkar vilin ho jaaein; jab ve dhanush taanein, unke baan nishaane tak nahin pahunchein.
Ve us ghonghe ke jaisa ho jaaein, jo sarakte-sarakte hi gal jaata hai, ya us mrit janme shishu ke jaisa, jiske lie sury prakaash ka anubhav asambhav hai.
Iske purv ki kantili jhaariyon mein lagaai agni ka taap pakaane ke paatr tak pahunche, vah jale ya anajle donon hi ko bavandar mein ura deinge.
Righteous ke lie aisa palta aanand-daayak hoga, vah evil logon ke rakt mein apne paanv dhoega.
Tab insaan yah kah utheinge, “Nishchay righteous uttam pratiphal receive karte hain; yah saty hai ki God hain aur vah prithvi par justice karte hain.”
God, mujhe mere dushmanon se chhura lijie; mujhe unse suraksha provide kijie, jo mere khilaaf uth khare hue hain.
Mujhe kukarmiyon se chhura lijie aur hatyaare aadmiyon se mujhe suraksha provide kijie.
Dekhie, ve kaise mere lie ghaat lagaae baithe hain! Jo mere lie buri yukti rach rahe hain ve hinsak aadmi hain. Yahweh, na mainne koi apraadh kiya hai aur na koi galti.
Mujhse koi bhul bhi nahin hui, phir bhi ve aakrman ke lie tatpar hain. Meri durgti par nazar kar, meri madad ke lie a jaaie!
Yahweh, sarvshaktimaan God, Israel ke God, in sab raashtron ko dand dene ke lie uth jaaie; evil vishvaasghaatiyon par koi grace na kijie.
Ve sandhya ko lautte, kutton ke jaisa chillaate, aur shehar mein ghumte rahte hain.
Aap dekhie ki ve apne munh se kya-kya ugal rahe hain, unke honthon mein se talvaar baahar aati hai, tab ve kahte hain, “Kaun sun sakta hai hamein?”
Lekin, Yahweh, aap un par hanste hain; ye saare raashtr aapke uphaas ke vishay hain.
Meri power, mujhe aapki hi pratiksha hai; mere God, aap mere aashray-sthal hain,
Aap mere premmay God hain. God mere aage-aage jaaeinge, tab main apne nindkon ke upar santosh ke saath vyangy purn nazar daal sakunga.
Lekin mere Lord, meri dhaal, unki murder na kijie, anytha meri people unhein bhul jaaegi. Apne power mein unhein titar-bitar bhatkaane ke lie chhor dijie, ki unmein manobal hi shesh na rah jaae.

Unke chehra ke vachan dvaara kie gae galtiyon ke kaaran, unke honthon dvaara kie gae anaachaar ke lie aur unke dvaara die gae shaap aur jhuthaachaar ke kaaran, unhein apne hi ahankaar mein phans jaane dijie.

Unhein apni krodh agni mein bhasm kar dijie, unhein is tarah bhasm kijie, ki unka kuchh bhi shesh na rah jaae. Tab yah prithvi ki chhor tak sarvvidit baatein ho jaaegi, ki God hi vastuth Yaakob ke shaasak hain.
Ve sandhya ko lautte, kutton ke jaisa chillaate aur shehar mein ghumte rahte hain.
Ve khaana ki khoj mein ghumte rahte hain aur santosh na hone par siyaaron jaise chillaane lagte hain.
Lekin main aapki power ka gungaan karunga, praatahkaal mere git ka vishay hoga aapka mercy-love kyonki mera drirh aashray-sthal aap hain, sankat kaal mein sharan sthal hain.
Mera bal, main aapka gungaan karta hun; God, aap mere aashray-sthal hain, aap hi mercy-premmay mere God hain.
God, aapne hamein shokit chhor diya, maano aap ham par tut pare hain; aap hamse krodhit ho gae hain. Ab hamein punh apna lijie!
Aapne prithvi ko kampaaya tha, dharti phat gai thi; ab jorkar ise shaant kar dijie, kyonki yah kaamp rahi hai.
Aapne apni people ko visham paristhitiyon ka anubhav karaaya; aapne hamein pine ke lie vah daakhamdhu di, jiske sevan se hamaare paanv larakhra gae,
Lekin apne shraddhaaluon ke lie aapne ek dhvaja unchi uthaai hai, ki vah saty ke pratik svarup pradarshit ki jaae.
Apne daayein haath se hamein chhuraakar hamein uttar dijie, ki aapke dear paatr chhuraae ja sakein.
God ne apne holy jagah mein ghoshna ki hai: “Apne vijay mein main shekem ko vibhaajit karunga aur main sukkoth ghaati ko naap kar bantvaara kar dunga.
Gilaaad par mera authority hai, manashsheh par mera authority hai; ephraaim mere sir ka rakhvaala hai, Yahudah mera raajdand hai.
Moaab raashtr mere haath dhone ka paatr hai, aur edom raashtr par main apni paaduka pheinkunga; philistiya ke upar uchch svar mein jayghosh karunga.”
Kaun le jaaega mujhe sudrirh-surakshit shehar tak? Kaun pahunchaaega mujhe edom shehar tak?
God, kya aap hi nahin, jinhonne hamein ab shokit chhor diya hai aur hamaari senaaon ko saath dena bhi chhor diya hai?
Dushman ke khilaaf hamaari madad kijie, kyonki kisi bhi insaan dvaara laayi gayi madad nirarthak hai.
God ke saath milkar hamaari vijay sunishchit hoti hai, vahi hamaare dushmanon ko kuchal daalega.
God, mere chillaane ko sunie; meri prayer par dhyaan dijie.
Main prithvi ki chhor se aapko pukaar raha hun, aapko pukaarte-pukaarte mera dil duba ja raha hai; mujhe us uchch, agamy chattaan par khara kijie jismein meri suraksha hai.
Dushmanon ke khilaaf mere lie aap ek sudrirh stambh, ek aashray-sthal rahe hain.
Meri laalsa hai ki main aapke aashray mein chirkaal nivaas karun aur aapke pankhon ki chhaaya mein meri suraksha rahe.
God, aapne meri manntein suni hain; aapne mujhe vah sab provide kiya hai, jo aapke shraddhaaluon ka nij bhaag hota hai.
Aap raaja ko aayushmaan kareinge, unki aayu ke varsh kai pirhiyon ke tuly ho jaaeinge.
God ki upasthiti mein vah hamesha-hamesha sinhaasan par viraajmaan raheinge; unki suraksha ke nimitt aap apne mercy-love aur saty ko pragat karein.
Tab main aapki glory ka gungaan karunga aur din-pratidin apni manntein puri karta rahunga.
Sirf God mein mere praanon ki vishraanti hai; vahi mere bachaav ke kaaran hain.
Vahi mere lie ek sthir chattaan aur mera bachaav hain; vah mere suraksha-durg hain, ab mera vichlit hona sambhav nahin.
Tum kab tak us aadmi par prahaar karte rahoge, main jo jhuki hui divaar ya girte baare jaisa hun? Kya tum meri murder karoge?

Unhonne mujhe meri unnat jagah se ukhaar daalne ka nishchay kar liya hai. Jhuthaachaar mein hi unka santosh magan hota hai. Apne chehra se ve aashirvchan uchchaarte to hain, lekin man hi man ve use shaap dete rahte hain.
Mere jaan, shaant hokar God ke uthne ki pratiksha kar; unhin mein tumhaari ekmaatr ummid magan hai.
Vahi mere lie ek sthir chattaan aur mera bachaav hain; vah mere suraksha-rach hain, ab mera vichlit hona sambhav nahin.
Mera bachaav aur mera sammaan God par avlambit hain; mere lie vah sudrirh chattaan aur aashray-sthal hai.
Mere logo, har ek paristhiti mein unhin par bharosa rakho; unhin ke sammukh apna dil undel do, kyonki God hi hamaara aashray-sthal hain.
Saadhaaran aadmi shvaas sirf hain, vishisht aadmi sirf bhraanti. Inhein tula par rakhkar taula jaae to ve nagany utreinge; ek shvaas sirf.
Na to hinsa-atyaachaar se kuchh uplabdh hoga, na lutmaar se receive property koi garv ka vishay hai; jab tumhaari samriddhi mein barhti hone lage, to property se man na jor lena.
God ne ek baat prakaashit ki, mainne do baatein grahan ki: “God, aap sarvsaamarthyi hain.
Aur Lord, aapka love amogh”; ismein sandeh nahin, “Aap har ek aadmi ko uske karmon ke anurup pratiphal provide kareinge.”

God, aap mere apne God hain, bahut utkattaapurvak main aapke saannidhy ki kaamna karta hun; sukhi aur pyaasi zameen mein, jahaan paani hai hi nahin, mera jaan aapke lie pyaasa aur meri deh aapki abhilaashi hai.
Aapke holy jagah mein mainne aapka darshan kiya hai, ki aapke power aur tej ko nihaarun.
Isliye ki aapka mercy-love mere life ki apeksha kahin adhik shreshth hai, mere honth aapke praise karte raheinge.
Main aajivan aapka thanks karta rahunga, aapki glory ka dhyaan karke main apne haath uthaaunga.
Honthon par git aur chehra se praise ke vachnon se mere jaan aise tript ho jaaeinge, jaise utkrisht khaana se.
Jab main bichhaune par hota hun, tab aapka smaran karta hun; main raatri ke prahron mein aapke baare mein chintan karta rahunga.
Kyonki aap hi mere sahaayak hain, aapke pankhon ki chhaaya mujhe git gaane ke lie apostle karti hai.
Main aapke nikat rahna chaahta hun; aapka daayaan haath mujhe sambhaale rahta hai.
Jo mere praanon ke pyaase hain, unka vinaash nishchit hai; ve prithvi ki gahraai mein sama jaaeinge.
Ve talvaar se ghaat kie jaane ke lie saump die jaaeinge, ki ve siyaaron ka aahaar ban jaaein.
Lekin raaja to God mein ullsit rahega; ve sabhi, jinhonne God mein shraddha rakhi hai, unka praise kareinge, jabki jhuth bolne vaalon ke chehra chup kar die jaaeinge.
God, meri prayer sunie, jab aapke saamne main apni shikaayat prastut kar raha hun; dushman ke aatank se mere life ko surakshit rakhie.
Kukarmiyon ke sharyantr se, evil logon ki buri yukti se suraksha ke lie mujhe apni aar mein le lijie.
Unhonne talvaar ke jaisa apni jibh tej kar rakhi hai aur apne words ko ve lakshy par aise chhorte hain, jaise ghaatak baanon ko.
Ve nirdosh aadmi ki ghaat mein baithkar baan chalaate hain; ve nidar hokar achaanak rup se prahaar karte hain.
Ve ekjut ho evil yuktiyon ke lie ek dusre ko uksaate hain, ve chhipkar jaal bichhaane ki yojna banaate hain; ve kahte hain, “Kaun dekh sakega hamein?”
Ve kutil yojna banaakar kahte hain, “Ab hamne saty yojna taiyaar kar li hai!” Ismein koi sandeh nahin ki maanav dil aur antahkran ko samajh paana kathin kaary hai.
God un par apne baan chhoreinge; ekaaek ve ghaayal ho gir pareinge.
God unki jibh ko unhin ke khilaaf kar deinge aur unka vinaash ho jaaega; ve sabhi, jo unhein dekheinge, nafrat mein apne sir hilaaeinge.
Sab insaanon par aatank chha jaaega; ve God ke mahaakaary ki ghoshna kareinge, ve God ke mahaakaary par soch karte raheinge.
Righteous Yahweh mein harshit hokar, unka aashray leinge aur sabhi sidhe manvaale unka praise karein!
God, ziyon mein aapka praise apekshit hai; aapke saamne ki gai manntein purn kie jaaeinge.
Sabhi insaan aapke nikat aaeinge, aap jo praarthnaaein sunkar unka uttar dete hain.
Mere galti ke apraadhon ki bahulta ne mujhe daba rakha hai, hamaare apraadhon par aapne aavran daal diya hai.
Blessed hota hai vah aadmi jise aap chun lete hain, ki vah aapke aangan mein aapke saamne mein rahe! Ham aapke aavaas, aapke temple ke holy jagah ke utkrisht padaarthon se tript kie jaaeinge.

Aapke pratyuttar hamein chakit kar dete hain, ye aapki righteousness hone ka pramaan hain. God, hamaare uddhaarkarta, prithvi ke chhor tak aur dur-dur mahaasaagar tak aap sabhi shraddhaaluon ki ummid hain.
Aap khud power se susajjit hain, aapne hi apni power se parvton ki rachna ki.
Aap samudr ki lahron ko, uske garjnon ko shaant kar dete hain, aap raashtron ki halchal ko bhi shaant karte hain.
Simaant deshon ke nivaasi aapke mahaakaary se ghabraae hue; udyaachal aur astaachal ko aap harshgaan ke lie apostle karte hain.

Aap zameen ka dhyaan rakh uski sinchaai ka prabandh karte hain; aap use bahut upjaau banaate hain; God ke paani pravaah kabhi nahin sukhte. Kyonki God, aapne yah nirdhaarit kiya hai, ki insaanon ke aahaar ke lie ann sadaiv uplabdh rahe.
Aap naaliyon ko aardr banaae rakhte hain aur kutak ko varsha dvaara samtal kar dete hain; vrishti se aap ise komal bana dete hain, aap iski upaj ko blessing dete hain.
Aap varsh ko vipul upaj ke dvaara gaurvaanvit karte hain, jisse ann uttam-uttam padaarth se bhandaar paripurn paae jaate hain.
Banjar zamin tak ghaas se sampann ho jaati hai; pahaariyaan khushi ka srot ho jaati hain.
Hare ghaas pashuon se aachchhaadit ho jaate hain; ghaatiyaan upaj se paripurn hain; ve ullsit ho uchch svar mein gaane lagti hain.
Sampurn prithvi harshollaas mein, God ka jay jaykaar kare!
God ki glory ke tej ka gungaan karo; glory ka bhajan gaakar unka praise karo.
God se kaho, “Kaise aashcharyajnak hain aapke mahaakaary! Aisi atulniy hai aapki power, ki aapke dushman aapke saamne sankuchit hokar jhuk jaate hain.
Sampurn prithvi aapke saamne natmastak ho jaati hai; sabhi desh aapka praise gaan karte hain, ve aapki glory ka praise gaan karte hain.”
Aakar khud dekh lo ki God ne kya-kya kiya hai, kaise shobhaaymaan hain insaan ke hit mein kie gae unke kaary!
Unhonne samudr ko sukhi zameen mein badal diya, jab ve nadi paar kar rahe the to unke paanv sukhi zameen par par rahe the. Aao, ham Lord mein khushi manaaein.
Power mein kiya gaya unka shaasan hamesha hai, sabhi raashtr unki nazar mein bane rahte hain, koi bhi unke khilaaf vidroh ka soch na kare.
Sabhi qaumon, hamaare God ka praise karo, unke praise ka naad sarvatr sunaai de;
Unhonne hi hamaare life ki raksha ki hai aur hamaare paanvon ko phisalne se bachaaya hai.
God, aapne hamaari pariksha li; aapne hamein chaandi jaise parishuddh kiya hai.
Aapne hamein uljhan ki paristhiti mein daalkar, hamaari pith par bojh laad die.
Aapne hamaare dushmanon ko hamaare sir kuchalte hue jaane diya; hamein agni aur jaldhaara mein se hokar jaana para, lekin antath aapne hamein samriddh zameen par la basaaya.
Main aapke temple mein agnibli ke saath pravesh karunga, aur aapse ki gai apni pratijnaaein purn karunga.
Ve sabhi pratijnaaein, jo vipatti ke avsar par khud mainne apne chehra se ki thi.
Main aapko pusht pashuon ki bali arpan karunga, main merhon, bachhron aur bakron ki bali arpan karunga.
God ke sabhi shraddhaaluo, aao aur suno; main un mahaakaary ko likha karunga, jo mere hit mein God dvaara kie gae hain.
Mainne unhein pukaara, mere honthon par unka gungaan tha.
Yadi mainne apne dil mein apraadh ko sanjoe rakhkar, use poshit kiya hota, to God ne meri pukaar na suni hoti;
Lekin God ne na keval meri prayer suni; unhonne uska uttar bhi diya hai.
Blessed hain God, jinhonne meri prayer sunkar use asvikaar nahin kiya, aur na mujhe apne mercy-love se chhin liya!
God ham par grace karein, aur blessing dein, aur unka chehra ham par prakaashit karte rahein.
Prithvi par aapki chaahat prakaashit hoti rahe, aur sab raashtron ko aapke bachaav ka parichay receive ho.
He God, insaan aapka praise karte rahein; sabhi insaanon dvaara aapka praise hota rahe.
Har ek raashtr ullsit hokar harshollaas mein gaane lage, kyonki aapka justice sabhi ke lie khara hai aur aap prithvi ke har ek raashtr ki aguvaai karte hain.
He God, insaan aapka praise karte rahein; sabhi insaanon dvaara aapka praise hota rahe.
Prithvi ne apni upaj provide ki hai; God, hamaare God, ham par apni kripaadrishti banaae rakhein.
God ham par apni kripaadrishti banaae rakheinge, ki prithvi ke dur-dur tak unke lie shraddha prasaarit ho jaae.
God uthe, ki unke dushman bikhar jaaein; unke dushman unke sammukh se bhaag khare hon.
Aap unhein vaise hi ura dein, jaise hava dhuein ko ura le jaati hai, ve God ke saamne usi tarah barbaad ho jaaein jis tarah agni ke sammukh aane par mom.
Righteous harshit hon aur ve God ki upasthiti mein harshollaas mein magan hon; ve khushi mein ullsit hon.
God ka gungaan karo, jo meghon par viraajmaan hokar aage barhte hain, unki glory ka praise karo, unka naam hai Yahweh. Upyukt hai ki unke saamne ullsit raha jaae.
God apne holy aavaas mein anaathon ke pita aur vidhvaaon ke rakshak hain.

Vah ekaakiyon ke lie sthaayi parivaar nirdhaarit karte aur bandiyon ko mukt kar dete hain tab ve harsh git gaane lagte hain; lekin hathile tapte, sukhe zameen mein nivaas karne ke lie chhor die jaate hain.
God, jab aap apni people ke aage-aage chalne ke lie nikal pare, jab aap banjar zamin mein se hokar ja rahe the,
Prithvi kaamp uthi, aakaash ne vrishti bheji, God ke saamne, vah jo sinaayi parvat ke God hain, God ke saamne, jo Israel ke God hain.
God, aapne samriddh vrishti provide ki; aapne apne thake hue viraasat ko taaza kiya.
Aapki people us desh mein bas gai; he God, aapne apni daya ke bhandaar se ashaay people ki aavashyakta ki law ki.
Lord ne order diya aur bari sankhya mein auraton ne yah shubh sandesh prasaarit kar diya:
“Raaja aur sena palaayan kar rahe hain; haan, ve palaayan kar rahe hain, aur vah jo ghar par rah gai hai lut ki saamagri ko vitrit karegi.
Jab tum bhershaala mein lette ho, tum aise lagte ho, maano kabutri ke pankhon par chaandi, aur uske pairon par prakaashmaan svarn marha gaya ho.”
Jab sarvshaktimaan ne raajaaon ko vahaan titar-bitar kiya, zalmon mein himpaat ho raha tha.
O devtaaon ka parvat, baashaan parvat, o kai shikharyukt parvat, baashaan parvat,
O kai shikharyukt parvat, tum us parvat ki or daah ki nazar kyon daal rahe ho, jise God ne apna aavaas banaana chaaha hai, nishchyath vahaan Yahweh hamesha-hamesha nivaas kareinge?
God ke rath das das hajaar, aur hajaaron hajaar hain; Lord apni pavitrta mein unke beech hain, jaise sinaayi parvat par.
Jab aap unchaaiyon par charh gae, aur aap apne saath bari sankhya mein yuddhbandi le gae; aapne insaanon se, haan, hathile insaanon se bhi bheint accept ki, ki aap, Yahweh God vahaan nivaas karein.
God, hamaare Lord, hamaare uddhaarak ka praise ho, jo pratidin ke life mein hamaare sahaayak hain.
Hamaare God vah God hain, jo hamein bachaav provide karte hain; maut se bachaav sarvsattaadhaari adhiraaj Yahweh se hi hota hai.
Ismein koi sandeh nahin, ki God apne dushmanon ke sir kuchal deinge, kesh yukt sir, jo galtiyon mein lipt rahte hain.
Lord ne ghoshna ki, “Main tumhaare dushmanon ko baashaan se bhi khinch laaunga; main unhein saagar ki gahraaiyon tak se nikaal laaunga,
Ki tum apne paanv apne dushmanon ke rakt mein duba sako, aur tumhaare kutte bhi apni jibh tript kar sakein.”
He God, aapki shobhaayaatra ab dikhne lagi hai; vah shobhaayaatra, jo mere God aur mere raaja ki hai, jo temple ki or barh rahi hai!
Is shobhaayaatra mein sabse aage chal raha hai gaayak-vrind, uske pichhe hai vaady-vrind; jinmein yuvtiyaan bhi hain jo daf baja rahi hain.
Vishaal janasbha mein God ka praise kiya jaae; Israel raashtr ki mahaasbha mein Yahweh ka praise kiya jaae.
Binyaamin ka chhota gotr unke aage-aage chal raha hai, vahin Yahudi gotr ke nyaayiyon ka vishaal samuh hai, zebulun aur naphtaali gotr ke leader bhi unmein sammilit hain.
He God, apni power ko order dijie, ham par apni power pradarshit kijie, he God, jaisa aapne pahle bhi kiye hain!
Yerushalem mein aapke temple ki glory ke kaaran, raaja apni bheintein aapko samarpit kareinge.

Sarkandon ke beech ghumte hinsak pashuon ko, raashtron ke bachhron ke beech saanron ke jhund ko aap phatkaar lagaaie. Unhein raund daalie, jinhein bheint paane ki laalsa rahti hai. Yuddh ke lie prasann raashtron ki ekta bhang kar dijie.
Misr desh se raajdut aaeinge; aur kush desh God ke saamne samarpit ho jaaega.
Prithvi ke sab raajyo, God ka gungaan karo, Lord ka praise karo.
Unhin ka praise, jo sanaatan kaal se heaven mein chalte phirte rahe hain, jinka svar megh ke garjan jaisa hai.
Un God ke power ki ghoshna karo, jinka vaibhav Israel raashtr par chhaaya hai, jinka niyantran sab heaven par pragat hai.
God, apne temple mein aap kitne shobhaaymaan lagte hain; Israel ke God apni people ko authority aur power provide karte hain. God ka praise hota rahe!
God, meri raksha kijie, kyonki paani star mere gale tak a pahuncha hai.
Main gahre daldal mein dub ja raha hun, yahaan main pair tak nahin tik pa raha hun. Main gahre paani mein a pahuncha hun; aur chaaron or se paani mujhe duba raha hai.
Madad ke lie pukaarte-pukaarte main thak chuka hun; mera gala sukh chuka hai. Apne God ki pratiksha karte-karte meri nazar dhundhli ho chuki hai.

Jo akaaran hi mujhse bair karte hain unki sankhya mere sir ke keshon se bhi barhkar hai; balvaan hain ve, jo akaaran hi mere dushman ho gae hain, ve sabhi mujhe mita dene par saamarthyi hain. Jo mainne churaaya hi nahin, usi ki bharpaai mujhse li ja rahi hai.
God, aap meri murkhtaapurn trutiyon se parichit hain; mere dosh aapse chhipe nahin hain.
Meri prayer hai ki mere kaaran aapke believers ko lajjit na hona pare. Lord, sarvshaktimaan Yahweh, mere kaaran, Israel ke God, aapke khojiyon ko lajjit na hona pare.
Main yah lajja aapke nimitt sah raha hun, mera mukhmandal hi ghrinaaspad ho chuka hai.
Main apne parivaar ke lie aprichit ho chuka hun; apne hi bhaaiyon ke lie main pardeshi ho gaya hun.
Aapke bhavan ki dhun mein jalte jalte main bhasm hua, aur aapke nindkon dvaara ki ja rahi ninda mujh par par rahi hai.
Jab mainne upvaas karte hue vilaap kiya, to main unke lie nafrat ka paatr ban gaya;
Jab mainne shok-kapde dhaaran kie, to log meri ninda karne lage.
Shehar dvaar par baithe hue aadmi mujh par taana maarte hain, main piyakkar aadmiyon ke giton ka vishay ban chuka hun.
Lekin Yahweh, aapse meri girgiraahat hai, apne mercy-love ke kaaran, apni kripaadrishti ke avsar par, God, apne nishchit bachaav ke dvaara mujhe pratyuttar dijie.
Mujhe is daldal se bacha lijie, is gahre paani mein mujhe dubne na dijie; mujhe mere dushmanon se bacha lijie.
Baarh ka paani mujhe samet na le aur main gahraai mein na ja parun aur paataal mujhe nigal na le.
Yahweh, apne mercy-love ki bhalaai ke kaaran mujhe pratyuttar dijie; apni kripaadrishti mein apna chehra meri or kijie.
Apne servant se munh na morie; mujhe shighr uttar dijie, kyonki main sankat mein para hua hun.
Paas aakar mujhe is situation se bacha lijie; mujhe mere dushmanon se chhura lijie.
Aapko sab kuchh jnaat hai, kis tarah mujhse nafrat ki ja rahi hai, mujhe lajjit aur apmaanit kiya ja raha hai; aap mere sabhi dushmanon ko bhi jaante hain.
Ninda ne mera dil tor diya hai aur ab main duhkhi rah gaya hun; mujhe sahaanubhuti ki aavashyakta thi, lekin yah kahin bhi na mili, tab mainne saantvna khoji, lekin vah bhi kahin na thi.
Unhonne mere khaana mein vish mila diya, aur pine ke lie mujhe sirka diya gaya.
Unke lie sajaai gai mez hi unke lie phanda ban jaae; aur jab ve shaantipurn situation mein hain, yahi unke lie jaal siddh ho jaae.
Unke aankhon ki roshni jaati rahe aur ve dekh na sakein, unki kamar sthaayi rup se jhuk jaae.
Apna krodh un par undel dijie; aapka bhasmkaari krodh unhein samet le.
Unki chhaavni nirjan ho jaae; unke mandpon mein nivaas karne ke lie koi shesh na rah jaae.
Ye unhein duhkhit karte hain, jinhein aapne ghaayal kiya tha, aur unki dard par vaartaalaap karte hain, jis par aapne prahaar kiya hai.
Unke sab galtiyon ke lie unhein doshi ghoshit kijie; ve kabhi aapki righteousness mein sammilit na hone paaein.
Main dard aur sankat mein para hua hun, God, aapke bachaav mein hi meri suraksha ho.
Main God ki glory git ke dvaara karunga, main thanks ke saath unke tej ki baraai karunga.
Isse Yahweh bachhre ke bali arpan se adhik prasann honge; ya sing aur khuryukt saanr ki bali se.
Daridron ke lie yah harsh ka vishay hoga. Tum, jo God ke khoji ho, isse naya bal receive karo!
Yahweh ashaayon ki sunte hain, unhein bandiyon se nafrat nahin hai.
Aakaash aur prithvi unki vandna karein, haan, mahaasaagar aur usmein chalte phirte sabhi praani bhi,
Kyonki God ziyon ki raksha kareinge; vah Yahudiya pradesh ke shehron ka punahnirmaan kareinge. Tab Lord ki people vahaan bas jaaegi aur us kshetr par authority kar legi.
Yah zameen Lord ke servants ki children ka bhaag ho jaaegi, aur jo Lord par shraddha rakhte hain, vahaan nivaas kareinge.
He God, grace kar mujhe bachaav provide kijie; Yahweh, turant meri madad kijie.
Ve, jo mere praanon ke pyaase hain, lajjit aur niraash kie jaaein; ve jinka khushi meri dard mein hai, pith dikhaakar bhaagein aur apmaanit kie jaaein.
Ve sabhi, jo meri situation ko dekh, “Aaha! Aaha!” Karte hain! Lajja mein apna chehra chhipa lein.
Lekin ve sabhi, jo aapki khoj karte hain harshollaas mein magan hon; ve sabhi, jinhein aapke bachaav ki aakaanksha hai, yahi kahein, “Ati mahaan hain God!”
Main daridr aur duhkhi aadmi hun; God, meri madad ke lie vilamb na kijie. Aap hi mere sahaayak aur chhuraanevaale hain; Yahweh, vilamb na kijie.
Yahweh, mainne aapka aashray liya hai; mujhe kabhi lajjit na hone dijiega.
Apni righteousness mein he God, mujhe bachaakar chhura lijie; meri pukaar sunkar mera bachaav kijie.
Aap mere aashray ki chattaan ban jaaie, jahaan main har ek paristhiti mein sharan le sakun; mere bachaav ka order prasaarit kijie, aap hi mere lie chattaan aur garh hain.
Mujhe evil ke shikanje se mukt kar dijie, God, un aadmiyon ke haathon se jo kutil aur krur hain.
Lord Yahweh, aap hi meri ummid hain, bachpan se hi mainne aap par bharosa rakha hai.
Vastuth garbh hi se aap mujhe sambhaalte a rahe hain; mere janm ki prakriya bhi aapke dvaara purn ki gai. Main hamesha-hamesha aapka praise karta rahunga.
Anekon ke lie main ek udaahran ban gaya hun; mere lie aap drirh aashray pramaanit hue hain.
Mera chehra aapka gungaan karte hue nahin thakta, aapka vaibhav aur tej saare din mere giton ke vishay hote hain.
Meri vriddhaavastha mein mera parityaag na kijie; ab, jab mera bal ghatta ja raha hai, mujhe bhul na jaaie,
Kyonki mere dushmanon ne mere khilaaf svar uthaana shuruaat kar diya hai; jo mere jaan lene chaahte hain, ve mere khilaaf sharyantr rach rahe hain.
Ve kahte phir rahe hain, “God to use chhor chuke hain, use khadero aur use ja pakro, koi nahin raha use bachaane ke lie.”
God, mujhse dur na rahie; turant meri madad ke lie a jaaie.
Ve, jo mujh par aarop lagaate hain, lajja mein hi barbaad ho jaaein; jo meri haani karne par saamarthyi hain, lajja aur apmaan mein sama jaaein.
Jahaan tak mera savaal hai, main ummid kabhi na chhorunga; aapka praise main adhik-adhik karta jaaunga.
Saare din main apne chehra se aapke dharmmay krityon ke aur aapke bachaav ke baare mein bataata rahunga; yadypi mujhe inki simaaon ka koi knowledge nahin hai.
Main Lord Yahweh ke vilakshan kaaryon ki ghoshna karta hua aaunga; meri ghoshna ka vishay hoga sirf aapki righteousness, haan, sirf aapki.
God, mere bachpan se hi aap mujhe teaching dete aae hain, aaj tak main aapke mahaakaary ki ghoshna kar raha hun.
Aaj jab main vriddh ho chuka hun, mere kesh pak chuke hain, God, mujhe us samay tak na chhorna, jab tak main agli pirhi ko aapke power aur aapke paraakram ke baare mein teaching na de dun.
God aapki righteousness aakaash tak unchi hai, aapne mahaakaary kie hain. God, kaun hai aapke tuly?
Yadypi aap mujhe kai vikat sankton mein se lekar yahaan tak le aae hain, aap hi mujhmein punh life ka sanchaar kareinge, aap prithvi ki gahraaiyon se mujhe upar le aaeinge.
Aap hi meri glory ko uncha kareinge aur aap hi mujhe punh saantvna provide kareinge.
Mere God, aapki faithfulness ke lie, main vina ke saath aapka praise karunga; Israel ke param holy, main kinnor ki sangat par, aapka gungaan karunga.
Apne honthon se main harshollaas mein naare lagaaunga, jab main aapke praise git gaaunga; main vahi hun, jiska aapne bachaav kiya hai.
Aapke yukt krityon ka varnan meri jibh se hamesha hota rahega, kyonki jo meri haani ke ichchhuk the aapne unhein lajjit aur niraash kar chhora hai.
God, raaja ko apna justice, aur raajputr ko apni righteousness provide kijie,
Ki vah aapki people ka justice righteousness-purvak, aur piriton ka shaasan justice sangat riti se kare.
Tab people ke lie parvton se samriddhi, aur ghaatiyon se righteousness ki upaj utpann hone lagegi.
Tab raaja people mein piriton ki raksha karega, daridron ki santaanon ka bachaav karega; aur sataanevaale ko kuchal daalega.
Pirhi se pirhi jab tak sury aur chandrma ka astitv rahega, people mein aapke prati shraddha bani rahegi.
Uska pragat hona vaisa hi hoga, jaisa ghaas par varsha ka aur shushk zameen par vrishti ka.
Uske shaasankaal mein righteous phule phaleinge, aur jab tak chandrma rahega samriddhi barhti jaaegi.
Uske saamraajy ka vistaar ek saagar se dusre saagar tak aur faraat nadi se prithvi ke chhor tak hoga.
Van mein rahnevaale log bhi uske saamne jhukeinge aur vah dushmanon ko dhul ka sevan karaaega.
Tarshish aur dur tat ke deshon ke raaja uske lie bheintein lekar aaeinge, shiba aur seba desh ke raaja bhi use uphaar prastut kareinge.
Sab raaja unke saamne natmastak honge aur sab raashtr unke adhin.
Kyonki vah duhkhi ki pukaar sunkar use mukt karaaega, aise piriton ko, jinka koi sahaayak nahin.
Vah daridron aur durblon par taras khaaega aur vah duhkhi ko maut se bacha lega.
Vah unke praanon ko andher aur hinsa se bacha lega, kyonki uski nazar mein unka rakt mulyvaan hai.
Vah dirghaayu ho! Use bheint mein shiba desh ka svarn provide kiya jaae. People uske lie prayer karti rahe aur nirantar uske hit ki kaamna karti rahe.

Sampurn desh mein ann vipulta mein bana rahe; pahaariyaan tak upaj se bhar jaaein. Desh mein phalon ki upaj labaanon ki upjaau zameen jaisi ho aur nagarvaasiyon ki samriddhi aisi ho, jaisi zameen ki vanaspti.
Uski khyaati chirasthaai ho; jab tak sury mein prakaash hai, uski glory nai ho. Uske dvaara sab raashtr blessed hon, ve use blessed kahein.
Israel ke God, Yahweh God ka praise ho, keval vahi hain, jo mahaakaary karte hain.
Unka glorious naam hamesha-hamesha blessed ho; sampurn prithvi unke tej se bhaybhit ho jaae. Aamen aur aamen.
Yishai ke son David ki praarthnaaein yahaan samaapt huin.
Ismein koi sandeh nahin ki God Israel ke prati, unke prati, jinke dil nirmal hain, hitkaari hain.
Vaise main lagbhag is situation tak pahunch chuka tha; ki mere pair phisalne par hi the, mere kadam larakhraane par hi the.
Mujhe durjnon ki samriddhi se daah hone lagi thi kyonki mera dhyaan unke ghamand par tha.
Maut tak unmein dard ke prati koi sanvedna na thi; unki deh svasth aur balvaan thi.
Unhein dusre insaanon ke jaisa saamaany samasyaaon ka saamna nahin karna parta; unhein parishram bhi nahin karna parta.
Ahankaar unke gale ka haar hai; aur hinsa unka kapde.
Unke sanvedan shuny dil se apraadh hi nikalta hai; unke mastishk mein ghumarti dushkalpnaaon ki koi sima hi nahin hai.
Ve uphaas karte rahte hain, buraai karne ki vaartaalaap karte hain; aur ahankaar ke saath ve utpiran ki dhamki dete hain.
Unki dinge aakaash tak unchi hoti hain, aur ve daava karte hain ki ve prithvi ke adhikaari hain.
Isliye unke log is jagah par laut aate hain, aur ve bhare hue paani mein se paan karte hain.
Ve kahte hain, “Yah kaise ho sakta hai, ki yah God ko jnaat ho jaae? Kya param leader ko iska bodh hai?”
Aise hote hain evil aadmi—sadaiv nishchint; aur unki property mein vriddhi hoti rahti hai.
Kya laabh hua mujhe apne dil ko shuddh rakhne ka? Vyarth hi mainne apne haath nirdosh rakhe.
Saare din main yaatnaaein sahta raha, prati bhor mujhe dand diya jaata raha.
Ab mera bolna unhin ke jaisa hoga, to yah aapki people ke saath vishvaasghaat hota.
Mainne is marm ko samajhne ka koshish kiya, to yah bahut kathin laga.
Tab main God ke holy jagah mein ja pahuncha; aur vahaan mujh par evil logon ki niyti ka prakaashan hua.
Sachmuch mein, aapne evil logon ko phisalne vaali zameen par rakha hai; vinaash hone ke lie aapne unhein nirdhaarit kar rakha hai.
Achaanak hi a parega un par vinaash, aatank unhein ekaaek hi le urega!
Jab dusvapn ke kaaran nidra se jaagne par ek person dusvapn ke rup se nafrat karta hai, he Lord, usi tarah aapke jaagne par unke svarup se aap nafrat kareinge!
Jab mera dil khedit tha aur meri aatma karvaahat se bhar gai thi,
Us samay main naasmajh aur ajnaani hi tha; aapke saamne main pashu jaisa tha.
Lekin main sadaiv aapke nikat raha hun; aur aap mera daayaan haath thaame rahe.
Aap apni sammti dvaara meri aguvaai karte hain, aur ant mein aap mujhe apni glory mein sammilit kar leinge.
Heaven mein aapke atirikt mera kaun hai? Aapki upasthiti mein mujhe prithvi ki kisi bhi vastu ki kaamna nahin rah jaati.
Yah sambhav hai ki meri deh mera saath na de aur mera dil kshin ho jaae, lekin mera bal khud God hain; vahi meri nidhi hain.
Kyonki ve, jo aapse dur hain, barbaad ho jaaeinge; aapne un sabhi ko barbaad kar diya hai, jo aapke prati vishvaasghaati hain.
Mera apna anubhav yah hai, ki manoram hai God ka saannidhy. Mainne Lord Yahweh ko apna aashray-sthal bana liya hai; ki main aapke sab mahaakaary ko likh sakun.
God! Aapne kyon hamein hamesha ke lie shokit chhor diya hai? Aapki charaai ki bheron ke prati aapke krodh ki agni ka dhuaan kyon uth raha hai?
Smaran kijie un logon ko, jinhein aapne mol liya tha, us kul ko, aapne apna bhaagi banaane ke lie jiska bachaav kiya tha; smaran kijie ziyon parvat ko, jo aapka aavaas hai.
In chirasthaai vidhvans avsheshon ke beech chalte phirte rahie, holy jagah mein dushman ne sabhi kuchh barbaad kar diya hai.
Ek samay jahaan aap hamse bheintkarte the, vahaan dushman ke jayghosh ke naare gunj rahe hain; unhonne vahaan pramaan svarup apne dhvaj gaar die hain.
Unka vyavhaar vrikshon aur jhaariyon par kulhaari chalaate hue aage barhte aadmiyon ke jaisa hota hai.
Unhonne kulhaariyon aur hathauron se dvaaron ke ukere gae naqkshidaar kaamon ko chur-chur kar daala hai.
Unhonne aapke temple ko bhasm kar dhul mein mila diya hai; us jagah ko, jahaan aapki glory ka vaas tha, unhonne bhrasht kar diya hai.
Unhonne yah kahte hue sankalp kiya, “Inhein ham purnath kuchal deinge!” Sampurn desh mein aise jagah, jahaan-jahaan God ki vandna ki jaati thi, bhasm kar die gae.
Ab kahin bhi aashchary kaary nahin dekhe ja rahe; kahin bhi bhavishyadvakta shesh na rahe, hammein se koi bhi yah nahin bata sakta, ki yah sab kab tak hota rahega.
God, dushman kab tak aapka uphaas karta rahega? Kya dushman aapki glory par sadaiv hi kichar uchhaalta rahega?
Aapne kyon apna haath roke rakha hai, aapka daayaan haath? Apne kapdon mein chhipe haath ko baahar nikaalie aur kar dijie apne dushmanon ka ant!
God, aap yug-yug se mere raaja rahe hain; prithvi par bachaav ke kaam karnevaale aap hi hain.
Aap hi ne apni power se samudr ko do bhaagon mein vibhakt kiya tha; aap hi ne vikraal paani jantu ke sir kuchal daale.
Livyaathaan ke sir bhi aapne hi kuchle the, ki uska maans van ke pashuon ko khila diya jaae.
Aapne hi jharne aur dhaaraaein pravaahit ki; aur aapne hi hamesha bahne vaali nadiyon ko sukha diya.
Din to aapka hai hi, saath hi raatri bhi aapki hi hai; sury, chandrma ki sthaapna bhi aapke dvaara ki gai hai.
Prithvi ki sab simaaein aapke dvaara nirdhaarit ki gai hain; grishmaritu aur sharad ritu donon hi aapki kriti hain.
Yahweh, smaran kijie dushman ne kaise aapka uphaas kiya tha, kaise bewakoofon ne aapki ninda ki thi.
Apne kabutri ka life hinsak pashuon ke haath mein na chhorie; apni pirit people ke life ko hamesha ke lie bhul na jaaie.
Apni vaacha ki laaj rakh lijie, kyonki desh ke andhkaarmay jagah hinsa ke adde ban gae hain.
Damit people ko lajjit hokar lautna na pare; ki daridr aur duhkhi aapka gungaan karein.
God, uth jaaie aur apne paksh ki raksha kijie; smaran kijie ki bewakoof kaise nirantar aapka uphaas karte rahe hain.
Apne virodhiyon ke aakrosh ki andekhi na kijie, aapke dushmanon ka vah kolaahal, jo nirantar barhta ja raha hai.
He God, ham aapki praise karte hain, ham aapki praise karte hain kyonki aapka naam hamaare nikat hai; log aapke mahaakaary ka varnan kar rahe hain.
Aapka kathan hai, “Upyukt samay ka nirdhaaran main karta hun; nishpaksh justice bhi mera hi hota hai.
Jab bhukamp hota hai aur prithvi ke nivaasi bhaybhit ho kaamp uthte hain, tab main hi hun, jo prithvi ke stambhon ko dridhtaapurvak thaame rakhta hun.
Ahankaari se mainne kaha, ‘Ghamand na karo,’ Aur evil se, ‘Apne sing unche na karo,
Heaven ki or sing uthaane ka saahas na karna; apna sir uncha kar baatein na karna.’ ”
Na to purv se, na pashchim se aur na hi dakshin ke van se, koi kisi insaan ko uncha kar sakta hai.
Sirf God hi justice karte hain: vah kisi ko uncha karte hain aur kisi ko nicha.
Yahweh ke haathon mein ek katora hai, usmein masaalon se mili uphanti daakhamdhu hai; vah ise undelte hain aur prithvi ke sab evil talchhat tak iska paan karte hain.
Meri or se hamesha yahi ghoshna hogi; main Yaakob ke God ka gungaan karunga;
Aap ka, jo kahte hain, “Main sab evil logon ke sing kaat daalunga, lekin dharmiyon ke sing unche kie jaaeinge.”
Yahudiya pradesh mein log God ko jaante hain; Israel desh mein unka naam basa hai.
Shaalem shehar mein unka aavaas hai, aur unka mukhyaalay ziyon shehar mein.
Yah vah jagah hai, jahaan unhonne aagney baanon ko, dhaal aur talvaaron ko tor daala.
Aap atyujjval roshni se ujjval hain, praakritik sampda se paripurn parvton se kahin adhik bhavy.
Shurviron se sab kuchh chhin liya gaya, ve chir-nidra mein sama gae; ek bhi yoddha mein itna power shesh na raha ki ise rok paae.
Yaakob ke God, aisi prachand thi aapki phatkaar, ki ashv aur rath donon hi barbaad ho gae.
Sirf aap hi is yogy hain ki aapke prati shraddha rakha jaae. Jab aap udaas hote hain tab kismein aapke saamne thaharne ki kshamta hoti hai?
Jab heaven se aapne apne nirnay prasaarit kie, to prithvi bhaybhit hokar chup ho gai.
God, aap us samay justice ke lie saamarthyi hue, ki prithvi ke pirit logon ko chhura liya jaae.
Nihsandeh evil logon ke prati aapka rosh aapke prati prashansa apostle karta hai, tab ve, jo aapke rosh ke baad shesh rah gae the, aap unhein niyantrit aur dharmmay kareinge.
Jab tum mannat maano, to God, apne Yahweh ke lie purn karo; sabhi nikatvarti raashtr unhein bheint arpit karein, jo shraddha-dar ke adhikaari hain.
Vah shaaskon ka manobal tor dete hain; sab prithvi ke raajaaon ke lie vah aatank hain.
Main God ko pukaarta hun—uchch svar mein God ki duhaai de raha hun; ki vah meri prayer par dhyaan dein.
Apni sankat ki situation mein, mainne Lord ki madad ki kaamna ki; raatri ke samay thakaavat ki andekhi kar main unki or haath barhaae raha lekin, mere jaan ko thodi bhi saantvna receive na hui.
God, karaahte hue main aapko smaran karta raha; aapka dhyaan karte hue meri aatma kshin ho gai.
Jab main sankat mein niraash ho chuka tha; aapne meri aankh na lagne di.
Mere soch praachin kaal mein chale gae, aur phir main praachin kaal mein dur chala gaya.
Jab raatri mein main apni git rachnaaein smaran kar raha tha, mera dil un par soch karne laga, tab meri aatma mein yah savaal ubhar aaya.
“Kya Lord sthaai rup se hamaara parityaag kar deinge? Kya hamne sthaai rup se unki kripaadrishti kho di hai?
Kya unka bara love ab purnath shuny ho gaya? Kya unki promise purnath viphal pramaanit ho gai?
Kya God ki kripaaluta ab jaati rahi? Kya apne krodh ke kaaran vah daya nahin kareinge?”
Tab mainne soch kiya, “Vastuth mere duhkh ka kaaran yah hai: ki sarvochch Lord God ne apna daayaan haath khinch liya hai.
Main Yahweh ke mahaakaary smaran karunga; haan, Lord purv yugon mein aapke dvaara kie gae aashchary kaaryon ka main smaran karunga.
Aapke sab mahaakaary mere manan ka vishay honge aur aapke aashchary kaary meri soch ka vishay.”
God, holy hain, aapke raasta. Aur kaun sa ishvar hamaare God ke tuly mahaan hai?
Aap to vah God hain, jo aashchary kaary karte hain; sab raashtron par aap apna power pradarshit karte hain.
Aapne apne bhujbal se apne logon ko, Yaakob aur Yosef ke vanshjon ko, chhura liya.
God, mahaasaagar ne aapki or nazar ki, mahaasaagar ne aapki or nazar ki aur chhataptaane laga; mahaasaagar ki gahraaiyon tak mein uthal-puthal ho gai.
Meghon ne paani vrishti ki, heaven mein megh ki garajna gunj uthi; aapke baan idhar-udhar-sarvatr barasne lage.
Aapki garajna ka svar bavandar mein sunaai par raha tha, aapki bijli ki chamak se sab duniya prakaashit ho utha; prithvi kaampi aur hil uthi.
Aapka raasta saagar mein se hokar gaya hai, haan, mahaasaagar mein hokar aapka raasta gaya hai, lekin aapke padchinh adrishy hi rahe.
Ek charvaahe ke jaisa aap apni people ko lekar aage barhte gae. Moshe aur ahron aapke pratinidhi the.
Meri people, meri teaching par dhyaan do; jo teaching main de raha hun use dhyaan se suno.
Main apni teaching drishtaanton mein dunga; main purvkaal se gopniy rakhi gai baaton ko prakaashit karunga—
Ve baatein jo ham sun chuke the, jo hamein maalum thin, ve baatein, jo hamne apne purvjon se receive ki thin.
Yahweh dvaara kie gae stuty kaary, jo unke power ke adbhut kaary hain, inhein ham inki santaanon se gupt nahin rakheinge; unka likha bhaavi pirhi tak kiya jaayega.
Lord ne Yaakob ke lie niyam sthaapit kiya aur Israel mein law sthaapit kar diya, inke sambandh mein God ka order tha ki hamaare purvaj agli pirhi ko inki teaching dein,
Ki aagaami pirhi inse parichit ho jaae, yahaan tak ki ve baalak bhi, jinka abhi janm bhi nahin hua hai, ki apne samay mein ve bhi apni agli pirhi tak inhein bataate jaae.
Tab ve God mein apna bharosa sthaapit kareinge aur ve God ke mahaakaary bhul na sakeinge, aur unke orders ka follow kareinge.
Tab unka aachran unke purvjon ke jaisa na rahega, jo hathi aur hathili pirhi pramaanit hui, jinka dil God ko samarpit na tha, unki aatmaaein unke prati sachchi nahin thin.
Ephraaim ke sainik yadypi dhanush se susajjit the, yuddh ke din ve phirkar bhaag gae;
Unhonne God se sthaapit vaacha ko bhang kar diya, unhonne unki law ki adhinta bhi asvikaar kar di.
God dvaara kie gae mahaakaary, ve sab aashchary kaary, jo unhein pradarshit kie gae the, ve bhul gae.
Ye aashcharykarm God ne unke purvjon ke dekhte unke saamne kie the, ye sab misr desh aur zoan kshetr mein kie gae the.
God ne samudr paani ko vibhakt kar diya aur ismein unke lie raasta nirmit kiya; iske lie God ne samudr paani ko divaar jaisa khara kar diya.
God din ke samay unki aguvaai baadal ke dvaara aur sampurn raatri mein agniprkaash ke dvaara karte rahe.
God ne banjar zameen mein chattaanon ko phaarkar unhein itna paani provide kiya, jitna paani samudr mein hota hai;
Unhonne chattaan mein se jaldhaaraaein pravaahit kar din, ki paani nadi jaisa pravaahit ho chala.
Yah sab hone par bhi ve God ke khilaaf galti karte hi rahe, banjar zameen mein unhonne sarvochch God ke khilaaf vidroh kiya.
Jis khaana ke lie ve laalaayit the, uske lie hath karke unhonne man hi man God ki pariksha li.
Ve yah kahte hue God ki ninda karte rahe; “Kya God banjar zameen mein bhi hamein khaana paros sakte hain?

Jab unhonne chattaan par prahaar kiya to paani-srot phut pare aur vipul jaldhaaraaein bahne lagin; lekin kya vah hamein khaana bhi de sakte hain? Kya vah sampurn people ke lie maans khaana ka bhi prabandh kar sakte hain?”
Yah sun Yahweh bahut udaas ho gae; Yaakob ke khilaaf unki agni bharak uthi, unka krodh Israel ke khilaaf bharak utha,
Kyonki unhonne na to God mein faith kiya aur na unke bachaav par bharosa kiya.
Yah hone par bhi unhonne aakaash ko order diya aur heaven ke jharokhe khol die;
Unhonne unke khaana ke lie manna vrishti ki, unhonne unhein svargik ann provide kiya.
Insaan vah khaana kar rahe the, jo angels ke lie nirdhaarit tha; God ne unhein bharpet khaana provide kiya.
Heaven se unhonne purvi hava pravaahit ki, apne power mein unhonne dakshini hava bhi pravaahit ki.
Unhonne unke lie maans ki aisi vrishti ki, maano vah dhuli sirf ho, pakshi aise ur rahe the, jaise saagar tat par ret kan urte hain.
God ne pakshiyon ko unke mandpon mein ghus jaane ke lie baadhy kar diya, ve mandap ke chaaron or chhaae hue the.
Unhonne tript hone ke baad bhi inhein khaaya. God ne unhein vahi provide kar diya tha, jiski unhonne kaamna ki thi.
Lekin iske purv ki ve apne kaamna kie khaana se tript hote, jab khaana unke chehra mein hi tha,
God ka rosh un par bharak utha; God ne unke sabse sashakton ko mita daala, unhonne Israel ke yuvaaon ko mita daala.
Itna sab hone par bhi ve galti se dur na hue; sab aashchary kaaryon ko dekhne ke baad bhi unhonne faith nahin kiya.
Tab God ne unke din vyarthta mein aur unke varsh aatank mein samaapt kar die.
Jab kabhi God ne unmein se kisi ko maara, ve baaki God ko khojne lage; ve daurkar God ki or laut gaye.
Unhein yah smaran aaya ki God unke lie chattaan hain, unhein yah smaran aaya ki sarvochch God unke uddhaarak hain.
Lekin unhonne apne chehra se God ki chaaplusi ki, apni jibh se unhonne unse jhuthaachaar kiya;
Unke dil mein sach nahin thi, ve unke saath baandhi gai vaacha ke pratinishth na rahe.

Phir bhi God unke prati kind bane rahe; God hi ne unke apraadhon ko maafi kar diya aur unka vinaash na hone diya. Baar-baar vah apne kop par niyantran karte rahe aur unhonne apne samagr prakop ko pragat na hone diya.
God ko yah smaran raha ki ve sirf insaan hi hain—pavan ke jaisa, jo bahne ke baad lautkar nahin aata.
Banjar zameen mein kitni hi baar unhonne God ke khilaaf vidroh kiya, kitni hi baar unhonne ujaar zameen mein unhein udaas kiya!
Baar-baar ve pariksha lekar God ko uksaate rahe; ve Israel ke holy God ko krodhit karte rahe.
Ve God ki power ko bhul gae, jab God ne unhein atyaachaari ki adhinta se chhura liya tha.
Jab God ne misr desh mein chamatkaar chinh pradarshit kie, jab zoan pradesh mein aashchary kaary kie the.
God ne nadi ko rakt mein badal diya; ve jaldhaaraaon se paani pine mein asmarth ho gae.
God ne un par kutki ke samuh bheje, jo unhein nigal gae. Meindhkon ne vahaan vidhvans kar daala.
God ne unki upaj haasil tiddon ko, aur unke utpaad arbeh tiddiyon ko saump die.
Unki draaksha upaj olon se barbaad kar di gai, aur unke gular-anjir paale mein barbaad ho gae.
Unka pashu wealth bhi olon dvaara barbaad kar diya gaya, aur unki bher-bakriyon ko bijliyon dvaara.
God ka uttapt krodh, prakop aur aakrosh un par tut para, ye sabhi unke vinaashak dut the.
God ne apne prakop ka path taiyaar kiya tha; unhonne unhein maut se suraksha provide nahin ki lekin unhein mahaamaari ko saump diya.
Misr ke sabhi pahlauthon ko God ne murder kar di, haam ke mandpon mein paurush ke pratham phalon ka.
Lekin unhonne bher ke jhund ke jaisa apni people ko bachaaya; banjar zameen mein vah bher ka jhund ke jaisa unki aguvaai karte rahe.
Unki aguvaai ne unhein suraksha provide ki, phalasvrup ve abhay aage barhte gae; jabki unke dushmanon ko samudr ne samet liya.
Yah sab karte hue God unhein apni holy zameen ki sima tak, us parvtiy zameen tak le aae jis par unke daayein haath ne apne adhin kiya tha.
Tab unhonne jantaaon ko vahaan se kaatkar alag kar diya aur unki zameen apni people mein bhaag svarup baat diya; Israel ke sab gotron ko unke aavaas provide karke unhein vahaan basa diya.
Itna sab hone ke baad bhi unhonne God ki pariksha li, unhonne sarvochch God ke khilaaf vidroh kiya; unhonne God ki commands ko bhang kar diya.
Apne purvjon ke jaise ve bhi akritajn aur vishvaasghaati ho gae; vaise hi ayogy, jaisa ek doshpurn dhanush hota hai.
Unhonne devtaaon ke lie nirmit vediyon ke dvaara God ke krodh ko bharkaaya hai; un pratimaaon ne God mein daah bhaav uttejit kiya.
Unhein sun God ko bahut jhunjhlaahat si ho gai; unhonne Israel ko purnath chhor diya.
Unhonne shilo ke nivaas-mandap ka parityaag kar diya, jise unhonne insaan ke beech basa diya tha.
God ne apne power ke sanduk ko banditv mein bhej diya, unka vaibhav dushmanon ke vash mein ho gaya.
Unhonne apni people talvaar ko bheint kar di; apne hi nij bhaag par vah bahut udaas the.
Agni unke yuvaaon ko nigal kar gai, unki kanyaaon ke lie koi bhi vaivaahik git-sangit shesh na rah gaya.
Unke priests ka talvaar se vadh kar diya gaya, unki vidhvaaein aansuon ke lie asmarth ho gain.
Tab maano Lord ki nind bhang ho gai, kuchh vaise hi, jaise koi vir daakhamdhu ki hosh se baahar a gaya ho.
God ne apne dushmanon ko aise maar bhagaaya; ki unki lajja chirasthaai ho gai.
Tab God ne Yosef ke mandpon ko asvikaar kar diya, unhonne ephraaim ke gotr ko nahin chuna;
Lekin unhonne Yahudah gotr ko chun liya, apne dear ziyon parvat ko.
God ne apna holy aavaas uchch parvat jaisa nirmit kiya, prithvi-sa chirasthaai.
Unhonne apne servant David ko chun liya, iske lie unhonne unhein bhershaala se baahar nikaal laaya;
Bheron ke charvaahe se unhein lekar God ne unhein apni people Yaakob ka rakhvaala bana diya, Israel ka, jo unke nij bhaag hain.
David unki dekhbhaal dil ki sach mein karte rahe; unke kushal haathon ne unki aguvaai ki.
God, jantaaon ne aapke nij bhaag mein atikrman kiya hai; aapke holy temple ko unhonne dushit kar diya hai, Yerushalem ab khandhar sirf rah gaya hai.
Unhonne aapke servants ke shav aakaash ke pakshiyon ke aahaar ke lie chhor die hain; aapke bhakton ka maans vany pashuon ka aahaar ban gaya hai.
Yerushalem ke chaaron or unhonne rakt ko jaldhaara jaisa baha diya hai, mritkon ko bhumisth karne ke lie koi shesh na raha.
Hamaare parosiyon ke lie ham tiraskaar ke paatr ho gae hain. Unke lie, jo hamaare aas-paas hote hain, ham nafrat aur thattha ka vishay ban gae hain.
Yahweh, kab tak? Kya ham par aapka krodh lagaataar rahega? Kab tak aapki daah agni ke jaisi dahakti rahegi?
Ab to un jantaaon par apna krodh undel dijie, jo aapki avmaanna karte hain, un raashtron par, jo aapki glory ko maanyta nahin dete;
Unhonne Yaakob ko nigal liya hai aur uski maatribhumi ko dhvast kar diya hai.
Hamaare purvjon ke galtiyon ka dand hamein na dijie; ham par aapki grace turant pahunch jaae, kyonki hamaari situation bahut gambhir ho gai hai.
God, hamaare chhuraanevaale, apni glory ke tej ke nimitt hamaari madad kijie; apni glory ke nimitt hamaare galti maafi kar hamaara bachaav kijie.
Bhala jantaaon ko yah kahne ka avsar kyon diya jaae, “Kahaan hai unka God?” Hamaare dekhte-dekhte raashtron par yah reveal kar dijie, ki aap apne servants ke bahe rakt ka pratishodh lete hain.
Bandiyon ka karaahna aap tak pahunche; apne maha power ke dvaara unki raksha kijie, jo maut ke lie saumpe ja chuke hain.
Lord, parosi raashtron ne jo aapki ninda ki hai, uska saat guna pratishodh unke jholi mein daal dijie.
Tab, ham aapki people, aapke charaagaah ki bherein, hamesha-hamesha aapka thanks kareinge; ek pirhi se dusri tak ham aapka gungaan karte raheinge.
Israel ke charvaahe, hamaari sunie, aap hi hain, jo Yosef ki aguvaai bheron ke vrind ki riti se karte hain. Aap, jo karubon ke beech viraajmaan hain, prakaashmaan hon!
Ephraaim, binyaamin aur manashsheh ke saamne apne power ko pragat kijie; aur hamaari raksha kijie.
God, hamein hamaari purv situation provide kijie; ham par apna chehra prakaashit kijie, ki hamaara bachaav ho jaae.
Yahweh, sarvshaktimaan God, kab tak aapki people ki praarthnaaon ke prati, aapka kop bhitar hi bhitar sulagta rahega?
Aapne aansuon ko unka aahaar bana chhora hai; aapne unhein vivash kar diya hai, ki ve katore bhar-bhar aansu piein.
Aapne hamein apne parosiyon ke lie vivaad ka kaaran bana diya hai, hamaare dushman hamaara uphaas karte hain.
Sarvshaktimaan God, hamein hamaari purv situation provide kar dijie; ham par apna chehra prakaashit kijie, ki hamaara bachaav ho jaae.
Misr desh se aap ek draakshaalta le aae; aapne jantaaon ko kaatkar ise vahaan rop diya.
Aapne iske lie zameen taiyaar ki, is lata ne jar pakri aur isne sab zameen aachchhaadit kar di.
Iski chhaaya ne aur majbut devdaar ki shaakhaaon ne, parvton ko dhank liya tha.
Vah apni shaakhaaein samudr tak, aur kishlay nadi tak phaili hui thi.
Aapne iski suraksha ki divaarein kyon dhaah din, ki aate jaate log iske draaksha torte jaaein?
Jangli suar ise nigal jaate, aur maidaan ke pashu ise apna aahaar banaate hain.
Sarvshaktimaan God, ham aagrah karte hain, aap laut aaie! Heaven se drishtipaat kijie! Aur is or dhyaan dijie,
Aur is draakshaalta ki haan us paudhe ki jise aapke daayein haath ne lagaaya hai, aur us son ko dekhie, jise aapne khud sashakt banaaya hai.
Aapki is draakshaalta ko kaat daala gaya hai, ise agni mein bhasm kar diya gaya hai; aapki phatkaar-sirf aapki people ko barbaad karne ke lie kaafi hai.
Us aadmi par aapke daayein haath ka aashvaasan sthir rahe, jo aapke daayein paksh mein upasthit hai, vah insaan ka son jise aapne apne lie taiyaar kiya hai.
Tab ham aapse dur na honge; hamein jilaaie, ham aapke hi naam ko pukaareinge.
Yahweh, sarvshaktimaan God, hamein punarsthaapit kijie; apna chehra ham par prakaashit kijie ki ham surakshit raheinge.
God ke lie, jo hamaara bal hain, khushi ke saath gaao; Yaakob ke God ke lie uchch svarnaad karo!
Sangit shuruaat ho, kinnor ke saath nebel ke vaadan se, madhur dhvani utpann ki jaae.
Navchandr ke avsar par shofaar bajaao, vaise hi purnima ke avsar par, jab hamaara utsav hota hai;
Israel ke lie yah vidhi hai, yah Yaakob ke God ka niyam hai.
Jab God misr desh ke khilaaf pratikaar ke lie katibaddh hue, unhonne ise Yosef ke lie adhiniyam svarup basa diya. Jahaan hamne vah bhaasha suni, jo hamaari samajh se pare thi:
