“Lord ne kaha, mainne unke kaandhon se bojh utaar diya; tokri dhone ke kaary se ve svatantr ho gae.
Jab tum par sankat ka avsar aaya, tumne mujhe pukaara aur mainne tumhein chhura liya, megh garajna mein se mainne tumhein javaab diya; meribaah paani par mainne tumhaari pariksha li.
Meri people, meri suno, ki main tumhein chita sakun, Israel, yadi tum sirf meri or dhyaan de sako!
Tumhaare beech ve devta na paae jaaein, jo vastuth anupyukt hain; tum un devtaaon ki vandna na karna.
Main, Yahweh, tumhaara God hun, jo tumhein misr desh se chhuraakar laaya hun. Tum apna chehra pura-pura kholo ki main use bhar dun.
“Lekin meri people ne meri nahin suni; Israel ne meri command nahin maani.
Tab mainne use usi ke hathile dil ke adhin chhor diya, ki vah apni hi yuktiyon ki purti karti rahe.
“Yadi meri people sirf meri command ka follow kar le, yadi Israel meri teaching ka follow kar le,
Shighr main uske dushmanon ka pichha karunga, aur uske dushmanon par mera prahaar hoga!
Jo Yahweh se nafrat karte hain, ve aajnaakaarita ka dikhaava kareinge aur unko bara dand hoga.
Lekin tumhaara aahaar hoga sarvottam gehun; main tumhein chattaan ke utkrisht madhu se tript karunga.”
Svargik mahaasbha mein God ne apna jagah grahan kiya hai; unhonne “Devtaaon” Ke saamne apna nirnay suna diya hai:
Kab tak tum anyaayi ko samarthan karte rahoge, kab tak tum anyaay ka pakshpaat karte rahoge?
Duhkhi aur pitrihin ka paksh drirh karo; daridron aur duhkhiton ke adhikaaron ki raksha karo.
Durbal aur dinon ko chhura lo; evil ke phande se unhein bacha lo.
“Ve kuchh nahin jaante, ve kuchh nahin samajhte. Ve andhera mein aage barh rahe hain; prithvi ke sab aadhaar dagamga gae hain.
“Mainne kaha, ‘Tum “Ishvar” Ho; tum sabhi sarvochch God ki children ho.’
Lekin tum sabhi ki maut dusre insaanon si hogi; tumhaara patan bhi dusre shaaskon ke jaisa hi hoga.”
God, uthkar prithvi ka justice kijie, kyonki sab raashtron par aapka prabhutv hai.
God, shaant na rahie; na hamaari upeksha kijie, aur na nishkriy baithie, God,
Dekhie, aapke dushmanon mein kaisi halchal ho rahi hai, kaise ve sir utha rahe hain.
Ve aapki people ke khilaaf chaturaai se buri yukti rach rahe hain; ve aapke priyon ke khilaaf paraspar sammti kar rahe hain.
Ve kahte hain, “Aao, ham is sampurn raashtr ko hi barbaad kar dein, yahaan tak ki Israel raashtr ka naam hi shesh na rahe.”
Ve ekjut hokar, ekchitt yukti rach rahe hain; ve sab aapke khilaaf sangthit ho gae hain—
Edom aur ishmaaeliyon ke mandap, moaab aur hagriyon ke vanshaj,
Gebal, ammon aur amaalek, philisti aur sor ke nivaasi.
Yahaan tak ki ashshuri bhi unke saath sammilit ho gae hain ki lot ke vanshjon ki sena ko sashakt banaaein.
Unke saath aap vahi kijie, jo aapne midiyaan ke saath kiya tha, jo aapne sisra ke saath kiya tha, jo aapne kishon nadi par yaabin ke saath kiya tha,
Jinka vinaash en-dor mein hua, jo zameen par pare gobar jaise ho gae the.
Unke raison ko oreb aur zeb jaisa, aur unke nyaayiyon ko zebah aur zalmunna jaisa bana dijie,
Jinhonne kaha tha, “Chalo, ham God ki charaaiyon ke adhikaari ban jaae.”
Mere God unhein bavandar mein urti dhul jaisa, pavan mein urte bhuse jaisa bana dijie.
Jaise agni van ko nigal jaati hai ya jaise chingaari parvat ko jvaalaamay kar deti hai,
Usi tarah apni aandhi se unka pichha kijie aur apne tuphaan se unhein ghabra dijie.
Ve lajja mein dub jaaein, ki Yahweh, log aapki glory ki khoj karne lagein.
Ve hamesha ke lie lajjit aur bhaybhit ho jaaein; apmaan mein hi unki maut ho.
Ve yah jaan lein ki aap, jinka naam Yahweh hai, sirf aap hi sab prithvi par sarvochch hain.
Sarvshaktimaan Yahweh, kaisa manoram hai aapka nivaas jagah!
Mere jaan Yahweh ke aangnon ki utkat abhilaasha karte hue murchhit tak ho jaate hain; mera dil aur meri deh jivant God ka praise karne lagti hai.
Sarvshaktimaan Yahweh, mere raaja, mere God, aapki vedi ke nikat hi gauraiyon ko aavaas, aur abaabil ko apne bachchon ko rakhne ke lie, ghosle ke lie, jagah receive ho gaya hai.
Blessed hote hain ve, jo aapke aavaas mein nivaas karte hain; ve nirantar aapka praise karte rahte hain.
Blessed hote hain ve, jinki power ke srot aap hain, jinke dil mein ziyon ka raajmaarg hain.

Jab ve baaka ghaati mein se hokar aage barhte hain, usmein jharne phut parte hain; sharadkaalin varsha se jalaashay bhar jaate hain. Sharadkaalin vrishti us kshetr ko aashishon se bharpur kar deti hai.
Tab tak unke bal uttrottar vriddhi hoti jaati hai, jab tak phir ziyon pahunchkar unmein se har ek God ke saamne upasthit ho jaayein.
Yahweh, sarvshaktimaan God, meri prayer sunie; Yaakob ke God, meri sunie.
God, hamaari dhaal par nazar kijie; apne abhishikt par kripaadrishti kijie.
Aapke parisar mein ek din, anyatr ke hajaar dinon se uttamtar hai; evil logon ke mandap mein nivaas ki apeksha main, aapke bhavan ka dvaarpaal hona upyukt samajhta hun.
Mere lie Yahweh God sury aur dhaal hain; glory aur sammaan Yahweh hi ke grace hain; nishklank aadmi ko vah kisi bhi uttam vastu se rok kar nahin rakhte.
Sarvshaktimaan Yahweh, blessed hota hai vah, jisne aap par bharosa rakha hai.
Yahweh, aapne apne desh par kripaadrishti ki hai; aapne Yaakob ki samriddhi ko punahsthaapit kiya hai.
Aapne apni people ke apraadh maafi kar die hain aur unke sabhi galtiyon ko dhaamp diya hai.
Aapne apna sampurn kop shaant kar diya aur aap apne ghor rosh se dur ho gae hain.
God, hamaare uddhaarkarta, hamaari samriddhi punahsthaapit kar dijie, hamaare khilaaf apne kop ko mita dijie.
Kya hamaare prati aapka krodh sadaiv sthaayi rahega? Kya aap apne krodh ko sabhi pirhiyon tak banaae rakheinge?
Kya aap hamein punh jilaaeinge nahin, ki aapki people aap mein praphullit ho sake?
Yahweh, ham par apna mercy-love pradarshit kijie, aur hamein apna bachaav provide kijie.
Jo kuchh Yahweh God kaheinge, vah main sununga; unhonne apni people, apne bhakton ke nimitt shaanti ki promise ki hai. Lekin upyukt yah hoga ki ve punh murkhta na karein.
Ismein koi sandeh nahin ki unki or se bachaav unhin ke lie nirdhaarit hai, jo unke shraddhaalu hain, ki hamaare desh mein unka tej bhar jaae.
Mercy-love aur sach aapas mein mil gai hain; righteousness aur shaanti ne ek dusre ka chumban le liya.
Prithvi se sach ugti rahi hai, righteousness heaven se yah dekh rahi hai.
Ismein koi sandeh nahin ki Yahweh vahi provide kareinge, jo uttam hai, aur dharti apni upaj degi.
Righteousness aage-aage chalegi aur vahi hamaare kadam ke lie raasta taiyaar karti hai.
Yahweh, meri binti sunkar mujhe uttar dijie, kyonki main daridr aur din hun.
Mere praanon ki raksha kijie, kyonki main aapke prati samarpit hun; apne is servant ko bacha lijie, jisne aap par bharosa rakha hai. Aap mere God hain;
Lord, mujh par grace kijie, kyonki main saara din aapko pukaarta rahta hun.
Apne servant ke praanon mein khushi ka sanchaar kijie, kyonki, Lord, main apna jaan aapki or uthaata hun.
Lord, aap kripaanidhaan aur maafi shil hain, un sabhi ke prati, jo aapko pukaarte hain, aapka mercy-love mahaan hai.
Yahweh, meri prayer sunie; grace kar meri pukaar par dhyaan dijie.
Sankat ke avsar par main aapko pukaarunga, kyonki aap mujhe uttar deinge.
Lord, devtaaon mein koi bhi aapke tuly nahin hai; aapke krityon ki tulna kisi dusre se nahin ki ja sakti.
Aapke dvaara banaae gae sab raashtron ke log, he Lord, aapke saamne aakar aapki vandna kareinge; ve aapki glory ka aadar kareinge.
Kyonki aap mahaan hain aur adbhut hain aapke krity; sirf aap hi God hain.
He Yahweh, mujhe apni raah ki teaching dijie, ki main aapke saty ka aachran karun; mujhe ekchitt dil provide kijie, ki main aapki glory ke prati shraddha banaae rakhun.
Mere Lord God, main sampurn dil se aapka praise karunga; main aapki glory ka aadar sadaiv karta rahunga.
Kyonki mere prati aapka mercy-love adhik hai; adholok ke gahre gaddhe se, aapne mere jaan chhura lie hain.
God, ahankaari mujh par aakrman kar rahe hain; krur aadmiyon ka samuh mere praanon ka pyaasa hai, ye ve hain, jinke dil mein aapke lie koi sammaan nahin hai.
Lekin Lord, aap kind aur dayaalu God hain, aap vilamb se krodh karnevaale aur ati karunaamay aur saty se paripurn hain.
Meri or phirkar mujh par grace kijie; apne servant ko apni or se power provide kijie; apni daasi ke son ko bacha lijie.
Mujhe apni kharaai ka chinh dikhaaie, ki ise dekh mere dushman lajjit ho sakein, kyonki ve dekheinge, ki Yahweh, aapne meri madad ki hai, aur aapne hi mujhe sahaara bhi diya hai.
Holy parvat par unhonne apni ninv daali hai;
Yaakob ke sab aavaason ki apeksha, Yahweh ko ziyon ke dvaar kahin adhik dear hain.
God ke shehar, tumhaare baare mein yashasvi baatein likhi gai hain,
“Apne parichiton ke beech main raahaab aur baabel ka lekha karunga, saath hi philistiya, sor aur kush ka bhi, aur phir main kahunga, ‘Yahi hai vah, jiski utpatti ziyon mein hui hai.’ ”
Ziyon ke baare mein yahi ghoshna ki jaaegi, “Iska bhi janm ziyon mein hua aur uska bhi, sarvochch God hi ne ziyon ko basaaya hai.”
Yahweh apni people ki ganna karte samay likhega: “Iska janm ziyon mein hua tha.”
Sangit ki sangat par ve gaaeinge, “Tumhin mein mere khushi ka sab ugam hain.”
He Yahweh, mere uddhaarkarta God; main din-raat aapko pukaarta rahta hun.
Meri prayer aap tak pahunch sake; aur aap meri pukaar sunein.
Mera jaan klesh mein dub chuka hai aur mera life adholok ke nikat a pahuncha hai.
Meri ganna unmein hone lagi hai, jo kabr mein pare hain; main duhkhi aadmi ke jaisa ho gaya hun.
Main mritkon ke beech chhor diya gaya hun, un vadh kie gae aadmiyon ke jaisa, jo kabr mein pare hain, jinhein ab aap smaran nahin karte, jo aapki hitchinta ke yogy nahin rah gae.
Aapne mujhe adholok mein daal diya hai aisi gahraai mein, jahaan andhera hi andhera hai.
Aapka kop mujh par bahut bhaari para hai; maano main lahron mein daba diya gaya hun.
Mere nikattam mitron ko aapne mujhse dur kar diya hai, aapne mujhe unki nafrat ka paatr bana diya hai. Main aisa bandh gaya hun ki mukt hi nahin ho pa raha;
Vedna se meri aankhein dhundhli ho gai hain. Yahweh, main pratidin aapko pukaarta hun; main aapke saamne haath phailaae rahta hun.
Kya aap apne adbhut kaary mritkon ke saamne pradarshit kareinge? Kya ve, jo mrit hain, jivit hokar aapki glory kareinge?
Kya aapke mercy-love ki ghoshna kabr mein ki jaati hai? Kya vinaash mein aapki sach pradarshit hogi?
Kya andhkaarmay jagah mein aapke aashchary kaary pahchaane ja sakeinge, ya kya vishvaasghaat ke jagah mein aapki righteousness pradarshit ki ja sakegi?
Lekin, he Yahweh, madad ke lie main aapko hi pukaarta hun; praatahkaal hi main apni maang aapke saamne prastut kar deta hun.
He Yahweh, aap kyon mujhe asvikaar karte rahte hain, kyon mujhse apna chehra chhipaate rahte hain?
Main yuvaavastha se aakraant aur maut ke nikat raha hun; main aapke aatank se taarna bhog raha hun aur main ab duhkhi rah gaya hun.
Aapke kop ne mujhe bhaybhit kar liya hai; aapke aatank ne mujhe barbaad kar diya hai.
Saare din ye mujhe baarh ke jaisa bhaybhit kie rahte hain; inhonne puri riti se mujhe apne mein samaahit kar rakha hai.
Aapne mujhse mere mitr aur mere dear paatr chhin lie hain; ab to andhera hi mera ghanishth mitr ho gaya hai.
Main Yahweh ke mercy-love ka hamesha gungaan karunga; main pirhi se pirhi apne chehra se aapki sach ko bataata rahunga.
Meri udghoshna hogi ki aapka mercy-love hamesha-hamesha atal hogi, heaven mein aap apni sach ko sthir kareinge.
Aapne kaha, “Mainne apne chune hue ke saath ek vaacha sthaapit ki hai, mainne apne servant David se yah shapath khaai hai,
‘Main tumhaare vansh ko yugaanuyug atal rakhunga. Main tumhaare sinhaasan ko pirhi se pirhi sthir banaae rakhunga.’ ”
Yahweh, heaven mandal aapke adbhut kaaryon ka gungaan karta hai. Bhakton ki sabha mein aapki sach ki praise ki jaati hai.
Heaven mein kaun Yahweh ke tuly ho sakta hai? Angels mein kaun Yahweh ke jaisa hai?
Jab saatvik ekatr hote hain, vahaan God ke prati gahan shraddha vyaapt hota hai; sabhi ke beech vahi sabse adhik shraddha yogy hain.
Yahweh, sarvshaktimaan God, kaun hai aapke jaisa sarvshaktimaan Yahweh? Aap sach ko dhaaran kie hue hain.
Umarta saagar aapke niyantran mein hai; jab iski lahrein ugr hone lagti hain, aap unhein shaant kar dete hain.
Aapne hi vikraal paani jantu rahab ko aise kuchal daala maano vah ek khokhla shav ho; yah aapka hi bhujbal tha, ki aapne apne dushmanon ko pachhaar diya.
Heaven ke maalik aap hain aur prithvi bhi aapki hi hai; aapne hi duniya sansthaapit kiya aur vah sab bhi banaaya jo, duniya mein hai.
Uttar disha aapki rachna hai aur dakshin disha bhi; aapki glory mein taabor aur harmon parvat ullaas mein gaane lagte hain.
Power aapki bhuja mein vyaapt hai; balvant hai aapka haath aur prabal hai aapka daayaan haath.
Righteousness aur kharaai aapke sinhaasan ke aadhaar hain; mercy-love aur sach aapke aage-aage chalte hain.
Yahweh, blessed hote hain ve, jinhonne aapka jayghosh karna sikh liya hai, jo aapki upasthiti ki roshni mein aachran karte hain.
Aapke naam par ve din bhar khushi manaate hain ve aapki righteousness ka utsav manaate hain.
Kyonki aap hi unke gaurav aur bal hain, aapki hi kripaadrishti ke dvaara hamaara bal aadhaarit rahta hai.
Vastuth Yahweh hi hamaari suraksha dhaal hain, hamaare raaja Israel ke holy God ke hi hain.
Varshon purv aapne darshan mein apne sachche logon se vaartaalaap kiya tha: “Ek yoddha ko mainne power-sampann kiya hai; apni people mein se mainne ek yuvak ko khara kiya hai.
Mujhe mera servant, David, mil gaya hai; apne holy tel se mainne uska abhishek kiya hai.
Mera hi haath use sthir rakhega; nishchyath meri bhuja use sashakt karti jaaegi.
Koi bhi dushman use paraajit na karega; koi bhi evil use duhkhit na karega.
Uske dekhte-dekhte main uske dushmanon ko barbaad kar dunga aur uske virodhiyon ko barbaad kar daalunga.
Meri sach aur mera mercy-love us par bana rahega, meri glory uski kirti ko uncha rakhegi.
Main use samudr par authority dunga, uska daayaan haath nadiyon par shaasan karega.
Vah mujhe sambodhit karega, ‘Aap mere pita hain, mere God, mere bachaav ki chattaan.’
Main use apne prathamjaat ka pad bhi provide karunga, uska pad prithvi ke sab raajaaon se uchch hoga—sarvochch.
Uske prati main apna mercy-love hamesha-hamesha banaae rakhunga, uske saath sthaapit ki gai meri vaacha kabhi bhang na hogi.
Main uske vansh ko sadaiv susthaapit rakhunga, jab tak aakaash ka astitv rahega, uska sinhaasan bhi sthir bana rahega.
“Yadi uski children meri law ka parityaag kar deti hai aur mere adhiniymon ke hisaab se nahin chalti,
Yadi ve meri vidhiyon ko bhang karte hain aur mere orders ka follow karne se chuk jaate hain,
To main unke apraadh ka dand unhein laathi ke prahaar se aur unke apraadhon ka dand koron ke prahaar se dunga;
Lekin main apna mercy-love uske prati kabhi kam na hone dunga aur na main apni sach ka ghaat karunga.
Main apni vaacha bhang nahin karunga aur na apne word parivartit karunga.
Ek hi baar mainne hamesha-hamesha ke lie apni pavitrta ki shapath khaai hai, main David se jhuth nahin bolunga;
Uska vansh hamesha-hamesha atal bana rahega aur uska sinhaasan mere saamne sury ke jaisa hamesha-hamesha thahre rahega;
Yah aakaash mein faithful saakshy hokar, chandrma ke jaisa hamesha-hamesha thahre rahega.”
Lekin aap apne abhishikt se bahut udaas ho gae, aapne uski upeksha ki, aapne uska parityaag kar diya.
Aapne apne servant se ki gai vaacha ki upeksha ki hai; aapne uske mukut ko dhul mein pheink dushit kar diya.
Aapne uski sab divaarein tor unhein dhvast kar diya aur uske sab rachon ko khandhar bana diya.
Aate jaate sab log use lutte chale gae; vah parosiyon ke lie nafrat ka paatr hokar rah gaya hai.
Aapne uske dushmanon ka daayaan haath sashakt kar diya; aapne uske sab dushmanon ko khushi vibhor kar diya.
Uski talvaar ki dhaar aapne samaapt kar di aur yuddh mein aapne uski koi madad nahin ki.
Aapne uske vaibhav ko samaapt kar diya aur uske sinhaasan ko dhul mein mila diya.
Aapne uski yuvaavastha ke din ghata die hain; aapne use lajja ke kapdon se dhaank diya hai.
Aur kab tak, Yahweh? Kya aapne khud ko hamesha ke lie chhipa liya hai? Kab tak aapka kop agni-sa dahakta rahega?
Mere life ki kshanbhangurta ka smaran kijie, kis vyarthta ke lie aapne sab insaanon ki rachna ki!
Aisa kaun sa insaan hai jo hamesha jivit rahe, aur maut ko na dekhe? Aisa kaun hai, apne praanon ko adholok ke authority se mukt kar sakta hai?
Lord, ab aapka vah mercy-love kahaan gaya, jiski shapath aapne apni sach mein David se li thi?
Lord, smaran kijie, kitna apmaan hua hai aapke servant ka, kaise main sab raashtron dvaara kie gae apmaan apne dil mein lie hue ji raha hun.
Yahweh, ye sabhi apmaan, jo mere dushman mujh par karte rahe, inka prahaar aapke abhishikt ke har ek kadam par kiya gaya.
Yahweh ka praise hamesha-hamesha hota rahe! Aamen aur aamen.
Lord, sab pirhiyon mein aap hamaare aashray-sthal bane rahe hain.
Iske purv ki parvat astitv mein aate ya prithvi aur duniya ki rachna ki jaati, anaadi se anant tak God aap hi hain.
Aap insaan ko yah kahkar punh dhul mein lauta dete hain, “Maanav-son, laut ja.”
Aapke lie ek hajaar varsh vaise hi hote hain, jaise gat kal ka din; ya raatri ka ek prahar.
Aap insaanon ko aise samet le jaate hain, jaise baarh; ve svapn sirf hote hain— praatahkaal mein barhne vaali komal ghaas ke jaisa:
Jo praatahkaal phulti hai, usmein barhti hai, lekin sandhya hote-hote yah murjhaati aur sukh jaati hai.
Aapka kop hamein mita daalta hai, aapki aprsannta hamein ghabra deti hai.
Hamaare apraadh aapke saamne khule hain, aapki upasthiti mein hamaare gupt galti reveal ho jaate hain.
Hamaare life ke din aapke krodh ki chhaaya mein hi vyatit hote hain; ham karaahte hue hi apne varsh purn karte hain.

Hamaari life avdhi sattar varsh hai—sambhvath assi varsh, yadi ham balishth hain; hamaari aayu ka adhikaansh ham duhkh aur kasht mein vyatit karte hain, haan, ye tivr gati se samaapt ho jaate hain aur ham kuch kar jaate hain.
Aapke kop ki power ki jaankaari kaun le saka hai! Aapka kop utna hi vyaapak hai jitna ki logon ke dvaara aapka dar maanna.
Hamein life ki nyunta ki dharmmay vivechna karne ki antardrishti provide kijie, ki hamaara dil wise ho jaae.
Yahweh! Mridu ho jaaie, aur kitna vilamb? Grace kijie-apne servants par.
Praatahkaal mein hi hamein apne mercy-love se santusht kar dijie, ki ham aajivan ullsit aur harshit rahein.
Hamaare utne hi dinon ko khushi se tript kar dijie, jitne din aapne hamein taarna di thi, utne hi din, jitne varsh hamne durdsha mein vyatit kie hain.
Aapke servants ke saamne aapke mahaakaary spasht ho jaaein aur unki children par aapka vaibhav.
Ham par Lord, hamaare God ki manoharta sthir rahe; aur hamaare lie hamaare haathon ke parishram ko sthaayi kijie— haan, hamaare haathon ka parishram sthaayi rahe.
Vah, jiska nivaas sarvochch God ke aashray mein hai, sarvshaktimaan ke chhaaya kunj mein surakshit nivaas karega.
Yahweh ke baare mein meri ghoshna hai, “Vah mere aashray, mere garh hain, mere sharnasthaan God hain, jinmein mera bharosa hai.”
Vah tumhein sabhi phande se bachaaeinge, vahi ghaatak mahaamaari se tumhaari raksha kareinge.
Vah tumhein apne paron mein chhipa leinge, unke pankhon ke niche tumhaara aashray hoga; unki sach dhaal aur garh hain.
Tum na to raatri ke aatank se bhaybhit hoge, na hi din mein chhore gae baan se,
Vaise hi na us mahaamaari se, jo andhera mein chhipi rahti hai, ya us vinaash se, jo din-dopahri mein prahaar karta hai.
Sambhav hai ki tumhaare nikat hajaar aur tumhaari daayin or das hajaar a girein, lekin vah tum tak nahin pahunchega.
Tum khud apni aankhon se dekhte rahoge aur dekhoge ki kaisa hota hai kukarmiyon ka dand.
Yahweh, aap, jinhonne sarvochch jagah ko apna nivaas banaaya hai, “Mere aashray hain.”
Koi bhi vipatti tum par aane na paaegi aur na koi vipatti hi tumhaare mandap ke nikat aaegi.
Kyonki vah apne angels ko tumhaari har ek gatividhi mein tumhaari suraksha ka order deinge;
Ve tumhein apne haathon mein utha leinge, ki kahin tumhaare paanv ko patthar se thokar na lag jaae.
Tum sinh aur naag ko kuchal doge; tum pusht sinh aur sarp ko raund daaloge.
Yah Yahweh ka aashvaasan hai, “Main use chhuraaunga, kyonki vah mujhse love karta hai; main use surakshit rakhunga, kyonki usne meri glory pahchaani hai.
Jab vah mujhe pukaarega, main use uttar dunga; sankat ki situation mein main uske saath rahunga, use chhuraakar main uska sammaan barhaaunga.
Main use dirghaayu se tript karunga aur main use apne bachaav ka anubhav karaaunga.”
Bhala hai Yahweh ke prati thanks, sarvochch God, aapki glory ka gungaan karna upyukt hai.
-3 das taaron ke aasor, nebel aur kinnor ki sangat par praatahkaal hi aapke mercy-love ki udghoshna karna aur raatri mein aapki sach ka varnan karna achchha hai.
Yahweh, aapne mujhe apne kaaryon ke ullaas se tript kar diya hai; aapke kaaryon ke lie main harshollaas ke git gaata hun.
Yahweh, kaise adbhut hain, aapke dvaara nishpann kaary! Gahan hain aapke soch!
Ajnaani ke lie asambhav hai inka anubhav karna, nirbuddhi ke lie ye baatein nirarthak hain.
Yadypi evil ghaas ke jaisa ankurit to hote hain aur sab evil unnti bhi karte hain, lekin unki niyti anant vinaash hi hai.
Lekin, Yahweh, aap hamesha-hamesha sarvochch hi hain.
Nishchyath aapke dushman, Yahweh, aapke dushman barbaadi ho jaaeinge; sab evil bikhra die jaaeinge.
Lekin meri power ko aapne vany saanr jaisa uncha kar diya hai; aapne mujh par naya naya tel undel diya hai.
Khud mainne apni hi aankhon se apne dushmanon ka patan dekha hai; khud mainne apne kaanon se apne evil dushmanon ke kolaahal ko suna hai.
Righteous khajur vriksh jaisa phalte jaaeinge, unka vikaas labaanon ke devdaar ke jaisa hoga;
Yahweh ke aavaas mein lagaae ve God ke aangan mein samriddh hote jaaeinge!
Vriddhaavastha mein bhi ve phaldaar bane raheinge, unki navinta aur unki kaanti vaisi hi bani rahegi,
Ki ve yah ghoshna kar sakein ki, “Yahweh sidhe hain; vah mere lie chattaan hain, unmein kahin bhi, kisi bhi dushtta ki chhaaya tak nahin hai.”

Yahweh, raajy karte hain, unhonne vaibhavshaali paridhaan dhaaran kie hain; Yahweh ne tej ke paridhaan dhaaran kie hain aur vah power se susajjit hain; vishv sudrirh ninv par sthaapit hai, jo atal hai.
Sanaatan kaal se aapka sinhaasan basa hai; khud aap sanaatan kaal se hain.

Kyonki vah hamaare God hain aur ham unke charaai ki people hain, unki apni sanrakshit bherein. Yadi aaj tum unka svar sunte ho,
“Apne dil kathor na kar lena. Jaise tumne meribaah mein kiya tha, jaise tumne us samay banjar zameen mein massaah naamak jagah par kiya tha,
Jahaan tumhaare purvjon ne mujhe parkha aur mere sabr ki pariksha li thi; jabki ve us sabke gavaah the, jo mainne unke saamne kiya tha.

Main kisi bhi anuchit vastu ki or nazar na uthaaunga. Mujhe nafrat hai bhrashtaachaari aadmiyon ke aachaar-vyavhaar se; main unse koi sambandh nahin rakhunga.

Prithvi par meri nazar unhin par rahegi jo faithful hain, ki ve mere saath nivaas kar sakein; mera servant vahi hoga, jiska aachran nishklank hai.
Kisi bhi jhuthon ka nivaas mere aavaas mein na hoga, koi bhi jhuth bolne vaala, meri upasthiti mein thahar na sakega.

Dhuein ke jaisa mera samay vilin hota ja raha hai; meri haddiyaan dahakte angaaron jaisi sulag rahi hain.

Meri satat karaahton ne mujhe sirf haddiyon aur tvacha ka dhaancha banaakar chhora hai.
Main van ke ullu jaisa hokar rah gaya hun, us ullu ke jaisa, jo khandahron mein nivaas karta hai.
Main so nahin paata, main chhat ke ekaaki pakshi-sa ho gaya hun.
Din bhar main dushmanon ke taane sunta rahta hun; jo meri ninda karte hain, ve mera naam shaap ke taur par jaahir karte hain.

Lekin, Yahweh, aap hamesha-hamesha sinhaasan par viraajmaan hain; aapka naam pirhi se pirhi sthaayi rahta hai.
Aap utheinge aur ziyon par manoharta kareinge, kyonki yahi suavsar hai ki aap us par apni kripaadrishti prakaashit karein. Vah thahraaya hua avsar a gaya hai.

Ki vah bandiyon ka karaahna sunein aur unhein mukt kar dein, jinhein maut dand diya gaya hai.”
Ki insaan ziyon mein Yahweh ki glory ki ghoshna kar sakein aur Yerushalem mein unka praise,
Jab log aur raajy Yahweh ki vandna ke lie ekatr honge.
Meri life yaatra purn bhi na hui thi, ki unhonne mera bal shuny kar diya; unhonne meri aayu ghata di.
Tab mainne aagrah kiya: “Mere God, mere life ke dinon ke purn hone ke purv hi mujhe utha na lijie; aap to pirhi se pirhi sthir hi rahte hain.
Lord, aapne shuruaat mein hi prithvi ki ninv rakhi, aur aakaashmandal aapke hi haathon ki kaarigri hai.

Lekin jab aapne phatkaar lagaai, tab paani hat gaya, aapke garjan jaisa order se paani-raashiyaan bhaag khari hui;
Jab parvton ki unchaai barhi, to ghaatiyaan gahri hoti gain, thik aapke niyojan ke anurup nirdhaarit jagah par.
Aapke dvaara unke lie nirdhaarit sima aisi thi; jiska atikrman unke lie sambhav na tha; aur ve prithvi ko punh jalmagn na kar sakein.
Aap hi ke power se ghaatiyon mein jharne phut parte hain; aur parvton ke beech se jaldhaaraaein bahne lagti hain.
Inhin se maidaan ke har ek pashu ko pey paani receive hota hai; aur vany gadhe bhi pyaas bujha lete hain.
Inke tat par aakaash ke pakshiyon ka basera hota hai; shaakhaaon ke beech se unki aavaaj nikalti hai.
Vahi apne aavaas ke upri kaksh se parvton ki sinchaai karte hain; aap hi ke dvaara upjaae phalon se prithvi tript hai.
Vah pashuon ke lie ghaas utpann karte hain, aur insaan ke shram ke lie vanaspti, ki vah prithvi se aahaar receive kar sake:
Insaan ke dil magan karne ke nimitt draakshaaras, mukhmandal ko chamkila karne ke nimitt tel, aur insaan ke life ko sambhaalne ke nimitt aahaar utpann hota hai.
Yahweh dvaara lagaae vrikshon ke lie arthaat labaanon mein lagaae devdaar ke vrikshon ke lie paani bari maatra mein hota hai.
Pakshiyon ne in vrikshon mein apne ghonsle banaae hain; saaras ne apna ghonsla chir ke vriksh mein banaaya hai.
Unche parvton mein vany bakriyon ka nivaas hai; chattaanon mein chattaani bijjuon ne aashray liya hai.
Aapne niyat samay ke lie chandrma banaaya hai, sury ko apne ast hone ka jagah jnaat hai.
Aapne andhera ka prabandh kiya, ki raatri ho, jis samay vany pashu chalne phirne ko nikal parte hain.
Apne shikaar ke lie pusht sinh garajnevaale hain, ve God se apne khaana khojte hain.
Suryoday ke saath hi ve chupchaap chhip jaate hain; aur apni-apni maandon mein jaakar so jaate hain.
Is samay insaan apne-apne kaaryon ke lie nikal parte hain, ve sandhya tak apne kaaryon mein parishram karte rahte hain.
Yahweh! Asankhy hain aapke dvaara nishpann kaary, aapne apne adbhut knowledge mein in sab ki rachna ki hai; sab prithvi aapke dvaara rache praaniyon se paripurn ho gai hai.
Ek or samudr hai, vistrit aur gahra, usmein bhi asankhy praani chalte phirte hain— sab jivit praani hain, sukshm bhi aur vishaalkaay bhi.
Ismein jalyaanon ka aagman hota rahta hai, saath hi ismein vishaalkaay jantu hain, livyaathaan, jise aapne samudr mein khelne ke lie banaaya hai.
In sabhi ki nazar aapki or isi ummid mein lagi rahti hai, ki inhein aapki or se upyukt avsar par aahaar receive hoga.
Jab aap unhein aahaar provide karte hain, ve ise ekatr karte hain; jab aap apni mutthi kholte hain, unhein uttam vastuein receive ho jaati hain.
Jab aap unse apna chehra chhipa lete hain, ve ghabra jaate hain; jab aap unki shvaas chhin lete hain, unke jaan pakheru ur jaate hain aur ve usi dhuli mein laut jaate hain.
Jab aap apna pavitraatma preshit karte hain, unka udbhav hota hai, us samay aap prithvi ke svarup ko naya bana dete hain.
Yahweh ka tej hamesha-hamesha sthir rahe; Yahweh ki kritiyaan unhein praphullit karti rahein.
Jab vah prithvi ki or drishtipaat karte hain, vah tharathra uthti hai, vah parvton ka sparsh sirf karte hain aur unse dhuaan uthne lagta hai.
Main aajivan Yahweh ka gungaan karta rahunga; jab tak mera astitv hai, main apne God ka praise gaan karunga.
Mera manan-chintan unko prasann karnevaala ho, kyonki Yahweh mere param khushi ka ugam hain.
Prithvi se galti karnevaala samaapt ho jaaein, evil phir dekhe na jaaein. Mere jaan, Yahweh ka praise karo. Yahweh ka praise ho.
Yahweh ke prati aabhaar vyakt karo, unko pukaaro; sabhi jantaaon ke saamne unke dvaara kie kaaryon ki ghoshna karo.
Unki prashansa mein gaao, unka gungaan karo; unke sabhi adbhut kaaryon ka varnan karo.
Unke holy naam par garv karo; unke dil, jo Yahweh ke khoji hain, ullsit hon.
Yahweh aur unki power ki khoj karo; unki upasthiti ke satat khoji bane raho.
Unke dvaara kie adbhut kaary smaran rakho aur unke dvaara huin adbhut baatein aur nirnay bhi,
Unke servant Abraham ke vansh, unke dvaara chune hue Yaakob ki children.
Vah Yahweh hain, hamaare God; sab prithvi par unke dvaara kiya gaya justice spasht hai.
Unhein apni vaacha sadaiv smaran rahti hai, vah order jo unhonne hajaar pirhiyon ko diya,
Vah vaacha, jo unhonne Abraham ke saath sthaapit ki, promise ki vah shapath, jo unhonne yitshaak se khaai thi,
Jiski pushti unhonne Yaakob se adhiniyam svarup ki, arthaat Israel se sthaapit amar yah vaacha:
“Kanaan desh tumhein main provide karunga. Yah vah bhukhand hai, jo tum nij bhaag mein receive karoge.”
Jab God ki people ki sankhya alp hi thi, jab unki sankhya bahut hi kam thi, aur ve us desh mein pardeshi the,
Jab ve ek desh se dusre desh mein bhatakte phir rahe the, ve ek raajy mein se hokar dusre mein yaatra kar rahe the,
God ne kisi bhi raashtr ko unhein duhkhit na karne diya; unki or se khud God un raajaaon ko daantte rahe:
“Mere abhishikton ka sparsh tak na karna; mere prophets ko koi haani na pahunche!”
Tab God ne us desh mein akaal ki situation utpann kar di. Unhonne hi sab aahaar tripti barbaad kar di;
Tab God ne ek aadmi, Yosef ko, jinko slave banaakar us desh mein pahle bhej diya.
Unhonne Yosef ke pairon mein beriyaan daalkar un pairon ko zakhmi kiya tha, unki gardan mein bhi beriyaan daal di gai thin.
Tab Yosef ki purvokti saty pramaanit hui, unke baare mein, Yahweh ke vaktavy ne unhein saty pramaanit kar diya.
Raaja ne unhein mukt karne ke order die, people ke shaasak ne unhein mukt kar diya.
Usne unhein apne bhavan ka leader aur sampurn property ka prashaasak bana diya,
Ki vah unke leaders ko apni ichchhaapurti ke nimitt order de sakein aur unke mantriyon ko subuddhi sikha sakein.
Tab Israel ne misr mein padaarpan kiya; tab haam ki dharti par Yaakob ek pravaasi hokar rahne lage.
Yahweh ne apne chune huon ko bahut samriddh kar diya; yahaan tak ki unhein unke dushmanon se adhik prabal bana diya,
Jinke dil mein khud God ne apni people ke prati nafrat utpann kar di, ve God ke servants ke khilaaf buri yukti rachne lage.
Tab God ne apne chune hue servant Moshe ko unke paas bheja, aur ahron ko bhi.
Unhonne God ki or se unke saamne aashchary kaary pradarshit kie, haam ki dharti par unhonne adbhut kaary pradarshit kie.
Unke order ne saare desh ko andhkaarmay kar diya; kyonki unhonne God ke orders ki avhelna ki.
God hi ke order se desh ka sab paani rakt mein badal gaya, parinaamasvrup sab machhliyaan mar gain.
Unke sab desh mein asankhy meindhak utpann ho gae, yahaan tak ki unke nyaayiyon ke shayankaksh mein bhi pahunch gae.
God ne order diya aur makkhiyon ke samuh desh par chha gae, iske saath hi sab desh mein machchhar bhi sama gae.
Unke order se varsha ne olon ka rup le liya, sab desh mein aagney vidyujjvaala barasne lagi.
Tab God ne unki draakshaaltaaon aur anjir ke vrikshon par bhi aakrman kiya, aur tab unhonne unke desh ke vrikshon ka ant kar diya.
Unke order se arbeh tiddiyon ne aakrman kar diya, ye yaalek tiddiyaan asankhy thin;
Unhonne desh ki sab vanaspti ko nigal liya, zameen ki sab upaj samaapt ho gai.
Tab God ne unke desh ke har ek pahlauthe ki murder ki, un sab pahilauthon ka, jo unke paurush ka pramaan the.
God ne svarn aur chaandi ke bare wealth ke saath Israel ko misr desh se bachaaya, uske sab gotron mein se koi bhi kul nahin larakhraaya.
Misr nivaasi prasann hi the, jab israaeli desh chhorkar ja rahe the, kyonki un par Israel ka aatank chha gaya tha.
Un par aachchhaadan ke nimitt God ne ek megh nirdhaarit kar diya tha, aur raatri mein prakaash ke lie agni bhi.
Unhonne prayer ki aur God ne unke nimitt aahaar ke lie baterein bhej din; aur unhein svargik aahaar se bhi tript kiya.
Unhonne chattaan ko aise khol diya, ki usmein se unke nimitt paani bahne laga; yah paani van mein nadi jaise bahne laga.
Kyonki unhein apne servant Abraham se ki gai apni holy promise smaran ki.
Khushi ke saath unki people vahaan se baahar laai gai, unke chune harshnaad kar rahe the;
God ne unke lie kai raashtron ki zameen de di, ve us property ke adhikaari ho gae jiske lie kisi dusre ne parishram kiya tha.
Ki ve God ke adhiniymon ka follow kar sakein aur unke niymon ko pura kar sakein. Yahweh ka praise ho.
Yahweh ki praise ho! Yahweh ka thanks karo-ve bhale hain; unki mercy hamesha ki hai.
Kismein kshamta hai Yahweh ke mahaakaary ko likhne ki ya unka tript praise karne ki?
Prashansniy hain ve, jo justice ka follow karte hain, jo sadaiv vahi karte hain, jo justice sangat hi hota hai.
Yahweh, jab aap apni people par kripaadrishti karein, tab mujhe smaran rakhie, jab aap unhein bachaav dilaaein, tab mera bhi dhyaan rakhein.
Ki main aapke chune huon ki samriddhi dekh sakun, ki main aapke raashtr ke khushi mein ullsit ho sakun, ki main aapke nij bhaag ke saath garv kar sakun.
Hamne apne purvjon ke jaisa galti kie hain; hamne apraadh kiya hai, hamaare aachran mein adharm tha.

Jab hamaare purvaj misr desh mein the, unhonne aapke dvaara kie gae aashchary kaaryon ki gahanta ko man mein grahan nahin kiya; unke lie aapke mercy-love mein kie gae ve kai hitkaary nagany hi rahe, saagar, laal saagar ke tat par unhonne vidroh kar diya.
Phir bhi God ne apni glory ke nimitt unki raksha ki, ki unka atulniy power prakhyaat ho jaae.
God ne laal saagar ko daanta aur vah sukh gaya; God unhein us gahraai mein se is tarah lekar aage barhte gae maano ve van ke raasta par chal rahe hon.
God ne dushmanon se unki suraksha ki; unhein dushmanon ke authority se mukt kar diya.
Unke pratirodhi paani mein dub gae; unmein se ek bhi jivit na raha.
Tab unhonne God ki pratijnaaon par faith kiya aur unki vandna ki.
Lekin shighr hi vah God ke mahaakaary ko bhul gae; yahaan tak ki unhonne God ke nirdeshon ki pratiksha bhi nahin ki.
Jab ve banjar zameen mein the, ve apne aniyantrit aavegon mein bah gae; ujaar kshetr mein unhonne God ki pariksha li.
Tab God ne unki abhilaasha ki purti kar di; iske atirikt God ne un par mahaamaari bhej di.
Mandap nivaaskaal mein ve Moshe aur ahron se, jo Yahweh ke abhishikt the, daah karne lage.
Tab zameen phat gai aur daathaan ko nigal gai; abiraam ke dal ko usne gaar diya.
Unke anuyaayiyon par agnipaat hua; aag ne kukarmiyon ko bhasm kar diya.
Horeb parvat par unhonne bachhre ki pratima dhaali aur is dhaatu pratima ki worship ki.
Unhonne God ki glory ka vinimay us bail ki pratima se kar liya, jo ghaas charta hai.
Ve us God ko bhul gae, jinhonne unki raksha ki thi, jinhonne misr desh mein asaadhaaran kaary kie the,
Haam ke kshetr mein aashchary kaary aur laal saagar ke tat par bhayankar kaary kie the.

Tab God ne nishchay kiya ki vah unhein barbaad kar deinge. Vah unhein barbaad kar chuke hote, yadi God ke chune Moshe unke aur God ke satyaanaash prakop ke beech aakar, jalajlaahat ko thanda na karte.
Iske baad israaeliyon ne us sukhdaayi zameen ko nikammi samjha; unhonne God ki promise par faith nahin kiya.
Apne-apne tambuon mein ve kurkuraate rahe, unhonne Yahweh ki aajnaaein nahin maanin.
Tab Yahweh ne shapath khaai, ki vah unhein banjar zameen mein hi mita deinge,
Ki vah unke vanshjon ko dusre jantaaon ke beech barbaad kar deinge aur unhein sab prithvi par bikhra deinge.
Unhonne paor ke devta baal ki puja-archna ki. Unhonne us bali mein se khaaya, jo nirjiv devtaaon ko arpit ki gai thi.
Apne adharm ke dvaara unhonne Yahweh ke krodh ko bharka diya, parinaamasvrup unke beech mahaamaari phail gai.
Tab phinihaas ne saamne aakar madhyasth ka kaary kiya, aur mahaamaari tham gai.
Unki is bhumika ko pirhi se pirhi ke lie yukt ghoshit kiya gaya.
Meribaah jalaashay ke nikat unhonne Yahweh ke kop ko bharkaaya, unke kaaran Moshe par sankat a para,
Kyonki unhonne God ke aatma ke khilaaf balva kiya tha, aur Moshe ne bin soche word bol daale the.
Yahweh ke order ke anurup unhonne un logon ki murder nahin ki,
Lekin ve dusre jantaaon se ghul-mil gae aur unhonne unki prathaaein bhi apna lin.
Unhonne unki pratimaaon ki worship ki, jo unke lie phanda ban gain.
Unhonne apne son-putriyon ko preton ke lie bali kar diya.
Unhonne nirdoshon ka rakt bahaaya, apne hi sons aur putriyon ka rakt, jinki unhonne kanaan desh ki pratimaaon ko bali arpit ki, aur unke rakt se zameen dushit ho gai.
Apne kaaryon se unhonne khud ko bhrasht kar daala; unhonne apne hi kaaryon ke dvaara vishvaasghaat kiya.
Ye sabhi ve kaary the, jinke kaaran Yahweh apne hi logon se krodhit ho gae aur unko apna nij bhaag unke lie ghrinaaspad ho gaya.
God ne unhein dusre raashtron ke adhin kar diya, unke virodhi hi un par shaasan karne lage.
Unke dushman un par authority karte rahe aur unhein unki power ke saamne samarpan karna para.
Kitni hi baar unhonne unhein mukt kiya, lekin ve the vidroh karne par hi atal, tab ve apne hi apraadh mein barbaad hote chale gae.
Lekin unka sankat God ki nazar mein tha. Tab unhonne unki pukaar suni;
Unke kalyaan ke nimitt God ne apni vaacha ka smaran kiya, aur apne mercy-love ki parinaamta mein God ne un par grace ki.
God ne unke prati, jinhonne unhein bandi bana rakha tha, unke dil mein kripaabhaav utpann kiya.

Yahweh, hamaare God, hamaari raksha kijie, aur hamein vibhinn raashtron mein se ekatr kar lijie, ki ham aapke holy naam ke prati aabhaar vyakt kar sakein aur aapka praise hamaare garv ka vishay ban jaae.
Aadi se anant kaal tak blessed hain. Yahweh, Israel ke God, is par saari people kahe, “Aamen,” Yahweh ki praise ho.
Yahweh ka thanks karo, ve bhale hain; unki mercy hamesha ki hai.
Yah naara un sabka ho, jo Yahweh dvaara uddhaarit hain, jinhein unhonne virodhiyon se mukt kiya hai,
Jinhein unhonne purv aur pashchim se, uttar aur dakshin se, vibhinn deshon se ekatr kar ekjut kiya hai.
Kuchh nirjan van mein bhatak rahe the, jinhein shehar ki or jaata hua koi raasta na mil saka.
Ve bhukhe aur pyaase the, ve durbal hote ja rahe the.
Apni vipatti ki situation mein unhonne Yahweh ko pukaara, Yahweh ne unhein unki durdsha se chhura liya.
Unhonne unhein sidhe-samtal path se aise shehar mein pahuncha diya jahaan ve jaakar bas sakte the.
Upyukt hai ki ve Yahweh ke prati unke mercy-love ke lie aur unke dvaara insaanon ke lie kie gae adbhut kaaryon ke lie unka aabhaar vyakt karein,
Kyonki vah pyaasi aatma ke pyaas ko santusht karte aur bhukhe ko uttam aahaar se tript karte hain.
Kuchh aise the, jo andhera mein, gahantam maut ki chhaaya mein baithe hue the, ve bandi lohe ki beriyon mein yaatna sah rahe the,
Kyonki unhonne God ke orders ke khilaaf vidroh kiya tha aur sarvochch God ke nirdeshon ko tuchchh samjha tha.
Tab God ne unhein kathor shram ke kaaryon mein laga diya; ve larakhra jaate the lekin koi unki madad na karta tha.
Apni vipatti ki situation mein unhonne Yahweh ko pukaara, Yahweh ne unhein unki durdsha se chhura liya.
God ne unhein andhera aur maut-chhaaya se baahar nikaal liya, aur unki beriyon ko tor daala.
Upyukt hai ki ve Yahweh ke prati unke mercy-love ke lie aur unke dvaara insaanon ke hit mein kie gae adbhut kaaryon ke lie unka aabhaar vyakt karein,
Kyonki vahi kaansy dvaaron ko tor dete aur lohe ki chharon ko kaatkar vibhakt kar daalte hain.
Kuchh aise bhi the, jo vidroh ka raasta apnaakar bewakoof pramaanit hue, jiska parinaam yah hua, ki unhein apne apraadhon ke kaaran hi dard sahni pari.
Unhein sabhi tarah ke khaana se nafrat ho gai aur ve maut-dvaar tak pahunch gae.
Apni vipatti ki situation mein unhonne Yahweh ko pukaara, Yahweh ne unhein unki durdsha se chhura liya.
Unhonne order diya aur ve svasth ho gae aur unhonne unhein unke vinaash se bacha liya.
Upyukt hai ki ve Yahweh ke prati unke mercy-love ke lie aur unke dvaara insaanon ke hit mein kie gae adbhut kaaryon ke lie unka aabhaar vyakt karein.
Ve thanks bali arpit karein aur harshgiton ke maadhyam se unke kaaryon ka varnan karein.
Kuchh ve the, jo jalyaanon mein samudri yaatra par chale gae; ve mahaasaagar paar jaakar vyaapaar karte the.
Unhonne Yahweh ke mahaakaary dekhe, ve adbhut kaary, jo samudr mein kie gae the.
Yahweh order dete the aur bavandar uth jaata tha, jiske kaaran samudr par unchi-unchi lahrein uthne lagti thin.
Ve jalyaan aakaash tak unche uthkar gahraaiyon tak pahunch jaate the; jokhim ki is buraai ki situation mein unka saahas jaata raha.
Ve matvaalon ke jaisa lurhakte aur larakhra jaate the; unki mati bhrasht ho chuki thi.
Apni vipatti ki situation mein unhonne Yahweh ko pukaara, Yahweh ne unhein unki durdsha se chhura liya.
Yahweh ne bavandar ko shaant kiya aur samudr ki lahrein stabdh ho gain.
Lahron ke shaant hone par unmein harsh ki lahar daur gai, Yahweh ne unhein unke manchaahe bandargaah tak pahuncha diya.
Upyukt hai ki ve Yahweh ke prati unke mercy-love ke lie aur unke dvaara insaanon ke hit mein kie gae adbhut kaaryon ke lie unka aabhaar vyakt karein.
Ve janasmuh ke saamne Yahweh ka bhajan karein, ve aguon ki sabha mein unki glory karein.
God ne nadiyaan marubhumi mein badal din, God ne jharnon ke pravaah ko roka.
Vahaan ke nivaasiyon ki dushtta ke kaaran Yahweh nadiyon ko van mein, nadi ko shushk zameen mein aur urvar zameen ko nirjan zameen mein badal dete hain.
Yahweh hi van ko jalaashay mein badal dete hain aur shushk zameen ko jharnon mein;
Vahaan vah bhukhon ko basne dete hain, ki ve vahaan basne ke liye ek shehar sthaapit kar dein,
Ki ve vahaan krishi karein, draakshaavaatika ka ropan karein aur inse unhein bara upaj receive ho.
Yahweh hi ki kripaadrishti mein unki sankhya mein bahut vriddhi hone lagti hai, Yahweh unke pashu wealth ki haani nahin hone dete.
Jab unki sankhya ghatne lagti hai aur pichhe, klesh aur shok ke kaaran unka manobal ghatta aur dab jaata hai,
God un adhikaariyon par ninda-vrishti karte hain, ve raasta rahit van mein bhatkaane ke lie chhor die jaate hain.
Lekin Yahweh duhkhi ko dard se bachaakar unke parivaaron ko bheron ke jhund jaisa vriddhi karte hain.
Yah sab dekh sidhe log ullsit hote hain, aur evil logon ko chup rah jaana parta hai.
Jo koi wise hai, in baaton ka dhyaan rakhe aur Yahweh ke mercy-love par soch karta rahe.
God, mera dil nishchint hai; main sampurn dil se sangit banaaunga, aur gaaunga.
Nebel aur kinnor jaago! Main subah ko jaagrit karunga.
Yahweh, main logon ke beech aapka aabhaar vyakt karunga; raashtron ke maghy main aapka praise karunga.
Kyonki aapka mercy-love aakaash se bhi mahaan hai; aapki sach antriksh tak ja pahunchti hai.
God, aap sarvochch heaven mein base hain; aapki glory sab prithvi ko tejomay karein.
Apne daayein haath se hamein chhuraakar hamein uttar dijie, ki aapke dear paatr chhuraae ja sakein.
God ne apne holy jagah mein ghoshna ki hai: “Apne vijay mein main shekem ko vibhaajit karunga, aur main sukkoth ghaati ko naap kar bantvaara kar dunga.
Gilaaad par mera authority hai, manashsheh par mera authority hai; ephraaim mere sir ka rakhvaala hai, Yahudah mera raajdand hai.
Moaab raashtr mere haath dhone ka paatr hai, aur edom raashtr par main apni paaduka pheinkunga; philistiya ke upar uchch svar mein jayghosh karunga.”
Kaun le jaaega mujhe sudrirh-surakshit shehar tak? Kaun pahunchaaega mujhe edom shehar tak?
God, kya aap hi nahin, jinhonne hamein shokit chhor diya hai aur hamaari senaaon ko saath dena bhi chhor diya hai?
Dushman ke khilaaf hamaari madad kijie, kyonki kisi bhi insaan dvaara laayi gayi madad nirarthak hai.
God ke saath milkar hamaari vijay sunishchit hoti hai, vahi hamaare dushmanon ko kuchal daalega.
God, mere praise paatr, nishkriy aur chup na rahie.
Evil aur jhuthe aadmiyon ne meri ninda karna shuruaat kar diya hai; ve jo kuchh kahkar meri ninda kar rahe hain, vah sabhi jhuth hai.
Unhonne mujh par ghinaune words ki bauchhaar kar di; akaaran hi unhonne mujh par aakrman kar diya hai.
Unhonne meri maitri ke badle mujh par aarop lagaaye, lekin main prayer ka aadmi hun!
Unhonne mere hit ka pratiphal buraai mein diya hai, aur meri maitri ka pratiphal nafrat mein.
Aap uska pratirodh karne ke lie kisi evil aadmi ko hi basa lijie; uske daayein paksh par koi virodhi khara ho jaae.
Jab us par justice chalaaya jaae tab vah doshi paaya jaae, uski praarthnaaein uske lie dand-command ho jaaein.
Uski aayu kam ho jaae; uske pad ko koi dusre harap le.
Mahaajan uska sarvasv harap lein; uske parishram ki sampurn nidhi pardeshi log lut lein.
Karunaabhaav uske man mein kabhi aaya hi nahin, vah khoj kar nirdhnon, dinon aur kheditmanvaalon ki murder karta hai.
Shaap dena use bahut dear hai, vahi shaap us par a pare. Kisi ki hitkaamna karne mein use koi khushi receive nahin hota— uttam yahi hoga ki hit usse hi dur-dur bana rahe.
Uske lie kapde dhaaran karne jaise hi ho gaya shaap dena; jaisa paani body ka ansh hota hai; vaise hi ho gaya shaap, haan, jaise tel haddiyon ka ansh ho jaata hai!
Shaap hi uska kapde ban jaae, katibandh jaisa, jo sadaiv samete rahta hai.
Yahweh ki or se mere virodhiyon ke lie yahi pratiphal ho, unke lie, jo meri ninda karte rahte hain.
Lekin aap, sarvsattaadhaari Yahweh, apni glory ke anurup mujh par grace kijie; apne mercy-love ke kaaran mera bachaav kijie.
Main din aur daridr hun, aur mera dil ghaayal hai.
Sandhyaakaalin chhaaya-jaisa mera astitv samaapti par hai; mujhe aise jhaar diya jaata hai maano main arbeh tiddi hun.
Upvaas ke kaaran mere ghutne durbal ho chuke hain; mera body kshin aur kamjor ho gaya hai.
Mere virodhiyon ke lie main ghrinaaspad ho chuka hun; mujhe dekhte hi ve sir hilaane lagte hain.
Yahweh mere God, meri madad kijie; apne mercy-love ke kaaran mera bachaav kijie.
Unko yah spasht ho jaae ki, vah aapke baahubal ke kaaran hi ho raha hai, yah ki Yahweh, yah sab aapne hi kiya hai.
Ve shaap dete rahein, lekin aap aashirvchan hi kahein; tab jab ve, aakrman kareinge, unhein lajjit hona parega, yah aapke servant ke lie khushi ka vishay hoga.
Mere virodhiyon ko anaadar ke kapdon ke jaisa dhaaran karni hogi, ve apni hi lajja ko kambal jaise lapet leinge.
Mere chehra ki vaani Yahweh ke sammaan mein uchchtam thanks hogi; vishaal janasmuh ke saamne main unka praise karunga,
Kyonki Yahweh duhkhiton ke nikat daayein paksh par a khare rahte hain, ki vah unke life ko un sabse suraksha provide karein, jinhonne uske lie maut dand nirdhaarit kiya tha.
Yahweh mere Lord ne, raaja se kaha: “Mere daayein paksh mein viraajmaan ho jaao. Tumhaare dushmanon ko main tumhaare charnon ki chauki bana raha hun.”
Yahweh hi ziyon se aapke saamarthyvaan raajdand ka vistaar kareinge, “Aapka shaasan aapke dushmanon ke beech basa hoga!”
Aapki sena aapki laraai ke samay svechchha se aapka saath degi, sabere ke garbh se janmi hui os ke jaisa pavitrta se sushobhit hokar aapke paas aaeinge aapke javaan.
Yah Yahweh ki shapath hai, jo apne vaktavy se dur nahin hote: “Tum melkhizedek ki shrinkhla mein sanaatan priest ho.”
Lord aapke daayein paksh mein tatpar hain; vah udaas hokar raajaaon ko kuchal daaleinge.
Vah raashtron par apne justice ka nirnay ghoshit kareinge, mritkon ka dher lag jaaega aur sampurn prithvi ke nyaayiyon ki murder kar di jaaegi.
Tab mahaaraaj raasta ke kinaare ke jharne se paani ka paan kareinge, unka sir garv se uncha hoga.
Yahweh ka praise ho. Main sampurn dil se Yahweh ka praise karunga, sidhe manvaalon ki samiti aur sabha mein.
Ati udaatt hain Yahweh ke krity; ve unki prasannta ka kaaran hain, jo inko manan karte hain.
Glorious aur bhavy hain Yahweh ke ye krity, unki righteousness hamesha hai.
Yahweh ne apne in krityon ko avismarniy bana diya hai; vah udaar aur kind hain.
Apne shraddhaaluon ke lie vah aahaar ka prabandh karte hain; vah apni vaacha hamesha-hamesha smaran rakhte hain.
Unhonne apni people par in krityon ki power reveal kar di, jab unhonne unhein dusre raashtron ki zameen provide ki.
Unke dvaara nishpann sab kaary faithful aur justice ke hain; faithful hain unke sabhi updesh.
Ve hamesha-hamesha ke lie atal hain, ki inka follow sach aur justice mein kiya jaae.
Yahweh ne apni people ka bachaav kiya; unhonne apni vaacha hamesha-hamesha ke lie sthaapit kar di hai. Unka naam sabse alag aur holy aur dar-yogy hai.
Yahweh ke prati shraddha samajh ka mul hai; un sabhi mein, jo ise maante hain, uttam samajh rahte hai. Yahweh hi hain hamesha vandna ke yogy.

Uske vanshjon ka tej sab prithvi par hoga; sidhe aadmi ki har ek pirhi blessed hogi.

Sidhe logon ke lie andhera mein bhi prakaash ka uday hota hai, vah udaar, kind aur nitiyukt hai.
Uttam hoga un logon ka pratiphal, jo udaar hai, jo udaartaapurvak rin deta hai, jo apne lenden mein sidha hai.
Yah sunishchit hai, ki vah kabhi pathabhrasht na hoga; righteous apne pichhe sthaayi naam chhor jaata hai.
Use kisi buraai ke samaachaar se dar nahin hota; Yahweh par bharosa karte hue uska dil shaant aur sthir bana rahta hai.
Uska dil suraksha mein sthaapit hai, tab use koi dar nahin hota; antath vahi dushmanon par jayant hokar nazar karega.
Unhonne kangaalon ko udaartaapurvak daan diya hai, unki sach aur righteousness yugaanuyug bani rahti hai. Unki glory sadaiv unchi hoti rahti hai.

Jinhein heaven aur prithvi ko dekhne ke lie jhukkar drishtipaat karna parta hai?
Yahweh hi kangaal ko dhuli se uthaakar basaate hain, vahi daridr ko raakh ke dher se uthaakar uncha karte hain.
Vahi unhein leaders ke saath laakar, apni people ke leaders ke saath viraajmaan karte hain.
Vahi baanjh aurat ko bachchon ki maata ka khushi provide karke parivaar mein sammaan provide karte hain. Yahweh ka praise ho.
Jab israaeli misr desh se baahar aae, jab Yaakob ke vanshaj videshi bhaasha-bhaashi desh se baahar aae,
Tab Yahudiya unka holy jagah aur Israel pradesh unka shaasit raashtr ho gaya.
Yah dekh samudr palaayan kar gaya, aur yardan nadi viprit disha mein pravaahit hone lagi;
Parvat merhon ke aur pahaariyaan memnon ke jaisa, chhalaang lagaane lagin.
Samudr, yah bataao, tumne palaayan kyon kiya? Aur yardan, tumhein ulta kyon bahna para?
Parvto, tum merhon ke jaisa aur pahaariyo, tum memnon ke jaisa chhalaangein kyon lagaane lage?
Prithvi, tum Yahweh ki upasthiti mein tharathraao, Yaakob ke God ki upasthiti mein,
Jinhonne chattaan ko taal mein badal diya, aur us kathor patthar ko paani ke sote mein.
Hamaari nahin, Yahweh, hamaari nahin, lekin aapki hi glory ho, aapke mercy-love aur aapki sach ke nimitt.
Dusre janta yah kyon kah rahe hain, “Kahaan hai unka God?”
Heaven mein hain hamaare God aur vah vahi sab karte hain; jismein unki chaahat hai.
Lekin in raashtron ki pratimaaein sirf svarn aur chaandi hain, insaanon ki hastkriti sirf.
Haan, unka chehra zarur hai, lekin ye bol nahin saktin, unki aankhein zarur hain, lekin ye dekh nahin saktin.
Unke kaan hain, lekin ye sun nahin saktin, naak to hai, lekin ye sungh nahin sakti.
Inke haath hain, lekin ye sparsh nahin kar saktin, pair bhi hain, lekin ye chal phir nahin saktin, na hi ye apne kanth se koi svar hi uchchaar sakti hain.
Inke jaisa hi ho jaaeinge inke nirmaata, saath hi ve sabhi, jo in par bharosa karte hain.

Ve mritak nahin hain, jo Yahweh ka praise karte hain, na hi jo chir-nidra mein sama jaate hain;

Ab apne servant se ki gai promise ke anurup, aapka mercy-love hi meri shaanti hai!

Aur kitni pratiksha karni hogi aapke servant ko? Aap kab mere sataanevaalon ko dand deinge?
Ahankaariyon ne mere lie gaddhe khod rakhe hain, unka aachran aapki law ke viprit hai.
Faithful hain aapke order; meri madad kijie, jhuth bolnevaale mujhe duhkhit kar rahe hain.
Unhonne mujhe dharti par se lagbhag mita hi daala tha, phir bhi main aapke niti sutron se dur na hua.
Main aapke chehra se bole hue niymon ka follow karta rahunga, apne mercy-love ke anurup mere life ki raksha kijie.
Yahweh, hamesha hai aapka vachan; yah heaven mein dridhtaapurvak basa hai.
Pirhi se pirhi aapki sach bani rahti hai; aapke dvaara hi prithvi ki sthaapna ki gai aur yah sthaayi bani hui hai.
Aap ke niyam sabhi aaj tak astitv mein hain, aur sabhi kuchh aapki service kar rahe hain.
Yadi aapki law mein main ullaas magan na hota, to in piraaon ko sahte sahte meri maut ho jaati.
Aapke updesh mere man se kabhi barbaad na honge, kyonki inhin ke dvaara aapne mujhe life provide kiya hai,
Tab mujh par aapka hi svaamitv hai, meri raksha kijie; main aapke hi updeshon ka khoji hun.
Evil mujhe barbaad karne ke purpose se ghaat lagaae baithe hain, lekin aapki chetaavniyon par main soch karta rahunga.
Har ek siddhta mein mainne koi na koi sima hi paai hai, lekin aapke order asimit hain.
Aah, kitni adhik dear hai mujhe aapki law! Itna, ki main din bhar isi par soch karta rahta hun.
Aapke orders ne to mujhe apne dushmanon se adhik wise bana diya hai kyonki ye kabhi mujhse dur nahin hote.
Mujhmein to apne sabhi shikshkon se adhik samajh hai, kyonki aapke updesh mere chintan ka vishay hain.
Aapke updeshon ka follow karne ka hi parinaam yah hai, ki mujhmein bujurgon se adhik samajh hai.
Aapki command ka follow karne ke lakshy se, mainne apne kadam har ek adharm ke path par chalne se bacha rakhe hain.
Aap hi ke dvaara di gai teaching ke kaaran, main aapke niyam torne se bach saka hun.
Kaisa madhur hai aapki pratijnaaon ka aasvaadan karna, aapki pratijnaaein mere chehra mein madhu se bhi adhik mithi hain!
Har ek jhutha raasta meri nazar mein ghrinaaspad hai; kyonki aapke updeshon se mujhe samajhdaari receive hoti hai.
Aapka vachan mere paanvon ke lie dipak, aur mere raasta ke lie prakaash hai.
Mainne yah shapath li hai aur yah sunishchit kiya hai, ki main aapke dharmmay niymon ka hi follow karta jaaunga.

Adharmiyo, dur raho mujhse, ki main God ke orders ka follow kar sakun!

Yahweh, meri raksha kijie, jhuth bolnevaale honthon se, aur chhali jibh se!
Tumhaare saath God kya kareinge, aur uske bhi atirikt aur kya kareinge, o chhali jibh?
Vah tujhe yoddha ke tikshn baanon se dand deinge, vah tujhe vriksh ki lakri ke prajvlit koylon se dand deinge.
Dhikkaar hai mujh par, jo main meshekh desh mein ja nivaas karun, jo main kedaar desh ke mandpon mein ja rahun!
Bahut samay mainne unke saath vyatit ki hai, jinhein shaanti se nafrat hain.
