Meri madad ka srot to Yahweh hain, heaven aur prithvi ke karta.
Vah tumhaara pair phisalne na deinge; vah, jo tumhein surakshit rakhte hain, jhapki nahin lete.
Nishchyath Israel ke rakshak na to jhapki leinge aur na so jaaeinge.
Yahweh tumhein surakshit rakhte hain— tumhaare daayein paksh mein upasthit Yahweh tumhaari suraksha ki chhaaya hain;
Na to din ke samay sury se tumhaari koi haani hogi, aur na raatri mein chandrma se.
Sabhi tarah ki buraai se Yahweh tumhaari raksha kareinge, vah tumhaare life ki raksha kareinge;
Tumhaare aane jaane mein Yahweh tumhein surakshit rakheinge, vartmaan mein aur hamesha-hamesha.
Jab yaatriyon ne mere saamne yah prastaav rakha, “Chalo, Yahweh ke aavaas ko chalein,” Main bahut ullsit hua.
Yerushalem, ham tumhaare dvaar par khare hue hain.
Yerushalem us shehar ke jaisa nirmit hai, jo sangthit taur par basa hua hai.
Yahi hai vah jagah, jahaan vibhinn kul, Yahweh ke kul, Yahweh ke naam ke prati aabhaar pradarshit karne ke lie jaaya karte hain jaisa ki unhein order diya gaya tha.
Yahin justice-sinhaasan sthaapit hain, David ke vansh ke sinhaasan.
Yerushalem ki shaanti ke nimitt yah prayer ki jaae: “Samriddh hon ve, jinhein tujhse love hai.
Tumhaari praachiron ki sima ke bhitar shaanti vyaapt rahe aur tumhaare raajmahlon mein tumhaare lie suraksha bani rahein.”
Apne bhaaiyon aur mitron ke nimitt meri yahi kaamna hai, “Tumhaare beech shaanti sthir rahe.”
Yahweh, hamaare God ke bhavan ke nimitt, main tumhaari samriddhi ki abhilaasha karta hun.
Main apni aankhein aapki or uthaae hue hun, aapki or, jinka sinhaasan heaven mein sthaapit hai.

Vaise hi jis tarah slaves ki nazar apne maalik ke haath ki or lagi rahti hai, jaisi daasi ki nazar apni svaamini ke haath ki or lagi rahti hai. Thik isi tarah hamaari nazar Yahweh, hamaare God ki or lagi rahti hai, jab tak vah ham par kripaadrishti nahin karte.
Ham par grace kijie, Yahweh, ham par grace kijie, hamne bahut tiraskaar saha hai.
Hamne ahankaariyon dvaara ghor uphaas bhi saha hai, ham ahankaariyon ke ghor nafrat ke paatr hokar rah gae hain.
Yadi hamaare paksh mein Yahweh na hote— israaeli raashtr yahi kahe—
Yadi hamaare paksh mein Yahweh na hote jab insaanon ne ham par aakrman kiya tha,
Jab unka krodh ham par bharak utha tha ve hamein jivit hi nigal gae hote;
Baarh ne hamein jalmagn kar diya hota, paani pravaah hamein baha le gaya hota,
Ugr paani pravaah hamein dur baha le gaya hota.
Praise ho Yahweh ka, jinhonne hamein unke daanton se phaare jaane se bacha liya hai.
Ham us pakshi ke jaisa hain, jo bahelie ke jaal se bach nikla hai; vah jaal tut gaya, aur ham bach nikle.
Hamaari madad Yahweh ke naam se hai, jo heaven aur prithvi ke karta hain.
Jinhonne Yahweh par bharosa kiya hai, ve ziyon parvat jaisa hain, jise hilaaya nahin ja sakta, jo hamesha-hamesha sthaayi hai.
Jis tarah parvton ne Yerushalem ko ghera hua hai, usi tarah Yahweh bhi apni people ko ghere hue hain aaj bhi aur hamesha-hamesha.
Dharmiyon ko aavantit zameen par evil logon ka raajdand sthaayi na rahega, kahin aisa na ho ki dharmiyon ke haath buraai ki or barh jaaein.
Yahweh, dharmiyon ka kalyaan kijie, unka, jinke dil nishth hain.
Unhein, jo dushtta ke raasta ki or mur jaate hain, Yahweh unhein evil logon ke saath kaat deinge. Israel raashtr mein shaanti vyaapt ho.
Jab Yahweh ne bandiyon ko ziyon lauta laaya, ham un aadmiyon ke jaisa the, jinhonne svapn dekha tha.
Hamaare chehra se hansi chhalak rahi thi, hamaari jibh par harshgaan the. Raashtron mein yah baat jaahir ho chuki thi, “Unke lie Yahweh ne adbhut kaary kie hain.”
Haan, Yahweh ne hamaare lie adbhut kaary kie, ham harsh se bhare hue the.
Yahweh, negev ki nadi jaisa, hamaari samriddhi lauta laaie.
Jo ashru bahaate hue ropan karte hain, ve harsh git gaate hue upaj ekatr kareinge.
Vah, jo rote hue bijaaropan ke lie baahar nikalta hai, apne saath pule lekar harsh git gaata hua lautega.
Yadi grih-nirmaan Yahweh dvaara na kiya gaya ho to, shramikon ka parishram nirarthak hota hai. Yadi shehar ki suraksha Yahweh na karein, to rakhvaale dvaara ki gai chauksi vyarth hoti hai.
Tumhaara subah jaag uthna der tak jaage rahna, sankatpurn shram ka khaana karna vyarth hai; kyonki Yahweh dvaara nind ka anudaan unke lie hai, jinse vah love karte hain.
Children Yahweh ke die hue nij bhaag hote hain, aur baalak unka diya hua uphaar.
Yuvaavastha mein utpann hui children vaisi hi hoti hai, jaise yoddha ke haathon mein baan.
Kaisa blessed hota hai vah aadmi, jiska tarkash in baanon se bhara hua hai! Shehar dvaar par dushmanon ka pratikaar karte hue unhein lajjit nahin hona parega.
Ve sabhi blessed hain, jinmein Yahweh ke prati shraddha paayi jaati hai, jo unki nitiyon ka aachran karte hain.
Jiske lie tum apne haathon se shram karte rahe ho, tumhein uska pratiphal receive hoga; tum blessed hoge aur kalyaan hoga tumhaara.
Tumhaare parivaar mein tumhaari patni phaldaayi daakhalta jaisa hogi; tumhaari mez ke chaaron or tumhaari children jaitun ke ankur jaisa hogi.
Blessed hota hai vah jismein Yahweh ke prati shraddha paai jaati hai.
Ziyon se Yahweh tumko tumhaare life ke har ek din aashishon se bharte rahein, tum aajivan Yerushalem ki samriddhi dekho.
Vastuth, tum apni children ki bhi children dekhne ke lie jivit raho. Israel raashtr mein shaanti sthir rahe.
“Mere bachpan se ve mujh par ghor atyaachaar karte aae hain,” Israel raashtr yahi kahe;
“Mere bachpan se ve mujh par ghor atyaachaar karte aae hain, lekin ve mujh par prabal na ho sake hain.
Hal chalaanevaalon ne mere pith par hal chalaaya hai, aur lambi-lambi hal rekhaaein khinch di hain.
Lekin Yahweh yukt hai; unhin ne mujhe evil logon ke bandhnon se mukt kiya hai.”
Ve sabhi, jinhein ziyon se bair hai, lajjit ho laut jaaein.
Unki niyti bhi vahi ho, jo ghar ki chhat par ug aai ghaas ki hoti hai, vah viksit hone ke purv hi murjha jaati hai;
Kisi ke haathon mein kuchh bhi nahin aata, aur na uski puliyaan baandhi ja sakti hain.
Aate jaate aadmi yah kabhi na kah paaein, “Tum par Yahweh ki kripaadrishti ho; ham Yahweh ke naam mein tumhaare lie mangal kaamna karte hain.”
Yahweh, gahraaiyon mein se main aapko pukaar raha hun;
He Lord, mera svar sun lijie, grace ke lie meri namr request ki or aapke kaan lage rahein.
Yahweh, yadi aap apraadhon ka lekha rakhne lagein, to Lord, kaun thahar sakega?
Lekin aap maafi shil hain, tab aap shraddha ke yogy hain.
Mujhe, mere praanon ko, Yahweh ki pratiksha rahti hai, unke vachan par mainne ummid rakhi hai.
Mujhe Lord ki pratiksha hai un rakhvaalon se bhi adhik, jinhein suryoday ki pratiksha rahti hai, vastuth un rakhvaalon se kahin adhik jinhein bhor ki pratiksha rahti hai.
Israel, Yahweh par bharosa rakho, kyonki jahaan Yahweh hain vahaan mercy-love bhi hai aur vahi pura chhutkaara denevaale hain.
Khud vahi Israel ko, unke apraadhon ko maafi kareinge.
Yahweh, mera dil na to ahankaar se phul raha hai, aur na meri aankhein ghamand mein charhi hui hain; meri ruchi na to asaadhaaran uplabdhiyon mein hai, na chamatkaaron mein.
Mainne apne praanon ko shaant aur chup kar liya hai, jaise maata ki god mein tript shishu; mera jaan ab aise hi shishu-jaisa shaant hai.
Israel, Yahweh par bharosa rakho is samay aur hamesha-hamesha.
Yahweh, David ko aur unke dvaara jheli gai sab vishamtaaon ko smaran kijie.
Unhonne Yahweh ki shapath khaai, aur Yaakob ke sarvshaktimaan se shapath ki thi:
“Main na to tab tak ghar mein pravesh karunga aur na main apne bichhaune par jaaunga,
Na to main apni aankhon mein nind aane dunga aur na palkon mein jhapki,
Jab tak mujhe Yahweh ke lie ek jagah uplabdh na ho jaae, Yaakob ke sarvshaktimaan ke aavaas ke lie.”
Iske baare mein hamne efraatha mein suna, yaaar ke maidaan mein bhi yahi paaya gaya:
“Aao, ham unke aavaas ko chalein; ham unke charnon mein jaakar worship karein.
‘Yahweh, ab uthkar apne vishraam sthal par a jaaie, aap aur aapki power ka sanduk bhi.
Aapke priest dharm ke kapde pahine hue hon; aur aapke saatvik harsh git gaaein.’ ”
Apne servant David ke nimitt, apne abhishikt ko na thukraaie.
Yahweh ne David se shapath khaai thi, ek aisi shapath, jise vah toreinge nahin: “Tumhaare hi apne vanshjon mein se ek ko main tumhaare sinhaasan par viraajmaan karunga.
Yadi tumhaare vanshaj meri vaacha ka follow kareinge aur mere dvaara sikhaae gae updeshon ka follow kareinge, tab unki children bhi tumhaare sinhaasan par hamesha-hamesha ke lie viraajmaan hogi.”
Kyonki ziyon Yahweh dvaara hi nirdhaarit kiya gaya hai, apne aavaas ke lie Yahweh ki yahi abhilaasha hai.
“Yah hamesha-hamesha ke lie mera vishraanti sthal hai; main yahin sinhaasan par viraajmaan rahunga, kyonki yahi meri abhilaasha hai.
Uske lie meri blessing bari yojna hogi; main iske daridron ko khaana se tript karunga.
Uske priests ko main bachaav ke paridhaanon se susajjit karunga, aur uske nivaasi saatvik sadaiv harshgaan gaate raheinge.
“Yahaan main David ke vansh ko badhaaunga, main apne abhishikt ke lie ek dip sthaapit karunga.
Main uske dushmanon ko lajja ke kapde pahnaaunga, lekin uske apne sir ka mukut ujjval rahega.”
Kaisi aadarsh aur manoram hai vah situation jab bhaaiyon mein paraspar ekta hoti hai!

Yah vaisi hi manoram situation hai, jab sugandh dravy priest ke sir par undela jaata hai, aur bahta hua daarhi tak pahunch jaata hai, haan, ahron ki daarhi par bahta hua, uske kapde ki chhor tak ja pahunchta hai.
Harmon parvat ki os ke jaisa, jo ziyon parvat par parti hai. Kyonki vahi hai vah jagah, jahaan Yahweh hamesha life ki blessing provide karte hain.
Tum sabhi, jo Yahweh ke servant ho, Yahweh ka praise karo, tum, jo raatri mein Yahweh ke aavaas mein sevaarat rahte ho.
Holy jagah mein apne haath unche uthaao, aur Yahweh ka praise karo.
Yahweh—heaven aur prithvi ke karta, tumhein ziyon se blessing provide karein.
Yahweh ka praise karo. Yahweh ki glory ka praise karo; tum, jo Yahweh ke servant ho, unka praise karo.
Tum, jo Yahweh ke aavaas mein sevaarat ho, jo God ke aavaas ke aangnon mein sevaarat ho.
Yahweh ka praise karo kyonki Yahweh blessed hain; unki glory ka gungaan karo, kyonki yah sukhad hai.
Yahweh ko yah upyukt laga, ki vah Yaakob ko apna bana lein, Israel ko apni amuly property ke liye chun liya hai.
Main yah jaanta hun ki Yahweh sarvashreshth hain, hamaare God sab devtaaon se mahaan hain.
Yahweh vahi karte hain jo unki nazar mein upyukt hota hai, heaven mein aur prithvi par, samudron mein aur unki gahraaiyon mein.
Prithvi ke chhor se unhin ke dvaara baadal uthaae jaate hain; vahi vrishti ke saath bijliyaan utpann karte hain aur apne bhandaar-grihon se hava ko pravaahit kar dete hain.
Unhonne misr ke pahilauthon ki murder ki, insaanon aur pashuon ke pahilauthon ki.
Unhin ne, he misr, tumhaare beech apne aashchary kaary aur chamatkaar pradarshit kie, jo faroh aur uske sabhi servants ke khilaaf the.
Unhin ne kai jantaaon ki murder ki aur kai shaktishaali raajaaon ka vadh bhi kiya.
Amoriyon ke raaja sihon ka, baashaan ke raaja og ka aur kanaan desh ke sab raajaaon ka.
Tatpashchaat unhonne in sab ki zameen nij bhaag svarup de di, apni people Israel ko, nij bhaag svarup.
Yahweh, hamesha ke lie hai, aapki glory. Aapki khyaati, Yahweh, pirhi se pirhi sthaayi rahti hai.
Yahweh apni people ko nirdosh pramaanit kareinge, vah apne servants par mercy pradarshit kareinge.
Dusre jantaaon ki pratimaaein sirf svarn aur chaandi hain, insaanon ki hastkriti sirf.
Haan, unka chehra zarur hai, lekin ye bol nahin sakti, unki aankhein zarur hain, lekin ye dekh nahin saktin.
Unke kaan zarur hain, lekin ye sun nahin sakte, aur na unke naak mein shvaas hai.
Inke jaisa hi ho jaaeinge inke nirmaata, saath hi ve sabhi, jo in par bharosa karte hain.
Israel vansh, Yahweh ka praise karo; ahron ke vanshjo, Yahweh ka praise karo;
Levi ke vanshjo, Yahweh ka praise karo; tum sabhi, jinmein Yahweh ke prati shraddha hai, Yahweh ka praise ho.
Ziyon se Yahweh ka, jo Yerushalem mein nivaas karte hain, praise ho. Yahweh ka praise ho.
Yahweh ka thanks karo, kyonki ve bhale hain, sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Param God ke prati aabhaar abhivyakt karo. Sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Unke prati, jo leaders ke leader hain, aabhaar abhivyakt karo: sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Unke prati, jinke atirikt dusre koi adbhut kaary kar hi nahin sakta, sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Jinhonne apni subuddhi se heaven ka nirmaan kiya, sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Jinhonne paani ke upar prithvi ka vistaar kar diya, sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Jinhonne prakhar prakaash punjon ki rachna ki, sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Din ke prabhutv ke lie sury ka, sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Raatri ke lie chandrma aur taaron ka; sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Unhin ke prati, jinhonne misr desh ke pahlauthon ki murder ki, sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Aur unke beech se Israel raashtr ko baahar nikaal liya, sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Sashakt bhuja aur unchi uthi hui baanh ke dvaara; sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Unhin ke prati, jinhonne laal saagar ko vibhakt kar diya tha sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Aur uske beech ki zameen se israaeliyon ko paar karva diya, sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Lekin faroh aur uski sena ko saagar hi mein dubo diya; sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Unhin ke prati, jinhonne apni people ko banjar zameen se paar karaaya; sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Jinhonne prakhyaat raajaaon ki murder ki, sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Jinhonne sashakt raajaaon ka vadh kar diya, sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Amoriyon ke raaja sihon ka, sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Baashaan ke raaja og ka, sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Aur unki zameen nij bhaag mein de di, sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Apne servant Israel ko, nij bhaag mein de di, sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Unhin ke prati, jinhonne hamaari durdsha mein hamaari sudhi li, sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Aur hamein hamaare dushmanon se mukt kiya, sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Jo sab praaniyon ke aahaar ka prabandh karte hain, sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Svargik God ke prati aabhaar abhivyakt karo, sanaatan hai unki mercy.
Baabel ki nadi ke tat par baithe hue ziyon ka smaran kar ham ro rahe the.
Vahaan majnu vrikshon par hamne apne vaady taang die the.
Kyonki jinhonne hamein bandi banaaya tha, ve hamaara gaayan sunna chaah rahe the aur jo hamein duhkh de rahe the; ve hamse harshgaan sunne ki chaah kar rahe the, “Hamein ziyon ka koi git sunaao!”
Pravaas mein hamaare lie Yahweh ka praise gaan gaana kaise sambhav ho sakta tha?
Yerushalem, yadi main tumhein bhul jaaun, to mere daayein haath ka kaushal jaata rahega.
Yadi main tumhaara smaran na karun, yadi main Yerushalem ko apna sarvochch khushi na maanun, meri jibh taalu se ja chipke.
Yahweh, vah din smaran kijie jab edom ke vanshaj Yerushalem ke khilaaf ekatr ho gae the. Ve kaise chilla rahe the, “Dha do ise, ise ninv tak dha do!”
Baabel ki putri, tera vinaash to nishchit hai, blessed hoga vah aadmi, jo tujhse un atyaachaaron ka pratishodh lega jo tune ham par kie.
Yahweh, main dil ki gahraai se aapka praise karunga; main “Devtaaon” Ke saamne aapka praise karunga.
Aapke holy temple ki or chehra kar main natmastak hun, aapke mercy-love ke lie; aapki sach ke lie main aapke naam ka aabhaar maanta hun; aapne apne vachan ko apni glory ke bhi upar uncha kiya hai.
Jis samay mainne aapko pukaara, aapne pratyuttar diya; aapne mere praanon mein bal ke sanchaar se sabr diya.
Prithvi ke sab raaja, Yahweh, aapke kritajn honge, kyonki unhonne aapke chehra se nikle vachan sune hain,
Ve Yahweh ki nitiyon ka gungaan kareinge, kyonki Yahweh ka tej bara hai.
Yadypi Yahweh khud mahaan hain, vah naganyon ka dhyaan rakhte hain; lekin ahankaari ko vah dur se hi pahchaan lete hain.

Yadypi is samay mera visham samay chal raha hai, aap mere life ke rakshak hain. Aap hi apna haath barhaakar mere dushmanon ke prakop se meri raksha karte hain; aapka daayaan haath mera bachaav karta hai.
Yahweh mere lie nirdhaarit purpose ko pura kareinge; Yahweh, hamesha hai aapka mercy-love. Apni hi hastkriti ka parityaag na kijie.
Yahweh, aapne mujhe parkha hai, aur jaan liya hai.
Main kab uthta hun aur main kab baithta hun, yah sab aapko jnaat rahta hai; durdarshita mein aap mere vichaaron ko samajh lete hain.
Aap mere aane jaane aur vishraanti ka parikshan karte rahte hain; aur mere sab aachaar-vyavhaar se aap bhali-bhaanti parichit hain.
Iske purv ki koi word meri jibh par aae, Yahweh, aap, use puri-puri riti se jaan lete hain.
Aap mujhe aage-pichhe, chaaron or se ghere rahte hain, aapka haath sadaiv mujh par sthir rahta hai.
Aapka knowledge meri parakh-power se sarvtha pare hain, main iski jaankaari lene mein khud ko purnath kamjor paata hun.
Aapke aatma se bachkar main kahaan ja sakta hun? Aapki upasthiti se bachne ke lie main kahaan bhaag sakta hun?
Yadi main heaven tak aarohan karun to aap vahaan hain; yadi main adholok mein ja letun, aap vahaan bhi hain.
Yadi main usha ke pankhon par baith dur ur chala jaaun, aur samudr ke dusre tat par bas jaaun,
Vahaan bhi aapka haath meri aguvaai karega, aapka daayaan haath mujhe thaame rahega.
Yadi main yah soch karun, “Nishchyath main andhera mein chhip jaaunga aur mere chaaron or ka prakaash raatri mein badal jaaega,”
Andhera bhi aapki nazar ke lie andhera nahin; aapke lie to raatri bhi din ke jaisa jyotirmay hai, aapke saamne andhera aur prakaash ek jaisa hain.
Aapne hi mere aantrik angon ki rachna ki; meri maata ke garbh mein aapne meri deh ki rachna ki.
Main aapke prati kritajn hun, kyonki aapne meri rachna bhayaanak aur adbhut dhang se ki hai; aashchary hain aapke kaary, mere praanon ko iska purn bodh hai.
Mera dhaancha us samay aapke lie rahasy nahin tha jab sabhi avastha mein mera nirmaan ho raha tha, jab main prithvi ki gahraaiyon mein jatil kaushal mein taiyaar kiya ja raha tha.
Aapki nazar mere vikaasonmukh bhrun par thi; mere lie nirdhaarit sab dinon ka kul lekha aapke granth mein ankit tha, jabki ve us samay astitv mein bhi na the.
God, mere lie nirdhaarit aapki yojnaaein kitni amuly hain! Kitna vishaal hai unka kul yog!
Yadi main unki ganna shuruaat karun, to ve dhul ke kanon se bhi adhik hongi. Jab main jaagta hun, aapko apne nikat paata hun.
God, achchha hota ki aap evil ki murder kar dete! He rakt pipaasu, dur ho jaao mujhse!
Ye ve hain, jo aapke khilaaf kuyukti ki baatein karte hain; aapke ye dushman aapka naam galat dhang se lete hain.
Yahweh, kya mujhe bhi unse nafrat nahin hai, jinhein aapse nafrat hai? Kya aapke dushman mere lie bhi ghrinaaspad nahin hain?
Unke prati meri nafrat akhand hai; ve mere bhi dushman hain.
God, parikshan karke mere dil ko pahchaan lijie; mujhe parakhkar mere chintaapurn vichaaron ko jaan lijie.
Yah dekhie ki mujhmein kahin koi buri pravritti to nahin hai, anant kaal ke raasta par meri aguvaai kijie.
Yahweh, evil aadmiyon se mujhe bachaav provide kijie; hinsak aadmiyon se meri raksha kijie,
Ve man hi man anarth sharyantr rachte rahte hain aur sadaiv yuddh hi bharkaate rahte hain.
Unhonne apni jibh sarp si tikhi bana rakhi hai; unke honthon ke niche naag ka vish bhara hai.
Yahweh, evil logon se meri raksha kijie; mujhe un hinsak aadmiyon se suraksha provide kijie, jinhonne, mere pairon ko ukhaarne ke lie yukti ki hai.
Un ahankaariyon ne mere pairon ke lie ek phanda banaakar chhipa diya hai; aur rassiyon ka ek jaal bhi bichha diya hai, raasta ke kinaare unhonne mere hi lie phande laga rakhe hain.
Main Yahweh se kahta hun, “Aap hi mere God hain.” Yahweh, grace karke meri pukaar par dhyaan dijie.
Yahweh, mere Lord, aap hi mere bachaav ka bal hain, yuddh ke samay aap hi mere sir ka aavran bane.
Evil logon ki abhilaasha purn na hone dein, Yahweh; unki buri yukti aage barhne na paae anytha ve garv mein unche ho jaaeinge.
Jinhonne is samay mujhe ghera hua hai; unke honthon dvaara utpann kaary unhin ke sir par a pare.
Unke upar jalte hue koylon ki vrishti ho; ve aag mein pheink die jaaein, ve daldal ke gaddhe mein daal die jaaein, ki ve usse baahar hi na nikal sakein.
Nindak is zameen par apne pair hi na jama sakein; hinsak aadmi ati shighr buraai dvaara pakre jaaein.
Main jaanta hun ki Yahweh dukhit ka paksh zarur leinge aur din ko justice bhi dilaaeinge.
Nishchyath righteous aapke naam ka aabhaar maaneinge, sidhe aapki upasthiti mein nivaas kareinge.
Yahweh, main aapko pukaar raha hun, mere paas shighr hi aaie; jab main aapko pukaarun, meri pukaar par dhyaan dijie.
Aapke saamne meri prayer sugandhdhup; aur mere haath uthaana, saandhy bali samarpan jaisa ho jaae.
Yahweh, mere chehra par pahra baitha dijie; mere honthon ke dvaar ki chauksi kijie.
Mere dil ko kisi bhi anaachaar ki or jaane na dijie, mujhe kukrityon mein shaamil hone se rok lijie, mujhe evil logon ki sangti se bachaaie; mujhe unke utkrisht khaana ko chakhne se bachaaie.

Koi nitimaan aadmi mujhe taarna kare, main ise grace ke taur par accept karunga; vah mujhe daant lagaae, yah mere sir ke abhyanjan tuly hai. Ise asvikaar karna mere lie upyukt nahin, phir bhi main nirantar evil logon ki buraai ke kaaryon ke khilaaf prayer karta rahunga.
Jab unke leaders ko unchi chattaan se niche pheink diya jaaega tab unhein mere is vaktavy par smaran aaega ki vah vyarth na tha, ki yah kitna saantvnaapurn aur sukhdaai vaktavy hai:
“Jaise hal chalaane ke baad zameen tutkar bikhar jaati hai, vaise hi hamaari haddiyon ko tute adholok ke chehra par bikhra diya jaaega.”
Mere Lord, mere Yahweh, meri nazar aap hi par lagi hui hai; aap hi mera aashray hain, mujhe asurakshit na chhoriega.
Mujhe un phandon se suraksha provide kijie, jo unhonne mere lie bichhaae hain, un phandon se, jo evil logon dvaara mere lie taiyaar kie gae hain.
Durjan apne hi jaal mein phans jaaein, aur main surakshit paar nikal jaaun.
Main apna svar uthaakar Yahweh se prayer kar raha hun; apne words ke dvaara mein Yahweh se grace ka anurodh kar raha hun.
Main unke saamne apne sankat ko undel raha hun; mainne apne kasht unke saamne rakh die hain.
Jab main purnath tut chuka hun, aapke saamne meri niyti spasht rahti hai. Vah path jis par main chal raha hun unhonne usi par phande bichha die hain.
Daayin or nazar kijie aur dekhie kisi ko bhi mera dhyaan nahin hai; koi bhi aashray ab shesh nahin rah gaya hai, kisi ko bhi mere praanon ki hitchinta nahin hai.
Yahweh, main aapko hi pukaar raha hun; main soch karta rahta hun, “Mera aashray aap hain, jiviton ke lok mein mera ansh.”
Meri pukaar par dhyaan dijie, kyonki main ab thak chuka hun; mujhe unse chhura lijie, jo mujhe duhkhit kar rahe hain, ve mujhse kahin adhik balvaan hain.
Mujhe is kaaraavaas se chhura dijie, ki main aapki glory ke prati mukt kanth se aabhaar vyakt kar sakun. Tab meri sangti dharmiyon ke sang ho sakegi kyonki mere prati yah aapka stuty upkaar hoga.
Yahweh, meri prayer sun lijie, grace karke mere girgiraane par dhyaan dijie; apni sach mein, apni nitimatt mein mujhe uttar dijie.
Apne servant ka justice kar use dand na dijie, kyonki aapke saamne koi bhi insaan righteous nahin hai.
Dushman mera pichha kar raha hai, usne mujhe kuchalkar mere jaan ko dhul mein mila diya hai. Usne mujhe aise andhera mein la baithaaya hai, jaisa dirgh kaal se mrit aadmi ke lie hota hai.
Main purnath durbal ho chuka hun; mere dil ko dar ne bhitar hi bhitar bhaybhit kar diya hai.
Mujhe praachin kaal smaran a raha hai; aapke ve sab mahaakaary mere vichaaron ka vishay hain, aapke hastkaary mere manan ka vishay hain.
Apne haath main aapki or barhaata hun; aapke lie meri laalsa vaisi hai jaisi shushk van mein ek pyaase aadmi ki hoti hai.
Yahweh, shighr hi mujhe uttar dijie; meri aatma durbal ho chuki hai. Apna chehra mujhse chhipa na lijie anytha meri bhi niyti vahi ho jaaegi, jo unki hoti hai, jo kabr mein sama jaate hain.

Mainne aap par hi bharosa kiya hai, tab arunoday mere lie aapke mercy-love ka sandesh lekar aae. Mujhe mere lie nirdhaarit raasta par chalna hai vah bataaie, kyonki mere praanon ki pukaar aapke hi or lagi hai.
He Yahweh, mujhe mere dushmanon se chhura lijie, aashray ke lie main daura hua aapke nikat aaya hun.
Mujhe apni chaahat ke aajnaapaalan ki teaching dijie, kyonki mere God aap hain; aapka blessed aatma mujhe dharm path ki or le jaae.
Yahweh, apni glory ke nimitt mere praanon ka parirakshan kijie; apni righteousness mein mere praanon ko sankat se bacha lijie.
Apne mercy-love mein mere dushmanon ki murder kijie; mere sab virodhiyon ko bhi barbaad kar dijie, kyonki main aapka servant hun.
Stuty hain Yahweh, jo meri chattaan hain, jo meri bhujaaon ko yuddh ke lie, aur meri ungliyon ko larne ke lie prashikshit karte hain.

Vah mere premi God, mere kila hain, vah mere lie drirh garh aur aashray hain, vah mere uddhaarak hain, vah aisi dhaal hai jahaan main aashray ke lie ja chhipta hun, vah people ko mere adhin banaae rakhte hain.
Yahweh, insaan hai hi kya, jo aap uski or dhyaan dein? Kya hai insaan ki santti, ki aap uski hitchinta karein?
Insaan shvaas jaisa hai; uski aayu vilin hoti chhaaya-jaisa hai.
Yahweh, heaven ko kholkar aap niche a jaaie; parvton ka sparsh kijie ki unmein se dhuaan uthne lage.
Vidyujjvaala bhejkar mere dushmanon ko bikhra dijie; apne baan chala kar unka aage barhna rok dijie.
Apne uchchaasan se apna haath barhaaie; dher paani raashi mein se mujhe bachaakar mera bachaav kijie, unse jo videshi aur pravaasi hain.
Unke chehra se jhuth baatein hi nikalti hain, jinka daayaan haath dhokhe ke kaam karnevaala daayaan haath hai.
God, main aapke lie main ek naya git gaaunga; main das taar vaali vina par aapke lie praise sangit banaaunga.
Raajaaon ki jay aapke dvaara receive hoti hai, aap hi apne servant David ko suraksha provide karte hain, talvaar ke krur prahaar se
Mujhe chhuraaie; videshiyon ke haathon se mujhe chhura lijie. Unke onth jhuth baatein hi karte hain, jinka daayaan haath jhuthi baatein karne ka daayaan haath hai.
Hamaare son apni yuvaavastha mein paripakv paudhon ke jaisa hon, aur hamaari putriyaan kone ke un stambhon ke jaisa, jo raajamhal ki sundarta ke lie sajaaye gae hain.
Hamaare annbhandaar paripurn bane rahein, unse sab tarah ki tripti hoti rahe. Hamaari bherein hajaaron memne utpann karein, hamaare maidaan das hajaaron se bhar jaaein;
Sashakt bane rahein hamaare pashu; unke saath koi durghatna na ho, ve prajnan mein kabhi viphal na hon, hamaari galiyon mein vedna ki karaahat kabhi na suni jaae.
Blessed hai vah people, jin par kripaadrishti ki aisi vrishti hoti hai; blessed hain ve log, jinke God Yahweh hain.
God, mere mahaaraaja, main aapka praise karta hun; main hamesha-hamesha aapke naam ka gungaan karunga.
Pratidin main aapki vandna karunga, main hamesha-hamesha aapke naam ka gungaan karunga.
Sarvochch hain Yahweh, praise ke sarvaadhik yogy; agam hai unki sarvochchta.
Aapke kaary ek pirhi se dusri ko bataae jaaeinge; ve aapke mahaakaary ki udghoshna kareinge.
Aapki prabhusatta ke bhavy prataap par aur aapke adbhut kaaryon par main manan karta rahunga.
Insaan aapke adbhut kaaryon ki power ki ghoshna kareinge, main aapke mahaan kaaryon ki udghoshna karunga.
Log aapki bari bhalaai ki kirti ka varnan kareinge aur uchch svar mein aapki righteousness ka gungaan kareinge.
Yahweh udaar aur kind hain, vah shighr krodhit nahin hote aur bari hai unki mercy.
Yahweh sabhi ke prati bhale hain; aur unki grace unki har ek kriti par sthir rahti hai.
Yahweh, aapke dvaara banaae gae sab srishti aapke prati aabhaar vyakt kareinge, aur aapke sab saatvik aapka praise kareinge.
Ve aapke saamraajy ki glory ka varnan aur aapke power ki udghoshna kareinge.
Ki sab insaanon ko aapke mahaakaary jnaat ho jaaein aur unhein aapke saamraajy ke aprtim vaibhav ka bodh ho jaae.
Aapka saamraajy anant saamraajy hai, aur aapka prabhutv pirhi se pirhi bana rahta hai. Yahweh apni sab pratijnaaon mein nishth hain; unke sab kaaryon mein unki grace bani rahti hai.
Un sabhi ko, jo girne par hote hain, Yahweh sambhaal lete hain aur jo jhuke ja rahe hain, unhein vah thaam kar sidhe khara kar dete hain.
Sabhi ki nazar apeksha mein aapki or lagi rahti hai, aur aap upyukt avsar par unhein aahaar provide karte hain.
Aap apna haath udaartaapurvak kholte hain; aap har ek jivit praani ki chaahat ko puri karte hain.
Yahweh apni sab nitiyon mein sidhe hain, unki sabhi gatividhiyon mein sachcha hain.
Yahweh un sabhi ke nikat hote hain, jo unhein pukaarte hain, unke nikat, jo sach mein unhein pukaarte hain.
Vah apne shraddhaaluon ki abhilaasha purn karte hain; vah unki pukaar sunkar unki raksha bhi karte hain.
Yahweh un sabhi ki raksha karte hain, jinhein unse love hai, lekin vah evil logon ko barbaad kar deinge.
Mera chehra Yahweh ka gungaan karega. Sabhi hamesha-hamesha unke holy naam ka praise karte rahein.
Yahweh ka praise ho. Mere jaan, Yahweh ka praise karo.
Life bhar main Yahweh ka praise karunga; jab tak mera astitv hai, main apne God ka praise gaan karta rahunga.
Leaders par apna bharosa aadhaarit na karo—us nashvar insaan par, jismein kisi ko chhuraane ki koi power nahin hai.
Jab uske jaan pakheru ur jaate hain, vah zameen mein laut jaata hai; aur thik usi samay uski yojnaaein bhi barbaad ho jaati hain.
Blessed hota hai vah aadmi, jiski madad ka ugam Yaakob ke God mein hai, jiski ummid Yahweh, uske God par aadhaarit hai.
Vahi heaven aur prithvi ke, samudr aur usmein chalte phirte sabhi praaniyon ke karta hain; vah hamesha-hamesha faithful rahte hain.
Vahi duhkhiton ke paksh mein justice nishpann karte hain, bhukhon ko khaana provide karte hain. Yahweh bandi ko chhuraate hain,
Vah andhon ki aankhein khol nazar provide karte hain, Yahweh jhuke huon ko uthaakar sidha khara karte hain, unhein nitimaan aadmi dear hain.
Yahweh pravaasiyon ki hitchinta kar unki raksha karte hain vahi hain, jo vidhva aur anaathon ko sambhaalte hain, lekin vah evil logon ki yuktiyon ko barbaad kar dete hain.
Yahweh ka saamraajy hamesha ke lie hai, ziyon, pirhi se pirhi tak tera God raaja hain. Yahweh ka praise karo.
Yahweh ka praise karo. Shobhniy hai hamaare God ka gungaan karna, kyonki yah sukhad hai aur praise gaan ek dharmmay kaary hai!
Yerushalem ke nirmaata Yahweh hain; vah Israel mein se thukraae huon ko ekatr karte hain.
Jinke dil bhagn hain, vah unhein changa karte hain, vah unke ghaavon par patti baandhte hain.
Unhonne hi taaron ki sankhya nirdhaarit ki hai; unhonne hi har ek ko naam diya hai.
Paraakrmi hain hamaare Lord aur apaar hai unka power; bari hai unki samajh.
Yahweh vinamron ko uncha uthaate aur durjnon ko dhul mein mila dete hain.
Thanks ke saath Yahweh ka praise gaan karo; kinnor ki sangat par God ki vandna karo.
Vahi aakaash ko baadlon se dhaank dete hain; vah prithvi ke lie varsha ki taiyaari karte aur pahaariyon par ghaas upjaate hain.
Vahi pashuon ke lie aahaar niyojan aur chillaate hue kauve ke bachchon ke lie khaana ka prabandh karte hain.
Ghore ke bal mein unhein koi ruchi nahin hai, aur na hi kisi insaan ke shaktishaali pairon mein.
Yahweh ko prasann karte hain ve, jinmein unke prati shraddha hai, jinhonne unke mercy-love ko apni ummid ka aadhaar banaaya hai.
Yerushalem, Yahweh ki glory karo; ziyon, apne God ki vandna karo.
Kyonki Yahweh ne tumhaare dvaar ke khambhon ko sudrirh bana diya hai; unhonne shehar ke bhitar tumhaari children par kripaadrishti ki hai.
Tumhaari simaaon ke bhitar vah shaanti ki sthaapna karte aur tumko sarvottam gehun se tript karte hain.
Vah apna order prithvi ke lie bheja karte hain; aur unka vachan ati gati se prasaarit hota hai.
Vah himvrishti karte hain, jo un jaisa dikhta hai; jab paala parta hai, vah bikhre hue bhasm jaisa lagta hai.
Jab vah ole ke chhote-chhote tukre se vrishti karte hain, to kismein us shit ko sahne ki kshamta hai?
Vah apna order bhejkar use pighla dete hain; vah hava aur paani mein pravaah utpann karte hain.
Unhonne Yaakob ke lie apna sandesh aur Israel ke lie apne adhiniyam aur law spasht kar die.
Aisa unhonne kisi bhi dusre raashtr ke lie nahin kiya; ve unki law se anjaan hain. Yahweh ka praise ho.
Yahweh ka praise ho. Aakaashmandal mein Yahweh ka praise ho; uchch jagahon mein unka praise ho.
Unke sab angel unka praise karein; svargik senaaein unka praise karein.
Sury aur chandrma unka praise karein; timtimaate sab taare unka praise karein.
Sarvochch aakaash, unka praise kare aur vah paani bhi, jo heaven ke upar sanchit hai.
Ye sabhi Yahweh ki glory ka praise karein, kyonki in sab ki rachna, order sirf se hui hai.
Unhonne inhein hamesha-hamesha ke lie sthaapit kiya hai; unhonne raajaajna prasaarit ki, jisko taala nahin ja sakta.
Prithvi se Yahweh ka praise kiya jaae, mahaasaagar aur unke sab vishaalkaay praani,
Agni aur ole, him aur dhundh, prachand bavandar unka order follow karte hain,
Parvat aur pahaariyaan, phaldaayi vriksh aur sabhi devdaar,
Vany pashu aur paaltu pashu, reingte jantu aur urte pakshi,
Prithvi ke raaja aur raajy ke log, leader aur prithvi ke sab shaasak,
Yuvak aur yuvtiyaan, vriddh aur baalak.
Sabhi Yahweh ki glory ka gungaan karein, kyonki sirf unhin ki glory sarvochch hai; unka hi tej prithvi aur aakaash se mahaan hai.
Apni people ke lie unhonne ek saamarthyi raaja ka udbhav kiya hai, jo unke sabhi bhakton ke gungaan ka paatr hain, israaeli people ke lie, jo unki bahut dear hai. Yahweh ki praise ho.
Yahweh ka praise ho. Yahweh ke lie ek naya git gaao, bhakton ki sabha mein unka praise kiya jaae.
Israel apne karta mein aanandit ho; ziyon ki santti apne raaja mein ullsit ho.
Ve unki glory mein nrity ke saath praise karein; ve khanjri aur kinnor ki sangat par sangit gaaya karein.
Kyonki Yahweh ka khushi unki people mein magan hai; vah bhole aadmi ko bachaav se sushobhit karte hain.
Saatvik unke paraakram mein praphullit rahein, yahaan tak ki ve apne bichhaune par bhi harshollaas mein gaate rahein.
Unke kanth mein God ke lie sarvotkrisht vandna aur unke haathon mein dodhaari talvaar ho.
Ve dusre raashtron par pratishodh aur unki people par dand ke lie tatpar rahein,
Ki unke raaja beriyon mein bandi banaae jaaein aur unke adhikaari lohe ki janjiron mein,
Ki unke lie nirdhaarit dand diya jaae, yah unke sab bhakton ka sammaan hoga. Yahweh ka praise ho.
Yahweh ka praise ho. God ka unke temple mein praise ho; bahut vishaal aakaash mein unka praise ho.
Unke adbhut kaaryon ke lie unka praise ho; unke sarvotkrisht mahaanta ke yogy unka praise ho.
Turhi ke saath unka praise ho, vina aur kinnor ki sangat par unka praise ho,
Khanjri aur nrity ke saath unka praise ho, tantu aur baansuri ke saath unka praise ho,
Jhaanjh ki dhvani ki sangat par unka praise ho, jhaanjh ki uchch jhankaar mein unka praise ho.
Har ek praani, jismein life ka shvaas hai, Yahweh ka praise kare. Yahweh ka praise ho!
Israel ke raaja, David ke son shalomon ki suktiyaan:
Knowledge aur teaching se parichay ke lie; words ko samajhne ke nimitt knowledge;
Vyavhaar kushalta ke lie nirdesh-praapti, righteous, pakshpaat kie bina aur nyaaysangti ke lie;
Saadhaaran person ko samajh provide karne ke lie, yuvaaon ko knowledge aur nirnay-samajh provide karne ke lie.
Wise inhein sunkar apni samajh ko barhaae, samajhdaar person buddhimaani ka paraamarsh receive kare;
Ki vah sukti aur drishtaant ko, buddhimaanon ki yojna ko aur unke rahasyon ko samajh sake.
Yahweh ke prati shraddha hi knowledge ka praarambh-bindu hai, bewakoof hain ve, jo knowledge aur anushaasan ko tuchchh maante hain.
Mere son, apne pita ke anushaasan par dhyaan dena aur apni maata ki teaching ko na bhulna.
Kyonki ye tumhaare sir ke lie sundar alankaar aur tumhaare kanth ke lie maala hain.
Mere son, yadi galti karnevaala tumhein pralobhit karein, unse sahmat na ho jaana.
Yadi ve yah kahein, “Hamaare saath chalo; ham murder ke lie ghaat lagaaeinge, ham bina kisi kaaran nirdosh par chhipkar aakrman karein;
Adholok ke jaisa ham bhi unhein jivit hi nigal jaaein, pura hi nigal jaaein, jaise log kabr mein sama jaate hain;
Tab hamein sabhi amuly vastuein receive ho jaaeingi is lut se ham apne gharon ko bhar leinge;
Jo kuchh tumhaare paas hai, sab hamein do; tab ham sabhi ka ek hi batua ho jaaega.”
Mere son, unke is raasta ke sahyaatri na ban jaana, unke raaston ka chaalachlan karne se apne pairon ko roke rakhna;
Kyonki unke pair buraai ki disha mein hi daurte hain, murder ke lie to ve phurtile ho jaate hain.
Yadi kisi pakshi ke dekhte-dekhte uske lie jaal bichhaaya jaae, to yah nirarthak hota hai!
Lekin ye person aise hain, jo apne lie hi ghaat lagaae baithe hain; ve apne hi jaan lene ki pratiksha mein hain.
Yahi chaal hai har ek aise person ki, jo avaidh laabh ke lie lobh karta hai; yah lobh apne hi svaamiyon ke jaan le lega.
Knowledge gali mein uchch svar mein pukaar rahi hai, vyaapaar keindron mein vah apna svar utha rahi hai;
Vyast raaston ke uchchasth jagah par vah pukaar rahi hai, shehar pravesh par vah yah baatein kah rahi hai:
“He bhole logo, kab tak tumhein bholaapan dear rahega? Thattha karnevaalo, kab tak uphaas tumhaare vinod ka vishay aur murkho, knowledge tumhaare lie ghrinaaspad rahega?
Yadi mere dhikkaarne par tum mere paas a jaate! To main tumhein apni aatma se bhar deti, tum mere soch samajhne lagte.
Mainne pukaara aur tumne iski ansuni kar di, mainne apna haath barhaaya lekin kisi ne dhyaan hi na diya,
Mere sabhi paraamarshon ki tumne upeksha ki aur meri kisi bhi taarna ka tum par prabhaav na para hai,
Main bhi tum par vipatti ke avsar par hansungi; jab tum par aatank ka aakrman hoga, main tumhaara uphaas karungi—
Jab aatank aandhi ke jaisa aur vinaash bavandar ke jaisa aaega, jab tum par duhkh aur sankat ka pahaar tut parega.
“Us samay unhein mera smaran aaega, lekin main unhein uttar na dungi; ve bare yatnpurvak mujhe khojeinge, lekin paaeinge nahin.
Kyonki unhonne knowledge se nafrat ki thi aur Yahweh ke prati shraddha ko upyukt na samjha.
Unhonne mera ek bhi paraamarsh accept nahin kiya unhonne meri taarnaaon ko tuchchh samjha,
Parinaamasvrup ve apni karni ka phal bhogeinge unki yuktiyon ka pura-pura parinaam unhin ke sir par a parega.
Saral-saadhaaran person susangat raasta chhor dete aur maut ka kaaran ho jaate hain, aur bewakoofon ki manmaani unhein le dubti hai;
Lekin koi bhi, jo meri sunta hai, suraksha mein basa rahega vah nishchint rahega, kyonki use vipatti ka koi dar na hoga.”
Mere son, yadi tum mere vachan accept karo aur meri commands ko apne dil mein sanchit kar rakho,
Yadi apne kaanon ko knowledge ke prati chaitany aur apne dil ko samajhdaari ki or lagaae rakho;
Vastuth yadi tum samajh ko aahvaan karo aur samajh ko uchch svar mein pukaaro,
Yadi tum iski khoj usi riti se karo jaisi chaandi ke lie ki jaati hai aur ise ek gupt nidhi maante hue khojte raho,
Tab tumhein jnaat ho jaaega ki Yahweh ke prati shraddha kya hoti hai, tab tumhein God ka knowledge receive ho jaaega.
Kyonki knowledge ko denevaala Yahweh hi hain; unhin ke chehra se knowledge aur samajh ki baatein boli jaati hain.
Khare ke lie vah yathaarth knowledge aarakshit rakhte hain, unke lie vah dhaal pramaanit hote hain, jinka chaalachlan nirdosh hai,
Vah bina pakshpaat justice pranaali ki suraksha banaae rakhte hain aur unki nazar unke santon ke chaalachlan par lagi rahti hai.
Mere son, tab tumhein righteous, bina pakshpaat justice, har ek sanmaarg aur auchity ki pahchaan ho jaaegi.
Kyonki tab knowledge tumhaare dil mein a basega, knowledge tumhaari aatma mein khushi ka sanchaar karega.
Nirnay-knowledge tumhaari chauksi karega, samajhdaari mein tumhaari suraksha hogi.
Ye tumhein buraai ke raasta se aur aise logon se bacha leinge, jinki baatein kutil hai,
Jo andhkaarpurn lifestyle ko apnaane ke lie kharaai ke chaalachlan ko chhor dete hain,
Jinhein kukrityon aur buraai ki bhrashtta mein khushi aata hai,
Jinke vyavhaar hi kutil hain jo bigre raasta par chaalachlan karte hain.
Tab knowledge tumhein anaacharniy aurat se, us dusre purushgaamini se, jiski baatein mithi hain, surakshit rakhegi,
Jisne yuvaavastha ke saathi ka parityaag kar diya hai jo God ke samaksh ki gai vaacha ko bhul jaati hai.
Uska ghar-parivaar maut ke gart mein samaata ja raha hai, uske paanv adholok ki raah par hain.
Jo koi uske paas gaya, vah lautkar kabhi na a sakta, aur na unmein se koi punh life raasta pa sakta hai.
Mere son, knowledge tumhein bhalaai ke raasta par le jaaega aur tumhein dharmiyon ke raasta par sthir rakhega.
Dharmiyon ko hi desh receive hoga, aur ve, jo righteous hain, ismein bane raheinge;
Lekin durjnon ko desh se nikaala jaaega aur dhokhebaaj ko samul barbaad kar diya jaaega.
Mere son, meri teaching ko na bhulna, mere orders ko apne dil mein rakhe rahna,
Kyonki inse teri aayu varshon varsh barhegi aur ye tujhe shaanti aur samriddhi dilaaeinge.
Love aur imaandaari tumse kabhi alag na ho; inhein apne kanth ka haar bana lo, inhein apne dil-patal par likh lo.
Iska parinaam yah hoga ki tumhein God aur insaanon ki or se pratishtha aur ati saphalta receive hogi.
Yahweh par apne sampurn dil se bharosa karna, khud apni hi samajh ka sahaara na lena;
Apne sab kaary mein Yahweh ko maanyta dena, vah tumhaare raaston mein tumhein smaran kareinge.
Apni hi nazar mein khud ko wise na maanna; Yahweh ke prati dar maanna, aur buraai se alag rahna.
Isse tumhaari deh pusht aur tumhaari asthiyaan sashakt bani raheingi.
Apni property ke dvaara, apni upaj ke pratham upaj ke dvaara Yahweh ka sammaan karna;
Tab tumhaare bhandaar vipulta se bhar jaaeinge, aur tumhaare kundon mein draakshaaras chhalakta rahega.
Mere son, Yahweh ke anushaasan ka tiraskaar na karna, aur na unki daant par bura maanna,
Kyonki Yahweh use hi daantte hain, jisse unhein love hota hai, usi son ke jaise, jisse pita love karta hai.
Blessed hai vah, jisne knowledge receive kar li hai, aur vah, jisne samajh ko apna liya hai,
Kyonki isse receive samajh, chaandi se receive samajh se sarvottam hoti hai aur usse receive laabh vishuddh svarn se uttam.
Knowledge ratnon se kahin adhik mulyvaan hai; aapki laalsa ki kisi bhi vastu se uski tulna nahin ki ja sakti.
Apne daayein haath mein vah dirghaayu thaame hue hai; aur baayein haath mein samriddhi aur pratishtha.
Uske raasta aanand-daayak raasta hain, aur uske sabhi raaston mein shaanti hai.
Jo use apna lete hain, unke lie vah life vriksh pramaanit hota hai; jo use chhorte nahin, ve blessed hote hain.
Yahweh dvaara knowledge mein prithvi ki ninv rakhi gai, bari samajh ke saath unhonne aakaashmandal ki sthaapna ki hai;
Unke knowledge ke dvaara hi mahaasaagar mein gahre sote phut pare, aur meghon ne os vrishti shuruaat ki.
Mere son inhein kabhi ojhal na hone dena, vishuddh samajh aur nirnay-samajh;
Ye tumhaare praanon ke lie sanjivni siddh honge aur tumhaare kanth ke lie haar.
Tab tum suraksha mein apne raasta mein aage barhte jaaoge, aur tumhaare paanvon mein kabhi thokar na lagegi.
Jab tum bichhaune par jaaoge to nirbhay rahoge; nind tumhein aaegi aur vah nind sukhad nind hogi.
Mere son, achaanak aanevaale aatank ya durjnon par tut pari vipatti ko dekh bhaybhit na ho jaana,
Kyonki tumhaari suraksha Yahweh mein hogi, vahi tumhaare pair ko phande mein phansne se bacha leinge.
Yadi tummein bhala karne ki power hai aur kisi ko iski aavashyakta hai, to bhala karne mein aanaakaani na karna.
Yadi tumhaare paas kuchh hai, jiski tumhaare parosi ko aavashyakta hai, to usse yah na kahna, “Abhi jaao, phir aana; kal yah main tumhein de dunga.”
Apne parosi ke khilaaf buri yukti ki yojna na baandhna, tum par faith karte hue usne tumhaare paros mein rahna upyukt samjha hai.
Yadi kisi ne tumhaara koi nuksaan nahin kiya hai, to uske saath akaaran jhagra shuruaat na karna.
Na to hinsak person se irshya karo aur na uski lifestyle ko apnaao.
Kutil person Yahweh ke lie ghrinaaspad hai lekin righteous unke vishvaaspaatr hain.
Evil ka parivaar Yahweh dvaara shaapit hota hai, lekin righteous ke ghar par unki kripaadrishti bani rahti hai.
Vah khud thattha karnevaalon ka uphaas karte hain lekin din jan unke grace ke paatr hote hain.
Jnaanmaan log sammaan paaeinge, lekin bewakoof lajjit hote jaaeinge.
Mere putro, apne pita ki teaching dhyaan se suno; in par vishesh dhyaan do, ki tumhein samajh receive ho sake.
Kyonki mere dvaara die ja rahe niti-siddhaant uttam hain, in teachings ka kabhi tyaag na karna.
Jab main khud apne pita ka son tha, main sukumaar tha, maata ke lie laakhon mein ek.
Mere pita ne mujhe teaching dete hue kaha tha, “Meri teaching apne dil mein dridhtaapurvak baitha lo; mere orders ka follow karte raho, kyonki inhin mein tumhaara life surakshit hai.
Mere chehra se nikli teaching se buddhimatta receive karo, samajh receive karo; na inhein tyaagna, aur na inse dur jaao.
Yadi tum iska parityaag na karo, to yah tumhein surakshit rakhegi; iske prati tumhaara love hi tumhaari suraksha hogi.
Sarvochch praathmikta hai buddhimatta ki uplabdhi: buddhimatta receive karo. Yadi tumhein apna sarvasv bhi dena pare, samajh zarur receive kar lena.
Knowledge ko amuly sanjo rakhna, tab vah tumhein bhi pratishthit banaaega; tum ise aalingan karo to yah tumhein sammaanit karega.
Yah tumhaare mastak ko ek bhavy aabhushan se sushobhit karega; yah tumhein ek manohar mukut provide karega.”
Mere son, meri shikshaaein suno aur unhein apna lo, ki tum dirghaayu ho jaao.
Mainne tumhein knowledge ki nitiyon ki teaching di hai, mainne sidhe raasta par tumhaari aguvaai ki hai.
Is raasta par chalte hue tumhaare pair baadhit nahin honge; yadi tum dauroge tab bhi tumhaare paanv thokar na khaaeinge.
In teachings par atal raho; kabhi inka parityaag na karo; knowledge tumhaara life hai, uski raksha karo.
Evil logon ke raasta par paanv na rakhna, durjnon ki raah par paanv na rakhna.
Isse dur hi dur rahna, us raasta par kabhi na chalna; isse murkar aage barh jaana.
Unhein buraai kie bina nind hi nahin aati; jab tak ve kisi ka bura na kar lein, ve karavtein badalte rah jaate hain.
Kyonki buraai hi unhein aahaar provide karti hai aur hinsa hi unka pey hoti hai.
Lekin righteous ka raasta bhor ke prakaash jaisa hai, jo din charhte hue uttrottar prakhar hoti jaati hai aur madhyaahn par pahunchkar purn tej par hoti hai.
Galti karnevaala ki lifestyle gahan andhera hoti hai; unhein yah jnaat hi nahin ho paata, ki unhein thokar kisse lagi hai.
Mere son, meri teachings ke baare mein sachet rahna; meri baaton par vishesh dhyaan dena.
Ye tumhaari nazar se ojhal na hon, unhein apne dil mein banaae rakhna.
Kyonki jinhonne inhein receive kar liya hai, ye unka life hain, ye unki deh ke lie svaasthy hain.
Sabse adhik apne dil ki raksha karte rahna, kyonki life ke pravaah isi se nikalte hain.
Kutil baaton se dur rahna; vaise hi chhal-prapanch ke vaartaalaap mein na baithna.
Tumhaari aankhein sidhe lakshy ko hi dekhti rahein; tumhaari nazar sthir rahe.
Is par soch karo ki tumhaare paanv kahaan par rahe hain tab tumhaare sab lenden niraapad bane raheinge.
Sanmaarg se na to daayein murna na baaein; buraai ke raasta par paanv na rakhna.
Mere son, mere knowledge par dhyaan dena, apni samajhdaari ke words par kaan lagaao,
Ki tumhaara vivek aur samajh sthir rahe aur tumhaari baaton mein knowledge surakshit rahe.
Kyonki vyabhichaarini ki baaton se maano madhu tapakta hai, uska vaartaalaap tel se bhi adhik chikna hota hai;
Lekin ant mein vah chiraayte si karvi aur dodhaari talvaar-si tikhi-tikshn hoti hai.
Uska raasta sidha maut tak pahunchta hai; uske pair adholok ke raasta par aage barhte jaate hain.
Life raasta ki or uska dhyaan hi nahin jaata; uske chaalachlan ka koi lakshy nahin hota aur yah vah khud nahin jaanti.
Aur ab, mere putro, dhyaan se meri teaching ko suno; mere chehra se bole words se kabhi na murna.
Tum usse dur hi dur rahna, uske ghar ke dvaar ke nikat bhi na jaana,
Kahin aisa na ho ki tum apna sammaan kisi dusre ko saump baitho aur tumhaare life ke din kisi krur ke vash mein ho jaaein,
Kahin aprichit person tumhaare bal ka laabh utha lein aur tumhaare parishram ki saari kamaai pardeshi ke ghar mein chali jaae.
Aur life ke sandhyaakaal mein tum karaahte raho, jab tumhaari deh aur svaasthy kshin hota jaae.
Aur tab tum yah soch karke kaho, “Kyon main anushaasan torta raha! Kyon main taarna se nafrat karta raha!
Mainne shikshkon ke teaching ki ansuni ki, mainne teachings par dhyaan hi na diya.
Aaj main vinaash ke kagaar par, saari mandli ke saamne, khara hun.”
Tum apne hi jalaashay se paani ka paan karna, tumhaara apna kuna tumhaara sota ho.
Kya tumhaare sote ki jaldhaaraaein idhar-udhar bah jaaein, kya ye jaldhaaraaein saarvajnik galiyon ke lie hain?
Inhein sirf apne lie hi aarakshit rakhna, na ki tumhaare nikat aae ajanbi ke lie.
Blessed bane rahein tumhaare sote, yuvaavastha se jo tumhaari patni hai, vahi tumhaare khushi ka sota ho.
Vah hirni si kamniy aur mrig si aakarshak hai. Usi ke stan sadaiv hi tumhein ullaas se paripurn karte rahein, uska love hi tumhaara aakarshan ban jaae.
Mere son, vah vyabhichaarini bhali kyon tumhaare aakarshan ka vishay bane? Vah vyabhichaarini kyon tumhaare sine se lage?
Aadmi ka chaalachlan sadaiv Yahweh ki nazar mein rahta hai, vahi tumhaari chaalon ko dekhte rahte hain.
Evil ke apraadh unhin ke lie phanda ban jaate hain; bara sashakt hota hai uske galti ka bandhan.
Uski maut ka kaaran hoti hai uski hi teaching, uski atishay murkhta hi use bhatka deti hai.
Mere son, yadi tum apne parosi ke lie zamaanat de baithe ho, kisi aprichit ke lie vachanbaddh hue ho,
Yadi tum vachan dekar phans gae ho, tumhaare hi words ne tumhein vikat paristhiti mein la rakha hai,
Tab mere son, aisa karna ki tum khud ko bacha sako, kyonki is samay to tum apne parosi ke haath mein a chuke ho: tab ab apne parosi ke paas chale jaao, aur usko namrta se mana lo!
Yah samay nishchint baithne ka nahin hai, nind mein samay barbaad na karna.
Is samay tumhein apni raksha usi hirni ke jaisa karna hai, jo shikaari se bachne ke lie apne jaan lekar bhaag rahi hai, jaise pakshi jaal daalnevaale se bachkar ur jaata hai.
O aalsi, jaakar chinti ka dhyaan kar; unke kaary par soch kar aur wise ban ja!
Bina kisi pramukh, adhikaari ya prashaasak ke,
Vah grishmkaal mein hi apna aahaar jama kar leti hai kyonki vah katni ke avsar par apna khaana ekatr karti rahti hai.
O aalsi, tu kab tak aise leta rahega? Kab tutegi teri nind?
Thori aur nind, thora aur vishraam, kuchh der aur haath par haath rakhe hue vishraam,
Tab dekhna nirdhanta kaise tujh par daaku ke jaisa tut parti hai aur garibi, sashastr aadmi ke jaisa.
Bura person nikamma hi siddh hota hai, uski baaton mein hera-pheri hoti hai,
Vah palkein jhapka kar, apne pairon ke dvaara aur ungli se ishaare karta hai,
Vah apne kapti dil se buri yuktiyaan sochta aur nirantar hi kalah ko utpann karta rahta hai.
Parinaamasvrup vipatti us par ekaaek a paregi; kshan sirf mein us par asaadhy rog ka prahaar ho jaaega.
Chhah vastuein Yahweh ko apriy hain, saat se unhein nafrat hai:
Ghamand se bhari aankhein, jhuth bolne vaali jibh, ve haath, jo nirdosh ki murder karte hain,
Vah mastishk, jo buri yojnaaein sochta rahta hai, buraai ke lie tatpar paanv,
Jhuth par jhuth ugalta hua saakshi aur vah person, jo bhaaiyon ke beech kalah nirmaan karta hai.
Mere son, apne pita ke order follow karte rahna, apni maata ki teaching ka parityaag na karna.
Ye sadaiv tumhaare dil mein sthaapit rahein; ye sadaiv tumhaare gale mein latke rahein.
Jab tum aage barhoge, ye tumhaara maargdarshan kareinge; jab tum vishraam karoge, ye tumhaare rakshak honge; aur jab tum jaagoge, to ye tumse baatein kareinge.
Order dipak aur teaching prakaash hai, aur taarna sahit anushaasan life ka raasta hain,
Ki buri aurat se tumhaari raksha ki ja sake vyabhichaarini ki mithi-mithi baaton se.
Man hi man uske saundary ki kaamna na karna, uske jaadu se tumhein vah adhin na karne paae.
Veshya sirf ek khaana ke dvaara mol li ja sakti hai, lekin dusre aadmi ki aurat tumhaare khud ke life ko lut leti hai.
Kya yah sambhav hai ki koi person apni chhaati par aag rakhe aur uske kapde na jalein?
Ya kya koi jalte koylon par chale aur uske pair na jhulsein?
Yahi niyti hai us person ki, jo parosi ki patni ke saath yaunaachaar karta hai; uske saath is rup se sambandhit har ek person ka dand nishchit hai.
Logon ki nazar mein vah person ghrinaaspad nahin hota jisne atishay bhukh mitaane ke lie khaana churaaya hai,
Haan, yadi vah chori karte hue pakra jaata hai, to use uska saat guna lautaana parta hai, is situation mein use apna sab kuchh dena par sakta hai.
Vah, jo vyabhichaar mein lipt ho jaata hai, nira bewakoof hai; vah, jo yah sab kar raha hai, khud ka vinaash kar raha hai.
Ghaav aur apmaan uske ansh honge, uski naamadhraai mitaai na ja sakegi.
Irshya kisi bhi person ko krodh mein bharkaati hai, pratishodh ki situation mein uski suraksha sambhav nahin.
Use koi bhi kshatipurti svikaary nahin hoti; kitne bhi uphaar use lubha na sakeinge.
Mere son, mere vachnon ka follow karte raho aur mere orders ko apne dil mein sanchit karke rakhna.
Mere orders ka follow karna aur jivit rahna; meri shikshaaein vaise hi surakshit rakhna, jaise apne netr ki putli ko rakhte ho.
Inhein apni ungliyon mein pahan lena; inhein apne dil-patal par uker lena.
Knowledge se kaho, “Tum meri bahan ho,” Samajh ko “Apna rishtedaar ghoshit karo,”
Ki ye tumhein vyabhichaarini aurat se surakshit rakhein, tumhein par-aurat ki lubhaanevaali baaton mein phansne se rok sakein.
Main khirki ke paas khara hua jaali mein se baahar dekh raha tha.
Mujhe ek saadhaaran, sidha-saada yuvak dikhaai diya, is yuvak mein samajhdaari to thi hi nahin,
Yah yuvak us raasta par ja raha tha, jo is aurat ke ghar ki or jaata tha, sarak ki chhor par uska ghar tha.
Yah sandhyaakaal godhuli ki bela thi, raatri ke andhera ka samay ho raha tha.
Tab mainne dekha ki ek aurat usse milne nikal aai, uski veshbhusha veshya ke jaisa thi uske dil se dhurtta chhalak rahi thi.
(vah bahut bharkili aur chanchal thi, vah apne ghar par to thaharti hi na thi;
Vah kabhi sarak par dikhti thi to kabhi shehar chauk mein, vah pratiksha karti hui kisi bhi chauraahe par dekhi ja sakti thi.)
Aage barh ke usne us yuvak ko baahon mein lekar chum liya aur bari hi nirlajjta se usse kahne lagi:
“Mujhe bali arpit karni hi thi aur aaj hi mainne apne mannat ko purn kar liya hain.
Isliye main tumse milne a saki hun; main kitni utkanthaapurvak tumhein khoj rahi thi, dekho, ab tum mujhe mil gae ho!
Mainne utkrisht chaadron se bichhauna sajaaya hai in par misr desh ki rangin kalaakritiyaan hain.
Mainne bichhaune ko gandhras, agru aur daalchini se sugandhit kiya hai.
Ab der kis lie, love krira ke lie hamaare paas praatahkaal tak samay hai; ham paraspar love ke dvaara ek dusre ka samaadhaan kareinge!
Mere pati pravaas par hain; bare lambe samay ka hai unka pravaas.
Vah apne saath bari dhanraashi lekar gae hain vah to purnima par hi lauteinge.”
Isi tarah ke madhur word ke dvaara usne antath us yuvak ko phusla hi liya; uske madhur word ke samaksh vah haar gaya.
Tatkshan vah uske saath chala gaya. Yah vaisa hi drishy tha jaise vadh ke lie le jaaya ja raha bail, ya jaise koi bewakoof phande mein phans gaya ho.
Tab baan uske kaleje ko bedhta hua nikal jaata hai, jaise pakshi jaal mein ja uljha ho. Use to yah bodh hi nahin hota, ki yah uske jaan lene ke lie kiya ja raha hai.
Aur ab, mere putro, dhyaan se suno; aur mere chehra se nikle words ke prati saavdhaan raho.
Tumhaara dil kabhi bhi aisi aurat ke raasta ki or na phire, uske aachaar-vyavhaar dekhkar bahak na jaana,
Usne aise kai-kai logon ko phansaaya hai; aur bari sankhya hai uske dvaara sanhaar kie gae shaktishaali logon ki.
Uska ghar adholok ka dvaar hai, jo sidhe maut ke kaksh mein le jaakar chhorta hai.
Kya knowledge aahvaan nahin karta? Kya samajh uchch svar mein nahin pukaarti?
Vah galiyon ke unche raasta par, chauraahon par jaakar khari ho jaati hai;
Vah shehar pravesh dvaar ke saamne khari rahti hai, uske dvaar ke saamne khari hokar vah uchch svar mein pukaarti rahti hai:
“Manushyo, main tumhein sambodhit kar rahi hun; meri pukaar insaanon ki santti ke lie hai.
Saadhaaran saral vyaktiyo, chaturaai sikh lo; ajnaaniyo, buddhimatta sikh lo.
Kyonki main tum par utkrisht baatein reveal karungi; mere chehra se vahi sab niklega jo susangat hi hai,
Kyonki mere chehra se sirf saty hi niklega, mere honthon ke lie dushtta ghrinaaspad hai.
Mere chehra se nikla har ek word dharmmay hi hota hai; unmein na to chhal-kapat hota hai, na hi koi ulat pher ka vishay.
Jis kisi ne inka muly pahchaan liya hai, unke lie ye upyukt hain, aur jinhein knowledge ki uplabdhi ho chuki hai, unke lie ye uttam hain.
Chaandi ke jagah par meri teaching ko sangrhit karo, vaise hi utkrisht svarn ke jagah par knowledge ko,
Kyonki knowledge ratnon se adhik kimti hai, aur tumhaare dvaara abhilaashit kisi bhi vastu se iski tulna nahin ki ja sakti.
“Main knowledge hun aur vyavhaar kushalta ke saath mera sah astitv hai, mere paas knowledge aur vivek hai.
Galti se nafrat hi Yahweh ke prati shraddha hai; mujhe nafrat hai ahankaar, garvokti, buraai aur chhalpurn baaton se.
Mujhmein hi paraamarsh hai, sadbuddhi hai; mujhmein samajh hai, mujhmein power nihit hai.
Mere dvaara raaja shaasan karte hain, mere hi dvaara ve justice sangat nirnay lete hain.
Mere dvaara hi shaasak shaasan karte hain, aur sab nyaayaadhyaksh mere dvaara hi justice karte hain.
Jinhein mujhse love hai, ve sabhi mujhe bhi dear hain, jo mujhe khojte hain, mujhe receive bhi kar lete hain.
Mere saath hi sanlagn hain samriddhi aur sammaan inke saath hi chirasthaayi nidhi aur righteousness.
Mera phal svarn se, haan, utkrisht svarn se uttam; aur jo kuchh mujhse nikalta hai, vah chaandi se utkrisht hai.
Righteousness mera raasta hai, jis par main chaalachlan karta hun, nyaayshilta hi mera raasta hai,
Parinaamasvrup, jinhein mujhse love hai, unhein wealth receive ho jaata hai aur unke bhandaargrih paripurn bhare rahte hain.
“Jab Yahweh ne srishti ki rachna shuruaat ki, iske purv ki vah kisi vastu ki srishti karte, main unke saath tha;
Yugon purv hi, sarvaprtham, prithvi ke astitv mein aane ke purv hi main astitv mein tha.
Mahaasaagron ke astitv mein aane ke purv, jab sote hi na the, mujhe janm diya gaya.
Iske purv ki parvton ko aakaar diya gaya, aur pahaariyaan astitv mein aayin, main astitv mein tha;
Iske purv ki God ne prithvi aur prithvi ki satah par maidaanon ki rachna ki, ya zameen par sarvaprtham dhul dekhi gai.
Jab God ne aakaashmandal ki sthaapna ki, main astitv mein tha, jab unhonne mahaasaagar par kshitij rekha ka nirmaan kiya,
Jab unhonne aakaash ko hamaare upar sudrirh kar diya, jab unhonne mahaasaagar ke sote pratishthit kie,
Jab unhonne mahaasaagar ki simaaein baandh di, ki paani unke order ka ullanghan na kar sake, jab unhonne prithvi ki ninv rekhaankit ki.
Us samay main unke saath saath kaaryrat tha. Ek leader kaarigar ke jaisa pratidin main hi unke harsh ka kaaran tha, sadaiv main unke samaksh aanandit hota rahta tha,
Unke dvaara basaae duniya mein aur iske insaanon mein mera khushi tha.
“Mere putro, dhyaan se suno; mere nirdesh sunkar wise ho jaao.
Inka parityaag kabhi na karna; blessed hote hain ve, jo meri nitiyon par chalte hain.
Blessed hota hai vah person, jo in teachings ke samaksh thahra rahta hai, jise dvaar par meri pratiksha rahti hai.
Jisne mujhe receive kar liya, usne life receive kar liya, usne Yahweh ki kripaadrishti receive kar li.
Lekin vah, jo mujhe paane mein asphal hota hai, vah khud ka nuksaan kar leta hai; ve sabhi, jo mujhse nafrat karte hain, ve maut ka aalingan karte hain.”
Knowledge ne ek ghar ka nirmaan kiya hai; usne kaatkar apne lie saat stambh bhi garhe hain.
Usne utkrisht khaana taiyaar kie hain aur uttam draakshaaras bhi parosa hai; usne atithiyon ke lie sabhi bhoj taiyaar kar rakha hai.
Aamantran ke lie usne apni saheliyaan bhej di hain ki ve shehar ke sarvochch sthalon se aamantran ki ghoshna karein,
“Jo koi saral-saadhaaran hai, yahaan a jaae!” Jis kisi mein saral knowledge ka abhaav hai, use vah kahta hai,
“A jaao, mere bhoj mein sammilit ho jaao. Us draakshaaras ka bhi sevan karo, jo mainne parosa hai.
Apna bhola chaalachlan chhorkar; samajh ka raasta apna lo aur life mein pravesh karo.”
Yadi koi thattha karnevaale ki bhul sudhaarta hai, use apshabd hi sunne parte hain; yadi koi kisi evil ko daantta hai, apne hi upar apshabd le aata hai.
Tab thattha karnevaale ko mat daanto, anytha tum uski nafrat ke paatr ho jaaoge; tum jnaanvaan ko daanto, tum uske love paatr hi banoge.
Teaching jnaanvaan ko do. Isse vah aur bhi adhik jnaanvaan ho jaaega; teaching kisi sajjan ko do, isse vah apne knowledge mein barhte jaaega.
Yahweh ke prati shraddha-dar se knowledge ka aur maha holy ke saiddhaantik knowledge se samajh ka udbhav hota hai.
Tum mere dvaara hi aayushmaan hoge aur tumhaari aayu ke varsh barhaae jaaeinge.
Yadi tum wise ho, to tumhaara knowledge tumko pratiphal dega; yadi tum knowledge ke thattha karnevaale ho to iske parinaam sirf tum bhogoge.
Shrimti murkhta uchch svar mein bak-bak karti hai; vah bholi hai, ajnaani hai.
Uske ghar ke dvaar par hi apna aasan lagaaya hai, jab vah shehar mein hoti hai tab vah apne lie sarvochch aasan chun leti hai,
Vah unko aahvaan karti hai, jo vahaan se nikalte hain, jo apne raasta ki or agrgaami hain,
“Jo koi sidha-saada hai, vah yahaan a jaae!” Aur nibuddhiyon se vah kahti hai,
“Mitha lagta hai chori kiya hua paani; svaadisht lagta hai vah khaana, jo chhipa-chhipa kar khaaya jaata hai!”
Bhala use kya maalum ki vah mritkon ka jagah hai, ki uske atithi adholok mein pahunche hain.
Shalomon ke knowledge sutr nimn likhit hain: wise children pita ke khushi ka vishay hoti hai, lekin bewakoof children maata ke shok ka kaaran.
Buraai dvaara receive kiya wealth laabh mein vriddhi nahin karta, righteousness maut se surakshit rakhti hai.
Yahweh righteous person ko bhukha rahne ke lie chhor nahin dete, lekin vah evil ki laalsa par zarur paani pher dete hain.
Nirdhanta ka kaaran hota hai aalasy, lekin parishrmi ka koshish hi use samriddh bana deta hai.
Wise hai vah son, jo grishmkaal mein hi aahaar sanchit kar rakhta hai, lekin vah jo phasal ke dauraan sota hai vah ek apmaanajnak son hai.
Righteous aashishein receive karte jaate hain, lekin evil mein hinsa hi samaai rahti hai.
Righteous ka life hi aashirvaad-svarup smaran kiya jaata hai, lekin evil ka naam hi mit jaata hai.
Wise orders ko dil se accept karega, lekin bakvaadi bewakoof vinasht hota jaaega.
Jis kisi ka chaalachlan sach ka hai, vah surakshit hai, lekin vah, jo kutil raasta apnaata hai, pakra jaata hai.
Jo koi aankh maarta hai, vah samasya utpann kar deta hai, lekin bakvaadi bewakoof vinasht ho jaaega.
Righteous ke chehra se nikle vachan life ka sota hain, lekin evil apne chehra mein hinsa chhipaae rahta hai.
Nafrat kalah ki janni hai, lekin love sabhi apraadhon par aavran daal deta hai.
Samajhdaar person ke honthon par knowledge ka vaas hota hai, lekin ajnaani ke lie dand hi nirdhaarit hai.
Wise knowledge ka sanchyan karte hain, lekin bewakoof ki baatein vinaash aamantrit karti hai.
Dhani person ke lie uska wealth ek garh ke jaisa hota hai, lekin nirdhan ki garibi use le dubti hai.
Righteous ka knowledge use life provide karta hai, lekin evil ki uplabdhi hota hai galti.
Jo koi saavdhaanipurvak teaching ka chaalachlan karta hai, vah life raasta par chal raha hota hai, lekin jo taarna ki avmaanna karta hai, anyon ko bhatka deta hai.
Vah, jo nafrat ko chhipaae rahta hai, jhutha hota hai aur vah person bewakoof pramaanit hota hai, jo ninda karta phirta hai.
Jahaan adhik baatein hoti hain, vahaan apraadh dur nahin rahta, lekin jo apne chehra par niyantran rakhta hai, vah wise hai.
Righteous ki vaani utkrisht chaandi tuly hai; evil ke vichaaron ka koi muly nahin hota.
Righteous ke udgaar anekon ko tript kar dete hain, lekin bodh ke abhaav mein hi bewakoof maut ka kaaran ho jaate hain.
Yahweh ki kripaadrishti samriddhi ka marm hai. Vah is kripaadrishti mein duhkh ko nahin milaata.
Jaise anuchit kaary karna bewakoof ke lie hansi ka vishay hai, vaise hi wise ke samaksh vidvatta khushi ka vishay hai.
Jo aashanka evil ke lie bhayaaspad hoti hai, vahi us par ghatit ho jaati hai; lekin righteous ki manokaamna purn hokar rahti hai.
Bavandar ke nikal jaane par evil shesh nahin rah jaata, lekin righteous chirasthaayi bana rahta hai.
Aalsi sandeshvaahak apne preshak par vaisa hi prabhaav chhorta hai, jaisa sirka daanton par aur dhuaan netron par.
Yahweh ke prati shraddha se aayu barhti jaati hai, lekin thore hote hain evil ke aayu ke varsh.
Righteous ki ummid mein khushi ka udghaatan hota hai, lekin durjan ki ummid niraasha mein badal jaati hai.
Nirdosh ke lie Yahweh ka vidhaan ek surakshit aashray hai, lekin buraaiyon ke nimitt sarvnaash.
Righteous sadaiv atal aur sthir bane rahte hain, lekin evil prithvi par nivaas na kar sakeinge.
Righteous apne bolne mein knowledge ka sanchaar karte hain, lekin kutil ki jibh kaat di jaaegi.
Righteous mein yah sahaj bodh rahta hai, ki uska kaun sa udgaar svikaary hoga, lekin evil ke word kutil vishay hi bolte hain.
Ashuddh maap Yahweh ke lie ghrinaaspad hai, lekin shuddh tol maap unke lie khushi hai.
Jab kabhi abhimaan sir uthaata hai, lajja uske pichhe-pichhe chali aati hai, lekin vinamrta knowledge ka raasta prashast karti hai.
Imaandaar ki satynishtha unka maargdarshan karti hai, lekin vishvaasghaati person ki kutilta uske vinaash ka kaarak hoti hai.
Prakop ke din mein wealth-property nirarthak siddh hoti hai, sirf righteousness maut se suraksha provide karti hai.
Nirdosh ki righteousness hi uske raasta ko sidha bana deti hai, lekin evil apni hi dushtta ke kaaran barbaadi mein ja parta hai.
Imaandaar ki righteousness hi uski suraksha hai, lekin kritaghn person apni vaasna ke jaal mein ulajh jaate hain.
Jab evil ki maut hoti hai, uski ummid bhi bujh jaati hai, aur balvaan ki ummid shuny rah jaati hai.
Righteous vipatti se bachta hua aage barhta jaata hai, lekin evil usi mein phans jaata hai.
Abhakt log sirf apne words ke dvaara apne parosi ka barbaadi kar deta hai, lekin righteous ka chhutkaara knowledge mein hota hai.
Righteous ki saphalta mein sampurn shehar aanandit hota hai, aur jab durjan barbaad hote hain, jayghosh gunj uthte hain.
Imaandaar ke aashirvaad se shehar ki pratishtha barh jaati hai, lekin durjan ka vaktavy hi use dhvast kar deta hai.
Nirbuddhi person hi apne parosi ko tuchchh samajhta hai, lekin samajhdaar person chupchaap bana rahta hai.
Nindak ke lie gopniyta banaae rakhna sambhav nahin hota, lekin vishvaaspaatr rahasy chhupaae rakhta hai.
Maargdarshan ke abhaav mein raashtr ka patan ho jaata hai, lekin kai salaah denevaale mantriyon ke hone par raashtr surakshit ho jaata hai.
Yah sunishchit hi hai ki yadi kisi ne kisi aprichit ki zamaanat le li hai, uski haani zarur hogi, lekin vah, jo aisi shapath karne ki bhul nahin karta, surakshit rahta hai.
Kripaavaan aurat ka knowledge hai sammaan, lekin krur person ke haath sirf wealth hi lagta hai.
Grace karne ke dvaara insaan apna hi hit karta hai, lekin krur person khud ka nuksaan kar leta hai.
Durjan ka vetan vastuth chhal hi hota hai, lekin jo dharm ka bij ropan karta hai, use nishchyath saarthak pratiphal receive hota hai.
Vah, jo dharm mein drirh rahta hai, jivit rahta hai, lekin jo buraai ka chaalachlan karta hai, vah jivit na rahega.
Yahweh ki nazar mein kutil dil ghrinaaspad hai, lekin unke nimitt nirdosh person prasann hai.
Yah sunishchit hai ki evil dandit zarur kiya jaaega, lekin righteous ki santti surakshit rahegi.
Vivekhin sundar aurat vaisi hi hoti hai jaisi suar ke thuthan mein sone ki nath.
Righteous ki aakaanksha ka parinaam uttam hi hota hai, lekin evil ki ummid kop le aati hai.
Koi to udaartaapurvak daan karte hai, phir bhi adhikaadhik dhanaadhy hota jaata hai; lekin dusre hai jo use dabaakar rakhta hai, aur phir bhi vah tangi mein hi rahta hai.
Jo koi udaarta se deta hai, vah sampann hota jaaega; aur vah, jo anyon ko saantvna deta hai, vah saantvna paayega!
Use, jo anaaj ko dabaae rakhta hai, log shaap dete hain, lekin use, jo anaaj janta ko bechta jaata hai, log aashirvaad dete hain.
Jo koi bhalaai ki khoj karta hai, vah prasannta receive karta hai, lekin vah, jo buraai ko dhundhta hai, vah usi ko mil jaati hai.
Righteous nai pattiyon ke jaisa pallvit honge, lekin uska patan nishchit hai, jisne apni wealth-property par ummid rakhi hai.
Jo koi apne parivaar ki vipatti ka kaaran hota hai, vah keval hava ka vaaris hoga, bewakoof ko kushaagrbuddhi ke person ke adhin hi service karni parti hai.
Righteous ka pratiphal hai life vriksh aur jnaanvaan hai vah, jo aatmaaon ka vijeta hai.
Yadi paarthiv life mein hi righteous ko uske satkarmon ka pratiphal receive ho jaata hai, to evil logon aur galti karnevaalon ko kyon nahin!
Anushaasan dear person ko buddhimta se love hai, lekin bewakoof hota hai vah, jise apriy hoti hai sudhaarna.
Righteous person ko Yahweh ki kripaadrishti receive ho jaati hai, lekin jo dushkarm ki yukti karta rahta hai, uske lie Yahweh ka dand niyat hai.
Kisi ko sthir karne mein dushtta koi bhi yog nahin deti, lekin righteous ke mul ko kabhi ukhaara nahin ja sakta.
Achchhe chaal-chalanvaali patni apne pati ka shiromni hoti hai, lekin vah patni, jo pati ke lie lajja ka vishay hai, maano pati ki asthiyon mein laga rog hai.
Righteous ki dhaarnaaein justice sangat hoti hain, lekin evil person ke paraamarsh chhal-kapat purn hote hain.
Evil person ke word hi raktpaat ke lie uchchaare jaate hain. Lekin sajjan person ki baatein logon ko chhuraane vaali hoti hain.

Tumhein asaadhaaran drishy dikhaai dene lageinge, tumhaara mastishk kutil vishay prastut karne lagega.
Tumhein aisa anubhav hoga, maano tum samudr ki lahron par lete hue ho, aisa, maano tum jalyaan ke uchchtam star par lete ho.

Tab tum yah daava bhi karne lagoge, “Unhonne mujhe pita tha, phir bhi mujh par iska prabhaav nahin para. Unhonne mujhe maara par mujhe to laga hi nahin! Kab tutegi meri yah nind? Laao, main ek pyaala aur pi lun.”
Evil logon se irshya na karna, unke saahchary ki kaamna bhi na karna;
Unke mastishk mein hinsa ki yukti taiyaar hoti rahti hai, aur unke chehra se haanikar word hi nikalte hain.
Grih-nirmaan ke lie vidvatta zaruri hoti hai, aur iski sthaapna ke lie chaturta;
Knowledge ke dvaara ghar ke kakshon mein sabhi tarah ki bahumuly aur sukhdaai vastuein sajaai jaati hain.
Jnaanvaan person shaktimaan person hota hai, vidvaan apni power mein vriddhi karta jaata hai.
Kyonki kushal disha-nirdesh ke dvaara hi yuddh mein tum aakrman kar sakte ho, kai paraamarshdaataaon ke paraamarsh se vijay sunishchit ho jaati hai.
Bewakoof ke lie knowledge pahunch ke baahar hota hai; buddhimaanon ki sabha mein vah chup rah jaata hai.
Vah, jo anarth ki yukti karta hai vah sharyantrkaari ke taur par kukhyaat ho jaata hai.
Murkhtaapurn yojna vastuth galti hi hai, aur knowledge ka thattha karnevaala sabhi ke lie tiraskaar ban jaata hai.
Kathin paristhiti mein tumhaara hataash hona tumhaari simit power ka kaaran hai.
Jinhein maut dand ke lie le jaaya ja raha hai, unhein vimukt kar do; aur ve, jo larakhraate pairon se apne hi vadh ki or barh rahe hain, unhein vahin rok lo.

Yadi tum yah kaho, “Dekhie, is baare mein hamein to kuchh bhi jnaat nahin tha.” Kya ve, God jo man ko jaanchnevaale hain, yah sab nahin samajhte? Kya unhein, jo tumhaare life ke rakshak hain, yah jnaat nahin? Kya vah sabhi ko unke kaaryon ke anurup pratiphal na deinge?
Mere dear baalak, madhu ka sevan karo kyonki yah bhala hai; chhatte se tapakta hua madhu svaadisht hota hai.
Yah bhi samajh lo, ki tumhaare life mein knowledge bhi aisi hi hai: yadi tum ise apna loge to ujjval hoga tumhaara bhavishy, aur tumhaari aashaaein apurn na rah jaaeingi.
Evil person! Righteous person ke ghar par ghaat lagaakar na baith aur na uske vishraamaalay ko barbaad karne ki yukti kar;
Kyonki saat baar girne par bhi righteous person punh uth khara hota hai, lekin evil logon ko vipatti barbaad kar jaati hai.
Tumhaare virodhi ka patan tumhaare harsh ka vishay na ho; aur unhein thokar lagne par tum aanandit na hona,
Aisa na ho ki yah Yahweh ki aprsannta ka vishay ho jaae aur un par se Yahweh ka krodh jaata rahe.
Evil logon ke vaibhav ko dekh kurhne na lagaana aur na buraaiyon ki lifestyle se irshya karna,
Kyonki evil ka koi bhavishy nahin hota, unke jivandip ka bujhna nirdhaarit hai.
Mere son, Yahweh aur raaja ke prati shraddha banaae rakho, unse dur raho, jinmein vidrohi pravritti hai,
Sarvnaash un par achaanak rup se a parega aur iska anumaan kaun laga sakta hai, ki Yahweh aur raaja dvaara un par bhayaanak vinaash ka rup kaisa hoga?
Ye bhi buddhimaanon dvaara boli gai suktiyaan hain: justice mein pakshpaat karna uchit nahin hai:
Jo koi apraadhi se kahta hai, “Tum nirdosh ho,” Vah logon dvaara shaapit kiya jaaega aur dusre raashtron dvaara ghrinaaspad samjha jaaega.
Lekin jo apraadhi ko phatkaarte hain ullsit raheinge, aur un par sukhad aashishon ki vrishti hogi.
Susangat pratyuttar honthon par kie gae chumban-jaisa sukhad hota hai.
Pahle apne baahy kaary purn karke khet ko taiyaar kar lo aur tab apna grih-nirmaan karo.
Bina kisi sangat ke kaaran apne parosi ke khilaaf saakshi na dena, aur na apni saakshi ke dvaara use jhutha pramaanit karna.
Yah kabhi na kahna, “Main uske saath vaisa hi karunga, jaisa usne mere saath kiya hai; usne mere saath jo kuchh kiya hai, main uska badla zarur lunga.”
Main us aalsi person ki vaatika ke paas se nikal raha tha, vah bewakoof person tha, jiski vah draakshaavaatika thi.
Mainne dekha ki sab vaatika mein, kantili jhaariyaan barh aai thin, saari zameen par bichchhu buti chha gai thi.
Yah sab dekh main soch karne laga, jo kuchh mainne dekha usse mujhe yah teaching receive hui:
Thori aur nind, thora aur vishraam, kuchh der aur haath par haath rakhe hue vishraam,
Tab dekhna nirdhanta kaise tujh par daaku ke jaisa tut parti hai aur garibi, sashastr aadmi ke jaisa.
Ye bhi raaja shalomon ke hi kuchh aur niti vaaky hain, jinhein Yahudiya raajy ke raaja hizkiyyaah ke logon ne taiyaar kiya hai:
God ki glory ismein hai ki vah kisi vishay ko gupt rakh dete hain; jabki raaja ki glory kisi vishay ki gahraai tak khojne mein hoti hai.
Jaise aakaash ki unchaai aur prithvi ki gahraai, usi tarah raajaaon ka dil bhi rahasymay hota hai.
Chaandi mein se khot dur kar do, to chaandikaar ke lie shuddh chaandi shesh rah jaati hai.
Raaja ke saamne se evil logon ko hata do, to raaj sinhaasan dharm mein pratishthit ho jaaega.
Na to raaja ke samaksh khud ko sammaany pramaanit karo, aur na hi kisi pratishthit person ka jagah lene ka koshish karo;
Kyonki uttam to yah hoga ki raaja hi tumhein aamantrit kar yah kahe, “Yahaan mere paas aao,” Iski apeksha ki tumhein sab ki nazar mein nimntar jagah par jaane ka order diya jaae.
Sirf isliye ki tumne kuchh dekh liya hai, mukadma chalaane ki utaavli na karna.
Vivaadaaspad vishay par sidha usi person se soch-vimarsh kar lo, aur kisi dusre person ka rahasy prakaashit na karna,
Kahin aisa na ho ki koi ise sun le, yah tumhaare hi lie lajja ka kaaran ho jaae aur tumhaari pratishtha sthaayi rup se barbaad ho jaae.
Uchit avsar par kaha hua vachan chaandi ke paatr mein prastut svarn ke seb ke jaisa hota hai.
Tatpar shrota ke lie jnaanvaan person ki chetaavni vaisi hi hoti hai jaise svarn karnphul ya svarn aabhushan.
Katni ke samay ki ushnta mein thande paani ke pey ke jaisa hota hai, preshak ke lie vah dut, jo faithful hai; vah apne maalik ke dil ko praphullit kar deta hai.
Baarish ke bina baadlon aur hava ki tarah hai jo person uphaar to deta nahin, lekin sabke samaksh dene ki ding maarta rahta hai.
Sabr ke dvaara shaasak ko bhi manaaya ja sakta hai, aur komalta mein kahe gae vachan se haddi ko bhi tora ja sakta hai.
Yadi tumhein kahin madhu receive ho jaae, to utna hi khaana, jitna paryaapt hai, sima se adhik khaaoge to, tum use ugal doge.
Uttam to yah hoga ki tumhaare parosi ke ghar mein tumhaare pair kam hi padein, aisa na ho ki vah tumse ub jaae aur tumse nafrat karne lage.
Vah person, jo apne parosi ke khilaaf jhutha saakshi ho jaata hai, vah yuddh ke lie prayukt laathi, talvaar ya baan ke jaisa hai.
Vipda ke avsar par aise person par bharosa rakhna, jis par faith nahin kiya ja sakta, vaisa hi hota hai, jaise sare daant ya tute pair par bharosa rakhna.
Duhkh mein dube person ke samaksh harsh git gaane ka vaisa hi prabhaav hota hai, jaisa shitkaal mein kisi ko vivastr kar dena ya kisi ke ghaavon par sirka mal dena.
Yadi tumhaara virodhi bhukha hai, use khaana karaao, yadi pyaasa hai, use pine ke lie paani do;
Isse tum uske sir par prajvlit koylon ka dher laga doge, aur tumhein Yahweh ki or se paaritoshik receive hoga.
Jaise uttri vaayu pravaah vrishti ka utpaadak hota hai, vaise hi pith pichhe par ninda karti jibh shighr krodhi mudra utpann karti hai.
Vivaadi patni ke saath ghar mein nivaas karne se kahin adhik shreshth hai chhat ke ek kone mein rah lena.
Dur desh se aaya shubh sandesh vaisa hi hota hai, jaisa pyaasi aatma ko diya gaya shital paani.
Vah righteous person, jo evil logon ke aage jhuk jaata hai, gandle sote aur dushit kuon-jaisa hota hai.
Madhu ka atydhik sevan kisi tarah laabhkar nahin hota, thik isi tarah apne lie sammaan se aur adhik sammaan ka yatn karna laabhkar nahin hota.
Vah person, jiska khud par koi niyantran nahin hai, vaisa hi hai, jaisa vah shehar, jiski suraksha ke lie koi divaar nahin hai.
Bewakoof ko sammaanit karna vaisa hi asangat hai, jaisa grishmaritu mein himpaat aur katni ke samay vrishti.
Nirdosh ko diya gaya shaap vaise hi prabhaavi nahin ho paata, jaise gaureya ka phudakna aur abaabil ki uraan.
Jaise ghore ke lie chaabuk aur gadhe ke lie lagaam, vaise hi bewakoof ki pith ke lie chhari nirdhaarit hai.
Bewakoof ko uski murkhta ke anurup uttar na do, kahin tum khud bewakoof siddh na ho jaao.
Bewakoofon ko unki murkhta ke upyukt uttar do, anytha ve apni nazar mein vidvaan ho jaaeinge.
Kisi bewakoof ke dvaara sandesh bhejna vaisa hi hota hai, jaisa apne hi pair par kulhaari maar lena ya vishpaan kar lena.
Bewakoof ke chehra dvaara nikla niti sutr vaisa hi hota hai, jaisa apang ke latakte nirjiv pair.
Kisi bewakoof ko sammaanit karna vaisa hi hoga, jaise patthar ko gophan mein baandh dena.
Bewakoof person dvaara kaha gaya nitivchan vaisa hi lagta hai, jaise madypi ke haathon mein chubha hua kaanta.
Jo anjaan bewakoof yaatri ya madonmatt person ko kaam par lagaata hai, vah us dhanurdhaari ke jaisa hai, jo bina kisi lakshy ke, logon ko ghaayal karta hai.
Apni murkhta ko dohraata hua person us kutte ke jaisa hai, jo baar-baar apne ulti ki or lautta hai.
Kya tumne kisi aise person ko dekha hai, jo khud ko wise samajhta hai? Uski apeksha ek bewakoof se kahin adhik apeksha sambhav hai.
Aalsi kahta hai, “Raasta mein sinh hai, sinh galiyon mein chhupa hua hai!”
Aalsi apne bichhaune par vaise hi karavtein badalte rahta hai, jaise chul par dvaar.
Aalsi apna haath khaana ki thaali mein daal to deta hai; lekin aalasyvash vah apna haath chehra tak nahin le jaata.
Apne soch mein aalsi un saat logon se adhik wise hota hai, jinmein susangat uttar dene ki kshamta hoti hai.
Raasta mein chalte hue aprichiton ke beech chal rahe vivaad mein hastakshep karte hue person ki situation vaisi hi hoti hai, maano usne vany kutte ko uske kaanon se pakar liya ho.
Us unmaadi sa jo mashaal uchhaalta hai ya insaan jo ghaatak tir pheinkta hai
Vaise hi vah bhi hota hai jo apne parosi ki chhalta hai aur kahta hai, “Main to bas aise hi majaak kar raha tha!”
Lakri samaapt hote hi aag bujh jaati hai; vaise hi jahaan kaanaaphusi nahin ki jaati, vahaan kalah bhi nahin hota.
Jaise prajvlit angaaron ke lie koyla aur agni ke lie lakri, vaise hi kalah utpann karne ke lie hota hai vivaadi pravritti ka person.
Phusphusaahat mein uchchaare gae word svaadisht khaana-jaisa hote hain; ye word insaan ke pet mein sama jaate hain.
Kutil dil ke person ke chikne-chupre word vaise hi hote hain, jaise mitti ke paatr par charhaai gai chaandi ka kit.
Ghrinaapurn dil ke person ke chehra se madhur vaaky tapakte rahte hain, jabki uske dil mein chhipa rahta hai chhal aur kapat.
Jab vah manbhaavan soch vyakt karne lage, to uska faith na karna, kyonki uske dil mein saat ghinauni baatein chhipi hui hain.
Yadypi is samay usne apne chhal ko chhupa rakha hai, uski kutilta ka prakaashan bhari sabha mein kar diya jaaega.
Jo koi gaddha khodta hai, usi mein ja girta hai; jo koi patthar ko lurhka deta hai, usi ke niche a jaata hai.
Jhuth bolne vaali jibh jisse baatein karti hai, vah uske nafrat ka paatr hota hai, aur vinaash ka kaaran hote hain chaaplus ke word.
Bhaavi kal tumhaare garv ka vishay na ho, kyonki tum yah nahin jaante ki din mein kya ghatnevaala hai.
Koi dusre tumhaari prashansa kare to kare, tum khud na karna; koi dusre koi aprichit tumhaari prashansa kare to kare, tum khud na karna, khud apne chehra se nahin.
Patthar bhaari hota hai aur ret ka bhi bojh hota hai, lekin in donon ki apeksha adhik bhaari hota hai bewakoof ka krodh.
Kop mein krurta nihit hoti hai aur rosh mein baarh ke jaisa ugrta, lekin irshya ke samaksh kaun thahar sakta hai?
Chhipe love se kahin adhik prabhaavshaali hai pratyaksh rup se di gai phatkaar.
Mitr dvaara kie gae ghaav bhi faithful hai, lekin virodhi chumbnon ki varsha karta hai!
Jab bhukh achchhi riti se tript ki ja chuki hai, tab madhu bhi apriy lagne lagta hai, lekin bahut bhukhe person ke lie karva khaana bhi mitha ho jaata hai.
