Apne ghar se dur chala gaya person vaisa hi hota hai jaise apne ghonsle se bhatak chuka pakshi.
Tel aur sugandh dravy dil ko manohar kar dete hain, usi tarah sukhad hota hai khare mitr ka paraamarsh.

Apne mitr aur apne maata-pita ke mitr ki upeksha na karna. Apni vipatti ki situation mein apne bhaai ke ghar bheint karne na jaana. Dur desh mein ja base tumhaare bhaai se uttam hai tumhaare nikat nivaas kar raha parosi.
Mere son, kaisa manohar hoga mera dil, jab tum khud ko wise pramaanit karoge; tab main apne nindkon ko munh tor pratyuttar de sakunga.
Chatur person jokhim ko dekhkar chhip jaata hai, lekin ajnaani aage hi barhta jaata hai, aur yaatna sahta hai.
Jo kisi anjaan ke rin ki zamaanat deta hai, vah apne kapde tak ganva baithta hai; jab koi anjaan logon ki zamaanat lene lage, tab pratibhuti suraksha mein uska kapde bhi rakh le.
Yadi kisi person ko praatahkaal mein apne parosi ko uchch svar mein aashirvaad deta hua suno, to use shaap samajhna.
Vivaadi patni aur varsha ritu mein lagaataar vrishti, donon hi jaisa hain,
Use niyantrit karne ka koshish pavan veg ko niyantrit karne ka koshish jaisa, ya apne daayein haath se tel ko pakarne ka koshish jaisa.
Jis tarah lohe se hi lohe par dhaar banaaya jaata hai, vaise hi ek person dusre ke sudhaar ke lie hote hai.
Anjir ka phal vahi khaata hai, jo us vriksh ki dekhbhaal karta hai, vah, jo apne maalik ka dhyaan rakhta hai, sammaanit kiya jaaega.
Jis tarah paani mein mukhmandal ki chhaaya dekh sakte hain, vaise hi person ka life bhi dil ko pratibimbit karta hai.
Maut aur vinaash ab tak santusht nahin hue hain, insaan ki aankhon ki abhilaasha bhi kabhi santusht nahin hoti.
Chaandi ki parakh kuthaali se aur svarn ki bhatti se hoti hai, vaise hi insaan ki parakh uski prashansa se ki jaati hai.
Yadi tum bewakoof ko okhli mein daalkar musal se anaaj ke jaisa bhi kuto, tum usse uski murkhta ko alag na kar sakoge.
Anivaary hai ki tumhein apne pashuon ki situation ka yathochit knowledge ho, apne pashuon ka dhyaan rakho;
Kyonki, na to wealth-property chirkaalin hoti hai, aur na yah kaha ja sakta hai ki raajpaat aagaami sabhi pirhiyon ke lie sunishchit ho gaya.
Jab sukhi ghaas ekatr ki ja chuki ho aur nai ghaas ankurit ho rahi ho, jab parvton se jari-buti ekatr ki jaati hai,
Tab memnon se tumhaare kapdon ki aavashyakta ki purti hogi, aur tum bakriyon ke muly se khet mol le sakoge,
Bakriyon ke dudh itna bharpur hoga ki vah tumhaare sampurn parivaar ke lie paryaapt khaana rahega; tumhaari sevikaaon ki zarurat bhi purn hoti rahegi.
Jab koi pichha nahin bhi kar raha hota, tab bhi durjan person bhaagta rahta hai, lekin righteous vaise hi nidar hote hain, jaise sinh.
Raashtr mein araajakta phailne par kai shaasak uth khare hote hain, lekin wise shaasak ke shaasan mein sthaayi suvyvastha bani rahti hai.
Vah shaasak, jo nirdhnon ko utpirit karta hai, aisi ghanghor vrishti-jaisa hai, jo sab upaj ko barbaad kar jaati hai.
Law ko nahin maanne vaala person durjnon ki prashansa karte nahin thakte, lekin ve, jo saamaajik suvyvastha ka nirvaah karte hain, aison ka pratirodh karte hain.
Evil log justice ka muly nahin samajh sakte, lekin Yahweh ke abhilaashi ise uttam riti se pahchaante hain.
Kharaai ka chalnevaala nirdhan us dhani se kahin uttam hai jiski lifestyle kutil hai.
Niymon ka follow karta hai wise children, lekin petu ka saathi apne pita ko lajja laata hai.
Jo koi apni property ki vriddhi atishay byaaj lekar karta hai, vah ise us person ke lie sanchit kar raha hota hai, jo nirdhnon ko udaartaapurvak deta rahta hai.
Jo person niyam-law ka parityaag karta hai, uski prayer bhi God ke lie ghrinit ho jaati hai.
Jo koi kisi righteous ko bhatka kar visangat chaalachlan ke lie uksaata hai vah apne hi jaal mein phans jaaega, lekin khare person ka pratiphal sukhad hota hai.
Apne hi soch mein dhanaadhy khud ko wise maanta hai; jo garib aur samajhdaar hai, vah dekhta hai ki dhanvaan kitna bhramit hai.
Righteous person ki vijay par atishay khushi manaaya jaata hai; lekin jab evil unnat hone lagte hain, people chhip jaati hai.
Jo apne apraadh ko chhipaae rakhta hai, vah samriddh nahin ho paata, lekin vah, jo apraadh accept kar unka parityaag kar deta hai, us par grace ki jaaegi.
Blessed hota hai vah person jiske dil mein Yahweh ke prati shraddha hamesha rahti hai, lekin jo apne dil ko kathor banaae rakhta hai, vipda mein ja parta hai.
Nirdhnon ke prati evil shaasak ka vyavhaar vaisa hi hota hai jaisa dahaarte hue sinh ya aakraamak richh ka.
Ek shaasak jo samajhdaar nahin, apni people ko utpirit karta hai, lekin vah, jise anuchit apriy hai, aayushmaan hota hai.
Yadi kisi ki antraatma par insaan murder ka bojh hai vah mrityuparyant chhipta aur bhaagta rahega; yah upyukt nahin ki koi uski madad kare.
Jiska chaalachlan kharaaipurn hai, vah vipattiyon se bacha rahega, lekin jiske chaalachlan mein kutilta hai, shighr hi patan ke gart mein ja girega.
Jo kisaan apni zameen ki jutaai-guraai karta rahta hai, use khaana ka abhaav nahin hota, lekin jo vyarth kaaryon mein samay barbaad karta hai, nirbuddhi pramaanit hota hai.
Khare person ko prachurta mein aashishein receive hoti rahti hai, lekin jo shighr hi dhanaadhy hone ki dhun mein rahta hai, vah dand se bach na sakega.
Pakshpaat bhayaavah hota hai. Phir bhi yah sambhav hai ki insaan sirf roti ke ek tukre ko receive karne ke lie apraadh kar baithe.
Kanjus person ko dhanaadhy ho jaane ki utaavli hoti hai, jabki unhein yah andesha hi nahin hota, ki uska nirdhan hona nirdhaarit hai.
Antath kripaapaatr vahi ban jaaega, jo kisi ko kisi bhul ke lie daantta hai, vah nahin, jo chaaplusi karta rahta hai.
Jo apne maata-pita se property chhinkar yah kahta hai, “Ismein mainne kuchh bhi anuchit nahin kiya hai,” Luteron ka sahyogi hota hai.
Lobhi person kalah utpann kara deta hai, lekin samriddh vah ho jaata hai, jisne Yahweh par bharosa rakha hai.
Bewakoof hota hai vah, jo sirf apni hi samajh par bharosa rakhta hai, lekin surakshit vah bana rahta hai, jo apne nirnay vidvatta mein leta hai.
Jo nirdhnon ko udaartaapurvak daan deta hai, use abhaav kabhi nahin hota, lekin vah, jo daan karne se katraata hai kai or se shaapit ho jaata hai.
Evil logon ka utthaan logon ko chhipne ke lie vivash kar deta hai; lekin evil barbaad ho jaate hain, khare ki vriddhi hone lagti hai.
Vah, jise baar-baar daant parti rahti hai, phir bhi apna hath nahin chhorta, us par vinaash achaanak rup se tut parega aur vah punh uth na sakega.
Jab khare ki sankhya mein vriddhi hoti hai, logon mein harsh ki lahar daur jaati hai; lekin jab evil shaasan karne lagte hain, tab people karaahne lagti hai.
Samajh se love karnevaala son apne pita ke harsh ka vishay hota hai, lekin jo veshyaaon mein sanlipt rahta hai vah apni property uraata jaata hai.
Nyaayyta par hi raaja apne raashtr ka nirmaan karta hai, lekin vah, jo janta ko karo ke bojh se daba deta hai, raashtr ke vinaash ko aamantrit karta hai.
Jo apne parosiyon ki chaaplusi karta hai, vah apne parosi ke pairon ke lie jaal bichha raha hota hai.
Evil apne hi apraadhon mein uljha rahta hai, lekin righteous sadaiv ullsit ho git gaata rahta hai.
Righteous ko sadaiv nirdhan ke adhikaaron ka bodh rahta hai, lekin evil ko is vishay ka knowledge hi nahin hota.
Thattha karnevaale shehar ko agni lagaate hain, lekin wise hi kop ko shaant karte hain.
Yadi wise person kisi bewakoof ko nyaayaalay le jaata hai, to vivaad na to shighr krodhi hone se sulajhta hai na hi hansi mein ura dene se.
Khun ke pyaase hinsak person kharaai se nafrat karte hain, ve righteous ke praanon ke pyaase ho jaate hain.
Krodh mein bewakoof person aniyantrit ho jaata hai, lekin wise sanyampurvak shaant bana rahta hai.
Yadi shaasak asaty ko sunne lagta hai, uske sabhi mantri kutil ban jaate hain.
Atyaachaari aur nirdhan person mein ek saamy zarur hai: donon hi ko Yahweh ne nazar provide ki hai.
Yadi raaja purn kharaai mein nirdhan ka justice karta hai, uska sinhaasan sthaayi rahta hai.
Evil logon ki sankhya mein vriddhi apraadh dar mein vriddhi karti hai, lekin righteous unke patan ke darshak hote hain.
Apne son ko anushaasan mein rakho ki tumhaara bhavishy sukhad ho; vahi tumhaare dil ko aanandit rakhega.
Bhavishy ke darshan ke abhaav mein log pratibandh tor pheinkte hain; lekin blessed hota hai vah, jo niymon ka follow karta hai.
Servants ke anushaasan ke lie sirf word nirdesh paryaapt nahin hota; ve ise samajh zarur leinge, lekin iska follow nahin kareinge.
Ek bewakoof person se us person ki apeksha adhik ummid ki ja sakti hai, jo bina soch apna mat de deta hai.
Yadi servant ko baalykaal se hi jo bhi chaahe diya jaae, to antath vah ghamandi ho jaaega.
Shighr krodhi person kalah karnevaala hota hai, aur aniyantrit krodh ka slave kai apraadh kar baithta hai.
Ahankaar hi person ke patan ka kaaran hota hai, lekin vah, jo aatma mein vinamr hai, sammaanit kiya jaata hai.
Jo chor ka saath deta hai, vah apne hi praanon ka dushman hota hai; vah nyaayaalay mein sabke dvaara shaapit kiya jaata hai, lekin phir bhi saty reveal nahin kar sakta.
Logon se bhaybhit hona uljhan pramaanit hota hai, lekin jo koi Yahweh par bharosa rakhta hai, surakshit rahta hai.
Shaasak ke dear paatr sabhi banna chaahte hain, lekin vaastvik justice Yahweh ke dvaara nishpann hota hai.
Anyaayi khare ke lie tuchchh hote hain; lekin vah, jiska chaalachlan khara hai, evil logon ke lie tuchchh hota hai.
Yaakeh ke son aagur ka vaktavy—ek prakaashan ithiel ke lie. Is insaan ki ghoshna—ithiel aur ukaal ke lie:
Nihsandeh, main insaan nahin, jaanvar jaisa hun; insaan ke jaisa samajhne ki kshamta bhi kho chuka hun.
Na to main knowledge receive kar saka hun, aur na hi mujhmein maha holy God ko samajhne ki koi kshamta shesh rah gai hai.

Kaun hai, jo heaven mein charhkar phir utar aaya hai? Kisne vaayu ko apni mutthi mein ekatr kar rakha hai? Kisne mahaasaagar ko kapde mein baandhkar rakha hai? Kisne prithvi ki simaaein sthaapit kar di hain? Kya hai unka naam aur kya hai unke son ka naam? Yadi aap jaante hain! To mujhe bata dijie.
“God ka har ek vachan praamaanik aur saty hai; vahi unke lie dhaal jaisa hain jo unmein aashray lete hain.
Unke vaktavy mein kuchh bhi na jora jaae aisa na ho ki tumhein unki phatkaar sunni pare aur tum jhuth pramaanit ho jaao.
“Apni maut ke purv main aapse do aagrah kar raha hun; mujhe inse vanchit na kijie.
Mujhse vah sab bahut dur kar dijie, jo jhuth hai, asaty hai; na to mujhe nirdhanta mein daalie aur na mujhe wealth dijie, sirf mujhe utna hi khaana provide kijie, jitna zaruri hai.

Aisa na ho ki sampannta mein main aapka tyaag hi kar dun aur kahne lagun, ‘Kaun hai yah Yahweh?’ Ya aisa na ho ki nirdhanta ki situation mein main chori karne ke lie baadhy ho jaaun, aur mere God ke naam ko kalankit kar baithun.
“Kisi servant ke khilaaf uske maalik ke kaan na bharna, aisa na ho ki vah servant tumhein shaap de aur tumhin doshi paae jaao.
“Ek pirhi aisi hai, jo apne hi pita ko shaap deti hai, aur unke chehra se unki maata ke lie koi bhi blessed udgaar nahin nikalte;
Kuchh ki nazar mein unka apna chaalachlan shuddh hota hai lekin vastuth unki apni hi malinta se ve dhule hue nahin hote hai;
Ek aur samuh aisa hai, aankhein garv se charhi hui aur unnat bhaunhein;
Kuchh ve hain, jinke daant talvaar jaisa aur jabra chaaku jaisa hain, ki prithvi se utpiriton ko aur nirdhnon ko insaanon ke beech mein se lekar nigal jaaein.
“Jonk ki do betiyaan hain. Jo chillaakar kahti hain, ‘Aur do! Aur do!’ “Tin vastuein asantusht hi rahti hai, vastuth chaar kabhi nahin kahti, ‘Ab bas karo!’:
Adholok aur baanjh ki kokh; zameen, jo paani se kabhi tript nahin hoti, aur agni, jo kabhi nahin kahti, ‘Bas!’
“Vah netr, jo apne pita ka anaadar karte hain, aur jiske lie maata ka aajnaapaalan ghrinaaspad hai, ghaati ke kauvon dvaara noch-noch kar nikaal liya jaaega, aur giddhon ka aahaar ho jaaega.
“Tin vastuein mere lie bahut vismaykaari hain, vastuth chaar, jo meri samajh se sarvtha pare hain:
Aakaash mein garur ki uraan, chattaan par sarp ka reingna, mahaasaagar par jalyaan ka aage barhna, aur aadmi aur aurat ka paarasprik sambandh.
“Vyabhichaarini aurat ki chaal yah hoti hai: sambhog ke baad vah kahti hai, ‘Kya visangat kiya hai mainne.’ Maano usne khaana karke apna chehra ponchh liya ho.
“Tin paristhitiyaan aisi hain, jinmein prithvi tak kaamp uthti hai; vastuth chaar ise ashaay hain:
Slave ka raaja ban jaana, bewakoof person ka chhak kar khaana karna,
Purnath ghinauni aurat ka vivaah ho jaana aur daasi ka svaamini ka jagah le lena.
“Prithvi par chaar praani aise hain, jo aakaar mein to chhote hain, lekin hain bahut wise:
Chitiyon ki ganna sashakt praaniyon mein nahin ki jaati, phir bhi unki khaana ki chaahat grishmkaal mein bhi samaapt nahin hoti;
Chattaanon ke nivaasi bijju sashakt praani nahin hote, lekin ve apna aashray chattaanon mein bana lete hain;
Arbeh tiddiyon ka koi shaasak nahin hota, phir bhi ve sainy dal ke jaisa panktiyon mein aage barhti hain;
Chhipakli, jo haath se pakre jaane yogy laghu praani hai, lekin iska pravesh raajmahlon tak mein hota hai.
“Tin hain, jinke chalne ki shaili bahut bhavy hai, chaar ki gati bahut prabhaavshaali hai:
Sinh, jo sabhi praaniyon mein sabse adhik shaktimaan hai, vah kisi ke kaaran pichhe nahin hatta;
Garvili chaal chalta hua murg, bakra, aur apni sena ke saath aage barhta hua raaja.
“Yadi tum aatmaprshansa ki murkhta kar baithe ho, ya tumne koi sharyantr garha hai, to apna haath apne chehra par rakh lo!
Jis tarah dudh ke manthan se makkhan taiyaar hota hai, aur naak par ghunse ke prahaar se rakt nikalta hai, usi tarah krodh ko bharkaane se kalah utpann hota hai.”
Ye raaja lamuel dvaara prastut niti sutr hain, jinki teaching unhein unki maata dvaara di gai thi.
Sun, mere son! Sun, mere hi garbh se janme son! Sun, meri praarthnaaon ke pratyuttar son!
Apna paurush auraton par vyay na karna aur na apne sansaadhan un par lutaana, jinhonne raajaaon tak ke avpaat mein yog diya hai.
Lamuel, yah raajaaon ke lie kadaapi upyukt nahin hai, daakhamdhu raajaaon ke lie susangat nahin hai, shaaskon ke lie maadak dravypaan bhala nahin hota.
Aisa na ho ki ve pikar law ko bhul jaaein, aur din daliton se unke authority chhin lein.
Maadak dravy unhein do, jo marne par hain, daakhamdhu unhein do, jo ghor man mein udaas hain!
Ve piein aur apni nirdhanta ko bhul jaaein aur unhein unki durdsha ka smaran na aaein.
Unke paksh mein khare hokar unke lie justice prastut karo, jo apna paksh prastut karne mein asmarth hain.
Nidartaapurvak justice prastut karo aur bina pakshpaat justice do; nirdhnon aur nirdhnon ke adhikaaron ki raksha karo.
Kise uplabdh hoti hai utkrisht, gunsampann patni? Uska muly ratnon se kahin adhik barhkar hai.
Uska pati us par purn bharosa karta hai aur uske kaaran uske pati ka muly aprimit hota hai.
Vah aajivan apne pati ka hit hi karti hai, bura kabhi nahin.
Vah khoj kar un aur patsan le aati hai aur hastkaary mein uski gahri ruchi hai.
Vyaapaarik jalyaanon ke jaisa, vah dur-dur jaakar bhojy vastuon ka prabandh karti hai.
Raatri samaapt bhi nahin hoti, ki vah uth jaati hai; aur apne parivaar ke lie khaana ka prabandh karti aur apni parichaarikaaon ko unke kaam sambandhi nirdesh deti hai.
Vah jaakar kisi bhukhand ko parakhti hai aur use mol le leti hai; vah apne arjit wealth se draakshaavaatika ka ropan karti hai.
Vah kamar kaskar tatpartaapurvak kaary mein jut jaati hai; aur uski baahein sashakt rahti hain.
Use yah bodh rahta hai ki uska laabhaansh uncha rahe, raatri mein bhi uski samriddhi ka dip bujhne nahin paata.
Vah charkhe par kaary karne ke lie baithti hai aur uske haath takli par chalne lagte hain.
Uske haath nirdhnon ki or barhte hain aur vah nirdhnon ki madad karti hai.
Shitkaal ka aagman uske parivaar ke lie chinta ka vishay nahin hota; kyonki uske sab parivaar ke lie paryaapt uni kapde taiyaar rahte hain.
Vah apne lie baahy uni kapde bhi taiyaar rakhti hai; uske sabhi kapde utkrisht aur bhavy hi hote hain.
Jab raajy parishad ka satr hota hai, tab pramukhon mein uska pati bahut pratishthit maana jaata hai.
Vah patsan ke kapde bunkar unka vikray kar deti hai, aur vyaapaariyon ko dupatte bechti hai.
Vah power aur sammaan dhaaran kie hue hai; bhavishy ki ummid mein uska ullaas hai.
Uske chehra se vidvattaapurn vachan hi bole jaate hain, uske vachan grace-apostle hote hain.
Vah apne parivaar ki gatividhi par niyantran rakhti hai aur aalasy ka khaana uski charya mein hai hi nahin.
Praatahkaal uthkar uske baalak uski prashansa karte hain; uska pati in words mein uski prashansa karte nahin thakta:
“Kai auraton ne utkrisht kaary kie hain, lekin tum un sabse utkrisht ho.”
Aakarshan ek jhuth hai aur saundary drut gati se ur jaata hai; lekin jis aurat mein Yahweh ke prati shraddha vidymaan hai, vah prashansniy rahegi.
Uske parishram ka shrey use diya jaae, aur uske kaary shehar mein ghoshit kie jaaein.
David ke son, Yerushalem mein raaja, daarshnik ke vachan:
“Bekaar hi bekaar!” Daarshnik ka kahna hai. “Bekaar hi bekaar! Bekaar hai sab kuchh.”
Suraj ke niche insaan dvaara kie gae kaamon se use kya milta hai?
Ek pirhi khatm hoti hai aur dusri aati hai, magar prithvi hamesha bani rahti hai.
Suraj ugta hai, suraj dubta hai, aur bina der kie apne nikalne ki jagah par pahunch dobaara ugta hai.
Dakshin ki or bahti hui hava uttar disha mein murkar nirantar ghumte hue apne ghere mein laut aati hai.
Haalaanki saari nadiyaan saagar mein mil jaati hain, magar isse saagar bhar nahin jaata. Nadiyaan dobaara usi jagah par bahne lagti hain, jahaan ve bah rahi thin.
Itna thakaane vaala hai sabhi kuchh, ki insaan ke lie iska varnan sambhav nahin. Aankhein dekhne se tript nahin hotin, aur na kaan sunne se santusht.
Jo ho chuka hai, vahi hai jo dobaara hoga, aur jo kiya ja chuka hai, vahi hai jo dobaara kiya jaaega; isliye dharti par naya kuchh bhi nahin.
Kya kuchh aisa hai jiske baare mein koi yah kah sake, “Ise dekho! Yah hai naya?” Yah to hamse pahle ke yugon se hota a raha hai.
Kuchh yaad nahin ki pahle kya hua, aur na yah ki jo honevaala hai. Aur na hi unke lie koi yaad bachi rah jaaegi jo unke bhi baad aanevaale hain.
Main, daarshnik, Yerushalem mein Israel ka raaja raha hun.

Dharti par jo saare kaam kie jaate hain, mainne samajh dvaara un sabhi kaamon ke jaanchne aur adhyyan karne mein apna man lagaaya. Yah bare duhkh ka kaam hai, jise God ne insaan ke lie isliye thahraaya hai ki vah ismein uljha rahe!
Mainne in sabhi kaamon ko jo is dharti par kie jaate hain, dekha hai, aur mainne yahi paaya ki yah bekaar aur hava se jhagarna hai.
Jo terha hai, use sidha nahin kiya ja sakta; aur jo hai hi nahin, uski ginti kaise ho sakti hai.
“Main soch raha tha, Yerushalem mein mujhse pahle jitne bhi raaja hue hain, mainne un sabse jyaada samajh paai hai aur unnti ki hai; mainne samajh aur knowledge ke wealth ka anubhav kiya hai.”
Mainne apna dil samajh ko aur baavlepan aur murkhta ko jaanne mein lagaaya, lekin mujhe ahsaas hua ki yah bhi hava se jhagarna hi hai.
Kyonki jyaada samajh mein bahut duhkh hota hai; knowledge barhaane se dard bhi barhta hai.
Mainne apne aapse kaha, “Chalo, main khushi ke dvaara tumhein parkhunga.” Isliye aanandit aur magan ho jaao. Magar mainne yahi paaya ki yah bhi bekaar hi hai.
Mainne hansi ke baare mein kaha, “Yah baavlaapan hai” Aur khushi ke baare mein, “Isse kya mila?”

Jab mera man yah soch raha tha ki kis tarah meri samajh bani rahe, mainne apne pure man se iske baare mein khoj kar daali ki kis tarah daakhamdhu se body ko bahlaaya ja sakta hai aur kis tarah murkhta ko kaabu mein kiya ja sakta hai, ki main yah samajh sakun ki prithvi par insaanon ke lie unke chhote se life mein kya karna achchha hai.
Mainne apne kaamon ko barhaaya: mainne apne lie gharon ko banaaya, mainne apne lie angur ke bagiche lagaae.
Mainne bagiche aur phalon ke baagon ko banaaya aur unmein sab tarah ke phalon ke per lagaae.
Vanon mein sinchaai ke lie mainne taalaab banvaae taaki usse per barh sakein.
Mainne slave-daasi kharidein jinki mere yahaan hi santaanein bhi paida huin. Main bahut se gaay-bailon ka maalik ho gaya. Jo mujhse pahle the unse kahin adhik mere gaay-bail the.
Mainne apne aapke lie sone, chaandi aur raajyon va raajaaon se wealth ikattha kiya, gaayak-gaayikaaein chun lie aur uppatniyaan bhi rakhin jisse aadmiyon ko sukh milta hai.
Main Yerushalem mein apne se pahle vaalon se bahut adhik mahaan ho gaya. Meri samajh ne hamesha hi mera saath diya.

Meri aankhon ne jis kisi chiz ki chaahat ki; mainne unhein usse dur na rakha aur na apne man ko kisi khushi se; kyonki meri uplabdhiyon mein meri santushti thi, aur yahi tha mere parishram ka puruskaar.
Isliye mainne apne dvaara kie gae sabhi kaamon ko, aur apne dvaara ki gai mehnat ko naapa, aur yahi paaya ki yah sab bhi bekaar aur hava se jhagarna tha; aur dharti par iska koi phaayda nahin.
So mainne samajh, baavlepan aur murkhta ke baare mein soch kiya. Raaja ke baad aanevaala iske alaava aur kya kar sakta hai? Keval vah jo pahle se hota aaya hai.
Mainne yah dekh liya ki samajh murkhta se behtar hai, jaise roshni andhera se.
Wise apne man ki aankhon se vyavhaar karta hai, jabki bewakoof andhera mein chalta hai. Yah sab hone par bhi main jaanta hun ki donon ka antim parinaam ek hi hai.
Mainne man mein soch kiya, jo dasha bewakoof ki hai vahi meri bhi hogi. To main adhik wise kyon raha? “Mainne khud ko yaad dilaaya, yah bhi bekaar hi hai.”
Wise ko hamesha yaad nahin kiya jaaega jaise bewakoof ko; kuchh dinon mein hi ve bhula die jaaeinge. Wise ki maut kaise hoti hai? Bewakoof ke jaisa hi na!
Isliye mujhe life se nafrat ho gai kyonki dharti par jo kuchh kiya gaya tha vah mere lie taklif denevaala tha; kyonki sab kuchh bekaar aur hava se jhagarna tha.
Isliye mainne jo bhi mehnat is dharti par ki thi usse mujhe nafrat ho gai, kyonki ise mujhe apne baad aanevaale ke lie chhorna parega.
Aur yah kise maalum hai ki vah wise hoga ya bewakoof. Magar vah un sabhi vastuon ka adhikaari ban jaaega jinke lie mainne dharti par buddhimaani se mehnat ki. Yah bhi bekaar hi hai.
Isliye dharti par mere dvaara ki gai mehnat ke pratiphal se mujhe ghor niraasha ho gai.

Kabhi ek person samajh, knowledge aur kushalta ke saath mehnat karta hai aur use har ek vastu us person ke khushi ke lie tyaagni parti hai jisne uske lie mehnat hi nahin ki. Yah bhi bekaar aur bahut bura hai.
Insaan ko apni saari mehnat aur kaamon se, jo vah dharti par karta hai, kya milta hai?
Vaastav mein saare life mein uski puri mehnat duhkhon aur kashton se bhari hoti hai; yahaan tak ki raat mein bhi uske man ko aur dimaag ko aaraam nahin mil paata. Yah bhi bekaar hi hai.
Insaan ke lie isse achchha aur kuchh nahin hai ki vah khaae, pie aur khud ko faith dilaae ki uski mehnat upyogi hai. Mainne yah bhi paaya hai ki ismein God ka yogdaan hota hai,
Nahin to kaun God se alag ho kha-pikar sukhi rah sakta hai?

Kyonki jo insaan God ki nazron mein achchha hai, use God ne samajh, knowledge aur khushi diya hai, magar galti karnevaala ko God ne ikattha karne aur batorne ka kaam diya hai sirph isliye ki vah us person ko de de jo God ki nazron mein achchha hai. Yah sab bhi bekaar aur hava se jhagarna hai.
Har ek kaam ke lie ek tay samay hai, aur dharti par har ek kaam karne ka ek samay hota hai:
Janm ka samay aur maut ka samay; bone ka samay aur boe hue ko ukhaarne ka samay.
Maar daalne ka samay aur svasth karne ka samay; giraane ka samay aur banaane ka samay;
Rone ka samay aur hansne ka samay; shok karne ka samay aur naachne ka samay.
Patthar pheinkne ka samay aur patthar ikattha karne ka samay; gale lagaane ka samay aur gale na lagaane ka samay.
Khojne ka samay aur chhor dene ka samay; bachaakar rakhne ka samay aur pheink dene ka samay.
Phaarne ka samay aur sine ka samay; chup rahne ka samay aur bolne ka samay.
Love ka samay aur naphrat ka samay; yuddh ka samay aur shaanti ka samay.
Mehnat karnevaale ko usse kya laabh jiske lie vah mehnat karta hai?
Insaan ko vyast rakhne ke lie God dvaara thahraae gae kaamon ka anubhav mainne kiya hai.
Unhonne har ek vastu ko uske lie sahi samay mein hi banaaya hai. Unhonne insaan ke dil mein anant kaal ka ahsaas jagaaya, phir bhi insaan nahin samajh paata ki God ne shuru se ant tak kya kiya hai.
Main jaanta hun ki insaan ke lie isse sahi aur kuchh nahin ki vah life mein khush rahe aur dusron ke saath bhalaai karne mein laga rahe.
Har ek person khaate-pite apni mehnat ke kaamon mein santusht rahe—yah insaan ke lie God dvaara diya gaya vardaan hai.

Mujhe maalum hai ki God dvaara kiya gaya-har-ek kaam hamesha bana rahega; aisa kuchh bhi nahin ki ismein jora nahin ja sakta ya isse alag kiya ja sake. God ne aisa isliye kiya hai ki log unke saamne shraddha aur dar mein rahein.
Vah jo hai, pahle hi ho chuka aur vah bhi jo hone par hai, pahle hi ho chuka; kyonki God biti hui baaton ko phir se dohraate hain.
Iske alaava mainne dharti par yah bhi dekha ki: justice ki jagah dushtta hai, aur achchhaai ki jagah mein bhi dushtta hi hoti hai.
Mainne socha, “God righteous aur evil donon ka hi justice kareinge, kyonki har ek kaam aur har ek shuru ka ek samay tay hai.”
Insaanon ke baare mein mainne socha, “God nishchit hi unko parakhte hain ki insaan yah samajh lein ki ve pashu ke alaava aur kuchh nahin.
Kyonki insaan aur pashu ka ant ek hi hai: jaise ek ki maut hoti hai vaise dusre ki bhi. Unki saans ek jaisi hai; insaan pashu se kisi bhi tarah se behtar nahin, kyonki sab kuchh bekaar hai.
Sab ki manzil ek hai. Sabhi mitti se bane hain aur mitti mein mil bhi jaate hain.
Kise maalum hai ki insaan ke jaan upri lok mein jaate hain aur pashu ke jaan paataal mein?”

Mainne yah paaya ki insaan ke lie isse behtar kuchh nahin hai ki vah apne kaamon mein santusht rahe, yahi hai uski manzil. Use kaun is situation mein la sakta hai ki vah dekh paae ki kya hoga uske baad?

Dharti par kie ja rahe atyaachaar ko dekhkar mainne dobaara socha: mainne atyaachaar sahne vaale logon ke aansuon ko dekha aur yah bhi ki unhein shaanti dene ke lie koi bhi nahin hai; atyaachaariyon ke paas to unka authority tha, magar atyaachaar sahne vaalon ke paas shaanti dene ke lie koi bhi na tha.
So mainne jiviton ki tulna mein, mare huon ko, jinki maut ho chuki hai, adhik saraaha ki ve adhik khush hain.
Magar in donon se behtar to vah hai jo kabhi aaya hi nahin aur jisne is dharti par kie ja rahe kukarmon ko dekha hi nahin.
Mainne yah bhi paaya ki saari mehnat aur saari kushalta insaan aur uske parosi ke bich jalan ke kaaran hai. Yah bhi bekaar aur hava se jhagarna hai.
Bewakoof apne haath par haath rakhe baitha rahta hai, aur khud ko barbaad karta hai.
Do mutthi bhar mehnat aur hava se sangharsh ki bajaay behtar hai jo kuchh mutthi bhar tumhaare paas hai usmein aaraam ke saath santusht rahna.
Tab mainne dharti par dobaara bekaar ki baat dekhi:

Ek person jiska koi nahin hai; na son, na bhaai. Uski mehnat ka koi ant nahin. Vah paryaapt wealth kama nahin paata, phir bhi vah yah savaal kabhi nahin karta, “Main apne aapko sukh se dur rakhkar yah sab kiske lie kar raha hun?” Yah bhi bekaar, aur duhkh bhari situation hai!
Ek se behtar hain do, kyonki unhein mehnat ka behtar pratiphal milta hai:
Yadi unmein se ek gir bhi jaae, to dusra apne mitr ko utha lega, magar shok hai us person ke lie jo girta hai aur use uthaane ke lie koi dusra nahin hota.
Agar do person saath saath sote hain to ve ek dusre ko garm rakhte hain. Magar akela person apne aapko kaise garm rakh sakta hai?
Akele person par to haavi hona sambhav hai, magar do person uska saamna kar sakte hain: tin doriyon se bani rassi ko aasaani se nahin tora ja sakta.
Ek garib magar wise naujvaan ek nirbuddhi burhe raaja se behtar hai, jise yah samajh nahin raha ki salaah kaise li jaae.
Vah bandigrih se sinhaasan par ja baitha haalaanki vah apne raajy mein garib hi janma tha.
Mainne dharti par ghumte hue sabhi praaniyon ko us dusre naujvaan ki or jaate dekha, jo pahle vaalon ki jagah lega.
Anginat the ve log jinka vah raaja tha. Phir bhi jo inke baad aaeinge usse khush na honge. Nishchit hi yah bhi bekaar aur hava se jhagarna hai.

God ke bhavan mein jaane par apne vyavhaar ke prati saavdhaan rahna aur bewakoofon ke jaisa bali bheint karne se behtar hai God ke paas aana. Bewakoof to yah jaante hi nahin ki ve kya galat kar rahe hain.
Apni kisi baat mein utaavli na karna, na hi God ke saamne kisi baat ko rakhne mein jaldbaaji karna, kyonki God heaven mein hain aur tum prithvi par ho, isliye apne words ko thora hi rakhna.
Svapn kisi kaam mein bahut adhik lin hone ke kaaran aata hai, aur bewakoof apne bak-bak karne ki aadat se pahchaana jaata hai.
Yadi tumne God se koi mannat maani to use pura karne mein der na karna; kyonki God bewakoof se prasann nahin hote; puri karo apni mannat.
Mannat maankar use puri na karne se kahin adhik achchha hai ki tum mannat hi na maano.

Tumhaari baatein tumhaare galti ka kaaran na hon. God ke angel ke saamne tumhein yah na kahna pare, “Mujhse galti hui.” God kahin tumhaari baaton ke kaaran krodhit na hon aur tumhaare kaamon ko barbaadi kar daalein.
Kyonki svapnon ki adhikta aur bak-bak karne mein khokhlaapan hota hai, islie tum God ke prati dar banaae rakho.
Agar tum apne kshetr mein garib par atyaachaar aur use justice aur dharm se dur hote dekho; to hairaan na hona kyonki ek adhikaari dusre adhikaari ke upar hota hai aur un par bhi ek bara adhikaari.
Vaastav mein jo raaja kheti ko barhaava deta hai, vah saare raajy ke lie vardaan saabit hota hai.
Jo wealth se love rakhta hai, vah kabhi wealth se santusht na hoga; aur na hi vah jo bahut wealth se love karta hai. Yah bhi bekaar hi hai.
Jab achchhi vastuein barhti hain, to ve bhi barhte hain, jo unko istemaal karte hain. Unke maalik ko unse kya laabh? Sivaay iske ki vah inhein dekhkar santusht ho sake.
Mehnat karnevaale ke lie nind mithi hoti hai, chaahe usne jyaada khaana khaaya ho ya kam, magar dhani ka barhta hua wealth use sone nahin deta.
Ek aur bari buri baat hai jo mainne suraj ke niche dekhi: ki dhani ne apni wealth-property apne aapko hi kasht dene ke lie hi kamaai thi.
Usne wealth-property nishphal jagah laga di hai, vah dhani ek son ka pita bana. Magar uski madad ke lie koi nahin hai.
Jaise vah apni maan ke garbh se nanga aaya tha, use laut jaana hoga, jaise vah aaya tha. Thik vaise hi vah apne haath mein apni mehnat ke phal ka kuchh bhi nahin le jaaega.
Yah bhi ek bari buri baat hai: thik jaise ek person ka janm hota hai, vaise hi uski maut bhi ho jaaegi. To uske lie iska kya phaayda, jo hava ko pakarne ke lie mehnat karta hai?
Vah apna pura life rog, krodh aur bahut hi niraasha mein bitaata hai.
Mainne jo ek achchhi baat dekhi vah yah hai: ki insaan God dvaara die gae life mein khaae, pie aur apni mehnat mein, jo vah suraj ke niche karta hai, ke inaam mein khush rahe.

Aur har ek person jise God ne wealth-property di hai to God ne use unka istemaal karne, unke inaam ko paane aur apni mehnat se khush hone ki yogyta bhi di hai; yah bhi God dvaara diya gaya inaam hi hai.
Insaan apne pure life ko hamesha ke lie yaad nahin rakhega, kyonki God use uske dil ke khushi mein vyast rakhte hain.
Mainne suraj ke niche ek buri baat dekhi jo insaan par bahut adhik haavi hai.

Ek person jise God ne wealth-property aur sammaan diya hai jisse use us kisi bhi vastu ki kami na ho jise uska man chaahta hai; magar God ne use unko istemaal karne ki samajh nahin di, unka khushi to ek videshi leta hai. Yah bekaar aur bari hi buri baat hai.

Yadi ek person sau sons ka pita hai aur vah bahut saal jivit rahta hai, chaahe uski aayu ke saal bahut hon, par agar vah apne life bhar mein achchhi vastuon ka istemaal nahin karta aur use kriya-karm hi nahin kiya gaya to mera kahna to yahi hai ki ek mara hua janma bachcha us person se behtar hai,
Kyonki vah bachcha bekaar mein aata hai aur andhere mein chala jaata hai. Andhere mein uska naam chhipa liya jaata hai.
Us bachche ne suraj ko nahin dekha aur na hi use kuchh maalum hi hua tha. Vah bachcha us person se kahin adhik behtar hai.
Do baar jiska life do hazaar saal ka ho magar us person ne kisi achchhi vastu ka istemaal na kiya ho, kya sabhi log ek hi jagah par nahin jaate?
Insaan ki saari mehnat uske khaana ke lie hi hoti hai, magar uska man kabhi santusht nahin hota.
Wise ko nirbuddhi se kya laabh? Aur garib ko yah maalum hone se kya laabh ki use buddhimaanon ke saamne kaisa vyavhaar karna hai?
Aankhon se dekh lena chaahat rakhne se kahin adhik behtar hai. Magar yah bhi bekaar hi hai, sirph hava ko pakarne ki koshish.
Jo ho chuka hai uska naam bhi rakha ja chuka hai, aur yah bhi maalum ho chuka hai ki insaan kya hai? Insaan us person par haavi nahin ho sakta jo usse balvaan hai.
Word jitna adhik hai, arth utna kam hota hai. Isse insaan ko kya phaayda?

Jise yah maalum hai ki uske pure life mein insaan ke lie kya achchha hai, apne us vyarth life ke thore se saalon mein. Vah ek parchhaai ke jaisa unhein bita dega. Insaan ko kaun bata sakta hai ki suraj ke niche uske baad kya hoga?
Sammaanit hona itr se kahin jyaada behtar hai, aur maut ke din se behtar hai kisi person ke janm ka din.
Shok ke ghar mein jaana bhoj ke ghar mein jaane se kahin jyaada achchha hai, kyonki har ek insaan ka ant yahi hai; aur jivit is par dhyaan dein.
Shok karna hansne se achchha hai, kyonki ho sakta hai ki chehra to udaas ho magar dil aanandit.
Wise ka dil to shok karnevaalon ke ghar mein hota hai, magar nirbuddhiyon ka dil bhoj ke ghar mein hi hota hai.
Ek wise ki phatkaar sunna bewakoofon ke giton ko sunne se behtar hai.
Bewakoofon ki hansi kisi bartan ke niche kaanton ke jalne ki aavaaj ke jaisa hoti hai. Aur yah bhi sirph bekaar hi hai.
Atyaachaar wise ko bewakoof bana deta hai aur ghus dil ko bhrasht kar deti hai.
Kisi kaam ka ant uski shuruaat se behtar hai, aur sabr behtar hai. Ghamand se.
Krodh karne mein jaldbaaji na karna, kyonki krodh nirbuddhiyon ke dil mein rahta hai.
Tumhaara yah kahna na ho, “Bita hua samay aaj se behtar kyon tha?” Kyonki is baare mein tumhaara yah kahna samajh dvaara nahin hai.
Samajh ke saath miraas paana sabse achchha hai, aur unke lie yah ek phaayda hai jo jivit hain.
Samajh ki suraksha vaisi hi hai jaise wealth ki suraksha, magar knowledge ka phaayda yah hai: ki samajh wise ko jivit rakhti hai.
God ke kaamon par manan karo: kyonki vah hi iske yogy hain ki terhe ko sidha kar sakein.
Bharpuri ke dinon mein to khush raho; magar duhkh ke dinon mein soch karo: donon hi God ne banaae hain, jisse insaan ko yah maalum ho ki uske baad kya hoga.
Apne bekaar ke life mein mainne har ek chiz dekhi: righteous apni righteousness mein hi khatm ho jaata hai, lekin jab dushtta karta hai tab apni umr barhaata hai.
Bahut righteous na hona, aur na hi bahut wise banna. Is tarah tum apna hi vinaash kyon karo?
Bahut evil na hona, aur na hi bewakoof banna. Kyonki samay se pahle tumhaari maut kyon ho?
Achchha hoga ki tum ek chiz par authority kar lo aur apne dusre haath ko bhi aaraam na karne do. Kyonki God ke prati shraddha aur dar rakhnevaala person hi ye donon kaam kar paaega.
Wise ke lie samajh shehar ke das shaaskon se bhi balvaan hoti hai.
Prithvi par ek person bhi aisa righteous nahin hai, jo achchhe kaam hi karta ho aur galti na karta ho.
Logon ki baaton par dhyaan na dena, to tum apne servant ko tumhaari ninda karte nahin sunoge.
Kyonki tumhein maalum hoga ki thik isi tarah tum bhi bahuton ki ninda kar chuke ho.
In sabhi kaamon ki chhaanbin mainne samajh dvaara ki aur mainne kaha, “Main wise banunga,” Magar yah mujhse bahut dur thi.
Jo kuchh hai vah hamaari samajh se pare hai. Yah gahra hai, bahut hi gahra. Uski thaah kaun paaega?
Mainne apne dil se yah maalum karne ki koshish ki ki samajh aur knowledge kya hain aur evil ki murkhta pata karun aur murkhta jo paagalpan hi hai.

Mujhe yah maalum hua ki ek aurat jiska dil ghaat lagaae rahta hai, aur uske haath beriyaan daalte hain vah maut se bhi karvi hai. Us aurat se vahi person surakshit bach nikalta hai jo God ke saamne achchha hai, magar galti karnevaala person uska shikaar ban jaata hai.
Daarshnik kahta hai, “Dekho!” Mujhe yah maalum hua: “Mainne ek chiz se dusri ko milaaya, ki iske baare mein maalum kar sakun,
Jiski main ab tak khoj kar raha hun magar vah mujhe nahin mili hai. Mainne hazaar aadmi to righteous paae, magar ek bhi aurat nahin!
Magar mujhe yah zarur maalum hua: God ne to insaanon ko righteous hone ke lie racha hai, magar ve apne hi banaae hue nichle raaste par barhne lage.”
Kaun wise ke jaisa hai? Kise is baat ka matlab maalum hai? Samajh se wise ka chehra chamak jaata hai.
Daarshnik kahta hai, God ke saamne li gai shapath ke kaaran raaja ki command ka follow karo.
Unke saamne se jaane mein jaldbaaji na karna aur buri baaton par hath na karna, kyonki raaja vahi kareinge jo unki nazron mein sahi hoga.
Raaja ki baaton mein to authority hota hai, unhein kaun kahega, “Aap kya kar rahe hain?”
Jo person command ka follow karta hai, bura uska bhi na hoga, kyonki wise dil ko sahi samay aur sahi tarika maalum hota hai.
Kyonki har ek khushi ke lie sahi samay aur tarika hota hai, phir bhi ek person par bhaari sankat a hi jaata hai.
Agar kisi person ko yah hi maalum nahin hai ki kya hoga, to kaun use bata sakta hai ki kya hoga?
Vaayu ko rokne ka authority kiske paas hai? Aur maut ke din par authority kaun rakhta hai? Yuddh ke samay chhutti nahin hoti, aur jo buraai karte hain ve iske prabhaav se kaise bacheinge.
Yah sab dekh mainne apne dil ko suraj ke niche kie ja rahe har ek kaam par lagaaya jab ek insaan dusre insaan ki buraai ke lie uske authority ka istemaal karta hai.
So mainne evil logon ko gaare jaate dekha. Ve holy jagah mein aate jaate the. Lekin jahaan ve aisa karte the jald hi us shehar ne unhein bhula diya. Yah bhi bekaar hi hai.
Bure kaam ke saza jaldbaaji mein nahin di jaati, isliye insaan ka dil buraai karne mein hamesha laga rahta hai,

Chaahe galti karnevaala hazaar baar bura karein aur apne life ko barhaate rahein, magar mujhe maalum hai ki jinmein God ke lie shraddha aur dar ki bhaavna hai unka bhala hi hoga, kyonki unmein God ke prati shraddha aur dar ki bhaavna hain.
Magar evil ke saath achchha na hoga aur na hi vah parchhaai ke jaisa apne saare life ko bara kar sakega, kyonki usmein God ke lie shraddha aur dar ki bhaavna nahin hai.

Prithvi par ek aur baat bekaar hoti hai: dharmiyon ke saath evil logon dvaara kie gae kaamon ke hisaab se ghatta hai aur evil logon ke saath dharmiyon dvaara kie gae kaamon ke hisaab se. Mainne kaha ki yah bhi bekaar hi hai.

So main khushi ki taarif karta hun, suraj ke niche insaan ke lie isse achchha kuchh nahin hai ki vah khaae-pie aur khush rahe kyonki suraj ke niche God dvaara die gae uske life bhar mein uski mehnat ke saath yah hamesha rahega.
Jab mainne apne dil ko samajh ke aur prithvi par ke kaamon ke baare mein maalum karne ke lie lagaaya (haalaanki ek person ko din aur raat nahin sona chaahie).

Aur mainne God ke har ek kaam ko dekha, tab mujhe maalum hua ki suraj ke niche kiya ja raha har ek kaam insaan nahin samajh sakta. Jabki insaan bahut mehnat kare phir bhi use yah maalum na hoga aur chaahe wise ka yah kahna ho ki, mujhe maalum hai, phir bhi vah ise maalum nahin kar sakta.

Mainne sabhi kaamon mein apna man lagaaya aur yah matlab nikaala ki righteous, wise aur unke saare kaam God ke haath mein hain. Insaan ko yah maalum nahin hota ki uske saamne kya hoga; love ya nafrat.

Yah sabhi ke lie baraabar hai. Righteous aur evil, bhale aur bure, shuddh aur ashuddh, jo bali charhaata hai aur jo bali nahin charhaata, sabhi ka ant ek jaisa hai. Jis tarah ek bhala person hai, usi tarah ek galti karnevaala bhi hai; aur jis tarah ek shapath khaanevaala hai, usi tarah vah person hai jiske saamne shapath khaana dar ki baat hai.

Suraj ke niche kie ja rahe har ek kaam mein mainne yahi buraai dekhi ki sabhi insaanon ka ek hi ant hai. Insaanon ke dil buraai se bhare hain aur unke pure life mein paagalpan unke dilon mein bhara rahta hai. Iske baad unki maut ho jaati hai.
Jo jivit hai uske lie ummid hai kyonki nishchay hi mare hue sher se jivit kutta jyaada achchha hai.
Jiviton ko yah maalum hota hai ki unki maut zarur hogi, magar mare huon ko kuchh bhi maalum nahin hota; unhein to koi inaam bhi nahin milta, aur jald hi unhein bhula diya jaata hai.
Is tarah unka love, nafrat aur utsaah khatm ho gaya, aur suraj ke niche kie gae kisi bhi kaam mein unka koi bhaag na hoga.
Isliye jaao aur khushi se khaana karo aur man mein sukh maankar angur ka ras piya karo kyonki pahle hi God tumhaare kaamon se khush hain.
Tumhaare kapre hamesha ujle rahein aur tumhaare sir par tel ki kami na ho.
Suraj ke niche God dvaara die gae bekaar ke life mein apni pyaari patni ke saath khush raho, kyonki tumhaare life ka aur suraj ke niche ki gai mehnat ka inaam yahi hai.
Apne saamne aae har ek kaam ko puri lagan se karo kyonki adholok mein jiski or tum barh rahe ho, vahaan na to koi kaam ya tarkib, na knowledge aur na hi samajh hai.

Mainne dobaara suraj ke niche dekha, ki na to daur mein tej daurne vaale aur na yuddh mein balvaan hi jitte hain, na wise ko khaana milta hai aur na hi jnaanvaan ko wealth-daulat aur na hi yogy ko grace; kyonki ye samay aur sanyog ke vash mein hain.

Insaan apne samay ke baare mein nahin jaanta: jaise bure jaal mein phansi ek machhli ke, aur phande mein phanse pakshiyon ke jaisa, vaise hi insaan bure samay mein ja phansega jab yah achaanak hi us par a parega.
Mainne suraj ke niche samajh ka ek aur udaahran dekha, jisne mujhe bahut prabhaavit kiya.
Bahut hi thore logon ka ek chhota shehar tha ismein ek bahut hi sammaanit raaja aaya aur usne is shehar ke khilaaf gheraav kiya.
Magar us shehar ke ek saadhaaran lekin wise ne apni samajh dvaara is shehar ko chhurva diya. Phir bhi us sidhe-saade ko kisi ne yaad nahin kiya.
Isliye mainne yah kaha, “Samajh power se barhkar hai.” Lekin kisi sidhe-saade ki samajh ko tuchchh hi jaana jaata hai aur uski baaton par dhyaan nahin diya jaata.
Bewakoofon ke bich raaja ki chillaahat se akele mein wise ki baatein sun lena kahin jyaada achchha hai.
Yuddh ke shastron ki tulna mein samajh jyaada achchhi hai, magar ek galti karnevaala har ek achchhi chiz ka barbaadi kar deta hai.
Jis tarah mari hui makkhiyaan sugandh tel ko badbudaar bana deti hain, usi tarah thori si murkhta samajh aur sammaan par bhaari parti hai.
Wise ka dil to use sahi or le jaata hai, lekin bewakoof ka dil use us or jo galat hai.
Raaste par chalte samay bhi bewakoofon ke dil mein, samajh ki kami hoti hai, aur sabse uska kahna yahi hota hai ki vah ek bewakoof hai.
Yadi raaja ka krodh tumhaare khilaaf bharak gaya hai, to bhi tum apni jagah ko na chhorna; kyonki tumhaara sabr uske krodh ko bujha dega.
Suraj ke niche mainne ek aur buraai dekhi, jaise ise koi raaja anjaane mein hi kar baithta hai.
Vah yah ki murkhta unche padon par baithi hoti hai, magar dhani log nichle padon par hi hote hain.
Mainne slaves ko to ghoron par, lekin raajaaon ko slaves ke jaisa paidal chalte hue dekha hai.
Jo gaddha khodta hai vah khud usmein girega; aur jo divaar mein seindh lagaata hai, saamp use das lega.
Jo patthar khodta hai vah unhin se chotil ho jaaega; aur jo lakri phaarta hai, vah unhin se jokhim mein par jaaega.
Yadi kulhaare ki dhaar tej nahin hai aur tum usko paina nahin karte, tab tumhein adhik mehnat karni paregi; lekin samajh saphalta dilaane mein sahaayak hoti hai.
Aur yadi saamp mantr parhne se pahle hi das le to, mantr parhne vaale ka koi phaayda nahin.
Wise ki baaton mein grace hota hai, jabki bewakoofon ke onth hi unke vinaash ka kaaran ho jaate hai.
Uski baaton ki shuruaat hi murkhta se hoti hai aur uska ant dukhdaai paagalpan hota hai.
Jabki vah apni baatein barhaakar bhi bolta hai. Yah kisi person ko maalum nahin hota ki kya honevaala hai, aur kaun use bata sakta hai ki uske baad kya hoga?
Bewakoof ki mehnat use itna thaka deti hai; ki use shehar ka raasta bhi pata nahin hota.
Dhikkaar hai us desh par jiska raaja ek kam umr ka yuvak hai aur jiske shaasak subah se hi manoranjan mein lag jaate hain.
Magar sukhi hai vah desh jiska raaja kulin vansh ka hai aur jiske shaasak taakat ke lie khaana karte hain, na ki matvaale banne ke lie.
Aalas se chhat ki kariyon mein jhol par jaate hain; aur jis person ke haathon mein susti hoti hai uska ghar tapakne lagta hai.
Log manoranjan ke lie khaana karte hain, daakhamdhu life mein khushi ko bhar deti hai, aur wealth se har ek samasya ka samaadhaan hota hai.

Apne vichaaron mein bhi raaja ko na dhikkaarna, aur na hi apne kamre mein kisi dhani person ko shaap dena, kyonki ho sakta hai ki aakaash ka pakshi tumhaari vah baat le ure aur koi urnevaala jantu unhein is baare mein bata dega.
Paani ke upar apni roti daal do; kyonki bahut dinon ke baad yah tumhein dobaara mil jaaegi.
Apna ansh saat bhaagon balki aath bhaagon mein baant do, kyonki tumhein yah pata hi nahin ki prithvi par kya ho jaae!
Agar baadal paani se bhare hote hain, to ve dharti par paani barsaate hain. Aur per chaahe dakshin ki or gire ya uttar ki or, yah usi jagah par para rahta hai jahaan yah girta hai.
Jo person hava ko dekhta hai vah bij nahin bo paaega; aur jo baadlon ko dekhta hai vah upaj nahin kaatega.

Jis tarah tumhein hava ke raasta aur garbhavti aurat ke garbh mein haddiyon ke banne ke baare mein maalum nahin, usi tarah saari chizon ke banaanevaale God ke kaam ke baare mein tumhein maalum kaise hoga?
Bij subah-subah hi bo dena aur shaam mein bhi aaraam na karna kyonki tumhein yah maalum nahin hai, ki subah ya shaam ka bij bona phaldaayi hoga ya donon hi ek baraabar achchhe honge.
Ujaala manbhaavan hota hai, aur aankhon ke lie suraj sukhdaayi.
Agar kisi person ki umr bari hai, to use apne jivankaal mein aanandit rahne do. Lekin vah apne andhera bhare din bhula na de kyonki ve bahut honge. Zaruri hai ki har ek chiz bekaar hi hogi.

He javaan! Apni javaani mein aanandit raho, ismein tumhaara dil tumhein aanandit kare. Apne dil aur apni aankhon ki chaahat puri karo. Lekin tumhein yah yaad rahe ki God in sabhi kaamon ke baare mein tum par justice aur dand laaeinge.
Apne dil se krodh aur apne body se buraai karna chhor do kyonki bachpan, aur javaani bhi bekaar hi hain.

Javaani mein apne banaanevaale ko yaad rakh: apni javaani mein apne banaanevaale ko yaad rakho, isse pahle ki buraai aur vah samay aae jinmein tumhaara kahna yah ho, “Mujhe inmein zara si bhi khushi nahin,”
Isse pahle ki suraj, chandrma aur taare andhiyaare ho jaaeinge, aur baadal baarish ke baad laut aaeinge;
Us din pahredaar kaampne lageinge, balvaan aadmi jhuk jaaeinge, jo piste hain ve kaam karna band kar deinge, kyonki ve kam ho gae hain, aur jo jharokhon se jhaankti hain ve andhi ho jaaeingi;
Chakki ki aavaaj dhimi hone ke kaaran shehar ke phaatak band ho jaaeinge; aur koi person uth khara hoga, aur saare giton ki aavaaj shaant ho jaaegi.

Log unchi jaghon se dareinge aur raaste bhi daraavne honge; baadaam ke per phuleinge aur tidda unke saath saath ghasitta hua chalega aur ichchhaaein khatm ho jaaeingi. Kyonki insaan to apne hamesha ke ghar ko chala jaaega jabki rone-pitne vaale raaston mein hi bhatakte rah jaaeinge.
Yaad karo unko isse pahle ki chaandi ki dor tori jaae, aur sone ka katora tut jaae, kuein ke paas rakha ghara phor diya jaae aur pahiya tor diya jaae;
Dhul jaisi thi vaisi hi zameen mein laut jaaegi, aur aatma God ke paas laut jaaegi jisne use diya tha.
“Bekaar! Hi bekaar hai!” Daarshnik kahta hai, “Sab kuchh bekaar hai!”
Wise hone ke saath saath daarshnik ne logon ko knowledge bhi sikhaaya usne khojbin ki aur bahut se nitivchan ko ikattha kiya.
Daarshnik ne manbhaavne words ki khoj ki aur sach ki baaton ko likha.
Buddhimaanon ki baatein chhari ke jaisa hoti hain aur shikshkon ki baatein achchhe se thoki gai kilon ke jaisa; ve ek hi charvaahe dvaara di gain hain.
Son! Inke alaava dusri teachings ke baare mein chaukas rahna; bahut si pustkon ko likhkar rakhne ka koi ant nahin hai aur pustkon ka jyaada parhna bhi body ko thakaana hi hai.
Isliye is baat ka ant yahi hai: ki God ke prati shraddha aur dar ki bhaavna rakho aur unki law aur vidhiyon ka follow karo, kyonki yahi har ek insaan par laagu hota hai.
Kyonki God har ek kaam ko, chaahe vah chhupi hui ho, bhali ya buri ho, uske lie justice kareinge.
Shalomon dvaara rachit giton ka git.
Vah apne chehra ke chumbnon se mera chumban kare! Kyonki tumhaara love daakhamdhu se uttam hai.
Tumhaare vibhinn itron ki sugandh sukhad hai, tumhaara naam undele hue itr ke jaisa hai; isliye aashchary nahin ki tum kanyaaon ke aakarshan ka keindr ho.
Mujhe apne paas le lo ki ham donon dur chale jaaein! Raaja mujhe apne kamron mein le aae hain.
Mera rang saanvla to zarur hai, magar main sundar hun, Yerushalem ki kanyaao, kedaar ke tambuon ke jaisa, shalomon ke pardon ke jaisa.

Mujhe is tarah se na dekho ki main saanvli hun, yah to dhup mein jhulasne se hua hai. Meri maata ke son mujh par gussa ho gae; unhonne mujhe angur ke bagiche ki dekhrekh ki javaabdaari saump di, magar main khud hi apne angur ke bagiche ka dhyaan na rakh saki.

Mere praanapriy, mujhe yah to bata do, kahaan hain ve charaagaah, jahaan tum apni bher-bakriyaan charaate ho, vah kaun si jagah hai jahaan tum dophar mein unhein aaraam ke lie baitha dete ho? Kyonki main tumhaare saathiyon ki bher-bakriyon ke paas uske jaisa kyon banun, jo apna munh chhipaae rakhti hai?
Auraton mein param sundri, yadi khud tumhein hi yah maalum nahin hai, bher-bakriyon ke paanv ke nishaanon par chalti jaao aur apne memnon ko charvaahon ke tambuon ke paas charaao.
Meri priyatma, mere lie tum vaisi hi ho, jaisi faroh ke rathon ke bich meri ghori.
Gahnon ke saath tumhaare gaal kya hi sundar lagte hain, vaise hi hiron ke haar ke saath tumhaari gardan.
Ham tumhaare lie aise gahne garheinge, jo chaandi mein jare hue sone ke honge.
Jab mahaaraaj baithe hue the, mera itr apni khushbu phaila raha tha.
Mera priytam mere lie meinhdi ke phulon ke guchchhe ke jaisa hai, jo en-gedi ke anguron ke bagichon mein paae jaate hain.
Meri priyatma, kitni sundar ho tum! Oh, tum vaastav mein kitni sundar ho! Tumhaari aankhein kabutri ke jaisa hain.
Kitne sundar lagte ho, tum, mere priytam! Aur aanand-daayak bhi! Vaastav mein kitna bhavy hai hamaara bichhauna.
Hamaare gharon ki dharnein devdaar ki hain; aur chhatein sanovar ki.
Main shaaron ka gulaab hun, ghaatiyon ki kumudini.
Kanyaaon ke bich meri priya kaanton ke bich kumudini ke jaisa hai.
Mera priytam javaanon ke bich vaisa hi lagta hai, jaisa jangli peron ke bich ek seb ka per. Uski chhaaya mein mera baithna sukhad anubhav tha, mitha tha uske phal ka svaad.
Vah mujhe apne mahaabhoj ke kamre mein le aaya, aur love hi mujh par uska jhanda hai.
Angur ki tikiyon se mujhmein bal bhar do, seb khilaakar mujhmein nai taazgi bhar do, kyonki mujhe love rog ho gaya hai.
Uska baayaan haath mere sir ke niche ho, aur daaein haath se vah mera aalingan kare.
Yerushalem ki kanyaao, tumhein maidaan ke hirnon aur hirniyon ki shapath, mujhko vachan do, jab tak sahi samay na aae, mere love ko na jagaana.
Suno-suno! Mera priytam a raha hai, parvton ko paar kar, pahaariyon par uchhalte hue.
Mera priytam ek chinkaare ya ek hiran ke jaisa hai. Vah dekho, vah hamaari divaar ke pichhe hi khara hai, vah khirkiyon mein se dekh raha hai, vah jaali mein se jhaank raha hai.
Iske uttar mein mere priytam ne mujhse kaha, “Utho, meri priyatma, meri sundri, mere saath chalo.
Kyonki dekh lo! Jaara ja raha hai; varsha ritu bhi ho chuki hai.
Desh mein phul khil chuke hain; gungunaane ka samay a chuka hai, hamaare desh mein kabutron ka git sunaai dene laga hai.
Anjir ke per mein anjir pak chuke hain; lataaon par khile phul sugandh phaila rahe hain. Utho, meri priyatma; meri sundri, mere saath chalo.”

Chattaan ki daraaron mein, charhaai ke raaste ke gupt jagahon mein baithi meri kabutri, main tumhaara chehra dekhna chaahta hun, main tumhaari aavaaj sunna chaahta hun; kyonki mithi hai tumhaari aavaaj, sundar hai tumhaara mukhmandal.
Hamaare lie un lomriyon ko pakar lo, un chhoti lomriyon ko, jo hamaare angur ke bagichon ko barbaad kar rahi hain, jab hamaare angur ke bagichon mein phul khil rahe hain.
Mera priytam sirph mera hi hai aur main uski; vah apni bher-bakriyon ko sosan ke phulon ke bich mein chara raha hai.
Shaam ke aane tak jab chhaaya mitne lagti hai, mere dear, bater pahaaron par ke hiran ke jaisa, haan, hiran ke bachche ke jaisa laut aao.
Apne bichhaune par main har raat uska intjaar karti rahi, jo mujhe praanon se bhi dear hai; main use khojti rahi, magar meri khoj bekaar rahi.

Ab thik to yahi hoga ki main uthun aur shehar mein jaakar khoj karun, galiyon mein aur chaukon mein; yah zaruri hai ki main use khojun, jo mere lie praanon se bhi adhik dear hai. Main khojti rahi, lekin meri khoj bekaar hi rahi.
Ve pahredaar, jo shehar mein ghumte rahte hain, unse meri mulaakaat hui. Mainne unse puchha, “Kya tumne use dekha hai, jo mujhe praanon se dear hai?”

Main pahredaaron se kuchh hi dur gai thi, ki vah mujhe mil gaya, jo mere lie praanon se bhi adhik dear hai, main usse lipat gai, mainne use jaane na diya, tab main use apni maata ke ghar par le gai, uske kamre mein, jisne mujhe apne garbh mein dhaaran kiya tha.
Yerushalem ki kanyaao, tumhein maidaan ke hirnon aur hirniyon ki shapath, mujhko vachan do, jab tak sahi samay na aae, mere love ko na jagaana.
Registaan ki disha se dhuein ke khambhe ke jaisa yah kya barha chala a raha hai, yah lobaan aur gandhras se sugandhit hai, vyaapaariyon ke saare churnon se bhi sugandhit?
Dekho-dekho, yah shalomon ki paalki hai, saath yoddha use ghere hue hain, ye Israel ke shurviron mein se chune hue hain.
Ve sabhi talvaar lie hue hain, yuddh kala mein behatrin, har ek ne apni talvaar apne paas rakhi hai, ye raat ke aatank ka saamna karne ke lie puri tarah se taiyaar hain.
Yah paalki raaja shalomon ne apne lie banvaai hai; ismein istemaal ki gai lakri labaanon se laai gai thi.
Iske khambhe chaandi ke, aur satah sone ka hai. Ismein baithne ke jagah ke lie baingni kapde ka istemaal hua hai, iske andar ke bhaag ko Yerushalem ki kanyaaon dvaara love se marh diya gaya hai.
Ziyon ki kanyaao, aage barho, mukut pahne hue mahaaraaj shalomon ko nihaaro, yah uski maata ne use pahnaaya hai, yah uske vivaah ka din hai, yah vah din hai, jab vah bahut hi khush hai.

Kitni sundar ho tum meri priya! Meri aankhon ke lie kitni dear ho tum! Orhni ke pichhe tumhaari aankhein kabutri ke jaisa hain. Tumhaare baal gilaaad parvat ki dhaal par charhaai kar rahi bakriyon ke jaisa hain.
Tumhaare daant abhi-abhi un katre hue bheron ke jaisa hain, jo nahaakar aain hain, un sabhi ke jurvaan bachche hote hain, aur jinmein se ek bhi akela nahin hai.
Tumhaare onth laal rang ki dori ke jaisa hain; aur manmohan hai tumhaara munh. Tumhaare gaal tumhaari orhni ke pichhe anaar ki do phaank ke jaisa hain.

David dvaara banaae gae minaaron ke jaisa hai tumhaari gardan, jinhein patthron ko taraashkar banaaya gaya hai, jin par ek hazaar dhaalein latka di jaati hain, vir yoddhaaon ki sabhi golaakaar dhaalein.
Shaam hone tak jab chhaaya mitne lagti hai, main gandhras ke pahaar par chala jaaunga, haan, lobaan ki pahaari par.
Meri priyatma, tum sarvaang sundri ho; koi bhi dosh nahin hai tummein.

Meri dulhin, mere saath labaanon se a jaao, kaisa hoga jab tum mere saath labaanon se aaogi. Utar aao; amaana shikhar se, senir aur harmon ke shikhar se, sheron ki guphaaon se, teinduon ke parvton se.
Meri bahan, meri dulhin, tumne to meri dil gati tej kar di hai; tumhaare gale ke haar ke ek hi hire se, tumhaari aankhon ke ek hi chitvan se, tumne to meri dil gati tej kar di hai!
Meri bahan, meri dulhin, kaisa manohar hai tumhaara love! Daakhamdhu se bhi uttam hai tumhaara love, aur tumhaare itron ki sugandh bhi uttmottar hai sabhi masaalon ki sugandh se!
Meri dulhin, tumhaare onth madhu tapkaate hain; tumhaari jibh ke niche dudh aur madhu rahta hai, tumhaare kapdon se uthti sugandh labaanon ki sugandh ke jaisa hai.
Meri bahan, meri dulhin ek gupt niji bagicha hai; chaardivaari mein band aur niji jharne vaala bagicha.
Tum to anaar ke peron ki baari ho, jismein sabse achchhe phal lage hue hain aur jismein meinhdi aur jataamaansi ke paudhe lage hue hain.
Jataamaansi aur kesar, narkul aur daalchini, ye sabhi gandhras, lobaan aur agar aur inke saare mukhy masaalon ke mishran ke saath.
Tum to bagiche ke bich ka sota ho, sukhdaayi paani ka kuna, ve nadiyaan, jo labaanon se nikli hain.

Uttri vaayu, jaago, dakshin vaayu! A jaao; mere bagiche ke upar se baho, iske masaalon ke mishran urkar dur chale jaaein. Kaisa ho yadi mera premi apne bagiche mein a jaae aur iske uttam-uttam phalon ko khaae.

Meri bahan, meri dulhin; main apne bagiche mein a chuka hun; mainne apna gandhras, apna lobaan ikattha kar liya hai. Mainne madhu ke saath madhuchhatte ko bhi kha liya hai; mainne apna daakhamdhu aur apna dudh pi liya hai.

Main soi hui thi, lekin mera dil jaag raha tha. Ek aavaaj! Mera premi darvaaja khatakhta raha tha: “Darvaaja kholo, meri bahan, meri priyatma, meri kabutri, meri sarvaang sundri. Kyonki os se mera sir bhiga hua hai, raat ki nami mere baalon mein samaai hui hai.”
Main to apne kapde utaar chuki hun, ab main kaise kapdon ko dobaara pahnun? Main apne paanv dho chuki hun, ab main unhein maila kyon karun?
Mere premi ne darvaaje ke chhed mein se apna haath meri or barhaaya; uske lie meri bhaavnaaein umar uthin.

Main bichhauna chhor apne premi ke lie darvaaja kholne ke lie uthi, mere haathon se gandhras tapak raha tha aur meri ungliyon se tapakta hua gandhras. Meri ungliyaan is samay darvaaje ki chitakni par thin.

Apne premi ke lie mainne darvaaja khola, magar mera premi laut chuka tha. Jab vah mujhse request kar raha tha, mera dil pighal gaya. Main use khojti rahi par vah mujhe nahin mila. Main use pukaarti rahi, par uski or se mujhe uttar na mila.
Yerushalem ki kanyaao, yah vaada karo, yadi tumhein kahin mera premi mil jaae, tum use bataaoge? Use bata dena ki mujhe love ki bimaari ho gayi hai.
Navyuvtiyon mein param sundri navyuvti, kis tarah tumhaara premi dusre premiyon se uttam hai? Kis tarah ka hai tumhaara yah premi, ki tum hamein saugandh de rahi ho?
Mera premi tejvaan aur laal hai, vah to das hazaaron mein sirph ek hai.
Uska sir sona; haan, shuddh sone ke jaisa hai; aur uske baal to khajur ke guchchhon ke jaisa hain, kaua ke jaisa kaale.
Uski aankhein un kabutron ke jaisa hain jo nadiyon ke kinaare paae jaate hain, maano unhonne dudh mein nahaaya hai, jinmein hire jare hue hain.
Uske gaal balsaan ki kyaariyon ke jaisa hain, maano ve sugandh mishran ke dher hon. Uske onth sosan ke phul hain, jinmein se gandhras ka ras tapakta hai.
Uske haath markat mani jare hue kundan ke hain; uska pet to uttam haathi-daant ka hai, jismein nilam jare hue hain.
Uske pair sangmarmar ke khambhe hain, jinhein kundan par baitha diya gaya hai. Uska rup labaanon ke jaisa hai, sundar devdaar ke vrikshon ke jaisa.
Uska chehra bahut hi mitha hai; vah har tarah se man ko bhaanevaala hai. Yerushalem ki kanyaao, aisa hi hai mera premi, mera mit.
Auraton mein param sundri, kahaan chala gaya hai tumhaara premi? Kis mor par barh gaya hai vah, hamein bataao ki ham bhi tumhaare saath use khojein?
Mera premi apni vaatika mein hai, jahaan balsaan ki kyaariyaan hain. Ki vah vahaan apni bher-bakriyon ko charaae, ki vahaan vah sosan ke phul ikattha kare.
Main apne premi ki ho chuki hun aur vah mera; vahi, jo apni bher-bakriyon ko sosan ke phulon ke bich mein chara raha hai.
Meri priyatma, tum to vaisi hi sundar ho, jaisi tirzaah, vaisi hi rupvaan, jaisi Yerushalem, vaisi hi prabhaavshaali, jaisi jhanda phahraati hui sena.
Hata lo mujhse apni aankhein; kyonki unhonne mujhe vyaakul kar diya hai. Tumhaare baal vaise hi hain, jaise bakriyon ka jhunr, jo gilaaad se utra hua hai.
Tumhaare daant abhi-abhi un katre hue bheron ke jaisa hain, un sabhi ke jurvaan bachche hote hain, aur jinmein se ek bhi akela nahin hai.
Tumhaare gaal orhni se dhanke hue anaar ki do phaank ke jaisa hain.
Vahaan raaniyon ki sankhya saath hai aur uppatniyon ki assi, daasiyaan anginat hain,

Lekin meri kabutri, meri nirmal sundri, anokhi hai, apni maata ki eklauti children, apni janni ki dulaari. Jaise hi daasiyon ne use dekha, use blessed kaha; raaniyon aur uppatniyon ne uski prashansa ki, unhonne kaha:
Kaun hai yah, jo bhor ke jaisa udbhut ho rahi hai, pure chaand ke jaisa sundar, sury ke jaisa nirmal, vaisi hi prabhaavshaali, jaise jhanda phahraati hui sena?
Main akhrot ke bagiche mein gayi ki ghaati mein khile phulon ko dekhun, ki yah pata karun ki daakhalta mein kaliyaan lagi hain ya nahin. Anaar ke peron mein phul aae hain ya nahin.
Iske pahle ki main kuchh samajh paati, meri chaahaton ne mujhe mere raajkumaar ke rathon par pahuncha diya.
Laut aao, shulaami, laut aao; laut aao, laut aao, ki ham tumhein dekh sakein!
Raajkumaari, kaise sundar lagte hain, jutiyon mein tumhaare paanv! Tumhaari jaanghon ki golaai gahnon ke jaisa hai, kisi nipun shilpi ki rachna ke jaisa.

Tumhaara gala haathi-daant ke minaaron ke jaisa hai. Tumhaari aankhein heshbon ke taalaabon ke jaisa hain, jo beth-rabbim ke phaatkon ke paas hain; tumhaari naak labaanon ke khambhe ke jaisa, jo dameshek ki or chehra kie hue hain.
Tumhaara sir karmel ke gaurav ke jaisa hai. Tumhaare lambe-lambe ghunghraale baal raajsi dhaagon ka ahsaas karaate hain; raaja to tumhaari laton ka bandi hokar rah gaya hai.
Meri dear, apni komaltaaon ke saath, tum kaisi sundar aur manohar lagti ho!
Khajur ke per ke jaisa hai tumhaara dildaul aur tumhaari chhaatiyaan khajur ke guchchhon ke jaisa.

Mere man mein soch aaya, “Main khajur ke per par charhunga aur iske phalon ke guchchhon ko thaam lunga.” Kaisa hota yadi tumhaari chhaatiyaan angur ke guchchhe hote tumhaari saans ki sugandh sebon ke jaisa
Tumhaara chehra sabse uttam daakhamdhu ke jaisa hai.
Main apne premi ki ho chuki hun, aur vah meri kaamna karta rahta hai.
Mere dear, chalo, ham baahar maidaan mein chalein, hamein raat gaanvon mein bitaani par sakti hai.

Chalo, subah tarke uthkar ham angur ke bagiche mein chalein; aao ham dekhein ki lata mein kaliyaan lagi bhi hui hain ya nahin, kya iske phul khile hue hain ya nahin. Kya anaar ke phul khil chuke hain ya nahin. Vahi vah jagah hogi jahaan main tum par apna love dikhaaungi.
Vishaakhmul se sugandh a rahi hai, hamaare darvaajon par sabhi tarah ke uttam phal sajaae gae hain, nae bhi puraane bhi. Ye sabhi, mere premi, mainne tumhaare lie bachaakar rakhe hain.

Kaisa hota yadi tum mere lie mere bhaai ke jaisa hote, meri maata ki chhaati ka dudh pite hue! Aur tab, tum mujhe baahar kahin dikh jaate, to main tumhein chum leti; isse mujhe koi bhi tuchchh nazron se na dekhta.
Main tumhein apne saath yahaan le aati, apni maata ke ghar mein, jisne mujhe teaching di hai. Main tumhein apne anaaron ke ras se bani hui uttam daakhamdhu parosti.
Uska baayaan haath mere sir ke niche ho, aur daaein haath se vah mera aalingan kare.
Yerushalem ki kanyaao, mujhko vachan do, jab tak sahi samay na aae, mere love ko na jagaana.
Banjar zameen se yah kaun chala a raha hai, jo uske premi ka sahaara lie hue hai?

Apne dil par mujhe ek mohar jaise laga lo, haath par mohar ke jaisa; love utna hi saamarthyi hai, jitni maut, irshya utni hi nirdyi, jitni maut. Uski jvaala aag ki jvaala hai, jo vaastav mein Yahweh hi ki jvaala hai.

Paani ki baarh bhi love ko bujhaane mein asmarth hoti hai; nadi mein aai baarh ise dubone mein asphal rahti hai. Yadi koi person love ke lie apni saari property bhi dena chaahe, yah property tuchchh hi hogi.
Main shahrapnaah thi, aur mere stan khambhe ke jaisa the. Tab main apne premi ki nazar mein shaanti laane vaali ke jaisa ho gai.
Baal-haamon mein shalomon ka ek angur ka bagicha tha; yah usne rakhvaalon ko saump diya tha. Har ek ke lie ek shart thi, ki vah iske phalon ke lie ek hazaar shekel chaandi laae.
Mera apna angur ka bagicha meri javaabdaari hai; shalomon, ek hazaar shekel par tumhaara authority hai, do sau unke lie hain, jo iske phalon ki raksha karte rahte hain.
Tum sabhi, jo bagichon mein rahte ho, mere saathi tumhaari aavaaj sunne ke lie ichchhuk bane rahte hain. Kab sun sakunga, main vah aavaaj?
Mere premi, der na karo, tumhaari chaal sugandh dravy ke pahaaron par se aate hue hiran ya javaan hiran ke jaisa tej ho.
This is the vision concerning Judah and Jerusalem that Isaiah son of Amoz saw during the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
Listen, O heavens, and give ear, O earth, for the LORD has spoken: “I have raised children and brought them up, but they have rebelled against Me.
The ox knows its owner, and the donkey its master’s manger, but Israel does not know; My people do not understand.”
Hear the word of the LORD, you rulers of Sodom; listen to the instruction of our God, you people of Gomorrah!

“What good to Me is your multitude of sacrifices?” says the LORD. “I am full from the burnt offerings of rams and the fat of well-fed cattle; I take no delight in the blood of bulls and lambs and goats.
When you come to appear before Me, who has required this of you— this trampling of My courts?
Bring your worthless offerings no more; your incense is detestable to Me— your New Moons, Sabbaths, and convocations. I cannot endure iniquity in a solemn assembly.
I hate your New Moons and your appointed feasts. They have become a burden to Me; I am weary of bearing them.
When you spread out your hands in prayer, I will hide My eyes from you; even though you multiply your prayers, I will not listen. Your hands are covered with blood.
Wash and cleanse yourselves. Remove your evil deeds from My sight. Stop doing evil!
Learn to do right; seek justice and correct the oppressor. Defend the fatherless and plead the case of the widow.”
“Come now, let us reason together,” says the LORD. “Though your sins are like scarlet, they will be as white as snow; though they are as red as crimson, they will become like wool.
If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the best of the land.”
See how the faithful city has become a harlot! She once was full of justice; righteousness resided within her, but now only murderers!
Your silver has become dross; your fine wine is diluted with water.
Your rulers are rebels, friends of thieves. They all love bribes and chasing after rewards. They do not defend the fatherless, and the plea of the widow never comes before them.
I will restore your judges as at first, and your counselors as at the beginning. After that you will be called the City of Righteousness, the Faithful City.
Zion will be redeemed with justice, her repentant ones with righteousness.
This is the message that was revealed to Isaiah son of Amoz concerning Judah and Jerusalem:
In the last days the mountain of the house of the LORD will be established as the chief of the mountains; it will be raised above the hills, and all nations will stream to it.

And many peoples will come and say: “Come, let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob. He will teach us His ways so that we may walk in His paths.” For the law will go forth from Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

Then He will judge between the nations and arbitrate for many peoples. They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will no longer take up the sword against nation, nor train anymore for war.
Come, O house of Jacob, let us walk in the light of the LORD.
Their land is full of silver and gold, with no limit to their treasures; their land is full of horses, with no limit to their chariots.
Their land is full of idols; they bow down to the work of their hands, to what their fingers have made.
Put no more trust in man, who has only the breath in his nostrils. Of what account is he?
The people will oppress one another, man against man, neighbor against neighbor; the young will rise up against the old, and the base against the honorable.
A man will seize his brother within his father’s house: “You have a cloak—you be our leader! Take charge of this heap of rubble.”
On that day he will cry aloud: “I am not a healer. I have no food or clothing in my house. Do not make me leader of the people!”
Tell the righteous it will be well with them, for they will enjoy the fruit of their labor.
Youths oppress My people, and women rule over them. O My people, your guides mislead you; they turn you from your paths.
The LORD arises to contend; He stands to judge the people.
The LORD brings this charge against the elders and leaders of His people: “You have devoured the vineyard; the plunder of the poor is in your houses.
Why do you crush My people and grind the faces of the poor?” declares the Lord GOD of Hosts.
In that day seven women will take hold of one man and say, “We will eat our own bread and provide our own clothes. Just let us be called by your name. Take away our disgrace!”
On that day the Branch of the LORD will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the pride and glory of Israel’s survivors.
Whoever remains in Zion and whoever is left in Jerusalem will be called holy— all in Jerusalem who are recorded among the living—
Then the LORD will create over all of Mount Zion and over her assemblies a cloud of smoke by day and a glowing flame of fire by night. For over all the glory there will be a canopy,
a shelter to give shade from the heat by day, and a refuge and hiding place from the storm and the rain.
I will sing for my beloved a song of his vineyard: My beloved had a vineyard on a very fertile hill.

He dug it up and cleared the stones and planted the finest vines. He built a watchtower in the middle and dug out a winepress as well. He waited for the vineyard to yield good grapes, but the fruit it produced was sour!
“And now, O dwellers of Jerusalem and men of Judah, I exhort you to judge between Me and My vineyard.
What more could I have done for My vineyard than I already did for it? Why, when I expected sweet grapes, did it bring forth sour fruit?”

For the vineyard of the LORD of Hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah are the plant of His delight. He looked for justice, but saw bloodshed; for righteousness, but heard a cry of distress.
Woe to you who add house to house and join field to field until no place is left and you live alone in the land.
Woe to those who rise early in the morning in pursuit of strong drink, who linger into the evening, to be inflamed by wine.
At their feasts are the lyre and harp, tambourines and flutes and wine. They disregard the actions of the LORD and fail to see the work of His hands.
But the LORD of Hosts will be exalted by His justice, and the holy God will show Himself holy in righteousness.
Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of deceit and pull sin along with cart ropes,
to those who say, “Let Him hurry and hasten His work so that we may see it! Let the plan of the Holy One of Israel come so that we may know it!”
Woe to those who call evil good and good evil, who turn darkness to light and light to darkness, who replace bitter with sweet and sweet with bitter.
Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes and clever in their own sight.
Woe to those who are heroes in drinking wine and champions in mixing strong drink,
who acquit the guilty for a bribe and deprive the innocent of justice.
In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord seated on a throne, high and exalted; and the train of His robe filled the temple.
Above Him stood seraphim, each having six wings: With two wings they covered their faces, with two they covered their feet, and with two they were flying.
And they were calling out to one another: “Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of Hosts; all the earth is full of His glory.”
At the sound of their voices the doorposts and thresholds shook, and the temple was filled with smoke.
Then I said: “Woe is me, for I am ruined, because I am a man of unclean lips dwelling among a people of unclean lips; for my eyes have seen the King, the LORD of Hosts.”
Then one of the seraphim flew to me, and in his hand was a glowing coal that he had taken with tongs from the altar.
And with it he touched my mouth and said: “Now that this has touched your lips, your iniquity is removed and your sin is atoned for.”
Then I heard the voice of the Lord saying: “Whom shall I send? Who will go for Us?” And I said: “Here am I. Send me!”

Now in the days that Ahaz son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, was king of Judah, Rezin king of Aram marched up to wage war against Jerusalem. He was accompanied by Pekah son of Remaliah the king of Israel, but he could not overpower the city.
When it was reported to the house of David that Aram was in league with Ephraim, the hearts of Ahaz and his people trembled like trees in the forest shaken by the wind.
Then the LORD said to Isaiah, “Go out with your son Shear-jashub to meet Ahaz at the end of the aqueduct that feeds the upper pool, on the road to the Launderer’s Field,
and say to him: Calm down and be quiet. Do not be afraid or disheartened over these two smoldering stubs of firewood—over the fierce anger of Rezin and Aram and of the son of Remaliah.
For Aram, along with Ephraim and the son of Remaliah, has plotted your ruin, saying:
‘Let us invade Judah, terrorize it, and divide it among ourselves. Then we can install the son of Tabeal over it as king.’
But this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘It will not arise; it will not happen.”
The head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is the son of Remaliah. If you do not stand firm in your faith, then you will not stand at all.’
Again the LORD spoke to Ahaz, saying,
“Ask for a sign from the LORD your God, whether from the depths of Sheol or the heights of heaven.”
But Ahaz replied, “I will not ask; I will not test the LORD.”
Then Isaiah said, “Hear now, O house of David! Is it not enough to try the patience of men? Will you try the patience of my God as well?
Therefore the Lord Himself will give you a sign: Behold, the virgin will be with child and will give birth to a son, and will call Him Immanuel.
By the time He knows enough to reject evil and choose good, He will be eating curds and honey.”
On that day a man will raise a young cow and two sheep,
and from the abundance of milk they give, he will eat curds; for all who remain in the land will eat curds and honey.
Then the LORD said to me, “Take a large scroll and write on it with an ordinary stylus: Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
And I will appoint for Myself trustworthy witnesses—Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberekiah.”
And I had relations with the prophetess, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. The LORD said to me, “Name him Maher-shalal-hash-baz.”
Devise a plan, but it will be thwarted; state a proposal, but it will not happen. For God is with us.
For this is what the LORD has spoken to me with a strong hand, instructing me not to walk in the way of this people:
“Do not call conspiracy everything these people regard as conspiracy. Do not fear what they fear; do not live in dread.
The LORD of Hosts is the One you shall regard as holy. Only He should be feared; only He should be dreaded.”
Bind up the testimony and seal the law among my disciples.
I will wait for the LORD, who is hiding His face from the house of Jacob. I will put my trust in Him.
Here am I, and the children the LORD has given me as signs and symbols in Israel from the LORD of Hosts, who dwells on Mount Zion.
When men tell you to consult the spirits of the dead and the spiritists who whisper and mutter, shouldn’t a people consult their God instead? Why consult the dead on behalf of the living?
To the law and to the testimony! If they do not speak according to this word, they have no light of dawn.

Nevertheless, there will be no more gloom for those in distress. In the past He humbled the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, but in the future He will honor the Way of the Sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations:
The people walking in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of the shadow of death, a light has dawned.
You have enlarged the nation and increased its joy. The people rejoice before You as they rejoice at harvest time, as men rejoice in dividing the plunder.
For as in the day of Midian You have shattered the yoke of their burden, the bar across their shoulders, and the rod of their oppressor.
For every trampling boot of battle and every garment rolled in blood will be burned as fuel for the fire.
For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given, and the government will be upon His shoulders. And He will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

Of the increase of His government and peace there will be no end. He will reign on the throne of David and over his kingdom, to establish and sustain it with justice and righteousness from that time and forevermore. The zeal of the LORD of Hosts will accomplish this.
Woe to those who enact unjust statutes and issue oppressive decrees,
to deprive the poor of fair treatment and withhold justice from the oppressed of My people, to make widows their prey and orphans their plunder.
Does an axe raise itself above the one who swings it? Does a saw boast over him who saws with it? It would be like a rod waving the one who lifts it, or a staff lifting him who is not wood!
On that day the remnant of Israel and the survivors of the house of Jacob will no longer depend on him who struck them, but they will truly rely on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel.
A remnant will return—a remnant of Jacob— to the Mighty God.
Then a shoot will spring up from the stump of Jesse, and a Branch from his roots will bear fruit.
The Spirit of the LORD will rest on Him— the Spirit of wisdom and understanding, the Spirit of counsel and strength, the Spirit of knowledge and fear of the LORD.
And He will delight in the fear of the LORD. He will not judge by what His eyes see, and He will not decide by what His ears hear,
but with righteousness He will judge the poor, and with equity He will decide for the lowly of the earth.
Righteousness will be the belt around His hips, and faithfulness the sash around His waist.
The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the goat; the calf and young lion and fatling will be together, and a little child will lead them.
The cow will graze with the bear, their young will lie down together, and the lion will eat straw like the ox.
The infant will play by the cobra’s den, and the toddler will reach into the viper’s nest.
They will neither harm nor destroy on all My holy mountain, for the earth will be full of the knowledge of the LORD as the sea is full of water.
On that day the Root of Jesse will stand as a banner for the peoples. The nations will seek Him, and His place of rest will be glorious.

On that day the Lord will extend His hand a second time to recover the remnant of His people from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
He will raise a banner for the nations and gather the exiles of Israel; He will collect the scattered of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
In that day you will say: “O LORD, I will praise You. Although You were angry with me, Your anger has turned away, and You have comforted me.
Surely God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. For the LORD GOD is my strength and my song, and He also has become my salvation.”
With joy you will draw water from the springs of salvation,
and on that day you will say: “Give praise to the LORD; proclaim His name! Make His works known among the peoples; declare that His name is exalted.
Sing to the LORD, for He has done glorious things. Let this be known in all the earth.
Cry out and sing, O citizen of Zion, for great among you is the Holy One of Israel.”
On the day that the LORD gives you rest from your pain and torment, and from the hard labor into which you were forced,
you will sing this song of contempt against the king of Babylon: How the oppressor has ceased, and how his fury has ended!
The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers.
It struck the peoples in anger with unceasing blows; it subdued the nations in rage with relentless persecution.
All the earth is at peace and at rest; they break out in song.
Those who see you will stare; they will ponder your fate: “Is this the man who shook the earth and made the kingdoms tremble,
who turned the world into a desert and destroyed its cities, who refused to let the captives return to their homes?”
What answer will be given to the envoys of that nation? “The LORD has founded Zion, where His afflicted people will find refuge.”
