The LORD will always guide you; He will satisfy you in a sun-scorched land and strengthen your frame. You will be like a well-watered garden, like a spring whose waters never fail.
Your people will rebuild the ancient ruins; you will restore the age-old foundations; you will be called Repairer of the Breach, Restorer of the Streets of Dwelling.

If you turn your foot from breaking the Sabbath, from doing as you please on My holy day, if you call the Sabbath a delight, and the LORD’s holy day honorable, if you honor it by not going your own way or seeking your own pleasure or speaking idle words,
then you will delight yourself in the LORD, and I will make you ride on the heights of the land and feed you with the heritage of your father Jacob.” For the mouth of the LORD has spoken.
Surely the arm of the LORD is not too short to save, nor His ear too dull to hear.
But your iniquities have built barriers between you and your God, and your sins have hidden His face from you, so that He does not hear.
For your hands are stained with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, and your tongue mutters injustice.
No one calls for justice; no one pleads his case honestly. They rely on empty pleas; they tell lies; they conceive mischief and give birth to iniquity.
They hatch the eggs of vipers and weave a spider’s web. Whoever eats their eggs will die; crack one open, and a viper is hatched.
Their cobwebs cannot be made into clothing, and they cannot cover themselves with their works. Their deeds are sinful deeds, and acts of violence are in their hands.
Their feet run to evil; they are swift to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are sinful thoughts; ruin and destruction lie in their wake.
The way of peace they have not known, and there is no justice in their tracks. They have turned them into crooked paths; no one who treads on them will know peace.
Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness does not reach us. We hope for light, but there is darkness; for brightness, but we walk in gloom.
Like the blind, we feel our way along the wall, groping like those without eyes. We stumble at midday as in the twilight; among the vigorous we are like the dead.
We all growl like bears and moan like doves. We hope for justice, but find none, for salvation, but it is far from us.
For our transgressions are multiplied before You, and our sins testify against us. Our transgressions are indeed with us, and we know our iniquities:
rebelling and denying the LORD, turning away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering lies from the heart.
So justice is turned away, and righteousness stands at a distance. For truth has stumbled in the public square, and honesty cannot enter.
Truth is missing, and whoever turns from evil becomes prey.
“The Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who turn from transgression,” declares the LORD.

“As for Me, this is My covenant with them,” says the LORD. “My Spirit will not depart from you, and My words that I have put in your mouth will not depart from your mouth or from the mouths of your children and grandchildren, from now on and forevermore,” says the LORD.
Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD rises upon you.
For behold, darkness covers the earth, and thick darkness is over the peoples; but the LORD will rise upon you, and His glory will appear over you.
Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your dawn.
Lift up your eyes and look around: They all gather and come to you; your sons will come from afar, and your daughters will be carried on the arm.
Then you will look and be radiant, and your heart will tremble and swell with joy, because the riches of the sea will be brought to you, and the wealth of the nations will come to you.
Caravans of camels will cover your land, young camels of Midian and Ephah, and all from Sheba will come, bearing gold and frankincense and proclaiming the praises of the LORD.
All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered to you; the rams of Nebaioth will serve you and go up on My altar with acceptance; I will adorn My glorious house.
Who are these who fly like clouds, like doves to their shelters?

Surely the islands will wait for Me, with the ships of Tarshish in the lead, to bring your children from afar, with their silver and gold, to the honor of the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, for He has glorified you.
Foreigners will rebuild your walls, and their kings will serve you. In favor I will show you mercy.
Your gates will always stand open; they will never be shut, day or night, so that the wealth of the nations may be brought into you, with their kings being led in procession.
The glory of Lebanon will come to you— its cypress, elm, and boxwood together— to adorn the place of My sanctuary, and I will glorify the place of My feet.
They will call you the City of the LORD, Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
Whereas you have been forsaken and despised, with no one passing through, I will make you an everlasting pride, a joy from age to age.
You will drink the milk of nations and nurse at the breasts of royalty; you will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

Instead of bronze I will bring you gold; I will bring silver in place of iron, bronze instead of wood, and iron instead of stones. I will appoint peace as your governor and righteousness as your ruler.
No longer will violence be heard in your land, nor ruin or destruction within your borders. But you will name your walls Salvation and your gates Praise.
No longer will the sun be your light by day, nor the brightness of the moon shine on your night; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your splendor.
Your sun will no longer set, and your moon will not wane; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and the days of your sorrow will cease.
Then all your people will be righteous; they will possess the land forever; they are the branch of My planting, the work of My hands, so that I may be glorified.
The least of you will become a thousand, and the smallest a mighty nation. I am the LORD; in its time I will accomplish it quickly.

The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on Me, because the LORD has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and freedom to the prisoners,
to proclaim the year of the LORD’s favor, to comfort all who mourn,

to console the mourners in Zion— to give them a crown of beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, and a garment of praise for a spirit of despair. So they will be called oaks of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that He may be glorified.
They will rebuild the ancient ruins; they will restore the places long devastated; they will renew the ruined cities, the desolations of many generations.
Strangers will stand and feed your flocks, and foreigners will be your plowmen and vinedressers.
But you will be called the priests of the LORD; they will speak of you as ministers of our God; you will feed on the wealth of nations, and you will boast in their riches.

Instead of shame, My people will have a double portion, and instead of humiliation, they will rejoice in their share; and so they will inherit a double portion in their land, and everlasting joy will be theirs.
For I, the LORD, love justice; I hate robbery and iniquity; in My faithfulness I will give them their recompense and make an everlasting covenant with them.
Their descendants will be known among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples. All who see them will acknowledge that they are a people the LORD has blessed.

I will rejoice greatly in the LORD, my soul will exult in my God; for He has clothed me with garments of salvation and wrapped me in a robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom wears a priestly headdress, as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
For as the earth brings forth its growth, and as a garden enables seed to spring up, so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.
For Zion’s sake I will not keep silent, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not keep still, until her righteousness shines like a bright light, her salvation like a blazing torch.
Nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory. You will be called by a new name that the mouth of the LORD will bestow.
You will be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, a royal diadem in the palm of your God.
No longer will you be called Forsaken, nor your land named Desolate; but you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; for the LORD will take delight in you, and your land will be His bride.
For as a young man marries a young woman, so your sons will marry you; and as a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so your God will rejoice over you.
On your walls, O Jerusalem, I have posted watchmen; they will never be silent day or night. You who call on the LORD shall take no rest for yourselves,
nor give Him any rest until He establishes Jerusalem and makes her the praise of the earth.
The LORD has sworn by His right hand and by His mighty arm: “Never again will I give your grain to your enemies for food, nor will foreigners drink the new wine for which you have toiled.
For those who harvest grain will eat it and praise the LORD, and those who gather grapes will drink the wine in My holy courts.”
Go out, go out through the gates; prepare the way for the people! Build it up, build up the highway; clear away the stones; raise a banner for the nations!
Behold, the LORD has proclaimed to the ends of the earth, “Say to Daughter Zion: See, your Savior comes! Look, His reward is with Him, and His recompense goes before Him.”
And they will be called the Holy People, the Redeemed of The LORD; and you will be called Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken.

I will make known the LORD’s loving devotion and His praiseworthy acts, because of all that the LORD has done for us— the many good things for the house of Israel according to His great compassion and loving devotion.
For He said, “They are surely My people, sons who will not be disloyal.” So He became their Savior.
In all their distress, He too was afflicted, and the Angel of His Presence saved them. In His love and compassion He redeemed them; He lifted them up and carried them all the days of old.
But they rebelled and grieved His Holy Spirit.
Then His people remembered the days of old, the days of Moses. Where is He who brought them through the sea with the shepherds of His flock? Where is the One who set His Holy Spirit among them,
who sent His glorious arm to lead them by the right hand of Moses, who divided the waters before them to gain for Himself everlasting renown,
who led them through the depths like a horse in the wilderness, so that they did not stumble?
Like cattle going down to the valley, the Spirit of the LORD gave them rest. You led Your people this way to make for Yourself a glorious name.
Look down from heaven and see, from Your holy and glorious habitation. Where are Your zeal and might? Your yearning and compassion for me are restrained.
Yet You are our Father, though Abraham does not know us and Israel does not acknowledge us. You, O LORD, are our Father; our Redeemer from Everlasting is Your name.
Why, O LORD, do You make us stray from Your ways and harden our hearts from fearing You? Return, for the sake of Your servants, the tribes of Your heritage.
For a short while Your people possessed Your holy place, but our enemies have trampled Your sanctuary.
We have become like those You never ruled, like those not called by Your name.
If only You would rend the heavens and come down, so that mountains would quake at Your presence,
as fire kindles the brushwood and causes the water to boil, to make Your name known to Your enemies, so that the nations will tremble at Your presence!
When You did awesome works that we did not expect, You came down, and the mountains trembled at Your presence.
From ancient times no one has heard, no ear has perceived, no eye has seen any God besides You, who acts on behalf of those who wait for Him.
You welcome those who gladly do right, who remember Your ways. Surely You were angry, for we sinned. How can we be saved if we remain in our sins?
Each of us has become like something unclean, and all our righteous acts are like filthy rags; we all wither like a leaf, and our iniquities carry us away like the wind.
No one calls on Your name or strives to take hold of You. For You have hidden Your face from us and delivered us into the hand of our iniquity.
But now, O LORD, You are our Father; we are the clay, and You are the potter; we are all the work of Your hand.
Do not be angry, O LORD, beyond measure; do not remember our iniquity forever. Oh, look upon us, we pray; we are all Your people!
Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wasteland and Jerusalem a desolation.
Our holy and beautiful temple, where our fathers praised You, has been burned with fire, and all that was dear to us lies in ruins.
After all this, O LORD, will You restrain Yourself? Will You keep silent and afflict us beyond measure?
“I revealed Myself to those who did not ask for Me; I was found by those who did not seek Me. To a nation that did not call My name, I said, ‘Here I am! Here I am!’”
And I will bring forth descendants from Jacob, and heirs from Judah; My elect will possess My mountains, and My servants will dwell there.
Sharon will become a pasture for flocks, and the Valley of Achor a resting place for herds, for My people who seek Me.

Whoever invokes a blessing in the land will do so by the God of truth, and whoever takes an oath in the land will swear by the God of truth. For the former troubles will be forgotten and hidden from My sight.
For behold, I will create new heavens and a new earth. The former things will not be remembered, nor will they come to mind.
But be glad and rejoice forever in what I create; for I will create Jerusalem to be a joy and its people to be a delight.
I will rejoice in Jerusalem and take delight in My people. The sounds of weeping and crying will no longer be heard in her.

No longer will a nursing infant live but a few days, or an old man fail to live out his years. For the youth will die at a hundred years, and he who fails to reach a hundred will be considered accursed.
They will build houses and dwell in them; they will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

No longer will they build houses for others to inhabit, nor plant for others to eat. For as is the lifetime of a tree, so will be the days of My people, and My chosen ones will fully enjoy the work of their hands.
They will not labor in vain or bear children doomed to disaster; for they will be a people blessed by the LORD— they and their descendants with them.
Even before they call, I will answer, and while they are still speaking, I will hear.

The wolf and the lamb will feed together, and the lion will eat straw like the ox, but the food of the serpent will be dust. They will neither harm nor destroy on all My holy mountain,” says the LORD.
This is what the LORD says: “Heaven is My throne, and earth is My footstool. What kind of house will you build for Me? Or where will My place of repose be?
Has not My hand made all these things? And so they came into being,” declares the LORD. “This is the one I will esteem: he who is humble and contrite in spirit, who trembles at My word.”
You who tremble at His word, hear the word of the LORD: “Your brothers who hate you and exclude you because of My name have said, ‘Let the LORD be glorified that we may see your joy!’”
“Before she was in labor, she gave birth; before she was in pain, she delivered a boy.
Who has heard of such as this? Who has seen such things? Can a country be born in a day or a nation be delivered in an instant? Yet as soon as Zion was in labor, she gave birth to her children.
Shall I bring a baby to the point of birth and not deliver it?” says the LORD. “Or will I who deliver close the womb?” says your God.
Be glad for Jerusalem and rejoice over her, all who love her. Rejoice greatly with her, all who mourn over her,
so that you may nurse and be satisfied at her comforting breasts; you may drink deeply and delight yourselves in her glorious abundance.
For this is what the LORD says: “I will extend peace to her like a river, and the wealth of nations like a flowing stream; you will nurse and be carried on her arm, and bounced upon her knees.
As a mother comforts her son, so will I comfort you, and you will be consoled over Jerusalem.”
When you see, you will rejoice, and you will flourish like grass; then the hand of the LORD will be revealed to His servants.
“And I, knowing their deeds and thoughts, am coming to gather all nations and tongues, and they will come and see My glory.

I will establish a sign among them, and I will send survivors from among them to the nations—to Tarshish, Put, and the archers of Lud; to Tubal, Javan, and the islands far away who have not heard of My fame or seen My glory. So they will proclaim My glory among the nations.

And they will bring all your brothers from all the nations as a gift to the LORD on horses and chariots and wagons, on mules and camels, to My holy mountain Jerusalem,” says the LORD, “just as the Israelites bring an offering in a clean vessel to the house of the LORD.”
“And I will select some of them as priests and Levites,” says the LORD.
“For just as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, will endure before Me,” declares the LORD, “so your descendants and your name will endure.
From one New Moon to another and from one Sabbath to another, all mankind will come to worship before Me,” says the LORD.”

Kaisi akeli rah gai hai, yah nagri jismein kabhi insaanon ka baahuly hua karta tha! Kaisa vidhva ke sadrish svarup ho gaya hai iska, jo raashtron mein sarvotkrisht hua karti thi! Jo kabhi pradeshon ke beech raajkumaari thi aaj bandi ban chuki hai.

Raatri mein bilakh-bilakhkar roti rahti hai, ashru uske gaalon par sukhte hi nahin. Uske kai-kai premiyon mein ab use saantvna dene ke lie koi bhi shesh na raha. Uske sabhi mitron ne usse chhal kiya hai; vastuth ve to ab uske dushman ban baithe hain.

Yahudiya ke nirvaasan ka kaaran tha uski dard aur uska kathor daasatv. Ab vah dusre raashtron ke beech mein hi hai; lekin uske lie ab koi vishraam sthal shesh na rah gaya; uski dard hi ki situation mein ve jo uska pichha kar rahe the, unhonne use ja pakra.

Ziyon ke raasta vilaap ke hain, nirdhaarit utsvon ke lie koi bhi nahin pahunch raha. Sab shehar pravesh dvaar sunsaan hain, priest karaah rahe hain, navyuvtiyon ko ghasita gaya hai, nagri ka kasht daarun hai.

Aaj uske dushman hi adhyaksh bane baithe hain; aaj samriddhi uske dushmanon ke paksh mein hai. Kyonki Yahweh ne hi use pirit kiya hai. Kyonki uske apraadh asankhy the. Uske baalak uske dekhte-dekhte hi dushman dvaara bandhuaai mein le jaae gae hain.

Ziyon ki putri se uske vaibhav ne vida le li hai. Uske adhikaari ab us hiran-sadrish ho gae hain, jise charaagaah hi receive nahin ho raha; ve unke samaksh, jo unka pichha kar rahe hain, balhin hokar bhaag rahe hain.

Ab in dard ke dinon mein, in bhatkaane ke dinon mein Yerushalem ko smaran a raha hai vah yug, jab vah amuly vastuon ki svaamini thi. Jab uske naagrik dushmanon ke authority mein ja pare, jab madad ke lie koi bhi na rah gaya. Uske dushman bare hi santosh ke bhaav mein use nihaar rahe hain, vastuth ve uske patan ka uphaas kar rahe hain.

Yerushalem ne ghor galti kiya hai parinaamasvrup vah ashuddh ho gai. Un sabko usse nafrat ho gai, jinke lie vah saamaany thi, kyonki ve uski nirlajjta ke pratyakshdarshi hain; vastuth ab to vahi karaahte hue apna chehra pher rahi hai.

Uski gandgi to uske kapdon mein thi; usne apne bhavishy ka koi dhyaan na rakha. Isliye uska patan aisa ghor hai; ab kisi se bhi use saantvna receive nahin ho rahi. “Yahweh, meri dard par nazar kijie, kyonki jay dushman ki hui hai.”

Dushman ne apni bhujaaein uske sab gaurav ki or vistirn kar rakhi hai; uske dekhte-dekhte jantaaon ne uske holy jagah mein balaat pravesh kar liya hai, us holy jagah mein, jahaan pravesh aapki sabha tak ke lie varjit tha.

Uske sabhi naagrik karaahte hue khaana ki khoj kar rahe hain; ve apni mulyvaan vastuon ka vinimay khaana ke lie kar rahe hain, ki unmein power ka sanchaar ho sake. “Yahweh, dekhie, dhyaan se dekhie, kyonki main nafrat ka paatr ho chuki hun.”

“Tum sabhi ke lie, jo is raasta se hokar nikal jaate ho, kya yah tumhaare lie kuchh bhi nahin? Khoj karke dekh lo. Ki kahin bhi kya mujh par aai vedna jaisi dekhi gai hai, mujhe di gai vah daarun vedna, jo Yahweh ne apne ugr kop ke din mujh par prabhaavi kar di hai?

“Yahi sab mere rone ka kaaran hain aur mere netron se ho raha ashrupaat bahta hai. Kyonki mujhse bahut dur hai saantvna denevaala, jismein mujhmein navjivan sanchaar karne ki kshamta hai. Mere baalak ab nisshaay rah gae hain, kyonki dushman prabal ho gaya hai.”

Ziyon ne apne haath phailaae hain, koi bhi nahin, jo use saantvna de sake. Yaakob ke sambandh mein Yahweh ka order prasaarit ho chuka hai, ki ve sabhi jo Yaakob ke aas-paas bane rahte hain, vastuth ve uske dushman hain; unke beech ab Yerushalem ek ghrinit vastu hokar rah gaya hai.
“Yahweh sachcha hain, phir bhi vidroh to mainne unke order ke khilaaf kiya hai. Ab sabhi log yah sun lein; aur meri is vedna ko dekh lein. Mere yuvak aur yuvtiyaan bandhuaai mein ja chuke hain.

“Mainne apne premiyon ko pukaara, lekin unhonne mujhe dhokha de diya. Mere priest aur mere purvaj shehar mein hi barbaad ho chuke hain, jab ve khud apni khoi power ki punahpraapti ke purpose se khaana khoj rahe the.

“Yahweh, meri or nazar kijie! Kyonki main dard mein dubi hui hun, bahut prachand hai meri aatma ki vedna, apne is vikat vidroh ke kaaran mere antar mein mera dil bahut vyagr hai. Baahar to talvaar sanhaar mein sakriy hai; yahaan aavaas mein maano maut vyaapt hai.

“Unhonne meri karaahat sun li hai, koi na raha jo mujhe saantvna de sake. Mere sab dushmanon tak mere is vinaash ka samaachaar pahunch chuka hai; aapne jo kiya hai, us par ve khushi manaate hain. Uttam to yah hota ki aap us din ka sutrpaat kar dete jiski aap purvghoshna kar chuke hain, ki mere dushman mere sadrish ho jaate.

“Unki sab dushkriti aapke samaksh reveal ho jaae; aap unke saath vahi vyavhaar karein, jaisa aapne mere saath kiya hai mere sab apraadh ke parinaamasvrup. Gahan hai meri karaahat aur shuny rah gaya hai mera manobal.”

Uske pravesh dvaar zameen mein dhans gae; unhonne uski suraksha chharon ko torkar barbaad kar diya hai. Uske raaja aur shaasak ab raashtron mein hain, niyam-law ab shuny rah gai hai, ab uske prophets ko Yahweh ki or se prakaashan receive hi nahin hota.
Ziyon ki putri ke purvaj zameen par maun baithe hue hain; unhonne apne sir par dhul daal rakhi hai aur unhonne taat pahan li hai. Yerushalem ki yuvtiyon ke sir zameen ki or jhuke hain.

Rote-rote mere netr apni roshni kho chuke hain, mere udar mein manthan ho raha hai; mera pitt zameen par bikhra para hai; iske pichhe sirf ek hi kaaran hai; meri people ki putri ka sarvnaash, shehar ki galiyon mein murchchhit pare hue shishu aur baalak.

Ve apni-apni maataaon ke samaksh rokar kah rahe hain, “Kahaan hai hamaara khaana, kahaan hai hamaara draakshaaras?” Ve shehar ki gali mein ghaayal yoddha ke jaisa pare hain, apni-apni maataaon ki god mein pare hue unka life jaan chhor rahe hai.

Yerushalem ki putri, kya kahun main tumse, kisse karun main tumhaari tulna? Ziyon ki kunvaari kanya, tumhaari saantvna ke lakshy se kisse karun main tumhaara saamy? Tathy yah hai ki tumhaara vidhvans mahaasaagar ke sadrish vyaapak hai. Ab kaun tumhein changa kar sakta hai?

Tumhaare prophets ne tumhaare lie vyarth aur jhutha prakaashan dekha hai; unhonne tumhaari galti ko prakaashit nahin kiya, ki tumhaari samriddhi punahsthaapit ho jaae. Lekin ve tumhaare santosh ke lie aise prakaashan prastut karte rahein, jo vyarth aur bhraamak the.

Ve sab jo is or se nikalte hain tumhaari situation ko dekhkar uphaas karte hue; Yerushalem ki putri par sir hilaate aur vichitr dhvani nikaalte hain: ve soch karte hain, “Kya yahi hai vah nagri, jo param saundaryavti aur sab prithvi ka ullaas thi?”

Tumhaare sabhi dushman tumhaare lie apmaanpurn words ka prayog karte hue; vichitr dhvaniyon ke saath daant piste hue uchch svar mein ghoshna karte hain, “Dekho, dekho! Hamne use nigal liya hai! Aah, kitni pratiksha ki hai hamne is din ki; nishchyath aaj vah din a gaya hai aaj vah hamaari nazar ke samaksh hai.”

Ziyon ki putri ki divaar uchch svar mein apne Lord ki dohaai do. Din aur raatri apne ashruprvaah ko ugr jaldhaara-sadrish pravaahit karti raho; khud ko koi raahat na do, aur na tumhaari aankhon ko aaraam.

Utho, raatri mein dohaai do, raatri prahar shuruaat hote hi; paani-sadrish undel do apna dil apne Lord ki upasthiti mein. Apni children ke kalyaan ke lie apne haath unki or barhaao, us children ke lie, jo bhukh se har ek gali ke mor par murchhit ho rahi hai.

“Yahweh, dhyaan se dekhkar soch kijie: kaun hai vah, jiske saath aapne is tarah ka vyavhaar kiya hai? Kya yah susangat hai ki striyaan apne hi garbh ke phal ko aahaar banaaein, jinka unhonne khud hi follow poshan kiya hai? Kya yah upyukt hai ki priests aur prophets ka sanhaar hamaare Lord ke holy jagah mein kiya jaae?
“Sarak ki dhuli mein yuvaaon aur vriddhon ke shav pare hue hain; mere yuvak, yuvtiyon ka sanhaar talvaar se kiya gaya hai. Apne kop-divas mein aapne unka nirdaytaapurvak sanhaar kar daala hai.

“Aapne to mere aatankon ka aahvaan chaaron or se is dhang se kiya, maano aap inhein kisi utsav ka aamantran de rahe hain. Yah sab Yahweh ke kop ke din hua hai, ismein koi bhi bachkar shesh na rah saka; ye ve sab the, jinka aapne apni god mein rakhkar follow poshan kiya tha, mere dushmanon ne unka sarvnaash kar diya hai.”
Sabhi ke lie ab to main uphaas paatr hun; saare din unke vyangy-baan mujh par chhore jaate hain.
Shaanti ne meri aatma ka saath chhor diya hai; mujhe to smaran hi nahin raha ki sukh-aanand kya hota hai.
Isliye mujhe yahi kahna par raha hai, “Na mujhmein sabr shesh raha hai aur na hi Yahweh se koi ummid.”
Smaran kijie meri dard aur meri bhatkan, vah naagdaun aur vah karvaahat.
Meri aatma ko iska smaran aata rahta hai, mera manobal shuny hua ja raha hai.
Meri ummid sirf is smriti ke aadhaar par jivit hai:
Yahweh ka mercy-love, ke hi kaaran ham bhasm nahi hote! Kabhi bhi unki grace ka hraas nahin hota.
Prati praath ve nae paae jaate hain; mahaan hai aapki faithfulness.
Meri aatma is tathy ki pushti karti hai, “Yahweh mera ansh hain; isliye unmein meri ummid rakhunga.”
Yahweh ke dear paatr ve hain, jo unke aashrit hain, ve, jo unke khoji hain;
Upyukt yahi hota hai ki ham dhirtaapurvak Yahweh dvaara bachaav ki pratiksha karein.
Lord ka parityaag chirasthaayi nahin hua karta.
Dard dena unka sukh nahin hota na hi insaanon ko yaatna dena unka khushi hota hai.
Prithvi ke sab bandiyon ka daman,
Param leader ki upasthiti mein justice-vanchna,
Kisi ki justice-dohaai mein ki gai vikriti mein Yahweh ka samarthan kadaapi nahin hota?
Aaie ham apne dil aur apni baanhein God ki or unmukh karein aur apne haath svargik God ki or uthaaein:
“Hamaare sabhi dushman bejhijhak hamaare khilaaf ninda ke word uchchaar rahe hain.
Aatank, jokhim, vinaash aur vidhvans ham par a pare hain.”
Meri people ke is vinaash ke kaaran mere netron ke ashruprvaah nadi sadrish ho gae hain.
Bina kisi vishraanti mera ashrupaat hota rahega,
Jab tak heaven se Yahweh is or drishtipaat na kareinge.
Apni nagri ki sab putriyon ki niyti ne mere netron ko pirit kar rakha hai.
Unhonne, jo akaaran hi mere dushman ho gae the, pakshi sadrish mera aher kiya hai.
Unhonne to mujhe gaddhe mein jhonk mujh par patthar lurhka die hain;
Jab paani satah mere sir tak pahunchne lagi, main soch karne laga, ab main mit jaaunga.
Gaddhe se mainne, Yahweh aapki dohaai di.
Aapne meri is dohaai sun li hai: “Meri vimukti ke lie ki gai meri pukaar ki or se, apne kaan band na kijie.”
Jab mainne aapki dohaai di, aap nikat a gae; aapne aashvaasan diya, “Daro mat.”
Lord aapne mera paksh lekar; mere life ko suraksha provide ki hai.
Yahweh, aapne vah anyaay dekh liya hai, jo mere saath kiya gaya hai. Ab aap mera justice kijie!
Unke dvaara liya gaya badla aapki nazar mein hai, unke dvaara rache gae sabhi sharyantr aapko jnaat hain.
Yahweh, aapne unke dvaara kie gae vyangy sune hain, unke dvaara rache gae sabhi sharyantr aapko jnaat hain—
Mere hatyaaron ke dil mein saare din jo soch ubharte hain honthon se nikalte hain, mere khilaaf hi hote hain.
Aap hi dekh lijie, unka uthna-baithna, main hi hun unka vyangy-git.
Sona khota kaise ho gaya, sone mein khot kaise! Har ek gali ke mor par holy patthar bikhre pare hain.
Ziyon ke ve utkrisht son, jinka muly utkrisht svarn ke tuly hai, ab mitti ke paatron-sadrish kumhaar ki hastkriti maane ja rahe hain!
Siyaar apne bachchon ko stanpaan karaati hai, lekin meri people ki putri krur ho chuki hai, marubhumi ke shuturmurgon ke sadrish.
Atishay trishna ke kaaran dudhmunhe shishu ki jibh uske taalu se chipak gai hai; baalak khaana ki yaachna karte hain, lekin koi bhi khaana nahin de raha.
Jinka aahaar utkrisht khaana hua karta tha, aaj galiyon mein barbaad hue ja rahe hain. Jinke paridhaan baingni kapde hua karte the, aaj bhasm mein baithe hue hain.
Meri people ki putri par para adharm sodom ke dand se kahin adhik prachand hai, kisi ne haath tak nahin lagaaya aur dekhte hi dekhte uska sarvnaash ho gaya.
Us nagri ke shaasak to him se adhik vishuddh, dugdh se adhik shvet the, unki deh munge se adhik gulaabi, unki deh rachna nilam ke saundary se bhi adhik utkrisht thi.
Ab unhin ke mukhmandal shyaamvarn rah gae hain; raasta chalte hue unhein pahchaanna sambhav nahin raha. Unki tvacha sikur kar asthiyon se chipak gai hai; vah kaath-sadrish shushk ho chuki hai.
Ve hi shreshthtar kahe jaaeinge, jinki maut talvaar prahaar se hui thi, unki apeksha, jinki maut bhukh se hui; jo ghul-ghul kar kuch kar gae kyonki khet mein upaj na ho saki thi.
Ye un karunaamyi maataaon ke hi haath the, jinhonne apni hi children ko apna aahaar bana liya, jab meri people ki putri vinaash ke kaal mein thi ye baalak unka aahaar banaae gae the.
Na to duniya ke raajaaon ko, aur na hi prithvi ke nivaasiyon ko iska faith hua, ki virodhi aur dushman Yerushalem ke pravesh dvaaron se pravesh pa sakega.
Ab ve shehar ki galiyon mein drishtihinon-sadrish bhatak rahe hain; ve rakt se aise dushit ho chuke hain ki koi bhi unke kapdon ko sparsh karne ka saahas nahin kar pa raha.

Unhein dekh log chilla uthte hai, “Dur, dur ashuddh! Dur, dur! Mat chhuna use!” Ab ve chhipte, bhaagte bhatak rahe hain, raashtron mein sabhi yahi kahte phirte hain, “Ab ve hamaare beech mein nivaas nahin kar sakte.”
Hamaare netr drishtihin ho gae, madad ki ummid vyarth siddh hui; hamne us raashtr se madad ki ummid ki thi, jismein hamaari madad ki kshamta hi na thi.

Unhonne is riti se hamaara pichha karna shuruaat kar diya, ki raasta par hamaara aana-jaana dubhar ho gaya; hamaari maut nikat aati gai, hamaara jivankaal simatta chala gaya, vastuth hamaara life samaapt hi ho gaya tha.
Ve, jo hamaara pichha kar rahe the, unki gati aakaashgaami garuron se bhi drut thi; unhonne parvton tak hamaara pichha kiya aur nirjan pradesh mein ve hamaari ghaat mein rahe.
Yahweh dvaara abhishikt, hamaare life ki saans unke phandon mein ja phanse. Hamaara soch to yah raha tha, ki unki chhatrchhaaya mein ham raashtron ke beech nivaas karte raheinge.
Yahweh, smaran kijie hamne kya-kya saha hai; hamaari ninda par dhyaan dijie.
Hamaara bhaag aprichiton ko diya gaya hai, pardeshiyon ne hamaare aavaas apna lie hain.
Ham anaath aur pitrihin ho gae hain, hamaari maataaon ki situation vidhvaaon ke sadrish ho chuki hai.
Yah zaruri hai ki ham pey paani ke muly ka bhugtaan karein; jo kaath hamein diya jaata hai, uska kray kiya jaana anivaary hai.
Ve jo hamaara pichha kar rahe hain, hamaare nikat pahunch chuke hain; ham thak chuke hain, hamein vishraam receive na ho saka hai.
Paryaapt khaana ke lie hamne misr aur ashshur ki adhinta accept kar li hai.
Jo kabhi hamaare slave the, aaj hamaare shaasak bane hue hain, koi bhi nahin, jo hamein unki adhinta se vimukt kare.
Apne praanon ka jokhim uthaakar ham apne khaana ki law karte hain, kyonki nirjan pradesh mein talvaar hamaare pichhe lagi rahti hai.
Durbhiksh ki ushma ne hamaari tvacha aisi kaaligard ho gai hai, maano yah tandur hai.
Ziyon mein striyaan bhrasht kar di gai hain, Yahudiya ke shehron ki kanyaaein.
Shaaskon ko unke haathon se latka diya gaya hai; purvjon ko koi sammaan nahin diya ja raha.
Yuvaaon ko chakki chalaane ke lie baadhy kiya ja raha hai; kishor latthon ke bojh se larakhra rahe hain.
Praurh shehar pravesh dvaar se shehar chhor ja chuke hain; yuvaaon ka sambandh sangit se tut chuka hai.
Hamaare dil mein ab koi ullaas na raha hai; nrity ki abhivyakti ab vilaap ho gai hai.
Hamaare sir ka mukut dhul mein ja para hai. Dhikkaar hai ham par, hamne galti kiya hai!
Parinaamasvrup hamaare dil rugn ho gae hain, inhin se hamaare netr dhundhle ho gae hain
Isliye ki ziyon parvat nirjan ho chuka hai, vahaan lomriyon ko vichran karte dekha ja sakta hai.
Lekin Yahweh, aapka shaasan chirkaalik hai; pirhi se pirhi tak aapka sinhaasan sthaayi rahta hai.
Aapne hamein hamesha ke lie vismrit kyon kar diya hai? Aapka yah parityaag itna dirghkaalin kyon?
Hamse apne sambandh punahsthaapit kar lijie, ki hamaari punahsthaapna ho jaae; Yahweh, vahi purvyug lauta laaie
Yahudiya ke raaja yahoiyaakim ke shaasan ke tisre varsh mein, baabel ke raaja nabukadnejzar ne aakar Yerushalem ko gher liya.

Aur Lord ne Yahudiya ke raaja yahoiyaakim ko God ke temple ke kuchh paatron sahit nabukadnejzar ke adhin kar diya. In chizon ko vah shinaar desh mein apne devta ke temple mein le aaya aur vah unhein apne devta ke koshaagaar mein rakh diya.
Tab raaja ne apne darbaar ke adhikaariyon ke leader aishpenaaj ko order diya ki raajaprivaar aur kulin varg ke kuchh israaeliyon ko raaja ki service mein laaya jaay—

Ye aise javaan hon, jinmein kisi tarah ka shaaririk khot na ho, sundar hon, har tarah ki baat sikhne ki power ho, achchhe jaankaar hon, turant samajhnevaale hon, aur raaja ke mahal mein service karne ki yogyta ho. Raaja ne leader ko order diya ki inhein baabelvaasiyon ki bhaasha aur saahity ki teaching de.

Raaja ne apne khud ke khaana padaarthon mein se unhein pratidin ka khaana aur daakhamdhu dene ki command di. Raaja ne yah bhi kaha ki unhein tin varsh tak prashikshit kiya jaae, aur uske baad unhein raaja ke service mein laaya jaay.
Jo chune gaye the, unmein se kuchh Yahudah ke vansh ke the: daaniel, hanniyaah, mishaael aur azriyaah.
Leader adhikaari ne unhein naye naam diye: daaniel ko bailshatsar, hanniyaah ko shadrakh, mishaael ko meshekh aur azriyaah ko abed-nago.

Par daaniel ne yah nishchay kar liya ki vah shaahi khaana aur daakhamdhu sevan karne ke dvaara khud ko ashuddh nahin karega aur is tarah se apne aapko ashuddh na karne ke liye usne leader adhikaari se anumti maangi.
God ne adhikaari ke man mein yah baat daal di ki vah daaniel ke prati kripaadrishti aur daya dikhaaye,

Par adhikaari ne daaniel se kaha, “Mujhe apne Lord raaja ka dar hai, jinhonne tumhaare khaane-pine ki vastuon ka nirdhaaran kiya hai. Kahin aisa na ho ki vah tumhein tumhaare umr ke dusre javaanon se kamjor dekhe? Aur tab tumhaare kaaran, raaja mujhe maar daale.”
Tab daaniel ne us pahredaar se kaha, jise leader adhikaari ne daaniel, hanniyaah, mishaael aur azriyaah ke dekhbhaal ke lie thahraaya tha,
“Grace kar aap das din tak apne servants ko parakhkar dekhein: khaane ke liye hamein sirph saag-paat aur pine ke liye sirph paani diya jaae.
Tab hamaare body se un javaanon ki tulna kiya jaae, jo shaahi khaana khaate hain, aur uske baad aapko jaisa dikhe uske hisaab se aap apne servants se vyavhaar karein.”
Pahredaar ne uski baat maan li aur das din tak unhein parakhkar dekha.
Das din ke baad ve un javaanon se jyaada svasth aur hrisht-pusht dikhe, jo shaahi khaana karte the.
Isliye pahredaar ne unke lie thahraae uttam khaana aur daakhamdhu ko hataakar unhein badle mein saag-paat dene laga.
In chaaron javaanon ko God ne sab tarah ke saahity aur vidya ka knowledge aur samajh di. Aur daaniel sab tarah ke darshnon aur svapnon ko bhi samajh leta tha.
Tab jitne din baad raaja ne un javaanon ko apni service mein laane ke liye kaha tha, utne dinon ke pure hone par leader adhikaari unhein nabukadnejzar ke saamne le gaya.
Raaja ne sab javaanon se baatein ki aur uski najar mein daaniel, hanniyaah, mishaael aur azriyaah ke baraabar koi dusre javaan na thahra; isliye ve raaja ki service mein chun liye gae.
Samajh aur samajh ke baare mein raaja ne unse jitne bhi savaal kie, ve raaja ke saare raajy ke sab jyotishiyon aur taantrikon se das guna uttam paaye gae.
Aur daaniel raaja koresh ke shaasankaal ke pahle saal tak vahaan service karta raha.
Nabukadnejzar ne apne shaasankaal ke dusre saal mein svapn dekhe; jisse uska man vyaakul ho gaya aur vah so na saka.
Isliye raaja ne order diya ki jaadugron, tonhon, taantrikon aur jyotishiyon ko bulaaya jaae ki ve raaja ko uska svapn bataaein. Jab ve aakar raaja ke saamne khare hue,
To raaja ne unse kaha, “Mainne ek svapn dekha hai jo mujhe vyaakul kar raha hai aur main jaanna chaahta hun ki iska matlab kya hai.”
Tab jyotishiyon ne raaja ko javaab diya, “Raaja chiranjivi hon! Aap apna svapn apne servants ko bataaiye, aur ham uska arth bataaeinge.”

Raaja ne jyotishiyon ko javaab diya, “Mainne yah drirh nishchay kiya hai: yadi tum log mujhe svapn sahit uska arth nahin bataaoge, to main tumhein tukre-tukre kar dunga aur tumhaare gharon ko kachre ke dher mein badal dunga.
Par yadi tum svapn ko bataakar uska arth bhi bataate ho, to tumko uphaar aur inaam aur bahut aadarmaan diya jaaega. Isliye tum mujhe svapn bataao aur uska arth bhi bataao.”
Ek baar phir unhonne javaab diya, “Raaja apna svapn apne servants ko bataaein, aur ham uska arth bataaeinge.”
Raaja ne javaab diya, “Mujhe pura nishchay ho gaya hai ki tum log samay ko taalne ki koshish kar rahe ho, kyonki tum samajh chuke ho ki mainne yah drirh nishchay kar liya hai:

Yadi tum mujhe svapn nahin bataate ho, to tumhaare liye sirph ek hi dand hai. Yah ummid karte hue ki paristhiti badlegi, tum logon ne mujhse jhuthi aur buri baatein kahne ka sharyantr racha hai. Isliye ab, tum mujhe mera svapn bataao, aur tab main jaan lunga ki tum mujhe us svapn ka arth bhi bata sakte ho.”

Jyotishiyon ne raaja ko javaab diya, “Prithvi par aisa koi person nahin jo raaja ke is puchhe gaye savaal ka uttar de sake! Par to bhi na to kisi bare aur shaktishaali raaja ne kisi jaadugar ya tonha ya jyotishi se kabhi is tarah ki koi baat puchhi hai.
Raaja jo baat puchh rahe hain, vah bahut kathin hai. Devtaaon ko chhor, aur koi raaja ko yah baat nahin bata sakta, aur devta maanav praani ke bich nahin rahte.”
Yah sunkar raaja itna krodhit aur aag babula ho gaya ki usne baabel ke sab wise logon ko maar daalne ki command de di.
Isliye sab wise logon ko maar daalne ka order nikaala gaya, aur logon ko daaniel aur uske mitron ke khoj mein bheja gaya ki ve bhi maar daale jaaein.
Jab raaja ke angrakshkon ka leader aariokh, baabel ke wise logon ko maar daalne ke liye nikla tha, to daaniel ne usse buddhimaani aur vyavhaar kushalta se baat ki.
Usne raaja ke adhikaari se puchha, “Raaja ne aisa kathor order kyon nikaala hai?” Tab aariokh ne daaniel ko vah baat bataai.
Yah jaankar daaniel raaja ke paas gaya aur kuchh samay dene ki maang ki, taaki vah raaja ko uske svapn ka arth bata sake.
Tab daaniel apne ghar lauta aur usne apne mitron hanniyaah, mishaael aur azriyaah ko is baare mein bataaya.
Usne unko utsaahit kiya ki ve heaven ke God se is rahasy ke baare mein grace karne ki binti karein, taaki vah aur uske mitr baabel ke baaki wise logon ke saath na maar daale jaaein.
Raat ke samay vah rahasy ek darshan ke taur par daaniel par pragat hua. Tab daaniel ne heaven ke God ki glory ki
Aur kaha: “God ke naam ki glory hamesha-hamesha hoti rahe; kyonki samajh aur power uski hai.
Vahi hain, jo samay aur rituon ko badalte hain; ve raajaaon ko gaddi se hataate aur dusron ko gaddi par baithaate hain. Ve wise ko samajh aur samajhdaar ko knowledge dete hain.
Ve gurh aur chhipi baaton ko pragat karte hain; ve jaante hain ki andhere mein kya rakha hai, aur unke saath prakaash bana rahta hai.

He mere purvjon ke God, main aapko thanks deta aur aapki prashansa karta hun: kyonki aapne mujhe samajh aur power di hai, aapne mujhe vah baat bataai hai jo hamne aapse puchhi, aapne ham par raaja ke svapn ko pragat kiya hai.”

Tab daaniel, aariokh ke paas gaya jise raaja ne baabel ke wise logon ko maar daalne ke liye niyukt kiya tha, aur usne aariokh se kaha, “Baabel ke wise logon ko maar daalne ka kaam rok dijie. Mujhe raaja ke paas le chalie, aur main raaja ko unke svapn ka arth bataaunga.”
Aariokh turant daaniel ko raaja ke paas le gaya aur usne raaja se kaha, “Yahudiya se bandhuaai mein aaye logon ke bich mujhe ek aisa person mila hai, jo raaja ko uske svapn ka arth bata sakta hai.”
Raaja ne daaniel se puchha (jise bailshatsar bhi kaha jaata tha), “Kya tum is yogy ho ki mainne svapn mein jo dekha hai use aur uska arth bata sako?”
Daaniel ne javaab diya, “Raaja jis rahasy ke baare mein puchh rahe hain, uske baare mein koi bhi wise person, jyotishi, jaadugar ya bhavishy bataanevaala raaja ko kuchh nahin bata sakta,

Lekin heaven mein ek God hain, jo rahasyon ko pragat karte hain. Unhonne ne hi raaja nabukadnejzar ko dikhaaya hai ki aanevaale dinon mein kya honevaala hai. Jab aap apne palang par lete hue the, tab aapne jo svapn aur darshan dekhe, ve ye hain:
“Mahaaraaj, jab aap apne palang par lete the, tab aapka man bhavishy mein honevaali ghatnaaon ki or ho gaya, aur rahasyon ke pragat karnevaale ne aapko dikhaaya ki bhavishy mein kya honevaala hai.

Jahaan tak meri baat hai, to yah rahasy mujh par isliye reveal nahin kiya gaya ki mere paas kisi aur jivit person se jyaada samajh hai, par isliye ki mahaaraaj ko rahasy ka arth maalum ho jaae aur aap samajh jaaein ki aapke man mein kya aaya tha.
“Mahaaraaj, aapne dekha ki aapke saamne ek bari murti khari thi—ek bahut bari, chaundhiyaanevaali murti, dikhne mein adbhut.
Us murti ka sir shuddh sone se bana tha, uski chhaati aur bhujaaein chaandi ki, uska pet aur jaanghein kaanse ki,
Uske taange lohe ki aur uske paanv kuchh lohe ke aur kuchh seinke gaye mitti ke the.
Jab aap dekh rahe the, to ek chattaan bina kisi maanviy koshish ke apne aap katkar aai aur us murti ke lohe aur mitti ke paanv ko aisi thokar maari ki ve chur-chur ho gae.

Tab loha, mitti, kaansa, chaandi aur sona sab tutkar tukre-tukre ho gae aur grishmkaal mein khalihaan ke bhunse ke jaisa ho gaye. Hava unko aise ura le gai ki unka koi chhota tukra bhi na bacha. Par jis chattaan ne murti ko thokar maari thi, vah chattaan ekaaek bahut bara pahaar ban gai aur saari prithvi mein phail gai.
“Yahi tha aapka svapn, aur ab ham raaja ko uska arth bataaeinge.
He mahaaraaj, aap to raajaaon ke raaja hain. Heaven ke God ne aapko raajy aur authority aur power aur glory di hai;

Aapke adhin, unhonne sab maanav praani aur zameen ke jaanvar aur aakaash ke pakshiyon ko kar diya hai. Ve jahaan kahin bhi rahte hain, God ne aapko unke upar shaasak thahraaya hai. Murti ke sone ka vah sir aap hi hain.
“Aapke baad ek dusre raajy ka uday hoga jo aapke raajy se nichle star ka hoga. Uske baad, ek tisre raajy ka uday hoga, jo kaanse ka pratirup hoga, jiska shaasan sampurn prithvi par hoga.

Aakhiri mein, ek chautha raajy hoga jo lohe ki tarah majbut hoga—kyonki loha sab chizon ko torta aur chur-chur kar deta hai—aur jaise ki loha chizon ko torkar tukre-tukre kar deta hai, vaise hi yah raajy bhi dusre sabhi raajyon ko kuchalkar tukre kar dega.

Jaisa ki aapne dekha ki paanv aur ungliyaan kuchh seinke gaye mitti aur kuchh lohe ki thin, isliye yah ek vibhaajit raajy hoga; phir bhi ismein kuchh lohe ka bal hoga, jaisa ki aapne lohe ko mitti ke saath mila hua dekha.
Jaise ki paanv ki ungliyaan kuchh loha aur kuchh mitti ki thi, isliye yah raajy kuchh to majbut aur kuchh nirbal hoga.
Aur jaisa ki aapne lohe ko seinke gaye mitti ke saath mila hua dekha, vaise hi logon ka mishran hoga aur unmein ekta na hogi, kyonki loha mitti ke saath mel nahin khaata.

“Un raajaaon ke samay mein, heaven ke God ek aise raajy ko sthaapit kareinge, jo kabhi barbaad na hoga aur na hi is par kisi dusre ka shaasan hoga. Yah raajy un sab raajyon ko chur-chur kar dega aur unka ant kar dega, par yah khud sadaakaal tak bana rahega.

Yah us chattaan ke darshan ka arth hai jo insaan ke haathon nahin, lekin apne aap ek pahaar se tutkar alag hui thi aur jisne loha, kaansa, mitti, chaandi aur sona ko tukre-tukre kar diya tha. “Mahaan God ne raaja ko dikhaaya hai ki bhavishy mein kya honevaala hai. Yah svapn saty hai aur iska arth faithful hai.”
Tab raaja nabukadnejzar ne daaniel ko saashtaang dandvat kiya aur use aadar diya aur command di ki daaniel ko bheint charhaai jaay aur uske saamne sugandhit dhup jalaaya jaay.
Raaja ne daaniel se kaha, “Nishchit rup se tumhaare God devtaaon ke God aur raajaaon ke Lord aur rahasyon ke pragatkarta hain, kyonki tum is rahasy ka arth bataane mein yogy thahre.”

Tab raaja ne daaniel ko ek unche pad par thahraaya aur use bahut saare kimti uphaar diye. Raaja ne use saare baabel pradesh ka shaasak banaaya aur baabel ke sab wise logon ke upar use adhikaari thahraaya.
Aur daaniel ke anurodh par raaja ne shadrakh, meshekh aur abed-nago ko baabel pradesh par prashaasak niyukt kar diya, lekin daaniel khud raaj-darbaar mein bana raha.
Raaja nabukadnejzar ne ek sone ki murti banvaai, jiski unchaai lagbhag 25 mitar aur chauraai arhaai mitar thi, aur usne use baabel pradesh mein dura ke maidaan mein sthaapit kiya.

Tab usne haakimon, leaders, raajypaalon, salaahkaaron, khazaanchiyon, nyaayaadhishon, jilaadhishon aur raajy ke dusre sab adhikaariyon ko bulvaaya ki ve aakar us murti ke pratishtha samaaroh mein shaamil hon jise usne sthaapit kiya tha.

Ath haakim, leader, raajypaal, salaahkaar, khajaanchi, nyaayaadhish, jilaadhish aur raajy ke dusre sab adhikaari us murti ke pratishtha ke liye ikatthe hue, jise raaja nabukadnejzar ne sthaapit kiya tha, aur ve sab us murti ke saamne khare hue.
Tab ghoshna karnevaale ne unchi aavaaj mein yah ghoshna ki, “Jaati-jaati aur har bhaasha ke logon, tumhein yah karne ki command di jaati hai:

Jis samay tum log narsinga, baansuri, sitaar, saarangi, vina, shahnaai aur sab tarah ke sangit ki aavaaj suno, usi samay tum girkar sone ke us murti ki worship karo, jise raaja nabukadnejzar ne sthaapit kiya hai.
Jo koi girkar worship nahin karega, use turant dhadhakti aag ki bhatti mein jhonk diya jaaega.”

Isliye jab unhonne narsinga, baansuri, sitaar, saarangi, vina aur har tarah ke sangit ki aavaaj suni, tab sab jaati aur har bhaasha ke logon ne girkar us sone ki murti ki worship ki, jise raaja nabukadnejzar ne sthaapit kiya tha.
Isi samay kuchh jyotishi aakar Yahudiyon par dosh lagaane lage.
Unhonne raaja nabukadnejzar se kaha, “He raaja, aap chiranjivi hon!
Aap hi ne yah raajaajna nikaali hai ki narsinga, baansuri, sitaar, saarangi, vina, shahnaai aur sab tarah ke sangit ki aavaaj sunte hi har person girkar sone ki murti ki worship kare,
Lekin jo koi girkar worship nahin karega, use ek dhadhakti aag ki bhatti mein jhonk diya jaaega.

Par kuchh Yahudi hain, jinhein aapne baabel pradesh ke kaary hetu thahraaya hai—arthaat shadrakh, meshekh aur abed-nago—he mahaaraaj, inhonne aapki command ko nahin maana hai. Ve na to aapke devtaaon ki service karte hain aur na hi aapke dvaara sthaapit sone ki murti ki worship karte hain.”
Gusse se aag babula hokar nabukadnejzar ne shadrakh, meshekh aur abed-nago ko bulvaaya. Tab in tinon ko raaja ke saamne laaya gaya,
Aur nabukadnejzar ne unse puchha, “Shadrakh, meshekh aur abed-nago, kya yah sach hai ki tum mere devtaaon ki service nahin karte ya mere dvaara sthaapit sone ki murti ki worship nahin karte ho?

Ab jab tum narsinga, baansuri, sitaar saarangi, vina, shahnaai aur sab tarah ke sangit ki aavaaj suno, yadi tum girkar mere dvaara banaae gaye murti ki worship karne ko taiyaar ho, to achchhi baat hai. Par yadi tum uski worship nahin karte ho, to tumhein turant ek dhadhakti aag ki bhatti mein jhonk diya jaaega. Tab aisa kaun sa devta hai, jo tumhein mere haath se bacha sakega?”
Shadrakh, meshekh aur abed-nago ne raaja ko javaab diya, “He raaja nabukadnejzar, is baare mein hamein aapke saamne apne aapka bachaav karne ki aavashyakta nahin hai.

Yadi hamein dhadhakti aag ki bhatti mein pheink diya jaata hai, to hamaara God, jinki ham service karte hain, hamein isse bachaane mein samarth hain, aur he mahaaraaj, vah hamein aapke haathon se bhi bachaaeinge.

Par yadi vah hamein na bhi bachaaein, tab bhi, he mahaaraaj, ham aapko bata dena chaahte hain ki ham aapke devtaaon ki service nahin kareinge ya aapke dvaara sthaapit sone ki murti ki worship nahin kareinge.”
Tab nabukadnejzar shadrakh, meshekh aur abed-nago ke upar bahut krodhit hua, aur uski bhaavna unke prati badal gai. Usne command di ki bhatti ko saamaany se saat guna jyaada dhadhkaaya jaae,
Aur usne apni sena ke kuchh sabse balishth sainikon ko order diya ki shadrakh, meshekh aur abed-nago ko baandhkar dhadhakti bhatti mein jhonk diya jaae.
Ath in tinon ko unke pahine gaye labaada, pajaama, pagri aur dusre kapron sahit baandhkar dhadhakti bhatti mein pheink diya gaya.
Raaja ki drirh command thi aur bhatti itni garm thi ki aag ki jvaala se ve sainik maare gaye, jo shadrakh, meshekh aur abed-nago ko bhatti tak le gae the,
Aur ye tinon person—shadrakh, meshekh aur abed-nago achchhe se bandhe hue dhadhakti aag ki bhatti mein daal diye gae.

Tab raaja nabukadnejzar aashchary mein uchhalkar khara ho gaya aur apne salaahkaaron se puchha, “Kya ve tin hi person nahin the, jinhein hamne baandhkar aag mein daala tha?” Unhonne javaab diya, “Nishchit rup se, mahaaraaj.”

Raaja ne kaha, “Dekho! Main aag ke bich chaar logon ko chalte hue dekh raha hun, ve bandhe hue nahin hain aur unhein kuchh bhi haani nahin hui hai, aur chautha person devtaaon ke son jaise dikh raha hai.”

Tab nabukadnejzar dhadhakti bhatti ke muhaane ke paas pahuncha aur unchi aavaaj mein kaha, “Shadrakh, meshekh aur abed-nago, sarvochch God ke sevko, baahar a jaao! Mere paas aao!” Yah sunkar shadrakh, meshekh aur abed-nago aag se baahar nikal aae,

Aur unke chaaron taraph haakimon, leaders, raajypaalon aur shaahi salaahkaaron ki bhir lag gai. Unhonne dekha ki un tinon ke body ko aag se koi nuksaan nahin pahuncha tha, na hi unke sir ka ek bhi baal jhulsa tha; unke kapre bhi nahin jale the, aur unse jalne ki koi gandh nahin a rahi thi.

Tab nabukadnejzar ne kaha, “Shadrakh, meshekh aur abed-nago ke God ki glory ho, jinhonne apne angel ko bhejkar apne servants ko bachaaya! Unhonne us par bharosa kiya aur raaja ke command ki parvaah na ki aur apna jaan dene tak taiyaar the, iske bajaay ki ve apne God ko chhorkar kisi aur devta ki service ya worship karein.

Isliye main yah command deta hun ki kisi bhi jaati ya bhaasha ke log, yadi shadrakh, meshekh aur abed-nago ke God ke khilaaf kuchh bhi kahte hain, to unko kaatkar tukre-tukre kar diya jaae aur unke gharon ko kachre ka dher kar diya jaae, kyonki aisa koi bhi devta nahin, jo is tarah se bacha sake.”
Tab raaja ne shadrakh, meshekh aur abed-nago ko baabel raajy mein aur uchch pad diya.
Raaja nabukadnejzar ki or se, saari prithvi par rahnevaale jaati-jaati aur har bhaasha ke logon ko yah vachan: aap sab ki bahut unnti ho!
Sarvochch God dvaara mere liye kie gae un adbhut chinhon aur aashchary karmon ke baare mein tumhein bataate hue mujhe khushi ho rahi hai.
Kya hi bare hain uske dikhaae chinh, kya hi mahaan hain uske aashcharykarm! Uska raajy ek sadaakaal ka raajy hai; uski prabhuta pirhi-pirhi tak bani rahti hai.
Main, nabukadnejzar apne mahal mein santusht aur sampann tha.
Mainne ek svapn dekha, jisse main bhaybhit ho gaya. Jab main apne palang par leta hua tha, to jo chitr aur darshan mere man mein aaye, unse main bhaybhit ho gaya.
Isliye mainne command di ki baabel ke saare wise log mere saamne laae jaaein ki ve mere svapn ka arth bataaein.
Jab jaadugar, tonhe, taantrik, jyotishi aur daiviy shaktivaale mere paas aaye, to mainne unhein apna svapn bataaya, par ve mujhko uska arth nahin bata sake.
Aakhir mein, daaniel mere saamne aaya aur mainne use apna svapn bataaya. (uska naam mere devta ke naam se bailshatsar rakha gaya hai, aur holy devtaaon ki aatma usmein hai.)

Mainne kaha, “He bailshatsar, jaadugron ka mukhiya, main jaanta hun ki holy devtaaon ki aatma tummein hai aur koi bhi rahasy tumhaare liye kathin nahin hai. Yah mera svapn hai; mujhe iska arth bataao.
Ye ve darshan hain jinhein mainne palang par lete hue dekha: mainne dekha ki prithvi ke bich ek per laga hai. Vah bahut uncha tha.
Vah per bara hokar majbut ho gaya aur iska sira aakaash ko chhune laga; ise saari prithvi ke chhor se bhi dekha ja sakta tha.

Iski pattiyaan sundar thi aur ismein bahut saare phal lage the, aur ismein sabke liye khaana tha. Iske niche jangli jaanvar rahte the, aur aakaash ke pakshi iski shaakhaaon par basera karte the; ismein se har ek jiv-jantu khaana paate the.
“Palang par lete hue mainne darshan mein dekha ki heaven se ek holy jan, ek sandeshvaahak niche a raha tha.

Usne unchi aavaaj mein kaha: ‘Kaat daalo is per ko aur iski shaakhaaon ko alag kar do; iski pattiyon ko gira do aur iske phal ko bikhra do. Jaanvar iske niche se bhaag jaaein aur chiriya iski shaakhaaon se ur jaaein.

Par per ke thunth aur iski jaron ko lohe aur kaansa se bandhe rahkar zamin ke ghaas par, zameen mein rahne do. “ ‘Use aakaash ki os se bhigne do, aur use prithvi ke paudhon ke bich jaanavron ke saath rahne do.
Uska man badal diya jaae aur ek insaan ke jaisa uska man na rahe aur use saat kaalkhand bitne tak ek jaanvar ka man diya jaae.

“ ‘Is nirnay ka ailaan sandeshvaahkon ke dvaara kiya jaata hai, holy jan is nirnay ki ghoshna karte hain, taaki jivit log is baat ko jaanein ki vah jo sarvochch hain, ve hi prithvi par sab raajyon ke upar param leader hain aur ve jise chaahte hain, use un raajyon ko de dete hain aur chhote se chhote person ko unke upar niyukt kar dete hain.’

“Yahi hai vah svapn jise main, raaja nabukadnejzar ne dekha. Ab, he bailshatsar, mujhe bataao ki iska kya arth hai, kyonki mere raajy ka koi bhi wise person mujhe iska arth nahin bata sakta. Par tum bata sakte ho, kyonki tummein holy devtaaon ki aatma hai.”

Tab daaniel (jise bailshatsar bhi kaha jaata tha) thori der ke liye vyaakul ho gaya, aur uske soch use bhaybhit karne lage. Isliye raaja ne kaha, “He bailshatsar, mere svapn ya iske arth se bhaybhit na ho.” Bailshatsar ne javaab diya, “He mere Lord, kaash, yah svapn sirph aapke dushmanon aur iska arth aapke virodhiyon par laagu hota!
Vah per jise aapne dekha, jo bara hokar majbut ho gaya, jiska sira aakaash ko chhune laga tha, aur jise saari prithvi se dekha ja sakta tha,
Jiski pattiyaan sundar aur jismein bahut saare phal the, jisse sabko khaana milta tha, jo jangli jaanavron ko aashray deta tha, aur chiriyaan jiski shaakhaaon par ghonsla banaati thin—
He mahaaraaj, vah per aap hain! Aap bare aur majbut ho gaye hain; aapki mahaanta itni ho gai hai ki yah aakaash ko chhune lagi hai, aur aapka raajy prithvi mein dur-dur tak phail gaya hai.

“He mahaaraaj, aapne ek holy jan, ek sandeshvaahak ko heaven se niche utarte hue dekha jo yah kah raha tha, ‘Is per ko kaat daalo aur ise barbaad kar do, par iske thunth ko, loha aur kaansa se bandhe hue zamin ke ghaans mein rahne do aur iske jaron ko zameen mein chhor do. Use aakaash ki os se bhigne do; use jangli jaanavron ke saath rahne do, jab tak ki uske liye saat kaalkhand pure na ho jaaein.’
“He mahaaraaj, yah uska arth hai, aur yah vah phaisla hai, jise sarvochch God ne mere Lord raaja ke khilaaf diya hai:

Aapko logon ke bich se bhaga diya jaaega aur aap jangli jaanavron ke saath raheinge; aap bail ki tarah ghaans khaaeinge aur aakaash ki os se bhigeinge. Saat kaalkhand ke bitne tak aap isi situation mein raheinge, aur tab aap yah maan leinge ki prithvi par saare raajyon ke upar sarvochch God hi param leader hain aur ve jise chaahte hain use ye raajy de dete hain.
Per ke thunth ko iske jaron sahit chhorne ki jo command di gai hai, uska arth yah hai ki aapko aapka raajy lauta diya jaaega, jab aap yah baat maan leinge ki heaven hi shaasan karta hai.

Isliye, he mahaaraaj, khushi se meri salaah ko maan lijiye: aap apne galtiyon ko chhorkar bhale kaam kariye, aur dushtta ko chhorkar sataaye hue logon par daya kijiye. Tab yah ho sakta hai ki aapki samriddhi hone lage.”
Ye sab baatein raaja nabukadnejzar ke saath hui.
Baarah mahinon ke baad, jab raaja baabel ke raajamhal ke chhat par tahal raha tha,
Tab usne kaha, “Kya yah vah bara baabel nahin hai, jise mainne apne bare power se shaahi nivaas ke taur par apne vaibhav ki glory ke liye banaaya hai?”

Abhi raaja ke ye vachan uske munh se nikle bhi nahin the ki heaven se ek aavaaj aai, “He raaja nabukadnejzar, tumhaare lie yah phaisla kiya jaata hai: tumhaara shaahi authority tumse chhin liya gaya hai.

Tumhein logon ke bich se bhaga diya jaaega aur tum jangli jaanavron ke saath rahoge; tum bail ki tarah ghaans khaaoge. Isi situation mein tumhaare liye saat kaalkhand bitega aur tab tum yah maan loge ki sarvochch God hi prithvi par sab raajyon ke upar param leader hain aur ve jise chaahte hain use in raajyon ko de dete hain.”

Nabukadnejzar ke baare mein jo baat kahi gai, vah usi ghari puri ho gai. Use logon ke bich se bhaga diya gaya aur vah bail ki tarah ghaans khaane laga. Uska body aakaash ki os se bhigta tha, yahaan tak ki uske baal barhkar garur ke pankhon ke jaisa aur uske naakhun chiriyon ke panjon ke jaisa ho gaye.

Nirdhaarit samay ke ant mein, main, nabukadnejzar ne heaven ki or apni nazar uthaai, aur meri maansik avastha phir pahle jaise ho gai. Tab mainne sarvochch God ki glory ki; mainne uska aadar aur prashansa kiya, jo sadaakaal tak jivit rahta hai. Uski prabhuta sadaakaal ki hai; uska raajy pirhi-pirhi tak bana rahta hai.

Prithvi ke saare logon ka koi mahatv nahin hai. Vah jaisa chaahta hai vaisa heaven ki shaktiyon aur prithvi ke logon ke saath karta hai. Use koi bhi rok nahin sakta ya yah kah nahin sakta: “Aapne yah kya kar daala?”

Jis samay meri maansik avastha pahle jaisi ho gai, usi samay mera sammaan aur vaibhav bhi mere raajy ke gaurav hetu mere paas laut aaya. Mere salaahkaaron aur kulin logon ne mujhe dhunrh nikaala, aur mujhe phir se mere sinhaasan par baithaaya gaya aur main pahle se bhi jyaada mahaan ho gaya.

Ab main, nabukadnejzar heaven ke raaja ki praise, glory aur prashansa karta hun, kyonki ve jo bhi karte hain, sahi karte hain aur unke sab yuktiyaan justice sangat hoti hain. Aur jo ghamand se chalte hain, unhein vah namr banaane mein samarth hai.
Raaja bailshatsar ne apne ek hajaar prabhaavshaali logon ko ek bara bhoj diya aur unke saath daakhamdhu pi.

Jab bailshatsar daakhamdhu pi raha tha, tab usne order diya ki jo sone aur chaandi ke pyaale uske pita nabukadnejzar ne Yerushalem ke temple se laae the, unhein laaya jaae, taaki raaja, uske prabhaavshaali log, raaja ki patniyaan aur uski uppatniyaan daakhamdhu pine ke lie unka upyog kar sakein.
Isliye Yerushalem ke God ke temple se nikaalkar laae gae sone ke pyaale laaye gaye, aur raaja aur uske prabhaavshaali log, uski patniyon aur uppatniyon ne unmein daakhamdhu paan kiya.
Ve daakhamdhu pikar sone aur chaandi, kaansa, loha, lakri aur patthar ke devtaaon ki praise karne lage.
Tab achaanak ek maanav haath ki ungliyaan reveal huin aur raajamhal mein divat ke paas divaar ke palastar par kuchh likhne lagin. Likhte hue us haath par raaja ki nazar pari.
Use dekhkar raaja ke chehre ka rang ur gaya aur vah itna dar gaya ki uske pair dhile ho gae aur kaampne se uske ghutne ek dusre se takraane lage.

Tab raaja ne taantrik, jyotishi aur daiviy shaktivaalon ko bulvaaya aur usne baabel ke un wise logon se kaha, “Jo koi is likhaavat ko parhega aur uska arth mujhe bataaega, use raajsi kapde pahnaaya jaaega aur uske gale mein sone ki maala pahnaai jaaegi, aur use raajy mein tisre nambar ka uchch padasth shaasak banaaya jaaega.”
Tab raaja ke sab wise log aae, par ve us divaar par likhi baat ko parh na sake aur na hi ve raaja ko uska arth bata sake.
Isse raaja bailshatsar aur bhaybhit ho gaya aur uska chehre ka rang aur ur gaya. Isse uske prabhaavshaali log bhi pareshaan ho gae.
Raaja aur uske prabhaavshaali logon ki aavaaj sunkar, raani bhoj ke kaksh mein aai aur kahne lagi, “Raaja chiranjivi hon! Aap chinta na karein! Aur aapke chehre ka rang na ure!

Aapke raajy mein ek aisa person hai, jismein holy devtaaon ki aatma rahti hai. Aapke pita ke samay mein is person mein devtaaon ke jaisa samajh-bujh, samajh aur knowledge paayi gai thi. Aapke pita, raaja nabukadnejzar ne use jaadugron, taantrikon, jyontishiyon aur daiviy shaktivaalon ka mukhiya niyukt kiya tha.

Usne aisa kiya kyonki daaniel naamak yah person ke paas, jise raaja bailshatsar naam se pukaarte the, tej dimaag aur knowledge aur samajh thi, aur usmein svapnon ka arth bataane, paheliyon ko samjhaane aur kathin samasyaaon ka hal nikaalne ki yogyta paayi gai thi. Isliye daaniel ko bulva lijie, aur vah aapko likhaavat ka arth bata dega.”
Tab daaniel ko raaja ke saamne laaya gaya, aur raaja ne usse kaha, “Kya tum daaniel ho, aur unmein se ek ho, jinhein mere pita, raaja ne Yahudah se bandhuaai mein laaya tha?
Mainne suna hai ki tummein devtaaon ki aatma rahti hai aur yah bhi ki tummein samajh-bujh, samajh aur asaadhaaran knowledge hai.
Wise aur taantrik log is likhaavat ko parhne aur iska arth bataane ke liye mere paas laaye gae, par ve isko samjha na sake.

Mainne suna hai ki tummein arth bataane aur kathin samasyaaon ka hal nikaalne ki yogyta hai. Yadi tum is lekh ko parhkar iska arth mujhe bata sake, to tumhein raajsi kapre pahnaae jaaeinge aur tumhaare gale mein sone ki maala pahnaai jaaegi, aur tumhein tisra uchch padasth shaasak banaaya jaaega.”

Tab daaniel ne raaja ko javaab diya, “Aap apne uphaaron ko apne paas rakhein aur apne puraskaaron ko kisi aur ko de dein. Phir bhi main yah likhaavat raaja ke liye parhunga aur usko iska arth bhi bataaunga.
“He mahaaraaj, sarvochch God ne aapke pita nabukadnejzar ko raajsatta, mahaanta, glory aur vaibhav diya.

Kyonki God ne use uncha pad diya tha, isliye saari jaati aur har bhaasha ke log aapke pita se darte the aur unka dar maante the. Jinhein vah jaan-dand dena chaahta, unhein vah jaan-dand deta; jinhein vah chhorna chaahta, unhein vah chhor deta; jinhein vah uncha pad dena chaahta, unhein vah uncha pad deta; aur jinhein vah nicha dikhaana chaahta, unhein vah nicha dikhaata.
Par jab ghamand se uska man phul gaya aur uska dil kathor ho gaya, to use raaj sinhaasan se hata diya gaya aur uski pratishtha chhin li gai.

Use logon ke bich se bhaga diya gaya aur use ek jaanvar ka man diya gaya; vah jangli gadhon ke saath rahta tha aur bail ki tarah ghaans khaata tha; aur uska body aakaash ke os se bhigta tha, yah tab tak hota raha, jab tak ki usne yah na maan liya ki prithvi par sab raajyon ke upar sarvochch God hi param leader hain aur ve jise chaahte hain use un raajyon par shaasak thahraate hain.
“Par he bailshatsar, unke bete hokar bhi aapne apne aapko namr nahin kiya, yadypi aap yah sab jaante the.

Varan aapne apne aapko heaven ke Lord se bhi bara bana liya hai. Aapne unke temple se pyaalon ko apne paas manga liya, aur aap aur aapke prabhaavshaali logon ne, aapki patniyon aur aapki uppatniyon ne unmein daakhamdhu piya hai. Aapne chaandi, sona, kaansa, loha, lakri aur patthar ke devtaaon ki glory kiya hai, jo na to dekh sakte hain, na sun sakte hai, aur na hi samajh sakte hain. Par aapne us God ka aadar nahin kiya, jinke haath mein aapka life aur aapke saare kriyaaklaap hain.
Isliye God ne yah haath bheja, jisne yah lekh likha hai.
“Yah vah lekh hai jise likha gaya tha: mane, mane, takel, pharsin
“In words ka arth is tarah hai: “ Mane: God aapke raajy karne ke dinon ki ginti kar chuke hain aur iska ant a chuka hai.
“ Takel: aap taraaju par taule ja chuke hain aur aapko halka paaya gaya hai.
“ Pharsin: aapke raajy ko baant diya gaya hai aur mediyon aur faarsiyon ko de diya gaya hai.”
Tab bailshatsar ki command se daaniel ko raajsi kapre pahnaae gae, uske gale mein sone ki ek maala pahnaain gai, aur raajy mein tisre uchch padasth shaasak ke taur par uski ghoshna ki gai.
Usi raat, kasdiyon ka raaja, bailshatsar maar daala gaya,
Aur iske baad daaryaavesh, jo mediya tha, baasath saal ke umr mein us raajy ka raaja bana.
Daaryaavesh ko yah achchha laga ki vah 120 leader niyukt kare, jo saare raajy mein shaasan karein,
Aur in sabke upar tin prashaasak hon, jinmein se ek daaniel tha. Un leaders ko prashaaskon ke prati uttardaayi banaaya gaya taaki raaja ko kisi tarah ki haani na ho.
Daaniel apni asaadhaaran yogytaaon ke kaaran prashaaskon aur leaders ke bich bahut prasiddh tha, isliye raaja ne use saare raajy ka shaasak banaane ki yojna banaai.

Is par, prashaasak aur leader sarkaari kaaryon mein daaniel ke kriyaaklaapon ke khilaaf dosh lagaane ka aadhaar khojne lage, par ve aisa na kar sake. Unhein usmein koi bhrashtaachaar ki baat na mili, kyonki daaniel faithful tha aur vah na to bhrashtaachaari tha aur na hi vah kisi baat mein asaavdhaani baratta tha.
Aakhir mein, in logon ne kaha, “Uske God ke law ke vishay ko chhor, hamein aur kisi bhi baare mein daaniel ke khilaaf dosh lagaane ka aadhaar nahin milega.”
Isliye ye prashaasak aur leader ek dal ke taur par raaja ke paas gaye aur unhonne kaha: “Raaja daaryaavesh, chiranjivi hon!

Raajy ke sab shaahi prashaasak, mukhiya, leader, salaahkaar, aur raajypaal is baat par sahmat hue ki raaja ek raajaajna nikaale aur us command ko follow karne ke liye kahein ki agle tis dinon tak koi bhi person mahaaraaja ko chhor kisi aur devta ya maanav praani se prayer kare, to vah sinhon ki maand mein daal diya jaae.
He mahaaraaj, ab aap aisi command dein aur ise likhit mein de dein taaki yah badli na ja sake—mediyon aur faarsiyon ke law ke hisaab se jise radd nahin kiya ja sakta.”
Tab raaja daaryaavesh ne us command ko likhit mein kar diya.

Jab daaniel ko maalum hua ki aisi command nikaali gai hai, to vah apne ghar jaakar upar ke kamre mein gaya, jahaan khirkiyaan Yerushalem ki or khuli rahti thi. Din mein tin baar ghutna tekkar usne apne God ko thanks dete hue prayer kiya, jaise ki vah pahle bhi karta tha.
Tab ve person ek dal ke taur par vahaan gaye aur unhonne daaniel ko God se prayer karte aur madad maangte hue paaya.

Ath ve raaja ke paas gaye aur use uske raajaajna ke baare mein kahne lage: “Kya aapne aisi command nahin nikaali hai ki agle tis dinon tak koi bhi person mahaaraaja ko chhor kisi aur devta ya maanav praani se prayer kare, to use sinhon ki maand mein daal diya jaaega?” Raaja ne javaab diya, “Yah command to hai—jise mediyon aur faarsiyon ke law ke hisaab se radd nahin kiya ja sakta.”

Tab unhonne raaja se kaha, “Daaniel, jo Yahudah se laaye gae bandhua logon mein se ek hai, he mahaaraaj, vah aapki ya aapke dvaara nikaale gaye likhit command ki parvaah nahin karta hai. Vah abhi bhi din mein tin baar prayer karta hai.”
Yah baat sunkar raaja bahut udaas hua; usne daaniel ko bachaane ka sankalp kar liya tha aur suryaast hone tak vah daaniel ko bachaane ki har koshish karta raha.

Tab log ek dal ke taur par raaja daaryaavesh ke paas gaye aur unhonne unse kaha, “He mahaaraaj, aap yah baat yaad rakhein ki mediya aur faarsi law ke hisaab se raaja ke dvaara diya gaya koi bhi phaisla ya raajaajna badli nahin ja sakti.”
Tab raaja ne command di, aur ve daaniel ko laakar use sinhon ki maand mein daal diye. Raaja ne daaniel se kaha, “Tumhaara God, jiski service tum nishthaapurvak karte ho, vahi tujhe bachaaein!”

Ek patthar laakar maand ke muhaane par rakh diya gaya, aur raaja ne apne khud ki muharvaali anguthi aur apne prabhaavshaali logon ki anguthiyon se us par muhar laga di, taaki daaniel ki situation mein kisi bhi tarah ka badlaav na kiya ja sake.
Tab raaja apne mahal mein laut aaya gaya aur usne puri raat bina kuchh khaaein aur bina kisi manoranjan ke bitaaya. Aur vah so na saka.
Bare subah, raaja utha aur jaldi se sinhon ki maand par gaya.

Jab vah maand ke paas pahuncha, to usne ek dard bhari aavaaj mein daaniel ko pukaara, “He daaniel, jivit God ke servant, kya tumhaare us God ne tumhein sinhon se bachaakar rakha hai, jiski tum nishthaapurvak service karte ho?”
Tab daaniel ne javaab diya, “He raaja, aap chiranjivi hon!

Mere God ne apna angel bhejkar sinhon ke munh ko band kar diya. Unhonne meri kuchh bhi haani nahin ki, kyonki main uski nazar mein nirdosh paaya gaya. Aur he mahaaraaj, aapke saamne bhi mainne koi apraadh nahin kiya hai.”

Tab raaja ati aanandit hua aur usne command di ki daaniel ko maand se baahar nikaala jaae. Aur jab daaniel ko maand se upar khinchkar baahar nikaala gaya, to usmein kisi bhi tarah ka chot ka nishaan nahin paaya gaya, kyonki usne apne God par bharosa rakha tha.
Tab raaja daaryaavesh ne saari prithvi mein sab jaati aur har bhaasha ke logon ko yah likha: “Aap sab bahut unnti karein!

“Main yah command deta hun ki mere raajy mein har jagah ke log daaniel ke God ka dar maane aur unka aadar karein. “Kyonki vahi jivit God hain aur vah sadaakaal tak bane rahte hain; unka raajy kabhi barbaadi nahin hoga, aur unka prabhutv kabhi samaapt nahin hoga.
Vah chhuraate hain aur vah bachaate hain; vah heaven aur prithvi par chinh aur chamatkaar dikhaate hain. Unhonne daaniel ko sinhon ki power se bachaaya hai.”
Is tarah daaniel, daaryaavesh aur phaaras desh ke koresh ke shaasankaal mein unnti karte gae.
Yahweh ka yah vachan amitai ke son yonaah ke paas pahuncha:
“Utho aur us mahaangar ninveh ko jaao aur uske nivaasiyon ke khilaaf ghoshna karo, kyonki unki dushtta meri nazar mein a gai hai.”

Par yonaah Yahweh ki upasthiti se bhaagne ke purpose se tarshish jaane ke lie yoppa ja pahuncha. Vahaan use ek paani jahaaz mila, jo tarshish jaane par tha. Kiraaya dene ke baad, vah paani jahaaz mein charh gaya ki vah Yahweh ki upasthiti se bhaagkar vah dusre yaatriyon ke saath tarshish pahunch sake.
Tab Yahweh ne samudr par ek prachand aandhi chalaai, aur satah par aisa bhayankar tuphaan utha ki paani jahaaz ke tutne ki situation utpann ho gai.

Sab naavik bhaybhit ho gae aur har ek apne-apne devta ko pukaarne laga. Aur ve paani jahaaz mein ladi hui saamagri ko samudr mein pheinkne lage taaki jahaaz ka bojh kam ho jaae. Lekin is samay yonaah jahaaz ke nichle bhaag mein jaakar gahri nind mein para hua tha.

Jahaaz ka kaptaan uske paas gaya aur use jagaakar kaha, “Tum aisi situation mein kaise so sakte ho? Utho aur apne ishvar ko pukaaro! Sambhav hai ki tumhaara ishvar ham par grace kare aur ham barbaadi hone se bach jaaein.”
Tab naavikon ne ek dusre ko kaha, “Aisa karein, ham chitthi daalkar yah pata karein ki kiske kaaran ham par yah vipatti aai hai.” Tab unhonne chitthi daali aur chitthi yonaah ke naam par nikli.
Is par unhonne yonaah se puchha, “Hamein bata ki ham par yah vipatti kiske kaaran aai hai? Tu kya kaam karta hai? Tu kahaan se a raha hai? Tu kis desh aur kis jaati ka hai?”
Yonaah ne unhein javaab diya, “Main ek ibri hun aur main us Yahweh, heaven ke God ki worship karta hun, jinhonne samudr aur zameen ki srishti ki hai.”
Yah sunkar ve bhaybhit ho gae aur unhonne yonaah se kaha, “Tumne yah kya kar daala?” (kyonki yonaah unhein yah bata chuka tha ki vah Yahweh ki upasthiti se bhaag raha tha.)
Is par unhonne yonaah se puchha, “Ab ham tumhaare saath kya karein ki hamaare liye samudr shaant ho jaae?” Kyonki samudr ki lahrein aur bhi ugr hoti ja rahi thi.
Yonaah ne kaha, “Mujhe uthaakar samudr mein pheink dein. Tab samudr shaant ho jaaega. Kyonki main jaanta hun ki tumhaare upar yah bara tuphaan mere hi kaaran aaya hai.”
Phir bhi, naavikon ne jahaaz ko tat tak le jaane ki bahut koshish ki. Par ve saphal na hue, kyonki samudr pahle se aur ugr hota ja raha tha.

Tab unhonne unche svar mein Yahweh ko yah kahkar pukaara, “He Yahweh, is person ka jaan lene ke kaaran, kripya hamein barbaadi na hone dein. Hamein ek nirdosh ko maarne ka doshi na thahraaein, kyonki aapne vahi kiya hai, jo aapko achchha laga.”
Tab unhonne yonaah ko uthaakar samudr mein pheink diya aur ugr samudr shaant ho gaya.
Isse un logon ne Yahweh ka bahut dar maana, aur unhonne Yahweh ke lie ek bali charhaai aur manntein maanin.
Yahweh ne ek vishaal machhli thahraayi thi, jisne yonaah ko nigal liya, aur yonaah us machhli ke pet mein tin din aur tin raat raha.
Tab machhli ke pet mein se yonaah ne Yahweh apne God se prayer ki.
Usne kaha: “Apne sankat mein mainne Yahweh ko pukaara, aur unhonne mujhe javaab diya. Mrityulok ki gahraai mein se mainne madad ki yaachna ki, aur aapne meri yaachna sun li.
Aapne mujhe gahraai mein, samudr ke gahraai mein daal diya, main samudr ke paani pravaah mein sama gaya; aap hi ki lahrein takraakar mere upar se pravaahit hoti rahin.
Mainne kaha, ‘Mujhe aapke saamne se nikaal diya gaya hai; phir bhi main aapke holy temple ki or phir taakunga.’
Dubaanevaala paani mujhe dara raha tha, gahraai mere chaaron taraph thi; samudri ghaanspaat se mera sir lipta hua tha.
Samudr mein main to parvton ke jar tak utar gaya; prithvi ke tal ne mujhe hamesha ke lie jakar liya tha. Lekin aapne, he Yahweh mere God, mujhe gaddhe mein se nikaal liya.
“Jab mere life ka ant ho raha tha, he Yahweh, mainne aapko smaran kiya, aur meri prayer aapke paas, aapke holy temple mein pahunchi.
“Ve jo bekaar ki murtiyon par man lagaate hain ve apne aapko God ke love se dur rakhte hain.
Par main kritajnta se bhare prashansa ke unche words ke saath, aapke liye balidaan charhaaunga. Jo mannat mainne maani hai, use main puri karunga. Main kahunga, ‘Bachaav Yahweh hi se hota hai.’ ”
Tab Yahweh ne us machhli ko command di, aur usne yonaah ko sukhi zameen par ugal diya.
Tab Yahweh ka vachan yonaah ke paas dusri baar pahuncha:
“Utho aur us bare shahar ninveh ko jaao aur vahaan us sandesh ki ghoshna karo jise main tumhein denevaala hun.”
Tab yonaah uthkar Yahweh ki command ke hisaab se ninveh ko gaya. Ninveh ek bara shahar tha; jisse hokar jaane mein tin din lag jaate the.
Yonaah ne shehar mein pravesh kiya aur apne pahle din ki yaatra mein yah ghoshna karte gaya, “Ab se chaalis din ke baad ninveh ko dhvast kar diya jaaega.”
Ninveh ke logon ne God mein faith kiya. Upvaas rakhne ki ghoshna ki gai aur saadhaaran se lekar bare, sab logon ne taat (shok-kapde) pahna.
Jab ninveh ke raaja tak yonaah ka samaachaar pahuncha, to vah apne sinhaasan se utha, aur apne raajsi kapde ko utaarkar taat ko orh liya aur jaakar raakh mein baith gaya.

Usne ninveh mein yah ghoshna karvaayi: “Raaja aur saamanton ke phaisle ke hisaab se: “Koi bhi insaan ya pashu, gaay-bail ya bher-bakri kuchh bhi na khaay; unhein kuchh bhi khaane ya pine na diya jaay.
Par insaan aur pashu taat orhein. Har ek jan turant God ki dohaai de aur ve apni bure kaamon aur hinsa ke kaaryon ko chhor dein.
Sambhav hai ki God apne nirnay ko badal dein aur daya karke ham par krodh na karein aur ham barbaadi hone se bach jaaein.”
Jab God ne unke kaam ko dekha ki kaise ve apne bure kaaryon se phir gaye hain, to unhonne apni chaahat badal di aur unke upar vah vinaash nahin laaya jiska nirnay unhonne liya tha.
Lekin yonaah ko God ka yah nirnay galat laga, aur vah krodhit hua.

Usne Yahweh se yah prayer ki, “He Yahweh, kya mainne yah nahin kaha tha, jab main apne ghar mein tha? Isliye tarshish ko bhaagne ke dvaara mainne anumaan lagaane ki koshish ki. Main jaanta tha ki aap anugrahkaari aur kind God hain; aap krodh karne mein dhima aur love se bhare hue hain; aap aise God hain jo vipatti bhejne se apne aapko rokte hain.
Tab he Yahweh, mere jaan le lein, kyonki mere liye jivit rahne se mar jaana bhala hai.”
Lekin Yahweh ne javaab diya, “Kya tumhaara krodhit hona uchit hai?”
Tab yonaah baahar jaakar shahar ke purv ki or ek jagah mein baith gaya. Vahaan usne apne liye ek chhat banaayi aur uski chhaaya mein baithkar intjaar karne laga ki ab shahar ka kya hoga.
Tab Yahweh God ne ek pattivaale paudhe ko ugaaya aur use yonaah ke upar barhaaya taaki yonaah ke sir par chhaaya ho aur use asuvidha na ho; yonaah us paudhe ke kaaran bahut khush tha.
Par agle din bare sabere God ne ek kire ko bheja, jisne us paudhe ko kutar daala, jisse vah paudha murjha gaya.

Jab suraj nikla, tab God ne ek jhulsaati purvi hava chalaai, aur yonaah ke sir par sury ki garmi parne lagi, jisse vah murchhit hone laga. Vah marna chaahta tha, aur usne kaha, “Mere liye jivit rahne se mar jaana bhala hai.”
Lekin God ne yonaah se kaha, “Kya is paudhe ke baare mein tumhaara gussa hona uchit hai?” Yonaah ne javaab diya, “Bilkul uchit hai. Main itne gusse mein hun ki meri chaahat hai ki main mar jaaun.”
Lekin Yahweh ne kaha, “Tum is paudhe ke lie chintit ho, jiski tumne na to koi dekhbhaal ki aur na hi tumne use barhaaya. Yah raaton-raat nikla aur raaton-raat yah mar bhi gaya.

To phir kya main is bare shahar ninveh ki chinta na karun? Jismein ek laakh bis hajaar se adhik insaan rahte hain, jo apne daaein aur baaein haath ke bhed ko bhi nahin jaante—aur is shahar mein kai pashu bhi hain.”
Dhikkaar hai un par jo bure kaaryon ki yojna banaate rahte hain, jo apne bichhaune par pare hue sharyantr rachte hain! Pau phatte hi apni yukti ko pura karte hain kyonki satta unke haath hoti hai.
Ve dusron ke khet ka lobh karke use harap bhi lete hain, ve dusron ke ghar bhi chhin lete hain. Ve logon ke gharon ko chhal karke le lete hain, aur unke purkhon ki property ko lut lete hain.
Unke prophet kahte hain, “Bhavishyvaani mat karo; in baaton ke baare mein bhavishyvaani mat karo; hamaare upar kalank nahin lagega.”
Haal hi mein mere log ek dushman ke jaisa uth khare hue hain. Tum un logon ke manhge kapre chhin lete ho jo bephikr hokar jaate rahte hain, maano ve yuddh se laut rahe hon.
Tum mere logon ke mahilaaon ko unke khushhaal gharon se nikaal dete ho. Tum unki children se meri blessing ko hamesha ke liye chhin lete ho.

“He Yaakob, nishchit rup se main tum sabko ekatr karunga; main nishchit rup se Israel ke bache logon ko ikattha karunga. Jaise bherein bhershaala mein ekatr ki jaati hain, jaise charaagaah mein jhund ekatrit kiya jaata hai, vaise hi main unhein ikattha karunga; us jagah mein logon ki bhir lag jaaegi.
Vah, jo baare ko torkar raasta kholta hai, vah unke aage-aage jaaega; ve dvaar ko torkar baahar chale jaaeinge. Unka raaja unke aage-aage jaaega, khud Yahweh unka agua honge.”
Tab mainne kaha, “He Yaakob ke aguo, he Israel ke shaasko, suno. Kya tumhein justice se love nahin karna chaahiye,
Tum jo bhalaai se nafrat karte ho aur buraai se love karte ho; tum jo mere logon ki khaal aur unki haddiyon se maans noch lete ho;

Tum jo mere logon ka maans khaate ho, unki khaal khinch lete ho aur unke haddiyon ko tukre-tukre kar dete ho; unki asthiyon ko churn kar dete ho tum jo unko karaahi mein pakaane vaale maans ya bartan mein rakhe maans ki tarah kaat daalte ho?”

Yahweh ka yah kahna hai: “Ve prophet jo mere logon ko bhatka dete hain, yadi unko khaane ko kuchh milta hai, tab ve shaanti ki ghoshna karte hain, par jo person unko khilaane se mana karta hai, uske khilaaf laraai karne ko taiyaar ho jaate hain.
Par jahaan tak mera savaal hai, main Yahweh ke aatma ke saath power se, aur justice aur bal se bhara hua hun, taaki Yaakob ko uska apraadh, aur Israel ko uska galti bata sakun.
He Yaakob ke aguo, he Israel ke shaasko, yah baat suno, tum jo justice ko tuchchh samajhte ho aur sab sahi baaton ko bigaarte ho;
Tum jo ziyon ko raktpaat se, aur Yerushalem ko dushtta se bharte ho.

Uske ague ghus lekar justice karte hain, uske priest daam lekar teaching dete hain, aur uske prophet paison ke liye bhavishy bataate hain. Taubhi ve Yahweh ki madad ki kaamna karte hue kahte hain, “Kya Yahweh hamaare beech mein nahin hain? Koi bhi vipatti hamaare upar nahin aaegi.”
Ki ant ke dinon mein vah parvat aur pahaar jis par Yahweh ka bhavan hai; use drirh aur uncha kiya jaayega, aur sab jaati ke log bahti hui nadi ke jaisa us or aaeinge.
