Aur jaati ke log kaheinge, “Aao, ham Yahweh ke parvat, Yaakob ke God ke bhavan ko chalein. Ki vah hamein apne niyam sikhaaein, aur ham unke raaston par chalein.” Kyonki ziyon se law niklegi, aur Yerushalem se Yahweh ka vachan aaega.

God jantaaon ke bich justice kareinge aur logon ki pareshaaniyaan dur kareinge. Tab ve apni talvaaron ko pit-pitkar hal ke phaal aur apne bhaalon ko hansiya bana leinge. Ek desh dusre ke khilaaf talvaar nahin uthaayega, aur unhein phir kabhi larne ke lie taiyaar nahin kiya jaaega.
Har ek jan apni hi angur ki lata aur apne hi anjir ke vriksh ke niche baithega, aur unhein koi nahin daraaega, kyonki sarvshaktimaan Yahweh ne kaha hai.
“Us din,” Yah Yahweh ki ghoshna hai, “Main langron ko ikattha karunga; main bandhuva logon ko aur un logon ko bhi ikattha karunga jinhein mainne duhkh diya hai.
Main langron ko apna bacha hua bhaag, aur bhagaaye huon ko ek majbut jaati banaaunga. Tab us samay se lekar hamesha-hamesha tak Yahweh ziyon parvat se un par shaasan karte raheinge.
Jahaan tak tumhaara savaal hai, he jhund ki chauksi ke machaan, he ziyon ki putri ke suraksha garh, tumhein tumhaare pahle ka raajy de diya jaaega; Yerushalem ki putri ko raajpad diya jaaega.”
“He mere logon, people, mainne tumhaare saath kya anyaay kiya hai? Mujhe bataao ki mainne tumhaare upar kya bojh daala hai?
Mainne tumhein misr desh se baahar nikaala hai aur tumhein daasatv ke bandhan se chhuraaya hai. Mainne tumhaari aguvaai karne ke liye Moshe ko bheja, ahron aur miriyam ko bhi bheja.
Main Yahweh ke saamne kya lekar aaun aur prashansa ke yogy God ke saamne dandvat karun? Kya main homabli ke liye ek-ek saal ke bachhre lekar uske saamne aaun?

Kya Yahweh ki prasannta ke lie hajaaron merhe, ya jaitun tel ki das hajaar nadiyaan paryaapt hongi? Kya main apne apraadh ke praayashchit ke liye apne pahlauthe son ka balidaan karun, ya apni aatma ke galti ke apne janmaae kisi ka balidaan karun?
He insaan, unhonne tumhein dikhaaya hai ki kya achchha hai. Aur Yahweh tumse kya apeksha karta hai? Justice ke kaam karo aur daya karo aur God ke saath namrta se chalo.
Kya main kisi ko galat vajan ki thaili ke saath, use uske galat maapon se chhutkaara dun?
Tere dhanvaan log hinsa karte hain; tere nivaasi jhuthe hain aur unki jibh dhokha denevaali baat karti hain.

Meri kya durgti hai! Main us insaan ke jaisa hun, jo angur ki baari mein lavni ke chhute angur ko dhupkaal mein batorta hai; khaane ke liye angur ka koi guchchha nahin bacha hai, mainne shuru ke anjir ke phalon ki jo laalsa ki thi, ve bhi nahin hain.

Faithful log desh se barbaadi ho gaye hain; ek bhi imaandaar person nahin bacha hai. Har ek jan khun bahaane ke ghaat mein laga rahta hai; ve jaal bichhaakar ek dusre ko phansaane ke chakkar mein rahte hain.

Unke haath buraai ke kaam karne mein maahir hain; shaasan karnevaale uphaar ki maang karte hain, nyaayaadhish ghus lete hain, shaktishaali log apni chaahaton ki purti balpurvak karte hain, ve sab milkar sharyantr rachte hain.
Kisi parosi par faith na karna aur na hi apne kisi mitr par bharosa karna. Yahaan tak ki apni arddhaagini se bhi sambhalkar baat karna.
Kyonki son apne pita ka anaadar karta hai, putri uski maata ke khilaaf aur bahu uski saas ke khilaaf, uth khari hoti hai, insaan ke dushman uske parivaar ke sadasy hi hote hain.
Par jahaan tak meri baat hai, meri ummid Yahweh par lagi rahti hai, main apne uddhaarkarta God ki baat johta hun; mere God meri suneinge.
He mere dushman, meri situation par khushi mat mana! Yadypi main gir gaya hun, par main uth khara hounga. Yadypi main andhera mein baitha hua hun, par Yahweh meri roshni honge.
Tumhaare divaaron ko banaane ka din, aur tumhaari simaaon ka barhaane ka din aaega.

Apne logon ki rakhvaali, apne uttraadhikaar mein paaye jhund ki rakhvaali apni laathi se karna, jo banjar zameen mein, aur upjaau charaagaah mein apne bute rahte hain. Unhein bahut pahle ke samay jaise baashaan aur gilaaad mein charne do.
Aapke jaisa aur kaun God hai, jo apne nij bhaag ke bache huon ke galtiyon aur apraadhon ko maafi karte hain? Aapka krodh hamesha ke liye nahin hota par aap daya dikhaane mein prasann hote hain.
Aap ham par phir daya kareinge; aap apne pairon tale hamaare galtiyon ko kuchal deinge aur hamaare dushtta ke kaamon ko gahre samudr mein pheink deinge.
Aap us shapath ke anurup, jo aapne varshon pahle hamaare purvjon se ki thi, Yaakob ke logon ke prati faithful bane raheinge, aur Abraham ke vanshjon ko apna love dikhaaeinge.
